name: OAI.PowerSaving.Tape.look_of_lt
statement:
@[simp] theorem look_of_lt (v : Tape α) (z : α) {i} (h : i < v.len) :
    v.look i z = v.pos ⟨i,h⟩
proof: := by simp [look, h]

name: OAI.PowerSaving.Tape.look_of_le
statement:
@[simp] theorem look_of_le (v : Tape α) (z : α) {i} (h : v.len ≤ i) :
    v.look i z = z
proof: := by simp [look, Nat.not_lt.mpr h]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.ActionWeightDerivative.coeff_coeff_swap
statement:
theorem coeff_coeff_swap (p : Polynomial (LaurentPolynomial A)) (m : ℕ) (n : ℤ) :
    ((swap p).coeff n).coeff m = (p.coeff m).coeff n
proof:
:= by
  induction p using Polynomial.induction_on' with
  | add p q hp hq => simp [hp, hq]
  | monomial i a =>
    simp only [swap, Polynomial.coe_eval₂RingHom, Polynomial.eval₂_monomial,
      AddMonoidAlgebra.single_pow, nsmul_zero, AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_mul_single_zero,
      AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_mapRingHom, Polynomial.coeff_C_mul_X_pow,
      Polynomial.coeff_monomial]
    split_ifs <;> simp_all

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.ActionWeightDerivative.commute_coeff
statement:
theorem commute_coeff (ρ : A →ₐ[k] LaurentPolynomial A) (α : A →ₐ[k] Polynomial A)
    (hcomm : CommutesWithWeights ρ α) (a : A) (m : ℕ) (n : ℤ) :
    (ρ ((α a).coeff m)).coeff n = (α ((ρ a).coeff n)).coeff m
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (fun p : LaurentPolynomial (Polynomial A) => (p.coeff n).coeff m)
    (hcomm a)
  simp only [coeff_coeff_swap, Polynomial.coeff_map,
    AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_mapAlgHom] at h
  exact h

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.ActionWeightDerivative.coeff_preserves_weight
statement:
theorem coeff_preserves_weight (ρ : A →ₐ[k] LaurentPolynomial A)
    (α : A →ₐ[k] Polynomial A) (hcomm : CommutesWithWeights ρ α)
    {a : A} {n : ℤ} (ha : ρ a = AddMonoidAlgebra.single n a) (m : ℕ) :
    ρ ((α a).coeff m) = AddMonoidAlgebra.single n ((α a).coeff m)
proof:
:= by
  ext j
  rw [commute_coeff ρ α hcomm, ha]
  simp only [AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_single, Finsupp.single_apply]
  split_ifs <;> simp only [map_zero, Polynomial.coeff_zero]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.ActionWeightDerivative.commutesWithWeights_of_generators
statement:
theorem commutesWithWeights_of_generators {σ : Type*}
    (ρ : A →ₐ[k] LaurentPolynomial A) (α : A →ₐ[k] Polynomial A)
    (g : σ → A) (w : σ → ℤ) (hgen : Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range g) = ⊤)
    (hρ : ∀ i, ρ (g i) = AddMonoidAlgebra.single (w i) (g i))
    (hα : ∀ i m, ρ ((α (g i)).coeff m) =
      AddMonoidAlgebra.single (w i) ((α (g i)).coeff m)) :
    CommutesWithWeights ρ α
proof:
:= by
  let L : A →ₐ[k] LaurentPolynomial (Polynomial A) :=
    (swapAlgHom (k := k) (A := A)).comp ((Polynomial.mapAlgHom ρ).comp α)
  let R : A →ₐ[k] LaurentPolynomial (Polynomial A) :=
    (AddMonoidAlgebra.mapAlgHom ℤ α).comp ρ
  have heq : L = R := by
    apply AlgHom.ext_of_adjoin_eq_top hgen
    rintro a ⟨i, rfl⟩
    apply LaurentPolynomial.ext
    intro n
    apply Polynomial.ext
    intro m
    change (((swap (Polynomial.map ρ.toRingHom (α (g i)))).coeff n).coeff m) = _
    rw [coeff_coeff_swap, Polynomial.coeff_map]
    change (ρ ((α (g i)).coeff m)).coeff n =
      ((AddMonoidAlgebra.mapAlgHom ℤ α (ρ (g i))).coeff n).coeff m
    rw [hα, hρ, AddMonoidAlgebra.mapAlgHom_single]
    simp only [AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_single, Finsupp.single_apply]
    split_ifs <;> simp only [Polynomial.coeff_zero]
  intro a
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun heq a

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.ActionWeightDerivative.derivation_preserves_weight
statement:
theorem derivation_preserves_weight (ρ : A →ₐ[k] LaurentPolynomial A)
    (α : A →ₐ[k] Polynomial A) (hcomm : CommutesWithWeights ρ α)
    (D : Derivation k A A) (hD : ∀ a, D a = (α a).coeff 1)
    {a : A} {n : ℤ} (ha : ρ a = AddMonoidAlgebra.single n a) :
    ρ (D a) = AddMonoidAlgebra.single n (D a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [hD]
  exact coeff_preserves_weight ρ α hcomm ha 1

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.AffineGeometry.specIsoOfAlgEquiv_hom_over
statement:
theorem specIsoOfAlgEquiv_hom_over (e : A ≃ₐ[k] B) :
    (specIsoOfAlgEquiv e).hom ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A)) =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k B))
proof:
:= by
  change Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom e.toRingHom) ≫ _ = _
  rw [← Spec.map_comp]
  congr 1
  ext r
  exact e.commutes r

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.AffineGeometry.ringEquivOfSpecIso_apply
statement:
theorem ringEquivOfSpecIso_apply
    (e : Spec (CommRingCat.of B) ≅ Spec (CommRingCat.of A)) (a : A) :
    ringEquivOfSpecIso e a = Spec.preimage e.hom a
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.AffineGeometry.specIsoOfAlgEquiv_algEquivOfSpecIso
statement:
theorem specIsoOfAlgEquiv_algEquivOfSpecIso
    (e : Spec (CommRingCat.of B) ≅ Spec (CommRingCat.of A))
    (he : e.hom ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A)) =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k B))) :
    specIsoOfAlgEquiv (algEquivOfSpecIso e he) = e
proof:
:= by
  apply Iso.ext
  change Spec.map (Spec.preimage e.hom) = e.hom
  exact Spec.map_preimage e.hom

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.AffineGeometry.nonempty_algEquiv_iff_algebraSpecIso
statement:
theorem nonempty_algEquiv_iff_algebraSpecIso :
    Nonempty (A ≃ₐ[k] B) ↔ Nonempty (algebraSpec k B ≅ algebraSpec k A)
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun ⟨e⟩ => ⟨algebraSpecIso e⟩, fun ⟨e⟩ => ⟨algEquivOfAlgebraSpecIso e⟩⟩

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.AffineGeometry.specIso_image_zeroLocus_of_ideal_map
statement:
theorem specIso_image_zeroLocus_of_ideal_map
    (e : A ≃ₐ[k] B) (I : Ideal A) (J : Ideal B)
    (h : I.map e.toRingHom = J) :
    (specIsoOfAlgEquiv e.symm).hom ''
        PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (I : Set A) = PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (J : Set B)
proof:
:= by
  change PrimeSpectrum.comap e.symm.toRingHom '' PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (I : Set A) = _
  rw [image_comap_zeroLocus_eq_zeroLocus_comap _ _ e.symm.surjective]
  change PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (I.comap e.toRingEquiv.symm : Set B) = _
  rw [Ideal.comap_symm e.toRingEquiv]
  exact congrArg (fun K : Ideal B => PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (K : Set B)) h

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.AffineGeometry.ideal_map_of_specIso_image_zeroLocus
statement:
theorem ideal_map_of_specIso_image_zeroLocus
    (I : Ideal B) (J : Ideal A) (hI : I.IsRadical) (hJ : J.IsRadical)
    (e : Spec (CommRingCat.of B) ≅ Spec (CommRingCat.of A))
    (he : e.hom ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A)) =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k B)))
    (h : e.hom '' PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (I : Set B) =
      PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (J : Set A)) :
    I.map (algEquivOfSpecIso e he).symm.toRingHom = J
proof:
:= by
  let a := algEquivOfSpecIso e he
  have ha : Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom a.toRingHom) = e.hom := by
    exact congrArg Iso.hom (specIsoOfAlgEquiv_algEquivOfSpecIso e he)
  have hz : PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (I.comap a.toRingHom : Set A) =
      PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (J : Set A) := by
    rw [← image_comap_zeroLocus_eq_zeroLocus_comap B a.toRingHom a.surjective I]
    change Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom a.toRingHom) ''
      PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (I : Set B) = _
    rw [ha]
    exact h
  have hi : I.comap a.toRingHom = J := by
    have hz' := PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus_eq_iff.mp hz
    rwa [(hI.comap a.toRingHom).radical, hJ.radical] at hz'
  change I.map a.toRingEquiv.symm = J
  rw [Ideal.map_symm a.toRingEquiv]
  exact hi

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.AffineGeometry.ideal_transport_iff_scheme_transport
statement:
theorem ideal_transport_iff_scheme_transport (I J : Ideal A)
    (hI : I.IsRadical) (hJ : J.IsRadical) :
    (∃ e : A ≃ₐ[k] A, I.map e.toRingHom = J) ↔
      ∃ e : Spec (CommRingCat.of A) ≅ Spec (CommRingCat.of A),
        (e.hom ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A)) =
          Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A))) ∧
        e.hom '' PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (I : Set A) =
          PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (J : Set A)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨e, he⟩
    exact ⟨specIsoOfAlgEquiv e.symm, specIsoOfAlgEquiv_hom_over e.symm,
      specIso_image_zeroLocus_of_ideal_map e I J he⟩
  · rintro ⟨e, he, h⟩
    exact ⟨(algEquivOfSpecIso e he).symm,
      ideal_map_of_specIso_image_zeroLocus I J hI hJ e he h⟩

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.AffineGeometry.affineSpaceIsoOfAlgEquiv_hom_over
statement:
theorem affineSpaceIsoOfAlgEquiv_hom_over {σ : Type u}
    (e : A ≃ₐ[k] MvPolynomial σ k) :
    (affineSpaceIsoOfAlgEquiv e).hom ≫
      (AffineSpace σ (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [affineSpaceIsoOfAlgEquiv, Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom, Category.assoc,
    AffineSpace.SpecIso_inv_over]
  exact specIsoOfAlgEquiv_hom_over e.symm

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.AffineGeometry.quotientEmbedding_range
statement:
theorem quotientEmbedding_range (I : Ideal A) :
    Set.range (quotientEmbedding I) = PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (I : Set A)
proof:
:= by
  change Set.range (PrimeSpectrum.comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)) = _
  rw [range_comap_of_surjective _ _ Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective]
  simp

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.affineAll_X
statement:
@[simp] theorem affineAll_X (a b : k) (ha : a ≠ 0) (i : σ) :
    affineAll (σ := σ) a b ha (X i) = C a * X i + C b
proof:
:= by
  change (aeval fun j => C a * X j + C b) (X i) = _
  exact aeval_X _ _

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.affineAll_C
statement:
@[simp] theorem affineAll_C (a b : k) (ha : a ≠ 0) (c : k) :
    affineAll (σ := σ) a b ha (C c) = C c
proof:
:= by
  exact (affineAll (σ := σ) a b ha).commutes c

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.affineAll_symm_X
statement:
@[simp] theorem affineAll_symm_X (a b : k) (ha : a ≠ 0) (i : σ) :
    (affineAll (σ := σ) a b ha).symm (X i) = C a⁻¹ * (X i - C b)
proof:
:= by
  change (aeval fun j => C a⁻¹ * (X j - C b)) (X i) = _
  exact aeval_X _ _

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.exists_equiv_eq_X_of_affine
statement:
theorem exists_equiv_eq_X_of_affine
    (p : MvPolynomial σ k) (i : σ) (a b : k) (ha : a ≠ 0)
    (φ : MvPolynomial σ k ≃ₐ[k] MvPolynomial σ k)
    (hφ : φ p = C a * X i + C b) :
    ∃ ψ : MvPolynomial σ k ≃ₐ[k] MvPolynomial σ k, ψ p = X i
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨φ.trans (affineAll (σ := σ) a b ha).symm, ?_⟩
  change (affineAll (σ := σ) a b ha).symm (φ p) = X i
  rw [hφ, ← affineAll_X a b ha i, AlgEquiv.symm_apply_apply]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.exists_equiv_eq_X_of_sub_eq_scalar_mul
statement:
theorem exists_equiv_eq_X_of_sub_eq_scalar_mul
    (p : MvPolynomial σ k) (i : σ) (t a : k) (ha : a ≠ 0)
    (φ : MvPolynomial σ k ≃ₐ[k] MvPolynomial σ k)
    (hφ : φ (p - C t) = C a * X i) :
    ∃ ψ : MvPolynomial σ k ≃ₐ[k] MvPolynomial σ k, ψ p = X i
proof:
:= by
  apply exists_equiv_eq_X_of_affine p i a t ha φ
  have hc : φ (C t) = C t := φ.commutes t
  rw [map_sub, hc] at hφ
  exact sub_eq_iff_eq_add.mp hφ

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.isCoordinate_of_equiv_sub_eq_scalar_mul_X
statement:
theorem isCoordinate_of_equiv_sub_eq_scalar_mul_X
    {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (p : R n) (t a : ℂ) (ha : a ≠ 0)
    (φ : R n ≃ₐ[ℂ] R n)
    (hφ : φ (p - C t) = C a * X ⟨0, hn⟩) :
    IsCoordinate hn p
proof:
:=
  exists_equiv_eq_X_of_sub_eq_scalar_mul p ⟨0, hn⟩ t a ha φ hφ

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.isCoordinate_sub_C_iff
statement:
theorem isCoordinate_sub_C_iff {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (p : R n) (t : ℂ) :
    IsCoordinate hn (p - C t) ↔ IsCoordinate hn p
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨φ, hφ⟩
    apply isCoordinate_of_equiv_sub_eq_scalar_mul_X hn p t 1 one_ne_zero φ
    simpa using hφ
  · rintro ⟨φ, hφ⟩
    apply exists_equiv_eq_X_of_affine (p - C t) ⟨0, hn⟩ 1 (-t) one_ne_zero φ
    rw [map_sub, hφ]
    have hc : φ (C t) = C t := φ.commutes t
    rw [hc, C_1, one_mul, C_neg, sub_eq_add_neg]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.all_fibers_isAffineThreeSpace
statement:
theorem all_fibers_isAffineThreeSpace :
    ∀ t : ℂ, IsAffineThreeSpaceFiber t
proof:
:= by
  intro t
  by_cases ht : t = 0
  · subst t
    exact zeroFiber_isAffineThreeSpace
  · exact isAffineThreeSpaceFiber_of_ne_zero t ht

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.fiberPackage_of_noncoordinate
statement:
theorem fiberPackage_of_noncoordinate
    (h : ¬ IsCoordinate (by decide : 0 < 4) f) : FiberPackage
proof:
:=
  fiberPackage_of_noncoordinate_of_affine h all_fibers_isAffineThreeSpace

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.AmbientMaps.aeval_pointMap
statement:
theorem aeval_pointMap (φ : MvPolynomial τ k →ₐ[k] MvPolynomial σ k)
    (x : σ → k) (p : MvPolynomial τ k) :
    aeval (pointMap φ x) p = aeval x (φ p)
proof:
:= by
  have h : aeval (pointMap φ x) = (aeval x).comp φ := by
    ext i
    simp [pointMap]
  exact AlgHom.congr_fun h p

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.AmbientMaps.pointMap_id
statement:
@[simp]
theorem pointMap_id (x : σ → k) :
    pointMap (AlgHom.id k (MvPolynomial σ k)) x = x
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  simp [pointMap]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.AmbientMaps.pointMap_comp
statement:
theorem pointMap_comp (φ : MvPolynomial τ k →ₐ[k] MvPolynomial σ k)
    (ψ : MvPolynomial υ k →ₐ[k] MvPolynomial τ k) (x : σ → k) :
    pointMap (φ.comp ψ) x = pointMap ψ (pointMap φ x)
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  exact (aeval_pointMap φ x (ψ (X i))).symm

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.AmbientMaps.PolynomialEquiv.invPointMap_toPointMap
statement:
@[simp]
theorem invPointMap_toPointMap (e : PolynomialEquiv k σ τ) (x : σ → k) :
    e.invPointMap (e.toPointMap x) = x
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  change aeval (fun j => aeval x (e.forward j)) (e.inverse i) = x i
  rw [← comp_aeval_apply e.forward (aeval x), e.forward_inverse, aeval_X]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.AmbientMaps.PolynomialEquiv.toPointMap_invPointMap
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toPointMap_invPointMap (e : PolynomialEquiv k σ τ) (y : τ → k) :
    e.toPointMap (e.invPointMap y) = y
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  change aeval (fun j => aeval y (e.inverse j)) (e.forward i) = y i
  rw [← comp_aeval_apply e.inverse (aeval y), e.inverse_forward, aeval_X]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.AmbientMaps.PolynomialEquiv.ofAlgEquiv_toPointMap
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ofAlgEquiv_toPointMap
    (e : MvPolynomial τ k ≃ₐ[k] MvPolynomial σ k) (x : σ → k) :
    (ofAlgEquiv e).toPointMap x = pointMap e.toAlgHom x
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.AmbientMaps.PolynomialEquiv.ofAlgEquiv_invPointMap
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ofAlgEquiv_invPointMap
    (e : MvPolynomial τ k ≃ₐ[k] MvPolynomial σ k) (y : τ → k) :
    (ofAlgEquiv e).invPointMap y = pointMap e.symm.toAlgHom y
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.AmbientMaps.pointMap_levelSet
statement:
theorem pointMap_levelSet (e : MvPolynomial τ k ≃ₐ[k] MvPolynomial σ k)
    (p : MvPolynomial τ k) (c : k) :
    pointMap e.toAlgHom ⁻¹' {y | aeval y p = c} =
      {x | aeval x (e p) = c}
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp only [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, aeval_pointMap]
  rfl

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.AssociatedGradedPresentation.monomialWeight_eq_weight
statement:
theorem monomialWeight_eq_weight :
    Filtration.monomialWeight = Finsupp.weight presentationWeight
proof:
:= by
  apply Finsupp.addHom_ext
  intro i n
  rw [Finsupp.weight_single]
  fin_cases i <;> simp [Filtration.monomialWeight, presentationWeight ]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.AssociatedGradedPresentation.piece_eq_boundedSubmodule
statement:
theorem piece_eq_boundedSubmodule (d : ℤ) :
    Filtration.piece k d = boundedSubmodule presentationWeight d
proof:
:= by
  rw [boundedSubmodule_eq_span]
  simp only [Filtration.piece, monomialWeight_eq_weight]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.AssociatedGradedPresentation.imagePiece_mem_iff
statement:
theorem imagePiece_mem_iff (φ : P k 5 →ₐ[k] A) (p : P k 5) (d : ℤ) :
    φ p ∈ imagePiece φ d ↔
      ∃ r : P k 5, Bounded presentationWeight r d ∧ φ r = φ p
proof:
:= by
  rw [imagePiece, piece_eq_boundedSubmodule]
  exact GradedPresentationKernel.mem_boundedImage_iff presentationWeight φ p d

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.AssociatedGradedPresentation.reesMap_coeff_weighted
statement:
theorem reesMap_coeff_weighted (φ : P k 5 →ₐ[k] A) (p : P k 5) (d : ℤ) :
    (reesMap φ p : LaurentPolynomial A).coeff d =
      φ (weightedHomogeneousComponent presentationWeight d p)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [reesMap_coeff, weightedHomogeneousComponent_apply, Finset.sum_filter]
  simp only [monomialWeight_eq_weight]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.AssociatedGradedPresentation.homogeneous_symbol_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem homogeneous_symbol_eq_zero_iff (p : P k 5) (d : ℤ)
    (hp : p.IsWeightedHomogeneous presentationWeight d) :
    quotientMap k p ∈ imagePiece (quotientMap k) (d - 1) ↔ p ∈ idealG k
proof:
:= by
  have h := GradedPresentationKernel.homogeneous_image_mem_lower_iff presentationWeight
    (quotientMap k) (imagePiece (quotientMap k)) (imagePiece_mem_iff (quotientMap k))
    (H k) 1 (PrincipalInitialRelation.H_isTopDegree k).1
    (PrincipalInitialRelation.H_isTopDegree k).2
    (by exact Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ_ker k (idealA k)) hp
  simpa only [idealA, idealG, H_degree_one_component k] using h

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.AssociatedGradedPresentation.gradedPresentation_ker
statement:
theorem gradedPresentation_ker :
    RingHom.ker (gradedPresentationMap k).toRingHom = idealG k
proof:
:= by
  have h := GradedPresentationKernel.kernel_eq_top_principal presentationWeight
    (quotientMap k) (imagePiece (quotientMap k)) (imagePiece_mono (quotientMap k))
    (imagePiece_mem_iff (quotientMap k)) (H k) 1
    (PrincipalInitialRelation.H_isTopDegree k).1
    (PrincipalInitialRelation.H_isTopDegree k).2
    (by exact Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ_ker k (idealA k))
    (reesMap (quotientMap k)) (reesMap_coeff_weighted (quotientMap k))
  simpa only [gradedPresentationMap, gradedMap, idealG, H_degree_one_component k] using h

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.AssociatedGradedPresentation.associatedGradedEquiv_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem associatedGradedEquiv_mk (p : P k 5) :
    associatedGradedEquiv k (Ideal.Quotient.mk (idealG k) p) =
      gradedPresentationMap k p
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.AssociatedGradedPresentation.associatedGradedEquiv_gX
statement:
@[simp]
theorem associatedGradedEquiv_gX (i : Fin 5) :
    associatedGradedEquiv k (gX k i) =
      FilteredRees.initial (imagePiece (quotientMap k)) (imagePiece_mono (quotientMap k))
        (monomialWeight (Finsupp.single i 1)) (variableElement (quotientMap k) i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [gX, associatedGradedEquiv_mk]
  exact gradedMap_X (quotientMap k) i

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.BundleCharts.quadric_relation
statement: theorem quadric_relation : qgen K 0 * qgen K 1 = qgen K 2 * (qgen K 2 + 1)
proof:
:= by
  apply sub_eq_zero.mp
  have h : Ideal.Quotient.mk (quadricIdeal K)
      (X 0 * X 1 - X 2 * (X 2 + 1) : MvPolynomial (Fin 4) K) = 0 := by
    apply Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr
    exact Ideal.subset_span (Set.mem_singleton _)
  simpa only [map_sub, map_mul, map_add, map_one, qgen] using h

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.BundleCharts.determinant_relation
statement: theorem determinant_relation : dgen K 0 * dgen K 3 - dgen K 2 * dgen K 1 = 1
proof:
:= by
  apply sub_eq_zero.mp
  have h : Ideal.Quotient.mk (determinantIdeal K)
      (X 0 * X 3 - X 2 * X 1 - 1 : MvPolynomial (Fin 5) K) = 0 := by
    apply Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr
    exact Ideal.subset_span (Set.mem_singleton _)
  simpa only [map_sub, map_mul, map_one, dgen] using h

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.BundleCharts.quadricIdeal_le_ker_basePolynomialMap
statement:
theorem quadricIdeal_le_ker_basePolynomialMap :
    quadricIdeal K ≤ RingHom.ker (basePolynomialMap K).toRingHom
proof:
:= by
  rw [quadricIdeal, Ideal.span_singleton_le_iff_mem]
  change basePolynomialMap K (X 0 * X 1 - X 2 * (X 2 + 1)) = 0
  simp only [basePolynomialMap, map_mul, map_sub, map_add, map_one, MvPolynomial.aeval_X,
    Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.cons_val]
  have h := determinant_relation K
  linear_combination (dgen K 1 * dgen K 2) * h

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.BundleCharts.baseMap_qgen
statement:
@[simp] theorem baseMap_qgen (i : Fin 4) :
    baseMap K (qgen K i) =
      ![dgen K 0 * dgen K 2, dgen K 1 * dgen K 3,
        dgen K 1 * dgen K 2, dgen K 4] i
proof:
:= by
  change basePolynomialMap K (X i) = _
  simp [basePolynomialMap]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.BundleCharts.agen_relation
statement: theorem agen_relation : agen K 0 * agen K 1 = agen K 2 * (agen K 2 + 1)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [map_mul, map_add, map_one, agen] using
    congrArg (algebraMap (QuadricRing K) (ChartA K)) (quadric_relation K)

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.BundleCharts.zgen_relation
statement: theorem zgen_relation : zgen K 0 * zgen K 1 = zgen K 2 * (zgen K 2 + 1)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [map_mul, map_add, map_one, zgen] using
    congrArg (algebraMap (QuadricRing K) (ChartD K)) (quadric_relation K)

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.BundleCharts.agen_mul_ainv
statement: @[simp] theorem agen_mul_ainv : (agen K 2 + 1) * ainv K = 1
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [agen, ainv, map_add, map_one] using
    IsLocalization.Away.mul_invSelf (qgen K 2 + 1) (S := ChartA K)

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.BundleCharts.zgen_mul_zinv
statement: @[simp] theorem zgen_mul_zinv : zgen K 2 * zinv K = 1
proof:
:= by
  exact IsLocalization.Away.mul_invSelf (qgen K 2) (S := ChartD K)

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.BundleCharts.determinantIdeal_le_ker_sectionAPolynomialMap
statement:
theorem determinantIdeal_le_ker_sectionAPolynomialMap :
    determinantIdeal K ≤ RingHom.ker (sectionAPolynomialMap K).toRingHom
proof:
:= by
  rw [determinantIdeal, Ideal.span_singleton_le_iff_mem]
  change sectionAPolynomialMap K (X 0 * X 3 - X 2 * X 1 - 1) = 0
  simp only [sectionAPolynomialMap, map_mul, map_sub, map_one,
    MvPolynomial.aeval_X, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one,
    Matrix.cons_val]
  have hr := agen_relation K
  have hi := agen_mul_ainv K
  linear_combination -(ainv K) * hr - (agen K 2) * hi

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.BundleCharts.determinantIdeal_le_ker_sectionDPolynomialMap
statement:
theorem determinantIdeal_le_ker_sectionDPolynomialMap :
    determinantIdeal K ≤ RingHom.ker (sectionDPolynomialMap K).toRingHom
proof:
:= by
  rw [determinantIdeal, Ideal.span_singleton_le_iff_mem]
  change sectionDPolynomialMap K (X 0 * X 3 - X 2 * X 1 - 1) = 0
  simp only [sectionDPolynomialMap, map_mul, map_sub, map_one,
    MvPolynomial.aeval_X, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one,
    Matrix.cons_val]
  have hr := zgen_relation K
  have hi := zgen_mul_zinv K
  linear_combination (zinv K) * hr + (zgen K 2 + 1) * hi

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.BundleCharts.sectionA_dgen
statement:
@[simp] theorem sectionA_dgen (i : Fin 5) :
    sectionA K (dgen K i) =
      ![1, agen K 1 * ainv K, agen K 0, agen K 2 + 1, agen K 3] i
proof:
:= by
  change sectionAPolynomialMap K (X i) = _
  simp [sectionAPolynomialMap]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.BundleCharts.sectionD_dgen
statement:
@[simp] theorem sectionD_dgen (i : Fin 5) :
    sectionD K (dgen K i) =
      ![zgen K 0 * zinv K, 1, zgen K 2, zgen K 1, zgen K 3] i
proof:
:= by
  change sectionDPolynomialMap K (X i) = _
  simp [sectionDPolynomialMap]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.BundleCharts.sectionA_y
statement:
theorem sectionA_y :
    (agen K 1 * ainv K) * (agen K 2 + 1) = agen K 1
proof:
:= by
  linear_combination (agen K 1) * (agen_mul_ainv K)

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.BundleCharts.sectionA_z
statement: theorem sectionA_z : (agen K 1 * ainv K) * agen K 0 = agen K 2
proof:
:= by
  linear_combination (ainv K) * (agen_relation K) + (agen K 2) * (agen_mul_ainv K)

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.BundleCharts.sectionD_x
statement: theorem sectionD_x : (zgen K 0 * zinv K) * zgen K 2 = zgen K 0
proof:
:= by
  linear_combination (zgen K 0) * (zgen_mul_zinv K)

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.BundleCharts.sectionA_comp_baseMap
statement:
theorem sectionA_comp_baseMap :
    (sectionA K).comp (baseMap K) = IsScalarTower.toAlgHom K (QuadricRing K) (ChartA K)
proof:
:= by
  apply Ideal.Quotient.algHom_ext
  apply MvPolynomial.algHom_ext
  intro i
  change sectionA K (baseMap K (qgen K i)) = agen K i
  fin_cases i <;> simp [sectionA_y, sectionA_z]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.BundleCharts.sectionD_comp_baseMap
statement:
theorem sectionD_comp_baseMap :
    (sectionD K).comp (baseMap K) = IsScalarTower.toAlgHom K (QuadricRing K) (ChartD K)
proof:
:= by
  apply Ideal.Quotient.algHom_ext
  apply MvPolynomial.algHom_ext
  intro i
  change sectionD K (baseMap K (qgen K i)) = zgen K i
  fin_cases i <;> simp [sectionD_x]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.BundleCharts.sectionA_baseMap
statement:
@[simp] theorem sectionA_baseMap (p : QuadricRing K) :
    sectionA K (baseMap K p) = algebraMap (QuadricRing K) (ChartA K) p
proof:
:=
  AlgHom.congr_fun (sectionA_comp_baseMap K) p

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.BundleCharts.sectionD_baseMap
statement:
@[simp] theorem sectionD_baseMap (p : QuadricRing K) :
    sectionD K (baseMap K p) = algebraMap (QuadricRing K) (ChartD K) p
proof:
:=
  AlgHom.congr_fun (sectionD_comp_baseMap K) p

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.BundleCharts.eq_zero_of_chartA_eq_zero_of_chartD_eq_zero
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_chartA_eq_zero_of_chartD_eq_zero (p : QuadricRing K)
    (hA : algebraMap (QuadricRing K) (ChartA K) p = 0)
    (hD : algebraMap (QuadricRing K) (ChartD K) p = 0) : p = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := IsLocalization.Away.exists_of_eq
    (x := qgen K 2 + 1) (S := ChartA K) (a := p) (b := 0) (by simpa only [map_zero] using hA)
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := IsLocalization.Away.exists_of_eq
    (x := qgen K 2) (S := ChartD K) (a := p) (b := 0) (by simpa only [map_zero] using hD)
  simp only [mul_zero] at hn hm
  have hcop : IsCoprime (qgen K 2 + 1) (qgen K 2) :=
    IsCoprime.add_one_left_of_dvd (dvd_refl _)
  obtain ⟨s, t, hst⟩ := hcop.pow (m := n) (n := m)
  calc
    p = (s * (qgen K 2 + 1) ^ n + t * qgen K 2 ^ m) * p := by rw [hst, one_mul]
    _ = s * ((qgen K 2 + 1) ^ n * p) + t * (qgen K 2 ^ m * p) := by ring
    _ = 0 := by rw [hn, hm]; ring

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.BundleCharts.baseMap_eq_zero
statement: theorem baseMap_eq_zero (p : QuadricRing K) (hp : baseMap K p = 0) : p = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply eq_zero_of_chartA_eq_zero_of_chartD_eq_zero K p
  · simpa only [sectionA_baseMap, map_zero] using congrArg (sectionA K) hp
  · simpa only [sectionD_baseMap, map_zero] using congrArg (sectionD K) hp

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.BundleCharts.baseMap_injective
statement: theorem baseMap_injective : Function.Injective (baseMap K)
proof:
:= by
  intro p q hpq
  apply sub_eq_zero.mp
  apply baseMap_eq_zero K
  simp only [map_sub, hpq, sub_self]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.Bundle.g₀_factor
statement:
theorem g₀_factor (a d b c u : R) (h : a * c - b * d = 1) :
    g₀ a d b c u = b ^ 2 * v a d b u
proof:
:= by
  unfold g₀ s v
  linear_combination -(b * d) * h

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.Bundle.f₀_factor
statement:
theorem f₀_factor (a d b c u : R) (h : a * c - b * d = 1) :
    f₀ a d b c u = (c ^ 2 - b ^ 2 * (a * b + u ^ 2)) * v a d b u
proof:
:= by
  unfold f₀ s v
  linear_combination -((a * b + u ^ 2) * (a * c - b * d + 1)) * h

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.Bundle.coefficients_bezout
statement:
theorem coefficients_bezout (a d b c u : R) (h : a * c - b * d = 1) :
    coeffA a d b * (c ^ 2 - b ^ 2 * (a * b + u ^ 2)) +
      coeffB a d b u * b ^ 2 = 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold coeffB coeffA
  linear_combination (1 - 2 * b * d) * (a * c + b * d + 1) * h

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.Bundle.generator_bezout
statement:
theorem generator_bezout (a d b c u : R) (h : a * c - b * d = 1) :
    coeffA a d b * f₀ a d b c u + coeffB a d b u * g₀ a d b c u =
      v a d b u
proof:
:= by
  rw [f₀_factor a d b c u h, g₀_factor a d b c u h]
  rw [← mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc, ← add_mul, coefficients_bezout a d b c u h, one_mul]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.Bundle.principalization
statement:
theorem principalization (a d b c u : R) (h : a * c - b * d = 1) :
    Ideal.span ({f₀ a d b c u, g₀ a d b c u} : Set R) =
      Ideal.span ({v a d b u} : Set R)
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply Ideal.span_le.2
    intro z hz
    rcases Set.mem_insert_iff.mp hz with rfl | hz
    · apply Ideal.mem_span_singleton.2
      exact ⟨c ^ 2 - b ^ 2 * (a * b + u ^ 2), by
        rw [f₀_factor a d b c u h, mul_comm]⟩
    · obtain rfl := Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hz
      apply Ideal.mem_span_singleton.2
      exact ⟨b ^ 2, by rw [g₀_factor a d b c u h, mul_comm]⟩
  · apply Ideal.span_le.2
    intro z hz
    obtain rfl := Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hz
    exact Ideal.mem_span_pair.2
      ⟨coeffA a d b, coeffB a d b u, generator_bezout a d b c u h⟩

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.Bundle.exists_factor_of_mem
statement:
theorem exists_factor_of_mem (a d b c u : R) (h : a * c - b * d = 1)
    {r : R} (hr : r ∈ Ideal.span ({f₀ a d b c u, g₀ a d b c u} : Set R)) :
    ∃ q : R, r = v a d b u * q
proof:
:= by
  rw [principalization a d b c u h, Ideal.mem_span_singleton] at hr
  rcases hr with ⟨q, hq⟩
  exact ⟨q, hq⟩

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.ChartIntersection.eq_C_of_mul_C_eq_C
statement:
theorem eq_C_of_mul_C_eq_C {S : Type*} [CommRing S] [NoZeroDivisors S]
    {p : Polynomial S} {r s : S} (hr : r ≠ 0)
    (h : p * C r = C s) : p = C (p.coeff 0)
proof:
:= by
  ext n
  by_cases hn : n = 0
  · simp [hn]
  · have hc := congrArg (fun f : Polynomial S => f.coeff n) h
    simp only [coeff_mul_C, coeff_C, ite_eq_right hn] at hc
    simp only [coeff_C, ite_eq_right hn]
    exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hc).resolve_right hr

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.ChartIntersection.away_algebraMap_injective
statement:
theorem away_algebraMap_injective (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    Function.Injective (algebraMap R S)
proof:
:= by
  apply IsLocalization.injective (M := Submonoid.powers a) S
  rintro x ⟨m, rfl⟩
  exact mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero m ha)

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.ChartIntersection.has_power_denominator_of_chart_constant
statement:
theorem has_power_denominator_of_chart_constant
    (e : A →ₐ[R] Polynomial S) (he : Function.Injective e)
    {q : A} {v : S} (hconst : e q = C v) :
    ∃ (m : ℕ) (t : R), q * algebraMap R A (a ^ m) = algebraMap R A t
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, t, ht⟩ := IsLocalization.Away.surj a v
  refine ⟨m, t, he ?_⟩
  simp only [map_mul, AlgHom.commutes, Polynomial.algebraMap_apply]
  rw [hconst, ← map_mul, map_pow]
  exact congrArg C ht

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.ChartIntersection.has_power_denominator_of_chart
statement:
theorem has_power_denominator_of_chart
    (ha : a ≠ 0) (e : A →ₐ[R] Polynomial S) (he : Function.Injective e)
    {q : A} {r s : R} (hr : r ≠ 0)
    (h : q * algebraMap R A r = algebraMap R A s) :
    ∃ (m : ℕ) (t : R), q * algebraMap R A (a ^ m) = algebraMap R A t
proof:
:= by
  have hinj : Function.Injective (algebraMap R S) := away_algebraMap_injective ha
  have hrS : algebraMap R S r ≠ 0 := by
    exact fun h0 => hr (hinj (by simpa using h0))
  have hchart : e q * C (algebraMap R S r) = C (algebraMap R S s) := by
    simpa only [map_mul, AlgHom.commutes, Polynomial.algebraMap_apply] using congrArg e h
  have hconst : e q = C ((e q).coeff 0) := eq_C_of_mul_C_eq_C hrS hchart
  exact has_power_denominator_of_chart_constant e he hconst

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.ChartIntersection.mem_range_of_two_constant_charts
statement:
theorem mem_range_of_two_constant_charts
    (ha : a ≠ 0) (had : IsRelPrime a d)
    (e : A →ₐ[R] Polynomial S) (he : Function.Injective e)
    (f : A →ₐ[R] Polynomial T) (hf : Function.Injective f)
    {q : A} {v : S} {w : T} (hq : e q = C v) (hq' : f q = C w) :
    q ∈ Set.range (algebraMap R A)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, u, hu⟩ := has_power_denominator_of_chart_constant (a := a) e he hq
  obtain ⟨n, v, hv⟩ := has_power_denominator_of_chart_constant (a := d) f hf hq'
  have hbase : Function.Injective (algebraMap R A) := by
    intro x y hxy
    apply away_algebraMap_injective (S := S) ha
    apply Polynomial.C_injective
    simpa only [AlgHom.commutes, Polynomial.algebraMap_apply] using congrArg e hxy
  exact exists_algebraMap_eq_of_two_power_denominators hbase ha had hu hv

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.ChartIntersection.mem_range_of_fraction_eq_of_two_charts
statement:
theorem mem_range_of_fraction_eq_of_two_charts
    (ha : a ≠ 0) (hd : d ≠ 0) (had : IsRelPrime a d)
    (e : A →ₐ[R] Polynomial S) (he : Function.Injective e)
    (f : A →ₐ[R] Polynomial T) (hf : Function.Injective f)
    {q : A} {r s : R} (hr : r ≠ 0)
    (h : q * algebraMap R A r = algebraMap R A s) :
    q ∈ Set.range (algebraMap R A)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, u, hu⟩ := has_power_denominator_of_chart ha e he hr h
  obtain ⟨n, v, hv⟩ := has_power_denominator_of_chart hd f hf hr h
  have hbase : Function.Injective (algebraMap R A) := by
    intro x y hxy
    apply away_algebraMap_injective (S := S) ha
    apply Polynomial.C_injective
    simpa only [AlgHom.commutes, Polynomial.algebraMap_apply] using congrArg e hxy
  exact exists_algebraMap_eq_of_two_power_denominators hbase ha had hu hv

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.ChartIntersection.exists_base_of_two_ring_charts
statement:
theorem exists_base_of_two_ring_charts
    (ι : R →+* A) (ha : a ≠ 0) (had : IsRelPrime a d)
    (e : A →+* Polynomial S) (he : Function.Injective e)
    (f : A →+* Polynomial T) (hf : Function.Injective f)
    (heBase : ∀ r, e (ι r) = Polynomial.C (algebraMap R S r))
    (hfBase : ∀ r, f (ι r) = Polynomial.C (algebraMap R T r))
    {q : A} {v : S} {w : T}
    (hq : e q = Polynomial.C v) (hq' : f q = Polynomial.C w) :
    ∃ t : R, ι t = q

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.ChartLNDConstant.chart_coefficient_eq_C
statement:
theorem chart_coefficient_eq_C
    (D : Derivation k A A)
    (hD : ∀ x : A, ∃ n : ℕ, ((D : A → A)^[n]) x = 0)
    (hi : ∀ r : R, D (i r) = 0)
    (e : L ≃ₐ[k] S[X])
    (he : ∀ r : R, e (algebraMap A L (i r)) = C (algebraMap R S r))
    (b q : A)
    (hb : e (algebraMap A L b) = X)
    (hDb : D b = i a * q) :
    e (algebraMap A L q) = C ((e (algebraMap A L q)).coeff 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hden : ∀ m : Submonoid.powers (i a), D (m : A) = 0 := by
    rintro ⟨m, hm⟩
    obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := (Submonoid.mem_powers_iff m (i a)).mp hm
    simp only [Derivation.leibniz_pow, hi a, smul_zero]
  let DL : Derivation k L L :=
    localizeTo D (Submonoid.powers (i a)) hden L
  let E : Derivation k S[X] S[X] := transport DL e
  have hEmap (x : A) :
      E (e (algebraMap A L x)) = e (algebraMap A L (D x)) := by
    dsimp only [E, DL]
    rw [transport_apply, localizeTo_algebraMap]
  have hELND : ∀ p : S[X], ∃ n : ℕ, ((E : S[X] → S[X])^[n]) p = 0 :=
    transport_locallyNilpotent DL e
      (localizeTo_locallyNilpotent D (Submonoid.powers (i a)) hden L hD)
  have hEC : ∀ s : S, E (C s) = 0 := by
    apply DerivationScalarUpgrade.annihilates_localization
      (Submonoid.powers a) E (C : S →+* S[X])
    intro r
    rw [← he r, hEmap, hi, map_zero, map_zero]
  let ES : Derivation S S[X] S[X] := DerivationScalarUpgrade.upgrade E hEC
  have hESLND : ∀ p : S[X], ∃ n : ℕ, ((ES : S[X] → S[X])^[n]) p = 0 :=
    DerivationScalarUpgrade.upgrade_locallyNilpotent E hEC hELND
  have hESX : ES X = C (algebraMap R S a) * e (algebraMap A L q) := by
    change E X = _
    rw [← hb, hEmap, hDb, map_mul, map_mul, he]
  have hconst := UnivariateLND.apply_X_eq_C_of_locallyNilpotent ES hESLND
  rw [hESX, coeff_C_mul, C_mul] at hconst
  exact ((IsLocalization.Away.algebraMap_isUnit (S := S) a).map
    (C : S →+* S[X])).mul_left_cancel hconst

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.ChartLNDConstant.exists_chart_coefficient
statement:
theorem exists_chart_coefficient
    (D : Derivation k A A)
    (hD : ∀ x : A, ∃ n : ℕ, ((D : A → A)^[n]) x = 0)
    (hi : ∀ r : R, D (i r) = 0)
    (e : L ≃ₐ[k] S[X])
    (he : ∀ r : R, e (algebraMap A L (i r)) = C (algebraMap R S r))
    (b q : A)
    (hb : e (algebraMap A L b) = X)
    (hDb : D b = i a * q) :
    ∃ s : S, e (algebraMap A L q) = C s
proof:
:=
  ⟨_, chart_coefficient_eq_C i a D hD hi e he b q hb hDb⟩

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.CoactionLND.PolynomialAdditiveAction.specialize_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem specialize_apply (ρ : PolynomialAdditiveAction k A) (t : k) (a : A) :
    ρ.specialize t a = (ρ.toAlgHom a).eval (algebraMap k A t)
proof:
:= by
  simp [specialize, Polynomial.eval₂AlgHom_apply]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.CoactionLND.PolynomialAdditiveAction.map_specialize
statement:
theorem map_specialize (ρ : PolynomialAdditiveAction k A) (t : k) (a : A) :
    (ρ.toAlgHom a).map (ρ.specialize t).toRingHom =
      taylor (algebraMap k A t) (ρ.toAlgHom a)
proof:
:= by
  have he : (Polynomial.evalRingHom (algebraMap k A t)).comp
      ρ.toAlgHom.toRingHom = (ρ.specialize t).toRingHom := by
    ext b
    simp [specialize_apply]
  have hc : (Polynomial.evalRingHom (algebraMap k A t)).comp
      (C : A →+* A[X]) = RingHom.id A := by
    ext b
    simp
  have h := congrArg (Polynomial.map (Polynomial.evalRingHom (algebraMap k A t)))
    (ρ.coassoc a)
  simpa only [map_map, he, map_taylor, coe_evalRingHom, eval_X, hc, map_id] using h

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.CoactionLND.PolynomialAdditiveAction.specialize_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem specialize_zero (ρ : PolynomialAdditiveAction k A) (a : A) :
    ρ.specialize 0 a = a
proof:
:= by
  simp [specialize_apply, ← coeff_zero_eq_eval_zero, ρ.identity]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.CoactionLND.PolynomialAdditiveAction.specialize_add
statement:
theorem specialize_add (ρ : PolynomialAdditiveAction k A) (s t : k) (a : A) :
    ρ.specialize s (ρ.specialize t a) = ρ.specialize (s + t) a
proof:
:= by
  have h := Polynomial.eval_map_apply (ρ.specialize s).toRingHom
    (p := ρ.toAlgHom a) (algebraMap k A t)
  rw [ρ.map_specialize, AlgHom.toRingHom_eq_coe, AlgHom.coe_toRingHom,
    AlgHom.commutes, taylor_eval] at h
  simpa only [specialize_apply, map_add, add_comm] using h.symm

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.CoactionLND.PolynomialAdditiveAction.specializeEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem specializeEquiv_apply (ρ : PolynomialAdditiveAction k A) (t : k) (a : A) :
    ρ.specializeEquiv t a = ρ.specialize t a
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.CoactionLND.PolynomialAdditiveAction.invariant_iff_derivation_eq_zero
statement:
theorem invariant_iff_derivation_eq_zero (ρ : PolynomialAdditiveAction k A) (a : A) :
    ρ.toAlgHom a = C a ↔ ρ.derivation a = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    simp [derivation_apply, h]
  · intro h
    ext n
    by_cases hn : n = 0
    · subst n
      simp [ρ.identity]
    · rw [coeff_C, ite_eq_right hn]
      have hz : (ρ.derivation : A → A)^[n] a = 0 := by
        obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero hn
        rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply, h]
        exact Function.iterate_fixed (map_zero ρ.derivation) m
      rw [ρ.iterate_derivation, nsmul_eq_mul] at hz
      exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hz).resolve_left (by exact_mod_cast Nat.factorial_ne_zero n)

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.CoactionLND.PolynomialAdditiveAction.toAlgHom_eq_of_derivation_eq
statement:
theorem toAlgHom_eq_of_derivation_eq (ρ σ : PolynomialAdditiveAction k A)
    (h : ρ.derivation = σ.derivation) : ρ.toAlgHom = σ.toAlgHom
proof:
:= by
  ext a n
  have hi : n.factorial • (ρ.toAlgHom a).coeff n =
      n.factorial • (σ.toAlgHom a).coeff n := by
    rw [← ρ.iterate_derivation, ← σ.iterate_derivation, h]
  simp only [nsmul_eq_mul] at hi
  exact mul_left_cancel₀ (by exact_mod_cast Nat.factorial_ne_zero n) hi

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.CoactionLND.universal_translate_map
statement:
theorem universal_translate_map (p : B[X]) (i : B →+* A) :
    (taylor (X : B[X]) (p.map (C : B →+* B[X]))).map (mapRingHom i) =
      taylor (X : A[X]) ((p.map i).map (C : A →+* A[X]))
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_taylor]
  have hX : mapRingHom i (X : B[X]) = (X : A[X]) := map_X i
  rw [hX]
  congr 1
  rw [map_map, map_map]
  congr 1
  apply RingHom.ext
  intro b
  simp

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.CoactionLND.coassoc_on_image_of_extension
statement:
theorem coassoc_on_image_of_extension
    (α : PolynomialAdditiveAction k B) (β : A →ₐ[k] A[X]) (i : B →ₐ[k] A)
    (hβ : ∀ b, β (i b) = (α.toAlgHom b).map i.toRingHom) (b : B) :
    (β (i b)).map β.toRingHom =
      taylor (X : A[X]) ((β (i b)).map (C : A →+* A[X]))
proof:
:= by
  have hmaps : β.toRingHom.comp i.toRingHom =
      (mapRingHom i.toRingHom).comp α.toAlgHom.toRingHom := by
    apply RingHom.ext
    intro b
    exact hβ b
  calc
    (β (i b)).map β.toRingHom =
        ((α.toAlgHom b).map i.toRingHom).map β.toRingHom := by rw [hβ]
    _ = ((α.toAlgHom b).map α.toAlgHom.toRingHom).map (mapRingHom i.toRingHom) := by
      rw [map_map, map_map, hmaps]
    _ = (taylor (X : B[X]) ((α.toAlgHom b).map (C : B →+* B[X]))).map
        (mapRingHom i.toRingHom) := by rw [α.coassoc]
    _ = taylor (X : A[X]) (((α.toAlgHom b).map i.toRingHom).map
        (C : A →+* A[X])) := universal_translate_map _ _
    _ = taylor (X : A[X]) ((β (i b)).map (C : A →+* A[X])) := by rw [hβ]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.CoactionLND.hasseDeriv_map
statement:
lemma hasseDeriv_map {B : Type*} [CommRing B] (f : A →+* B)
    (p : A[X]) (n : ℕ) :
    hasseDeriv n (p.map f) = (hasseDeriv n p).map f
proof:
:= by
  ext j
  simp only [hasseDeriv_coeff, coeff_map, map_mul, map_natCast]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.CoactionLND.coeff_universal_translate
statement:
lemma coeff_universal_translate (p : A[X]) (n : ℕ) :
    (taylor (X : A[X]) (p.map (C : A →+* A[X]))).coeff n =
      hasseDeriv n p
proof:
:= by
  rw [taylor_coeff, hasseDeriv_map, eval_map, eval₂_C_X]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.CoactionLND.PolynomialAdditiveAction.derivation_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem derivation_apply (a : A) :
    α.derivation a = (α.toAlgHom a).coeff 1
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.CoactionLND.PolynomialAdditiveAction.action_coeff
statement:
theorem action_coeff (a : A) (n : ℕ) :
    α.toAlgHom ((α.toAlgHom a).coeff n) = hasseDeriv n (α.toAlgHom a)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [coeff_map, coeff_universal_translate, AlgHom.toRingHom_eq_coe, AlgHom.coe_toRingHom] using
    congrArg (fun p : A[X][X] => p.coeff n) (α.coassoc a)

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.CoactionLND.PolynomialAdditiveAction.derivation_coeff
statement:
theorem derivation_coeff (a : A) (n : ℕ) :
    α.derivation ((α.toAlgHom a).coeff n) =
      (n + 1) • (α.toAlgHom a).coeff (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [derivation_apply, α.action_coeff, hasseDeriv_coeff]
  simp [Nat.add_comm, Nat.choose_succ_self_right, nsmul_eq_mul]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.CoactionLND.PolynomialAdditiveAction.iterate_derivation
statement:
theorem iterate_derivation (a : A) (n : ℕ) :
    (α.derivation : A → A)^[n] a = n.factorial • (α.toAlgHom a).coeff n
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [α.identity]
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply', ih, map_nsmul, α.derivation_coeff,
      smul_smul, Nat.factorial_succ]
    rw [Nat.mul_comm]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.CoactionLND.PolynomialAdditiveAction.iterate_derivation_eq_zero
statement:
theorem iterate_derivation_eq_zero (a : A) :
    (α.derivation : A → A)^[(α.toAlgHom a).natDegree + 1] a = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [α.iterate_derivation, coeff_eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt (Nat.lt_succ_self _),
    smul_zero]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.CoactionLND.PolynomialAdditiveAction.locallyNilpotent
statement: theorem locallyNilpotent : ∀ a, ∃ n : ℕ, (α.derivation : A → A)^[n] a = 0
proof:
:=
  fun a => ⟨_, α.iterate_derivation_eq_zero a⟩

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.CoactionLND.PolynomialAdditiveAction.action_eq_C_of_derivation_eq_zero
statement:
theorem action_eq_C_of_derivation_eq_zero [NoZeroDivisors A] [CharZero A]
    (h : α.derivation = 0) (a : A) : α.toAlgHom a = C a
proof:
:= by
  ext n
  cases n with
  | zero => simp [α.identity]
  | succ n =>
    have hc := α.derivation_coeff a n
    rw [h, Derivation.zero_apply] at hc
    have hn : (n + 1 : A) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Nat.succ_ne_zero n
    have hz : (α.toAlgHom a).coeff (n + 1) = 0 := by
      apply (mul_eq_zero.mp ?_).resolve_left hn
      simpa only [nsmul_eq_mul, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] using hc.symm
    simpa using hz

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.CoactionLND.PolynomialAdditiveAction.derivation_ne_zero_of_nontrivial
statement:
theorem derivation_ne_zero_of_nontrivial [NoZeroDivisors A] [CharZero A]
    (h : ∃ a, α.toAlgHom a ≠ C a) : α.derivation ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hzero
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := h
  exact ha (α.action_eq_C_of_derivation_eq_zero hzero a)

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.CoactionLND.PolynomialAdditiveAction.derivation_naturality
statement:
theorem derivation_naturality {B : Type*} [CommRing B] [Algebra k B]
    (β : PolynomialAdditiveAction k B) (f : A →ₐ[k] B)
    (hf : ∀ a, β.toAlgHom (f a) = (α.toAlgHom a).map f.toRingHom) (a : A) :
    β.derivation (f a) = f (α.derivation a)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [derivation_apply, hf, coeff_map, AlgHom.toRingHom_eq_coe,
    AlgHom.coe_toRingHom]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.CoactionLND.PolynomialAdditiveAction.derivation_ne_zero_of_injective
statement:
theorem derivation_ne_zero_of_injective {B : Type*} [CommRing B] [Algebra k B]
    (β : PolynomialAdditiveAction k B) (f : A →ₐ[k] B)
    (hf : ∀ a, β.toAlgHom (f a) = (α.toAlgHom a).map f.toRingHom)
    (hinj : Function.Injective f) (hα : α.derivation ≠ 0) : β.derivation ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hβ
  apply hα
  ext a
  apply hinj
  have h := α.derivation_naturality β f hf a
  rw [hβ, Derivation.zero_apply] at h
  simpa using h.symm

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.CoordinateDerivation.coeff_iterate_pderiv_eq_zero
statement:
theorem coeff_iterate_pderiv_eq_zero (i : σ) (p : MvPolynomial σ k)
    (n : ℕ) (m : σ →₀ ℕ) (h : p.degreeOf i < m i + n) :
    (((pderiv i : Derivation k (MvPolynomial σ k)
      (MvPolynomial σ k)) : MvPolynomial σ k → MvPolynomial σ k)^[n] p).coeff m = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction n generalizing m with
  | zero =>
      simp only [Nat.add_zero] at *
      by_contra hn
      exact (not_lt_of_ge (monomial_le_degreeOf i (mem_support_iff.mpr hn))) h
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply', coeff_pderiv]
      have hm : p.degreeOf i < (m + Finsupp.single i 1 : σ →₀ ℕ) i + n := by
        simpa only [Finsupp.add_apply, Finsupp.single_eq_same] using
          (show p.degreeOf i < m i + 1 + n by omega)
      rw [ih _ hm, zero_mul]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.CoordinateDerivation.pderiv_locallyNilpotent
statement:
theorem pderiv_locallyNilpotent (i : σ) (p : MvPolynomial σ k) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, (((pderiv i : Derivation k (MvPolynomial σ k)
      (MvPolynomial σ k)) : MvPolynomial σ k → MvPolynomial σ k)^[n]) p = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨p.degreeOf i + 1, ?_⟩
  ext m
  simp only [AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_zero]
  apply coeff_iterate_pderiv_eq_zero
  omega

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.CoordinateDerivation.transport_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem transport_apply (e : A ≃ₐ[k] B) (D : Derivation k A A) (b : B) :
    transport e D b = e (D (e.symm b))
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.CoordinateDerivation.transport_iterate
statement:
theorem transport_iterate (e : A ≃ₐ[k] B) (D : Derivation k A A) (n : ℕ) (b : B) :
    ((transport e D : B → B)^[n]) b = e (((D : A → A)^[n]) (e.symm b))
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih => simp [Function.iterate_succ_apply', ih]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.CoordinateDerivation.transport_locallyNilpotent
statement:
theorem transport_locallyNilpotent (e : A ≃ₐ[k] B) (D : Derivation k A A)
    (hD : ∀ a, ∃ n : ℕ, ((D : A → A)^[n]) a = 0) :
    ∀ b, ∃ n : ℕ, ((transport e D : B → B)^[n]) b = 0
proof:
:= by
  intro b
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hD (e.symm b)
  exact ⟨n, by rw [transport_iterate, hn, map_zero]⟩

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.CoordinateDerivation.transport_apply_image
statement:
@[simp] theorem transport_apply_image (e : A ≃ₐ[k] B) (D : Derivation k A A) (a : A) :
    transport e D (e a) = e (D a)
proof: := by simp

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.CoordinateDerivation.transport_ne_zero
statement:
theorem transport_ne_zero (e : A ≃ₐ[k] B) (D : Derivation k A A) (hD : D ≠ 0) :
    transport e D ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  apply hD
  ext a
  have ha := congrArg (fun E : Derivation k B B => E (e a)) h
  simpa using e.injective (by simpa using ha)

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.CoordinateDerivation.coordinatePartial_self
statement:
@[simp] theorem coordinatePartial_self (e : MvPolynomial σ k ≃ₐ[k] A) (i : σ) :
    coordinatePartial e i (e (X i)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [coordinatePartial]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.CoordinateDerivation.coordinatePartial_other
statement:
@[simp] theorem coordinatePartial_other (e : MvPolynomial σ k ≃ₐ[k] A)
    {i j : σ} (h : j ≠ i) : coordinatePartial e i (e (X j)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [coordinatePartial, pderiv_X_of_ne h]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.CoordinateDerivation.coordinatePartial_locallyNilpotent
statement:
theorem coordinatePartial_locallyNilpotent (e : MvPolynomial σ k ≃ₐ[k] A) (i : σ) :
    ∀ a, ∃ n : ℕ, ((coordinatePartial e i : A → A)^[n]) a = 0
proof:
:=
  transport_locallyNilpotent e (pderiv i) (pderiv_locallyNilpotent i)

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.CoordinateDerivation.coordinatePartial_ne_zero
statement:
theorem coordinatePartial_ne_zero [Nontrivial A]
    (e : MvPolynomial σ k ≃ₐ[k] A) (i : σ) : coordinatePartial e i ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hi := congrArg (fun D : Derivation k A A => D (e (X i))) h
  simp at hi

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.CoordinateDerivation.exists_nonzero_locallyNilpotent_killing_two
statement:
theorem exists_nonzero_locallyNilpotent_killing_two [Nontrivial A]
    (e : MvPolynomial σ k ≃ₐ[k] A) (i j l : σ) (hji : j ≠ i) (hli : l ≠ i) :
    ∃ D : Derivation k A A, D ≠ 0 ∧
      (∀ a, ∃ n : ℕ, ((D : A → A)^[n]) a = 0) ∧
      D (e (X j)) = 0 ∧ D (e (X l)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨coordinatePartial e i, coordinatePartial_ne_zero e i,
    coordinatePartial_locallyNilpotent e i,
    coordinatePartial_other e hji, coordinatePartial_other e hli⟩

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.CoordinateDerivation.exists_coordinate_not_mem
statement:
theorem exists_coordinate_not_mem (e : MvPolynomial σ k ≃ₐ[k] A)
    (S : Subalgebra k A) (hS : S ≠ ⊤) : ∃ j, e (X j) ∉ S
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_contra h
  have hX : ∀ j, e (X j) ∈ S := by simpa only [not_exists, not_not] using h
  apply hS
  apply top_unique
  intro a ha
  clear ha
  obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := e.surjective a
  induction p using MvPolynomial.induction_on with
  | C r =>
      change e (algebraMap k (MvPolynomial σ k) r) ∈ S
      rw [e.commutes]
      exact S.algebraMap_mem r
  | add p q hp hq => simpa using S.add_mem hp hq
  | mul_X p j hp => simpa using S.mul_mem hp (hX j)

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.CoordinateDerivation.exists_lnd_invariant_outside
statement:
theorem exists_lnd_invariant_outside [Nontrivial A] {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 < n)
    (e : MvPolynomial (Fin n) k ≃ₐ[k] A) (S : Subalgebra k A)
    (hS : S ≠ ⊤) (i : Fin n) (hi : e (X i) ∈ S) :
    ∃ D : Derivation k A A, D ≠ 0 ∧
      (∀ a, ∃ r : ℕ, ((D : A → A)^[r]) a = 0) ∧
      D (e (X i)) = 0 ∧ ∃ j : Fin n, j ≠ i ∧ e (X j) ∉ S ∧ D (e (X j)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := exists_coordinate_not_mem e S hS
  have hji : j ≠ i := by
    intro h
    apply hj
    simpa [h] using hi
  obtain ⟨l, hli, hlj⟩ := Fin.exists_ne_and_ne_of_two_lt i j hn
  refine ⟨coordinatePartial e l, coordinatePartial_ne_zero e l,
    coordinatePartial_locallyNilpotent e l, coordinatePartial_other e hli.symm,
    j, hji, hj, coordinatePartial_other e hlj.symm⟩

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.FilteredRees.mem_degreeZeroSubalgebra
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_degreeZeroSubalgebra
    (F : ℤ → Submodule k A) [SetLike.GradedMonoid F] (a : A) :
    a ∈ degreeZeroSubalgebra F ↔ a ∈ F 0
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.FilteredRees.degreeZeroSubalgebra_ne_top_of_initial_ne_zero
statement:
theorem degreeZeroSubalgebra_ne_top_of_initial_ne_zero
    (F : ℤ → Submodule k A) [SetLike.GradedMonoid F] (hmono : Monotone F)
    {d : ℤ} (hd : 0 < d) (a : F d)
    (ha : initial F hmono d a ≠ 0) : degreeZeroSubalgebra F ≠ ⊤
proof:
:= by
  intro htop
  have ha0 : (a : A) ∈ F 0 := by
    change (a : A) ∈ degreeZeroSubalgebra F
    rw [htop]
    trivial
  exact ha ((initial_eq_zero_iff F hmono d a).mpr
    (hmono (by omega : 0 ≤ d - 1) ha0))

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.FilteredRees.exists_leading_lnd
statement:
theorem exists_leading_lnd
    (φ : MvPolynomial (Fin 5) k →ₐ[k] A) (hφ : Function.Surjective φ)
    (hsep : (⨅ d : ℤ, Filtration.imagePiece φ d) = ⊥)
    (D : Derivation k A A) (hD : D ≠ 0)
    (hln : ∀ a, ∃ n : ℕ, ((D : A → A)^[n]) a = 0) :
    ∃ (m : ℤ) (δ : Derivation k
      (Gr (Filtration.imagePiece φ) (Filtration.imagePiece_mono φ))
      (Gr (Filtration.imagePiece φ) (Filtration.imagePiece_mono φ))),
      δ ≠ 0 ∧
      (∀ a, ∃ n : ℕ, ((δ : _ → _)^[n]) a = 0) ∧
      (∀ (d : ℤ) (a : Filtration.imagePiece φ d),
        ∃ b : Filtration.imagePiece φ (d + m),
          δ (initial (Filtration.imagePiece φ) (Filtration.imagePiece_mono φ) d a) = initial (Filtration.imagePiece φ) (Filtration.imagePiece_mono φ) (d + m) b) ∧
      (∀ (d : ℤ) (a : Filtration.imagePiece φ d),
        D a = 0 → δ (initial (Filtration.imagePiece φ) (Filtration.imagePiece_mono φ) d a) = 0)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, i, _, _, hDi, hshift⟩ :=
    Filtration.exists_attained_derivation_imagePiece_shift φ hφ hsep D hD
  let shift : ∀ d (a : A), a ∈ Filtration.imagePiece φ d →
      D a ∈ Filtration.imagePiece φ (d + m) := fun d a ha => hshift d ha
  refine ⟨m, gradedDerivation _ D m shift (Filtration.imagePiece_mono φ), ?_,
    gradedDerivation_locallyNilpotent _ D m shift _ hln, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact gradedDerivation_ne_zero _ D m shift _
      (Filtration.monomialWeight (Finsupp.single i 1))
      ⟨φ (X i), Filtration.image_monomial_mem φ (Finsupp.single i 1) 1⟩ hDi
  · intro d a
    exact ⟨⟨D a, shift d a a.property⟩,
      gradedDerivation_initial _ D m shift _ d a⟩
  · intro d a ha
    exact gradedDerivation_initial_eq_zero _ D m shift _ d a ha

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.FilteredRees.exists_positive_initial
statement:
theorem exists_positive_initial
    (F : ℤ → Submodule k A) [SetLike.GradedMonoid F] (hmono : Monotone F)
    (hext : ∀ a : A, ∃ d : ℤ, a ∈ F d) (hsep : (⨅ d : ℤ, F d) = ⊥)
    {a : A} (ha : a ∉ F 0) :
    ∃ (d : ℤ) (hd : a ∈ F d), 0 < d ∧
      initial F hmono d ⟨a, hd⟩ ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have hane : a ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    exact ha (h ▸ (F 0).zero_mem)
  obtain ⟨d, hd, hprev⟩ := IntegerFiltration.exists_initial_index
    (fun d => (F d : Set A)) (fun _ _ h => hmono h) hext
    (IntegerFiltration.separated_of_iInf_eq_bot F hsep) hane
  have hdpos : 0 < d := by
    by_contra hn
    exact ha (hmono (by omega : d ≤ 0) hd)
  exact ⟨d, hd, hdpos, fun h => hprev ((initial_eq_zero_iff F hmono d _).mp h)⟩

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.FilteredRees.coordinate_produces_leading_lnd
statement:
theorem coordinate_produces_leading_lnd
    [Nontrivial A]
    (φ : MvPolynomial (Fin 5) k →ₐ[k] A) (hφ : Function.Surjective φ)
    (hsep : (⨅ d : ℤ, Filtration.imagePiece φ d) = ⊥)
    (hproper : degreeZeroSubalgebra (Filtration.imagePiece φ) ≠ ⊤)
    (e : MvPolynomial (Fin 4) k ≃ₐ[k] A) (hp : e (X 0) = φ (X 0)) :
    ∃ (m : ℤ) (δ : Derivation k
      (Gr (Filtration.imagePiece φ) (Filtration.imagePiece_mono φ))
      (Gr (Filtration.imagePiece φ) (Filtration.imagePiece_mono φ))),
      δ ≠ 0 ∧
      (∀ a, ∃ n : ℕ, ((δ : _ → _)^[n]) a = 0) ∧
      (∀ (d : ℤ) (a : Filtration.imagePiece φ d),
        ∃ b : Filtration.imagePiece φ (d + m),
          δ (initial (Filtration.imagePiece φ) (Filtration.imagePiece_mono φ) d a) = initial (Filtration.imagePiece φ) (Filtration.imagePiece_mono φ) (d + m) b) ∧
      δ (initial (Filtration.imagePiece φ) (Filtration.imagePiece_mono φ) (-1)
        ⟨φ (X 0), Filtration.image_X_zero_mem_neg_one φ⟩) = 0 ∧
      ∃ (d : ℤ) (a : Filtration.imagePiece φ d), 0 < d ∧
        initial (Filtration.imagePiece φ) (Filtration.imagePiece_mono φ) d a ≠ 0 ∧ δ (initial (Filtration.imagePiece φ) (Filtration.imagePiece_mono φ) d a) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hp0 : e (X 0) ∈ degreeZeroSubalgebra (Filtration.imagePiece φ) := by
    rw [hp]
    exact Filtration.imagePiece_mono φ (by decide : (-1 : ℤ) ≤ 0)
      (Filtration.image_X_zero_mem_neg_one φ)
  obtain ⟨D, hD, hln, hDp, j, _, hj, hDj⟩ :=
    CoordinateDerivation.exists_lnd_invariant_outside (by decide : 2 < 4)
      e (degreeZeroSubalgebra (Filtration.imagePiece φ)) hproper 0 hp0
  obtain ⟨m, δ, hδ, hδln, hhom, hinv⟩ := exists_leading_lnd φ hφ hsep D hD hln
  obtain ⟨d, hd, hdpos, hinit⟩ := exists_positive_initial
    (Filtration.imagePiece φ) (Filtration.imagePiece_mono φ)
    (Filtration.exists_mem_imagePiece φ hφ) hsep hj
  refine ⟨m, δ, hδ, hδln, hhom, ?_, d, ⟨e (X j), hd⟩, hdpos, hinit, ?_⟩
  · apply hinv
    simpa only [hp] using hDp
  · exact hinv d ⟨e (X j), hd⟩ hDj

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.FilteredRees.coordinate_produces_leading_lnd_of_nonunit
statement:
theorem coordinate_produces_leading_lnd_of_nonunit
    [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsDomain A]
    (φ : MvPolynomial (Fin 5) k →ₐ[k] A) (hφ : Function.Surjective φ)
    (hpunit : ¬ IsUnit (φ (X 0)))
    (hproper : degreeZeroSubalgebra (Filtration.imagePiece φ) ≠ ⊤)
    (e : MvPolynomial (Fin 4) k ≃ₐ[k] A) (hp : e (X 0) = φ (X 0)) :
    ∃ (m : ℤ) (δ : Derivation k
      (Gr (Filtration.imagePiece φ) (Filtration.imagePiece_mono φ))
      (Gr (Filtration.imagePiece φ) (Filtration.imagePiece_mono φ))),
      δ ≠ 0 ∧
      (∀ a, ∃ n : ℕ, ((δ : _ → _)^[n]) a = 0) ∧
      (∀ (d : ℤ) (a : Filtration.imagePiece φ d),
        ∃ b : Filtration.imagePiece φ (d + m),
          δ (initial (Filtration.imagePiece φ) (Filtration.imagePiece_mono φ) d a) = initial (Filtration.imagePiece φ) (Filtration.imagePiece_mono φ) (d + m) b) ∧
      δ (initial (Filtration.imagePiece φ) (Filtration.imagePiece_mono φ) (-1)
        ⟨φ (X 0), Filtration.image_X_zero_mem_neg_one φ⟩) = 0 ∧
      ∃ (d : ℤ) (a : Filtration.imagePiece φ d), 0 < d ∧
        initial (Filtration.imagePiece φ) (Filtration.imagePiece_mono φ) d a ≠ 0 ∧ δ (initial (Filtration.imagePiece φ) (Filtration.imagePiece_mono φ) d a) = 0
proof:
:=
  coordinate_produces_leading_lnd φ hφ
    (Filtration.iInf_imagePiece_eq_bot φ hpunit) hproper e hp

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.FilteredRees.coordinate_produces_leading_lnd_of_noetherian_domain
statement:
theorem coordinate_produces_leading_lnd_of_noetherian_domain
    [IsNoetherianRing k] [IsDomain k]
    (φ : MvPolynomial (Fin 5) k →ₐ[k] A) (hφ : Function.Surjective φ)
    (hproper : degreeZeroSubalgebra (Filtration.imagePiece φ) ≠ ⊤)
    (e : MvPolynomial (Fin 4) k ≃ₐ[k] A) (hp : e (X 0) = φ (X 0)) :
    ∃ (m : ℤ) (δ : Derivation k
      (Gr (Filtration.imagePiece φ) (Filtration.imagePiece_mono φ))
      (Gr (Filtration.imagePiece φ) (Filtration.imagePiece_mono φ))),
      δ ≠ 0 ∧
      (∀ a, ∃ n : ℕ, ((δ : _ → _)^[n]) a = 0) ∧
      (∀ (d : ℤ) (a : Filtration.imagePiece φ d),
        ∃ b : Filtration.imagePiece φ (d + m),
          δ (initial (Filtration.imagePiece φ) (Filtration.imagePiece_mono φ) d a) =
            initial (Filtration.imagePiece φ) (Filtration.imagePiece_mono φ) (d + m) b) ∧
      δ (initial (Filtration.imagePiece φ) (Filtration.imagePiece_mono φ) (-1)
        ⟨φ (X 0), Filtration.image_X_zero_mem_neg_one φ⟩) = 0 ∧
      ∃ (d : ℤ) (a : Filtration.imagePiece φ d), 0 < d ∧
        initial (Filtration.imagePiece φ) (Filtration.imagePiece_mono φ) d a ≠ 0 ∧
        δ (initial (Filtration.imagePiece φ) (Filtration.imagePiece_mono φ) d a) = 0
proof:
:= by
  let : IsDomain A := Function.Injective.isDomain e.symm.toRingHom e.symm.injective
  let : IsNoetherianRing A :=
    isNoetherianRing_of_ringEquiv (MvPolynomial (Fin 4) k) e.toRingEquiv
  have hpunit : ¬ IsUnit (φ (X 0)) := by
    intro hu
    have hX : IsUnit (X (0 : Fin 4) : MvPolynomial (Fin 4) k) := by
      have hu' := hu.map e.symm
      simpa only [← hp, AlgEquiv.symm_apply_apply] using hu'
    exact not_isUnit_zero (by simpa only [eval_X] using hX.map (eval (fun _ => (0 : k))))
  exact coordinate_produces_leading_lnd_of_nonunit φ hφ hpunit hproper e hp

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.CoordinateToQuadric.source_coordinate_produces_quadric_lnd
statement:
theorem source_coordinate_produces_quadric_lnd
    (k : Type*) [Field k]
    (e : P k 4 ≃ₐ[k] A k) (hp : e (X 0) = aX k 0) :
    ∃ E : Derivation k (B k) (B k),
      IsLocallyNilpotent E ∧ E ≠ 0 ∧
      ∃ h : B k, h ∈ I k ∧ h ≠ 0 ∧ E h = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, D, hDne, hD, hshift, hpD, d, η, hd, hη, hηne, hDη⟩ :=
    ReesToDegeneration.coordinate_produces_degeneration_lnd k e hp
  exact SourceInvariant.exists_quadric_lnd_invariant D m hshift hD hDne hpD
    hd hη hηne hDη

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.CoordinateToQuadric.f_coordinate_produces_quadric_lnd
statement:
theorem f_coordinate_produces_quadric_lnd
    (hf : IsCoordinate (by decide : 0 < 4) StableCoordinate.f) :
    ∃ E : Derivation ℂ (B ℂ) (B ℂ),
      IsLocallyNilpotent E ∧ E ≠ 0 ∧
      ∃ h : B ℂ, h ∈ I ℂ ∧ h ≠ 0 ∧ E h = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e, hp⟩ := source_coordinate_system_of_f_coordinate hf
  exact source_coordinate_produces_quadric_lnd ℂ e hp

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.Q_isHomogeneous
statement: theorem Q_isHomogeneous : Q.IsHomogeneous 2
proof:
:= by
  unfold Q
  exact ((isHomogeneous_X_pow (1 : Fin 4) 2).sub
    (isHomogeneous_X_pow (3 : Fin 4) 2)).add
    ((isHomogeneous_X ℂ (0 : Fin 4)).mul (isHomogeneous_X ℂ (2 : Fin 4)))

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.Q_ne_zero
statement: theorem Q_ne_zero : Q ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have he := congrArg (eval (fun i : Fin 4 => if i.val = 1 then (1 : ℂ) else 0)) h
  norm_num [Q] at he

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.Q_totalDegree
statement: theorem Q_totalDegree : Q.totalDegree = 2
proof: := Q_isHomogeneous.totalDegree Q_ne_zero

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.x2_add_x4_ne_zero
statement: private theorem x2_add_x4_ne_zero : (X (1 : Fin 4) + X 3 : R 4) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have he := congrArg (eval (fun i : Fin 4 => if i.val = 1 then (1 : ℂ) else 0)) h
  norm_num at he

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.f_totalDegree
statement: theorem f_totalDegree : f.totalDegree = 5
proof:
:= by
  let top : R 4 := -(2 * Q ^ 2 * (X 1 + X 3))
  let low : R 4 := X 0 - 2 * Q * (X 0 * X 3)
  have htop_hom : top.IsHomogeneous 5 := by
    have hh := (((Q_isHomogeneous.pow 2).mul
      ((isHomogeneous_X ℂ (1 : Fin 4)).add (isHomogeneous_X ℂ (3 : Fin 4)))).C_mul
        (2 : ℂ)).neg
    simpa only [top, map_ofNat, mul_assoc, show 2 * 2 + 1 = 5 from rfl] using hh
  have htop_ne : top ≠ 0 := by
    dsimp [top]
    exact neg_ne_zero.mpr (mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero (by norm_num) (pow_ne_zero 2 Q_ne_zero))
      x2_add_x4_ne_zero)
  have htop_deg : top.totalDegree = 5 := htop_hom.totalDegree htop_ne
  have hnum : (2 : R 4).totalDegree = 0 := by
    rw [← map_ofNat (C : ℂ →+* R 4) 2, totalDegree_C]
  have hinner : (X (0 : Fin 4) * X 3 : R 4).totalDegree ≤ 2 := by
    simpa using totalDegree_mul (X (0 : Fin 4) : R 4) (X 3)
  have hmul : (2 * Q * (X 0 * X 3) : R 4).totalDegree ≤ 4 := by
    calc
      _ ≤ (2 * Q : R 4).totalDegree + (X 0 * X 3 : R 4).totalDegree := totalDegree_mul _ _
      _ ≤ ((2 : R 4).totalDegree + Q.totalDegree) + 2 :=
        Nat.add_le_add (totalDegree_mul _ _) hinner
      _ = 4 := by rw [hnum, Q_totalDegree]
  have hlow_deg : low.totalDegree ≤ 4 := by
    exact (totalDegree_sub _ _).trans (max_le (by simp) hmul)
  have hsplit : f = top + low := by
    dsimp [f, top, low]
    ring
  rw [hsplit, totalDegree_add_eq_left_of_totalDegree_lt]
  · exact htop_deg
  · omega

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.DerivationScalarUpgrade.upgrade_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem upgrade_apply (D : Derivation k A A)
    (hS : ∀ s : S, D (algebraMap S A s) = 0) (a : A) :
    upgrade D hS a = D a
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.DerivationScalarUpgrade.upgrade_iterate
statement:
theorem upgrade_iterate (D : Derivation k A A)
    (hS : ∀ s : S, D (algebraMap S A s) = 0) (n : ℕ) (a : A) :
    (upgrade D hS : A → A)^[n] a = (D : A → A)^[n] a
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.DerivationScalarUpgrade.upgrade_locallyNilpotent
statement:
theorem upgrade_locallyNilpotent (D : Derivation k A A)
    (hS : ∀ s : S, D (algebraMap S A s) = 0)
    (hD : ∀ a : A, ∃ n : ℕ, (D : A → A)^[n] a = 0) :
    ∀ a : A, ∃ n : ℕ, (upgrade D hS : A → A)^[n] a = 0
proof: := hD

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.DerivationScalarUpgrade.upgrade_ne_zero
statement:
theorem upgrade_ne_zero (D : Derivation k A A)
    (hS : ∀ s : S, D (algebraMap S A s) = 0) (hD : D ≠ 0) :
    upgrade D hS ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  apply hD
  ext a
  exact congrArg (fun (E : Derivation S A A) => E a) h

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.DerivationScalarUpgrade.annihilates_mvPolynomial
statement:
theorem annihilates_mvPolynomial {σ : Type*} (D : Derivation k A A)
    (φ : MvPolynomial σ k →ₐ[k] A)
    (hX : ∀ j : σ, D (φ (MvPolynomial.X j)) = 0) :
    ∀ p : MvPolynomial σ k, D (φ p) = 0
proof:
:= by
  intro p
  induction p using MvPolynomial.induction_on with
  | C r =>
    rw [show MvPolynomial.C r = algebraMap k (MvPolynomial σ k) r from rfl,
      AlgHom.commutes, D.map_algebraMap]
  | add p q hp hq => simp only [map_add, hp, hq, add_zero]
  | mul_X p j hp =>
    simp only [map_mul, Derivation.leibniz, hX, hp, smul_zero, add_zero]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.DerivationScalarUpgrade.annihilates_localization
statement:
theorem annihilates_localization (D : Derivation k A A) (φ : L →+* A)
    (hR : ∀ r : R, D (φ (algebraMap R L r)) = 0) :
    ∀ l : L, D (φ l) = 0
proof:
:= by
  intro l
  obtain ⟨⟨r, m⟩, hm⟩ := IsLocalization.surj M l
  have hd := congrArg D (congrArg φ hm)
  simp only [map_mul, Derivation.leibniz, hR, smul_eq_mul,
    mul_zero, zero_add] at hd
  exact ((IsLocalization.map_units L m).map φ).mul_right_eq_zero.mp hd

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.DerivationTopShift.exists_proj_ne_zero
statement:
theorem exists_proj_ne_zero {a : A} (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    ∃ j : ℤ, proj 𝒜 j a ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_contra! h
  apply ha
  apply (DirectSum.decompose 𝒜).injective
  ext j
  simpa using h j

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.DerivationTopShift.exists_generator_ne_zero
statement:
theorem exists_generator_ne_zero (g : ι → A)
    (hg : Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range g) = ⊤)
    (D : Derivation k A A) (hD : D ≠ 0) :
    ∃ i, D (g i) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  by_contra! h
  apply hD
  apply Derivation.ext_of_adjoin_eq_top (Set.range g) hg
  intro a ha
  obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := ha
  simpa using h i

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.DerivationTopShift.exists_maximal_generator_shift
statement:
theorem exists_maximal_generator_shift (g : ι → A) (d : ι → ℤ)
    (hg : Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range g) = ⊤)
    (D : Derivation k A A) (hD : D ≠ 0) :
    ∃ m : ℤ,
      (∀ i j, d i + m < j → proj 𝒜 j (D (g i)) = 0) ∧
      (∃ i, proj 𝒜 (d i + m) (D (g i)) ≠ 0)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let S : Finset ℤ := Finset.univ.biUnion fun i =>
    ((DirectSum.decompose 𝒜 (D (g i))).support).image (fun j => j - d i)
  have memS (i : ι) (j : ℤ) (hj : proj 𝒜 j (D (g i)) ≠ 0) : j - d i ∈ S := by
    apply Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr
    refine ⟨i, Finset.mem_univ _, ?_⟩
    apply Finset.mem_image.mpr
    exact ⟨j, (GradedAlgebra.mem_support_iff 𝒜 _ _).mpr hj, rfl⟩
  have hS : S.Nonempty := by
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := exists_generator_ne_zero g hg D hD
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := exists_proj_ne_zero 𝒜 hi
    exact ⟨j - d i, memS i j hj⟩
  refine ⟨S.max' hS, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i j hj
    by_contra hne
    have hle := Finset.le_max' S (j - d i) (memS i j hne)
    omega
  · have hm : S.max' hS ∈ S := Finset.max'_mem S hS
    obtain ⟨i, _, hi⟩ := Finset.mem_biUnion.mp hm
    obtain ⟨j, hj, heq⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hi
    refine ⟨i, ?_⟩
    have hidx : d i + S.max' hS = j := by omega
    rw [hidx]
    exact (GradedAlgebra.mem_support_iff 𝒜 _ _).mp hj

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.DerivationTopShift.exists_maximal_component
statement:
theorem exists_maximal_component (g : ι → A) (d : ι → ℤ)
    (hg : Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range g) = ⊤)
    (D : Derivation k A A) (hD : D ≠ 0)
    (E : ℤ → Derivation k A A)
    (hE : ∀ m i, E m (g i) = proj 𝒜 (d i + m) (D (g i))) :
    ∃ m : ℤ, E m ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ n, m < n → E n = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, hbound, i, hi⟩ := exists_maximal_generator_shift 𝒜 g d hg D hD
  refine ⟨m, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro hzero
    apply hi
    rw [← hE, hzero]
    rfl
  · intro n hn
    apply Derivation.ext_of_adjoin_eq_top (Set.range g) hg
    intro a ha
    obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := ha
    rw [hE]
    exact hbound i (d i + n) (by omega)

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.DerivationTopShift.exists_top_component_and_global_bound
statement:
theorem exists_top_component_and_global_bound
    (g : ι → A) (d : ι → ℤ)
    (hg : Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range g) = ⊤)
    (hhom : ∀ i, g i ∈ 𝒜 (d i))
    (D : Derivation k A A) (hD : D ≠ 0)
    (E : ℤ → Derivation k A A)
    (hE : ∀ m i (x : A), x ∈ 𝒜 i →
      E m x = proj 𝒜 (i + m) (D x)) :
    ∃ m : ℤ, E m ≠ 0 ∧
      (∀ n, m < n → E n = 0) ∧
      (∀ i (x : A), x ∈ 𝒜 i → ∀ j, i + m < j → proj 𝒜 j (D x) = 0)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, hm, hmax⟩ := exists_maximal_component 𝒜 g d hg D hD E
    (fun m i => hE m (d i) (g i) (hhom i))
  refine ⟨m, hm, hmax, ?_⟩
  intro i x hx j hj
  have heq := hE (j - i) i x hx
  have hz := hmax (j - i) (by omega)
  rw [hz] at heq
  have hidx : i + (j - i) = j := by omega
  rw [hidx] at heq
  exact heq.symm

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.DeterminantActionWeights.generator_adjoin_eq_top
statement:
theorem generator_adjoin_eq_top :
    Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range (generator k)) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  have hm : aeval (generator k) = mk k := by
    ext i
    simp [generator]
  rw [← MvPolynomial.aeval_range, hm, AlgHom.range_eq_top]
  exact Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.DeterminantActionWeights.commutesWithWeights_of_generator_coefficients
statement:
theorem commutesWithWeights_of_generator_coefficients
    (α : C k →ₐ[k] Polynomial (C k))
    (hα : ∀ (i : Fin 5) (m : ℕ),
      DeterminantWeights.fiberCoaction k ((α (generator k i)).coeff m) =
        AddMonoidAlgebra.single (Obstruction.fiberWeight i)
          ((α (generator k i)).coeff m)) :
    CommutesWithWeights (DeterminantWeights.fiberCoaction k) α
proof:
:=
  commutesWithWeights_of_generators (DeterminantWeights.fiberCoaction k) α
    (generator k) Obstruction.fiberWeight (generator_adjoin_eq_top k)
    (DeterminantWeights.fiberCoaction_generator k) hα

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.DeterminantActionWeights.coefficient_preserves_fiberPiece
statement:
theorem coefficient_preserves_fiberPiece
    (α : C k →ₐ[k] Polynomial (C k))
    (hα : ∀ (i : Fin 5) (m : ℕ),
      DeterminantWeights.fiberCoaction k ((α (generator k i)).coeff m) =
        AddMonoidAlgebra.single (Obstruction.fiberWeight i)
          ((α (generator k i)).coeff m))
    {n : ℤ} {q : C k} (hq : q ∈ Obstruction.fiberPiece k n) (m : ℕ) :
    (α q).coeff m ∈ Obstruction.fiberPiece k n
proof:
:= by
  apply (DeterminantGradedObstruction.mem_fiberPiece_iff_fiberCoaction k n).mpr
  apply coeff_preserves_weight (DeterminantWeights.fiberCoaction k) α
    (commutesWithWeights_of_generator_coefficients k α hα)
  exact (DeterminantGradedObstruction.mem_fiberPiece_iff_fiberCoaction k n).mp hq

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.DeterminantActionWeights.derivation_preserves_fiberPiece
statement:
theorem derivation_preserves_fiberPiece
    (α : C k →ₐ[k] Polynomial (C k))
    (hα : ∀ (i : Fin 5) (m : ℕ),
      DeterminantWeights.fiberCoaction k ((α (generator k i)).coeff m) =
        AddMonoidAlgebra.single (Obstruction.fiberWeight i)
          ((α (generator k i)).coeff m))
    (D : Derivation k (C k) (C k)) (hD : ∀ q, D q = (α q).coeff 1) :
    ∀ (n : ℤ) (q : C k), q ∈ Obstruction.fiberPiece k n →
      D q ∈ Obstruction.fiberPiece k n
proof:
:= by
  intro n q hq
  rw [hD]
  exact coefficient_preserves_fiberPiece k α hα hq 1

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.DeterminantActionWeights.generator_laws_of_five_coefficients
statement:
theorem generator_laws_of_five_coefficients
    (α : C k →ₐ[k] Polynomial (C k))
    (ha : ∀ m, DeterminantWeights.fiberCoaction k ((α (a k)).coeff m) =
      AddMonoidAlgebra.single 1 ((α (a k)).coeff m))
    (hd : ∀ m, DeterminantWeights.fiberCoaction k ((α (d k)).coeff m) =
      AddMonoidAlgebra.single 1 ((α (d k)).coeff m))
    (hb : ∀ m, DeterminantWeights.fiberCoaction k ((α (b k)).coeff m) =
      AddMonoidAlgebra.single (-1) ((α (b k)).coeff m))
    (hc : ∀ m, DeterminantWeights.fiberCoaction k ((α (c k)).coeff m) =
      AddMonoidAlgebra.single (-1) ((α (c k)).coeff m))
    (hu : ∀ m, DeterminantWeights.fiberCoaction k ((α (u k)).coeff m) =
      AddMonoidAlgebra.single 0 ((α (u k)).coeff m)) :
    ∀ (i : Fin 5) (m : ℕ),
      DeterminantWeights.fiberCoaction k ((α (generator k i)).coeff m) =
        AddMonoidAlgebra.single (Obstruction.fiberWeight i)
          ((α (generator k i)).coeff m)
proof:
:= by
  intro i m
  fin_cases i
  · simpa [Obstruction.fiberWeight, a] using ha m
  · simpa [Obstruction.fiberWeight, d] using hd m
  · simpa [Obstruction.fiberWeight, b] using hb m
  · simpa [Obstruction.fiberWeight, c] using hc m
  · simpa [Obstruction.fiberWeight, u] using hu m

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.DeterminantRing.chartVariable_mul_inverse
statement:
@[simp] theorem chartVariable_mul_inverse (i : Fin 3) :
    chartVariable k i i * chartInverse k i = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [chartVariable, chartInverse, ← map_mul, IsLocalization.Away.mul_invSelf, map_one]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.DeterminantRing.chartVariable_isUnit
statement: theorem chartVariable_isUnit (i : Fin 3) : IsUnit (chartVariable k i i)
proof:
:=
  isUnit_iff_exists_inv.mpr ⟨chartInverse k i, chartVariable_mul_inverse k i⟩

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.DeterminantRing.chartMapA_a
statement: @[simp] theorem chartMapA_a : chartMapA k (a k) = chartVariable k 0 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [chartMapA]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.DeterminantRing.map_invSelf_eq
statement:
private theorem map_invSelf_eq {R S T : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [CommRing T]
    [Algebra R S] (r : R) [IsLocalization.Away r S] (f : S →+* T) (y : T)
    (hy : f (algebraMap R S r) * y = 1) :
    f (IsLocalization.Away.invSelf r) = y
proof:
:= by
  apply ((IsLocalization.Away.algebraMap_isUnit r).map f).mul_left_cancel
  rw [← map_mul, IsLocalization.Away.mul_invSelf, map_one, hy]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.DeterminantRing.fromChartA_inverse
statement:
@[simp] theorem fromChartA_inverse :
    fromChartA k (chartInverse k 0) = IsLocalization.Away.invSelf (a k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [chartInverse, fromChartA_C]
  apply map_invSelf_eq (X 0 : Base k) (coefficientFromChartA k).toRingHom
  change coefficientFromChartA k (algebraMap (Base k) (BaseAway k 0) (X 0)) *
    IsLocalization.Away.invSelf (a k) = 1
  simp

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.DeterminantRing.toChartA_inverse

    toChartA k (IsLocalization.Away.invSelf (a k)) = chartInverse k 0
proof:
:= by
  apply map_invSelf_eq (a k) (toChartA k).toRingHom
  change toChartA k (algebraMap (C k) (AwayA k) (a k)) * chartInverse k 0 = 1
  simp

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.DeterminantRing.localized_c

theorem localized_c : algebraMap (C k) (AwayA k) (c k) =
    IsLocalization.Away.invSelf (a k) *
      (1 + algebraMap (C k) (AwayA k) (b k) * algebraMap (C k) (AwayA k) (d k))
proof:
:= by
  apply (IsLocalization.Away.algebraMap_isUnit (a k)).mul_left_cancel
  rw [← mul_assoc, IsLocalization.Away.mul_invSelf, one_mul]
  have h := congrArg (algebraMap (C k) (AwayA k)) (determinant_relation k)
  simp only [map_sub, map_mul, map_one] at h
  linear_combination h

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.DeterminantRing.baseMap_injective
statement: theorem baseMap_injective [IsDomain k] : Function.Injective (baseMap (k := k))
proof:
:= by
  intro r s h
  have h' := congrArg (chartMapA k) h
  simp only [chartMapA_baseMap] at h'
  apply IsLocalization.injective (BaseAway k 0)
    (powers_le_nonZeroDivisors_of_noZeroDivisors (MvPolynomial.X_ne_zero (0 : Fin 3)))
  exact Polynomial.C_injective h'

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.DeterminantRing.chartMapA_injective
statement:
theorem chartMapA_injective [IsDomain k] [IsDomain (C k)] :
    Function.Injective (chartMapA k)
proof:
:= by
  have ha : a k ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    apply MvPolynomial.X_ne_zero (0 : Fin 3) (R := k)
    apply baseMap_injective k
    simpa using h
  intro r s h
  apply IsLocalization.injective (AwayA k) (powers_le_nonZeroDivisors_of_noZeroDivisors ha)
  apply (chartEquivA k).injective
  change toChartA k _ = toChartA k _
  simpa using h

  intro r s h
  apply IsLocalization.injective (AwayD k) (powers_le_nonZeroDivisors_of_noZeroDivisors hd)

  change toChartD k _ = toChartD k _
  simpa using h

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.DeterminantDomain.determinantRelation_irreducible
statement: theorem determinantRelation_irreducible : Irreducible (determinantRelation k)
proof:
:= by
  have hrel : IsRelPrime (X (0 : Fin 5) : MvPolynomial (Fin 5) k)
      (-(X 2 * X 1 + 1)) := by
    apply (X_prime.irreducible).isRelPrime_iff_not_dvd.mpr
    intro h
    have he := map_dvd (eval (fun _ : Fin 5 => (0 : k))) h
    simp at he
  have hvars : (3 : Fin 5) ∉ (-(X 2 * X 1 + 1) : MvPolynomial (Fin 5) k).vars := by
    intro hv
    rw [vars_neg] at hv
    have hs := vars_add_subset (X 2 * X 1 : MvPolynomial (Fin 5) k) 1 hv
    have hm : (3 : Fin 5) ∉ (X 2 * X 1 : MvPolynomial (Fin 5) k).vars := by
      intro h
      have h := vars_mul (X 2 : MvPolynomial (Fin 5) k) (X 1) h
      simp at h
    simp [hm] at hs
  have h := irreducible_mul_X_add (X (0 : Fin 5) : MvPolynomial (Fin 5) k)
    (-(X 2 * X 1 + 1)) 3 (X_ne_zero 0) (by simp) hvars hrel
  convert h using 1
  simp only [determinantRelation]
  ring

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.DeterminantDomain.quadricRelation_irreducible
statement: theorem quadricRelation_irreducible : Irreducible (quadricRelation k)
proof:
:= by
  have hrel : IsRelPrime (X (0 : Fin 4) : MvPolynomial (Fin 4) k)
      (-(X 2 * (X 2 + 1))) := by
    apply (X_prime.irreducible).isRelPrime_iff_not_dvd.mpr
    intro h
    have h : (X (0 : Fin 4) : MvPolynomial (Fin 4) k) ∣ X 2 * (X 2 + 1) := by
      simpa using h
    rcases X_prime.dvd_mul.mp h with h | h
    · simp [X_dvd_X] at h
    · have he := map_dvd (eval (fun _ : Fin 4 => (0 : k))) h
      simp at he
  have hvars : (1 : Fin 4) ∉ (-(X 2 * (X 2 + 1)) : MvPolynomial (Fin 4) k).vars := by
    intro hv
    rw [vars_neg] at hv
    have hm := vars_mul (X 2 : MvPolynomial (Fin 4) k) (X 2 + 1) hv
    have ha : (1 : Fin 4) ∉ (X 2 + 1 : MvPolynomial (Fin 4) k).vars := by
      intro h
      have h := vars_add_subset (X 2 : MvPolynomial (Fin 4) k) 1 h
      simp at h
    simp [ha] at hm
  simpa only [quadricRelation, sub_eq_add_neg] using
    irreducible_mul_X_add (X (0 : Fin 4) : MvPolynomial (Fin 4) k)
      (-(X 2 * (X 2 + 1))) 1 (X_ne_zero 0) (by simp) hvars hrel

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.DeterminantRing.derivation_eq_zero_of_fixed_base_and_coefficient_mem
statement:
theorem derivation_eq_zero_of_fixed_base_and_coefficient_mem
    (D : Derivation k (C k) (C k))
    (ha : D (a k) = 0) (hd : D (d k) = 0) (hu : D (u k) = 0)
    (hgraded : ∀ n : ℤ, ∀ x ∈ Obstruction.fiberPiece k n,
      D x ∈ Obstruction.fiberPiece k n)
    (hq : rigidityCoefficient D (b k) (c k) ∈ (baseMap (k := k)).range) :
    D = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hb : b k ∈ Obstruction.fiberPiece k (-1) := by
    change Obstruction.cX k 2 ∈ Obstruction.fiberPiece k (-1)
    simpa [Obstruction.fiberWeight] using Obstruction.cX_mem_fiberPiece k 2
  have hc : c k ∈ Obstruction.fiberPiece k (-1) := by
    change Obstruction.cX k 3 ∈ Obstruction.fiberPiece k (-1)
    simpa [Obstruction.fiberWeight] using Obstruction.cX_mem_fiberPiece k 3
  have hzero : rigidityCoefficient D (b k) (c k) = 0 :=
    DeterminantGradedObstruction.coefficient_eq_zero_of_mem_baseRange k
      (hgraded (-1) (b k) hb) (hgraded (-1) (c k) hc) hq
  obtain ⟨hb', hc'⟩ := derivation_rigidityCoefficient D (a k) (d k) (b k) (c k)
    (determinant_relation k) ha hd
  rw [hzero, mul_zero] at hb' hc'
  exact derivation_eq_zero k D ha hd hb' hc' hu

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.DeterminantGradedObstruction.mem_fiberPiece_iff_fiberCoaction
statement:
theorem mem_fiberPiece_iff_fiberCoaction {q : C k} (n : ℤ) :
    q ∈ Obstruction.fiberPiece k n ↔
      DeterminantWeights.fiberCoaction k q = AddMonoidAlgebra.single n q
proof:
:=
  HomogeneousQuotientWeight.mem_piece_iff_coaction Obstruction.fiberWeight
    (relation k) (DeterminantWeights.relation_fiber_homogeneous k) n q

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.DeterminantGradedObstruction.eq_zero_of_mem_baseRange_of_mem_fiberPiece

:=
