  simp [shift, s, substitution]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.ExponentialShift.shift_u
statement: @[simp] theorem shift_u (c : k) : shift k c (u k) = u k - p k * t k c
proof:
:= by
  simp [shift, u, substitution]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.ExponentialShift.shift_F
statement:
@[simp] theorem shift_F (c : k) : shift k c (F k) =
    F k - (2 * s k * x k + 1) * d k c - p k * x k ^ 2 * d k c ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  simp [shift, F, substitution]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.ExponentialShift.shift_J
statement: @[simp] theorem shift_J (c : k) : shift k c (J k) = J k - x k ^ 2 * d k c
proof:
:= by
  simp [shift, J, substitution]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.ExponentialShift.shift_w
statement: @[simp] theorem shift_w (c : k) : shift k c (w k) = w k
proof:
:= by
  simp [shift, w, substitution]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.ExponentialShift.shift_t
statement: @[simp] theorem shift_t (c b : k) : shift k c (t k b) = t k b
proof:
:= by
  simp [t, shift, w, substitution]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.ExponentialShift.t_neg
statement: @[simp] theorem t_neg (c : k) : t k (-c) = -t k c
proof:
:= by
  simp [t]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.ExponentialShift.quadratic_invariant
statement:
private theorem quadratic_invariant {A : Type*} [CommRing A]
    (p s u F t : A) :
    let x
proof:
:= s ^ 2 - u ^ 2 + p * F
    let d := 2 * u * t - p * t ^ 2
    (s + p * x * d) ^ 2 - (u - p * t) ^ 2 +
      p * (F - (2 * s * x + 1) * d - p * x ^ 2 * d ^ 2) = x := by
  dsimp
  ring

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.ExponentialShift.shift_x
statement: @[simp] theorem shift_x (c : k) : shift k c (x k) = x k
proof:
:= by
  simp only [x, map_add, map_sub, map_pow, map_mul, shift_s, shift_u, shift_p, shift_F]
  exact quadratic_invariant (p k) (s k) (u k) (F k) (t k c)

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.ExponentialShift.shift_d_neg
statement: @[simp] theorem shift_d_neg (c : k) : shift k c (d k (-c)) = -d k c
proof:
:= by
  simp only [d, map_sub, map_mul, map_ofNat, map_pow, shift_u, shift_t, shift_p, t_neg, map_neg]
  ring

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.ExponentialShift.inverse_F
proof:
:= by
  ring

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.ExponentialShift.shift_comp_neg
statement:
@[simp] theorem shift_comp_neg (c : k) :
    (shift k c).comp (shift k (-c)) = AlgHom.id k (P k)
proof:
:= by
  apply MvPolynomial.algHom_ext
  intro i
  fin_cases i
  · change shift k c (shift k (-c) (p k)) = p k
    simp
  · change shift k c (shift k (-c) (s k)) = s k
    simp only [shift_s, map_add, map_mul, shift_p, shift_x, shift_d_neg]
    ring
  · change shift k c (shift k (-c) (u k)) = u k
    simp only [shift_u, map_sub, map_mul, shift_p, shift_t, t_neg, map_neg]
    ring
  · change shift k c (shift k (-c) (F k)) = F k
    simp only [shift_F, map_sub, map_add, map_mul, map_ofNat, map_one, map_pow,
      shift_s, shift_x, shift_d_neg, shift_p]
    exact inverse_F (p k) (s k) (F k) (x k) (d k c)
  · change shift k c (shift k (-c) (J k)) = J k
    simp only [shift_J, map_sub, map_mul, map_pow, shift_x, shift_d_neg]
    ring
  · change shift k c (shift k (-c) (w k)) = w k
    simp

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.ExponentialShift.shiftEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem shiftEquiv_apply (c : k) (a : P k) :
    shiftEquiv k c a = shift k c a
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.ExponentialShift.equation_shift
statement:
private theorem equation_shift {A : Type*} [CommRing A]
    (p s u F J x t d : A) :
    x ^ 2 * (F - (2 * s * x + 1) * d - p * x ^ 2 * d ^ 2) -
      (1 + 2 * (s + p * x * d) * x) * (J - x ^ 2 * d) -
      p * (J - x ^ 2 * d) ^ 2 - (u - p * t) =
      (x ^ 2 * F - (1 + 2 * s * x) * J - p * J ^ 2 - u) + p * t
proof:
:= by
  ring

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.ExponentialShift.shift_H
statement: theorem shift_H (c : k) : shift k c (H k) = H k + p k * t k c
proof:
:= by
  simp only [H, map_sub, map_mul, map_add, map_pow, map_one, map_ofNat,
    shift_x, shift_F, shift_s, shift_J, shift_p, shift_u]
  exact equation_shift (p k) (s k) (u k) (F k) (J k) (x k) (t k c) (d k c)

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.ExponentialShift.exponential_shift_exists
statement:
theorem exponential_shift_exists :
    ∃ e : P k ≃ₐ[k] P k, e (p k) = p k ∧ e (H k) = H k + p k * w k
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨shiftEquiv k 1, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp
  · simpa [t] using shift_H k 1

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.derivation_iterate_mul
statement:
theorem derivation_iterate_mul (D : Derivation k A A) (n : ℕ) (a b : A) :
    (D : A → A)^[n] (a * b) =
      ∑ ij ∈ antidiagonal n,
        n.choose ij.1 • ((D : A → A)^[ij.1] a * (D : A → A)^[ij.2] b)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [sum_antidiagonal_choose_succ_nsmul (M := A)
      (fun i j => (D : A → A)^[i] a * (D : A → A)^[j] b) n]
    simp only [Function.iterate_succ_apply', ih, map_sum, map_nsmul,
      Derivation.leibniz, smul_eq_mul, smul_add, sum_add_distrib, add_right_inj]
    apply sum_congr rfl
    rintro ⟨i, j⟩ hij
    rw [n.choose_symm_of_eq_add (mem_antidiagonal.1 hij).symm]
    rw [mul_comm]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.derivation_iterate_eq_zero_of_le
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hmn
  rw [Nat.add_comm, Function.iterate_add_apply, hm]
  exact Function.iterate_fixed (map_zero D) r

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.exists_last_nonzero_iterate
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hn : Nat.find hnil ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have := Nat.find_spec hnil
    rw [h, Function.iterate_zero_apply] at this
    exact ha this
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero hn
  refine ⟨m, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact Nat.find_min hnil (by omega)
  · simpa [hm] using Nat.find_spec hnil

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.derivation_iterate_top_mul
statement:
theorem derivation_iterate_top_mul (D : Derivation k A A) (a b : A) (m n : ℕ)
    (hm : (D : A → A)^[m + 1] a = 0)
    (hn : (D : A → A)^[n + 1] b = 0) :
    (D : A → A)^[m + n] (a * b) =
      (m + n).choose m • ((D : A → A)^[m] a * (D : A → A)^[n] b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [derivation_iterate_mul]
  apply sum_eq_single (m, n)
  · intro ij hij hne
    have hijsum := mem_antidiagonal.mp hij
    by_cases hi : m < ij.1
    · rw [derivation_iterate_eq_zero_of_le D hm (by omega), zero_mul, smul_zero]
    · have hj : n < ij.2 := by
        have hp : ij.1 ≠ m ∨ ij.2 ≠ n := by
          by_contra hp
          push Not at hp
          exact hne (Prod.ext hp.1 hp.2)
        omega
      rw [derivation_iterate_eq_zero_of_le D hn (by omega), mul_zero, smul_zero]
  · simp

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.lnd_factorial_closure
statement:
theorem lnd_factorial_closure [IsDomain A] [CharZero A]
    (D : Derivation k A A) (hD : IsLocallyNilpotent D) {a b : A}
    (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0) (hab : D (a * b) = 0) :
    D a = 0 ∧ D b = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, hm, hm'⟩ := exists_last_nonzero_iterate D ha (hD a)
  obtain ⟨n, hn, hn'⟩ := exists_last_nonzero_iterate D hb (hD b)
  have hmn : m + n = 0 := by
    by_contra hmn
    have hz : (D : A → A)^[m + n] (a * b) = 0 :=
      derivation_iterate_eq_zero_of_le D (m := 1) (by simpa using hab) (by omega)
    rw [derivation_iterate_top_mul D a b m n hm' hn', nsmul_eq_mul] at hz
    have hchoose : ((m + n).choose m : A) ≠ 0 := by
      exact_mod_cast (Nat.choose_pos (by omega : m ≤ m + n)).ne'
    exact (mul_ne_zero hchoose (mul_ne_zero hm hn)) hz
  obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := Nat.add_eq_zero_iff.mp hmn
  simpa using And.intro hm' hn'

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.lnd_fixed_of_difference_of_squares
statement:
theorem lnd_fixed_of_difference_of_squares [IsDomain A] [CharZero A]
    (D : Derivation k A A) (hD : IsLocallyNilpotent D) {a d u : A}
    (ha : a ≠ 0) (hu : u ≠ 0)
    (hminus : a * u - d ≠ 0) (hplus : a * u + d ≠ 0)
    (hv : D (a ^ 2 * u ^ 2 - d ^ 2) = 0) :
    D a = 0 ∧ D d = 0 ∧ D u = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hprod : D ((a * u - d) * (a * u + d)) = 0 := by
    rw [show (a * u - d) * (a * u + d) = a ^ 2 * u ^ 2 - d ^ 2 by ring]
    exact hv
  obtain ⟨hm, hp⟩ := lnd_factorial_closure D hD hminus hplus hprod
  rw [map_sub] at hm
  rw [map_add] at hp
  have htwo : (2 : A) ≠ 0 := by norm_num
  have hau : D (a * u) = 0 := by
    apply (mul_eq_zero.mp (show (2 : A) * D (a * u) = 0 by
      calc
        (2 : A) * D (a * u) = (D (a * u) - D d) + (D (a * u) + D d) := by ring
        _ = 0 := by rw [hm, hp, add_zero])).resolve_left htwo
  have hd : D d = 0 := by simpa [hau] using hp
  obtain ⟨ha', hu'⟩ := lnd_factorial_closure D hD ha hu hau
  exact ⟨ha', hd, hu'⟩

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.FilteredRees.mem_rees
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_rees (p : LaurentPolynomial A) :
    p ∈ rees F ↔ ∀ d, p.coeff d ∈ F d
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.FilteredRees.homogeneous_coe
statement:
@[simp] theorem homogeneous_coe (d : ℤ) (a : F d) :
    (homogeneous F d a : LaurentPolynomial A) = AddMonoidAlgebra.single d (a : A)
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.FilteredRees.parameter_coe
statement:
@[simp] theorem parameter_coe (hmono : Monotone F) :
    (parameter F hmono : LaurentPolynomial A) = AddMonoidAlgebra.single 1 1
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.FilteredRees.initial_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem initial_eq_zero_iff (hmono : Monotone F) (d : ℤ) (a : F d) :
    initial F hmono d a = 0 ↔ (a : A) ∈ F (d - 1)
proof:
:= by
  change Ideal.Quotient.mk (parameterIdeal F hmono) (homogeneous F d a) = 0 ↔ _
  rw [Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem, parameterIdeal, Ideal.mem_span_singleton]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨q, hq⟩
    have he := congrArg (fun p : rees F => (p : LaurentPolynomial A).coeff d) hq
    have hae : (a : A) = (q : LaurentPolynomial A).coeff (d - 1) := by
      change (AddMonoidAlgebra.single d (a : A)).coeff d =
        (AddMonoidAlgebra.single 1 1 * (q : LaurentPolynomial A)).coeff d at he
      rw [AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_single_mul_apply] at he
      simpa only [AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_single, Finsupp.single_eq_same, one_mul,
        sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm] using he
    rw [hae]
    exact q.property (d - 1)
  · intro ha
    refine ⟨homogeneous F (d - 1) ⟨a, ha⟩, ?_⟩
    apply Subtype.ext
    change AddMonoidAlgebra.single d (a : A) =
      AddMonoidAlgebra.single 1 1 * AddMonoidAlgebra.single (d - 1) (a : A)
    rw [AddMonoidAlgebra.single_mul_single, one_mul]
    congr 1
    omega

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.FilteredRees.initial_mul
statement:
theorem initial_mul (hmono : Monotone F) (d e : ℤ) (a : F d) (b : F e) :
    initial F hmono d a * initial F hmono e b =
      initial F hmono (d + e) ⟨(a : A) * (b : A),
        SetLike.mul_mem_graded a.property b.property⟩
proof:
:= by
  rw [initial, initial, ← map_mul]
  congr 1
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact AddMonoidAlgebra.single_mul_single d e (a : A) (b : A)

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.FilteredRees.rees_eq_sum
statement:
theorem rees_eq_sum (p : rees F) :
    p = ∑ d ∈ (p : LaurentPolynomial A).coeff.support,
      homogeneous F d ⟨(p : LaurentPolynomial A).coeff d, p.property d⟩
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  change (p : LaurentPolynomial A) = (rees F).val
    (∑ d ∈ (p : LaurentPolynomial A).coeff.support,
      homogeneous F d ⟨(p : LaurentPolynomial A).coeff d, p.property d⟩)
  rw [map_sum]
  exact (AddMonoidAlgebra.sum_coeff_single (p : LaurentPolynomial A)).symm

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.FilteredRees.initial_add
statement:
theorem initial_add (hmono : Monotone F) (d : ℤ) (a b : F d) :
    initial F hmono d (a + b) = initial F hmono d a + initial F hmono d b
proof:
:= by
  rw [initial, initial, initial, ← map_add]
  congr 1
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact AddMonoidAlgebra.single_add d (a : A) (b : A)

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.FilteredRees.hom_ext
statement:
theorem hom_ext {S : Type*} [CommRing S] [Algebra k S]
    (hmono : Monotone F) (f g : Gr F hmono →ₐ[k] S)
    (h : ∀ (d : ℤ) (a : F d), f (initial F hmono d a) = g (initial F hmono d a)) :
    f = g
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective z
  rw [rees_eq_sum F p, map_sum, map_sum, map_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro d hd
  exact h d _

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.FilteredRees.adjoin_initials_eq_top
statement:
theorem adjoin_initials_eq_top (hmono : Monotone F) :
    Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range fun a : (d : ℤ) × (F d) => initial F hmono a.1 a.2) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  apply top_unique
  intro z hz
  obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective z
  rw [rees_eq_sum F p, map_sum]
  apply Subalgebra.sum_mem
  intro d hd
  exact Algebra.subset_adjoin ⟨⟨d, _⟩, rfl⟩

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.FilteredRees.coefficientLinear_coeff
statement:
@[simp] theorem coefficientLinear_coeff (f : A →ₗ[k] A)
    (p : LaurentPolynomial A) (d : ℤ) :
    (coefficientLinear f p).coeff d = f (p.coeff d)
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.FilteredRees.coefficientLinear_single
statement:
@[simp] theorem coefficientLinear_single (f : A →ₗ[k] A) (d : ℤ) (a : A) :
    coefficientLinear f (single d a) = single d (f a)
proof:
:= by
  ext i
  rw [coefficientLinear_coeff]
  simp only [coeff_single, Finsupp.single_apply]
  split_ifs <;> simp only [map_zero]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.FilteredRees.coefficientLinear_leibniz
statement:
private theorem coefficientLinear_leibniz (D : Derivation k A A)
    (p q : LaurentPolynomial A) :
    coefficientLinear D.toLinearMap (p * q) =
      p * coefficientLinear D.toLinearMap q + q * coefficientLinear D.toLinearMap p
proof:
:= by
  induction p using AddMonoidAlgebra.induction_linear with
  | zero => simp only [zero_mul, map_zero, mul_zero, add_zero]
  | add p₁ p₂ ih₁ ih₂ =>
      simp only [add_mul, map_add, ih₁, ih₂, mul_add]
      abel
  | single i a =>
      induction q using AddMonoidAlgebra.induction_linear with
      | zero => simp only [zero_mul, map_zero, mul_zero, add_zero]
      | add q₁ q₂ ih₁ ih₂ =>
          simp only [mul_add, map_add, ih₁, ih₂, add_mul]
          abel
      | single j b =>
          simp only [single_mul_single, coefficientLinear_single]
          change single (i + j) (D (a * b)) =
            single (i + j) (a * D b) + single (j + i) (b * D a)
          rw [Derivation.leibniz, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul, single_add]
          rw [add_comm j i]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.FilteredRees.coefficientDerivation_coeff
statement:
@[simp] theorem coefficientDerivation_coeff (D : Derivation k A A)
    (p : LaurentPolynomial A) (d : ℤ) :
    (coefficientDerivation D p).coeff d = D (p.coeff d)
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.FilteredRees.coefficientDerivation_single
statement:
@[simp] theorem coefficientDerivation_single (D : Derivation k A A)
    (d : ℤ) (a : A) :
    coefficientDerivation D (single d a) = single d (D a)
proof:
:=
  coefficientLinear_single D.toLinearMap d a

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.FilteredRees.shiftedDerivation_coeff
statement:
@[simp] theorem shiftedDerivation_coeff (D : Derivation k A A) (m : ℤ)
    (p : LaurentPolynomial A) (d : ℤ) :
    (shiftedDerivation D m p).coeff d = D (p.coeff (d - m))
proof:
:= by
  change (single m 1 * coefficientDerivation D p).coeff d = _
  rw [coeff_single_mul_apply, one_mul, coefficientDerivation_coeff]
  congr 2
  omega

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.FilteredRees.shiftedDerivation_single
statement:
@[simp] theorem shiftedDerivation_single (D : Derivation k A A) (m d : ℤ) (a : A) :
    shiftedDerivation D m (single d a) = single (d + m) (D a)
proof:
:= by
  change single m 1 * coefficientDerivation D (single d a) = _
  rw [coefficientDerivation_single, single_mul_single, one_mul, add_comm]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.FilteredRees.shiftedDerivation_iterate_single
statement:
theorem shiftedDerivation_iterate_single (D : Derivation k A A)
    (m d : ℤ) (a : A) (n : ℕ) :
    ((shiftedDerivation D m : LaurentPolynomial A → LaurentPolynomial A)^[n])
      (single d a) = single (d + (n : ℤ) * m) (((D : A → A)^[n]) a)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp only [Function.iterate_zero_apply, Nat.cast_zero, zero_mul, add_zero]
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply', ih, shiftedDerivation_single,
        Function.iterate_succ_apply']
      congr 1
      push_cast
      ring

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.FilteredRees.shiftedDerivation_locallyNilpotent
statement:
theorem shiftedDerivation_locallyNilpotent (D : Derivation k A A) (m : ℤ)
    (hD : ∀ a, ∃ n, ((D : A → A)^[n]) a = 0) :
    ∀ p : LaurentPolynomial A,
      ∃ n, ((shiftedDerivation D m : LaurentPolynomial A → LaurentPolynomial A)^[n]) p = 0
proof:
:= by
  intro p
  have hzero : ∀ n, ((shiftedDerivation D m : LaurentPolynomial A → LaurentPolynomial A)^[n]) 0 = 0 :=
    fun n => Function.iterate_fixed (map_zero (shiftedDerivation D m)) n
  have hadd : ∀ n (p q : LaurentPolynomial A),
      ((shiftedDerivation D m : LaurentPolynomial A → LaurentPolynomial A)^[n]) (p + q) =
      ((shiftedDerivation D m : LaurentPolynomial A → LaurentPolynomial A)^[n]) p +
      ((shiftedDerivation D m : LaurentPolynomial A → LaurentPolynomial A)^[n]) q := by
    intro n p q
    induction n with
    | zero => rfl
    | succ n ih => simp only [Function.iterate_succ_apply', ih, map_add]
  induction p using AddMonoidAlgebra.induction_linear with
  | zero => exact ⟨0, rfl⟩
  | add p q hp hq =>
      obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hp
      obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := hq
      refine ⟨n + l, ?_⟩
      rw [hadd]
      have hpn : ((shiftedDerivation D m : LaurentPolynomial A → LaurentPolynomial A)^[n+l]) p = 0 := by
        rw [Nat.add_comm, Function.iterate_add_apply, hn, hzero]
      have hql : ((shiftedDerivation D m : LaurentPolynomial A → LaurentPolynomial A)^[n+l]) q = 0 := by
        rw [Function.iterate_add_apply, hl, hzero]
      rw [hpn, hql, add_zero]
  | single d a =>
      obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hD a
      exact ⟨n, by rw [shiftedDerivation_iterate_single, hn, single_zero]⟩

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.FilteredRees.reesDerivation_coe
statement:
@[simp] theorem reesDerivation_coe (p : rees F) :
    (reesDerivation F D m hshift p : LaurentPolynomial A) = shiftedDerivation D m p
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.FilteredRees.reesDerivation_parameter
statement:
@[simp] theorem reesDerivation_parameter (hmono : Monotone F) :
    reesDerivation F D m hshift (parameter F hmono) = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  change shiftedDerivation D m (single 1 1) = 0
  rw [shiftedDerivation_single, Derivation.map_one_eq_zero, single_zero]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.FilteredRees.reesDerivation_preserves_parameterIdeal
statement:
theorem reesDerivation_preserves_parameterIdeal (hmono : Monotone F)
    (p : rees F) (hp : p ∈ parameterIdeal F hmono) :
    reesDerivation F D m hshift p ∈ parameterIdeal F hmono
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, rfl⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mp hp
  rw [Derivation.leibniz, reesDerivation_parameter, smul_zero, add_zero]
  exact Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mpr ⟨reesDerivation F D m hshift q, rfl⟩

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.FilteredRees.gradedDerivation_mk
statement:
@[simp] theorem gradedDerivation_mk (hmono : Monotone F) (p : rees F) :
    gradedDerivation F D m hshift hmono (Ideal.Quotient.mk (parameterIdeal F hmono) p) =
      Ideal.Quotient.mk (parameterIdeal F hmono) (reesDerivation F D m hshift p)
proof:
:=
  Derivation.liftOfSurjective_apply _ _ p

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.FilteredRees.gradedDerivation_initial
statement:
theorem gradedDerivation_initial (hmono : Monotone F) (d : ℤ) (a : F d) :
    gradedDerivation F D m hshift hmono (initial F hmono d a) =
      initial F hmono (d + m) ⟨D a, hshift d a a.property⟩
proof:
:= by
  rw [initial, gradedDerivation_mk]
  congr 1
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact shiftedDerivation_single D m d a

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.FilteredRees.reesDerivation_iterate_coe
statement:
theorem reesDerivation_iterate_coe (p : rees F) (n : ℕ) :
    (((reesDerivation F D m hshift : rees F → rees F)^[n]) p : LaurentPolynomial A) =
      ((shiftedDerivation D m : LaurentPolynomial A → LaurentPolynomial A)^[n]) p
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply', reesDerivation_coe, ih,
        Function.iterate_succ_apply']

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.FilteredRees.reesDerivation_locallyNilpotent
statement:
theorem reesDerivation_locallyNilpotent
    (hD : ∀ a, ∃ n, ((D : A → A)^[n]) a = 0) :
    ∀ p : rees F, ∃ n, ((reesDerivation F D m hshift : rees F → rees F)^[n]) p = 0
proof:
:= by
  intro p
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := shiftedDerivation_locallyNilpotent D m hD (p : LaurentPolynomial A)
  refine ⟨n, Subtype.ext ?_⟩
  rw [reesDerivation_iterate_coe]
  exact hn

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.FilteredRees.gradedDerivation_iterate_mk
statement:
theorem gradedDerivation_iterate_mk (hmono : Monotone F) (p : rees F) (n : ℕ) :
    ((gradedDerivation F D m hshift hmono : Gr F hmono → Gr F hmono)^[n])
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (parameterIdeal F hmono) p) =
    Ideal.Quotient.mk (parameterIdeal F hmono)
      (((reesDerivation F D m hshift : rees F → rees F)^[n]) p)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply', ih, gradedDerivation_mk,
        Function.iterate_succ_apply']

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.FilteredRees.gradedDerivation_locallyNilpotent
statement:
theorem gradedDerivation_locallyNilpotent (hmono : Monotone F)
    (hD : ∀ a, ∃ n, ((D : A → A)^[n]) a = 0) :
    ∀ p : Gr F hmono,
      ∃ n, ((gradedDerivation F D m hshift hmono : Gr F hmono → Gr F hmono)^[n]) p = 0
proof:
:= by
  intro p
  obtain ⟨q, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective p
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := reesDerivation_locallyNilpotent F D m hshift hD q
  exact ⟨n, by rw [gradedDerivation_iterate_mk, hn, map_zero]⟩

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.FilteredRees.gradedDerivation_ne_zero
statement:
theorem gradedDerivation_ne_zero (hmono : Monotone F) (d : ℤ) (a : F d)
    (hDa : D a ∉ F (d + m - 1)) :
    gradedDerivation F D m hshift hmono ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hzero
  have hz := congrArg (fun E : Derivation k (Gr F hmono) (Gr F hmono) =>
    E (initial F hmono d a)) hzero
  rw [gradedDerivation_initial, Derivation.zero_apply] at hz
  exact hDa ((initial_eq_zero_iff F hmono (d + m) _).mp hz)

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.FilteredRees.gradedDerivation_initial_eq_zero
statement:
theorem gradedDerivation_initial_eq_zero (hmono : Monotone F) (d : ℤ) (a : F d)
    (ha : D a = 0) :
    gradedDerivation F D m hshift hmono (initial F hmono d a) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [gradedDerivation_initial, initial_eq_zero_iff]
  change D a ∈ F (d + m - 1)
  rw [ha]
  exact (F (d + m - 1)).zero_mem

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.Filtration.image_monomial_mem
statement:
theorem image_monomial_mem (φ : MvPolynomial (Fin 5) K →ₐ[K] A)
    (s : Fin 5 →₀ ℕ) (c : K) :
    φ (monomial s c) ∈ imagePiece φ (monomialWeight s)
proof:
:=
  ⟨monomial s c, monomial_mem_piece K le_rfl c, rfl⟩

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.Filtration.monomialWeight_single
statement:
theorem monomialWeight_single (i : Fin 5) (n : ℕ) :
    monomialWeight (Finsupp.single i n) =
      n • monomialWeight (Finsupp.single i 1)
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases i <;> simp [monomialWeight]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.Filtration.derivation_mul_mem_imagePiece
statement:
theorem derivation_mul_mem_imagePiece
    (φ : MvPolynomial (Fin 5) K →ₐ[K] A) (D : Derivation K A A)
    {a b : A} {d e m : ℤ}
    (ha : a ∈ imagePiece φ d) (hb : b ∈ imagePiece φ e)
    (hDa : D a ∈ imagePiece φ (d + m))
    (hDb : D b ∈ imagePiece φ (e + m)) :
    D (a * b) ∈ imagePiece φ (d + e + m)
proof:
:= by
  rw [D.leibniz, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul]
  apply (imagePiece φ _).add_mem
  · simpa only [add_assoc] using mul_mem_imagePiece φ ha hDb
  · convert mul_mem_imagePiece φ hb hDa using 1
    congr 1
    omega

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.Filtration.derivation_pow_mem_imagePiece
statement:
theorem derivation_pow_mem_imagePiece
    (φ : MvPolynomial (Fin 5) K →ₐ[K] A) (D : Derivation K A A)
    {a : A} {d m : ℤ}
    (ha : a ∈ imagePiece φ d) (hDa : D a ∈ imagePiece φ (d + m))
    (n : ℕ) : D (a ^ n) ∈ imagePiece φ (n • d + m)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [pow_succ]
    convert derivation_mul_mem_imagePiece φ D (SetLike.pow_mem_graded n ha) ha ih hDa using 1
    congr 1
    simp only [succ_nsmul]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.Filtration.derivation_monomial_mem_imagePiece
statement:
theorem derivation_monomial_mem_imagePiece
    (φ : MvPolynomial (Fin 5) K →ₐ[K] A) (D : Derivation K A A) (m : ℤ)
    (hD : ∀ i : Fin 5, D (φ (X i)) ∈
      imagePiece φ (monomialWeight (Finsupp.single i 1) + m))
    (s : Fin 5 →₀ ℕ) (c : K) :
    D (φ (monomial s c)) ∈ imagePiece φ (monomialWeight s + m)
proof:
:= by
  have hone : ∀ s : Fin 5 →₀ ℕ,
      D (φ (monomial s 1)) ∈ imagePiece φ (monomialWeight s + m) := by
    intro s
    induction s using Finsupp.induction with
    | zero => simp
    | single_add i n s hni hn ih =>
      rw [add_comm (Finsupp.single i n), monomial_add_single, map_mul]
      have hpow := derivation_pow_mem_imagePiece φ D
        (image_monomial_mem φ (Finsupp.single i 1) 1) (hD i) n
      change D (φ (X i) ^ n) ∈ _ at hpow
      have hmul := derivation_mul_mem_imagePiece φ D
        (image_monomial_mem φ s 1)
        (SetLike.pow_mem_graded n (image_monomial_mem φ (Finsupp.single i 1) 1))
        ih hpow
      rw [map_add, monomialWeight_single i n]
      simpa only [map_pow, MvPolynomial.X] using hmul
  have hsmul := (imagePiece φ _).smul_mem c (hone s)
  have hmono : monomial s c = c • (monomial s 1 : MvPolynomial (Fin 5) K) := by
    simp only [smul_monomial, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
  rw [hmono, map_smul, Derivation.map_smul]
  exact hsmul

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.Filtration.derivation_source_piece_mem_imagePiece
statement:
theorem derivation_source_piece_mem_imagePiece
    (φ : MvPolynomial (Fin 5) K →ₐ[K] A) (D : Derivation K A A) (m : ℤ)
    (hD : ∀ i : Fin 5, D (φ (X i)) ∈
      imagePiece φ (monomialWeight (Finsupp.single i 1) + m))
    {q : MvPolynomial (Fin 5) K} {d : ℤ} (hq : q ∈ piece K d) :
    D (φ q) ∈ imagePiece φ (d + m)
proof:
:= by
  induction hq using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem q hq =>
    obtain ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩ := hq
    have hsm : monomialWeight s + m ≤ d + m := by omega
    exact imagePiece_mono φ hsm
      (derivation_monomial_mem_imagePiece φ D m hD s 1)
  | zero => simp
  | add q r hq hr ihq ihr =>
    simpa only [map_add] using (imagePiece φ _).add_mem ihq ihr
  | smul c q hq ihq =>
    simpa only [map_smul, Derivation.map_smul] using (imagePiece φ _).smul_mem c ihq

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.Filtration.derivation_imagePiece_le
statement:
theorem derivation_imagePiece_le
    (φ : MvPolynomial (Fin 5) K →ₐ[K] A) (D : Derivation K A A) (m : ℤ)
    (hD : ∀ i : Fin 5, D (φ (X i)) ∈
      imagePiece φ (monomialWeight (Finsupp.single i 1) + m))
    (d : ℤ) :
    imagePiece φ d ≤ (imagePiece φ (d + m)).comap D.toLinearMap
proof:
:= by
  rintro a ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩
  exact derivation_source_piece_mem_imagePiece φ D m hD hq

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.Filtration.derivation_eq_zero_of_generator_values
statement:
theorem derivation_eq_zero_of_generator_values
    (φ : MvPolynomial (Fin 5) K →ₐ[K] A) (hφ : Function.Surjective φ)
    (D : Derivation K A A) (hD : ∀ i : Fin 5, D (φ (X i)) = 0) : D = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext a
  obtain ⟨q, rfl⟩ := hφ a
  change D (φ q) = 0
  induction q using MvPolynomial.induction_on with
  | C c => simp
  | add q r ihq ihr => simp [ihq, ihr]
  | mul_X q i ihq => simp [D.leibniz, ihq, hD]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.Filtration.exists_ne_zero_generator_value
statement:
theorem exists_ne_zero_generator_value
    (φ : MvPolynomial (Fin 5) K →ₐ[K] A) (hφ : Function.Surjective φ)
    (D : Derivation K A A) (hD : D ≠ 0) :
    ∃ i : Fin 5, D (φ (X i)) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h
  push Not at h
  exact hD (derivation_eq_zero_of_generator_values φ hφ D h)

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.Filtration.exists_derivation_imagePiece_shift
statement:
theorem exists_derivation_imagePiece_shift
    (φ : MvPolynomial (Fin 5) K →ₐ[K] A) (hφ : Function.Surjective φ)
    (D : Derivation K A A) :
    ∃ m : ℤ, ∀ d : ℤ,
      imagePiece φ d ≤ (imagePiece φ (d + m)).comap D.toLinearMap
proof:
:= by
  classical
  choose degree hdegree using fun i : Fin 5 =>
    exists_mem_imagePiece φ hφ (D (φ (X i)))
  obtain ⟨i, _, himax⟩ := Finset.exists_max_image Finset.univ
    (fun i : Fin 5 => degree i - monomialWeight (Finsupp.single i 1))
    (Finset.univ_nonempty : (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 5)).Nonempty)
  refine ⟨degree i - monomialWeight (Finsupp.single i 1), ?_⟩
  apply derivation_imagePiece_le φ D
  intro j
  apply imagePiece_mono φ _ (hdegree j)
  have hj := himax j (Finset.mem_univ j)
  omega

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.Filtration.exists_attained_derivation_imagePiece_shift
statement:
theorem exists_attained_derivation_imagePiece_shift
    (φ : MvPolynomial (Fin 5) K →ₐ[K] A) (hφ : Function.Surjective φ)
    (hsep : (⨅ d : ℤ, imagePiece φ d) = ⊥)
    (D : Derivation K A A) (hD : D ≠ 0) :
    ∃ (m : ℤ) (i : Fin 5),
      D (φ (X i)) ≠ 0 ∧
      D (φ (X i)) ∈ imagePiece φ (monomialWeight (Finsupp.single i 1) + m) ∧
      D (φ (X i)) ∉ imagePiece φ (monomialWeight (Finsupp.single i 1) + m - 1) ∧
      ∀ d : ℤ, imagePiece φ d ≤ (imagePiece φ (d + m)).comap D.toLinearMap
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let F : ℤ → Set A := fun d => (imagePiece φ d : Set A)
  have hmono : Monotone F := fun _ _ h => imagePiece_mono φ h
  have hext : ∀ a : A, ∃ d : ℤ, a ∈ F d := exists_mem_imagePiece φ hφ
  have hseparated : ∀ a : A, (∀ d : ℤ, a ∈ F d) → a = 0 :=
    IntegerFiltration.separated_of_iInf_eq_bot (imagePiece φ) hsep
  let deg : Fin 5 → ℤ := fun i => IntegerFiltration.degree F (D (φ (X i)))
  let S : Finset (Fin 5) := Finset.univ.filter fun i => D (φ (X i)) ≠ 0
  have hS : S.Nonempty := by
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := exists_ne_zero_generator_value φ hφ D hD
    exact ⟨i, Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ i, hi⟩⟩
  obtain ⟨i, hi, himax⟩ := Finset.exists_max_image S
    (fun i : Fin 5 => deg i - monomialWeight (Finsupp.single i 1)) hS
  have hiD : D (φ (X i)) ≠ 0 := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).2
  let m : ℤ := deg i - monomialWeight (Finsupp.single i 1)
  have him : monomialWeight (Finsupp.single i 1) + m = deg i := by
    dsimp [m]
    omega
  have hbounded : ∀ j : Fin 5, D (φ (X j)) ∈
      imagePiece φ (monomialWeight (Finsupp.single j 1) + m) := by
    intro j
    by_cases hjD : D (φ (X j)) = 0
    · rw [hjD]
      exact (imagePiece φ _).zero_mem
    · have hj : j ∈ S := Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ j, hjD⟩
      have hmax := himax j hj
      have hdeg := (IntegerFiltration.degree_spec F hmono hext hseparated hjD).1
      apply imagePiece_mono φ _ hdeg
      change deg j ≤ monomialWeight (Finsupp.single j 1) +
        (deg i - monomialWeight (Finsupp.single i 1))
      omega
  refine ⟨m, i, hiD, hbounded i, ?_, derivation_imagePiece_le φ D m hbounded⟩
  rw [him]
  exact IntegerFiltration.not_mem_degree_sub_one F hmono hext hseparated hiD

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.Filtration.exists_attained_derivation_shift_with_initial_generator
statement:
theorem exists_attained_derivation_shift_with_initial_generator
    (φ : MvPolynomial (Fin 5) K →ₐ[K] A) (hφ : Function.Surjective φ)
    (hsep : (⨅ d : ℤ, imagePiece φ d) = ⊥)
    (D : Derivation K A A) (hD : D ≠ 0) :
    ∃ (m : ℤ) (i : Fin 5),
      φ (X i) ∈ imagePiece φ (monomialWeight (Finsupp.single i 1)) ∧
      φ (X i) ∉ imagePiece φ (monomialWeight (Finsupp.single i 1) - 1) ∧
      D (φ (X i)) ∈ imagePiece φ (monomialWeight (Finsupp.single i 1) + m) ∧
      D (φ (X i)) ∉ imagePiece φ (monomialWeight (Finsupp.single i 1) + m - 1) ∧
      ∀ d : ℤ, imagePiece φ d ≤ (imagePiece φ (d + m)).comap D.toLinearMap
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, i, _, hDi, hDiprev, hshift⟩ :=
    exists_attained_derivation_imagePiece_shift φ hφ hsep D hD
  refine ⟨m, i, image_monomial_mem φ (Finsupp.single i 1) 1, ?_, hDi, hDiprev, hshift⟩
  intro hiprev
  apply hDiprev
  have hm := hshift (monomialWeight (Finsupp.single i 1) - 1) hiprev
  change D (φ (X i)) ∈ imagePiece φ
    (monomialWeight (Finsupp.single i 1) - 1 + m) at hm
  convert hm using 1
  congr 1
  omega

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.Filtration.exists_attained_derivation_shift_of_nonunit
statement:
theorem exists_attained_derivation_shift_of_nonunit
    [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsDomain A]
    (φ : MvPolynomial (Fin 5) K →ₐ[K] A) (hφ : Function.Surjective φ)
    (hp : ¬ IsUnit (φ (X 0))) (D : Derivation K A A) (hD : D ≠ 0) :
    ∃ (m : ℤ) (i : Fin 5),
      φ (X i) ∈ imagePiece φ (monomialWeight (Finsupp.single i 1)) ∧
      φ (X i) ∉ imagePiece φ (monomialWeight (Finsupp.single i 1) - 1) ∧
      D (φ (X i)) ∈ imagePiece φ (monomialWeight (Finsupp.single i 1) + m) ∧
      D (φ (X i)) ∉ imagePiece φ (monomialWeight (Finsupp.single i 1) + m - 1) ∧
      ∀ d : ℤ, imagePiece φ d ≤ (imagePiece φ (d + m)).comap D.toLinearMap
proof:
:=
  exists_attained_derivation_shift_with_initial_generator φ hφ
    (iInf_imagePiece_eq_bot φ hp) D hD

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.Filtration.monomialWeight_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem monomialWeight_apply (e : Fin 5 →₀ ℕ) :
    monomialWeight e = (e 3 : ℤ) + (e 4 : ℤ) - (e 0 : ℤ)
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.Filtration.exponent_zero_ge_of_weight_le_neg
statement:
theorem exponent_zero_ge_of_weight_le_neg {e : Fin 5 →₀ ℕ} {r : ℕ}
    (h : monomialWeight e ≤ -(r : ℤ)) : r ≤ e 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [monomialWeight_apply] at h
  omega

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.Filtration.piece_mono
statement: theorem piece_mono : Monotone (piece K)
proof:
:= by
  intro d e hde
  apply Submodule.span_mono
  rintro q ⟨m, hm, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨m, hm.trans hde, rfl⟩

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.Filtration.pow_X_zero_dvd_monomial
proof:
:= by
  rw [X_pow_eq_monomial, monomial_dvd_monomial]
  refine ⟨Or.inr ?_, one_dvd _⟩
  exact Finsupp.single_le_iff.mpr (exponent_zero_ge_of_weight_le_neg h)

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.Filtration.piece_neg_le_span_pow
statement:
theorem piece_neg_le_span_pow (r : ℕ) :
    piece K (-(r : ℤ)) ≤
      (Ideal.span {((X (0 : Fin 5) : MvPolynomial (Fin 5) K) ^ r)}).restrictScalars K
proof:
:= by
  apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
  rintro q ⟨e, he, rfl⟩
  exact Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mpr (pow_X_zero_dvd_monomial K he 1)

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.Filtration.monomial_mem_piece
statement:
theorem monomial_mem_piece {e : Fin 5 →₀ ℕ} {d : ℤ}
    (h : monomialWeight e ≤ d) (c : K) : monomial e c ∈ piece K d
proof:
:= by
  have hm : monomial e (1 : K) ∈ piece K d :=
    Submodule.subset_span ⟨e, h, rfl⟩
  simpa only [smul_monomial, smul_eq_mul, mul_one] using (piece K d).smul_mem c hm

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.Filtration.mem_piece_iff
statement:
theorem mem_piece_iff {q : MvPolynomial (Fin 5) K} {d : ℤ} :
    q ∈ piece K d ↔ ∀ e ∈ q.support, monomialWeight e ≤ d
proof:
:= by
  classical
  constructor
  · intro hq
    induction hq using Submodule.span_induction with
    | mem q hq =>
      obtain ⟨e, he, rfl⟩ := hq
      intro m hm
      have hm' : m = e := Finset.mem_singleton.mp (support_monomial_subset hm)
      simpa [hm'] using he
    | zero => simp
    | add q r hq hr ihq ihr =>
      intro e he
      rcases Finset.mem_union.mp (support_add he) with he | he
      · exact ihq e he
      · exact ihr e he
    | smul c q hq ihq =>
      intro e he
      exact ihq e (support_smul he)
  · intro hq
    rw [q.as_sum]
    apply Submodule.sum_mem
    intro e he
    exact monomial_mem_piece K (hq e he) _

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.Filtration.exists_mem_piece
statement:
theorem exists_mem_piece (q : MvPolynomial (Fin 5) K) :
    ∃ d : ℤ, q ∈ piece K d
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine ⟨(q.support.sup fun e => (monomialWeight e).toNat : ℕ), mem_piece_iff K |>.mpr ?_⟩
  intro e he
  have hsup : (monomialWeight e).toNat ≤ q.support.sup (fun e => (monomialWeight e).toNat) :=
    Finset.le_sup (f := fun e => (monomialWeight e).toNat) he
  omega

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.Filtration.one_mem_piece
statement: theorem one_mem_piece : (1 : MvPolynomial (Fin 5) K) ∈ piece K 0
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [monomial_zero', C_1] using
    (monomial_mem_piece K (e := 0) (d := 0) (by simp) 1)

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.Filtration.mul_mem_piece
statement:
theorem mul_mem_piece {q r : MvPolynomial (Fin 5) K} {d e : ℤ}
    (hq : q ∈ piece K d) (hr : r ∈ piece K e) : q * r ∈ piece K (d + e)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction hq, hr using Submodule.span_induction₂ with
  | mem_mem q r hq hr =>
    obtain ⟨m, hm, rfl⟩ := hq
    obtain ⟨n, hn, rfl⟩ := hr
    rw [monomial_mul_monomial]
    apply monomial_mem_piece
    simpa only [map_add] using add_le_add hm hn
  | zero_left => simp
  | zero_right => simp
  | add_left q r s hq hr hs ihq ihr =>
    rw [add_mul]
    exact (piece K _).add_mem ihq ihr
  | add_right q r s hq hr hs ihr ihs =>
    rw [mul_add]
    exact (piece K _).add_mem ihr ihs
  | smul_left c q r hq hr ihr =>
    rw [smul_mul_assoc]
    exact (piece K _).smul_mem c ihr
  | smul_right c q r hq hr ihr =>
    rw [mul_smul_comm]
    exact (piece K _).smul_mem c ihr

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.Filtration.imagePiece_mono
statement:
theorem imagePiece_mono (φ : MvPolynomial (Fin 5) K →ₐ[K] A) :
    Monotone (imagePiece φ)
proof:
:= by
  intro d e hde
  exact Submodule.map_mono (piece_mono K hde)

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.Filtration.exists_mem_imagePiece
statement:
theorem exists_mem_imagePiece (φ : MvPolynomial (Fin 5) K →ₐ[K] A)
    (hφ : Function.Surjective φ) (a : A) : ∃ d : ℤ, a ∈ imagePiece φ d
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, rfl⟩ := hφ a
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := exists_mem_piece K q
  exact ⟨d, q, hd, rfl⟩

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.Filtration.X_mem_piece
statement:
theorem X_mem_piece (i : Fin 5) :
    (X i : MvPolynomial (Fin 5) K) ∈ piece K (monomialWeight (Finsupp.single i 1))
proof:
:= by
  exact monomial_mem_piece K le_rfl 1

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.Filtration.X_zero_mem_piece_neg_one
statement:
theorem X_zero_mem_piece_neg_one :
    (X (0 : Fin 5) : MvPolynomial (Fin 5) K) ∈ piece K (-1)
proof:
:= by
  simpa [monomialWeight] using (X_mem_piece (K := K) 0)

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.Filtration.image_X_zero_mem_neg_one
statement:
theorem image_X_zero_mem_neg_one (φ : MvPolynomial (Fin 5) K →ₐ[K] A) :
    φ (X 0) ∈ imagePiece φ (-1)
proof:
:=
  ⟨X 0, X_zero_mem_piece_neg_one, rfl⟩

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.Filtration.mul_mem_imagePiece
statement:
theorem mul_mem_imagePiece (φ : MvPolynomial (Fin 5) K →ₐ[K] A)
    {a b : A} {d e : ℤ} (ha : a ∈ imagePiece φ d) (hb : b ∈ imagePiece φ e) :
    a * b ∈ imagePiece φ (d + e)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩ := ha
  obtain ⟨r, hr, rfl⟩ := hb
  exact ⟨q * r, mul_mem_piece K hq hr, map_mul φ q r⟩

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.Filtration.pow_dvd_of_mem_imagePiece_neg
statement:
theorem pow_dvd_of_mem_imagePiece_neg (φ : MvPolynomial (Fin 5) K →ₐ[K] A)
    {r : ℕ} {a : A} (ha : a ∈ imagePiece φ (-(r : ℤ))) :
    φ (X 0) ^ r ∣ a
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩ := ha
  have hdiv : (X (0 : Fin 5) : MvPolynomial (Fin 5) K) ^ r ∣ q :=
    Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mp (piece_neg_le_span_pow K r hq)
  simpa only [map_pow, AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply] using map_dvd φ hdiv

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.Filtration.eq_zero_of_mem_all_imagePieces
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_mem_all_imagePieces [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsDomain A]
    (φ : MvPolynomial (Fin 5) K →ₐ[K] A) (hp : ¬ IsUnit (φ (X 0)))
    {a : A} (ha : ∀ d : ℤ, a ∈ imagePiece φ d) : a = 0
proof:
:= by
  let I : Ideal A := Ideal.span {φ (X 0)}
  have hI : I ≠ ⊤ := by
    simpa only [I, ne_eq, Ideal.span_singleton_eq_top] using hp
  have hmem : a ∈ ⨅ r : ℕ, I ^ r := by
    apply Ideal.mem_iInf.mpr
    intro r
    change a ∈ (Ideal.span {φ (X 0)}) ^ r
    rw [Ideal.span_singleton_pow]
    exact Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mpr (pow_dvd_of_mem_imagePiece_neg φ (ha (-(r : ℤ))))
  rw [Ideal.iInf_pow_eq_bot_of_isDomain I hI] at hmem
  exact hmem

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.Filtration.iInf_imagePiece_eq_bot
statement:
theorem iInf_imagePiece_eq_bot [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsDomain A]
    (φ : MvPolynomial (Fin 5) K →ₐ[K] A) (hp : ¬ IsUnit (φ (X 0))) :
    (⨅ d : ℤ, imagePiece φ d) = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  apply eq_bot_iff.mpr
  intro a ha
  exact eq_zero_of_mem_all_imagePieces φ hp ((Submodule.mem_iInf _).mp ha)

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.FrameLift.iterateHom_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem iterateHom_apply (β : R →+* R[X]) (r : R) :
    iterateHom β r = (β r).map β
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.FrameLift.addParameterHom_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem addParameterHom_apply (β : R →+* R[X]) (r : R) :
    addParameterHom β r = taylor (X : R[X]) ((β r).map (C : R →+* R[X]))
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.FrameLift.outer_constantCoeff_agrees
statement:
theorem outer_constantCoeff_agrees (β : R →+* R[X])
    (hβ : ∀ r, (β r).coeff 0 = r) (r : R) :
    Polynomial.constantCoeff (iterateHom β r) =
      Polynomial.constantCoeff (addParameterHom β r)
proof:
:= by
  change ((β r).map β).coeff 0 =
    (taylor (X : R[X]) ((β r).map (C : R →+* R[X]))).coeff 0
  rw [Polynomial.coeff_map, hβ, CoactionLND.coeff_universal_translate]
  simp

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.FrameLift.coassociative_frame
statement:
theorem coassociative_frame [IsReduced R]
    (β : R →+* R[X]) (hβ : ∀ r, (β r).coeff 0 = r)
    (F : Frame R)
    (hbase : CoassociativeAt β (F.a*F.b) ∧
      CoassociativeAt β (F.d*F.c) ∧ CoassociativeAt β (F.d*F.b)) :
    F.map (iterateHom β) = F.map (addParameterHom β)
proof:
:= by
  let : IsReduced R[X] := ⟨by
    intro p hp
    ext n
    simpa using isNilpotent_iff_eq_zero.mp ((Polynomial.isNilpotent_iff.mp hp) n)⟩
  apply normalized_univariate_unique
  · change iterateHom β F.a * iterateHom β F.b =
      addParameterHom β F.a * addParameterHom β F.b ∧
      iterateHom β F.d * iterateHom β F.c =
      addParameterHom β F.d * addParameterHom β F.c ∧
      iterateHom β F.d * iterateHom β F.b =
      addParameterHom β F.d * addParameterHom β F.b
    simpa only [iterateHom_apply, addParameterHom_apply, CoassociativeAt,
      map_mul, Polynomial.map_mul, Polynomial.taylor_mul] using hbase
  · apply Frame.ext <;> exact outer_constantCoeff_agrees β hβ _

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.FrameLift.coassociative_on_frame_entries
statement:
theorem coassociative_on_frame_entries [IsReduced R]
    (β : R →+* R[X]) (hβ : ∀ r, (β r).coeff 0 = r)
    (F : Frame R)
    (hbase : CoassociativeAt β (F.a*F.b) ∧
      CoassociativeAt β (F.d*F.c) ∧ CoassociativeAt β (F.d*F.b)) :
    CoassociativeAt β F.a ∧ CoassociativeAt β F.d ∧
      CoassociativeAt β F.b ∧ CoassociativeAt β F.c
proof:
:= by
  have h := coassociative_frame β hβ F hbase
  exact ⟨congrArg Frame.a h, congrArg Frame.d h, congrArg Frame.b h, congrArg Frame.c h⟩

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.FrameLiftCoassoc.iterateMap_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem iterateMap_apply (β : A →ₐ[k] A[X]) (r : A) :
    iterateMap β r = (β r).map β.toRingHom
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.FrameLiftCoassoc.sumParameterMap_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem sumParameterMap_apply (β : A →ₐ[k] A[X]) (r : A) :
    sumParameterMap β r =
      taylor (X : A[X]) ((β r).map (C : A →+* A[X]))
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.FrameLiftCoassoc.coassoc_of_generators
statement:
theorem coassoc_of_generators
    (β : Obstruction.C k →ₐ[k] (Obstruction.C k)[X])
    (h : ∀ i : Fin 5,
      (β (Obstruction.cX k i)).map β.toRingHom =
        taylor (X : (Obstruction.C k)[X])
          ((β (Obstruction.cX k i)).map (C : Obstruction.C k →+* (Obstruction.C k)[X]))) :
    ∀ r, (β r).map β.toRingHom =
      taylor (X : (Obstruction.C k)[X]) ((β r).map (C : Obstruction.C k →+* (Obstruction.C k)[X]))
proof:
:= by
  have heq : iterateMap β = sumParameterMap β := by
    apply Ideal.Quotient.algHom_ext
    apply MvPolynomial.algHom_ext
    intro i
    change iterateMap β (Obstruction.cX k i) = sumParameterMap β (Obstruction.cX k i)
    exact h i
  intro r
  exact AlgHom.congr_fun heq r

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.FrameLiftCoassoc.coassoc_of_normalized_extension
statement:
theorem coassoc_of_normalized_extension
    [IsReduced (Obstruction.C k)]
    (α : PolynomialAdditiveAction k (Obstruction.B k))
    (β : Obstruction.C k →ₐ[k] (Obstruction.C k)[X])
    (hidentity : ∀ r, (β r).coeff 0 = r)
    (hbase : ∀ b, β (BundleCharts.baseMap k b) =
      (α.toAlgHom b).map (BundleCharts.baseMap k).toRingHom) :
    ∀ r, (β r).map β.toRingHom =
      taylor (X : (Obstruction.C k)[X])
        ((β r).map (C : Obstruction.C k →+* (Obstruction.C k)[X]))
proof:
:= by
  let F : FrameLift.Frame (Obstruction.C k) :=
    ⟨Obstruction.cX k 0, Obstruction.cX k 1,
      Obstruction.cX k 2, Obstruction.cX k 3,
      sub_eq_zero.mp (Obstruction.c_relation k)⟩
  have hcoord (i : Fin 4) : FrameLift.CoassociativeAt β.toRingHom
      (BundleCharts.baseMap k (Obstruction.bX k i)) :=
    coassoc_on_image_of_extension α β (BundleCharts.baseMap k) hbase (Obstruction.bX k i)
  have hx : BundleCharts.baseMap k (Obstruction.bX k 0) =
      Obstruction.cX k 0 * Obstruction.cX k 2 := by
    change BundleCharts.baseMap k (BundleCharts.qgen k 0) = BundleCharts.dgen k 0 * BundleCharts.dgen k 2
    exact BundleCharts.baseMap_qgen k 0
  have hy : BundleCharts.baseMap k (Obstruction.bX k 1) =
      Obstruction.cX k 1 * Obstruction.cX k 3 := by
    change BundleCharts.baseMap k (BundleCharts.qgen k 1) = BundleCharts.dgen k 1 * BundleCharts.dgen k 3
    exact BundleCharts.baseMap_qgen k 1
  have hz : BundleCharts.baseMap k (Obstruction.bX k 2) =
      Obstruction.cX k 1 * Obstruction.cX k 2 := by
    change BundleCharts.baseMap k (BundleCharts.qgen k 2) = BundleCharts.dgen k 1 * BundleCharts.dgen k 2
    exact BundleCharts.baseMap_qgen k 2
  have hu : BundleCharts.baseMap k (Obstruction.bX k 3) =
      Obstruction.cX k 4 := by
    change BundleCharts.baseMap k (BundleCharts.qgen k 3) = BundleCharts.dgen k 4
    exact BundleCharts.baseMap_qgen k 3
  have hab : FrameLift.CoassociativeAt β.toRingHom (F.a * F.b) := by
    simpa only [hx] using hcoord 0
  have hdc : FrameLift.CoassociativeAt β.toRingHom (F.d * F.c) := by
    simpa only [hy] using hcoord 1
  have hdb : FrameLift.CoassociativeAt β.toRingHom (F.d * F.b) := by
    simpa only [hz] using hcoord 2
  have hF := FrameLift.coassociative_on_frame_entries β.toRingHom hidentity F
    ⟨hab, hdc, hdb⟩
  apply coassoc_of_generators β
  intro i
  fin_cases i
  · exact hF.1
  · exact hF.2.1
  · exact hF.2.2.1
  · exact hF.2.2.2
  · change FrameLift.CoassociativeAt β.toRingHom (Obstruction.cX k 4)
    simpa only [hu] using hcoord 3

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.FrameLiftCoassoc.actionOfNormalizedExtension_toAlgHom
statement:
@[simp] theorem actionOfNormalizedExtension_toAlgHom
    [IsReduced (Obstruction.C k)]
    (α : PolynomialAdditiveAction k (Obstruction.B k))
    (β : Obstruction.C k →ₐ[k] (Obstruction.C k)[X])
    (hidentity : ∀ r, (β r).coeff 0 = r)
    (hbase : ∀ b, β (BundleCharts.baseMap k b) =
      (α.toAlgHom b).map (BundleCharts.baseMap k).toRingHom) :
    (actionOfNormalizedExtension α β hidentity hbase).toAlgHom = β
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.FrameLift.Frame.ext
statement:
@[ext]
theorem Frame.ext {F G : Frame R}
    (ha : F.a = G.a) (hd : F.d = G.d) (hb : F.b = G.b) (hc : F.c = G.c) :
    F = G
proof: := by cases F; cases G; simp_all

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.FrameLift.sameBase_symm
statement: theorem sameBase_symm {F G : Frame R} (h : SameBase F G) : SameBase G F
proof:
:=
  ⟨h.1.symm, h.2.1.symm, h.2.2.symm⟩

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.FrameLift.comparison_a
statement:
theorem comparison_a {F G : Frame R} (h : SameBase F G) :
    comparison F G * F.a = G.a
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [comparison]
  linear_combination G.a * F.determinant + G.a * h.2.2 - G.d * h.1

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.FrameLift.comparison_d
statement:
theorem comparison_d {F G : Frame R} (h : SameBase F G) :
    comparison F G * F.d = G.d
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [comparison]
  linear_combination G.a * h.2.1 + G.d * G.determinant - G.d * h.2.2

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.FrameLift.comparison_b
statement:
theorem comparison_b {F G : Frame R} (h : SameBase F G) :
    comparison G F * F.b = G.b
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [comparison]
  linear_combination G.c * h.1 + G.b * G.determinant - G.b * h.2.2

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.FrameLift.comparison_c
statement:
theorem comparison_c {F G : Frame R} (h : SameBase F G) :
    comparison G F * F.c = G.c
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [comparison]
  linear_combination G.c * F.determinant + G.c * h.2.2 - G.b * h.2.1

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.FrameLift.comparison_mul_reverse
statement:
theorem comparison_mul_reverse {F G : Frame R} (h : SameBase F G) :
    comparison F G * comparison G F = 1
proof:
:= by
  calc
    comparison F G * comparison G F =
        comparison F G * comparison G F * (F.a * F.c - F.b * F.d) := by
      rw [F.determinant, mul_one]
    _ = (comparison F G * F.a) * (comparison G F * F.c) -
        (comparison G F * F.b) * (comparison F G * F.d) := by ring
    _ = 1 := by
      rw [comparison_a h, comparison_c h, comparison_b h, comparison_d h, G.determinant]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.FrameLift.comparison_self
statement:
@[simp]
theorem comparison_self (F : Frame R) : comparison F F = 1
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [comparison, mul_comm F.c F.a] using F.determinant

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.FrameLift.comparison_map
statement:
@[simp]
theorem comparison_map (f : R →+* S) (F G : Frame R) :
    comparison (F.map f) (G.map f) = f (comparison F G)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [comparison, Frame.map, map_sub, map_mul]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.FrameLift.comparison_unique
statement:
theorem comparison_unique (F G : Frame R) {q : R}
    (ha : q * F.a = G.a) (hd : q * F.d = G.d) : q = comparison F G
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [comparison]
  linear_combination -q * F.determinant + F.c * ha - F.b * hd

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.FrameLift.eq_of_comparison_eq_one
statement:
theorem eq_of_comparison_eq_one {F G : Frame R} (h : SameBase F G)
    (hq : comparison F G = 1) : F = G
proof:
:= by
  have hrev : comparison G F = 1 := by
    simpa only [hq, one_mul] using comparison_mul_reverse h
  apply Frame.ext
  · simpa only [hq, one_mul] using comparison_a h
  · simpa only [hq, one_mul] using comparison_d h
  · simpa only [hrev, one_mul] using comparison_b h
  · simpa only [hrev, one_mul] using comparison_c h

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.FrameLift.normalized_polynomial_unique
statement:
theorem normalized_polynomial_unique {σ : Type*} [IsReduced R]
    {F G : Frame (MvPolynomial σ R)} (h : SameBase F G)
    (hzero : F.map MvPolynomial.constantCoeff = G.map MvPolynomial.constantCoeff) :
    F = G
proof:
:= by
  have hu : IsUnit (comparison F G) := (comparisonUnit h).isUnit
  obtain ⟨r, _, hr⟩ := MvPolynomial.isUnit_iff_eq_C_of_isReduced.mp hu
  have heval : MvPolynomial.constantCoeff (comparison F G) = 1 := by
    rw [← comparison_map, hzero, comparison_self]
  have hr1 : r = 1 := by simpa only [hr, MvPolynomial.constantCoeff_C] using heval
  apply eq_of_comparison_eq_one h
  simpa only [hr1, map_one] using hr

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.FrameLift.Frame.scale_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem Frame.scale_one (F : Frame R) : F.scale 1 = F
proof:
:= by
  apply Frame.ext <;> simp [Frame.scale]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.FrameLift.Frame.scale_mul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem Frame.scale_mul (F : Frame R) (u v : Rˣ) :
    (F.scale u).scale v = F.scale (v * u)
proof:
:= by
  apply Frame.ext <;> simp [Frame.scale, mul_assoc, mul_left_comm, mul_comm]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.FrameLift.Frame.scale_sameBase
statement: theorem Frame.scale_sameBase (F : Frame R) (u : Rˣ) : SameBase (F.scale u) F
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [SameBase, Frame.scale]
  constructor
  · calc
      ((u : R) * F.a) * ((↑u⁻¹ : R) * F.b) =
          ((u : R) * (↑u⁻¹ : R)) * (F.a * F.b) := by ring
      _ = F.a * F.b := by simp
  constructor
  · calc
      ((u : R) * F.d) * ((↑u⁻¹ : R) * F.c) =
          ((u : R) * (↑u⁻¹ : R)) * (F.d * F.c) := by ring
      _ = F.d * F.c := by simp
  · calc
      ((u : R) * F.d) * ((↑u⁻¹ : R) * F.b) =
          ((u : R) * (↑u⁻¹ : R)) * (F.d * F.b) := by ring
      _ = F.d * F.b := by simp

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.FrameLift.Frame.map_scale
statement:
@[simp]
theorem Frame.map_scale (F : Frame R) (u : Rˣ) (f : R →+* S) :
    (F.scale u).map f = (F.map f).scale (Units.map f.toMonoidHom u)
proof:
:= by
  apply Frame.ext <;> simp [Frame.scale, Frame.map]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.FrameLift.scale_comparison
statement:
theorem scale_comparison {F G : Frame R} (h : SameBase F G) :
    F.scale (comparisonUnit h) = G
proof:
:= by
  apply Frame.ext
  · exact comparison_a h
  · exact comparison_d h
  · exact comparison_b h
  · exact comparison_c h

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.FrameLift.sameBase_trans
statement:
theorem sameBase_trans {F G H : Frame R} (hFG : SameBase F G) (hGH : SameBase G H) :
    SameBase F H
proof:
:=
  ⟨hFG.1.trans hGH.1, hFG.2.1.trans hGH.2.1, hFG.2.2.trans hGH.2.2⟩

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.FrameLift.normalizeFrame_sameBase
statement:
theorem normalizeFrame_sameBase (F : Frame (MvPolynomial σ R)) (G : Frame R)
    (h : SameBase (F.map constantCoeff) G) : SameBase (normalizeFrame F G h) F
proof:
:=
  F.scale_sameBase _

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.FrameLift.normalizeFrame_at_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem normalizeFrame_at_zero (F : Frame (MvPolynomial σ R)) (G : Frame R)
    (h : SameBase (F.map constantCoeff) G) :
    (normalizeFrame F G h).map constantCoeff = G
proof:
:= by
  rw [normalizeFrame, Frame.map_scale]
  have hu : Units.map constantCoeff.toMonoidHom
      (Units.map (C : R →+* MvPolynomial σ R).toMonoidHom (comparisonUnit h)) =
      comparisonUnit h := by
    apply Units.ext
    simp
  rw [hu, scale_comparison h]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.FrameLift.normalizeFrame_unique
statement:
theorem normalizeFrame_unique [IsReduced R]
    (F : Frame (MvPolynomial σ R)) (G : Frame R)
    (h : SameBase (F.map constantCoeff) G)
    (F' : Frame (MvPolynomial σ R)) (hbase : SameBase F' F)
    (hzero : F'.map constantCoeff = G) : F' = normalizeFrame F G h
proof:
:= by
  apply normalized_polynomial_unique
  · exact ⟨hbase.1.trans (normalizeFrame_sameBase F G h).1.symm,
      hbase.2.1.trans (normalizeFrame_sameBase F G h).2.1.symm,
      hbase.2.2.trans (normalizeFrame_sameBase F G h).2.2.symm⟩
  · rw [hzero, normalizeFrame_at_zero]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.FrameLift.Frame.specialize_map
statement:
theorem Frame.specialize_map (F : Frame (MvPolynomial σ R)) (θ : R →+* S) :
    (F.map (MvPolynomial.map θ)).map constantCoeff =
      (F.map constantCoeff).map θ
proof:
:= by
  apply Frame.ext <;> simp [Frame.map]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.FrameLift.normalized_lift_scaling_equivariance
statement:
theorem normalized_lift_scaling_equivariance [IsReduced R]
    (F : Frame (MvPolynomial σ R)) (F₀ : Frame R)
    (hzero : F.map constantCoeff = F₀)
    (θ : R →+* R) (u : Rˣ)
    (href : F₀.map θ = F₀.scale u)
    (hbase : SameBase (F.map (MvPolynomial.map θ)) F) :
    F.map (MvPolynomial.map θ) =
      F.scale (Units.map (C : R →+* MvPolynomial σ R).toMonoidHom u)
proof:
:= by
  apply normalized_polynomial_unique
  · exact sameBase_trans hbase (sameBase_symm (F.scale_sameBase _))
  · rw [Frame.specialize_map, hzero, href, Frame.map_scale, hzero]
    congr 1
    apply Units.ext
    simp

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.FrameLift.Frame.polynomialMap_relation
statement:
theorem Frame.polynomialMap_relation (F : Frame S) (u : S) :
    F.polynomialMap (k := k) u (Obstruction.determinantRelation k) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simpa [Frame.polynomialMap, Obstruction.determinantRelation] using
    sub_eq_zero.mpr F.determinant

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.FrameLift.Frame.ideal_le_ker_polynomialMap
statement:
theorem Frame.ideal_le_ker_polynomialMap (F : Frame S) (u : S) :
    Obstruction.idealC k ≤ RingHom.ker (F.polynomialMap (k := k) u).toRingHom
proof:
:= by
  rw [Obstruction.idealC, Ideal.span_singleton_le_iff_mem]
  exact F.polynomialMap_relation u

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.FrameLift.Frame.quotientMap_cX
statement:
@[simp] theorem Frame.quotientMap_cX (F : Frame S) (u : S) (i : Fin 5) :
    F.quotientMap (k := k) u (Obstruction.cX k i) = ![F.a, F.d, F.b, F.c, u] i
proof:
:= by
  change F.polynomialMap u (X i) = _
  simp [Frame.polynomialMap]

proof:
:=
  BundleCharts.baseMap_qgen k i

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.FrameLift.Frame.quotientMap_comp_baseMap
statement:
theorem Frame.quotientMap_comp_baseMap (F : Frame S) (u : S)
    (φ : Obstruction.B k →ₐ[k] S)
    (hx : F.a * F.b = φ (Obstruction.bX k 0))
    (hy : F.d * F.c = φ (Obstruction.bX k 1))
    (hz : F.d * F.b = φ (Obstruction.bX k 2))
    (hu : u = φ (Obstruction.bX k 3)) :
    (F.quotientMap u).comp (sourceBaseMap k) = φ
proof:
:= by
  apply quadric_algHom_ext
  intro i
  fin_cases i
  · simpa [AlgHom.comp_apply, baseMap_bX] using hx
  · simpa [AlgHom.comp_apply, baseMap_bX] using hy
  · simpa [AlgHom.comp_apply, baseMap_bX] using hz
  · simpa [AlgHom.comp_apply, baseMap_bX] using hu

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.FrameLift.comp_baseMap_eq_iff
statement:
theorem comp_baseMap_eq_iff {φ ψ : Obstruction.C k →ₐ[k] S} :
    φ.comp (sourceBaseMap k) = ψ.comp (sourceBaseMap k) ↔
      SameBase (frameOfHom φ) (frameOfHom ψ) ∧
      φ (Obstruction.cX k 4) = ψ (Obstruction.cX k 4)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · simpa [AlgHom.comp_apply, baseMap_bX] using AlgHom.congr_fun h (Obstruction.bX k 0)
    · simpa [AlgHom.comp_apply, baseMap_bX] using AlgHom.congr_fun h (Obstruction.bX k 1)
    · simpa [AlgHom.comp_apply, baseMap_bX] using AlgHom.congr_fun h (Obstruction.bX k 2)
    · simpa [AlgHom.comp_apply, baseMap_bX] using AlgHom.congr_fun h (Obstruction.bX k 3)
  · rintro ⟨⟨hx, hy, hz⟩, hu⟩
    apply quadric_algHom_ext
    intro i
    fin_cases i
    · simpa [AlgHom.comp_apply, baseMap_bX] using hx
    · simpa [AlgHom.comp_apply, baseMap_bX] using hy
    · simpa [AlgHom.comp_apply, baseMap_bX] using hz
    · simpa [AlgHom.comp_apply, baseMap_bX] using hu

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.FrameLift.normalized_quotientMap_unique
statement:
theorem normalized_quotientMap_unique {R σ : Type*} [CommRing R] [Algebra k R]
    [IsReduced R] {φ ψ : Obstruction.C k →ₐ[k] MvPolynomial σ R}
    (hbase : φ.comp (sourceBaseMap k) = ψ.comp (sourceBaseMap k))
    (hzero : (frameOfHom φ).map MvPolynomial.constantCoeff =
      (frameOfHom ψ).map MvPolynomial.constantCoeff) : φ = ψ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hF, hu⟩ := comp_baseMap_eq_iff.mp hbase
  exact determinant_algHom_ext_frame (normalized_polynomial_unique hF hzero) hu

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.FrameLift.Frame.map_map
statement:
@[simp] theorem Frame.map_map (F : Frame R) (f : R →+* S)
    {T : Type*} [CommRing T] (g : S →+* T) :
    (F.map f).map g = F.map (g.comp f)
proof:
:= by
  ext <;> rfl

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.FrameLift.sameBase_scale
statement: theorem sameBase_scale (F : Frame R) (q : Rˣ) : SameBase F (F.scale q)
proof:
:= by
  have hm (x y : R) : (↑q * x) * (↑q⁻¹ * y) = x * y := by
    calc
      (↑q * x) * (↑q⁻¹ * y) = (↑q * ↑q⁻¹) * (x * y) := by ring
      _ = x * y := by simp
  exact ⟨(hm _ _).symm, (hm _ _).symm, (hm _ _).symm⟩

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.FrameLift.normalized_univariate_unique
statement:
theorem normalized_univariate_unique [IsReduced R] {F G : Frame R[X]}
    (h : SameBase F G)
    (hzero : F.map Polynomial.constantCoeff = G.map Polynomial.constantCoeff) :
    F = G
proof:
:= by
  have hu : IsUnit (comparison F G) := (comparisonUnit h).isUnit
  have hp : comparison F G = C ((comparison F G).coeff 0) := by
    ext n
    by_cases hn : n = 0
    · subst n; simp
    · rw [coeff_C, ite_eq_right hn]
      exact isNilpotent_iff_eq_zero.mp
        ((Polynomial.isUnit_iff_coeff_isUnit_isNilpotent.mp hu).2 n hn)
  have heval : (comparison F G).coeff 0 = 1 := by
    change Polynomial.constantCoeff (comparison F G) = 1
    rw [← comparison_map, hzero, comparison_self]
  apply eq_of_comparison_eq_one h
  simpa only [heval, C_1] using hp

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.FrameLift.Frame.map_polynomial_constantCoeff
statement:
theorem Frame.map_polynomial_constantCoeff (F : Frame R[X]) (f : R →+* S) :
    (F.map (Polynomial.mapRingHom f)).map Polynomial.constantCoeff =
      (F.map Polynomial.constantCoeff).map f
proof:
:= by
  ext <;> simp [Frame.map, Polynomial.constantCoeff, Polynomial.coeff_map]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.FrameLift.normalized_frame_scaling
statement:
theorem normalized_frame_scaling [IsReduced S]
    (F : Frame R[X]) (F₀ : Frame R) (ρ ι : R →+* S) (q : Sˣ)
    (hnormal : F.map Polynomial.constantCoeff = F₀)
    (hzero : F₀.map ρ = (F₀.map ι).scale q)
    (hbase : SameBase (F.map (Polynomial.mapRingHom ρ))
      (F.map (Polynomial.mapRingHom ι))) :
    F.map (Polynomial.mapRingHom ρ) =
      (F.map (Polynomial.mapRingHom ι)).scale (Units.map (Polynomial.C : S →+* S[X]).toMonoidHom q)
proof:
:= by
  apply normalized_univariate_unique
  · exact sameBase_trans hbase (sameBase_scale _ _)
  · rw [Frame.map_polynomial_constantCoeff, hnormal, hzero, Frame.map_scale,
      Frame.map_polynomial_constantCoeff, hnormal]
    congr 1
    ext
    simp

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.FrameLift.sameBase_map_of_base_polynomials
statement:
theorem sameBase_map_of_base_polynomials
    {B : Type*} [CommRing B] (F : Frame R[X]) (j : B →+* R)
    (ρ ι : R →+* S) (hbase : ρ.comp j = ι.comp j)
    (x y z : B[X])
    (hx : F.a * F.b = x.map j)
    (hy : F.d * F.c = y.map j)
    (hz : F.d * F.b = z.map j) :
    SameBase (F.map (Polynomial.mapRingHom ρ))
      (F.map (Polynomial.mapRingHom ι))
proof:
:= by
  have hm (p : B[X]) : (p.map j).map ρ = (p.map j).map ι := by
    rw [Polynomial.map_map, Polynomial.map_map, hbase]
  change (F.a.map ρ) * (F.b.map ρ) = (F.a.map ι) * (F.b.map ι) ∧
    (F.d.map ρ) * (F.c.map ρ) = (F.d.map ι) * (F.c.map ι) ∧
    (F.d.map ρ) * (F.b.map ρ) = (F.d.map ι) * (F.b.map ι)
  simpa only [← Polynomial.map_mul, hx, hy, hz] using
    And.intro (hm x) (And.intro (hm y) (hm z))

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.FrameLift.normalized_frame_scaling_of_base
statement:
theorem normalized_frame_scaling_of_base [IsReduced S]
    {B : Type*} [CommRing B] (F : Frame R[X]) (F₀ : Frame R)
    (j : B →+* R) (ρ ι : R →+* S) (q : Sˣ)
    (hbase : ρ.comp j = ι.comp j)
    (x y z : B[X])
    (hx : F.a * F.b = x.map j)
    (hy : F.d * F.c = y.map j)
    (hz : F.d * F.b = z.map j)
    (hnormal : F.map Polynomial.constantCoeff = F₀)
    (hzero : F₀.map ρ = (F₀.map ι).scale q) :
    F.map (Polynomial.mapRingHom ρ) =
      (F.map (Polynomial.mapRingHom ι)).scale
        (Units.map (Polynomial.C : S →+* S[X]).toMonoidHom q)
proof:
:=
  normalized_frame_scaling F F₀ ρ ι q hnormal hzero
    (sameBase_map_of_base_polynomials F j ρ ι hbase x y z hx hy hz)

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.FrameLift.coefficient_scaling
statement:
theorem coefficient_scaling (F : Frame R[X]) (ρ ι : R →+* S) (q : Sˣ)
    (h : F.map (Polynomial.mapRingHom ρ) =
      (F.map (Polynomial.mapRingHom ι)).scale
        (Units.map (Polynomial.C : S →+* S[X]).toMonoidHom q)) (n : ℕ) :
    ρ (F.a.coeff n) = ↑q * ι (F.a.coeff n) ∧
    ρ (F.d.coeff n) = ↑q * ι (F.d.coeff n) ∧
    ρ (F.b.coeff n) = ↑q⁻¹ * ι (F.b.coeff n) ∧
    ρ (F.c.coeff n) = ↑q⁻¹ * ι (F.c.coeff n)
proof:
:= by
  have ha := congrArg (fun G : Frame S[X] => G.a.coeff n) h
  have hd := congrArg (fun G : Frame S[X] => G.d.coeff n) h
  have hb := congrArg (fun G : Frame S[X] => G.b.coeff n) h
  have hc := congrArg (fun G : Frame S[X] => G.c.coeff n) h
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa [Frame.map, Frame.scale] using ha
  · simpa [Frame.map, Frame.scale] using hd
  · simpa [Frame.map, Frame.scale] using hb
  · simpa [Frame.map, Frame.scale] using hc

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.GeometricInterpretation.hyperplaneIdeal_isPrime
statement: theorem hyperplaneIdeal_isPrime : hyperplaneIdeal.IsPrime

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.GeometricInterpretation.fiberIdeal_isPrime_of_affineFiber
statement:
theorem fiberIdeal_isPrime_of_affineFiber (t : ℂ) (h : IsAffineThreeSpaceFiber t) :
    (fiberIdeal t).IsPrime
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e⟩ := h
  let : IsDomain (FiberRing t) := Function.Injective.isDomain e e.injective
  exact (Ideal.Quotient.isDomain_iff_prime (fiberIdeal t)).mp inferInstance

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.GeometricInterpretation.rectifiableFiber_iff_schemeRectifiable
statement:
theorem rectifiableFiber_iff_schemeRectifiable (t : ℂ)
    (h : IsAffineThreeSpaceFiber t) :
    IsRectifiableFiber t ↔ IsSchemeRectifiableFiber t
proof:
:= by
  unfold IsRectifiableFiber IsSchemeRectifiableFiber fiberEmbedding
  rw [AffineGeometry.quotientEmbedding_range]
  exact AffineGeometry.ideal_transport_iff_scheme_transport (fiberIdeal t) hyperplaneIdeal
    (fiberIdeal_isPrime_of_affineFiber t h).isRadical hyperplaneIdeal_isPrime.isRadical

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.GeometricInterpretation.affineFiber_gives_schemeIso
statement:
theorem affineFiber_gives_schemeIso (t : ℂ) (h : IsAffineThreeSpaceFiber t) :
    Nonempty (AffineGeometry.algebraSpec ℂ (FiberRing t) ≅
      Over.mk (AffineSpace (Fin 3) (Spec (CommRingCat.of ℂ)) ↘
        Spec (CommRingCat.of ℂ)))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e⟩ := h
  exact ⟨AffineGeometry.affineSpaceOverIsoOfAlgEquiv e⟩

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.GeometricInterpretation.fiberPackage_gives_geometric_conclusion
statement:
theorem fiberPackage_gives_geometric_conclusion (h : FiberPackage) :
    ∀ t : ℂ,
      Nonempty (AffineGeometry.algebraSpec ℂ (FiberRing t) ≅
        Over.mk (AffineSpace (Fin 3) (Spec (CommRingCat.of ℂ)) ↘
          Spec (CommRingCat.of ℂ))) ∧
      IsClosedImmersion (fiberEmbedding t) ∧
      ¬ IsSchemeRectifiableFiber t
proof:
:= by
  intro t
  obtain ⟨haff, hnonrect⟩ := h t
  refine ⟨affineFiber_gives_schemeIso t haff, inferInstance, ?_⟩
  exact fun hrect => hnonrect ((rectifiableFiber_iff_schemeRectifiable t haff).mpr hrect)

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.Obstruction.mk_mem_gPiece
proof:
:=
  HomogeneousQuotient.mk_mem_piece _ _ hq

statement: theorem gX_mem_piece (i : Fin 5) : gX k i ∈ gPiece k (presentationWeight i)

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.Obstruction.mk_xP
statement: @[simp] theorem mk_xP : Ideal.Quotient.mk (idealG k) (xP k) = xG k
proof:
:= by

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.Obstruction.xG_mem_piece

proof:
:= by
