name: OAI.StableCoordinate.Obstruction.mul_mem_gPiece_zero
statement:
theorem mul_mem_gPiece_zero {a b : G k} (ha : a ∈ gPiece k 0) (hb : b ∈ gPiece k 0) :
    a * b ∈ gPiece k 0
proof:
:= by
  simpa using SetLike.GradedMul.mul_mem ha hb

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.Obstruction.yG_mem_piece
statement: theorem yG_mem_piece : yG k ∈ gPiece k 0
proof:
:= by
  have hs : gX k 1 ∈ gPiece k 0 := by simpa [presentationWeight] using gX_mem_piece k 1
  have hu : gX k 2 ∈ gPiece k 0 := by simpa [presentationWeight] using gX_mem_piece k 2
  have hu2 : gX k 2 ^ 2 ∈ gPiece k 0 := by
    simpa [pow_two] using mul_mem_gPiece_zero k hu hu
  exact (gPiece k 0).add_mem hs
    (mul_mem_gPiece_zero k (xG_mem_piece k) ((gPiece k 0).add_mem (xG_mem_piece k) hu2))

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.Obstruction.zG_mem_piece
statement: theorem zG_mem_piece : zG k ∈ gPiece k 0
proof:
:= by
  have hs : gX k 1 ∈ gPiece k 0 := by simpa [presentationWeight] using gX_mem_piece k 1
  have hpJ : gX k 0 * gX k 4 ∈ gPiece k 0 := by
    simpa [presentationWeight] using
      SetLike.GradedMul.mul_mem (gX_mem_piece k 0) (gX_mem_piece k 4)
  exact (gPiece k 0).add_mem (mul_mem_gPiece_zero k hs (xG_mem_piece k)) hpJ

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.Obstruction.uG_mem_piece
statement: theorem uG_mem_piece : gX k 2 ∈ gPiece k 0
proof:
:= by
  simpa [presentationWeight] using gX_mem_piece k 2

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.Obstruction.g_relation
statement:
theorem g_relation :
    xG k ^ 2 * gX k 3 - (1 + 2 * gX k 1 * xG k) * gX k 4 -
      gX k 0 * gX k 4 ^ 2 = 0
proof:
:= by
  simpa [Hstar, xP, xG, gX, map_ofNat] using mk_Hstar k

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.Obstruction.g_quadric_relation
statement: theorem g_quadric_relation : xG k * yG k - zG k * (zG k + 1) = 0
proof:
:= by
  calc
    xG k * yG k - zG k * (zG k + 1) =
      gX k 0 * (xG k ^ 2 * gX k 3 -
        (1 + 2 * gX k 1 * xG k) * gX k 4 - gX k 0 * gX k 4 ^ 2) := by
      unfold yG zG xG
      ring
    _ = 0 := by rw [g_relation k, mul_zero]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.Obstruction.baseToDegenerationPre_relation
statement:
theorem baseToDegenerationPre_relation :
    baseToDegenerationPre k (quadricRelation k) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simpa [baseToDegenerationPre, quadricRelation] using g_quadric_relation k

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.Obstruction.baseToDegeneration_mk
statement:
@[simp] theorem baseToDegeneration_mk (q : P k 4) :
    baseToDegeneration k (Ideal.Quotient.mk (idealB k) q) =
      baseToDegenerationPre k q
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.Obstruction.baseToDegeneration_bX
statement:
@[simp] theorem baseToDegeneration_bX (i : Fin 4) :
    baseToDegeneration k (bX k i) = ![xG k, yG k, zG k, gX k 2] i
proof:
:= by
  simp [bX, baseToDegeneration_mk, baseToDegenerationPre]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.Obstruction.baseToDegenerationPre_X_mem_piece
statement:
theorem baseToDegenerationPre_X_mem_piece (i : Fin 4) :
    baseToDegenerationPre k (X i) ∈ gPiece k 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [baseToDegenerationPre, aeval_X]
  fin_cases i
  · exact xG_mem_piece k
  · exact yG_mem_piece k
  · exact zG_mem_piece k
  · exact uG_mem_piece k

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.Obstruction.baseToDegeneration_mem_piece
statement:
theorem baseToDegeneration_mem_piece (q : B k) :
    baseToDegeneration k q ∈ gPiece k 0
proof:
:= by
  refine Quotient.inductionOn' q ?_
  intro p
  change baseToDegenerationPre k p ∈ gPiece k 0
  induction p using MvPolynomial.induction_on with
  | C r =>
      simp only [baseToDegenerationPre, aeval_C]
      rw [← (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ k (idealG k)).commutes r]
      exact mk_mem_gPiece k (isWeightedHomogeneous_C presentationWeight r)
  | add p q hp hq =>
      rw [map_add]
      exact (gPiece k 0).add_mem hp hq
  | mul_X p i hp =>
      rw [map_mul]
      exact mul_mem_gPiece_zero k hp (baseToDegenerationPre_X_mem_piece k i)

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.Obstruction.baseToDegeneration_sB
statement:
@[simp] theorem baseToDegeneration_sB :
    baseToDegeneration k (sB k) = gX k 1
proof:
:= by
  simp only [sB, map_sub, map_mul, map_add, map_pow, baseToDegeneration_bX]
  simp only [Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val,
    yG]
  ring

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.Obstruction.baseToDegeneration_f0
statement:
@[simp] theorem baseToDegeneration_f0 :
    baseToDegeneration k (f0 k) = gX k 0 * gX k 3
proof:
:= by
  simp only [f0, map_sub, map_add, map_pow, baseToDegeneration_bX, baseToDegeneration_sB]
  simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val, xG]
  ring

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.Obstruction.baseToDegeneration_g0
statement:
@[simp] theorem baseToDegeneration_g0 :
    baseToDegeneration k (g0 k) = gX k 0 * gX k 4
proof:
:= by
  simp only [g0, map_sub, map_mul, baseToDegeneration_bX, baseToDegeneration_sB]
  simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val, zG]
  ring

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.GradedPresentationKernel.mem_boundedImage_iff
statement:
theorem mem_boundedImage_iff (w : σ → ℤ)
    (φ : MvPolynomial σ k →ₐ[k] A) (p : MvPolynomial σ k) (d : ℤ) :
    φ p ∈ (boundedSubmodule w d).map φ.toLinearMap ↔
      ∃ r : MvPolynomial σ k, Bounded w r d ∧ φ r = φ p
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.GradedPresentationKernel.homogeneous_image_mem_lower_iff
statement:
theorem homogeneous_image_mem_lower_iff [IsDomain k]
    (w : σ → ℤ) (φ : MvPolynomial σ k →ₐ[k] A)
    (F : ℤ → Submodule k A)
    (hF : ∀ (p : MvPolynomial σ k) (d : ℤ),
      φ p ∈ F d ↔ ∃ r : MvPolynomial σ k, Bounded w r d ∧ φ r = φ p)
    (H : MvPolynomial σ k) (e : ℤ)
    (hH : Bounded w H e) (hHt : weightedHomogeneousComponent w e H ≠ 0)
    (hker : RingHom.ker φ.toRingHom = Ideal.span ({H} : Set (MvPolynomial σ k)))
    {p : MvPolynomial σ k} {d : ℤ} (hp : IsWeightedHomogeneous w p d) :
    φ p ∈ F (d - 1) ↔
      p ∈ Ideal.span ({weightedHomogeneousComponent w e H} : Set (MvPolynomial σ k))
proof:
:= by
  rw [hF p (d - 1), ← homogeneous_quotient_kernel_iff w H e hH hHt hp]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨r, hr, heq⟩
    refine ⟨r, hr, ?_⟩
    rw [← hker, RingHom.mem_ker]
    change φ (p - r) = 0
    rw [map_sub, heq, sub_self]
  · rintro ⟨r, hr, hpr⟩
    refine ⟨r, hr, ?_⟩
    rw [← hker, RingHom.mem_ker] at hpr
    change φ (p - r) = 0 at hpr
    rw [map_sub, sub_eq_zero] at hpr
    exact hpr.symm

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.GradedPresentationKernel.top_principal_mem_iff
statement:
theorem top_principal_mem_iff (w : σ → ℤ) (H p : MvPolynomial σ k) (e : ℤ) :
    p ∈ Ideal.span ({weightedHomogeneousComponent w e H} : Set (MvPolynomial σ k)) ↔
      ∀ d : ℤ, weightedHomogeneousComponent w d p ∈
        Ideal.span ({weightedHomogeneousComponent w e H} : Set (MvPolynomial σ k))
proof:
:= by
  let := weightedGradedAlgebra k w
  apply mem_iff_weightedHomogeneousComponent_mem
  apply Ideal.homogeneous_span
  intro q hq
  have hq' : q = weightedHomogeneousComponent w e H := Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hq
  subst q
  exact ⟨e, weightedHomogeneousComponent_isWeightedHomogeneous e H⟩

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.GradedPresentationKernel.kernel_eq_top_principal
statement:
theorem kernel_eq_top_principal [IsDomain k]
    (w : σ → ℤ) (φ : MvPolynomial σ k →ₐ[k] A)
    (F : ℤ → Submodule k A) [SetLike.GradedMonoid F] (hmono : Monotone F)
    (hF : ∀ (p : MvPolynomial σ k) (d : ℤ),
      φ p ∈ F d ↔ ∃ r : MvPolynomial σ k, Bounded w r d ∧ φ r = φ p)
    (H : MvPolynomial σ k) (e : ℤ)
    (hH : Bounded w H e) (hHt : weightedHomogeneousComponent w e H ≠ 0)
    (hker : RingHom.ker φ.toRingHom = Ideal.span ({H} : Set (MvPolynomial σ k)))
    (ψ : MvPolynomial σ k →ₐ[k] FilteredRees.rees F)
    (hcoeff : ∀ (p : MvPolynomial σ k) (d : ℤ),
      ((ψ p : FilteredRees.rees F) : LaurentPolynomial A).coeff d =
        φ (weightedHomogeneousComponent w d p)) :
    RingHom.ker ((Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ k (FilteredRees.parameterIdeal F hmono)).comp ψ).toRingHom =
      Ideal.span ({weightedHomogeneousComponent w e H} : Set (MvPolynomial σ k))
proof:
:= by
  ext p
  change Ideal.Quotient.mk (FilteredRees.parameterIdeal F hmono) (ψ p) = 0 ↔ _
  rw [FilteredRees.quotient_mk_eq_zero_iff]
  simp_rw [hcoeff]
  calc
    (∀ d : ℤ, φ (weightedHomogeneousComponent w d p) ∈ F (d - 1)) ↔
        ∀ d : ℤ, weightedHomogeneousComponent w d p ∈
          Ideal.span ({weightedHomogeneousComponent w e H} : Set (MvPolynomial σ k)) := by
      apply forall_congr'
      intro d
      exact homogeneous_image_mem_lower_iff w φ F hF H e hH hHt hker
        (weightedHomogeneousComponent_isWeightedHomogeneous d p)
    _ ↔ p ∈ Ideal.span ({weightedHomogeneousComponent w e H} : Set (MvPolynomial σ k)) :=
      (top_principal_mem_iff w H p e).symm

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.GradedPresentationMap.gradedMap_X
statement:
@[simp] theorem gradedMap_X (i : Fin 5) :
    gradedMap φ (X i) = initial (imagePiece φ) (imagePiece_mono φ)
      (monomialWeight (Finsupp.single i 1)) (variableElement φ i)
proof:
:= by
  simp [gradedMap, reesMap, initial]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.GradedPresentationMap.monomialWeight_single
statement:
theorem monomialWeight_single (i : Fin 5) (n : ℕ) :
    monomialWeight (Finsupp.single i n) =
      (n : ℤ) * monomialWeight (Finsupp.single i 1)
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases i <;> simp [monomialWeight]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.GradedPresentationMap.monomialWeight_eq_weight
statement:
theorem monomialWeight_eq_weight (w : Fin 5 → ℤ)
    (hw : ∀ i, w i = monomialWeight (Finsupp.single i 1)) :
    monomialWeight = Finsupp.weight w
proof:
:= by
  apply Finsupp.addHom_ext
  intro i n
  rw [monomialWeight_single, Finsupp.weight_single, hw]
  simp only [nsmul_eq_mul]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.GradedPresentationMap.reesMap_monomial_coe
statement:
theorem reesMap_monomial_coe (e : Fin 5 →₀ ℕ) (c : k) :
    (reesMap φ (monomial e c) : LaurentPolynomial A) =
      AddMonoidAlgebra.single (monomialWeight e) (φ (monomial e c))
proof:
:= by
  induction e using Finsupp.induction with
  | zero =>
      rw [monomial_zero', map_zero, algHom_C, algHom_C]
      rfl
  | single_add i n e hi hn ih =>
      rw [add_comm (Finsupp.single i n) e, monomial_add_single,
        map_mul, map_pow]
      change (reesMap φ (monomial e c) : LaurentPolynomial A) *
        (reesMap φ (X i) : LaurentPolynomial A) ^ n = _
      rw [ih]
      rw [map_add, monomialWeight_single i n]
      simp only [reesMap, aeval_X, homogeneous_coe, variableElement,
        AddMonoidAlgebra.single_pow, AddMonoidAlgebra.single_mul_single,
        nsmul_eq_mul]
      congr 1
      simp only [map_mul, map_pow]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.GradedPresentationMap.gradedMap_monomial
statement:
theorem gradedMap_monomial (e : Fin 5 →₀ ℕ) (c : k) :
    gradedMap φ (monomial e c) =
      initial (imagePiece φ) (imagePiece_mono φ) (monomialWeight e)
        (monomialElement φ e c)
proof:
:= by
  change Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (reesMap φ (monomial e c)) =
    Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (homogeneous _ _ _)
  congr 1
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact reesMap_monomial_coe φ e c

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.GradedPresentationMap.reesMap_coeff
statement:
theorem reesMap_coeff (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 5) k) (d : ℤ) :
    (reesMap φ p : LaurentPolynomial A).coeff d =
      φ (∑ e ∈ p.support, if monomialWeight e = d then monomial e (p.coeff e) else 0)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hp : reesMap φ p = ∑ e ∈ p.support, reesMap φ (monomial e (p.coeff e)) := by
    rw [← map_sum]
    exact congrArg (reesMap φ) p.as_sum
  rw [hp]
  change ((rees (imagePiece φ)).val
    (∑ e ∈ p.support, reesMap φ (monomial e (p.coeff e)))).coeff d = _
  rw [map_sum]
  simp only [AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_sum, Finsupp.finsetSum_apply, map_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro e he
  change (reesMap φ (monomial e (p.coeff e)) : LaurentPolynomial A).coeff d = _
  rw [reesMap_monomial_coe]
  by_cases h : monomialWeight e = d <;>
    simp only [AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_single, Finsupp.single_apply, h,
      ite_true, ite_false, map_zero]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.GradedPresentationMap.reesMap_coeff_weightedComponent
statement:
theorem reesMap_coeff_weightedComponent (w : Fin 5 → ℤ)
    (hw : ∀ i, w i = monomialWeight (Finsupp.single i 1))
    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 5) k) (d : ℤ) :
    (reesMap φ p : LaurentPolynomial A).coeff d =
      φ (weightedHomogeneousComponent w d p)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [reesMap_coeff, weightedHomogeneousComponent_apply]
  simp only [← monomialWeight_eq_weight w hw, Finset.sum_filter]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.GradedPresentationMap.reesMap_coe_of_homogeneous
statement:
theorem reesMap_coe_of_homogeneous (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 5) k) (d : ℤ)
    (hp : ∀ e ∈ p.support, monomialWeight e = d) :
    (reesMap φ p : LaurentPolynomial A) = AddMonoidAlgebra.single d (φ p)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have he : reesMap φ p = ∑ e ∈ p.support, reesMap φ (monomial e (p.coeff e)) := by
    rw [← map_sum]
    exact congrArg (reesMap φ) p.as_sum
  rw [he]
  change (rees (imagePiece φ)).val
    (∑ e ∈ p.support, reesMap φ (monomial e (p.coeff e))) = _
  rw [map_sum]
  calc
    ∑ e ∈ p.support, (reesMap φ (monomial e (p.coeff e)) : LaurentPolynomial A) =
        ∑ e ∈ p.support, AddMonoidAlgebra.single d (φ (monomial e (p.coeff e))) := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro e he
          rw [reesMap_monomial_coe, hp e he]
    _ = AddMonoidAlgebra.single d (φ p) := by
      change (∑ e ∈ p.support,
        (AddMonoidAlgebra.singleAddHom d) (φ (monomial e (p.coeff e)))) =
          (AddMonoidAlgebra.singleAddHom d) (φ p)
      rw [← map_sum (AddMonoidAlgebra.singleAddHom d), ← map_sum]
      exact congrArg (fun q => AddMonoidAlgebra.single d (φ q)) p.as_sum.symm

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.GradedPresentationMap.gradedMap_of_homogeneous
statement:
theorem gradedMap_of_homogeneous (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 5) k) (d : ℤ)
    (hp : ∀ e ∈ p.support, monomialWeight e = d) :
    gradedMap φ p = initial (imagePiece φ) (imagePiece_mono φ) d
      ⟨φ p, p, (mem_piece_iff k).mpr (fun e he => (hp e he).le), rfl⟩
proof:
:= by
  change Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (reesMap φ p) = Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (homogeneous _ _ _)
  congr 1
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact reesMap_coe_of_homogeneous φ p d hp

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.GradedPresentationMap.sourceInitial_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem sourceInitial_apply (d : ℤ) (p : piece k d) :
    sourceInitial φ d p = initial (imagePiece φ) (imagePiece_mono φ) d
      ⟨φ p, p, p.property, rfl⟩
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.GradedPresentationMap.sourceInitial_monomial_mem_range
statement:
theorem sourceInitial_monomial_mem_range (e : Fin 5 →₀ ℕ) (c : k)
    (d : ℤ) (h : monomialWeight e ≤ d) :
    sourceInitial φ d ⟨monomial e c, monomial_mem_piece k h c⟩ ∈
      (gradedMap φ).range
proof:
:= by
  by_cases he : monomialWeight e = d
  · subst d
    exact ⟨monomial e c, gradedMap_monomial φ e c⟩
  · have hl : monomialWeight e ≤ d - 1 := by omega
    have hz : sourceInitial φ d ⟨monomial e c, monomial_mem_piece k h c⟩ = 0 := by
      rw [sourceInitial_apply, initial_eq_zero_iff]
      exact ⟨monomial e c, monomial_mem_piece k hl c, rfl⟩
    rw [hz]
    exact (gradedMap φ).range.zero_mem

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.GradedPresentationMap.linear_span_range
statement:
private theorem linear_span_range
    {M N : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] [AddCommMonoid N]
    [Module k M] [Module k N] (s : Set M) (L : Submodule.span k s →ₗ[k] N)
    (S : Submodule k N)
    (h : ∀ (p : M) (hp : p ∈ s), L ⟨p, Submodule.subset_span hp⟩ ∈ S)
    (p : Submodule.span k s) : L p ∈ S
proof:
:= by
  rcases p with ⟨p, hp⟩
  induction hp using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem p hp => exact h p hp
  | zero =>
      change L 0 ∈ S
      rw [map_zero]
      exact S.zero_mem
  | add p q hp hq ihp ihq =>
      change L (⟨p, hp⟩ + ⟨q, hq⟩) ∈ S
      rw [map_add]
      exact S.add_mem ihp ihq
  | smul c p hp ihp =>
      change L (c • ⟨p, hp⟩) ∈ S
      rw [map_smul]
      exact S.smul_mem c ihp

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.GradedPresentationMap.sourceInitial_mem_range
statement:
theorem sourceInitial_mem_range (d : ℤ) (p : piece k d) :
    sourceInitial φ d p ∈ (gradedMap φ).range
proof:
:= by
  apply linear_span_range (k := k) _ (sourceInitial φ d)
    (gradedMap φ).range.toSubmodule _ p
  rintro q ⟨e, he, rfl⟩
  exact sourceInitial_monomial_mem_range φ e 1 d he

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.GradedPresentationMap.initial_mem_range
statement:
theorem initial_mem_range (d : ℤ) (a : imagePiece φ d) :
    initial (imagePiece φ) (imagePiece_mono φ) d a ∈ (gradedMap φ).range
proof:
:= by
  rcases a with ⟨a, ha⟩
  rcases ha with ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩
  exact sourceInitial_mem_range φ d ⟨p, hp⟩

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.GradedPresentationMap.gradedMap_surjective
statement: theorem gradedMap_surjective : Function.Surjective (gradedMap φ)
proof:
:= by
  intro z
  apply (AlgHom.mem_range (gradedMap φ)).mp
  obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective z
  rw [rees_eq_sum (imagePiece φ) p, map_sum]
  apply Subalgebra.sum_mem
  intro d hd
  exact initial_mem_range φ d _

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.Obstruction.p_not_dvd_Hstar
statement: theorem p_not_dvd_Hstar : ¬ (X 0 : P k 5) ∣ Hstar k
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have he := map_dvd (MvPolynomial.eval ![(0:k),0,0,0,1]) h
  simp [Hstar, xP] at he

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.Obstruction.Hstar_not_dvd_X
statement: theorem Hstar_not_dvd_X (i : Fin 5) : ¬ Hstar k ∣ (X i : P k 5)
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases i
  · intro h
    have he := map_dvd (MvPolynomial.eval ![(1:k),0,0,0,0]) h
    simp [Hstar, xP] at he
  · intro h
    have he := map_dvd (MvPolynomial.eval ![(0:k),1,0,0,0]) h
    simp [Hstar, xP] at he
  · intro h
    have he := map_dvd (MvPolynomial.eval ![(0:k),0,1,0,0]) h
    simp [Hstar, xP] at he
  · intro h
    have he := map_dvd (MvPolynomial.eval ![(0:k),0,0,1,0]) h
    simp [Hstar, xP] at he
  · intro h
    have he := map_dvd (MvPolynomial.eval ![(-1:k),0,0,0,1]) h
    simp [Hstar, xP] at he

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.Obstruction.gX_ne_zero
statement: theorem gX_ne_zero (i : Fin 5) : gX k i ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  apply Hstar_not_dvd_X k i
  exact Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mp (Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mp h)

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.Obstruction.weighted_sub
proof:
:=
  (weightedHomogeneousSubmodule k w n).sub_mem hf hg

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.Obstruction.xP_homogeneous
statement: theorem xP_homogeneous : (xP k).IsWeightedHomogeneous presentationWeight 0
proof:
:= by
  have hp := isWeightedHomogeneous_X k presentationWeight (0 : Fin 5)
  have hs := isWeightedHomogeneous_X k presentationWeight (1 : Fin 5)
  have hu := isWeightedHomogeneous_X k presentationWeight (2 : Fin 5)
  have hF := isWeightedHomogeneous_X k presentationWeight (3 : Fin 5)
  have hs2 : ((X 1 : P k 5)^2).IsWeightedHomogeneous presentationWeight 0 := by
    simpa [presentationWeight] using hs.pow 2
  have hu2 : ((X 2 : P k 5)^2).IsWeightedHomogeneous presentationWeight 0 := by
    simpa [presentationWeight] using hu.pow 2
  have hpF : ((X 0 : P k 5) * X 3).IsWeightedHomogeneous presentationWeight 0 := by
    simpa [presentationWeight] using hp.mul hF
  exact (weighted_sub k hs2 hu2).add hpF

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.Obstruction.Hstar_homogeneous
statement: theorem Hstar_homogeneous : (Hstar k).IsWeightedHomogeneous presentationWeight 1
proof:
:= by
  have hp := isWeightedHomogeneous_X k presentationWeight (0 : Fin 5)
  have hs := isWeightedHomogeneous_X k presentationWeight (1 : Fin 5)
  have hF := isWeightedHomogeneous_X k presentationWeight (3 : Fin 5)
  have hJ := isWeightedHomogeneous_X k presentationWeight (4 : Fin 5)
  have hx := xP_homogeneous k
  have hfirst : (((xP k)^2) * X 3).IsWeightedHomogeneous presentationWeight 1 := by
    simpa [presentationWeight] using (hx.pow 2).mul hF
  have hmid : ((1 + 2 * X 1 * xP k) * X 4).IsWeightedHomogeneous presentationWeight 1 := by
    have ht : (2 * (X 1 : P k 5) * xP k).IsWeightedHomogeneous presentationWeight 0 := by
      simpa only [map_ofNat, presentationWeight, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.cons_val_zero,
        zero_add] using ((hs.C_mul (2 : k)).mul hx)
    simpa [presentationWeight] using ((isWeightedHomogeneous_one k presentationWeight).add ht).mul hJ
  have hlast : ((X 0 : P k 5) * (X 4)^2).IsWeightedHomogeneous presentationWeight 1 := by
    simpa [presentationWeight] using hp.mul (hJ.pow 2)
  exact weighted_sub k (weighted_sub k hfirst hmid) hlast

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.Obstruction.Hstar_degree
statement:
theorem Hstar_degree [Nontrivial k] :
    weightedTotalDegree' presentationWeight (Hstar k) = (1 : WithBot ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  apply (Hstar_homogeneous k).weighted_total_degree
  intro h
  exact p_not_dvd_Hstar k (h ▸ dvd_zero _)

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.Obstruction.H_degree_one_component
statement:
theorem H_degree_one_component :
    weightedHomogeneousComponent presentationWeight 1 (H k) = Hstar k
proof:
:= by
  unfold H
  rw [map_sub, (Hstar_homogeneous k).weightedHomogeneousComponent_same]
  have hu : (X 2 : P k 5).IsWeightedHomogeneous presentationWeight 0 := by
    simpa [presentationWeight] using isWeightedHomogeneous_X k presentationWeight (2 : Fin 5)
  rw [hu.weightedHomogeneousComponent_ne (1 : ℤ) (by decide), sub_zero]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.Obstruction.idealG_homogeneous
statement:
theorem idealG_homogeneous :
    (idealG k).IsHomogeneous (weightedHomogeneousSubmodule k presentationWeight)
proof:
:= by
  apply Ideal.homogeneous_span
  intro q hq
  simp only [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hq
  subst q
  exact ⟨1, Hstar_homogeneous k⟩

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.GradedRelationSanity.quotient_mem_nonZeroDivisors
statement:
theorem quotient_mem_nonZeroDivisors {h p : R} (hr : IsRelPrime h p) :
    Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span ({h} : Set R)) p ∈
      nonZeroDivisors (R ⧸ Ideal.span ({h} : Set R))
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_left]
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective x
  rw [← map_mul, Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem, Ideal.mem_span_singleton] at hx
  rw [Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem, Ideal.mem_span_singleton]
  exact hr.dvd_of_dvd_mul_left hx

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.GradedRelationSanity.quotient_away_injective
statement:
theorem quotient_away_injective {h p : R} (hr : IsRelPrime h p)
    (S : Type*) [CommRing S] [Algebra (R ⧸ Ideal.span ({h} : Set R)) S]
    [IsLocalization.Away (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span ({h} : Set R)) p) S] :
    Function.Injective (algebraMap (R ⧸ Ideal.span ({h} : Set R)) S)
proof:
:= by
  apply IsLocalization.injective (M := Submonoid.powers
    (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span ({h} : Set R)) p)) S
  rintro _ ⟨n, rfl⟩
  exact pow_mem (quotient_mem_nonZeroDivisors hr) n

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.GradedRelationSanity.quotient_isDomain_of_away_isDomain
statement:
theorem quotient_isDomain_of_away_isDomain {h p : R} (hr : IsRelPrime h p)
    (S : Type*) [CommRing S] [Algebra (R ⧸ Ideal.span ({h} : Set R)) S]
    [IsLocalization.Away (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span ({h} : Set R)) p) S]
    [IsDomain S] : IsDomain (R ⧸ Ideal.span ({h} : Set R))
proof:
:=
  Function.Injective.isDomain (algebraMap (R ⧸ Ideal.span ({h} : Set R)) S)
    (quotient_away_injective hr S)

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.GradedRelationSanity.p_not_dvd_Hstar
statement: theorem p_not_dvd_Hstar : ¬ (X 0 : P k 5) ∣ Hstar k
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨q, hq⟩
  have h := congrArg (eval (![0, 0, 0, 0, 1] : Fin 5 → k)) hq
  norm_num [Hstar, xP] at h

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.GradedRelationSanity.Hstar_ne_zero
statement: theorem Hstar_ne_zero : Hstar k ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  apply p_not_dvd_Hstar k
  rw [h]
  exact dvd_zero _

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.GradedRelationSanity.Hstar_relPrime_p
statement: theorem Hstar_relPrime_p : IsRelPrime (Hstar k) (X 0 : P k 5)
proof:
:= by
  have hp : Irreducible (X 0 : P k 5) := by
    apply (MulEquiv.irreducible_iff (finSuccEquiv k 4)).mp
    rw [finSuccEquiv_X_zero]
    exact Polynomial.irreducible_X
  exact (hp.isRelPrime_iff_not_dvd.mpr (p_not_dvd_Hstar k)).symm

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.GradedRelationSanity.gX_zero_mem_nonZeroDivisors
statement: theorem gX_zero_mem_nonZeroDivisors : gX k 0 ∈ nonZeroDivisors (G k)
proof:
:=
  quotient_mem_nonZeroDivisors (Hstar_relPrime_p k)

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.GradedRelationSanity.G_away_injective
statement:
theorem G_away_injective (S : Type*) [CommRing S] [Algebra (G k) S]
    [IsLocalization.Away (gX k 0) S] : Function.Injective (algebraMap (G k) S)
proof:
:= by
  let : Algebra (P k 5 ⧸ Ideal.span ({Hstar k} : Set (P k 5))) S :=
    ‹Algebra (G k) S›
  let : IsLocalization.Away
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span ({Hstar k} : Set (P k 5))) (X 0)) S :=
    ‹IsLocalization.Away (gX k 0) S›
  exact quotient_away_injective (Hstar_relPrime_p k) S

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.GradedRelationSanity.G_isDomain_of_away_isDomain
statement:
theorem G_isDomain_of_away_isDomain (S : Type*) [CommRing S] [Algebra (G k) S]
    [IsLocalization.Away (gX k 0) S] [IsDomain S] : IsDomain (G k)
proof:
:= by
  exact Function.Injective.isDomain (algebraMap (G k) S) (G_away_injective k S)

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.HomogeneousQuotient.coe_pieceMap
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_pieceMap (i : ι) (x : 𝒜 i) :
    (pieceMap 𝒜 I i x : A ⧸ I) = Ideal.Quotient.mk I (x : A)
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.HomogeneousQuotient.decomposeBefore_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem decomposeBefore_apply (a : A) (i : ι) :
    (decomposeBefore 𝒜 I a i : A ⧸ I) =
      Ideal.Quotient.mk I (DirectSum.decompose 𝒜 a i : A)
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.HomogeneousQuotient.ideal_le_ker_decomposeBefore
statement:
theorem ideal_le_ker_decomposeBefore :
    I.restrictScalars k ≤ LinearMap.ker (decomposeBefore 𝒜 I)
proof:
:= by
  intro a ha
  apply DFinsupp.ext
  intro i
  apply Subtype.ext
  change Ideal.Quotient.mk I (DirectSum.decompose 𝒜 a i : A) = 0
  exact Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr (hI i ha)

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.HomogeneousQuotient.decomposeQuotient_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem decomposeQuotient_mk (a : A) :
    decomposeQuotient 𝒜 I hI (Ideal.Quotient.mk I a) = decomposeBefore 𝒜 I a
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.HomogeneousQuotient.recompose_decomposeBefore
statement:
theorem recompose_decomposeBefore :
    (DirectSum.coeLinearMap (piece 𝒜 I)).comp (decomposeBefore 𝒜 I) =
      (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ k I).toLinearMap
proof:
:= by
  apply DirectSum.decompose_lhom_ext 𝒜
  intro i
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  simp [decomposeBefore, DirectSum.decomposeLinearEquiv_apply_coe]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.HomogeneousQuotient.recompose_decomposeQuotient
statement:
theorem recompose_decomposeQuotient :
    (DirectSum.coeLinearMap (piece 𝒜 I)).comp (decomposeQuotient 𝒜 I hI) =
      LinearMap.id
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  refine Quotient.inductionOn' x ?_
  intro a
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun (recompose_decomposeBefore 𝒜 I) a

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.HomogeneousQuotient.decomposeQuotient_recompose
statement:
theorem decomposeQuotient_recompose :
    (decomposeQuotient 𝒜 I hI).comp (DirectSum.coeLinearMap (piece 𝒜 I)) =
      LinearMap.id
proof:
:= by
  apply DirectSum.linearMap_ext
  intro i
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro y
  obtain ⟨a, ha, hay⟩ := y.2
  have hy : y = pieceMap 𝒜 I i ⟨a, ha⟩ := Subtype.ext hay.symm
  subst y
  have hdecomp : DirectSum.decomposeLinearEquiv 𝒜 a =
      DirectSum.lof k ι (fun i ↦ 𝒜 i) i ⟨a, ha⟩ :=
    DirectSum.decomposeLinearEquiv_apply_coe 𝒜 i ⟨a, ha⟩
  simp [decomposeBefore, hdecomp]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.HomogeneousQuotient.proj_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem proj_mk (i : ι) (a : A) :
    letI : GradedAlgebra (piece 𝒜 I)
proof:
:= gradedAlgebra 𝒜 I hI
    GradedAlgebra.proj (piece 𝒜 I) i (Ideal.Quotient.mk I a) =
      Ideal.Quotient.mk I (GradedAlgebra.proj 𝒜 i a) := rfl

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.HomogeneousQuotient.mk_mem_piece
statement:
theorem mk_mem_piece {i : ι} {a : A} (ha : a ∈ 𝒜 i) :
    Ideal.Quotient.mk I a ∈ piece 𝒜 I i
proof: := ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.HomogeneousQuotientWeight.aeval_variable
statement:
@[simp]
theorem aeval_variable (H : MvPolynomial σ k) (p : MvPolynomial σ k) :
    aeval (generator H) p = (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ k _ :
      MvPolynomial σ k →ₐ[k] QuotientRing H) p
proof:
:= by
  have h : aeval (generator H) = (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ k _ :
      MvPolynomial σ k →ₐ[k] QuotientRing H) := by
    ext i
    simp [generator]
  exact congrArg (fun f => f p) h

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.HomogeneousQuotientWeight.defining_relation_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem defining_relation_zero (H : MvPolynomial σ k) :
    (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ k _ : MvPolynomial σ k →ₐ[k] QuotientRing H) H = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr
  exact Ideal.subset_span (Set.mem_singleton H)

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.HomogeneousQuotientWeight.weightedEval_relation_zero
proof:
:= by
  rw [LaurentWeightObstruction.weightedEval_of_homogeneous w (generator H) hH]
  simp

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.HomogeneousQuotientWeight.coaction_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coaction_mk (w : σ → ℤ) (H : MvPolynomial σ k) {n : ℤ}
    (hH : H.IsWeightedHomogeneous w n) (p : MvPolynomial σ k) :
    coaction w H hH ((Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ k _ :
      MvPolynomial σ k →ₐ[k] QuotientRing H) p) =
      LaurentWeightObstruction.weightedEval w (generator H) p
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.HomogeneousQuotientWeight.coaction_variable
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coaction_variable (w : σ → ℤ) (H : MvPolynomial σ k) {n : ℤ}
    (hH : H.IsWeightedHomogeneous w n) (i : σ) :
    coaction w H hH (generator H i) =
      AddMonoidAlgebra.single (w i) (generator H i)
proof:
:= by
  change LaurentWeightObstruction.weightedEval w (generator H) (X i) = _
  simp [LaurentWeightObstruction.weightedEval]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.HomogeneousQuotientWeight.coaction_mk_of_homogeneous
statement:
theorem coaction_mk_of_homogeneous (w : σ → ℤ) (H : MvPolynomial σ k) {n : ℤ}
    (hH : H.IsWeightedHomogeneous w n) {p : MvPolynomial σ k} {m : ℤ}
    (hp : p.IsWeightedHomogeneous w m) :
    coaction w H hH ((Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ k _ :
      MvPolynomial σ k →ₐ[k] QuotientRing H) p) =
      AddMonoidAlgebra.single m ((Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ k _ :
        MvPolynomial σ k →ₐ[k] QuotientRing H) p)
proof:
:= by
  rw [coaction_mk, LaurentWeightObstruction.weightedEval_of_homogeneous w (generator H) hp]
  simp

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.HomogeneousQuotientWeight.coeff_coaction_mk
statement:
theorem coeff_coaction_mk (w : σ → ℤ) (H : MvPolynomial σ k) {n : ℤ}
    (hH : H.IsWeightedHomogeneous w n) (p : MvPolynomial σ k) (m : ℤ) :
    (coaction w H hH ((Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ k _ :
      MvPolynomial σ k →ₐ[k] QuotientRing H) p)).coeff m =
      (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ k _ : MvPolynomial σ k →ₐ[k] QuotientRing H)
        (weightedHomogeneousComponent w m p)
proof:
:= by
  rw [coaction_mk, LaurentWeightObstruction.coeff_weightedEval, aeval_variable]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.HomogeneousQuotientWeight.component_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem component_apply (w : σ → ℤ) (H : MvPolynomial σ k) {n : ℤ}
    (hH : H.IsWeightedHomogeneous w n) (m : ℤ) (q : QuotientRing H) :
    component w H hH m q = (coaction w H hH q).coeff m
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.HomogeneousQuotientWeight.component_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem component_mk (w : σ → ℤ) (H : MvPolynomial σ k) {n : ℤ}
    (hH : H.IsWeightedHomogeneous w n) (p : MvPolynomial σ k) (m : ℤ) :
    component w H hH m ((Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ k _ :
      MvPolynomial σ k →ₐ[k] QuotientRing H) p) =
      (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ k _ : MvPolynomial σ k →ₐ[k] QuotientRing H)
        (weightedHomogeneousComponent w m p)
proof: := coeff_coaction_mk w H hH p m

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.HomogeneousQuotientWeight.component_mem_piece
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ_surjective k (Ideal.span {H}) q
  rw [component_mk]
  exact ⟨weightedHomogeneousComponent w m p,
    weightedHomogeneousComponent_isWeightedHomogeneous m p, rfl⟩

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.HomogeneousQuotientWeight.mem_piece_iff_coaction
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩
    exact coaction_mk_of_homogeneous w H hH hp
  · intro hq
    have heq : component w H hH m q = q := by
      rw [component_apply, hq]
      simp only [AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_single, Finsupp.single_eq_same]
    rw [← heq]
    exact component_mem_piece w H hH m q

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.HomogeneousQuotientWeight.component_of_mem_piece
proof:
:= by
  rw [component_apply, (mem_piece_iff_coaction w H hH m q).mp hq]
  simp only [AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_single, Finsupp.single_apply]
  by_cases h : r = m
  · simp [h]
  · simp [h, Ne.symm h]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.HomogeneousQuotientWeight.polynomial_components_commute
statement:
theorem polynomial_components_commute (w₁ w₂ : σ → ℤ) (m₁ m₂ : ℤ)
    (p : MvPolynomial σ k) :
    weightedHomogeneousComponent w₁ m₁ (weightedHomogeneousComponent w₂ m₂ p) =
      weightedHomogeneousComponent w₂ m₂ (weightedHomogeneousComponent w₁ m₁ p)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext d
  simp only [coeff_weightedHomogeneousComponent]
  by_cases h₁ : Finsupp.weight w₁ d = m₁ <;>
    by_cases h₂ : Finsupp.weight w₂ d = m₂ <;> simp [h₁, h₂]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.HomogeneousQuotientWeight.components_commute
statement:
theorem components_commute (w₁ w₂ : σ → ℤ) (H : MvPolynomial σ k) {n₁ n₂ : ℤ}
    (hH₁ : H.IsWeightedHomogeneous w₁ n₁) (hH₂ : H.IsWeightedHomogeneous w₂ n₂)
    (m₁ m₂ : ℤ) (q : QuotientRing H) :
    component w₁ H hH₁ m₁ (component w₂ H hH₂ m₂ q) =
      component w₂ H hH₂ m₂ (component w₁ H hH₁ m₁ q)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ_surjective k (Ideal.span {H}) q
  simp only [component_mk, polynomial_components_commute]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.IntegerFiltration.degree_eq_of_least
proof:
:= by
  exact IsLeast.csInf_eq ⟨hd, hleast⟩

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.IntegerFiltration.exists_least_index
statement:
theorem exists_least_index (F : ℤ → Set A) (hmono : Monotone F)
    (hexhaustive : ∀ x : A, ∃ d : ℤ, x ∈ F d)
    (hseparated : ∀ x : A, (∀ d : ℤ, x ∈ F d) → x = 0)
    {x : A} (hx : x ≠ 0) :
    ∃ d : ℤ, x ∈ F d ∧ ∀ e : ℤ, x ∈ F e → d ≤ e
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ : ∃ b : ℤ, x ∉ F b := by
    by_contra habs
    push Not at habs
    exact hx (hseparated x habs)
  apply Int.exists_least_of_bdd _ (hexhaustive x)
  refine ⟨b + 1, fun e he => ?_⟩
  have hnot : ¬ e ≤ b := fun heb => hb (hmono heb he)
  omega

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.IntegerFiltration.exists_initial_index
statement:
theorem exists_initial_index (F : ℤ → Set A) (hmono : Monotone F)
    (hexhaustive : ∀ x : A, ∃ d : ℤ, x ∈ F d)
    (hseparated : ∀ x : A, (∀ d : ℤ, x ∈ F d) → x = 0)
    {x : A} (hx : x ≠ 0) :
    ∃ d : ℤ, x ∈ F d ∧ x ∉ F (d - 1)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨d, hd, hleast⟩ := exists_least_index F hmono hexhaustive hseparated hx
  refine ⟨d, hd, fun hprev => ?_⟩
  have := hleast (d - 1) hprev
  omega

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.IntegerFiltration.initial_index_unique
statement:
theorem initial_index_unique (F : ℤ → Set A) (hmono : Monotone F)
    {x : A} {d e : ℤ} (hd : x ∈ F d) (hd' : x ∉ F (d - 1))
    (he : x ∈ F e) (he' : x ∉ F (e - 1)) : d = e
proof:
:= by
  have hde : d ≤ e := by
    by_contra h
    exact hd' (hmono (by omega : e ≤ d - 1) he)
  have hed : e ≤ d := by
    by_contra h
    exact he' (hmono (by omega : d ≤ e - 1) hd)
  exact le_antisymm hde hed

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.IntegerFiltration.degree_spec
statement:
theorem degree_spec (F : ℤ → Set A) (hmono : Monotone F)
    (hexhaustive : ∀ x : A, ∃ d : ℤ, x ∈ F d)
    (hseparated : ∀ x : A, (∀ d : ℤ, x ∈ F d) → x = 0)
    {x : A} (hx : x ≠ 0) :
    x ∈ F (degree F x) ∧ ∀ e : ℤ, x ∈ F e → degree F x ≤ e
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨d, hd, hleast⟩ := exists_least_index F hmono hexhaustive hseparated hx
  rw [degree_eq_of_least F hd hleast]
  exact ⟨hd, hleast⟩

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.IntegerFiltration.mem_iff_degree_le
statement:
theorem mem_iff_degree_le (F : ℤ → Set A) (hmono : Monotone F)
    (hexhaustive : ∀ x : A, ∃ d : ℤ, x ∈ F d)
    (hseparated : ∀ x : A, (∀ d : ℤ, x ∈ F d) → x = 0)
    {x : A} (hx : x ≠ 0) (e : ℤ) :
    x ∈ F e ↔ degree F x ≤ e
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hd, hleast⟩ := degree_spec F hmono hexhaustive hseparated hx
  exact ⟨hleast e, fun he => hmono he hd⟩

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.IntegerFiltration.not_mem_degree_sub_one
statement:
theorem not_mem_degree_sub_one (F : ℤ → Set A) (hmono : Monotone F)
    (hexhaustive : ∀ x : A, ∃ d : ℤ, x ∈ F d)
    (hseparated : ∀ x : A, (∀ d : ℤ, x ∈ F d) → x = 0)
    {x : A} (hx : x ≠ 0) : x ∉ F (degree F x - 1)
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have := (degree_spec F hmono hexhaustive hseparated hx).2 _ h
  omega

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.IntegerFiltration.degree_eq_iff_initial
statement:
theorem degree_eq_iff_initial (F : ℤ → Set A) (hmono : Monotone F)
    (hexhaustive : ∀ x : A, ∃ d : ℤ, x ∈ F d)
    (hseparated : ∀ x : A, (∀ d : ℤ, x ∈ F d) → x = 0)
    {x : A} (hx : x ≠ 0) (d : ℤ) :
    degree F x = d ↔ x ∈ F d ∧ x ∉ F (d - 1)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro rfl
    exact ⟨(degree_spec F hmono hexhaustive hseparated hx).1,
      not_mem_degree_sub_one F hmono hexhaustive hseparated hx⟩
  · rintro ⟨hd, hprev⟩
    exact initial_index_unique F hmono
      (degree_spec F hmono hexhaustive hseparated hx).1
      (not_mem_degree_sub_one F hmono hexhaustive hseparated hx) hd hprev

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.IntegerFiltration.degree_pos_iff
statement:
theorem degree_pos_iff (F : ℤ → Set A) (hmono : Monotone F)
    (hexhaustive : ∀ x : A, ∃ d : ℤ, x ∈ F d)
    (hseparated : ∀ x : A, (∀ d : ℤ, x ∈ F d) → x = 0)
    {x : A} (hx : x ≠ 0) :
    0 < degree F x ↔ x ∉ F 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_iff_degree_le F hmono hexhaustive hseparated hx 0]
  exact lt_iff_not_ge

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.IntegerFiltration.initial_form_ne_zero
statement:
theorem initial_form_ne_zero (F : ℤ → Submodule K A) {d : ℤ} {x : A}
    (hx : x ∈ F d) (hxprev : x ∉ F (d - 1)) :
    (Submodule.Quotient.mk ⟨x, hx⟩ :
      (F d) ⧸ (F (d - 1)).comap (F d).subtype) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hmem : (⟨x, hx⟩ : F d) ∈ (F (d - 1)).comap (F d).subtype :=
    (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero _).mp h
  exact hxprev hmem

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.IntegerFiltration.separated_of_iInf_eq_bot
statement:
theorem separated_of_iInf_eq_bot (F : ℤ → Submodule K A) (hF : ⨅ d, F d = ⊥)
    (x : A) (hx : ∀ d : ℤ, x ∈ F d) : x = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hx' : x ∈ ⨅ d, F d := (Submodule.mem_iInf F).mpr hx
  rw [hF] at hx'
  exact hx'

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.IntegerFiltration.exists_nonzero_initial_form
statement:
theorem exists_nonzero_initial_form (F : ℤ → Submodule K A) (hmono : Monotone F)
    (hexhaustive : ∀ x : A, ∃ d : ℤ, x ∈ F d) (hF : ⨅ d, F d = ⊥)
    {x : A} (hx : x ≠ 0) :
    ∃ (d : ℤ) (hd : x ∈ F d),
      (Submodule.Quotient.mk ⟨x, hd⟩ :
        (F d) ⧸ (F (d - 1)).comap (F d).subtype) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨d, hd, hprev⟩ := exists_initial_index
    (fun d => (F d : Set A)) (fun _ _ hij => hmono hij)
    hexhaustive (separated_of_iInf_eq_bot F hF) hx
  exact ⟨d, hd, initial_form_ne_zero F hd hprev⟩

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.IteratedQuotient.span_pair_eq_sup
statement:
lemma span_pair_eq_sup (a b : A) :
    pairIdeal A a b = relationIdeal A a ⊔ relationIdeal A b
proof:
:= by
  rw [pairIdeal, relationIdeal, relationIdeal, Ideal.span_insert]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.IteratedQuotient.map_relationIdeal
proof:
:= by
  simp only [relationIdeal, Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton,
    Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ_eq_mk]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.IteratedQuotient.equiv_mk_mk
statement:
@[simp] theorem equiv_mk_mk (a b x : A) :
    equiv k A a b
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (Ideal.Quotient.mk (relationIdeal A a) x)) =
        Ideal.Quotient.mk (pairIdeal A a b) x
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.IteratedQuotient.equiv_symm_mk
statement:
@[simp] theorem equiv_symm_mk (a b x : A) :
    (equiv k A a b).symm (Ideal.Quotient.mk (pairIdeal A a b) x) =
      Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (Ideal.Quotient.mk (relationIdeal A a) x)
proof:
:= by
  apply (equiv k A a b).injective
  simp

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.IteratedQuotient.fiberEquiv_mk_mk
statement:
@[simp] theorem fiberEquiv_mk_mk (H p x : A) (lam : k) :
    fiberEquiv k A H p lam
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (Ideal.Quotient.mk (relationIdeal A H) x)) =
        Ideal.Quotient.mk (pairIdeal A H (p - algebraMap k A lam)) x
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.IteratedQuotient.fiberEquiv_symm_mk
statement:
@[simp] theorem fiberEquiv_symm_mk (H p x : A) (lam : k) :
    (fiberEquiv k A H p lam).symm
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (pairIdeal A H (p - algebraMap k A lam)) x) =
        Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (Ideal.Quotient.mk (relationIdeal A H) x)
proof:
:= by
  apply (fiberEquiv k A H p lam).injective
  simp

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.exponentialAction_toAlgHom
statement:
@[simp] theorem exponentialAction_toAlgHom
    (D : Derivation k A A) (hD : IsLocallyNilpotent D) :
    (exponentialAction D hD).toAlgHom = LNDExponential.exponential D hD
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.exponentialAction_derivation
statement:
@[simp] theorem exponentialAction_derivation
    (D : Derivation k A A) (hD : IsLocallyNilpotent D) :
    (exponentialAction D hD).derivation = D
proof:
:= by
  ext a
  exact LNDExponential.coeff_exponential_one D hD a

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.exponentialAction_group_law
statement:
theorem exponentialAction_group_law
    (D : Derivation k A A) (hD : IsLocallyNilpotent D) (a : A) :
    (LNDExponential.exponential D hD a).map (LNDExponential.exponential D hD).toRingHom =
      taylor (X : A[X]) ((LNDExponential.exponential D hD a).map C)
proof:
:=
  (exponentialAction D hD).coassoc a

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.exponentialAction_fixed_iff
statement:
theorem exponentialAction_fixed_iff
    (D : Derivation k A A) (hD : IsLocallyNilpotent D) (a : A) :
    (exponentialAction D hD).toAlgHom a = C a ↔ D a = 0
proof:
:=
  LNDExponentialLaw.fixed_iff D (LNDExponential.exponential D hD)
    (LNDExponential.coeff_exponential D hD) a

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.exponential_derivation_eq
statement:
theorem exponential_derivation_eq (ρ : PolynomialAdditiveAction k A) :
    LNDExponential.exponential ρ.derivation ρ.locallyNilpotent = ρ.toAlgHom
proof:
:= by
  ext a n
  calc
    _ = ((n.factorial : k)⁻¹) • (ρ.derivation : A → A)^[n] a :=
      LNDExponential.coeff_exponential ρ.derivation ρ.locallyNilpotent a n
    _ = ((n.factorial : k)⁻¹) • (n.factorial • (ρ.toAlgHom a).coeff n) := by
      rw [ρ.iterate_derivation]
    _ = (ρ.toAlgHom a).coeff n := by
      rw [← Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul k, smul_smul]
      have hn : (n.factorial : k) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.factorial_ne_zero n)
      rw [inv_mul_cancel₀ hn, one_smul]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.exists_additiveCoaction_of_locallyNilpotent
statement:
theorem exists_additiveCoaction_of_locallyNilpotent
    (D : Derivation k A A) (hD : IsLocallyNilpotent D) :
    ∃ ρ : PolynomialAdditiveAction k A, ρ.derivation = D
proof:
:=
  ⟨exponentialAction D hD, exponentialAction_derivation D hD⟩

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.additiveCoaction_ext
statement:
theorem additiveCoaction_ext {ρ σ : PolynomialAdditiveAction k A}
    (h : ρ.toAlgHom = σ.toAlgHom) : ρ = σ
proof:
:= by
  cases ρ
  cases σ
  cases h
  rfl

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.derivation_iterate_naturality
statement:
theorem derivation_iterate_naturality
    (D : Derivation k A A) (E : Derivation k B B) (f : A →ₐ[k] B)
    (h : ∀ a, E (f a) = f (D a)) (n : ℕ) (a : A) :
    (E : B → B)^[n] (f a) = f ((D : A → A)^[n] a)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih => rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply', ih, h, Function.iterate_succ_apply']

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.exponentialAction_naturality
statement:
theorem exponentialAction_naturality
    (D : Derivation k A A) (E : Derivation k B B)
    (hD : IsLocallyNilpotent D) (hE : IsLocallyNilpotent E)
    (f : A →ₐ[k] B) (h : ∀ a, E (f a) = f (D a)) (a : A) :
    (exponentialAction E hE).toAlgHom (f a) =
      ((exponentialAction D hD).toAlgHom a).map f.toRingHom
proof:
:= by
  ext n
  simp only [exponentialAction_toAlgHom, LNDExponential.coeff_exponential,
    coeff_map, AlgHom.toRingHom_eq_coe, AlgHom.coe_toRingHom,
    derivation_iterate_naturality D E f h]
  exact (f.toLinearMap.map_smul _ _).symm

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LNDExponential.dividedIterate_finiteSupport
statement:
lemma dividedIterate_finiteSupport (D : Derivation k A A)
    (hD : IsLocallyNilpotent D) (a : A) :
    (Function.support (dividedIterate D a)).Finite
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := hD a
  apply (Set.finite_Iio N).subset
  intro n hn
  by_contra h
  have hz := derivation_iterate_eq_zero_of_le D hN (Nat.le_of_not_gt h)
  exact hn (by simp [dividedIterate, hz])

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LNDExponential.coeff_polynomial
statement:
@[simp]
lemma coeff_polynomial (D : Derivation k A A) (hD : IsLocallyNilpotent D)
    (a : A) (n : ℕ) :
    (polynomial D hD a).coeff n = ((n.factorial : k)⁻¹) • (D : A → A)^[n] a
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LNDExponential.iterate_add
statement:
lemma iterate_add (D : Derivation k A A) (n : ℕ) (a b : A) :
    (D : A → A)^[n] (a + b) = (D : A → A)^[n] a + (D : A → A)^[n] b
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih => simp only [Function.iterate_succ_apply', ih, map_add]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LNDExponential.iterate_smul
statement:
lemma iterate_smul (D : Derivation k A A) (n : ℕ) (c : k) (a : A) :
    (D : A → A)^[n] (c • a) = c • (D : A → A)^[n] a
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih => simp only [Function.iterate_succ_apply', ih, Derivation.map_smul]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LNDExponential.polynomial_add
statement:
lemma polynomial_add (D : Derivation k A A) (hD : IsLocallyNilpotent D) (a b : A) :
    polynomial D hD (a + b) = polynomial D hD a + polynomial D hD b
proof:
:= by
  ext n
  simp [smul_add]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LNDExponential.polynomial_smul
statement:
lemma polynomial_smul (D : Derivation k A A) (hD : IsLocallyNilpotent D)
    (c : k) (a : A) : polynomial D hD (c • a) = c • polynomial D hD a
proof:
:= by
  ext n
  rw [coeff_polynomial, Polynomial.coeff_smul, coeff_polynomial, iterate_smul, smul_comm]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LNDExponential.polynomial_one
statement:
lemma polynomial_one (D : Derivation k A A) (hD : IsLocallyNilpotent D) :
    polynomial D hD 1 = 1
proof:
:= by
  ext n
  cases n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n =>
    have hzero : (D : A → A)^[n + 1] 1 = 0 :=
      derivation_iterate_eq_zero_of_le D (m := 1) (by simp) (by omega)
    simp [hzero, Polynomial.coeff_one]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LNDExponential.inverse_factorial_mul_choose
statement:
lemma inverse_factorial_mul_choose (i j : ℕ) :
    ((i + j).factorial : k)⁻¹ * ((i + j).choose i : k) =
      (i.factorial : k)⁻¹ * (j.factorial : k)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.cast_add_choose]
  have hi : (i.factorial : k) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.factorial_ne_zero i)
  have hj : (j.factorial : k) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.factorial_ne_zero j)
  have hij : ((i+j).factorial : k) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.factorial_ne_zero _)
  field_simp

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LNDExponential.dividedIterate_mul
statement:
lemma dividedIterate_mul (D : Derivation k A A) (n : ℕ) (a b : A) :
    ((n.factorial : k)⁻¹) • (D : A → A)^[n] (a * b) =
    ∑ ij ∈ antidiagonal n,
      (((ij.1.factorial : k)⁻¹) • (D : A → A)^[ij.1] a) *
      (((ij.2.factorial : k)⁻¹) • (D : A → A)^[ij.2] b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [derivation_iterate_mul, Finset.smul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  rintro ⟨i,j⟩ hij
  have hn : i + j = n := Finset.mem_antidiagonal.mp hij
  subst n
  rw [← Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul k, smul_smul, inverse_factorial_mul_choose]
  simp only [smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm, smul_smul]
  rw [mul_comm ((i.factorial : k)⁻¹)]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LNDExponential.polynomial_mul
statement:
lemma polynomial_mul (D : Derivation k A A) (hD : IsLocallyNilpotent D) (a b : A) :
    polynomial D hD (a * b) = polynomial D hD a * polynomial D hD b
proof:
:= by
  ext n
  simpa only [coeff_polynomial, Polynomial.coeff_mul] using dividedIterate_mul D n a b

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LNDExponential.coeff_exponential
statement:
@[simp]
lemma coeff_exponential (D : Derivation k A A) (hD : IsLocallyNilpotent D)
    (a : A) (n : ℕ) :
    (exponential D hD a).coeff n = ((n.factorial : k)⁻¹) • (D : A → A)^[n] a
proof:
:=
  coeff_polynomial D hD a n

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LNDExponential.coeff_exponential_zero
statement:
@[simp]
lemma coeff_exponential_zero (D : Derivation k A A) (hD : IsLocallyNilpotent D) (a : A) :
    (exponential D hD a).coeff 0 = a
proof: := by simp

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LNDExponential.coeff_exponential_one
statement:
@[simp]
lemma coeff_exponential_one (D : Derivation k A A) (hD : IsLocallyNilpotent D) (a : A) :
    (exponential D hD a).coeff 1 = D a
proof: := by simp

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LNDExponentialLaw.iterate_smul
statement:
lemma iterate_smul (D : Derivation k A A) (n : ℕ) (r : k) (a : A) :
    ((D : A → A)^[n]) (r • a) = r • ((D : A → A)^[n]) a
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    simp only [Function.iterate_succ_apply', ih]
    exact D.toLinearMap.map_smul r _

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LNDExponentialLaw.inv_factorial_mul_inv_factorial
statement:
lemma inv_factorial_mul_inv_factorial (n m : ℕ) :
    (n.factorial : k)⁻¹ * (m.factorial : k)⁻¹ =
      ((n + m).choose n : k) * ((n + m).factorial : k)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have hn : (n.factorial : k) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.factorial_ne_zero n)
  have hm : (m.factorial : k) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.factorial_ne_zero m)
  have hnm : ((n + m).factorial : k) ≠ 0 :=
    Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.factorial_ne_zero (n + m))
  rw [Nat.cast_add_choose]
  field_simp

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LNDExponentialLaw.coefficient_iterative
statement:
theorem coefficient_iterative
    (D : Derivation k A A) (E : A →ₐ[k] A[X])
    (hE : ∀ a n, (E a).coeff n = (n.factorial : k)⁻¹ • ((D : A → A)^[n]) a)
    (a : A) (n m : ℕ) :
    (E ((E a).coeff m)).coeff n =
      (n + m).choose n • (E a).coeff (n + m)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [hE, iterate_smul, smul_smul]
  rw [← Function.iterate_add_apply]
  rw [inv_factorial_mul_inv_factorial]
  rw [mul_smul]
  exact Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul k _ _

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LNDExponentialLaw.coefficient_zero
statement:
theorem coefficient_zero
    (D : Derivation k A A) (E : A →ₐ[k] A[X])
    (hE : ∀ a n, (E a).coeff n = (n.factorial : k)⁻¹ • ((D : A → A)^[n]) a)
    (a : A) : (E a).coeff 0 = a
proof:
:= by
  simp [hE]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LNDExponentialLaw.coefficient_one
statement:
theorem coefficient_one
    (D : Derivation k A A) (E : A →ₐ[k] A[X])
    (hE : ∀ a n, (E a).coeff n = (n.factorial : k)⁻¹ • ((D : A → A)^[n]) a)
    (a : A) : (E a).coeff 1 = D a
proof:
:= by
  simp [hE]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LNDExponentialLaw.iterate_zero
statement:
lemma iterate_zero (D : Derivation k A A) (n : ℕ) :
    ((D : A → A)^[n]) 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih => simp only [Function.iterate_succ_apply', ih, map_zero]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LNDExponentialLaw.iterate_eq_zero_of_pos
statement:
lemma iterate_eq_zero_of_pos (D : Derivation k A A) {a : A}
    (ha : D a = 0) {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) : ((D : A → A)^[n]) a = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero (Nat.ne_zero_of_lt hn)
  rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply, ha, iterate_zero]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LNDExponentialLaw.fixed_iff
statement:
theorem fixed_iff
    (D : Derivation k A A) (E : A →ₐ[k] A[X])
    (hE : ∀ a n, (E a).coeff n = (n.factorial : k)⁻¹ • ((D : A → A)^[n]) a)
    (a : A) : E a = C a ↔ D a = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have h1 := congrArg (fun q : A[X] => q.coeff 1) h
    simpa only [coefficient_one D E hE, coeff_C, one_ne_zero, ite_false] using h1
  · intro h
    ext n
    cases n with
    | zero => simp only [coefficient_zero D E hE, coeff_C, ite_true]
    | succ n =>
      rw [hE, iterate_eq_zero_of_pos D h (Nat.succ_pos n), smul_zero]
      simp

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LNDExponentialLaw.eval_zero
statement:
theorem eval_zero
    (D : Derivation k A A) (E : A →ₐ[k] A[X])
    (hE : ∀ a n, (E a).coeff n = (n.factorial : k)⁻¹ • ((D : A → A)^[n]) a)
    (a : A) : (E a).eval 0 = a
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [Polynomial.coeff_zero_eq_eval_zero] using coefficient_zero D E hE a

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LaurentDerivationTransport.lift_intertwine
statement:
theorem lift_intertwine (r : G k) :
    lift D hp (toLaurentBase k r) = toLaurentBase k (D r)
proof:
:= by
  have h := LocalizationLND.transport_apply (B := LaurentPresentation.Laurent k)
    (LocalizationLND.localizeAway D (gX k 0) hp (Localized k))
    (LaurentPresentation.equiv k) (localMap k r)
  change lift D hp (LaurentPresentation.equiv k (localMap k r)) =
    LaurentPresentation.equiv k
      (LocalizationLND.localizeAway D (gX k 0) hp (Localized k) (localMap k r)) at h
  have hlocal : LocalizationLND.localizeAway D (gX k 0) hp (Localized k) (localMap k r) =
      localMap k (D r) := LocalizationLND.localizeAway_algebraMap D (gX k 0) hp (Localized k) r
  simpa only [hlocal, equiv_apply, toLaurent_localMap] using h

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LaurentDerivationTransport.lift_C
statement:
theorem lift_C (b : B k) :
    lift D hp (LaurentPolynomial.C b) = toLaurentBase k (D (baseMap k b))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← toLaurentBase_baseMap k b, lift_intertwine]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LaurentDerivationTransport.lift_T_one
statement: @[simp] theorem lift_T_one : lift D hp (LaurentPolynomial.T 1) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := lift_intertwine D hp (gX k 0)
  rw [hp, map_zero, toLaurentBase_gX] at h
  exact h

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LaurentDerivationTransport.lift_kills
statement:
theorem lift_kills (r : G k) (hr : D r = 0) :
    lift D hp (toLaurentBase k r) = 0
proof: := by rw [lift_intertwine, hr, map_zero]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LaurentDerivationTransport.lift_iterate
statement:
theorem lift_iterate (n : ℕ) (r : G k) :
    (lift D hp : LaurentPresentation.Laurent k → LaurentPresentation.Laurent k)^[n]
      (toLaurentBase k r) = toLaurentBase k ((D : G k → G k)^[n] r)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply', ih, lift_intertwine, Function.iterate_succ_apply']

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LaurentDerivationTransport.lift_locallyNilpotent
statement:
theorem lift_locallyNilpotent
    (hD : ∀ r : G k, ∃ n : ℕ, (D : G k → G k)^[n] r = 0) :
    ∀ r : LaurentPresentation.Laurent k, ∃ n : ℕ,
      (lift D hp : LaurentPresentation.Laurent k → LaurentPresentation.Laurent k)^[n] r = 0
proof:
:=
  LocalizationLND.transport_locallyNilpotent (B := LaurentPresentation.Laurent k) _ _
    (LocalizationLND.localizeAway_locallyNilpotent D (gX k 0) hp (Localized k) hD)

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LaurentDerivationTransport.toLaurentBase_injective
statement: theorem toLaurentBase_injective : Function.Injective (toLaurentBase k)
proof:
:= by
  intro a b h
  apply GradedRelationSanity.G_away_injective k (Localized k)
  apply (LaurentPresentation.equiv k).injective
  change LaurentPresentation.equiv k (localMap k a) = LaurentPresentation.equiv k (localMap k b)
  simpa only [equiv_apply, toLaurent_localMap] using h

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LaurentDerivationTransport.lift_ne_zero
statement:
theorem lift_ne_zero (D : Derivation k (G k) (G k)) (hp : D (gX k 0) = 0)
    (hD : D ≠ 0) : lift D hp ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hzero
  apply hD
  ext r
  apply toLaurentBase_injective
  have h := congrArg (fun E : Derivation k (LaurentPresentation.Laurent k)
      (LaurentPresentation.Laurent k) => E (toLaurentBase k r)) hzero
  simpa only [lift_intertwine, Derivation.zero_apply, map_zero] using h

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LaurentDerivationTransport.lift_nonzero_invariant
statement:
theorem lift_nonzero_invariant (D : Derivation k (G k) (G k)) (hp : D (gX k 0) = 0)
    (r : G k) (hr : r ≠ 0) (hDr : D r = 0) :
    toLaurentBase k r ≠ 0 ∧ lift D hp (toLaurentBase k r) = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, lift_kills D hp r hDr⟩
  intro h
  apply hr
  apply toLaurentBase_injective
  simpa using h

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LaurentDescent.coeff_C_mul_T
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coeff_C_mul_T (a : A) (q i : ℤ) :
    (C a * T q : A[T;T⁻¹]).coeff i = if q = i then a else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← single_eq_C_mul_T]
  simp only [AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_single, Finsupp.single_apply]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LaurentDescent.derivation_T_eq_zero
statement:
theorem derivation_T_eq_zero (D : Derivation k A[T;T⁻¹] A[T;T⁻¹])
    (hT : D (T 1) = 0) (n : ℤ) : D (T n) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hneg : D (T (-1)) = 0 := by
    simpa [hT] using D.leibniz_invOf (T 1)
  induction n using Int.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [T_add, D.leibniz, hT, ih]
    simp
  | pred n ih =>
    rw [sub_eq_add_neg, T_add, D.leibniz, hneg, ih]
    simp

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LaurentDescent.homogeneousOnConstants_iff
statement:
theorem homogeneousOnConstants_iff (D : Derivation k A[T;T⁻¹] A[T;T⁻¹]) (q : ℤ) :
    HomogeneousOnConstants D q ↔
      ∀ (a : A) (i : ℤ), i ≠ q → (D (C a)).coeff i = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h a i hi
    rw [h a, coeff_C_mul_T, ite_eq_right (Ne.symm hi)]
  · intro h a
    apply LaurentPolynomial.ext
    intro i
    by_cases hi : i = q
    · subst i
      simp
    · rw [h a i hi, coeff_C_mul_T, ite_eq_right (Ne.symm hi)]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LaurentDescent.descend_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem descend_apply (D : Derivation k A[T;T⁻¹] A[T;T⁻¹]) (q : ℤ)
    (hq : HomogeneousOnConstants D q) (a : A) :
    descend D q hq a = (D (C a)).coeff q
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LaurentDescent.derivation_C_eq
statement:
theorem derivation_C_eq (D : Derivation k A[T;T⁻¹] A[T;T⁻¹]) (q : ℤ)
    (hq : HomogeneousOnConstants D q) (a : A) :
    D (C a) = C (descend D q hq a) * T q
proof: := hq a

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LaurentDescent.derivation_C_mul_T
statement:
theorem derivation_C_mul_T (D : Derivation k A[T;T⁻¹] A[T;T⁻¹]) (q : ℤ)
    (hq : HomogeneousOnConstants D q) (hT : D (T 1) = 0) (a : A) (j : ℤ) :
    D (C a * T j) = C (descend D q hq a) * T (q + j)
proof:
:= by
  rw [D.leibniz, derivation_T_eq_zero D hT, smul_zero, zero_add, smul_eq_mul,
    derivation_C_eq D q hq, mul_comm (T j), mul_T_assoc]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LaurentDescent.iterate_C
statement:
theorem iterate_C (D : Derivation k A[T;T⁻¹] A[T;T⁻¹]) (q : ℤ)
    (hq : HomogeneousOnConstants D q) (hT : D (T 1) = 0) (a : A) (n : ℕ) :
    (D : A[T;T⁻¹] → A[T;T⁻¹])^[n] (C a) =
      C ((descend D q hq : A → A)^[n] a) * T ((n : ℤ) * q)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply', ih, derivation_C_mul_T D q hq hT,
      Function.iterate_succ_apply']
    congr 2
    push_cast
    ring

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LaurentDescent.descend_locallyNilpotent
statement:
theorem descend_locallyNilpotent (D : Derivation k A[T;T⁻¹] A[T;T⁻¹]) (q : ℤ)
    (hq : HomogeneousOnConstants D q) (hT : D (T 1) = 0)
    (hD : StableCoordinate.IsLocallyNilpotent D) :
    StableCoordinate.IsLocallyNilpotent (descend D q hq)
proof:
:= by
  intro a
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hD (C a)
  refine ⟨n, ?_⟩
  rw [iterate_C D q hq hT] at hn
  have hc := congrArg (fun p : A[T;T⁻¹] => p.coeff ((n : ℤ) * q)) hn
  simpa using hc

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LaurentDescent.derivation_eq_zero_of_constants
statement:
theorem derivation_eq_zero_of_constants (D : Derivation k A[T;T⁻¹] A[T;T⁻¹])
    (hC : ∀ a : A, D (C a) = 0) (hT : D (T 1) = 0) : D = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply Derivation.ext
  intro p
  change D p = 0
  induction p using LaurentPolynomial.induction_on' with
  | add p p' hp hp' => simp [map_add, hp, hp']
  | C_mul_T n a => simp [D.leibniz, hC, derivation_T_eq_zero D hT]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LaurentDescent.descend_ne_zero
statement:
theorem descend_ne_zero (D : Derivation k A[T;T⁻¹] A[T;T⁻¹]) (q : ℤ)
    (hq : HomogeneousOnConstants D q) (hT : D (T 1) = 0) (hD : D ≠ 0) :
    descend D q hq ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hE
  apply hD
  apply derivation_eq_zero_of_constants D ?_ hT
  intro a
  rw [derivation_C_eq D q hq, hE]
  simp

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LaurentDescent.descend_invariant
proof:
:= by
  rw [derivation_C_mul_T D q hq hT] at ha
  have hc := congrArg (fun p : A[T;T⁻¹] => p.coeff (q + j)) ha
  simpa using hc

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LaurentDescent.exists_descended_lnd
statement:
theorem exists_descended_lnd (D : Derivation k A[T;T⁻¹] A[T;T⁻¹]) (q : ℤ)
    (hq : HomogeneousOnConstants D q) (hT : D (T 1) = 0)
    (hD : StableCoordinate.IsLocallyNilpotent D) (hne : D ≠ 0) :
    ∃ E : Derivation k A A,
      StableCoordinate.IsLocallyNilpotent E ∧ E ≠ 0 ∧
      (∀ a : A, D (C a) = C (E a) * T q) ∧
      (∀ (a : A) (j : ℤ), D (C a * T j) = 0 → E a = 0)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨descend D q hq, descend_locallyNilpotent D q hq hT hD,
    descend_ne_zero D q hq hT hne, derivation_C_eq D q hq, ?_⟩
  intro a j ha
  exact descend_invariant D q hq hT ha

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LaurentPresentation.quadric_identity
statement:
private theorem quadric_identity {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (p s u F J : R) :
    let x
proof:
:= s ^ 2 - u ^ 2 + p * F
    let y := s + x * (x + u ^ 2)
    let z := s * x + p * J
    x * y - z * (z + 1) =
      p * (x ^ 2 * F - (1 + 2 * s * x) * J - p * J ^ 2) := by
  dsimp
  ring

 theorem quadricG : xG k * yG k - zG k * (zG k + 1) = 0 := by
  have h : xG k ^ 2 * gX k 3 - (1 + 2 * gX k 1 * xG k) * gX k 4 -
      gX k 0 * gX k 4 ^ 2 = 0 := by
    simpa [gX, Hstar, xP, xG, map_ofNat] using mk_Hstar k
  change (let x := gX k 1 ^ 2 - gX k 2 ^ 2 + gX k 0 * gX k 3
          let y := gX k 1 + x * (x + gX k 2 ^ 2)
          let z := gX k 1 * x + gX k 0 * gX k 4
          x * y - z * (z + 1)) = 0
  rw [quadric_identity]
  change gX k 0 * (xG k ^ 2 * gX k 3 - (1 + 2 * gX k 1 * xG k) * gX k 4 -
      gX k 0 * gX k 4 ^ 2) = 0
  rw [h, mul_zero]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LaurentPresentation.quadricG
statement: theorem quadricG : xG k * yG k - zG k * (zG k + 1) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h : xG k ^ 2 * gX k 3 - (1 + 2 * gX k 1 * xG k) * gX k 4 -
      gX k 0 * gX k 4 ^ 2 = 0 := by
    simpa [gX, Hstar, xP, xG, map_ofNat] using mk_Hstar k
  change (let x := gX k 1 ^ 2 - gX k 2 ^ 2 + gX k 0 * gX k 3
          let y := gX k 1 + x * (x + gX k 2 ^ 2)
          let z := gX k 1 * x + gX k 0 * gX k 4
          x * y - z * (z + 1)) = 0
  rw [quadric_identity]
  change gX k 0 * (xG k ^ 2 * gX k 3 - (1 + 2 * gX k 1 * xG k) * gX k 4 -
      gX k 0 * gX k 4 ^ 2) = 0
  rw [h, mul_zero]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LaurentPresentation.baseMap_bX
statement:
@[simp] theorem baseMap_bX (i : Fin 4) :
    baseMap k (bX k i) = ![xG k, yG k, zG k, gX k 2] i
proof:
:= by
  change (aeval ![xG k, yG k, zG k, gX k 2]) (X i) = _
  simp

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LaurentPresentation.baseMap_sB
statement: @[simp] theorem baseMap_sB : baseMap k (sB k) = gX k 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [sB, yG]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LaurentPresentation.baseMap_f0
statement: @[simp] theorem baseMap_f0 : baseMap k (f0 k) = gX k 0 * gX k 3
proof:
:= by
  simp [f0, xG]
  ring

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LaurentPresentation.baseMap_g0
statement: @[simp] theorem baseMap_g0 : baseMap k (g0 k) = gX k 0 * gX k 4
proof:
:= by
  simp [g0, zG]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LaurentPresentation.fromLaurent_C
statement:
@[simp] theorem fromLaurent_C (r : B k) :
    fromLaurent k (LaurentPolynomial.C r) = localMap k (baseMap k r)
proof:
:=
  LaurentPolynomial.eval₂_C _ _ r

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LaurentPresentation.fromLaurent_T
statement:
@[simp] theorem fromLaurent_T (n : ℤ) :
    fromLaurent k (LaurentPolynomial.T n) = ((localParameter k) ^ n).val
proof:
:=
  LaurentPolynomial.eval₂_T _ _ n

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LaurentPresentation.fromLaurent_T_one
statement:
@[simp] theorem fromLaurent_T_one :
    fromLaurent k (LaurentPolynomial.T 1) = localMap k (gX k 0)
proof:
:= by
  simp [localParameter]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LaurentPresentation.fromLaurent_T_neg_one
statement:
@[simp] theorem fromLaurent_T_neg_one :
    fromLaurent k (LaurentPolynomial.T (-1)) = IsLocalization.Away.invSelf (gX k 0)
proof:
:= by
  simp [localParameter]
  rfl

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LaurentPresentation.cancel_T
proof:
:= by
  calc
    LaurentPolynomial.T 1 * (LaurentPolynomial.C r * LaurentPolynomial.T (-1)) =
        LaurentPolynomial.C r * (LaurentPolynomial.T 1 * LaurentPolynomial.T (-1)) := by ring
    _ = LaurentPolynomial.C r := by rw [← LaurentPolynomial.T_add]; simp

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LaurentPresentation.value_x
proof:
:= by
  change LaurentPolynomial.C (sB k) ^ 2 - LaurentPolynomial.C (bX k 3) ^ 2 +
    LaurentPolynomial.T 1 * (LaurentPolynomial.C (f0 k) * LaurentPolynomial.T (-1)) = _
  rw [cancel_T]
  simp only [f0, map_add, map_sub, map_pow]
  ring

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LaurentPresentation.value_y
statement:
private theorem value_y :
    laurentValues k 1 +
      (LaurentPolynomial.C (bX k 0) : Laurent k) *
        (LaurentPolynomial.C (bX k 0) + laurentValues k 2 ^ 2) =
      LaurentPolynomial.C (bX k 1)
proof:
:= by
  change LaurentPolynomial.C (sB k) + LaurentPolynomial.C (bX k 0) *
    (LaurentPolynomial.C (bX k 0) + LaurentPolynomial.C (bX k 3) ^ 2) = _
  simp only [sB, map_sub, map_mul, map_add, map_pow]
  ring

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LaurentPresentation.value_z
proof:
:= by
  change LaurentPolynomial.C (sB k) * LaurentPolynomial.C (bX k 0) +
    LaurentPolynomial.T 1 * (LaurentPolynomial.C (g0 k) * LaurentPolynomial.T (-1)) = _
  rw [cancel_T]
  simp only [g0, map_sub, map_mul]
  ring

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LaurentPresentation.laurentValues_relation
statement:
private theorem laurentValues_relation :
    (let x := laurentValues k 1 ^ 2 - laurentValues k 2 ^ 2 +
      laurentValues k 0 * laurentValues k 3
     x ^ 2 * laurentValues k 3 - (1 + 2 * laurentValues k 1 * x) *
       laurentValues k 4 - laurentValues k 0 * laurentValues k 4 ^ 2) = 0
proof:
:= by
  let e := (let x := laurentValues k 1 ^ 2 - laurentValues k 2 ^ 2 +
      laurentValues k 0 * laurentValues k 3
     x ^ 2 * laurentValues k 3 - (1 + 2 * laurentValues k 1 * x) *
       laurentValues k 4 - laurentValues k 0 * laurentValues k 4 ^ 2)
  have he : laurentValues k 0 * e = 0 := by
    dsimp only [e]
    rw [← quadric_identity (laurentValues k 0) (laurentValues k 1) (laurentValues k 2)
      (laurentValues k 3) (laurentValues k 4)]
    rw [value_x, value_y, value_z]
    have h := congrArg (LaurentPolynomial.C : B k →+* Laurent k) (b_relation k)
    simpa using h
  change e = 0
  calc
    e = LaurentPolynomial.T (-1) * (laurentValues k 0 * e) := by
      change e = LaurentPolynomial.T (-1) * (LaurentPolynomial.T 1 * e)
      rw [← mul_assoc, ← LaurentPolynomial.T_add]
      simp
    _ = 0 := by rw [he, mul_zero]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LaurentPresentation.toLaurentBase_gX
statement:
@[simp] theorem toLaurentBase_gX (i : Fin 5) :
    toLaurentBase k (gX k i) = laurentValues k i
proof:
:= by
  change (aeval (laurentValues k)) (X i) = laurentValues k i
  simp

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LaurentPresentation.toLaurentBase_parameter_isUnit
statement: theorem toLaurentBase_parameter_isUnit : IsUnit (toLaurentBase k (gX k 0))
proof:
:= by
  rw [toLaurentBase_gX]
  exact LaurentPolynomial.isUnit_T (R := B k) 1

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LaurentPresentation.toLaurent_localMap
statement:
@[simp] theorem toLaurent_localMap (r : G k) :
    toLaurent k (localMap k r) = toLaurentBase k r
proof:
:=
  IsLocalization.Away.lift_eq (S := Localized k) (gX k 0)
    (toLaurentBase_parameter_isUnit k) r

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LaurentPresentation.toLaurentBase_xG
statement:
@[simp] theorem toLaurentBase_xG :
    toLaurentBase k (xG k) = LaurentPolynomial.C (bX k 0)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [xG, map_add, map_sub, map_pow, map_mul, toLaurentBase_gX] using value_x k

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LaurentPresentation.toLaurentBase_yG
statement:
@[simp] theorem toLaurentBase_yG :
    toLaurentBase k (yG k) = LaurentPolynomial.C (bX k 1)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [yG, map_add, map_mul, map_pow, toLaurentBase_xG, toLaurentBase_gX]
    using value_y k

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LaurentPresentation.toLaurentBase_zG
statement:
@[simp] theorem toLaurentBase_zG :
    toLaurentBase k (zG k) = LaurentPolynomial.C (bX k 2)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [zG, map_add, map_mul, toLaurentBase_xG, toLaurentBase_gX] using value_z k

 theorem toLaurentBase_comp_baseMap :
    (toLaurentBase k).comp (baseMap k) =
      IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k (B k) (Laurent k) := by
  apply Ideal.Quotient.algHom_ext k
  apply MvPolynomial.algHom_ext
  intro i
  change toLaurentBase k (baseMap k (bX k i)) = LaurentPolynomial.C (bX k i)
  fin_cases i <;> simp [laurentValues]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LaurentPresentation.toLaurentBase_comp_baseMap
statement:
theorem toLaurentBase_comp_baseMap :
    (toLaurentBase k).comp (baseMap k) =
      IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k (B k) (Laurent k)
proof:
:= by
  apply Ideal.Quotient.algHom_ext k
  apply MvPolynomial.algHom_ext
  intro i
  change toLaurentBase k (baseMap k (bX k i)) = LaurentPolynomial.C (bX k i)
  fin_cases i <;> simp [laurentValues]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LaurentPresentation.toLaurentBase_baseMap
statement:
@[simp] theorem toLaurentBase_baseMap (r : B k) :
    toLaurentBase k (baseMap k r) = LaurentPolynomial.C r
proof:
:=
  DFunLike.congr_fun (toLaurentBase_comp_baseMap k) r

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LaurentPresentation.parameter_cancel
statement:
private theorem parameter_cancel (r : Localized k) :
    (localMap k (gX k 0) * r) * IsLocalization.Away.invSelf (gX k 0) = r
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (localMap k (gX k 0) * r) * IsLocalization.Away.invSelf (gX k 0) =
        r * (localMap k (gX k 0) * IsLocalization.Away.invSelf (gX k 0)) := by ring
    _ = r := by rw [show localMap k (gX k 0) * IsLocalization.Away.invSelf (gX k 0) = 1 from
        IsLocalization.Away.mul_invSelf (gX k 0), mul_one]

 theorem fromLaurent_comp_toLaurentBase :
    (fromLaurent k).comp (toLaurentBase k) = localMap k := by
  apply Ideal.Quotient.algHom_ext k
  apply MvPolynomial.algHom_ext
  intro i
  change fromLaurent k (toLaurentBase k (gX k i)) = localMap k (gX k i)
  fin_cases i
  · simp [laurentValues, localParameter]
  · simp [laurentValues]
  · simp [laurentValues]
  · simp only [toLaurentBase_gX]
    change fromLaurent k (LaurentPolynomial.C (f0 k) * LaurentPolynomial.T (-1)) = _
    rw [map_mul, fromLaurent_C, fromLaurent_T_neg_one, baseMap_f0, map_mul, parameter_cancel]
    rfl
  · simp only [toLaurentBase_gX]
    change fromLaurent k (LaurentPolynomial.C (g0 k) * LaurentPolynomial.T (-1)) = _
    rw [map_mul, fromLaurent_C, fromLaurent_T_neg_one, baseMap_g0, map_mul, parameter_cancel]
    rfl

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LaurentPresentation.fromLaurent_comp_toLaurentBase
statement:
theorem fromLaurent_comp_toLaurentBase :
    (fromLaurent k).comp (toLaurentBase k) = localMap k
proof:
:= by
  apply Ideal.Quotient.algHom_ext k
  apply MvPolynomial.algHom_ext
  intro i
  change fromLaurent k (toLaurentBase k (gX k i)) = localMap k (gX k i)
  fin_cases i
  · simp [laurentValues, localParameter]
  · simp [laurentValues]
  · simp [laurentValues]
  · simp only [toLaurentBase_gX]
    change fromLaurent k (LaurentPolynomial.C (f0 k) * LaurentPolynomial.T (-1)) = _
    rw [map_mul, fromLaurent_C, fromLaurent_T_neg_one, baseMap_f0, map_mul, parameter_cancel]
    rfl
  · simp only [toLaurentBase_gX]
    change fromLaurent k (LaurentPolynomial.C (g0 k) * LaurentPolynomial.T (-1)) = _
    rw [map_mul, fromLaurent_C, fromLaurent_T_neg_one, baseMap_g0, map_mul, parameter_cancel]
    rfl

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LaurentPresentation.fromLaurent_toLaurentBase
statement:
@[simp] theorem fromLaurent_toLaurentBase (r : G k) :
    fromLaurent k (toLaurentBase k r) = localMap k r
proof:
:=
  DFunLike.congr_fun (fromLaurent_comp_toLaurentBase k) r

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LaurentPresentation.toLaurent_invSelf
statement:
@[simp] theorem toLaurent_invSelf :
    toLaurent k (IsLocalization.Away.invSelf (gX k 0)) = LaurentPolynomial.T (-1)
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (toLaurent k) (IsLocalization.Away.mul_invSelf
    (S := Localized k) (gX k 0))
  change toLaurent k (localMap k (gX k 0) * IsLocalization.Away.invSelf (gX k 0)) =
    toLaurent k 1 at h
  simp only [map_mul, map_one, toLaurent_localMap, toLaurentBase_gX] at h
  change LaurentPolynomial.T 1 * toLaurent k (IsLocalization.Away.invSelf (gX k 0)) = 1 at h
  calc
    toLaurent k (IsLocalization.Away.invSelf (gX k 0)) =
        LaurentPolynomial.T (-1) * (LaurentPolynomial.T 1 *
          toLaurent k (IsLocalization.Away.invSelf (gX k 0))) := by
      rw [← mul_assoc, ← LaurentPolynomial.T_add]
      simp
    _ = LaurentPolynomial.T (-1) := by rw [h, mul_one]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LaurentPresentation.laurent_hom_ext
statement:
private theorem laurent_hom_ext {R S : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    {f g : LaurentPolynomial R →+* S}
    (hC : ∀ a, f (LaurentPolynomial.C a) = g (LaurentPolynomial.C a))
    (hT : f (LaurentPolynomial.T 1) = g (LaurentPolynomial.T 1))
    (hTi : f (LaurentPolynomial.T (-1)) = g (LaurentPolynomial.T (-1))) : f = g
proof:
:= by
  apply RingHom.ext
  intro r
  refine LaurentPolynomial.induction_on r hC ?_ ?_ ?_
  · intro p q hp hq
    simp only [map_add, hp, hq]
  · intro n a h
    rw [LaurentPolynomial.T_add, ← mul_assoc, map_mul f, map_mul g, h, hT]
  · intro n a h
    rw [sub_eq_add_neg, LaurentPolynomial.T_add, ← mul_assoc, map_mul f, map_mul g, h, hTi]

 theorem toLaurent_comp_fromLaurent :
    (toLaurent k).comp (fromLaurent k) = AlgHom.id k (Laurent k) := by
  apply AlgHom.coe_ringHom_injective
  apply laurent_hom_ext (R := B k) (S := Laurent k)
  · intro r
    change toLaurent k (fromLaurent k (LaurentPolynomial.C r)) = LaurentPolynomial.C r
    simp
  · change toLaurent k (fromLaurent k (LaurentPolynomial.T 1)) = LaurentPolynomial.T 1
    rw [fromLaurent_T_one, toLaurent_localMap, toLaurentBase_gX]
    rfl
  · change toLaurent k (fromLaurent k (LaurentPolynomial.T (-1))) = LaurentPolynomial.T (-1)
    rw [fromLaurent_T_neg_one, toLaurent_invSelf]

 theorem fromLaurent_comp_toLaurent :
    (fromLaurent k).comp (toLaurent k) = AlgHom.id k (Localized k) := by
  apply AlgHom.coe_ringHom_injective
  apply IsLocalization.ringHom_ext (Submonoid.powers (gX k 0))
  apply RingHom.ext
  intro r
  change fromLaurent k (toLaurent k (localMap k r)) = localMap k r
  simp

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LaurentPresentation.toLaurent_comp_fromLaurent
statement:
theorem toLaurent_comp_fromLaurent :
    (toLaurent k).comp (fromLaurent k) = AlgHom.id k (Laurent k)
proof:
:= by
  apply AlgHom.coe_ringHom_injective
  apply laurent_hom_ext (R := B k) (S := Laurent k)
  · intro r
    change toLaurent k (fromLaurent k (LaurentPolynomial.C r)) = LaurentPolynomial.C r
    simp
  · change toLaurent k (fromLaurent k (LaurentPolynomial.T 1)) = LaurentPolynomial.T 1
    rw [fromLaurent_T_one, toLaurent_localMap, toLaurentBase_gX]
    rfl
  · change toLaurent k (fromLaurent k (LaurentPolynomial.T (-1))) = LaurentPolynomial.T (-1)
    rw [fromLaurent_T_neg_one, toLaurent_invSelf]

 theorem fromLaurent_comp_toLaurent :
    (fromLaurent k).comp (toLaurent k) = AlgHom.id k (Localized k) := by
  apply AlgHom.coe_ringHom_injective
  apply IsLocalization.ringHom_ext (Submonoid.powers (gX k 0))
  apply RingHom.ext
  intro r
  change fromLaurent k (toLaurent k (localMap k r)) = localMap k r
  simp

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LaurentPresentation.fromLaurent_comp_toLaurent
statement:
theorem fromLaurent_comp_toLaurent :
    (fromLaurent k).comp (toLaurent k) = AlgHom.id k (Localized k)
proof:
:= by
  apply AlgHom.coe_ringHom_injective
  apply IsLocalization.ringHom_ext (Submonoid.powers (gX k 0))
