name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LaurentPresentation.equiv_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem equiv_apply (r : Localized k) : equiv k r = toLaurent k r
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LaurentPresentation.equiv_symm_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem equiv_symm_apply (r : Laurent k) : (equiv k).symm r = fromLaurent k r
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LaurentPresentation.equiv_localMap_gX
statement:
@[simp] theorem equiv_localMap_gX (i : Fin 5) :
    equiv k (localMap k (gX k i)) = laurentValues k i
proof: := by simp

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LaurentPresentation.equiv_localMap_baseMap
statement:
@[simp] theorem equiv_localMap_baseMap (r : B k) :
    equiv k (localMap k (baseMap k r)) = LaurentPolynomial.C r
proof: := by simp

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LaurentPresentation.baseMap_injective
statement: theorem baseMap_injective : Function.Injective (baseMap k)
proof:
:= by
  intro a b h
  have hc : LaurentPolynomial.C a = (LaurentPolynomial.C b : Laurent k) := by
    simpa using congrArg (fun r => equiv k (localMap k r)) h
  have he := congrArg (fun p : Laurent k => p.coeff 0) hc
  simpa using he

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LaurentWeightObstruction.single_mem_nonnegativePart
statement:
theorem single_mem_nonnegativePart (n : ℤ) (hn : 0 ≤ n) (a : A) :
    AddMonoidAlgebra.single n a ∈ nonnegativePart (k := k) (A := A)
proof:
:= by
  lift n to ℕ using hn
  change ∃ p : Polynomial A, p.toLaurent = AddMonoidAlgebra.single (n : ℤ) a
  exact ⟨Polynomial.monomial n a, by
    simp [LaurentPolynomial.single_eq_C_mul_T, Polynomial.toLaurent_C_mul_T]⟩

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LaurentWeightObstruction.eq_zero_of_single_mem_nonnegativePart
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := h
  change p.toLaurent = AddMonoidAlgebra.single n a at hp
  have hp0 : p = 0 := by
    calc
      p = LaurentPolynomial.trunc p.toLaurent := (Polynomial.trunc_toLaurent p).symm
      _ = LaurentPolynomial.trunc (AddMonoidAlgebra.single n a) := congrArg _ hp
      _ = 0 := by
        rw [LaurentPolynomial.single_eq_C_mul_T, LaurentPolynomial.trunc_C_mul_T]
        simp [not_le.mpr hn]
  have hs : AddMonoidAlgebra.single n a = (0 : A[T;T⁻¹]) := by
    rw [← hp, hp0, map_zero]
  have hc := congrArg (fun f : A[T;T⁻¹] => f.coeff n) hs
  simpa only [AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_single, Finsupp.single_eq_same,
    AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_zero, Finsupp.zero_apply] using hc

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LaurentWeightObstruction.adjoin_mem_nonnegativePart
statement:
theorem adjoin_mem_nonnegativePart
    (ρ : A →ₐ[k] A[T;T⁻¹]) {s : Set A}
    (hs : ∀ a ∈ s, ρ a ∈ nonnegativePart (k := k) (A := A))
    {a : A} (ha : a ∈ Algebra.adjoin k s) :
    ρ a ∈ nonnegativePart (k := k) (A := A)
proof:
:= by
  have hle : Algebra.adjoin k s ≤ (nonnegativePart (k := k) (A := A)).comap ρ :=
    Algebra.adjoin_le hs
  exact hle ha

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LaurentWeightObstruction.eq_zero_of_adjoin_of_negative_weight
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_adjoin_of_negative_weight
    (ρ : A →ₐ[k] A[T;T⁻¹]) {s : Set A}
    (hs : ∀ a ∈ s, ρ a ∈ nonnegativePart (k := k) (A := A))
    {a : A} (ha : a ∈ Algebra.adjoin k s) {n : ℤ} (hn : n < 0)
    (hweight : ρ a = AddMonoidAlgebra.single n a) : a = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply eq_zero_of_single_mem_nonnegativePart (k := k) hn
  rw [← hweight]
  exact adjoin_mem_nonnegativePart ρ hs ha

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LaurentWeightObstruction.weightedEval_of_homogeneous
statement:
theorem weightedEval_of_homogeneous {σ : Type*} (w : σ → ℤ) (f : σ → A)
    {p : MvPolynomial σ k} {n : ℤ} (hp : p.IsWeightedHomogeneous w n) :
    weightedEval w f p = AddMonoidAlgebra.single n (MvPolynomial.aeval f p)
proof:
:= by
  induction hp using MvPolynomial.IsWeightedHomogeneous.induction_on with
  | zero => simp [weightedEval]
  | add p q hp hq ihp ihq =>
      simp only [map_add, ihp, ihq, AddMonoidAlgebra.single_add]
  | monomial d r hw =>
      simp only [weightedEval, MvPolynomial.aeval_monomial,
        AddMonoidAlgebra.single_pow, AddMonoidAlgebra.finsuppProd_single,
        LaurentPolynomial.algebraMap_apply, ← LaurentPolynomial.single_eq_C,
        AddMonoidAlgebra.single_mul_single, zero_add]
      rw [← Finsupp.weight_apply, hw]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LaurentWeightObstruction.coeff_weightedEval
statement:
theorem coeff_weightedEval {σ : Type*} (w : σ → ℤ) (f : σ → A)
    (p : MvPolynomial σ k) (n : ℤ) :
    (weightedEval w f p).coeff n =
      MvPolynomial.aeval f (MvPolynomial.weightedHomogeneousComponent w n p)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction p using MvPolynomial.induction_on' with
  | add p q hp hq =>
      simp only [map_add, AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_add, Finsupp.add_apply, hp, hq]
  | monomial d r =>
      have hd : (MvPolynomial.monomial d r).IsWeightedHomogeneous w (Finsupp.weight w d) :=
        MvPolynomial.isWeightedHomogeneous_monomial w d r rfl
      rw [weightedEval_of_homogeneous w f hd]
      by_cases h : Finsupp.weight w d = n
      · subst n
        rw [MvPolynomial.IsWeightedHomogeneous.weightedHomogeneousComponent_same hd]
        simp only [AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_single, Finsupp.single_eq_same]
      · rw [MvPolynomial.IsWeightedHomogeneous.weightedHomogeneousComponent_ne n hd (Ne.symm h)]
        simp only [map_zero, AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_single, Finsupp.single_apply,
          ite_eq_right h]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LaurentWeightedMap.evaluate_X
statement:
@[simp] theorem evaluate_X (w : σ → ℤ) (c : σ → B) (i : σ) :
    evaluate w c (MvPolynomial.X i : MvPolynomial σ k) = C (c i) * T (-w i)
proof:
:= by
  simp [evaluate]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LaurentWeightedMap.evaluate_monomial
statement:
theorem evaluate_monomial (w : σ → ℤ) (c : σ → B) (d : σ →₀ ℕ) (r : k) :
    evaluate w c (MvPolynomial.monomial d r) =
      C (MvPolynomial.aeval c (MvPolynomial.monomial d r)) * T (-Finsupp.weight w d)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [evaluate, MvPolynomial.aeval_monomial, LaurentPolynomial.algebraMap_apply]
  simp only [← single_eq_C_mul_T, AddMonoidAlgebra.single_pow, Finsupp.prod,
    AddMonoidAlgebra.prod_single]
  simp [Finsupp.weight_apply, Finsupp.sum, Finset.sum_neg_distrib, mul_assoc]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LaurentWeightedMap.evaluate_homogeneous
statement:
theorem evaluate_homogeneous (w : σ → ℤ) (c : σ → B)
    {p : MvPolynomial σ k} {m : ℤ} (hp : p.IsWeightedHomogeneous w m) :
    evaluate w c p = C (MvPolynomial.aeval c p) * T (-m)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  calc
    evaluate w c p = ∑ d ∈ p.support, evaluate w c (MvPolynomial.monomial d (p.coeff d)) := by
      conv_lhs => rw [p.as_sum, map_sum]
    _ = ∑ d ∈ p.support, C (MvPolynomial.aeval c (MvPolynomial.monomial d (p.coeff d))) * T (-m) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro d hd
      rw [evaluate_monomial, hp (MvPolynomial.mem_support_iff.mp hd)]
    _ = C (MvPolynomial.aeval c p) * T (-m) := by
      rw [← Finset.sum_mul, ← map_sum, ← map_sum, ← p.as_sum]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LaurentWeightedMap.coeff_evaluate_eq_zero
statement:
theorem coeff_evaluate_eq_zero (w : σ → ℤ) (c : σ → B)
    {p : MvPolynomial σ k} {m : ℤ} (hp : p.IsWeightedHomogeneous w m)
    (j : ℤ) (hj : j ≠ -m) :
    (evaluate w c p).coeff j = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [evaluate_homogeneous w c hp, ← single_eq_C_mul_T]
  simp only [AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_single, Finsupp.single_apply, ite_eq_right (Ne.symm hj)]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LaurentWeightedMap.map_homogeneous
statement:
theorem map_homogeneous (w : σ → ℤ) (c : σ → B)
    (φ : MvPolynomial σ k →ₐ[k] B[T;T⁻¹])
    (hφ : ∀ i : σ, φ (MvPolynomial.X i) = C (c i) * T (-w i))
    {p : MvPolynomial σ k} {m : ℤ} (hp : p.IsWeightedHomogeneous w m) :
    φ p = C (MvPolynomial.aeval c p) * T (-m)
proof:
:= by
  have heq : φ = evaluate w c := by
    apply MvPolynomial.algHom_ext
    intro i
    rw [hφ, evaluate_X]
  rw [heq]
  exact evaluate_homogeneous w c hp

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LeadingComponent.proj_mem
statement: @[simp] theorem proj_mem (i : ℤ) (x : A) : proj 𝒜 i x ∈ 𝒜 i
proof:
:=
  (DirectSum.decompose 𝒜 x i).property

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LeadingComponent.proj_of_mem
statement: theorem proj_of_mem {x : A} {i : ℤ} (hx : x ∈ 𝒜 i) : proj 𝒜 i x = x
proof:
:=
  DirectSum.decompose_of_mem_same 𝒜 hx

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LeadingComponent.proj_of_mem_ne
statement:
theorem proj_of_mem_ne {x : A} {i j : ℤ} (hx : x ∈ 𝒜 i) (hij : i ≠ j) :
    proj 𝒜 j x = 0
proof:
:=
  DirectSum.decompose_of_mem_ne 𝒜 hx hij

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LeadingComponent.proj_mul_left
statement:
theorem proj_mul_left {x y : A} {i j : ℤ} (hx : x ∈ 𝒜 i) :
    proj 𝒜 (i + j) (x * y) = x * proj 𝒜 j y
proof:
:=
  DirectSum.coe_decompose_mul_add_of_left_mem 𝒜 hx

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LeadingComponent.componentLinear_of_mem
statement:
theorem componentLinear_of_mem (D : A →ₗ[k] A) (m : ℤ)
    {i : ℤ} {x : A} (hx : x ∈ 𝒜 i) :
    componentLinear 𝒜 D m x = proj 𝒜 (i + m) (D x)
proof:
:= by
  let x' : 𝒜 i := ⟨x, hx⟩
  change componentLinear 𝒜 D m (x' : A) = _
  simp only [componentLinear, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe,
    DirectSum.decomposeLinearEquiv_apply_coe, DirectSum.toModule_lof,
    Submodule.subtype_apply]
  rfl

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LeadingComponent.componentLinear_mem
statement:
theorem componentLinear_mem (D : A →ₗ[k] A) (m : ℤ)
    {i : ℤ} {x : A} (hx : x ∈ 𝒜 i) :
    componentLinear 𝒜 D m x ∈ 𝒜 (i + m)
proof:
:= by
  rw [componentLinear_of_mem 𝒜 D m hx]
  exact proj_mem 𝒜 _ _

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LeadingComponent.componentLinear_one
statement:
theorem componentLinear_one (D : Derivation k A A) (m : ℤ) :
    componentLinear 𝒜 D.toLinearMap m 1 = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [componentLinear_of_mem 𝒜 _ m (SetLike.GradedOne.one_mem (A := 𝒜))]
  change proj 𝒜 (0 + m) (D 1) = 0
  rw [Derivation.map_one_eq_zero, map_zero]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LeadingComponent.componentLinear_mul
statement:
theorem componentLinear_mul (D : Derivation k A A) (m : ℤ) (x y : A) :
    componentLinear 𝒜 D.toLinearMap m (x * y) =
      x * componentLinear 𝒜 D.toLinearMap m y +
      y * componentLinear 𝒜 D.toLinearMap m x
proof:
:= by
  let E := componentLinear 𝒜 D.toLinearMap m
  change E (x * y) = x * E y + y * E x
  induction x using DirectSum.Decomposition.inductionOn 𝒜 with
  | zero => simp
  | homogeneous x =>
    induction y using DirectSum.Decomposition.inductionOn 𝒜 with
    | zero => simp
    | homogeneous y =>
      obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := x
      obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := y
      dsimp only at *
      dsimp only [E]
      rw [componentLinear_of_mem 𝒜 _ m (SetLike.GradedMul.mul_mem hx hy),
        componentLinear_of_mem 𝒜 _ m hx, componentLinear_of_mem 𝒜 _ m hy]
      change proj 𝒜 _ (D (x * y)) = _
      rw [D.leibniz, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul, map_add]
      have h₁ : ∀ i j : ℤ, i + j + m = i + (j + m) := by omega
      have h₂ : ∀ i j : ℤ, i + j + m = j + (i + m) := by omega
      rw [h₁, proj_mul_left 𝒜 hx]
      congr 1
      rw [← h₁, h₂, proj_mul_left 𝒜 hy]
      rfl
    | add y z hy hz => simp only [mul_add, map_add, hy, hz]; ring
  | add x z hx hz => simp only [add_mul, map_add, hx, hz]; ring

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LeadingComponent.component_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem component_apply (D : Derivation k A A) (m : ℤ) (x : A) :
    component 𝒜 D m x = componentLinear 𝒜 D.toLinearMap m x
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LeadingComponent.component_of_mem
statement:
theorem component_of_mem (D : Derivation k A A) (m : ℤ)
    {i : ℤ} {x : A} (hx : x ∈ 𝒜 i) :
    component 𝒜 D m x = proj 𝒜 (i + m) (D x)
proof:
:=
  componentLinear_of_mem 𝒜 D.toLinearMap m hx

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LeadingComponent.component_mem
statement:
theorem component_mem (D : Derivation k A A) (m : ℤ)
    {i : ℤ} {x : A} (hx : x ∈ 𝒜 i) :
    component 𝒜 D m x ∈ 𝒜 (i + m)
proof:
:=
  componentLinear_mem 𝒜 D.toLinearMap m hx

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LeadingComponent.degreeLE_of_mem
statement:
theorem degreeLE_of_mem {i : ℤ} {x : A} (hx : x ∈ 𝒜 i) :
    DegreeLE 𝒜 i x
proof:
:= by
  intro j hj
  exact proj_of_mem_ne 𝒜 hx (ne_of_lt hj)

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LeadingComponent.degreeLE_zero
statement: theorem degreeLE_zero (i : ℤ) : DegreeLE 𝒜 i (0 : A)
proof:
:= by
  intro j _
  exact map_zero _

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LeadingComponent.le_of_proj_ne_zero_of_degreeLE
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h
  exact hi (hx i (lt_of_not_ge h))

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LeadingComponent.degreeLE_map
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro j hj
  have hsum : ∑ i ∈ (DirectSum.decompose 𝒜 x).support, proj 𝒜 i x = x :=
    DirectSum.sum_support_decompose 𝒜 x
  rw [← hsum, map_sum, map_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro i hi
  have hid := le_of_proj_ne_zero_of_degreeLE 𝒜 hx ((GradedAlgebra.mem_support_iff 𝒜 x i).mp hi)
  exact hD i (proj 𝒜 i x) (proj_mem 𝒜 i x) j (by omega)

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LeadingComponent.top_projection_map
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [componentLinear_of_mem 𝒜 D m (proj_mem 𝒜 d x)]
  have hsum : ∑ i ∈ (DirectSum.decompose 𝒜 x).support, proj 𝒜 i x = x :=
    DirectSum.sum_support_decompose 𝒜 x
  conv_lhs => rw [← hsum, map_sum, map_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_eq_single d
  · intro i hi hid
    have hle := le_of_proj_ne_zero_of_degreeLE 𝒜 hx ((GradedAlgebra.mem_support_iff 𝒜 x i).mp hi)
    exact hD i (proj 𝒜 i x) (proj_mem 𝒜 i x) (d + m) (by omega)
  · intro hd
    have hzero : proj 𝒜 d x = 0 := by
      by_contra hne
      exact hd ((GradedAlgebra.mem_support_iff 𝒜 x d).mpr hne)
    simp only [hzero, map_zero]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LeadingComponent.degreeLE_iterate
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simpa using degreeLE_of_mem 𝒜 hx
  | succ n hn =>
    rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply']
    convert degreeLE_map 𝒜 D hD hn using 1
    push_cast
    ring

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LeadingComponent.top_projection_iterate
statement:
theorem top_projection_iterate (D : A →ₗ[k] A) {m i : ℤ}
    (hD : HasShiftLE 𝒜 D m) {x : A} (hx : x ∈ 𝒜 i) (n : ℕ) :
    proj 𝒜 (i + (n : ℤ) * m) ((D : A → A)^[n] x) =
      ((componentLinear 𝒜 D m : A → A)^[n] x)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simpa using proj_of_mem 𝒜 hx
  | succ n hn =>
    rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply', Function.iterate_succ_apply']
    have hindex : i + ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) * m = (i + (n : ℤ) * m) + m := by
      push_cast
      ring
    rw [hindex, top_projection_map 𝒜 D hD (degreeLE_iterate 𝒜 D hD hx n), hn]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LeadingComponent.iterate_linear_zero
statement:
theorem iterate_linear_zero (D : A →ₗ[k] A) (n : ℕ) :
    (D : A → A)^[n] 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Module.End.pow_apply]
  exact map_zero _

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LeadingComponent.iterate_linear_add
statement:
theorem iterate_linear_add (D : A →ₗ[k] A) (n : ℕ) (x y : A) :
    (D : A → A)^[n] (x + y) = (D : A → A)^[n] x + (D : A → A)^[n] y
proof:
:= by
  simp only [← Module.End.pow_apply, map_add]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LeadingComponent.eventually_zero_add
statement:
theorem eventually_zero_add (D : A →ₗ[k] A) {x y : A}
    (hx : ∃ n : ℕ, (D : A → A)^[n] x = 0)
    (hy : ∃ n : ℕ, (D : A → A)^[n] y = 0) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, (D : A → A)^[n] (x + y) = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨nx, hx⟩ := hx
  obtain ⟨ny, hy⟩ := hy
  refine ⟨nx + ny, ?_⟩
  rw [iterate_linear_add]
  have hx' : (D : A → A)^[nx + ny] x = 0 := by
    rw [Nat.add_comm, Function.iterate_add_apply, hx, iterate_linear_zero]
  have hy' : (D : A → A)^[nx + ny] y = 0 := by
    rw [Function.iterate_add_apply, hy, iterate_linear_zero]
  rw [hx', hy', zero_add]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LeadingComponent.locallyNilpotent_componentLinear
statement:
theorem locallyNilpotent_componentLinear (D : A →ₗ[k] A) {m : ℤ}
    (hD : HasShiftLE 𝒜 D m)
    (hln : ∀ x : A, ∃ n : ℕ, (D : A → A)^[n] x = 0) :
    ∀ x : A, ∃ n : ℕ, ((componentLinear 𝒜 D m : A → A)^[n] x) = 0
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  induction x using DirectSum.Decomposition.inductionOn 𝒜 with
  | zero => exact ⟨0, rfl⟩
  | homogeneous x =>
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hln x
    refine ⟨n, ?_⟩
    rw [← top_projection_iterate 𝒜 D hD x.property n, hn, map_zero]
  | add x y hx hy =>
    exact eventually_zero_add (componentLinear 𝒜 D m) hx hy

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LeadingComponent.locallyNilpotent_component
statement:
theorem locallyNilpotent_component (D : Derivation k A A) {m : ℤ}
    (hD : HasShiftLE 𝒜 D.toLinearMap m)
    (hln : ∀ x : A, ∃ n : ℕ, (D : A → A)^[n] x = 0) :
    ∀ x : A, ∃ n : ℕ, ((component 𝒜 D m : A → A)^[n] x) = 0
proof:
:=
  locallyNilpotent_componentLinear 𝒜 D.toLinearMap hD hln

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LeadingComponent.component_ne_zero
statement:
theorem component_ne_zero (D : Derivation k A A) (m : ℤ)
    {i : ℤ} {x : A} (hx : x ∈ 𝒜 i) (hDx : proj 𝒜 (i + m) (D x) ≠ 0) :
    component 𝒜 D m ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have heq : component 𝒜 D m x = 0 := by rw [h]; rfl
  rw [component_of_mem 𝒜 D m hx] at heq
  exact hDx heq

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LeadingComponent.component_eq_zero_of_eq_zero
statement:
theorem component_eq_zero_of_eq_zero (D : Derivation k A A) (m : ℤ)
    {i : ℤ} {x : A} (hx : x ∈ 𝒜 i) (hDx : D x = 0) :
    component 𝒜 D m x = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [component_of_mem 𝒜 D m hx, hDx, map_zero]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LeadingComponent.component_high_term_eq_zero
statement:
theorem component_high_term_eq_zero (D : Derivation k A A) {m : ℤ}
    (hD : HasShiftLE 𝒜 D.toLinearMap m)
    {i j : ℤ} {x y : A} (hx : x ∈ 𝒜 i) (hy : y ∈ 𝒜 j)
    (hij : i < j) (hxy : D (x + y) = 0) : component 𝒜 D m y = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hxzero : proj 𝒜 (j + m) (D x) = 0 :=
    hD i x hx (j + m) (by omega)
  have heq := congrArg (proj 𝒜 (j + m)) hxy
  rw [map_add, map_add, map_zero, hxzero, zero_add] at heq
  rw [component_of_mem 𝒜 D m hy]
  exact heq

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LeadingComponent.componentLinear_eq_sum
statement:
theorem componentLinear_eq_sum [DecidableEq A] (D : A →ₗ[k] A) (m : ℤ) (x : A) :
    componentLinear 𝒜 D m x =
      ∑ i ∈ (DirectSum.decompose 𝒜 x).support, proj 𝒜 (i + m) (D (proj 𝒜 i x))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hsum : ∑ i ∈ (DirectSum.decompose 𝒜 x).support, proj 𝒜 i x = x :=
    DirectSum.sum_support_decompose 𝒜 x
  conv_lhs => rw [← hsum, map_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  exact componentLinear_of_mem 𝒜 D m (proj_mem 𝒜 i x)

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LeadingComponent.componentLinear_preserves
statement:
theorem componentLinear_preserves (D : A →ₗ[k] A) (m : ℤ) (S : Submodule k A)
    (hS : ∀ (i : ℤ) (x : A), x ∈ S → proj 𝒜 i x ∈ S)
    (hD : ∀ x : A, x ∈ S → D x ∈ S) {x : A} (hx : x ∈ S) :
    componentLinear 𝒜 D m x ∈ S
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [componentLinear_eq_sum]
  apply Submodule.sum_mem
  intro i _
  exact hS (i + m) _ (hD _ (hS i x hx))

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LeadingComponent.projection_preserves_of_commute
statement:
theorem projection_preserves_of_commute
    (ℬ : ℤ → Submodule k A) [GradedAlgebra ℬ]
    (hcomm : ∀ (i j : ℤ) (x : A),
      proj 𝒜 i (proj ℬ j x) = proj ℬ j (proj 𝒜 i x))
    {i j : ℤ} {x : A} (hx : x ∈ ℬ j) : proj 𝒜 i x ∈ ℬ j
proof:
:= by
  rw [← proj_of_mem ℬ hx, hcomm]
  exact proj_mem ℬ j _

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LeadingComponent.component_preserves_compatible_grading
statement:
theorem component_preserves_compatible_grading
    (ℬ : ℤ → Submodule k A) [GradedAlgebra ℬ]
    (hcomm : ∀ (i j : ℤ) (x : A),
      proj 𝒜 i (proj ℬ j x) = proj ℬ j (proj 𝒜 i x))
    (D : Derivation k A A) (m : ℤ)
    (hD : ∀ (j : ℤ) (x : A), x ∈ ℬ j → D x ∈ ℬ j)
    {j : ℤ} {x : A} (hx : x ∈ ℬ j) : component 𝒜 D m x ∈ ℬ j
proof:
:= by
  apply componentLinear_preserves 𝒜 D.toLinearMap m (ℬ j)
  · intro i x hx
    exact projection_preserves_of_commute 𝒜 ℬ hcomm hx
  · exact hD j
  · exact hx

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LeadingComponent.exists_nonzero_locallyNilpotent_component
statement:
theorem exists_nonzero_locallyNilpotent_component
    (g : ι → A) (d : ι → ℤ)
    (hg : Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range g) = ⊤)
    (hhom : ∀ i, g i ∈ 𝒜 (d i))
    (D : Derivation k A A) (hD : D ≠ 0)
    (hln : ∀ x : A, ∃ n : ℕ, (D : A → A)^[n] x = 0) :
    ∃ m : ℤ, component 𝒜 D m ≠ 0 ∧
      HasShiftLE 𝒜 D.toLinearMap m ∧
      (∀ x : A, ∃ n : ℕ, ((component 𝒜 D m : A → A)^[n] x) = 0)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, hm, _, hbound⟩ :=
    DerivationTopShift.exists_top_component_and_global_bound 𝒜 g d hg hhom D hD
      (component 𝒜 D) (fun m _ _ hx => component_of_mem 𝒜 D m hx)
  exact ⟨m, hm, hbound, locallyNilpotent_component 𝒜 D hbound hln⟩

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LeadingComponent.exists_nonzero_locallyNilpotent_component_annihilating_top
statement:
theorem exists_nonzero_locallyNilpotent_component_annihilating_top
    (g : ι → A) (d : ι → ℤ)
    (hg : Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range g) = ⊤)
    (hhom : ∀ i, g i ∈ 𝒜 (d i))
    (D : Derivation k A A) (hD : D ≠ 0)
    (hln : ∀ x : A, ∃ n : ℕ, (D : A → A)^[n] x = 0)
    {i j : ℤ} {x y : A} (hx : x ∈ 𝒜 i) (hy : y ∈ 𝒜 j)
    (hij : i < j) (hxy : D (x + y) = 0) :
    ∃ m : ℤ, component 𝒜 D m ≠ 0 ∧
      (∀ z : A, ∃ n : ℕ, ((component 𝒜 D m : A → A)^[n] z) = 0) ∧
      component 𝒜 D m y = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, hm, hbound, hnil⟩ :=
    exists_nonzero_locallyNilpotent_component 𝒜 g d hg hhom D hD hln
  exact ⟨m, hm, hnil, component_high_term_eq_zero 𝒜 D hbound hx hy hij hxy⟩

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LeadingComponent.exists_nonzero_locallyNilpotent_component_compatible
statement:
theorem exists_nonzero_locallyNilpotent_component_compatible
    (ℬ : ℤ → Submodule k A) [GradedAlgebra ℬ]
    (hcomm : ∀ (i j : ℤ) (x : A),
      proj 𝒜 i (proj ℬ j x) = proj ℬ j (proj 𝒜 i x))
    (g : ι → A) (d : ι → ℤ)
    (hg : Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range g) = ⊤)
    (hhom : ∀ i, g i ∈ 𝒜 (d i))
    (D : Derivation k A A) (hD : D ≠ 0)
    (hln : ∀ x : A, ∃ n : ℕ, (D : A → A)^[n] x = 0)
    (hpres : ∀ (r : ℤ) (z : A), z ∈ ℬ r → D z ∈ ℬ r)
    {i j : ℤ} {x y : A} (hx : x ∈ 𝒜 i) (hy : y ∈ 𝒜 j)
    (hij : i < j) (hxy : D (x + y) = 0) :
    ∃ m : ℤ, component 𝒜 D m ≠ 0 ∧
      (∀ z : A, ∃ n : ℕ, ((component 𝒜 D m : A → A)^[n] z) = 0) ∧
      (∀ (r : ℤ) (z : A), z ∈ ℬ r → component 𝒜 D m z ∈ ℬ r) ∧
      component 𝒜 D m y = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, hm, hnil, htop⟩ :=
    exists_nonzero_locallyNilpotent_component_annihilating_top 𝒜 g d hg hhom D hD hln
      hx hy hij hxy
  refine ⟨m, hm, hnil, ?_, htop⟩
  intro r z hz
  exact component_preserves_compatible_grading 𝒜 ℬ hcomm D m hpres hz

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.Obstruction.liftedAdditiveAction_derivation_preserves_fiberPiece
statement:
theorem liftedAdditiveAction_derivation_preserves_fiberPiece
    (α : PolynomialAdditiveAction k (B k)) :
    ∀ (n : ℤ) (q : C k), q ∈ fiberPiece k n →
      (liftedAdditiveAction α).derivation q ∈ fiberPiece k n
proof:
:= by
  apply DeterminantActionWeights.derivation_preserves_fiberPiece k
    (NormalizedDeterminantLift.liftHom α)
  · exact DeterminantLiftWeights.generator_coefficient_weights_of_normalized_lift k
      (NormalizedDeterminantLift.liftHom α) α.toAlgHom
      (NormalizedDeterminantLift.liftHom_baseMap α)
      (NormalizedDeterminantLift.liftHom_identity α)
  · intro q
    rfl

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.Obstruction.exists_weight_preserving_lnd_lift
statement:
theorem exists_weight_preserving_lnd_lift
    (E : Derivation k (B k) (B k)) (hE : IsLocallyNilpotent E) :
    ∃ D : Derivation k (C k) (C k), IsLocallyNilpotent D ∧
      (∀ b, D (baseMap k b) = baseMap k (E b)) ∧
      (∀ (n : ℤ) (q : C k), q ∈ fiberPiece k n → D q ∈ fiberPiece k n)
proof:
:= by
  let α := exponentialAction E hE
  let β := liftedAdditiveAction α
  refine ⟨β.derivation, β.locallyNilpotent, ?_,
    liftedAdditiveAction_derivation_preserves_fiberPiece α⟩
  intro b
  have h := α.derivation_naturality β (baseMap k)
    (liftedAdditiveAction_baseMap α) b
  simpa only [α, exponentialAction_derivation] using h

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.Obstruction.lift_invariant
statement:
theorem lift_invariant
    (E : Derivation k (B k) (B k)) (hE : IsLocallyNilpotent E) (hE0 : E ≠ 0)
    (hInv : ∃ h : B k, h ∈ I k ∧ h ≠ 0 ∧ E h = 0) :
    ∃ D : Derivation k (C k) (C k), IsLocallyNilpotent D ∧ D ≠ 0 ∧
      (∀ b, D (baseMap k b) = baseMap k (E b)) ∧
      (∀ (n : ℤ) (q : C k), q ∈ fiberPiece k n → D q ∈ fiberPiece k n) ∧
      D (v k) = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨D, hD, hExt, hWeight⟩ := exists_weight_preserving_lnd_lift E hE
  obtain ⟨hD0, hv⟩ := extension_nonzero_and_annihilates_v E D hE0 hD hExt hInv
  exact ⟨D, hD, hD0, hExt, hWeight, hv⟩

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.Obstruction.exists_nonzero_weight_preserving_lnd_killing_v
statement:
theorem exists_nonzero_weight_preserving_lnd_killing_v
    (E : Derivation k (B k) (B k)) (hE : IsLocallyNilpotent E) (hE0 : E ≠ 0)
    (hInv : ∃ h : B k, h ∈ I k ∧ h ≠ 0 ∧ E h = 0) :
    ∃ D : Derivation k (C k) (C k), D ≠ 0 ∧ IsLocallyNilpotent D ∧
      (∀ (n : ℤ) (q : C k), q ∈ fiberPiece k n → D q ∈ fiberPiece k n) ∧
      D (v k) = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨D, hD, hD0, _, hWeight, hv⟩ := lift_invariant E hE hE0 hInv
  exact ⟨D, hD0, hD, hWeight, hv⟩

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.exists_algebraMap_eq_of_two_power_denominators
statement:
theorem exists_algebraMap_eq_of_two_power_denominators
    (hinj : Function.Injective (algebraMap A K))
    {a d : A} (ha : a ≠ 0) (had : IsRelPrime a d)
    {z : K} {m n : ℕ} {r s : A}
    (hr : z * algebraMap A K (a ^ m) = algebraMap A K r)
    (hs : z * algebraMap A K (d ^ n) = algebraMap A K s) :
    ∃ t : A, algebraMap A K t = z
proof:
:= by
  have hcross : r * d ^ n = s * a ^ m := by
    apply hinj
    simp only [map_mul]
    rw [← hr, ← hs]
    exact mul_right_comm _ _ _
  have hdiv : a ^ m ∣ r :=
    had.pow.dvd_of_dvd_mul_right (hcross ▸ dvd_mul_left (a ^ m) s)
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hdiv
  refine ⟨t, ?_⟩
  apply mul_right_cancel₀ (show algebraMap A K (a ^ m) ≠ 0 from
    fun h ↦ pow_ne_zero m ha (hinj (h.trans (map_zero _).symm)))
  rw [hr, ht, map_mul, mul_comm]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.powers_le_nonZeroDivisors

theorem powers_le_nonZeroDivisors {a : A} (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    Submonoid.powers a ≤ nonZeroDivisors A
proof:
:= by
  rintro s ⟨n, rfl⟩
  exact mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_ne_zero.mpr (pow_ne_zero n ha)

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.mem_awayInFractionField_iff
statement:
theorem mem_awayInFractionField_iff (a : A) (ha : a ≠ 0) (z : K) :
    z ∈ awayInFractionField K a ha ↔
      ∃ (n : ℕ) (r : A), z * algebraMap A K (a ^ n) = algebraMap A K r
proof:
:= by
  change (∃ (r s : A) (_ : s ∈ Submonoid.powers a),
    z = algebraMap A K r * (algebraMap A K s)⁻¹) ↔ _
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨r, s, ⟨n, rfl⟩, hz⟩
    refine ⟨n, r, ?_⟩
    have hnonzero : algebraMap A K (a ^ n) ≠ 0 :=
      fun h ↦ pow_ne_zero n ha (IsFractionRing.injective A K (h.trans (map_zero _).symm))
    exact (eq_div_iff hnonzero).mp (by simpa only [div_eq_mul_inv] using hz)
  · rintro ⟨n, r, hz⟩
    refine ⟨r, a ^ n, ⟨n, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    have hnonzero : algebraMap A K (a ^ n) ≠ 0 :=
      fun h ↦ pow_ne_zero n ha (IsFractionRing.injective A K (h.trans (map_zero _).symm))
    simpa only [div_eq_mul_inv] using (eq_div_iff hnonzero).mpr hz

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.awayInFractionField_inf_eq_bot
statement:
theorem awayInFractionField_inf_eq_bot {a d : A} (ha : a ≠ 0) (hd : d ≠ 0)
    (had : IsRelPrime a d) :
    awayInFractionField K a ha ⊓ awayInFractionField K d hd = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm ?_ bot_le
  intro z hz
  obtain ⟨m, r, hr⟩ := (mem_awayInFractionField_iff K a ha z).mp hz.1
  obtain ⟨n, s, hs⟩ := (mem_awayInFractionField_iff K d hd z).mp hz.2
  exact Algebra.mem_bot.mpr
    (exists_algebraMap_eq_of_two_power_denominators
      (IsFractionRing.injective A K) ha had hr hs)

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LocalizationLND.transport_iterate

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LocalizationLND.transport_locallyNilpotent
statement:
theorem transport_locallyNilpotent (e : A ≃ₐ[k] B)
    (hD : ∀ a : A, ∃ n : ℕ, (D : A → A)^[n] a = 0) :
    ∀ b : B, ∃ n : ℕ, (transport D e : B → B)^[n] b = 0
proof:
:= by
  intro b
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := e.surjective b
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hD a
  exact ⟨n, by rw [transport_iterate, hn, map_zero]⟩

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LocalizationLND.transport_ne_zero
statement: theorem transport_ne_zero (e : A ≃ₐ[k] B) (hD : D ≠ 0) : transport D e ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  apply hD
  ext a
  apply e.injective
  have he := congrArg (fun (d : Derivation k B B) => d (e a)) h
  simpa only [transport_apply, Derivation.zero_apply, map_zero] using he

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LocalizationLND.localizeTo_mk'
statement:
@[simp] theorem localizeTo_mk' (a : A) (b : M) :
    localizeTo D M hM S (IsLocalization.mk' S a b) = IsLocalization.mk' S (D a) b
proof:
:= by
  change transport (localize D M hM) ((Localization.algEquiv M S).restrictScalars k)
    (IsLocalization.mk' S a b) = _
  rw [← Localization.algEquiv_mk, ← AlgEquiv.restrictScalars_apply k, transport_apply]
  change Localization.algEquiv M S (localize D M hM (Localization.mk a b)) = _
  rw [localize_mk, Localization.algEquiv_mk]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LocalizationLND.localizeTo_algebraMap
statement:
@[simp] theorem localizeTo_algebraMap (a : A) :
    localizeTo D M hM S (algebraMap A S a) = algebraMap A S (D a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← IsLocalization.mk'_one (S := S) (M := M) a, localizeTo_mk',
    IsLocalization.mk'_one]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LocalizationLND.localizeTo_locallyNilpotent
statement:
theorem localizeTo_locallyNilpotent
    (hD : ∀ a : A, ∃ n : ℕ, (D : A → A)^[n] a = 0) :
    ∀ s : S, ∃ n : ℕ, (localizeTo D M hM S : S → S)^[n] s = 0
proof:
:=
  transport_locallyNilpotent _ _ (localize_locallyNilpotent D M hM hD)

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LocalizationLND.localizeTo_ne_zero
statement:
theorem localizeTo_ne_zero (hinj : Function.Injective (algebraMap A S)) (hD : D ≠ 0) :
    localizeTo D M hM S ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  apply hD
  ext a
  apply hinj
  have he := congrArg (fun (d : Derivation k S S) => d (algebraMap A S a)) h
  simpa only [localizeTo_algebraMap, Derivation.zero_apply, map_zero] using he

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LocalizationLND.annihilates_powers
statement: theorem annihilates_powers : ∀ m : Submonoid.powers a, D (m : A) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨m, hm⟩
  obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := hm
  simp only [Derivation.leibniz_pow, ha, smul_zero]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LocalizationLND.localizeAway_algebraMap
statement:
@[simp] theorem localizeAway_algebraMap (b : A) :
    localizeAway D a ha S (algebraMap A S b) = algebraMap A S (D b)
proof:
:=
  localizeTo_algebraMap D (Submonoid.powers a) (annihilates_powers D a ha) S b

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.LocalizationLND.localizeAway_locallyNilpotent
statement:
theorem localizeAway_locallyNilpotent
    (hD : ∀ b : A, ∃ n : ℕ, (D : A → A)^[n] b = 0) :
    ∀ s : S, ∃ n : ℕ, (localizeAway D a ha S : S → S)^[n] s = 0
proof:
:=
  localizeTo_locallyNilpotent D (Submonoid.powers a) (annihilates_powers D a ha) S hD

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.MatrixChange.map_quad
statement:
@[simp] lemma map_quad (h : G) (p s u F : K) :
    h (quad p s u F) = quad (h p) (h s) (h u) (h F)
proof:
:= by
  simp [quad]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.MatrixChange.map_pChange
statement:
@[simp] lemma map_pChange (h : G) (t p s u F J : K) :
    h (pChange t p s u F J) = pChange (h t) (h p) (h s) (h u) (h F) (h J)
proof:
:= by
  simp [pChange, map_ofNat]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.MatrixChange.map_sChange
statement:
@[simp] lemma map_sChange (h : G) (t p s u F J : K) :
    h (sChange t p s u F J) = sChange (h t) (h p) (h s) (h u) (h F) (h J)
proof:
:= by
  simp [sChange, map_ofNat]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.MatrixChange.map_uChange
statement:
@[simp] lemma map_uChange (h : G) (t p s u F J : K) :
    h (uChange t p s u F J) = uChange (h t) (h p) (h s) (h u) (h F) (h J)
proof:
:= by
  simp [uChange, map_ofNat]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.MatrixChange.map_FChange
statement:
@[simp] lemma map_FChange (h : G) (t p s u F J : K) :
    h (FChange t p s u F J) = FChange (h t) (h p) (h s) (h u) (h F) (h J)
proof:
:= by
  simp [FChange, map_ofNat]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.MatrixChange.map_relation
statement:
@[simp] lemma map_relation (h : G) (p s u F J : K) :
    h (relation p s u F J) = relation (h p) (h s) (h u) (h F) (h J)
proof:
:= by
  simp [relation, map_ofNat]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.MatrixChange.quad_change
statement:
lemma quad_change (t p s u F J : K) :
    quad (pChange t p s u F J) (sChange t p s u F J)
      (uChange t p s u F J) (FChange t p s u F J) = quad p s u F
proof:
:= by
  unfold quad pChange sChange uChange FChange
  ring

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.MatrixChange.pChange_add
statement:
lemma pChange_add (t r p s u F J : K) :
    pChange t (pChange r p s u F J) (sChange r p s u F J)
      (uChange r p s u F J) (FChange r p s u F J) J = pChange (t + r) p s u F J
proof:
:= by
  rw [pChange]
  simp only [quad_change]
  simp only [pChange, sChange, uChange]
  ring

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.MatrixChange.sChange_add
statement:
lemma sChange_add (t r p s u F J : K) :
    sChange t (pChange r p s u F J) (sChange r p s u F J)
      (uChange r p s u F J) (FChange r p s u F J) J = sChange (t + r) p s u F J
proof:
:= by
  rw [sChange]
  simp only [quad_change]
  simp only [pChange, sChange, uChange, FChange]
  ring

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.MatrixChange.uChange_add
statement:
lemma uChange_add (t r p s u F J : K) :
    uChange t (pChange r p s u F J) (sChange r p s u F J)
      (uChange r p s u F J) (FChange r p s u F J) J = uChange (t + r) p s u F J
proof:
:= by
  rw [uChange]
  simp only [quad_change]
  simp only [pChange, sChange, uChange, FChange]
  ring

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.MatrixChange.FChange_add
statement:
lemma FChange_add (t r p s u F J : K) :
    FChange t (pChange r p s u F J) (sChange r p s u F J)
      (uChange r p s u F J) (FChange r p s u F J) J = FChange (t + r) p s u F J
proof:
:= by
  rw [FChange]
  simp only [quad_change]
  simp only [sChange, uChange, FChange]
  ring

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.MatrixChange.pChange_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma pChange_zero (p s u F J : K) : pChange 0 p s u F J = p
proof:
:= by
  simp [pChange]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.MatrixChange.sChange_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma sChange_zero (p s u F J : K) : sChange 0 p s u F J = s
proof:
:= by
  simp [sChange]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.MatrixChange.uChange_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma uChange_zero (p s u F J : K) : uChange 0 p s u F J = u
proof:
:= by
  simp [uChange]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.MatrixChange.FChange_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma FChange_zero (p s u F J : K) : FChange 0 p s u F J = F
proof:
:= by
  simp [FChange]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.MatrixChange.uChange_one
statement:
lemma uChange_one (p s u F J : K) :
    uChange 1 p s u F J = -relation p s u F J - J
proof:
:= by
  unfold uChange relation
  ring

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.MatrixChange.relation_change_neg_one
statement:
lemma relation_change_neg_one (p s u F J : K) :
    relation (pChange (-1) p s u F J) (sChange (-1) p s u F J)
      (uChange (-1) p s u F J) (FChange (-1) p s u F J) J = -J - u
proof:
:= by
  have h := uChange_one (pChange (-1) p s u F J) (sChange (-1) p s u F J)
      (uChange (-1) p s u F J) (FChange (-1) p s u F J) J
  rw [uChange_add] at h
  simp only [add_neg_cancel, uChange_zero] at h
  linear_combination h

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.ModificationEmbedding.polynomialMap_X
statement:
@[simp]
theorem polynomialMap_X (i : Fin 5) :
    polynomialMap k (X i) = values k i
proof:
:=
  MvPolynomial.aeval_X _ _

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.ModificationEmbedding.toLaurent_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toLaurent_mk (p : P k 5) :
    toLaurent k (Ideal.Quotient.mk (idealG k) p) = polynomialMap k p
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.ModificationEmbedding.toLaurent_gX
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toLaurent_gX (i : Fin 5) :
    toLaurent k (gX k i) = values k i
proof:
:=
  LaurentPresentation.toLaurentBase_gX k i

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.ModificationEmbedding.values_mem
statement:
theorem values_mem (i : Fin 5) :
    values k i ∈ ModificationPieces.modification (I k)
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases i
  · exact ModificationPieces.T_one_mem_modification _
  · exact (ModificationPieces.modification (I k)).algebraMap_mem _
  · exact (ModificationPieces.modification (I k)).algebraMap_mem _
  · apply ModificationPieces.numerator_mem_modification
    exact Ideal.subset_span (by simp)
  · apply ModificationPieces.numerator_mem_modification
    exact Ideal.subset_span (by simp)

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.ModificationEmbedding.polynomialMap_mem
statement:
theorem polynomialMap_mem (p : P k 5) :
    polynomialMap k p ∈ ModificationPieces.modification (I k)
proof:
:= by
  induction p using MvPolynomial.induction_on with
  | C a =>
      simp only [polynomialMap, MvPolynomial.aeval_C, LaurentPolynomial.algebraMap_apply]
      exact (ModificationPieces.modification (I k)).algebraMap_mem _
  | add p q hp hq =>
      rw [map_add]
      exact (ModificationPieces.modification (I k)).add_mem hp hq
  | mul_X p i hp =>
      rw [map_mul, polynomialMap_X]
      exact (ModificationPieces.modification (I k)).mul_mem hp (values_mem k i)

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.ModificationEmbedding.toLaurent_mem
statement:
theorem toLaurent_mem (a : G k) :
    toLaurent k a ∈ ModificationPieces.modification (I k)
proof:
:= by
  induction a using Quotient.inductionOn with
  | h p => exact polynomialMap_mem k p

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.ModificationEmbedding.values_homogeneous
statement:
theorem values_homogeneous (i : Fin 5) :
    ModificationPieces.Homogeneous (presentationWeight i) (values k i)
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases i
  · exact ModificationPieces.homogeneous_single (-1) (1 : B k)
  · exact ModificationPieces.homogeneous_C (sB k)
  · exact ModificationPieces.homogeneous_C (bX k 3)
  · change ModificationPieces.Homogeneous 1 (LP.C (f0 k) * LP.T (-1))
    rw [← LaurentPolynomial.single_eq_C_mul_T]
    exact ModificationPieces.homogeneous_single 1 (f0 k)
  · change ModificationPieces.Homogeneous 1 (LP.C (g0 k) * LP.T (-1))
    rw [← LaurentPolynomial.single_eq_C_mul_T]
    exact ModificationPieces.homogeneous_single 1 (g0 k)

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.ModificationEmbedding.polynomialMap_homogeneous
proof:
:=
  ModificationPieces.homogeneous_aeval presentationWeight (values k)
    (values_homogeneous k) hp

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.ModificationEmbedding.polynomialMap_positive_piece
proof:
:=
  ModificationPieces.homogeneous_numerator (polynomialMap_mem k p)
    (polynomialMap_homogeneous k hp)

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.ModificationEmbedding.polynomialMap_positive_nonzero_numerator
statement:
theorem polynomialMap_positive_nonzero_numerator {p : P k 5} {ℓ : ℕ}
    (hℓ : 0 < ℓ) (hp : p.IsWeightedHomogeneous presentationWeight (ℓ : ℤ))
    (hne : polynomialMap k p ≠ 0) :
    ∃ h ∈ I k, h ≠ 0 ∧ polynomialMap k p = LP.C h * LP.T (-(ℓ : ℤ))
proof:
:=
  ModificationPieces.positive_nonzero_numerator hℓ (polynomialMap_mem k p)
    (polynomialMap_homogeneous k hp) hne

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.ModificationEmbedding.image_eq_modification
statement:
theorem image_eq_modification :
    imageSubalgebra k = ModificationPieces.modification (I k)
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · rintro p ⟨a, rfl⟩
    exact toLaurent_mem k a
  · rw [I, ModificationPieces.modification_pair_eq]
    apply Algebra.adjoin_le
    rintro p (rfl | rfl | rfl)
    · exact ⟨gX k 0, toLaurent_gX k 0⟩
    · exact ⟨gX k 3, toLaurent_gX k 3⟩
    · exact ⟨gX k 4, toLaurent_gX k 4⟩

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.ModificationEmbedding.range_toLaurent
statement:
theorem range_toLaurent :
    Set.range (toLaurent k) = (ModificationPieces.modification (I k) : Set _)
proof:
:= by
  change (imageSubalgebra k : Set (LaurentPolynomial (B k))) = _
  rw [image_eq_modification]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.ModificationPieces.mem_extendedRees_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_extendedRees_iff (I : Ideal R) (p : R[T;T⁻¹]) :
    p ∈ extendedRees I ↔ ∀ n : ℤ, p.coeff n ∈ I ^ (-n).toNat
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.ModificationPieces.single_mem_extendedRees_iff
statement:
theorem single_mem_extendedRees_iff (I : Ideal R) (n : ℤ) (r : R) :
    AddMonoidAlgebra.single n r ∈ extendedRees I ↔ r ∈ I ^ (-n).toNat
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    simpa only [AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_single, Finsupp.single_apply, ite_true] using h n
  · intro h i
    by_cases hi : n = i
    · subst i
      simpa only [AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_single, Finsupp.single_apply, ite_true] using h
    · simp only [AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_single, Finsupp.single_apply, ite_eq_right hi]
      exact Ideal.zero_mem _

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.ModificationPieces.T_one_mem_modification
statement:
theorem T_one_mem_modification (I : Ideal R) :
    (T 1 : R[T;T⁻¹]) ∈ modification I
proof:
:=
  Algebra.subset_adjoin (Set.mem_insert _ _)

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.ModificationPieces.numerator_mem_modification
statement:
theorem numerator_mem_modification {I : Ideal R} {r : R} (hr : r ∈ I) :
    C r * T (-1) ∈ modification I
proof:
:=
  Algebra.subset_adjoin (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ ⟨r, hr, rfl⟩)

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.ModificationPieces.modification_le_extendedRees
statement:
theorem modification_le_extendedRees (I : Ideal R) :
    modification I ≤ extendedRees I
proof:
:= by
  apply Algebra.adjoin_le
  rintro p (rfl | ⟨r, hr, rfl⟩)
  · change AddMonoidAlgebra.single 1 1 ∈ extendedRees I
    rw [single_mem_extendedRees_iff]
    simp
  · dsimp only
    rw [← single_eq_C_mul_T]
    change AddMonoidAlgebra.single (-1) r ∈ extendedRees I
    rw [single_mem_extendedRees_iff]
    simpa using hr

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.ModificationPieces.negative_single_mem_modification
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing r with
  | zero =>
      change C r ∈ modification I
      exact (modification I).algebraMap_mem r
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [pow_succ'] at hr
      refine Submodule.smul_induction_on hr ?_ ?_
      · intro a ha b hb
        have h₁ := numerator_mem_modification ha
        have h₂ := ih hb
        rw [← single_eq_C_mul_T] at h₁
        convert (modification I).mul_mem h₁ h₂ using 1
        simp only [smul_eq_mul, AddMonoidAlgebra.single_mul_single, Nat.cast_add,
          Nat.cast_one, neg_add_rev]
      · intro a b ha hb
        simpa only [AddMonoidAlgebra.single_add] using
          (modification I).add_mem ha hb

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.ModificationPieces.nonnegative_single_mem_modification
statement:
theorem nonnegative_single_mem_modification (I : Ideal R) (n : ℤ) (hn : 0 ≤ n)
    (r : R) :
    AddMonoidAlgebra.single n r ∈ modification I
proof:
:= by
  have hT := (modification I).pow_mem (T_one_mem_modification I) n.toNat
  rw [T_pow, mul_one, Int.toNat_of_nonneg hn] at hT
  rw [single_eq_C_mul_T]
  exact (modification I).mul_mem ((modification I).algebraMap_mem r) hT

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.ModificationPieces.single_mem_modification_of_mem_power
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hn : 0 ≤ n
  · exact nonnegative_single_mem_modification I n hn r
  · convert negative_single_mem_modification hr using 1
    congr 1
    omega

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.ModificationPieces.modification_eq_extendedRees
statement:
theorem modification_eq_extendedRees (I : Ideal R) :
    modification I = extendedRees I
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm (modification_le_extendedRees I)
  intro p hp
  rw [← p.sum_coeff_single]
  unfold Finsupp.sum
  apply Subalgebra.sum_mem
  intro n hn
  exact single_mem_modification_of_mem_power n (hp n)

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.ModificationPieces.single_mem_modification_iff
statement:
theorem single_mem_modification_iff (I : Ideal R) (n : ℤ) (r : R) :
    AddMonoidAlgebra.single n r ∈ modification I ↔ r ∈ I ^ (-n).toNat
proof:
:= by
  rw [modification_eq_extendedRees, single_mem_extendedRees_iff]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.ModificationPieces.positive_piece
statement:
theorem positive_piece (I : Ideal R) (ℓ : ℕ) (r : R) :
    C r * T (-(ℓ : ℤ)) ∈ modification I ↔ r ∈ I ^ ℓ
proof:
:= by
  rw [← single_eq_C_mul_T, single_mem_modification_iff]
  simp

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.ModificationPieces.coefficient_mem_power
proof:
:= by
  have h := modification_le_extendedRees I hp (-(ℓ : ℤ))
  simpa using h

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.ModificationPieces.modification_span_eq
statement:
theorem modification_span_eq (s : Set R) :
    modification (Ideal.span s) = generatedModification s
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · have hspan : Ideal.span s ≤ numeratorIdeal (generatedModification s) := by
      apply Ideal.span_le.mpr
      intro r hr
      exact Algebra.subset_adjoin (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ ⟨r, hr, rfl⟩)
    apply Algebra.adjoin_le
    rintro p (rfl | ⟨r, hr, rfl⟩)
    · exact Algebra.subset_adjoin (Set.mem_insert _ _)
    · exact hspan hr
  · apply Algebra.adjoin_le
    rintro p (rfl | ⟨r, hr, rfl⟩)
    · exact T_one_mem_modification _
    · exact numerator_mem_modification (Ideal.subset_span hr)

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.ModificationPieces.modification_pair_eq
statement:
theorem modification_pair_eq (f g : R) :
    modification (Ideal.span ({f, g} : Set R)) =
      Algebra.adjoin R ({T 1, C f * T (-1), C g * T (-1)} : Set R[T;T⁻¹])
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [generatedModification, Set.image_insert_eq, Set.image_singleton] using
    modification_span_eq ({f, g} : Set R)

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.ModificationPieces.eq_single_of_homogeneous
proof:
:= by
  apply LaurentPolynomial.ext
  intro n
  by_cases hn : n = -ℓ
  · subst n
    simp only [AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_single, Finsupp.single_apply, ite_true]
  · rw [hp n hn]
    simp only [AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_single, Finsupp.single_apply,
      ite_eq_right (Ne.symm hn)]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.ModificationPieces.homogeneous_single
statement:
theorem homogeneous_single (ℓ : ℤ) (r : R) :
    Homogeneous ℓ (AddMonoidAlgebra.single (-ℓ) r)
proof:
:= by
  intro n hn
  simp only [AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_single, Finsupp.single_apply, ite_eq_right (Ne.symm hn)]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.ModificationPieces.homogeneous_zero
statement: theorem homogeneous_zero (ℓ : ℤ) : Homogeneous ℓ (0 : R[T;T⁻¹])
proof:
:= by
  intro n hn
  simp

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.ModificationPieces.homogeneous_C
statement: theorem homogeneous_C (r : R) : Homogeneous 0 (C r)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [neg_zero, LaurentPolynomial.single_eq_C] using homogeneous_single 0 r

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.ModificationPieces.Homogeneous.add
statement:
theorem add {d : ℤ} {p q : R[T;T⁻¹]} (hp : Homogeneous d p) (hq : Homogeneous d q) :
    Homogeneous d (p + q)
proof:
:= by
  intro n hn
  simp only [AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_add, Finsupp.add_apply, hp n hn, hq n hn, add_zero]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.ModificationPieces.Homogeneous.mul
statement:
theorem mul {d e : ℤ} {p q : R[T;T⁻¹]} (hp : Homogeneous d p) (hq : Homogeneous e q) :
    Homogeneous (d + e) (p * q)
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_single_of_homogeneous hp, eq_single_of_homogeneous hq,
    AddMonoidAlgebra.single_mul_single, ← neg_add]
  exact homogeneous_single _ _

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.ModificationPieces.Homogeneous.pow
statement:
theorem pow {d : ℤ} {p : R[T;T⁻¹]} (hp : Homogeneous d p) (n : ℕ) :
    Homogeneous (n • d) (p ^ n)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      simpa only [pow_zero, zero_nsmul, map_one] using homogeneous_C (1 : R)
  | succ n ih =>
      simpa only [pow_succ, succ_nsmul] using ih.mul hp

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.ModificationPieces.Homogeneous.sum
statement:
theorem sum {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (p : ι → R[T;T⁻¹]) (d : ℤ)
    (hp : ∀ i ∈ s, Homogeneous d (p i)) : Homogeneous d (∑ i ∈ s, p i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simpa using homogeneous_zero d
  | @insert i s his ih =>
      rw [Finset.sum_insert his]
      exact (hp i (Finset.mem_insert_self _ _)).add
        (ih (fun j hj => hp j (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hj)))

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.ModificationPieces.Homogeneous.prod
statement:
theorem prod {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (p : ι → R[T;T⁻¹]) (d : ι → ℤ)
    (hp : ∀ i ∈ s, Homogeneous (d i) (p i)) :
    Homogeneous (∑ i ∈ s, d i) (∏ i ∈ s, p i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simpa only [Finset.sum_empty, Finset.prod_empty, map_one] using homogeneous_C (1 : R)
  | @insert i s his ih =>
      rw [Finset.sum_insert his, Finset.prod_insert his]
      exact (hp i (Finset.mem_insert_self _ _)).mul
        (ih (fun j hj => hp j (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hj)))

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.ModificationPieces.homogeneous_aeval
statement:
theorem homogeneous_aeval {k σ : Type*} [CommRing k] [Algebra k R]
    (w : σ → ℤ) (v : σ → R[T;T⁻¹]) (hv : ∀ i, Homogeneous (w i) (v i))
    {p : MvPolynomial σ k} {d : ℤ} (hp : p.IsWeightedHomogeneous w d) :
    Homogeneous d (MvPolynomial.aeval v p)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [p.as_sum, map_sum]
  apply Homogeneous.sum
  intro m hm
  rw [MvPolynomial.aeval_monomial]
  have hprod : Homogeneous (Finsupp.weight w m) (m.prod fun i n => v i ^ n) := by
    simpa only [Finsupp.weight_apply, Finsupp.sum, Finsupp.prod] using
      Homogeneous.prod m.support (fun i => v i ^ m i) (fun i => m i • w i)
        (fun i hi => (hv i).pow (m i))
  have hweight : Finsupp.weight w m = d := hp (MvPolynomial.mem_support_iff.mp hm)
  simpa only [LaurentPolynomial.algebraMap_apply, zero_add, hweight] using
    (homogeneous_C (algebraMap k R (p.coeff m))).mul hprod

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.ModificationPieces.homogeneous_numerator
proof:
:=
  ⟨p.coeff (-(ℓ : ℤ)), coefficient_mem_power hp ℓ,
    (eq_single_of_homogeneous hh).trans (single_eq_C_mul_T _ _)⟩

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.ModificationPieces.homogeneous_nonzero_numerator
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, hr, heq⟩ := homogeneous_numerator hp hh
  refine ⟨r, hr, ?_, heq⟩
  intro hzero
  apply hne
  simp [heq, hzero]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.ModificationPieces.positive_nonzero_numerator
statement:
theorem positive_nonzero_numerator {I : Ideal R} {ℓ : ℕ} {p : R[T;T⁻¹]}
    (hℓ : 0 < ℓ) (hp : p ∈ modification I)
    (hh : Homogeneous (ℓ : ℤ) p) (hne : p ≠ 0) :
    ∃ r ∈ I, r ≠ 0 ∧ p = C r * T (-(ℓ : ℤ))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hne, heq⟩ := homogeneous_nonzero_numerator hp hh hne
  exact ⟨r, Ideal.pow_le_self (Nat.ne_zero_of_lt hℓ) hr, hne, heq⟩

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.f_not_coordinate
statement: theorem f_not_coordinate : ¬ IsCoordinate (by decide : 0 < 4) f
proof:
:= by
  intro hf
  obtain ⟨E, hE, hE0, hInv⟩ := CoordinateToQuadric.f_coordinate_produces_quadric_lnd hf
  exact Obstruction.no_nonzero_lnd_preserving_fiber_weights_killing_v ℂ
    (Obstruction.exists_nonzero_weight_preserving_lnd_killing_v E hE hE0 hInv)

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.monomial_weight_nonneg
statement:
theorem monomial_weight_nonneg (w : σ → ℤ) (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i)
    (d : σ →₀ ℕ) : 0 ≤ Finsupp.weight w d
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [Finsupp.weight_apply, Finsupp.sum]
  exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => nsmul_nonneg (hw i) (d i)

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.homogeneous_weight_nonneg
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := MvPolynomial.ne_zero_iff.mp hp
  rw [← hn hd]
  exact monomial_weight_nonneg w hw d

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.eq_zero_of_homogeneous_negative
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hp
  exact (not_le_of_gt hneg) (homogeneous_weight_nonneg hw hp hn)

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.homogeneousComponent_negative
statement:
theorem homogeneousComponent_negative {w : σ → ℤ} (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i)
    (p : MvPolynomial σ K) {n : ℤ} (hneg : n < 0) :
    MvPolynomial.weightedHomogeneousComponent w n p = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply eq_zero_of_homogeneous_negative hw
  · exact MvPolynomial.weightedHomogeneousComponent_isWeightedHomogeneous n p
  · exact hneg

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.rigidityPolynomialWeight_nonneg
statement:
theorem rigidityPolynomialWeight_nonneg (i : Fin 3) :
    0 ≤ rigidityPolynomialWeight i
proof:
:= by
  unfold rigidityPolynomialWeight
  split_ifs <;> norm_num

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.rigidity_polynomial_weight_neg_two
proof:
:= by
  exact eq_zero_of_homogeneous_negative rigidityPolynomialWeight_nonneg hq (by norm_num)

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.no_nonzero_rigidity_polynomial_weight_neg_two
statement:
theorem no_nonzero_rigidity_polynomial_weight_neg_two {K : Type*} [CommSemiring K]
    (q : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) K) (hq : q ≠ 0) :
    ¬ q.IsWeightedHomogeneous rigidityPolynomialWeight (-2)
proof:
:= by
  intro hweight
  exact hq (rigidity_polynomial_weight_neg_two hweight)

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.NonzeroFiber.quadric_identity
statement:
theorem quadric_identity (p s u F J : K) :
    xCoord p s u F * yCoord p s u F - zCoord p s u F J * (zCoord p s u F J + 1) =
      p * (relation p s u F J + u)
proof:
:= by
  unfold xCoord yCoord zCoord relation quadric
  ring

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.NonzeroFiber.x_inverse
statement:
theorem x_inverse (p t x y z : K) (hpt : p*t=1) :
    xCoord p (inverseS t x y z) (inverseU t x y z) (inverseF t x y z) = x
proof:
:= by
  unfold xCoord quadric inverseF
  rw [← mul_assoc, hpt, one_mul]
  ring

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.NonzeroFiber.y_inverse
statement:
theorem y_inverse (p t x y z : K) (hpt : p*t=1) :
    yCoord p (inverseS t x y z) (inverseU t x y z) (inverseF t x y z) = y
proof:
:= by
  change inverseS t x y z + xCoord p (inverseS t x y z) (inverseU t x y z)
    (inverseF t x y z) * (xCoord p (inverseS t x y z) (inverseU t x y z)
    (inverseF t x y z) + inverseU t x y z ^ 2) = y
  rw [x_inverse p t x y z hpt]
  unfold inverseS
  ring

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.NonzeroFiber.z_inverse
statement:
theorem z_inverse (p t x y z : K) (hpt : p*t=1) :
    zCoord p (inverseS t x y z) (inverseU t x y z) (inverseF t x y z)
      (inverseJ t x y z) = z
proof:
:= by
  change inverseS t x y z * xCoord p (inverseS t x y z) (inverseU t x y z)
    (inverseF t x y z) + p*inverseJ t x y z = z
  rw [x_inverse p t x y z hpt]
  unfold inverseJ
  rw [← mul_assoc, hpt, one_mul]
  ring

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.NonzeroFiber.inverseU_forward
statement:
theorem inverseU_forward (p t s u F J : K) (hpt : p*t=1)
    (hH : relation p s u F J = 0) :
    inverseU t (xCoord p s u F) (yCoord p s u F) (zCoord p s u F J) = u
proof:
:= by
  unfold inverseU
  rw [quadric_identity, hH, zero_add, ← mul_assoc, mul_comm t p, hpt, one_mul]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.NonzeroFiber.inverseS_forward
statement:
theorem inverseS_forward (p t s u F J : K) (hpt : p*t=1)
    (hH : relation p s u F J = 0) :
    inverseS t (xCoord p s u F) (yCoord p s u F) (zCoord p s u F J) = s
proof:
:= by
  unfold inverseS
  rw [inverseU_forward p t s u F J hpt hH]
  unfold xCoord yCoord
  ring

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.NonzeroFiber.inverseF_forward
statement:
theorem inverseF_forward (p t s u F J : K) (hpt : p*t=1)
    (hH : relation p s u F J = 0) :
    inverseF t (xCoord p s u F) (yCoord p s u F) (zCoord p s u F J) = F
proof:
:= by
  unfold inverseF
  rw [inverseU_forward p t s u F J hpt hH, inverseS_forward p t s u F J hpt hH]
  unfold xCoord quadric
  have ht : t*p=1 := by simpa [mul_comm] using hpt
  calc
    t * (s ^ 2 - u ^ 2 + p * F - s ^ 2 + u ^ 2) = (t*p)*F := by ring
    _ = F := by rw [ht, one_mul]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.NonzeroFiber.inverseJ_forward
statement:
theorem inverseJ_forward (p t s u F J : K) (hpt : p*t=1)
    (hH : relation p s u F J = 0) :
    inverseJ t (xCoord p s u F) (yCoord p s u F) (zCoord p s u F J) = J
proof:
:= by
  unfold inverseJ
  rw [inverseS_forward p t s u F J hpt hH]
  unfold zCoord xCoord
  have ht : t*p=1 := by simpa [mul_comm] using hpt
  calc
    t * (s * quadric p s u F + p * J - s * quadric p s u F) = (t*p)*J := by ring
    _ = J := by rw [ht, one_mul]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.NonzeroFiber.relation_inverse
statement:
theorem relation_inverse (p t x y z : K) (hpt : p*t=1) :
    relation p (inverseS t x y z) (inverseU t x y z) (inverseF t x y z)
      (inverseJ t x y z) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hq := quadric_identity p (inverseS t x y z) (inverseU t x y z)
    (inverseF t x y z) (inverseJ t x y z)
  rw [x_inverse p t x y z hpt, y_inverse p t x y z hpt,
    z_inverse p t x y z hpt] at hq
  have hu : p*inverseU t x y z = x*y-z*(z+1) := by
    unfold inverseU
    rw [← mul_assoc, hpt, one_mul]
  have hz : p*relation p (inverseS t x y z) (inverseU t x y z)
      (inverseF t x y z) (inverseJ t x y z) = 0 := by
    calc
      _ = p*(relation p (inverseS t x y z) (inverseU t x y z)
        (inverseF t x y z) (inverseJ t x y z) + inverseU t x y z) -
        p*inverseU t x y z := by ring
      _ = 0 := by rw [← hq, hu, sub_self]
  calc
    _ = t*(p*relation p (inverseS t x y z) (inverseU t x y z)
      (inverseF t x y z) (inverseJ t x y z)) := by
        rw [← mul_assoc, mul_comm t p, hpt, one_mul]
    _ = 0 := by rw [hz, mul_zero]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.NonzeroFiber.forward_X
statement: @[simp] theorem forward_X (l : K) (i : Fin 5) : forward l (X i) = decode l i
proof:
:=
  MvPolynomial.aeval_X _ _

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.NonzeroFiber.forward_C
statement: @[simp] theorem forward_C (l c : K) : forward l (C c) = C c
proof:
:=
  MvPolynomial.aeval_C _ _

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.NonzeroFiber.constants_inv
statement:
theorem constants_inv (l : K) (hl : l≠0) :
    (C l : P3 K)*C l⁻¹=1
proof: := by rw [← map_mul, mul_inv_cancel₀ hl, map_one]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.NonzeroFiber.forward_H
statement: theorem forward_H (l : K) (hl : l≠0) : forward l H = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold H
  simp only [relation, quadric, map_sub, map_add, map_mul, map_pow, map_one,
    map_ofNat, forward_X]
  change relation (C l) (inverseS (C l⁻¹) (X 0) (X 1) (X 2))
    (inverseU (C l⁻¹) (X 0) (X 1) (X 2))
    (inverseF (C l⁻¹) (X 0) (X 1) (X 2))
    (inverseJ (C l⁻¹) (X 0) (X 1) (X 2)) = 0
  exact relation_inverse (C l : P3 K) (C l⁻¹) (X 0) (X 1) (X 2) (constants_inv l hl)

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.NonzeroFiber.forward_relation
statement: theorem forward_relation (l : K) : forward l (X 0-C l) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [decode]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.NonzeroFiber.forward_kills
statement: theorem forward_kills (l : K) (hl : l≠0) : ∀ a ∈ fiberIdeal l, forward l a=0
proof:
:= by
  intro a ha
  rcases Ideal.mem_span_pair.mp ha with ⟨b,c,rfl⟩
  simp [forward_H l hl, forward_relation l]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.NonzeroFiber.toPoly_mk
statement:
@[simp] theorem toPoly_mk (l : K) (hl : l≠0) (a : P5 K) :
    toPoly l hl (mk l a)=forward l a
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.NonzeroFiber.fromPoly_X
statement: @[simp] theorem fromPoly_X (l : K) (i : Fin 3) : fromPoly l (X i)=encode l i
proof:
:=
  MvPolynomial.aeval_X _ _

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.NonzeroFiber.fromPoly_C
statement: @[simp] theorem fromPoly_C (l c : K) : fromPoly l (C c)=algebraMap K (Fiber l) c
proof:
:=
  MvPolynomial.aeval_C _ _

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.NonzeroFiber.mk_H
statement: theorem mk_H (l : K) : mk l H = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr
  exact Ideal.subset_span (by simp)

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.NonzeroFiber.mk_p
statement: theorem mk_p (l : K) : mk l (X 0) = algebraMap K (Fiber l) l
proof:
:= by
  have hr : mk l (X 0-C l) = 0 := by
    apply Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr
    exact Ideal.subset_span (by simp)
  simpa only [map_sub, AlgHom.commutes, algebraMap_eq] using sub_eq_zero.mp hr

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.NonzeroFiber.mk_relation
statement:
theorem mk_relation (l : K) :
    relation (mk l (X 0)) (mk l (X 1)) (mk l (X 2)) (mk l (X 3)) (mk l (X 4))=0
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [H, relation, quadric, map_sub, map_add, map_mul, map_pow, map_one,
    map_ofNat] using mk_H l

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.NonzeroFiber.mk_unit
statement:
theorem mk_unit (l : K) (hl : l≠0) :
    mk l (X 0)*algebraMap K (Fiber l) l⁻¹=1
proof:
:= by
  rw [mk_p, ← map_mul, mul_inv_cancel₀ hl, map_one]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.NonzeroFiber.toPoly_fromPoly
statement:
theorem toPoly_fromPoly (l : K) (hl : l≠0) :
    (toPoly l hl).comp (fromPoly l) = AlgHom.id K (P3 K)
proof:
:= by
  apply MvPolynomial.algHom_ext
  intro i
  fin_cases i
  · simpa [encode, xCoord, quadric, decode] using
      (x_inverse (C l : P3 K) (C l⁻¹) (X 0) (X 1) (X 2) (constants_inv l hl))
  · simpa [encode, xCoord, yCoord, quadric, decode] using
      (y_inverse (C l : P3 K) (C l⁻¹) (X 0) (X 1) (X 2) (constants_inv l hl))
  · simpa [encode, xCoord, zCoord, quadric, decode] using
      (z_inverse (C l : P3 K) (C l⁻¹) (X 0) (X 1) (X 2) (constants_inv l hl))

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.NonzeroFiber.fromPoly_toPoly
statement:
theorem fromPoly_toPoly (l : K) (hl : l≠0) :
    (fromPoly l).comp (toPoly l hl) = AlgHom.id K (Fiber l)
proof:
:= by
  apply Ideal.Quotient.algHom_ext K
  apply MvPolynomial.algHom_ext
  intro i
  change fromPoly l (toPoly l hl (mk l (X i))) = mk l (X i)
  rw [toPoly_mk, forward_X]
  fin_cases i
  · simpa [decode] using (mk_p l).symm
  · simpa [decode, encode, inverseS, inverseU] using
      (inverseS_forward (mk l (X 0)) (algebraMap K (Fiber l) l⁻¹)
        (mk l (X 1)) (mk l (X 2)) (mk l (X 3)) (mk l (X 4))
        (mk_unit l hl) (mk_relation l))
  · simpa [decode, encode, inverseU] using
      (inverseU_forward (mk l (X 0)) (algebraMap K (Fiber l) l⁻¹)
        (mk l (X 1)) (mk l (X 2)) (mk l (X 3)) (mk l (X 4))
        (mk_unit l hl) (mk_relation l))
  · simpa [decode, encode, inverseF, inverseS, inverseU] using
      (inverseF_forward (mk l (X 0)) (algebraMap K (Fiber l) l⁻¹)
        (mk l (X 1)) (mk l (X 2)) (mk l (X 3)) (mk l (X 4))
        (mk_unit l hl) (mk_relation l))
  · simpa [decode, encode, inverseJ, inverseS, inverseU] using
      (inverseJ_forward (mk l (X 0)) (algebraMap K (Fiber l) l⁻¹)
        (mk l (X 1)) (mk l (X 2)) (mk l (X 3)) (mk l (X 4))
        (mk_unit l hl) (mk_relation l))

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.isAffineThreeSpaceFiber_of_ne_zero
statement:
theorem isAffineThreeSpaceFiber_of_ne_zero (l : ℂ) (hl : l≠0) :
    IsAffineThreeSpaceFiber l

:=
  ⟨exactNonzeroFiberEquiv l hl⟩

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.NormalizedDeterminantLift.pulledBase_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem pulledBase_apply (α : PolynomialAdditiveAction k (Obstruction.B k))
    (b : Obstruction.B k) :
    pulledBase α b = (α.toAlgHom b).map (sourceBaseMap k).toRingHom
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.NormalizedDeterminantLift.pulledBase_at_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem pulledBase_at_zero (α : PolynomialAdditiveAction k (Obstruction.B k))
    (b : Obstruction.B k) :
    Polynomial.constantCoeff (pulledBase α b) = sourceBaseMap k b
proof:
:= by
  change (pulledBase α b).coeff 0 = _
  rw [pulledBase_apply, Polynomial.coeff_map, α.identity]
  rfl

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.NormalizedDeterminantLift.pulledBase_relation
statement:
theorem pulledBase_relation (α : PolynomialAdditiveAction k (Obstruction.B k)) :
    pulledBase α (bX k 0) * pulledBase α (bX k 1) =
      pulledBase α (bX k 2) * (pulledBase α (bX k 2) + 1)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [map_mul, map_add, map_one] using
    congrArg (pulledBase α) (sub_eq_zero.mp (b_relation k))

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.NormalizedDeterminantLift.rawFrame_ab
statement:
@[simp] theorem rawFrame_ab (α : PolynomialAdditiveAction k (Obstruction.B k)) :
    (rawFrame α).a * (rawFrame α).b = pulledBase α (bX k 0)
proof:
:=
  QuadricFactorization.frameAbove_ab _ _ _ _

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.NormalizedDeterminantLift.rawFrame_dc
statement:
@[simp] theorem rawFrame_dc (α : PolynomialAdditiveAction k (Obstruction.B k)) :
    (rawFrame α).d * (rawFrame α).c = pulledBase α (bX k 1)
proof:
:=
  QuadricFactorization.frameAbove_dc _ _ _ _

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.NormalizedDeterminantLift.rawFrame_db
statement:
@[simp] theorem rawFrame_db (α : PolynomialAdditiveAction k (Obstruction.B k)) :
    (rawFrame α).d * (rawFrame α).b = pulledBase α (bX k 2)
proof:
:=
  QuadricFactorization.frameAbove_db _ _ _ _

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.NormalizedDeterminantLift.rawFrame_at_zero_sameBase
statement:
theorem rawFrame_at_zero_sameBase (α : PolynomialAdditiveAction k (Obstruction.B k)) :
    SameBase ((rawFrame α).map Polynomial.constantCoeff) (sourceFrame k)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · change Polynomial.constantCoeff (rawFrame α).a *
      Polynomial.constantCoeff (rawFrame α).b = cX k 0 * cX k 2
    rw [← map_mul, rawFrame_ab, pulledBase_at_zero]
    simp
  constructor
  · change Polynomial.constantCoeff (rawFrame α).d *
      Polynomial.constantCoeff (rawFrame α).c = cX k 1 * cX k 3
    rw [← map_mul, rawFrame_dc, pulledBase_at_zero]
    simp
  · change Polynomial.constantCoeff (rawFrame α).d *
      Polynomial.constantCoeff (rawFrame α).b = cX k 1 * cX k 2
    rw [← map_mul, rawFrame_db, pulledBase_at_zero]
    simp

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.NormalizedDeterminantLift.normalizedFrame_sameBase
statement:
theorem normalizedFrame_sameBase (α : PolynomialAdditiveAction k (Obstruction.B k)) :
    SameBase (normalizedFrame α) (rawFrame α)
proof:
:=
  normalizePolynomialFrame_sameBase _ _ _

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.NormalizedDeterminantLift.normalizedFrame_at_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem normalizedFrame_at_zero (α : PolynomialAdditiveAction k (Obstruction.B k)) :
    (normalizedFrame α).map Polynomial.constantCoeff = sourceFrame k
proof:
:=
  normalizePolynomialFrame_at_zero _ _ _

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.NormalizedDeterminantLift.normalizedFrame_ab
statement:
@[simp] theorem normalizedFrame_ab (α : PolynomialAdditiveAction k (Obstruction.B k)) :
    (normalizedFrame α).a * (normalizedFrame α).b = pulledBase α (bX k 0)
proof:
:=
  (normalizedFrame_sameBase α).1.trans (rawFrame_ab α)

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.NormalizedDeterminantLift.normalizedFrame_dc
statement:
@[simp] theorem normalizedFrame_dc (α : PolynomialAdditiveAction k (Obstruction.B k)) :
    (normalizedFrame α).d * (normalizedFrame α).c = pulledBase α (bX k 1)
proof:
:=
  (normalizedFrame_sameBase α).2.1.trans (rawFrame_dc α)

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.NormalizedDeterminantLift.normalizedFrame_db
statement:
@[simp] theorem normalizedFrame_db (α : PolynomialAdditiveAction k (Obstruction.B k)) :
    (normalizedFrame α).d * (normalizedFrame α).b = pulledBase α (bX k 2)
proof:

  (normalizedFrame_sameBase α).2.2.trans (rawFrame_db α)

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.NormalizedDeterminantLift.liftHom_comp_baseMap
statement:
theorem liftHom_comp_baseMap (α : PolynomialAdditiveAction k (Obstruction.B k)) :
    (liftHom α).comp (sourceBaseMap k) = pulledBase α
proof:
:=
  Frame.quotientMap_comp_baseMap _ _ _ (normalizedFrame_ab α)
    (normalizedFrame_dc α) (normalizedFrame_db α) rfl

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.NormalizedDeterminantLift.liftHom_baseMap
statement:
theorem liftHom_baseMap (α : PolynomialAdditiveAction k (Obstruction.B k))
    (b : Obstruction.B k) :
    liftHom α (sourceBaseMap k b) = (α.toAlgHom b).map (sourceBaseMap k).toRingHom
proof:
:=
  AlgHom.congr_fun (liftHom_comp_baseMap α) b

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.NormalizedDeterminantLift.atZero_comp_liftHom
statement:
theorem atZero_comp_liftHom (α : PolynomialAdditiveAction k (Obstruction.B k)) :
    atZero.comp (liftHom α) = AlgHom.id k (Obstruction.C k)
proof:
:= by
  unfold liftHom
  rw [(normalizedFrame α).quotientMap_natural (pulledBase α (bX k 3)) (atZero (k := k))]
  change ((normalizedFrame α).map Polynomial.constantCoeff).quotientMap
    (Polynomial.constantCoeff (pulledBase α (bX k 3))) = _
  rw [normalizedFrame_at_zero, pulledBase_at_zero]
  simp

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.NormalizedDeterminantLift.liftHom_identity
statement:
@[simp] theorem liftHom_identity (α : PolynomialAdditiveAction k (Obstruction.B k))
    (c : Obstruction.C k) : (liftHom α c).coeff 0 = c
proof:
:=
  AlgHom.congr_fun (atZero_comp_liftHom α) c

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.NormalizedDeterminantLift.exists_normalized_lift
statement:
theorem exists_normalized_lift (α : PolynomialAdditiveAction k (Obstruction.B k)) :
    ∃ β : Obstruction.C k →ₐ[k] Polynomial (Obstruction.C k),
      (∀ c, (β c).coeff 0 = c) ∧
      (∀ b, β (sourceBaseMap k b) = (α.toAlgHom b).map (sourceBaseMap k).toRingHom)
proof:
:=
  ⟨liftHom α, liftHom_identity α, liftHom_baseMap α⟩

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.Obstruction.mk_H
statement: @[simp] theorem mk_H : Ideal.Quotient.mk (idealA k) (H k) = 0
proof:

  exact Ideal.subset_span (Set.mem_singleton (H k))

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.Obstruction.mk_Hstar

  exact Ideal.subset_span (Set.mem_singleton (Hstar k))

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.Obstruction.b_relation
statement: theorem b_relation : bX k 0 * bX k 1 - bX k 2 * (bX k 2 + 1) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h : Ideal.Quotient.mk (idealB k) (quadricRelation k) = 0 := by
    apply Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr
    exact Ideal.subset_span (Set.mem_singleton (quadricRelation k))
  simpa [quadricRelation, bX] using h

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.Obstruction.c_relation
statement: theorem c_relation : cX k 0 * cX k 3 - cX k 2 * cX k 1 - 1 = 0
proof:
:= by

    apply Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr
    exact Ideal.subset_span (Set.mem_singleton (determinantRelation k))
  simpa [determinantRelation, cX] using h
