name: OAI.StableCoordinate.Obstruction.cX_ne_zero
statement: theorem cX_ne_zero (i : Fin 5) : cX k i ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  let φ : DeterminantRing.C k →ₐ[k] k :=
    DeterminantRing.lift (k := k) (1 : k) 1 0 1 1 (by ring)
  let ψ : DeterminantRing.C k →ₐ[k] k :=
    DeterminantRing.lift (k := k) (1 : k) 0 1 1 1 (by ring)
  intro hz
  fin_cases i
  · have h := congrArg φ hz
    change φ (DeterminantRing.a k) = φ 0 at h
    simp [φ] at h
  · have h := congrArg φ hz
    change φ (DeterminantRing.d k) = φ 0 at h
    simp [φ] at h
  · have h := congrArg ψ hz
    change ψ (DeterminantRing.b k) = ψ 0 at h
    simp [ψ] at h
  · have h := congrArg φ hz
    change φ (DeterminantRing.c k) = φ 0 at h
    simp [φ] at h
  · have h := congrArg φ hz
    change φ (DeterminantRing.u k) = φ 0 at h
    simp [φ] at h

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.Obstruction.explicit_au_sub_d_ne_zero
statement: theorem explicit_au_sub_d_ne_zero : cX k 0 * cX k 4 - cX k 1 ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  let φ : DeterminantRing.C k →ₐ[k] k :=
    DeterminantRing.lift (k := k) (1 : k) 0 0 1 1 (by ring)
  intro hz
  have h := congrArg φ hz
  change φ (DeterminantRing.a k * DeterminantRing.u k - DeterminantRing.d k) = φ 0 at h
  simp [φ] at h

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.Obstruction.explicit_au_add_d_ne_zero
statement: theorem explicit_au_add_d_ne_zero : cX k 0 * cX k 4 + cX k 1 ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  let φ : DeterminantRing.C k →ₐ[k] k :=
    DeterminantRing.lift (k := k) (1 : k) 0 0 1 1 (by ring)
  intro hz
  have h := congrArg φ hz
  change φ (DeterminantRing.a k * DeterminantRing.u k + DeterminantRing.d k) = φ 0 at h
  simp [φ] at h

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.Obstruction.v_ne_zero
statement: theorem v_ne_zero : v k ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  let φ : DeterminantRing.C k →ₐ[k] k :=
    DeterminantRing.lift (k := k) (1 : k) 0 1 1 0 (by ring)
  have h : φ (DeterminantRing.a k ^ 3 * DeterminantRing.b k +
      DeterminantRing.a k ^ 2 * DeterminantRing.u k ^ 2 -
      DeterminantRing.d k ^ 2) = 1 := by
    simp [φ]
  change φ (v k) = 1 at h
  intro hz
  rw [hz] at h
  change φ (0 : DeterminantRing.C k) = 1 at h
  simp at h

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.Obstruction.baseMap_bX
statement:
@[simp] theorem baseMap_bX (i : Fin 4) :
    baseMap k (bX k i) =
      ![cX k 0 * cX k 2, cX k 1 * cX k 3, cX k 1 * cX k 2, cX k 4] i
proof:
:=
  BundleCharts.baseMap_qgen k i

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.Obstruction.baseMap_injective
statement: theorem baseMap_injective : Function.Injective (baseMap k)
proof:
:=
  BundleCharts.baseMap_injective k

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.Obstruction.baseMap_sB
statement:
@[simp] theorem baseMap_sB :
    baseMap k (sB k) = Bundle.s (cX k 0) (cX k 1) (cX k 2) (cX k 3) (cX k 4)
proof:
:= by
  simp [sB, Bundle.s]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.Obstruction.baseMap_f0
statement:
@[simp] theorem baseMap_f0 :
    baseMap k (f0 k) = Bundle.f₀ (cX k 0) (cX k 1) (cX k 2) (cX k 3) (cX k 4)
proof:
:= by
  simp [f0, Bundle.f₀]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.Obstruction.baseMap_g0
statement:
@[simp] theorem baseMap_g0 :
    baseMap k (g0 k) = Bundle.g₀ (cX k 0) (cX k 1) (cX k 2) (cX k 3) (cX k 4)
proof:
:= by
  simp [g0, Bundle.g₀]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.Obstruction.map_I_eq_span_v
statement:
theorem map_I_eq_span_v :
    Ideal.map (baseMap k).toRingHom (I k) = Ideal.span ({v k} : Set (C k))
proof:
:= by
  rw [I, Ideal.map_span, Set.image_insert_eq, Set.image_singleton]
  change Ideal.span ({baseMap k (f0 k), baseMap k (g0 k)} : Set (C k)) = _
  rw [baseMap_f0, baseMap_g0]
  exact Bundle.principalization (cX k 0) (cX k 1) (cX k 2) (cX k 3) (cX k 4)
    (sub_eq_zero.mp (c_relation k))

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.Obstruction.baseMap_factor_of_mem_I
statement:
theorem baseMap_factor_of_mem_I {h : B k} (hh : h ∈ I k) :
    ∃ q : C k, baseMap k h = v k * q
proof:
:= by
  have hm : baseMap k h ∈ Ideal.map (baseMap k).toRingHom (I k) :=
    Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ hh
  rw [map_I_eq_span_v, Ideal.mem_span_singleton] at hm
  exact hm

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.Obstruction.extension_ne_zero
statement:
theorem extension_ne_zero
    (hD : D ≠ 0) (hExt : ∀ b, D' (baseMap k b) = baseMap k (D b)) : D' ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hD'
  apply hD
  ext b
  apply baseMap_injective k
  change baseMap k (D b) = baseMap k 0
  rw [map_zero, ← hExt, hD', Derivation.zero_apply]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.Obstruction.extension_annihilates_v
statement:
theorem extension_annihilates_v
    (hLND : StableCoordinate.IsLocallyNilpotent D')
    (hExt : ∀ b, D' (baseMap k b) = baseMap k (D b))
    {h : B k} (hh : h ∈ I k) (h0 : h ≠ 0) (hFix : D h = 0) : D' (v k) = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := baseMap_factor_of_mem_I k hh
  have hmap : baseMap k h ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    apply h0
    exact baseMap_injective k (by simpa using hz)
  have hprod : v k * q ≠ 0 := by rwa [← hq]
  have hv : v k ≠ 0 := (mul_ne_zero_iff.mp hprod).1
  have hq0 : q ≠ 0 := (mul_ne_zero_iff.mp hprod).2
  have hFixed : D' (v k * q) = 0 := by rw [← hq, hExt, hFix, map_zero]
  exact (StableCoordinate.lnd_factorial_closure D' hLND hv hq0 hFixed).1

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.Obstruction.extension_nonzero_and_annihilates_v
statement:
theorem extension_nonzero_and_annihilates_v
    (hD : D ≠ 0) (hLND : StableCoordinate.IsLocallyNilpotent D')
    (hExt : ∀ b, D' (baseMap k b) = baseMap k (D b))
    (hInv : ∃ h : B k, h ∈ I k ∧ h ≠ 0 ∧ D h = 0) :
    D' ≠ 0 ∧ D' (v k) = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h, hh, h0, hFix⟩ := hInv
  exact ⟨extension_ne_zero D D' hD hExt,
    extension_annihilates_v D D' hLND hExt hh h0 hFix⟩

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.PicardSupport.invertibleModule_trivial_of_gcd
statement:
theorem invertibleModule_trivial_of_gcd
    (A M : Type*) [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsGCDMonoid A]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module A M] [Module.Invertible A M] :
    Nonempty (M ≃ₗ[A] A)
proof:
:=
  CommRing.Pic.mk_eq_one_iff.mp (Subsingleton.elim _ _)

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.PicardSupport.invertibleModule_trivial_of_localization
statement:
theorem invertibleModule_trivial_of_localization
    (A B M : Type*) [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [UniqueFactorizationMonoid A]
    [CommRing B] [Algebra A B] (S : Submonoid A) [IsLocalization S B]
    (hS : S ≤ nonZeroDivisors A)
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module B M] [Module.Invertible B M] :
    Nonempty (M ≃ₗ[B] B)
proof:
:= by
  let : IsDomain B := IsLocalization.isDomain_of_le_nonZeroDivisors B hS
  let : UniqueFactorizationMonoid B := UniqueFactorizationMonoid.of_isLocalization S B
  exact invertibleModule_trivial_of_gcd B M

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.PicardSupport.invertibleModule_trivial_of_away
statement:
theorem invertibleModule_trivial_of_away
    (A B M : Type*) [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [UniqueFactorizationMonoid A]
    [CommRing B] [Algebra A B] (a : A) [IsLocalization.Away a B] (ha : a ≠ 0)
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module B M] [Module.Invertible B M] :
    Nonempty (M ≃ₗ[B] B)
proof:
:=
  invertibleModule_trivial_of_localization A B M (Submonoid.powers a)
    (powers_le_nonZeroDivisors_of_noZeroDivisors ha)

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.PicardSupport.invertibleModule_polynomial_trivial
statement:
theorem invertibleModule_polynomial_trivial
    (A M : Type*) [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [UniqueFactorizationMonoid A]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module (Polynomial A) M] [Module.Invertible (Polynomial A) M] :
    Nonempty (M ≃ₗ[(Polynomial A)] (Polynomial A))
proof:
:=
  invertibleModule_trivial_of_gcd (Polynomial A) M

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.PicardSupport.invertibleModule_away_polynomial_trivial
statement:
theorem invertibleModule_away_polynomial_trivial
    (A B M : Type*) [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [UniqueFactorizationMonoid A]
    [CommRing B] [Algebra A B] (a : A) [IsLocalization.Away a B] (ha : a ≠ 0)
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module (Polynomial B) M] [Module.Invertible (Polynomial B) M] :
    Nonempty (M ≃ₗ[(Polynomial B)] (Polynomial B))
proof:
:= by
  let : IsDomain B := IsLocalization.Away.isDomain B ha
  let : UniqueFactorizationMonoid B :=
    UniqueFactorizationMonoid.of_isLocalization (Submonoid.powers a) B
  exact invertibleModule_polynomial_trivial B M

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.PolynomialChartIntersection.constant_mem_range_map_iff
statement:
theorem constant_mem_range_map_iff (f : R →+* S) (s : S) :
    C s ∈ Set.range (Polynomial.map f) ↔ s ∈ Set.range f
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨p, hp⟩
    refine ⟨p.coeff 0, ?_⟩
    simpa only [coeff_map, coeff_C_zero] using congrArg (fun q : S[X] ↦ q.coeff 0) hp
  · rintro ⟨r, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨C r, map_C f⟩

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.PolynomialChartIntersection.map_eq_C_iff
statement:
theorem map_eq_C_iff (f : R →+* S) (hf : Function.Injective f)
    (p : R[X]) (s : S) :
    Polynomial.map f p = C s ↔ ∃ r : R, p = C r ∧ f r = s
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hr : f (p.coeff 0) = s := by
      simpa only [coeff_map, coeff_C_zero] using congrArg (fun q : S[X] ↦ q.coeff 0) h
    use p.coeff 0
    refine ⟨?_, hr⟩
    apply Polynomial.map_injective f hf
    rw [h, map_C, hr]
  · rintro ⟨r, rfl, rfl⟩
    exact map_C f

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.PolynomialChartIntersection.polynomial_range_inf_constants
statement:
theorem polynomial_range_inf_constants (f : R →+* S) :
    (Polynomial.mapRingHom f).rangeS ⊓ (C : S →+* S[X]).rangeS =
      ((C : S →+* S[X]).comp f).rangeS
proof:
:= by
  ext p
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨r, hr⟩, ⟨s, rfl⟩⟩
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := (constant_mem_range_map_iff f s).mp ⟨r, hr⟩
    exact ⟨a, by simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, ha]⟩
  · rintro ⟨r, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨⟨C r, map_C f⟩, ⟨f r, rfl⟩⟩

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.PolynomialChartIntersection.mem_coefficient_range_of_compatible_chart
statement:
theorem mem_coefficient_range_of_compatible_chart
    (f : A →+* K) (chart : C →+* A[X])
    (inclusion : C →+* Ω) (coefficients : K →+* Ω)
    (polynomialEmbedding : K[X] →+* Ω)
    (hinj : Function.Injective polynomialEmbedding)
    (hchart : (polynomialEmbedding.comp (Polynomial.mapRingHom f)).comp chart = inclusion)
    (hcoeff : polynomialEmbedding.comp (Polynomial.C : K →+* K[X]) = coefficients)
    {c : C} {q : K} (h : inclusion c = coefficients q) :
    q ∈ Set.range f
proof:
:= by
  apply (constant_mem_range_map_iff f q).mp
  refine ⟨chart c, hinj ?_⟩
  calc
    polynomialEmbedding (Polynomial.map f (chart c)) = inclusion c :=
      RingHom.congr_fun hchart c
    _ = coefficients q := h
    _ = polynomialEmbedding (Polynomial.C q) := (RingHom.congr_fun hcoeff q).symm

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.PolynomialChartIntersection.chart_eq_constant_of_compatible_chart
statement:
theorem chart_eq_constant_of_compatible_chart
    (f : A →+* K) (hf : Function.Injective f) (chart : C →+* A[X])
    (inclusion : C →+* Ω) (coefficients : K →+* Ω)
    (polynomialEmbedding : K[X] →+* Ω)
    (hinj : Function.Injective polynomialEmbedding)
    (hchart : (polynomialEmbedding.comp (Polynomial.mapRingHom f)).comp chart = inclusion)
    (hcoeff : polynomialEmbedding.comp (Polynomial.C : K →+* K[X]) = coefficients)
    {c : C} {q : K} (h : inclusion c = coefficients q) :
    ∃ a : A, chart c = Polynomial.C a ∧ f a = q
proof:
:= by
  apply (map_eq_C_iff f hf _ _).mp
  apply hinj
  calc
    polynomialEmbedding (Polynomial.map f (chart c)) = inclusion c :=
      RingHom.congr_fun hchart c
    _ = coefficients q := h
    _ = polynomialEmbedding (Polynomial.C q) := (RingHom.congr_fun hcoeff q).symm

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.PolynomialChartIntersection.polynomial_algRange_inf_constants
statement:
theorem polynomial_algRange_inf_constants (f : R →ₐ[k] S) :
    (Polynomial.mapAlgHom f).range ⊓ (Polynomial.CAlgHom : S →ₐ[k] S[X]).range =
      ((Polynomial.CAlgHom : S →ₐ[k] S[X]).comp f).range
proof:
:= by
  ext p
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨r, hr⟩, ⟨s, rfl⟩⟩
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := (constant_mem_range_map_iff f.toRingHom s).mp ⟨r, hr⟩
    exact ⟨a, congrArg (Polynomial.C : S → S[X]) ha⟩
  · rintro ⟨r, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨⟨C r, map_C f.toRingHom⟩, ⟨f r, rfl⟩⟩

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.FrameLift.sameBase_map_aux
statement:
private theorem sameBase_map_aux {F G : Frame R} (h : SameBase F G) (f : R →+* S) :
    SameBase (F.map f) (G.map f)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa only [Frame.map, map_mul] using congrArg f h.1
  · simpa only [Frame.map, map_mul] using congrArg f h.2.1
  · simpa only [Frame.map, map_mul] using congrArg f h.2.2

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.FrameLift.univariate_unit_eq_C_constantCoeff
statement:
theorem univariate_unit_eq_C_constantCoeff [IsReduced R]
    {p : Polynomial R} (hp : IsUnit p) :
    p = Polynomial.C (Polynomial.constantCoeff p)
proof:
:= by
  have hd : p.natDegree = 0 := by
    apply Nat.eq_zero_of_not_pos
    intro hpos
    exact Polynomial.not_isUnit_of_natDegree_pos_of_isReduced p hpos hp
  exact Polynomial.eq_C_of_natDegree_eq_zero hd

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.FrameLift.polynomial_isReduced
statement: theorem polynomial_isReduced [IsReduced R] : IsReduced (Polynomial R)
proof:
:= by
  rw [isReduced_iff]
  intro p hp
  apply Polynomial.ext
  intro n
  simpa using ((Polynomial.isNilpotent_iff.mp hp) n).eq_zero

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.FrameLift.normalized_bivariate_unique
statement:
theorem normalized_bivariate_unique [IsReduced R]
    {F G : Frame (Polynomial (Polynomial R))} (h : SameBase F G)
    (hzero : (F.map Polynomial.constantCoeff).map Polynomial.constantCoeff =
      (G.map Polynomial.constantCoeff).map Polynomial.constantCoeff) : F = G
proof:
:= by
  let : IsReduced (Polynomial R) := polynomial_isReduced
  apply normalized_univariate_unique h
  exact normalized_univariate_unique (sameBase_map_aux h Polynomial.constantCoeff) hzero

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.FrameLift.normalizePolynomialFrame_sameBase
statement:
theorem normalizePolynomialFrame_sameBase (F : Frame (Polynomial R)) (G : Frame R)
    (h : SameBase (F.map Polynomial.constantCoeff) G) :
    SameBase (normalizePolynomialFrame F G h) F
proof:
:=
  F.scale_sameBase _

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.FrameLift.normalizePolynomialFrame_at_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem normalizePolynomialFrame_at_zero (F : Frame (Polynomial R)) (G : Frame R)
    (h : SameBase (F.map Polynomial.constantCoeff) G) :
    (normalizePolynomialFrame F G h).map Polynomial.constantCoeff = G
proof:
:= by
  rw [normalizePolynomialFrame, Frame.map_scale]
  have hu : Units.map Polynomial.constantCoeff.toMonoidHom
      (Units.map (Polynomial.C : R →+* Polynomial R).toMonoidHom (comparisonUnit h)) =
      comparisonUnit h := by
    apply Units.ext
    simp
  rw [hu, scale_comparison h]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.FrameLift.Frame.specializePolynomial_map
statement:
theorem Frame.specializePolynomial_map (F : Frame (Polynomial R)) (θ : R →+* S) :
    (F.map (Polynomial.mapRingHom θ)).map Polynomial.constantCoeff =
      (F.map Polynomial.constantCoeff).map θ
proof:
:= by
  apply Frame.ext <;> simp [Frame.map]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.FrameLift.normalized_univariate_lift_scaling_equivariance
statement:
theorem normalized_univariate_lift_scaling_equivariance [IsReduced R]
    (F : Frame (Polynomial R)) (F₀ : Frame R)
    (hzero : F.map Polynomial.constantCoeff = F₀)
    (θ : R →+* R) (u : Rˣ)
    (href : F₀.map θ = F₀.scale u)
    (hbase : SameBase (F.map (Polynomial.mapRingHom θ)) F) :
    F.map (Polynomial.mapRingHom θ) =
      F.scale (Units.map (Polynomial.C : R →+* Polynomial R).toMonoidHom u)
proof:
:= by
  apply normalized_univariate_unique
  · exact sameBase_trans hbase (sameBase_symm (F.scale_sameBase _))
  · rw [Frame.specializePolynomial_map, hzero, href, Frame.map_scale, hzero]
    congr 1
    apply Units.ext
    simp

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.Presentation.toPolynomial_fromPolynomial
statement:
lemma toPolynomial_fromPolynomial (n : ℕ) :
    (toPolynomial n).comp (fromPolynomial n) = AlgHom.id ℂ (R (4+n))
proof:
:= by
  apply AlgHom.ext
  intro r
  simp only [AlgHom.comp_apply, fromPolynomial, toPolynomial_mk, polynomialMap, AlgHom.id_apply]
  change eliminateHom n ((matrixEquiv n) ((matrixEquiv n).symm (includeHom n r))) = r
  rw [AlgEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun (eliminateHom_includeHom n) r

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.Presentation.mk_matrix_symm_include_eliminate
statement:
lemma mk_matrix_symm_include_eliminate (n : ℕ) :
    ((mk n).comp (matrixEquiv n).symm.toAlgHom).comp
      ((includeHom n).comp (eliminateHom n)) =
    (mk n).comp (matrixEquiv n).symm.toAlgHom
proof:
:= by
  apply MvPolynomial.algHom_ext
  intro i
  refine Fin.addCases (fun j => ?_) (fun j => ?_) i
  · fin_cases j
    · simp [AlgHom.comp_apply, eliminateHom, includeHom, p]
    · simp [AlgHom.comp_apply, eliminateHom, includeHom, s]
    · change mk n ((matrixEquiv n).symm (includeHom n (eliminateHom n (u n)))) =
        mk n ((matrixEquiv n).symm (u n))
      have hj : includeHom n (X ((3 : Fin 4).castAdd n)) = J n := by simp [includeHom]
      rw [eliminateHom_u, map_neg, hj]
      simp only [map_neg, matrixEquiv_symm_apply, changeHom_J, changeHom_u, map_one]
      rw [uChange_one]
      change -(mk n (J n)) = mk n (-H n - J n)
      simp
    · simp [AlgHom.comp_apply, eliminateHom, includeHom, F]
    · simp [AlgHom.comp_apply, eliminateHom, includeHom, J]
  · simp [AlgHom.comp_apply]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.Presentation.fromPolynomial_toPolynomial
statement:
lemma fromPolynomial_toPolynomial (n : ℕ) :
    (fromPolynomial n).comp (toPolynomial n) = AlgHom.id ℂ (A n)
proof:
:= by
  apply Ideal.Quotient.algHom_ext ℂ
  apply AlgHom.ext
  intro v
  change fromPolynomial n (toPolynomial n (mk n v)) = mk n v
  rw [toPolynomial_mk]
  change mk n ((matrixEquiv n).symm (includeHom n
    (eliminateHom n ((matrixEquiv n) v)))) = mk n v
  have h := DFunLike.congr_fun (mk_matrix_symm_include_eliminate n) ((matrixEquiv n) v)
  simpa only [AlgHom.comp_apply, AlgEquiv.coe_toAlgHom, AlgEquiv.symm_apply_apply] using h

      IsCoordinate (by decide : 0 < 4) g)

  apply f_not_coordinate
  apply h f

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.eq_nonzero_scalar_mul_of_span_singleton_eq
statement:
theorem eq_nonzero_scalar_mul_of_span_singleton_eq
    {f g : MvPolynomial σ k}
    (h : Ideal.span ({f} : Set (MvPolynomial σ k)) = Ideal.span {g}) :
    ∃ c : k, c ≠ 0 ∧ f = C c * g
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := (Ideal.span_singleton_eq_span_singleton.mp h).symm
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hcu⟩ :=
    MvPolynomial.isUnit_iff_eq_C_of_isReduced.mp u.isUnit
  exact ⟨c, isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mp hc, by simpa [hcu, mul_comm] using hu.symm⟩

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.span_singleton_eq_of_eq_nonzero_scalar_mul
proof:
:= by
  rw [h]
  exact Ideal.span_singleton_mul_left_unit ((isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hc).map C) g

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.span_singleton_eq_iff_nonzero_scalar_mul

theorem span_singleton_eq_iff_nonzero_scalar_mul
    {f g : MvPolynomial σ k} :
    Ideal.span ({f} : Set (MvPolynomial σ k)) = Ideal.span {g} ↔
      ∃ c : k, c ≠ 0 ∧ f = C c * g
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact eq_nonzero_scalar_mul_of_span_singleton_eq
  · rintro ⟨c, hc, h⟩
    exact span_singleton_eq_of_eq_nonzero_scalar_mul hc h

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.eq_nonzero_scalar_mul_of_map_span_singleton_eq

    (h : Ideal.map φ.toRingHom (Ideal.span ({f} : Set (MvPolynomial σ k))) =
      Ideal.span {g}) :
    ∃ c : k, c ≠ 0 ∧ φ f = C c * g
proof:
:= by
  apply eq_nonzero_scalar_mul_of_span_singleton_eq
  simpa only [map_span_singleton_algHom] using h

theorem homogeneous_lower_iff (p : P k 5) (d : ℤ)
    (hp : p.IsWeightedHomogeneous presentationWeight d) :
    (∃ r : P k 5, Bounded presentationWeight r (d - 1) ∧ p - r ∈ idealA k) ↔
      p ∈ idealG k
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [idealA, idealG, H_degree_one_component k] using
    homogeneous_quotient_kernel_iff presentationWeight (H k) 1
      (H_isTopDegree k).1 (H_isTopDegree k).2 hp

      Ideal.Quotient.mk (idealG k) p = 0

  simpa only [Ideal.Quotient.eq, Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem] using
    homogeneous_lower_iff k p d hp

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.QuadricFactorization.exists_frame_of_ne_zero
statement:
theorem exists_frame_of_ne_zero (x y z : R) (hx : x ≠ 0)
    (h : x * y = z * (z + 1)) :
    ∃ a d b c : R,
      a * b = x ∧ d * b = z ∧ d * c = y ∧ a * c = z + 1 ∧
        a * c - b * d = 1
proof:
:= by
  rcases (inferInstance : IsGCDMonoid R) with ⟨hGCD⟩
  let := hGCD
  obtain ⟨a, d, hxa, hzd, had⟩ := extract_gcd x z
  let b := gcd x z
  have hb : b ≠ 0 := by
    intro hb
    exact hx (by simpa [b, hb] using hxa)
  have ha : a ≠ 0 := by
    intro ha
    exact hx (by simpa [ha] using hxa)
  have hrel : IsRelPrime a d := gcd_isUnit_iff_isRelPrime.mp had
  have hcancel : a * y = d * (z + 1) := by
    apply mul_left_cancel₀ hb
    calc
      b * (a * y) = x * y := by rw [hxa]; simp [b, mul_assoc]
      _ = z * (z + 1) := h
      _ = b * (d * (z + 1)) := by rw [hzd]; simp [b, mul_assoc]
  have hadvd : a ∣ d * (z + 1) := ⟨y, hcancel.symm⟩
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hrel.dvd_of_dvd_mul_left hadvd
  have hy : d * c = y := by
    apply mul_left_cancel₀ ha
    calc
      a * (d * c) = d * (a * c) := by ring
      _ = d * (z + 1) := by rw [← hc]
      _ = a * y := hcancel.symm
  refine ⟨a, d, b, c, ?_, ?_, hy, hc.symm, ?_⟩
  · simpa [b, mul_comm] using hxa.symm
  · simpa [b, mul_comm] using hzd.symm
  · rw [← hc, ← hzd]
    ring

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.QuadricFactorization.exists_frame
statement:
theorem exists_frame (x y z : R) (h : x * y = z * (z + 1)) :
    ∃ a d b c : R,
      a * b = x ∧ d * b = z ∧ d * c = y ∧ a * c = z + 1 ∧
        a * c - b * d = 1
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hx : x = 0
  · have hz : z = 0 ∨ z + 1 = 0 := mul_eq_zero.mp (by rw [← h, hx, zero_mul])
    rcases hz with hz | hz
    · refine ⟨1, y, 0, 1, ?_⟩
      simp [hx, hz]
    · have hz' : z = -1 := eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left hz
      refine ⟨0, 1, -1, y, ?_⟩
      simp [hx, hz']
  · exact exists_frame_of_ne_zero x y z hx h

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.QuadricFactorization.exists_frameAbove
statement:
theorem exists_frameAbove (x y z : R) (h : x * y = z * (z + 1)) :
    ∃ F : FrameLift.Frame R,
      F.a * F.b = x ∧ F.d * F.c = y ∧ F.d * F.b = z
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, d, b, c, hx, hz, hy, _, hdet⟩ := exists_frame x y z h
  exact ⟨⟨a, d, b, c, hdet⟩, hx, hy, hz⟩

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.QuadricFactorization.frameAbove_ab
statement:
@[simp]
theorem frameAbove_ab (x y z : R) (h : x * y = z * (z + 1)) :
    (frameAbove x y z h).a * (frameAbove x y z h).b = x
proof:
:=
  (exists_frameAbove x y z h).choose_spec.1

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.QuadricFactorization.frameAbove_dc
statement:
@[simp]
theorem frameAbove_dc (x y z : R) (h : x * y = z * (z + 1)) :

proof:
:=
  (exists_frameAbove x y z h).choose_spec.2.1

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.QuadricFactorization.frameAbove_db
statement:
@[simp]
theorem frameAbove_db (x y z : R) (h : x * y = z * (z + 1)) :
    (frameAbove x y z h).d * (frameAbove x y z h).b = z
proof:
:=
  (exists_frameAbove x y z h).choose_spec.2.2

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.principalQuotientEquiv_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem principalQuotientEquiv_mk (e : A ≃ₐ[k] B) (p : A) (q : B)

    principalQuotientEquiv e p q hpq (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ a) =

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.principalQuotientEquiv_symm_mk

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.fiberQuotientEquiv_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem fiberQuotientEquiv_mk (e : A ≃ₐ[k] B) (p : A) (q : B)

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.fiberQuotientEquiv_symm_mk

@[simp]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.rectifiableFiber_iff_affine_image
statement:
theorem rectifiableFiber_iff_affine_image (t : ℂ) :
    IsRectifiableFiber t ↔
      ∃ (φ : R 4 ≃ₐ[ℂ] R 4) (c : ℂ), c ≠ 0 ∧
        φ f = C c * X 0 + C t
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨φ, hφ⟩
    obtain ⟨c, hc, heq⟩ := eq_nonzero_scalar_mul_of_map_span_singleton_eq
      φ.toAlgHom (f := f - C t) (g := X 0) hφ
    refine ⟨φ, c, hc, ?_⟩
    have hC : φ (C t) = C t := φ.commutes t
    change φ (f - C t) = C c * X 0 at heq
    rw [map_sub, hC] at heq
    exact (sub_eq_iff_eq_add).mp heq
  · rintro ⟨φ, c, hc, heq⟩
    use φ
    unfold fiberIdeal
    rw [Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton]
    change Ideal.span ({φ (f - C t)} : Set (R 4)) = Ideal.span {X 0}
    apply span_singleton_eq_of_eq_nonzero_scalar_mul hc
    change φ (f - C t) = C c * X 0
    have hC : φ (C t) = C t := φ.commutes t
    rw [map_sub, hC, heq, add_sub_cancel_right]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.rectifiableFiber_iff_coordinate
statement:
theorem rectifiableFiber_iff_coordinate (t : ℂ) :
    IsRectifiableFiber t ↔ IsCoordinate (by decide : 0 < 4) f
proof:
:= by
  rw [rectifiableFiber_iff_affine_image]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨φ, c, hc, hφ⟩
    exact exists_equiv_eq_X_of_affine f 0 c t hc φ hφ
  · rintro ⟨φ, hφ⟩
    refine ⟨φ.trans (affineAll (σ := Fin 4) 1 t one_ne_zero), 1, one_ne_zero, ?_⟩
    change affineAll (σ := Fin 4) 1 t one_ne_zero (φ f) = _
    rw [hφ, affineAll_X]
    rfl

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.noncoordinate_implies_all_fibers_nonrectifiable
statement:
theorem noncoordinate_implies_all_fibers_nonrectifiable
    (h : ¬ IsCoordinate (by decide : 0 < 4) f) :
    ∀ t : ℂ, ¬ IsRectifiableFiber t
proof:
:= by
  intro t ht
  exact h ((rectifiableFiber_iff_coordinate t).mp ht)

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.fiberPackage_of_noncoordinate_of_affine
statement:
theorem fiberPackage_of_noncoordinate_of_affine
    (h : ¬ IsCoordinate (by decide : 0 < 4) f)
    (hFibers : ∀ t : ℂ, IsAffineThreeSpaceFiber t) : FiberPackage
proof:
:= by
  intro t
  exact ⟨hFibers t, noncoordinate_implies_all_fibers_nonrectifiable h t⟩

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.FilteredRees.mem_parameterIdeal_iff
statement:
theorem mem_parameterIdeal_iff (hmono : Monotone F) (p : rees F) :
    p ∈ parameterIdeal F hmono ↔
      ∀ d : ℤ, (p : LaurentPolynomial A).coeff d ∈ F (d - 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [parameterIdeal, Ideal.mem_span_singleton]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨q, hq⟩ d
    have he := congrArg (fun p : rees F => (p : LaurentPolynomial A).coeff d) hq
    have hae : (p : LaurentPolynomial A).coeff d =
        (q : LaurentPolynomial A).coeff (d - 1) := by
      change (p : LaurentPolynomial A).coeff d =
        (AddMonoidAlgebra.single 1 1 * (q : LaurentPolynomial A)).coeff d at he
      rw [AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_single_mul_apply] at he
      simpa only [one_mul, sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm] using he
    rw [hae]
    exact q.property (d - 1)
  · intro hp
    let q : rees F := ⟨AddMonoidAlgebra.single (-1) 1 * (p : LaurentPolynomial A), by
      intro d
      rw [AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_single_mul_apply, one_mul]
      have hd := hp (1 + d)
      simpa only [neg_neg, show (1 : ℤ) + d - 1 = d by omega] using hd⟩
    refine ⟨q, ?_⟩
    apply Subtype.ext
    change (p : LaurentPolynomial A) = AddMonoidAlgebra.single 1 1 *
      (AddMonoidAlgebra.single (-1) 1 * (p : LaurentPolynomial A))
    rw [← mul_assoc, AddMonoidAlgebra.single_mul_single]
    simp only [add_neg_cancel, mul_one, ← AddMonoidAlgebra.one_def, one_mul]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.FilteredRees.quotient_mk_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem quotient_mk_eq_zero_iff (hmono : Monotone F) (p : rees F) :
    Ideal.Quotient.mk (parameterIdeal F hmono) p = 0 ↔
      ∀ d : ℤ, (p : LaurentPolynomial A).coeff d ∈ F (d - 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem, mem_parameterIdeal_iff]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.FilteredRees.quotient_mk_eq_iff
statement:
theorem quotient_mk_eq_iff (hmono : Monotone F) (p q : rees F) :
    Ideal.Quotient.mk (parameterIdeal F hmono) p =
        Ideal.Quotient.mk (parameterIdeal F hmono) q ↔
      ∀ d : ℤ, (p : LaurentPolynomial A).coeff d - (q : LaurentPolynomial A).coeff d ∈
        F (d - 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sub_eq_zero, ← map_sub, quotient_mk_eq_zero_iff]
  rfl

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.FilteredRees.mk_eq_zero_iff_coeff
statement:
theorem mk_eq_zero_iff_coeff (hmono : Monotone F) (p : rees F) :
    Ideal.Quotient.mk (parameterIdeal F hmono) p = 0 ↔
      ∀ d : ℤ, (p : LaurentPolynomial A).coeff d ∈ F (d - 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem, parameterIdeal, Ideal.mem_span_singleton]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨q, hq⟩ d
    have he := congrArg (fun r : rees F => (r : LaurentPolynomial A).coeff d) hq
    change (p : LaurentPolynomial A).coeff d =
      (AddMonoidAlgebra.single 1 1 * (q : LaurentPolynomial A)).coeff d at he
    rw [AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_single_mul_apply] at he
    have he' : (p : LaurentPolynomial A).coeff d =
        (q : LaurentPolynomial A).coeff (d - 1) := by
      simpa only [one_mul, sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm] using he
    rw [he']
    exact q.property (d - 1)
  · intro hp
    let q : rees F := ⟨AddMonoidAlgebra.single (-1) 1 * (p : LaurentPolynomial A), by
      intro d
      rw [AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_single_mul_apply, one_mul]
      have hd := hp (1 + d)
      simpa using hd⟩
    refine ⟨q, ?_⟩
    apply Subtype.ext
    change (p : LaurentPolynomial A) = AddMonoidAlgebra.single 1 1 *
      (AddMonoidAlgebra.single (-1) 1 * (p : LaurentPolynomial A))
    rw [← mul_assoc, AddMonoidAlgebra.single_mul_single]
    simp

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.FilteredRees.sum_initial_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem sum_initial_eq_zero_iff (hmono : Monotone F) (s : Finset ℤ)
    (a : (d : ℤ) → F d) :
    (∑ d ∈ s, initial F hmono d (a d)) = 0 ↔
      ∀ d ∈ s, (a d : A) ∈ F (d - 1)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hcoeff (d : ℤ) :
      ((∑ i ∈ s, homogeneous F i (a i) : rees F) : LaurentPolynomial A).coeff d =
        if d ∈ s then (a d : A) else 0 := by
    change ((rees F).val (∑ i ∈ s, homogeneous F i (a i))).coeff d = _
    rw [map_sum]
    change (∑ i ∈ s, AddMonoidAlgebra.single i (a i : A) : LaurentPolynomial A).coeff d = _
    simp only [AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_sum, AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_single, Finsupp.finsetSum_apply, Finsupp.single_apply]
    exact Finset.sum_ite_eq' s d (fun i => (a i : A))
  have hmk : (∑ d ∈ s, initial F hmono d (a d)) =
      Ideal.Quotient.mk (parameterIdeal F hmono) (∑ d ∈ s, homogeneous F d (a d)) := by
    simp only [map_sum, initial]
  rw [hmk, mk_eq_zero_iff_coeff]
  constructor
  · intro h d hd
    have h' := h d
    simpa only [hcoeff, ite_eq_left hd] using h'
  · intro h d
    rw [hcoeff]
    split_ifs with hd
    · exact h d hd
    · exact (F (d - 1)).zero_mem

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.FilteredRees.sum_initial_eq_zero_iff_individual
statement:
theorem sum_initial_eq_zero_iff_individual (hmono : Monotone F) (s : Finset ℤ)
    (a : (d : ℤ) → F d) :
    (∑ d ∈ s, initial F hmono d (a d)) = 0 ↔
      ∀ d ∈ s, initial F hmono d (a d) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [sum_initial_eq_zero_iff, initial_eq_zero_iff]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.ReesToDegeneration.homogeneous_mem_piece
statement:
theorem homogeneous_mem_piece {p : P k 5} {d : ℤ}
    (hp : p.IsWeightedHomogeneous presentationWeight d) : p ∈ piece k d
proof:
:= by
  rw [piece_eq_boundedSubmodule]
  exact fun m hm => (hp hm).le

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.ReesToDegeneration.sub_top_mem_piece
statement:
theorem sub_top_mem_piece {p : P k 5} {d : ℤ} (hp : p ∈ piece k d) :
    p - weightedHomogeneousComponent presentationWeight d p ∈ piece k (d - 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [piece_eq_boundedSubmodule] at hp ⊢
  exact bounded_sub_top hp

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.ReesToDegeneration.sourceInitial_eq_gradedMap_component
statement:
theorem sourceInitial_eq_gradedMap_component
    (φ : P k 5 →ₐ[k] A) (d : ℤ) (p : piece k d) :
    sourceInitial φ d p =
      gradedMap φ (weightedHomogeneousComponent presentationWeight d (p : P k 5))
proof:
:= by
  let q := weightedHomogeneousComponent presentationWeight d (p : P k 5)
  have hqhom : q.IsWeightedHomogeneous presentationWeight d :=
    weightedHomogeneousComponent_isWeightedHomogeneous d (p : P k 5)
  have hq : q ∈ piece k d := homogeneous_mem_piece hqhom
  have hsub : (p : P k 5) - q ∈ piece k (d - 1) := sub_top_mem_piece p.property
  have hinit : sourceInitial φ d p = sourceInitial φ d ⟨q, hq⟩ := by
    apply sub_eq_zero.mp
    rw [← map_sub (sourceInitial φ d)]
    rw [sourceInitial_apply, initial_eq_zero_iff]
    exact ⟨(p : P k 5) - q, hsub, rfl⟩
  rw [hinit, sourceInitial_apply]
  symm
  apply gradedMap_of_homogeneous
  intro m hm
  rw [AssociatedGradedPresentation.monomialWeight_eq_weight]
  exact hqhom (mem_support_iff.mp hm)

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.ReesToDegeneration.initial_has_homogeneous_representative
statement:
theorem initial_has_homogeneous_representative
    (φ : P k 5 →ₐ[k] A) (d : ℤ) (a : imagePiece φ d) :
    ∃ p : P k 5, p.IsWeightedHomogeneous presentationWeight d ∧
      gradedMap φ p = initial (imagePiece φ) (imagePiece_mono φ) d a
proof:
:= by
  rcases a with ⟨a, p, hp, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨weightedHomogeneousComponent presentationWeight d p,
    weightedHomogeneousComponent_isWeightedHomogeneous d p, ?_⟩
  exact (sourceInitial_eq_gradedMap_component φ d ⟨p, hp⟩).symm

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.ReesToDegeneration.mem_gPiece_iff
statement:
theorem mem_gPiece_iff (d : ℤ) (g : G k) :
    g ∈ gPiece k d ↔ ∃ a : imagePiece (quotientMap k) d,
      associatedGradedEquiv k g =
        initial (imagePiece (quotientMap k)) (imagePiece_mono (quotientMap k)) d a
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩
    have hp' : p.IsWeightedHomogeneous presentationWeight d := hp
    refine ⟨⟨quotientMap k p, p, homogeneous_mem_piece hp', rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    change associatedGradedEquiv k (Ideal.Quotient.mk (idealG k) p) = _
    rw [associatedGradedEquiv_mk]
    apply gradedMap_of_homogeneous
    intro m hm
    rw [AssociatedGradedPresentation.monomialWeight_eq_weight]
    exact hp' (mem_support_iff.mp hm)
  · rintro ⟨a, ha⟩
    obtain ⟨p, hp, he⟩ := initial_has_homogeneous_representative (quotientMap k) d a
    have hg : g = Ideal.Quotient.mk (idealG k) p := by
      apply (associatedGradedEquiv k).injective
      rw [ha, associatedGradedEquiv_mk, ← he]
    rw [hg]
    exact mk_mem_gPiece k hp

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.ReesToDegeneration.source_degreeZeroSubalgebra_ne_top
statement:
theorem source_degreeZeroSubalgebra_ne_top :
    degreeZeroSubalgebra (imagePiece (quotientMap k)) ≠ ⊤
proof:
:= by
  have hne : associatedGradedEquiv k (gX k 3) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    exact gX_ne_zero k 3 ((associatedGradedEquiv k).injective (by simpa using h))
  rw [associatedGradedEquiv_gX] at hne
  exact degreeZeroSubalgebra_ne_top_of_initial_ne_zero
    (imagePiece (quotientMap k)) (imagePiece_mono (quotientMap k))
    (by simp [monomialWeight] : 0 < monomialWeight (Finsupp.single (3 : Fin 5) 1))
    (variableElement (quotientMap k) 3) hne

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.ReesToDegeneration.transportDerivation_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem transportDerivation_apply
    (D : Derivation k (associatedGraded k) (associatedGraded k)) (g : G k) :
    transportDerivation k D g =
      (associatedGradedEquiv k).symm (D (associatedGradedEquiv k g))
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.ReesToDegeneration.transportDerivation_locallyNilpotent
statement:
theorem transportDerivation_locallyNilpotent
    (D : Derivation k (associatedGraded k) (associatedGraded k))
    (hD : IsLocallyNilpotent (k := k) (A := associatedGraded k) D) :
    IsLocallyNilpotent (transportDerivation k D)
proof:
:= by
  unfold transportDerivation IsLocallyNilpotent
  exact CoordinateDerivation.transport_locallyNilpotent _ D hD

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.ReesToDegeneration.transportDerivation_ne_zero
statement:
theorem transportDerivation_ne_zero
    (D : Derivation k (associatedGraded k) (associatedGraded k)) (hD : D ≠ 0) :
    transportDerivation k D ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold transportDerivation
  exact CoordinateDerivation.transport_ne_zero _ D hD

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.ReesToDegeneration.transportDerivation_homogeneous
statement:
theorem transportDerivation_homogeneous
    (D : Derivation k (associatedGraded k) (associatedGraded k)) (m : ℤ)
    (hD : ∀ (d : ℤ) (a : imagePiece (quotientMap k) d),
      ∃ b : imagePiece (quotientMap k) (d + m),
        D (initial (imagePiece (quotientMap k)) (imagePiece_mono (quotientMap k)) d a) =
          initial (imagePiece (quotientMap k)) (imagePiece_mono (quotientMap k)) (d + m) b) :
    ∀ (d : ℤ) (g : G k), g ∈ gPiece k d →
      transportDerivation k D g ∈ gPiece k (d + m)
proof:
:= by
  intro d g hg
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := (mem_gPiece_iff k d g).mp hg
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hD d a
  refine (mem_gPiece_iff k (d + m) _).mpr ⟨b, ?_⟩
  simp only [transportDerivation_apply, AlgEquiv.apply_symm_apply, ha, hb]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.ReesToDegeneration.associatedGradedEquiv_p
statement:
theorem associatedGradedEquiv_p :
    associatedGradedEquiv k (gX k 0) =
      initial (imagePiece (quotientMap k)) (imagePiece_mono (quotientMap k)) (-1)
        ⟨quotientMap k (X 0), image_X_zero_mem_neg_one (quotientMap k)⟩
proof:
:= by
  rw [associatedGradedEquiv_gX]
  unfold initial
  congr 1
  apply Subtype.ext
  simp [homogeneous, monomialWeight, variableElement]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.ReesToDegeneration.coordinate_produces_degeneration_lnd
statement:
theorem coordinate_produces_degeneration_lnd [IsNoetherianRing k]
    (e : P k 4 ≃ₐ[k] Obstruction.A k) (hp : e (X 0) = aX k 0) :
    ∃ (m : ℤ) (D : Derivation k (G k) (G k)),
      D ≠ 0 ∧ IsLocallyNilpotent D ∧
      (∀ (n : ℤ) (g : G k), g ∈ gPiece k n → D g ∈ gPiece k (n + m)) ∧
      D (gX k 0) = 0 ∧
      ∃ (d : ℤ) (η : G k), 0 < d ∧ η ∈ gPiece k d ∧ η ≠ 0 ∧ D η = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, δ, hδ, hln, hshift, hpδ, d, a, hd, hane, haδ⟩ :=
    coordinate_produces_leading_lnd_of_noetherian_domain
      (quotientMap k) (fun a => Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective a)
      (source_degreeZeroSubalgebra_ne_top k) e hp
  refine ⟨m, transportDerivation k δ, transportDerivation_ne_zero k δ hδ,
    transportDerivation_locallyNilpotent k δ hln,
    transportDerivation_homogeneous k δ m hshift, ?_,
    d, (associatedGradedEquiv k).symm
      (initial (imagePiece (quotientMap k)) (imagePiece_mono (quotientMap k)) d a),
    hd, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [transportDerivation_apply, associatedGradedEquiv_p, hpδ, map_zero]
  · exact (mem_gPiece_iff k d _).mpr ⟨a, (associatedGradedEquiv k).apply_symm_apply _⟩
  · intro h
    apply hane
    have he := congrArg (associatedGradedEquiv k) h
    simpa only [AlgEquiv.apply_symm_apply, map_zero] using he
  · rw [transportDerivation_apply, AlgEquiv.apply_symm_apply, haδ, map_zero]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.Obstruction.weight_preserving_lnd_killing_v_eq_zero
statement:
theorem weight_preserving_lnd_killing_v_eq_zero
    (D : Derivation k (C k) (C k))
    (hln : IsLocallyNilpotent D)
    (hpres : ∀ (n : ℤ) (x : C k), x ∈ fiberPiece k n → D x ∈ fiberPiece k n)
    (hv : D (v k) = 0) : D = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hD
  obtain ⟨E, hE, hnil, hgraded, ha, hd, hu⟩ :=
    exists_nonzero_lnd_fixing_a_d_u k D hD hln hpres hv
  exact hE (DeterminantRing.derivation_eq_zero_of_fixed_base_and_coefficient_mem k E
    ha hd hu hgraded (VerticalLND.coefficient_mem_baseRange E hnil ha hd hu))

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.Obstruction.no_nonzero_lnd_preserving_fiber_weights_killing_v
statement:
theorem no_nonzero_lnd_preserving_fiber_weights_killing_v :
    ¬ ∃ D : Derivation k (C k) (C k), D ≠ 0 ∧ IsLocallyNilpotent D ∧
      (∀ (n : ℤ) (x : C k), x ∈ fiberPiece k n → D x ∈ fiberPiece k n) ∧
      D (v k) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨D, hD, hln, hpres, hv⟩
  exact hD (weight_preserving_lnd_killing_v_eq_zero k D hln hpres hv)

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.determinant_coefficient_left
statement:
theorem determinant_coefficient_left (a d b c B C : A)
    (hdet : a * c - b * d = 1) (hcompat : a * C = d * B) :
    B = a * (c * B - b * C)
proof:
:= by
  symm
  calc
    a * (c * B - b * C) = (a * c - b * d) * B + b * (d * B - a * C) := by ring
    _ = B := by rw [hdet, hcompat]; ring

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.determinant_coefficient_right
statement:
theorem determinant_coefficient_right (a d b c B C : A)
    (hdet : a * c - b * d = 1) (hcompat : a * C = d * B) :
    C = d * (c * B - b * C)
proof:
:= by
  symm
  calc
    d * (c * B - b * C) = (a * c - b * d) * C + c * (d * B - a * C) := by ring
    _ = C := by rw [hdet, hcompat]; ring

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.determinant_coefficient_unique
statement:
theorem determinant_coefficient_unique (a d b c B C q : A)
    (hdet : a * c - b * d = 1) (hB : B = a * q) (hC : C = d * q) :
    q = c * B - b * C
proof:
:= by
  rw [hB, hC]
  calc
    q = (a * c - b * d) * q := by rw [hdet, one_mul]
    _ = c * (a * q) - b * (d * q) := by ring

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.derivation_determinant_compatibility
statement:
theorem derivation_determinant_compatibility (D : Derivation k A A)
    (a d b c : A) (hdet : a * c - b * d = 1)
    (ha : D a = 0) (hd : D d = 0) :
    a * D c = d * D b
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg D hdet
  simpa only [map_sub, Derivation.leibniz, ha, hd, smul_eq_mul,
    mul_zero, add_zero, zero_add, Derivation.map_one_eq_zero, sub_eq_zero] using h

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.derivation_rigidityCoefficient
statement:
theorem derivation_rigidityCoefficient (D : Derivation k A A)
    (a d b c : A) (hdet : a * c - b * d = 1)
    (ha : D a = 0) (hd : D d = 0) :
    D b = a * rigidityCoefficient D b c ∧ D c = d * rigidityCoefficient D b c
proof:
:= by
  have hcompat := derivation_determinant_compatibility D a d b c hdet ha hd
  exact ⟨determinant_coefficient_left a d b c (D b) (D c) hdet hcompat,
    determinant_coefficient_right a d b c (D b) (D c) hdet hcompat⟩

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.derivation_eq_zero_of_five_generators
statement:
theorem derivation_eq_zero_of_five_generators (D : Derivation k A A)
    (a d b c u : A) (hgen : Algebra.adjoin k {a, d, b, c, u} = ⊤)
    (ha : D a = 0) (hd : D d = 0) (hb : D b = 0) (hc : D c = 0)
    (hu : D u = 0) : D = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply Derivation.ext_of_adjoin_eq_top {a, d, b, c, u} hgen
  intro x hx
  simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx
  rcases hx with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl <;>
    simp only [ha, hd, hb, hc, hu, Derivation.zero_apply]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.rigidityCoefficient_ne_zero
statement:
theorem rigidityCoefficient_ne_zero (D : Derivation k A A)
    (a d b c u : A) (hdet : a * c - b * d = 1)
    (hgen : Algebra.adjoin k {a, d, b, c, u} = ⊤)
    (ha : D a = 0) (hd : D d = 0) (hu : D u = 0) (hD : D ≠ 0) :
    rigidityCoefficient D b c ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hq
  obtain ⟨hb, hc⟩ := derivation_rigidityCoefficient D a d b c hdet ha hd
  rw [hq, mul_zero] at hb hc
  exact hD (derivation_eq_zero_of_five_generators D a d b c u hgen ha hd hb hc hu)

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.Obstruction.f_coordinate_iff_source_coordinate_system
statement:
theorem f_coordinate_iff_source_coordinate_system :
    IsCoordinate (by decide : 0 < 4) StableCoordinate.f ↔
      ∃ e : StableCoordinate.R 4 ≃ₐ[ℂ] A ℂ, e (X 0) = aX ℂ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [f_coordinate_iff_source_coordinate]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨e, he⟩
    exact ⟨e.symm, by rw [← he, AlgEquiv.symm_apply_apply]⟩
  · rintro ⟨e, he⟩
    exact ⟨e.symm, by rw [← he, AlgEquiv.symm_apply_apply]⟩

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.Obstruction.source_coordinate_system_of_f_coordinate
statement:
theorem source_coordinate_system_of_f_coordinate
    (h : IsCoordinate (by decide : 0 < 4) StableCoordinate.f) :
    ∃ e : StableCoordinate.R 4 ≃ₐ[ℂ] A ℂ, e (X 0) = aX ℂ 0
proof:
:=
  f_coordinate_iff_source_coordinate_system.mp h

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.SourceFiltration.aeval_H_testPoint

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.SourceFiltration.testEval_presentation

@[simp] theorem testEval_presentation (t : k) (q : P k 5) :
    testEval k t (presentation k q) = aeval (testPoint k t) q
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.SourceFiltration.testEval_aX
statement:
@[simp] theorem testEval_aX (t : k) (i : Fin 5) :
    testEval k t (aX k i) = testPoint k t i
proof:

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.SourceFiltration.testPoint_monomial_eq
statement:
theorem testPoint_monomial_eq (t : k) (e : Fin 5 →₀ ℕ)
    (he : monomialWeight e ≤ 0) (c : k) :
    aeval (testPoint k t) (monomial e c) =
      aeval (testPoint k 0) (monomial e c)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [aeval_monomial, aeval_monomial]
  congr 1
  rw [Finsupp.prod_fintype _ _ (by intros; simp),
    Finsupp.prod_fintype _ _ (by intros; simp)]
  by_cases h0 : e 0 = 0
  · have h3 : e 3 = 0 := by
      simp only [monomialWeight_apply, h0, Nat.cast_zero, sub_zero] at he
      omega
    simp [Fin.prod_univ_succ, testPoint, h3]
  · simp [Fin.prod_univ_succ, testPoint, zero_pow h0]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.SourceFiltration.testPoint_eq_of_mem_piece_zero
statement:
theorem testPoint_eq_of_mem_piece_zero (t : k) {q : P k 5} (hq : q ∈ piece k 0) :
    aeval (testPoint k t) q = aeval (testPoint k 0) q
proof:
:= by
  induction hq using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem q hq =>
    obtain ⟨e, he, rfl⟩ := hq
    exact testPoint_monomial_eq k t e he 1
  | zero => simp
  | add q r hq hr ihq ihr => simp only [map_add, ihq, ihr]
  | smul c q hq ihq => simp only [map_smul, ihq]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.SourceFiltration.testEval_eq_of_mem_zero_layer
statement:
theorem testEval_eq_of_mem_zero_layer (t : k) {a : A k}
    (ha : a ∈ imagePiece (presentation k) 0) : testEval k t a = testEval k 0 a
proof:

  obtain ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩ := ha
  exact testPoint_eq_of_mem_piece_zero k t hq

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.SourceFiltration.F_not_mem_zero_layer
statement:
theorem F_not_mem_zero_layer [Nontrivial k] :
    aX k 3 ∉ imagePiece (presentation k) 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have he := testEval_eq_of_mem_zero_layer k 1 h
  simp [testPoint] at he

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.SourceFiltration.F_mem_one_layer
statement: theorem F_mem_one_layer : aX k 3 ∈ imagePiece (presentation k) 1
proof:

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.SourceFiltration.degree_F
statement:
theorem degree_F [Nontrivial k] :
    IntegerFiltration.degree (fun d => (imagePiece (presentation k) d : Set (A k)))
      (aX k 3) = 1
proof:
:= by
  apply IntegerFiltration.degree_eq_of_least _ (F_mem_one_layer k)
  intro d hd
  by_contra h
  have hd0 : d ≤ 0 := by omega
  exact F_not_mem_zero_layer k (imagePiece_mono (presentation k) hd0 hd)

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.SourceFiltration.mem_zeroLayerSubalgebra
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_zeroLayerSubalgebra (a : A k) :

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.SourceFiltration.p_mem_zeroLayerSubalgebra
statement: theorem p_mem_zeroLayerSubalgebra : aX k 0 ∈ zeroLayerSubalgebra k
proof:
:= by
  change aX k 0 ∈ imagePiece (presentation k) 0
  exact imagePiece_mono (presentation k) (by omega : (-1 : ℤ) ≤ 0)
    (image_X_zero_mem_neg_one (presentation k))

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.SourceFiltration.zeroLayerSubalgebra_ne_top
statement: theorem zeroLayerSubalgebra_ne_top [Nontrivial k] : zeroLayerSubalgebra k ≠ ⊤
proof:

  intro h
  apply F_not_mem_zero_layer k
  change aX k 3 ∈ zeroLayerSubalgebra k
  rw [h]
  trivial

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.SourceInvariant.exists_quadric_lnd_invariant
statement:
theorem exists_quadric_lnd_invariant
    (D : Derivation k (G k) (G k)) (m : ℤ)
    (hshift : ∀ (n : ℤ) (r : G k), r ∈ gPiece k n → D r ∈ gPiece k (n + m))
    (hD : IsLocallyNilpotent D) (hDne : D ≠ 0) (hp : D (gX k 0) = 0)
    {η : G k} {ℓ : ℤ} (hℓ : 0 < ℓ) (hη : η ∈ gPiece k ℓ)
    (hηne : η ≠ 0) (hDη : D η = 0) :
    ∃ E : Derivation k (B k) (B k),
      IsLocallyNilpotent E ∧ E ≠ 0 ∧
      ∃ h : B k, h ∈ I k ∧ h ≠ 0 ∧ E h = 0
proof:
:= by
  let δ := LaurentDerivationTransport.lift D hp
  have hδhom : LaurentDescent.HomogeneousOnConstants δ (-m) :=
    SourceLocalizedDerivation.homogeneousOnConstants_of_intertwining k D δ m
      hshift (LaurentDerivationTransport.lift_intertwine D hp)
  have hδT : δ (LaurentPolynomial.T 1) = 0 :=
    LaurentDerivationTransport.lift_T_one D hp
  have hδ : IsLocallyNilpotent (k := k) (A := LaurentPolynomial (B k)) δ :=
    LaurentDerivationTransport.lift_locallyNilpotent D hp hD
  have hδne : δ ≠ 0 := LaurentDerivationTransport.lift_ne_zero D hp hDne
  obtain ⟨hηimage, hδη⟩ := LaurentDerivationTransport.lift_nonzero_invariant D hp η hηne hDη
  have hℓnat : (ℓ.toNat : ℤ) = ℓ := Int.toNat_of_nonneg (le_of_lt hℓ)
  have hℓpos : 0 < ℓ.toNat := by omega
  have hhom : ModificationPieces.Homogeneous (ℓ.toNat : ℤ) (toLaurentBase k η) := by
    rw [hℓnat]
    exact SourceLocalizedDerivation.toLaurentBase_coeff_eq_zero k hη
  obtain ⟨h, hhI, hhne, hηeq⟩ := ModificationPieces.positive_nonzero_numerator
    hℓpos (ModificationEmbedding.toLaurent_mem k η) hhom hηimage
  refine ⟨LaurentDescent.descend δ (-m) hδhom,
    LaurentDescent.descend_locallyNilpotent δ (-m) hδhom hδT hδ,
    LaurentDescent.descend_ne_zero δ (-m) hδhom hδT hδne, h, hhI, hhne, ?_⟩
  apply LaurentDescent.descend_invariant δ (-m) hδhom hδT
  rw [← hηeq]
  exact hδη

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.SourceLocalizedDerivation.toLaurentBase_generator
statement:
theorem toLaurentBase_generator (i : Fin 5) :
    LaurentPresentation.toLaurentBase k (gX k i) =
      LaurentPolynomial.C (generatorCoefficients k i) *
        LaurentPolynomial.T (-presentationWeight i)
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases i <;>
    simp [LaurentPresentation.laurentValues, generatorCoefficients, presentationWeight]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.SourceLocalizedDerivation.toLaurentBase_mk_homogeneous
statement:
theorem toLaurentBase_mk_homogeneous {p : P k 5} {n : ℤ}
    (hp : p.IsWeightedHomogeneous presentationWeight n) :
    LaurentPresentation.toLaurentBase k (Ideal.Quotient.mk (idealG k) p) =
      LaurentPolynomial.C (aeval (generatorCoefficients k) p) *
        LaurentPolynomial.T (-n)
proof:
:= by
  exact LaurentWeightedMap.map_homogeneous presentationWeight (generatorCoefficients k)
    ((LaurentPresentation.toLaurentBase k).comp (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ k (idealG k)))
    (fun i => toLaurentBase_generator k i) hp

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.SourceLocalizedDerivation.toLaurentBase_coeff_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩ := hr
  change (LaurentPresentation.toLaurentBase k (Ideal.Quotient.mk (idealG k) p)).coeff j = 0
  rw [toLaurentBase_mk_homogeneous k hp, LaurentDescent.coeff_C_mul_T,
    ite_eq_right (Ne.symm hj)]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.SourceLocalizedDerivation.toLaurentBase_homogeneous
statement:
theorem toLaurentBase_homogeneous {r : G k} {n : ℤ}
    (hr : r ∈ gPiece k n) :
    LaurentPresentation.toLaurentBase k r =
      LaurentPolynomial.C ((LaurentPresentation.toLaurentBase k r).coeff (-n)) *
        LaurentPolynomial.T (-n)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩ := hr
  change LaurentPresentation.toLaurentBase k (Ideal.Quotient.mk (idealG k) p) =
    LaurentPolynomial.C
      ((LaurentPresentation.toLaurentBase k (Ideal.Quotient.mk (idealG k) p)).coeff (-n)) *
      LaurentPolynomial.T (-n)
  rw [toLaurentBase_mk_homogeneous k hp, LaurentDescent.coeff_C_mul_T, ite_eq_left rfl]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.SourceLocalizedDerivation.baseMap_eq_baseToDegeneration
statement:
theorem baseMap_eq_baseToDegeneration :
    LaurentPresentation.baseMap k = baseToDegeneration k
proof:
:= by
  apply Ideal.Quotient.algHom_ext k
  apply MvPolynomial.algHom_ext
  intro i
  change LaurentPresentation.baseMap k (bX k i) = baseToDegeneration k (bX k i)
  simp only [LaurentPresentation.baseMap_bX, baseToDegeneration_bX]
  rfl

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.SourceLocalizedDerivation.baseMap_mem_piece
statement:
theorem baseMap_mem_piece (b : B k) :
    LaurentPresentation.baseMap k b ∈ gPiece k 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [baseMap_eq_baseToDegeneration]
  exact baseToDegeneration_mem_piece k b

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.SourceLocalizedDerivation.homogeneousOnConstants_of_intertwining
statement:
theorem homogeneousOnConstants_of_intertwining
    (D : Derivation k (G k) (G k))
    (δ : Derivation k (LaurentPresentation.Laurent k) (LaurentPresentation.Laurent k))
    (m : ℤ)
    (hD : ∀ (n : ℤ) (r : G k), r ∈ gPiece k n → D r ∈ gPiece k (n + m))
    (hintertwine : ∀ r : G k,
      δ (LaurentPresentation.toLaurentBase k r) = LaurentPresentation.toLaurentBase k (D r)) :
    LaurentDescent.HomogeneousOnConstants δ (-m)
proof:
:= by
  intro b
  have hDb : D (LaurentPresentation.baseMap k b) ∈ gPiece k m := by
    simpa using hD 0 (LaurentPresentation.baseMap k b) (baseMap_mem_piece k b)
  have hcompat := hintertwine (LaurentPresentation.baseMap k b)
  rw [LaurentPresentation.toLaurentBase_baseMap] at hcompat
  rw [hcompat]
  exact toLaurentBase_homogeneous k hDb

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.Obstruction.sourcePresentation_p
statement: @[simp] theorem sourcePresentation_p : sourcePresentation (aX ℂ 0) = StableCoordinate.f
proof:
:=
  Presentation.originalPresentation_p

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.Obstruction.f_coordinate_iff_source_coordinate
statement:
theorem f_coordinate_iff_source_coordinate :
    IsCoordinate (by decide : 0 < 4) StableCoordinate.f ↔
      ∃ e : A ℂ ≃ₐ[ℂ] StableCoordinate.R 4, e (aX ℂ 0) = MvPolynomial.X 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨e, he⟩
    refine ⟨sourcePresentation.trans e, ?_⟩
    change e StableCoordinate.f = MvPolynomial.X 0 at he
    simpa only [AlgEquiv.trans_apply, sourcePresentation_p] using he
  · rintro ⟨e, he⟩
    refine ⟨sourcePresentation.symm.trans e, ?_⟩
    change e (sourcePresentation.symm StableCoordinate.f) = MvPolynomial.X 0
    rw [← sourcePresentation_p, AlgEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
    exact he

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.Stabilization.shiftQuotientEquiv_mk

@[simp] theorem shiftQuotientEquiv_mk (a : R 6) :

proof:
:= by
  change Ideal.Quotient.mk shiftedIdeal
    (ExponentialShift.shiftEquiv ℂ 1 (ExponentialShift.p ℂ)) = _

proof:

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.Stabilization.trans_apply_eq
statement:
private theorem trans_apply_eq {K A B C : Type*} [CommSemiring K]
    [CommSemiring A] [CommSemiring B] [CommSemiring C]
    [Algebra K A] [Algebra K B] [Algebra K C]
    (e : A ≃ₐ[K] B) (d : B ≃ₐ[K] C) (a : A) (b : B) (c : C)
    (he : e a = b) (hd : d b = c) : e.trans d a = c
proof:
:= by
  rw [AlgEquiv.trans_apply, he, hd]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.Stabilization.stablePresentationEquiv_p
statement:
@[simp] theorem stablePresentationEquiv_p :
    stablePresentationEquiv (Ideal.Quotient.mk presentationIdeal (X 0)) = X 0
proof:
:=
  trans_apply_eq shiftQuotientEquiv eliminateQuotientEquiv _ _ _
    shiftQuotientEquiv_p eliminateQuotientEquiv_p

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.Stabilization.oneStable_of_presentations
statement:
theorem oneStable_of_presentations {A : Type*} [CommRing A] [Algebra ℂ A]
    (p : A) (present eliminate : A ≃ₐ[ℂ] R 5)
    (hpresent : present p = stabilize f) (heliminate : eliminate p = X 0) :
    IsOneStableCoordinate f
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨present.symm.trans eliminate, ?_⟩
  rw [AlgEquiv.trans_apply, ← hpresent, AlgEquiv.symm_apply_apply, heliminate]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.f_isOneStableCoordinate
statement: theorem f_isOneStableCoordinate : IsOneStableCoordinate f
proof:
:= by
  exact Stabilization.oneStable_of_presentations
    (Presentation.mk 1 (Presentation.p 1))
    Presentation.stabilizedPresentation
    Stabilization.stablePresentationEquiv
    Presentation.stabilizedPresentation_p
    Stabilization.stablePresentationEquiv_p

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.stabilizationEquiv_X_castSucc
statement:
@[simp]
theorem stabilizationEquiv_X_castSucc (i : Fin 4) :
    stabilizationEquiv (X i.castSucc) = Polynomial.C (X i)
proof:
:= by
  simp [stabilizationEquiv, renameEquiv_apply]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.stabilizationEquiv_X_last
statement:
@[simp]
theorem stabilizationEquiv_X_last :
    stabilizationEquiv (X 4) = Polynomial.X
proof:
:= by
  have h : (finSuccEquivLast : Fin 5 ≃ Option (Fin 4)) (4 : Fin 5) = none :=
    finSuccEquivLast_last
  simp [stabilizationEquiv, renameEquiv_apply, h]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.stabilizationEquiv_stabilize
statement:
@[simp]
theorem stabilizationEquiv_stabilize (g : R 4) :
    stabilizationEquiv (stabilize g) = Polynomial.C g
proof:
:= by
  have h : stabilizationEquiv.toAlgHom.comp stabilize =
      (Polynomial.CAlgHom : R 4 →ₐ[ℂ] Polynomial (R 4)) := by
    ext i
    simp [stabilize]
  exact AlgHom.congr_fun h g

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.stabilizationEquiv_symm_C
statement:
@[simp]
theorem stabilizationEquiv_symm_C (g : R 4) :
    stabilizationEquiv.symm (Polynomial.C g) = stabilize g
proof:
:= by
  apply stabilizationEquiv.injective
  simp

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.stabilize_injective
statement: theorem stabilize_injective : Function.Injective stabilize
proof:
:= by
  intro g h hgh
  apply Polynomial.C_injective
  simpa using congrArg stabilizationEquiv hgh

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.last_variable_not_mem_stabilize_range
statement:
theorem last_variable_not_mem_stabilize_range :
    (X 4 : R 5) ∉ Set.range stabilize
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨g, hg⟩
  have h := congrArg stabilizationEquiv hg
  simp only [stabilizationEquiv_stabilize, stabilizationEquiv_X_last] at h
  exact Polynomial.X_ne_C g h.symm

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.isOneStableCoordinate_iff_polynomial
statement:
theorem isOneStableCoordinate_iff_polynomial (g : R 4) :
    IsOneStableCoordinate g ↔
      ∃ φ : Polynomial (R 4) ≃ₐ[ℂ] Polynomial (R 4),
        φ (Polynomial.C g) = Polynomial.C (X 0)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨φ, hφ⟩
    refine ⟨stabilizationEquiv.symm.trans (φ.trans stabilizationEquiv), ?_⟩
    change stabilizationEquiv (φ (stabilizationEquiv.symm (Polynomial.C g))) = _
    rw [stabilizationEquiv_symm_C, hφ]
    exact stabilizationEquiv_X_castSucc 0
  · rintro ⟨φ, hφ⟩
    refine ⟨stabilizationEquiv.trans (φ.trans stabilizationEquiv.symm), ?_⟩
    change stabilizationEquiv.symm (φ (stabilizationEquiv (stabilize g))) = _
    rw [stabilizationEquiv_stabilize, hφ, stabilizationEquiv_symm_C]
    simp [stabilize]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.StabilizedQuotient.evaluate_equation

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.StabilizedQuotient.out_mk

proof: := rfl

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.StabilizedQuotient.quotient_equation

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.StabilizedQuotient.out_comp_into
statement: theorem out_comp_into : out.comp into = AlgHom.id ℂ S
proof:
:= by

  fin_cases i <;> simp [into, evaluate]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.StabilizedQuotient.into_comp_out
statement: theorem into_comp_out : into.comp out = AlgHom.id ℂ A
proof:
:= by
  apply Ideal.Quotient.algHom_ext
  apply MvPolynomial.algHom_ext
  intro i
  fin_cases i <;> simp [evaluate, into]
  have h := quotient_equation
  simp only [equation, map_add, map_sub, map_mul] at h
  change Ideal.Quotient.mk equationIdeal (X 3) -
    Ideal.Quotient.mk equationIdeal (X 2) +
    Ideal.Quotient.mk equationIdeal (X 0) * Ideal.Quotient.mk equationIdeal (X 5) = 0 at h
  linear_combination -h

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.StabilizedQuotient.equiv_mk

proof: := rfl

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.StabilizedQuotient.equiv_p

proof:
:= by
