name: OAI.StableCoordinate.polynomial_unit_eq_C_eval
statement:
theorem polynomial_unit_eq_C_eval {p : MvPolynomial σ R} (hp : IsUnit p)
    (x : σ → R) : p = C (eval x p)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, _, rfl⟩ := isUnit_iff_eq_C_of_isReduced.mp hp
  simp

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.polynomial_unit_eval_independent
statement:
theorem polynomial_unit_eval_independent {p : MvPolynomial σ R} (hp : IsUnit p)
    (x y : σ → R) : eval x p = eval y p
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, _, rfl⟩ := isUnit_iff_eq_C_of_isReduced.mp hp
  simp

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.polynomial_units_eq_of_eval_eq
proof:
:= by
  rw [polynomial_unit_eq_C_eval hp x, polynomial_unit_eq_C_eval hq x, h]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.polynomial_unit_eq_one_of_eval_eq_one
statement:
theorem polynomial_unit_eq_one_of_eval_eq_one {p : MvPolynomial σ R}
    (hp : IsUnit p) (x : σ → R) (h : eval x p = 1) : p = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [polynomial_unit_eq_C_eval hp x, h, map_one]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.normalized_two_parameter_unit_eq_one
statement:
theorem normalized_two_parameter_unit_eq_one
    {c : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) R} (hc : IsUnit c)
    (hzero : eval (fun _ => 0) c = 1) : c = 1
proof:
:=
  polynomial_unit_eq_one_of_eval_eq_one hc (fun _ => 0) hzero

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.UnivariateLND.apply_eq_derivative_mul
statement:
theorem apply_eq_derivative_mul (D : Derivation K K[X] K[X]) (p : K[X]) :
    D p = p.derivative * D X
proof:
:= by
  simpa using D.map_aeval p (X : K[X])

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.UnivariateLND.natDegree_apply_pos
statement:
theorem natDegree_apply_pos (D : Derivation K K[X] K[X])
    (hD : 0 < (D X).natDegree) {p : K[X]} (hp : 0 < p.natDegree) :
    0 < (D p).natDegree
proof:
:= by
  have hp' : p.derivative ≠ 0 := derivative_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.ne_of_gt hp)
  have hD' : D X ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    simp [h] at hD
  rw [apply_eq_derivative_mul, natDegree_mul hp' hD', natDegree_derivative]
  omega

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.UnivariateLND.natDegree_iterate_X_pos
statement:
theorem natDegree_iterate_X_pos (D : Derivation K K[X] K[X])
    (hD : 0 < (D X).natDegree) (n : ℕ) :
    0 < (((D : K[X] → K[X])^[n]) X).natDegree
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply']
    exact natDegree_apply_pos D hD ih

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.UnivariateLND.natDegree_apply_X_eq_zero_of_iterate_eq_zero
statement:
theorem natDegree_apply_X_eq_zero_of_iterate_eq_zero
    (D : Derivation K K[X] K[X])
    (hD : ∃ n : ℕ, ((D : K[X] → K[X])^[n]) X = 0) :
    (D X).natDegree = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hD
  have hp := natDegree_iterate_X_pos D (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero h) n
  simp [hn] at hp

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.UnivariateLND.apply_X_eq_C_of_locallyNilpotent
statement:
theorem apply_X_eq_C_of_locallyNilpotent (D : Derivation K K[X] K[X])
    (hD : ∀ p : K[X], ∃ n : ℕ, ((D : K[X] → K[X])^[n]) p = 0) :
    D X = C ((D X).coeff 0)
proof:
:= by
  exact eq_C_of_natDegree_eq_zero
    (natDegree_apply_X_eq_zero_of_iterate_eq_zero D (hD X))

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.UnivariateLND.exists_apply_X_eq_C_of_locallyNilpotent
statement:
theorem exists_apply_X_eq_C_of_locallyNilpotent (D : Derivation K K[X] K[X])
    (hD : ∀ p : K[X], ∃ n : ℕ, ((D : K[X] → K[X])^[n]) p = 0) :
    ∃ c : K, D X = C c
proof:
:=
  ⟨(D X).coeff 0, apply_X_eq_C_of_locallyNilpotent D hD⟩

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.VerticalLND.annihilates_baseMap
statement:
theorem annihilates_baseMap (D : Derivation k (DeterminantRing.C k) (DeterminantRing.C k))
    (ha : D (a k) = 0) (hd : D (d k) = 0) (hu : D (u k) = 0) :
    ∀ p : Base k, D (baseMap p) = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply DerivationScalarUpgrade.annihilates_mvPolynomial D baseMap
  intro i
  fin_cases i
  · simpa using ha
  · simpa using hd
  · simpa using hu

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.VerticalLND.coefficient_equations
statement:
theorem coefficient_equations
    (D : Derivation k (DeterminantRing.C k) (DeterminantRing.C k))
    (ha : D (a k) = 0) (hd : D (d k) = 0) :
    D (b k) = a k * coefficient D ∧ D (c k) = d k * coefficient D
proof:
:=
  derivation_rigidityCoefficient D (a k) (d k) (b k) (c k)
    (determinant_relation k) ha hd

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.VerticalLND.coefficient_chartA_eq_C
statement:
theorem coefficient_chartA_eq_C
    (D : Derivation K (DeterminantRing.C K) (DeterminantRing.C K))
    (hD : ∀ z : DeterminantRing.C K, ∃ n : ℕ,
      (D : DeterminantRing.C K → DeterminantRing.C K)^[n] z = 0)
    (ha : D (a K) = 0) (hd : D (d K) = 0) (hu : D (u K) = 0) :
    chartMapA K (coefficient D) =
      Polynomial.C ((chartMapA K (coefficient D)).coeff 0)
proof:
:= by
  let : IsDomain (BaseAway K 0) :=
    IsLocalization.Away.isDomain (BaseAway K 0) (MvPolynomial.X_ne_zero (R := K) (0 : Fin 3))
  let : CharZero (BaseAway K 0) :=
    charZero_of_injective_algebraMap (algebraMap K (BaseAway K 0)).injective
  let : IsLocalization.Away (baseMap (MvPolynomial.X 0 : Base K)) (AwayA K) := by
    rw [baseMap_X0]
    infer_instance
  have h := ChartLNDConstant.chart_coefficient_eq_C
    (baseMap (k := K)) (MvPolynomial.X 0) D hD
    (annihilates_baseMap D ha hd hu) (chartEquivA K)
    (fun r => by
      change toChartA K (algebraMap (DeterminantRing.C K) (AwayA K) (baseMap r)) = _
      simp only [toChartA_algebraMap, chartMapA_baseMap])
    (b K) (coefficient D)
    (by
      change toChartA K (algebraMap (DeterminantRing.C K) (AwayA K) (b K)) = _
      simp only [toChartA_algebraMap, chartMapA_b])
    (by simpa only [baseMap_X0] using (coefficient_equations D ha hd).1)
  change toChartA K (algebraMap (DeterminantRing.C K) (AwayA K) (coefficient D)) =
    Polynomial.C ((toChartA K
      (algebraMap (DeterminantRing.C K) (AwayA K) (coefficient D))).coeff 0) at h
  simpa only [toChartA_algebraMap] using h

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.VerticalLND.coefficient_chartD_eq_C
statement:
theorem coefficient_chartD_eq_C
    (D : Derivation K (DeterminantRing.C K) (DeterminantRing.C K))
    (hD : ∀ z : DeterminantRing.C K, ∃ n : ℕ,
      (D : DeterminantRing.C K → DeterminantRing.C K)^[n] z = 0)
    (ha : D (a K) = 0) (hd : D (d K) = 0) (hu : D (u K) = 0) :
    chartMapD K (coefficient D) =
      Polynomial.C ((chartMapD K (coefficient D)).coeff 0)
proof:
:= by
  let : IsDomain (BaseAway K 1) :=
    IsLocalization.Away.isDomain (BaseAway K 1) (MvPolynomial.X_ne_zero (R := K) (1 : Fin 3))
  let : CharZero (BaseAway K 1) :=
    charZero_of_injective_algebraMap (algebraMap K (BaseAway K 1)).injective
  let : IsLocalization.Away (baseMap (MvPolynomial.X 1 : Base K)) (AwayD K) := by
    rw [baseMap_X1]
    infer_instance
  have h := ChartLNDConstant.chart_coefficient_eq_C
    (baseMap (k := K)) (MvPolynomial.X 1) D hD
    (annihilates_baseMap D ha hd hu) (chartEquivD K)
    (fun r => by
      change toChartD K (algebraMap (DeterminantRing.C K) (AwayD K) (baseMap r)) = _
      simp only [toChartD_algebraMap, chartMapD_baseMap])
    (c K) (coefficient D)
    (by
      change toChartD K (algebraMap (DeterminantRing.C K) (AwayD K) (c K)) = _
      simp only [toChartD_algebraMap, chartMapD_c])
    (by simpa only [baseMap_X1] using (coefficient_equations D ha hd).2)
  change toChartD K (algebraMap (DeterminantRing.C K) (AwayD K) (coefficient D)) =
    Polynomial.C ((toChartD K
      (algebraMap (DeterminantRing.C K) (AwayD K) (coefficient D))).coeff 0) at h
  simpa only [toChartD_algebraMap] using h

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.VerticalLND.exists_polynomial_coefficient
statement:
theorem exists_polynomial_coefficient
    (D : Derivation K (DeterminantRing.C K) (DeterminantRing.C K))
    (hD : ∀ z : DeterminantRing.C K, ∃ n : ℕ,
      (D : DeterminantRing.C K → DeterminantRing.C K)^[n] z = 0)
    (ha : D (a K) = 0) (hd : D (d K) = 0) (hu : D (u K) = 0) :
    ∃ r : Base K, baseMap r = coefficient D
proof:
:=
  exists_base_of_constant_charts K (coefficient_chartA_eq_C D hD ha hd hu)
    (coefficient_chartD_eq_C D hD ha hd hu)

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.VerticalLND.coefficient_mem_baseRange
statement:
theorem coefficient_mem_baseRange
    (D : Derivation K (DeterminantRing.C K) (DeterminantRing.C K))
    (hD : ∀ z : DeterminantRing.C K, ∃ n : ℕ,
      (D : DeterminantRing.C K → DeterminantRing.C K)^[n] z = 0)
    (ha : D (a K) = 0) (hd : D (d K) = 0) (hu : D (u K) = 0) :
    coefficient D ∈ (baseMap (k := K)).range
proof:
:=
  exists_polynomial_coefficient D hD ha hd hu

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.VerticalLND.classification
statement:
theorem classification
    (D : Derivation K (DeterminantRing.C K) (DeterminantRing.C K))
    (hD : ∀ z : DeterminantRing.C K, ∃ n : ℕ,
      (D : DeterminantRing.C K → DeterminantRing.C K)^[n] z = 0)
    (ha : D (a K) = 0) (hd : D (d K) = 0) (hu : D (u K) = 0) :
    ∃ r : Base K, D (b K) = a K * baseMap r ∧ D (c K) = d K * baseMap r
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := exists_polynomial_coefficient D hD ha hd hu
  exact ⟨r, by rw [hr]; exact (coefficient_equations D ha hd).1,
    by rw [hr]; exact (coefficient_equations D ha hd).2⟩

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.WeightedInitial.bounded_zero
statement: lemma bounded_zero (w : σ → ℤ) (d : ℤ) : Bounded w (0 : MvPolynomial σ K) d
proof:
:= by
  intro m hm
  simp at hm

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.WeightedInitial.Bounded.mono
statement:
lemma Bounded.mono {w : σ → ℤ} {p : MvPolynomial σ K} {d e : ℤ}
    (hp : Bounded w p d) (hde : d ≤ e) : Bounded w p e
proof:
:=
  fun m hm => (hp m hm).trans hde

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.WeightedInitial.Bounded.add
statement:
lemma Bounded.add {w : σ → ℤ} {p q : MvPolynomial σ K} {d : ℤ}
    (hp : Bounded w p d) (hq : Bounded w q d) : Bounded w (p + q) d
proof:
:= by
  intro m hm
  rw [AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_add] at hm
  by_cases hpm : p.coeff m = 0
  · exact hq m (by simpa [hpm] using hm)
  · exact hp m hpm

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.WeightedInitial.Bounded.mul
statement:
lemma Bounded.mul {w : σ → ℤ} {p q : MvPolynomial σ K} {d e : ℤ}
    (hp : Bounded w p d) (hq : Bounded w q e) : Bounded w (p * q) (d + e)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro m hm
  rw [coeff_mul] at hm
  obtain ⟨⟨a,b⟩, hab, hterm⟩ := Finset.exists_ne_zero_of_sum_ne_zero hm
  have ha : p.coeff a ≠ 0 := left_ne_zero_of_mul hterm
  have hb : q.coeff b ≠ 0 := right_ne_zero_of_mul hterm
  have hab' : a + b = m := Finset.mem_antidiagonal.mp hab
  rw [← hab', map_add]
  exact add_le_add (hp a ha) (hq b hb)

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.WeightedInitial.bounded_iff_degree_le
statement:
theorem bounded_iff_degree_le {w : σ → ℤ} {p : MvPolynomial σ K} {d : ℤ} :
    Bounded w p d ↔ weightedTotalDegree' w p ≤ (d : WithBot ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Bounded, weightedTotalDegree', Finset.sup_le_iff, mem_support_iff,
    WithBot.coe_le_coe]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.WeightedInitial.bounded_monomial
statement:
lemma bounded_monomial (w : σ → ℤ) (m : σ →₀ ℕ) (c : K) {d : ℤ}
    (hm : Finsupp.weight w m ≤ d) : Bounded w (monomial m c) d
proof:
:= by
  intro a ha
  have hw := isWeightedHomogeneous_monomial w m c rfl ha
  exact hw.le.trans hm

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.WeightedInitial.boundedSubmodule_eq_span
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro p hp
    change Bounded w p d at hp
    rw [p.as_sum]
    apply Submodule.sum_mem
    intro m hm
    have hsingle : monomial m (1 : K) ∈ Submodule.span K
        {p | ∃ m : σ →₀ ℕ, Finsupp.weight w m ≤ d ∧ p = monomial m (1 : K)} :=
      Submodule.subset_span ⟨m, hp m (mem_support_iff.mp hm), rfl⟩
    simpa only [smul_monomial, smul_eq_mul, mul_one] using
      Submodule.smul_mem _ (p.coeff m) hsingle
  · apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
    rintro p ⟨m, hm, rfl⟩
    exact bounded_monomial w m 1 hm

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.WeightedInitial.component_mul_of_bounded
statement:
theorem component_mul_of_bounded {w : σ → ℤ} {p q : MvPolynomial σ K} {d e : ℤ}
    (hp : Bounded w p d) (hq : Bounded w q e) :
    weightedHomogeneousComponent w (d + e) (p * q) =
      weightedHomogeneousComponent w d p * weightedHomogeneousComponent w e q
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext m
  rw [coeff_weightedHomogeneousComponent, coeff_mul, coeff_mul]
  rw [Finset.ite_sum_zero]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  rintro ⟨a,b⟩ hab
  rw [coeff_weightedHomogeneousComponent, coeff_weightedHomogeneousComponent]
  have hab' : a + b = m := Finset.mem_antidiagonal.mp hab
  by_cases ha : p.coeff a = 0
  · simp [ha]
  by_cases hb : q.coeff b = 0
  · simp [hb]
  have hap := hp a ha
  have hbq := hq b hb
  have hweight : Finsupp.weight w a + Finsupp.weight w b = Finsupp.weight w m := by
    rw [← map_add, hab']
  have hiff : Finsupp.weight w m = d + e ↔
      Finsupp.weight w a = d ∧ Finsupp.weight w b = e := by omega
  by_cases hma : Finsupp.weight w a = d <;>
    by_cases hmb : Finsupp.weight w b = e <;> simp [hiff, hma, hmb]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.WeightedInitial.component_eq_zero_of_bounded
statement:
lemma component_eq_zero_of_bounded {w : σ → ℤ} {p : MvPolynomial σ K} {d e : ℤ}
    (hp : Bounded w p d) (hde : d < e) : weightedHomogeneousComponent w e p = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext m
  rw [coeff_weightedHomogeneousComponent, AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_zero]
  split_ifs with hm
  · by_contra hc
    have := hp m hc
    omega
  · rfl

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.WeightedInitial.exists_top
statement:
theorem exists_top {w : σ → ℤ} {p : MvPolynomial σ K} (hp : p ≠ 0) :
    ∃ d : ℤ, Bounded w p d ∧ weightedHomogeneousComponent w d p ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hs : p.support.Nonempty := support_nonempty.mpr hp
  obtain ⟨m, hm, hmax⟩ := Finset.exists_max_image p.support (Finsupp.weight w) hs
  refine ⟨Finsupp.weight w m, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro a ha
    exact hmax a (mem_support_iff.mpr ha)
  · intro h
    have heq := congrArg (fun q : MvPolynomial σ K => q.coeff m) h
    simp only [coeff_weightedHomogeneousComponent, AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_zero] at heq
    exact (mem_support_iff.mp hm) heq

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.WeightedInitial.degree_eq_of_top
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · rw [weightedTotalDegree', Finset.sup_le_iff]
    intro m hm
    exact WithBot.coe_le_coe.mpr (hb m (mem_support_iff.mp hm))
  · obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := exists_coeff_ne_zero ht
    rw [coeff_weightedHomogeneousComponent] at hm
    split_ifs at hm with hmd
    · have hb' := Finset.le_sup (f := fun a => (Finsupp.weight w a : WithBot ℤ))
        (mem_support_iff.mpr hm)
      simpa only [weightedTotalDegree', hmd] using hb'
    · exact (hm rfl).elim

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.WeightedInitial.top_mul
statement:
theorem top_mul {w : σ → ℤ} {p q : MvPolynomial σ K} {d e : ℤ}
    (hp : Bounded w p d) (hq : Bounded w q e)
    (htp : weightedHomogeneousComponent w d p ≠ 0)
    (htq : weightedHomogeneousComponent w e q ≠ 0) :
    Bounded w (p * q) (d + e) ∧
      weightedHomogeneousComponent w (d + e) (p * q) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨hp.mul hq, ?_⟩
  rw [component_mul_of_bounded hp hq]
  exact mul_ne_zero htp htq

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.WeightedInitial.degree_mul
statement:
theorem degree_mul (w : σ → ℤ) (p q : MvPolynomial σ K) :
    weightedTotalDegree' w (p * q) = weightedTotalDegree' w p + weightedTotalDegree' w q
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hp : p = 0
  · simp [hp, weightedTotalDegree'_zero]
  by_cases hq : q = 0
  · simp [hq, weightedTotalDegree'_zero]
  obtain ⟨d, hd, htd⟩ := exists_top (w := w) hp
  obtain ⟨e, he, hte⟩ := exists_top (w := w) hq
  obtain ⟨hbound, htop⟩ := top_mul hd he htd hte
  rw [degree_eq_of_top hbound htop, degree_eq_of_top hd htd, degree_eq_of_top he hte]
  rfl

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.WeightedInitial.Bounded.neg
statement:
lemma Bounded.neg {w : σ → ℤ} {p : MvPolynomial σ A} {d : ℤ}
    (hp : Bounded w p d) : Bounded w (-p) d
proof:
:= by
  intro m hm
  rw [coeff_neg, neg_ne_zero] at hm
  exact hp m hm

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.WeightedInitial.Bounded.sub
statement:
lemma Bounded.sub {w : σ → ℤ} {p q : MvPolynomial σ A} {d : ℤ}
    (hp : Bounded w p d) (hq : Bounded w q d) : Bounded w (p - q) d
proof:
:= by
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg]
  exact hp.add hq.neg

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.WeightedInitial.bounded_sub_top
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro m hm
  rw [coeff_sub, coeff_weightedHomogeneousComponent] at hm
  by_cases hmd : Finsupp.weight w m = d
  · simp [hmd] at hm
  · simp only [ite_eq_right hmd, sub_zero] at hm
    have hle := hp m hm
    omega

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.WeightedInitial.homogeneous_bounded
statement: lemma homogeneous_bounded (hp : p.IsWeightedHomogeneous w d) : Bounded w p d
proof:
:=
  fun _ hm => le_of_eq (hp hm)

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.WeightedInitial.IsTopDegree.ne_zero
statement: lemma IsTopDegree.ne_zero (hp : IsTopDegree w p d) : p ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  exact hp.2 (by rw [h, map_zero])

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.WeightedInitial.IsTopDegree.of_homogeneous
statement:
lemma IsTopDegree.of_homogeneous (hp : p.IsWeightedHomogeneous w d) (hne : p ≠ 0) :
    IsTopDegree w p d
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨homogeneous_bounded hp, ?_⟩
  rwa [hp.weightedHomogeneousComponent_same]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.WeightedInitial.IsTopDegree.unique
statement: lemma IsTopDegree.unique (hp : IsTopDegree w p d) (hq : IsTopDegree w p e) : d = e
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · by_contra h
    exact hp.2 (component_eq_zero_of_bounded hq.1 (lt_of_not_ge h))
  · by_contra h
    exact hq.2 (component_eq_zero_of_bounded hp.1 (lt_of_not_ge h))

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.WeightedInitial.component_mul_homogeneous_left
statement:
lemma component_mul_homogeneous_left (hp : p.IsWeightedHomogeneous w d) (q : MvPolynomial σ R)
    (e : ℤ) :
    weightedHomogeneousComponent w (d + e) (p * q) =
      p * weightedHomogeneousComponent w e q
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext m
  rw [coeff_weightedHomogeneousComponent, coeff_mul, coeff_mul, Finset.ite_sum_zero]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  rintro ⟨a, b⟩ hab
  rw [coeff_weightedHomogeneousComponent]
  by_cases ha : p.coeff a = 0
  · simp [ha]
  have hwa : Finsupp.weight w a = d := hp ha
  have hab' : a + b = m := Finset.mem_antidiagonal.mp hab
  have hwm : Finsupp.weight w m = d + Finsupp.weight w b := by
    rw [← hab', map_add, hwa]
  simp only [hwm, add_right_inj]
  split_ifs <;> simp_all

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.WeightedInitial.initialIdeal_span_singleton
statement:
theorem initialIdeal_span_singleton (hH : IsTopDegree w q e) :
    initialIdeal w (Ideal.span ({q} : Set (MvPolynomial σ R))) =
      Ideal.span ({weightedHomogeneousComponent w e q} : Set (MvPolynomial σ R))
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply Ideal.span_le.mpr
    intro f hf
    obtain ⟨r, hr, d, hd, rfl⟩ := hf
    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mp hr
    have htne : t ≠ 0 := by
      intro hzero
      exact hd.ne_zero (by rw [ht, hzero, mul_zero])
    obtain ⟨c, hc, hct⟩ := exists_top (w := w) htne
    have hp : IsTopDegree w (q * t) (e + c) := top_mul hH.1 hc hH.2 hct
    rw [← ht] at hp
    have hdegree := hd.unique hp
    rw [hdegree, ht, component_mul_of_bounded hH.1 hc]
    exact Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mpr ⟨weightedHomogeneousComponent w c t, rfl⟩
  · apply Ideal.span_le.mpr
    intro f hf
    have hf' : f = weightedHomogeneousComponent w e q := Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hf
    subst f
    exact Ideal.subset_span ⟨q, Ideal.subset_span (Set.mem_singleton q), e, hH, rfl⟩

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.WeightedInitial.bounded_of_homogeneous
statement:
lemma bounded_of_homogeneous {w : σ → ℤ} {p : MvPolynomial σ K} {d : ℤ}
    (hp : IsWeightedHomogeneous w p d) : Bounded w p d
proof:
:=
  fun _ hm => (hp hm).le

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.WeightedInitial.top_sub_lower
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_sub, weightedHomogeneousComponent_eq_self hp,
    component_eq_zero_of_bounded hr (by omega), sub_zero]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.WeightedInitial.homogeneous_quotient_kernel_iff
statement:
theorem homogeneous_quotient_kernel_iff
    (w : σ → ℤ) (H : MvPolynomial σ K) (e : ℤ)
    (hH : Bounded w H e) (hHt : weightedHomogeneousComponent w e H ≠ 0)
    {p : MvPolynomial σ K} {d : ℤ} (hp : IsWeightedHomogeneous w p d) :
    (∃ r : MvPolynomial σ K, Bounded w r (d - 1) ∧
      p - r ∈ Ideal.span ({H} : Set (MvPolynomial σ K))) ↔
    p ∈ Ideal.span ({weightedHomogeneousComponent w e H} : Set (MvPolynomial σ K))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hp0 : p = 0
  · subst p
    constructor
    · intro _
      exact Ideal.zero_mem _
    · intro _
      exact ⟨0, bounded_zero w _, by simp⟩
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨r, hr, hpr⟩
    obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mp hpr
    have hprtop : weightedHomogeneousComponent w d (p - r) ≠ 0 := by
      rw [top_sub_lower hp hr]
      exact hp0
    have hqr : q ≠ 0 := by
      intro hq0
      rw [hq0, mul_zero] at hq
      rw [hq, map_zero] at hprtop
      exact hprtop rfl
    obtain ⟨t, hqt, hqtop⟩ := exists_top (w := w) hqr
    obtain ⟨hprod, hprodtop⟩ := top_mul hH hqt hHt hqtop
    have hprbound : Bounded w (p - r) d :=
      (bounded_of_homogeneous hp).sub (hr.mono (by omega))
    have hde : d = e + t := by
      apply WithBot.coe_injective
      calc
        (d : WithBot ℤ) = weightedTotalDegree' w (p - r) :=
          (degree_eq_of_top hprbound hprtop).symm
        _ = weightedTotalDegree' w (H * q) := congrArg _ hq
        _ = ((e + t : ℤ) : WithBot ℤ) := degree_eq_of_top hprod hprodtop
    apply Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mpr
    refine ⟨weightedHomogeneousComponent w t q, ?_⟩
    calc
      p = weightedHomogeneousComponent w d (p - r) := (top_sub_lower hp hr).symm
      _ = weightedHomogeneousComponent w (e + t) (H * q) := by rw [hq, hde]
      _ = _ := component_mul_of_bounded hH hqt
  · intro hpmem
    obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mp hpmem
    have hq0 : q ≠ 0 := by
      intro hh
      rw [hh, mul_zero] at hq
      exact hp0 hq
    obtain ⟨t, hqt, hqtop⟩ := exists_top (w := w) hq0
    have hhom : IsWeightedHomogeneous w (weightedHomogeneousComponent w e H) e :=
      weightedHomogeneousComponent_isWeightedHomogeneous e H
    have htopself : weightedHomogeneousComponent w e
        (weightedHomogeneousComponent w e H) = weightedHomogeneousComponent w e H :=
      weightedHomogeneousComponent_eq_self hhom
    have htopself_ne : weightedHomogeneousComponent w e
        (weightedHomogeneousComponent w e H) ≠ 0 := by rwa [htopself]
    obtain ⟨hprod, hprodtop⟩ :=
      top_mul (bounded_of_homogeneous hhom) hqt htopself_ne hqtop
    have hde : d = e + t := by
      apply WithBot.coe_injective
      calc
        (d : WithBot ℤ) = weightedTotalDegree' w p :=
          (hp.weighted_total_degree hp0).symm
        _ = weightedTotalDegree' w (weightedHomogeneousComponent w e H * q) := congrArg _ hq
        _ = ((e + t : ℤ) : WithBot ℤ) := degree_eq_of_top hprod hprodtop
    have hptop : p = weightedHomogeneousComponent w e H * weightedHomogeneousComponent w t q := by
      calc
        p = weightedHomogeneousComponent w d p := (weightedHomogeneousComponent_eq_self hp).symm
        _ = weightedHomogeneousComponent w (e + t)
              (weightedHomogeneousComponent w e H * q) := by rw [hq, hde]
        _ = _ := by rw [component_mul_of_bounded (bounded_of_homogeneous hhom) hqt, htopself]
    let r := p - H * weightedHomogeneousComponent w t q
    refine ⟨r, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have hb := (bounded_sub_top hH).mul
        (bounded_of_homogeneous (weightedHomogeneousComponent_isWeightedHomogeneous t q))
      have hr : r = -((H - weightedHomogeneousComponent w e H) *
          weightedHomogeneousComponent w t q) := by
        dsimp [r]
        rw [hptop]
        ring
      rw [hr]
      have heq : e - 1 + t = d - 1 := by omega
      simpa only [heq] using hb.neg
    · apply Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mpr
      refine ⟨weightedHomogeneousComponent w t q, ?_⟩
      dsimp [r]
      ring

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.ZeroFiber.forward_relation
statement: lemma forward_relation : forward K (relation K) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [forward, relation, squareDifference, map_sub, map_add, map_mul, map_pow,
    map_ofNat, aeval_X, map_one]
  simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.cons_val]
  ring

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.ZeroFiber.forward_vanishes
statement: lemma forward_vanishes : ∀ a ∈ relationIdeal K, forward K a = 0
proof:
:= by
  intro a ha
  have h : relationIdeal K ≤ RingHom.ker (forward K).toRingHom := by
    rw [relationIdeal, Ideal.span_le]
    intro b hb
    rcases Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hb with rfl
    exact forward_relation K
  exact h ha

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.ZeroFiber.toThree_qmk
statement: @[simp] lemma toThree_qmk (a : Four K) : toThree K (qmk K a) = forward K a
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.ZeroFiber.forward_backward
statement: lemma forward_backward : (toThree K).comp (backward K) = AlgHom.id K (Three K)
proof:
:= by
  ext i : 1
  fin_cases i <;> simp [backward, forward, squareDifference, map_ofNat]
  ring

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.ZeroFiber.qmk_relation
statement: lemma qmk_relation : qmk K (relation K) = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr
  exact Ideal.subset_span (Set.mem_singleton _)

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.ZeroFiber.backward_forward
statement: lemma backward_forward : (backward K).comp (toThree K) = AlgHom.id K (Ring K)
proof:
:= by
  apply Ideal.Quotient.algHom_ext
  ext i : 1
  change backward K (toThree K (qmk K (X i))) = qmk K (X i)
  rw [toThree_qmk]
  fin_cases i <;> simp [forward, backward, map_ofNat]
  · have h := qmk_relation K
    simp only [relation, squareDifference, map_sub, map_add, map_mul, map_pow,
      map_ofNat, map_one] at h ⊢
    linear_combination -4 * (qmk K (X 0)) ^ 2 * h
  · have h := qmk_relation K
    simp only [relation, squareDifference, map_sub, map_add, map_mul, map_pow,
      map_ofNat, map_one] at h ⊢
    linear_combination (1 - 2 * qmk K (X 0) * (qmk K (X 0) ^ 2 - qmk K (X 1) ^ 2)) * h

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.zeroFiber_isAffineThreeSpace
statement: theorem zeroFiber_isAffineThreeSpace : IsAffineThreeSpaceFiber 0
proof:
:=
  ⟨zeroFiberEquiv⟩

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.ZeroFiber.sourceMk_parameter
statement: lemma sourceMk_parameter : sourceMk K (X 0) = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr
  exact Ideal.subset_span (Set.mem_singleton _)

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.ZeroFiber.sourceMk_relation
statement: lemma sourceMk_relation : sourceMk K (sourceH K) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h : hypersurfaceMk K (sourceH K) = 0 := by
    apply Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr
    exact Ideal.subset_span (Set.mem_singleton _)
  change Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ K (parameterIdeal K) (hypersurfaceMk K (sourceH K)) = 0
  rw [h, map_zero]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.ZeroFiber.specialize_relation
statement: lemma specialize_relation : specialize K (sourceH K) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := qmk_relation K
  simpa [specialize, sourceH, sourceX, relation, squareDifference, map_ofNat] using h

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.ZeroFiber.specialize_vanishes
statement: lemma specialize_vanishes : ∀ a ∈ sourceIdeal K, specialize K a = 0
proof:
:= by
  intro a ha
  have h : sourceIdeal K ≤ RingHom.ker (specialize K).toRingHom := by
    rw [sourceIdeal, Ideal.span_le]
    intro b hb
    rcases Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hb with rfl
    exact specialize_relation K

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.ZeroFiber.specializeHypersurface_mk
statement:
@[simp] lemma specializeHypersurface_mk (a : Five K) :
    specializeHypersurface K (hypersurfaceMk K a) = specialize K a
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.ZeroFiber.specializeHypersurface_vanishes
statement:
lemma specializeHypersurface_vanishes :
    ∀ a ∈ parameterIdeal K, specializeHypersurface K a = 0
proof:
:= by

  have h : parameterIdeal K ≤ RingHom.ker (specializeHypersurface K).toRingHom := by
    rw [parameterIdeal, Ideal.span_le]
    intro b hb
    rcases Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hb with rfl

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.ZeroFiber.specializeQuotient_mk
statement:
@[simp] lemma specializeQuotient_mk (a : Five K) :
    specializeQuotient K (sourceMk K a) = specialize K a
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.ZeroFiber.includeVariables_relation
statement: lemma includeVariables_relation : includeVariables K (relation K) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := sourceMk_relation K
  simp only [sourceH, sourceX, map_sub, map_add, map_mul, map_pow, map_ofNat,
    map_one] at h
  rw [sourceMk_parameter] at h
  simp only [includeVariables, relation, squareDifference, map_sub, map_add, map_mul,
    map_pow, map_ofNat, map_one, aeval_X, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.cons_val]
  linear_combination h

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.ZeroFiber.includeVariables_vanishes
statement: lemma includeVariables_vanishes : ∀ a ∈ relationIdeal K, includeVariables K a = 0
proof:
:= by
  intro a ha
  have h : relationIdeal K ≤ RingHom.ker (includeVariables K).toRingHom := by
    rw [relationIdeal, Ideal.span_le]
    intro b hb
    rcases Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hb with rfl
    exact includeVariables_relation K
  exact h ha

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.ZeroFiber.includeQuotient_mk
statement:
@[simp] lemma includeQuotient_mk (a : Four K) :
    includeQuotient K (qmk K a) = includeVariables K a
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.ZeroFiber.specialize_include
statement:
lemma specialize_include :
    (specializeQuotient K).comp (includeQuotient K) = AlgHom.id K (Ring K)
proof:
:= by
  apply Ideal.Quotient.algHom_ext
  ext i : 1
  change specializeQuotient K (includeQuotient K (qmk K (X i))) = qmk K (X i)
  rw [includeQuotient_mk]
  fin_cases i <;> simp [includeVariables, specialize]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.ZeroFiber.include_specialize
statement:
lemma include_specialize :
    (includeQuotient K).comp (specializeQuotient K) = AlgHom.id K (SourceRing K)
proof:
:= by
  apply Ideal.Quotient.algHom_ext
  apply Ideal.Quotient.algHom_ext
  ext i : 1
  change includeQuotient K (specializeQuotient K (sourceMk K (X i))) = sourceMk K (X i)
  rw [specializeQuotient_mk]
  fin_cases i <;> simp [specialize, includeVariables, sourceMk_parameter]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.ZeroLocusInterface.aeval_pointMap
statement:
theorem aeval_pointMap (φ : MvPolynomial σ k →ₐ[k] MvPolynomial σ k)
    (x : σ → k) (p : MvPolynomial σ k) :
    aeval (pointMap φ x) p = aeval x (φ p)
proof:
:= by
  have h : aeval (pointMap φ x) = (aeval x).comp φ := by
    ext i
    simp [pointMap]
  exact AlgHom.congr_fun h p

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.ZeroLocusInterface.pointMap_id
statement:
@[simp]
theorem pointMap_id (x : σ → k) :
    pointMap (AlgHom.id k (MvPolynomial σ k)) x = x
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  simp [pointMap]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.ZeroLocusInterface.pointMap_comp
statement:
theorem pointMap_comp (φ ψ : MvPolynomial σ k →ₐ[k] MvPolynomial σ k)
    (x : σ → k) :
    pointMap (φ.comp ψ) x = pointMap ψ (pointMap φ x)
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  simp [pointMap, aeval_pointMap]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.ZeroLocusInterface.pointEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem pointEquiv_apply (e : MvPolynomial σ k ≃ₐ[k] MvPolynomial σ k)
    (x : σ → k) : pointEquiv e x = pointMap e.toAlgHom x
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.ZeroLocusInterface.preimage_zeroLocus
statement:
theorem preimage_zeroLocus (e : MvPolynomial σ k ≃ₐ[k] MvPolynomial σ k)
    (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ k)) :
    (pointEquiv e) ⁻¹' zeroLocus k I = zeroLocus k (I.map e.toRingHom)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx p hp
    obtain ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩ :=
      (Ideal.mem_map_iff_of_surjective e.toRingHom e.surjective).mp hp
    change aeval x (e.toAlgHom q) = 0
    rw [← aeval_pointMap]
    exact hx q hq
  · intro hx p hp
    change aeval (pointMap e.toAlgHom x) p = 0
    rw [aeval_pointMap]
    exact hx (e p) (Ideal.mem_map_of_mem e.toRingHom hp)

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.ZeroLocusInterface.image_zeroLocus
statement:
theorem image_zeroLocus (e : MvPolynomial σ k ≃ₐ[k] MvPolynomial σ k)
    (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ k)) :
    (pointEquiv e).symm '' zeroLocus k I = zeroLocus k (I.map e.toRingHom)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← preimage_zeroLocus]
  exact (pointEquiv e).image_symm_eq_preimage _

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.ZeroLocusInterface.radical_ideal_eq_of_zeroLocus_eq
statement:
theorem radical_ideal_eq_of_zeroLocus_eq
    {I J : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ k)} (hI : I.IsRadical) (hJ : J.IsRadical)
    (h : zeroLocus k I = zeroLocus k J) : I = J
proof:
:= by
  calc
    I = vanishingIdeal k (zeroLocus k I) := by
      rw [vanishingIdeal_zeroLocus_eq_radical, hI.radical]
    _ = vanishingIdeal k (zeroLocus k J) := congrArg (vanishingIdeal k) h
    _ = J := by rw [vanishingIdeal_zeroLocus_eq_radical, hJ.radical]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.ZeroLocusInterface.map_ideal_eq_of_image_zeroLocus_eq
statement:
theorem map_ideal_eq_of_image_zeroLocus_eq
    (e : MvPolynomial σ k ≃ₐ[k] MvPolynomial σ k)
    {I J : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ k)} (hI : I.IsRadical) (hJ : J.IsRadical)
    (h : (pointEquiv e).symm '' zeroLocus k I = zeroLocus k J) :
    I.map e.toRingHom = J
proof:
:= by
  refine radical_ideal_eq_of_zeroLocus_eq ?_ hJ ?_
  · have hm : I.map e.toRingHom = I.comap e.symm.toRingHom := by
      ext p
      rw [Ideal.mem_map_iff_of_surjective e.toRingHom e.surjective]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩
        simpa using hq
      · intro hp
        exact ⟨e.symm p, hp, e.apply_symm_apply p⟩
    rw [hm]
    exact hI.comap _
  · rw [← image_zeroLocus]
    exact h

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.ZeroLocusInterface.image_zeroLocus_eq_iff_map_eq
statement:
theorem image_zeroLocus_eq_iff_map_eq
    (e : MvPolynomial σ k ≃ₐ[k] MvPolynomial σ k)
    (I J : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ k)) [I.IsPrime] [J.IsPrime] :
    (pointEquiv e).symm '' zeroLocus k I = zeroLocus k J ↔
      I.map e.toRingHom = J
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact map_ideal_eq_of_image_zeroLocus_eq e
      (Ideal.IsPrime.isRadical inferInstance) (Ideal.IsPrime.isRadical inferInstance)
  · intro h
    rw [image_zeroLocus, h]

name: OAI.StableCoordinate.ZeroLocusInterface.zeroLocus_fiber_ideal
proof:
:= by
  rw [zeroLocus_span]
  ext x
  simp [sub_eq_zero]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.CastShow.lone
statement:
private lemma lone (s : Scene M) (p : Node) (hv : p.valid) (x u : Grid M) (h : x∈p.block M) :
    ∑ k∈Finset.range (2^p.lev), FinJump ⟨p.lev,k⟩ (finMod s.wage u) x = FinJump p (finMod s.wage u) x
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single p.ix]
  · intro b hb hh
    rw [FinJump, Gi_out _ (show pos x∉ Node.cells ⟨p.lev,b⟩ from by
      intro H
      exact Set.disjoint_left.mp (cells_dis hh) H h),zero_smul]
  intro H; exact (H (Finset.mem_range.mpr hv)).elim

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.CastShow.tail_move
statement:
lemma tail_move {s : Scene M} (x u : Grid M) (hh : s.here.valid)
    (hp : s.here.lev < J) (h : x∈s.here.block M) (b : Bool) :
    tailE s J x u=FinJump s.here (finMod s.wage u) x+tailE (s.smaller b) J x u
proof:
:= by
  unfold tailE
  let f (n) := ∑ k∈Finset.range (2^n),FinJump ⟨n,k⟩ (finMod s.wage u) x
  let n := s.here.lev
  have he : Finset.Ico s.here.lev J=insert n (Finset.Ico (n+1) J) := by
    ext i; simp only [Finset.mem_insert,Finset.mem_Ico,n]; omega
  rw [he,Finset.sum_insert (by simp),lone s s.here hh x u h]
  cases b <;> rfl

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.CastShow.tail_attempt
statement:
lemma tail_attempt {s : Scene M} (v : Update j M s.here) (x u : Grid M) (J : ℕ) :
    tailE s J x u=tailE (s.lose v) J x u + tailE (s.win v) J x u
proof:
:= by
  let f := finMod s.wage u; let g := finMod (s.lose v).wage u
  let w := finMod (s.win v).wage u
  have H : f=g+w := by
    funext i
    unfold f g w lose win finMod; simp only [Pi.add_apply]
    by_cases HH : v.take s.fund.mood i
    all_goals simp [HH]
  have HV (p : Node) :
      FinJump p (finMod s.wage u) x=FinJump p g x+FinJump p w x := by
    unfold FinJump
    have Hx (x : Grid M) : finMod s.wage u x=g x+w x := congrFun H x
    simp_rw [Hx,smul_add,avg_sum,Finset.sum_add_distrib,smul_add]
  unfold tailE; simp_rw [HV,Finset.sum_add_distrib]; rfl

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.CastShow.tail_fail
statement:
lemma tail_fail (s : Scene M) (u x : Grid M) (h : Safe s j J f)
    (hp : finGood (cutoff j) J f x) (hh : x∈s.here.block M)
    (ht : ¬s.openHere j J f) :
    tailE s J x u=0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hb : s.here.lev < J
  · have hx := hp s.here h.within.1 hb hh
    have he : s.mass=0 := le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt (fun hv => ht ⟨hb,hx,hv⟩)) h.mass_lower
    have H (i) (hf : i∈s.here.block M) : s.wage i=0 := by
      have HE := mass_actor (s:=s) h.within h.positive i
      rw [he,zero_mul] at HE
      exact (mul_eq_zero.mp HE.symm).resolve_left ((dice_positive h.within).2 hf).ne'
    unfold tailE; apply Finset.sum_eq_zero; intro n hn
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero; intro k hk
    let p := Node.mk n k
    by_cases hm : x∈p.block M
    · have HI (y : Grid M) (hy : y∈p.block M) : finMod s.wage u y=0 := by
        unfold finMod; rw [H y]; simp
        have hf := coarse_const (Finset.mem_Ico.mp hn).1 (q:=p) (p:=s.here) (x:=pos x) (y:=pos y) hm hy
        exact hf.mp hh
      rw [FinJump,avg_sum]
      rw [Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun i hi => by rw [HI _ ((mem_group _ _).1 hi),smul_zero])]
      simp
    · rw [FinJump, Gi_out p hm,zero_smul]
  · unfold tailE; simp [Finset.Ico_eq_empty hb]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.CastShow.FinJump_align
statement:
lemma FinJump_align (s : Scene M) (hv : s.here.valid) (hm : s.here.lev < M)
    (he : 0 < s.norm) (u x : Grid M) :
    FinJump s.here (finMod s.wage u) x=
      (s.norm:ℂ)*proceeds x u (Thread.Beat.mk s s ((step s).bit x))
proof:
:= by
  let p := s.here; let f := finMod s.wage u
  let g (y : Grid M) := p.Hi (pos y) • f y
  have H (b : Bool) :
      (p.child b).avg g=((curl b:ℝ)*s.norm:ℝ)*scalar (s.smaller b) u := by
    rw [avg_cx (child_ok p hv hm b)]
    unfold Cx scalar; rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
    let q := p.child b
    by_cases hh : i∈q.block M
    · change (q.dice M i:ℂ)*g i=(((curl b*s.norm:ℝ):ℝ):ℂ)*((↑(wt q s.wage s.norm i):ℂ)*_)
      unfold g p wt
      rw [heav_bit _ _ _ hh,Complex.real_smul]
      have HR : (s.norm:ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast he.ne'
      unfold f finMod
      push_cast; field_simp
    have hx : q.dice M i=0 := by rw [dice_apply (child_ok p hv hm b),ite_eq_right hh]
    have hi : wt (s.smaller b).here (s.smaller b).wage (s.smaller b).norm i=0 := by
      unfold wt; rw [show (s.smaller b).here=q from rfl,hx]; simp
    rw [hx,hi]; simp
  rw [FinJump, Complex.real_smul]
  have hi : p.avg g=(s.norm:ℂ)*gain s u := by
    rw [avg_split_complex]
    rw [show p.L=p.child false from rfl,show p.R=p.child true from rfl,H,H]
    unfold gain; simp only [curl,Bool.false_eq_true,↓reduceIte]; push_cast
    ring
  change (p.Gi (pos x):ℂ)*p.avg g=_*((p.Gi (pos x):ℂ)*_)
  rw [hi]; ring

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.CastShow.ordinary_jump
statement:
lemma ordinary_jump (s : Scene M) (l : Play j M (s.smaller false)) (r : Play j M (s.smaller true)) (u x : Grid M) :
    let b
proof:
:= (step s).bit x
    ordinary u x (.jump s l r)=(s.norm:ℂ)*proceeds x u ⟨s,s,b⟩+
      if b=true then ordinary u x r else ordinary u x l := by
  intro b
  unfold ordinary b
  simp only [project,stream,subtotal_cons]
  cases (step s).bit x <;>
    simp only [smaller,Bool.false_eq_true,↓reduceIte,mul_add]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.CastShow.stage_shift
statement:
lemma stage_shift (s : Scene M) (t : Play j M s) (u x : Grid M)
    (h : t.Follows J f) (hp : x∈ s.here.block M)
    (hh : finGood (cutoff j) J f x) : tailE s J x u=ordinary u x t+summons u x t
proof:
:= by
  induction t with
  | rest s =>
    rw [tail_fail s u x h.1 hh hp h.2]
    unfold ordinary; simp [project,stream,subtotal,summons]
  | ticket s t ih =>
    have HH := ih h.2.2.2.2 hp
    change tailE s.reset _ _ _ = _
    rw [HH]
    simp [ordinary,project,stream,subtotal,summons]
  | freeze s t ih =>
    have H := ih h.2.2.2 hp
    change tailE s.out _ _ _ = _
    rw [H]
    simp [ordinary,project,stream,subtotal,summons,out]
  | attempt s v l r il ir =>
    rw [tail_attempt v x u J, il h.2.2.2.2.1 hp, ir h.2.2.2.2.2 hp]
    rw [show ordinary u x (.attempt s v l r) = ordinary u x l by
      unfold ordinary; rw [project]
      cases project l <;> rfl]
    rw [summons]
    rw [show ordinary u x r=0 by unfold ordinary; rw [show (s.win v).norm=0 from rfl]; simp]; ring
  | jump s l r il ir =>
    obtain ⟨ha,hb,hc,hd,he⟩ := h
    let b := (step s).bit x
    have hM : s.here.lev < M := (Play.first hd).within.2
    have hs := share_small hb
    have Hm := FinJump_align s ha.within.1 hM hs.1 u x
    have HE := stream_child (less_self _) hp
    rw [tail_move x u ha.within.1 hb.1.1 hp b,Hm]
    change x ∈ (s.smaller b).here.block M at HE
    unfold b at *
    rcases HA : (step s).bit x
    · rw [ordinary_jump s l r u x, summons,HA,ite_eq_right (by simp)]
      rw [HA] at HE
      rw [il hd HE]; simp only [Bool.false_eq_true,↓reduceIte,add_assoc]
    · rw [ordinary_jump s l r u x, summons,HA,ite_eq_left rfl]
      rw [HA] at HE
      rw [ir he HE]; simp only [↓reduceIte,add_assoc]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.CastShow.drought_pos
statement: lemma drought_pos (m : ℝ) : 0 ≤ drought m
proof: := le_max_right _ _

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.CastShow.charge_pos
statement: lemma charge_pos (j : ℕ) (m : ℝ) : 0 ≤ chargeStatic j m
proof:
:= by
  unfold chargeStatic
  have := H_pos j
  have := d_pos j
  have := drought_pos m
  positivity

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.CastShow.chill_descendants
statement:
lemma chill_descendants :
    ∀ᶠ j : ℕ in atTop, ∀ M J : ℕ, ∀ f : Grid M → ℝ,
    ∀ s : Scene M, ∀ t : Play j M s, Play.Follows J f t →
      s.live=false → s.norm=0 → 0 < s.mass →
        netGross t ≤ chargeStatic j s.mass
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [cutoff_log] with j h M J f s t hF he hx hm
  let x := s.mass
  let A := height j+2+drought x
  let v := Thermal.H j; let U := 20000*v
  have HV : 1 ≤ v := H_ge j
  have hA : 0 ≤ A := by unfold A; have := d_pos j; have := drought_pos x; positivity
  have HE (q : Scene M) (hh : Safe q j J f) (h : 0 < q.mass) :
      log q.mass ≤ U :=
    le_trans (log_le_log h hh.budget) (by assumption)
  let K : ℝ := 10^140*A
  have hK : 0 ≤ K := by unfold K; positivity
  have HT (s : Scene M) (hh : x ≤ s.mass) (ht : s.live=false) :
      gateTax s.reset j ≤ K := by
    unfold gateTax amount; simp only [reset,ht, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte]
    have hi : max (-log s.mass) 0 ≤ drought x := max_le_max_right 0 (neg_le_neg (log_le_log hm hh))
    unfold K A; linarith

  have HI {q : Scene M} (t : Play j M q) (h : Play.Follows J f t) (he : q.live=false)
      (hE : x ≤ q.norm) (hL : log q.norm ≤ U) :
      netGross t ≤ 2*K*(U-log q.norm) := by
    induction t with
    | rest q =>
      rw [netGross,trace,flat_finish]; nlinarith
    | ticket q z ih =>
      obtain ⟨ha,hb,hc,hd,hf⟩ := h
      have he₁ := hb.2.2
      have he₂ : 0 < q.norm := hm.trans_le hE
      have hv : x ≤ q.mass := by unfold enter at hd; linarith
      have HE' := ih hf he hv (HE q ha he₁)
      unfold netGross
      rw [trace,flat_push]
      change gateTax _ j+netGross z ≤ _
      have he₃ : log q.norm+1/2 ≤ log q.mass := by
        have HH := log_le_log (show 0 < 2*q.norm by positivity) (le_of_lt (show 2*q.norm < q.mass from hd))
        rw [log_mul (by norm_num) he₂.ne'] at HH
        linarith [Real.log_two_gt_d9]
      change netGross z ≤ 2*K*(U-log q.mass) at HE'
      linarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left he₃ hK,HT q hv he]
    | jump q l r il ir =>
      have HG := traced _ true h
      rw [netGross,trace,flat_fork _ _ HG]
      obtain ⟨ha,hb,hc,hd,hf⟩ := h
      rw [← Ex_const (Turn.fork (Turn.move (j:=j) (s:=q))).probs (2*K*(U-log q.norm))]
      apply Ex_mono; intro b
      cases b
      · change normStamp q j+netGross l ≤ _
        rw [normStamp,ite_eq_right (by rw [he]; simp),zero_add]
        exact il hd he hE hL
      change normStamp q j+netGross r ≤ _
      rw [normStamp,ite_eq_right (by rw [he]; simp),zero_add]
      exact ir hf he hE hL
    | attempt q u l r =>
      have HH := h.2.2.1
      rw [he] at HH; cases HH
    | freeze q w ih =>
      have HH := h.2.2.1.1
      rw [he] at HH; cases HH
  cases t with
  | rest s =>
    rw [netGross,trace,flat_finish]; exact charge_pos _ _
  | freeze s w =>
    have HH := hF.2.2.1.1
    rw [he] at HH; cases HH
  | attempt s u l r =>
    have HH := hF.2.2.1
    rw [he] at HH; cases HH
  | jump s l r =>
    have HH := share_small hF.2.1
    rw [hx] at HH
    linarith [HH.1]
  | ticket s w =>
    rw [netGross,trace,flat_push]
    have HC := HI w hF.2.2.2.2 he (le_refl _) (HE s hF.1 hm)
    change netGross w ≤ 2*K*(U-log x) at HC
    change gateTax s.reset j+netGross w ≤ 10^150*(v+1+drought x)*A
    have hz := drought_pos x
    have hx' : -log x ≤ drought x := le_max_left _ _
    apply le_trans (add_le_add (HT s le_rfl he) HC)
    unfold K U; nlinarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.CastShow.frostCompare
statement:
lemma frostCompare :
    ∀ᶠ j : ℕ in atTop, ∀ M J : ℕ, ∀ f : Grid M → ℝ, ∀ s : Scene M,
    ∀ t : Play j M s, Play.Follows J f t → s.live=true →

      netGross t ≤ (trace false t).flatFee billOf + coldFee (trace false t)
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [chill_descendants] with j h M J f s t hh he
  induction t with
  | rest s =>
    unfold coldFee netGross; simp only [trace,flat_finish,zero_add]
    simp [expHike,hike,Ex_const,coldLump]
  | freeze s t ih =>
    have HX := hh.2.2.2
    have H := h M J f s.out t HX rfl rfl hh.2.1.2.2
    unfold netGross coldFee
    rw [trace,ite_eq_left rfl, flat_push]
    simp only [trace,Bool.false_eq_true,ite_false,flat_finish,zero_add]
    simp only [expHike,hike,coldLump, ↓reduceIte,Ex_const]
    change 0+netGross t ≤ _
    rw [zero_add]; exact H
  | ticket s t ih =>
    have H := ih hh.2.2.2.2 he
    unfold netGross coldFee
    rw [trace,flat_push]
    simp only [trace,flat_push]
    rw [Ex_hike_push]
    apply le_trans (add_le_add_right H _)
    rw [← add_assoc]; exact le_rfl
  | jump s l r il ir =>
    have HF := traced _ true hh
    have HG := traced _ false hh
    unfold netGross coldFee
    rw [trace,flat_fork _ _ HF]
    simp only [trace,flat_fork _ _ HG]
    rw [Ex_hike_fork HG, ← Ex_add]
    apply Ex_mono; intro b
    cases b
    · apply le_trans (add_le_add_right (il hh.2.2.2.1 he) _)
      rw [←add_assoc]; exact le_rfl
    · apply le_trans (add_le_add_right (ir hh.2.2.2.2 he) _)
      rw [←add_assoc]; exact le_rfl
  | attempt s u l r il ir =>
    have HF := traced _ true hh
    have HG := traced _ false hh
    unfold netGross coldFee; rw [trace,flat_fork _ _ HF]
    simp only [trace,flat_fork _ _ HG]
    rw [Ex_hike_fork HG, ← Ex_add]
    apply Ex_mono; intro b
    cases b
    · apply le_trans (add_le_add_right (il hh.2.2.2.2.1 he) _)
      rw [← add_assoc]; exact le_rfl
    · apply le_trans (add_le_add_right (ir hh.2.2.2.2.2 he) _)
      rw [← add_assoc]; exact le_rfl

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Troupe.rate_easy
statement: lemma rate_easy (i) : 0 < depthRate i ∧ depthRate i ≤ 1 ∧ (depthRate i)^2=side i
proof:
:=
    thick_rate (M:=0) (rose (tagM i) 0)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Troupe.mainRatio_one
statement:
lemma mainRatio_one (i j : ℕ) {L : Path M} {x : Grid M} {s : Scene M}
    (h : Trip x s L) : 1 ≤ mainRatio i j L
proof:
:= by
  let g := tagM i; let p : Streak M := rose g 0
  have hv := trip_K h; have ht := flagged_pos p h
  have hi := (timex_scores g j L).1
  let a := depthRate i; have hx : 0 < a ∧ a ≤ 1 := ⟨(rate_easy _).1,(rate_easy i).2.1⟩
  change 1 ≤ (1+fullKills L+p.flagged L)/a+a*_
  exact le_trans ((one_le_div hx.1).mpr (by linarith))
    (le_add_of_nonneg_right (mul_nonneg hx.1.le hi))

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Troupe.mainSticker_pos
statement:
lemma mainSticker_pos (i j : ℕ) {L : Path M} {x : Grid M} {s : Scene M}
    (h : Trip x s L) : 0 ≤ mainSticker i j L
proof:
:=
    add_nonneg (le_trans (by norm_num) (mainRatio_one i j h)) (by positivity)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Troupe.scalarSticker_pos
statement:
lemma scalarSticker_pos (i j : ℕ) {L : Path M} {x : Grid M} {s : Scene M}
    (h : Trip x s L) : 0 ≤ scalarSticker i j L
proof:
:=
    mul_nonneg (rate_easy i).1.le
      (add_nonneg (add_nonneg (by norm_num) (trip_K h)) (timex_scores (tagL i) j L).1)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Troupe.ride
statement:
lemma ride :
    ∀ᶠ j : ℕ in atTop,
      ∀ M J i : ℕ, ∀ s : Scene M, ∀ f : Grid M → ℝ, ∀ l r m : Path M,
        ∀ (b : Beat M) (x u : Grid M),
          let g
proof:
:= tagM i
          let D := b::r
          let L := l++(D++m)
          let p := heroPlot g L
          Cast j J f s L → Trip x s L → entitled g s j →
            ringing u p j l b →
              (0 < i → stall u (tagM (i-1)) j L (l++D)) →
            ‖subtotal (proceeds x u) D‖ ≤ 10^20*(fullFax D+mainSticker i j L) := by
  filter_upwards [live_rec,channel_inner,near_size] with j h₁ h₂ h₃
    M J i s f l r m b x u g D L p hh he hg hp hf
  let g' := tagM (i-1)
  let n := billWait g' j L
  obtain ⟨z,hz⟩ := bound_stage (u:=u) L hh g'
  obtain ⟨v,hA,l₀,l₁,hL,hT⟩ := h₁ M J s f u g l (r++m) b hh hg hp
  let t := timex g j L
  let S := rose g v
  have HT : 2*log (sumbling S none (l₁++(b::(r++m)))) ≤ t := by
    apply le_trans _ hT
    unfold S g Troupe.rose Troupe.tagM recital
    simp
    exact le_rfl
  have hI : i ≤ mainIx j := (hg rfl).1
  have H : ∃ k, delta (dye b.post) k ≤ sepRad j ∧ rad (u-v-k) ≤ 2*spotLimit b.post j i true := by
    change aligned p b.post j u v at hA
    unfold aligned at hA
    rw [ite_eq_left (show p.main=true from rfl)] at hA; exact hA
  obtain ⟨k,hK,hD⟩ := H
  let a := depthRate i
  obtain ⟨_,q,hq⟩ := trip_cut (show Trip x s (l++(D++m)) from he)
  obtain ⟨hX,_,_⟩ := trip_cut hq
  have hY : b.post.here=q.here := hX.2.1.lower.here.trans (congrArg Scene.here hX.1)
  have hy : dye b.post=dye q := (trip_attend hX b List.mem_cons_self).2.2.2.2
  have HV (c : Beat M) (hc : c∈D) (hA : ¬betweenS z n c) :
      innerV S c.post := by
    have hr := trip_attend hX c hc
    refine h₂ i hI M b.post c.post (by rw [hY]; exact hr.2.2.2.1)
      (hr.2.2.2.2.trans hy.symm) hr.1.climb u v k hK hD ?_
    intro hi hx
    have HX := hf hi
    exact hA (hz (l++D) m (by unfold L; rw [List.append_assoc]) HX c (by simp [hc]) hx)
  let P := proceeds x u
  have HA : 1 ≤ mainRatio i j L := mainRatio_one i j he
  have hc (v' w q' : Path M) (hiD : D=v'++(w++q')) (hiA : ∀ b∈w, ¬betweenS z n b) :
      ‖subtotal P w‖ ≤ 10^16*(fullFax w+mainRatio i j L) := by
    have hp₁ : Trip x q (v'++(w++q')) := hiD ▸ hX
    have hp₂ : L=l₀++(((l₁++v')++(w++(q'++m)))) := by
      unfold L; rw [hL,hiD]; simp only [List.append_assoc]
    have hp₃ : l₁++(b::(r++m))=(l₁++v')++(w++(q'++m)) := by
      change l₁++(D++m)=_
      rw [hiD]; simp only [List.append_assoc]
    let K := (l₁++v')++(w++(q'++m))
    obtain ⟨hU,c₀,hc₀⟩ := trip_cut (show Trip x s (l₀++K) from hp₂ ▸ he)
    have hi₁ := possible S (l₁++v') w (q'++m) hc₀
      (fun b hb => HV b (by rw [hiD]; simp [hb]) (hiA b hb)) t (hp₃ ▸ HT)
    have hi₂ : yieldW (subtotal (duties x v) w) ≤ 10^15*(fullFax w + mainRatio i j L) := by
      apply hi₁.trans; unfold mainRatio
      change 10^15*(fullFax w+(1+fullKills K+flagged S K)/a+a*t) ≤
        10^15*(fullFax w+((1+fullKills L+flagged S L)/a+a*t))
      have ht₁ : fullKills K ≤ fullKills L := by
        rw [hp₂,show fullKills (l₀++K)=fullKills l₀+fullKills K from subtotal_app killed _ _]
        exact le_add_of_nonneg_left (trip_K hU)
      have ht₂ : flagged S K ≤ flagged S L := by
        rw [hp₂,show flagged S (l₀++K)=flagged S l₀+flagged S K from subtotal_app _ _ _]
        exact le_add_of_nonneg_left (flagged_pos S hU)
      have ha : 0 < a := (rate_easy i).1
      have HE : (1+fullKills K+flagged S K)/a ≤ (1+fullKills L+flagged S L)/a :=
        div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) ha.le
      linarith
    have hi₃ := h₃ i hI
    have hga : 64*q.here.len*rad (u-v-k) ≤ 4 := by
      have HE : b.post.here.len*rad (u-v-k) ≤ 2*sig j :=
        halo_limit b.post j i true _ (below_refl _) hD
      rw [←hY]; nlinarith [hi₃.2, side_le i, side_pos i]
    have HB := below_decode u v k x (dye b.post) v' w q' hp₁ hy (hK.trans (hi₃.1.trans (side_le i)))
    apply HB.trans
    obtain ⟨_,C,Hc⟩ := trip_cut hp₁
    linarith [trip_fax (trip_cut Hc).1]
  obtain ⟨w,v,q,hD',hw,hp,hq⟩ := slab_on _ _ (matrix_trip D hX) z n
  let K := mainRatio i j L
  have Heq : mainSticker i j L=K+(n:ℝ) := rfl
  have HW : D=w++(v++q) := by rw [hD',List.append_assoc]
  have HA₁ := hc [] w (v++q) (by simpa using HW) hw
  have HA₂ := hc (w++v) q [] (by simpa using hD') hp
  obtain ⟨hw',q₀,Hh⟩ := trip_cut (show Trip x _ (w++(v++q)) from HW ▸ hX)
  obtain ⟨hv',q₁,hq₁⟩ := trip_cut Hh
  rw [Heq,hD',subtotal_app,subtotal_app]
  change ‖subtotal P w + subtotal P v + subtotal P q‖ ≤ _
  apply (norm_add_le _ _).trans
  have he' : (v.length:ℝ) ≤ n := by exact_mod_cast hq
  have HE := straight_fee u v hv'
  change ‖subtotal P v‖ ≤ _ at HE
  change 1 ≤ K at HA
  change _ ≤ 10^16* (fullFax w+K) at HA₁
  change _ ≤ 10^16*(fullFax q+K) at HA₂
  have HE : fullFax (w++v++q)=fullFax w+fullFax v+fullFax q := by
    rw [fullFax,subtotal_app,subtotal_app]; rfl
  rw [HE]
  linarith [norm_add_le (subtotal P w) (subtotal P v),trip_fax hw',trip_fax hv',trip_fax hq₁]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Troupe.mask_estimate
statement:
lemma mask_estimate :
    ∀ᶠ j : ℕ in atTop, ∀ M J i : ℕ, ∀ s : Scene M, ∀ f : Grid M → ℝ,
      ∀ l r m : Path M, ∀ b : Beat M, ∀ x u : Grid M,
        let g
proof:
:= tagL i
        let D := b::r
        let L := l++(D++m)
        let p := heroPlot g L
        Cast j J f s L → Trip x s L → ringing u p j l b →
          ∃ v : Grid M, let μ := guardedV i v
            ‖subtotal (aired μ x u) D‖ ≤ 20000*scalarSticker i j L ∧
            ∀ z∈D, ¬μ z → 4*side i < ampU z.post u := by
  filter_upwards [live_rec] with j hj M J i s f l r m b x u g D L p h ht hp
  let y := side i
  have Hg : entitled g s j := fun H => False.elim (Bool.noConfusion H)
  obtain ⟨v,hA,l₀,l₁,hL,hT⟩ := hj M J s f u g l (r++m) b h Hg hp
  have HK : rad (u-v) ≤ 2*spotLimit b.post j i false := by
    change aligned p b.post j u v at hA
    unfold aligned at hA; rw [ite_eq_right (show p.main ≠ true from Bool.false_ne_true)] at hA; exact hA
  obtain ⟨_,q,hq⟩ := trip_cut (show Trip x s (l++(D++m)) from ht)
  have HX := (trip_cut hq).1
  have HE : b.post.here=q.here := HX.2.1.lower.here.trans (congrArg Scene.here HX.1)
  have hb : b.post.here.len*rad (u-v) ≤ 2*(y^4/65536) := halo_limit _ j i false _ (below_refl _) HK
  let a := depthRate i
  have ha : 0 < a ∧ a ≤ 1 ∧ a^2=y := rate_easy i
  have hy : 0 < y := side_pos i
  have hf : y^4 ≤ y := by simpa using pow_le_pow_of_le_one hy.le (side_le i) (by omega : 1≤4)
  refine ⟨v,?_⟩
  intro μ
  let t := timex g j L
  have hp₂ : L=l₀++(l₁++(D++m)) := by unfold L; rw [hL,List.append_assoc]
  constructor
  · have ht₀ : 2*log (coldScore v y (l₁++D++m)) ≤ t := by
      apply le_trans _ hT
      simp only [g,tagL,recital,Bool.false_eq_true,↓reduceIte,List.append_assoc]
      exact le_rfl
    obtain ⟨hU,c₀,hc₀⟩ := trip_cut (show Trip x s (l₀++(l₁++(D++m))) from hp₂ ▸ ht)
    have He : Trip x c₀ (l₁++D++m) := by rwa [List.append_assoc]
    have HR : aired μ x v = frosty x v y := by
      funext b; unfold aired frosty prize
      split_ifs with h1 h2 h2
      · rfl
      · exact (h2 h1).elim
      · exact (h1 h2).elim
      simp
    have Hx := rail_fee u v μ [] D [] (s:=q) (by simpa using HX)
    have HV := frosty_portion v hy (side_le i) l₁ D m He t ht₀
    have H := norm_add_le (subtotal (aired μ x u) D-chi (u-v) x*subtotal (aired μ x v) D)
      (chi (u-v) x*subtotal (aired μ x v) D)
    rw [sub_add_cancel,norm_mul,norm_chi,one_mul,HR] at H
    have hE' : fullKills (l₁++D++m) ≤ fullKills L := by
      rw [hp₂,List.append_assoc,show fullKills (l₀++(l₁++(D++m)))=fullKills l₀+fullKills (l₁++(D++m)) from subtotal_app killed _ _]
      exact le_add_of_nonneg_left (trip_K hU)
    have hV : 0 ≤ fullKills L := trip_K ht
    have hY : 0 ≤ t := (timex_scores g j _).1
    apply H.trans
    rw [HR,← HE] at Hx
    change _ ≤ 12000*a*_ at HV
    change _ ≤ 20000*(a*(1+fullKills L+t))
    nlinarith
  · intro z hz hμ
    obtain ⟨hz₁,hz₂,hz₃,hz₄,hz₅⟩ := trip_attend HX z hz
    rw [←HE] at hz₄
    change ¬∀ k, ‖scalar (z.post.smaller k) v‖ ≤ 10*y at hμ
    push Not at hμ
    obtain ⟨c,hc⟩ := hμ
    let d := z.post.smaller c
    have H1 := hz₁.climb.child c
    have H2 := scalar_compare d u v H1.ready H1.pos.le 4 H1.lift
    have H3 : d.here.len ≤ b.post.here.len :=
      node_compress (below_trans (child_below _ _) hz₄)
    have HH' : ‖scalar d u‖ ≤ ampU z.post u := by unfold d ampU; cases c; exact le_max_left _ _; exact le_max_right _ _
    change _ < ‖scalar d v‖ at hc
    change 4*y < _
    nlinarith [(abs_le.mp H2).1,rad_nonneg (u-v)]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.gridProof
statement: theorem gridProof : GridBound
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨10^222,by positivity,?_⟩
  filter_upwards [grossDry,grossOur,plant,annual_valid] with j h1 h2 hp h J
  filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop (J+20)] with M hM f hF hm hG
  let m := expU f
  let b := decide (1/Thermal.H j ≤ m)
  let s := beginPlay f b
  have he : J ≤ M := by omega
  obtain ⟨t,ht⟩ := hp M J he f hF hm hG b
  let W (x : Grid M) := annual x t
  have hX (x : Grid M) : x ∈ s.here.block M := (mem_group _ _).mp
    (by change x∈root.group M; rw [group_top]; simp)
  refine ⟨W,fun x => ?_, ?_,?_⟩
  · exact le_trans (norm_nonneg _) (h M J he s f t ht 0 x (hX x))
  · rw [← top_avg W,avg_ex (root_ok M)]
    change yieldA t ≤ _
    suffices H : ∀ b : Bool, decide (1/Thermal.H j ≤ m)=b → ∀ t : Play j M (beginPlay f b), t.Follows J f → yieldA t ≤ (10:ℝ)^222*height j from H b rfl t ht
    intro b ha t ht
    have hd := d_pos j
    cases b
    · have hh := le_of_not_ge (of_decide_eq_false ha)
      exact le_trans (h1 M J f hG t ht (by rw [show (beginPlay f false).mass=m from top_avg _]; exact hh
       )) (by linarith)
    · have hh := of_decide_eq_true ha
      have HE : 1000*(2:ℝ)^J ≤ 2^M := by
        apply le_trans _ (pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num) hM)
        rw [pow_add]
        nlinarith [show 0 < (2:ℝ)^J by positivity]
      have HX : (beginPlay f true).mass=m := top_avg f
      have HV := h2 M J HE f hG t ht (HX.symm ▸ hh)
      rw [HX] at HV
      have hc : m ≤ 2 := hm
      change _ ≤ (10:ℝ)^222* height j
      nlinarith
  intro x hx u
  have HE := stage_shift s t u x ht (hX x) hx
  have HI : tailE s J x u=FinShift J (finMod f u) x := by
    unfold tailE; rw [show s.here.lev=0 from rfl,Nat.Ico_zero_eq_range]
    rfl
  rw [HI,ordinary,show s.norm=0 from rfl,Complex.ofReal_zero,zero_mul,zero_add] at HE
  rw [HE]; exact h M J he s f t ht u x (hX x)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Troupe.masked_split
statement:
lemma masked_split (m : Beat M → Prop) (x u : Grid M) (l : Path M) :
    subtotal (proceeds x u) l=subtotal (aired m x u) l+subtotal (aired (fun b => ¬m b) x u) l
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp [subtotal]
  | cons b l ih =>
    simp only [subtotal_cons,ih]
    by_cases h : m b <;> unfold aired <;> simp only [h,not_false_eq_true,ite_false,ite_true,zero_add,not_true]
    all_goals abel

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Troupe.subt_le
statement:
lemma subt_le {l : Path M} {f g : Beat M → ℝ} (h : ∀ b∈l, f b ≤ g b) :
    subtotal f l ≤ subtotal g l
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => exact le_rfl
  | cons b l ih =>
    exact add_le_add (h b List.mem_cons_self)
      (ih (fun i hi => h i (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hi)))

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Troupe.start_ico
statement:
lemma start_ico (t n : ℕ) (h : n < t) (f : ℕ → ℝ) :
    ∑ i∈Finset.Ico n t,f i = f n+∑ i∈Finset.Ico (n+1) t,f i
proof:
:= by
  have he : Finset.Ico n t=insert n (Finset.Ico (n+1) t) := by
    ext i; simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_Ico]; omega
  rw [he, Finset.sum_insert (by simp)]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Troupe.scalar_stage
statement:
lemma scalar_stage :
    ∀ᶠ j : ℕ in atTop,
      ∀ (M J : ℕ) (s : Scene M) (c : Bool) (f : Grid M → ℝ) (x u : Grid M),
      let t
proof:
:= lowI j c
      let T := highI j M c
      ∀ (L : Path M) (a : Grade → ℕ), Cast j J f s L → Trip x s L → shades a u L j →
        ∀ (l r : Path M), L=l++r → (c=true→stall u (tagM (mainIx j)) j L l) →
          ‖subtotal (proceeds x u) l‖ ≤
            subtotal (token a L j c) l + crumb t T j L := by
  filter_upwards [mask_estimate] with j hj M J s c f x u t T L a h hh hV
  let P := proceeds x u
  let q := token a L j c
  suffices HE : ∀ k n : ℕ, t ≤ n → n+k=T → ∀ l r : Path M, L=l++r →
      (c=true → stall u (tagM (mainIx j)) j L l) →
      (∀ i∈Finset.Ico t n, stall u (tagL i) j L l) →
      ‖subtotal P l‖ ≤ subtotal q l+crumb n T j L by
    intro l r hx hf
    have hT : t ≤ T := Nat.le_trans (Nat.le_add_right _ _) (Nat.le_add_right _ _)
    exact HE (T-t) t (le_refl _) (by omega) l r hx hf (by simp)
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    intro n hn hE l r hl hf he
    obtain rfl := (show T=n by omega)
    rw [show crumb T T j L=0 by simp [crumb],add_zero]
    apply (subt_norm l P).trans
    exact subt_le (fun b hb => direct_point hh j c a hV T l r b hf he ⟨hn,le_rfl⟩ hl hb (by omega))
  | succ k ih =>
    intro n hn hE l r hl hf he
    have hT : n < T := by omega
    have HV : crumb n T j L = 20000*scalarSticker n j L + crumb (n+1) T j L := by
      rw [crumb, start_ico T n hT,mul_add]; rfl
    rw [HV]
    let g := tagL n
    have HP (p w : Path M) (hL : l=p++w) (hh : stall u g j L p) :
        ‖subtotal P p‖ ≤ subtotal q p + crumb (n+1) T j L := by
      have hx (g) (hh : stall u g j L l) : stall u g j L p := by
        rw [hL] at hh
        exact ((mute_cat _ _ _ _ _ _).1 hh).1
      apply ih (n+1) (hn.trans (Nat.le_add_right n 1)) (by omega) p (w++r) ?_
        (fun H => hx _ (hf H))
      · intro i hi
        obtain ⟨h₁,h₂⟩ := Finset.mem_Ico.mp hi
        by_cases heq : i=n
        · subst heq; exact hh
        · exact hx _ (he _ (Finset.mem_Ico.mpr ⟨h₁,by omega⟩))
      rw [hl,hL,List.append_assoc]
    let p := heroPlot g L
    rcases first_on u p (vacant M) j l with H|⟨d,b,m,H,h₁,h₂⟩
    · have Hx := HP l [] (by simp) H
      have HE := scalarSticker_pos n j hh; linarith
    · let w := b::m
      let L' := d++(w++r)
      have HB : L=L' := by unfold L' w; rw [hl,H,List.append_assoc]
      have HC : ringing u (heroPlot g L') j d b := HB ▸ h₂
      have Hw : l=d++w := H
      obtain ⟨v,hX⟩ := hj M J n s f d m r b x u (show Cast j J f s L' from HB ▸ h) (show Trip x s L' from HB ▸ hh) HC
      let μ := guardedV n v; let Q := aired μ x u; let R := aired (fun z => ¬μ z) x u
      change ‖subtotal Q w‖ ≤ _*scalarSticker n j L' ∧ _ at hX
      have hx₁ : ‖subtotal Q w‖ ≤ 20000* scalarSticker n j L := by rw [HB]; exact hX.1
      have hx₂ : ‖subtotal R w‖ ≤ subtotal q w := by
        apply (subt_norm w R).trans; apply subt_le
        intro z hz
        unfold R aired; split
        · rename_i HH
          apply direct_point hh j c a hV n l r z hf he ⟨hn,hT.le⟩ hl (by rw [Hw]; simp [hz])
          intro _; exact hX.2 z hz HH
        · rw [norm_zero]; exact tokens_nonneg a L z j c
      rw [Hw,subtotal_app,subtotal_app,
        show subtotal P w=subtotal Q w+subtotal R w from masked_split μ x u w]
      apply (norm_add_le _ _).trans
      linarith [HP d w Hw h₁,norm_add_le (subtotal Q w) (subtotal R w)]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Troupe.main_stage
statement:
lemma main_stage :
    ∀ᶠ j : ℕ in atTop, ∀ (M J : ℕ) (s : Scene M) (f : Grid M → ℝ) (x u : Grid M)
      (L : Path M), s.live=true → Cast j J f s L → Trip x s L →
        ∀ (v : ℝ),
          (∀ l r : Path M, L=l++r → (∀ i, i ≤ mainIx j → stall u (tagM i) j L l) →
            ‖subtotal (proceeds x u) l‖ ≤ v) →
          ‖subtotal (proceeds x u) L‖ ≤ v+10^20*fullFax L+
            bigCrumb 0 (mainIx j+1) j L
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [ride] with j hj M J s f x u L hs hc ht v hv
  let P := proceeds x u
  let T := mainIx j+1
  suffices H : ∀ k n : ℕ, n+k=T → ∀ (l r : Path M), L=l++r →
      (∀ i, i < n → stall u (tagM i) j L l) →
        ‖subtotal P l‖ ≤ v+10^20*fullFax l+bigCrumb n T j L from
    H T 0 (by omega) L [] (by simp) (by omega)
  intro k; induction k with
  | zero =>
    intro n hh l r he hf
    have HX : Trip x s (l++r) := he ▸ ht
    have hT : n=T := by omega
    cases hT
    have HH := hv l r he (fun i hi => hf i (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hi))
    have HJ := trip_fax (trip_cut HX).1
    simp only [bigCrumb,Finset.Ico_self,Finset.sum_empty,mul_zero,add_zero]
    unfold P; linarith
  | succ k ih =>
    intro n hn l r hl hf
    let g := tagM n; let p := heroPlot g L
    have hE : n < mainIx j+1 := Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le (by omega : n < T) (le_refl _)
    have hX : Cast j J f s (l++r) := hl ▸ hc
    have hY : Trip x s (l++r) := hl ▸ ht
    have HI (d w : Path M) (hD : l=d++w) (hh : stall u g j L d) :
        ‖subtotal P d‖ ≤ v+10^20*fullFax d+bigCrumb (n+1) T j L := by
      apply ih _ (by omega) d (w++r) ?_
      · intro i hi
        by_cases he : i=n; subst i; exact hh
        have H := hf i (by omega)
        rw [hD] at H
        exact ((mute_cat _ _ _ _ _ _).1 H).1
      rw [hl,hD,List.append_assoc]
    rw [show bigCrumb n T j L=10^20*mainSticker n j L+bigCrumb (n+1) T j L by
      unfold bigCrumb; rw [start_ico _ n hE,mul_add]]
    rcases first_on u p (vacant M) j l with H|⟨d,b,w,hD,hp,ha⟩
    · have HE := HI l [] (by simp) H
      linarith [mainSticker_pos n j ht]
    · let D := b::w; let X := d++(D++r)
      have heq : X = L := by unfold X D; rw [hl,hD,List.append_assoc]
      have H : Cast j J f s X := heq.symm ▸ hc; have HR : Trip x s X := heq.symm ▸ ht
      have HF : ringing u (heroPlot g X) j d b := by rw [heq]; exact ha
      have Ht (hh : 0 < n) : stall u (tagM (n-1)) j X (d++D) := by rw [heq]; exact (hD ▸ hf (n-1) (by omega))
      have HH := hj M J n s f d w r b x u H HR (fun _ => ⟨by change n ≤ mainIx j; omega,hs⟩) HF Ht
      change ‖subtotal P D‖ ≤ _*(fullFax D+mainSticker n j X) at HH
      rw [heq] at HH
      rw [show l=d++D from hD,subtotal_app,show fullFax (d++D)=fullFax d+fullFax D from subtotal_app billFax d D]
      apply (norm_add_le _ _).trans; linarith [HI d D hD hp]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Troupe.gala
statement:
lemma gala :
    ∀ᶠ j : ℕ in atTop, ∀ (M J : ℕ), J ≤ M → ∀ s : Scene M, ∀ f : Grid M → ℝ,
      ∀ x u : Grid M, ∀ L : Path M, Cast j J f s L → Trip x s L →
        ‖subtotal (proceeds x u) L‖ ≤ souvenir s.live j L
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [scalar_stage, main_stage] with j hs hm M J hJ s f x u L h hh
  obtain ⟨a,ha⟩ := sheds h u
  let V (c : Bool) := tokenCost j c L+ crumb (lowI j c) (highI j M c) j L
  have HV (b : Bool) (l r : Path M) (he : L=l++r) (ht : b=true→stall u (tagM (mainIx j)) j L l) :
      ‖subtotal (proceeds x u) l‖ ≤ V b := by
    apply (hs M J s b f x u L a h hh ha l r he ht).trans
    apply add_le_add_left
    have hM : L.length ≤ M := by have HE := trip_depth_limit h; omega
    apply le_trans _ (max_tokens L hh a j b hM)
    obtain ⟨hx,V,hR⟩ := trip_cut (show Trip x s (l++r) from he ▸ hh)
    nth_rw 3 [he]
    exact le_trans (le_add_of_nonneg_right (trip_nonneg hR (f:=token a L j b)
      (fun i _ => tokens_nonneg _ _ _ _ _))) (le_of_eq (subtotal_app _ l r).symm)
  unfold souvenir
  by_cases HB : s.live=true
  · have HH := hm M J s f x u L HB h hh (V true) (fun l r hL he =>
      HV _ _ _ hL (fun _ => he _ (le_refl _)))
    rw [HB,ite_eq_left rfl]
    unfold V at HH; linarith
  rw [show s.live=false from Bool.eq_false_iff.mpr HB,ite_eq_right (by simp),add_zero]
  exact HV false L [] (by simp) fun h => Bool.noConfusion h

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.CastShow.fit_ticket
statement:
lemma fit_ticket {s : Scene M} {t : Play j M s.reset} (h : (Play.ticket s t).Follows J f) :
    Fit s.reset ∧ entry s.reset ∧ (s.live=true → exp (-height j) ≤ s.reset.norm)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ha,hb,hc,hd,he⟩ := h
  have hh := hb.2.2
  refine ⟨⟨⟨ha.within,ha.positive⟩,hh,?_⟩,rfl, fun H => le_of_not_gt (fun h => hc ⟨H,Or.inr h⟩)⟩
  change s.mass/s.mass ≤ 4; rw [div_self hh.ne']; norm_num

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.CastShow.annual_valid
statement:
lemma annual_valid :
    ∀ᶠ j : ℕ in atTop, ∀ M J : ℕ, J ≤ M → ∀ s : Scene M, ∀ f : Grid M → ℝ,
      ∀ t : Play j M s, t.Follows J f → ∀ u x : Grid M, x∈s.here.block M →
        ‖summons u x t‖ ≤ annual x t
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [gala] with j hj M J hh s f t h u x hx
  induction t with
  | rest s => simp [summons,annual]
  | ticket s t ih =>
    rw [summons,annual]
    have HT := fit_ticket h
    obtain ⟨ha,hb,hc,hd,he⟩ := h
    apply le_trans (norm_add_le _ _)
    apply add_le_add _ (ih he hx)
    let q := t
    unfold ordinary jackpot; rw [norm_scaleC,abs_of_nonneg HT.1.pos.le]
    apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ HT.1.pos.le
    have H := Thread.projected _ he
    exact hj _ _ hh _ f _ _ _ (stream_cast _ H x) (trip_stream _ H HT.1 hx)
  | freeze s t ih => exact ih h.2.2.2 hx
  | attempt s v l r il ir =>
    rw [summons,annual]
    exact (norm_add_le _ _).trans (add_le_add (il h.2.2.2.2.1 hx) (ir h.2.2.2.2.2 hx))
  | jump s l r il ir =>
    rw [summons,annual]
    have HE := stream_child (less_self _) hx
    split_ifs with HH
    · exact ir h.2.2.2.2 (HH ▸ HE)
    · rw [show (step s).bit x=false from Bool.eq_false_iff.mpr HH] at HE
      exact il h.2.2.2.1 HE

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.CastShow.dueEmpty
statement: lemma dueEmpty {s : Scene M} {t : Play j M s} (h : project t=blank s) : overdue t=0
proof:
:= by
  unfold overdue; rw [h]
  split; simp only [stats_nil,subtotal_nil,mul_zero]; rfl

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.CastShow.due_restart
statement: lemma due_restart {s : Scene M} {t : Play j M s} (h : s.norm=0) : overdue t=0
proof: := by simp [overdue,h]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.CastShow.cost_jump
statement:
lemma cost_jump (s : Scene M) (l : Play j M (s.smaller false)) (r : Play j M (s.smaller true))
    (h : (Play.jump s l r).Follows J f) :
    let a
proof:
:= s.norm*(if s.live then stamp s j else 0)
    yieldA (Play.jump s l r) + overdue (Play.jump s l r) =
      ((yieldA l+overdue l)+(yieldA r+overdue r))/2+a :=

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.CastShow.cost_attempt
statement:
lemma cost_attempt (s : Scene M) (u : Update j M s.here)
    (l : Play j M (s.lose u)) (r : Play j M (s.win u)) :
    yieldA (Play.attempt s u l r)+overdue (Play.attempt s u l r) =
      yieldA l+overdue l+(yieldA r+overdue r)
proof:
:= by
  rw [due_restart (s:=s.win u) rfl]
  have h₁ : yieldA (Play.attempt s u l r)=yieldA l+yieldA r :=
    Ex_add (s.here.dice M) _ _
  have h₂ : overdue (Play.attempt s u l r)=overdue l := by
    unfold overdue; rw [project]
    cases project l <;> rfl
  rw [h₁,h₂]; ring

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.CastShow.cost_overall
statement:
lemma cost_overall :
    ∀ᶠ j : ℕ in atTop, ∀ M J : ℕ, ∀ f : Grid M → ℝ, ∀ s : Scene M,
      ∀ t : Play j M s, t.Follows J f → (∀ x, f x ≤ exp (height j)) →
        yieldA t+overdue t ≤ s.mass*netGross t
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [receipt_paid] with j hj M J f s t h hf
  induction t with
  | rest s =>
    rw [netGross,trace,flat_finish,dueEmpty rfl]
    simp_rw [yieldA,annual,Ex_const]; simp
  | ticket s t ih =>
    let v := s.reset
    have hs := fit_ticket h
    obtain ⟨ha,hb,hc,hd,he⟩ := h
    have HE := hj M J v (project t) f (projected _ he) hs.1 hs.2.1 hs.2.2 hf
    have HA : yieldA (Play.ticket s t)=
        v.norm*stats (project t) (souvenir v.live j)+yieldA t := by
      unfold yieldA
      simp_rw [annual,jackpot]; rw [Ex_add,Ex_lmul]
      rfl
    rw [HA, netGross, trace, flat_push,dueEmpty rfl,add_zero]
    let x := stats (project t) (souvenir v.live j)
    change v.norm*x+_ ≤ s.mass*(gateTax s.reset j+netGross t)
    let a : ℝ := if v.live then stats (project t) (subtotal (fun b => stamp b.post j)) else 0
    change x ≤ gateTax v j+a at HE
    have Hi := ih he
    rw [show overdue t = s.mass*a by unfold overdue a v; split <;> first|rfl|simp] at Hi
    change yieldA t+s.mass*a ≤ s.mass*_ at Hi
    change s.mass*x+_ ≤ s.mass*(gateTax v j+_)
    nlinarith [hb.2.2]
  | freeze s t ih =>
    rw [dueEmpty rfl,netGross,trace]
    rw [ite_eq_left rfl,flat_push]
    have HH := ih h.2.2.2
    rw [due_restart (s:=s.out) rfl] at HH
    change yieldA t+0 ≤ s.mass*(0+netGross t)
    rw [zero_add]; exact HH
  | jump s l r il ir =>
    let t := Play.jump s l r
    rw [cost_jump _ _ _ h]
    have H₁ := traced t true h
    unfold netGross; rw [trace,flat_fork _ _ H₁]
    obtain ⟨ha,hb,hc,hd,he⟩ := h
    let g (b : Bool) := if b then netGross r else netGross l

    let v : Bool → ℝ := fun b => match b with
      | false => netGross l
      | true => netGross r
    let w : ∀ b, Road j M (s.smaller b) := fun b => match b with
      | false => trace true l
      | true => trace true r
    let P := (step s).probs
    let m := s.mass; let x := s.norm*(if s.live then stamp s j else 0)
    have HV (b : Bool) : (w b).flatFee billOf = v b := by cases b <;> rfl
    have heq : P.Ex (fun b : Bool => normStamp s j+(w b).flatFee billOf) = normStamp s j+P.Ex v := by
      simp_rw [HV,Ex_add _ (f:=fun _ => _),Ex_const]
    change _ + x ≤ s.mass*P.Ex (fun b => normStamp s j+(w b).flatFee billOf)
    rw [heq,mul_add]
    have hM : s.here.lev < M := (Play.first hd).within.2
    have hi := output_split s ha.within.1 hM ha.positive hb.1.2.2 v
    have hm := hb.1.2.2
    rw [show s.mass*normStamp s j=x by unfold x normStamp; split; field_simp; simp]
    change s.mass*P.Ex v=_ at hi
    rw [hi,fair_av]
    have HI : (fun b => (s.smaller b).mass*v b) false = (s.smaller false).mass*netGross l := rfl
    change _/2+x ≤ x+ ((s.smaller false).mass*netGross l+(s.smaller true).mass*netGross r)/2
    linarith [il hd,ir he]
  | attempt s u l r il ir =>
    let t := Play.attempt s u l r
    let v := toss s u; let P := v.probs
    have H := traced t true h
    rw [cost_attempt,netGross,trace,flat_fork _ _ H]
    obtain ⟨ha,hb,hc,hd,he,hx⟩ := h
    let w : ∀ b, Road j M (v.dst b) := fun b => match b with
      | false => trace true l
      | true => trace true r
    change _ ≤ s.mass*P.Ex (fun b => 0+(w b).flatFee billOf)
    simp only [zero_add,Ex,Fintype.sum_bool]
    have Hi := toss_true u ha.within ha.positive hb.1.2.2
    have HH : (s.lose u).mass = P false*s.mass := toss_mass Hi false
    have HJ : (s.win u).mass = P true*s.mass := toss_mass Hi true
    change _ ≤ s.mass*(P true*netGross r+P false*netGross l)
    have Hi₁ := il he; have Hi₂ := ir hx
    rw [HH] at Hi₁; rw [HJ] at Hi₂; linarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Troupe.ray_channel
statement:
private lemma ray_channel (A : Form M) (f : Grid M → ℂ) (x : Grid M) :
    (channel A x).Cx f = (label A).Cx fun z => f (x+z)
proof:
:= by
  apply Complex.ext
  · rw [re_Cx,re_Cx,ch_ex]
  · have H (P : Law (Grid M)) (f) : (P.Cx f).im=P.Ex (fun i => (f i).im) := by
      simp [Cx,Ex,Complex.im_sum]
    rw [H,H,ch_ex]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Troupe.duet_decode
statement:
lemma duet_decode (s : Scene M) (v k : Grid M) :
    ∑ z, chi k z*letter s v z = (cred (dye s) k:ℂ)*scalar s (v+k)
proof:
:= by
  let A := dye s
  let L := channel A
  have HE (x : Grid M) :
      ∑ z, (L x z:ℂ)*chi k z=chi k x*(cred A k:ℂ) := by
    change (channel A x).Cx _=_
    rw [ray_channel,cred_eq]
    simp_rw [chi_add,Cx_lmul]
  unfold letter fz scalar; unfold omegaObs
  simp_rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro i _
  let p : ℂ := ante s i
  calc
    _ = p*chi v i*∑ z,(L i z:ℂ)*chi k z := by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun z _ => by unfold L p A ante; push_cast; ring
    _ = _ := by rw [HE i,chi_add']; unfold p ante A; ring

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Troupe.gain_decode
statement:
lemma gain_decode (s : Scene M) (v k : Grid M) :
    ∑ z, chi k z*factor s v z = (cred (dye s) k:ℂ)*gain s (v+k)
proof:
:= by
  unfold factor
  simp_rw [← mul_div_assoc,mul_sub]; rw [←Finset.sum_div,Finset.sum_sub_distrib,
    duet_decode,duet_decode,gain]
  simp only [dye,smaller]; ring

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Troupe.energy_near_channel
statement:
lemma energy_near_channel (s : Scene M) (h : Fit s) (v k : Grid M) :
    energy s v ≤ 2*energy s (v+k)+2*(share s*delta (dye s) k^2)
proof:
:= by
  let A := dye s; let P := channel A; let f := ante s
  let W (x y : Grid M) := f x * P x y
  let a := letter s v; let b := letter s (v+k)
  let m := matter s
  let T (x y : Grid M) := chi k x-chi k y
  let G (y : Grid M) := ∑ i,W i y* ‖T i y‖^2
  have hw (x y) : 0 ≤ W x y := mul_nonneg (ante_nonneg _ h.ready.2 h.pos.le _) ((P x).nonneg _)
  have H (z : Grid M) :
      b z-chi k z*a z = ∑ x, (W x z:ℂ)*(T x z*chi v x) := by
    unfold a b letter fz; rw [Finset.mul_sum,←Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun x _ => by
      rw [chi_add']
      unfold W T f P A ante omegaObs
      ring
  have HI (y) : ‖b y-chi k y*a y‖^2 / m y ≤ G y := by
    have HH : 0 ≤ m y := matter_nonneg h _
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le HH with HH|HH
    · rw [←HH,div_zero]; exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ => mul_nonneg (hw _ _) (sq_nonneg _)
    apply (div_le_iff₀ HH).mpr
    rw [H y]
    have hi (x : Grid M) :
        ‖(W x y:ℂ)*(T x y*chi v x)‖= W x y* ‖T x y‖ := by
      rw [norm_scaleC,norm_mul,abs_of_nonneg (hw _ _),norm_chi,mul_one]
    apply le_trans (pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) (norm_sum_le _ _) _)
    simp_rw [hi]
    have HX : m y=∑ x,W x y := rfl
    rw [HX]; unfold G
    apply Finset.sum_sq_le_sum_mul_sum_of_sq_le_mul _
      (fun i _ => mul_nonneg (hw _ _) (sq_nonneg _)) (fun i _ => hw _ _) (fun i _ => ?_)
    exact le_of_eq (by ring)
  have HB (x : Grid M) : ∑ y,P x y* ‖T x y‖^2=delta A k ^ 2 := by
    change (channel A x).Ex _=_
    rw [ch_ex]
    have he (z) : T x (x+z)=chi k x *(1-chi k z) := by unfold T; rw [chi_add]; ring
    simp_rw [he,norm_mul,norm_chi,one_mul]
    exact (sq_sqrt ((label A).Ex_nonneg fun i => sq_nonneg _)).symm
  have HL : ∑ z,G z=share s*delta A k ^ 2 := by
    unfold G; rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    simp_rw [W,mul_assoc,← Finset.mul_sum,HB]
    rw [← Finset.sum_mul,ante_total _ h.ready.1]
  unfold energy energyZ
  change ∑ z, ‖a z‖^2/m z ≤ 2*(∑ z, ‖b z‖^2/m z)+2*(share s*_)
  rw [show dye s=A from rfl,←HL, Finset.mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum,← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum; intro z _
  have he : ‖a z‖ ≤ ‖b z‖+‖b z-chi k z*a z‖ := by
    have H := norm_sub_le (b z) (b z-chi k z*a z)
    rw [sub_sub_cancel,norm_mul,norm_chi,one_mul] at H; exact H
  have hev : ‖a z‖^2 ≤ 2*‖b z‖^2+2*‖b z-chi k z*a z‖^2 := by
    have H := pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) he 2
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (‖b z‖-‖b z-chi k z*a z‖)]
  apply le_trans (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hev (matter_nonneg h _))
  rw [add_div,mul_div_assoc,mul_div_assoc]; linarith [HI z]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Troupe.near_size
statement:
lemma near_size :
    ∀ᶠ j : ℕ in atTop,
      ∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ mainIx j → sepRad j ≤ side i ∧ 256*sig j ≤ side i^2
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [h_large 1000] with j h i hi
  let a := Thermal.H j
  have H : 1/a^16 ≤ side i :=
    le_trans (bottom_level j).ge (pow_le_pow_of_le_one (by norm_num) (by norm_num) hi)
  have hx : 1000 ≤ a := h
  have hH : 1 ≤ a := by linarith
  change 1/a^30 ≤ _ ∧ 256*(1/a^40) ≤ _
  constructor
  · apply le_trans _ H; gcongr; omega
  · apply le_trans (b:=(1/a^16)^2) _ (pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) H 2)
    have hv : a ≤ a^8 := by simpa using pow_le_pow_right₀ hH (by omega : 1≤8)
    field_simp; nlinarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Troupe.node_compress
statement:
lemma node_compress {p q : Node} (h : p.below q) :
    p.len ≤ q.len
proof: := pow_le_pow_of_le_one (by norm_num) (by norm_num) h.1

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Troupe.halo_limit
statement:
lemma halo_limit {p : Scene M} (s : Scene M) (j i : ℕ) (main : Bool) (d : Grid M)
    (hh : s.here.below p.here) (h : rad d ≤ 2*spotLimit p j i main) :
    s.here.len*rad d ≤ 2*tolerance j i main
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ ≤ p.here.len*(2*spotLimit p j i main) :=
