      mul_le_mul (node_compress hh) h (rad_nonneg _) p.here.len_pos.le
    _ = _ := by rw [spotLimit,rinv]; field_simp [p.here.len_pos.ne']

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Troupe.channel_inner
statement:
lemma channel_inner :
    ∀ᶠ j : ℕ in atTop, ∀ (i : ℕ), i ≤ mainIx j → ∀ (M : ℕ)
    (p q : Scene M), q.here.below p.here → dye q=dye p → Climb q →
    ∀ u v k : Grid M, delta (dye p) k ≤ sepRad j →
      rad (u-v-k) ≤ 2*spotLimit p j i true →
        (0 < i → ¬ snag ⟨true,i-1⟩ u (⟨q,q,false⟩:Beat M)) →
        Run.Streak.innerV (rose ⟨true,i⟩ v) q
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [near_size] with j hj i hI M p q h1 h2 h u v k hx hk hp

  by_cases hi : i=0
  · subst i
    apply Or.inr; intro b
    let s := q.smaller b
    apply ((energy_small (h.child b) v).2.trans (h.child b).lift).trans
    change (4:ℝ) ≤ 64*side 0^2; norm_num [side]
  let A := rose ⟨true,i⟩ v
  apply or_iff_not_imp_left.mpr
  intro HH
  have hf := hp (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hi)
  have HV (b : Bool) : energy (q.smaller b) u ≤ (2*side i)^2 := by
    have HH' : ¬ hazard q true (i-1) := fun hh => HH ⟨Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hi, hh⟩
    have Ht : energy (q.smaller b) u < side (i-1)^2 :=
      lt_of_not_ge fun hz => hf ⟨⟨b,hz⟩,HH'⟩
    have hc := side_succ (i-1)
    rw [Nat.sub_add_cancel (by omega : 1 ≤ i)] at hc
    rw [hc]; nlinarith
  intro b
  let s := q.smaller b
  have hS : below s.here p.here := below_trans (child_below _ _) h1
  let x := side i
  have HP := h.child b
  have H : energy s (v+k) ≤ energy s u+4*(16*s.here.len*rad (v+k-u)) :=
    magnitude_near true s (v+k) u HP.ready HP.pos.le 4 HP.lift
  rw [show v+k-u= -(u-v-k) by ring,rad_even] at H
  have he₁ : s.here.len*rad (u-v-k) ≤ 2*sig j :=
    halo_limit s j i true _ hS hk
  have hd := hj i hI
  have he₂ : delta (dye s) k^2 ≤ side i^2 := by
    change delta (dye q) k^2 ≤ _
    rw [h2]; exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (sqrt_nonneg _) (hx.trans hd.1) _
  change energy s v ≤ 64*side i^2
  have ht₁ : share s*delta (dye s) k^2 ≤ 4*(side i)^2 := by
    apply le_trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right HP.lift (sq_nonneg _)); nlinarith
  have hT : energy s u ≤ (2*side i)^2 := HV b
  nlinarith [energy_near_channel s HP v k, hd.2]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Troupe.gain_point
statement:
lemma gain_point {s : Scene M} (hp : Climb s)
    (u v x : Grid M) (hh : x∈s.here.block M) :
    ‖gain s u-chi (u-v) x*gain s v‖ ≤ 32*(s.here.len*rad (u-v))
proof:
:= by
  let a B := scalar (s.smaller B) u- chi (u-v) x * scalar (s.smaller B) v
  let k := s.here.len*rad (u-v)
  have H (b : Bool) : ‖a b‖ ≤ 32*k := by
    have he := hp.child b
    apply (scalar_point _ u he.ready he.pos.le (child_below s.here b) x hh v).trans
    rw [mul_assoc 8]
    nlinarith [show 0 ≤ k from mul_nonneg s.here.len_pos.le (rad_nonneg _),he.lift]
  rw [show gain s u-chi (u-v) x*gain s v=(a false-a true)/2 by unfold gain a; ring]
  apply (norm_halfcomplex _ _).trans; linarith [H false,H true]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Troupe.scalar_energy
statement:
lemma scalar_energy (s : Scene M) (h : Fit s) (u) :
    ‖scalar s u‖^2 ≤ 4*energy s u
proof:
:= by
  rw [scalar_label]
  apply le_trans (pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) (norm_sum_le _ _) _)
  apply le_trans (b:=share s*energy s u)
  · rw [←matter_sum h,sun_energy h]
    apply Finset.sum_sq_le_sum_mul_sum_of_sq_le_mul _ (fun i _ => matter_nonneg h _)
      (fun i _ => (sun_rays h _ _).1) (fun i _ => ?_)
    rw [← (mean_hold _ h _ _).1,norm_scaleC,abs_of_nonneg (matter_nonneg h _)]
    unfold sun; exact le_of_eq (by ring)
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h.lift (energy_small h u).1

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Troupe.blend
statement:
lemma blend (l : Path M) {E : Type*} [AddCommMonoid E] (f g : Beat M → E) :
    subtotal (fun b => f b+g b) l = subtotal f l + subtotal g l
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => change 0=0+(0:E); simp
  | cons b l ih => simp only [subtotal_cons,ih]; ac_rfl

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Troupe.subtC
statement:
lemma subtC (l : Path M) (f : Beat M → ℂ) (c : ℂ) :
    subtotal (fun b => c*f b) l=c*subtotal f l
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => change 0=c*0; simp
  | cons b l ih => rw [subtotal_cons,subtotal_cons,ih,mul_add]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Troupe.subtR
statement:
lemma subtR (l : Path M) (f : Beat M → ℝ) (c : ℝ) :
    subtotal (fun b => c*f b) l=c*subtotal f l
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => change 0=c*0; simp
  | cons b l ih => rw [subtotal_cons,subtotal_cons,ih,mul_add]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Troupe.subt_constant
statement:
lemma subt_constant (l : Path M) (c : ℝ) :
    subtotal (fun _ => c) l = c*l.length
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp [subtotal]
  | cons b l ih => rw [subtotal_cons,List.length_cons,ih]; push_cast; ring

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Troupe.subt_neg
statement:
lemma subt_neg (l : Path M) (f g : Beat M → ℂ) :
    subtotal f l-subtotal g l=subtotal (fun b => f b-g b) l
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp [subtotal]
  | cons b l ih => rw [subtotal_cons,subtotal_cons,subtotal_cons,← ih]; abel

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Troupe.subt_norm
statement:
lemma subt_norm (l : Path M) (f : Beat M → ℂ) :
    ‖subtotal f l‖ ≤ subtotal (fun b => ‖f b‖) l
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => change ‖(0:ℂ)‖ ≤ 0; simp
  | cons b l ih => exact (norm_add_le (f b) _).trans (add_le_add_right ih _)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Troupe.trip_attend
statement:
lemma trip_attend {x : Grid M} {l : Path M} (h : Trip x s l) :
    ∀ b∈l, Ideal b.pre b.post ∧ x∈b.post.here.block M ∧ |blow x b|=1 ∧
      b.post.here.below s.here ∧ dye b.post=dye s
proof:
:= by
  induction l generalizing s with
  | nil => simp
  | cons b l ih =>
    intro z hz
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp hz with rfl|hz
    · refine ⟨h.2.1,?_,trip_final h,?_,?_⟩
      · exact block_of_below (child_below _ _) _ (trip_head h.2.2).2
      · rw [h.2.1.lower.here,h.1]; exact below_refl _
      rw [dye,h.2.1.lower.fund,h.1]; rfl
    obtain ⟨hp,hj,hi,h₁,h₂⟩ := ih h.2.2 z hz
    refine ⟨hp,hj,hi,?_,?_⟩
    · rw [← h.1,← h.2.1.lower.here]; exact below_trans h₁ (child_below _ _)
    change dye z.post=dye b.post at h₂; rw [h₂,dye,h.2.1.lower.fund,h.1]; rfl

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Troupe.length_fee
statement:
lemma length_fee {x : Grid M} {l : Path M} (h : Trip x s l) :
    subtotal spaceRent l ≤ 2*s.here.len
proof:
:= by
  induction l generalizing s with
  | nil => change 0 ≤ 2*_; exact mul_nonneg (by norm_num) s.here.len_pos.le
  | cons b l ih =>
    have H := ih h.2.2
    rw [show (winds b).here.len=b.post.here.len/2 from child_len _ b.bit] at H
    rw [←h.1,←h.2.1.lower.here]
    change b.post.here.len+subtotal spaceRent l ≤ _
    linarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Troupe.rail_fee
statement:
lemma rail_fee {x : Grid M} (u v : Grid M) (μ : Beat M → Prop) (p l r : Path M)
    (h : Trip x s (p++(l++r))) :
    ‖subtotal (aired μ x u) l-chi (u-v) x*subtotal (aired μ x v) l‖ ≤
      64*s.here.len*rad (u-v)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← subtC,subt_neg]
  let F (b : Beat M) := aired μ x u b-chi (u-v) x * aired μ x v b
  apply (subt_norm l F).trans
  have ht := trip_cut h
  obtain ⟨hs,w,hk⟩ := ht
  obtain ⟨hL,t,hT⟩ := trip_cut hk
  have HH : subtotal (fun b => ‖F b‖) l ≤ subtotal (fun b => 32*rad (u-v)*spaceRent b) l := by
    suffices HX : ∀ l s, Trip x s l → subtotal (fun b => ‖F b‖) l ≤
        subtotal (fun b => 32*rad (u-v)*spaceRent b) l from HX _ w hL
    intro l; induction l with
    | nil => intro s h; exact le_rfl
    | cons b l ih =>
      intro s H
      rw [subtotal_cons,subtotal_cons]
      apply add_le_add _ (ih (winds b) H.2.2)
      unfold F aired; split_ifs
      · rw [proceeds,proceeds,mul_left_comm,← mul_sub,norm_scaleC,trip_final H,one_mul]
        have HC := (trip_attend H b List.mem_cons_self)
        exact (gain_point H.2.1.climb u v x HC.2.1).trans (le_of_eq (by unfold spaceRent; ring))
      · simp; exact mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (rad_nonneg _)) b.post.here.len_pos.le
  apply HH.trans
  rw [subtR]
  have hp' : subtotal spaceRent l ≤ 2*s.here.len := by
    have HH := length_fee h
    simp_rw [subtotal_app] at HH
    linarith [trip_nonneg hs (f:=spaceRent) (fun b _ => b.post.here.len_pos.le),
      trip_nonneg hT (f:=spaceRent) (fun b _ => b.post.here.len_pos.le)]
  nlinarith [rad_nonneg (u-v)]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Troupe.straight_fee
statement:
lemma straight_fee {x : Grid M} (u : Grid M) (l : Path M)
    (h : Trip x s l) :
    ‖subtotal (proceeds x u) l‖ ≤ 4*l.length
proof:
:= by
  induction l generalizing s with
  | nil => change ‖(0:ℂ)‖ ≤ 4*(↑([]:Path M).length:ℝ); simp
  | cons b l ih =>
    rw [subtotal_cons,List.length_cons]; push_cast
    apply (norm_add_le _ _).trans
    have he := h.2.1.climb
    rw [proceeds,norm_scaleC,trip_final h,one_mul]
    linarith [(gain_norm he u).trans he.fit.lift,ih h.2.2]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Troupe.decode_track
proof:
:= subtotal (duties x v) l
    ∑ z,chi k z*w z=(cred (dye s) k:ℂ)*subtotal (proceeds x (v+k)) l := by
  induction l generalizing s with
  | nil => simp [subtotal]
  | cons b l ih =>
    have H := gain_decode b.post v k
    let C : ℂ := cred (dye b.post) k
    have HH := ih h.2.2
    intro w
    have hr : dye b.post=dye s := (trip_attend h b List.mem_cons_self).2.2.2.2
    rw [←hr]
    let t := duties x v b; let u := subtotal (duties x v) l
    have hw (z) : w z=t z+u z := rfl
    simp_rw [hw,mul_add,Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    rw [subtotal_cons,mul_add]
    congr 1
    · unfold t duties; simp_rw [mul_left_comm (chi k _),←Finset.mul_sum]
      rw [H]; unfold proceeds; ring

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Troupe.below_decode
statement:
lemma below_decode (u v k x : Grid M) (A : Form M) (p l r : Path M)
    (h : Trip x s (p++(l++r))) (hx : A=dye s)
    (hh : delta A k ≤ 1) :
    ‖subtotal (proceeds x u) l‖ ≤
      2*Beam.yieldW (subtotal (duties x v) l)+64*s.here.len*rad (u-v-k)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨_,q,h₁⟩ := trip_cut h
  obtain ⟨hp,d,h₂⟩ := trip_cut h₁
  let a := v+k
  let f := subtotal (proceeds x a) l; let W := subtotal (duties x v) l
  have HI : ‖f‖ ≤ 2*Beam.yieldW W := by
    by_cases ht : l=[]
    · unfold f W; rw [ht,subtotal_nil,subtotal_nil,norm_zero,Beam.yield_zero]; norm_num
    have hz := decode_track l x v k hp
    have HV : dye q=A := by
      obtain ⟨b,hb⟩ := List.exists_mem_of_ne_nil _ ht
      have hT : b∈p++(l++r) := by simp [hb]
      rw [← (trip_attend hp b hb).2.2.2.2, (trip_attend h b hT).2.2.2.2,hx]
    change ∑ z,chi k z*W z=(cred (dye q) k:ℂ)*f at hz
    rw [HV] at hz
    have hC : 1/2 ≤ cred A k := by
      nlinarith [delta_sq A k,show 0 ≤ delta A k from sqrt_nonneg _]
    have H : ‖(↑(cred A k):ℂ)*f‖ ≤ Beam.yieldW W := by
      rw [← hz]
      exact (norm_sum_le _ _).trans (by simp only [norm_mul,norm_chi,one_mul]; exact le_rfl)
    rw [norm_scaleC,abs_of_nonneg (by linarith)] at H
    nlinarith [norm_nonneg f]
  have he := rail_fee u a (fun _ => True) p l r h
  have hA (v) : aired (fun _ => True) x v=proceeds x v := by funext b; simp [aired]
  rw [hA,hA] at he
  let f' := subtotal (proceeds x u) l
  have HH : ‖f'‖ ≤ ‖f'-chi (u-a) x*f‖ + ‖f‖ := by
    have H := norm_add_le (f'-chi (u-a) x*f) (chi (u-a) x*f)
    rwa [sub_add_cancel,norm_mul,norm_chi,one_mul] at H
  rw [show u-v-k=u-a by unfold a; ring]
  change ‖f'-chi (u-a) x*f‖ ≤ _ at he
  change ‖f'‖ ≤ 2*Beam.yieldW W+_
  linarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Troupe.stamp_nonneg
statement: lemma stamp_nonneg {s : Scene M} (h : Climb s) (j : ℕ) : 0 ≤ stamp s j
proof:
:= by
  unfold stamp stampAux
  have H := surcharge_nonneg s false (priciest s j true)
  have HH (i : ℕ) : 0 ≤ parody s i := flag_nonneg _ _
  have HP : 0 ≤ ∑ i∈Finset.Ico 0 (mainIx j+1), parody s i / depthRate i :=
    Finset.sum_nonneg (fun _ _ => div_nonneg (HH _) (rate_easy _).1.le)
  unfold mutedR
  linarith [(fax_floor h).1,HH (mainIx j+1)]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Troupe.chamber_fee
statement:
private lemma chamber_fee (c j) (L : Path M) :
    tokenCost j c L + crumb (lowI j c) (highI j M c) j L =
      rooms c j L+512*subtotal (fun b => mutedR b.post j c) L+
        (if c then 4*(subtotal (special j) L+(billWait (tagM (mainIx j)) j L:ℝ)) else 0)
proof:
:= by
  unfold tokenCost crumb rooms miniStage playsL
  rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib,← Finset.mul_sum]
  ring

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Troupe.receipt_main
statement:
lemma receipt_main (j : ℕ) (L : Path M) :
    souvenir true j L=rooms true j L+palaces j L + subtotal (fun b => stamp b.post j) L
proof:
:= by
  simp only [souvenir,chamber_fee]
  simp only [↓reduceIte]
  unfold palaces stamp stampAux bigCrumb
  simp_rw [blend _ (f:=fun _ => _) (g:=fun _ => _),subtR]
  let m := Finset.Ico 0 (mainIx j+1)
  let F (b : Beat M) (i : ℕ) := parody b.post i / depthRate i
  have H (i : ℕ) : mainSticker i j L = nakedStage i j L + subtotal (fun b => F b i) L := by
    unfold F mainSticker nakedStage mainRatio parody flagged
    simp_rw [div_eq_mul_inv,mul_comm _ (depthRate i)⁻¹,subtR]
    ring
  simp_rw [H,Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  have HH := cross_subtotal L m F
  unfold F m at HH
  rw [blend L (fun b => fax b.post),HH]; unfold F
  rw [show subtotal (fun b => fax b.post) L=fullFax L from rfl]

  have HV : special j = fun b : Beat M => parody b.post (mainIx j+1) := rfl
  rw [HV]

  linarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Troupe.receipt_static
statement:
lemma receipt_static (j : ℕ) (L : Path M) :
    souvenir false j L=rooms false j L+512*subtotal (fun b => mutedR b.post j false) L
proof:
:= by
  simp only [souvenir,chamber_fee]; simp

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Troupe.tax_pos
statement: lemma tax_pos (s : Scene M) (j : ℕ) : 0 ≤ gateTax s j
proof:
:= by
  have := d_pos j; have := H_pos j; have HA := (amount_limits s j).1
  unfold gateTax; split <;> positivity

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Troupe.receipt_paid
statement:
lemma receipt_paid :
    ∀ᶠ j : ℕ in atTop, ∀ M J : ℕ, ∀ s : Scene M, ∀ t : Thread M s, ∀ f : Grid M → ℝ,
      t.Following j J f → Fit s → entry s →
      (s.live=true → exp (-height j) ≤ s.norm) →
      (∀ x, f x ≤ exp (height j)) →
      stats t (souvenir s.live j) ≤ gateTax s j +
        (if s.live then stats t (subtotal (fun b => stamp b.post j)) else 0)
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [rooms_fee,palaces_fee,segment_cost,hpoly 1 1] with j hr hp hv hT
    M J s t f h hh hx he hf
  let d := height j
  let k := amount s j; let v := Thermal.H j
  have hV : 1 ≤ v := H_ge _
  have hk : 1 ≤ k := (amount_limits _ _).1
  have hd : 1 ≤ d := one_le_pow₀ (by norm_num)
  have HG := stats_plus t
  have HS := hr M J s f t h hh hx hf
  unfold gateTax
  split
  · rename_i hE
    have Ht := HS true
    have HH := hp M J s f t h hh hx hE (he hE) hf
    have hK : k ≤ 4*d := by
      have H := log_le_log (exp_pos _) (he hE)
      rw [log_exp] at H
      change d+max _ 0+2 ≤ _
      have he' : max (-log s.norm) 0 ≤ d := max_le (by unfold d; linarith) (by linarith)
      linarith
    rw [hE]
    rw [show souvenir (M:=M) true j=
      fun L => rooms true j L+palaces j L+subtotal (fun b => stamp b.post j) L from funext (receipt_main _)]
    rw [HG (f:=fun L => _),HG (f:=fun L => _)]
    have heq : lowI j true=mainIx j := rfl
    rw [heq,depth_at_main] at Ht
    have hi : 0 < v := H_pos j
    have HE : 1/v^8 ≤ 1/v := one_div_le_one_div_of_le hi
      (by simpa using pow_le_pow_right₀ hV (by omega : 1 ≤ 8))
    have HT : 1+10^30*(1/v^8)*k ≤ 10^31*(d/v) := by
      have hΦ : 1 ≤ d/v := (one_le_div hi).mpr (by simpa using hT)
      have hh := mul_le_mul HE hK (by positivity) (by positivity)
      rw [show 1/v*(4*d)=4*(d/v) by ring] at hh; nlinarith
    change stats t _ ≤ 1+10^30*(1/v^8)*k at Ht
    unfold v d at *
    nlinarith [show 0 ≤ height j/Thermal.H j by have := H_pos j; have := d_pos j; positivity,
      show 10^140*height j/Thermal.H j=10^140*(height j/Thermal.H j) by ring,
      show 10^120*height j/Thermal.H j=10^120*(height j/Thermal.H j) by ring]
  · rename_i hE
    have Ht := HS false
    rw [show lowI j false=0 from rfl,show depthRate 0=1 by simp [depthRate,side]] at Ht
    have HM := hv M J s f t h hf (show 0 < s.mass from hx ▸ hh.pos) hh.pos (fun q => priciest q j false) false
    rw [show s.mass/s.norm=1 from entry_share hh hx, one_mul] at HM
    rw [show s.live=false from Bool.eq_false_iff.mpr hE]
    simp only [add_zero]
    rw [show souvenir (M:=M) false j =
      fun L => rooms false j L+512* subtotal (fun b => mutedR b.post j false) L from funext (receipt_static _)]
    change stats t _ ≤ _*k
    rw [HG]
    have HE : stats t (fun L => 512*subtotal (fun b => mutedR b.post j false) L) =
        512* t.fee (fun b => mutedR b.post j false) :=
      Ex_lmul (s.here.dice M) _ 512
    rw [HE]
    change _≤ 1+_*_*k at Ht
    have hp : height j ≤ k := (amount_limits _ _).2
    have hh0 : -log s.mass ≤ k := by unfold entry at hx; rw [← hx]; unfold k amount; linarith [le_max_left (-log s.norm) 0,d_pos j]
    unfold mutedR; linarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Troupe.parody_fee
statement:
lemma parody_fee (s : Scene M) (j : ℕ) (i : ℕ) (h : i ≤ mainIx j+1) :
    parody s i ≤ 10^6*Thermal.H j^32*surcharge s true (i-1)
proof:
:= by
  have hE : 0 < Thermal.H j := H_pos _
  by_cases he : (rose (tagM i) (0:Grid M)).rogue s
  · have hx := he.1
    have hp : 0 < i := hx
    have HH := he.2
    have HC := (bottom_level j)
    have HT : side (mainIx j) ≤ side (i-1) :=
      side_ant _ _ (by omega)
    rw [HC] at HT
    change hazard s true (i-1) at HH
    rw [show parody s i=1 from ite_eq_left he,surcharge,ite_eq_left HH]
    change side (i-1)^2/128 ≤ _ at HH
    let v := Thermal.H j
    have Hb : 1/v^32/128 ≤ edgeW s (i-1) := by
      have Hi : 0 ≤ 1/(Thermal.H j)^16 := by positivity
      apply le_trans _ HH
      have HT := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (pow_le_pow_left₀ Hi HT 2) (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)≤128)
      rw [show (1/Thermal.H j^16)^2=1/v^32 by unfold v; ring] at HT; exact HT
    have hx' : 0 < v^32 := pow_pos hE _
    change 1 ≤ 10^6*v^32*_
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left Hb hx'.le,
      show v^32*(1/v^32/128)=1/128 by have Hx : 0 < v := hE; field_simp]
  · rw [show parody s i=0 from ite_eq_right he]
    exact mul_nonneg (by positivity) (surcharge_nonneg _ _ _)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Troupe.depth_rate_fee
statement:
lemma depth_rate_fee (i j : ℕ) (h : i ≤ mainIx j) :
    1/depthRate i ≤ Thermal.H j^8
proof:
:= by
  have H : depthRate (mainIx j) ≤ depthRate i := sqrt_le_sqrt (side_ant i _ h)
  rw [depth_at_main] at H
  apply (div_le_iff₀ (rate_easy _).1).mpr
  have HE := (div_le_iff₀ (show 0 < Thermal.H j^8 by have := H_pos j; positivity)).mp H
  linarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Troupe.decayed
statement: lemma decayed (n : ℕ) : depthRate (n+1) ≤ 3/4*depthRate n
proof:
:= by
  let x := depthRate (n+1); let y := depthRate n
  have h := rate_easy (n+1); have hv := rate_easy n
  obtain ⟨ha,hb,hc⟩ := h
  rw [side_succ] at hc
  nlinarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Troupe.weight_decay
statement:
lemma weight_decay (x : ℝ) (hx : 0 ≤ x) (n m : ℕ) (h : n ≤ m) :
    ∑ i∈Finset.Ico n m, depthRate i*(x+1+i) ≤ 10*depthRate n*(x+10+n)
proof:
:= by
  suffices hh : ∀ k n : ℕ, n+k=m →
      ∑ i∈Finset.Ico n m, depthRate i*(x+1+i) ≤ 10*depthRate n*(x+10+n) from hh (m-n) n (by omega)
  intro k; induction k with
  | zero =>
    intro n he; simp only [Nat.add_zero] at he
    rw [he]; simp only [Finset.Ico_self,Finset.sum_empty]
    have := (rate_easy m).1; positivity
  | succ k ih =>
    intro n he
    rw [start_ico _ n (by omega)]
    apply le_trans (add_le_add_right (ih (n+1) (by omega)) (depthRate n*(x+1+n)))
    push_cast
    have H := decayed n; have hp := (rate_easy n).1
    nlinarith [Nat.cast_nonneg (α:=ℝ) n]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Troupe.waiting_fee
proof:
:= by
  let U := s.here.dice M; let f (x : Grid M) := (↑(chooseCap g (t.stream x)):ℝ)
  have HE : stats t (fun l => (billWait g j l:ℝ)) =
      1000*(1+U.Ex f+g.i+(ell j:ℝ)) := by
    unfold stats billWait latency
    push_cast
    simp_rw [heroPlot,stage]
    rw [Ex_lmul,Ex_add,Ex_add,Ex_add (f:=fun _ => 1)]
    simp only [Ex_const]
    rfl
  rw [HE]
  change U.Ex f ≤ _ at h
  have Hi : (ell j:ℝ) ≤ Thermal.H j := by unfold Thermal.H; exact_mod_cast ell_le_h j
  have H := log_nonneg (amount_limits s j).1
  unfold dBase at *; linarith [H_pos j,Nat.cast_nonneg (α:=ℝ) g.i]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Troupe.size_stat
statement:
lemma size_stat {t : Thread M s} (h : t.Following j J f) (hh : Fit s) (hv : entry s) :
    stats t fullKills ≤ 1
proof:
:=
  le_trans (deaths t h hh.pos) (entry_share hh hv).le

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Troupe.rooms_fee
statement:
lemma rooms_fee :
    ∀ᶠ j : ℕ in atTop, ∀ M J : ℕ, ∀ s : Scene M, ∀ f : Grid M → ℝ, ∀ t : Thread M s,
      t.Following j J f → Fit s → entry s →
        (∀ x, f x ≤ exp (height j)) →
       ∀ c : Bool, stats t (rooms c j) ≤ 1 + 10^30*depthRate (lowI j c)*amount s j
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [paid_levels,hpoly 20 1] with j hj hv M J s f t h hh hx hf c
  let n := lowI j c; let m := highI j M c
  let A := amount s j
  have hP : 1 ≤ A ∧ height j ≤ A := amount_limits _ _
  have hz : 20*Thermal.H j ≤ height j := by rw [pow_one] at hv; exact hv
  have H (i : ℕ) : stats t (miniStage j i) ≤ 10^20*depthRate i*(A+1+i) := by
    let g := tagL i; let a := depthRate i
    let H := dBase g s j
    have hi := hj M J s f t h hh hx hf g (fun x => Bool.noConfusion x)
    obtain ⟨h₁,h₂⟩ := hi
    have HC : H ≤ 2*(A+1+i) := by
      change 1+log A+(i:ℝ) ≤ _
      linarith [Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (by linarith : 0<A),Nat.cast_nonneg (α:=ℝ) i]
    have HT : cutBook g s j ≤ 1000*(A+1+i) := by
      unfold g cutBook tagL scLimit
      simp only [↓reduceIte,Bool.false_eq_true]
      unfold A amount; linarith
    have HE : stats t (timex g j) ≤ 10^11*(A+1+i) := by
      change stats t _ ≤ _*(H+_) at h₁
      linarith [Nat.cast_nonneg (α:=ℝ) i]
    have HR := waiting_fee h₂
    change stats t _ ≤ 10^10*(H+_) at HR
    let f (l : Path M) := ((billWait g j l):ℝ)
    have HJ : stats t f ≤ 10^11*(A+1+i) := by
      apply HR.trans
      linarith [Nat.cast_nonneg (α:=ℝ) i]
    have hE : stats t (miniStage j i) =
        20000*(a*(1+stats t fullKills+stats t (timex g j)))+(4*side i)*stats t f := by
      change stats t (fun L => 20000*(a*(1+_+_)) +4*side i * _) = _
      unfold stats
      rw [Ex_add _ (f:=fun l => _),Ex_lmul,Ex_lmul,Ex_lmul,Ex_add,Ex_add (f:=fun l=>1),Ex_const]
    rw [hE]
    have ha : 0 < a ∧ a ≤ 1 ∧ a^2=side i := rate_easy _
    have HA : side i ≤ a := by nlinarith
    have hv := size_stat h hh hx
    have HL : side i * stats t f ≤ a*(10^11*(A+1+i)) :=
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left HJ (side_pos i).le).trans
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right HA (by have hh := le_trans (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)≤1) hP.1; positivity))
    change _ ≤ 10^20*a*_
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left HE ha.1.le,Nat.cast_nonneg (α:=ℝ) i,
      mul_nonneg ha.1.le (Nat.cast_nonneg (α:=ℝ) i)]
  have Hn : (n:ℝ) ≤ 19*Thermal.H j := by
    unfold n lowI
    split
    · exact (main_bounds j (Nat.le_add_right _ 3)).2.1
    · simp only [Nat.cast_zero]; have := H_pos j; positivity
  calc
    _ = 1+∑ i∈Finset.Ico n m, stats t (miniStage j i) := by
      unfold stats rooms; rw [Ex_add (f:=fun _ => 1),Ex_const,Ex_finset_sum]
      rfl
    _ ≤ 1+∑ i∈Finset.Ico n m, (10^20*depthRate i*(A+1+i)) :=
      add_le_add_right (Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => H i)) _
    _ ≤ _ := by
      simp_rw [mul_assoc (a:=(10:ℝ)^20) (b:=depthRate _),
        ← Finset.mul_sum]
      have HC := weight_decay A (by linarith) n m (by unfold m highI n; omega)
      have H : A+10+n ≤ 1000*A := by linarith
      change _ ≤ 1+10^30*depthRate n*A
      nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left H (rate_easy n).1.le,show
        0 ≤ depthRate n*A by apply mul_nonneg (rate_easy n).1.le; linarith]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Troupe.depth_at_main
statement: lemma depth_at_main (j : ℕ) : depthRate (mainIx j) = 1/(Thermal.H j)^8
proof:
:= by
  unfold depthRate; rw [bottom_level]
  rw [show 1/Thermal.H j^16=(1/Thermal.H j^8)^2 by ring]; rw [Real.sqrt_sq (by positivity)]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Troupe.palaces_fee
statement:
lemma palaces_fee :
    ∀ᶠ j : ℕ in atTop, ∀ M J : ℕ, ∀ s : Scene M, ∀ f : Grid M → ℝ, ∀ t : Thread M s,
      t.Following j J f → Fit s → entry s →
        s.live=true → exp (-height j) ≤ s.norm →
        (∀ x, f x ≤ exp (height j)) →
       stats t (palaces j) ≤ 10^120*height j/Thermal.H j
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [paid_levels,hpoly_mix 1 11 1,eventually_ge_atTop 1] with j hj hT Hj
    M J s f t h hh hx he hhx hf
  let d := height j; let v := Thermal.H j; let k := mainIx j+1
  have hd : 1 ≤ d := one_le_pow₀ (by norm_num)
  have hV : 1 ≤ v := H_ge j
  have hv : 0 < v := by linarith
  have hk : (k:ℝ) ≤ 20*v := by
    unfold k; push_cast
    linarith [(main_bounds j (Nat.le_add_right (mainIx j) 3)).2.1,show Thermal.H j=v from rfl]
  let A := amount s j
  have hl : A ≤ 4*d := by
    have H := log_le_log (exp_pos _) hhx
    rw [log_exp] at H
    change d+max _ 0 + 2 ≤ _
    have he' : max (-log s.norm) 0 ≤ d := max_le (by unfold d; linarith) (by linarith)
    linarith
  let m := (j:ℝ)
  have hm : 1 ≤ m := by unfold m; exact_mod_cast Hj
  have HP : v^11*m ≤ d := by simpa only [pow_one,one_mul] using hT
  have hA : log A ≤ 4+m := by
    have Hx : 1 ≤ A := (amount_limits _ _).1
    apply (log_le_log (show 0 < A by linarith) hl).trans
    unfold d; rw [log_mul (by positivity) (d_pos j).ne',height, log_pow]
    unfold m
    have hU : log 2 ≤ 1 := by linarith [log_le_sub_one_of_pos (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) < 2)]
    nlinarith [log_le_sub_one_of_pos (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<4),Nat.cast_nonneg (α:=ℝ) j]
  have hP (i : ℕ) (hK : i < k) := hj M J s f t h hh hx hf (tagM i) (fun _ =>
    ⟨(by change i ≤ mainIx j; unfold k at hK; omega),he⟩)
  have HR (i : ℕ) (hi : i<k) :
      stats t (fun l => (billWait (tagM i) j l:ℝ)) ≤ 10^12*(v+m) := by
    apply (waiting_fee (hP i hi).2).trans
    change (10:ℝ)^10*(1+log A+(i:ℝ)+v) ≤ _
    have HH : (i:ℝ) ≤ k := Nat.cast_le.mpr hi.le
    linarith
  have HX : m ≤ d/v := (le_div_iff₀ hv).mpr (by
    have HL : v ≤ v^11 := by simpa using pow_le_pow_right₀ hV (by omega : 1 ≤ 11)
    nlinarith)
  have HU (i : ℕ) (hi : i<k) :
      stats t (timex (tagM i) j) ≤ 10^35*(d/v)*(1+(i:ℝ)) := by
    apply (hP i hi).1.trans
    let y := (i:ℝ); let W := codeWeight capA
    have HH : 1 ≤ W ∧ W ≤ 10^25 := by unfold W codeWeight capA reserve; norm_num
    have HE : cutBook (tagM i) s j = W*(d/v)*(2+y) := by
      unfold cutBook kappa
      simp only [tagM,↓reduceIte]
      push_cast; unfold W d v y; ring
    rw [HE]
    change _ *(1+log A+y+W*(d/v)*(2+y)) ≤ _*(d/v)*(1+y)
    have hY : 0 ≤ y := by unfold y; positivity
    nlinarith [show W*(d/v)*(2+y) ≤ 10^25*((d/v)*(2+y)) by
      rw [mul_assoc]; gcongr; linarith, mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right HX hY]
  have hcost (i : ℕ) (hi : i < k) :
      stats t (nakedStage i j) ≤
        2*v^8 + 10^12*(v+m) + 10^35*(d/v)*(depthRate i * (1+(i:ℝ))) := by
    let a := depthRate i
    have ha := (rate_easy i).1
    have HE : stats t (nakedStage i j) =
        (1+stats t fullKills)/a+a*stats t (timex (tagM i) j)+
          stats t (fun L => (↑(billWait (tagM (i-1)) j L):ℝ)) := by
      unfold stats nakedStage
      simp_rw [Ex_add,Ex_lmul,div_eq_mul_inv,Ex_mul,
        Ex_add (f:=fun _ => 1),Ex_const]
      rfl
    have hb : 1/a ≤ v^8 := by
      have hn : i ≤ mainIx j := by unfold k at hi; omega
      have HH : depthRate (mainIx j) ≤ a := sqrt_le_sqrt (side_ant _ _ hn)
      rw [depth_at_main] at HH
      apply (div_le_iff₀ ha).mpr
      have H' := (div_le_iff₀ (show 0 < v^8 by positivity)).mp HH
      linarith
    rw [HE]
    have HH : (1+stats t fullKills)/a ≤ 2/a := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (by linarith [size_stat h hh hx]) ha.le
    have ht := HR (i-1) (by omega)
    unfold a at *; linarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (HU i hi) ha.le,show
      (2:ℝ)/depthRate i=2*(1/depthRate i) by ring]
  let F (i) := depthRate i*(1+(i:ℝ))
  let V := 2*v^8+10^12*(v+m); let S := 10^35*(d/v)
  have HS : 0 ≤ S := by unfold S; positivity
  let R := Finset.Ico 0 k
  have HI : ∑ i∈R,stats t (nakedStage i j) ≤ k*V+100*S := by
    have H : ∑ i∈R,F i ≤ 100 := by
      have HI := weight_decay 0 le_rfl 0 k (by omega)
      unfold F R
      norm_num [depthRate,side] at HI ⊢; exact HI
    calc
      _ ≤ ∑ i∈R,(V+S*F i) := Finset.sum_le_sum fun i hi => hcost i (Finset.mem_Ico.mp hi).2
      _ ≤ _ := by
        unfold R; rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib,←Finset.mul_sum,Finset.sum_const,Nat.card_Ico,nsmul_eq_mul,Nat.sub_zero]
        unfold R at H; nlinarith
  have hΦ : (v:ℝ)^10 *m ≤ d/v := (le_div_iff₀ hv).mpr (by apply le_trans _ HP; exact le_of_eq (by ring))
  have HQ : k*V ≤ 10^16*(d/v) := by
    have he' : v^9 ≤ v^10*m := le_trans (pow_le_pow_right₀ hV (by omega))
      (le_mul_of_one_le_right (by positivity) hm)
    have ht' : v^2 ≤ v^9 := pow_le_pow_right₀ hV (by omega)
    have hh' : v*m ≤ v^10*m := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
      (by simpa using pow_le_pow_right₀ hV (by omega : 1 ≤ 10)) (by linarith)
    have hv' : 0 ≤ V := by unfold V; positivity
    apply (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hk hv').trans
    unfold V; nlinarith
  have H₁ : stats t (fun l => (billWait (tagM (mainIx j)) j l:ℝ)) ≤ 10^14*(d/v) := by
    apply (HR (mainIx j) (by unfold k; omega)).trans
    have HH : v ≤ d/v := le_trans (by
      have HE : v ≤ v^10 := by simpa using pow_le_pow_right₀ hV (by omega : 1 ≤ 10)
      exact le_trans HE (le_mul_of_one_le_right (by positivity) hm)) hΦ
    linarith
  have HHH : stats t (palaces j) =
      4*stats t (fun l => (billWait (tagM (mainIx j)) j l:ℝ))+
      10^20*∑ i∈R,stats t (nakedStage i j) := by
    unfold stats palaces; rw [Ex_add _ (f:=fun _ => _),Ex_lmul,Ex_lmul,Ex_finset_sum]
  rw [HHH]
  apply le_trans (add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left H₁ (by norm_num)) (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left HI (by norm_num)))
  change _ ≤10^120*d/v
  unfold S at *; nlinarith [show 10^120*d/v=10^120*(d/v) by ring]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Troupe.matrix_trip
statement:
lemma matrix_trip {x : Grid M} (l : Path M) (h : Trip x s l) :
    matrix s.here.lev l
proof:
:= by
  induction l generalizing s with
  | nil => exact True.intro
  | cons b l ih =>
    have He : depthB b=s.here.lev := by unfold depthB; rw [h.2.1.lower.here,h.1]
    have HH := ih h.2.2
    rw [depth_next,He] at HH; exact ⟨He,HH⟩

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Troupe.matrix_cut
statement:
lemma matrix_cut (l : Path M) (n : ℕ) (k : ℕ) (h : matrix n l) :
    ∃ p q : Path M, l=p++q ∧ matrix (n+p.length) q ∧
      (∀ b∈p, depthB b < k) ∧ (∀ b∈q, k ≤ depthB b) ∧
      n+p.length = min (max n k) (n+l.length)
proof:
:= by
  induction l generalizing n with
  | nil => refine ⟨[],[],rfl,True.intro,?_⟩; simp
  | cons b l ih =>
    obtain ⟨hp,hq,hh,hE,h₁,h₂,h₃⟩ := ih _ h.2
    have HI : depthB b=n := h.1
    by_cases hv : n < k
    · refine ⟨b::hp,hq, by rw [hh]; rfl,?_,?_,h₂,?_⟩
      · rw [List.length_cons,show n+(List.length hp+1)=n+1+List.length hp by omega]
        exact hE
      · intro x hx; rcases List.mem_cons.mp hx with rfl|hx
        · omega
        exact h₁ _ hx
      · simp only [List.length_cons]
        omega
    · have H : hp.length=0 := by omega
      have hL : hp=[] := List.eq_nil_of_length_eq_zero H
      rw [hL,List.nil_append] at hh; cases hh
      refine ⟨[],b::l,rfl,h,fun b hb => ?_,fun z hz => ?_,?_⟩
      · simp at hb
      · rcases List.mem_cons.mp hz with rfl|hz; omega
        exact h₂ _ hz
      · simp; omega

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Troupe.slab_on
statement:
lemma slab_on (l : Path M) (n : ℕ) (h : matrix n l) (a k : ℕ) :
    ∃ p q r : Path M, l=p++q++r ∧
      (∀ b∈p, ¬betweenS a k b) ∧ (∀ b∈r, ¬betweenS a k b) ∧
      q.length ≤ k
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p,s,H,h₁,h₂,h₃,h₄⟩ := matrix_cut l n a h
  obtain ⟨q,r,hr,hx,hp,he,hk⟩ := matrix_cut s _ (a+k) h₁
  refine ⟨p,q,r,by rw [H,hr,List.append_assoc],fun b hi hh => ?_,fun b hi hh => ?_,?_⟩
  exact (h₂ b hi).not_ge hh.1
  exact hh.2.not_ge (he b hi)
  have ht₁ : l.length=p.length+s.length := by rw [H,List.length_append]
  have ht₂ : s.length=q.length+r.length := by rw [hr,List.length_append]
  omega

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Troupe.sheds
statement:
lemma sheds {s : Scene M} {l : Path M} (h : Cast j J f s l) (u : Grid M) :
    ∃ m : Grade → ℕ, shades m u l j
proof:
:= by
  choose m hm using fun g => bound_stage (u:=u) l h g
  exact ⟨m,hm⟩

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Troupe.stripe_pos
statement:
lemma stripe_pos (a : Grade → ℕ) (g : Grade) (j : ℕ) (l : Path M) (b : Beat M) :
    0 ≤ stripe a g j l b
proof: := by unfold stripe; split <;> norm_num

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Troupe.stripe_bill
statement:
lemma stripe_bill (a : Grade → ℕ) (g : Grade) (j : ℕ) (l : Path M) (x : Grid M)
    {s : Scene M} (h : Trip x s l) : subtotal (stripe a g j l) l ≤ billWait g j l
proof:
:= by
  let f := stripe a g j l
  obtain ⟨v,w,p,hl,hv,hp,hw⟩ := slab_on l _ (matrix_trip l h) (a g) (billWait g j l)
  have HF (m : Path M) (hi : ∀ b∈m, ¬ betweenS (a g) (billWait g j l) b) :
      subtotal f m=0 := by
    induction m with
    | nil => rfl
    | cons b r ih =>
      have HH : f b=0 := ite_eq_right (hi b List.mem_cons_self)
      rw [subtotal_cons,HH,ih fun y hy => hi y (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hy),zero_add]
  have HX (m : Path M) :
      subtotal f m ≤ m.length := by
    induction m with
    | nil => simp [subtotal]
    | cons b r ih =>
      have he : f b≤ 1 := by unfold f stripe; split <;> norm_num
      rw [subtotal_cons, List.length_cons]; push_cast; linarith
  change subtotal f l ≤ _
  nth_rw 1 [hl]
  rw [subtotal_app,subtotal_app,HF v hv,HF p hp,zero_add,add_zero]
  apply (HX w).trans
  exact_mod_cast hw

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Troupe.trim_cost
statement:
lemma trim_cost (g : Beat M → ℝ) (hg : ∀ b, Ideal b.pre b.post → 0 ≤ g b)
    {x : Grid M} (l p r : Path M) (h : Trip x s (p++(l++r))) :
    subtotal g l ≤ subtotal g (p++(l++r))
proof:
:= by
  rw [subtotal_app,subtotal_app]
  obtain ⟨ha,q,hq⟩ := trip_cut h
  obtain ⟨hc,t,ht⟩ := trip_cut hq
  linarith [trip_nonneg ht hg,trip_nonneg ha hg]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Troupe.trip_depth_limit
statement:
lemma trip_depth_limit {l : Path M} {s : Scene M} (h : Cast j J f s l) :
    s.here.lev+l.length ≤ J
proof:
:= by
  induction l generalizing s with
  | nil => exact (show s.Safe j J f from h).depth_ok
  | cons b l ih =>
    obtain ⟨rfl,⟨t,ht⟩,hh⟩ := h
    have hi := ih hh
    rw [List.length_cons]
    have hX := ht.2.1.1.here
    rw [depth_next,depthB,hX] at hi
    omega

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Troupe.pricey
statement:
lemma pricey (s : Scene M) (j : ℕ) (b : Bool) (i : ℕ) (h : picks s i j b) :
    side i ≤ 128*mutedR s j b
proof:
:= by
  let n := priciest s j b
  have hi : ∃ i, picks s i j b := ⟨i,h⟩
  have hn : n=Nat.find hi := dite_eq_left hi
  have HE : hazard s false n := hn.symm ▸ (Nat.find_spec hi).2
  have H : side i ≤ side n := pow_le_pow_of_le_one (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
      (hn.le.trans (Nat.find_min' hi h))
  change side n / 128 ≤ edgeW s n at HE
  change _ ≤ 128*surcharge s false n
  rw [surcharge,ite_eq_left (show hazard s false n from HE)]; linarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Troupe.token_floor
statement:
lemma token_floor (a : Grade → ℕ) (j : ℕ) (s : Bool) (L : Path M) (b : Beat M) :
    side M ≤ token a L j s b ∧ 512*mutedR b.post j s ≤ token a L j s b ∧
      (∑ i∈playsL j M s,4*side i*stripe a (tagL i) j L b) ≤ token a L j s b ∧
      (s=true → 4*(special j b+stripe a (tagM (mainIx j)) j L b) ≤ token a L j s b)
proof:
:= by
  let z := ∑ i∈playsL j M s,4*side i*stripe a (tagL i) j L b
  have hZ : 0 ≤ z := Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num)
    (side_pos _).le) (stripe_pos _ _ _ _ _)
  have hx : 0 ≤ mutedR b.post j s := surcharge_nonneg _ _ _
  have hi : 0 ≤ special j b := flag_nonneg _ _
  have hv := stripe_pos a (tagM (mainIx j)) j L b
  have hh := side_pos M
  unfold token
  unfold z at *
  cases s <;> simp only [↓reduceIte,Bool.false_eq_true] <;>
    refine ⟨?_,?_,?_,fun H => ?_⟩ <;> first | linarith | contradiction

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Troupe.tokens_nonneg
statement:
lemma tokens_nonneg (a : Grade → ℕ) (L : Path M) (b : Beat M) (j : ℕ) (s : Bool) :
    0 ≤ token a L j s b
proof: := (side_pos M).le.trans (token_floor a j s L b).1

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Troupe.amp_test
statement:
lemma amp_test {s : Scene M} (h : Climb s) (u : Grid M) :
    ‖gain s u‖ ≤ ampU s u ∧ ampU s u ≤ 4 ∧
      ∃ b : Bool, ampU s u=‖scalar (s.smaller b) u‖
proof:
:= by
  have H (b) := (scalar_norm (h.child b) u).trans (h.child b).lift
  constructor
  · apply (norm_halfcomplex _ _).trans
    have h1 : ‖scalar (s.smaller false) u‖ ≤ ampU s u := le_max_left _ _
    have h2 : ‖scalar (s.smaller true) u‖ ≤ ampU s u := le_max_right _ _
    linarith
  · unfold ampU
    refine ⟨max_le (H false) (H true),?_⟩
    by_cases hh : ‖scalar (s.smaller true) u‖ ≤ ‖scalar (s.smaller false) u‖
    exact ⟨false,max_eq_left hh⟩
    exact ⟨true,max_eq_right (le_of_not_ge hh)⟩

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Troupe.side_ant
statement: lemma side_ant (i j : ℕ) (h : i ≤ j) : side j ≤ side i
proof:
:=
    pow_le_pow_of_le_one (by norm_num) (by norm_num) h

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Troupe.direct_point
statement:
lemma direct_point {s : Scene M} {L : Path M} {x u : Grid M} (h : Trip x s L)
    (j : ℕ) (c : Bool) (a : Grade → ℕ) (hh : shades a u L j)
    (n : ℕ) (l r : Path M) (b : Beat M)
    (hR : c=true → stall u (tagM (mainIx j)) j L l)
    (hc : ∀ i ∈ Finset.Ico (lowI j c) n, stall u (tagL i) j L l)
    (_hn : n ∈ Set.Icc (lowI j c) (highI j M c)) (hl : L=l++r)
    (hm : b∈l) (hb : n < highI j M c → 4*side n < ampU b.post u) :
    ‖proceeds x u b‖ ≤ token a L j c b
proof:
:= by
  let t := lowI j c; let B := side t; let q := b.post; let s := playsL j M c
  let K := t+M
  let v := token a L j c b
  let p := ampU q u
  have ht := trip_attend h b (by rw [hl]; simp [hm])
  have H := token_floor a j c L b
  change _ ≤ v ∧ _ ≤ v ∧ _ ≤ v ∧ (c=true→_ ≤ v) at H
  obtain ⟨hP,hB,z,hz⟩ := amp_test ht.1.climb u
  change p ≤ 4 at hB
  change p=_ at hz
  rw [proceeds,norm_scaleC,ht.2.2.1,one_mul]
  apply hP.trans
  by_cases hi : 4*B < p
  · have he : c=true := by
      by_contra he
      have HE : t=0 := ite_eq_right he
      unfold B at hi; rw [HE,show side 0=1 by simp [side]] at hi; linarith
    have hI : mainIx j=t := by unfold t lowI; rw [ite_eq_left he]
    apply le_trans _ (H.2.2.2 he)
    by_cases ha : hazard q true t
    · have HF : special j b=1 :=
        ite_eq_left ⟨(show 0 < mainIx j + 1 by omega),by
          change hazard q true (mainIx j+1-1); rw [hI]; exact ha⟩
      rw [HF]
      linarith [stripe_pos a (tagM (mainIx j)) j L b]
    · have HV : snag (tagM (mainIx j)) u b := by
        rw [hI]; refine ⟨⟨z,?_⟩,ha⟩
        change B^2 ≤ energy (q.smaller z) u
        have hi' := scalar_energy (q.smaller z) (ht.1.climb.child z) u
        change p=‖scalar (q.smaller z) u‖ at hz
        rw [←hz] at hi'
        nlinarith [show 0 < B from side_pos _]
      have HW := hh _ l r hl (hR he) b hm HV
      rw [show stripe a (tagM (mainIx j)) j L b=1 from ite_eq_left HW]
      have hx : 0 ≤ special j b := flag_nonneg _ _
      linarith
  have hk : p ≤ 4*B := le_of_not_gt hi
  by_cases h : p < side K
  · apply le_trans _ H.1
    exact h.le.trans (side_ant M K (by unfold K; omega))
  have hq : side K ≤ p := le_of_not_gt h
  let goodN (i : ℕ) := t ≤ i ∧ side i ≤ p
  have HX : goodN K := ⟨by unfold K; omega,hq⟩
  have HF : ∃ i,goodN i := ⟨K,HX⟩
  let i := Nat.find HF
  have hE : goodN i := Nat.find_spec HF
  have hV : i ≤ K := Nat.find_min' HF HX
  have hS : i∈s := Finset.mem_Ico.mpr ⟨hE.1,Nat.lt_succ_of_le hV⟩
  have HI : p ≤ 4*side i := by
    by_cases HC : t=i
    · unfold B at hk; rwa [← HC]
    have HH := Nat.find_min HF (m:=i-1) (by have hi : t < i := lt_of_le_of_ne hE.1 HC; change i-1 < i; omega)
    have hx' : p < side (i-1) := lt_of_not_ge fun H =>
      HH ⟨Nat.le_sub_one_of_lt (lt_of_le_of_ne hE.1 HC), H⟩
    have H := side_succ (i-1)
    have HV : 0 < i := by have hi := hE.1; omega
    rw [Nat.sub_add_cancel HV] at H
    nlinarith [side_pos i]
  have hj : i < n := by
    by_cases hz : n < highI j M c
    · by_contra! he
      exact not_lt_of_ge (HI.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (side_ant n i he) (by norm_num)))
        (hb hz)
    exact (Finset.mem_Ico.mp hS).2.trans_le (le_of_not_gt hz)
  apply HI.trans
  by_cases hv : hazard q false i
  · apply le_trans _ H.2.1
    linarith [pricey b.post j c i (show picks q i j c from ⟨hS,hv⟩)]
  · let g := tagL i
    have hb : stall u g j L l := hc _ (Finset.mem_Ico.mpr ⟨hE.1,hj⟩)
    have hi : betweenS (a g) (billWait g j L) b :=
      hh g l r hl hb b hm ⟨⟨z,(show side i ≤ ‖scalar _ _‖ from le_trans hE.2 hz.le)⟩,hv⟩
    have hx' : stripe a g j L b=1 := ite_eq_left hi
    apply le_trans _ H.2.2.1
    calc
      _ = 4*side i*stripe a (tagL i) j L b := by rw [hx']; ring
      _ ≤ _ := Finset.single_le_sum (f:=fun i => 4*side i*stripe a (tagL i) j L b) (fun k _ =>
        mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (side_pos _).le) (stripe_pos _ _ _ _ _)) hS

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Troupe.cross_subtotal
statement:
lemma cross_subtotal (l : Path M) (s : Finset ℕ) (f : Beat M → ℕ → ℝ) :
    subtotal (fun b => ∑ i∈s,f b i) l=∑ i∈s,subtotal (fun b => f b i) l
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp only [subtotal_nil,Finset.sum_const_zero]
  | cons b l ih =>
    rw [subtotal_cons,ih]; simp_rw [subtotal_cons,Finset.sum_add_distrib]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Troupe.max_tokens
statement:
lemma max_tokens {x : Grid M} (L : Path M) (h : Trip x s L)
    (a : Grade→ℕ) (j : ℕ) (p : Bool)
    (hh : L.length ≤ M) :
    subtotal (token a L j p) L ≤ tokenCost j p L
proof:
:= by
  let C i := 4*side i
  have h1 : subtotal (fun _ => side M) L ≤ 1 := by
    rw [subt_constant]
    have H : (L.length:ℝ) ≤ 2^M := by exact_mod_cast (hh.trans Nat.lt_two_pow_self.le)
    apply le_trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left H (side_pos _).le)
    rw [side_card]
  have h2 (T : Finset ℕ) :
      subtotal (fun b => ∑ i∈T,4*side i *stripe a (tagL i) j L b) L ≤
        ∑ i∈T,4*side i*(billWait (tagL i) j L:ℝ) := by
    rw [cross_subtotal _ _ (fun b i => _)]
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum; intro i _
    rw [subtR]; exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (stripe_bill _ _ _ _ x h)
      (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (side_pos _).le)
  have HE (b : Bool) :
      subtotal (fun B : Beat M => 512*mutedR B.post j b) L=512*subtotal (fun B => mutedR B.post j b) L :=
    subtR _ _ _
  unfold token tokenCost
  have h3 := stripe_bill a (tagM (mainIx j)) j L x h
  cases p <;>
   simp only [Bool.false_eq_true,↓reduceIte,add_zero]
  · rw [blend _ (f:=fun _ => _) (g:=fun _ => _),blend _ (f:=fun _=>_) (g:=fun _=>_),HE]
    linarith [h2 (playsL j M false)]
  · simp_rw [blend _ (f:=fun b => _) (g:=fun b => _)]
    rw [HE,subtR _ _ 4,blend _ (f:=special j)]
    linarith [h2 (playsL j M true)]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.CastShow.stamp_upper
statement:
lemma stamp_upper (s : Scene M) (j : ℕ) :
    stamp s j ≤ 512*mutedR s j true + 10^20*fax s+
      10^40*Thermal.H j^40*(∑ i∈holders j,bouts i j s)
proof:
:= by
  let R := holders j; let n := mainIx j; let a := Thermal.H j
  let f (i) := bouts i j s
  have he : 1 ≤ a := H_ge j
  have hp : 0 < a := H_pos j
  have hi (i) : 0 ≤ f i := surcharge_nonneg _ _ _
  have HR : 0 ≤ ∑ i∈R,f i := Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => hi _
  let K := Finset.Ico 0 (n+1)
  have HH :
      ∑ i∈K, parody s i/depthRate i ≤ (10^6*a^40)*∑ i∈R, f i := by
    have he' : 0 ≤ 10^6*a^40 := by positivity
    apply le_trans (b:=(10^6*a^40)*∑ i∈K,f i)
    · rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum; intro i hv
      have hI : i ≤ n := by
        have hx : i < n+1 := (Finset.mem_Ico.mp hv).2; omega
      have Hx : parody s i ≤ 10^6*a^32*f i := parody_fee s j i (hI.trans (Nat.le_add_right _ _))
      have Hv := depth_rate_fee i j hI
      rw [div_eq_mul_one_div]
      apply le_trans (mul_le_mul Hx Hv (by have := (rate_easy i).1; positivity)
        (by have := hi i; positivity)); change 10^6*a^32*f i*a^8 ≤ _
      exact le_of_eq (by ring)
    · apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ he'
      refine Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg ?_ fun i _ _ => hi i
      unfold K R holders n; intro i hi
      obtain ⟨ha,hb⟩ := Finset.mem_Ico.mp hi; exact Finset.mem_Ico.mpr ⟨ha,by omega⟩
  have HK : f (n+1) ≤ ∑ i∈R,f i := Finset.single_le_sum (fun i _ => hi i)
    (Finset.mem_Ico.mpr ⟨by omega,by unfold n; omega⟩)
  have HT : parody s (n+1) ≤ (10^6*a^40)*∑ i∈R, f i := by
    apply (parody_fee s j (n+1) le_rfl).trans
    change 10^6*a^32*f (n+1) ≤ _
    gcongr <;> first| omega| apply hi
  unfold stamp stampAux
  change _ + (4*parody s (n+1)+10^20*(fax s+∑ i∈K,_)) ≤ _+_+10^40*a^40*(∑ i∈R,f i)
  nlinarith [mul_nonneg (show 0 ≤ a^40 by positivity) HR]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.CastShow.bound_bit
proof:
:= Event.march s (Turn.move (j:=j)) k
    billOf b ≤ upperFare b := by
  intro b
  unfold b upperFare
  let r := s.norm/s.mass
  have ht : normStamp s j=r*stamp s j := ite_eq_left he
  have h1 : edgeFee (picker j M) false b=r*mutedR s j true := by
    unfold b edgeFee toll
    simp only [true_and,ite_eq_left hp.2.2, r, picker,mutedR]
  have h2 (i) : aura i b=r*bouts i j s := by
    unfold aura b edgeFee toll
    simp only [true_and,ite_eq_left hp.2.2,r,bouts]
  have HH : 0 ≤ r := div_nonneg h.norm_ok h.mass_lower
  change normStamp s j ≤ _*0+512*edgeFee (picker j M) false b+
    4*10^20*(1/4*r*fax s)+ 10^40* Thermal.H j^40*(∑ i∈holders j,aura i b)
  simp_rw [h2,h1,ht,← Finset.mul_sum]
  apply le_trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (stamp_upper s j) HH)
  exact le_of_eq (by ring)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.CastShow.short_trace_bound
statement:
lemma short_trace_bound (t : Play j M s) (h : t.Follows J f) (he : s.live=true) :
    let v
proof:
:= trace false t
    v.flatFee billOf ≤ v.flatFee upperFare := by
  induction t with
  | rest s => simp only [trace,flat_finish,le_refl]
  | freeze s t ih =>
    intro v
    change flatFee (.finish s true : Road j M s) billOf ≤ flatFee (.finish s true) upperFare
    rw [flat_finish,flat_finish]
  | ticket s t ih =>
    simp only [trace,flat_push]
    apply add_le_add _ (ih h.2.2.2.2 he)
    unfold upperFare billOf beginFee edgeFee infoFee gateTax
    have H : ∀ i, aura i (.pace s .renew : Event j M)=0 := fun i => rfl
    simp only [H,reset,he,↓reduceIte,Finset.sum_const_zero]
    exact le_of_eq (by ring)
  | jump s l r il ir =>
    simp only [trace, flat_fork _ _ (traced _ false h)]
    apply Ex_mono; intro b
    apply add_le_add (bound_bit s b h.1 he h.2.1)
    cases b
    exact il h.2.2.2.1 he
    exact ir h.2.2.2.2 he
  | attempt s u l r il ir =>
    simp only [trace,flat_fork _ _ (traced _ false h)]
    apply Ex_mono; intro b
    apply add_le_add
    · have H : ∀ i, aura i (.march s (.ask u) b)=0 := fun i => rfl
      simp [upperFare,H,beginFee,edgeFee,infoFee,billOf]
    · cases b; exact il h.2.2.2.2.1 he; exact ir h.2.2.2.2.2 he

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.CastShow.linear_fee
statement:
lemma linear_fee (t : Road j M s) (A B : Event j M → ℝ) (a : ℝ) :
    flatFee t (fun i => A i+B i)=flatFee t A+flatFee t B ∧
      flatFee t (fun i => a*A i)=a*flatFee t A
proof:
:= by
  have HE (l : List (Event j M)) :
      (l.map (fun i => A i+B i)).sum=(l.map A).sum+(l.map B).sum ∧
      (l.map (fun i => a*A i)).sum=a*(l.map A).sum := by
    induction l with
    | nil => simp
    | cons b l ih =>
      simp only [List.map_cons,List.sum_cons, ih.1, ih.2]
      constructor <;> ring
  constructor
  · unfold flatFee expHike Journal.fee; simp_rw [(HE _).1, Ex_add]
  unfold flatFee expHike Journal.fee; simp_rw [(HE _).2, Ex_lmul]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.CastShow.sum_fee
statement:
lemma sum_fee (t : Road j M s) (p : Finset ℕ) (f : ℕ → Event j M → ℝ) :
    t.flatFee (fun i => ∑ z∈p,f z i)=∑ z∈p,t.flatFee (f z)
proof:
:= by
  induction p using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty =>
    have H (s : Journal j M) : s.fee (fun _ => 0)=0 := by
      unfold Journal.fee; induction s.events with
      | nil => simp
      | cons a l ih => simp
    simp only [Finset.sum_empty,flatFee,expHike,H,Ex_const]
  | @insert a p ha ih =>
    simp only [Finset.sum_insert ha]
    rw [(linear_fee t (f a) (fun i => _) 0).1,ih]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.CastShow.upper_total
statement:
lemma upper_total :
    ∀ᶠ j : ℕ in atTop, ∀ M J : ℕ, ∀ f : Grid M → ℝ,
      (∀ x,f x ≤ exp (height j)) →
      let s
proof:
:= beginPlay f true
      ∀ t : Road j M s, t.Trusted J f → 1/Thermal.H j ≤ s.mass →
        t.flatFee upperFare ≤ 10^190*height j := by
  filter_upwards [global_edges, fisher_bound, final_coarse,hpoly 1 42] with j he hq ht hk
    M J f hF s t h hp
  let a := Thermal.H j; let d := height j; let phi := t.flatFee
  let x := limitC
  obtain ⟨H1,H2⟩ := he M J f hF t h hp
  have H₃ := hq M J f hF t h hp
  have H₄ := (ht M J s f t h hp).2.2 rfl
  let R := holders j
  have HH : ∑ i∈R,phi (aura i) ≤ 300000*x*a^2 := by
    calc
      _ ≤ ∑ _i∈R,10000*x*a := Finset.sum_le_sum fun i hi => by
        have hh := (Finset.mem_Ico.mp hi).2
        apply H2
        unfold testIx; omega
      _ ≤ _ := by
        unfold R holders
        simp only [Finset.sum_const,Nat.card_Ico,Nat.sub_zero,nsmul_eq_mul]
        have he : ((mainIx j:ℕ):ℝ) ≤ 19*a := (main_bounds j (Nat.le_add_right _ 3)).2.1
        push_cast
        have HX : 1 ≤ a := H_ge _
        unfold x limitC; nlinarith
  let f₁ := edgeFee (picker j M) false (j:=j)
  let C := 10^140*(d/a)
  let Y := 10^40*a^40
  have HY : 0 ≤ C ∧ 0 ≤ Y := by
    have hi : 0 < a := H_pos _
    have hh : 0 < d := d_pos j
    unfold C Y; constructor <;> positivity

  have HE (A B : Event j M → ℝ) : phi (fun i => A i+B i)=phi A+phi B := (linear_fee t A B 1).1
  have HM (A : Event j M → ℝ) (c : ℝ) : phi (fun i => c*A i)=c*phi A := (linear_fee t A A c).2
  have H := H1 (picker j M)
  unfold upperFare
  change phi (fun e => C*beginFee e+512*f₁ e+4*10^20*infoFee e + Y*(∑ i∈R,aura i e)) ≤ _
  simp_rw [HE (fun _ => _) (fun _ => _),HM]
  rw [show phi (fun e => ∑ i∈R,aura i e) = ∑ i∈R,phi (aura i) from sum_fee t R aura]
  have Ha : 1 ≤ a := H_ge _
  have hd : 0 ≤ d := (d_pos j).le
  change phi f₁ ≤ 1000*d at H
  change phi infoFee ≤ x*d at H₃
  change phi beginFee ≤ 100*x*a at H₄
  have HZ : a^42 ≤ d := by simpa using hk
  have HC : C*(100*x*a) ≤ 10^180*d := by
    have He : 0<a := by linarith
    unfold x limitC C
    rw [show 10^140*(d/a)*(100*10^30*a)=10^172*d by field_simp; ring]
    linarith
  have HL : Y*(300000*x*a^2) ≤ 10^78*d := by
    apply le_trans _ (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left HZ (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)≤10^78))
    unfold Y x limitC
    nlinarith [pow_nonneg (lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one Ha).le 42]
  change _ ≤ 10^190*d
  have HH' := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left HH HY.2
  have H₄' := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left H₄ HY.1
  unfold x limitC at *
  linarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.CastShow.burn_rate
statement:
lemma burn_rate :
    ∀ᶠ j : ℕ in atTop, ∀ M J : ℕ, 1000*((2:ℝ)^J) ≤ 2^M →
      ∀ f : Grid M → ℝ, (∀ x, f x ≤ exp (height j)) →
      let s
proof:
:= beginPlay f true
      ∀ t : Road j M s, Trusted J f t → 1/Thermal.H j ≤ s.mass →
        coldFee t ≤ 10^220*height j := by
  filter_upwards [rare,log_mass_budget,hpoly 1 4] with j h1 h2 hd M J hm f hf s t h hh
  let a := Thermal.H j; let d := height j; let P := s.actor
  let c := 10*limitC
  have hp : 1 ≤ a := H_ge j
  have ha : 0 < a := H_pos j
  have he : a^4 ≤ d := by simpa using hd
  have hD : 1 ≤ d := one_le_pow₀ (by norm_num)
  let k (x : Grid M) := t.hike x
  let w (x : Grid M) := if (k x).froze then (1:ℝ) else 0
  let y (x : Grid M) := drought (k x).done.mass
  have HX : P.Ex w ≤ 1/a^10 := by
    apply le_trans _ (h1 M J hm f hf t h hh)
    apply Ex_mono; intro x; unfold w
    cases he : (k x).froze <;> simp_all only [k,Bool.false_eq_true,↓reduceIte,le_refl]
  have HH : P.Ex (fun i => y i^2) ≤ (c*a)^2 := h2 M J s f t h hh
  let L := fun i => w i*y i
  let K := fun i => w i*y i^2
  have hw (i) : w i ≤ 1 ∧ w i^2=w i := by unfold w; split <;> norm_num
  have H : P.Ex K ≤ (c*a)^2 := le_trans (Ex_mono _ fun i =>
    mul_le_of_le_one_left (sq_nonneg (y i)) (hw _).1) HH
  have HC : P.Ex L ≤ c := by
    have Heq := Law.sq_Ex_mul P w y
    simp_rw [(hw _).2] at Heq
    have HJ : P.Ex w * P.Ex (fun i => y i^2) ≤ (1/a^10)*(c*a)^2 :=
      mul_le_mul HX HH (Ex_nonneg _ (fun _ => sq_nonneg _)) (by positivity)
    have HF : (1/a^10)*(c*a)^2 ≤ c^2 := by
      apply le_trans (b:=(1/a^2)*(c*a)^2)
      · apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ (sq_nonneg _)
        exact one_div_le_one_div_of_le (by positivity) (pow_le_pow_right₀ hp (by omega))
      exact le_of_eq (by field_simp)
    change (P.Ex L)^2 ≤ _ at Heq
    have hP : 0 < c := by unfold c limitC; norm_num
    nlinarith
  have heq (x : Grid M) : coldLump (k x) =
      10^150* ((a+1)*(d+2)*w x+(a+d+3)*L x+K x) := by
    unfold coldLump chargeStatic
    unfold L K w y
    split_ifs <;> unfold d a <;> ring
  unfold coldFee expHike
  change P.Ex (fun i => coldLump (k i)) ≤ 10^220*d
  simp_rw [heq,Ex_lmul,Ex_add,Ex_lmul]
  have HR : a ≤ d := le_trans (by simpa using pow_le_pow_right₀ hp (by omega : 1≤4)) he
  have Hs : a^2 ≤ d := le_trans (pow_le_pow_right₀ hp (by omega)) he
  have HS : (a+1)*(d+2)*P.Ex w ≤ 6*d :=
    le_trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left HX (by positivity)) (by
      have H : 1/a^10 ≤ 1/a := one_div_le_one_div_of_le ha (by simpa using pow_le_pow_right₀ hp (by omega : 1≤10))
      apply (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left H (show 0 ≤ (a+1)*(d+2) by positivity)).trans
      rw [mul_one_div]
      apply (div_le_iff₀ ha).mpr; nlinarith)
  have HT : (a+d+3)*P.Ex L ≤ 5*d*c :=
    le_trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left HC (by positivity)) (by
      have H : 0 ≤ c := by unfold c limitC; norm_num
      nlinarith)
  unfold c limitC at *
  nlinarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.CastShow.grossOur
statement:
lemma grossOur :
    ∀ᶠ j : ℕ in atTop, ∀ M J : ℕ, 1000*((2:ℝ)^J) ≤ 2^M →
      ∀ f : Grid M → ℝ, (∀ x, f x ≤ exp (height j)) →
      let s
proof:
:= beginPlay f true
      ∀ t : Play j M s, t.Follows J f → 1/Thermal.H j ≤ s.mass →
        yieldA t ≤ s.mass*(10^221*height j) := by
  filter_upwards [cost_overall,burn_rate,upper_total,frostCompare] with j h1 h2 h3 h4 M J hC f hf s t h hm
  have H := traced t false h
  have HP := (Play.first h).mass_lower
  let v := trace false t
  have hE := h1 M J f s t h hf
  rw [due_restart rfl,add_zero] at hE
  apply le_trans hE (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ HP)
  have hc := h2 M J hC f hf v H hm
  have he := h3 M J f hf v H hm
  have HH := short_trace_bound t h rfl
  apply (h4 M J f s t h rfl).trans
  change v.flatFee billOf ≤ v.flatFee upperFare at HH
  change v.flatFee billOf+coldFee v ≤ _
  linarith [d_pos j]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.CastShow.scale_drought
statement:
private lemma scale_drought (m : ℝ) (hm : 0 < m) (h : m ≤ 1) :
    m*drought m ≤ 4 ∧ m*(drought m)^2 ≤ 4
proof:
:= by
  have hh' : drought m= -log m := max_eq_left (by linarith [log_nonpos hm.le h])
  let x := drought m
  have heq : m= (exp x)⁻¹ := by unfold x; rw [hh',exp_neg,inv_inv,exp_log hm]
  have H : x^2 /4 ≤ exp x := by
    have h0 : exp x=(exp (x/2))^2 := by rw [pow_two,←exp_add]; ring_nf
    have hi := add_one_le_exp (x/2)
    rw [h0]
    nlinarith [show 0 ≤ x from drought_pos m]
  have HH := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left H hm.le
  have Hx : m*exp x=1 := by rw [heq,inv_mul_cancel₀ (exp_pos x).ne']
  change m*x≤4 ∧ m*x^2≤4
  constructor
  · nlinarith [mul_nonneg hm.le (sq_nonneg (x-1))]
  linarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.CastShow.grossDry
statement:
lemma grossDry :
    ∀ᶠ j : ℕ in atTop, ∀ M J : ℕ, ∀ f : Grid M → ℝ,
      (∀ x, f x ≤ exp (height j)) →
      let s
proof:
:= beginPlay f false
      ∀ t : Play j M s, t.Follows J f → s.mass ≤ 1/Thermal.H j →
        yieldA t ≤ 10^152*height j := by
  filter_upwards [cost_overall,chill_descendants,hpoly 1 1] with j h1 h2 h3 M J f hf s t h hm
  have H := h1 _ _ f s t h hf
  rw [due_restart rfl,add_zero] at H
  apply H.trans
  let m := s.mass; let d := height j; let a := Thermal.H j
  have hh : 0 ≤ m := (Play.first h).mass_lower
  have ha : 1 ≤ a := H_ge _
  have hd : 1 ≤ d := one_le_pow₀ (by norm_num)
  have hp : a ≤ d := by simpa using h3
  have hz : 0 < a := by linarith
  change m≤1/a at hm
  have hi : m*a ≤ 1 := (le_div_iff₀ hz).mp hm
  have hr : m ≤ 1 := by nlinarith
  change m*_ ≤ 10^152*d
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hh with hh|hh
  · rw [←hh,zero_mul]; positivity
  apply le_trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (h2 M J f s t h rfl rfl hh) hh.le)
  let x := drought m
  change m*(10^150*(a+1+x)*(d+2+x)) ≤ _
  have he : m*x ≤ 4 ∧ m*x^2 ≤ 4 := scale_drought m hh hr
  nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hi (show 0 ≤ d by linarith),mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right he.1
    (show 0 ≤ a by linarith),mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right he.1 (show 0 ≤ d by linarith)]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Capture.leak_gate
proof:
:= by
  have hi : side i ^2 ≤ amp i main := (strength_bounds main (side_pos _) (side_le _)).2.2
  have he' := side_le n
  have he := side_pos n
  have hs : side (offset i n) = side 16 * side i^2*side n^2 := by simp [offset,side,pow_add,pow_mul]
  have hP : side 16 ≤ 1/128 := by norm_num [side]
  have hQ : 2^n*side n=(1:ℝ) := by rw [mul_comm,side_card]
  rw [hs]
  have hn' : side 16*side i^2 ≤ amp i main/128 := by
    calc
      _ ≤ (1/128)*amp i main := mul_le_mul hP hi (sq_nonneg _) (by norm_num)
      _ = _ := by ring
  constructor
  · refine le_trans (mul_le_of_le_one_right (mul_nonneg (side_pos _).le (sq_nonneg _)) ?_) hn'; nlinarith
  calc
    _ = side n*(side 16*side i^2) := by
        rw [show 2^n * (side 16*side i^2*side n^2) =
            (2^n * side n)*(side n*(side 16*side i^2)) by ring,hQ,one_mul]
    _ ≤ _ := by gcongr

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Capture.boundary_leak
statement:
private lemma boundary_leak (p : Node) (hp : p.ok M) (F g : Grid M → ℝ)
    (hF : ∀ x, 0 ≤ g x ∧ |F x| ≤ g x) (hG : expU F=0) (L : ℝ)
    (he : expU (fun x => if x∈p.block M then 0 else g x) ≤ L*p.len) :
    (p.dice M).Ex F ≤ L
proof:
:= by
  let f (x : Grid M) := if x∈p.block M then F x else 0
  let g' (x : Grid M) := if x∈p.block M then 0 else g x
  have hE (x : Grid M) : f x ≤ F x+g' x := by
    unfold f g'; split_ifs
    · rw [add_zero]
    · linarith [(abs_le.mp (hF x).2).1]
  have hX : expU f ≤ L*p.len := by
    apply le_trans (b:=expU (fun x => F x+g' x))
    · rw [expU_ex,expU_ex]; apply Ex_mono _ hE
    rw [expU_add,hG,zero_add]; exact he
  have hh : (p.dice M).Ex F = expU f / p.len := by
    rw [← avg_ex hp,avg]; rw [div_eq_inv_mul,smul_eq_mul]
    congr 2
  rw [hh]
  exact (div_le_iff₀ p.len_pos).mpr hX

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Capture.append_choose
statement:
theorem append_choose (main : Bool) (i : ℕ) {q : Scene M}
    (hp : q.here.valid) (he : q.here.lev < M) (ha : 0 ≤ q.wage) (hn : 0 < q.norm)
    (hm : 0 < q.mass) (hM : q.mass ≤ 2*q.norm) (hE : ¬ hazard q main i)
    (D : Chart M) (hD : D.Sound)
    (x : Grid M) (hx : intense main q (side i) x)
    (hX : ¬ atReach D.items (D.wide+band q.here i (offset i D.size)) x) :
    ∃ C : Chart M, C.items=insert x D.items ∧ D.size+1=C.size ∧
      C.wide=D.wide+band q.here i (offset i D.size) ∧ C.Sound ∧
      flex q main C.refs + price main i ≤ flex q main D.refs
proof:
:= by
  let r := offset i D.size
  let p := band q.here i r
  let a := amp i main; let t := a/128
  let P := tracker q main; let U := q.here.dice M
  have hR : 0 ≤ p := by unfold p band; positivity
  have h₀ : 0 < a := amp_pos _ _
  have hT : 0 < t := by unfold t; positivity
  have h₁ : a ≤ 1 := amp_hi _ _
  obtain ⟨g,hg,f,hf,hY,hZ,hW⟩ := masked_bias main x hp he ha hn hm hM hx hE r (leak_gate i D.size main).1
  let B := D.refs
  let Y (z y : Grid M) := f y * (g z * chi x y).re
  let L (z y : Grid M) := 1+t*Y z y
  let C : Chart M := ⟨fun z y => B z y*L z y, insert x D.items, D.wide+p⟩
  have HT (z y) : |Y z y| ≤ 1 := by
    unfold Y; rw [abs_mul]
    have hfy : |f y| ≤ 1 := by simpa only [abs_of_nonneg (hY y).1] using (hY y).2
    have hgy : |(g z * chi x y).re| ≤ 1 :=
      (Complex.abs_re_le_norm _).trans (by rw [norm_mul,norm_chi,mul_one]; exact hg _)
    exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hfy (abs_nonneg _)).trans (by simpa using hgy)
  have HF (z y) : 1/2 ≤ L z y ∧ L z y ≤ 2 := by
    unfold L t; rcases abs_le.mp (HT z y) with ⟨hh1,hh2⟩; constructor <;> nlinarith
  have HH (z) :
      x∉D.items ∧ tinted C.items C.wide (C.refs z) := by
    convert tinted_extend _ _ _ _ _ (hD.radius z) hf hD.bound hR
      x hX ((t:ℂ)*g z) using 2
    · dsimp only [C,B,L,Y]
      funext y; rw [mul_assoc (a:=(t:ℂ)),Complex.re_ofReal_mul]; ring
  have HX : C.size=D.size+1 := Finset.card_insert_of_notMem (HH 0).1
  have HL : C.Sound := by
    constructor
    · exact add_nonneg hD.bound hR
    · intro z y
      rcases HF z y with ⟨hh1,hh2⟩
      rcases hD.total z y with ⟨HE1,HE2⟩
      have he := side_pos D.size
      rw [HX, side_succ,pow_succ]
      unfold C B
      dsimp only
      constructor <;> nlinarith
    intro z; exact (HH z).2
  refine ⟨C,rfl,HX.symm,rfl,HL,?_⟩
  have HE (z : Grid M) : log (normQ q C.refs z) - log (normQ q B z) ≤ t*(a/128) := by
    have hv (y) : |B z y*Y z y| ≤ 2^D.size * f y := by
      have he : 0 ≤ B z y := ((Chart.Sound.pos D hD) _ _).le
      have hM := hY y
      unfold Y; simp_rw [abs_mul,abs_of_nonneg he, abs_of_nonneg hM.1]
      rw [← mul_assoc]
      refine le_trans (mul_le_of_le_one_right (mul_nonneg he hM.1) ?_) ?_
      · exact (Complex.abs_re_le_norm _).trans (by rw [norm_mul,norm_chi,mul_one]; exact hg _)
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hD.total _ _).2 hM.1
    have hh : U.Ex (fun y => B z y*Y z y) ≤ 2^D.size * side r := by
      apply boundary_leak _ ⟨hp,he.le⟩ _ (fun y => 2^D.size*f y)
        (fun i => ⟨by have hx := (hY i).1; positivity,hv i⟩)
      · unfold Y B; simp_rw [← mul_assoc]
        exact tinted_cancel (tinted_mul (hD.radius z) hf) hX _
      · rw [expU_ex]; rw [expU_ex] at hZ
        simp_rw [show ∀ x : Grid M, (if x∈q.here.block M then (0:ℝ) else 2^D.size*f x) =
          2^D.size*(if x∈q.here.block M then 0 else f x) from fun x => by split_ifs <;> ring, Ex_lmul]
        apply le_trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hZ (by positivity))
        exact le_of_eq (by ring)
    have hn : normQ q C.refs z=normQ q B z+t* U.Ex (fun y => B z y*Y z y) := by
      change U.Ex _ = U.Ex _ + _
      rw [← Ex_lmul,← Ex_add]
      congr 1; funext i
      change B z i*(1+t*Y z i) = _
      ring
    have hG : side D.size ≤ normQ q B z :=
      le_trans (Ex_const U _).ge (Ex_mono U fun i => (hD.total _ _).1)
    have h₃ : 0 < normQ q B z := normQ_pos _ _ (Chart.Sound.pos D hD) _
    have h₄ : 0 < normQ q C.refs z := normQ_pos _ _ (Chart.Sound.pos C HL) _
    rw [← log_div h₄.ne' h₃.ne']
    apply le_trans (Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (div_pos h₄ h₃))
    have hl : 2^D.size * side r ≤ side D.size*(a/128) := (leak_gate _ _ main).2
    refine sub_le_iff_le_add.mpr ((div_le_iff₀ h₃).mpr ?_)
    nlinarith [hh.trans (hl.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hG (by positivity : 0 ≤ a/128)))]
  have h₃ : t*(a/8) - 2*t^2 ≤ P.Ex (fun i => log (L i.2 i.1)) := by
    let W (i : Grid M × Grid M) := Y i.2 i.1
    have hi (i : Grid M × Grid M) :
        t*W i - 2*t^2 ≤ log (L i.2 i.1) := by
      have hW := HT i.2 i.1
      have hX : |t* W i| ≤ t := by
        rw [abs_mul,abs_of_nonneg hT.le]
        exact mul_le_of_le_one_right hT.le hW
      have hF : log (1+t*W i) ≥ t*W i -2*(t*W i)^2 :=
        log_shift_bound _ (hX.trans (by unfold t; linarith))
      change _ ≤ log (1+t*W i)
      have hE := pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) hX 2; rw [sq_abs] at hE
      linarith
    have HT := P.Ex_mono hi
    rw [Ex_sub,Ex_lmul,Ex_const] at HT
    change a/8 ≤ P.Ex W at hW
    nlinarith
  unfold flex
  let delta := fun (F : ProductRef M) (i : Grid M × Grid M) => log (normQ q F i.2)-log (F i.2 i.1)
  have HX (i : Grid M × Grid M) :
      delta C.refs i+log (L i.2 i.1) ≤ delta B i+t*(a/128) := by
    unfold delta
    have heq : C.refs i.2 i.1=B i.2 i.1*L i.2 i.1 := rfl
    rw [heq,Real.log_mul ((Chart.Sound.pos D hD) _ _).ne'
      (lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<1/2) (HF _ _).1).ne']
    linarith [HE i.2]
  have He := Ex_mono P HX
  rw [Ex_add,Ex_add,Ex_const] at He
  unfold price
  change _+ P.Ex (delta C.refs)+ a^2/2048 ≤ _ + P.Ex (delta D.refs)
  unfold t B at *
  nlinarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Capture.atReach_neg
statement:
lemma atReach_neg {d : Finset (Grid M)} {r : ℝ} {x : Grid M} (h : atReach d r x) :
    atReach d r (-x)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i,h1,h2⟩ := h
  exact ⟨-i,enclosed_neg h1,by rw [show -x- -i= -(x-i) by ring,rad_even]; exact h2⟩

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Capture.tinted_mul
statement:
lemma tinted_mul {d : Finset (Grid M)} {r s : ℝ} {f g : Grid M → ℝ} (hf : tinted d r f)
    (hg : limitR g s) : tinted d (r+s) (fun i => f i*g i)
proof:
:= by
  intro i hi
  simp only [Complex.ofReal_mul]
  rw [fc_prod]
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero; intro j _
  by_cases h : atReach d r j
  · obtain ⟨v,hv,H⟩ := h
    have hX : s < rad (i-j) := by
      by_contra! he; apply hi; refine ⟨v,hv,?_⟩
      have hZ := rad_add (i-j) (j-v); rw [sub_add_sub_cancel] at hZ; linarith
    rw [hg _ hX,mul_zero]
  rw [hf j h,zero_mul]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Capture.tinted_cancel
statement:
lemma tinted_cancel {d : Finset (Grid M)} {r : ℝ} {f : Grid M → ℝ} (hf : tinted d r f)
    {i : Grid M} (hh : ¬ atReach d r i) (c : ℂ) :
    expU (fun x => f x*(c*chi i x).re)=0
proof:
:= by
  have H : c* fc (fun x => (↑(f x):ℂ)) (-i) = 0 := by
    rw [hf (-i) (fun h => hh (by simpa using atReach_neg h)),mul_zero]
  unfold fc at H
  rw [expU_cx,← Cx_lmul] at H
  have HE := congrArg Complex.re H
  simp_rw [re_Cx,neg_neg,mul_left_comm c, Complex.re_ofReal_mul,← expU_ex,
    Complex.zero_re] at HE
  exact HE

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Capture.tinted_one
statement: lemma tinted_one (d : Finset (Grid M)) {r : ℝ} (h : 0 ≤ r) : tinted d r (fun _ => 1)
proof:
:= by
  intro i hi
  have hn : ¬ enclosed d 1 i := by
    intro H; apply hi; exact ⟨i,H,by simp [rad,h]⟩
  simp only [Complex.ofReal_one]; exact spanned_one _ _ hn

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Capture.tinted_extend
statement:
lemma tinted_extend (f g : Grid M → ℝ) (d : Finset (Grid M)) (r s : ℝ) (hf : tinted d r f)
    (hg : limitR g s) (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hs : 0 ≤ s)
    (i : Grid M) (hi : ¬ atReach d (r+s) i) (c : ℂ) :
    i∉d ∧ tinted (insert i d) (r+s)
      (fun x => f x*(1+g x*(c*chi i x).re))
proof:
:= by
  have hx : i∉d := fun H => hi ⟨i,enclosed_mem _ H,by simp [rad]; linarith⟩
  let F : Grid M → ℂ := fun x => (f x * g x:ℝ)
  have Hf : ∀ x, ¬ atReach d (r+s) x → fc F x=0 := tinted_mul hf hg
  refine ⟨hx,?_⟩
  intro x hh
  have H (p : Grid M) (h : ¬ atReach (insert i d) (r+s) x)
      (j : ℤ) (hj : |j| ≤ 1) (heq : x=p+j•i) :
      ¬ atReach d (r+s) p := by
    intro hL
    obtain ⟨u,hu,hb⟩ := hL
    apply h
    refine ⟨u+j•i,enclosed_insert hx hu j (by simpa using hj),?_⟩
    rw [heq]; simpa only [add_sub_add_right_eq_sub] using hb
  have hX : ¬ atReach d (r+s) x := H x hh 0 (by norm_num) (by simp)
  have hA : ¬ atReach d r x := by
    rintro ⟨p,hp,hb⟩
    exact hX ⟨p,hp,by linarith⟩
  have hB : ¬ atReach d (r+s) (x-i) := H _ hh 1 (by norm_num) (by simp)
  have hC : ¬ atReach d (r+s) (x+i) := H _ hh (-1) (by norm_num) (by simp)
  have he (x) :
    (↑(f x * (1 + g x *(c*chi i x).re)):ℂ) = (↑(f x):ℂ)+F x*((c*chi i x).re) := by
    unfold F; push_cast; ring
  simp_rw [he,fc_add,hf x hA]
  have ht := expand_one_step F c i x
  rw [Hf x hX,Hf (x-i) hB,Hf (x+i) hC] at ht
  have h₁ (x) : F x*(1+(↑((c*chi i x).re):ℂ))=F x+F x*((c*chi i x).re) := by ring
  simp_rw [h₁,fc_add,Hf x hX] at ht
  exact ht.trans (by ring)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Capture.Chart.classic_sound

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Capture.strength_bounds
statement:
lemma strength_bounds (b : Bool) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (h : r ≤ 1) :

proof:
:= by

  cases b <;> simp only [strength, Bool.false_eq_true,↓reduceIte] <;> exact ⟨by positivity,by linarith,by linarith⟩

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Capture.amp_pos

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Capture.scalar_series
statement:
lemma scalar_series (s : Scene M) (A : Form M) (u : Grid M) :
    scalar s u = ∑ z, fz s.here s.wage s.norm A u z
proof:
:= by
  unfold fz scalar
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]; refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i hi => ?_
  unfold omegaObs; simp_rw [Complex.ofReal_mul,mul_right_comm
    ((wt s.here s.wage s.norm i):ℂ) _ (chi u i)]
  rw [← Finset.mul_sum,← Complex.ofReal_sum,(channel A i).total]; simp

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Capture.strong_sum
statement:
lemma strong_sum (s : Scene M) (b : Bool) (x : Grid M)
    (ha : 0 ≤ s.wage) (hb : 0 < s.norm) :
    magnitude b s x ≤ ∑ z, ‖fz s.here s.wage s.norm (optic s b) x z‖
proof:
:= by
  cases b
  · change ‖scalar s x‖ ≤ _
    rw [scalar_series s (optic s false)]; exact norm_sum_le _ _
  · exact energyZ_le s.here ha hb.le _ _

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Capture.aim_identity
statement:
private lemma aim_identity (s : Scene M) (b : Bool) (i : Grid M) (main : Bool)
    (v : Grid M → ℂ) (hp : s.here.valid) (hh : s.here.lev < M)
    (ha : 0 ≤ s.wage) (hb : 0 < s.norm) (hm : 0 < s.mass) :
    let q
proof:
:= s.smaller b
    ∑ z, (v z*fz q.here q.wage q.norm (optic q main) i z).re =
      (2*s.mass/s.norm)*(tracker s main).Ex (fun w =>
        aim (p:=s.here) b w.1*(v w.2*chi i w.1).re) := by
  classical
  intro q
  let A := optic s main
  let L := channel A; let P := s.actor
  let H := fun y : Grid M => aim (p:=s.here) b y
  let c := 2*s.mass/s.norm
  have HE (z : Grid M) :
      (v z*fz q.here q.wage q.norm (optic q main) i z).re =
        ∑ y, c * (P y * (L y z * (H y*(v z*chi i y).re))) := by
    unfold fz; rw [Finset.mul_sum,Complex.re_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun y hy => ?_
    have Hi : omegaObs q.here q.wage q.norm (optic q main) y z =
        c*H y*P y*L y z := by
      unfold omegaObs
      change wt (s.here.child b) s.wage s.norm y*L y z = _
      unfold H Procedure.Capture.aim c P
      rw [actor_def ⟨hp,hh.le⟩ ha hm y,wt_half hp hh]
      split_ifs
      · unfold mass wt; unfold mass at hm; field_simp
      · simp
    rw [Hi,mul_left_comm,Complex.re_ofReal_mul]; ring
  unfold tracker; rw [Ex_withNext]; simp only [HE,← Finset.mul_sum,Ex]
  congr 1
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  dsimp only [c,P,H,A,L]
  simp_rw [Finset.mul_sum]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Capture.criterion_bias
statement:
lemma criterion_bias (s : Scene M) (main : Bool) (k : ℕ) (x : Grid M)
    (hp : s.here.valid) (hh : s.here.lev < M) (ha : 0 ≤ s.wage)
    (hx : 0 < s.norm) (hm : 0 < s.mass) (he : intense main s (side k) x) :
    ∃ b : Bool, ∃ f : Grid M → ℂ, (∀ z, ‖f z‖ ≤ 1) ∧
      amp k main /2 ≤ (s.mass/s.norm)*(tracker s main).Ex (fun w =>
        aim (p:=s.here) b w.1 * (f w.2*chi x w.1).re)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨b,hL⟩ := he
  let q := s.smaller b
  let v := fun z => fz q.here q.wage q.norm (optic q main) x z
  let f := fun z => polar (v z)
  have HH := aim_identity s b x main f hp hh ha hx hm
  have He (z : Grid M) : (f z*v z).re=‖v z‖ := polar_identity _
  have H : amp k main ≤ ∑ z, ‖v z‖ := hL.trans (strong_sum q main x ha hx)
  refine ⟨b,f,fun z => polar_unit _,?_⟩
  change ∑ z,(f z*v z).re = _ at HH
  simp_rw [He,mul_div_assoc] at HH
  nlinarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Capture.test_one
statement:
private lemma test_one (g z : ℂ) (hg : ‖g‖ ≤ 1) (hz : ‖z‖ = 1) :
    |(g*z).re| ≤ 1
proof:
:= (Complex.abs_re_le_norm _).trans
      (by rw [norm_mul,hz,mul_one]; exact hg)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Capture.expensive_intent
statement:
lemma expensive_intent {s : Scene M} (main : Bool) {k : ℕ} {x : Grid M}
    (hp : s.here.valid) (hh : s.here.lev < M) (ha : 0 ≤ s.wage)
    (hx : 0 < s.norm) (hm : 0 < s.mass) (he : intense main s (side k) x) :
    amp k main /2 ≤ s.mass/s.norm
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨b,f,hf,hb⟩ := criterion_bias _ _ _ _ hp hh ha hx hm he
  apply hb.trans
  apply mul_le_of_le_one_right (by positivity)
  refine le_trans (Ex_mono _ (g:=fun _ => 1) fun i => ?_) (Ex_const _ _).le
  unfold aim; split_ifs
  · rw [one_mul]; exact (le_abs_self _).trans (test_one _ _ (hf _) (norm_chi _ _))
  norm_num

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Capture.edge_prob
statement:
lemma edge_prob {s : Scene M} {i : ℕ} (hm : 0 < s.mass) (hn : 0 < s.norm)
    (hp : s.here.ok M) (h : 0 ≤ s.wage) :
    s.mass/s.norm * s.actor.prob (fun x => lanes s.here i M ∧ flanked s.here i x)
      = edgeW s i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [prob_eq,edgeW]
  by_cases hh : lanes s.here i M
  · simp only [hh,ite_true,true_and]; rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun x hx => ?_
    split_ifs with H
    · rw [actor_def hp h hm]
      unfold wt mass; unfold mass at hm
      field_simp
    exact mul_zero _
  simp [hh]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Capture.masked_bias
statement:
theorem masked_bias {s : Scene M} {i : ℕ} (main : Bool) (x : Grid M)
    (hp : s.here.valid) (he : s.here.lev < M)
    (ha : 0 ≤ s.wage) (hn : 0 < s.norm) (hm : 0 < s.mass) (hM : s.mass ≤ 2*s.norm)
    (h : intense main s (side i) x)
    (hB : ¬ hazard s main i) (r : ℕ) (hr : side r ≤ amp i main /128) :
    ∃ g : Grid M → ℂ, (∀ z, ‖g z‖ ≤ 1) ∧ ∃ f : Grid M → ℝ,
      limitR f (band s.here i r) ∧ (∀ y, 0 ≤ f y ∧ f y ≤ 1) ∧
      expU (fun y => if y∈s.here.block M then 0 else f y) ≤ s.here.len*side r ∧
      amp i main /8 ≤ (tracker s main).Ex (fun y => f y.1*(g y.2*chi x y.1).re)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨b,g,hg,hG⟩ := criterion_bias s main i x hp he ha hn hm h
  obtain ⟨f,hf,hN,hE,hP⟩ := make_mask (M:=M) s.here hp he b i r
  let p := s.here
  let a := amp i main; let v := s.mass/s.norm
  let P := tracker s main
  let w (y : Grid M × Grid M) := (g y.2*chi x y.1).re
  let G (y : Grid M) := lanes p i M ∧ flanked p i y
  let F (y : Grid M × Grid M) := f y.1*w y
  have Hq : v*P.prob (fun y => G y.1) ≤ a/128 := by
    rw [← prob_send P Prod.fst G,show P.send Prod.fst=s.actor from send_fst_withNext _ _]
    rw [edge_prob hm hn ⟨hp,he.le⟩ ha]
    exact le_of_not_ge hB
  have Hw (i) : |w i| ≤ 1 := test_one _ _ (hg _) (norm_chi _ _)
  have H : v * P.Ex (fun i => aim (p:=p) b i.1*w i) ≤
      v* (P.Ex F + P.prob (fun i => G i.1) + side r) := by
    apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (by positivity)
    rw [← Ex_const P (side r)]; unfold prob
    rw [← Ex_add,← Ex_add]
    apply Ex_mono_mem; rintro ⟨y,z⟩ h
    have h0 : y∈p.block M := by
      have hh : 0 < s.actor y := pos_of_mul_pos_left h ((channel (optic s main) y).nonneg z)
      exact piece_support ⟨hp,he.le⟩ (actor_def ⟨hp,he.le⟩ ha hm) _ hh
    change aim (p:=p) b y*w (y,z) ≤ f y*w (y,z)+(@ite ℝ (G y) (Classical.propDecidable _) 1 0)+side r
    have hi := abs_le.mp (Hw (y,z))
    have hi' := hN y
    split_ifs with H
    · unfold aim; split_ifs <;> nlinarith [side_pos r]
    have He : |aim (p:=p) b y-f y| ≤ side r := hE y h0 H
    have hY := (mul_le_mul He (Hw (y,z)) (abs_nonneg _) (side_pos r).le)
    rw [← abs_mul,mul_one] at hY
    have hx := (abs_le.mp hY).2
    linarith
  refine ⟨g,hg,f,hf,hN,hP,?_⟩
  have hv : v ≤ 2 := (div_le_iff₀ hn).mpr hM
  have hp' : 0 < v := by unfold v; positivity
  change a/2 ≤ _ at hG
  change _ ≤ v * P.Ex (fun i => aim (p:=p) b i.1*w i) at hG
  have HH : 0 < a := amp_pos _ _
  change a/8 ≤ P.Ex F
  change side r ≤ a/128 at hr
  nlinarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Capture.speed_pos
statement: lemma speed_pos (p : Node) (i n : ℕ) : 0 ≤ speed p i n
proof: := by unfold speed band; positivity

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Capture.speed_le
statement:
lemma speed_le {p q : Node} (h : p.lev ≤ q.lev) {i n m : ℕ} (he : n ≤ m) :
    speed p i n ≤ speed q i m
proof:
:= by
  unfold speed band offset
  gcongr; norm_num

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Capture.widen_done
statement:
lemma widen_done (main : Bool) (i : ℕ) {q : Scene M}
    (hp : q.here.valid) (he : q.here.lev < M) (ha : 0 ≤ q.wage) (hn : 0 < q.norm)
    (hm : 0 < q.mass) (hM : q.mass ≤ 2*q.norm)
    (c : Chart M) (h : c.Sound) : ∃ d, Widen q i main c d
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let b := Fintype.card (Grid M)
  suffices H : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ c : Chart M, b-c.size=n → c.Sound →
      ∃ d, Widen q i main c d from H _ _ rfl h
  intro n; induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | h n ih =>
  intro c heq h
  by_cases hv : ¬ hazard q main i → ∀ x, intense main q (side i) x →
      atReach c.items (c.wide+speed q.here i c.size) x
  · exact ⟨c,h,Finset.Subset.refl _,by simp,id,Or.inl rfl,hv⟩
  push Not at hv
  obtain ⟨hH,x,hx,hB⟩ := hv
  obtain ⟨d,h1,h2,h3,h4,h5⟩ := append_choose _ _ hp he ha hn hm hM hH c h x hx hB
  have hd : b-d.size < n := by
    have H : d.size ≤ b := Finset.card_le_univ _; omega
  obtain ⟨t,h₁,h₂,h₃,h₄,h₅,h₆⟩ := ih _ hd d rfl h4
  refine ⟨t,h₁,Finset.Subset.trans ?_ h₂,?_,fun hk => h₄ ?_,Or.inr
    (expensive_intent main hp he ha hn hm hx), h₆⟩
  · rw [h1]; exact Finset.subset_insert _ _
  · rw [← h2] at h₃; push_cast at *
    linarith
  unfold localSize at *; rw [h3,← h2]; push_cast
  have hi' : speed q.here i c.size ≤ speed q.here i (c.size+1) := speed_le le_rfl (by omega)
  change c.wide+speed q.here i c.size ≤ _
  nlinarith [Nat.cast_nonneg (α:=ℝ) c.size]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Capture.zoom_spec
proof:
:= by
  unfold zoom; split
  · exact Classical.choose_spec _
  · rename_i hF; apply False.elim; apply hF
    obtain ⟨ha,hb,hc,hd,he,hk⟩ := h
    have hS := hd.2.2; unfold enter at hS
    have ht := hd.1.2.2
    exact widen_done main _ hc.within.1 (rooted _ (hk false)).within.2 hc.positive (by linarith) ht
      (by linarith) _ hp

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Capture.buildup_ran
statement:
lemma buildup_ran (i : ℕ) (main : Bool) (q : Chart M) (b : Beat M) (l : List (Beat M)) :
    buildup i main q (b::l) = (zoom b.post i main q).size - (q.size:ℝ) +
      buildup i main (zoom b.post i main q) l
proof: := by simp only [buildup,goal]; ring

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Capture.buildup_total
statement:
lemma buildup_total (s : Scene M) (t : Thread M s) (f : Grid M → ℝ)
    (h : Following j J f t) (main : Bool) (i : ℕ) (C : Chart M) (hC : C.Sound)
    (hn : 0 < s.norm) :
    (amp i main/2*price main i)*(s.here.dice M).Ex (fun x => buildup i main C (t.stream x)) ≤
      s.mass/s.norm*chartDebt s j C main
proof:
:= by
  induction t generalizing C with
  | blank s =>
    have hh := rooted _ h
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hh.mass_lower with H|H
    · simp [stream,buildup,goal,← H,Ex_const]
    have hF := flex_nonneg _ ⟨hh.within,hh.positive⟩ H main _ (Chart.Sound.pos C hC)
    have hp : 0 ≤ s.mass/s.norm*chartDebt s j C main := mul_nonneg (by positivity)
      (add_nonneg hF (inv_nonneg.mpr (minimum_pos j).le))
    simpa only [stream,buildup,goal,sub_self,Ex_const,mul_zero] using hp
  | ran s q k ih =>
    let Z := zoom q i main C
    let A := amp i main; let b := price main i
    let G (u : Chart M) (t : Scene M) := flex t main u.refs
    let B := (minimumT j)⁻¹
    let v := step q; let m := (keep s q).snip
    have hm' := pre_pos h
    have hD : Widen q i main C Z := zoom_spec _ hC i main h
    have hd := debt_at h
    rw [stream_branch k h (fun l _ => buildup i main C l)]
    have he b' :
