        (q.smaller b').norm = q.norm := rfl
    obtain ⟨ha,hb,hc,hf,ht,hk⟩ := h
    have hs' : ReadyAt s := ⟨ha.within,ha.positive⟩
    have hq' : ReadyAt q := ⟨hc.within,hc.positive⟩
    have hQ : 0 < q.norm := by rw [hb.1.flat]; exact hn
    have hq := hf.1.2.2
    have hv : q.here.lev < M := (rooted _ (hk false)).within.2
    have hF := flex_down main q hc.within.1 hv hc.positive hq Z.refs (Chart.Sound.pos _ hD.sonic)
    have hS := flex_keep main hb.1 hs' hq' hm' _ (Chart.Sound.pos _ hC)
    have hK : m.probs true * s.mass=q.mass := (kept_mass hb.1 hs' hq' hm').symm
    have hz : 0 ≤ (Z.size:ℝ)-C.size := by
      apply sub_nonneg.mpr
      exact_mod_cast Finset.card_le_card hD.extend
    have HP : 0 ≤ b := by unfold b price; positivity
    let d := (Z.size:ℝ)-C.size
    have hP : A/2*b*d ≤ q.mass/q.norm*(b*d) := by
      rcases hD.mass with H|H
      · unfold d; simp [H]
      · rw [mul_assoc]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right H (mul_nonneg HP hz)
    let D (u) := G Z (q.smaller u)+B
    have hh (u : Bool) :
      (A/2*b)* ((q.smaller u).here.dice M).Ex (fun x => buildup i main Z ((k u).stream x)) ≤
        (q.smaller u).mass/q.norm * D u := ih u (hk u) Z hD.sonic hQ
    let U := uniform Bool
    let x (u : Bool) := ((q.smaller u).here.dice M).Ex (fun x => buildup i main Z ((k u).stream x))

    have HI : U.Ex (fun z => ((q.smaller z).mass/q.norm)*D z) ≤
        q.mass/q.norm*(G Z q +B) := by
      have He := output_split q hc.within.1 hv hc.positive hq (fun z => q.norm⁻¹*D z)
      have HM : (step q).probs.Ex D ≤ G Z q+B := by
        unfold D; rw [Ex_add,Ex_const]
        exact add_le_add_left hF B
      rw [Ex_lmul] at He
      calc
        _ = q.mass*(q.norm⁻¹ * v.probs.Ex D) := by
          unfold U v; rw [He]; congr 1; funext z; ring
        _ ≤ _ := by
          rw [← mul_assoc,← div_eq_mul_inv]; exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left HM (by positivity)
    have HS :
        (A/2*b)*(U.Ex fun z => d+x z) ≤ q.mass/q.norm*(b*d+G Z q+B) := by
      rw [Ex_add (f:=fun _ => d),Ex_const,mul_add,← Ex_lmul]
      have HH := U.Ex_mono hh
      change U.Ex (fun z => A/2*b*x z) ≤ _ at HH
      apply le_trans (add_le_add hP (HH.trans HI)); rw [mul_add,mul_add]
      exact le_of_eq (by ring)
    simp_rw [buildup_ran,Ex_add,Ex_const]
    have hhT : (A/2*b)*(d+U.Ex x) ≤ q.mass/q.norm*(b*d+G Z q+B) := by
      rw [Ex_add (f:=fun _=>d),Ex_const] at HS; exact HS

    have hg3 :
        q.mass/q.norm*(b*d+G Z q+B) ≤ s.mass/s.norm*(G C s+B) := by
      rw [hb.1.flat,← hK]
      have hx : b*d + G Z q ≤ G C q := by
        have hi := hD.paid; change G Z q + b*d ≤ G C q at hi; linarith
      have ht : m.probs true*(b*d+G Z q+B) ≤ G C s+B := by
        change m.probs.entropy ≤ B*m.probs false at hd
        change m.probs true*G C q ≤ G C s+m.probs.entropy at hS
        have HQ : m.probs true + m.probs false = 1 := by simpa only [Fintype.sum_bool] using m.probs.total
        nlinarith [m.probs.nonneg true,show B * (m.probs true + m.probs false) = B by rw [HQ]; ring]
      rw [mul_div_assoc,mul_comm (m.probs true),mul_assoc (a:=s.mass/s.norm)]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ht (div_nonneg hm'.le hn.le)
    change A/2*b*(d+U.Ex x) ≤ s.mass/s.norm*(G C s+B)
    exact hhT.trans hg3

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Capture.utility_bounds
statement:
lemma utility_bounds (main : Bool) (k x : ℂ) (hk : ‖k‖ ≤ 1) (hx : ‖x‖=1) :
    |utility main k x| ≤ 3
proof:
:= by
  have hi : |(k*x).re| ≤ 1 := (Complex.abs_re_le_norm _).trans (by rw [norm_mul,hx,mul_one]; exact hk)
  obtain ⟨h1,h2⟩ := abs_le.mp hi
  rw [abs_le]
  unfold utility; split <;>
  · constructor <;> nlinarith [norm_nonneg k]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Capture.utility_diff
statement:
lemma utility_diff (main : Bool) (k x y : ℂ) (hk : ‖k‖ ≤ 1) :
    |utility main k x- utility main k y| ≤ 2* ‖x-y‖
proof:
:= by
  have he : |(k*x).re-(k*y).re| ≤ ‖x-y‖ := by
    rw [← Complex.sub_re,←mul_sub]
    exact (Complex.abs_re_le_norm _).trans (by
      rw [norm_mul]; exact mul_le_of_le_one_left (norm_nonneg _) hk)
  cases main
  · change |(k*x).re-(k*y).re| ≤ _; linarith [norm_nonneg (x-y)]
  change |2*_ -_-(2*_ -_)| ≤ _
  rw [sub_sub_sub_cancel_right,←mul_sub,abs_mul,abs_of_nonneg (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)≤2)]
  linarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Capture.income
statement:
private lemma income (main : Bool) (s : Scene M) (c : Grid M → ℂ) (i : Grid M) :
    let A
proof:
:= optic s main
    (sales main s c i) = ∑ z : Grid M, let f := fz s.here s.wage s.norm A i z
                                       let H := hist s (channel A) z
                                       if main then 2 * (c z*f).re - H*‖c z‖^2
                                         else (c z*f).re := by
  intro A
  unfold sales rung
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun z _ => ?_
  let l := fun x : Grid M => addMass s (channel A) x z
  have hi : (c z * fz s.here s.wage s.norm A i z).re =
      ∑ x : Grid M, l x * (c z * chi i x).re := by
    unfold fz
    rw [Finset.mul_sum,Complex.re_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun x hx => ?_
    rw [mul_left_comm, Complex.re_ofReal_mul]
    rfl
  change ∑ x, l x * utility main _ _ = (if _ then _ else _)
  rw [hi]
  split
  case isTrue he =>
    simp_rw [show ∀ k v : ℂ, utility main k v = 2*(k*v).re-‖k‖^2 from fun _ _ => by simp [he,utility]]
    rw [Finset.mul_sum,show hist s (channel A) z=∑ i, l i from rfl, Finset.sum_mul]
    rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]; exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun _ _ => by ring
  case isFalse he =>
    simp_rw [show ∀ k v : ℂ, utility main k v = (k*v).re from fun _ _ => by simp [he,utility]]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Capture.fz_dry
statement:
private lemma fz_dry (s : Scene M) (i z : Grid M) :
    fz s.here s.wage s.norm 0 i z = (side M:ℂ)*scalar s i
proof:
:= by
  unfold fz omegaObs scalar; simp_rw [no_label,uniform_side,Complex.ofReal_mul,Finset.mul_sum]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun _ _ => by ring

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Capture.seller_limit
statement: private lemma seller_limit (M : ℝ) (f : ℂ) (hf : ‖f‖ ≤ M) : ‖seller M f‖ ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  have hx : 0 ≤ M := le_trans (norm_nonneg _) hf
  unfold seller; rw [norm_div,Complex.norm_real,Real.norm_eq_abs,
    abs_of_nonneg hx,Complex.norm_conj]
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hx with h|h
  · rw [← h,div_zero]; norm_num
  exact (div_le_one h).mpr hf

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Capture.price_upper
statement:
private lemma price_upper (m : ℝ) (f k : ℂ) (hf : ‖f‖ ≤ m) :
    2*(k*f).re - m*‖k‖^2 ≤ ‖f‖^2/m
proof:
:= by
  have hx : 0 ≤ m := le_trans (norm_nonneg _) hf
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hx with h|h
  · have hh : f=0 := norm_le_zero_iff.mp (h ▸ hf)
    simp [←h, hh]
  · have hi : (k*f).re ≤ ‖k‖ * ‖f‖ :=
      (le_abs_self _).trans ((Complex.abs_re_le_norm _).trans (by rw [norm_mul]))
    apply (le_div_iff₀ h).mpr
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (m *‖k‖ - ‖f‖),mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hi h.le]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Capture.seller_eq
statement:
private lemma seller_eq (m : ℝ) (f : ℂ) (hf : ‖f‖ ≤ m) :
    2*(seller m f*f).re - m*‖seller m f‖^2= ‖f‖^2 / m
proof:
:= by
  have hx : 0 ≤ m := le_trans (norm_nonneg _) hf
  unfold seller
  by_cases hm : m = 0
  · subst m; simp
  · rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div,mul_comm (conj f) f,Complex.mul_conj,
      ←Complex.sq_norm,← Complex.ofReal_div,norm_div,Complex.norm_real,
      Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_nonneg hx,Complex.norm_conj,Complex.ofReal_re]
    field_simp; ring

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Capture.test_complete
statement:
theorem test_complete (main : Bool) (s : Scene M) (hp : 0 ≤ s.wage) (hv : 0 ≤ s.norm)
    (i : Grid M) :
    (∀ c : Grid M → ℂ, (∀ z, ‖c z‖ ≤ 1) → sales main s c i ≤ magnitude main s i) ∧
      ∃ c : Grid M → ℂ, (∀ z, ‖c z‖ ≤ 1) ∧ sales main s c i = magnitude main s i
proof:
:= by
  cases main
  case true =>
    let L (z) := Mz s.here s.wage s.norm s.fund.mood z
    let f (z) := fz s.here s.wage s.norm s.fund.mood i z
    have hf z : ‖f z‖ ≤ L z := fz_norm _ hp hv _ _ _
    constructor
    · intro c _; rw [income]
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum; intro j hj; exact price_upper (L j) (f j) _ (hf j)
    refine ⟨fun i => seller (L i) (f i),fun i => seller_limit _ _ (hf i),?_⟩
    rw [income]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => seller_eq (L j) (f j) (hf j)
  case false =>
    let f := scalar s i
    have h1 (c : Grid M → ℂ) :
        sales false s c i = (uniform (Grid M)).Ex (fun z => (c z*f).re) := by
      rw [income]
      change ∑ z : Grid M,(c z*fz s.here s.wage s.norm 0 i z).re= _
      unfold Ex
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun z _ => ?_
      rw [fz_dry,mul_left_comm,Complex.re_ofReal_mul,uniform_side]
    constructor
    · intro c hc
      rw [h1]
      apply le_trans (b:=(uniform (Grid M)).Ex fun _ => ‖f‖)
      · refine Ex_mono _ fun i => ?_
        apply (le_abs_self _).trans ((Complex.abs_re_le_norm _).trans _)
        rw [norm_mul]; exact mul_le_of_le_one_left (norm_nonneg _) (hc i)
      rw [Ex_const]
      exact le_rfl
    refine ⟨fun _ => polar f,fun _ => polar_unit f,?_⟩
    rw [h1,Ex_const]
    exact polar_identity f

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Capture.sup_children
statement:
lemma sup_children (main : Bool) (s : Scene M) (hp : s.here.valid) (h : s.here.lev < M)
    (ha : 0 ≤ s.wage) (hb : 0 ≤ s.norm) (i : Grid M) :
    ∃ b, magnitude main s i ≤ magnitude main (s.smaller b) i
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c,hc,H⟩ := (test_complete main s ha hb i).2
  let T (b : Bool) := sales main (s.smaller b) c i
  have he : T false+T true= 2*sales main s c i := rung_split s hp h _ _
  by_contra! HH
  have h1 (b : Bool) : T b ≤ magnitude main (s.smaller b) i :=
    (test_complete main (s.smaller b) ha hb i).1 _ hc
  linarith [HH true,HH false,h1 true,h1 false]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Capture.normQ_pos
statement:
lemma normQ_pos (s : Scene M) (f : ProductRef M) (h : ∀ i j, 0 < f i j) (z) :
    0 < normQ s f z
proof:
:= by
  let Q := s.here.dice M
  obtain ⟨i,hi,he⟩ := Q.exists_le_Ex (f z)
  exact lt_of_lt_of_le (h z i) he

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Capture.flex_nonneg
statement:
lemma flex_nonneg (s : Scene M) (h : ReadyAt s) (hm : 0 < s.mass)
    (main : Bool) (f : ProductRef M) (hP : ∀ z y, 0 < f z y) :
    0 ≤ flex s main f
proof:
:= by
  let A := optic s main
  let k := channel A
  let Q := s.actor.withNext k
  let P := s.here.dice M
  have hh (z : Grid M) : 0 < ∑ i, P i * f z i := normQ_pos s _ hP z
  let Hq (z : Grid M) : Law (Grid M) := proportional (fun i => P i*f z i)
    (fun i => mul_nonneg (P.nonneg _) (hP _ _).le) (hh z)
  have hz (i z : Grid M) : Hq z i = P i*f z i / normQ s f z := rfl
  have HV (x : Grid M × Grid M) (hx : 0 < Q x) : 0 < P x.1 := by
    apply (dice_positive h.1).mpr
    apply piece_support h.1 (actor_def h.1 h.2 hm)
    exact pos_of_mul_pos_left hx ((k _).nonneg _)
  have hi := Hcond_compare Q Prod.fst Prod.snd Hq (fun i hi => by
    rw [hz]; exact div_pos (mul_pos (HV i hi) (hP _ _)) (normQ_pos s _ hP _))
  have he (i) (hx : 0 < Q i) :
      -log (Hq i.2 i.1) = levels s+(log (normQ s f i.2)-log (f i.2 i.1)) := by
    rw [hz,Real.log_div (mul_pos (HV i hx) (hP _ _)).ne' (normQ_pos s _ hP _).ne',
        Real.log_mul (HV i hx).ne' (hP _ _).ne']
    have HE := (dice_positive h.1).mp (HV i hx)
    unfold levels P
    rw [dice_apply h.1,ite_eq_left HE,Real.log_mul (side_pos _).ne'
      (inv_pos.mpr s.here.len_pos).ne']
    unfold len; simp_rw [side_pow_two,log_inv,log_pow]
    rw [Nat.cast_sub h.1.2]
    ring
  rw [Ex_congr_mem _ he, Ex_add (f:=fun _ => levels s), Ex_const] at hi
  change 0 ≤ levels s -Q.Hcond Prod.fst Prod.snd + Q.Ex _
  linarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Capture.flex_one
statement:
lemma flex_one (s : Scene M) (main : Bool) :
    flex s main (fun _ _ => 1) = deficit s (channel (optic s main))
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [flex,normQ,Ex_const,log_one,sub_zero,add_zero]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Capture.track_shift
statement:
lemma track_shift {s : Scene M} (main : Bool) {v : Fork M} (he : v.src = s)
    (h : v.TrueLaw) (k : ∀ i, optic (v.dst i) main = optic s main)
    (g : Bool → Grid M × Grid M → ℝ) :
    v.probs.Ex (fun i => (tracker (v.dst i) main).Ex (g i)) =
    (tracker s main).Ex (fun x => g (v.bit x.1) x)
proof:
:= by
  subst s
  unfold tracker
  simp_rw [k,Ex_withNext]
  exact expect_bit h (fun i x => (channel _ x).Ex (fun y => g i (x,y)))

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Capture.flex_keep
statement:
lemma flex_keep (main : Bool) {s q : Scene M} (h : Less s q) (hh : ReadyAt s)
    (hp : ReadyAt q) (hm : 0 < s.mass)
    (f : ProductRef M) (hF : ∀ i j, 0 < f i j) :
    let P
proof:
:= (keep s q).snip.probs
    P true * flex q main f ≤ flex s main f + P.entropy := by
  intro P
  let v := (keep s q).snip
  have he := keep_true h hh hp hm
  let A := optic s main; let k := channel A
  have hX (i : Bool) : optic (v.dst i) main = A := by
    cases i
    · rfl
    change optic q main=optic s main; simp [optic,h.fund]
  have hi (i) : (v.dst i).here=s.here := keep_here h _
  let Z (i : Grid M × Grid M) := log (normQ s f i.2)-log (f i.2 i.1)
  have hv : P.Ex (fun i => flex (v.dst i) main f) ≤ flex s main f + P.entropy := by
    have hi' := track_shift main (v:=v) rfl he hX (fun _ => Z)
    have heq (i z) : normQ (v.dst i) f z = normQ s f z := by unfold normQ; rw [hi]
    have hE' : P.Ex (fun i => deficit (v.dst i) k) ≤ deficit s k + P.entropy := by
      have he := conditioned_balance k v he
      unfold deficit; rw [Ex_sub]; have hz (b) : levels (v.dst b)=levels s := by unfold levels; rw [hi]
      simp_rw [hz,Ex_const]
      have HE := old_entropy_cost v k
      change _+_= s.actor.privateH k at he
      unfold P v at *
      linarith
    have hF (i) : flex (v.dst i) main f =
        deficit (v.dst i) k + (tracker (v.dst i) main).Ex Z := by
      unfold flex; simp_rw [heq,hX]; rfl
    simp_rw [hF,Ex_add]
    change P.Ex _ + v.probs.Ex _ ≤ deficit s k + (tracker s main).Ex Z + _
    rw [hi']
    change _ + (tracker s main).Ex Z ≤ _
    linarith
  rw [Ex,Fintype.sum_bool] at hv
  have hE : 0 ≤ P false * flex (v.dst false) main f := by
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le (P.nonneg false) with H|H; rw [← H,zero_mul]
    exact mul_nonneg H.le <| flex_nonneg _ (other_ok h hh)
      ((true_mass he).mp H) _ _ hF
  exact (le_add_of_nonneg_right hE).trans hv

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Capture.flex_down
statement:
lemma flex_down (main : Bool) (s : Scene M) (hp : s.here.valid) (hh : s.here.lev < M)
    (ha : 0 ≤ s.wage) (hm : 0 < s.mass)
    (f : ProductRef M) (hF : ∀ i j, 0 < f i j) :
    (step s).probs.Ex (fun i => flex (s.smaller i) main f) ≤ flex s main f
proof:
:= by
  let P := tracker s main; let v := step s
  let k := channel (optic s main)
  have hx (i : Bool) : channel (optic (s.smaller i) main) = k := rfl
  let g (x : Grid M × Grid M) := v.bit x.1
  have H := step_true hp hh ha hm
  let q (z : Grid M) (b : Bool) : ℝ := normQ (s.smaller b) f z/(2*normQ s f z)
  have HQ (z i) : 0 < q z i := div_pos (normQ_pos _ _ hF _) (by have := normQ_pos s f hF z; positivity)
  let Q (z : Grid M) : Law Bool :=
    ⟨q z,fun i => (HQ z i).le,by
      rw [Fintype.sum_bool]
      have HE :
          normQ s f z=(normQ (s.smaller false) f z+normQ (s.smaller true) f z)/2 :=
        s.here.dice_child hp hh _
      have hh := normQ_pos s f hF z
      simp only [q]; field_simp; linarith⟩
  have he := Hcond_compare P g Prod.snd Q (fun i _ => HQ _ _)
  have hl (i : Grid M × Grid M) : -log (Q i.2 (g i)) =
      log 2+log (normQ s f i.2)-log (normQ (s.smaller (g i)) f i.2) := by
    change -log (q _ _) = _
    unfold q; have hx := normQ_pos s f hF i.2
    rw [log_div (normQ_pos _ _ hF _).ne' (by positivity),log_mul (by norm_num) hx.ne']; ring
  rw [funext hl] at he
  let D (b : Bool) (x : Grid M × Grid M) :=
    log (normQ (s.smaller b) f x.2)-log (f x.2 x.1)
  have hi : P.Hcond g Prod.snd = sideH v k := rfl
  rw [hi] at he
  have hT :
      v.probs.Ex (fun i => (tracker (s.smaller i) main).Ex (D i)) = P.Ex fun x => D (g x) x :=
    track_shift main (v:=v) rfl H (fun _ => rfl) D
  have hhE : v.probs.Ex (fun b => (s.smaller b).actor.privateH k) =
      s.actor.privateH k-sideH v k := by
    have Hh := conditioned_balance k v H
    change v.probs.Ex (fun b => (s.smaller b).actor.privateH k)+_=s.actor.privateH k at Hh
    linarith
  change v.probs.Ex (fun b => deficit _ k + (tracker _ _).Ex (D b)) ≤ _
  unfold flex deficit
  simp_rw [levels_child s hh, Ex_add v.probs]
  rw [show v.probs.Ex (fun x => _-_) = levels s-log 2-v.probs.Ex
      (fun b => (s.smaller b).actor.privateH k) by rw [Ex_sub (f:=fun _ => levels s-log 2),Ex_const],hT,hhE]
  unfold D at *
  simp_rw [Ex_sub] at *
  change _ ≤ levels s-s.actor.privateH k+(P.Ex _-P.Ex _)
  rw [Ex_add (f:=fun _=>log 2),Ex_const] at he
  linarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Capture.margins
statement: lemma margins (p : Node) (hp : p.valid) : 0 ≤ p.a ∧ p.a+p.len ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold a
  have he : 0 < p.len := p.len_pos
  refine ⟨by positivity,?_⟩
  calc
    _ = ↑(p.ix+1)*p.len := by push_cast; ring
    _ ≤ ↑(2^p.lev:ℕ)*p.len :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (Nat.cast_le.mpr hp) he.le
    _ = _ := by unfold len; push_cast; rw [mul_comm,side_card]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Capture.inner_strip
statement:
lemma inner_strip (p : Node) (b : Bool) (i : ℕ) (x : Grid M)
    (hx : x∈(child p b).block M) (hh : ¬ flanked p i x) :
    let q
proof:
:= child p b; let r := p.len*side (reach i)
    q.a+r ≤ pos x ∧ pos x < q.a+q.len-r := by
  intro q r
  have hi (c : Bool) : ¬ (x∈(strip p i b c).block M) :=
    fun h => hh ⟨_,_,h⟩
  have h1 : (strip p i b false).a=q.a := extreme_left q _
  have h2 (c : Bool) : (strip p i b c).len=r := strip_length _ _ _ _
  have h3 : (strip p i b true).a + r=q.a+q.len := by
    rw [← h2 true]; exact extreme_right _ _
  have Hp : x∈q.block M:=hx
  constructor
  · by_contra! h
    apply hi false
    change pos x∈Ico _ _
    rw [h1,h2]
    exact ⟨Hp.1,h⟩
  · by_contra! h
    apply hi true
    change pos x∈Ico _ _
    rw [h2,h3]; exact ⟨by linarith,Hp.2⟩

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Capture.circle_near
statement:
lemma circle_near (p : Node) (hp : p.valid) (x y : Grid M) (r : ℝ)
    (hr : 0 < r) (hx : p.a+r ≤ pos x) (he : pos x ≤ p.a+p.len-r)
    (hy : Dyadic.diam (x-y)<r) : y∈p.block M
proof:
:= by
  have hp' := margins _ hp
  change p.a ≤ pos y ∧ pos y < p.a+p.len
  by_cases H : x-y=0
  · have h := sub_eq_zero.mp H; subst y; constructor <;> linarith
  rw [diam_min,min_lt_iff,pos_neg H] at hy
  rcases le_total x.val y.val with h|h
  · have h1 := pos_sub_val h
    rw [show y-x= -(x-y) by ring,pos_neg H] at h1
    rcases hy with hy|hy <;> constructor <;> linarith [pos_lt y,pos_lt (x-y),pos_nonneg y]
  have h1 := pos_sub_val h
  rcases hy with hy|hy <;> constructor <;> linarith [pos_nonneg y,pos_lt y,pos_nonneg (x-y)]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Capture.limit_full
statement: private lemma limit_full {f : Grid M → ℝ} (s : ℝ) (h : 2^M ≤ s) : limitR f s
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  have H := rad_le_val x
  have hh : (x.val:ℝ) < 2^M := by exact_mod_cast ZMod.val_lt x
  linarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Capture.smoothing_limit
statement:
private lemma smoothing_limit (P : Law (Grid M)) (q : Grid M → Prop) (r : ℝ)
    (h : limitR P r) : limitR (fun x => P.prob fun y => q (x-y)) r
proof:
:= by
  have He (x : Grid M) :
      P.prob (fun y => q (x-y)) = ∑ y, (if q y then P (x-y) else 0) := by
    rw [prob_eq]
    apply Fintype.sum_equiv ((Equiv.neg _).trans (Equiv.addLeft x))
    intro i
    have HH : x-i=x+ -i := sub_eq_add_neg x i
    change (if q (x-i) then P i else 0) = if q (x+ -i) then P (x-(x+ -i)) else 0; rw [← HH,sub_sub_self]
  unfold limitR limit; intro i hi
  simp_rw [He,Complex.ofReal_sum]
  rw [fc_sum _ (fun y x => (↑(if q y then P (x-y) else 0):ℂ))]
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero; intro x hx
  by_cases H : q x
  · simp only [H,ite_true]
    rw [fc_right_translate (fun x => (P x:ℂ)) x i, h _ hi,mul_zero]
  · simp only [H,ite_false,fc, Complex.ofReal_zero,zero_mul,expU,Finset.sum_const_zero,smul_zero]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Capture.make_mask
statement:
lemma make_mask (p : Node) (h : p.valid) (hp : p.lev < M) (b : Bool) (i j : ℕ) :
    let q
proof:
:= p.child b
    ∃ f : Grid M → ℝ, limitR f (band p i j) ∧ (∀ x, 0 ≤ f x ∧ f x ≤ 1) ∧
      (∀ x, x∈p.block M → ¬ (lanes p i M ∧ flanked p i x) →
        |(if x∈q.block M then (1:ℝ) else 0)-f x| ≤ side j) ∧
      expU (fun x => if x∈p.block M then 0 else f x) ≤ p.len*side j := by
  classical
  let s : ℝ := p.len*side (reach i)
  intro q
  have Hq := child_ok p h hp b
  have hpq := block_of_below (child_below p b) M
  let D := 2^(p.lev+reach i+10)
  have hD : 0<D := by unfold D; positivity
  have hD' : (0:ℝ) < D := Nat.cast_pos.mpr hD
  have hS : 0 < s := mul_pos p.len_pos (side_pos _)
  have He : band p i j = (D:ℝ)*(2*(j+10)) := by unfold D band; push_cast; rfl
  by_cases H : D ≤ 2^M
  case neg =>
    let f (x : Grid M) := if x∈q.block M then (1:ℝ) else 0
    have hj := side_pos j
    refine ⟨f,limit_full _ ?_, fun x => by unfold f; split_ifs <;> norm_num,fun x _ _ => by unfold f; simp [hj.le],?_⟩
    · rw [He]; have hx : (2:ℝ)^M ≤ D := by exact_mod_cast le_of_not_ge H
      nlinarith [Nat.cast_nonneg (α:=ℝ) j]
    have HE (x : Grid M) : (if x∈p.block M then 0 else f x) = 0 := by
      unfold f
      split_ifs with h hq
      · rfl
      · exact (h (hpq hq)).elim
      rfl
    simp_rw [HE,expU,Finset.sum_const_zero,smul_zero]; exact (mul_pos p.len_pos hj).le

  obtain ⟨P,hP,hT⟩ := boosted M D j hD H
  let r : ℝ := 16/D
  have hr : 0<r := div_pos (by norm_num) hD'
  have hb : lanes p i M := by
    have HE : p.lev+reach i+10 ≤ M :=
      (Nat.pow_le_pow_iff_right (by omega : 1 < 2)).mp H
    unfold lanes; omega
  have hrS : 2*r ≤ s := by
    have he : s * D = 2^10 := by
      unfold D s len; push_cast
      rw [side_pow_two,side_pow_two,pow_add,pow_add]; field_simp
    unfold r; rw [← mul_div_assoc]; apply (div_le_iff₀ hD').mpr; rw [he]; norm_num
  let g (x : Grid M) := inland q r x
  let f (x : Grid M) := P.prob (fun i => g (x-i))
  have hHi (x : Grid M) (hx : g x) : x∈q.block M := by
    apply hx x
    simpa only [sub_self,diam,rad, neg_zero,ZMod.val_zero,min_self,Nat.cast_zero,mul_zero] using hr
  refine ⟨f,smoothing_limit _ _ _ ?_,fun x => ⟨prob_nonneg _ _,prob_le_one _ _⟩,?_,?_⟩
  · rw [He,show (D:ℝ)*(2*(j+10))=2*(D:ℝ)*(j+10) by ring]
    exact hP
  · intro x hx hE
    have hv : ¬ flanked p i x := fun hh => hE ⟨hb,hh⟩
    by_cases HH : x∈q.block M
    · have hi := inner_strip p b i x HH hv
      have hi (v : Grid M) (hv : Dyadic.diam v<r) : g (x-v) := by
        intro y hy
        refine circle_near q Hq.1 x y s hS hi.1 hi.2.le ?_
        have H := diam_add v (x-v-y)
        rw [show v+(x-v-y)=x-y by ring] at H; linarith
      rw [ite_eq_left HH, abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr (prob_le_one _ _))]
      rw [← prob_compl]
      refine (prob_mono _ _ _ fun i hv => ?_).trans hT
      exact le_of_not_gt (fun h => hv (hi i h))
    rw [ite_eq_right HH,zero_sub,abs_neg,abs_of_nonneg (prob_nonneg _ _)]
    apply le_trans _ hT
    refine prob_mono _ _ _ fun i hi => ?_
    apply le_of_not_gt; intro hi'
    apply HH
    apply hi x; rw [sub_sub_cancel_left,diam_even]; exact hi'
  rw [expU_ex]
  let U := uniform (Grid M)
  let G (x i : Grid M) := if x∈p.block M then (0:ℝ) else if g (x-i) then 1 else 0
  have heq (x : Grid M) : (if x∈p.block M then 0 else f x) = P.Ex (G x) := by
    unfold f prob G; split_ifs with hx
    rw [Ex_const]
    rfl
  have hg1 : U.prob g ≤ p.len := by
    rw [← prob_block (M:=M) (p:=p) ⟨h,hp.le⟩]
    apply prob_mono _ _ _ (fun i hi => hpq (hHi _ hi))
  have heq' (i : Grid M) : U.Ex (fun x => G x i) ≤ p.len*(if r ≤ Dyadic.diam i then 1 else 0) := by
    split_ifs with H
    · rw [mul_one]
      apply le_trans (b:=U.prob fun x => g (x-i))
      · unfold prob G; apply Ex_mono; intro x; split_ifs <;> norm_num
      rw [prob_translate g]; exact hg1
    have he (x : Grid M) : G x i=0 := by
      unfold G; split_ifs with h h'
      · rfl
      · refine (h (hpq (h' x ?_))).elim
        rw [sub_sub_cancel_left,diam_even]
        exact not_le.mp H
      rfl
    rw [funext he,Ex_const,mul_zero]
  simp_rw [heq,Ex_swap (uniform (Grid M)) P]
  apply le_trans (Ex_mono P heq')
  rw [Ex_lmul]
  apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ p.len_pos.le
  apply le_trans _ hT

  rw [prob_eq]
  unfold Ex r
  simp

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Capture.limit_mul
statement:
lemma limit_mul (f g : Grid M → ℂ) (p q : ℝ) (hf : limit f p) (hg : limit g q) :
    limit (fun x => f x*g x) (p+q)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx; rw [fc_prod]; apply Finset.sum_eq_zero; intro i _
  by_cases hh : p < rad i
  · rw [hf i hh,zero_mul]
  have H : q < rad (x-i) := by
    have Hh := rad_add (x-i) i; rw [sub_add_cancel] at Hh
    linarith
  rw [hg _ H,mul_zero]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Capture.limit_scale
statement:
lemma limit_scale (f : Grid M → ℂ) (c : ℂ) (p : ℝ) (hf : limit f p) :
    limit (fun x => c*f x) p
proof: := by intro x hx; rw [fc_lmul,hf x hx,mul_zero]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Capture.limit_const
statement: lemma limit_const (p : ℝ) (hp : 0 ≤ p) : limit (M:=M) (fun _ => 1) p
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx; rw [← funext chi_zero_left,fc_chi,ite_eq_right]
  intro h; subst x; simp [rad] at hx; linarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Capture.limit_pow
statement:
lemma limit_pow (f : Grid M → ℂ) (p : ℝ) (hf : limit f p) (k : ℕ) :
    limit (fun x => f x^k) (k*p)
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simpa only [Nat.cast_zero,zero_mul,pow_zero] using limit_const (M:=M) 0 le_rfl
  | succ k ih =>
    simp_rw [pow_succ,Nat.cast_add_one,add_mul,one_mul]
    exact limit_mul _ _ _ p ih hf

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Capture.limit_star
statement:
lemma limit_star (f : Grid M → ℂ) (p : ℝ) (hf : limit f p) :
    limit (fun x => conj (f x)) p
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  have hh : fc (fun x => conj (f x)) x = conj (fc f (-x)) := by
    unfold fc
    simp_rw [expU_cx,← Cx_conj,chi_neg', map_mul]
    simp
  rw [hh,hf _ (by rw [rad_even]; exact hx),map_zero]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Capture.tile_limit
statement: private lemma tile_limit (M d : ℕ) : limit (tile M d) d
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  unfold tile; rw [fc_lmul,fc_sum _ (fun i : ℕ => chi (i:Grid M))]
  suffices H : ∀ i ∈ Finset.range d, fc (chi (i:Grid M)) x=0 by simp [Finset.sum_eq_zero H]
  intro i hi; rw [fc_chi,ite_eq_right]
  intro h; subst x
  have H := rad_le_nat (M:=M) i
  have hi : (i:ℝ) < d := Nat.cast_lt.mpr (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)
  linarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Capture.slab_limit
statement: lemma slab_limit (M d : ℕ) : limitR (slab M d) (2*d)
proof:
:= by
  have hi (x : Grid M) : (↑(slab M d x):ℂ) =
      tile M d x * conj (tile M d x) := by rw [slab,Complex.mul_conj,Complex.sq_norm]
  have h := tile_limit M d
  unfold limitR; simp_rw [hi, two_mul]
  exact limit_mul _ _ _ _ h (limit_star _ _ h)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Capture.slab_nonneg
statement: lemma slab_nonneg (M d : ℕ) (x : Grid M) : 0 ≤ slab M d x
proof: := by unfold slab; positivity

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Capture.slab_total
statement:
lemma slab_total (M : ℕ) (d : ℕ) (h : 0 < d) (he : d ≤ 2^M) :
    expU (slab M d) = (d:ℝ)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  change expU (fun x => ‖tile M d x‖^2) = _
  rw [← fc_parseval]
  have H (x : Grid M) : fc (tile M d) x = if x∈Dyadic.first M d then (d:ℂ)⁻¹ else 0 := by
    unfold tile; rw [fc_lmul,fc_sum _ (fun i : ℕ => chi (i:Grid M))]
    simp_rw [fc_chi]
    by_cases hx : x∈Dyadic.first M d
    · rw [ite_eq_left hx]
      rw [Finset.sum_eq_single x.val, ite_eq_left (ZMod.natCast_zmod_val _),mul_one]
      · intro j hj he'; rw [ite_eq_right]
        intro H
        have hi := ZMod.val_natCast_of_lt ((Finset.mem_range.mp hj).trans_le he)
        rw [H] at hi; exact he' hi.symm
      · exact fun HH => (HH (Finset.mem_range.mpr ((mem_first _ _).mp hx))).elim
    rw [first_eq_range d he] at hx
    rw [first_eq_range d he,ite_eq_right hx,Finset.sum_eq_zero,mul_zero]
    intro i hi; rw [ite_eq_right]; intro H; exact hx (Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨_,hi,H⟩)
  simp_rw [H]
  calc
    _ = ∑ _x ∈ Dyadic.first M d, ((d:ℝ)⁻¹)^2 := by
      classical
      have hi (x : Grid M) :
          ‖(if x∈Dyadic.first M d then (d:ℂ)⁻¹ else 0)‖^2 =
            if x∈Dyadic.first M d then ((d:ℝ)⁻¹)^2 else 0 := by split_ifs <;> simp
      simp_rw [hi]; rw [← Finset.sum_filter]
      simp
    _ = _ := by simp [first_card d he]; field_simp

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Capture.tile_lower
proof:
:= by
  have hp : 0 < (d:ℝ) := by positivity
  have hh := norm_phase_sq 1 x
  have ha : ‖1-chi 1 x‖ ≤ 8*Dyadic.diam x := by nlinarith [(cost_diam x).2,diam_nonneg x]
  have HF (i : ℕ) : ‖1-chi (i:Grid M) x‖ ≤ i*‖1-chi 1 x‖ := by
    induction i with
    | zero => simp [chi_zero_left]
    | succ i ih =>
      push_cast
      have Hx := norm_phase_add x (i:Grid M) 1
      rw [chi_comm x _,chi_comm x _,chi_comm x _] at Hx
      linarith
  have hE (i : ℕ) (hi : i < d) : ‖1-chi (i:Grid M) x‖ ≤ 1/2 := calc
    _ ≤ _ := HF i
    _ ≤ d*(8*Dyadic.diam x) := mul_le_mul (Nat.cast_le.mpr hi.le) ha (norm_nonneg _) hp.le
    _ ≤ _ := by have := (le_div_iff₀ hp).mp hx; linarith
  have hr (i : ℕ) (hi : i < d) : 1/2 ≤ (chi (i:Grid M) x).re := by
    have H := Complex.abs_re_le_norm (1-chi (i:Grid M) x); simp only [Complex.sub_re,Complex.one_re] at H
    linarith [(abs_le.mp (H.trans (hE i hi))).2]
  apply le_trans (b:=(tile M d x).re)
  · unfold tile; rw [show (d:ℂ)⁻¹=(↑((d:ℝ)⁻¹):ℂ) by push_cast; rfl,
       Complex.re_ofReal_mul,Complex.re_sum,← div_eq_inv_mul]
    apply (le_div_iff₀ hp).mpr
    have HH := Finset.sum_le_sum (s:=Finset.range d) fun i hi => hr i (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)
    simp only [Finset.sum_const,Finset.card_range,nsmul_eq_mul] at HH; linarith
  exact (le_abs_self _).trans (Complex.abs_re_le_norm _)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Capture.tile_upper
statement:
private lemma tile_upper (M d : ℕ) (h : 0 < d) (x : Grid M) :
    (4*d:ℝ)*Dyadic.diam x * ‖tile M d x‖ ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  let z := chi (1:Grid M) x
  have he (i : ℕ) : z ^ i = chi (i:Grid M) x := by unfold z; rw [← chi_nsmul,nsmul_one]
  have H : ‖1-z‖ * (d:ℝ)* ‖tile M d x‖ ≤ 2 := by
    let W := ∑ i∈Finset.range d,z^i
    have HH := geom_sum_mul_neg z d
    have HB : ‖W*(1-z)‖ ≤ 2 := by
      rw [show W*(1-z)=_ from HH]
      apply (norm_sub_le _ _).trans; rw [norm_pow,norm_one,show ‖z‖=1 from norm_chi _ _]; simp
      norm_num
    rw [norm_mul] at HB
    have Hp : 0 < (d:ℝ) := by positivity
    have hz : ‖tile M d x‖ = (d:ℝ)⁻¹*‖W‖ := by
      unfold tile W; simp_rw [he, norm_mul,norm_inv]; simp
    rw [hz]
    apply le_trans _ HB; exact le_of_eq (by field_simp)
  have he₁ := (cost_diam x).1
  have He : 4*Dyadic.diam x ≤ ‖1-z‖ := by unfold z; nlinarith [norm_phase_sq 1 x,norm_nonneg (1-chi 1 x)]
  apply le_trans _ H
  have hp : 0 ≤ (d:ℝ) := by positivity
  rw [mul_right_comm (4:ℝ)]; gcongr

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Capture.boosted
statement:
lemma boosted (M d k : ℕ) (h : 0 < d) (he : d ≤ 2^M) :
    ∃ P : Law (Grid M), limitR P (2*(d:ℝ)*(k+10)) ∧
      P.prob (fun x => 16/d ≤ Dyadic.diam x) ≤ side k
proof:
:= by
  let n := k+10
  let f (x : Grid M) := slab M d x^n
  let a := ∑ x, f x
  have hh : (0:ℝ)<d := Nat.cast_pos.mpr h
  let b := side M
  have hb : 0 < b := side_pos M
  have hf (x) : 0 ≤ f x := pow_nonneg (slab_nonneg _ _ _) _
  let r := ((1/16:ℝ)/d)/b
  have hr : 0 ≤ r := by unfold r; positivity
  have heR : r ≤ 2^M := by
    unfold r; apply (div_le_iff₀ hb).mpr
    rw [show (2:ℝ)^M*b=1 by unfold b; rw [mul_comm,side_card]]
    have H : 1 ≤ (d:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast h
    apply (div_le_one hh).mpr; linarith
  let D := arc M r
  have Hlow (x) (hx : x∈D) : (1/4:ℝ)^n ≤ f x := by
    apply pow_le_pow_left₀ (by norm_num : 0 ≤ (1/4:ℝ))
    have HI : Dyadic.diam x ≤ (1/16:ℝ)/d := by
      have HI := (mem_arc r _).mp hx
      rw [diam,mul_comm]
      exact (le_div_iff₀ hb).mp HI
    unfold slab
    have HE := tile_lower M d h x HI; nlinarith
  have HD : r ≤ (D.card:ℝ) := arc_card_lo M r hr heR
  have HG : r*(1/4:ℝ)^n ≤ a := calc
    _ ≤ D.card*(1/4:ℝ)^n := by gcongr
    _ = ∑ _i∈D,(1/4:ℝ)^n := by simp
    _ ≤ ∑ i∈D,f i := Finset.sum_le_sum Hlow
    _ ≤ ∑ i,f i := Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (Finset.subset_univ _) (fun i _ _ => hf i)
  have ha : 0 < a := lt_of_lt_of_le (by unfold r; positivity) HG
  let P := proportional f hf ha
  refine ⟨P,?_,?_⟩
  · have He : limitR f (n*(2*d):ℝ) := by
      unfold limitR f; simp_rw [Complex.ofReal_pow]; exact limit_pow _ _ (slab_limit M d) _
    unfold limitR
    have HE (x : Grid M) : P x = a⁻¹ * f x := by unfold P; rw [proportional_apply,div_eq_inv_mul]
    simp_rw [HE,Complex.ofReal_mul]
    rw [show 2*(d:ℝ)*(k+10) = n*(2*d) by unfold n; push_cast; ring]
    exact limit_scale _ _ _ He
  · let t (x : Grid M) := (16/d:ℝ) ≤ Dyadic.diam x
    have Ht (x : Grid M) (hx : t x) : slab M d x ≤ 1/16 := by
      unfold slab
      have Hx := tile_upper M d h x
      have HH := (div_le_iff₀ hh).mp hx
      generalize HE : ‖tile M d x‖ = w at *
      have hw : 0 ≤ w := HE ▸ norm_nonneg _
      nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right HH hw]
    let A := (1/16:ℝ)^(k+9)
    have HI :
        ∑ x, (if t x then f x else 0) ≤ A*(∑ x : Grid M, slab M d x) := by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum; intro i hi
      have hip := slab_nonneg M d i
      split_ifs with H
      · apply le_trans (b:=slab M d i^(k+9)*slab M d i)
        · unfold f n; rw [show k+10=k+9+1 from rfl,pow_succ]
        unfold A; gcongr; exact Ht i H
      unfold A; positivity
    have HT (x : Grid M) : P x=f x/a := proportional_apply f hf ha _
    rw [prob_eq]; simp_rw [HT]
    have HH (i : Grid M) : (if t i then f i/a else 0) = (if t i then f i else 0)/a := by
      split_ifs <;> simp
    change (∑ i, if t i then f i / a else 0) ≤ side k
    simp_rw [HH, ← Finset.sum_div]
    apply (div_le_iff₀ ha).mpr
    have H := slab_total M d h he
    change b* (∑ x : Grid M, slab M d x) = _ at H
    calc
      _ ≤ _ := HI
      _ ≤ side k * (r*(1/4:ℝ)^n) := by
        apply le_of_mul_le_mul_left ?_ hb
        rw [mul_left_comm b, H]
        unfold r n
        have he : b*(side k*(1/16/d/b*(1/4:ℝ)^(k+10))) =
            (d:ℝ)⁻¹*((1/16)*(side k*(1/4:ℝ)^(k+10))) := by field_simp
        rw [he]
        unfold A
        apply le_trans (le_of_eq (mul_comm _ _)) (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ (by positivity))
        unfold side
        rw [pow_add, pow_add]
        have hh : (1/16:ℝ)^k ≤ (1/2:ℝ)^k*(1/4:ℝ)^k := by rw [← mul_pow]; norm_num; gcongr; norm_num
        norm_num at *; nlinarith [show 0 ≤ (1/16:ℝ)^k by positivity]
      _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left HG (side_pos _).le

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.offset_injective
statement: lemma offset_injective (j l : ℕ) (h : j+l ≤ n) : Injective (offset j l h)
proof:
:= by
  intro a b hab
  have H := congrArg Fin.val hab
  simp only [offset,Nat.add_left_cancel_iff] at H
  exact Fin.ext H

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.prefix_partition
statement:
lemma prefix_partition (X : Ω → Letters n α) (l k : ℕ) (h : l+k ≤ n) (x y : Ω) :
    prefixB X (l+k) h x = prefixB X (l+k) h y ↔
      prefixB X l (by omega) x = prefixB X l (by omega) y ∧ readBlock X l k h x = readBlock X l k h y
proof:
:= by
  simp only [funext_iff]
  constructor
  · intro H; constructor
    · intro i
      exact H (i.castAdd k)
    · intro ⟨i,hi⟩
      have h1 := H (⟨l+i,by omega⟩:Fin (l+k))
      simpa only [prefixB,readBlock,keep,offset,zero_add] using h1
  · rintro ⟨H,G⟩ ⟨i,hi⟩
    by_cases hp : i < l
    · exact H ⟨i,hp⟩
    · have h1 := G (⟨i-l,by omega⟩:Fin k)
      simpa only [prefixB,readBlock,keep,offset,zero_add, Nat.add_sub_of_le (le_of_not_gt hp)]
        using h1

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.prefix_last_partition
statement:
lemma prefix_last_partition (X : Ω → Letters n α) (l : ℕ) (h : l<n) (x y : Ω) :
    prefixB X (l+1) h x = prefixB X (l+1) h y ↔
      readLetter X l h x = readLetter X l h y ∧
      prefixB X l (by omega) x = prefixB X l (by omega) y
proof:
:= by
  rw [prefix_partition X l 1 h]
  have HH : readBlock X l 1 h x = readBlock X l 1 h y ↔ readLetter X l h x = readLetter X l h y :=
    ⟨fun e => congrFun e (0:Fin 1),fun e => by funext i; rw [Subsingleton.elim i 0]; exact e⟩
  rw [HH,and_comm]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.prefix_zero
statement: lemma prefix_zero (X : Ω → Letters n α) : prefixB X 0 (by omega) = fun _ => Fin.elim0
proof:
:=
  funext fun _ => Subsingleton.elim _ _

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.prefix_all
statement: lemma prefix_all (X : Ω → Letters n α) : prefixB X n le_rfl = X
proof:
:= by
  funext a ⟨i,hi⟩
  simp only [prefixB,readBlock,keep,offset,zero_add]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.block_cut
statement:
lemma block_cut (X : Ω → Letters n α) (j m l : ℕ) (h : j+m ≤ n) (hl : l ≤ m) :
    readBlock X j l (by omega) = prefixB (readBlock X j m h) l hl
proof:
:= by
  funext a ⟨i,hi⟩; simp only [prefixB,readBlock,keep,offset,zero_add]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.block_in_prefix
statement:
lemma block_in_prefix (X : Ω → Letters n α) (j k l : ℕ) (hk : j+k ≤ l) (hl : l ≤ n) :
    readBlock X j k (hk.trans hl) = readBlock (prefixB X l hl) j k hk
proof:
:= by
  funext a ⟨i,hi⟩; simp only [prefixB,readBlock,keep,offset,zero_add]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.splitIx_left
statement:
lemma splitIx_left (l m : ℕ) (h : l+m=n) (i : Fin m) :
    splitIx l m h (.inl i) = offset l m h.le i
proof:
:= by
  apply Fin.ext
  simp only [splitIx,Equiv.trans_apply,finCongr_apply_coe]
  rfl

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.splitIx_right
statement:
lemma splitIx_right (l m : ℕ) (h : l+m=n) (i : Fin l) :
    splitIx l m h (.inr i) = offset 0 l (by omega : 0+l≤n) i
proof:
:= by
  apply Fin.ext
  simp only [splitIx,Equiv.trans_apply,finCongr_apply_coe,offset,zero_add]
  rfl

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.lift_perm
statement:
lemma lift_perm (g : J → I) (hg : Injective g) (e : Equiv.Perm J) :
    ∃ f : Equiv.Perm I, (∀ i, f (g i) = g (e i)) ∧ ∀ x, x ∉ range g → f x = x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let T := (Equiv.sumCongr (Equiv.ofInjective g hg) (Equiv.refl {x : I // x ∉ range g}))
    |>.trans (Equiv.sumCompl (fun x => x ∈ range g))
  let E := Equiv.sumCongr e (Equiv.refl {x : I // x ∉ range g})
  have H (x) : ((T.symm.trans E).trans T) (T x) = T (E x) := by simp
  refine ⟨(T.symm.trans E).trans T,fun i => H (.inl i),fun x hx => ?_⟩
  exact H (.inr ⟨x,hx⟩)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.exch_subSample
statement:
lemma exch_subSample {P : Law (Sample I α G)} (hx : exch P)
    (g : J → I) (hg : Injective g) : exch (P.send (subSample g))
proof:
:= by
  intro e
  obtain ⟨f,hf,hf'⟩ := lift_perm g hg e
  rw [send_send]
  have HH := congrArg (fun R : Law (Sample I α G) => R.send (subSample g)) (hx f)
  rw [send_send] at HH
  simpa [subSample,appPerm,hf] using HH

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.exch_subSample_cond
statement:
lemma exch_subSample_cond {P : Law (Sample I α G)} (hx : exch P)
    (g : J → I) (hg : Injective g) (u : K → I) (hu : ∀ i, u i ∉ range g)
    (w : K → α) :
    let W
proof:
:= keep (fun p : Sample I α G => p.1) u
    exch ((P.after W w).send (subSample g)) := by
  intro W e
  obtain ⟨f,hf,hf'⟩ := lift_perm g hg e
  have HH := congrArg (fun R : Law (Sample I α G) => R.send fun x => (subSample g x,W x)) (hx f)
  rw [send_send] at HH
  have h1 (x : Sample I α G) : subSample g (appPerm f x) = appPerm e (subSample g x) := by
    simp only [appPerm,subSample,hf]
  have h2 (x : Sample I α G) : W (appPerm f x) = W x := by
    funext i
    simp only [W,keep,appPerm,hf' _ (hu i)]
  simp_rw [h1,h2] at HH
  rw [send_send]
  exact after_send_eq_of_send_pair_eq (X:=fun x => appPerm e (subSample g x)) (W:=W)
    (Y:=subSample g) (V:=W) HH w

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.prefix_bill
statement:
lemma prefix_bill (tag : α → G) (c : G → ℝ) (q : Law α)
    (P : Law Ω) (X : Ω → Letters n α) (U : Ω → G) (h : covered P X q)
    (j m : ℕ) (hh : j+m ≤ n) :
    let W
proof:
:= prefixB X j (by omega)
    (P.send W).Ex (fun w => bill tag c q (P.after W w) (readBlock X j m hh) U) ≤
      bill tag c q P X U := by
  intro W
  let l := n-j
  have he : j+l=n := by dsimp [l]; omega
  have hhh := bill_split tag c q P X U h (splitIx j l he)
  let V := readBlock X j l he.le
  have H1 :
      (P.send W).Ex (fun w => bill tag c q (P.after W w) V U) ≤ bill tag c q P X U := by
    simpa only [W,V,prefixB,readBlock,splitIx_left,splitIx_right] using hhh
  apply le_trans ?_ H1
  refine Ex_mono_mem _ (fun w hw => ?_)
  have hB : readBlock X j m hh = prefixB V m (by omega) := block_cut X j l m he.le (by omega)
  rw [hB]
  exact bill_subfamily tag c q _ V U
    (covered_subfamily (covered_after h _ _ hw) _) _ (offset_injective 0 m _)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.refines_refl
statement: lemma refines_refl (p : Labelled A) : refines p p
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨id,?_⟩; exact send_id p.law

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.refines_trans
statement:
lemma refines_trans {p q r : Labelled A} :
    refines p q → refines q r → refines p r
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨u,hu⟩ ⟨v,hv⟩
  rw [← hu,send_send] at hv
  exact ⟨v ∘ u,hv⟩

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.I_anti
statement:
lemma I_anti (tag : A → G) {P Q : Labelled A} (h : refines P Q) (r : ℕ) :
    fundI tag P r ≤ fundI tag Q r
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u,hu⟩ := h
  unfold fundI
  rw [← hu]
  let f (x : A×P.obs) := (x.1,u x.2)
  exact opt_refined (tag ∘ Prod.fst) Prod.snd Prod.snd (fun _ : Unit => 0) (fun _ => 0) P.law f r u rfl

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.K_anti
statement:
lemma K_anti (tag : A → G) (c : G → ℝ) {P Q : Labelled A}
    (h : refines P Q) (m r : ℕ) : fundK tag c P m r ≤ fundK tag c Q m r
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u,hu⟩ := h
  let X (x : A × P.obs) := (x.1,u x.2)
  let f (x : Letters m _) i := X (x i)
  have H : lblP Q m = (lblP P m).send f := by
    unfold lblP iid; rw [show Q.law = _ from hu.symm]
    exact (sendPack (fun _ : Fin m => P.law) (fun _ => X)).symm
  unfold fundK
  rw [H]
  exact opt_refined (lblSum tag Q m) (lblCtx Q m) (lblCtx P m) id c (lblP P m) f r (fun x i => u (x i)) rfl

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.G_anti
statement:
lemma G_anti (tag : A → G) {P Q : Labelled A} (h : refines P Q)
    (m : ℕ) : fundG tag P m ≤ fundG tag Q m
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u,hu⟩ := h
  let X (x : A × P.obs) := (x.1,u x.2)
  let f (x : Letters m _) i := X (x i)
  have H : lblP Q m = (lblP P m).send f := by
    unfold lblP iid; rw [show Q.law = _ from hu.symm]
    exact (sendPack (fun _ : Fin m => P.law) (fun _ => X)).symm
  unfold fundG
  rw [H,Hcond_send]
  apply Hcond_antitone
  intro a b hh
  funext i
  exact congrArg u (congrFun hh i)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.fundG_one
statement:
lemma fundG_one (tag : A → G) (hi : Injective tag) (P : Labelled A) :
    fundG tag P 1 = P.law.Hcond Prod.fst Prod.snd
proof:
:= by
  let Q := lblP P 1
  have h : Q.send (fun x => x 0) = P.law := marginalPack _ _
  rw [← h,Hcond_send]
  unfold fundG Hcond
  congr 1
  · refine H_partition _ fun a b => ?_
    unfold lblSum lblCtx tot
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_one,comp_apply,Prod.mk.injEq,hi.eq_iff,funext_iff]
    simp [Fin.forall_fin_one]
  · refine H_partition _ fun a b => ?_
    simp [funext_iff,lblCtx, Fin.forall_fin_one]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.iid_succ
statement:
lemma iid_succ (P : Law A) (m : ℕ) :
    iid P (m+1) = (P.tensorP (iid P m)).send appendOne
proof:
:= by
  apply ext_by_products
  intro f
  dsimp only [iid]
  rw [Ex_send,Ex_tensorP]
  rw [pack_Ex_prod _ f]
  simp_rw [Fin.prod_univ_succ]
  unfold appendOne
  simp only [Fin.cons_zero,Fin.cons_succ]
  simp_rw [Ex_lmul,pack_Ex_prod _ (fun i : Fin m => f i.succ),Ex_mul]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.cons_part
statement:
lemma cons_part {m : ℕ} {a b : A} {x y : Letters m A} :
    (Fin.cons a x : Letters (m+1) A) = Fin.cons b y ↔ a = b ∧ x = y
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact ⟨by simpa using congrFun h 0,by funext i; simpa using congrFun h i.succ⟩
  · rintro ⟨rfl,rfl⟩; rfl

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.Hcond_tensor
statement:
lemma Hcond_tensor (P : Law Ω) (Q : Law Ω') (X : Ω → α) (Z : Ω' → β)
    (Y : Ω → V) (T : Ω' → W) :
    (P.tensorP Q).Hcond (fun x => (X x.1,Z x.2)) (fun x => (Y x.1,T x.2)) =
      P.Hcond X Y + Q.Hcond Z T
proof:
:= by
  unfold Hcond
  rw [H_partition (X:=fun (x:Ω×Ω') => ((X x.1,Z x.2),(Y x.1,T x.2)))
    (Y:=fun x => ((X x.1,Y x.1),(Z x.2,T x.2))) _ (fun _ _ => by simp; tauto)]
  rw [H_tensorP P Q (fun x => (X x,Y x)) (fun x => (Z x,T x)),H_tensorP]; ring

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.Hcond_tensor_right
statement:
lemma Hcond_tensor_right (P : Law Ω) (Q : Law Ω') (Z : Ω' → β)
    (Y : Ω → V) (T : Ω' → W) :
    (P.tensorP Q).Hcond (fun x => Z x.2) (fun x => (Y x.1,T x.2)) = Q.Hcond Z T
proof:
:= by
  let X (_x : Ω) := ()
  rw [show Q.Hcond Z T = P.Hcond X Y + Q.Hcond Z T by
        rw [Hcond_determined (P:=P) (X:=X) (W:=Y) (fun _ _ _ => rfl)]; ring,
    ← Hcond_tensor]
  unfold Hcond
  congr 1
  apply H_partition
  simp only [Prod.mk.injEq, X]; tauto

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.lbl_succ_sum
statement:
lemma lbl_succ_sum (tag : A → G) (P : Labelled A) (m : ℕ)
    (x : (A×P.obs) × Letters m (A × P.obs)) :
    lblSum tag P (m+1) (appendOne x) = tag x.1.1 + lblSum tag P m x.2
proof:
:= by
  unfold lblSum tot; rw [Fin.sum_univ_succ]; rfl

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.lbl_succ_ctx
statement:
lemma lbl_succ_ctx (P : Labelled A) (m : ℕ)
    (x : (A×P.obs) × Letters m (A × P.obs)) :
    lblCtx P (m+1) (appendOne x) = appendOne (x.1.2,lblCtx P m x.2)
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  cases i using Fin.cases <;> simp [lblCtx,appendOne]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.fundG_succ
statement:
lemma fundG_succ (tag : A → G) (P : Labelled A) (m : ℕ) :
    let Q
proof:
:= P.law.tensorP (lblP P m)
    let X (x : (A×P.obs) × Letters m (A×P.obs)) := tag x.1.1 + lblSum tag P m x.2
    let Z (x : (A×P.obs) × Letters m (A×P.obs)) := (x.1.2,lblCtx P m x.2)
    fundG tag P (m+1) = Q.Hcond X Z := by
  intro Q X Z
  unfold fundG
  rw [show lblP P (m+1)=Q.send appendOne from iid_succ P.law m,Hcond_send]
  simp_rw [lbl_succ_sum,lbl_succ_ctx]
  refine Hcond_right_partition _ X (fun x y => ?_)
  unfold appendOne Z
  simp only [cons_part,Prod.mk.injEq]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.fundG_mono
statement: lemma fundG_mono (tag : A → G) (P : Labelled A) : Monotone (fundG tag P)
proof:
:= by
  refine monotone_nat_of_le_succ fun i => ?_
  rw [fundG_succ]
  let Q := lblP P i
  let R := P.law.tensorP Q
  let W (x : (A×P.obs) × Letters i (A×P.obs)) := (x.1, lblCtx P i x.2)
  let X (x : (A×P.obs) × Letters i (A×P.obs)) := tag x.1.1 + lblSum tag P i x.2
  have hr : R.Hcond X W = R.Hcond (fun x => lblSum tag P i x.2) W := by
    unfold Hcond
    congr 1
    apply H_partition
    intro x y
    simp only [W,X,Prod.mk.injEq]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨h,h1,h2⟩; rw [h1] at h; exact ⟨add_left_cancel h,h1,h2⟩
    · rintro ⟨h,h1,h2⟩; exact ⟨by rw [h,h1],h1,h2⟩
  have he : R.Hcond (fun x => lblSum tag P i x.2) W = fundG tag P i :=
    Hcond_tensor_right P.law Q (lblSum tag P i) (fun x => x) (lblCtx P i)
  change fundG tag P i ≤ R.Hcond X _
  rw [← hr.trans he]
  apply Hcond_antitone
  intro x y h
  have H1 := congrArg Prod.fst h
  have H2 := congrArg Prod.snd h
  exact Prod.ext (show x.1.2=y.1.2 from congrArg Prod.snd H1) (show lblCtx P i x.2=lblCtx P i y.2 from H2)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.opt_succ
statement:
lemma opt_succ (p : Law A) (tag : A → G) (w : A → V)
    (u : E → G) (c : E → ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    opt n p tag w u c ≤ opt (n+1) p tag w u c
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨P,hP,he⟩ := (opt_spec (n+1) p tag w u c).1
  let X : WordSample (n+1) A E → Letters (n+1) A := Prod.fst
  let U : WordSample (n+1) A E → E := Prod.snd
  let Y (x : _) (i : Fin n) := X x i.succ
  let A' := readP X 0
  let W (x) := ans tag X (fun x => u (U x)) x
  let Z (x) := ans tag Y (fun x => u (U x)) x
  let WX (x : WordSample (n+1) A E) := (W x,ctxt w X x)
  let WY (x : WordSample (n+1) A E) := (Z x,ctxt w Y x)
  have hr : rent tag w u c P Y U ≤ rent tag w u c P X U := by
    have h :
        P.Hcond X WX = P.Hcond Y (fun x => (A' x,WX x))+P.Hcond A' WX := by
      rw [← Hcond_chain]
      unfold Hcond
      congr 1
      refine H_partition _ fun x y => ?_
      have hX : X x = X y ↔ Y x = Y y ∧ A' x = A' y := by
        constructor
        · intro h; dsimp only [Y,A',readP]; rw [h]; exact ⟨rfl,rfl⟩
        · rintro ⟨h1,h2⟩; funext i
          cases i using Fin.cases with
          | zero => exact h2
          | succ j => exact congrFun h1 j
      simp only [Prod.mk.injEq,hX]
    have hc : P.Hcond Y (fun x => (A' x,WX x)) ≤ P.Hcond Y WY := by
      refine Hcond_antitone _ _ fun x y hh => ?_
      change (Z x,ctxt w Y x) = _
      have heW (x) : W x = tag (A' x)+Z x := by
        unfold W Z ans tot
        rw [Fin.sum_univ_succ,add_assoc]
        rfl
      have h1 := congrArg Prod.fst hh
      have h2 := congrArg Prod.snd hh
      have h3 : W x=W y := congrArg (fun a : G×_ => a.1) h2
      have h4 : ctxt w X x=ctxt w X y := congrArg (fun a : G×_ => a.2) h2
      rw [heW,heW, show A' x = A' y from h1] at h3
      exact Prod.ext (add_left_cancel h3) (funext fun i => congrFun h4 i.succ)
    have hd : P.Hcond A' WX ≤ P.Hcond A' (w ∘ A') := by
      refine Hcond_antitone P _ (fun x y hh => ?_)
      have he : ctxt w X x = ctxt w X y := congrArg (fun a : G×_ => a.2) hh
      exact congrFun he 0
    unfold rent
    refine add_le_add_left ?_ _
    change _ - P.Hcond Y WY ≤ _ - P.Hcond X WX
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_succ,h]
    have hEq (i : Fin n) : readP X i.succ = readP Y i := rfl
    simp_rw [hEq]
    change _ ≤ P.Hcond A' (w ∘ A')+_ - _
    linarith
  exact (opt_le_rent tag w u c p P Y U fun i => hP i.succ).trans (hr.trans he.le)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.fundI_mono
statement: lemma fundI_mono (tag : A → G) (P : Labelled A) : Monotone (fundI tag P)
proof:
:=
  monotone_nat_of_le_succ (fun n => opt_succ P.law (tag ∘ Prod.fst) Prod.snd
    (fun _ : Unit => 0) (fun _ => 0) n)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.bill_send
statement:
lemma bill_send (tag : α → G) (c : G → ℝ) (q : Law α)
    (P : Law Ω) (X : Ω' → ι → α) (U : Ω' → G) (W : Ω → Ω') :
    bill tag c q (P.send W) X U = bill tag c q P (fun x => X (W x)) (fun x => U (W x))
proof:
:= by
  unfold bill; simp_rw [Hcond_send,Ex_send]; rfl

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.bill_mixture_le
statement:
lemma bill_mixture_le (tag : α → G) (c : G → ℝ) (q : Law α)
    (P Q : Law Ω) (X : Ω → ι → α) (U : Ω → G) (t : ℝ) (h0 : 0 ≤ t) (h1 : t ≤ 1) :
    bill tag c q (mixture P Q t h0 h1) X U ≤
      t*bill tag c q P X U + (1-t)*bill tag c q Q X U
proof:
:= by
  unfold bill
  simp_rw [mixture_Ex,Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum]
  have H := Hcond_mixture_ge P Q t h0 h1 X (ans tag X U)
  linarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.bill_cont
statement:
lemma bill_cont (tag : α → G) (c : G → ℝ) (q : Law α)
    (X : Ω → ι → α) (U : Ω → G) :
    Continuous (fun P : Law Ω => bill tag c q P X U)
proof:
:=
  ((continuous_finsetSum _ fun _ _ => continuous_Ex _).sub (continuous_Hcond _ _)).add
    (continuous_Ex _)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.bill_through_le
statement:
lemma bill_through_le (tag : α → G) (c : G → ℝ) (q : Law α)
    (P : Law Ω) (X : Ω' → ι → α) (U : Ω' → G) (Q : Ω → Law Ω') :
    bill tag c q (P.through Q) X U ≤ P.Ex (fun a => bill tag c q (Q a) X U)
proof:
:= by
  unfold bill
  simp_rw [Ex_add,Ex_sub,Ex_through, ← Ex_finset_sum]
  linarith [Hcond_through P Q X (ans tag X U)]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.covered_pack
statement:
lemma covered_pack {P : Law Ω} {X : Ω → ι → α} {q : Law α} (h : covered P X q) :
    (P.send X).dominated (pack (fun _ => q))
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨a,rfl,ha⟩ := (send_pos_iff _ _ _).mp hx
  exact (pack_pos _ _).mpr (h a ha)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.sum_crosspack
statement:
lemma sum_crosspack {P : Law Ω} {X : Ω → ι → α} {q : Law α} (h : covered P X q) :
    (P.send X).crossE (pack (fun _ => q)) = ∑ i, P.Ex fun a => -log (q (X a i))
proof:
:= by
  rw [crossE_pack (covered_pack h)]
  simp_rw [crossE,Ex_send]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.kl_le_bill
statement:
lemma kl_le_bill {P : Law Ω} {X : Ω → ι → α} {q : Law α} (h : covered P X q)
    (tag : α → G) (c : G → ℝ) (_hc : ∀ x, 0 ≤ c x) (U : Ω → G) :
    (P.send X).kl (pack (fun _ => q)) + P.Ex (fun a => c (U a)) ≤ bill tag c q P X U
proof:
:= by
  unfold bill kl
  rw [sum_crosspack h]
  exact add_le_add_left (sub_le_sub_left (Hcond_le_H P X _) _) _

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.bill_nonneg
statement:
lemma bill_nonneg {P : Law Ω} {X : Ω → ι → α} {q : Law α} (h : covered P X q)
    (tag : α → G) (c : G → ℝ) (hc : ∀ x, 0 ≤ c x) (U : Ω → G) :
    0 ≤ bill tag c q P X U
proof:
:= le_trans
      (add_nonneg (kl_nonneg (covered_pack h)) (P.Ex_nonneg fun a => hc (U a)))
      (kl_le_bill h tag c hc U)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.bill_with_entropy
statement:
lemma bill_with_entropy {P : Law Ω} {X : Ω → ι → α} {q : Law α} (h : covered P X q)
    (tag : α → G) (c : G → ℝ) (U : Ω → G) :
    bill tag c q P X U =
      (P.send X).kl (pack (fun _ => q)) + (P.H (ans tag X U) - P.Hcond U X) +
        P.Ex fun a => c (U a)
proof:
:= by
  let Z := ans tag X U
  have h1 : P.H (fun a => (U a,X a)) = P.H (fun a => (X a,Z a)) :=
    P.H_partition fun x y => by
      simp only [Z,ans,Prod.mk.injEq]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨hu,hx⟩; rw [hu,hx]; exact ⟨rfl,rfl⟩
      · rintro ⟨hx,hz⟩; rw [hx] at hz; exact ⟨add_left_cancel hz,hx⟩
  unfold bill kl
  rw [← sum_crosspack h]
  change _ - P.Hcond X Z + _ = (_ - P.H X) + (P.H Z- P.Hcond U X)+_
  unfold Hcond; rw [h1]; ring

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.bill_change
statement:
lemma bill_change {P : Law Ω} {X : Ω → ι → α} {q : Law α} (h : covered P X q)
    (tag : α → G) (c : G → ℝ) (U : Ω → G) (p : Law α)
    (hp : ∀ i, P.send (fun x => X x i) = p) :
    bill tag c p P X U ≤ bill tag c q P X U
proof:
:= by
  apply add_le_add_left
  apply sub_le_sub_right
  refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => ?_
  let x (a : Ω) := X a i
  have h1 : p.dominated q := by
    intro b hb
    have HH : 0 < P.send x b := by rw [hp i]; exact hb
    obtain ⟨a,rfl,ha⟩ := (P.send_pos_iff _ b).mp HH
    exact h a ha i
  suffices hi : (P.send x).crossE p ≤ (P.send x).crossE q by
    simpa only [crossE, Ex_send] using hi
  rw [show x = _ from rfl, hp i]
  exact sub_nonneg.mp (kl_nonneg h1)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.bill_condition
statement:
lemma bill_condition (tag : α → G) (c : G → ℝ) (q : Law α)
    (P : Law Ω) (X : Ω → ι → α) (U : Ω → G) (W : Ω → A) :
    (P.send W).Ex (fun w => bill tag c q (P.after W w) X U) ≤
      bill tag c q P X U + P.H W
proof:
:= by
  let Z := ans tag X U
  have hE (f : Ω → ℝ) :
      (P.send W).Ex (fun w => (P.after W w).Ex f) = P.Ex f :=
    P.after_Ex_sum W (fun _ => f)
  have hY := Hcond_after_cond P X Z W
  have hP := P.Hcond_nonneg W (fun x => (X x,Z x))
  have hl := Hcond_le_H P W Z
  have heq := P.H_partition (X:=fun x => ((X x), Z x,W x))
    (Y:=fun x => (W x,X x,Z x)) (fun _ _ => by simp; tauto)
  have hp := P.H_pair_rev W Z
  unfold bill
  simp_rw [Ex_add,Ex_sub,Ex_finset_sum,hE]
  change _ - ((P.send W).Ex (fun w => (P.after W w).Hcond X Z)) + _ ≤
    (_-P.Hcond X Z + _)+_
  rw [← hY]
  unfold Hcond at *
  linarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.sum_split'
statement:
lemma sum_split' (e : τ ⊕ κ ≃ ι) {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] (f : ι → M) :
    ∑ i, f i = ∑ i, f (e (.inl i)) + ∑ i, f (e (.inr i))
proof:
:=
  calc
    _ = ∑ i, f (e i) :=
      (Fintype.sum_equiv e _ f (fun _ => rfl)).symm
    _ = _ := Fintype.sum_sum_type _

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.bill_split
statement:
lemma bill_split (tag : α → G) (c : G → ℝ) (q : Law α)
    (P : Law Ω) (X : Ω → ι → α) (U : Ω → G) (h : covered P X q) (e : τ ⊕ κ ≃ ι) :
    let V
proof:
:= keep X (fun i => e (.inl i))
    let W := keep X (fun i => e (.inr i))
    (P.send W).Ex (fun w => bill tag c q (P.after W w) V U) ≤ bill tag c q P X U := by
  intro V W
  let Y := ans tag V U
  let Z := ans tag X U
  have hs (x : Ω) : Z x = Y x + tot tag (W x) := by
    unfold Z Y ans tot
    rw [sum_split' e (fun i => tag _)]
    dsimp only [V,W,keep]
    abel
  have hh (x y : Ω) : X x = X y ↔ (V x,W x) = (V y,W y) := by
    constructor
    · intro h; unfold V W keep; rw [h]
    · intro H
      funext i
      obtain ⟨t,rfl⟩ := e.surjective i
      rcases t with t|t
      · exact congrFun (congrArg Prod.fst H) t
      · exact congrFun (congrArg Prod.snd H) t
  have hpart :
      P.Hcond X Z = P.Hcond (fun x => (V x,W x)) Z := by
    unfold Hcond
    congr 1
    exact P.H_partition fun x y => by simp [hh x y]
  have hpart' :
      P.Hcond V (fun x => (W x,Z x)) = P.Hcond V (fun x => (Y x,W x)) := by
    apply Hcond_right_partition
    intro a b
    simp only [Prod.mk.injEq, hs]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨h,he⟩; rw [h] at he; exact ⟨add_right_cancel he,h⟩
    · rintro ⟨h,h'⟩; rw [h,h']; exact ⟨rfl,rfl⟩
  have hCE : P.Hcond W Z ≤ ∑ i, P.Ex (fun x => -log (q (W x i))) := by
    have hcW : covered P W q := fun x hx _ => h x hx _
    apply le_trans (P.Hcond_le_H W Z)
    rw [← sum_crosspack hcW]
    exact sub_nonneg.mp (kl_nonneg (covered_pack hcW))
  have hE (f : Ω → ℝ) :
      (P.send W).Ex (fun w => (P.after W w).Ex f) = P.Ex f :=
    P.after_Ex_sum W (fun _ => f)
  unfold bill
  simp_rw [Ex_add,Ex_sub,Ex_finset_sum,hE, ← Hcond_after_cond]
  change _ - P.Hcond V _ + _ ≤ (_ - P.Hcond X Z) + _
  rw [sum_split' e (fun i : ι => P.Ex (fun x => -log (q (X x i)))),
    hpart,Hcond_chain,hpart']
  change _ - P.Hcond V (fun x => (Y x,W x)) + _ ≤
    ((∑ i, P.Ex fun x => -log (q (V x i))) + (∑ i, P.Ex fun x => -log (q (W x i))) - _) + _
  linarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.bill_subfamily
statement:
lemma bill_subfamily (tag : α → G) (c : G → ℝ) (q : Law α)
    (P : Law Ω) (X : Ω → ι → α) (U : Ω → G) (h : covered P X q)
    (g : τ → ι) (hg : Injective g) :
    bill tag c q P (keep X g) U ≤ bill tag c q P X U
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let e := (Equiv.sumCongr (Equiv.ofInjective g hg)
      (Equiv.refl {x // ¬ (fun y => y ∈ range g) x})).trans (Equiv.sumCompl (fun y => y ∈ range g))
  let V := keep X (fun i => e (.inl i))
  let W := keep X (fun i => e (.inr i))
  have H :
      bill tag c q P V U ≤ bill tag c q P X U := by
    refine le_trans ?_ (bill_split tag c q P X U h e)
    have hh := bill_through_le tag c q (P.send W) V U (P.after W)
    rw [through_after] at hh
    exact hh
  have heq : V = keep X g := rfl
  rwa [heq] at H

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.covered_subfamily
statement:
lemma covered_subfamily {P : Law Ω} {X : Ω → ι → α} {q : Law α} (h : covered P X q)
    (g : τ → ι) : covered P (keep X g) q
proof: := fun x hx _ => h x hx _

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.covered_after
statement:
lemma covered_after {P : Law Ω} {X : Ω → ι → α} {q : Law α} (h : covered P X q)
    (W : Ω → A) (w : A) (hw : 0 < P.send W w) : covered (P.after W w) X q
proof:
:=
  fun x hx i => h x ((after_mem hw).mp hx).2 i

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.log_ticket
statement:
lemma log_ticket (r j : ℕ) (hr : 1 ≤ r) (h : r ≤ 2^j) (hj : 1 ≤ j) :
    log (Fintype.card (Ticket r (2*r)) : ℝ) ≤ 1 + r*(2*(j:ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  have hp : 0 < (r:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hr
  have hcard : Fintype.card (Fin r ↪ Fin (2*r)) ≤ (2*r)^r := by
    have hi := Fintype.card_le_of_injective
      (fun (e : Fin r ↪ Fin (2*r)) => (e : Fin r → Fin (2*r))) (by intro a b hab; ext i : 1; exact congrFun hab i)
    simpa using hi
  have hl2 := log_le_sub_one_of_pos (show (0:ℝ)<2 by norm_num)
  have hx : log (2*(r:ℝ)) ≤ 2*(j:ℝ) := by
    rw [log_mul (by norm_num) hp.ne']
    have h1 := Real.log_le_log hp (show (r:ℝ) ≤ 2^j by exact_mod_cast h)
    rw [log_pow] at h1
    have hJ : (1:ℝ) ≤ j := by exact_mod_cast hj
    nlinarith
  unfold Ticket
  rw [Fintype.card_option]
  have ht : 0 < ((Fintype.card (Fin r ↪ Fin (2*r)) + 1:ℕ):ℝ) := by positivity
  apply le_trans (Real.log_le_log ht (y:=2*(2*(r:ℝ))^r) ?_) ?_
  · have h1 : Fintype.card (Fin r ↪ Fin (2*r)) + 1 ≤ 2*(2*r)^r := by
      have hp : 0 < (2*r)^r := pow_pos (by omega) _
      omega
    exact_mod_cast h1
  rw [Real.log_mul (by norm_num) (by positivity),Real.log_pow]
  nlinarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.approx_error
statement:
private lemma approx_error {d h F D T m j : ℝ} (hh : 1 ≤ h) (hj : h ≤ j)
    (hd : 0 < d) (hm : 0 < m) (hD : 1 ≤ D)
    (hF : d/h^2 ≤ F) (hFd : F ≤ D*d)
    (Ht : d=4*T*h^6)
    (H : 1024*D*j^16 ≤ m) (H' : m^4 ≤ d) :
    (2*m*√F/T)*(d*j^2) ≤ F
proof:
:= by
  have hh' : 0 < h := by linarith
  have hF' : 0 < F := lt_of_lt_of_le (by positivity) hF
  have hp : 0 < T := pos_of_mul_pos_left (show 0 < T*(4*h^6) by
    calc 0 < d := hd
         _ = T*(4*h^6) := by rw [Ht]; ring) (by positivity)
  have hw : 8*D*(j^2*h^8) ≤ m := by
    apply le_trans _ H
    have hj1 : 1 ≤ j := hh.trans hj
    calc
      _ ≤ 8*D*(j^2*j^8) := by gcongr
      _ ≤ 1024*D*j^16 := by
        have HH : j^10 ≤ j^16 := pow_le_pow_right₀ hj1 (by omega)
        rw [← pow_add]; gcongr; norm_num
  have hsr : √F ≤ D*√d := by
    have Hx := sq_sqrt hF'.le
    have Hy := sq_sqrt hd.le
    have Hh : D*d ≤ (D*√d)^2 := by
      rw [mul_pow,Hy]; gcongr; nlinarith
    nlinarith [hFd.trans Hh,sqrt_nonneg F, show 0 ≤ D*√d by positivity]
  have hQ : m^2 ≤ √d := by
    have Ht := sq_sqrt hd.le
    nlinarith [show m^4=(m^2)^2 by ring,sqrt_nonneg d,sq_nonneg (m^2-√d)]
  have hz : 8*m*√F*j^2*h^8 ≤ d := by
    calc
      _ ≤ m * √d * (8*D*(j^2*h^8)) := by
        calc
          _ ≤ 8*m*(D*√d)*j^2*h^8 := by gcongr
          _ = _ := by ring
      _ ≤ m*√d*m := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hw (by positivity)
      _ = m^2*√d := by ring
      _ ≤ √d*√d := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hQ (sqrt_nonneg _)
      _ = d := by rw [← sq,sq_sqrt hd.le]
  apply le_trans (b:=d/h^2) _ hF
  apply (le_div_iff₀ (pow_pos hh' 2)).mpr

  have hle : 2*m*√F*j^2*h^2 ≤ T := by
    rw [Ht] at hz
    refine le_of_mul_le_mul_right ?_ (show 0 < 4*h^6 by positivity)
    calc
      _ = 8*m*√F*j^2*h^8 := by ring
      _ ≤ 4*T*h^6 := hz
      _ = T*(4*h^6) := by ring
  calc
    _ = (2*m*√F*j^2*h^2)/T*d := by ring
    _ ≤ 1*d := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ((div_le_one hp).mpr hle) hd.le
    _ = d := one_mul d

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.size_bound
statement:
private lemma size_bound {d h F D T a : ℝ} (hh : 1 ≤ h) (hd : 0 < d) (hT : 0 < T)
    (hD : 1 ≤ D) (hp : 0 < F) (hF : F ≤ D*d)
    (Ht : d=4*T*h^6)
    (H : D*h^8 ≤ d) (ha : a ≤ 66/h^2) :
    8*(3*(F/T)+a*(20*D*d)*(20*D*d)/F)+2 ≤ 300000*D^2*d^2/(F*h^2)
proof:
:= by
  have hh' : 0 < h := by linarith
  have hc : 0 < 20*D*d := by positivity
  apply (le_div_iff₀ (by positivity : 0 < F*h^2)).mpr
  let x := D^2*d^2
  have hx : 0 ≤ x := by unfold x; positivity
  have hF1 : F^2 ≤ x := by unfold x; rw [← mul_pow]; gcongr
  have hT1 : h^2 ≤ 4*T := by
    have H1 : h^8 ≤ d := le_trans (le_mul_of_one_le_left (by positivity) hD) H
    rw [Ht,show h^8=h^2*h^6 by ring] at H1
    exact le_of_mul_le_mul_right H1 (by positivity)
  have he1 : F/T*(F*h^2) ≤ 4*x := calc
    _ ≤ F/T*(F*(4*T)) := by gcongr
    _ = 4*F^2 := by field_simp
    _ ≤ 4*x := by gcongr
  have he2 : a*(20*D*d)*(20*D*d)/F*(F*h^2) ≤ (66*400)*x := by
    calc
      _ ≤ (66/h^2)*(20*D*d)*(20*D*d)/F*(F*h^2) := by gcongr
      _ = _ := by unfold x; field_simp; ring
  have HH : h^2 ≤ h^8 := pow_le_pow_right₀ hh (by norm_num)
  have he3 : F*h^2 ≤ x := by
    have h1 : h^8 ≤ d := le_trans (le_mul_of_one_le_left (by positivity) hD) H
    calc
      _ ≤ (D*d)*(D*d) := by gcongr; nlinarith
      _ = _ := by unfold x; ring
  calc
    _ = 24*(F/T*(F*h^2))+8*(a*(20*D*d)*(20*D*d)/F*(F*h^2))+2*(F*h^2) := by ring
    _ ≤ 300000*x := by linarith
    _ = _ := by unfold x; ring

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.entropy_compression
statement:
theorem entropy_compression (D : ℝ) (hD : 1 ≤ D) :
    ∀ᶠ j : ℕ in atTop, ∀ (A G Θ : Type)
      (_ : Fintype A) (_ : Fintype G) (_ : Fintype Θ) (_ : Nonempty A)
      (_ : DecidableEq G) (_ : AddCommGroup G)
      (tag : A → G), Injective tag → ∀ (q : Law G), (∀ x, 0 < q x) →
      ∀ (c : G → ℝ), (∀ x, 0 ≤ c x) → c 0=0 →
      ∀ (Q : Law Θ) (χ : Θ → AddChar G ℂ),
        (∀ t x, ‖χ t x‖=1) →
        (∀ g, (↑(exp (-c g)):ℂ)=Q.Cx (fun t => χ t g)) →
        (∀ g, -log (q g) = -log (q 0) + c g) →
        -log (q 0) ≤ D*height j →
        (∀ n : ℕ, n ≤ 2^(2*j) → lnS (Fin n) tag ≤ height j * j^2) →
        ∀ F : ℝ, height j/(slow j:ℝ)^2 ≤ F → F ≤ D*height j →
        (∀ p : Law A, exp (-F) ≤ heatMoment (Fin (sLen j)) p tag c) →
        ∃ (a : A) (s : Finset A), s.Nonempty ∧
          log (Fintype.card A)-log (s.card:ℝ) ≤
            300000*D^2*(height j)^2/(F*(slow j:ℝ)^2) ∧
          small_defects tag χ Q (long j) s a (350*F)
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [array_spec,big_t_real,below_base 16 (1024*D),
    slow_le_j,slow_tendsto.eventually (eventually_ge_atTop 4),t_expr] with j hs ht hb hj h4 hjt
  intro A G Θ _ _ _ _ _ _ tag hi q hq c hc hc0 Q χ hn hrq hlog hq0 hv F hF hFd h
  let d := height j; let t : ℝ := slow j
  have h4' : 4 ≤ t := by unfold t; exact_mod_cast h4
  have htj : t ≤ j := by unfold t; exact_mod_cast hj
  have hd : 0 < d := by unfold d height; positivity
  let N := sSeg j
  have hpN : (0:ℝ) < N := by
    unfold N; exact_mod_cast pow_pos_nat (j-6*ell j-2)
  obtain ⟨hT,hsm,hmd,hil,horder⟩ := hs
  change d=4*N*t^6 ∧ _ at ht
  have hb' : (base j:ℝ) ≤ cap j := by exact_mod_cast base_le_cap j
  have hj1 : (1:ℝ) ≤ (j:ℝ) := by linarith
  have hh : D*t^8 ≤ d := by
    have h1 : (cap j:ℝ) ≤ d := by unfold d height; exact_mod_cast hmd
    calc
      _ ≤ 1024*D*(j:ℝ)^16 := by
        have hx : t^8 ≤ (j:ℝ)^16 := le_trans (pow_le_pow_left₀ (by linarith) htj _) (pow_le_pow_right₀ hj1 (by norm_num))
        gcongr; nlinarith
      _ ≤ _ := hb.trans (hb'.trans h1)
  have h44 : t^2 ≤ d := by
    calc
      t^2 ≤ t^8 := pow_le_pow_right₀ (by linarith) (by norm_num)
      _ ≤ _ := le_trans (le_mul_of_one_le_left (by positivity) hD) hh
  have htp : 0 < t := by linarith
  have he : 1 ≤ F := le_trans (b := d / t^2) ((le_div_iff₀ (sq_pos_of_pos htp)).mpr (by simpa)) hF
  let S := searchSched j h4
  obtain ⟨a,s,h1,h2,h3⟩ := compress_arrays tag hi q hq c hc hc0 Q χ hn hrq hlog
    F (long j) (20*D*d) he (by unfold long; positivity)
    (sLen j) N (cap j) (pow_pos_nat _) hsm hT S (stepLow j) (stepHigh j) (stepRows j)
    (by
      intro i _
      have hh := hil i
      exact ⟨hh.1,hh.2.1,pow_pos_nat _,pow_pos_nat _,hh.2.2.1.le,hh.2.2.2.1⟩)
    (by intro i k hik hk; exact horder i k hik hk) h (by dsimp only [d] at *; linarith)
    (fun i _ => pow_pos_nat _) (by
      have hn' : N ≤ 2^j := by unfold N sSeg; apply Nat.pow_le_pow_right <;> omega
      have hErr := approx_error (by linarith : (1:ℝ) ≤ t) htj hd
        (show (0:ℝ) < cap j by exact_mod_cast pow_pos_nat (capE j))
        hD hF hFd ht.1 (hb.trans hb') ht.2
      intro i _
      let l := stepLow j i; let r := stepRows j i
      have hlo := hil i
      have hjt : 2^j ≤ 2^(2*j) := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) (by omega)
      let ε := 2*(cap j:ℝ)*√F/N
      have hε : 0 ≤ ε := by unfold ε; positivity
      have hz (k : ℕ) (hh : k ≤ 2^j) : ε * lnS (Fin k) tag ≤ F :=
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hv k (hh.trans hjt)) hε).trans hErr
      have hp : 0 < r := pow_pos_nat _
      have hl : 0 < l := pow_pos_nat _
      have hqr : 2*r*l=N := hlo.2.2.1
      have hiN : r*l ≤ N := by nlinarith
      have hiR : r ≤ N := le_trans (Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right r hl) hiN
      have HR := hz (r*l) (hiN.trans hn')
      refine ⟨hz _ (hlo.2.1.trans hmd),?_⟩
      have H1 := log_ticket r j hp (hiR.trans hn') (by omega)
      have hb'' : (base j:ℝ) ≤ l := by exact_mod_cast hlo.2.2.2.2
      have hlB : 4*(j:ℝ)*t^2 ≤ l := by
        apply le_trans _ (hb.trans hb'')
        calc
          _ ≤ 4*((j:ℝ)*(j:ℝ)^2) := by rw [mul_assoc]; gcongr
          _ ≤ _ := by
            rw [show (j:ℝ)*(j:ℝ)^2=(j:ℝ)^3 by ring]
            have HH : (j:ℝ)^3 ≤ (j:ℝ)^16 := pow_le_pow_right₀ hj1 (by norm_num)
            gcongr; linarith
      have hND : (N:ℝ) ≤ d := by unfold d height; exact_mod_cast hn'
      have hRN : (r:ℝ)*l ≤ N := by exact_mod_cast hiN
      have hrD : (r:ℝ)*(4*(j:ℝ)) ≤ F := by
        apply le_trans _ hF
        apply (le_div_iff₀ (by positivity : 0 < t^2)).mpr
        rw [mul_assoc]
        exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlB (by positivity)).trans (hRN.trans hND)
      change log _+(r:ℝ)+ 2 * ε*lnS (Fin (r*l)) tag ≤ _
      nlinarith [show (0:ℝ) ≤ r by positivity])
  exact ⟨a,s,h1,h2.trans
    (size_bound (by linarith : (1:ℝ) ≤ t) hd hpN hD (by linarith) hFd ht.1 hh (searchSched_loss _ h4)),h3⟩

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.mix_send
statement:
lemma mix_send (P Q : Law Ω) (t : ℝ) (h0 : 0 ≤ t) (h1 : t ≤ 1)
    (X : Ω → A) :
    (mixture P Q t h0 h1).send X = mixture (P.send X) (Q.send X) t h0 h1
proof:
:= by
  apply ext_of_Ex; intro f
  simp_rw [mixture_Ex,Ex_send,mixture_Ex]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.marked_cond
statement:
lemma marked_cond (P Q : Law Ω) (t : ℝ) (h0 : 0 ≤ t) (h1 : t ≤ 1)
    (X : Ω → A) (W : Ω → V) (f : V → Bool)
    (hP : ∀ x, 0 < P x → f (W x) = true)
    (hQ : ∀ x, 0 < Q x → f (W x) = false) :
    (mixture P Q t h0 h1).Hcond X W =
      t*P.Hcond X W+(1-t)*Q.Hcond X W
proof:
:= by
  rw [mixture_eq_through]
  let B := coinP t h0 h1
  let K (b : Bool) := if b then P else Q
  let R := withNext B K
  change (through B K).Hcond X W = _
  have hy (z : Bool × Ω) (hz : 0 < R z) : f (W z.2) = z.1 := by
    obtain ⟨b,x⟩ := z
    change 0 < B b * K b x at hz
    have hx : 0 < K b x := pos_of_mul_pos_right hz (B.nonneg b)
    cases b
    · exact hQ x hx
    · exact hP x hx
  let X' (z : Bool×Ω) := X z.2
  let W' (z : Bool×Ω) := W z.2
  rw [← send_snd_withNext B K,Hcond_send]
  have HH : R.Hcond X' W' = R.Hcond X' (fun z => (z.1, W' z)) := by
    calc
      _ = R.Hcond X' (fun z => (f (W' z),W' z)) :=
        Hcond_right_partition _ _ (fun _ _ => by simp; grind)
      _ = _ := Hcond_congr (X:=X') (fun _ _ => rfl)
        (W:=fun z => (f (W' z),W' z)) fun z hz => by rw [show _=z.1 from hy z hz]
  have H :=
    Hcond_withNext B K (fun _ => X) (fun _ => W)
  change R.Hcond X' W' = _
  rw [HH,show R.Hcond X' _ = _ from H,coinP_Ex]
  rfl

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.retag_inj
statement:
lemma retag_inj (f : V → W) (hf : Injective f) :
    Injective (retag (A:=A) f)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨x,a⟩ ⟨y,b⟩ h
  simpa only [retag,Prod.mk.injEq,hf.eq_iff] using h

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.blend_refines
statement:
lemma blend_refines (P Q R : Labelled A) (hp : refines P R) (hq : refines Q R)
    (t : ℝ) (h0 : 0 ≤ t) (h1 : t ≤ 1) : refines (blend P Q t h0 h1) R
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u,hu⟩ := hp; obtain ⟨v,hv⟩ := hq
  refine ⟨Sum.elim u v,?_⟩
  dsimp only [blend]
  rw [mix_send,send_send,send_send]
  apply Law.ext; intro a
  rw [mixture_apply]
  dsimp only [retag,Sum.elim_inl,Sum.elim_inr]
  rw [hu,hv]; ring

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.retag_Hcond
statement:
lemma retag_Hcond (P : Law (A×V)) (f : V→W) (h : Injective f) :
    (P.send (retag f)).Hcond (fun x => x) Prod.snd = P.Hcond (fun x => x) Prod.snd
proof:
:= by
  rw [full_pair,full_pair,Hcond_send]
  apply Hcond_right_partition
  exact fun _ _ => h.eq_iff

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.blend_H
statement:
lemma blend_H (P Q : Labelled A) (t : ℝ) (h0 : 0 ≤ t) (h1 : t ≤ 1) :
    (blend P Q t h0 h1).law.Hcond (fun a => a) Prod.snd =
      t*P.law.Hcond (fun a => a) Prod.snd+(1-t)*Q.law.Hcond (fun a => a) Prod.snd
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only [blend]
  let K := Sum.elim (fun _ : P.obs => true) (fun _ : Q.obs => false)
  rw [marked_cond _ _ t h0 h1 _ _ K, retag_Hcond _ (Sum.inl : P.obs → P.obs ⊕ Q.obs)
    Sum.inl_injective,retag_Hcond _ (Sum.inr : Q.obs → P.obs ⊕ Q.obs) Sum.inr_injective]
  all_goals
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨y,rfl,_⟩ := (send_pos_iff _ _ _).mp hx
    rfl

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.retag_trial
statement:
lemma retag_trial (n : ℕ) (tag : A → G) (P : Law (WordSample n (A×V) Unit))
    (f : V → W) (h : Injective f) :
    (P.send (upRows n f)).Hcond Prod.fst (packedH n tag W) =
      P.Hcond Prod.fst (packedH n tag V)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Hcond_send]
  have hc (x y : WordSample n (A×V) Unit) :
      packedH n tag W (upRows n f x) = packedH n tag W (upRows n f y) ↔
      packedH n tag V x = packedH n tag V y := by
    simp only [packedH,upRows,ctxt,ans,tot,comp_apply,retag, Prod.mk.injEq,funext_iff,h.eq_iff]
  unfold Hcond
  congr 1
  · refine H_partition _ fun x y => ?_
    have heq : (upRows n f x).1=(upRows n f y).1 ↔ x.1=y.1 := by
      simp only [funext_iff,upRows,ctxt,(retag_inj f h).eq_iff]
    rw [show (Prod.fst x) = x.1 from rfl]
    constructor
    · intro hh
      replace hh := Prod.mk.inj hh
      exact Prod.ext (heq.mp hh.1) ((hc x y).mp hh.2)
    · intro hh
      replace hh := Prod.mk.inj hh
      exact Prod.ext (heq.mpr hh.1) ((hc x y).mpr hh.2)
  · exact H_partition _ hc

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.retag_trial_rows
statement:
lemma retag_trial_rows (n : ℕ) (p : Law (A × V)) (P : Law (WordSample n (A × V) Unit))
    (h : hasRows p P Prod.fst) (f : V → W) :
    hasRows (p.send (retag f)) (P.send (upRows n f)) Prod.fst
proof:
:= by
  intro i; rw [← h i,send_send,send_send]; rfl

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.exact_rent
statement:
lemma exact_rent (n : ℕ) (S : Labelled A) (tag : A → G)
    (P : Law (WordSample n (A×S.obs) Unit)) (h : hasRows S.law P Prod.fst) :
    rent (tag ∘ Prod.fst) Prod.snd (fun _ : Unit => (0:G)) (fun _ => 0) P Prod.fst Prod.snd =
      (n:ℝ) * S.law.Hcond (fun a => a) Prod.snd - P.Hcond Prod.fst (packedH n tag _)
proof:
:= by
  rw [rent,rent_first h, Fintype.card_fin]
  rw [Ex_const,add_zero]; rfl

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.blend_I
statement:
lemma blend_I (tag : A → G) (P Q : Labelled A) (t : ℝ) (h0 : 0 ≤ t) (h1 : t ≤ 1)
    (n : ℕ) : fundI tag (blend P Q t h0 h1) n ≤ t*fundI tag P n+(1-t)*fundI tag Q n
proof:
:= by
  let u0 (_ : Unit) := (0:G)
  let c0 (_ : Unit) := (0:ℝ)
  obtain ⟨R,hR,eR⟩ := (opt_spec n P.law (tag ∘ Prod.fst) Prod.snd u0 c0).1
  obtain ⟨S,hS,eS⟩ := (opt_spec n Q.law (tag ∘ Prod.fst) Prod.snd u0 c0).1
  let B := blend P Q t h0 h1
  let p := (Sum.inl : P.obs → P.obs ⊕ Q.obs)
  let q := (Sum.inr : Q.obs → P.obs ⊕ Q.obs)
  let T := mixture (R.send (upRows n p)) (S.send (upRows n q)) t h0 h1
  have hT : hasRows (blend P Q t h0 h1).law T Prod.fst := by
    intro i
    unfold T
    rw [mix_send, retag_trial_rows n _ R hR p i, retag_trial_rows n _ S hS q i]
  apply le_trans (opt_le_rent (tag ∘ Prod.fst) Prod.snd u0 c0 _ T _ Prod.snd hT)
  change _ ≤ t*opt n P.law _ _ u0 c0+(1-t)*opt n Q.law _ _ u0 c0
  rw [← eR,← eS]
  dsimp only [u0,c0]
  rw [exact_rent n (blend P Q t h0 h1) tag T hT, exact_rent n P tag R hR,exact_rent n Q tag S hS]
  have hp := Hcond_mixture_ge (R.send (upRows n p)) (S.send (upRows n q)) t h0 h1
    Prod.fst (packedH n tag _)
  rw [retag_trial n tag R p Sum.inl_injective, retag_trial n tag S q Sum.inr_injective] at hp
  rw [blend_H]
  unfold T
  linarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.blend_G1
statement:
lemma blend_G1 (tag : A→G) (hi : Injective tag) (P Q : Labelled A)
    (t : ℝ) (h0 : 0 ≤ t) (h1 : t ≤ 1) :
    fundG tag (blend P Q t h0 h1) 1 = t*fundG tag P 1+(1-t)*fundG tag Q 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [I_single tag hi, I_single tag hi, I_single tag hi]; exact blend_H P Q t h0 h1

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.average_two_below
statement:
lemma average_two_below (P : Law Ω) (f g : Ω → ℝ)
    (h0 : ∀ x, 0 < P x → 0 ≤ f x) (h1 : ∀ x, 0 < P x → 0 ≤ g x)
    (F G : ℝ) (hp : 0 < F) (hq : 0 < G) (hf : P.Ex f ≤ F) (hg : P.Ex g ≤ G) :
    ∃ x, 0 < P x ∧ f x ≤ 2*F ∧ g x ≤ 2*G
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x,hx,hh⟩ := P.exists_le_Ex (fun x => F*g x + G*f x)
  rw [Ex_add,Ex_lmul,Ex_lmul] at hh
  have H : F*g x + G*f x ≤ F*G+G*F := le_trans hh (by gcongr)
  exact ⟨x,hx,by nlinarith [h1 _ hx],by nlinarith [h0 _ hx]⟩

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.large_heat
statement:
lemma large_heat (P : Law Ω) (q : Law A) (X : Ω → A) (tag : A → G) (U : Ω → G) (c : G → ℝ)
    (hcov : (P.send X).dominated q) (F : ℝ)
    (hF : P.Ex (fun x => -log (q (X x))) - P.Hcond X (fun x => tag (X x)+U x)+
      P.Ex (fun x => c (U x)) ≤ F) :
    ∃ z : G, exp (-F) ≤ q.Ex fun a => exp (-c (z-tag a))
proof:
:= by
  let Z (a : Ω) := tag (X a)+U a
  let V := P.send Z
  let p z := P.after Z z
  let g (z : G) :=
    (p z).Ex (fun x => -log (q (X x))) - (p z).H X + (p z).Ex (fun x => c (U x))
  have hh : V.Ex g ≤ F := by
    have H (f : Ω → ℝ) :
        V.Ex (fun z => (p z).Ex f) = P.Ex f := after_Ex_sum P Z (fun _ => f)
    unfold g; rw [Ex_add,Ex_sub,H,H]
    change _ - (P.send Z).Ex (fun z => (P.after Z z).H X)+_≤ _
    rw [← Hcond_after]; exact hF
  obtain ⟨z,hz,hze⟩ := V.exists_le_Ex g
  let f a := q a* exp (-c (z-tag a))
  let D := ∑ a, f a
  have hf (a) : 0 ≤ f a := mul_nonneg (q.nonneg _) (exp_nonneg _)
  have hc (a) (ha : 0 < p z a) : 0 < q (X a) := by
    have HH := (after_mem (P:=P) (W:=Z) hz).mp ha
    exact hcov _ (P.send_pos X HH.2)
  have ht : 0 < D := by
    obtain ⟨x,hx⟩ := q.mem_nonempty
    have h : 0 < f x := mul_pos hx (exp_pos _)
    exact lt_of_lt_of_le h (Finset.single_le_sum (s:=Finset.univ) (fun a _ => hf a) (Finset.mem_univ _))
  let Q := proportional f hf ht
  have he (x) (hx : 0 < p z x) :
      -log (Q (X x)) = -log (q (X x))+c (U x)+log D := by
    have hx' := (after_mem (P:=P) (W:=Z) hz).mp hx
    have h : z-tag (X x)=U x := by rw [← hx'.1]; unfold Z; abel
    change -log (f _/D) = _
    rw [log_div (mul_pos (hc _ hx) (exp_pos _)).ne' ht.ne']
    rw [log_mul (hc _ hx).ne' (exp_pos _).ne',h,log_exp]
    ring
  have hd : ((p z).send X).dominated Q := by
    intro a ha
    obtain ⟨y,rfl,hy⟩ := (send_pos_iff _ _ _).mp ha
    exact div_pos (mul_pos (hc y hy) (exp_pos _)) ht
  have HC : (p z).H X ≤ (p z).Ex (fun x => -log (Q (X x))) := by
    rw [← Ex_send (p z) X (fun x => -log (Q x))]
    exact sub_nonneg.mp (kl_nonneg hd)
  have hlin := ((p z).Ex_congr_mem he)
  rw [hlin,Ex_add,Ex_add,Ex_const] at HC
  have h1 : -F ≤ log D := by
    have hi := hze.trans hh
    dsimp only [g] at hi; linarith
  refine ⟨z,le_trans (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr h1) (Real.exp_log ht).le⟩

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.stack_select
statement:
lemma stack_select (tag : A → G) (c : G → ℝ) (hc : ∀ x, 0 ≤ c x)
    (p : Law (A×V)) (P : Law Ω) (X : Ω → I → A) (W : Ω → I → V) (U : Ω → G)
    (hp : ∀ i : I, P.send (fun x => (X x i,W x i)) = p)
    (F D : ℝ) (hF : 0 < F) (hD : 0 < D)
    [Nonempty I]
    (hs : Fintype.card I * p.Hcond Prod.fst Prod.snd -
      P.Hcond X (fun x => (ans tag X U x, W x)) + P.Ex (fun x => c (U x)) ≤ F)
    (hd : log (Fintype.card A) - p.Hcond Prod.fst Prod.snd ≤ D) :
    ∃ (q : I → Law A) (z : G),
      exp (-(2*F)) ≤ (pack q).Ex (fun x => exp (-c (z-tot tag x))) ∧
      ∑ i, (log (Fintype.card A)- (q i).entropy) ≤ 2*(Fintype.card I*D)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let R w := P.after W w
  let k v := (p.after Prod.snd v).send Prod.fst
  let q (w : I → V) (i : I) : Law A := k (w i)
  let Z := ans tag X U
  let Y := P.send W
  have hval (a : Ω) (ha : 0 < P a) (i : I) : 0 < q (W a) i (X a i) := by
    have H0 := P.send_pos (fun a => (X a i,W a i)) ha
    rw [hp i] at H0
    exact (p.after Prod.snd (W a i)).send_pos Prod.fst (p.after_self_pos _ H0)
  have hdom (w : I → V) (hw : 0 < Y w) :
      ((R w).send X).dominated (pack (q w)) := by
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨a,rfl,ha⟩ := (send_pos_iff _ _ _).mp hx
    have H := (after_mem hw).mp ha
    rw [pack_pos,← H.1]
    exact hval a H.2
  let N := Fintype.card I
  let a (w : I → V) :=
    (R w).Ex (fun x => -log (pack (q w) (X x))) -
      (R w).Hcond X Z + (R w).Ex fun x => c (U x)
  let b (w : I → V) := ∑ i, (log (Fintype.card A) - entropy (q w i))
  have ha (w) (hw : 0 < Y w) : 0 ≤ a w := by
    have hh := kl_nonneg (hdom w hw)
    unfold kl crossE at hh
    rw [Ex_send] at hh
    have ht := Hcond_le_H (R w) X Z
    unfold H at ht
    exact add_nonneg (by linarith) (Ex_nonneg (R w) (fun x => hc _))
  have hb (w : I → V) : 0 ≤ b w :=
    Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => sub_nonneg.mpr (entropy_le_log_card _)
  have hrow (i : I) (f : (A×V) → ℝ) :
