      P.Ex (fun x => f (X x i,W x i)) = p.Ex f := by
    rw [← Ex_send P (fun x => (X x i,W x i)), hp i]
  have hE : Y.Ex a ≤ F := by
    have hX : Y.Ex (fun w => (R w).Ex fun x => -log (pack (q w) (X x))) =
        ∑ i : I, p.Hcond Prod.fst Prod.snd := by
      let f (w : I → V) (x : Ω) := -log (pack (q w) (X x))
      rw [show Y.Ex _ = P.Ex _ from P.after_Ex_sum W f]
      have H1 (x : Ω) (hx : 0 < P x) :
          f (W x) x = ∑ i, -log (q (W x) i (X x i)) := by
        unfold f; rw [pack_apply,log_prod,Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
        exact fun i _ => (hval x hx i).ne'
      rw [P.Ex_congr_mem H1,Ex_finset_sum,Hcond_log]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
      exact hrow i (fun x => -log (k x.2 x.1))
    have HU : Y.Ex (fun w => (R w).Ex (fun x => c (U x))) = _ :=
      P.after_Ex_sum W (fun _ x => c (U x))
    have hz : Y.Ex (fun w => (R w).Hcond X Z) = _ :=
      (Hcond_after_cond P X Z W).symm
    unfold a
    rw [Ex_add,Ex_sub,hX,HU,hz,Finset.sum_const,Finset.card_univ,nsmul_eq_mul]
    exact hs
  have hB : Y.Ex b ≤ N * D := by
    have HH : ∀ i : I, Y.Ex (fun w => entropy (q w i)) = p.Hcond Prod.fst Prod.snd := by
      intro i
      dsimp only [Y]; rw [Ex_send]
      rw [Hcond_after,Ex_send]
      exact hrow i (fun x => entropy (k x.2))
    unfold b
    simp_rw [Ex_finset_sum,Ex_sub,HH,Ex_const,Finset.sum_const,Finset.card_univ,nsmul_eq_mul]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hd (by positivity)
  obtain ⟨w,hw,hw',hw''⟩ :=
    average_two_below Y a b ha (fun x _ => hb x) F (N*D) hF
      (mul_pos (by unfold N; positivity) hD) hE hB
  obtain ⟨z,hz⟩ := large_heat (R w) (pack (q w)) X (tot tag) U c (hdom w hw) (2*F) hw'
  exact ⟨q w,z,hz,hw''⟩

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.freeze
statement:
lemma freeze (tag : A → G) (hi : Injective tag) (c : G → ℝ) (hc : ∀ x, 0 ≤ c x)
    (P : Labelled A) (m r : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (hr : 0 < r)
    (F D : ℝ) (hF : 0 < F) (hD : 0 < D) (hs : fundK tag c P m r ≤ F)
    (hd : log (Fintype.card A) - fundG tag P 1 ≤ D) :
    ∃ (q : (Fin r×Fin m) → Law A) (z : G),
      exp (-(2*F)) ≤ (pack q).Ex (fun x => exp (-c (z-tot tag x))) ∧
      ∑ i, (log (Fintype.card A)- (q i).entropy) ≤ 2*((r:ℝ)*m*D)
proof:
:= by
  have : NeZero r := ⟨hr.ne'⟩
  have : NeZero m := ⟨hm.ne'⟩
  let t := lblSum tag P m
  let C := lblCtx P m
  let Q := lblP P m
  obtain ⟨S,hS,he⟩ := (opt_spec r Q t C (fun x => x) c).1
  let Y := WordSample r (Letters m (A×P.obs)) G
  let X (p : Y) (i : Fin r × Fin m) := (p.1 i.1 i.2).1
  let W (p : Y) (i : Fin r × Fin m) := (p.1 i.1 i.2).2
  have Hrow (i : Fin r×Fin m) : S.send (fun p => (X p i,W p i)) = P.law := by
    have h1 : Q.send (fun x => x i.2) = P.law := marginalPack _ _
    rw [← h1,← hS i.1,send_send]; rfl
  have HQ : Q.Hcond (fun x => x) C = m*P.law.Hcond Prod.fst Prod.snd := by
    have HH := Hcond_vec_pack (fun _ : Fin m => P.law) (fun _ a => a)
      (fun _ => Prod.snd)
    have hi : P.law.Hcond (fun x => x) Prod.snd = P.law.Hcond Prod.fst Prod.snd := by
      unfold Hcond; congr 1; apply H_partition; simp
    simp_rw [hi,Finset.sum_const,Finset.card_univ,Fintype.card_fin,nsmul_eq_mul] at HH
    exact HH
  let u0 : Y → G := Prod.snd
  let s0 (x : Y) := ans t Prod.fst u0 x
  have ht0 (x : Y) : s0 x = ans tag X u0 x := by
    unfold s0 t lblSum ans tot
    simp only [Fintype.sum_prod_type, Function.comp_apply, X]
  let w0 (x : Y) := ctxt C Prod.fst x
  have h1 : S.Hcond Prod.fst (fun x => (s0 x,w0 x)) =
      S.Hcond X (fun x => (ans tag X u0 x,W x)) := by
    unfold Hcond
    have h' (x y : Y) : w0 x = w0 y ↔ W x=W y := by
      simp only [w0,W,C,ctxt,lblCtx,funext_iff,Prod.forall]
    congr 1
    · apply H_partition
      intro x y
      simp only [Prod.mk.injEq,h',ht0]
      have hy : x.1=y.1 ↔ X x=X y ∧ W x=W y := by
        simp only [X,W,funext_iff,Prod.forall]
        constructor
        · intro h; simp [h]
        · grind
      tauto
    · apply H_partition; simp only [Prod.mk.injEq,h',ht0]; tauto
  have hcost : Fintype.card (Fin r×Fin m)*P.law.Hcond Prod.fst Prod.snd -
      S.Hcond X (fun x => (ans tag X u0 x,W x))+ S.Ex (fun a => c (u0 a)) ≤ F := by
    have HH : rent t C (fun x => x) c S Prod.fst Prod.snd ≤ F := he.le.trans hs
    unfold rent at HH
    rw [rent_first hS,HQ] at HH
    change _ - S.Hcond Prod.fst (fun x => (s0 x,w0 x))+S.Ex (fun x => c (u0 x)) ≤ F at HH
    rw [h1] at HH
    simp only [Fintype.card_fin,Fintype.card_prod,Nat.cast_mul,mul_assoc] at *
    exact HH
  have Hsel := stack_select tag c hc P.law S X W u0 Hrow F D hF hD hcost
    (by rwa [fundG_one tag hi] at hd)
  simpa only [Fintype.card_prod,Fintype.card_fin,Nat.cast_mul] using Hsel

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.initial_pack
statement:
lemma initial_pack (p : Law A) (m : ℕ) :
    lblP (initial p) m = (iid p m).send
      (fun x => fun i => (x i,()))
proof:
:= by
  unfold lblP iid initial
  exact (sendPack (fun _ => p) (fun _ (x : A) => (x,()))).symm

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.G_initial
statement:
lemma G_initial (tag : A → G) (p : Law A) (m : ℕ) :
    fundG tag (initial p) m = (iid p m).H (tot tag)
proof:
:= by
  unfold fundG
  rw [initial_pack]
  exact (Hcond_send (iid p m) (fun x i => (x i,()))
    (lblSum tag (initial p) m) (lblCtx (initial p) m)).trans (Hcond_constant _ _ (fun _ => ()))

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.K_initial
statement:
lemma K_initial (tag : A → G) (c : G → ℝ) (p : Law A) (m r : ℕ) :
    fundK tag c (initial p) m r = opt r (iid p m) (tot tag)
      (fun _ => fun _ : Fin m => ()) id c
proof:
:= by
  unfold fundK
  rw [initial_pack]
  exact opt_proj (lblSum tag (initial p) m) (lblCtx (initial p) m) id c
    (iid p m) (fun x i => (x i,())) r

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.I_initial
statement:
lemma I_initial (tag : A → G) (p : Law A) (r : ℕ) :
    fundI tag (initial p) r = opt r p tag (fun _ => ()) (fun _ : Unit => (0:G))
      (fun _ => 0)
proof:
:= by
  unfold fundI initial
  exact opt_proj (fun x : A×Unit => tag x.1) Prod.snd _ _ p (fun x => (x,())) r

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.trial_initial
statement:
lemma trial_initial {E Z : Type} [Fintype E] [Fintype Z] [Nonempty E]
    (tag : A → G) (p : Law A) (e : E → G) (c : E→ℝ) (z : Z)
    (P : Law Ω) (X : Ω → Letters n A) (U : Ω → E)
    (h : hasRows p P X) :
    rent tag (fun _ => z) e c P X U =
      (∑ i, P.Ex (fun a => -log (p (X a i)))) -
        P.Hcond X (ans tag X (fun a => e (U a))) + P.Ex (fun a => c (U a))
proof:
:= by
  have hz (i : Fin n) :
      P.Hcond (readP X i) ((fun _ => z) ∘ readP X i) =
      P.Ex (fun a => -log (p (X a i))) := by
    have h1 : P.Hcond (readP X i) (fun _ => z) = P.H (readP X i) :=
      Hcond_constant _ _ _
    rw [show (fun (_:A) => z) ∘ readP X i = fun _ => z from rfl,h1,H_log,h i]; rfl
  unfold rent
  simp_rw [hz]
  congr 2
  apply Hcond_right_partition
  simp only [Prod.mk.injEq]; tauto

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.K_initial_le
statement:
lemma K_initial_le (tag : A → G) (c : G → ℝ) (p : Law A) (m r : ℕ)
    (P : Law Ω) (X : Ω → Letters r (Letters m A)) (U : Ω → G)
    (h : hasRows (iid p m) P X) :
    fundK tag c (initial p) m r ≤ bill (tot tag) c (iid p m) P X U
proof:
:= by
  rw [K_initial]
  apply le_trans (opt_le_rent _ _ _ _ _ P X U h) (le_of_eq ?_)
  rw [trial_initial _ _ _ _ _ _ X U h]; rfl

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.exact_zero_g
statement:
lemma exact_zero_g {I : Type} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
    (P : Law Ω) (X : Ω → I → A) (tag : A → G) (q : Law A) (h : covered P X q) :
    bill tag (fun _=>0) q P X (fun _=>0) =
      (P.send X).kl (pack (fun _ => q)) + P.H (fun a => tot tag (X a))
proof:
:= by
  rw [bill_with_entropy h,Hcond_determined (P:=P) (X:=fun _=>0) (W:=X) (fun _ _ _ => rfl)]
  unfold ans
  simp_rw [add_zero,Ex_const]
  ring

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.I_initial_le
statement:
lemma I_initial_le (tag : A → G) (p : Law A) (r : ℕ)
    (P : Law Ω) (X : Ω → Letters r A) (hh : hasRows p P X) :
    fundI tag (initial p) r ≤ (P.send X).kl (iid p r)+P.H (fun a => tot tag (X a))
proof:
:= by
  rw [I_initial]
  apply le_trans (opt_le_rent _ _ _ _ p P X (fun _ => ()) hh)
  rw [trial_initial _ _ _ _ _ _ X _ hh]
  change bill tag (fun _=>0) p P X (fun _=>0) ≤ _
  exact (exact_zero_g P X tag p (kl_covered P X p hh)).le

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.sum_entropy
statement:
lemma sum_entropy {I : Type} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
    (P : Law Ω) (X : Ω → I → A) (U : Ω → G) (tag : A → G)
    (c : G → ℝ) (hc : ∀ x, 0 ≤ c x) (q : Law A) (hcov : covered P X q)
    (Q : Law G) (hQ : ∀ y, 0 < Q y) (L : ℝ) (hL : ∀ y, -log (Q y) = L+c y) :
    let F
proof:
:= bill tag c q P X U
    P.H (fun a => tot tag (X a)) + (P.send X).kl (pack fun _ => q) ≤ 3*F+2*L := by
  intro F
  let S (a) := tot tag (X a)
  let Z := ans tag X U
  have hEnt : P.H U ≤ L + P.Ex (fun a => c (U a)) := by
    have H := entropy_le_cross_aux (P.send U) Q Q.nonneg Q.total.le fun x _ => hQ x
    refine H.trans (le_of_eq ?_)
    unfold crossE
    simp_rw [hL,Ex_send,Ex_add,Ex_const]
  have hBill : P.Ex (fun a => c (U a)) ≤ F :=
    ((le_add_of_nonneg_left (kl_nonneg (covered_pack hcov))).trans
      (kl_le_bill hcov tag c hc _))
  have hH := bill_with_entropy hcov tag c U
  change F = _+(P.H Z-_)+_ at hH
  have HI : P.H S ≤ P.H Z + P.H U := by
    have H1 : P.H S ≤ P.H (fun a => (U a,Z a)) :=
      H_le_of_determined _ fun a b hh => by
        have hi := Prod.mk.inj hh
        change U a=U b ∧ S a+U a=S b+U b at hi
        exact add_right_cancel (b:=U b) (by rw [← hi.2,hi.1])
    have H2 := Hcond_le_H P U Z
    rw [H_pair_chain] at H1; linarith
  have hC := Hcond_le_H P U X
  change P.H S + _ ≤ _
  linarith [P.Ex_nonneg (fun a => hc (U a))]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.Starting.cover
statement: lemma cover : covered s.P Prod.fst s.q
proof: := kl_covered _ _ _ s.marg

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.Starting.exact_bound
statement:
lemma exact_bound (hc : ∀ x, 0 ≤ c x) (Q : Law G) (hQ : ∀ y, 0 < Q y)
    (L : ℝ) (hL : ∀ y, -log (Q y)=L+c y)
    (n : ℕ) (hn : n ≤ N) :
    let X
proof:
:= prefixB (α:=A) (Ω:=WordSample N A G) Prod.fst n hn
    s.P.H (fun a => tot tag (X a)) + (s.P.send X).kl (iid s.q n) ≤ 3*E+2*L := by
  intro X
  have h1 := bill_subfamily tag c s.q s.P Prod.fst Prod.snd s.cover
    (offset 0 n (show 0+n ≤ N by omega)) (offset_injective _ _ _)
  change bill tag c s.q s.P X Prod.snd ≤ _ at h1
  refine (sum_entropy s.P X Prod.snd tag c hc s.q (covered_subfamily s.cover _) Q hQ L hL).trans ?_
  linarith [s.bound]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.Starting.I_upper
statement:
lemma I_upper (hc : ∀ x, 0 ≤ c x) (Q : Law G) (hQ : ∀ y, 0 < Q y)
    (L : ℝ) (hL : ∀ y,-log (Q y)=L+c y) (n : ℕ) (hn : n ≤ N) :
    fundI tag (initial s.q) n ≤ 3*E+2*L
proof:
:= by
  have h := s.exact_bound hc Q hQ L hL n hn
  let X := prefixB (α:=A) (Ω:=WordSample N A G) Prod.fst n hn
  have heq : hasRows s.q s.P X := fun i => s.marg (offset 0 n _ i)
  refine (I_initial_le tag s.q n s.P X heq).trans ?_
  rw [add_comm]
  exact h

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.Starting.near_small
statement:
lemma near_small (n : ℕ) (hn : n ≤ m) :
    tv (s.P.send (prefixB Prod.fst n (hn.trans s.within))) (iid s.q n) ≤ ε
proof:
:= by
  let X : Letters m A → Letters n A := fun x i => x (offset 0 n (by omega : 0+n ≤ m) i)
  have h := tv_data_processing (s.P.send (prefixB Prod.fst m s.within)) (iid s.q m) X
  rw [send_send] at h
  have hh : (iid s.q m).send X = iid s.q n :=
    sendPack_embedding _ _ (offset_injective _ _ _)
  rw [hh] at h
  apply le_trans _ s.near
  have he : (fun a : WordSample N A G => X (prefixB Prod.fst m s.within a)) = prefixB Prod.fst n (hn.trans s.within) := by
    funext x ⟨i,hi⟩; simp only [X,prefixB,readBlock,keep,offset,zero_add]
  rwa [he] at h

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.Starting.G_upper
statement:
lemma G_upper (hc : ∀ x, 0 ≤ c x) (Q : Law G) (hQ : ∀ y, 0 < Q y)
    (L : ℝ) (hL : ∀ y,-log (Q y)=L+c y) (n : ℕ) (hn : n ≤ m) :
    fundG tag (initial s.q) n ≤ 3*E+2*L+log 2 + ε*lnS (Fin n) tag
proof:
:= by
  rw [G_initial]
  let X := prefixB (α:=A) (Ω:= WordSample N A G) Prod.fst n (hn.trans s.within)
  let Y := tot tag (ι:=Fin n)
  have H1 : tv ((iid s.q n).send Y) ((s.P.send X).send Y) ≤ ε := by
    rw [tv_comm]
    exact (tv_data_processing _ _ Y).trans (s.near_small n hn)
  have HT := entropy_le_of_tv ((iid s.q n).send Y) ((s.P.send X).send Y)
    (sums (Fin n) tag) fun x hx => by
      obtain ⟨a,rfl,_⟩ := (send_pos_iff _ _ _).mp hx
      exact Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ (Finset.mem_univ _)
  change _ ≤ (s.P.send X).H Y + (_ + _ * lnS (Fin n) tag) at HT
  have hk : dominated (s.P.send X) (iid s.q n) := covered_pack
    (covered_subfamily s.cover _)
  have he := s.exact_bound hc Q hQ L hL n (hn.trans s.within)
  change s.P.H _+kl (s.P.send X) _ ≤ _ at he
  apply HT.trans
  rw [H_send]
  nlinarith [kl_nonneg hk,lnS_nonneg (Fin n) tag]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.Starting.block_near
statement:
lemma block_near (n : ℕ) (hn : n ≤ m) (g : Fin n → Fin N) (hg : Injective g) :
    tv (s.P.send (keep Prod.fst g)) (iid s.q n) ≤ ε
proof:
:= by
  let f := offset 0 n (by have := s.within; omega : 0+n ≤ N)
  have Hf : Injective f := offset_injective _ _ _
  obtain ⟨e,he⟩ := Equiv.Perm.exists_extending_pair _ _ Hf hg
  have hh :=
    congrArg (fun R : Law (WordSample N A G) => R.send (keep Prod.fst f)) (s.sym e)
  rw [send_send] at hh
  have heq : (fun x : WordSample N A G => keep Prod.fst f (appPerm e x)) =
      keep Prod.fst g := by
    funext x i; dsimp only [keep,appPerm]; rw [he i]
  rw [heq] at hh
  rw [hh]
  exact s.near_small n hn

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.Starting.block_card
statement:
lemma block_card (n r : ℕ) :
    lnS (Fin r) (tot tag (ι:=Fin n)) = lnS (Fin (r*n)) tag
proof:
:= by
  let e := finProdFinEquiv (m:=r) (n:=n)
  have hh (x : Fin (r*n) → A) :
      tot tag x = tot (tot tag (ι:=Fin n)) (fun i : Fin r => fun j => x (e (i,j))) := by
    unfold tot
    rw [← Fintype.sum_equiv e (fun i => tag (x (e i))) (fun i => tag (x i)) (fun _ => rfl),
      Fintype.sum_prod_type]
  have H : sums (Fin (r*n)) tag = sums (Fin r) (tot tag (ι:=Fin n)) := by
    ext a
    simp only [sums,Finset.mem_image,Finset.mem_univ,true_and]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨x,rfl⟩
      exact ⟨_,(hh x).symm⟩
    · rintro ⟨x,rfl⟩
      refine ⟨(fun i => x (e.symm i).1 (e.symm i).2),?_⟩
      rw [hh]; simp
  simp only [lnS,H]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.Starting.K_upper
statement:
lemma K_upper (hc : ∀ x, 0 ≤ c x) (hc0 : c 0 = 0)
    (n r : ℕ) (hr : 0 < r) (hn : n ≤ m) (hn' : 2*r*n ≤ N) :
    fundK tag c (initial s.q) n r ≤ E + log (Fintype.card (Ticket r (2*r))) +
      (r + 2*ε*lnS (Fin (r*n)) tag)
proof:
:= by
  let g : Fin (2*r) × Fin n → Fin N := offset 0 ((2*r)*n) (by omega) ∘ finProdFinEquiv
  have hg : Injective g := (offset_injective _ _ _).comp finProdFinEquiv.injective
  let X (x : WordSample N A G) (i : Fin (2*r)) (j : Fin n) := x.1 (g (i,j))
  let q := iid s.q n
  have Hc : covered s.P X q := by
    intro x hx i; exact (pack_pos _ _).mpr (fun j => s.cover x hx (g (i,j)))
  have Hm (i : Fin (2*r)) : tv (s.P.send (fun x => X x i)) q ≤ ε :=
    s.block_near _ hn (fun j => g (i,j)) (fun _ _ h => congrArg Prod.snd (hg h))
  obtain ⟨Q,hQ,hb⟩ := thinned_bill (tot tag (ι:=Fin n)) c hc hc0 r (2*r) hr rfl
    s.P X Prod.snd q Hc ε Hm
  let X' := keep (Prod.fst : WordSample N A G → _) g
  have heq : bill (tot tag (ι:=Fin n)) c q s.P X Prod.snd =
      bill tag c s.q s.P X' Prod.snd := by
    let Y := ans tag X' Prod.snd
    have hy : ans (tot tag (ι:=Fin n)) X Prod.snd = Y := by
      ext x; unfold Y ans tot
      rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]; rfl
    unfold bill
    rw [hy, Fintype.sum_prod_type]
    have h2 : s.P.Hcond X Y = s.P.Hcond X' Y := by
      unfold Hcond
      congr 1
      refine H_partition _ fun a b => ?_
      simp only [Prod.mk.injEq,funext_iff,Prod.forall,X,X',keep]
    have h1 (i : Fin (2*r)) : s.P.Ex (fun a => -log (q (X a i))) =
        ∑ j, s.P.Ex (fun a => -log (s.q (X' a (i,j)))) := by
      rw [← Ex_finset_sum]
      apply Ex_congr_mem
      intro x hx
      change -log (∏ j : Fin n, s.q (X x i j)) = _
      rw [log_prod,Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
      · rfl
      · exact fun j _ => (s.cover x hx _).ne'
    rw [h2]
    simp_rw [h1]
    rfl
  have hh := bill_subfamily tag c s.q s.P Prod.fst Prod.snd s.cover g hg
  change bill tag c s.q s.P X' Prod.snd ≤ _ at hh
  rw [heq,block_card] at hb
  refine le_trans (K_initial_le tag c s.q n r Q Prod.fst Prod.snd hQ) ?_
  exact le_trans hb (add_le_add_left (add_le_add_left (hh.trans s.bound) _) _)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.full_pair
statement:
lemma full_pair (p : Law (Ω×Ω')) :
    p.Hcond (fun x => x) Prod.snd = p.Hcond Prod.fst Prod.snd
proof:
:= by
  unfold Hcond
  congr 1
  exact H_partition _ (by simp)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.G_as_sum
statement:
lemma G_as_sum (tag : A → G) (P : Labelled A) (m) :
    fundG tag P m = (sumLaw tag P m).Hcond (fun x => x) Prod.snd
proof:
:= by
  rw [full_pair]
  unfold sumLaw fundG; rw [Hcond_send]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.I_single
statement:
lemma I_single (tag : A → G) (hi : Injective tag) (P : Labelled A) :
    fundG tag P 1 = P.law.Hcond (fun x => x) Prod.snd
proof:
:=
  (fundG_one _ hi P).trans (full_pair P.law).symm

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.K_as_sum
statement:
lemma K_as_sum (tag : A → G) (c : G → ℝ) (P : Labelled A) (m n) :
    fundK tag c P m n = opt n (sumLaw tag P m) Prod.fst Prod.snd (fun x => x) c
proof:
:=
  (opt_proj Prod.fst Prod.snd (fun x => x) c (lblP P m) (fun a => (lblSum tag P m a,lblCtx P m a)) n).symm

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.sumLaw_succ
statement:
lemma sumLaw_succ (tag : A → G) (P : Labelled A) (m) :
    sumLaw tag P (m+1) = (P.law.tensorP (sumLaw tag P m)).send (sumPlus tag P m)
proof:
:= by
  unfold sumLaw
  rw [show lblP P (m+1) = _ from iid_succ P.law m,send_send]
  have hQ := send_tensorP P.law (lblP P m) (fun x => x)
    (fun a => (lblSum tag P m a,lblCtx P m a))
  rw [send_id] at hQ
  rw [← hQ,send_send]
  simp_rw [lbl_succ_sum,lbl_succ_ctx]
  rfl

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.observe_refines
statement:
lemma observe_refines (tag : A → G) (P : Labelled A) (m : ℕ) :
    refines (observe tag P m) P
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun x => x.2 0,?_⟩
  dsimp only [observe]
  rw [send_send]
  have he : (fun x : (A × P.obs) × (G × Letters m P.obs) =>
      ((rowPlus tag P m x).1,(rowPlus tag P m x).2.2 0)) = Prod.fst := by
    funext x; rfl
  rw [he, send_fst_tensorP]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.rowPlus_inj
statement:
lemma rowPlus_inj (tag : A → G) (P : Labelled A) (m : ℕ) :
    Injective (rowPlus tag P m)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨⟨a,b⟩,⟨s,w⟩⟩ ⟨⟨a',b'⟩,⟨s',w'⟩⟩ he
  simp only [rowPlus,sumPlus,Prod.mk.injEq,appendOne,cons_part] at *
  grind

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.observe_row_ent
statement:
lemma observe_row_ent (tag : A → G) (P : Labelled A) (m : ℕ) :
    (sumLaw tag P (m+1)).Hcond (fun x => x) Prod.snd +
      (observe tag P m).law.Hcond (fun x => x) Prod.snd =
      P.law.Hcond (fun x => x) Prod.snd + (sumLaw tag P m).Hcond (fun x => x) Prod.snd
proof:
:= by
  rw [sumLaw_succ]
  dsimp only [observe]
  let R := P.law
  let Q := sumLaw tag P m
  let Z := R.tensorP Q
  let Y := sumPlus tag P m
  let X := rowPlus tag P m
  have hf {α β : Type} [Fintype α] [Fintype β] (P : Law (α × β)) :
      P.Hcond (fun x => x) Prod.snd = P.entropy - P.H Prod.snd := by
    have h := Hcond_function P (fun x => x) Prod.snd
    rw [H_self] at h; exact h
  simp_rw [hf]
  have hx : Z.H X = Z.entropy :=
    (H_partition Z (X:=X) (Y:=fun x => x) (fun a b => (rowPlus_inj tag P m).eq_iff)).trans (H_self Z)
  have hz : (Z.send Y).H Prod.snd = P.law.H Prod.snd + Q.H Prod.snd := by
    rw [H_send]; refine Eq.trans ?_ (H_tensorP R Q Prod.snd Prod.snd)
    apply H_partition
    intro x y
    simp only [Y,sumPlus,appendOne,cons_part,Prod.mk.injEq]
  change ((Z.send Y).entropy - (Z.send Y).H Prod.snd)+((Z.send X).entropy - (Z.send X).H Prod.snd) = _
  rw [hz,H_send]
  change (Z.H Y- (R.H Prod.snd+Q.H Prod.snd))+(Z.H X-Z.H Y) = _
  rw [hx,show Z.entropy = _ from entropy_tensorP R Q]
  change _ = (R.entropy-_) + (Q.entropy-_)
  ring

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.observe_cost
statement:
lemma observe_cost (tag : A → G) (hi : Injective tag) (P : Labelled A) (m : ℕ) :
    fundG tag P 1 - fundG tag (observe tag P m) 1 =
      fundG tag P (m+1) - fundG tag P m
proof:
:= by
  rw [I_single tag hi,I_single tag hi,G_as_sum tag P (m+1),G_as_sum tag P m]
  linarith [observe_row_ent tag P m]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.observe_cond
statement:
private lemma observe_cond (tag : A → G) (P : Labelled A) (m r : ℕ)
    (R : Law Ω) (S : Law Ω') (X : Ω → Letters r (A×P.obs))
    (Y : Ω' → Letters r (G × Letters m P.obs)) (g : Ω' → G) :
    let V
proof:
:= R.tensorP S
    let tag' := tag ∘ Prod.fst (β := P.obs)
    let Y' (x : Ω × Ω') (i : Fin r) := sumPlus tag P m (X x.1 i, Y x.2 i)
    let X' (x : Ω × Ω') (i : Fin r) := rowPlus tag P m (X x.1 i, Y x.2 i)
    R.Hcond X (fun x => (ans tag' X (fun _ => 0) x, ctxt Prod.snd X x)) +
      S.Hcond Y (fun x => (ans Prod.fst Y g x, ctxt Prod.snd Y x)) ≤
      V.Hcond Y' (fun x => (ans Prod.fst Y' (fun x => g x.2) x, ctxt Prod.snd Y' x)) +
      V.Hcond X' (fun x => (ans (tag ∘ Prod.fst) X' (fun _ => 0) x, ctxt Prod.snd X' x)) := by
  intro V tag' Y' X'
  let B (x) := (ans tag' X (fun _ => 0) x, ctxt Prod.snd X x)
  let C (x) := (ans Prod.fst Y g x, ctxt Prod.snd Y x)
  let B' (x) := (ans Prod.fst Y' (fun x => g x.2) x, ctxt Prod.snd Y' x)
  let C' (x) := (ans (tag ∘ Prod.fst) X' (fun _ => 0) x, ctxt Prod.snd X' x)
  let W (x : Ω × Ω') := (B x.1,C x.2)
  have hb1 (x : Ω × Ω') : (B' x).1 = (B x.1).1 + (C x.2).1 := by
    unfold B' B C Y'
    unfold ans tot tag' sumPlus
    simp only [Finset.sum_add_distrib,comp_apply,add_zero,add_assoc]
  have hc1 (x : Ω × Ω') : (C' x).1 = (B x.1).1 := rfl
  have H1 : V.Hcond Y' W ≤ V.Hcond Y' B' := by
    apply Hcond_antitone
    intro x y hh
    have h1 : B x.1 = B y.1 := congrArg (fun v => v.1) hh
    have h2 : C x.2 = C y.2 := congrArg Prod.snd hh
    apply Prod.ext
    · rw [hb1,hb1,h1,h2]
    · funext i
      have h3 := congrFun (congrArg Prod.snd h1) i
      have h4 := congrFun (congrArg Prod.snd h2) i
      change appendOne (_,_) = appendOne (_,_)
      exact congrArg appendOne (Prod.ext h3 h4)
  have H2 : V.Hcond X' (fun x => (Y' x,W x)) ≤ V.Hcond X' C' := by
    refine Hcond_antitone _ _ fun x y hh => ?_
    have h1 : W x=W y := congrArg Prod.snd hh
    have h2 : Y' x=Y' y := congrArg Prod.fst hh
    apply Prod.ext
    · rw [hc1,hc1,show B x.1 = B y.1 from congrArg Prod.fst h1]
    · exact h2
  have Hi : V.Hcond (fun x => (X x.1,Y x.2)) W = V.Hcond (fun x => (X' x,Y' x)) W := by
    unfold Hcond
    congr 1
    apply H_partition
    intro a b
    have HH : (X a.1,Y a.2)=(X b.1,Y b.2) ↔ (X' a,Y' a)=(X' b,Y' b) := by
      simp only [X',Y',funext_iff,Prod.mk.injEq,(rowPlus_inj tag P m).eq_iff,forall_and]
      constructor
      · intro ⟨hh,h⟩; simp [hh,h]
      · tauto
    simp only [Prod.mk.injEq,HH]
  rw [Hcond_chain V X' Y' W] at Hi
  have h := Hcond_tensor R S X Y B C
  change V.Hcond (fun x => (X x.1,Y x.2)) W = _ at h
  change R.Hcond X B+S.Hcond Y C ≤ V.Hcond Y' B'+V.Hcond X' C'
  linarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.observe_save
statement:
lemma observe_save (tag : A → G) (c : G → ℝ) (P : Labelled A) (m r : ℕ) :
    fundK tag c P (m+1) r + fundI tag (observe tag P m) r ≤
      fundI tag P r + fundK tag c P m r
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [K_as_sum,K_as_sum]
  let tag' : A × P.obs → G := tag ∘ Prod.fst
  let u0 (_ : Unit) := (0:G)
  let c0 (_ : Unit) := (0:ℝ)
  obtain ⟨R,hR,eR⟩ := (opt_spec r P.law tag' Prod.snd u0 c0).1
  let Q := sumLaw tag P m
  obtain ⟨S,hS,eS⟩ := (opt_spec r Q Prod.fst Prod.snd (fun x => x) c).1
  let D := WordSample r (A × P.obs) Unit
  let E := WordSample r (G × Letters m P.obs) G
  let V := R.tensorP S
  let Y (x : D×E) (i : Fin r) := sumPlus tag P m (x.1.1 i, x.2.1 i)
  let X (x : D×E) (i : Fin r) := rowPlus tag P m (x.1.1 i, x.2.1 i)
  let Ue (x : D×E) := x.2.2
  have Hlaw (i : Fin r) :
      V.send (fun x : D×E => (x.1.1 i,x.2.1 i)) = P.law.tensorP Q := by
    rw [show (fun x : D×E => (x.1.1 i,x.2.1 i)) = _ from rfl]
    have HH := send_tensorP R S (readP Prod.fst i) (readP Prod.fst i)
    rw [hR i,hS i] at HH
    exact HH
  have hY : hasRows (sumLaw tag P (m+1)) V Y := by
    intro i
    rw [sumLaw_succ,show P.law.tensorP (sumLaw tag P m) = _ from (Hlaw i).symm,
      send_send]; rfl
  have hX : hasRows (observe tag P m).law V X := by
    intro i; dsimp only [observe]
    rw [show P.law.tensorP (sumLaw tag P m) = _ from (Hlaw i).symm,send_send]; rfl
  let tag'' : (A × (observe tag P m).obs) → G := tag ∘ Prod.fst
  refine (add_le_add (opt_le_rent _ _ _ c _ V Y Ue hY)
    (opt_le_rent tag'' Prod.snd u0 c0 _ V X (fun _ => ()) hX)).trans ?_
  change _ ≤ opt _ _ tag' _ u0 c0 + opt _ Q _ _ _ _
  rw [← eR,← eS]
  dsimp only []
  unfold rent
  rw [rent_first hX,rent_first hY,rent_first hS,rent_first hR]
  have H := observe_cond tag P m r R S Prod.fst Prod.fst Prod.snd
  have H0 := observe_row_ent tag P m

  have heq : V.Ex (fun a => c (Ue a)) = S.Ex (fun a => c a.2) := by
    dsimp only [V,Ue]
    rw [Ex_tensorP]; exact Ex_const R (S.Ex (fun a => c a.2))
  dsimp only [u0,c0,X,Y,Ue,tag'',tag',V,Q,id_eq,comp_apply] at *
  simp only [Ex_const]
  have hmul := congrArg (fun t : ℝ => (Fintype.card (Fin r):ℝ)*t) H0
  linarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.Params.pow_pos_nat
statement: lemma pow_pos_nat (n : ℕ) : 0 < 2^n
proof: := Nat.pow_pos (by omega)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.Params.slow_pos
statement: lemma slow_pos (j : ℕ) : 0 < slow j
proof: := pow_pos_nat _

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.Params.ell_tendsto
statement: lemma ell_tendsto : Tendsto ell atTop atTop
proof:
:= by
  refine tendsto_atTop.2 fun l => ?_
  filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop (2^(2^l*1000))] with j hj
  have h := Nat.le_log_of_pow_le (by omega : 1 < 2) hj
  apply Nat.le_log_of_pow_le (by omega : 1 < 2)
  change 2^l ≤ Nat.log 2 j / 1000
  omega

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.Params.slow_tendsto
statement: lemma slow_tendsto : Tendsto slow atTop atTop
proof:
:= by
  refine tendsto_atTop_mono (f:=ell) ?_ ell_tendsto
  intro j
  exact (Nat.lt_two_pow_self).le

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.Params.wide_tendsto
statement: lemma wide_tendsto : Tendsto wide atTop atTop
proof:
:= by
  refine tendsto_atTop_mono (f:=slow) ?_ slow_tendsto
  intro j
  exact Nat.le_of_lt (Nat.lt_two_pow_self)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.Params.evt_slow
statement:
lemma evt_slow : ∀ᶠ j : ℕ in atTop,
    2^(1000*slow j) ≤ j ∧ j < 2^(3000*slow j)
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop (2^1000)] with j hj
  have h := Nat.le_log_of_pow_le (by omega : 1 < 2) hj
  have hp := (show 0 < Nat.log 2 j/1000 by omega)
  have h1 : 2^ell j ≤ Nat.log 2 j/1000 := Nat.pow_log_le_self 2 hp.ne'
  have hx := slow_pos j
  have h2 := Nat.lt_pow_succ_log_self (by omega : 1 < 2) (Nat.log 2 j/1000)
  change _ < 2^(ell j+1) at h2
  rw [pow_succ] at h2
  change _ < slow j *2 at h2
  change slow j ≤ _ at h1
  constructor
  · apply le_trans (b:=2^(Nat.log 2 j)) ?_ (Nat.pow_log_le_self 2 (by have := pow_pos_nat 1000; omega))
    apply Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega)
    omega
  · apply lt_of_lt_of_le (Nat.lt_pow_succ_log_self (by omega : 1 < 2) j)
    apply Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega)
    omega

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.Params.eventually_pow_small
statement:
lemma eventually_pow_small (n : ℕ) (C : ℝ) :
    ∀ᶠ j : ℕ in atTop, C*(j:ℝ)^n ≤ 2^j
proof:
:= by
  have H := (tendsto_pow_const_div_const_pow_of_one_lt n (show (1:ℝ)<2 by norm_num)).const_mul C
  rw [mul_zero] at H
  filter_upwards [H.eventually (gt_mem_nhds (show (0:ℝ)<1 by norm_num))] with j hj
  apply le_of_lt
  apply (div_lt_one (by positivity : (0:ℝ)<2^j)).mp
  rw [mul_div_assoc]
  exact hj

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.Params.eventually_pow_small_slow
statement:
lemma eventually_pow_small_slow (n : ℕ) (C : ℝ) :
    ∀ᶠ j : ℕ in atTop, C*(slow j:ℝ)^n ≤ 2^slow j
proof:
:=
  slow_tendsto.eventually (eventually_pow_small n C)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.Params.nat_pow_small_slow
statement:
lemma nat_pow_small_slow (n C : ℕ) :
    ∀ᶠ j in atTop, C * (slow j)^n ≤ wide j
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [eventually_pow_small_slow n C] with j hj
  unfold wide; exact_mod_cast hj

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.Params.wide_le_j
statement: lemma wide_le_j : ∀ᶠ j : ℕ in atTop, wide j ≤ j
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [evt_slow] with j ⟨hj,h'⟩
  exact le_trans (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) (by omega)) hj

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.Params.ell_le_h
statement: lemma ell_le_h (j : ℕ) : ell j ≤ slow j
proof: := Nat.le_of_lt Nat.lt_two_pow_self

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.Params.h_le_wide
statement: lemma h_le_wide (j : ℕ) : slow j ≤ wide j
proof: := Nat.le_of_lt Nat.lt_two_pow_self

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.Params.slow_le_j
statement: lemma slow_le_j : ∀ᶠ j in atTop, slow j ≤ j
proof: := wide_le_j.mono fun j h => (h_le_wide j).trans h

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.Params.base_le_cap
statement: lemma base_le_cap (j : ℕ) : base j ≤ cap j
proof:
:= by
  unfold base cap capE wide
  apply Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega)
  rw [← pow_mul]
  apply Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega)
  omega

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.Params.cap_power
statement: lemma cap_power : ∀ᶠ j : ℕ in atTop, 64*capE j ≤ j
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [evt_slow] with j hj
  apply le_trans (b:=2^(1000*slow j)) _ hj.1
  unfold capE
  rw [show 64 = 2^6 by norm_num]
  rw [← pow_add]
  apply Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega)
  have := slow_pos j; omega

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.Params.below_base
statement:
lemma below_base (n : ℕ) (C : ℝ) :
    ∀ᶠ j : ℕ in atTop, C * (j:ℝ)^n ≤ base j
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k,hk⟩ := exists_nat_gt C
  filter_upwards [evt_slow, wide_tendsto.eventually (eventually_ge_atTop (max k (4000*n+2)))] with j ⟨hj,h1⟩ h2
  apply le_trans (b:=(k:ℝ)*(j:ℝ)^n) (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hk.le (by positivity))
  suffices H : k*j^n ≤ base j by exact_mod_cast H
  have hk1 : k ≤ wide j := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) h2
  apply le_trans (b:= (2^k)*(2^(3000*slow j))^n) (Nat.mul_le_mul
    (Nat.le_of_lt Nat.lt_two_pow_self) (Nat.pow_le_pow_left h1.le n))
  unfold base
  rw [← pow_mul, ← pow_add]
  apply Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega)
  have hx : 4000*n+2 ≤ wide j := le_trans (le_max_right _ _) h2
  nlinarith [h_le_wide j]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.Params.t_expr
statement:
lemma t_expr : ∀ᶠ j : ℕ in atTop,
    sLen j * (slow j)^6 = 2^j ∧ 4*sSeg j = sLen j
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [evt_slow] with j ⟨h,_⟩
  have h1 := Nat.lt_two_pow_self (n:=1000*slow j)
  have h2 := ell_le_h j
  have h3 := slow_pos j
  constructor
  · unfold sLen slow
    rw [← pow_mul,← pow_add]
    congr 1; omega
  · unfold sSeg sLen
    rw [show 4=2^2 by norm_num,← pow_add]
    congr 1; omega

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.Params.nSched_scale
statement:
lemma nSched_scale (j : ℕ) (hj : 4 ≤ slow j) :
    (searchSched j hj).size = mSched j
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.Params.searchSched_loss
statement:
lemma searchSched_loss (j : ℕ) (hj : 4 ≤ slow j) :
    (searchSched j hj).loss ≤ 66/(slow j:ℝ)^2
proof:
:= by
  let h : ℝ := slow j
  have hp : 4 ≤ h := by dsimp only [h]; exact_mod_cast hj
  change 2*(32/h^2)+1/h^3*(1+exp (-2*h)) ≤ 66/h^2
  have HH : exp (-2*h) ≤ 1 := Real.exp_le_one_iff.mpr (by linarith)
  have : (0:ℝ) < h := by linarith
  field_simp; ring_nf at HH ⊢; nlinarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.Params.index_budgets
statement:
lemma index_budgets :
    ∀ᶠ j : ℕ in atTop, ∀ i, levelHigh j i ≤ capE j ∧ 6*ell j+3+levelHigh j i ≤ j
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [wide_tendsto.eventually (eventually_ge_atTop 8),cap_power] with j h wj
  let w := wide j
  have hp : 8 ≤ w := h
  have hm : nSched j = w^16 := by
    unfold nSched w wide
    rw [← pow_mul]; congr 1; omega
  have hc : capE j = w^64 := by
    unfold capE w wide
    rw [← pow_mul]; congr 1; omega
  have hb : mSched j ≤ 2*w^34 := by
    rw [mSched,hm,qSched]
    calc
      _ ≤ w^16*(2*w^2*w^16) := by
        have H : slow j ≤ w := h_le_wide j
        gcongr
      _ = _ := by ring
  have hhE : 6*ell j+3 ≤ capE j := by
    have hg : ell j ≤ w := (ell_le_h j).trans (h_le_wide j)
    rw [hc]
    have hh : w^2 ≤ w^64 := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) (by omega)
    nlinarith
  intro i
  have hx : levelHigh j i ≤ capE j := by
    have H1 : mSched j-i ≤ 2*w^34 := le_trans (by omega) hb
    change w^2+4*w*(mSched j-i)+3*w ≤ _
    rw [hc]
    have h₁ : w ≤ w^35 := by
      exact le_trans (by rw [pow_one] : w ≤ w^1) (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) (by omega))
    have h₂ : w^2 ≤ w^35 := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) (by omega)
    have h₃ : 16*w^35 ≤ w^64 := by
      have H : 16 ≤ w^29 := le_trans (b:=w^2) (by nlinarith)
        (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) (by omega))
      apply le_trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_right (w^35) H)
      rw [← pow_add]
    calc
      _ ≤ w^2+4*w*(2*w^34)+3*w := by gcongr
      _ ≤ 16*w^35 := by
        rw [show 4*w*(2*w^34)=8*w^35 by ring]; omega
      _ ≤ _ := h₃
  exact ⟨hx,by omega⟩

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.Params.array_spec
statement:
lemma array_spec :
    ∀ᶠ j : ℕ in atTop,
    3*sSeg j ≤ sLen j ∧ cap j ≤ sSeg j ∧
    cap j ≤ 2^j ∧
    (∀ i, stepLow j i ≤ stepHigh j i ∧ stepHigh j i ≤ cap j ∧
      2*stepRows j i * stepLow j i = sSeg j ∧
      long j ≤ (stepRows j i:ℝ) * stepHigh j i ∧
      base j ≤ stepLow j i) ∧
    (∀ i k, i < k → k < mSched j →
      stepHigh j k ≤ stepLow j i ∧ stepRows j i ≤ stepRows j k)
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [index_budgets,t_expr,nat_pow_small_slow 1 10,
    slow_tendsto.eventually (eventually_ge_atTop 4),cap_power] with j heq ht hw hs hj
  have h1 : 6*ell j+2+capE j ≤ j := by
    have H0 : 6*ell j ≤ levelHigh j 0 := by
      unfold levelHigh levelLow; rw [pow_one] at hw
      have H := ell_le_h j; omega
    have h2 := heq 0
    have hh := pow_pos_nat (64*slow j); change 0 < capE j at hh
    omega
  refine ⟨by omega,?_,?_ ,?_,?_⟩
  · apply Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega)
    omega
  · apply Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega)
    omega
  · intro i
    have hp := heq i
    have hlow : levelLow j i ≤ levelHigh j i := by unfold levelHigh; omega
    refine ⟨Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) hlow,Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) hp.1,?_,?_,?_⟩
    · unfold stepLow stepRows sSeg
      nth_rw 1 [show 2 = 2^1 by rfl]
      rw [← pow_add,← pow_add]; congr 1; omega
    · unfold long height stepRows stepHigh
      push_cast
      rw [← pow_add, ← pow_add]
      apply pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num)
      unfold levelHigh at *
      rw [pow_one] at hw
      have hh := ell_le_h j
      omega
    · unfold base stepLow
      apply Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega)
      unfold levelLow; omega
  intro i k hi hk
  have h1 : levelHigh j k ≤ levelLow j i := by
    unfold levelHigh levelLow
    have h2 : mSched j-k+1 ≤ mSched j-i := by omega
    nlinarith
  constructor
  · exact Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) h1
  · unfold stepRows
    apply Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega)
    unfold levelHigh at h1; omega

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.Params.big_t_real
statement:
lemma big_t_real :
    ∀ᶠ j : ℕ in atTop,
      height j = 4*(sSeg j:ℝ)*(slow j:ℝ)^6 ∧
      (cap j:ℝ)^4 ≤ height j
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [t_expr,cap_power] with j h h'
  constructor
  · have H : 2^j = 4*sSeg j*slow j^6 := by rw [h.2,h.1]
    unfold height
    exact_mod_cast H
  · have H1 : cap j^4 ≤ (2:ℕ)^j := by
      rw [cap, ← pow_mul]
      exact Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) (by omega)
    unfold height
    exact_mod_cast H1

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.char_neg
statement:
lemma char_neg (χ : AddChar G ℂ) (hn : ∀ x, ‖χ x‖ = 1) (x : G) :
    χ (-x) = conj (χ x)
proof:
:= by
  apply mul_left_cancel₀ (a := χ x) (by intro h; have H := hn x; rw [h,norm_zero] at H; norm_num at H)
  rw [← χ.map_add_eq_mul,Complex.mul_conj,← Complex.sq_norm, hn]
  simp

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.char_sum
statement:
lemma char_sum (χ : AddChar G ℂ) (f : I → G) :
    χ (∑ i, f i) = ∏ i, χ (f i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  suffices H : ∀ s : Finset I, χ (∑ i ∈ s, f i) = ∏ i ∈ s, χ (f i) from H _
  intro s
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | @insert i s hi ih => rw [Finset.prod_insert hi,Finset.sum_insert hi,χ.map_add_eq_mul,ih]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.heat_prod
statement:
lemma heat_prod (tag : A→G) (c : G→ℝ) (Q : Law Θ) (χ : Θ→AddChar G ℂ)
    (hn : ∀ t x, ‖χ t x‖=1)
    (hc : ∀ g, ((exp (-c g) : ℝ):ℂ)=Q.Cx (fun t => χ t g))
    (p : I→Law A) (z : G) :
    (pack p).Ex (fun x => exp (-c (z-tot tag x))) ≤
      Q.Ex (fun t => ∏ i, ‖(p i).Cx (fun a => χ t (tag a))‖)
proof:
:= by
  let f (x : I→A) := exp (-c (z-tot tag x))
  have H (x : I→A) (t : Θ) :
      χ t (z-tot tag x) = χ t z * ∏ i, conj (χ t (tag (x i))) := by
    rw [sub_eq_add_neg,(χ t).map_add_eq_mul,char_neg (χ t) (hn t)]
    unfold tot
    rw [char_sum,map_prod]
  let C (i : I) (t : Θ) := (p i).Cx fun a => χ t (tag a)
  have heq :
      (↑((pack p).Ex f) : ℂ) =
        Q.Cx fun t => χ t z * ∏ i, conj (C i t) := by
    rw [← Cx_ofReal]; unfold f
    simp_rw [hc,H]
    rw [Cx_swap]
    apply congrArg

    funext t
    rw [Cx_lmul,Cx_prod p (fun _ x => conj (χ t (tag x)))]
    simp_rw [Cx_conj]; rfl
  have ht := Cx_norm Q (fun t => χ t z * ∏ i, conj (C i t))
  rw [← heq, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs] at ht
  simp_rw [norm_mul,Complex.norm_prod,hn,one_mul,Complex.norm_conj] at ht
  exact le_trans (le_abs_self _) ht

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.defect_nonneg
statement:
lemma defect_nonneg (tag : A → G) (χ : Θ → AddChar G ℂ) (hn : ∀ t x, ‖χ t x‖=1) (a b t) :
    0 ≤ defect tag χ a b t
proof:
:= by
  unfold defect
  have H := Complex.abs_re_le_norm (χ t (tag a-tag b))
  rw [hn] at H; linarith [(abs_le.mp H).2]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.defect_mean
statement:
lemma defect_mean (tag : A → G) (χ : Θ → AddChar G ℂ) (hn : ∀ t x, ‖χ t x‖=1)
    (p : Law A) (t) :
    p.Ex (fun a => p.Ex (fun b => defect tag χ a b t)) =
      1- ‖p.Cx (fun a => χ t (tag a))‖^2
proof:
:= by
  unfold defect
  have h (a b : A) :
      (χ t) (tag a-tag b) = χ t (tag a)*conj (χ t (tag b)) := by
    rw [sub_eq_add_neg,(χ t).map_add_eq_mul,char_neg _ (hn t)]
  simp_rw [h,Ex_sub,Ex_const,sq_norm_Cx]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.phase_region
proof:
:= ∑ i, (1-f i x ^ 2)
    exp (-(3*E)) ≤ Q.prob fun x => A x ≤ 8*E := by
  classical
  intro D
  let S (x : Θ) := D x ≤ 8*E
  have h1 (x : ℝ) (hp : 0 ≤ x) : x ≤ exp (-(1-x^2)/2) := by
    have hi := Real.add_one_le_exp (-(1-x^2))
    have hh := Real.exp_pos (-(1-x^2)/2)
    rw [show -(1-x^2)=-(1-x^2)/2+ -(1-x^2)/2 by ring,
      Real.exp_add] at hi
    nlinarith
  have hx (x : Θ) :
      (∏ i, f i x) ≤ (if S x then (1:ℝ) else 0)+ exp (-(4*E)) := by
    split_ifs with H
    · apply le_trans (b:=∏ i : I,(1:ℝ)) (Finset.prod_le_prod₀ (fun i _ => (hf i x).1)
        (fun i _ => (hf i x).2))
      simp [exp_nonneg]
    · apply le_trans (b:=∏ i, exp (-(1-f i x^2)/2)) (Finset.prod_le_prod₀
        (fun i _ => (hf i x).1) (fun i _ => h1 _ (hf _ _).1))
      have heq : ∑ i, (-(1-f i x^2)/2) = -(D x)/2 := by
        unfold D; rw [← Finset.sum_div,Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
      rw [← Real.exp_sum,heq,zero_add]
      apply exp_monotone; unfold S at H; linarith
  have heq : Q.Ex (fun x => if S x then (1:ℝ) else 0) = Q.prob S := by
    unfold prob
    congr 1
  have H := Q.Ex_mono hx
  rw [Ex_add,heq,Ex_const] at H
  have hb : 2 ≤ exp E := le_trans (by linarith) (Real.add_one_le_exp E)
  have H1 := exp_nonneg (-(4*E))
  have H2 := exp_nonneg (-(3*E))
  have H3 : exp (-(2*E)) = exp (-(3*E))*exp E := by rw [← exp_add]; congr 1; ring
  have H4 : exp (-(3*E)) = exp (-(4*E))*exp E := by rw [← exp_add]; congr 1; ring
  change _ ≤ Q.prob S
  nlinarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.log_gap
statement:
lemma log_gap (P : Law A) [Nonempty A]
    (s : Finset A)
    (hp : (1/2:ℝ) ≤ P.prob fun x => x ∈ s) :
    log (Fintype.card A) - log (s.card:ℝ) ≤
      2*(log (Fintype.card A)-P.entropy+log 2)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let f (x : A) : Bool := decide (x ∈ s)
  let Q := P.send f
  have h1 : P.entropy = Q.entropy +
      Q.Ex fun b => (P.after f b).entropy := by
    have hI : P.H (fun x => (x,f x)) = P.entropy := by
      rw [← H_self]; apply H_partition; simp
    rw [← hI,H_pair_chain,Hcond_after]
    simp_rw [H_self]
    rfl
  have hh : Q true = P.prob (fun x => x ∈ s) := by
    unfold Q; rw [ send_apply]
    congr; simp [f]
  have hPos : 0 < Q true := by rw [hh]; linarith
  have hcard : 0 < (s.card:ℝ) := by
    obtain ⟨x,hx,_⟩ := (send_pos_iff P f true).mp hPos
    have ht : x ∈ s := by simpa only [f,decide_eq_true_eq] using hx
    exact_mod_cast Finset.card_pos.mpr ⟨x,ht⟩
  let L := log (Fintype.card A)
  let T := log (s.card:ℝ)
  have hT : T ≤ L := Real.log_le_log hcard (by exact_mod_cast Finset.card_le_univ _)
  have H : (P.after f true).entropy ≤ T :=
    entropy_le_log_size _ s fun x hx => by
      simpa only [f,decide_eq_true_eq] using ((after_mem hPos).mp hx).1
  have H' : (P.after f false).entropy ≤ L := entropy_le_log_card _
  have Hb : Q.entropy ≤ log 2 := by simpa using entropy_le_log_card Q
  have HI : Q false + Q true = 1 := by simpa [Fintype.sum_bool,add_comm] using Q.total
  rw [h1,Ex,Fintype.sum_bool]
  change L-T ≤ _
  have : L-T ≤ 2*(L-(Q.entropy+
      (Q true*(P.after f true).entropy + Q false*(P.after f false).entropy))+log 2) := by
    have hPos' := Q.nonneg false
    rw [← hh] at hp
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left H hPos.le,
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left H' hPos', show Q false * L+ Q true * L=L by rw [← add_mul,HI,one_mul]]
  exact this

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.prob_half
statement:
lemma prob_half (P : Law Ω) (f : Ω → ℝ) (hn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x) (E : ℝ) (he : 0 < E)
    (hp : P.Ex f ≤ E) :
    (1/2:ℝ) ≤ P.prob fun x => f x ≤ 2*E
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let p (x : Ω) := f x ≤ 2*E
  let F (x : Ω) := if ¬p x then 1 else (0:ℝ)
  have hh : P.Ex F = P.prob (fun x => ¬p x) := by
    apply congrArg (P.Ex)
    funext x; unfold F
    split_ifs <;> simp_all
  rw [prob_compl] at hh
  have hi (x : Ω) : 2*E * F x ≤ f x := by
    unfold F p; split_ifs with H
    · simp [hn x]
    · simp; linarith
  have H := (P.Ex_mono hi).trans hp
  rw [Ex_lmul, hh] at H
  change _ ≤ P.prob p
  nlinarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.alignment
statement:
lemma alignment (tag : A → G) (c : G → ℝ) (Q : Law Θ) (χ : Θ → AddChar G ℂ)
    (hn : ∀ t x, ‖χ t x‖=1)
    (hc : ∀ g, ((exp (-c g) : ℝ):ℂ)=Q.Cx (fun t => χ t g))
    (p : I → Law A) [Nonempty I] [Nonempty A] (z : G)
    (F D L : ℝ) (he : 1 ≤ F) (hd : 0 < D) (hL : 0 ≤ L)
    (hL' : L ≤ Fintype.card I)
    (hz : exp (-(2*F)) ≤ (pack p).Ex (fun x => exp (-c (z-tot tag x))))
    (hs : ∑ i, (log (Fintype.card A)-entropy (p i)) ≤ 2*(Fintype.card I*D)) :
    ∃ (a : A) (s : Finset A), s.Nonempty ∧
      log (Fintype.card A) - log (s.card:ℝ) ≤ 8*D+2 ∧
      small_defects tag χ Q L s a (35*F)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let f i (t : Θ) := ‖(p i).Cx (fun a => χ t (tag a))‖
  have hf1 (i : I) (t : Θ) : f i t ≤ 1 := norm_Cx_unit _ _ fun x => (hn _ _).le
  have hf0 (i : I) (t : Θ) : 0 ≤ f i t := norm_nonneg _
  let W (x : Θ) : Prop := ∑ i, (1 - f i x ^ 2) ≤ 8*F
  have hh : exp (-(3*F)) ≤ Q.prob W := phase_region Q f (fun i t => ⟨hf0 _ _,hf1 _ _⟩)
    he (hz.trans (heat_prod _ _ _ _ hn hc p z))
  let P := Q.condP W
  have hW : 0 < Q.prob W := lt_of_lt_of_le (exp_pos _) hh
  let g (i : I) := P.Ex fun t => 1-f i t^2
  let A' (i : I) := log (Fintype.card A)-entropy (p i)
  have hgp (i : I) : 0 ≤ g i := Ex_nonneg P fun t => by
    nlinarith [hf1 i t,hf0 i t]
  let T := (Fintype.card I:ℝ)
  have ht : 0 < T := by unfold T; positivity
  have hg : (uniform I).Ex g ≤ 8*F/T := by
    have hi : ∑ i, g i ≤ 8*F := by
      unfold g
      rw [← Ex_finset_sum]
      refine le_trans (b:=P.Ex fun _ => 8*F) (P.Ex_mono_mem fun x hx => ?_) (P.Ex_const _).le
      exact ((Law.condP_mem hW).mp hx).1
    simp_rw [Ex,uniform_apply,← Finset.mul_sum]
    exact le_trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hi (inv_pos.mpr ht).le)
      (by dsimp [T]; rw [← div_eq_inv_mul])
  have ha : (uniform I).Ex A' ≤ 2*D := by
    simp_rw [Ex,uniform_apply,← Finset.mul_sum,← div_eq_inv_mul]
    exact (div_le_iff₀ ht).mpr (by dsimp only [T,A']; linarith)
  obtain ⟨i, _,hi,hi'⟩ := average_two_below (uniform I) g A' (fun i _ => hgp i)
    (fun i _ => sub_nonneg.mpr (entropy_le_log_card _)) (8*F/T) (2*D)
    (by have := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one he; positivity) (by positivity) hg ha
  let R := p i
  let G (x y : A) := P.Ex (defect tag χ x y)
  have HG : R.Ex (fun y => R.Ex fun x => G x y) ≤ 16*F/T := by
    have Heq : R.Ex (fun y => R.Ex fun x => G x y) = g i := by
      rw [Ex_swap]
      unfold G
      simp_rw [Ex_swap R P]
      unfold g f
      simp_rw [defect_mean _ _ hn]
      rfl
    rw [Heq]
    exact hi.trans (le_of_eq (by ring))
  obtain ⟨a,ha',ha''⟩ := R.exists_le_Ex (fun y => R.Ex fun x => G x y)
  let s := Finset.univ.filter fun x => G x a ≤ 2*(16*F/T)
  have ha0 : R.Ex (fun x => G x a) ≤ 16*F/T := ha''.trans HG
  have hp : (1/2:ℝ) ≤ R.prob fun x => x ∈ s := by
    simp only [s,Finset.mem_filter,Finset.mem_univ,true_and]
    exact prob_half _ _ (fun x => Ex_nonneg _ (fun y => defect_nonneg _ _ hn x a y))
      _ (by have := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one he; positivity) ha0
  obtain ⟨x,hx,_⟩ := (prob_pos_iff R (fun x => x∈s)).mp
    (lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<1/2) hp)
  refine ⟨a,s,⟨x,hx⟩,(log_gap R s hp).trans ?_,?_⟩
  · change log (Fintype.card A) - entropy R ≤ _ at hi'
    have hi := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (x:=2) (by norm_num)
    linarith
  intro V hv
  let v (t : Θ) := V.Ex fun x => defect tag χ x a t
  have hB : P.Ex v ≤ 32*F/T := by
    unfold v; rw [Ex_swap P V]
    refine le_trans (b:=V.Ex fun _ => 32*F/T) (V.Ex_mono_mem fun x hx => ?_)
      (V.Ex_const _).le
    have H := (Finset.mem_filter.mp (hv x hx)).2
    change G x a ≤ _
    exact H.trans (le_of_eq (by ring))
  have H1 : P.Ex (fun t => exp ((-L)* v t)) ≥ exp (-(32*F)) := by
    have H := Ex_exp P (fun t => (-L)*v t)
    rw [Ex_lmul] at H
    apply le_trans _ H
    apply exp_monotone
    have hbp := (le_div_iff₀ ht).mp hB
    change L ≤ T at hL'
    have hg1 : 0 ≤ P.Ex v :=
      P.Ex_nonneg fun t => V.Ex_nonneg fun x => defect_nonneg tag χ hn x a t
    nlinarith
  calc
    exp (-(35*F)) = exp (-(3*F))*exp (-(32*F)) := by rw [← exp_add]; congr 1; ring
    _ ≤ Q.prob W * P.Ex (fun t => exp ((-L)*v t)) :=
      mul_le_mul hh H1 (exp_nonneg _) hW.le
    _ ≤ _ := by
      dsimp only [P]
      rw [prob_mul_Ex_condP]
      apply Q.Ex_mono; intro t; split_ifs <;> first | exact le_rfl | exact exp_nonneg _

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.rate_lt
statement:
lemma rate_lt (P : Law Ω) (X : Ω → Letters n α) {j : ℕ} (h : j < n) :
    rateH P X j = P.Hcond (readLetter X j h) (prefixB X j h.le)
proof:
:=
  dite_eq_left h

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.H_prefix
statement:
lemma H_prefix (P : Law Ω) (X : Ω → Letters n α) (l : ℕ) (h : l ≤ n) :
    P.H (prefixB X l h) = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range l, rateH P X j
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | zero =>
    rw [prefix_zero, H_constant]; simp
  | succ l ih =>
    have hh := P.H_partition (X:=prefixB X (l+1) h)
      (Y:=fun x => (readLetter X l h x, prefixB X l (by omega) x))
      (by intro x y; simp only [Prod.mk.injEq]; exact prefix_last_partition X l h x y)
    rw [hh,H_pair_chain, ih, Finset.sum_range_succ, rate_lt _ _ h]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.H_post_prefix
statement:
lemma H_post_prefix (P : Law Ω) (X : Ω → Letters n α) (j l : ℕ) (h : j+l ≤ n) :
    let W
proof:
:= prefixB X j (by omega)
    (P.send W).Ex (fun w => (P.after W w).H (readBlock X j l h)) =
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range l, rateH P X (j+i) := by
  intro W
  rw [← Hcond_after,Hcond]
  have H : P.H (prefixB X (j+l) h) = P.H (fun x => (readBlock X j l h x, W x)) := by
    refine P.H_partition fun x y => ?_
    rw [prefix_partition, Prod.mk.injEq]
    exact and_comm
  rw [← H,H_prefix]
  dsimp only [W]
  rw [H_prefix, Finset.sum_range_add]
  ring

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.conditional_block_exch
statement:
lemma conditional_block_exch {P : Law (S n α G)} (hp : exch P)
    {j m} (hh : j+m ≤ n) (w : Letters j α) :
    exch ((P.after (prefixB Prod.fst j (by omega)) w).send (fun p =>
      (readBlock Prod.fst j m hh p,p.2)))
proof:
:= by
  apply exch_subSample_cond hp (offset j m hh) (offset_injective _ _ _)
    (offset 0 j (by omega))
  rintro i ⟨b,hb⟩
  have H := congrArg Fin.val hb
  simp only [offset] at H
  omega

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.conditional_block_marg
statement:
lemma conditional_block_marg {P : Law (S n α G)} (hp : exch P)
    {j m} (hh : j+m ≤ n) (w : Letters j α) (i : Fin m) :
    let R
proof:
:= P.after (prefixB Prod.fst j (by omega)) w
    R.send (fun x => readBlock Prod.fst j m hh x i) =
      R.send (readLetter Prod.fst j (by have := i.isLt; omega)) := by
  intro R
  let i₀ : Fin m := ⟨0,by have := i.isLt; omega⟩
  have he := same_marginal (conditional_block_exch hp hh w) i i₀
  simp only [send_send] at he
  exact he

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.rate_antitone_succ
statement:
lemma rate_antitone_succ {P : Law (S n α G)} (hp : exch P)
    {j} (h : j+1 < n) : rateH P Prod.fst (j+1) ≤ rateH P Prod.fst j
proof:
:= by
  let X : S n α G → Letters n α := Prod.fst
  let W := prefixB X j (by omega)
  let V := prefixB X (j+1) h.le
  have H : P.Hcond (readLetter X (j+1) h) W = P.Hcond (readLetter X j (by omega)) W := by
    rw [Hcond_after,Hcond_after]
    have HH (w) := conditional_block_marg hp (j:=j) (m:=2) (by omega) w (1:Fin 2)
    have hEq (w : Letters j α) :
        (P.after W w).send (readLetter X (j+1) h) =
          (P.after W w).send (readLetter X j (by omega)) := HH w
    simp_rw [Law.H,hEq]
  rw [rate_lt _ _ h, rate_lt _ _ (by omega : j < n)]
  change P.Hcond _ V ≤ P.Hcond (readLetter X j _) W
  rw [← H]
  apply Hcond_antitone
  exact fun a b hh => ((prefix_last_partition X j (by omega) a b).mp hh).2

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.rate_antitone
statement:
lemma rate_antitone {P : Law (S n α G)} (hp : exch P) :
    Antitone (rateH P Prod.fst)
proof:
:= by
  refine antitone_nat_of_succ_le fun k => ?_
  by_cases h : k+1<n
  · exact rate_antitone_succ hp h
  rw [rateH,dite_eq_right h]
  unfold rateH
  split
  · exact Hcond_nonneg _ _ _
  · exact le_rfl

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.rate_bdd
statement:
lemma rate_bdd (P : Law Ω) (X : Ω → Letters n α) (j : ℕ) :
    rateH P X j ≤ log (Fintype.card α)
proof:
:= by
  rw [rateH]
  split
  · exact (Hcond_le_H P _ _).trans (H_card _ _)
  · cases Fintype.card α with
    | zero => simp
    | succ k => apply log_nonneg; simp

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.avg_block_kl
statement:
lemma avg_block_kl {P : Law (S n α G)} (hp : exch P)
    {j m} (hh : j+m ≤ n) (hj : j<n) :
    let X : S n α G → Letters n α
proof:
:= Prod.fst
    let W := prefixB X j hj.le
    let V := readBlock X j m hh
    (P.send W).Ex (fun w =>
      let R := P.after W w
      kl (R.send V) (pack (fun _ : Fin m => R.send (readLetter X j hj)))) =
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range m, (rateH P X j - rateH P X (j+i)) := by
  intro X W V
  let f := readLetter X j hj
  let A (w : Letters j α) := P.after W w
  have hk (w : Letters j α) :
      kl ((A w).send V) (pack (fun _ : Fin m => (A w).send f)) =
        (m:ℝ) * (A w).H f - (A w).H V := by
    have hm (i : Fin m) := conditional_block_marg hp hh w i
    have hm' (i : Fin m) :
        ((A w).send V).send (fun x => x i) = (A w).send f := by rw [send_send]; exact hm i
    have he : dominated ((A w).send V) (pack (fun _ : Fin m => (A w).send f)) := by
      intro x hx
      rw [pack_pos]
      intro i
      rw [← hm' i]; exact send_pos _ _ hx
    rw [kl,crossE_pack he]
    simp_rw [hm']
    simp only [Finset.sum_const,Finset.card_univ,Fintype.card_fin,nsmul_eq_mul]
    rfl
  change (P.send W).Ex (fun w => kl ((A w).send V) (pack (fun _ : Fin m => (A w).send f))) = _
  have h1 : (P.send W).Ex (fun w => (A w).H f) = rateH P X j :=
    (rate_lt P X hj ▸ Hcond_after P f W).symm
  have h2 : (P.send W).Ex (fun w => (A w).H V) = _ := H_post_prefix P X j m hh
  simp_rw [hk,Ex_sub,Ex_lmul,h1,h2,Finset.sum_sub_distrib,Finset.sum_const,Finset.card_range,
    nsmul_eq_mul]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.kl_uniform
statement:
lemma kl_uniform {α : Type} [Fintype α] [Nonempty α]
    (P : Law (Letters n α)) :
    P.kl (pack (fun _ : Fin n => uniform α)) =
      n*log (Fintype.card α) - P.entropy
proof:
:= by
  have h : P.dominated (pack (fun _ => uniform α)) := by
    intro x _
    rw [pack_pos]
    intro i
    rw [uniform_apply]
    positivity
  unfold kl
  rw [crossE_pack h]
  simp_rw [crossE, uniform_apply, log_inv,neg_neg,Ex_const,Finset.sum_const,Finset.card_univ,
    Fintype.card_fin,nsmul_eq_mul]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.sum_deficit
statement:
lemma sum_deficit (P : Law Ω) [Nonempty α] (X : Ω → Letters n α) :
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.range n, (log (Fintype.card α)-rateH P X j) =
      (P.send X).kl (pack (fun _ => uniform α))
proof:
:= by
  have h := H_prefix P X n le_rfl
  rw [prefix_all] at h
  rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib,kl_uniform,← h]
  simp only [Finset.sum_const,Finset.card_range,nsmul_eq_mul]; rfl

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.Hcond_congr
proof:
:= by
  unfold Hcond
  rw [H_congr_mem P h']
  congr 1
  refine H_congr_mem P fun a ha => ?_
  rw [h a ha,h' a ha]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.rent_proj_eq
statement:
lemma rent_proj_eq (tag : B → G) (w : B → V) (u : E → G) (c : E → ℝ)
    (P : Law Ω) (X : Ω → Letters n A) (U : Ω → E) (σ : A → B) :
    let Y
proof:
:= ctxt σ X
    rent (tag ∘ σ) (w ∘ σ) u c P X U =
      rent tag w u c P Y U +
      ((∑ i, P.Hcond (readP X i) (readP Y i)) -
        P.Hcond X (fun x => (Y x, ans tag Y (fun a => u (U a)) x))) := by
  intro Y
  let Z := ans tag Y (fun a => u (U a))
  have h1 (i : Fin n) :
      P.Hcond (readP X i) ((w ∘ σ) ∘ readP X i) =
      P.Hcond (readP X i) (readP Y i) + P.Hcond (readP Y i) (w ∘ readP Y i) := by
    let R := (w ∘ readP Y i)
    have he := Hcond_reduce P (readP X i) R σ
    change P.Hcond _ R = _ + P.Hcond (readP Y i) R
    rw [he]; congr 1
    apply Hcond_right_partition
    simp only [R,Y,ctxt,readP,comp_apply,Prod.mk.injEq]
    grind
  have h2 :
      P.Hcond X (fun x => (Z x,ctxt w Y x)) =
        P.Hcond X (fun x => (Y x,Z x)) +
        P.Hcond Y (fun x => (Z x,ctxt w Y x)) := by
    nth_rw 1 [Hcond_reduce P X _ (fun v i => σ (v i))]
    congr 1
    apply Hcond_right_partition
    intro a b
    simp only [Prod.mk.injEq,Y,ctxt,funext_iff]
    grind
  unfold rent
  change _ - P.Hcond X (fun x => (Z x,ctxt w Y x))+_ = _
  rw [h2]
  simp_rw [h1,Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  dsimp only [Z]
  ring

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.rent_projection
statement:
lemma rent_projection (tag : B → G) (w : B → V) (u : E → G) (c : E → ℝ)
    (P : Law Ω) (X : Ω → Letters n A) (U : Ω → E) (σ : A → B) :
    rent tag w u c P (ctxt σ X) U ≤ rent (tag ∘ σ) (w ∘ σ) u c P X U
proof:
:= by
  rw [rent_proj_eq]
  refine le_add_of_nonneg_right (sub_nonneg.mpr ?_)
  let Y := ctxt σ X
  let Z (x : Ω) := (Y x,ans tag Y (fun x => u (U x)) x)
  refine (Hcond_vec_le P X Z).trans (Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => ?_)
  apply Hcond_antitone
  intro a b h
  exact congrFun (congrArg Prod.fst h) i

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.rent_congr_mem
statement:
lemma rent_congr_mem (tag : A → G) (w : A → V) (u : E → G) (c : E → ℝ)
    (P : Law Ω) {X Y : Ω → Letters n A} (U : Ω → E)
    (h : ∀ x, 0 < P x → X x=Y x) :
    rent tag w u c P X U = rent tag w u c P Y U
proof:
:= by
  unfold rent
  suffices H : ∑ i, P.Hcond (readP X i) (w ∘ readP X i) =
      ∑ i, P.Hcond (readP Y i) (w ∘ readP Y i) by
    have hh (x : Ω) (hx : 0 < P x) :
        (ans tag X (fun x => u (U x)) x, ctxt w X x) =
          (ans tag Y (fun x => u (U x)) x, ctxt w Y x) := by
      unfold ans ctxt; rw [h x hx]
    rw [H]
    have ht := Hcond_congr h (W:=fun x => (ans tag X (fun x => u (U x)) x, ctxt w X x))
      (W':=fun x => (ans tag Y (fun x => u (U x)) x, ctxt w Y x)) hh
    rw [ht]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
  apply Hcond_congr
  · exact fun x hx => congrFun (h x hx) _
  · exact fun x hx => congrArg w (congrFun (h x hx) _)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.opt_proj
statement:
lemma opt_proj (tag : B → G) (w : B → V) (u : E → G) (c : E → ℝ)
    (p : Law A) (σ : A → B) (n : ℕ) :
    opt n (p.send σ) tag w u c = opt n p (tag ∘ σ) (w ∘ σ) u c
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply le_antisymm
  · obtain ⟨P,hP,he⟩ := (opt_spec n p (tag ∘ σ) (w ∘ σ) u c).1
    rw [← he]
    let X : WordSample n A E → Letters n A := Prod.fst
    exact (opt_le_rent tag w u c (p.send σ) P (ctxt σ X) Prod.snd fun i => by
      rw [← hP i,send_send]; rfl).trans (rent_projection tag w u c P _ _ _)
  obtain ⟨P,hP,he⟩ := (opt_spec n (p.send σ) tag w u c).1
  let X : WordSample n B E → Letters n B := Prod.fst
  let Q x := pack (fun i : Fin n => p.after σ (X x i))
  let R := P.withNext Q
  let Y : WordSample n B E × (Letters n A) → Letters n A := Prod.snd
  let B0 (z : WordSample n B E × Letters n A) := X z.1
  let error (z : WordSample n B E × Letters n A) := z.1.2
  have hr : hasRows p R Y := by
    intro i
    apply ext_of_Ex; intro f
    rw [Ex_send]
    change R.Ex (fun z => f (z.2 i)) = p.Ex f
    unfold R
    rw [Ex_withNext]
    simp_rw [Q, Ex_pack_proj _ i f]
    change P.Ex (fun x => (p.after σ (readP X i x)).Ex f) = _
    rw [← Ex_send P (readP X i) (fun b => (p.after σ b).Ex f),show P.send (readP X i) = _ from hP i]
    exact p.after_Ex_sum σ (fun _ => f)
  have heq (x : WordSample n B E × Letters n A) (hx : 0 < R x) : ctxt σ Y x = B0 x := by
    rcases x with ⟨a,b⟩
    change 0 < P a * Q a b at hx
    have hpos : 0 < P a ∧ 0 < Q a b :=
      (mul_pos_iff.mp hx).resolve_right (by intro hh; linarith [hh.1,P.nonneg a])
    funext i
    have hi := (pack_pos (fun i => p.after σ (X a i)) b).mp hpos.2 i
    have hmarg := P.send_pos (readP X i) hpos.1
    rw [show P.send (readP X i) = _ from hP i] at hmarg
    exact ((after_mem hmarg).mp hi).1
  have hsrc : rent tag w u c R B0 error = opt n (p.send σ) tag w u c := by
    have h1 := send_fst_withNext P Q
    have hi := rent_send tag w u c R X Prod.snd Prod.fst
    change rent tag w u c (R.send Prod.fst) X Prod.snd = _ at hi
    rw [h1] at hi
    exact hi.symm.trans he
  refine (opt_le_rent (tag ∘ σ) (w ∘ σ) u c p R Y error hr).trans ?_
  rw [rent_proj_eq]
  let B1 := ctxt σ Y
  let Z (b : WordSample n B E × Letters n A) :=
    (B1 b, ans tag B1 (fun x => u (error x)) b)
  let Z0 (b : WordSample n B E × Letters n A) :=
    (B0 b, ans tag B0 (fun x => u (error x)) b)
  change rent tag w u c R B1 error + (_ - R.Hcond Y Z) ≤ _
  rw [rent_congr_mem tag w u c R error heq,hsrc]
  suffices H : ∑ i, R.Hcond (readP Y i) (readP B1 i) ≤ R.Hcond Y Z by linarith
  have hZ : R.Hcond Y Z = R.Hcond Y Z0 :=
    Hcond_congr (fun _ _ => rfl) fun x hx => by unfold Z Z0 ans; rw [show B1 x = B0 x from heq x hx]
  rw [hZ]
  apply le_trans (b:=R.Hcond Y Prod.fst)
  · have H1 : R.Hcond Y Prod.fst = P.Ex (fun x => (Q x).entropy) := by
      have H := Hcond_withNext' P Q (fun _ y => y)
      simpa only [H_self] using H
    have H2 (i : Fin n) : R.Hcond (readP Y i) (readP B1 i) = p.Hcond (fun a => a) σ := by
      rw [← hr i]
      rw [Hcond_send]; rfl
    have H3 (i : Fin n) :
        P.Ex (fun x => (p.after σ (X x i)).entropy) = p.Hcond (fun a => a) σ := by
      rw [Hcond_after]
      simp_rw [H_self]
      have hi := hP i
      rw [← hi,Ex_send]; rfl
    rw [H1]; simp_rw [Q,entropy_pack,H2,Ex_finset_sum,H3]; exact le_rfl
  · apply Hcond_antitone
    rintro ⟨a,b⟩ ⟨a',b'⟩ h
    cases (show a=a' from h)
    rfl

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.opt_refined
statement:
lemma opt_refined (tag : B → G) (w : B → V) (w' : A → W) (u : E → G) (c : E → ℝ)
    (p : Law A) (σ : A → B) (n : ℕ) (g : W → V) (h : w ∘ σ = g ∘ w') :
    opt n p (tag ∘ σ) w' u c ≤ opt n (p.send σ) tag w u c
proof:
:= by
  rw [opt_proj tag w]
  obtain ⟨P,hP,he⟩ := (opt_spec n p (tag ∘ σ) (w ∘ σ) u c).1
  exact (opt_le_rent _ _ _ _ p P _ _ hP).trans
    ((rent_antitone _ w' (w ∘ σ) u c g h P Prod.fst Prod.snd).trans he.le)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.rent_first
statement:
lemma rent_first {P : Law Ω} {X : Ω → I → A} {p : Law A} (h : hasRows p P X)
    (w : A → V) :
    ∑ i, P.Hcond (readP X i) (w ∘ readP X i) = Fintype.card I * p.Hcond (fun x => x) w
proof:
:= by
  have heq (i : I) :
      P.Hcond (readP X i) (w ∘ readP X i) = p.Hcond (fun x => x) w := by
    rw [← h i,Hcond_send]; rfl
  simp_rw [heq,Finset.sum_const,Finset.card_univ,nsmul_eq_mul]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.rent_nonneg
statement:
lemma rent_nonneg (tag : A → G) (w : A → V) (u : E → G) (c : E → ℝ)
    (hc : ∀ x, 0 ≤ c x) (P : Law Ω) (X : Ω → I → A) (U : Ω → E) :
    0 ≤ rent tag w u c P X U
proof:
:= by
  refine add_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr ?_) (P.Ex_nonneg fun a => hc _)
  refine (P.Hcond_vec_le X _).trans (Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => ?_)
  apply Hcond_antitone
  intro a b hh
  exact congrFun (congrArg Prod.snd hh) i

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.rent_send
statement:
lemma rent_send (tag : A → G) (w : A → V) (u : E → G) (c : E → ℝ)
    (P : Law Ω) (X : Ω' → I → A) (U : Ω' → E) (b : Ω → Ω') :
    rent tag w u c (P.send b) X U = rent tag w u c P (fun a => X (b a)) (fun a => U (b a))
proof:
:= by
  unfold rent; simp_rw [Hcond_send,Ex_send]
  rfl

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.rent_cont
statement:
lemma rent_cont (tag : A → G) (w : A → V) (u : E → G) (c : E → ℝ)
    (X : Ω → I → A) (U : Ω → E) :
    Continuous (fun P : Law Ω => rent tag w u c P X U)
proof:
:=
  ((continuous_finsetSum _ fun _ _ => continuous_Hcond _ _).sub (continuous_Hcond _ _)).add
    (continuous_Ex _)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.opt_spec
statement:
lemma opt_spec (n : ℕ) (p : Law A) (tag : A → G) (w : A → V) (u : E → G) (c : E → ℝ) :
    let C (P : Law (WordSample n A E))
proof:
:= rent tag w u c P Prod.fst Prod.snd
    (∃ P : Law (WordSample n A E), hasRows p P Prod.fst ∧ C P = opt n p tag w u c) ∧
    ∀ P : Law (WordSample n A E), hasRows p P Prod.fst → opt n p tag w u c ≤ C P := by
  classical
  intro C
  let s := {P : Law (WordSample n A E) | hasRows p P Prod.fst}
  have hs : IsCompact s := by
    apply IsClosed.isCompact
    have heq : s = ⋂ i, {P | P.send (readP Prod.fst i) = p} := by ext; simp [s,hasRows]
    rw [heq]
    exact isClosed_iInter fun i => isClosed_eq (continuous_send _) continuous_const
  let Q := pack fun _ : Fin n => p
  obtain ⟨e⟩ := (inferInstance : Nonempty E)
  have h1 : s.Nonempty := by
    refine ⟨Q.send (fun x => (x,e)),fun i => ?_⟩
    rw [send_send]; exact marginalPack _ i
  have hh := hs.image (rent_cont tag w u c Prod.fst Prod.snd)
  have H1 : (C '' s).Nonempty := h1.image _
  exact ⟨hh.sInf_mem H1,fun P h => csInf_le hh.bddBelow ⟨_, h,rfl⟩⟩

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.opt_le_rent
statement:
lemma opt_le_rent (tag : A → G) (w : A → V) (u : E → G) (c : E → ℝ)
    (p : Law A) (P : Law Ω) (X : Ω → Fin n → A) (U : Ω → E) (h : hasRows p P X) :
    opt n p tag w u c ≤ rent tag w u c P X U
proof:
:= by
  let Q := P.send (fun a => (X a,U a))
  have hh := (opt_spec n p tag w u c).2 Q (by
    intro i
    dsimp only [Q]; rw [send_send]; exact h i)
  dsimp only [Q] at hh
  rw [rent_send] at hh
  exact hh

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.opt_nonneg
statement:
lemma opt_nonneg (n : ℕ) (p : Law A) (tag : A → G) (w : A → V) (u : E → G) (c : E → ℝ)
    (hc : ∀ x, 0 ≤ c x) : 0 ≤ opt n p tag w u c
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨P,_,he⟩ := (opt_spec n p tag w u c).1
  rw [← he]
  exact rent_nonneg tag w u c hc P _ _

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.Hcond_function
statement:
lemma Hcond_function (P : Law Ω) (X : Ω → A) (W : A → V) :
    P.Hcond X (fun x => W (X x)) = P.H X - P.H (fun x => W (X x))
proof:
:= by
  unfold Hcond
  congr 1
  apply H_partition
  simp [Prod.mk.injEq]; grind

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.Hcond_reduce
statement:
lemma Hcond_reduce (P : Law Ω) (X : Ω → A) (W : Ω → V) (f : A → B) :
    P.Hcond X W = P.Hcond X (fun x => (f (X x),W x)) + P.Hcond (fun x => f (X x)) W
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Hcond_chain P X (fun x => f (X x)) W]
  unfold Hcond
  congr 1
  refine H_partition _ fun a b => ?_
  simp only [Prod.mk.injEq]
  constructor <;> grind

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.rent_antitone
statement:
lemma rent_antitone (tag : A → G) (w : A → V) (w' : A → W) (u : E → G) (c : E → ℝ)
    (p : V → W) (h : w' = p ∘ w)
    (P : Law Ω) (X : Ω → I → A) (U : Ω → E) :
    rent tag w u c P X U ≤ rent tag w' u c P X U
proof:
:= by
  subst w'
  let Y := ans tag X (fun x => u (U x))
  let W₁ := ctxt w X
  let W₂ := ctxt (p ∘ w) X
  have h (i : I) : P.Hcond (readP X i) ((p ∘ w) ∘ readP X i) =
      P.Hcond (readP X i) (w ∘ readP X i) + P.Hcond (readP W₁ i) (readP W₂ i) := by
    have h1 := Hcond_function P (readP X i) (p ∘ w)
    have h2 := Hcond_function P (readP X i) w
    have h3 := Hcond_function P (readP W₁ i) p
    change P.Hcond (readP X i) (fun x => p (w ((readP X i) x))) = _
    dsimp only [comp_apply] at h1
    rw [h1]
    change _ = P.Hcond (readP X i) (fun x => w ((readP X i) x)) +
      P.Hcond (readP W₁ i) (fun x => p (readP W₁ i x))
    rw [h2,h3]; simp only [W₁]; unfold readP ctxt; ring
  let vmap (x : I → A) (i : I) := w (x i)
  let Z₁ (x : Ω) := (Y x,W₁ x)
  let Z₂ (x : Ω) := (Y x,W₂ x)
  have hz : P.Hcond X Z₂ = P.Hcond X Z₁ + P.Hcond W₁ Z₂ := by
    nth_rw 1 [Hcond_reduce P X Z₂ vmap]
    have H : P.Hcond X (fun x => (vmap (X x), Z₂ x)) = P.Hcond X Z₁ := by
      apply Hcond_right_partition
      intro a b
      simp only [Z₁,Z₂,W₁,W₂,ctxt,vmap,Prod.mk.injEq,funext_iff,comp_apply]
      constructor
      · tauto
      · rintro ⟨hh,hx⟩
        simp [hx,hh]
    rw [H]; rfl
  have H : P.Hcond W₁ Z₂ ≤ ∑ i, P.Hcond (readP W₁ i) (readP W₂ i) := by
    refine (P.Hcond_vec_le W₁ Z₂).trans (Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => ?_)
    exact Hcond_antitone P _ fun _ _ hh => congrFun (congrArg Prod.snd hh) i
  unfold rent
  refine add_le_add_left ?_ _
  change _ - P.Hcond X Z₁ ≤ _ - P.Hcond X Z₂
  rw [hz]
  simp_rw [h,Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  linarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.any_above
proof:
:= by
  by_contra! hh
  have he : ∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, f i ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, a :=
    Finset.sum_le_sum fun i hi => hh i (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)
  simp only [Finset.sum_const,Finset.card_range,nsmul_eq_mul] at he
  linarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.exists_offer
statement:
private lemma exists_offer (k m : ℕ) (hkm : k ≤ m) (hmp : 0 < m)
    (d c : ℕ → ℝ) (τ p : ℝ) (hT : 0 < τ) (hp : 0 ≤ p)
    (h : τ < ∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, d i) (h1 : ∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, c i = τ*p)
    (hg : ∀ i, 0 ≤ c i) :
    ∃ i < k, τ/(2*m) ≤ d i ∧ c i ≤ 2*p*d i
proof:
:= by
  have hpos : (0:ℝ) < m := by exact_mod_cast hmp
  let v := τ/(2*m)
  have hv : 0 ≤ v := by unfold v; positivity
  have HH : k*v ≤ τ/2 := calc
    _ ≤ (m:ℝ)*v := by gcongr
    _ = τ/2 := by unfold v; field_simp
  obtain hs|hs := eq_or_lt_of_le hp
  · obtain ⟨i,hi,hb⟩ := any_above v (f:=d) (k:=k) (by linarith)
    refine ⟨i,hi,hb.le,?_⟩
    have he := Finset.single_le_sum (fun i (_ : i ∈ Finset.range k) => hg i)
      (Finset.mem_range.mpr hi)
    rw [← hs] at h1 ⊢
    linarith
  obtain ⟨i,hi,hb⟩ := any_above v (f:=fun i => d i - c i/(2*p)) (k:=k) (by
    rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.sum_div,h1]
    rw [show τ*p/(2*p)=τ/2 by field_simp]
    linarith)
  have hn : 0 ≤ c i/(2*p) := by have := hg i; positivity
  refine ⟨i,hi,le_of_lt (by linarith),?_⟩
  have hI : c i/(2*p) ≤ d i := by linarith
  have he := (div_le_iff₀ (show 0 < 2*p by positivity)).mp hI
  linarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.Schedule.loss_pos
statement: lemma loss_pos (w : Schedule) : 0 < w.loss
proof:
:= by
  have H := lt_of_lt_of_le (mul_pos w.d0 (exp_pos _)) w.heta
  unfold loss; nlinarith [w.hα,w.a0]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.offer_at
statement:
lemma offer_at (tag : A→G) (hi : Injective tag) (c : G→ℝ) (s : Labelled A)
    (D F : ℝ) (hd : 0 < D) (hf : 0 < F) (r l u M : ℕ) (hl : l ≤ u) (hu : u ≤ M)
    (hm : 0 < M) (hno : F+fundK tag c s l r < fundK tag c s u r)
    (x : ℝ) (hx : 0 < x) (hb : x ≤ F/D/(2*M)) :
    ∃ t, refines t s ∧
      x ≤ fundI tag s r / D - fundI tag t r / D ∧
      F/D * (fundG tag s 1 / D - fundG tag t 1 / D) ≤
        2*(fundG tag s u/D-fundG tag s l/D)*x
proof:
:= by
  let g n := fundG tag s n/D
  let a t := fundI tag t r/D
  let τ := F/D
  let T m := observe tag s (l+m)
  let k := u-l
  let f m := a s - a (T m)
  let b m := τ*(fundG tag s 1/D - fundG tag (T m) 1 / D)
  let K n := fundK tag c s n r
  have hg : Monotone g := fun i j hh => div_le_div_of_nonneg_right
    (fundG_mono tag s hh) hd.le
  have hτ : 0 < τ := div_pos hf hd
  have h1 : τ < ∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, f i := by
    have hc (i : ℕ) : K (l+(i+1))/D-K (l+i)/D ≤ f i := by
      have hh := observe_save tag c s (l+i) r
      unfold K f a T; rw [← sub_div, ← sub_div,← Nat.add_assoc]
      exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) hd.le
    refine lt_of_lt_of_le ?_ (Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => hc i))
    rw [Finset.sum_range_sub (fun i => K (l+i)/D)]
    unfold k τ K
    rw [Nat.add_zero,Nat.add_sub_of_le hl, ← sub_div]
    gcongr; linarith
  have heq (i : ℕ) : b i = τ*(g (l+(i+1))-g (l+i)) := by
    unfold b g T
    rw [← sub_div,observe_cost tag hi s (l+i),← sub_div,Nat.add_assoc]
  have h2 : ∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, b i = τ*(g u-g l) := by
    simp_rw [heq,← Finset.mul_sum]
    rw [Finset.sum_range_sub (fun i => g (l+i))]
    simp only [k,Nat.add_sub_of_le hl,Nat.add_zero]
  obtain ⟨i,hh,hI,hJ⟩ := exists_offer k M (by omega) hm f b τ (g u-g l)
    hτ (sub_nonneg.mpr (hg hl)) h1 h2 (by
      intro i; rw [heq]; exact mul_nonneg hτ.le (sub_nonneg.mpr (hg (by omega))))
  have hX : x ≤ f i := le_trans hb hI
  have Hf : 0 < f i := lt_of_lt_of_le hx hX
  let y := x/f i
  have hy0 : 0 ≤ y := (div_pos hx Hf).le
  have hy1 : y ≤ 1 := (div_le_one Hf).mpr hX
  refine ⟨blend (T i) s y hy0 hy1,
    blend_refines _ _ _ (observe_refines _ _ _) (refines_refl s) _ _ _, ?_,?_⟩
  · have hh := blend_I tag (T i) s y hy0 hy1 r
    have hi := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hh hd.le
    have He : y*f i=x := div_mul_cancel₀ _ Hf.ne'
    unfold f a at He; rw [add_div,mul_div_assoc,mul_div_assoc] at hi
    linarith
  · rw [blend_G1 tag hi _ _ _]
    change τ*_ ≤ 2*(g u-g l)*x
    calc
      _ = y*b i := by unfold b; ring
      _ ≤ y*(2*(g u-g l)*f i) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hJ hy0
      _ = _ := by rw [mul_left_comm,show y*f i=x from div_mul_cancel₀ _ Hf.ne']

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.reach
statement:
theorem reach (tag : A → G) (hi : Injective tag) (c : G → ℝ) (_hc0 : ∀ x, 0 ≤ c x)
    (S : Labelled A) (D F : ℝ) (hd : 0 < D) (hf : 0 < F) (B : Schedule)
    (m : ℕ) (l u r : ℕ → ℕ) (hm : 0 < m)
    (hl : ∀ i, i < B.size → l i ≤ u i ∧ u i ≤ m)
    (hp : ∀ i j, i < j → j < B.size → u j ≤ l i ∧ r i ≤ r j)
    (hG : ∀ i, i<B.size → fundG tag S (u i) ≤ D)
    (hI : ∀ i, i<B.size → fundI tag S (r i) ≤ D) :
    ∃ T, refines T S ∧ fundG tag S 1 - fundG tag T 1 ≤ B.loss*D*D/F ∧
      ∃ i, i < B.size ∧ fundK tag c T (u i) (r i) ≤ F+fundK tag c T (l i) (r i)
proof:
:= by
  let Ω := {p // refines p S}
  let τ := F/D
  have hτ : 0 < τ := div_pos hf hd
  let g (i : ℕ) (x : Ω) := fundG tag x.val i / D
  let a (i : ℕ) (x : Ω) := fundI tag x.val (r i) / D
  let v : Arena Ω :=
    { N := B.size
      mov := fun s t => refines t.val s.val
      refl := fun s => refines_refl _
      trans := fun h1 h2 => refines_trans h2 h1
      topc := fun x => τ*g 1 x
      pay := fun {x y} hh => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right
        (G_anti tag hh 1) hd.le) hτ.le
      A := a
      Alo := fun s i _ => div_nonneg (opt_nonneg _ s.val.law (tag ∘ Prod.fst) Prod.snd
        (fun _ : Unit => 0) (fun _ => 0) (fun _ => le_refl _)) hd.le
      Ahi := fun s i hi => (div_le_one hd).mpr ((I_anti tag s.property _).trans (hI i hi))
      Am := fun s {i j} hij hj => by
        obtain h|h := eq_or_lt_of_le hij
        · subst i; exact le_rfl
        · exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (fundI_mono tag _ (hp i j h hj).2) hd.le
      As := fun {x y} h _ _ => div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (I_anti _ h _) hd.le
      L := fun i => g (l i)
      H := fun i => g (u i)
      Llo := fun s i h => div_nonneg (show 0 ≤ fundG tag s.val (l i) from Hcond_nonneg _ _ _) hd.le
      Hhi := fun s i hi => (div_le_one hd).mpr ((G_anti tag s.property _).trans (hG i hi))
      LH := fun s i h => div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (fundG_mono _ _ (hl i h).1) hd.le
      BC := fun s {i j} h hb => div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (fundG_mono _ _ (hp i j h hb).1) hd.le
      Ls := fun {s t} h i _ => div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (G_anti _ h _) hd.le
      Hs := fun {s t} h i _ => div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (G_anti _ h _) hd.le
      found := fun s => ∃ i, i < B.size ∧ fundK tag c s.val (u i) (r i) ≤ F +
        fundK tag c s.val (l i) (r i)
      rate := τ/(2*m)
      r0 := by have : (0:ℝ) < m := by exact_mod_cast hm
               positivity
      offer := by
        intro s i hb h x hx hx'
        obtain ⟨Q,hQ,h1,h2⟩ := offer_at tag hi c s.val D F hd hf (r i) (l i) (u i)
          m (hl i hb).1 (hl i hb).2 hm (lt_of_not_ge (fun hh => h ⟨i,hb,hh⟩)) x hx hx'
        exact ⟨⟨Q,refines_trans hQ s.property⟩,hQ,h1,by rwa [← mul_sub]⟩ }
  obtain ⟨t,ht,hc,hP⟩ :=
    v.complete_search ⟨S,refines_refl S⟩ B.N B.q B.n B.n0 B.q0 B.N0 le_rfl
      B.u B.a B.δ B.η B.α B.ε B.u0 B.a0 B.d0 B.heta B.hn B.hα B.hε B.hβ B.hc B.hq B.ht
  refine ⟨t.val,t.property,?_,hc⟩
  change F/D * (fundG tag S 1 / D) - F/D*(fundG tag t.val 1 / D) ≤ B.loss at hP
  field_simp at *

  linarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.Arena.dummy
statement: private lemma dummy : True
proof: := trivial

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.Arena.H_index
statement: lemma H_index (s) {i j} (hi : i ≤ j) (hj : j<d.N) : d.H j s ≤ d.H i s
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl|h := eq_or_lt_of_le hi
  · exact le_rfl
  · exact (d.BC s h hj).trans (d.LH s _ (by omega))

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.Arena.L_index
statement: lemma L_index (s) {i j} (hi : i ≤ j) (hj : j<d.N) : d.L j s ≤ d.L i s
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl|h := eq_or_lt_of_le hi
  · exact le_rfl
  · exact (d.LH s _ hj).trans (d.BC s h hj)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.Arena.budget_index
statement:
lemma budget_index (s : S) {i : ℕ} (hi : i < d.N)
    (u a δ η : ℝ) (hu : 0 < u) (ha : 0 < a) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hη : δ*exp (2*u/a) ≤ η) :
    ∃ t, d.mov s t ∧ d.topc s-d.topc t ≤ a*η ∧
      (d.found t ∨ u ≤ d.A i s - d.A i t ∨
        (d.topc s-d.topc t)+a*δ ≤ a*(d.H i s-d.L i t))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let cost (t : S) := d.topc s-d.topc t
  let Δ t := d.A i s - d.A i t
  let b t := min u (Δ t)
  let goal (t : S) := d.found t ∨ u ≤ Δ t ∨ cost t+a*δ ≤ a*(d.H i s-d.L i t)

  have H (k : ℕ) : ∃ t, d.mov s t ∧ cost t+a*δ ≤ a*δ*exp (2*b t/a) ∧
      (goal t ∨ k*d.rate ≤ Δ t) := by
    induction k with
    | zero =>
      refine ⟨s,d.refl _,?_ ,Or.inr ?_⟩ <;> simp [cost,Δ,b,le_of_lt hu]
    | succ k ih =>
      obtain ⟨t,hst,hc,hk⟩ := ih
      by_cases h : goal t
      · exact ⟨t,hst,hc,Or.inl h⟩
      unfold goal at h
      push Not at h
      have he : 0 < u-Δ t := by linarith [h.2.1]
      let x := min d.rate (u-Δ t)
      have hx : 0 < x := lt_min d.r0 he
      obtain ⟨q,hq,hA,hV⟩ := d.offer t hi h.1 x hx (min_le_left _ _)
      have hT : b t = Δ t := min_eq_right h.2.1.le
      have hQ : Δ t+x ≤ b q := by
        refine le_min ?_ ?_
        · linarith [show x ≤ u-Δ t from min_le_right _ _]
        · dsimp [Δ]; linarith
      have hcp : 0 ≤ cost t := sub_nonneg.mpr (d.pay hst)
      have H1 : cost q+a*δ ≤ (cost t+a*δ)*(1+2*x/a) := by
        have HH : a*(d.H i t-d.L i t) ≤ cost t+a*δ :=
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (sub_le_sub_right (d.Hs hst hi) _) ha.le).trans h.2.2.le
        have h1 : a*(cost q-cost t) ≤ (cost t+a*δ)* (2*x) := by
          calc
            _ ≤ a*(2*(d.H i t-d.L i t)*x) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by unfold cost; linarith) ha.le
            _ = a*(d.H i t-d.L i t)*(2*x) := by ring
            _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right HH (by positivity)
        field_simp; linarith
      have H2 : exp (2*b t/a) * exp (2*x/a) ≤ exp (2*b q/a) := by
        rw [← exp_add,exp_le_exp,hT]
        field_simp; linarith
      have H3 : cost q+a*δ ≤ a*δ*exp (2*b q/a) := by
        apply le_trans H1
        have hxp : 1+2*x/a ≤ exp (2*x/a) := by linarith [add_one_le_exp (2*x/a)]
        apply le_trans (mul_le_mul hc hxp (by positivity) (by positivity))
        rw [mul_assoc]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left H2 (mul_pos ha hδ).le
      refine ⟨q,d.trans hst hq,H3,?_⟩

      rcases le_total d.rate (u-Δ t) with hn|hn
      · have hh : k*d.rate ≤ Δ t := hk.resolve_left (by unfold goal; grind)
        right
        have hh' : x = d.rate := min_eq_left hn
        push_cast
        have H := min_le_right u (Δ q)
        linarith [show b q ≤ Δ q from H]
      · left
        refine Or.inr (Or.inl ?_)
        have hh : x = u - Δ t := min_eq_right hn
        have he : b q ≤ Δ q := min_le_right _ _
        linarith
  obtain ⟨k,hk⟩ := exists_nat_gt (1 / d.rate)
  obtain ⟨t,hst,h1,h2⟩ := H k
  have h3 : goal t :=
    h2.resolve_right (fun hh => by
      have Hr := (div_lt_iff₀ d.r0).mp hk
      unfold Δ at hh; linarith [d.Ahi s i hi,d.Alo t i hi])
  refine ⟨t,hst,?_ ,h3⟩
  have H0 : b t ≤ u := min_le_left _ _
  have H1 : exp (2*b t/a) ≤ exp (2*u/a) := by gcongr
  change cost t ≤ _
  nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left H1 (mul_pos ha hδ).le,
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hη ha.le]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.Arena.budget_ascending
statement:
lemma budget_ascending (s : S) (G : S → Prop)
    (o n m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (hn : 0 < n) (hb : o+n*m ≤ d.N)
    (a b δ : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hδ : 1 < n*δ)
    (hstep : ∀ (t) (_h : d.mov s t) i (_hi : i<n), ∃ q, d.mov t q ∧
      ((G q ∧ d.topc t-d.topc q ≤ a*(d.H (o+i*m) t-d.L (o+(i+1)*m-1) q)+b) ∨
        (d.topc t-d.topc q)+a*δ ≤ a*(d.H (o+i*m) t-d.L (o+(i+1)*m-1) q))) :
    ∃ t, d.mov s t ∧ G t ∧ d.topc s-d.topc t ≤ a*(d.H o s-d.L (o+n*m-1) t)+b
proof:
:= by
  let first i := o+i*m
  let last i := o+(i+1)*m-1
  have hF (i) (hi : i < n) : first i < d.N := by dsimp [first]; nlinarith
  have hL (i) (hi : i < n) : last i < d.N := by
    have hb' : o+(i+1)*m ≤ o+n*m := by gcongr; omega
    have hp : 0 < (i+1)*m := Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hm
    dsimp [last]; omega
  have H (k) (hk : k < n) :
      ∃ t, d.mov s t ∧
       ((G t ∧ d.topc s-d.topc t ≤ a*(d.H o s-d.L (last k) t)+b) ∨
         d.topc s-d.topc t+((k:ℝ)+1)*(a*δ) ≤ a*(d.H o s-d.L (last k) t)) := by
    induction k with
    | zero => simpa [last] using hstep s (d.refl s) 0 hk
    | succ k ih =>
      have hk' : k<n := by omega
      obtain ⟨t,hst,HG|hh⟩ := ih hk'
      · refine ⟨t,hst,Or.inl ⟨HG.1,HG.2.trans ?_⟩⟩
        have Hs : d.L (last (k+1)) t ≤ d.L (last k) t :=
          d.L_index _ (by unfold last; gcongr; omega) (hL _ hk)
        gcongr
      obtain ⟨q,hq,hq'⟩ := hstep t hst (k+1) hk
      have he : last k < first (k+1) := by
        have : 0 < m*(k+1) := Nat.mul_pos hm (by omega)
        rw [Nat.mul_comm] at this
        unfold last first; omega
      have h' := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (d.BC t he (hF _ hk)) ha.le
      have hd : 0 ≤ (k+1:ℝ)*(a*δ) := by
        have hp : 0 < δ := by
          have : (0:ℝ) < n := by exact_mod_cast hn
          nlinarith
        positivity
      refine ⟨q,d.trans hst hq,?_⟩
      dsimp only [last,first] at *
      rcases hq' with H1|H1
      · exact Or.inl ⟨H1.1,by linarith [H1.2]⟩
      · right; push_cast; linarith
  obtain ⟨k,rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero hn.ne'
  obtain ⟨t,hst,hh|hh⟩ := H k (by omega)
  · exact ⟨t,hst,hh⟩
  exfalso
  have h1 := (d.pay hst)
  have h2 := d.Llo t (last k) (hL k (by omega))
  have hx : o < d.N := by simpa [first] using hF 0 (by omega)
  have h3 := d.Hhi s o hx
  push_cast at hδ
  nlinarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.Arena.budget_sub
statement:
lemma budget_sub (s : S) (o n : ℕ) (hn : 0<n) (hb : o+n ≤ d.N)
    (u a δ η : ℝ) (hu : 0 < u) (ha : 0 < a) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hη : δ*exp (2*u/a) ≤ η)
    (hnδ : 1 < (n:ℝ)*δ) :
    ∃ t, d.mov s t ∧
      (d.found t ∨ u ≤ d.A (o+n-1) s - d.A o t) ∧
      d.topc s-d.topc t ≤ a*(d.H o s-d.L (o+n-1) t)+a*η
proof:
:= by
