  let G t := d.found t ∨ u ≤ d.A (o+n-1) s-d.A o t
  have step : ∀ (t) (_h : d.mov s t) i (_hi : i<n), ∃ q, d.mov t q ∧
      ((G q ∧ d.topc t-d.topc q ≤ a*(d.H (o+i) t-d.L (o+i) q)+a*η) ∨
        (d.topc t-d.topc q)+a*δ ≤ a*(d.H (o+i) t-d.L (o+i) q)) := by
    intro t ht i hi
    have hb' : o+i<d.N := by omega
    obtain ⟨q,hq,hA,hQ⟩ := d.budget_index t hb' u a δ η hu ha hδ hη
    refine ⟨q,hq,?_⟩
    have hp := (d.Ls hq hb').trans (d.LH t _ hb')
    have hA' : d.topc t - d.topc q ≤ a*(d.H (o+i) t-d.L (o+i) q)+a*η := by
      nlinarith
    rcases hQ with h|h|h
    · exact Or.inl ⟨Or.inl h,hA'⟩
    · have hl := d.Am q (i:=o) (by omega) hb'
      have hv := d.Am s (i:=o+i) (by omega) (by omega : o+n-1<d.N)
      have hj := d.As ht hb'
      exact Or.inl ⟨Or.inr (by linarith),hA'⟩
    · exact Or.inr h
  have Hstep := d.budget_ascending s G o n 1 (by omega) hn (by simpa)
    a (a*η) δ ha (by linarith)
  simpa only [G,mul_one] using Hstep (by simpa [← add_assoc] using step)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.Arena.budget_macro
statement:
lemma budget_macro (s : S) (o q n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (hq : 0 < q)
    (hb : o+q*n ≤ d.N)
    (u a δ η α ε : ℝ) (hu : 0 < u) (ha : 0 < a) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hη : δ*exp (2*u/a) ≤ η) (hnδ : 1 < (n:ℝ)*δ)
    (ha' : 0 < α) (he : 0 < ε) (hb' : 2*(a/α) ≤ 1)
    (hc : (ε+η)*exp (2*(a/α)*q) ≤ 1) (hqu : 1 < (q:ℝ)*u) :
    ∃ t, d.mov s t ∧
      ((d.found t ∧ d.topc s-d.topc t ≤ α+a*(1+η)) ∨
        (d.topc s-d.topc t)+α*ε ≤ α*(d.H o s-d.L (o+q*n-1) t))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let l := o+q*n-1
  have hpn : 0 < q*n := Nat.mul_pos hq hn
  have hlo : o ≤ l := by unfold l; omega
  have hl : l<d.N := by unfold l; omega
  have hl' := lt_of_le_of_lt hlo hl
  let x t := d.topc s-d.topc t
  let y t := α*(d.H o s-d.L l t)
  let z := α*(η+ε)
  let β := a/α
  let G t := (d.found t ∧ x t ≤ α+a*(1+η)) ∨ x t + α*ε ≤ y t
  have bpos : 0 < β := div_pos ha ha'
  have zpos : 0 < z := mul_pos ha' (add_pos_of_nonneg_of_pos
    (le_trans (by positivity : 0 ≤ δ*exp (2*u/a)) hη) he)
  have hB : β*α = a := div_mul_cancel₀ a ha'.ne'
  change 2*β ≤ 1 at hb'
  change _*exp (2*β*q) ≤ 1 at hc
  have HI (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ q) : ∃ t, d.mov s t ∧
      (G t ∨
        (x t + z ≤ z * exp (2*β*k) ∧ k*u ≤ (1:ℝ) ∧
        ∀ i < o+(q-k)*n, d.A i t ≤ 1 - k*u)) := by
    induction k with
    | zero =>
      refine ⟨s,d.refl _,Or.inr ⟨by simp [x],by simp,?_⟩⟩
      intro i hi; have HH : i<d.N := lt_of_lt_of_le (by simpa using hi) hb
      simpa using d.Ahi s i HH
    | succ k ih =>
      obtain ⟨t,hst,ht|⟨ht,hv,hA⟩⟩ := ih (by omega)
      · exact ⟨t,hst,Or.inl ht⟩
      let b := o+(q-(k+1))*n
      have h1 : b+n=o+(q-k)*n := by
        have H1 : q-k=q-(k+1)+1 := by omega
        unfold b; rw [H1,add_mul]; omega
      have h2 : b+n ≤ o+q*n := by rw [h1]; gcongr; omega
      obtain ⟨t',htt',hg,hw⟩ := d.budget_sub t b n hn (h2.trans hb) u a δ η hu ha hδ hη hnδ
      have hx := d.trans hst htt'
      refine ⟨t',hx,?_⟩
      have hy1 : b+n-1 ≤ l := by dsimp only [l]; omega
      have hb0 : o ≤ b := Nat.le_add_right _ _
      have hy2 : o ≤ b+n-1 := by omega
      have hl2 := lt_of_le_of_lt hy1 hl
      have hl3 : b ≤ b+n-1 := by omega
      have hl4 := lt_of_le_of_lt hl3 hl2
      have hw' : x t' - x t ≤ a*(d.H o s-d.L l t')+a*η := by
        have hA : d.H b t ≤ d.H o s := le_trans (d.Hs hst hl4) (d.H_index s hb0 hl4)
        have hL := d.L_index t' hy1 hl
        unfold x
        nlinarith [hw]
      rcases hg with hh|hh
      · have hE : exp (2*β*k) ≤ exp (2*β*q) := by
          gcongr; omega
        have hv : z*exp (2*β*q) ≤ α := by
          unfold z; nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hc ha'.le]
        have hT : x t ≤ α := by nlinarith
        exact Or.inl (Or.inl ⟨hh,by nlinarith [d.Hhi s o hl',d.Llo t' l hl]⟩)
      by_cases H : x t'+α*ε ≤ y t'
      · exact Or.inl (Or.inr H)
      have hy : y t' ≤ x t'+α*ε := le_of_not_ge H

      have hrec : (x t'+z)*(1-β) ≤ (x t+z) := by
        unfold y at hy
        unfold z
        have Hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hy bpos.le

        simp only [mul_add, ← mul_assoc,hB] at Hh
        have h3 (c : ℝ) : β*(α*c) = a*c := by rw [← mul_assoc,hB]
        nlinarith [h3 (η+ε)]
      have hxp : x t'+z ≥ 0 := by have H := d.pay hx; unfold x; linarith

      have hiter : (x t'+z) ≤ z * exp (2*β*(k+1)) := by
        have hg : 1 ≤ (1-β)*exp (2*β) := by
          have h := Real.add_one_le_exp (2*β)
          nlinarith
        apply le_trans (b:=(z*exp (2*β*k))*exp (2*β))
        · have HH := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hrec.trans ht) (exp_nonneg (2*β))
          exact le_trans (by
            rw [mul_assoc]; exact le_mul_of_one_le_right hxp hg) HH
        · rw [mul_assoc,← exp_add]
          apply le_of_eq; ring_nf
      refine Or.inr ⟨by push_cast; exact hiter,?_,?_⟩
      · have H := hA (b+n-1) (by omega)
        have H1 := d.Alo t' b hl4
        push_cast; linarith
      · intro i hi
        have H := hA (b+n-1) (by omega)
        change i < b at hi
        have H1 := d.Am t' hi.le hl4
        push_cast; linarith
  obtain ⟨t,hst,h|h⟩ := HI q le_rfl
  · exact ⟨t,hst,h⟩
  · exfalso
    linarith [h.2.1]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.Arena.complete_search
statement:
lemma complete_search (s : S) (N q n : ℕ) (hn : 0<n) (hq : 0<q)
    (hN : 0<N) (hb : N*(q*n) ≤ d.N)
    (u a δ η α ε : ℝ) (hu : 0 < u) (ha : 0 < a) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hη : δ*exp (2*u/a) ≤ η) (hnδ : 1 < (n:ℝ)*δ)
    (ha' : 0 < α) (he : 0 < ε) (hb' : 2*(a/α) ≤ 1)
    (hc : (ε+η)*exp (2*(a/α)*q) ≤ 1) (hqu : 1 < (q:ℝ)*u) (ht : 1 < (N:ℝ)*ε) :
    ∃ t, d.mov s t ∧ d.found t ∧ d.topc s-d.topc t ≤ 2*α+a*(1+η)
proof:
:= by
  let m := q*n
  have hm : 0 < m := Nat.mul_pos hq hn
  obtain ⟨t,hst,hd,hH⟩ := d.budget_ascending s d.found 0 N m hm hN
    (by simpa using hb) α (α+a*(1+η)) ε ha' ht (by
    intro t hst i hi
    simp only [zero_add]
    have h1 : i*m+m ≤ d.N := by
      rw [show i*m+m=(i+1)*m by ring]
      exact le_trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_right m hi) hb
    obtain ⟨t',h',hH⟩ :=
      d.budget_macro t (i*m) q n hn hq h1 u a δ η α ε hu ha hδ hη hnδ ha' he hb' hc hqu
    rw [show (i+1)*m=i*m+q*n by dsimp [m]; ring]
    refine ⟨t',h',?_⟩
    rcases hH with h|h
    · left
      have hh : i*m ≤ i*m+m-1 := by omega
      have hk : i*m+m-1 < d.N := by omega
      have ht : d.L (i*m+m-1) t' ≤ d.H (i*m) t := (d.Ls h' hk).trans
        ((d.L_index t hh hk).trans (d.LH _ _ (by omega)))
      exact ⟨h.1,h.2.trans (le_add_of_nonneg_left (mul_nonneg ha'.le (sub_nonneg.mpr ht)))⟩
    · exact Or.inr h)
  refine ⟨t,hst,hd,?_⟩
  have hh : 0<N*m := Nat.mul_pos hN hm
  have hh' : N*m ≤ d.N := hb
  have h1 := d.Hhi s 0 (by omega)
  have h2 := d.Llo t (0+N*m-1) (by omega)
  nlinarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.choose_slow
statement:
private lemma choose_slow {a : ℕ → ℝ} (ha : Monotone a)
    (h0 : ∀ j, 0 ≤ a j) {E : ℝ} (hE : 0 ≤ E) (T N m : ℕ)
    (hN : 0 < N) (hm : m ≤ N) (hT : 3*N ≤ T)
    (hh : ∑ j ∈ Finset.range T, a j ≤ E) :
    ∃ j, j < N ∧ a j ≤ E/N ∧
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range m, (a (j+i)-a j) ≤ m^2*E/(N:ℝ)^2
proof:
:= by
  have hp : 0 < (N:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hN
  let D := E/N
  have hs (l : ℕ) (hl : l ≤ 2*N) : a l ≤ D := by
    have Hlt : ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (l+N), a j ≤ E :=
      le_trans (Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg
        (Finset.range_mono (by omega)) (fun i _ _ => h0 i)) hh
    rw [Finset.sum_range_add] at Hlt
    have H : ∑ _ ∈ Finset.range N, a l ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range N, a (l+i) :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => ha (by omega : l ≤ l+i)
    simp only [Finset.sum_const,Finset.card_range,nsmul_eq_mul] at H
    apply (le_div_iff₀ hp).mpr
    have : 0 ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range l, a j := Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => h0 j
    linarith
  have HD : 0 ≤ D := div_nonneg hE hp.le
  have hr (i : ℕ) (hi : i ≤ m) :
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.range N, (a (j+i)-a j) ≤ m*D := by
    have h1 := Finset.sum_range_add a N i
    have h2 := Finset.sum_range_add a i N
    have hcmp : ∑ j ∈ Finset.range i, a (N+j) ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range i, D := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro j hj
      apply hs; rw [Finset.mem_range] at hj; omega
    simp only [Finset.sum_const,Finset.card_range,nsmul_eq_mul] at hcmp
    have hl : 0 ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range i, a j := Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => h0 j
    have hle : (i:ℝ)*D ≤ (m:ℝ)*D := by gcongr
    rw [show i+N=N+i by omega] at h2
    simp_rw [show ∀ j, j+i=i+j from fun j => add_comm _ _, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    linarith
  let f j := ∑ i ∈ Finset.range m, (a (j+i)-a j)
  have hAvg : ∑ j ∈ Finset.range N, f j ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range N, ((m:ℝ)^2*E/(N:ℝ)^2) := by
    unfold f
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    calc
      _ ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range m, ((m:ℝ)*D) :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum fun i hi => hr i (Finset.mem_range.mp hi).le
      _ = _ := by simp only [Finset.sum_const,Finset.card_range,nsmul_eq_mul,D]; field_simp
  by_contra! hy
  apply (not_lt_of_ge hAvg)
  refine Finset.sum_lt_sum_of_nonempty ⟨0,Finset.mem_range.mpr hN⟩ (fun j hj => ?_)
  have hj := Finset.mem_range.mp hj

  exact hy _ hj (hs _ (by omega))

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.choose3
statement:
private lemma choose3 (P : Law Ω) (a b c : Ω → ℝ)
    (ha : ∀ x, 0 ≤ a x) (hb : ∀ x, 0 ≤ b x) (hc : ∀ x, 0 ≤ c x)
    (A B C : ℝ) (hA : 0 < A) (hB : 0 < B) (hC : 0 < C)
    (h1 : P.Ex a ≤ A) (h2 : P.Ex b ≤ B) (h3 : P.Ex c ≤ C) :
    ∃ x, 0 < P x ∧ a x ≤ 3*A ∧ b x ≤ 3*B ∧ c x ≤ 3*C
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x,hx,hh⟩ := P.exists_le_Ex fun x => a x*A⁻¹+b x*B⁻¹+c x*C⁻¹
  have H : a x/A+b x/B+c x/C ≤ 3 := by
    simp_rw [Ex_add,Ex_mul, ← div_eq_mul_inv] at hh
    linarith [(div_le_one hA).mpr h1,(div_le_one hB).mpr h2,(div_le_one hC).mpr h3]
  have hI := div_nonneg (ha x) hA.le
  have hJ := div_nonneg (hb x) hB.le
  have hK := div_nonneg (hc x) hC.le
  exact ⟨x,hx,(div_le_iff₀ hA).mp (by linarith),(div_le_iff₀ hB).mp
    (by linarith),(div_le_iff₀ hC).mp (by linarith)⟩

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.kl_covered
statement:
lemma kl_covered {ι : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (P : Law Ω) (X : Ω → ι → α) (q : Law α) (h : ∀ i, P.send (fun a => X a i) = q) :
    covered P X q
proof:
:= by
  intro a ha i
  rw [← h i]
  exact P.send_pos (fun a => X a i) ha

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.select_context
statement:
theorem select_context (tag : α → G) (c : G → ℝ) (hc : ∀ x, 0 ≤ c x)
    (T N m : ℕ) (hm0 : 0 < m) (hm : m ≤ N) (hT : 3*N ≤ T)
    (E : ℝ) (hE : 0 < E) [Nonempty α]
    (h : ∀ p : Law α, exp (-E) ≤ heatMoment (Fin T) p tag c) :
    ∃ (p : Law α) (Ψ : Law (WordSample N α G)), exch Ψ ∧
      (∀ i : Fin N, Ψ.send (fun a => a.1 i) = p) ∧
      log (Fintype.card α) - p.entropy ≤ 3*(E/N) ∧
      bill tag c p Ψ Prod.fst Prod.snd ≤ 3*E ∧
      tv (Ψ.send (prefixB Prod.fst m hm)) (iid p m) ≤ 2*m*√E/N
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨P,hp,hx,hu⟩ := noisy_symm tag c E h
  let X : WordSample T α G → Letters T α := Prod.fst
  let L := log (Fintype.card α)
  let a j := L-rateH P X j
  have h0 : 0 < N := by omega
  have h1 (j : ℕ) : 0 ≤ a j := sub_nonneg.mpr (rate_bdd P X j)
  let u := uniform α
  have hcov : covered P X u := kl_covered P X u hu
  have heq : ∑ j ∈ Finset.range T, a j ≤ E := by
    have H := kl_le_bill hcov tag c hc Prod.snd
    dsimp only [a,L]
    rw [sum_deficit]
    exact le_trans (le_trans
      (le_add_of_nonneg_right (P.Ex_nonneg fun x => hc (x.2))) H) hp
  obtain ⟨j,hj,hb,hj'⟩ := choose_slow (a:=a) (fun x y hh =>
    sub_le_sub_left (rate_antitone hx hh) _) h1 hE.le T N m h0 hm hT heq
  let W := prefixB X j (by omega)
  let V := readBlock X j N (by omega)
  let Y := readBlock X j m (by omega)
  let R (w) := P.after W w
  let H := readLetter X j (by omega)
  let ν (w) := (R w).send H
  let Pw := P.send W
  let b (w) := L-(ν w).entropy
  let k (w) := bill tag c u (R w) V Prod.snd
  let d (w) := kl ((R w).send Y) (pack (fun _ : Fin m => ν w))
  have Hb (w : Letters j α) : 0 ≤ b w :=
    sub_nonneg.mpr (entropy_le_log_card _)
  have Hk (w : Letters j α) : 0 ≤ k w := by
    apply bill_nonneg _ tag c hc
    intro a _ _
    rw [uniform_apply]
    positivity
  have hv (w) (i : Fin m) :
      (R w).send (fun x => Y x i) = ν w := conditional_block_marg hx (j:=j) (m:=m) (by omega) w i
  have hv' (w) (i : Fin N) :
      (R w).send (fun x => V x i) = ν w := conditional_block_marg hx (j:=j) (m:=N) (by omega) w i
  have Hd (w : Letters j α) : 0 ≤ d w := kl_nonneg
    (covered_pack (kl_covered _ _ _ (hv w)))
  have Hm' : (0:ℝ) < m := by exact_mod_cast hm0
  have HN : (0:ℝ) < N := by exact_mod_cast h0
  have H1 : Pw.Ex b ≤ E/N := by
    unfold b ν Pw
    rw [Ex_sub,Ex_const]
    exact le_trans (le_of_eq (by
      dsimp only [a]
      rw [rate_lt P X (show j<T by omega),Hcond_after]; rfl)) hb
  have H2 : Pw.Ex k ≤ E := le_trans
    (prefix_bill tag c u P X _ hcov j N (by omega)) hp
  have H3 : Pw.Ex d ≤ (m:ℝ)^2*E/N^2 := by
    unfold Pw d
    have HH := avg_block_kl hx (j:=j) (m:=m) (by omega) (by omega)
    apply le_trans (b:=∑ i ∈ Finset.range m, (rateH P X j - rateH P X (j+i))) HH.le
    apply le_trans (b:=∑ i ∈ Finset.range m, (a (j+i)-a j)) ?_ hj'
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum; intro i _; dsimp only [a]; linarith
  obtain ⟨w,hw,h1,h2,h3⟩ := choose3 Pw b k d Hb Hk Hd (E/N) E ((m:ℝ)^2*E/N^2)
    (by positivity) hE (by positivity) H1 H2 H3
  let Ψ := (R w).send (fun x => (V x,x.2))
  have hmx := conditional_block_exch hx (j:=j) (m:=N) (by omega) w
  refine ⟨ν w,Ψ,hmx,fun i => ?_,h1,?_,?_⟩
  · dsimp only [Ψ]
    rw [send_send]; exact hv' w i
  · dsimp only [Ψ]
    rw [bill_send]
    exact (bill_change (covered_subfamily (covered_after hcov W w hw) (offset j N (by omega)))
      tag c Prod.snd (ν w) (hv' w)).trans h2
  · have hh : Ψ.send (prefixB Prod.fst m hm) = (R w).send Y := by
      unfold Ψ; rw [send_send, show Y = _ from block_cut X j N m (by omega) hm]; rfl
    rw [hh]
    let v := tv ((R w).send Y) (iid (ν w) m)
    have ht : v^2 ≤ 3*((m:ℝ)^2*E/N^2) :=
      (tv_sq_le_kl (covered_pack (kl_covered _ _ _ (hv w)))).trans h3
    have h4 : 3*((m:ℝ)^2*E/N^2) ≤ (2*m*√E/N)^2 := by
      rw [div_pow,mul_pow,mul_pow, sq_sqrt hE.le]
      have H := pow_pos HN 2
      field_simp; nlinarith
    change v ≤ _
    nlinarith [ht.trans h4,sqrt_nonneg E,show 0 ≤ 2*m*√E/N by positivity]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.init_gap
statement:
lemma init_gap (tag : A → G) (hi : Injective tag) (P : Law A) :
    fundG tag (initial P) 1 = P.entropy
proof:
:= by
  rw [G_initial]
  let Q := iid P 1
  have h : Q.send (fun x => x 0) = P := marginalPack (fun _ => P) _
  change Q.H _ = _; rw [← h]
  refine H_partition Q (X:=tot tag) (Y:=fun x => x 0) (fun _ _ => ?_)
  simp only [tot,Fin.sum_univ_one,hi.eq_iff]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.compress_arrays
statement:
lemma compress_arrays (tag : A → G) (hi : Injective tag) (q : Law G)
    (hq : ∀ x, 0 < q x) (c : G → ℝ) (hc : ∀ x, 0 ≤ c x) (hc0 : c 0=0)
    (Q : Law Θ) (χ : Θ → AddChar G ℂ) (hn : ∀ t x, ‖χ t x‖=1)
    (hrq : ∀ g, (↑(exp (-c g)):ℂ)=Q.Cx fun t => χ t g)
    (hlog : ∀ g, -log (q g) = -log (q 0) + c g)
    (F L C : ℝ) (hF : 1 ≤ F) (hL : 0 ≤ L)
    (T N m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (hN : m ≤ N) (hT : 3*N ≤ T) (S : Schedule)
    (l u r : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hl : ∀ i, i < S.size → l i ≤ u i ∧ u i ≤ m ∧ 0 < u i ∧ 0 < r i ∧
      2*r i*l i ≤ N ∧ L ≤ (r i:ℝ)*(u i:ℝ))
    (hp : ∀ i j, i < j → j < S.size → u j ≤ l i ∧ r i ≤ r j)
    (hg : ∀ P : Law A, exp (-F) ≤ heatMoment (Fin T) P tag c)
    (hC : 10*F+2*(-log (q 0))+1 ≤ C)
    (hh : ∀ i, i < S.size → 0 < l i)
    (hs : ∀ i, i < S.size →
      2*m*√F/N*lnS (Fin (u i)) tag ≤ F ∧
      log (Fintype.card (Ticket (r i) (2*r i))) + r i +
        2*(2*m*√F/N)*lnS (Fin (r i*l i)) tag ≤ 6*F) :
    ∃ (a : A) (s : Finset A), s.Nonempty ∧
      log (Fintype.card A)-log (s.card:ℝ) ≤
        8*(3*(F/N)+S.loss*C*C/F)+2 ∧ small_defects tag χ Q L s a (350*F)
proof:
:= by
  have hFp : 0 < F := by linarith
  have hCp : 0 < C := by
    have hh := Real.log_nonpos (q.nonneg 0) (q.le_one 0)
    linarith
  have hNp : (0:ℝ)< N := by
    exact_mod_cast (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le hm hN)
  obtain ⟨p,R,h1,h2,h3,h4,h5⟩ := select_context tag c hc T N m hm hN hT F hFp hg
  let ε := 2*m*√F/N
  let x : Starting tag c N m (3*F) ε := ⟨p,R,h1,h2,h4,hN,h5⟩
  let W := initial p
  have ha (i) (hh : i < S.size) : fundG tag W (u i) ≤ C := by
    have H := x.G_upper hc q hq (-log (q 0)) hlog _ (hl i hh).2.1
    apply H.trans
    unfold ε
    have hj := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (show (0:ℝ)<2 by norm_num)
    linarith [(hs i hh).1]
  have hb (i) (hh : i < S.size) (hle : 1 ≤ l i) : fundI tag W (r i) ≤ C := by
    refine (x.I_upper hc q hq (-log (q 0)) hlog _ ?_).trans ?_
    · have := (hl i hh).2.2.2.2.1
      nlinarith
    linarith

  obtain ⟨P,hv,hW,i,hi',hK⟩ :=
    reach tag hi c hc W C F hCp hFp S m l u r hm (fun i h => ⟨(hl i h).1,(hl i h).2.1⟩)
      hp ha (fun i h => hb i h (hh i h))
  obtain ⟨hi1,hi2,hu',hr',hn',hL'⟩ := hl i hi'
  have HK : fundK tag c P (u i) (r i) ≤ 10*F := by
    have H := x.K_upper hc hc0 (l i) (r i) hr' (le_trans hi1 hi2) hn'
    have HH := K_anti tag c hv (l i) (r i)
    change fundK tag c W _ _ ≤ _ at H
    dsimp only [ε] at H
    linarith [(hs i hi').2]
  let D := 3*(F/N)+S.loss*C*C/F
  have hD : 0 < D := by unfold D; have := S.loss_pos; positivity
  have Hd : log (Fintype.card A) - fundG tag P 1 ≤ D := by
    rw [show fundG tag W 1 = _ from init_gap tag hi p] at hW
    linarith
  obtain ⟨p',z,hz,hz'⟩ := freeze tag hi c hc P (u i) (r i) hu' hr' (10*F) D
    (by positivity) hD HK Hd
  have : NeZero (r i) := ⟨hr'.ne'⟩
  have : NeZero (u i) := ⟨hu'.ne'⟩
  have H0 := alignment tag c Q χ hn hrq p' z (10*F) D L (by linarith) hD hL
    (by simpa only [Fintype.card_prod,Fintype.card_fin,Nat.cast_mul]) hz (by
      simpa only [Fintype.card_prod,Fintype.card_fin,Nat.cast_mul])
  rwa [show 350*F = 35*(10*F) by ring]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.perm_uniform
statement:
private lemma perm_uniform (x : B) :
    (uniform (Equiv.Perm B)).send (fun e => e x) = letI : Nonempty B
proof:
:= ⟨x⟩; uniform B := by
  have : Nonempty B := ⟨x⟩
  let R := uniform (Equiv.Perm B)
  let W := R.send (fun e => e x)
  have he (a b : B) : W a = W b := by
    classical
    let f := Equiv.swap a b
    have hh (e : Equiv.Perm B) : (e x=a) ↔ (f*e) x=b := by
      change _ ↔ f (e x) = _
      rw [← show f a = b from Equiv.swap_apply_left _ _, f.injective.eq_iff]
    unfold W; rw [send_apply,send_apply,prob_eq,prob_eq]
    exact Fintype.sum_equiv (Equiv.mulLeft f) _ _ fun i => by
      change _ = if (f*i) x=b then _ else _
      split_ifs <;> simp_all only
      all_goals first | rfl | exact False.elim (by grind)
  apply Law.ext
  intro a
  have hh (w : B) := he w a
  have H := W.total
  simp_rw [hh, Finset.sum_const,Finset.card_univ,nsmul_eq_mul] at H
  change W a = _
  rw [uniform_apply]
  field_simp
  linarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.count_frac
statement:
private lemma count_frac (s : Finset (Fin n)) (hn : 0 < n) :
    0 ≤ (s.card:ℝ)/n ∧ (s.card:ℝ)/n ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  have hp : (0:ℝ)< n := by exact_mod_cast hn
  constructor
  · positivity
  · apply (div_le_one hp).mpr
    exact_mod_cast (by simpa using Finset.card_le_univ s : s.card ≤ n)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.choose_tickets
statement:
lemma choose_tickets (r n : ℕ) (hr : 0 < r) (hn : 0 < n) (s : Finset (Fin n)) :
    ∃ k : Law (Ticket r n), ∀ (j : Fin r) (f : Fin n → ℝ),
      k.Ex (gain j f) = if r ≤ s.card then (∑ i ∈ s, f i)/n else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hs : r ≤ s.card
  · have he : r ≤ Fintype.card s := by simpa using hs
    have : Nonempty s := Fintype.card_pos_iff.mp (lt_of_lt_of_le hr he)
    let t := (s.card:ℝ)/n
    let g : Fin r ↪ s := (Fin.castLEEmb he).trans (Fintype.equivFin _).symm.toEmbedding
    let T (f : Equiv.Perm s) : Ticket r n :=
      some ((g.trans f.toEmbedding).trans (Embedding.subtype _))
    refine ⟨mixture ((uniform (Equiv.Perm s)).send T) (point none) t
      (count_frac _ hn).1 (count_frac _ hn).2,?_⟩
    intro j f
    rw [ite_eq_left hs, mixture_Ex,Ex_point,Ex_send]
    dsimp only [gain,T]
    let F (x : s) := f x

    change t*(uniform (Equiv.Perm s)).Ex (fun i => F (i (g j))) + _*0 = _
    have h : (uniform (Equiv.Perm s)).Ex (fun i => F (i (g j))) = (uniform s).Ex F := by
      have H := Ex_send (uniform (Equiv.Perm s)) (fun i => i (g j)) F
      rw [perm_uniform] at H
      exact H.symm
    rw [h]
    unfold t Ex F
    have hh : 0 < (s.card:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast lt_of_lt_of_le hr hs
    simp only [uniform_apply,← Finset.mul_sum,mul_zero,add_zero, Fintype.card_coe,
      Finset.univ_eq_attach,Finset.sum_attach]
    field_simp
  · refine ⟨point none,fun j f => ?_⟩
    rw [ite_eq_right hs,Ex_point]; rfl

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.ratio_bounds
statement:
private lemma ratio_bounds (a b : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) :
    0 ≤ ratio a b ∧ ratio a b ≤ 1 ∧ a * ratio a b = min a b
proof:
:= by
  unfold ratio
  obtain hx|hx := eq_or_lt_of_le ha
  · simp [← hx,hb]
  exact ⟨div_nonneg (le_min ha hb) ha, (div_le_one hx).mpr (min_le_left _ _), by field_simp⟩

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.tag_test
statement:
lemma tag_test (p q : Law A) (f : A → ℝ) :
    p.Ex (fun x => (tagChance p q x).Ex (fun b : Bool => if b then f x else 0)) =
      ∑ x, min (p x) (q x) * f x
proof:
:= by
  unfold tagChance
  simp_rw [coinP_Ex]
  simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte,mul_zero,add_zero,Ex,← mul_assoc,
    (ratio_bounds (p _) (q _) (p.nonneg _) (q.nonneg _)).2.2]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.thin_sampler
statement:
lemma thin_sampler (r n : ℕ) (hr : 0 < r) (hn : n=2*r) (P : Law Ω) (q : Law A)
    (X : Ω → Fin n → A) (ε : ℝ)
    (hε : ∀ i, ((P.send fun x => X x i).tv q) ≤ ε) :
    ∃ (k : Ω → Law (Ticket r n)),
      let R
proof:
:= P.withNext k
      R.prob (fun x => x.2 = none) ≤ 2 * ε ∧
      (∀ (j : Fin r) (f : A → ℝ) (_h : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x),
        R.Ex (fun x => gain j (fun i => f (X x.1 i)) x.2) ≤ q.Ex f) := by
  classical
  have hnp : 0 < n := by omega
  have hNr : (0:ℝ) < n := by exact_mod_cast hnp
  choose c hc using choose_tickets r n hr hnp
  let p (i : Fin n) := P.send fun x => X x i
  let Q (x) := pack (fun i : Fin n => tagChance (p i) q (X x i))
  let S (x : Fin n → Bool) := Finset.univ.filter (fun i => x i = true)
  let k (x : Ω) := (Q x).through fun y => c (S y)
  let R := P.withNext k
  have hTag (x) (f : Fin n → ℝ) :
      (Q x).Ex (fun b => ∑ i ∈ S b, f i) =
        ∑ i : Fin n, (tagChance (p i) q (X x i)).Ex (fun b : Bool => if b then f i else 0) := by
    unfold S Q
    simp_rw [Finset.sum_filter,Ex_finset_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    exact Ex_pack_proj _ i (fun b : Bool => if b then f i else 0)
  have hComp (f : A → ℝ) :
      P.Ex (fun x => (Q x).Ex fun b => ∑ i ∈ S b, f (X x i)) =
        ∑ i : Fin n, ∑ a, min (p i a) (q a) * f a := by
    have HH (x : Ω) := hTag x (fun i => f (X x i))
    simp_rw [HH,Ex_finset_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro i _
    rw [← tag_test]
    exact (Ex_send P (fun x => X x i) (fun y =>
      (tagChance (p i) q y).Ex (fun b => if b then f y else 0))).symm
  have hTick (x) (j : Fin r) (f : Fin n → ℝ) :
      (k x).Ex (gain j f) =
        (Q x).Ex (fun b => if r ≤ (S b).card then (∑ i ∈ S b, f i)/n else 0) := by
    unfold k; rw [Ex_through]; simp_rw [hc]
  refine ⟨k,?_,?_⟩
  · let j : Fin r := ⟨0,hr⟩
    let F := fun (_ : Fin n) => (1:ℝ)
    have hg : R.prob (fun x => x.2 = none) =
        1 - P.Ex (fun x => (k x).Ex (gain j F)) := by
      unfold prob
      rw [← Ex_withNext P k (fun x => gain j F x.2)]
      calc
        _ = R.Ex fun x => 1-gain j F x.2 := by
          congr 1; funext x; cases x with
          | mk a b => cases b <;> simp [gain,F]
        _ = _ := by rw [Ex_sub (f:=fun _ => 1),Ex_const]
    have h1 (x : Ω) :
        2/n * (Q x).Ex (fun b => ∑ i ∈ S b, F i)-1 ≤ (k x).Ex (gain j F) := by
      rw [hTick]
      have HH (b : Fin n → Bool) :
          2/(n:ℝ) * (∑ i ∈ S b, F i) - 1 ≤ if r ≤ (S b).card then
            (∑ i ∈ S b, F i)/n else 0 := by
        have ha : (↑n:ℝ) = 2*(r:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hn
        have hb : ((S b).card:ℝ) ≤ n := by exact_mod_cast
          (by simpa using Finset.card_le_univ (S b) : (S b).card ≤ n)
        simp only [F,Finset.sum_const,nsmul_eq_mul,mul_one]
        split_ifs with H
        · field_simp; linarith
        · have : ((S b).card:ℝ) ≤ r := by exact_mod_cast (le_of_not_ge H)
          field_simp; linarith
      refine le_trans (b:=(Q x).Ex (fun b => 2/(n:ℝ)*(∑ i ∈ S b, F i)-1))
        ?_ (Ex_mono _ HH)
      rw [Ex_sub,Ex_lmul,Ex_const]
    have HE := hComp (fun _ => 1)
    have HF : (n:ℝ)*(1-ε) ≤ P.Ex fun x => (Q x).Ex (fun b => ∑ i ∈ S b, F i) := by
      unfold F; rw [HE]
      simp_rw [mul_one,tv_common]
      apply le_trans (b:=∑ i : Fin n,(1-ε)) _ (Finset.sum_le_sum _)
      · simp; apply le_of_eq; ring
      intro i _; exact sub_le_sub_left (hε i) _
    have HL := P.Ex_mono h1
    rw [Ex_sub,Ex_lmul,Ex_const] at HL
    change R.prob _ ≤ _
    rw [hg]
    field_simp at HL

    nlinarith
  · intro j f hf
    change R.Ex _ ≤ _
    unfold R; rw [Ex_withNext]
    have h1 (x : Ω) :
        (k x).Ex (gain j (fun i => f (X x i))) ≤
          (Q x).Ex (fun b => ∑ i ∈ S b, f (X x i)) * (n:ℝ)⁻¹ := by
      rw [hTick, ← Ex_mul]
      apply Ex_mono
      intro b
      split_ifs
      · simp [div_eq_mul_inv]
      · exact mul_nonneg (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => hf _)) (by positivity)
    refine le_trans (Ex_mono P h1) ?_
    rw [Ex_mul,hComp]
    apply le_trans (b := (∑ i : Fin n, q.Ex f) * (n:ℝ)⁻¹)
    · apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ (by positivity)
      refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => Finset.sum_le_sum fun a _ =>
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (min_le_right _ _) (hf _)
    simp only [Finset.sum_const,Finset.card_univ,Fintype.card_fin,nsmul_eq_mul]
    apply le_of_eq; field_simp

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.lnS_bound
statement:
lemma lnS_bound (P : Law Ω) (X : Ω → I → A) (tag : A → G) :
    P.H (fun x => tot tag (X x)) ≤ lnS I tag
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine entropy_le_log_size _ _ fun x hx => ?_
  obtain ⟨a,rfl,ha⟩ := (send_pos_iff _ _ _).mp hx
  exact Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ (Finset.mem_univ _)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.lnS_nonneg
statement:
lemma lnS_nonneg (I : Type) [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I] (tag : A → G) :
    0 ≤ lnS I tag
proof:
:= by
  unfold lnS
  cases (sums I tag).card with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n => exact log_nonneg (by simp)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.kl_le_by_height
statement:
lemma kl_le_by_height (d : ℝ) (hd : 0 < d) (P Q : Law A) (h : ∀ x, d*P x ≤ Q x) :
    P.kl Q ≤ -log d
proof:
:= by
  rw [kl_ex,show -log d = P.Ex _ from (Ex_const P (-log d)).symm]
  refine Ex_mono_mem P ?_
  intro x hx
  have H := Real.log_le_log (mul_pos hd hx) (h x)
  rw [log_mul hd.ne' hx.ne'] at H
  linarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.fill_cost
statement:
lemma fill_cost (tag : A → G) (c : G → ℝ) (hc : c 0=0) (q : Law A)
    (d : ℝ) (hd : 0 < d) (Q : I → Law A) (hq : ∀ i x, d*Q i x ≤ q x) :
    d * bill tag c q (pack Q) (fun x => x) (fun _ => 0) ≤
      Fintype.card I + d * lnS I tag
proof:
:= by
  have hh (i : I) : (Q i).dominated q :=
    fun x hx => lt_of_lt_of_le (mul_pos hd hx) (hq i x)
  have heq : covered (pack Q) (fun x => x) q :=
    fun x hx i => hh i _ ((pack_pos Q x).mp hx i)
  rw [bill_with_entropy heq,send_id,pack_kl hh]
  have Hk : ∑ i, kl (Q i) q ≤ ∑ _i : I, -log d := Finset.sum_le_sum
    (fun i _ => kl_le_by_height d hd (Q i) q (hq i))
  have Hs := lnS_bound (pack Q) (fun x => x) tag
  unfold ans
  simp only [add_zero]
  have Hn := Hcond_nonneg (pack Q) (fun _ => (0:G)) (fun x => x)
  simp_rw [hc,Ex_const]
  have HC := Real.negMulLog_le_one_sub_self hd.le
  unfold negMulLog at HC
  have hsub : d*(-log d) ≤ 1 := by linarith
  calc
    _ ≤ d*((∑ _i : I, -log d)+lnS I tag) := by
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ hd.le
      linarith
    _ ≤ _ := by
      rw [Finset.sum_const,Finset.card_univ,nsmul_eq_mul]
      have H : (0:ℝ)≤ Fintype.card I := by positivity
      nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsub H]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.complete_row
proof:
:= by
  have h : ∑ x, (P x - a x) = δ := by rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib,P.total,ht]; ring
  obtain hz|hz := eq_or_lt_of_le hd
  · refine ⟨P,fun x => ?_⟩
    have HH := Finset.single_le_sum (s:=Finset.univ) (f:=fun x => P x-a x)
      (fun x _ => sub_nonneg.mpr (hp x)) (Finset.mem_univ x)
    rw [← hz,zero_mul]; linarith [hp x]
  · refine ⟨proportional (fun x => P x-a x) (fun x => sub_nonneg.mpr (hp x)) (by rw [h]; exact hz),fun x => ?_⟩
    rw [proportional_apply,h]; field_simp; ring

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.thinned_bill
statement:
theorem thinned_bill (tag : A → G) (c : G → ℝ) (hc : ∀ x, 0 ≤ c x) (hc0 : c 0 = 0)
    (r n : ℕ) (hr : 0 < r) (hn : n=2*r)
    (P : Law Ω) (X : Ω → Letters n A) (U : Ω → G) (q : Law A)
    (hcov : covered P X q) (ε : ℝ) (hε : ∀ i, tv (P.send (fun x => X x i)) q ≤ ε) :
    ∃ Q : Law (WordSample r A G), (∀ i, Q.send (fun a => a.1 i) = q) ∧
      bill tag c q Q Prod.fst Prod.snd ≤ bill tag c q P X U +
        log (Fintype.card (Ticket r n)) + (r + 2*ε*lnS (Fin r) tag)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨k, hδ, h⟩ := thin_sampler r n hr hn P q X ε hε
  let R := P.withNext k
  let W := Ticket r n
  let Z : Ω × W → W := Prod.snd
  let D := R.send Prod.snd
  let δ := D none
  have hd : 0 ≤ δ := D.nonneg _
  have hds : δ ≤ 2*ε := le_trans (le_of_eq (send_apply R Prod.snd none)) hδ
  let X' (p : Ω × W) := X p.1
  let U' (p : Ω × W) := U p.1
  let QA (e : Fin r ↪ Fin n) : Law (WordSample r A G) :=
    (R.after Z (some e)).send (fun x => (keep X' e x,U' x))
  let m (i : Fin r) (a : A) :=
    ∑ e : Fin r ↪ Fin n, D (some e) * ((QA e).send (fun x => x.1 i)) a
  have hmm (i : Fin r) (f : A → ℝ) :
      ∑ e : Fin r ↪ Fin n, D (some e)* (QA e).Ex (fun x => f (x.1 i)) =
        R.Ex (fun x => gain i (fun j => f (X' x j)) x.2) := by
    let V (j : W) (x : Ω × W) := gain i (fun a => f (X' x a)) j
    have H : D.Ex (fun w => (R.after Z w).Ex (V w)) = _ :=
      R.after_Ex_sum Z V
    refine Eq.trans ?_ H
    change _ = ∑ w, D w * (R.after Z w).Ex (V w)
    rw [Fintype.sum_option]
    unfold V gain
    change _ = D none*((R.after Z none).Ex fun _ => 0)+(∑ e : Fin r ↪ Fin n,D (some e)*((R.after Z (some e)).Ex fun a => f (X' a (e i))))
    rw [Ex_const,mul_zero,zero_add]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun e _ => ?_
    dsimp only [QA]
    rw [Ex_send]; rfl
  have Hm0 (i a) : 0 ≤ m i a := Finset.sum_nonneg fun e _ =>
    mul_nonneg (D.nonneg _) ((send _ _).nonneg _)
  have Hmp (i a) : m i a ≤ q a := by
    let f (x : A) : ℝ := if x=a then 1 else 0
    have HH := h i f (by intro x; unfold f; split_ifs <;> norm_num)
    change R.Ex (fun x => gain i (fun j => f (X' x j)) x.2) ≤ _ at HH
    rw [← hmm] at HH
    have H1 (P : Law A) : P.Ex f = P a := by unfold f Ex; simp
    have H2 (e : Fin r ↪ Fin n) :
        (QA e).Ex (fun x => f (x.1 i)) = (QA e).send (fun x => x.1 i) a :=
      (Ex_send (QA e) (fun x => x.1 i) f).symm.trans (H1 _)
    simp_rw [H1,H2] at HH; exact HH
  have ht (i) : ∑ a, m i a = 1-δ := by
    unfold m
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    simp only [← Finset.mul_sum,Law.total,mul_one]
    have HH := D.total
    rw [Fintype.sum_option] at HH
    unfold δ; linarith
  choose R' hR using fun i => complete_row δ hd q (m i) (Hm0 i) (Hmp i) (ht i)
  let Ξ : Law (WordSample r A G) := (pack R').send (fun x => (x,0))
  let T (x : Ticket r n) := match x with
    | none => Ξ
    | some e => QA e
  refine ⟨D.through T,fun i => ?_,?_⟩
  · apply Law.ext; intro a
    let f (x : WordSample r A G) := x.1 i
    have heq : (D.through T).send f = D.through (fun w => (T w).send f) := by
      apply ext_of_Ex; intro g; rw [Ex_send]
      simp_rw [Ex_through,Ex_send]
    change (D.through T).send f a = q a
    rw [heq,through_apply,Ex,Fintype.sum_option]
    have h1 : (T none).send f a = R' i a := by
      change (((pack R').send _).send _) _ = _
      unfold f; rw [send_send]
      exact congrArg (fun P : Law A => P a) (marginalPack _ i)
    rw [h1]
    exact (add_comm _ _).trans (hR i a)
  let C (Q : Law (WordSample r A G)) := bill tag c q Q Prod.fst Prod.snd
  let V (w) := bill tag c q (R.after Z w) X' U'
  have HV : D.Ex V ≤ bill tag c q P X U + log (Fintype.card (Ticket r n)) := by
    have heq : bill tag c q R X' U' = bill tag c q P X U :=
      calc
        _ = bill tag c q (R.send Prod.fst) X U := (bill_send tag c q R X U Prod.fst).symm
        _ = _ := by rw [show R.send Prod.fst = P from send_fst_withNext P k]
    refine (bill_condition tag c q R X' U' Z).trans ?_
    rw [heq]
    exact add_le_add_right (H_card _ _) _
  have hr' : covered R X' q := fun x hx i => hcov _ (by
      have H := R.send_pos Prod.fst hx; rwa [show R.send Prod.fst=P from send_fst_withNext P k] at H) i
  have hb (e : Fin r ↪ Fin n) :
      D (some e)*C (QA e) ≤ D (some e)*V (some e) := by
    obtain hh|hh := eq_or_lt_of_le (D.nonneg (some e))
    · rw [← hh,zero_mul,zero_mul]
    · apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ hh.le
      unfold C QA
      rw [bill_send]
      exact bill_subfamily tag c q (R.after Z _) X' U' (covered_after hr' Z _ hh) _ e.injective
  have hxy : δ*C Ξ ≤ r + 2*ε*lnS (Fin r) tag + δ*V none := by
    obtain he|he := eq_or_lt_of_le hd
    · rw [← he,zero_mul,zero_mul]
      have := lnS_nonneg (Fin r) tag
      have : 0 ≤ ε := by linarith
      positivity
    unfold C Ξ
    rw [bill_send]
    have hF := fill_cost tag c hc0 q δ he R' (fun i x => by linarith [hR i x,Hm0 i x])
    rw [Fintype.card_fin] at hF
    have hV : 0 ≤ V none := bill_nonneg (covered_after hr' Z _ he) _ _ hc _
    refine hF.trans ?_
    nlinarith [lnS_nonneg (Fin r) tag]
  refine (bill_through_le tag c q D Prod.fst Prod.snd T).trans ?_
  change D.Ex (fun w => C (T w)) ≤ _ + _
  calc
    _ ≤ D.Ex V + (r+2*ε*lnS (Fin r) tag) := by
      unfold Ex
      rw [Fintype.sum_option,Fintype.sum_option]
      dsimp only [T]
      have HH := Finset.sum_le_sum (s:=Finset.univ) (fun e _ => hb e)
      unfold δ at hxy
      linarith
    _ ≤ _ := add_le_add_left HV _

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.Emp_cont
statement: lemma Emp_cont : Continuous (fun P : Law (Sample ι α G) => Emp P)
proof:
:=
  continuous_pi fun y => continuous_finsetSum _ fun _ _ => continuous_send_pdf _ y

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.Emp_mixture
statement:
lemma Emp_mixture (P Q : Law (Sample ι α G)) (t : ℝ) (h0 : 0 ≤ t) (h1 : t ≤ 1) :
    Emp (mixture P Q t h0 h1) = t • Emp P + (1-t) • Emp Q
proof:
:= by
  classical
  funext x
  simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply,smul_eq_mul,Emp,send_apply,prob,mixture_Ex,Finset.sum_add_distrib,← Finset.mul_sum]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.trial_bill_uniform
statement:
lemma trial_bill_uniform (tag : α → G) (c : G → ℝ)
    (p : Law (ι → α)) (z : G) :
    bill tag c (uniform α) (p.send (fun x => (x,z-tot tag x))) Prod.fst Prod.snd =
      Fintype.card ι * log (Fintype.card α) - p.entropy +
      p.Ex fun x => c (z-tot tag x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [bill_send]
  unfold bill
  have HH : ans tag (fun x : ι → α => x) (fun x => z - tot tag x) =
      (fun _ => z) := funext (fun x => by
        change tot tag x + (z-tot tag x) = z
        rw [add_comm,sub_add_cancel])
  change _ - Hcond p (fun x => x) (ans tag (fun x => x) (fun x => z - tot tag x)) + _ = _
  rw [HH,Hcond_constant,H_self]
  simp only [uniform_apply, log_inv, neg_neg,Ex_const,Finset.sum_const,Finset.card_univ,nsmul_eq_mul]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.exp_norm
statement: lemma exp_norm (a : α → ℝ) : 0 < ∑ x, exp (a x)
proof:
:=
  Finset.sum_pos (fun _ _ => exp_pos _) Finset.univ_nonempty

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.trial_cost_with_potential
statement:
lemma trial_cost_with_potential (tag : α → G) (c : G → ℝ)
    (E : ℝ) (h : ∀ p : Law α, exp (-E) ≤ heatMoment ι p tag c)
    (a : α → ℝ) :
    ∃ P : Law (Sample ι α G),
      bill tag c (uniform α) P Prod.fst Prod.snd +
        ∑ i : ι, (P.Ex (fun x => a (x.1 i))-(uniform α).Ex a) ≤ E
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let s : ℝ := ∑ x, exp (-a x)
  have hs : 0 < s := exp_norm _
  let p : Law α := proportional (fun x => exp (-a x)) (fun _ => exp_nonneg _) hs
  have hpos (x : α) : 0 < p x := div_pos (exp_pos _) hs
  let Q := pack fun _ : ι => p
  obtain ⟨y,_,hy⟩ := Q.exists_Ex_le fun y => Q.Ex fun x => exp (-c (tot tag y - tot tag x))
  let z := tot tag y
  let W (x) := Q x * exp (-c (z - tot tag x))
  have hpW (x) : 0 < W x := mul_pos ((pack_pos _ _).mpr fun _ => hpos _) (exp_pos _)
  let D := ∑ x, W x
  have hD : exp (-E) ≤ D := le_trans (h p) hy
  have hD' : 0 < D := (exp_pos _).trans_le hD
  let R := proportional W (fun x => (hpW x).le) hD'
  let n := (Fintype.card ι : ℝ)
  have hlogp (x : α) : log (p x) = -a x - log s := by
    dsimp only [p,s]
    rw [proportional_apply,log_div (exp_pos _).ne' hs.ne', log_exp]
  have hlogQ (x) : log (Q x) = ∑ i : ι, (-a (x i) - log s) := by
    dsimp only [Q]; rw [pack_apply,Real.log_prod (fun j _ => (hpos _).ne')]
    simp_rw [hlogp]
  have hlogR (x) :
      -log (R x) = (∑ i, a (x i)) + n*log s + c (z - tot tag x) + log D := by
    change -log (W x/D) = _
    rw [log_div (hpW x).ne' hD'.ne']
    unfold W; rw [log_mul ((pack_pos _ _).mpr fun _ => hpos _).ne'
      (exp_pos _).ne',hlogQ,log_exp, Finset.sum_sub_distrib,Finset.sum_const,Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
    unfold n; rw [Finset.card_univ,nsmul_eq_mul]; ring
  have hR : R.entropy =
      (∑ i, R.Ex (fun x => a (x i))) + n*log s + R.Ex (fun x => c (z-tot tag x)) + log D := by
    unfold entropy crossE; simp_rw [hlogR,Ex_add,Ex_finset_sum,Ex_const]
  refine ⟨R.send (fun x => (x,z-tot tag x)),?_⟩
  rw [trial_bill_uniform]
  simp_rw [Ex_send,Finset.sum_sub_distrib,Finset.sum_const,Finset.card_univ,nsmul_eq_mul]
  have hce := Law.entropy_le_cross_aux (uniform α) p p.nonneg p.total.le (fun x _ => hpos _)
  rw [Law.entropy_uniform, crossE] at hce
  have Hpl (x : α) : -log (p x) = a x + log s := by rw [hlogp]; ring
  simp_rw [Hpl,Ex_add,Ex_const] at hce
  have HH : -E ≤ log D := by
    rw [← Real.exp_le_exp]; simpa only [Real.exp_log hD'] using hD
  change n*_ - _ + _ + (_ - n*_) ≤ E
  rw [hR]
  have Hn : 0 ≤ n := by dsimp [n]; positivity
  nlinarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.Emp_linear
statement:
private lemma Emp_linear (P : Law (Sample ι α G))
    (L : (α → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) :
    L (Emp P - fun x => Fintype.card ι * uniform α x) =
      ∑ i : ι, (P.Ex (fun x => L (point (x.1 i) : α → ℝ)) -
        (uniform α).Ex (fun a => L (point a : α → ℝ)))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hh (Q : Law α) : L (fun a => Q a) = Q.Ex (fun a => L (point a : α → ℝ)) := by
    have hEq : (fun a => Q a) = ∑ i : α, Q i • (fun a => point i a) := by
      funext a
      simp only [Finset.sum_apply,Pi.smul_apply,smul_eq_mul,point_apply]
      simp
    nth_rw 1 [hEq]
    simp only [map_sum, map_smul, Ex]
    rfl
  have he : Emp P = ∑ i : ι, (fun y => P.send (fun x => x.1 i) y) := by
    funext; simp only [Finset.sum_apply, Emp]
  rw [map_sub,he,map_sum,show (fun x => Fintype.card ι * uniform α x) =
    (Fintype.card ι : ℝ) • (fun x => uniform α x) from rfl,map_smul]
  rw [hh (uniform α),Finset.sum_sub_distrib,Finset.sum_const,Finset.card_univ,nsmul_eq_mul,smul_eq_mul]
  congr 1
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  rw [hh, Ex_send]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.noisy_avg
statement:
theorem noisy_avg (tag : α → G) (c : G → ℝ) (E : ℝ)
    (h : ∀ p : Law α, exp (-E) ≤ heatMoment ι p tag c) :
    ∃ P : Law (Sample ι α G),
      bill tag c (uniform α) P Prod.fst Prod.snd ≤ E ∧
      Emp P = fun x => Fintype.card ι * uniform α x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let g (P : Law (Sample ι α G)) := Emp P - fun x => Fintype.card ι * uniform α x
  have hh : ∃ P, bill tag c (uniform α) P Prod.fst Prod.snd ≤ E ∧ g P = 0 := by
    refine Law.primal_feasible _ (bill_cont _ _ _ _ _) g (Emp_cont.sub continuous_const)
      (fun _ _ _ _ _ => bill_mixture_le _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _) ?_ ?_ E ?_
    · intro P Q t h0 h1
      unfold g; rw [Emp_mixture]
      module
    · let P : Law (ι → α) := pack (fun _ => uniform α)
      refine ⟨P.send (fun x => (x,(0:G))), ?_⟩
      unfold g
      rw [sub_eq_zero]
      ext1 x
      simp_rw [Emp,send_send]

      simp only [P,marginalPack, Finset.sum_const,Finset.card_univ,nsmul_eq_mul]
    intro L
    obtain ⟨P,hP⟩ := trial_cost_with_potential tag c E h
      (fun x => L (point x : α → ℝ))
    exact ⟨P,by unfold g; rw [Emp_linear]; exact hP⟩
  obtain ⟨P,h1,h2⟩ := hh
  exact ⟨P,h1,sub_eq_zero.mp h2⟩

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.same_marginal
statement:
lemma same_marginal {P : Law (Sample ι α G)} (hx : exch P) (i j : ι) :
    P.send (fun a => a.1 i) = P.send (fun a => a.1 j)
proof:
:= by
  let e := Equiv.swap i j
  have H := congrArg (fun r : Law (Sample ι α G) => send r (fun a => a.1 i)) (hx e)
  rw [send_send] at H
  simpa [appPerm,e] using H.symm

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.Emp_perm
statement:
lemma Emp_perm (P : Law (Sample ι α G)) (e : Equiv.Perm ι) :
    Emp (P.send (appPerm e)) = Emp P
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  unfold Emp
  simp_rw [send_send]
  exact Fintype.sum_equiv e _ (fun i : ι => P.send (fun a => a.1 i) x) (fun i => rfl)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Compress.noisy_symm
statement:
theorem noisy_symm (tag : α → G) (c : G → ℝ) (E : ℝ)
    (h : ∀ p : Law α, exp (-E) ≤ heatMoment ι p tag c) :
    ∃ P : Law (Sample ι α G),
      bill tag c (uniform α) P Prod.fst Prod.snd ≤ E ∧ exch P ∧
      ∀ i : ι, P.send (fun x => x.1 i) = uniform α
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨P,hp,hp'⟩ := noisy_avg tag c E h
  let V := uniform (Equiv.Perm ι)
  let q (e : Equiv.Perm ι) := P.send (appPerm e)
  let R := V.through q
  have hx : exch R := by
    intro e
    apply ext_of_Ex; intro f
    rw [Ex_send]
    dsimp only [R,q]
    simp_rw [Ex_through,Ex_send]
    let g (d : Equiv.Perm ι) := P.Ex fun x => f (appPerm d x)
    change V.Ex (fun d => P.Ex (fun x => f (appPerm e (appPerm d x)))) = V.Ex g
    have heq (d : Equiv.Perm ι) : P.Ex (fun x => f (appPerm e (appPerm d x))) = g (d*e) := rfl
    simp_rw [heq,Ex]
    exact Fintype.sum_equiv (Equiv.mulRight e) _ _ (fun d => rfl)
  refine ⟨R,?_ ,hx,?_⟩
  · have hq (e : Equiv.Perm ι) :
        bill tag c (uniform α) (q e) Prod.fst Prod.snd ≤ E := by
      dsimp only [q]
      rw [bill_send]
      have HH := bill_subfamily tag c (uniform α) P Prod.fst Prod.snd (fun x _ i => by
        rw [uniform_apply]; positivity) e e.injective
      exact HH.trans hp
    exact le_trans (bill_through_le tag c _ _ _ _ _) ((V.Ex_mono hq).trans (V.Ex_const _).le)
  intro i; have : Nonempty ι := ⟨i⟩
  apply Law.ext; intro x
  have H (e) : Emp (q e) x = Fintype.card ι * (uniform α x) := by dsimp only [q]; rw [Emp_perm, hp']
  have H2 : Emp R x = V.Ex fun e => Emp (q e) x := by
    unfold Emp R
    simp_rw [send_apply,prob,Ex_through,Ex_finset_sum]
  have H3 : Emp R x = (Fintype.card ι : ℝ) * R.send (fun a => a.1 i) x := by
    calc
      _ = ∑ j : ι, R.send (fun a => a.1 i) x :=
        Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => by rw [same_marginal hx j i]
      _ = _ := by simp
  simp_rw [H, V.Ex_const] at H2
  exact mul_left_cancel₀ (by positivity : (Fintype.card ι : ℝ) ≠ 0) (H3.symm.trans H2)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.rad_abs
statement: lemma rad_abs (x : Grid M) : rad x = |(liftInt x:ℝ)|
proof:
:= by
  unfold liftInt rad
  split_ifs with h
  · rw [min_eq_left h, Int.cast_natCast,abs_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
  · rw [min_eq_right (by omega),Int.cast_neg, abs_neg,Int.cast_natCast,abs_of_nonneg (by positivity)]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.liftInt_cast
statement: lemma liftInt_cast (x : Grid M) : (liftInt x:Grid M) = x
proof: := by unfold liftInt; split_ifs <;> simp

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.rad_even
statement: lemma rad_even (x : Grid M) : rad (-x) = rad x
proof: := by simp [rad,min_comm]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.diam_even
statement: lemma diam_even (x : Grid M) : diam (-x) = diam x
proof: := by rw [diam,diam,rad_even]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.rad_nonneg
statement: lemma rad_nonneg (x : Grid M) : 0 ≤ rad x
proof: := by rw [rad_abs]; positivity

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.diam_nonneg
statement: lemma diam_nonneg (x : Grid M) : 0 ≤ diam x
proof: := mul_nonneg (side_pos _).le (rad_nonneg _)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.pos_nonneg
statement: lemma pos_nonneg (x : Grid M) : 0 ≤ pos x
proof: := mul_nonneg (by positivity) (side_pos _).le

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.pos_lt
statement: lemma pos_lt (x : Grid M) : pos x < 1
proof: := (atom_sub x (pos_mem x)).2

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.pos_neg
statement: lemma pos_neg {x : Grid M} (hx : x≠0) : pos (-x) = 1-pos x
proof:
:= by
  have : NeZero x := ⟨hx⟩
  simp_rw [pos, ZMod.val_neg_of_ne_zero, Nat.cast_sub (ZMod.val_lt _).le, sub_mul,side_pow_two]
  push_cast
  rw [mul_inv_cancel₀ (by positivity)]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.diam_min
statement: lemma diam_min (x : Grid M) : diam x = min (pos x) (pos (-x))
proof:
:= by
  unfold diam rad pos
  rw [Nat.cast_min, mul_comm, min_mul_of_nonneg _ _ (side_pos _).le]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.diam_le_half
statement: lemma diam_le_half (x : Grid M) : diam x ≤ 1/2
proof:
:= by
  rw [diam_min]
  by_cases hx : x=0
  · subst x; simp [pos]
  · rw [pos_neg hx, min_le_iff]
    by_cases H : pos x ≤ 1/2
    · exact Or.inl H
    · exact Or.inr (by linarith)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.rad_le_val
statement: lemma rad_le_val (x : Grid M) : rad x ≤ ↑x.val
proof: := by simp [rad]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.rad_le_nat
statement: lemma rad_le_nat (k : ℕ) : rad (k:Grid M) ≤ ↑k
proof:
:= by
  refine (rad_le_val _).trans ?_
  rw [ZMod.val_natCast]; exact_mod_cast (Nat.mod_le k (2^M))

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.rad_le_int
statement: lemma rad_le_int (k : ℤ) : rad (k:Grid M) ≤ |(k:ℝ)|
proof:
:= by
  cases k with
  | ofNat k => simpa using rad_le_nat (M:=M) k
  | negSucc k =>
    rw [show ((Int.negSucc k:ℤ):Grid M) = -((k+1:ℕ):Grid M) by simp, rad_even]
    convert rad_le_nat (M:=M) (k+1) using 1
    push_cast
    rw [abs_of_nonpos (by have H := Nat.cast_nonneg (α:=ℝ) k; linarith)]; ring

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.rad_add
statement: lemma rad_add (x y : Grid M) : rad (x+y) ≤ rad x+rad y
proof:
:= by
  have H := rad_le_int (M:=M) (liftInt x + liftInt y)
  rw [Int.cast_add,liftInt_cast,liftInt_cast,Int.cast_add] at H
  rw [rad_abs x,rad_abs y]
  exact H.trans (abs_add_le _ _)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.diam_add
statement: lemma diam_add (x y : Grid M) : diam (x+y) ≤ diam x+diam y
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [diam]; rw [← mul_add]
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (rad_add _ _) (side_pos _).le

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.pos_sub_val
statement: lemma pos_sub_val {x y : Grid M} (h : y.val ≤ x.val) : pos (x-y) = pos x-pos y
proof:
:= by
  simp [pos,ZMod.val_sub h,Nat.cast_sub h,sub_mul]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.diam_le_diff
statement: lemma diam_le_diff (x y : Grid M) : diam (x-y) ≤ |pos x-pos y|
proof:
:= by
  rcases le_total y.val x.val with h|h
  · exact le_trans (show diam (x-y) ≤ pos (x-y) by rw [diam_min]; exact min_le_left _ _)
      (by rw [pos_sub_val h]; exact le_abs_self _)
  rw [diam_min,neg_sub]
  exact (min_le_right _ _).trans (by rw [pos_sub_val h,abs_sub_comm]; exact le_abs_self _)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.phase_distance
statement:
lemma phase_distance (s x y : Grid M) :
    ‖chi s x-chi s y‖ ≤ rad s * (8 * |pos x-pos y|)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ = ‖phase (liftInt s :ℝ) (pos x) - phase (liftInt s:ℝ) (pos y)‖ := by
      rw [← chi_cast,← chi_cast,liftInt_cast]
    _ ≤ _ := (norm_phase_sub _ _ _).trans (by rw [rad_abs s]; gcongr; linarith [pi_le_four])

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.mem_first
statement: lemma mem_first (m : ℕ) (x : Grid M) : x ∈ first M m ↔ x.val < m
proof: := by simp [first]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.first_eq_range
statement:
lemma first_eq_range (m : ℕ) (h : m ≤ 2^M) :
    first M m = (Finset.range m).image (fun k : ℕ => (k:Grid M))
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  rw [mem_first,Finset.mem_image]
  constructor
  · intro hi; exact ⟨x.val,Finset.mem_range.mpr hi, ZMod.natCast_zmod_val _⟩
  · rintro ⟨k,hk,rfl⟩; rw [ZMod.val_natCast_of_lt ((Finset.mem_range.mp hk).trans_le h)]
    exact Finset.mem_range.mp hk

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.range_inj
statement:
lemma range_inj {m : ℕ} (h : m ≤ 2^M) :
    Set.InjOn (fun k : ℕ => (k:Grid M)) (Finset.range m)
proof:
:= by
  intro i hi j hj HH
  have he := congrArg ZMod.val HH
  rwa [ZMod.val_natCast_of_lt ((Finset.mem_range.mp hi).trans_le h),
    ZMod.val_natCast_of_lt ((Finset.mem_range.mp hj).trans_le h)] at he

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.first_card
statement: lemma first_card (m : ℕ) (h : m ≤ 2^M) : (first M m).card = m
proof:
:= by
  rw [first_eq_range m h,Finset.card_image_of_injOn (range_inj h), Finset.card_range]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.first_card_le
statement: lemma first_card_le (m : ℕ) : (first M m).card ≤ m
proof:
:= by
  rcases le_total m (2^M) with h | h
  · exact (first_card _ h).le
  · refine le_trans (Finset.card_le_univ _) ?_
    simpa [Grid] using h

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.sum_first
statement:
lemma sum_first {E : Type*} [AddCommMonoid E] (m : ℕ) (h : m ≤ 2^M) (f : ℕ → E) :
    ∑ x ∈ first M m, f x.val = ∑ k ∈ Finset.range m, f k
proof:
:= by
  rw [first_eq_range _ h, Finset.sum_image]
  · exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i hi => by
      rw [ZMod.val_natCast_of_lt ((Finset.mem_range.mp hi).trans_le h)]
  intro i hi j hj h'
  exact range_inj h hi hj h'

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.first_max
statement: lemma first_max : first M (2^M) = Finset.univ
proof:
:= by
  ext x; simp [first,ZMod.val_lt]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.sum_grid
statement:
lemma sum_grid {E : Type*} [AddCommMonoid E] (f : ℕ → E) :
    ∑ x : Grid M, f x.val = ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (2^M), f k
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sum_first _ le_rfl, first_max]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.mem_arc
statement: lemma mem_arc (r : ℝ) (x : Grid M) : x ∈ arc M r ↔ rad x ≤ r
proof: := by simp [arc]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.arc_card_hi
statement:
lemma arc_card_hi (M : ℕ) (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 ≤ r) :
    ((arc M r).card :ℝ) ≤ 2*(r+1)
proof:
:= by
  let m := Nat.floor r +1
  have hin :
      arc M r ⊆ first M m ∪ (first M m).image Neg.neg := by
    intro x hx
    rw [mem_arc, rad, Nat.cast_min,min_le_iff] at hx
    rw [Finset.mem_union,Finset.mem_image,mem_first]
    rcases hx with H | H
    · exact Or.inl (Nat.lt_succ_of_le ((Nat.le_floor_iff hr).mpr H))
    exact Or.inr ⟨-x, (mem_first _ _).mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_le ((Nat.le_floor_iff hr).mpr H)),neg_neg _⟩
  have h1 := (Finset.card_le_card hin).trans (Finset.card_union_le _ _)
  have h2 := Finset.card_image_le (s:=first M m) (f:=Neg.neg)
  have he : (arc M r).card ≤ 2*m := by have := first_card_le (M:=M) m; omega
  calc
    _ ≤ ((2*m:ℕ):ℝ) := Nat.cast_le.mpr he
    _ ≤ _ := by unfold m; push_cast; have H := Nat.floor_le hr; linarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.arc_card_lo
statement:
lemma arc_card_lo (M : ℕ) (r : ℝ) (_hr : 0 ≤ r) (h : r ≤ 2^M) :
    r ≤ ((arc M r).card:ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  let m := Nat.ceil r
  have hm : m ≤ 2^M := Nat.ceil_le.mpr (by exact_mod_cast h)
  have hh : first M m ⊆ arc M r := by
    intro x hx
    rw [mem_first] at hx; rw [mem_arc]
    exact (rad_le_val x).trans ((Nat.lt_ceil.mp hx).le)
  calc
    _ ≤ (m:ℝ) := Nat.le_ceil _
    _ ≤ _ := Nat.cast_le.mpr (by rw [← first_card m hm]; exact Finset.card_le_card hh)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.side_card
statement: lemma side_card (M : ℕ) : side M * (2:ℝ)^M = 1
proof: := by rw [side_pow_two]; field_simp

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.arc_length
statement:
lemma arc_length (M : ℕ) (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 ≤ r) :
    (uniform (Grid M)).prob (fun x => diam x ≤ r) ≤ 2*(r+side M)
proof:
:= by
  rw [prob_eq]
  have Heq :
      (∑ x : Grid M, if diam x ≤ r then uniform (Grid M) x else 0) =
        (arc M (r / side M)).card* side M := by
    have he : arc M (r / side M) = Finset.univ.filter fun x : Grid M => diam x ≤ r := by
      ext x
      simp [diam,arc,le_div_iff₀ (side_pos M),mul_comm]
    rw [← Finset.sum_filter,← he]
    simp [uniform_side]
  rw [Heq]
  calc
    _ ≤ (2*(r / side M +1))*side M := by
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (arc_card_hi M _ (div_nonneg hr (side_pos _).le)) (side_pos _).le
    _ = _ := by field_simp [(side_pos _).ne']

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.card_side
statement: lemma card_side (M : ℕ) : side M = (Fintype.card (Grid M):ℝ)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  unfold Grid
  rw [ZMod.card]
  simp [side]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.uniform_side
statement: lemma uniform_side (x : Grid M) : uniform (Grid M) x = side M
proof:
:=
  (uniform_apply x).trans (card_side M).symm

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.side_pow_two
statement: lemma side_pow_two (M : ℕ) : side M = ((2:ℝ)^M)⁻¹
proof: := by simp [side]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.expU_ex
statement: lemma expU_ex (f : Grid M → ℝ) : expU f = (uniform _).Ex f
proof:
:= by
  unfold expU Ex
  simp_rw [uniform_side,← Finset.mul_sum]; rfl

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.expU_cx
statement: lemma expU_cx (f : Grid M → ℂ) : expU f = (uniform _).Cx f
proof:
:= by
  unfold expU Cx
  simp_rw [uniform_side,← Finset.mul_sum]
  rw [Complex.real_smul]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.expU_prod
statement:
lemma expU_prod {E : Type*} [AddCommMonoid E] [DistribMulAction ℝ E]
    (f : Grid M → Grid M → E) :
    expU (fun y => expU (f y)) = expU fun x => expU fun y => f y x
proof:
:= by
  unfold expU
  simp_rw [← Finset.smul_sum]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.expU_sum
statement:
lemma expU_sum {E : Type*} [AddCommMonoid E] [DistribMulAction ℝ E]
    {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → Grid M → E) :
    expU (fun y => ∑ i ∈ s, f i y) = ∑ i ∈ s, expU (f i)
proof:
:= by
  unfold expU; rw [Finset.sum_comm, Finset.smul_sum]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.expU_add
statement:
lemma expU_add {E : Type*} [AddCommMonoid E] [DistribMulAction ℝ E]
    (f g : Grid M → E) :
    expU (fun x => f x+g x) = expU f+expU g
proof:
:= by
  unfold expU; rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, smul_add]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.expU_translate
statement:
lemma expU_translate {E : Type*} [AddCommMonoid E] [SMul ℝ E]
    (f : Grid M → E) (a : Grid M) :
    expU (fun x => f (a+x)) = expU f
proof:
:= by
  unfold expU
  congr 1
  exact Fintype.sum_equiv (Equiv.addLeft a) _ _ (fun _ => rfl)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.expU_reflect
statement:
lemma expU_reflect {E : Type*} [AddCommMonoid E] [SMul ℝ E]
    (f : Grid M → E) :
    expU (fun x => f (-x)) = expU f
proof:
:= by
  unfold expU; congr 1
  exact Fintype.sum_equiv (Equiv.neg _) _ _ (fun _ => rfl)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.expU_lmul
statement:
lemma expU_lmul (a : ℂ) (f : Grid M → ℂ) :
    expU (fun x => a*f x) = a*expU f
proof: := by rw [expU_cx, expU_cx, Cx_lmul]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.expU_real
statement:
lemma expU_real (f : Grid M → ℝ) :
    expU (fun x => (f x:ℂ)) = (expU f:ℝ)
proof: := by rw [expU_cx, expU_ex, Cx_ofReal]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.phaseChar_apply
statement: @[simp] lemma phaseChar_apply (u x : Grid M) : phaseChar u x = chi u x
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.chi_comm
statement: lemma chi_comm (x y : Grid M) : chi x y = chi y x
proof:
:= by
  unfold chi; rw [mul_comm]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.chi_zero_right
statement: lemma chi_zero_right (u : Grid M) : chi u 0 = 1
proof: := (phaseChar u).map_zero_eq_one

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.chi_zero_left
statement: lemma chi_zero_left (u : Grid M) : chi 0 u = 1
proof: := by rw [chi_comm,chi_zero_right]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.chi_add
statement: lemma chi_add (u x y : Grid M) : chi u (x+y) = chi u x * chi u y
proof:
:=
  (phaseChar u).map_add_eq_mul _ _

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.chi_add'
statement: lemma chi_add' (x y u : Grid M) : chi (x+y) u = chi x u * chi y u
proof:
:= by
  rw [chi_comm _ u,chi_add,chi_comm u x,chi_comm u y]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.chi_neg
statement: lemma chi_neg (u x : Grid M) : chi u (-x) = conj (chi u x)
proof:
:= by
  have H1 : chi u x * chi u (-x) = 1 := by rw [← chi_add, add_neg_cancel, chi_zero_right]
  have H2 := Complex.mul_conj (chi u x)
  rw [← Complex.sq_norm,norm_chi] at H2
  simp only [one_pow,Complex.ofReal_one] at H2
  exact mul_left_cancel₀ (by rintro H; rw [H] at H1; simp at H1) (H1.trans H2.symm)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.chi_neg'
statement: lemma chi_neg' (x u : Grid M) : chi (-x) u = conj (chi x u)
proof: := by rw [chi_comm,chi_neg,chi_comm u x]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.chi_sub
statement: lemma chi_sub (u x y : Grid M) : chi u (x-y) = chi u x * conj (chi u y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg,chi_add,chi_neg]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.chi_nsmul
statement: lemma chi_nsmul (u x : Grid M) (n : ℕ) : chi (n • u) x = (chi u x)^n
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [chi_zero_left]
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [add_smul,one_smul,chi_add',ih,pow_succ]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.expU_chi
statement:
lemma expU_chi (u : Grid M) :
    expU (chi u) = if u=0 then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases H : u=0
  · subst u
    rw [expU_cx, funext chi_zero_left]
    norm_num [Cx,← Complex.ofReal_sum, uniform_apply, ZMod.card,Grid]
  · rw [ite_eq_right H]
    unfold expU chi
    rw [show ∑ x : Grid M, ZMod.stdAddChar (u*x) = 0 from
      AddChar.sum_eq_zero_of_ne_one (ZMod.isPrimitive_stdAddChar _ H), smul_zero]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.fc_lmul
statement:
lemma fc_lmul (f : Grid M → ℂ) (a : ℂ) (u : Grid M) :
    fc (fun x => a*f x) u = a*fc f u
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [fc,mul_assoc]
  exact expU_lmul _ _

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.fc_add
statement:
lemma fc_add (f g : Grid M → ℂ) (u : Grid M) :
    fc (fun x => f x+g x) u = fc f u+fc g u
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [fc,add_mul]
  exact expU_add _ _

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.fc_sum
statement:
lemma fc_sum {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → Grid M → ℂ) (u : Grid M) :
    fc (fun x => ∑ i ∈ s, f i x) u = ∑ i ∈ s, fc (f i) u
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [fc,Finset.sum_mul]
  exact expU_sum _ _

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.fc_chi
statement: lemma fc_chi (u v : Grid M) : fc (chi v) u = if v=u then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [fc,← chi_add', ← sub_eq_add_neg, expU_chi, sub_eq_zero]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.expU_coeff
statement:
lemma expU_coeff (f : Grid M → ℂ) (u : Grid M) :
    expU (fun x => f x*chi u x) = fc f (-u)
proof: := by rw [fc]; simp

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.fc_neg_even
statement:
lemma fc_neg_even (f : Grid M → ℂ) (h : f.Even) (u : Grid M) :
    fc f (-u) = fc f u
proof:
:= by
  unfold fc
  rw [← expU_reflect (fun x => f x*chi (-u) x)]
  simp_rw [neg_neg, h _, chi_neg',chi_neg, RingHomCompTriple.comp_apply]
  rfl

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.fc_neg_real
statement:
lemma fc_neg_real (f : Grid M → ℝ) (u : Grid M) :
    fc (fun x => (f x:ℂ)) (-u) = conj (fc (fun x => (f x:ℂ)) u)
proof:
:= by
  unfold fc
  simp_rw [expU_cx, ← Cx_conj, map_mul, chi_neg', Complex.conj_ofReal]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.real_fc_even
statement:
lemma real_fc_even (f : Grid M → ℝ) (h : f.Even) (u : Grid M) :
    (↑(fc (fun x => (f x:ℂ)) u).re:ℂ) = fc (fun x => (f x:ℂ)) u
proof:
:= by
  rw [← fc_neg_even (fun x => (f x:ℂ)) (fun x => by simp [h x]) u]
  have H := fc_neg_even (fun x => (f x:ℂ)) (fun x => by simp [h x]) u
  have he := fc_neg_real f u
  rw [H]
  have hi := congrArg Complex.im (H.symm.trans he)
  simp only [Complex.conj_im] at hi
  apply Complex.ext
  · simp
  · simp; linarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.invert_fc
statement:
lemma invert_fc (f : Grid M → ℂ) (x : Grid M) :
    ∑ u : Grid M, fc f u * chi u x = f x
proof:
:= by
  unfold fc expU
  simp only [Complex.real_smul, Finset.mul_sum,Finset.sum_mul]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  have heq (y : Grid M) :
      ∑ u : Grid M, ↑(side M)*(f y*chi (-u) y)*chi u x =
        f y * expU fun u : Grid M => chi (x-y) u := by
    unfold expU; simp only [Complex.real_smul, Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro u hu
    rw [chi_comm (x-y) u,chi_sub,chi_neg']
    ring
  simp_rw [heq,expU_chi,sub_eq_zero,mul_ite,mul_one,mul_zero]
  simp

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.fc_mul_chi
statement:
lemma fc_mul_chi (f : Grid M → ℂ) (u v : Grid M) :
    fc (fun y => f y * chi v y) u = fc f (u-v)
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [fc, mul_assoc, ← chi_add', neg_sub, ← sub_eq_add_neg]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.fc_prod
statement:
lemma fc_prod (f g : Grid M → ℂ) (u : Grid M) :
    fc (fun y => f y * g y) u = ∑ v : Grid M, fc f v * fc g (u-v)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ = fc (fun y => ∑ v : Grid M, fc f v * (g y*chi v y)) u := by
      congr 1; funext y; rw [← invert_fc f y,Finset.sum_mul]
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun _ _ => by ring
    _ = _ := by simp_rw [fc_sum,fc_lmul,fc_mul_chi]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.fc_right_translate
statement:
lemma fc_right_translate (f : Grid M → ℂ) (a u : Grid M) :
    fc (fun y => f (y-a)) u = chi (-u) a * fc f u
proof:
:= by
  unfold fc; rw [← expU_translate (fun y => f (y-a)*chi (-u) y) a]
  simp_rw [add_sub_cancel_left,chi_add]
  rw [← expU_lmul]
  congr 1; funext y; ring

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.fc_parseval
statement:
lemma fc_parseval (f : Grid M → ℂ) :
    ∑ u, ‖fc f u‖^2 = expU fun y => ‖f y‖^2
proof:
:= by
  have hc (u : Grid M) :
      fc (fun y => conj (f y)) (-u) = conj (fc f u) := by
    unfold fc
    simp_rw [expU_cx,← Cx_conj,map_mul, chi_neg']
  have H := fc_prod f (fun y => conj (f y)) 0
  simp_rw [zero_sub,hc,Complex.mul_conj,← Complex.sq_norm] at H
  unfold fc at H
  rw [neg_zero] at H
  simp_rw [chi_zero_left,mul_one,expU_real,← Complex.ofReal_sum] at H
  exact Complex.ofReal_inj.mp H.symm

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.chi_cast
statement: lemma chi_cast {M : ℕ} (n : ℤ) (x : Grid M) : chi (n:Grid M) x = phase n (pos x)
proof:
:= by
  unfold chi
  have heq : (n:Grid M)*x = ((n*(x.val:ℤ):ℤ):Grid M) := by
    rw [Int.cast_mul, Int.cast_natCast, ZMod.natCast_zmod_val]
  rw [heq, ZMod.stdAddChar_coe, phase, pos, side]
  congr 1
  push_cast
  simp only [div_eq_mul_inv, ← inv_pow]; ring

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.norm_chi
statement: lemma norm_chi {M : ℕ} (n x : Grid M) : ‖chi n x‖ = 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold chi
  simp [ZMod.stdAddChar_apply]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Node.len_pos
statement: theorem len_pos (p : Node) : 0 < p.len
proof: := side_pos _

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Node.cells_sub
statement: lemma cells_sub {p : Node} (hp : p.valid) : p.cells ⊆ unitInt
proof:
:= by
  simpa [lft, unitInt, cells, a, len, box] using cell_in_top 0 zero_lt_one hp

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Node.cells_dis
statement:
lemma cells_dis {n k l : ℕ} (h : k ≠ l) :
    Disjoint (cells ⟨n,k⟩) (cells ⟨n,l⟩)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Set.disjoint_left]
  intro x hx hy
  apply h
  apply cell_unique 0 1 zero_lt_one n (x:=x)
  all_goals simpa only [lft,one_mul,zero_add]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Node.len_L
statement: lemma len_L (p : Node) : p.L.len = p.len/2
proof: := side_succ _

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Node.len_R
statement: lemma len_R (p : Node) : p.R.len = p.len/2
proof: := side_succ _

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Node.a_L
statement: lemma a_L (p : Node) : p.L.a = p.a
proof:
:= by
  unfold a
  rw [len_L]
  dsimp only [L]
  push_cast; ring

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Node.a_R
statement: lemma a_R (p : Node) : p.R.a = p.a+p.len/2
proof:
:= by
  unfold a
  rw [len_R]
  dsimp only [R]
  push_cast; ring

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Node.cells_L
statement: lemma cells_L (p : Node) : p.L.cells = Ico p.a (p.a+p.len/2)
proof: := by rw [cells, len_L, a_L, box]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Node.cells_R
statement: lemma cells_R (p : Node) : p.R.cells = Ico (p.a+p.len/2) (p.a+p.len)
proof:
:= by
  rw [cells,len_R,a_R,box]
  ring_nf

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Node.cells_split
statement: lemma cells_split (p : Node) : p.cells = p.L.cells ∪ p.R.cells
proof:
:= by
  rw [cells_L,cells_R,Ico_union_Ico_eq_Ico (by linarith [p.len_pos]) (by linarith [p.len_pos])]
  rfl

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Node.valid_L
statement: lemma valid_L (p : Node) : p.L.valid ↔ p.valid
proof:
:= by
  unfold L valid; simp; omega

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Node.valid_R
statement: lemma valid_R (p : Node) : p.R.valid ↔ p.valid
proof:
:= by
  unfold R valid; simp; omega

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Node.arg_mem
statement: lemma arg_mem (p : Node) (x : ℝ) : p.normarg x ∈ unitInt ↔ x ∈ p.cells
proof:
:=
  norm_mem_box p.len_pos

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Node.argL_eq
statement: lemma argL_eq (p : Node) (x : ℝ) : p.L.normarg x = 2*p.normarg x
proof:
:= by
  rw [normarg, a_L,len_L,normarg]
  ring

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Node.argR_eq
statement: lemma argR_eq (p : Node) (x : ℝ) : p.R.normarg x = 2*p.normarg x - 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [normarg, a_R,len_R,normarg]
  have H := p.len_pos
  field_simp; ring

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Node.Gi_eq
statement: lemma Gi_eq (p : Node) (x : ℝ) : p.Gi x = p.L.Hi x - p.R.Hi x
proof:
:= by
  rw [Hi,Hi, argL_eq, argR_eq]; rfl

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Node.Hi_L
statement: lemma Hi_L (p : Node) {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ p.L.cells) : p.Hi x = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← arg_mem, argL_eq] at hx
  apply H_of_left
  constructor <;> linarith [hx.1,hx.2]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Node.Hi_R
statement: lemma Hi_R (p : Node) {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ p.R.cells) : p.Hi x = -1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← arg_mem, argR_eq] at hx
  apply H_of_right
  constructor <;> linarith [hx.1,hx.2]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Node.Hi_out
statement: lemma Hi_out (p : Node) {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∉ p.cells) : p.Hi x = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← arg_mem] at hx
  exact H_outside hx

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Node.Gi_out
statement: lemma Gi_out (p : Node) {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∉ p.cells) : p.Gi x = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← arg_mem] at hx
  exact G_outside hx

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.pos_mem
statement: lemma pos_mem {M : ℕ} (x : Grid M) : pos x ∈ atom x
proof:
:=
  ⟨le_refl (pos x), lt_add_of_pos_right (pos x) (side_pos M)⟩

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.atom_sub
statement: lemma atom_sub {M : ℕ} (x : Grid M) : atom x ⊆ unitInt
proof:
:=
  cells_sub (ZMod.val_lt _)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.atom_disjoint
statement: lemma atom_disjoint {M : ℕ} : Pairwise (fun x y : Grid M => Disjoint (atom x) (atom y))
proof:
:= by
  intro x y h
  apply cells_dis
  intro he
  have H := congrArg (fun n : ℕ => (n:Grid M)) he
  exact h (by simpa using H)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.atom_measurable
statement: lemma atom_measurable {M : ℕ} (x : Grid M) : MeasurableSet (atom x)
proof: := measurableSet_Ico

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.atom_volume
statement: lemma atom_volume {M : ℕ} (x : Grid M) : volume (atom x) = ENNReal.ofReal (side M)
proof:
:= by
  change volume (Ico (pos x) (pos x+side M)) = _
  simp

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.atom_partition
statement: lemma atom_partition (M : ℕ) : unitInt = ⋃ x : Grid M, atom x
proof:
:= by
  apply Subset.antisymm _ (iUnion_subset atom_sub)
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨p,hp,hi,hxp⟩ :
      ∃ p : Node, p.valid ∧ p.lev = M ∧ x ∈ p.cells := by
    induction M with
    | zero =>
      refine ⟨root,by simp [valid,root], rfl, ?_⟩
      simpa [root,cells,box, len,side,a,unitInt] using hx
    | succ M ih =>
      obtain ⟨p,hv,hM,hx⟩ := ih
      rw [cells_split] at hx
      exact hx.elim (fun h => ⟨p.L,p.valid_L.mpr hv,congrArg Nat.succ hM,h⟩)
        (fun h => ⟨p.R,p.valid_R.mpr hv,congrArg Nat.succ hM,h⟩)
  refine mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨(p.ix:Grid M),?_⟩
  obtain ⟨n,k⟩ := p
  cases hi
  change x ∈ cells ⟨_, ((k:Grid _).val)⟩
  rwa [ZMod.val_natCast_of_lt hp]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.coarse_const
statement:
lemma coarse_const {p q : Node} (h : p.lev ≤ q.lev) {x y : ℝ}
    (hx : x ∈ q.cells) (hy : y ∈ q.cells) : x ∈ p.cells ↔ y ∈ p.cells
proof:
:= by
  suffices HH : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ q : Node, q.lev = p.lev+n →
      x ∈ q.cells → y ∈ q.cells → (x ∈ p.cells ↔ y ∈ p.cells) by
    exact HH (q.lev - p.lev) q (by omega) hx hy
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    rintro ⟨l,k⟩ hl hx hy
    obtain ⟨m,r⟩ := p
    simp only [Nat.add_zero] at hl
    subst l
    by_cases H : r = k
    · subst r; exact iff_of_true hx hy
    · have Hd := Set.disjoint_left.mp (cells_dis (n:=m) H)
      exact iff_of_false (fun hh => Hd hh hx) (fun hh => Hd hh hy)
  | succ n ih =>
    rintro ⟨l,k⟩ hl hx hy
    let r : Node := ⟨p.lev+n,k/2⟩
    have hs : cells ⟨l,k⟩ ⊆ r.cells := by
      have heq : (⟨l,k⟩:Node) = r.L ∨ (⟨l,k⟩:Node) = r.R := by
        simp only [r,L,R,Node.mk.injEq]
        change l = p.lev+(n+1) at hl
        omega
      rw [cells_split r]
      exact heq.elim (fun e => e ▸ subset_union_left) (fun e => e ▸ subset_union_right)
    exact ih r rfl (hs hx) (hs hy)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.atom_iff_coarse
statement:
lemma atom_iff_coarse {M : ℕ} (p : Node) (h : p.lev ≤ M) {y : Grid M} {x : ℝ}
    (hx : x ∈ atom y) : x ∈ p.cells ↔ y ∈ p.block M
proof:
:=
  coarse_const (q:=vertex y) h hx (pos_mem y)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Hi_const
statement:
lemma Hi_const {p q : Node} (h : p.lev+1 ≤ q.lev) {x y : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ q.cells)
    (hy : y ∈ q.cells) : p.Hi x = p.Hi y
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hp : x ∈ p.cells
  · rw [cells_split] at hp
    exact hp.elim (fun hh => (p.Hi_L hh).trans
        (p.Hi_L ((coarse_const (p:=p.L) h hx hy).mp hh)).symm)
      (fun hh => (p.Hi_R hh).trans (p.Hi_R ((coarse_const (p:=p.R) h hx hy).mp hh)).symm)
  · rw [p.Hi_out hp, p.Hi_out (mt (coarse_const (p:=p) (by omega) hy hx).mp hp)]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Gi_const
statement:
lemma Gi_const {p q : Node} (h : p.lev+2 ≤ q.lev) {x y : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ q.cells)
    (hy : y ∈ q.cells) : p.Gi x = p.Gi y
proof:
:= by
  rw [Gi_eq,Gi_eq, Hi_const (p:=p.L) h hx hy, Hi_const (p:=p.R) h hx hy]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.expU_mono
statement:
lemma expU_mono {M : ℕ} {f g : Grid M → ℝ} (h : ∀ y, f y ≤ g y) :
    expU f ≤ expU g
proof:
:=
  mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Finset.sum_le_sum (fun y _ => h y)) (side_pos _).le

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.avg_mono
statement:
lemma avg_mono {M : ℕ} (p : Node) {f g : Grid M → ℝ} (h : ∀ y ∈ p.block M, f y ≤ g y) :
    p.avg f ≤ p.avg g
proof:
:= by
  apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (expU_mono ?_) (inv_pos.mpr p.len_pos).le
  intro y
  by_cases hy : y ∈ p.block M
  · simpa [hy] using h y hy
  · simp [hy]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.atom_volume_real
statement: lemma atom_volume_real {M : ℕ} (x : Grid M) : volume.real (atom x) = side M
proof:
:= by
  rw [measureReal_def, atom_volume, ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (side_pos M).le]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.expU_liftGrid
statement:
lemma expU_liftGrid (M : ℕ) (f : ℝ → E) (hf : Integrable f μ₁) :
    expU (liftGrid M f) = ∫ x, f x ∂μ₁
proof:
:= by
  have hi : IntegrableOn f (⋃ y : Grid M, atom y) := by rw [← atom_partition]; exact hf
  unfold expU liftGrid μ₁
  rw [atom_partition M, integral_iUnion atom_measurable atom_disjoint hi, tsum_fintype]
  rw [Finset.smul_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun x _ => ?_
  rw [smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ (side_pos M).ne', one_smul]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.liftGrid_ind
statement:
lemma liftGrid_ind {M : ℕ} (p : Node) (h : p.lev ≤ M) (f : ℝ → E) :
    liftGrid M (p.cells.indicator f) = (p.block M).indicator (liftGrid M f)
proof:
:= by
  ext y
  by_cases hy : y ∈ p.block M
  · rw [indicator_of_mem hy]
    unfold liftGrid
    congr 1
    exact setIntegral_congr_fun (atom_measurable y)
      (fun x hx => indicator_of_mem ((atom_iff_coarse p h hx).mpr hy) f)
  · rw [indicator_of_notMem hy, liftGrid, setIntegral_eq_zero_of_forall_eq_zero]
    · exact smul_zero _
    · exact fun x hx => indicator_of_notMem (mt (atom_iff_coarse p h hx).mp hy) f

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.avg_liftGrid
statement:
lemma avg_liftGrid {M : ℕ} (f : ℝ → E) (hf : Integrable f μ₁)
    {p : Node} (hp : p.valid) (h : p.lev ≤ M) :
    p.avg (liftGrid M f) = p.len⁻¹ • ∫ x in p.cells, f x
proof:
:= by
  rw [avg, ← liftGrid_ind p h, expU_liftGrid, μ₁, setIntegral_indicator
    (show MeasurableSet p.cells from measurableSet_Ico), inter_eq_right.mpr (cells_sub hp)]
  exact hf.indicator measurableSet_Ico

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.avg_smulHi_lift
statement:
lemma avg_smulHi_lift {M : ℕ} (f : ℝ → E) {p : Node} (hp : p.valid) (h : p.lev+1 ≤ M)
    (hF : Integrable (fun x => p.Hi x • f x) μ₁) :
    p.avg (fun y => p.Hi (pos y) • liftGrid M f y) =
      ∫ x, haarH x • f (p.a+p.len*x) ∂μ₁
proof:
:= by
  have heq : (fun y => p.Hi (pos y) • liftGrid M f y) =
      liftGrid M (fun x => p.Hi x • f x) := by
    ext y
    unfold liftGrid
    rw [smul_comm, ← integral_smul]
    congr 1
    exact setIntegral_congr_fun (atom_measurable _) fun x hx =>
      congrArg (fun c : ℝ => c • f x) (Hi_const (p:=p) (q:=vertex y) h (pos_mem y) hx)
  rw [heq, avg_liftGrid _ hF hp (by omega),
    cells, box, ← mean_translate_scale (fun x => p.Hi x • f x) p.a p.len_pos]
  congr 1
  funext x
  rw [show p.Hi (p.a+p.len*x) = haarH x from congrArg haarH (by
    unfold normarg; field_simp [p.len_pos.ne']; ring)]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.norm_expU_le
statement: lemma norm_expU_le {M : ℕ} (f : Grid M → E) : ‖expU f‖ ≤ expU (fun x => ‖f x‖)
proof:
:= by
  unfold expU
  rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (side_pos _)]
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (norm_sum_le _ _) (side_pos _).le

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.norm_avg_le
statement:
lemma norm_avg_le {M : ℕ} (p : Node) (f : Grid M → E) :
    ‖p.avg f‖ ≤ p.avg (fun x => ‖f x‖)
proof:
:= by
  unfold avg
  rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr p.len_pos)]
  refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ((norm_expU_le _).trans ?_) (inv_pos.mpr p.len_pos).le
  apply expU_mono
  intro y; by_cases hy : y ∈ block p M <;> simp [hy]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.avg_sub
statement:
lemma avg_sub {M : ℕ} (p : Node) (f g : Grid M → E) :
    p.avg (fun y => f y - g y) = p.avg f - p.avg g
proof:
:= by
  unfold avg expU
  simp_rw [indicator_sub, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, smul_sub]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.liftGrid_const
statement:
lemma liftGrid_const {M : ℕ} (c : E) (y : Grid M) :
    liftGrid M (fun _ => c) y = c
proof:
:= by
  rw [liftGrid, setIntegral_const, atom_volume_real, smul_smul,
    inv_mul_cancel₀ (side_pos _).ne', one_smul]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.avg_const
statement:
lemma avg_const {M : ℕ} {p : Node} (hp : p.valid) (h : p.lev ≤ M) (c : E) :
    p.avg (fun _ : Grid M => c) = c
proof:
:= by
  have heq := funext (liftGrid_const (M:=M) c)
  rw [← heq, avg_liftGrid (fun _ : ℝ => c) (integrable_const _) hp h, setIntegral_const]
  have hh : volume.real p.cells = p.len := by
    rw [cells,box, Real.volume_real_Ico_of_le (by linarith [p.len_pos])]
    ring
  rw [hh, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ p.len_pos.ne', one_smul]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.lift_bounds
statement:
lemma lift_bounds {M : ℕ} {ρ : ℝ → ℝ} (hρ : Integrable ρ μ₁) (h0 : ∀ x, 0 ≤ ρ x)
    (B : ℝ) (hb : ∀ x, ρ x ≤ B) (y : Grid M) :
    0 ≤ liftGrid M ρ y ∧ liftGrid M ρ y ≤ B
proof:
:= by
  have hi : IntegrableOn ρ (atom y) := (show IntegrableOn ρ unitInt volume from hρ).mono_set (atom_sub y)
  have : IsFiniteMeasure (volume.restrict (atom y)) :=
    show IsFiniteMeasure (volume.restrict (Ico (pos y) (pos y+side M))) from inferInstance
  constructor
  · exact mul_nonneg (inv_pos.mpr (side_pos _)).le (integral_nonneg h0)
  · have H : (∫ x in atom y, ρ x) ≤ ∫ x in atom y, B :=
      integral_mono hi (integrable_const _) hb
    exact le_trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left H (inv_pos.mpr (side_pos _)).le)
      (liftGrid_const B y).le

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.lift_shift
statement:
lemma lift_shift {M : ℕ} (J : ℕ) (hJ : J+1 ≤ M) (f : ℝ → ℂ)
    (hf : Measurable f) (B : ℝ) (hb : ∀ x, ‖f x‖ ≤ B) {y : Grid M} {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ atom y) :
    FinShift J (liftGrid M f) y = shift f 0 1 J x
proof:
:= by
  unfold FinShift shift haarLayer
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun n hn => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k hk => ?_
  let p : Node := ⟨n,k⟩
  have hl : p.lev+2 ≤ M := by dsimp [p]; rw [Finset.mem_range] at hn; omega
  have hB' (x : ℝ) := H_bound (p.normarg x)
  have Hm : Measurable (p.Hi) := measurableH.comp (by unfold normarg; fun_prop)
  have Hi : Integrable (fun x => p.Hi x • f x) μ₁ :=
    Integrable.of_bound (Hm.smul hf).aestronglyMeasurable B (ae_of_all _ (fun x => by
      change ‖p.Hi x • f x‖ ≤ _
      rw [norm_smul]
      exact (mul_le_of_le_one_left (norm_nonneg _)
        (show ‖p.Hi x‖ ≤ 1 from hB' x)).trans (hb x)))
  rw [show lft 0 1 n k = p.a by simp [lft,p,a,len], one_mul]
  change FinJump p _ y = p.Gi x • _
  rw [FinJump, Gi_const (q:=vertex y) hl (pos_mem y) hx,
    avg_smulHi_lift f (Finset.mem_range.mp hk) (by omega) Hi]
  rfl

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.lift_mod_error
statement:
lemma lift_mod_error (M : ℕ) {ρ : ℝ → ℝ} (hρ : Measurable ρ) (h0 : ∀ x, 0 ≤ ρ x)
    (B : ℝ) (hb : ∀ x, ρ x ≤ B) (n : ℤ) (y : Grid M) :
    ‖liftGrid M (modρ ρ (n:ℝ)) y - finMod (liftGrid M ρ) (n:Grid M) y‖ ≤
      (B * |(n:ℝ)| * (2*π)) * side M
proof:
:= by
  rw [finMod, chi_cast]
  have : IsFiniteMeasure (volume.restrict (atom y)) :=
    show IsFiniteMeasure (volume.restrict (Ico (pos y) (pos y+side M))) from inferInstance
  let u : ℝ := n
  let q (x : ℝ) := (ρ x:ℂ) * phase u (pos y)
  let F := modρ ρ u
  let C := (B * |u| *(2*π))*side M
  have heq : (↑(liftGrid M ρ y) : ℂ) * phase u (pos y) = liftGrid M q y := by
    unfold liftGrid q
    rw [integral_mul_const, integral_complex_ofReal]
    simp only [Complex.real_smul, smul_eq_mul, Complex.ofReal_mul, mul_assoc]
  change ‖liftGrid M F y - _ * phase u (pos y)‖ ≤ C
  rw [heq]
  have HiF : IntegrableOn F (atom y) := Integrable.of_bound (measurable_mod hρ _).aestronglyMeasurable B
    (ae_of_all _ fun x => by rw [norm_mod h0]; exact hb x)
  have Hiq : IntegrableOn q (atom y) :=
    Integrable.of_bound (((Complex.continuous_ofReal.measurable.comp hρ).mul measurable_const).aestronglyMeasurable) B (ae_of_all _ fun x => by
        change ‖q x‖ ≤ _
        unfold q
        simpa only [norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (h0 x),
          phase_unimod, mul_one] using hb x)
  have hh (x : ℝ) (hx : x ∈ atom y) : ‖F x - q x‖ ≤ C := by
    unfold F modρ q C
    rw [← mul_sub, norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (h0 _)]
    have hk : |x-pos y| ≤ side M := by
      change pos y ≤ x ∧ x < pos y+side M at hx
      rw [abs_le]; constructor <;> linarith [hx.1,hx.2,side_pos M]
    calc
      _ ≤ B*(|u| *(2*π*side M)) := mul_le_mul (hb x)
        ((norm_phase_sub u x _).trans (by gcongr)) (norm_nonneg _) ((h0 x).trans (hb x))
      _ = _ := by ring
  rw [liftGrid, liftGrid, ← smul_sub, ← integral_sub HiF Hiq, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs,
    abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr (side_pos M))]
  have H : ‖∫ x in atom y, F x - q x‖ ≤ ∫ _ in atom y, C :=
    (norm_integral_le_integral_norm _).trans (integral_mono_ae (HiF.sub Hiq).norm
      (integrable_const _) ((ae_restrict_mem (atom_measurable y)).mono hh))
  refine (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left H (inv_pos.mpr (side_pos M)).le).trans ?_
  rw [setIntegral_const, atom_volume_real, smul_eq_mul, ← mul_assoc,
    inv_mul_cancel₀ (side_pos M).ne', one_mul]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.FinJump_error
statement:
lemma FinJump_error {M : ℕ} {f g : Grid M → ℂ} (B : ℝ)
    (h : ∀ x, ‖f x - g x‖ ≤ B) {p : Node} (hp : p.valid) (hl : p.lev ≤ M) (x : Grid M) :
    ‖FinJump p f x - FinJump p g x‖ ≤ B
proof:
:= by
  rw [FinJump, FinJump, ← smul_sub, ← avg_sub, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs]
  refine (mul_le_of_le_one_left (norm_nonneg _) (G_bound _)).trans
    ((norm_avg_le _ _).trans ?_)
  refine (avg_mono p (g:=fun _ => B) fun y _ => ?_).trans (avg_const hp hl B).le
  rw [← smul_sub, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs]
  exact (mul_le_of_le_one_left (norm_nonneg _) (H_bound _)).trans (h _)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.FinShift_error
statement:
lemma FinShift_error {M : ℕ} {f g : Grid M → ℂ} (B : ℝ)
    (h : ∀ x, ‖f x - g x‖ ≤ B) {J : ℕ} (hJ : J ≤ M) (x : Grid M) :
    ‖FinShift J f x - FinShift J g x‖ ≤ (∑ n ∈ Finset.range J, (2:ℝ)^n)*B
proof:
:= by
  unfold FinShift
  rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib,Finset.sum_mul]
  refine (norm_sum_le _ _).trans (Finset.sum_le_sum (fun n hn => ?_))
  rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  refine (norm_sum_le _ _).trans ?_
  apply le_trans (b:=∑ k ∈ Finset.range (2^n), B)
  · exact Finset.sum_le_sum (fun k hk => FinJump_error B h (Finset.mem_range.mp hk)
      ((Finset.mem_range.mp hn).le.trans hJ) _)
  simp

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.usable_transfer
statement:
lemma usable_transfer {ρ : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : Integrable ρ μ₁) (D : ℝ)
    {M J : ℕ} (h : J ≤ M) {x : ℝ} (hx : usable ρ 0 1 J D x)
    {y : Grid M} (hy : x ∈ atom y) :
    finGood D J (liftGrid M ρ) y
proof:
:= by
  intro p hp hl hpy
  rw [avg_liftGrid ρ hf hp (hl.le.trans h)]
