  have hx' : x ∈ p.cells := (atom_iff_coarse p (hl.le.trans h) hy).mpr hpy
  have H1 : lft 0 1 p.lev p.ix = p.a := by simp [lft,a,len]
  have H2 : 1*side p.lev = p.len := one_mul _
  have H := hx p.lev hl p.ix hp (by rwa [H1,H2])
  rw [H1,H2,density,mean_translate_scale _ _ p.len_pos] at H
  exact H

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.expU_add_one
statement:
lemma expU_add_one (M : ℕ) (W : Grid M → ℝ) :
    expU (fun y => W y + 1) = expU W + 1
proof:
:= by
  simp only [expU, Finset.sum_add_distrib, smul_eq_mul, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ,
    nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one, mul_add, Grid, ZMod.card, Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_ofNat]
  rw [mul_comm (side M) ((2:ℝ)^M), pow_mul_side]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.GridBound.unitTreeBound
statement: theorem GridBound.unitTreeBound (hgrid : GridBound) : UnitTreeBound
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨C,hC,h⟩ := hgrid
  refine ⟨C+1, by positivity,?_⟩
  filter_upwards [h] with j hj
  intro ρ hρ h0 hm hb J G hG hGu hD
  let B := Real.exp ((2:ℝ)^j)
  have hB : 0 ≤ B := Real.exp_nonneg _
  have hbi : Integrable ρ μ₁ := Integrable.of_bound hρ.aestronglyMeasurable B
    (ae_of_all _ (fun x => by simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (h0 x)] using hb x))
  let Y (n : ℤ) (x : ℝ) := ENNReal.ofReal ‖shift (modρ ρ n) 0 1 J x‖
  let Z (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ) := ⨆ i : ℤ, ⨆ (_h : i.natAbs ≤ n), Y i x
  have hYm (n : ℤ) : Measurable (Y n) :=
    (show Measurable (fun x => shift (modρ ρ n) 0 1 J x)
      from measurable_shift_comp (measurable_mod hρ _) measurable_const measurable_const measurable_id J)
      |>.norm.ennreal_ofReal
  have hZm (n : ℕ) : Measurable (Z n) :=
    Measurable.iSup fun i => Measurable.iSup fun (_ : i.natAbs ≤ n) => hYm i
  have hZo : Monotone Z := fun n m h x => iSup_le fun i => iSup_le fun hi =>
    le_iSup₂ (f := fun i (_h : i.natAbs ≤ m) => Y i x) i (le_trans hi h)
  have hZ (x : ℝ) : maxShift ρ 0 1 J x ≤ ⨆ n, Z n x := by
    refine iSup_le fun i =>
      (le_iSup₂ (f := fun l : ℤ => fun (_ : l.natAbs ≤ i.natAbs) => Y l x) i le_rfl).trans
        (le_iSup (fun n => Z n x) i.natAbs)
  refine (lintegral_mono hZ).trans ?_
  rw [lintegral_iSup hZm hZo]
  refine iSup_le fun n => ?_
  let S := ∑ m ∈ Finset.range J, (2:ℝ)^m
  have ht : Tendsto (fun M => S*(B*(n:ℝ)*(2*π))*side M) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    have hs : Tendsto side atTop (𝓝 0) := tendsto_pow_atTop_nhds_zero_of_lt_one
      (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
    simpa only [mul_zero] using hs.const_mul (S*(B*(n:ℝ)*(2*π)))
  obtain ⟨M,hM,hMJ,hMt⟩ := ((hj J).and
    ((eventually_ge_atTop (J+1)).and (ht.eventually (gt_mem_nhds (show (0:ℝ)<1 by norm_num))))).exists
  change _ < (1:ℝ) at hMt
  obtain ⟨W,hW,hWm,hWe⟩ :=
    hM (liftGrid M ρ) (fun y => (lift_bounds hbi h0 B hb y).1) (by rwa [expU_liftGrid M ρ hbi])
      (fun y => (lift_bounds hbi h0 B hb y).2)
  have Hx (y : Grid M) (x : ℝ) (hx : x ∈ atom y) (hxg : x ∈ G) :
      Z n x ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (W y + 1) := by
    refine iSup_le fun (i : ℤ) => iSup_le fun hi => ?_
    have hw := hWe y (usable_transfer hbi _ (by omega) (hD x hxg) hx) (i:Grid M)
    let f := liftGrid M (modρ ρ (i:ℝ))
    have hh := FinShift_error (B*|(i:ℝ)| * (2*π)*side M) (lift_mod_error M hρ h0 B hb i)
      (show J ≤ M by omega) y
    change ‖FinShift J f y - _‖ ≤ S*_ at hh
    have Hlem : |(i:ℝ)| ≤ (n:ℝ) := by rw [abs_le]; constructor <;> exact_mod_cast (by omega)
    have hlim : S*(B*|(i:ℝ)| * (2*π)*side M) ≤ 1 := by
      calc
        _ ≤ S*(B*(n:ℝ)*(2*π)*side M) := by
          have h := side_pos M
          have : 0 ≤ S := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun _ _ => by positivity)
          gcongr
        _ ≤ 1 := by linarith
    change ENNReal.ofReal _ ≤ _
    apply ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
    have hfi (x : ℝ) : ‖modρ ρ i x‖ ≤ B := by rw [norm_mod h0]; exact hb _
    rw [← lift_shift J hMJ _ (measurable_mod hρ _) B hfi hx]
    have HE := norm_sub_norm_le (FinShift J f y) (FinShift J (finMod (liftGrid M ρ) (i:Grid M)) y)

    change ‖FinShift J f y‖ ≤ W y + 1
    linarith
  let V := G.indicator (Z n)
  have HV : (∫⁻ x in G, Z n x) = ∫⁻ x in unitInt, V x := by
    unfold V
    rw [lintegral_indicator hG, Measure.restrict_restrict hG, inter_eq_left.mpr hGu]
  rw [HV, atom_partition M, lintegral_iUnion atom_measurable atom_disjoint, tsum_fintype]
  have Hv (y : Grid M) :
      (∫⁻ x in atom y, V x) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((W y+1)*side M) := by
    calc
      _ ≤ ∫⁻ _ in atom y, ENNReal.ofReal (W y+1) := by
        apply lintegral_mono_ae
        filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem (atom_measurable y)] with x hx
        by_cases H : x ∈ G
        · simpa [V,H] using Hx y x hx H
        · simp [V,H]
      _ = _ := by rw [setLIntegral_const, atom_volume,
                       ENNReal.ofReal_mul (by linarith [hW y] : 0 ≤ W y+1)]
  refine (Finset.sum_le_sum (fun y _ => Hv y)).trans ?_
  rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_sum_of_nonneg]
  · apply ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
    calc
      ∑ y, _ = expU (fun y => W y + 1) := by simp only [expU,smul_eq_mul,← Finset.sum_mul]; ring
      _ ≤ C*(2:ℝ)^j+1 := by rw [expU_add_one M W]; linarith
      _ ≤ _ := by linarith [one_le_pow₀ (by norm_num : (1:ℝ) ≤ 2) (n:=j)]
  · intro y _; have := side_pos M; have := hW y; positivity

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Node.rinv
statement: lemma rinv (p : Node) : invlen p = p.len⁻¹
proof: := by rw [len,side_pow_two,inv_inv]; rfl

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Node.invlen_ge
statement: lemma invlen_ge (p : Node) : 1 ≤ invlen p
proof: := one_le_pow₀ (by norm_num)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Node.invlen_pos
statement: lemma invlen_pos (p : Node) : 0 < invlen p
proof: := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one p.invlen_ge

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Node.descale
statement:
lemma descale {p : Node} (h : p.lev ≤ M) :
    p.len = side M * (2:ℝ)^(M-p.lev)
proof:
:= by
  rw [len,side_pow_two,side_pow_two]
  conv_rhs => lhs; rw [show M=p.lev+(M-p.lev) by omega]
  rw [pow_add]; field_simp

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Node.mem_block_iff
statement:
lemma mem_block_iff {p : Node} (h : p.lev ≤ M) (x : Grid M) :
    x ∈ p.block M ↔ p.ix*2^(M-p.lev) ≤ x.val ∧ x.val < (p.ix+1)*2^(M-p.lev)
proof:
:= by
  change p.a ≤ pos x ∧ _ < p.a+p.len ↔ _
  have he (i : ℕ) : (i:ℝ)*p.len = (i*2^(M-p.lev) : ℕ) * side M := by
    rw [descale h]; push_cast; ring
  unfold a pos
  rw [show p.ix*p.len+p.len=↑(p.ix+1)*p.len by push_cast; ring, he,he,
    mul_le_mul_iff_left₀ (side_pos _),mul_lt_mul_iff_left₀ (side_pos _)]
  norm_cast

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Node.fitting
statement:
lemma fitting (p : Node) (hv : p.valid) (h : p.lev ≤ M) :
    p.idx M+p.wid M ≤ 2^M
proof:
:= by
  unfold idx wid
  calc
    _ = (p.ix+1)*2^(M-p.lev) := by ring
    _ ≤ 2^p.lev*2^(M-p.lev) := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hv
    _ = _ := by rw [← pow_add]; congr 1; omega

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Node.wid_pos
statement: lemma wid_pos (p : Node) (M : ℕ) : 0 < p.wid M
proof: := pow_pos (by omega) _

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Node.start_val
statement:
lemma start_val {p : Node} (hv : p.valid) (h : p.lev ≤ M) :
    (p.start M).val = p.idx M
proof:
:= by
  apply ZMod.val_natCast_of_lt
  have HH := p.fitting hv h
  have HH' := p.wid_pos M
  omega

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Node.start_pos
statement:
lemma start_pos {p : Node} (hv : p.valid) (h : p.lev ≤ M) :
    pos (p.start M) = p.a
proof:
:= by
  rw [pos, start_val hv h,a,descale h]
  unfold idx; push_cast; ring

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Node.start_mem
statement:
lemma start_mem {p : Node} (hv : p.valid) (h : p.lev ≤ M) :
    p.start M ∈ p.block M
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_block_iff h,start_val hv h]
  unfold idx
  constructor
  · exact le_rfl
  · gcongr; omega

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Node.mem_group
statement: lemma mem_group (p : Node) (x : Grid M) : x ∈ p.group M ↔ x ∈ p.block M
proof: := by simp [group]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Node.group_range
statement:
lemma group_range {p : Node} (h : p.lev ≤ M) :
    p.group M = first M (p.idx M+p.wid M) \ first M (p.idx M)
proof:
:= by
  ext i; simp only [mem_group, Finset.mem_sdiff, mem_first, mem_block_iff h]
  unfold idx wid; rw [add_mul,one_mul]; omega

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Node.group_card
statement:
lemma group_card {p : Node} (hv : p.valid) (h : p.lev ≤ M) :
    (p.group M).card = p.wid M
proof:
:= by
  have hh := p.fitting hv h
  rw [group_range h,Finset.card_sdiff_of_subset ?sub,first_card _ hh,first_card _ (by omega)]
  · omega
  case sub =>
    intro x hx
    simp_rw [mem_first] at *
    omega

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Node.group_size
statement:
lemma group_size {p : Node} (hv : p.valid) (h : p.lev ≤ M) :
    (p.group M).card * side M = p.len
proof:
:= by
  rw [group_card hv h,descale h]
  unfold wid; push_cast; ring

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Node.block_separate
statement:
lemma block_separate (p : Node) (M : ℕ) :
    Disjoint (p.L.block M) (p.R.block M)
proof:
:= by
  refine Set.disjoint_left.mpr fun x hx hy => ?_
  exact Set.disjoint_left.mp (cells_dis (k:=p.ix*2) (l:=p.ix*2+1) (by omega)
    (n:=p.lev+1)) hx hy

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Node.block_union
statement:
lemma block_union (p : Node) (M : ℕ) :
    p.block M = p.L.block M ∪ p.R.block M
proof: := by rw [block,p.cells_split]; rfl

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Node.group_dis
statement:
lemma group_dis (p : Node) (M : ℕ) :
    Disjoint (p.L.group M) (p.R.group M)
proof:
:=
  Finset.disjoint_left.mpr fun _ hx hy => Set.disjoint_left.mp (p.block_separate _)
      ((mem_group _ _).mp hx) ((mem_group _ _).mp hy)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Node.group_union
statement:
lemma group_union (p : Node) (M : ℕ) :
    p.group M = p.L.group M ∪ p.R.group M
proof: := by ext x; simp only [Finset.mem_union,mem_group]; rw [p.block_union]; rfl

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Node.root_ok
statement: lemma root_ok (M : ℕ) : ok root M
proof: := by simp [ok,valid,root]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Node.len_top
statement: lemma len_top : root.len = 1
proof: := by simp [len,root,side]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Node.invlen_top
statement: lemma invlen_top : root.invlen = 1
proof: := by simp [invlen,root]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Node.group_top
statement: lemma group_top (M : ℕ) : root.group M = Finset.univ
proof:
:= by
  ext x; rw [mem_group,mem_block_iff (root_ok M).2]
  simp only [root, Nat.zero_mul, Nat.zero_le, true_and, zero_add,one_mul,Nat.sub_zero]
  simp [ZMod.val_lt]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Node.avg_sum
statement:
lemma avg_sum {E : Type*} [AddCommMonoid E] [SMul ℝ E] (p : Node)
    (f : Grid M → E) :
    p.avg f = p.len⁻¹ • (side M • ∑ x ∈ p.group M, f x)
proof:
:= by
  unfold avg expU
  congr 2
  calc
    _ = ∑ x ∈ p.group M, (p.block M).indicator f x := by
      refine (Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ _) ?_).symm
      intro i _ hi
      apply Set.indicator_of_notMem ((mem_group _ _).not.mp hi) f
    _ = _ := Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i hi => Set.indicator_of_mem ((mem_group _ _).mp hi) f

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Node.avg_nonneg
statement:
lemma avg_nonneg (p : Node) {f : Grid M → ℝ} (h : ∀ x, x∈p.block M → 0 ≤ f x) :
    0 ≤ p.avg f
proof:
:= by
  rw [avg_sum, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul]
  exact mul_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr p.len_pos.le) <| mul_nonneg (side_pos _).le
    (Finset.sum_nonneg fun i hi => h _ ((mem_group _ _).mp hi))

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Node.avg_split_real
statement:
lemma avg_split_real (p : Node) (f : Grid M → ℝ) :
    p.avg f = (p.L.avg f+p.R.avg f)/2
proof:
:= by
  rw [avg_sum,avg_sum,avg_sum,p.group_union,Finset.sum_union (p.group_dis M),p.len_L,p.len_R]; simp; ring

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Node.avg_split_complex
statement:
lemma avg_split_complex (p : Node) (f : Grid M → ℂ) :
    p.avg f = (p.L.avg f+p.R.avg f)/2
proof:
:= by
  rw [avg_sum,avg_sum,avg_sum,p.group_union,Finset.sum_union (p.group_dis M),p.len_L,p.len_R]
  simp_rw [Complex.real_smul]; push_cast; ring_nf

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Node.prob_block
statement:
lemma prob_block {p : Node} (h : p.ok M) :
    (uniform (Grid M)).prob (fun x => x∈p.block M) = p.len
proof:
:= by
  rw [prob_eq]
  have He : Finset.univ.filter (fun x : Grid M => x∈p.block M)=p.group M := by
    ext x; simp [mem_group]
  rw [← Finset.sum_filter, He]
  simp_rw [uniform_side,Finset.sum_const,nsmul_eq_mul,group_size h.1 h.2]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Node.dice_apply
statement:
lemma dice_apply {p : Node} (h : p.ok M) (x : Grid M) :
    p.dice M x = if x∈p.block M then side M * p.len⁻¹ else 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold dice
  rw [condP_pos_apply _ _ (by rw [prob_block h]; exact p.len_pos),prob_block h,uniform_side]
  split_ifs <;> simp [div_eq_mul_inv]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Node.dice_positive
statement:
lemma dice_positive {p : Node} (h : p.ok M) {x : Grid M} :
    0 < p.dice M x ↔ x ∈ p.block M
proof:
:= by
  rw [dice_apply h]; split_ifs with hh
  · exact iff_of_true (mul_pos (side_pos _) (inv_pos.mpr p.len_pos)) hh
  · simp [hh]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Node.avg_ex
statement:
lemma avg_ex {p : Node} (h : p.ok M) (f : Grid M → ℝ) :
    p.avg f = (p.dice M).Ex f
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [avg,smul_eq_mul,expU_ex,Ex,dice_apply h,uniform_side,Finset.mul_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
  split_ifs with hi
  · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hi]; ring
  rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hi]; ring

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Node.avg_cx
statement:
lemma avg_cx {p : Node} (h : p.ok M) (f : Grid M → ℂ) :
    p.avg f = (p.dice M).Cx f
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [avg,Complex.real_smul,expU_cx,Cx,dice_apply h,uniform_side,Finset.mul_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
  split_ifs with hi
  · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hi]; push_cast; ring
  rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hi]; push_cast; ring

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Node.dice_child
statement:
lemma dice_child (p : Node) (hv : p.valid) (h : p.lev < M) (f : Grid M → ℝ) :
    (p.dice M).Ex f = ((p.L.dice M).Ex f + (p.R.dice M).Ex f)/2
proof:
:= by
  have H : ok p M := ⟨hv,h.le⟩
  have H1 : ok p.L M := ⟨p.valid_L.mpr hv,h⟩
  have H2 : ok p.R M := ⟨p.valid_R.mpr hv,h⟩
  rw [← avg_ex H,← avg_ex H1,← avg_ex H2]
  exact p.avg_split_real _

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Node.below_left
statement: lemma below_left (p : Node) : p.L.below p
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨Nat.le_add_right _ 1,?_⟩
  rw [cells_split p]; exact subset_union_left

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Node.below_right
statement: lemma below_right (p : Node) : p.R.below p
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨Nat.le_add_right _ 1,?_⟩
  rw [cells_split p]; exact subset_union_right

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Node.below_refl
statement: lemma below_refl (p : Node) : p.below p
proof: := ⟨le_rfl,Subset.rfl⟩

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Node.below_trans
statement: lemma below_trans {p q r : Node} (h : p.below q) (h' : q.below r) : p.below r
proof:
:=
  ⟨h'.1.trans h.1,h.2.trans h'.2⟩

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Node.block_of_below
statement: lemma block_of_below {p q : Node} (h : p.below q) (M : ℕ) : p.block M ⊆ q.block M
proof:
:=
  Set.preimage_mono h.2

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Node.scale_below
statement: lemma scale_below {p q : Node} (h : p.below q) : q.invlen ≤ p.invlen
proof:
:=
  pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num) h.1

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Node.diam_block
statement:
lemma diam_block {p : Node} {x y : Grid M} (hx : x ∈ p.block M) (hy : y ∈ p.block M) :
    |pos x-pos y| ≤ p.len
proof: := by rw [abs_le]; constructor <;> linarith [hx.1,hx.2,hy.1,hy.2]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.cut_natCast
statement:
lemma cut_natCast (h : l ≤ M) (k : ℕ) :
    cut h (k:Grid M) = (k:Grid l)
proof: := map_natCast _ _

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.cut_val
statement:
lemma cut_val (h : l ≤ M) (x : Grid M) :
    cut h x = (x.val:Grid l)
proof: := by rw [← cut_natCast h,ZMod.natCast_zmod_val]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.cut_mod
statement:
lemma cut_mod (h : l ≤ M) (x : Grid M) :
    (cut h x).val = x.val % 2^l
proof: := by rw [cut_val,ZMod.val_natCast]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.raise_cast
statement:
lemma raise_cast (h : l ≤ M) (x : ℕ) :
    raise h (x : Grid l) = (↑(2^(M-l)*x:ℕ):Grid M)
proof:
:= by
  have H : ∀ k : ℤ, raise h (k:Grid l) = times_step l M k := fun k => ZMod.lift_coe _ _ _
  convert H x using 1 <;> simp [times_step]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.raise_eq
statement:
lemma raise_eq (h : l ≤ M) (x : Grid l) :
    raise h x = ↑(2^(M-l)*x.val:ℕ)
proof: := by rw [← raise_cast h,ZMod.natCast_zmod_val]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.raise_val
statement:
lemma raise_val (h : l ≤ M) (x : Grid l) :
    (raise h x).val = 2^(M-l)*x.val
proof:
:= by
  rw [raise_eq,ZMod.val_natCast_of_lt]
  calc
    _ < 2^(M-l)*2^l := Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left (ZMod.val_lt _) (by positivity)
    _ = _ := by rw [← pow_add]; congr 1; omega

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.raise_inj
statement: lemma raise_inj (h : l ≤ M) : Injective (raise h)
proof:
:= by
  intro x y he
  apply ZMod.val_injective _
  have H := congrArg ZMod.val he
  simp only [raise_val] at H
  exact mul_left_cancel₀ (by positivity) H

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.raised_pos
statement: lemma raised_pos (h : l ≤ M) (i : Grid l) : pos (raise h i) = pos i
proof:
:= by
  simp only [pos,raise_val]
  have heq : side l = side M*(2:ℝ)^(M-l) := descale (p:=⟨l,0⟩) h
  rw [heq]; push_cast; ring

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.cut_chi
statement:
lemma cut_chi (h : l ≤ M) (i : Grid l) (x : Grid M) :
    chi (raise h i) x = chi i (cut h x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [cut_val,chi_comm i _,chi_comm (raise h i) x]
  have heq (x : ℕ) : chi (x:Grid M) (raise h i) = chi (x:Grid l) i := by
    have H := chi_cast (x:ℤ) (raise h i)
    have hh := chi_cast (x:ℤ) i
    rw [raised_pos] at H
    simpa only [Int.cast_natCast] using H.trans hh.symm
  rw [← heq, ZMod.natCast_zmod_val x]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.annihilator
statement:
lemma annihilator (h : l ≤ M) (u : Grid M) :
    cut (show M-l ≤ M by omega) u = 0 ↔ ∃ i, raise h i = u
proof:
:= by
  let p := cut (show M-l ≤ M by omega)
  have he (u : Grid M) : p u = 0 ↔ 2^(M-l) ∣ u.val := by
    rw [← (ZMod.val_injective (2^(M-l))).eq_iff]
    simp only [p,cut_mod,ZMod.val_zero,Nat.dvd_iff_mod_eq_zero]
  constructor
  · intro hu
    obtain ⟨i,hi⟩ := (he _).mp hu
    refine ⟨(i:Grid l),?_⟩
    rw [raise_cast,← hi,ZMod.natCast_zmod_val]
  rintro ⟨i,rfl⟩
  exact (he _).mpr (by rw [raise_val]; simp)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.raise_down
statement:
lemma raise_down (h : l ≤ M) (u : Grid M) :
    u - raise h (down h u) = (↑(u.val % 2^(M-l)):Grid M)
proof:
:= by
  have hh := Nat.mod_add_div u.val (2^(M-l))
  unfold down; rw [raise_cast]
  apply sub_eq_iff_eq_add.mpr; rw [← Nat.cast_add,hh,ZMod.natCast_zmod_val]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.snap_dist
statement:
lemma snap_dist (h : l ≤ M) (u : Grid M) :
    rad (u-raise h (down h u)) ≤ 2^(M-l)-1
proof:
:= by
  rw [raise_down]
  apply le_trans (rad_le_nat _)
  have H : u.val % 2^(M-l) +1 ≤ 2^(M-l) := Nat.mod_lt _ (by positivity)
  apply le_sub_iff_add_le.mpr
  exact_mod_cast H

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.cut_injOn
statement:
lemma cut_injOn {p : Node} (h : l ≤ M) (hp : p.lev ≤ M) (hh : M-l ≤ p.lev) :
    InjOn (cut h) (p.block M)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx y hy hxy
  apply ZMod.val_injective _
  have HE := congrArg ZMod.val hxy
  simp only [cut_mod] at HE
  rw [mem_block_iff hp x] at hx; rw [mem_block_iff hp y] at hy
  let a := 2^(M-p.lev)
  let b := 2^l
  let i := p.ix
  change i*a ≤ _ ∧ _ < (i+1)*a at hx hy
  rw [add_mul,one_mul] at hx hy
  have h1 := Nat.mod_add_div x.val b
  have h2 := Nat.mod_add_div y.val b
  have hi : a ≤ b := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) (by omega)
  change _ % b = _ % b at HE
  have h3 : x.val/b=y.val/b := by
    by_contra! he
    rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne he with H|H
    · have Hx : b*(x.val/b +1) ≤ b*(y.val/b) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left b H
      rw [mul_add,mul_one] at Hx; omega
    · have Hx : b*(y.val/b +1) ≤ b*(x.val/b) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left b H
      rw [mul_add,mul_one] at Hx; omega
  rw [HE,h3,h2] at h1; exact h1.symm

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.cut_send
statement:
lemma cut_send {p : Node} (h : l ≤ M) (hp : p.ok M) (hh : M-l ≤ p.lev)
    (P : Law (Grid M)) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a)
    (H : ∀ x, P x ≤ a*p.dice M x) (i : Grid l) :
    P.send (cut h) i ≤ a*p.invlen*side M
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le ((P.send (cut h)).nonneg i) with H0|H0
  · rw [← H0]
    have := p.invlen_pos; have := side_pos M; positivity
  obtain ⟨x,hx,hx'⟩ := (P.send_pos_iff _ _).mp H0
  have he {x : Grid M} (hh : 0 < P x) : x∈p.block M := by
    have H := lt_of_lt_of_le hh (H x)
    rw [dice_apply hp] at H
    by_contra h'
    rw [ite_eq_right h',mul_zero] at H
    exact lt_irrefl _ H
  rw [send_apply, prob_eq]
  have HX := H x
  rw [dice_apply hp,ite_eq_left (he hx'), p.rinv] at *
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single x,ite_eq_left hx,mul_right_comm]
  · nlinarith
  · intro j _ hj; split_ifs with hi
    · by_contra hh'
      have h2 : j∈p.block M := he ((P.nonneg j).lt_of_ne (Ne.symm hh'))
      exact hj (cut_injOn h hp.2 hh h2 (he hx') (hi.trans hx.symm))
    rfl
  simp

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.enclosed_zero
statement: lemma enclosed_zero (s : Finset (Grid M)) (n : ℕ) : enclosed s n 0
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun _ => 0,by simp,by simp⟩

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.enclosed_mem
statement: lemma enclosed_mem (s : Finset (Grid M)) {x : Grid M} (hx : x∈s) : enclosed s 1 x
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun i => if i=x then 1 else 0,fun i hi => ?_,?_⟩
  · dsimp only; split_ifs <;> norm_num
  simp [ite_smul,hx]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.enclosed_neg
statement:
lemma enclosed_neg {s : Finset (Grid M)} {n : ℕ} {x : Grid M} (h : enclosed s n x) :
    enclosed s n (-x)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f,hf,rfl⟩ := h
  refine ⟨fun i => -f i,fun i hi => ?_,?_⟩
  · simpa only [abs_neg] using hf i hi
  simp

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.enclosed_add
statement:
lemma enclosed_add {s : Finset (Grid M)} {n m : ℕ} {x y : Grid M} (h : enclosed s n x)
    (h' : enclosed s m y) : enclosed s (n+m) (x+y)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f,hf,rfl⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨g,hg,rfl⟩ := h'
  refine ⟨fun i => f i + g i,fun i hi => ?_,?_⟩
  · rw [Nat.cast_add]
    exact (abs_add_le _ _).trans (add_le_add (hf _ hi) (hg _ hi))
  simp [add_smul,Finset.sum_add_distrib]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.enclosed_insert
statement:
lemma enclosed_insert {s : Finset (Grid M)} {i x : Grid M} (hi : i ∉ s)
    {n : ℕ} (h : enclosed s n x) (j : ℤ) (hj : |j| ≤ n) :
    enclosed (insert i s) n (x+j•i)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f,hf,rfl⟩ := h
  refine ⟨fun k => if k=i then j else f k,?_,?_⟩
  · intro k hk
    dsimp only
    split_ifs with h
    · exact hj
    · exact hf _ ((Finset.mem_insert.mp hk).resolve_left h)
  · rw [Finset.sum_insert hi]; dsimp only; rw [ite_eq_left rfl,add_comm _ (j • i)]
    congr 1
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k hk => by rw [ite_eq_right (by intro he; exact hi (he ▸ hk))]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.enclosed_sum
statement:
lemma enclosed_sum {α : Type*} [Fintype α] (s : Finset (Grid M)) (X : α → Grid M)
    (h : ∀ x, enclosed s 1 (X x)) :
    enclosed s (Fintype.card α) (∑ i, X i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  suffices HH : ∀ t : Finset α, enclosed s t.card (∑ i∈t, X i) from HH _
  intro t; induction t using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp [enclosed_zero]
  | @insert i t hi ih =>
    rw [Finset.sum_insert hi,Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hi,add_comm t.card]
    exact enclosed_add (h _) ih

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.palace_size
statement: lemma palace_size (s : Finset (Grid M)) (n : ℕ) : (palace s n).card ≤ (2*n+1)^s.card
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let t : Finset ℤ := Finset.Icc (-(n:ℤ)) n
  let f (w : s → (t:Type)) := ∑ i : s, (w i).val • (i:Grid M)
  have hs : palace s n ⊆ Finset.univ.image f := by
    intro i hi
    obtain ⟨g,hg,he⟩ := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).2
    let w (i : s) : t := ⟨g i, Finset.mem_Icc.mpr (abs_le.mp (hg _ i.property))⟩
    refine Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨w,Finset.mem_univ _,?_⟩
    rw [← he,← Finset.sum_attach s]
    simp only [f,w]; rfl
  apply le_trans ((Finset.card_le_card hs).trans Finset.card_image_le)
  simp only [Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fun,Fintype.card_coe]
  have He : t.card = 2*n+1 := by simp [t]; omega
  rw [He]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.spanned_one
statement: lemma spanned_one (s : Finset (Grid M)) : spanned s 1
proof:
:= by
  intro i hi
  have hn : i≠0 := fun he => hi (he ▸ enclosed_zero s 1)
  change fc (fun x => 1) i = 0
  rw [← funext chi_zero_left,fc_chi,ite_eq_right hn.symm]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.fc_real_step
proof:
:= by
  have he (x : Grid M) :
    f x * (↑((c*chi s x).re):ℂ) = 2⁻¹ *
      (c*(f x*chi s x) + (conj c)*(f x * chi (-s) x)) := by
    rw [Complex.re_eq_add_conj,map_mul,chi_neg']
    ring
  simp_rw [he]; rw [fc_lmul,fc_add, fc_lmul,fc_lmul, fc_mul_chi,fc_mul_chi]
  rw [sub_neg_eq_add]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.expand_one_step
statement:
lemma expand_one_step (f : Grid M → ℂ) (c : ℂ) (s i : Grid M) :
    fc (fun x => f x * (1 + (↑((c*chi s x).re):ℂ))) i =
      fc f i + 2⁻¹*(c*fc f (i-s)+conj c*fc f (i+s))
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [mul_add,mul_one,fc_add,fc_real_step]
  ring

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.span_augment
statement:
lemma span_augment {f : Grid M → ℂ} {u : Finset (Grid M)} (h : spanned u f)
    (c : ℂ) (s : Grid M) (hs : ¬ enclosed u 1 s) :
    let g
proof:
:= fun x : Grid M => f x * (1+(↑((c*chi s x).re):ℂ))
    spanned (insert s u) g ∧ fc g 0 = fc f 0 := by
  have hx : s ∉ u := fun h => hs (enclosed_mem _ h)
  intro g
  have ha (i : Grid M) := expand_one_step f c s i
  constructor
  · intro i hi
    have hA : ¬ enclosed u 1 i := by
      intro he
      apply hi; simpa using enclosed_insert hx he 0 (by norm_num)
    have hB : ¬ enclosed u 1 (i-s) := by
      intro he
      apply hi; simpa using enclosed_insert hx he 1 (by norm_num)
    have hC : ¬ enclosed u 1 (i+s) := by
      intro he
      apply hi; simpa using enclosed_insert hx he (-1) (by norm_num)
    rw [ha i,h _ hA,h _ hB,h _ hC]; ring
  · have hs' : ¬ enclosed u 1 (-s) := fun he => hs (by simpa using enclosed_neg he)
    rw [ha 0, zero_add, zero_sub,h _ hs,h _ hs']; ring

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Wire.mark_total
proof:
:= by
  induction w generalizing a with
  | term => simp [expenditure,read,Ex_const,labels]
  | stay s v w ih =>
    rw [fee_stay]
    cases v <;> exact ih h.2 hm
  | spot s u k ih =>
    have hh := h.2.2.1 hm
    have h1 := spotEx u k (fun z _ => (labels p z:ℝ)) hh
    rw [fee_spot _ _ _ hh,h1,← Ex_lmul]
    apply Ex_mono_mem _
    exact fun b hb => ih b (h.2.2.2 _) ((true_mass hh).mp hb)
  | link s v k ih =>
    obtain ⟨he,hh,hx,hk⟩ := h
    have hf := step_true he.1.1 hh he.2 hm
    let P := (step s).probs; let T := s.actor
    let F (b : Bool) := (k b).expenditure (toll p main)
    let L := Wire.link s v k
    let Q (b : Bool) := (s.smaller b).actor
    have ht (b : Bool) (hp : 0 < P b) :
        F b ≤ 2*(Q b).Ex (fun x => (labels p ((k b).read x):ℝ)) :=
      ih b (hk _) ((true_mass hf).mp hp)
    let Y (b : Bool) : Pulse M := ⟨s,v,b⟩
    let B := if v = true ∧ ¬ s.enter then s.norm/s.mass * surcharge s main (p s) else 0
    have hT (b) : toll p main (Y b) = B := rfl
    let x1 (b : Bool) (i : Grid M) : ℝ := ↑(tags p (Y b) ((k b).read i))
    let x2 (b : Bool) (i : Grid M) : ℝ := ↑(labels p ((k b).read i))
    have Hx : T.Ex (fun i => (labels p (L.read i):ℝ)) =
        P.Ex (fun b => (Q b).Ex (x1 b)+(Q b).Ex (x2 b)) := by
      unfold T L; rw [linkEx v k (fun z _ => (labels p z:ℝ)) hf]
      unfold P Q; simp only [labels,Nat.cast_add]
      simp_rw [Ex_add]; rfl
    have H₁ : B ≤ 2*P.Ex (fun b => (Q b).Ex (x1 b)) := by
      have hp1 : 0 ≤ 2*P.Ex (fun b => (Q b).Ex (x1 b)) := by
        apply mul_nonneg (by norm_num)
        exact Ex_nonneg _ fun i => Ex_nonneg _ fun j => by unfold x1; positivity
      dsimp only [B]
      split_ifs with hv
      · obtain ⟨hv,hE⟩ := hv
        cases ha : decide (hazard s main (p s))
        · rw [surcharge,ite_eq_right (of_decide_eq_false ha),mul_zero]; exact hp1
        have hi := of_decide_eq_true ha
        rw [surcharge,ite_eq_left hi,(hazard_rule he.1 he.2 hm hE hi).2.1]
        have Hh : L.Valid a := ⟨he,hh,hx,hk⟩
        apply (mark_chance L Hh hm hE main (p s) hi).trans
        refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_of_eq ?_) (by norm_num)
        unfold prob
        rw [linkEx v k (fun z i => if startMark (p s) z then (1:ℝ) else 0) hf]
        unfold P Q
        congr 1; funext b; refine congrArg (Q b).Ex ?_
        funext i
        unfold x1 tags Y
        simp [hv]
      exact hp1
    rw [fee_link v k _ hf,Ex_add]
    change P.Ex (fun b => toll p main (Y b))+P.Ex F ≤ _
    simp_rw [hT,Ex_const]
    change _ ≤ 2*T.Ex (fun i => (labels p (L.read i):ℝ))
    rw [Hx,Ex_add,mul_add]
    apply add_le_add H₁
    rw [← Ex_lmul]; exact Ex_mono_mem _ ht

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Wire.edge_total
proof:
:= by
  apply le_trans (mark_total main t h hm)
  have H := s.actor.Ex_mono (mark_intervals p t h K hk)
  rw [Ex_add,Ex_lmul,Ex_const] at H
  unfold expenditure
  linarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Wire.extra_ok
statement:
lemma extra_ok (s : Scene M) (n : ℕ) (a : Bool) (h : ReadyAt s) (hn : s.here.lev+n=M) :
    Valid (extra s n) a
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing s a with
  | zero => exact ⟨h,hn⟩
  | succ n ih =>
    have hp : s.here.lev < M := by omega
    refine ⟨h,hp,fun he => False.elim (by simp at he),fun b => ih _ _ ?_ ?_⟩
    · exact ⟨child_ok _ h.1.1 hp b,h.2⟩
    have hh := child_depth s.here b
    change (s.here.child b).lev+n=M; omega

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Wire.extraDebt
statement: lemma extraDebt (s : Scene M) (n : ℕ) : spotDebt (extra s n) = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing s with
  | zero => simp [extra,spotDebt]
  | succ n ih => simp [extra,spotDebt,ih,Ex_const]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Wire.due_all
statement:
lemma due_all (t : Wire M s) (a : Bool) (h : Valid t a) (hm : 0 < s.mass) :
    t.expenditure (due 0) ≤ levels s - s.actor.entropy + t.spotDebt
proof:
:= by
  let unit := fun _ : Grid M => uniform Unit
  have h1 (v : Fork M) (ht : v.TrueLaw) :
      v.probs.Ex (fun b => (v.dst b).actor.entropy) =
        v.src.actor.entropy - v.probs.entropy := by
    have he := conditioned_balance unit v ht
    have hx : sideH v unit = v.probs.entropy := by
      let P := v.src.actor.tensorP (uniform Unit)
      let q := fun i : Grid M × Unit => v.bit i.1
      have HS : P.send q = v.probs := by
        have HH := P.send_send Prod.fst v.bit
        rw [send_fst_tensorP] at HH; exact HH.symm
      have hh : (Prod.snd : Grid M × Unit → Unit)=fun _ => () := rfl
      change P.Hcond q Prod.snd=_
      rw [Hcond_right_partition (Z:=fun _ => ()) _ _ (fun i j => by simp)]
      rw [Hcond_constant, Law.H, HS]
    simp only [unit, privateH_const] at he
    unfold unit at hx; linarith
  induction t generalizing a with
  | term =>
    simp only [spotDebt,expenditure,read,List.map_nil,List.sum_nil,Ex_const]
    have hx := cap_entropy _ h.1.1 h.1.2 hm
    linarith
  | stay s v k ih =>
    rw [fee_stay]
    cases v <;> exact ih _ h.2 hm
  | spot s u k ih =>
    obtain ⟨hs,hS,hv,h⟩ := h
    let v := u.snip
    have hb := hv hm
    rw [fee_spot _ _ _ hb,spotDebt]
    have Hx (b : Bool) (hx : 0 < v.probs b) := ih b _ (h _) ((true_mass hb).mp hx)
    have HH := v.probs.Ex_mono_mem Hx
    have hl (b) : levels (u.dst b)=levels s := by unfold levels; rw [hS]
    rw [Ex_add,Ex_sub] at HH
    simp_rw [hl,Ex_const] at HH
    have h1 := h1 v hb
    change v.probs.Ex (fun b => (u.dst b).actor.entropy) =s.actor.entropy-v.probs.entropy at h1
    unfold v at *; linarith
  | link s v k ih =>
    obtain ⟨hs,hS,hv,h⟩ := h
    let U := step s
    have hb := step_true hs.1.1 hS hs.2 hm
    rw [fee_link v k _ hb,spotDebt]
    have Hx (b : Bool) (hx : 0 < U.probs b) := ih b _ (h _) ((true_mass hb).mp hx)
    have Hh := U.probs.Ex_mono_mem Hx
    simp_rw [due,true_or, ite_true]
    rw [Ex_add]
    simp_rw [signal,Ex_const]
    rw [Ex_add,Ex_sub] at Hh
    simp_rw [levels_child _ hS,Ex_const] at Hh
    have hh := h1 U hb
    change U.probs.Ex (fun b => (s.smaller b).actor.entropy)=s.actor.entropy-U.probs.entropy at hh
    unfold pitch; unfold U at *
    linarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Wire.fork_up
statement: lemma fork_up (u : Update j M s.here) : (Turn.up u).snip = toss s u
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Wire.tape_ok
statement:
lemma tape_ok (t : Road j M s) {f : Grid M → ℝ} (h : Trusted J f t) :
    (tape t).Valid true
proof:
:= by
  have he (s : Scene M) (h : s.Safe j J f) : ReadyAt s := ⟨h.within,h.positive⟩
  induction t with
  | finish =>
    exact extra_ok _ _ _ (he _ h.1) (by rw [Nat.add_sub_of_le h.1.within.2])
  | push s v k ih => exact ⟨he _ h.1,ih h.2.2.2⟩
  | fork s v k ih =>
    have H := branchTrusted h
    obtain ⟨hs,hb,hv,h⟩ := h
    cases v with
    | ask u => exact ⟨he _ hs,fun b => by cases b <;> rfl,fun _ => H,fun b => ih b (h _)⟩
    | move => exact ⟨he _ hs,(rootSafe (h false)).within.2,id,fun b => ih b (h _)⟩

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Wire.debt_like
statement:
lemma debt_like (t : Road j M s) {f : Grid M → ℝ} (h : Trusted J f t) (hm : 0 < s.mass) :
    (tape t).spotDebt = t.flatFee memFee
proof:
:= by
  induction t with
  | finish s b => rw [flat_finish]; exact extraDebt _ _
  | push s v k ih =>
    rw [flat_push]; simp only [memFee,winFee,failFee,zero_add]; apply ih h.2.2.2
    rw [pace_mass]; exact hm
  | fork s v k ih =>
    have hh := flat_fork v k h memFee
    have H := branchTrusted h
    have ht : v.fork.probs.Ex (fun b => (tape (k b)).spotDebt) =
        v.fork.probs.Ex (fun b => (k b).flatFee memFee) :=
        Ex_congr_mem _ fun b hb => ih b (h.2.2.2 b) ((true_mass H).mp hb)
    rw [hh,Ex_add,← ht]
    cases v with
    | move => simp [tape,spotDebt,memFee,winFee,failFee,Turn.fork,Ex_const]; rfl
    | ask u =>
      let P := (toss s u).probs; let v : Procedure.Turn j s := .ask u
      have HE : P.Ex (fun b => memFee (.march s v b))=P.entropy := by
        unfold entropy crossE; congr 1; funext b; cases b <;> simp [memFee,winFee,failFee,surprise,v] <;> rfl
      change P.entropy + P.Ex _ = P.Ex (fun b => memFee (.march s v b))+P.Ex _
      rw [HE]; rfl

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Wire.extra_bill
statement:
lemma extra_bill (s : Scene M) (n : ℕ) (f : Pulse M → ℝ) (h : ∀ e : Pulse M, e.active=false → f e=0)
    (hs : ReadyAt s) (_hm : 0 < s.mass) (hn : s.here.lev+n = M) :
    expenditure (extra s n) f = 0
proof:
:= by
  let t := extra s n
  unfold expenditure
  have he (x : Grid M) :
      ((t.read x).map f).sum=0 := by
    have h1 := faded _ (fades _ (extra_ok s n false hs hn) x)
    apply List.sum_eq_zero
    intro i hi; obtain ⟨j,hj,rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hi; exact h _ (h1 _ hj)
  change _ = _
  change s.actor.Ex (fun x => _) = _
  simp_rw [show (fun x : Grid M => ((read (extra s n) x).map f).sum)=(fun _ => 0) from funext he]
  rw [Ex_const]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Wire.active_charge
statement:
lemma active_charge (F : Pulse M → ℝ) (hF : ∀ i : Pulse M, i.active=false → F i=0)
    (g : Event j M → ℝ) (ha : ∀ s v, g (Event.pace s v)=0)
    (hb : ∀ (s : Scene M) (u : Update j M s.here) b, g (.march s (.ask u) b)=0)
    (hg : ∀ s, 0 < s.mass →
      (step s).probs.Ex (fun b => g (.march s .move b)) =
        (step s).probs.Ex (fun b => F ⟨s,true,b⟩))
    (t : Road j M s) {f : Grid M → ℝ} (h : Trusted J f t) (hm : 0 < s.mass) :
    (tape t).expenditure F=t.flatFee g
proof:
:= by
  induction t with
  | finish =>
    rw [flat_finish]
    exact extra_bill _ _ F hF (Valid.atSrc (tape_ok _ h)) hm (by rw [Nat.add_sub_of_le h.1.within.2])
  | push s v k ih =>
    rw [flat_push,ha,zero_add]
    rw [tape,fee_stay]; exact ih h.2.2.2 (by rw [pace_mass]; exact hm)
  | fork s v k ih =>
    have ht := branchTrusted h
    rw [flat_fork _ _ h,Ex_add]
    have HH : v.fork.probs.Ex (fun b => expenditure (tape (k b)) F) =
        v.fork.probs.Ex fun b => (k b).flatFee g :=
      Ex_congr_mem _ fun i hi => ih i (h.2.2.2 i) ((true_mass ht).mp hi)
    cases v with
    | ask u =>
      change expenditure (.spot s (Turn.up u) _) F = _
      rw [fee_spot (Turn.up u) _ _ ht]
      simp_rw [hb,Ex_const,zero_add]
      exact HH
    | move =>
      change expenditure (.link s true _) F =
        (step s).probs.Ex (fun b => g (.march s .move b))+ _
      rw [fee_link _ _ _ ht,Ex_add,hg s hm]
      congr 1

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.reach_pos
statement: lemma reach_pos (i : ℕ) : 1 ≤ reach i
proof: := by unfold reach; omega

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.gate_pos
statement: lemma gate_pos (main : Bool) (i : ℕ) : 0 < gateWidth main i
proof: := by unfold gateWidth; have := side_pos i; split <;> positivity

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.child_depth
statement: lemma child_depth (p : Node) (b : Bool) : (p.child b).lev=p.lev+1
proof: := by cases b <;> rfl

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.extreme_depth
statement:
lemma extreme_depth (p : Node) (b : Bool) (n : ℕ) :
    (extreme p b n).lev = p.lev+n
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [extreme]
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [extreme,child_depth,ih, Nat.add_assoc]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.extreme_length
statement:
lemma extreme_length (p : Node) (b : Bool) (n : ℕ) :
    (extreme p b n).len = p.len*side n
proof: := by rw [len,extreme_depth,len,side,side,side,pow_add]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.extreme_below
statement: lemma extreme_below (p : Node) (b : Bool) (n : ℕ) : (extreme p b n).below p
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact below_refl p
  | succ n ih => exact below_trans (child_below _ _) ih

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.extreme_valid
statement:
lemma extreme_valid (p : Node) (hp : p.valid) (b : Bool) (n : ℕ) :
    (extreme p b n).valid
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact hp
  | succ n ih => cases b; exact (valid_L _).mpr ih; exact (valid_R _).mpr ih

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.extreme_left
statement: lemma extreme_left (p : Node) (n : ℕ) : (extreme p false n).a=p.a
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    change (extreme p false n).L.a=_
    rw [a_L,ih]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.extreme_right
statement:
lemma extreme_right (p : Node) (n : ℕ) :
    (extreme p true n).a+(extreme p true n).len=p.a+p.len
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    change (extreme p true n).R.a+(extreme p true n).R.len=_
    rw [a_R,len_R]; linarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.strip_depth
statement:
lemma strip_depth (p : Node) (i : ℕ) (b c : Bool) :
    (strip p i b c).lev = p.lev+reach i
proof: := by rw [strip,extreme_depth,child_depth]; have := reach_pos i; omega

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.strip_valid
statement:
lemma strip_valid {p : Node} (hp : p.valid) (i : ℕ) (b c : Bool) :
    (strip p i b c).valid
proof:
:= by
  apply extreme_valid; cases b; exact p.valid_L.mpr hp; exact p.valid_R.mpr hp

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.strip_below_child
statement:
lemma strip_below_child (p : Node) (i : ℕ) (b c : Bool) :
    (strip p i b c).below (p.child b)
proof: := extreme_below _ _ _

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.strip_below
statement:
lemma strip_below (p : Node) (i : ℕ) (b c : Bool) :
    (strip p i b c).below p
proof: := below_trans (strip_below_child _ _ _ _) (child_below _ _)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.strip_length
statement:
lemma strip_length (p : Node) (i : ℕ) (b c : Bool) :
    (strip p i b c).len = p.len * side (reach i)
proof: := by rw [len,strip_depth,len,side,side,side,pow_add]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.surcharge_nonneg
statement:
lemma surcharge_nonneg (s : Scene M) (main : Bool) (i : ℕ) :
    0 ≤ surcharge s main i
proof:
:= by
  unfold surcharge; split_ifs with H
  · exact (gate_pos _ _).le.trans H
  exact le_rfl

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.flank_in
statement: lemma flank_in {p : Node} {i : ℕ} {x : Grid M} (hi : flanked p i x) : x∈p.block M
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u,v,h⟩ := hi
  exact block_of_below (strip_below _ _ _ _) _ h

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.flanked_at
statement:
lemma flanked_at (p : Node) (i : ℕ) :
    spotted (M:=M) (flanked p i) (p.lev+reach i)
proof:
:= by
  intro q he x hx y hy
  unfold flanked
  have Heq (b c) : x∈(strip p i b c).block M ↔ y∈(strip p i b c).block M := by
    apply coarse_const (q:=q) _ hx hy
    rw [he,strip_depth]
  simp_rw [Heq]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.prob_under
statement:
lemma prob_under {p q : Node} (hp : p.ok M) (hh : q.ok M) (h : q.below p) :
    (p.dice M).prob (fun x => x∈q.block M) = q.len/p.len
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [prob_eq]
  calc
    _ = p.len⁻¹*(uniform _).prob (fun x => x∈q.block M) := by
      rw [prob_eq,Finset.mul_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun x _ => ?_
      by_cases hx : x∈q.block M
      · simp only [hx,ite_true,dice_apply hp,ite_eq_left (block_of_below h _ hx),uniform_side,mul_comm]
      simp [hx]
    _ = q.len/p.len := by rw [prob_block hh]; ring

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.flank_prob
statement:
lemma flank_prob (p : Node) (hp : p.valid) (i : ℕ) (he : lanes p i M) :
    (p.dice M).prob (flanked p i) ≤ 4 * side (reach i)
proof:
:= by
  let f (b c : Bool) (x : Grid M) := if x∈(strip p i b c).block M then (1:ℝ) else 0
  let Q := p.dice M
  have HF (b c) : Q.Ex (f b c) = side (reach i) := by
    have hh : (strip p i b c).ok M := ⟨strip_valid hp _ _ _,strip_depth p _ _ _ |>.symm ▸ he⟩
    have hx := prob_under (p:=p) (q:=strip p i b c)
      (show p.ok M from ⟨hp,Nat.le_trans (Nat.le_add_right _ _) he⟩) hh (strip_below _ _ _ _)
    have hy : Q.prob (fun x => x∈(strip p i b c).block M) = Q.Ex (f b c) := by rw [prob_eq]; simp [Ex,f]
    change Q.prob _ = _ at hx
    rw [hy,strip_length] at hx; rw [hx]; field_simp [p.len_pos.ne']
  unfold prob; apply le_trans (b:=Q.Ex fun x =>
    f false false x + f false true x + f true false x + f true true x)
  · apply Ex_mono; intro x
    split_ifs with H
    · obtain ⟨a,b,H⟩ := H
      cases a <;> cases b <;> unfold f <;> split_ifs <;> norm_num
    unfold f; split_ifs <;> norm_num
  · simp_rw [Ex_add,HF]; linarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.hazard_rule
statement:
lemma hazard_rule {s : Scene M} {main : Bool} {i : ℕ} (ha : s.here.ok M)
    (hh : 0 ≤ s.wage) (hm : 0 < s.mass) (ht : ¬ s.enter) (hx : hazard s main i) :
    lanes s.here i M ∧
      s.norm/s.mass * edgeW s i = s.actor.prob (flanked s.here i) ∧
      gateWidth main i / 2 ≤ s.actor.prob (flanked s.here i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  change gateWidth main i ≤ _ at hx
  have hl : lanes s.here i M := by
    by_contra hv; rw [edgeW,ite_eq_right hv] at hx
    exact (gate_pos _ _).not_ge hx
  unfold enter at ht
  have hp : 0 < s.norm := by linarith
  have he : s.norm/s.mass * edgeW s i = s.actor.prob (flanked s.here i) := by
    rw [prob_eq,edgeW,ite_eq_left hl, Finset.mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun x h => ?_
    split_ifs with H
    · rw [actor_def ha hh hm x]
      unfold wt; unfold mass at *
      field_simp
    exact mul_zero _
  refine ⟨hl,he,?_⟩
  rw [← he]
  apply le_trans (b:=1/2*gateWidth main i) (le_of_eq (by ring))
  apply mul_le_mul _ hx (gate_pos _ _).le (by positivity)
  apply (le_div_iff₀ hm).mpr; linarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.cut_wire
statement:
lemma cut_wire (t : Road j M s) (h : Trusted J f t) (hm : 0 < s.mass) (K : ℕ) (hK : K ≠ 0) :
    expenditure (tape t) (due K) = flatFee t likelihood
proof:
:= by
  apply active_charge _ _ _ _ _ _ t h hm
  · intro i hi; unfold due; rw [ite_eq_right]; simp [hi,hK]
  · intro s p; simp [likelihood]
  · intro s v p; simp [likelihood]
  intro s _
  simp only [due,or_true, ↓reduceIte,Pulse.signal]
  change (step s).probs.Ex (step s).whistle = _
  rw [Ex_const,pitch_eq]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.toll_wire
statement:
lemma toll_wire (t : Road j M s) (h : Trusted J f t) (hm : 0 < s.mass) (p : Policy M) (b : Bool) :
    expenditure (tape t) (toll p b) = flatFee t (edgeFee p b)
proof:
:= by
  apply active_charge _ _ _ _ _ _ t h hm
  · intro i hi; simp [toll,hi]
  · intro s v; simp [edgeFee]
  · intro s u v; simp [edgeFee]
  intro s _; rfl

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.global_edges
statement:
lemma global_edges :
    ∀ᶠ j : ℕ in atTop, ∀ M J : ℕ, ∀ f : Grid M → ℝ,
      (∀ x, f x ≤ exp (height j)) →
      let s
proof:
:= beginPlay f true
      ∀ t : Road j M s, Trusted J f t → 1/Thermal.H j ≤ s.mass →
        (∀ p : Policy M, t.flatFee (edgeFee p false) ≤ 1000*height j) ∧
        ∀ i, i ≤ testIx j → t.flatFee (edgeFee (fun _ => i) true) ≤ 10000*limitC*Thermal.H j := by
  filter_upwards [Road.final_coarse, Road.mem_budget,hpoly limitC 1] with j hi hL h
    M J f hF s t hT hM
  let a := Thermal.H j; let d := height j
  have hp : 0 < a := H_pos _
  have he : 1 ≤ a := H_ge _
  have hc : 1 ≤ limitC := by unfold limitC; norm_num
  have hm : 0 < s.mass := lt_of_lt_of_le (by positivity : 0<1/a) hM
  let T := tape t
  have ht : T.Valid true := tape_ok t hT
  constructor
  · intro p
    rw [← toll_wire t hT hm]
    apply le_trans (edge_total p false T ht hm 0 (fun i => Or.inl rfl))
    have hr := rootSafe hT
    let k := fun _ : Grid M => uniform Unit
    have hD : levels s-s.actor.entropy ≤ d+a := by
      have h := local_deficit_dry s (uniform Unit) hr.within hr.positive hm d hF
      unfold deficit at h
      rw [privateH_const] at h
      have HH := log_le_log (by positivity : 0 < 1/a) hM
      rw [one_div,log_inv] at HH
      linarith [log_le_sub_one_of_pos hp]
    have H₁ := due_all T _ ht hm
    rw [show T.spotDebt=t.flatFee memFee from debt_like t hT hm] at H₁
    have HH := (hL M J s f t hT hm).2
    change t.flatFee memFee ≤ limitC*a at HH
    rw [pow_one] at h; change limitC*a≤d at h
    change 128 * expenditure T (due 0)+_≤1000*d
    norm_num; nlinarith
  intro i he'
  rw [←toll_wire t hT hm]
  apply le_trans (edge_total _ true T ht hm (reach i) (fun i => Or.inr le_rfl))
  have H : T.expenditure (due (reach i)) = t.flatFee likelihood := cut_wire t hT hm _ (Nat.ne_of_gt (reach_pos _))
  rw [H]
  have hi := (hi M J s f t hT hM).1
  have hz := (main_bounds _ he').2.1
  unfold reach; push_cast
  change t.flatFee likelihood ≤ 2*limitC *a at hi
  change _ ≤ 19*a at hz
  change _ ≤ 10000*limitC*a
  nlinarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Wire.due_nonneg
statement: lemma due_nonneg (K : ℕ) (e : Pulse M) : 0 ≤ due K e
proof:
:= by
  unfold due; split_ifs; exact signal_nonneg _; exact le_rfl

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Wire.faded
statement:
lemma faded (l : List (Pulse M)) (h : fading l false) :
    ∀ e∈l, e.active=false
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp
  | cons i l ih =>
    obtain ⟨h,hl⟩ := h
    have he : i.active=false := by cases H:i.active <;> simp_all
    rw [he] at hl
    intro j hj; rcases List.mem_cons.mp hj with H|H; exact H.symm ▸ he; exact ih hl j H

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Wire.fades
statement:
lemma fades (t : Wire M s) {a : Bool} (h : t.Valid a) (x : Grid M) :
    fading (t.read x) a
proof:
:= by
  induction t generalizing a with
  | term => trivial
  | stay s v t ih => exact ih h.2
  | spot s u k ih => exact ih _ (h.2.2.2 _)
  | link s v k ih => exact ⟨h.2.2.1, ih _ (h.2.2.2 _)⟩

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Wire.mark_rent
statement:
private lemma mark_rent (l : List (Pulse M)) (i : ℕ) (ht : startMark i l) :
    (reach i:ℝ) ≤ 64 * (((l.take (reach i)).map Pulse.signal).sum)
proof:
:= by
  let n := reach i; let L := l.take n
  let f := fun e : Pulse M => max e.realized 0
  have hf (e) : f e^2 ≤ 4*e.signal := whistle_high _ _
  have hQ (l : List (Pulse M)) :
      ((l.map f).sum)^2 ≤ l.length*(4:ℝ)*((l.map Pulse.signal).sum) := by
    have HH (z : List (Pulse M)) :
        0 ≤ (z.map Pulse.signal).sum ∧
        ((z.map f).sum)^2 ≤ z.length*(4:ℝ)*((z.map Pulse.signal).sum) := by
      induction z with
      | nil => simp
      | cons i z ih =>
        obtain ⟨ha,hb⟩ := ih
        simp only [List.sum_cons,List.map_cons,List.length_cons,Nat.cast_add,Nat.cast_one]
        refine ⟨add_nonneg (signal_nonneg _) ha,?_⟩
        let m := (z.length:ℝ)
        let a := (z.map Pulse.signal).sum
        let b := (z.map f).sum
        change b^2 ≤ m*4*a at hb
        change (f i+b)^2 ≤ (m+1)*4*(i.signal+a)
        have hv : 0 ≤ m := by unfold m; positivity
        have HH : 2*f i*b ≤ 4*(a + m*i.signal) := by
          rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hv with hi|hi
          · have hx : b=0 := by nlinarith
            rw [← hi,hx]; linarith
          have he := hf i
          by_contra! h
          have hX := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left he (by positivity : 0 ≤ m^2)
          have hZ := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left h hi
          nlinarith [sq_nonneg (m*f i-b)]
        nlinarith [hf i]
    exact (HH l).2
  have H (a : List (Pulse M)) : (a.map Pulse.realized).sum ≤ (a.map f).sum := by
    induction a with
    | nil => exact le_rfl
    | cons i a hi =>
      simp only [List.sum_cons,List.map_cons]
      exact add_le_add (le_max_left _ _) hi
  have hx := H L; have he := hQ L
  change ↑n*log 2/2 ≤ (L.map Pulse.realized).sum at ht
  have hn : (0:ℝ)< n := by unfold n; exact_mod_cast reach_pos i
  have hb : (0.5:ℝ) ≤ log 2 := by linarith [log_two_gt_d9]
  let a := (L.map Pulse.signal).sum
  have hh : (L.length:ℝ) ≤ n := by unfold L; simp
  have ha : 0 ≤ a := List.sum_nonneg (by intro i hi; rcases List.mem_map.mp hi with ⟨x,_,rfl⟩; exact signal_nonneg x)
  change (n:ℝ) ≤ 64*a
  change _ ≤ _*4*a at he
  have hE : (n:ℝ)/4 ≤ (L.map f).sum := by nlinarith
  have hY : ((n:ℝ)/4)^2 ≤ (n:ℝ)*4*a := (pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) hE 2).trans (he.trans (by gcongr))
  nlinarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Wire.fades_suffix
statement:
private lemma fades_suffix (l l' : List (Pulse M)) {a : Bool} (h : fading (l++l') a) :
    (∃ b, fading l' b) ∧ ((∃ i∈l, i.active=false) → fading l' false)
proof:
:= by
  induction l generalizing a with
  | nil =>
    refine ⟨⟨a,h⟩,?_⟩; simp
  | cons i l ih =>
    change (_→_)∧fading (l++l') i.active at h
    obtain ⟨hh,hx⟩ := ih h.2
    refine ⟨hh,?_⟩
    rintro ⟨x,hx',hf⟩
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp hx' with H|H; subst x
    · have he (l l' : List (Pulse M)) : fading (l++l') false → fading l' false := by
        induction l with
        | nil => exact fun h => h
        | cons i l ih =>
          rintro ⟨h,h'⟩
          apply ih
          have hh : i.active=false := by cases H : i.active <;> simp_all
          exact hh ▸ h'
      exact he l l' (hf ▸ h.2)
    exact hx ⟨x,H,hf⟩

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Wire.mark_intervals
statement:
theorem mark_intervals (p : Policy M) (t : Wire M s) {a : Bool} (h : t.Valid a)
    (K : ℕ) (hk : ∀ x : Scene M, K=0 ∨ reach (p x) ≤ K) (x : Grid M) :
      (labels p (t.read x):ℝ) ≤ 64*(((t.read x).map (due K)).sum) + K
proof:
:= by
  have hv0 (z : List (Pulse M)) : 0 ≤ (z.map (due K)).sum :=
    List.sum_nonneg (by intro i hi; rcases List.mem_map.mp hi with ⟨x,_,rfl⟩; exact due_nonneg K x)
  have hc : ∀ k : ℕ, ∀ (l : List (Pulse M)), l.length=k → ∀ a, fading l a →
      (labels p l:ℝ) ≤ 64*((l.map (due K)).sum) + K := by
    intro k; induction k using Nat.strong_induction_on with
    | h k ih =>
    intro l hl a ha
    cases l with
    | nil => simp [labels]
    | cons e l =>
      let Z := e::l
      rcases ha with ⟨H,hh⟩
      by_cases ht : e.active=true ∧ startMark (p e.scene) (e::l)
      · let n := reach (p e.scene)
        let U := Z.take n; let V := Z.drop n
        have hE : U ++ V= Z := List.take_append_drop n Z
        have he : V.length < k := by
          have h1 : 0 < n := reach_pos _
          change (e::l).length=k at hl; unfold V Z; rw [List.length_drop]
          simp only [List.length_cons] at *; omega
        have hT : (labels p Z:ℝ) ≤ (U.length:ℝ)+labels p V := by
          have hh (l : List (Pulse M)) :
              labels p (l++V) ≤ l.length+labels p V := by
            induction l with
            | nil => simp
            | cons i l ih =>
              change tags p i (l++V) + labels p (l++V) ≤ _
              have ht : tags p i (l++V) ≤ 1 := by unfold tags; split_ifs <;> omega
              simp only [List.length_cons]
              omega
          have H := hh U; rw [hE] at H
          exact_mod_cast H
        have hx1 := mark_rent (e::l) _ ht.2
        have HX : fading Z a := ⟨H,hh⟩
        rw [← hE] at HX
        obtain ⟨⟨b,hx⟩,hx'⟩ := fades_suffix U V HX
        have hz : (Z.map (due K)).sum = (U.map (due K)).sum + (V.map (due K)).sum :=
          calc
            _ = ((U++V).map (due K)).sum := by rw [hE]
            _ = _ := by simp
        have hn : (U.length:ℝ) ≤ n := by simp [U]
        change (labels p Z:ℝ) ≤ 64* (Z.map (due K)).sum + K
        rw [hz]
        by_cases HH : ∀ y∈U, K=0 ∨ y.active=true
        · have hhi := ih _ he V rfl b hx
          change (n:ℝ) ≤ 64*(U.map Pulse.signal).sum at hx1
          have hQ : U.map (due K) = U.map Pulse.signal :=
            List.map_congr_left (fun i hi => ite_eq_left (HH i hi))
          rw [hQ]
          linarith
        push Not at HH
        obtain ⟨i,hi,hK,hi'⟩ := HH
        have hk : (n:ℝ) ≤ K := by
          exact_mod_cast ((hk _).resolve_left hK : n ≤ K)
        have hi'' : fading V false :=
          hx' ⟨i,hi,by cases H:i.active <;> simp_all⟩
        have hj (l : List (Pulse M)) (hh : ∀ i∈l,i.active=false) : labels p l=0 := by
          induction l with
          | nil => rfl
          | cons i l ih =>
            have he : i.active=false := hh i List.mem_cons_self
            have hV := ih fun i hi => hh i (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hi)
            simp [labels, tags,hV, he]
        rw [hj _ (faded V hi''),Nat.cast_zero] at hT
        linarith [hv0 V,hv0 U]
      have HE : tags p e l=0 := ite_eq_right ht
      have h1 := ih _ (by rw [List.length_cons] at hl; omega : l.length < k) l rfl _ hh
      simp only [labels,HE,zero_add,List.map_cons,List.sum_cons]
      linarith [due_nonneg K e]
  exact hc _ (t.read x) rfl a (t.fades h x)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Wire.spotted_equal
proof:
:= by
  let c := s.here.start M
  have hc : c∈s.here.block M := start_mem h.1.1 h.1.2
  have hh (P : Law (Grid M)) (hp : ∀ x, 0 < P x → x∈s.here.block M) :
      P.prob q = if q c then 1 else 0 := by
    unfold prob
    conv_rhs => rw [← Ex_const P (if q c then 1 else 0)]
    refine Ex_congr_mem _ fun x hx => ?_
    have H := hq _ rfl _ (hp x hx) _ hc
    by_cases hv : q c <;> simp [hv,H]
  exact (hh _ (piece_support h.1 (actor_def h.1 h.2 hm))).trans (hh _
    (fun x hx => (dice_positive h.1).mp hx)).symm

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Wire.present
statement:
private lemma present {s : Scene M} (t : Wire M s) {a : Bool} (h : t.Valid a)
    (hm : 0 < s.mass) (n : ℕ) (hn : s.here.lev+n ≤ M) (q : Grid M → Prop)
    (hq : spotted q (s.here.lev+n)) :
    s.actor.Ex (fun x => fairValue q n (t.read x) x) ≤ (s.here.dice M).prob q
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction t generalizing n a with
  | term s =>
    obtain ⟨hh,he⟩ := h
    have H : n = 0 := by omega
    subst n
    simp only [Nat.add_zero] at hq
    rw [← spotted_equal hh hm _ hq]
    unfold prob; simp only [fairValue,coverL,List.take_zero,List.map_nil,List.sum_nil,
      neg_zero,exp_zero]; exact le_rfl
  | stay s v k ih =>
    cases v <;> exact ih h.2 hm n hn hq
  | spot s u k ih =>
    obtain ⟨ha,h2,hH,hk⟩ := h
    have he := hH hm
    rw [spotEx u k (fairValue q n) he]
    rw [← Ex_const u.snip.probs ((s.here.dice M).prob q)]
    apply Ex_mono_mem
    intro b hb
    have hx := ih b (hk b) ((true_mass he).mp hb) n
      (by rw [h2 b]; exact hn) (by rw [h2 b]; exact hq)
    rw [h2 b] at hx
    exact hx
  | link s g k ih =>
    obtain ⟨ha,hG,hV,hk⟩ := h
    have he : (step s).TrueLaw := step_true ha.1.1 hG ha.2 hm
    cases n with
    | zero =>
      simp only [Nat.add_zero] at hq
      rw [← spotted_equal ha hm _ hq]
      unfold prob; simp only [fairValue,coverL,List.take_zero,List.map_nil,List.sum_nil,
        neg_zero,exp_zero]; exact le_rfl
    | succ n =>
      rw [linkEx g k (fairValue q (n+1)) he]
      let P := (step s).probs
      let V (b) := (s.smaller b).actor
      let Z (b) := fun x => fairValue q (n+1) (⟨s,g,b⟩::(k b).read x) x
      have HE (b : Bool) :
          P b * (V b).Ex (Z b) ≤ (1/2)*(s.smaller b |>.here.dice M).prob q := by
        rcases eq_or_lt_of_le (P.nonneg b) with hi|hi
        · rw [← hi,zero_mul]
          apply mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (prob_nonneg _ _)
        have hP : (s.smaller b).here.lev+n=s.here.lev+(n+1) := by cases b <;>
          simp [smaller,child,L,R,add_comm n,add_assoc]
        have H := ih b (hk b) ((true_mass he).mp hi) n (by rw [hP]; exact hn)
          (by rw [hP]; exact hq)
        have hZ (x : Grid M) : Z b x =
            (2*P b)⁻¹ * fairValue q n ((k b).read x) x := by
          unfold Z fairValue; split_ifs
          · unfold coverL; simp only [List.take_succ_cons,List.map_cons,List.sum_cons, Pulse.realized]
            rw [show -(whistle _ _+_)= -whistle (step s) b + -coverL n ((k b).read x) by
              unfold coverL; ring,exp_add,Real.exp_neg,whistle,exp_log (by change 0< 2* P b; positivity)]
            rfl
          · ring

        rw [funext hZ,Ex_lmul, ← mul_assoc]
        rw [show P b*(2*P b)⁻¹=1/2 by field_simp]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left H (by norm_num)
      change P.Ex (fun b => (V b).Ex (Z b)) ≤ _
      rw [Ex,Fintype.sum_bool]
      apply (add_le_add (HE true) (HE false)).trans
      unfold prob
      rw [dice_child s.here ha.1.1 hG]
      simp only [smaller,child]
      linarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Wire.distance_scale
statement:
private lemma distance_scale (i : ℕ) (main : Bool) :
    exp ((reach i)*log 2/2)*(4*side (reach i)) ≤ gateWidth main i/4
proof:
:= by
  let n := 40+4*i
  have hi : reach i = 2*n := by unfold reach n; omega
  have hE :
      exp (((reach i):ℝ)*log 2/2)*(4*side (reach i)) = 4 * side n := by
    rw [hi,Nat.cast_mul,Nat.cast_ofNat,show 2*(n:ℝ)*log 2/2=log (2^n) by rw [log_pow]; ring,
       exp_log (by positivity : 0 < (2:ℝ)^n)]
    unfold side
    rw [mul_comm 2 n,pow_mul,one_div,inv_pow]
    field_simp
  rw [hE]
  have he : side n = side 40 * side i ^ 4 := by
    unfold n side; rw [pow_add,mul_comm 4 i,pow_mul]
  unfold gateWidth; rw [he]
  have hQ : side i^4 ≤ side i^2 :=
      pow_le_pow_of_le_one (side_pos _).le (side_le _) (by omega)
  have h₂ : side i^2 ≤ side i := by
    simpa using pow_le_pow_of_le_one (side_pos i).le (side_le i) (by omega : 1 ≤ 2)
  split <;> norm_num [side] at * <;> nlinarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Wire.mark_chance
statement:
theorem mark_chance {s : Scene M} (t : Wire M s) {a : Bool} (h : t.Valid a)
    (hm : 0 < s.mass) (ht : ¬ enter s) (main : Bool) (i : ℕ) (hh : hazard s main i) :
    let P
proof:
:= s.actor
    P.prob (flanked s.here i) ≤ 2*P.prob (fun x => startMark i (t.read x)) := by
  obtain ⟨hx1,hx2⟩ := h.atSrc
  obtain ⟨hi,hj,hc⟩ := hazard_rule hx1 hx2 hm ht hh
  let q := flanked (M:=M) s.here i
  let n := reach i; let r := n * log 2/2
  intro P
  have HH := present t h hm n hi q (flanked_at _ _)
  have H₁ := HH.trans (flank_prob _ hx1.1 i hi)
  let f := fun x => fairValue q n (t.read x) x
  let b := fun x => startMark i (t.read x)
  let F (x) := if b x then (1:ℝ) else 0
  have H :
      P.prob q ≤ P.prob b + exp r*P.Ex f := by
    unfold prob
    rw [← Ex_lmul, ← Ex_add]
    refine Ex_mono _ fun x => ?_
    unfold f fairValue
    by_cases h1 : q x
    · simp only [h1,ite_true]
      split_ifs with H
      · have H : 0 ≤ exp r * exp (-coverL n (t.read x)) := by positivity
        linarith
      rw [zero_add,← exp_add]; apply Real.one_le_exp
      change ¬ r ≤ coverL n (t.read x) at H; linarith
    simp only [h1,ite_false]; split_ifs <;> norm_num
  have hT : exp r * P.Ex f ≤ gateWidth main i /4 :=
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left H₁ (exp_nonneg _)).trans (distance_scale i main)
  change gateWidth main i/2 ≤ P.prob q at hc
  change P.prob q ≤ 2*P.prob b
  linarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Fork.pitch_nonneg
statement: lemma pitch_nonneg (q : Fork M) : 0 ≤ q.pitch
proof:
:= by
  unfold pitch; have h := entropy_le_log_card q.probs; simpa [sub_nonneg] using h

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Fork.pitch_eq
statement: lemma pitch_eq (q : Fork M) : q.pitch=q.probs.Ex q.whistle
proof:
:= by
  unfold pitch entropy crossE whistle; rw [Ex_neg,sub_neg_eq_add]
  conv_lhs => lhs; rw [← Ex_const q.probs (log 2)]
  rw [← Ex_add]
  exact Ex_congr_mem _ fun i hi => (Real.log_mul (by norm_num) hi.ne').symm

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Fork.whistle_high
statement:
lemma whistle_high (q : Fork M) (b : Bool) :
    max (q.whistle b) 0 ^2 ≤ 4*q.pitch
proof:
:= by
  let x := q.probs
  have H := bit_cost x
  unfold pitch whistle
  change max (log (2*x b)) 0 ^2 ≤ 4*(log 2-x.entropy)
  apply le_trans (b:=(x false-x true)^2) _ H
  by_cases hi : x b=0
  · simp [hi,sq_nonneg]
  have he := log_le_sub_one_of_pos (mul_pos (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<2)
    ((x.nonneg b).lt_of_ne (Ne.symm hi)))
  have hj : x true+x false=1 := by simpa [Fintype.sum_bool] using x.total
  rw [max_def]
  split_ifs with h
  · simp [sq_nonneg]
  cases b
  · have hE : 2*x false-1=x false-x true := by linarith
    rw [hE] at he; nlinarith
  · have hE : 2*x true-1= -(x false-x true) := by linarith
    rw [hE] at he; nlinarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Pulse.signal_nonneg
statement: lemma signal_nonneg (e : Pulse M) : 0 ≤ e.signal
proof: := pitch_nonneg _

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Wire.Valid.atSrc
statement:
lemma Valid.atSrc {s : Scene M} {t : Wire M s} {a : Bool} (h : t.Valid a) :
    ReadyAt s
proof: := by cases t <;> exact h.1

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Wire.linkEx
statement:
lemma linkEx {s : Scene M} (v : Bool) (k : ∀ b, Wire M (s.smaller b))
    (t : List (Pulse M) → Grid M → ℝ) (h : (step s).TrueLaw) :
    s.actor.Ex (fun x => t ((Wire.link s v k).read x) x) = (step s).probs.Ex (fun b =>
      (s.smaller b).actor.Ex fun x => t (⟨s,v,b⟩::(k b).read x) x)
proof:
:= by
  let f := fun (b : Bool) x => t (⟨s,v,b⟩::(k b).read x) x
  exact (expect_bit h f).symm

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Wire.spotEx
statement:
lemma spotEx {s : Scene M} (u : TossUp s) (k : ∀ b, Wire M (u.dst b)) (t : List (Pulse M) → Grid M → ℝ)
    (h : u.snip.TrueLaw) :
    s.actor.Ex (fun x => t ((Wire.spot s u k).read x) x) = u.snip.probs.Ex (fun b =>
      (u.dst b).actor.Ex fun x => t ((k b).read x) x)
proof:
:= by
  let f := fun (b : Bool) x => t ((k b).read x) x
  exact (expect_bit h f).symm

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Wire.fee_stay
statement:
lemma fee_stay {s : Scene M} (v : Pace) (k : Wire M (s.pace v)) (f : Pulse M → ℝ) :
    (Wire.stay s v k).expenditure f = k.expenditure f
proof: := by cases v <;> rfl

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Wire.fee_spot
statement:
lemma fee_spot {s : Scene M} (u : TossUp s) (k : ∀ b, Wire M (u.dst b)) (f : Pulse M → ℝ)
    (h : u.snip.TrueLaw) :
    (Wire.spot s u k).expenditure f = u.snip.probs.Ex (fun b => (k b).expenditure f)
proof:
:=
  spotEx u k (fun l _ => (l.map f).sum) h

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Wire.fee_link
statement:
lemma fee_link {s : Scene M} (v : Bool) (k : ∀ b, Wire M (s.smaller b)) (f : Pulse M → ℝ)
    (h : (step s).TrueLaw) :
    (Wire.link s v k).expenditure f = (step s).probs.Ex (fun b => f ⟨s,v,b⟩+(k b).expenditure f)
proof:
:= by
  have hh := linkEx v k (fun l _ => (l.map f).sum) h
  simp_rw [List.map_cons,List.sum_cons,Ex_add,Ex_const] at hh
  unfold expenditure
  rw [hh, Ex_add]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.continuous_pdf
statement: lemma continuous_pdf (a : α) : Continuous (fun P : Law α => P a)
proof:
:=
  (continuous_apply a).comp continuous_subtype_val

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.continuous_entropy
statement: lemma continuous_entropy : Continuous (fun P : Law α => P.entropy)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [entropy_formula]
  exact continuous_finsetSum _ fun x _ => Real.continuous_negMulLog.comp (continuous_pdf _)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.continuous_Ex
statement: lemma continuous_Ex (f : α → ℝ) : Continuous (fun P : Law α => P.Ex f)
proof:
:=
  continuous_finsetSum _ fun a _ => (continuous_pdf a).mul continuous_const

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.continuous_prob
statement: lemma continuous_prob (p : α → Prop) : Continuous (fun P : Law α => P.prob p)
proof:
:=
  continuous_Ex _

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.continuous_send_pdf
statement: lemma continuous_send_pdf (X : α → β) (b : β) : Continuous (fun P : Law α => P.send X b)
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [send_apply]; exact continuous_prob _

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.continuous_send
statement: lemma continuous_send (X : α → β) : Continuous (fun P : Law α => P.send X)
proof:
:= by
  refine Continuous.subtype_mk (p:=(fun f : β → ℝ => (∀ x, 0 ≤ f x) ∧ ∑ x, f x = 1)) ?_ _
  exact continuous_pi (fun x => continuous_send_pdf X x)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.continuous_H
statement: lemma continuous_H (X : α → β) : Continuous (fun P : Law α => P.H X)
proof:
:=
  continuous_entropy.comp (continuous_send X)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.continuous_Hcond
statement: lemma continuous_Hcond (X : α → β) (Z : α → γ) : Continuous (fun P : Law α => P.Hcond X Z)
proof:
:=
  (continuous_H _).sub (continuous_H _)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.primal_feasible
statement:
lemma primal_feasible {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (f : Law α → ℝ) (hf : Continuous f)
    (g : Law α → E) (hg : Continuous g)
    (hfc : ∀ P Q t h0 h1, f (mixture P Q t h0 h1) ≤ t*f P+(1-t)*f Q)
    (hgc : ∀ P Q t h0 h1, g (mixture P Q t h0 h1) = t • g P+(1-t) • g Q)
    (hP : ∃ P, g P = 0)
    (C : ℝ) (hC : ∀ L : E →L[ℝ] ℝ, ∃ P, f P + L (g P) ≤ C) :
    ∃ P, f P ≤ C ∧ g P = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let K : Set (E×ℝ) := {x | ∃ P, g P = x.1 ∧ f P ≤ x.2}
  let S : Set ((Law α)×(E×ℝ)) := {z | g z.1 = z.2.1} ∩ {z | f z.1 ≤ z.2.2}
  have hK : K = Prod.snd '' S := by
    ext
    simp [K,S]
  have hs : IsClosed S :=
    (isClosed_eq (hg.comp continuous_fst) continuous_snd.fst).inter
      (isClosed_le (hf.comp continuous_fst) continuous_snd.snd)
  have hkc : IsClosed K := hK ▸ isClosedMap_snd_of_compactSpace _ hs
  have hkv : Convex ℝ K := by
    rintro x ⟨P,h1,h2⟩ y ⟨Q,h3,h4⟩ a b ha hb hab
    have ha' : a ≤ 1 := by linarith
    refine ⟨mixture P Q a ha ha',?_ ,?_⟩
    · rw [hgc,h1,h3,show 1-a=b by linarith]
      rfl
    · change _ ≤ a*x.2+b*y.2
      exact (hfc P Q a ha ha').trans (by rw [show 1-a=b by linarith]; gcongr)
  suffices H : (0,C) ∈ K by
    obtain ⟨P,hp,hq⟩ := H; exact ⟨P,hq,hp⟩
  by_contra hk
  obtain ⟨L,r,ha,hb⟩ := geometric_hahn_banach_point_closed hkv hkc hk
  let l := L.comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ E ℝ)
  let m := L (0,1)
  have hl (x : E) (t : ℝ) : L (x,t) = l x + t*m := by
    have heq : (x,t) = (x,(0:ℝ))+t • ((0:E),(1:ℝ)) := by simp
    rw [heq,map_add,map_smul]; rfl
  have hA : C*m < r := by simpa [hl] using ha
  have hB (P : Law α) : r < l (g P) + f P*m := hl _ _ ▸ hb (g P,f P) ⟨P,rfl,le_refl _⟩
  obtain ⟨P,hgp⟩ := hP
  have hc : C < f P := lt_of_not_ge (fun hh => hk ⟨P,hgp,hh⟩)
  have hm : 0 < m := by
    have hh := hB P
    rw [hgp,map_zero] at hh
    nlinarith
  obtain ⟨Q,hQ⟩ := hC (m⁻¹ • l)
  change f Q + m⁻¹ * l (g Q) ≤ C at hQ
  have HH := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hQ hm.le
  rw [add_mul, mul_comm (m⁻¹ * _), ← mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ hm.ne', one_mul] at HH
  linarith [hB Q]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.kl_ex
statement:
lemma kl_ex (P Q : Law α) :
    P.kl Q = P.Ex (fun x => log (P x) - log (Q x))
proof:
:= by
  unfold kl entropy crossE
  simp only [Ex_sub, Ex_neg]
  ring

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.after_dominated
statement:
lemma after_dominated {P Q : Law α} (h : P.dominated Q) (X : α → β)
    {x : β} (hx : 0 < P.send X x) : (P.after X x).dominated (Q.after X x)
proof:
:= by
  intro a ha
  obtain ⟨rfl, hp⟩ := (after_mem hx).mp ha
  exact Q.after_self_pos X (h a hp)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.kl_chain
statement:
lemma kl_chain {P Q : Law α} (h : P.dominated Q) (X : α → β) :
    P.kl Q = (P.send X).kl (Q.send X) +
      (P.send X).Ex (fun x => (P.after X x).kl (Q.after X x))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp_rw [kl_ex]
  have hA := P.after_Ex_sum X (fun x a => log ((P.after X x) a)-log ((Q.after X x) a))
  rw [hA,Ex_send, ← Ex_add]
  apply Ex_congr_mem
  intro a ha
  have hh (P : Law α) (ha : 0 < P a) :
      log (P a) = log (P.send X (X a)) + log (P.after X (X a) a) := by
    rw [← log_mul (P.send_pos X ha).ne' (P.after_self_pos X ha).ne',
      send_mul_after, ite_eq_left rfl]

  linarith [hh P ha,hh Q (h a ha)]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.kl_data_processing
statement:
lemma kl_data_processing {P Q : Law α} (h : P.dominated Q) (X : α → β) :
    (P.send X).kl (Q.send X) ≤ P.kl Q
proof:
:= by
  rw [kl_chain h X]
  have hh : 0 ≤ (P.send X).Ex (fun x => (P.after X x).kl (Q.after X x)) := by
    rw [← Ex_const (P.send X) 0]
    apply Ex_mono_mem
    exact fun x hx => kl_nonneg (after_dominated h _ hx)
  linarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.tv_nonneg
statement: lemma tv_nonneg (P Q : Law α) : 0 ≤ P.tv Q
proof: := by unfold tv; positivity

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.tv_comm
statement: lemma tv_comm (P Q : Law α) : P.tv Q = Q.tv P
proof: := by unfold tv; simp_rw [abs_sub_comm (P _)]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.tv_common
statement:
lemma tv_common (P Q : Law α) :
    (∑ a, min (P a) (Q a)) = 1 - P.tv Q
proof:
:= by
  have H (a : α) : min (P a) (Q a) = (P a + Q a - |P a - Q a|)/2 := by grind
  simp_rw [H, ← Finset.sum_div, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_add_distrib, Law.total]
  unfold tv; ring

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.tv_le_one
statement: lemma tv_le_one (P Q : Law α) : P.tv Q ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  have hh : 0 ≤ ∑ a, min (P a) (Q a) :=
    Finset.sum_nonneg fun a _ => le_min (P.nonneg _) (Q.nonneg _)
  rw [tv_common] at hh; linarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.tv_data_processing
statement:
lemma tv_data_processing (P Q : Law α) (X : α → β) :
    (P.send X).tv (Q.send X) ≤ P.tv Q
proof:
:= by
  classical
  suffices H : (∑ y : β, |P.send X y - Q.send X y|) ≤ ∑ x : α, |P x-Q x| by
    unfold tv
    exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right H (by norm_num)
  simp_rw [send_apply,prob_eq, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  refine (Finset.sum_le_sum (fun y _ => Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _)).trans ?_
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun x _ => ?_
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (X x)] <;> intros <;> simp_all [eq_comm]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.tv_sq_le_kl
statement:
lemma tv_sq_le_kl {P Q : Law α} (h : P.dominated Q) :
    (P.tv Q)^2 ≤ P.kl Q
proof:
:= by
  let a (x) := √(P x)
  let b (x) := √(Q x)
  have ha (x : α) : (a x)^2 = P x := sq_sqrt (P.nonneg x)
  have hb (x : α) : (b x)^2 = Q x := sq_sqrt (Q.nonneg x)
  have hkl : ∑ x, (a x - b x)^2 ≤ P.kl Q := by
    have H (x : α) :
        (a x - b x)^2 ≤ P x * (log (P x)-log (Q x)) - P x + Q x := by
      obtain hx | hx := eq_or_lt_of_le (P.nonneg x)
      · have hh : a x = 0 := by simp only [a, ← hx,sqrt_zero]
        rw [hh, ← hx]; nlinarith [hb x]
      have hu : 0 < a x := sqrt_pos.mpr hx
      have hv : 0 < b x := sqrt_pos.mpr (h x hx)
      have hh := log_le_sub_one_of_pos (div_pos hv hu)
      rw [log_div hv.ne' hu.ne'] at hh
      have heq (c : ℝ) : log (c^2) = 2*log c := by rw [Real.log_pow]; norm_num
      have hg := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hh (sq_nonneg (a x))
      have he : b x/a x * (a x)^2 = a x * b x := by field_simp
      rw [sub_mul, sub_mul, he] at hg
      rw [← ha x, ← hb x,heq,heq]
      nlinarith
    have hh := Finset.sum_le_sum (s:=Finset.univ) (fun x _ => H x)
    simp only [Finset.sum_add_distrib,Finset.sum_sub_distrib,Law.total,sub_add_cancel] at hh
    rw [kl_ex]; exact hh
  have hab1 : (∑ x, (a x + b x)^2) ≤ 4 := by
    have H (x : α) : (a x+b x)^2 ≤ 2*P x+2*Q x := by
      rw [← ha x,← hb x]
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (a x - b x)]
    have hh := Finset.sum_le_sum (s:=Finset.univ) (fun x _ => H x)
    simp only [Finset.sum_add_distrib,← Finset.mul_sum,Law.total] at hh
    linarith
  have hdiff (x : α) : |P x-Q x| = |a x - b x| * (a x+b x) := by
    rw [← ha x, ← hb x, sq_sub_sq, abs_mul,
      abs_of_nonneg (add_nonneg (sqrt_nonneg _) (sqrt_nonneg _))]
    exact mul_comm _ _
  have hh := Finset.sum_mul_sq_le_sq_mul_sq Finset.univ
    (fun x => |a x-b x|) (fun x => a x+b x)
  simp_rw [← hdiff,sq_abs] at hh
  have hi := mul_le_mul hkl hab1 (by positivity) (kl_nonneg h)
  unfold tv
  nlinarith [hh.trans hi]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.tv_le_sqrt_kl
statement:
lemma tv_le_sqrt_kl {P Q : Law α} (h : P.dominated Q) :
    P.tv Q ≤ √(P.kl Q)
proof:
:= by
  nlinarith [tv_sq_le_kl h, Real.sq_sqrt (kl_nonneg h), Real.sqrt_nonneg (P.kl Q)]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.Cx_ofReal
statement: lemma Cx_ofReal (P : Law α) (f : α → ℝ) : P.Cx (fun x => (f x:ℂ)) = ↑(P.Ex f)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Cx,Ex, Complex.ofReal_sum, Complex.ofReal_mul]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.re_Cx
statement:
lemma re_Cx (P : Law α) (f : α → ℂ) :
    (P.Cx f).re = P.Ex (fun x => (f x).re)
proof:
:= by
  simp [Cx,Ex,Complex.re_sum,Complex.mul_re]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.Cx_mul
statement: lemma Cx_mul (P : Law α) (f : α → ℂ) (c : ℂ) : P.Cx (fun x => f x*c) = P.Cx f * c
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [Cx, ← mul_assoc, Finset.sum_mul]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.Cx_lmul
statement: lemma Cx_lmul (P : Law α) (f : α → ℂ) (c : ℂ) : P.Cx (fun x => c*f x) = c*P.Cx f
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [mul_comm c] using P.Cx_mul f c

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.Cx_conj
statement: lemma Cx_conj (P : Law α) (f : α → ℂ) : P.Cx (fun x => conj (f x)) = conj (P.Cx f)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Cx,map_sum,map_mul,Complex.conj_ofReal]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.Cx_norm
statement: lemma Cx_norm (P : Law α) (f : α → ℂ) : ‖P.Cx f‖ ≤ P.Ex (fun x => ‖f x‖)
proof:
:= by
  unfold Cx
  refine (norm_sum_le _ _).trans ?_
  simp_rw [Ex,norm_mul,Complex.norm_real,Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_nonneg (P.nonneg _)]
  exact le_rfl

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.norm_Cx_unit
statement:
lemma norm_Cx_unit (P : Law α) (f : α → ℂ) (h : ∀ x, ‖f x‖ ≤ 1) :
    ‖P.Cx f‖ ≤ 1
proof: := (P.Cx_norm f).trans ((P.Ex_mono h).trans (P.Ex_const 1).le)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.Cx_swap
statement:
lemma Cx_swap (P : Law α) (Q : Law β) (f : α → β → ℂ) :
    P.Cx (fun x => Q.Cx (f x)) = Q.Cx (fun y => P.Cx (fun x => f x y))
proof:
:= by
  unfold Cx
  simp_rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro i _; apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro j _; ring

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.Ex_swap
statement:
lemma Ex_swap (P : Law α) (Q : Law β) (f : α → β → ℝ) :
    P.Ex (fun x => Q.Ex (f x)) = Q.Ex (fun y => P.Ex (fun x => f x y))
proof:
:= by
  unfold Ex
  simp_rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  simp_rw [mul_left_comm (Q _)]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.Cx_prod
statement:
lemma Cx_prod (P : I → Law α) (f : I → α → ℂ) :
    (pack P).Cx (fun x => ∏ i, f i (x i)) = ∏ i, (P i).Cx (f i)
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [Cx,pack_apply,Complex.ofReal_prod,← Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
  exact (Fintype.prod_sum (fun i x => (P i x:ℂ)*f i x)).symm

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.sq_norm_Cx
statement:
lemma sq_norm_Cx (P : Law α) (f : α → ℂ) :
    ‖P.Cx f‖^2 = P.Ex (fun x => P.Ex (fun y => (f x*conj (f y)).re))
proof:
:= by
  have heq : P.Cx f * conj (P.Cx f) =
      P.Cx (fun x => P.Cx (fun y => f x*conj (f y))) := by
    simp_rw [Cx_lmul,Cx_conj,Cx_mul]
  rw [Complex.sq_norm, ← Complex.ofReal_re (Complex.normSq _),
    ← Complex.mul_conj, heq]
  simp_rw [re_Cx]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.Ex_exp
statement: lemma Ex_exp (P : Law α) (f : α → ℝ) : exp (P.Ex f) ≤ P.Ex (fun x => exp (f x))
proof:
:= by
  let C := P.Ex f
  have H (x : ℝ) : exp C * ((x-C)+1) ≤ exp x := by
    apply le_trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (add_one_le_exp (x-C)) (exp_nonneg _))
    rw [← exp_add]; simp
  have H' := P.Ex_mono (f:=fun x => exp C*((f x-C)+1)) (g:=fun x => exp (f x))
    (fun x => H (f x))
  rw [Ex_lmul,Ex_add,Ex_sub,Ex_const,Ex_const,show P.Ex f=C from rfl] at H'
  simpa only [sub_self,zero_add,mul_one] using H'

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.entropy_formula
statement: lemma entropy_formula (P : Law α) : P.entropy = ∑ x, negMulLog (P x)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [entropy,crossE,Ex,negMulLog,mul_neg,neg_mul]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.entropy_nonneg
statement: lemma entropy_nonneg (P : Law α) : 0 ≤ P.entropy
proof:
:= by
  rw [entropy_formula]
  exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun x _ => negMulLog_nonneg (P.nonneg _) (P.le_one _)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.dominated_refl
statement: lemma dominated_refl (P : Law α) : P.dominated P
proof: := fun _ h => h

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.dominated_send
statement:
lemma dominated_send {P Q : Law α} (h : P.dominated Q) (X : α → β) :
    (P.send X).dominated (Q.send X)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨y,rfl,hy⟩ := (send_pos_iff P X x).mp hx
  exact Q.send_pos X (h y hy)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.entropy_le_cross_aux
statement:
lemma entropy_le_cross_aux (P : Law α) (q : α → ℝ)
    (h0 : ∀ x, 0 ≤ q x) (ht : ∑ x, q x ≤ 1) (h : ∀ x, 0 < P x → 0 < q x) :
    P.entropy ≤ P.crossE q
proof:
:= by
  have H (x : α) :
      P x * (-log (P x)) - P x * (-log (q x)) ≤ q x - P x := by
    obtain heq|hp := eq_or_lt_of_le (P.nonneg x)
    · simpa [← heq] using h0 x
    have he := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (div_pos (h x hp) hp)
    rw [log_div (h x hp).ne' hp.ne'] at he
    have HH := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right he hp.le
    rw [sub_mul, sub_mul, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hp.ne'] at HH
    linarith
  have HH := Finset.sum_le_sum (s:=Finset.univ) (fun x _ => H x)
  simp_rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, P.total] at HH
  unfold entropy crossE Ex; linarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.kl_nonneg
statement: lemma kl_nonneg {P Q : Law α} (h : P.dominated Q) : 0 ≤ P.kl Q
proof:
:=
  sub_nonneg.mpr (entropy_le_cross_aux P Q Q.nonneg Q.total.le h)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.entropy_uniform
statement:
lemma entropy_uniform [Nonempty α] :
    (uniform α).entropy = log (Fintype.card α : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  unfold entropy crossE
  simp_rw [uniform_apply, log_inv, neg_neg, Ex_const]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.entropy_le_log_card
statement:
lemma entropy_le_log_card (P : Law α) :
    P.entropy ≤ log (Fintype.card α : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x,_⟩ := P.mem_nonempty
  have : Nonempty α := ⟨x⟩
  have h : P.dominated (uniform α) := by intro x _; rw [uniform_apply]; positivity
  have hi := kl_nonneg h
  unfold kl crossE at hi
  simp_rw [uniform_apply, log_inv, neg_neg, Ex_const] at hi
  exact sub_nonneg.mp hi

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.entropy_point
statement: lemma entropy_point (x : α) : (point x).entropy = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [entropy, crossE, Ex_point, point_apply, ite_true, log_one, neg_zero]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.H_self
statement: lemma H_self (P : Law α) : P.H (fun x => x) = P.entropy
proof: := by rw [H,send_id]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.H_nonneg
statement: lemma H_nonneg (P : Law α) (X : α → β) : 0 ≤ P.H X
proof: := entropy_nonneg _

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.H_card
statement: lemma H_card (P : Law α) (X : α → β) : P.H X ≤ log (Fintype.card β : ℝ)
proof:
:=
  entropy_le_log_card _

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.H_log
statement:
lemma H_log (P : Law α) (X : α → β) :
    P.H X = P.Ex (fun x => -log (P.send X (X x)))
proof: := by rw [H,entropy,crossE,Ex_send]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.H_congr_mem
statement:
lemma H_congr_mem (P : Law α) {X Y : α → β} (h : ∀ x, 0 < P x → X x = Y x) :
    P.H X = P.H Y
proof: := congrArg entropy (P.send_congr_mem h)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.H_send
statement:
lemma H_send (P : Law α) (X : α → β) (Y : β → γ) :
    (P.send X).H Y = P.H (fun x => Y (X x))
proof: := by rw [H, H, send_send]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.H_partition
statement:
lemma H_partition (P : Law α) {X : α → β} {Y : α → γ}
    (h : ∀ x y, X x = X y ↔ Y x = Y y) : P.H X = P.H Y
proof:
:= by
  have hh (x : α) : P.send X (X x) = P.send Y (Y x) := by
    rw [send_apply, send_apply]
    congr 1
    ext y; exact h _ _
  simp_rw [H_log, hh]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.H_pair_rev
statement:
lemma H_pair_rev (P : Law α) (X : α → β) (W : α → γ) :
    P.H (fun a => (X a, W a)) = P.H (fun a => (W a, X a))
proof:
:=
  P.H_partition (fun x y => by simp [and_comm])

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.H_constant
statement: lemma H_constant (P : Law α) (b : β) : P.H (fun _ => b) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h : P.send (fun _ => b) = point b := by
    apply ext_of_Ex; intro f
    rw [Ex_send, Ex_point, Ex_const]
