  rw [H,h,entropy_point]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.Hcond_constant
statement:
lemma Hcond_constant (P : Law α) (X : α → β) (b : γ) :
    P.Hcond X (fun _ => b) = P.H X
proof:
:= by
  rw [Hcond,H_constant,sub_zero]
  exact P.H_partition (fun x y => by simp)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.Hcond_send
statement:
lemma Hcond_send (P : Law α) (X : α → β) (Y : β → γ) (W : β → η) :
    (P.send X).Hcond Y W = P.Hcond (fun x => Y (X x)) (fun x => W (X x))
proof:
:= by
  unfold Hcond; rw [H_send, H_send]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.H_pair_chain
statement:
lemma H_pair_chain (P : Law α) (X : α → β) (W : α → γ) :
    P.H (fun x => (X x,W x)) = P.H W + P.Hcond X W
proof: := by unfold Hcond; ring

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.Hcond_log
statement:
lemma Hcond_log (P : Law α) (X : α → β) (W : α → γ) :
    P.Hcond X W = P.Ex (fun x => -log ((P.after W (W x)).send X (X x)))
proof:
:= by
  unfold Hcond
  simp_rw [H_log, ← Ex_sub]
  apply Ex_congr_mem
  intro x hx
  have h1 := send_pos P W hx
  have h2 := send_pos _ X (P.after_self_pos W hx)
  rw [joint_after, log_mul h1.ne' h2.ne']
  ring

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.Hcond_after
statement:
lemma Hcond_after (P : Law α) (X : α → β) (W : α → γ) :
    P.Hcond X W = (P.send W).Ex fun w => (P.after W w).H X
proof:
:= by
  rw [Hcond_log]
  simp_rw [H_log]
  exact (P.after_Ex_sum W (fun w x => -log ((P.after W w).send X (X x)))).symm

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.Hcond_nonneg
statement:
lemma Hcond_nonneg (P : Law α) (X : α → β) (W : α → γ) :
    0 ≤ P.Hcond X W
proof:
:= by
  rw [Hcond_after]
  exact Ex_nonneg _ fun w => H_nonneg _ _

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.Hcond_determined
statement:
lemma Hcond_determined (P : Law α) {X : α → β} {W : α → γ}
    (h : ∀ x y, W x = W y → X x = X y) : P.Hcond X W = 0
proof:
:=
  sub_eq_zero.mpr (P.H_partition fun x y => by simp; exact fun hh => h x y hh)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.H_le_of_determined
statement:
lemma H_le_of_determined (P : Law α) {X : α → β} {W : α → γ}
    (h : ∀ x y, W x = W y → X x = X y) : P.H X ≤ P.H W
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := P.Hcond_nonneg W X
  have h2 := P.Hcond_determined h
  rw [Hcond,P.H_pair_rev] at h1; rw [Hcond] at h2; linarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.Hcond_le_H
statement:
lemma Hcond_le_H (P : Law α) (X : α → β) (W : α → γ) :
    P.Hcond X W ≤ P.H X
proof:
:= by
  have H1 : P.H X = (P.send W).Ex fun w => ((P.after W w).send X).crossE (P.send X) := by
    rw [H_log]
    simp_rw [crossE,Ex_send]
    have hh := (P.after_Ex_sum W (fun _ x => -log ((P.send X) (X x)))).symm
    rwa [Ex_send] at hh

  rw [H1,Hcond_after]
  refine Ex_mono_mem _ ?_
  intro w hw
  apply entropy_le_cross_aux
  · exact (send P X).nonneg
  · exact (send P X).total.le
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨a,rfl,ha⟩ := (send_pos_iff _ _ _).mp hx
  exact send_pos _ _ ((after_mem hw).mp ha).2

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.H_associate
statement:
lemma H_associate (P : Law α) (X : α → β) (Y : α → γ) (Z : α → η) :
    P.H (fun x => ((X x,Y x),Z x)) = P.H (fun x => (X x,(Y x,Z x)))
proof:
:=
  P.H_partition (fun x y => by simp [and_assoc])

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.Hcond_chain
statement:
lemma Hcond_chain (P : Law α) (X : α → β) (Y : α → γ) (Z : α → η) :
    P.Hcond (fun x => (X x,Y x)) Z =
      P.Hcond X (fun x => (Y x,Z x)) + P.Hcond Y Z
proof:
:= by
  unfold Hcond
  rw [H_associate]; ring

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.Hcond_after_cond
statement:
lemma Hcond_after_cond (P : Law α) (X : α → β) (Y : α → γ) (Z : α → η) :
    P.Hcond X (fun x => (Y x,Z x)) = (P.send Z).Ex fun z => (P.after Z z).Hcond X Y
proof:
:= by
  have h := P.Hcond_chain X Y Z
  have h2 :
      (P.send Z).Ex (fun z => (P.after Z z).Hcond X Y) =
        P.Hcond (fun x => (X x,Y x)) Z - P.Hcond Y Z := by
    rw [Hcond_after, Hcond_after, ← Ex_sub]
    rfl
  linarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.Hcond_refine
statement:
lemma Hcond_refine (P : Law α) (X : α → β) (Y : α → γ) (Z : α → η) :
    P.Hcond X (fun x => (Y x,Z x)) ≤ P.Hcond X Z
proof:
:= by
  rw [Hcond_after_cond, Hcond_after]
  exact Ex_mono _ fun _ => Hcond_le_H _ _ _

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.Hcond_right_partition
statement:
lemma Hcond_right_partition (P : Law α) (X : α → β) {Y : α → γ} {Z : α → η}
    (h : ∀ a b, Y a = Y b ↔ Z a = Z b) : P.Hcond X Y = P.Hcond X Z
proof:
:= by
  unfold Hcond
  rw [H_partition _ h]
  congr 1
  apply P.H_partition
  intro a b; simp [h]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.Hcond_antitone
statement:
lemma Hcond_antitone (P : Law α) (X : α → β) {Y : α → γ} {Z : α → η}
    (h : ∀ a b, Y a = Y b → Z a = Z b) : P.Hcond X Y ≤ P.Hcond X Z
proof:
:= by
  rw [Hcond_right_partition (Z:=fun x => (Y x,Z x)) P X (fun a b => by simp; exact h a b)]
  exact Hcond_refine P X _ _

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.Hcond_subadd
statement:
lemma Hcond_subadd (P : Law α) (X : α → β) (Y : α → γ) (Z : α → η) :
    P.Hcond (fun x => (X x,Y x)) Z ≤ P.Hcond X Z + P.Hcond Y Z
proof:
:= by
  rw [Hcond_chain]
  gcongr
  exact Hcond_refine P _ _ _

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.entropy_withNext
statement:
lemma entropy_withNext (P : Law α) (k : α → Law β) :
    (P.withNext k).entropy = P.entropy + P.Ex (fun x => (k x).entropy)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [entropy_formula, Ex, Fintype.sum_prod_type, withNext_apply]
  simp_rw [negMulLog_mul, Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.sum_mul, ← Finset.mul_sum]
  simp only [Law.total, one_mul]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.entropy_tensorP
statement:
lemma entropy_tensorP (P : Law α) (Q : Law β) :
    (P.tensorP Q).entropy = P.entropy + Q.entropy
proof:
:= by
  rw [tensorP, entropy_withNext, Ex_const]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.H_tensorP
statement:
lemma H_tensorP (P : Law α) (Q : Law β) (X : α → γ) (Y : β → η) :
    (P.tensorP Q).H (fun x => (X x.1,Y x.2)) = P.H X + Q.H Y
proof:
:= by
  unfold H; rw [send_tensorP, entropy_tensorP]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.pack_apply
statement:
lemma pack_apply (P : ι → Law α) (x : ι → α) :
    pack P x = ∏ i, P i (x i)
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.pack_pos
statement:
lemma pack_pos (P : ι → Law α) (x : ι → α) :
    0 < pack P x ↔ ∀ i, 0 < P i (x i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [pack_apply]
  constructor
  · intro h i
    obtain hx|hx := eq_or_lt_of_le ((P i).nonneg (x i))
    · rw [Finset.prod_eq_zero (Finset.mem_univ i) hx.symm] at h
      exact (lt_irrefl _ h).elim
    · exact hx
  · exact fun h => Finset.prod_pos fun i _ => h i

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.pack_Ex_prod
statement:
lemma pack_Ex_prod (P : ι → Law α) (f : ι → α → ℝ) :
    (pack P).Ex (fun x => ∏ i, f i (x i)) = ∏ i, (P i).Ex (f i)
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [Ex, pack_apply, ← Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
  exact (Fintype.prod_sum (fun i x => P i x * f i x)).symm

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.ext_by_products
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply Law.ext
  intro x
  let f i (a : α) : ℝ := if a = x i then 1 else 0
  have heq (y : ι → α) : (∏ i, f i (y i)) = if y = x then 1 else 0 := by
    split_ifs with H
    · subst y; simp [f]
    · have : ∃ i, y i ≠ x i := by contrapose! H; exact funext H
      obtain ⟨i,hi⟩ := this
      exact Finset.prod_eq_zero (Finset.mem_univ i) (ite_eq_right hi)
  have HH := h f
  simp_rw [heq] at HH
  simpa [Ex, mul_ite] using HH

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.sendPack
statement:
lemma sendPack (P : ι → Law α) (X : ι → α → β) :
    (pack P).send (fun x i => X i (x i)) = pack (fun i => (P i).send (X i))
proof:
:= by
  apply ext_by_products; intro f
  rw [Ex_send,pack_Ex_prod]
  have h := pack_Ex_prod P (fun i a => f i (X i a))
  simp_rw [Ex_send]
  exact h

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.marginalPack
statement:
lemma marginalPack (P : ι → Law α) (i : ι) :
    (pack P).send (fun x => x i) = P i
proof:
:= by
  apply ext_of_Ex; intro f
  let F (j : ι) := if j=i then f else fun _ : α => (1:ℝ)
  have h := pack_Ex_prod P F
  have h1 (x : ι → α) : (∏ j, F j (x j)) = f (x i) := by
    rw [Finset.prod_eq_single i] <;> intros <;> simp_all [F]
  have h2 : (∏ j, (P j).Ex (F j)) = (P i).Ex f := by
    rw [Finset.prod_eq_single i] <;> intros <;> simp_all [F, Ex_const]
  rw [Ex_send]; simp_rw [h1,h2] at h; exact h

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.Ex_pack_proj
statement:
lemma Ex_pack_proj (P : ι → Law α) (i : ι) (f : α → ℝ) :
    (pack P).Ex (fun x => f (x i)) = (P i).Ex f
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Ex_send (pack P) (fun x => x i), marginalPack]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.sendPack_embedding
statement:
lemma sendPack_embedding (P : ι → Law α) (s : τ → ι) (hs : Injective s) :
    (pack P).send (fun x i => x (s i)) = pack (fun i => P (s i))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply ext_by_products; intro f
  let F := extend s f (fun _ _ => 1)
  have h1 (i : τ) : F (s i) = f i := hs.extend_apply _ _ _
  have h2 (i : ι) (hi : i ∉ range s) : F i = fun _ => 1 :=
    extend_apply' _ _ _ hi
  have H (a : ι → ℝ) (h : ∀ i, i ∉ range s → a i = 1) :
      ∏ i, a i = ∏ i, a (s i) := by
    rw [← Finset.prod_image hs.injOn]
    apply (Finset.prod_subset (Finset.subset_univ _) ?_).symm
    intro i _ hi; apply h; simpa using hi
  have h3 (x : ι → α) :
      (∏ i, F i (x i)) = ∏ i, f i (x (s i)) := by
    rw [H]; simp_rw [h1]; intro i hi; rw [h2 i hi]
  have h4 :
      (∏ i, (P i).Ex (F i)) = ∏ i, (P (s i)).Ex (f i) := by
    rw [H]; simp_rw [h1]; intro i hi; rw [h2 i hi, Ex_const]
  have h := pack_Ex_prod P F
  rw [Ex_send,pack_Ex_prod]; simp_rw [h3,h4] at h; exact h

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.crossE_pack
proof:
:= by
  have hh (x) (hx : 0 < P x) : -log (pack Q x) = ∑ i, -log (Q i (x i)) := by
    rw [pack_apply, log_prod, Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
    intro i _
    exact ((pack_pos Q x).mp (h x hx) i).ne'
  unfold crossE
  have hi : P.Ex (fun x => -log (pack Q x)) =
      P.Ex fun x => ∑ i, -log (Q i (x i)) := P.Ex_congr_mem hh
  rw [hi, Ex_finset_sum]
  simp_rw [Ex_send]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.pack_kl
statement:
lemma pack_kl {P Q : ι → Law α} (h : ∀ i, (P i).dominated (Q i)) :
    (pack P).kl (pack Q) = ∑ i, (P i).kl (Q i)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : (pack P).dominated (pack Q) := fun x hx =>
    (pack_pos Q _).mpr fun i => h i _ ((pack_pos _ _).mp hx i)
  simp only [kl,entropy,crossE_pack h1,crossE_pack (dominated_refl (pack P)),marginalPack]
  rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.entropy_pack
statement: lemma entropy_pack (P : ι → Law α) : (pack P).entropy = ∑ i, (P i).entropy
proof:
:= by
  rw [entropy,crossE_pack (dominated_refl (pack P))]
  simp only [marginalPack, entropy]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.entropy_coord_bound
statement:
lemma entropy_coord_bound (P : Law (ι → α)) :
    P.entropy ≤ ∑ i, P.H (fun x => x i)
proof:
:= by
  let Q i := P.send (fun x => x i)
  have hh : P.dominated (pack Q) := fun x hx => (pack_pos Q _).mpr fun i => P.send_pos _ hx
  refine le_trans (b:=P.crossE (pack Q)) (sub_nonneg.mp (kl_nonneg hh)) ?_
  rw [crossE_pack hh]
  exact le_refl _

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.H_vec_le
statement:
lemma H_vec_le (P : Law α) (X : α → ι → β) :
    P.H X ≤ ∑ i, P.H (fun x => X x i)
proof:
:= by
  have h := entropy_coord_bound (P.send X)
  simp only [H_send] at h; exact h

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.Hcond_vec_le
statement:
lemma Hcond_vec_le (P : Law α) (X : α → ι → β) (W : α → γ) :
    P.Hcond X W ≤ ∑ i, P.Hcond (fun x => X x i) W
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [Hcond_after, ← Ex_finset_sum]
  exact Ex_mono _ fun _ => H_vec_le _ _

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.H_vec_pack
statement:
lemma H_vec_pack (P : ι → Law α) (X : ι → α → β) :
    (pack P).H (fun x i => X i (x i)) = ∑ i, (P i).H (X i)
proof:
:= by
  unfold H
  rw [sendPack P X, entropy_pack]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.Hcond_vec_pack
statement:
lemma Hcond_vec_pack (P : ι → Law α) (X : ι → α → β) (W : ι → α → γ) :
    (pack P).Hcond (fun x i => X i (x i)) (fun x i => W i (x i)) =
      ∑ i, (P i).Hcond (X i) (W i)
proof:
:= by
  unfold Hcond
  let Y i x := (X i x,W i x)
  have Heq :
      (pack P).H (fun x => ((fun i => X i (x i)),(fun i => W i (x i)))) =
      (pack P).H (fun x i => Y i (x i)) := by
    refine H_partition _ fun x y => ?_
    simp only [Y, Prod.mk.injEq, funext_iff, forall_and]
  rw [Heq,H_vec_pack P Y,H_vec_pack P W,Finset.sum_sub_distrib]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.pack_withNext
statement:
lemma pack_withNext (P : ι → Law α) (Q : ι → α → Law β) :
    ((pack P).withNext (fun v => pack (fun i => Q i (v i)))).send
      (fun (z : (ι→α)×(ι→β)) i => (z.1 i,z.2 i)) =
      pack (fun i => (P i).withNext (Q i))
proof:
:= by
  apply ext_by_products; intro f
  rw [Ex_send, Ex_withNext]
  have H (x : ι → α) := pack_Ex_prod (fun i => Q i (x i)) (fun i y => f i (x i,y))
  simp_rw [H]
  rw [pack_Ex_prod P (fun i a => (Q i a).Ex (fun y => f i (a,y))), pack_Ex_prod]
  simp_rw [Ex_withNext]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.ext
statement: protected lemma ext {P Q : Law α} (h : ∀ x, P x = Q x) : P = Q
proof:
:=
  DFunLike.ext _ _ h

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.nonneg
statement: protected lemma nonneg (P : Law α) (x) : 0 ≤ P x
proof: := P.property.1 x

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.total
statement: protected lemma total (P : Law α) : ∑ x, P x = 1
proof: := P.property.2

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.mem_nonempty
statement: lemma mem_nonempty (P : Law α) : ∃ x, 0 < P x
proof:
:= by
  by_contra! hh
  have hi : ∑ x, P x ≤ 0 := Finset.sum_nonpos fun x _ => hh x
  rw [P.total] at hi; norm_num at hi

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.Ex_const
statement: lemma Ex_const (P : Law α) (c : ℝ) : P.Ex (fun _ => c) = c
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ex, ← Finset.sum_mul, P.total, one_mul]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.Ex_add
statement:
lemma Ex_add (P : Law α) (f g : α → ℝ) :
    P.Ex (fun x => f x + g x) = P.Ex f + P.Ex g
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [Ex, mul_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.Ex_sub
statement:
lemma Ex_sub (P : Law α) (f g : α → ℝ) :
    P.Ex (fun x => f x - g x) = P.Ex f - P.Ex g
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [Ex, mul_sub, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.Ex_mul
statement:
lemma Ex_mul (P : Law α) (f : α → ℝ) (c : ℝ) :
    P.Ex (fun x => f x * c) = P.Ex f * c
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [Ex, ← mul_assoc, Finset.sum_mul]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.Ex_lmul
statement:
lemma Ex_lmul (P : Law α) (f : α → ℝ) (c : ℝ) :
    P.Ex (fun x => c * f x) = c * P.Ex f
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [mul_comm c] using Ex_mul P f c

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.Ex_neg
statement:
lemma Ex_neg (P : Law α) (f : α → ℝ) :
    P.Ex (fun x => -f x) = -P.Ex f
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [neg_one_mul] using Ex_lmul P f (-1)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.Ex_finset_sum
statement:
lemma Ex_finset_sum {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (P : Law α) (f : ι → α → ℝ) :
    P.Ex (fun x => ∑ i ∈ s, f i x) = ∑ i ∈ s, P.Ex (f i)
proof:
:= by
  unfold Ex
  simp_rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  exact Finset.sum_comm

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.Ex_mono_mem
statement:
lemma Ex_mono_mem (P : Law α) {f g : α → ℝ}
    (h : ∀ x, 0 < P x → f x ≤ g x) : P.Ex f ≤ P.Ex g
proof:
:= by
  refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun x _ => ?_
  obtain hP | hP := eq_or_lt_of_le (P.nonneg x)
  · rw [← hP, zero_mul, zero_mul]
  · exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (h x hP) hP.le

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.Ex_mono
statement:
lemma Ex_mono (P : Law α) {f g : α → ℝ}
    (h : ∀ x, f x ≤ g x) : P.Ex f ≤ P.Ex g
proof: := P.Ex_mono_mem fun x _ => h x

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.Ex_nonneg
statement: lemma Ex_nonneg (P : Law α) {f : α → ℝ} (h : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x) : 0 ≤ P.Ex f
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [Ex_const] using P.Ex_mono h

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.Ex_congr_mem
statement:
lemma Ex_congr_mem (P : Law α) {f g : α → ℝ}
    (h : ∀ x, 0 < P x → f x = g x) : P.Ex f = P.Ex g
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (P.Ex_mono_mem fun x hx => (h x hx).le)
    (P.Ex_mono_mem fun x hx => (h x hx).ge)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.exists_le_Ex
statement: lemma exists_le_Ex (P : Law α) (f : α → ℝ) : ∃ x, 0 < P x ∧ f x ≤ P.Ex f
proof:
:= by
  by_contra! hh
  obtain ⟨a,ha⟩ := P.mem_nonempty
  have H : P.Ex (fun _ => P.Ex f) < P.Ex f := by
    refine Finset.sum_lt_sum (fun x _ => ?_) ⟨a,Finset.mem_univ _,?_⟩
    · obtain hP | hP := eq_or_lt_of_le (P.nonneg x)
      · rw [← hP,zero_mul,zero_mul]
      · exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hh x hP).le hP.le
    · exact mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left (hh a ha) ha
  rw [Ex_const] at H
  exact (lt_irrefl _ H)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.exists_Ex_le
statement: lemma exists_Ex_le (P : Law α) (f : α → ℝ) : ∃ x, 0 < P x ∧ P.Ex f ≤ f x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x,hx,h⟩ := P.exists_le_Ex fun x => -f x
  exact ⟨x,hx, by simpa only [Ex_neg, neg_le_neg_iff] using h⟩

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.prob_eq
statement:
lemma prob_eq (P : Law α) (p : α → Prop) [DecidablePred p] :
    P.prob p = ∑ x, if p x then P x else 0
proof: := by simp only [prob, Ex, mul_ite, mul_one, mul_zero]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.prob_nonneg
statement: lemma prob_nonneg (P : Law α) (p : α → Prop) : 0 ≤ P.prob p
proof:
:=
  Ex_nonneg P (fun x => by split_ifs <;> norm_num)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.prob_le_one
statement: lemma prob_le_one (P : Law α) (p : α → Prop) : P.prob p ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  refine le_trans (b:=P.Ex fun _ => 1) (Ex_mono P fun x => ?_) (P.Ex_const 1).le
  split_ifs <;> norm_num

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.mem_le_prob
statement: lemma mem_le_prob (P : Law α) {p : α → Prop} {x} (h : p x) : P x ≤ P.prob p
proof:
:= by
  rw [prob_eq]
  let f (x : α) := if p x then P x else 0
  have h' (x) : 0 ≤ f x := by unfold f; split_ifs with H; exact P.nonneg _; exact le_rfl
  change P x ≤ ∑ y, f y
  rw [show P x = f x from (ite_eq_left h).symm]
  exact Finset.single_le_sum (fun x _ => h' x) (Finset.mem_univ _)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.prob_pos_iff
statement:
lemma prob_pos_iff (P : Law α) (p : α → Prop) :
    0 < P.prob p ↔ ∃ x, p x ∧ 0 < P x
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro ha
    by_contra! h
    rw [prob_eq] at ha
    refine (not_lt_of_ge (Finset.sum_nonpos fun x _ => ?_) ha)
    split_ifs with hh; exact h _ hh; exact le_rfl
  · rintro ⟨x,hx,h⟩; exact lt_of_lt_of_le h (mem_le_prob P hx)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.prob_single
statement: lemma prob_single (P : Law α) (x : α) : P.prob (· = x) = P x
proof: := by simp [prob_eq]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.prob_compl
statement: lemma prob_compl (P : Law α) (p : α → Prop) : P.prob (fun x => ¬ p x) = 1 - P.prob p
proof:
:= by
  unfold prob
  calc
    _ = P.Ex (fun x => 1-(if p x then 1 else 0)) := by congr 1; funext x; split_ifs <;> simp_all
    _ = _ := by rw [Ex_sub (f:=fun _ => 1), Ex_const]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.ext_of_Ex
statement: lemma ext_of_Ex {P Q : Law α} (h : ∀ f : α → ℝ, P.Ex f = Q.Ex f) : P = Q
proof:
:= by
  apply Law.ext; intro x
  have H := h (fun a => if a=x then 1 else 0)
  change P.prob (· = x) = Q.prob (· = x) at H
  simpa only [prob_single] using H

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.point_apply
statement:
lemma point_apply (x y : α) [DecidableEq α] :
    point x y = (if y=x then 1 else 0)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  change (point x).val y = _
  by_cases h : y = x <;> simp [point, h]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.Ex_point
statement: @[simp] lemma Ex_point (x : α) (f : α → ℝ) : (point x).Ex f = f x
proof:
:= by
  simp [Ex, point_apply]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.uniform_apply
statement: lemma uniform_apply [Nonempty α] (x : α) : uniform α x = (Fintype.card α : ℝ)⁻¹
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.through_apply
statement: lemma through_apply (P : Law α) (k : α → Law β) (y) : P.through k y = P.Ex (fun x => k x y)
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.Ex_through
statement:
lemma Ex_through (P : Law α) (k : α → Law β) (f : β → ℝ) :
    (P.through k).Ex f = P.Ex (fun x => (k x).Ex f)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ex]
  simp_rw [through_apply, ← Ex_mul, ← Ex_finset_sum]
  rfl

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.withNext_apply
statement:
lemma withNext_apply (P : Law α) (k : α → Law β) (a : α) (b : β) :
    P.withNext k (a,b) = P a * k a b
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.Ex_withNext
statement:
lemma Ex_withNext (P : Law α) (k : α → Law β) (f : α × β → ℝ) :
    (P.withNext k).Ex f = P.Ex (fun x => (k x).Ex (fun y => f (x,y)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ex,Fintype.sum_prod_type]
  simp only [Ex, withNext_apply, mul_assoc, Finset.mul_sum]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.tensorP_apply
statement:
lemma tensorP_apply (P : Law α) (Q : Law β) (a : α) (b : β) :
    P.tensorP Q (a,b) = P a * Q b
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.Ex_tensorP
statement:
lemma Ex_tensorP (P : Law α) (Q : Law β) (f : α × β → ℝ) :
    (P.tensorP Q).Ex f = P.Ex fun x => Q.Ex fun y => f (x,y)
proof:
:=
  Ex_withNext _ _ _

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.send_apply
statement: lemma send_apply (P : Law α) (X : α → β) (y) : P.send X y = P.prob (fun x => X x = y)
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [send, through_apply, point_apply, prob, eq_comm]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.Ex_send
statement:
lemma Ex_send (P : Law α) (X : α → β) (f : β → ℝ) :
    (P.send X).Ex f = P.Ex fun x => f (X x)
proof: := by simp_rw [send, Ex_through, Ex_point]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.send_send
statement:
lemma send_send (P : Law α) (X : α → β) (Y : β → γ) :
    (P.send X).send Y = P.send (fun x => Y (X x))
proof:
:= by
  apply ext_of_Ex; intro f; simp_rw [Ex_send]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.send_id
statement: @[simp] lemma send_id (P : Law α) : P.send (fun x => x) = P
proof:
:= by
  apply ext_of_Ex; intro f; exact Ex_send _ _ _

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.le_send
statement: lemma le_send (P : Law α) (X : α → β) (x) : P x ≤ P.send X (X x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [send_apply]; exact mem_le_prob P (p:=fun y => X y = X x) rfl

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.send_pos
statement:
lemma send_pos (P : Law α) (X : α → β) {x} (h : 0 < P x) :
    0 < P.send X (X x)
proof: := lt_of_lt_of_le h (le_send P X x)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.send_pos_iff
statement:
lemma send_pos_iff (P : Law α) (X : α → β) (y) :
    0 < P.send X y ↔ ∃ x, X x = y ∧ 0 < P x
proof: := by rw [send_apply]; apply prob_pos_iff

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.send_congr_mem
statement:
lemma send_congr_mem (P : Law α) {X Y : α → β} (h : ∀ x, 0 < P x → X x = Y x) :
    P.send X = P.send Y
proof:
:= by
  apply ext_of_Ex; intro f
  rw [Ex_send,Ex_send]
  exact Ex_congr_mem _ fun x hx => congrArg f (h x hx)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.send_fst_withNext
statement:
lemma send_fst_withNext (P : Law α) (k : α → Law β) :
    (P.withNext k).send Prod.fst = P
proof:
:= by
  apply ext_of_Ex; intro f
  simp_rw [Ex_send,Ex_withNext,Ex_const]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.send_snd_withNext
statement:
lemma send_snd_withNext (P : Law α) (k : α → Law β) :
    (P.withNext k).send Prod.snd = P.through k
proof:
:= by
  apply ext_of_Ex; intro f
  simp_rw [Ex_send,Ex_withNext,Ex_through]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.send_tensorP
statement:
lemma send_tensorP (P : Law α) (Q : Law β) (X : α → γ) (Y : β → η) :
    (P.tensorP Q).send (fun p => (X p.1, Y p.2)) = (P.send X).tensorP (Q.send Y)
proof:
:= by
  apply ext_of_Ex; intro f
  simp_rw [Ex_tensorP, Ex_send, Ex_tensorP]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.send_fst_tensorP
statement:
lemma send_fst_tensorP (P : Law α) (Q : Law β) :
    (P.tensorP Q).send Prod.fst = P
proof: := send_fst_withNext _ _

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.send_snd_tensorP
statement:
lemma send_snd_tensorP (P : Law α) (Q : Law β) :
    (P.tensorP Q).send Prod.snd = Q
proof:
:= by
  apply ext_of_Ex; intro f
  simp_rw [Ex_send,Ex_tensorP,Ex_const]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.condP_pos_apply
statement:
lemma condP_pos_apply (P : Law α) (p : α → Prop) [DecidablePred p]
    (hp : 0 < P.prob p) (x : α) :
    P.condP p x = (if p x then P x else 0) / P.prob p
proof:
:= by
  unfold condP
  rw [dite_eq_left hp]
  change @ite ℝ (p x) (Classical.propDecidable (p x)) (P x) 0 / P.prob p = _
  by_cases H : p x <;> simp [H]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.prob_mul_condP
statement:
lemma prob_mul_condP (P : Law α) (p : α → Prop) [DecidablePred p] (x : α) :
    P.prob p * P.condP p x = if p x then P x else 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain H|H := eq_or_lt_of_le (P.prob_nonneg p)
  · rw [← H, zero_mul]
    split_ifs with h
    · exact (P.nonneg _).antisymm ((mem_le_prob P h).trans H.ge)
    · rfl
  · rw [condP_pos_apply P p H]
    field_simp

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.condP_mem
statement:
lemma condP_mem {P : Law α} {p : α → Prop} (hp : 0 < P.prob p) {x : α} :
    0 < P.condP p x ↔ p x ∧ 0 < P x
proof:
:= by
  rw [condP_pos_apply P _ hp, lt_div_iff₀ hp, zero_mul]
  split_ifs <;> simp_all

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.prob_mul_Ex_condP
statement:
lemma prob_mul_Ex_condP (P : Law α) (p : α → Prop) [DecidablePred p] (f : α → ℝ) :
    P.prob p * (P.condP p).Ex f = P.Ex fun x => if p x then f x else 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold Ex
  rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  simp only [← mul_assoc, prob_mul_condP, ite_mul, mul_ite, mul_zero, zero_mul]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.send_mul_after
statement:
lemma send_mul_after (P : Law α) (W : α → β) [DecidableEq β] (b : β) (x : α) :
    P.send W b * P.after W b x = if W x = b then P x else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [send_apply]
  exact prob_mul_condP _ _ _

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.after_mem
statement:
lemma after_mem {P : Law α} {W : α → β} {b : β} (h : 0 < P.send W b) {x : α} :
    0 < P.after W b x ↔ W x = b ∧ 0 < P x
proof:
:=
  condP_mem (by rwa [send_apply] at h)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.after_self_pos
statement:
lemma after_self_pos (P : Law α) (W : α → β) {x : α} (hx : 0 < P x) :
    0 < P.after W (W x) x
proof: := (after_mem (P.send_pos W hx)).mpr ⟨rfl,hx⟩

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.after_Ex_sum
statement:
lemma after_Ex_sum (P : Law α) (W : α → β) (f : β → α → ℝ) :
    (P.send W).Ex (fun w => (P.after W w).Ex (f w)) =
      P.Ex fun x => f (W x) x
proof:
:= by
  unfold Ex
  simp_rw [Finset.mul_sum, ← mul_assoc, send_mul_after]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro x _
  simp [ite_mul]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.through_after
statement:
lemma through_after (P : Law α) (W : α → β) :
    (P.send W).through (P.after W) = P
proof:
:= by
  apply ext_of_Ex
  intro f
  rw [Ex_through]
  exact P.after_Ex_sum W (fun _ => f)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.joint_after
statement:
lemma joint_after (P : Law α) (X : α → β) (W : α → γ) (x w) :
    P.send (fun a => (X a, W a)) (x,w) = P.send W w * ((P.after W w).send X x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [send_apply P, send_apply (after _ _ _)]
  simp_rw [prob_eq, Finset.mul_sum, mul_ite, mul_zero, send_mul_after]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => ?_
  simp only [Prod.mk.injEq]
  split_ifs <;> simp_all

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.after_send_eq_of_send_pair_eq
proof:
:= by
  have H1 := congrArg (fun p : Law (β × γ) => p.send Prod.fst) h
  have H2 := congrArg (fun p : Law (β × γ) => p.send Prod.snd) h
  simp only [send_send] at H1 H2
  by_cases hh : 0 < P.send W w
  · apply Law.ext; intro x
    have he : P.send W w * (P.after W w).send X x =
        Q.send V w * (Q.after V w).send Y x := by rw [← joint_after, ← joint_after, h]
    rw [← H2] at he
    exact mul_left_cancel₀ hh.ne' he
  · have hh' : ¬ 0 < Q.send V w := by rwa [← H2]
    rw [send_apply] at hh hh'
    simp only [after, condP, dite_eq_right hh, dite_eq_right hh', H1]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.mixture_apply
statement:
lemma mixture_apply (P Q : Law α) (t : ℝ) (h0 : 0 ≤ t) (h1 : t ≤ 1) (x : α) :
    mixture P Q t h0 h1 x = t * P x + (1-t)*Q x
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.mixture_Ex
statement:
lemma mixture_Ex (P Q : Law α) (t : ℝ) (h0 : 0 ≤ t) (h1 : t ≤ 1) (f : α → ℝ) :
    (mixture P Q t h0 h1).Ex f = t * P.Ex f + (1-t) * Q.Ex f
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [Ex,mixture_apply, add_mul,mul_assoc,Finset.sum_add_distrib,Finset.mul_sum]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.le_one
statement: lemma le_one (P : Law α) (x : α) : P x ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  calc
    P x ≤ ∑ y, P y := Finset.single_le_sum (fun y _ => P.nonneg y) (Finset.mem_univ x)
    _ = 1 := P.total

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.proportional_apply
statement:
lemma proportional_apply (w : α → ℝ) (hw : ∀ x, 0 ≤ w x) (ht : 0 < ∑ x, w x) (x) :
    proportional w hw ht x = w x / ∑ y, w y
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.send_withNext
statement:
lemma send_withNext (P : Law α) (Q : α → Law β) (X : α → β → γ) :
    (P.withNext Q).send (fun (z : α × β) => (z.1, X z.1 z.2)) =
      P.withNext (fun i => (Q i).send (X i))
proof:
:= by
  apply ext_of_Ex; intro f
  simp_rw [Ex_withNext,Ex_send,Ex_withNext]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.H_withNext
statement:
lemma H_withNext (P : Law α) (Q : α → Law β) (X : α → β → γ) :
    (P.withNext Q).H (fun (z : α × β) => (z.1, X z.1 z.2)) =
      P.entropy + P.Ex (fun i => (Q i).H (X i))
proof:
:= by
  unfold H
  rw [send_withNext, entropy_withNext]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.Hcond_withNext
statement:
lemma Hcond_withNext (P : Law α) (Q : α → Law β) (X : α → β → γ) (W : α → β → η) :
    (P.withNext Q).Hcond (fun z => X z.1 z.2) (fun z => (z.1,W z.1 z.2)) =
      P.Ex fun i => (Q i).Hcond (X i) (W i)
proof:
:= by
  unfold Hcond
  let R := P.withNext Q
  have H : R.H (fun z => ((X z.1 z.2),z.1,W z.1 z.2)) =
      R.H (fun z => (z.1,X z.1 z.2,W z.1 z.2)) :=
    R.H_partition fun x y => by simp [and_left_comm]
  change R.H _ - R.H _ = _
  rw [H]
  unfold R
  rw [H_withNext P Q (fun i x => (X i x,W i x)), H_withNext P Q W,
    Ex_sub]; ring

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.Hcond_withNext'
statement:
lemma Hcond_withNext' (P : Law α) (Q : α → Law β) (X : α → β → γ) :
    (P.withNext Q).Hcond (fun z => X z.1 z.2) Prod.fst =
      P.Ex fun i => (Q i).H (X i)
proof:
:= by
  have h := Hcond_withNext P Q X (fun _ _ => ())
  rw [Hcond_right_partition _ _ (Z:=Prod.fst) (by simp)] at h
  simpa only [Hcond_constant] using h

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.Hcond_through
statement:
lemma Hcond_through (P : Law α) (Q : α → Law β) (X : β → γ) (W : β → η) :
    P.Ex (fun a => (Q a).Hcond X W) ≤ (P.through Q).Hcond X W
proof:
:= by
  rw [← send_snd_withNext, Hcond_send,
    ← Hcond_withNext P Q (fun _ => X) (fun _ => W)]
  exact Hcond_refine _ _ Prod.fst _

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.H_through_ge
statement:
lemma H_through_ge (P : Law α) (Q : α → Law β) (X : β → γ) :
    P.Ex (fun a => (Q a).H X) ≤ (P.through Q).H X
proof:
:= by
  rw [← send_snd_withNext, H_send,
    ← Hcond_withNext' P Q (fun _ => X)]
  exact Hcond_le_H _ _ _

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.H_through_le
statement:
lemma H_through_le (P : Law α) (Q : α → Law β) (X : β → γ) :
    (P.through Q).H X ≤ P.entropy + P.Ex (fun a => (Q a).H X)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← H_withNext P Q (fun _ => X), ← send_snd_withNext, H_send]
  exact H_le_of_determined _ (by simp)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.coinP_Ex
statement:
lemma coinP_Ex (t : ℝ) (h0 : 0 ≤ t) (h1 : t ≤ 1) (f : Bool → ℝ) :
    (coinP t h0 h1).Ex f = t*f true+(1-t)*f false
proof:
:= by
  rw [coinP, mixture_Ex, Ex_point, Ex_point]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.coinP_entropy
statement:
lemma coinP_entropy (t : ℝ) (h0 : 0 ≤ t) (h1 : t ≤ 1) :
    (coinP t h0 h1).entropy ≤ log 2
proof: := by simpa using entropy_le_log_card (coinP t h0 h1)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.mixture_eq_through
statement:
lemma mixture_eq_through (P Q : Law α) (t : ℝ) (h0 : 0 ≤ t) (h1 : t ≤ 1) :
    mixture P Q t h0 h1 = (coinP t h0 h1).through (fun b => if b then P else Q)
proof:
:= by
  apply ext_of_Ex; intro f
  rw [Ex_through,mixture_Ex,coinP_Ex]
  rfl

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.H_mixture_ge
statement:
lemma H_mixture_ge (P Q : Law α) (t : ℝ) (h0 : 0 ≤ t) (h1 : t ≤ 1) (X : α → β) :
    t*(P.H X)+(1-t)*(Q.H X) ≤ (mixture P Q t h0 h1).H X
proof:
:= by
  rw [mixture_eq_through]
  have h := H_through_ge (coinP t h0 h1) (fun b => if b then P else Q) X
  rwa [coinP_Ex] at h

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.Hcond_mixture_ge
statement:
lemma Hcond_mixture_ge (P Q : Law α) (t : ℝ) (h0 : 0 ≤ t) (h1 : t ≤ 1)
    (X : α → β) (W : α → γ) :
    t*(P.Hcond X W)+(1-t)*(Q.Hcond X W) ≤ (mixture P Q t h0 h1).Hcond X W
proof:
:= by
  rw [mixture_eq_through]
  have h := Hcond_through (coinP t h0 h1) (fun b => if b then P else Q) X W
  rwa [coinP_Ex] at h

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.entropy_mixture_le
statement:
lemma entropy_mixture_le (P Q : Law α) (t : ℝ) (h0 : 0 ≤ t) (h1 : t ≤ 1) :
    (mixture P Q t h0 h1).entropy ≤ log 2 + (t*P.entropy+(1-t)*Q.entropy)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mixture_eq_through, ← H_self]
  let C := coinP t h0 h1
  let f (b : Bool) := if b then P else Q
  refine (H_through_le C f (fun x => x)).trans ?_
  dsimp only [C]
  rw [coinP_Ex]
  simp only [f, H_self]; norm_num
  exact coinP_entropy _ _ _

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.entropy_mixture_ge
statement:
lemma entropy_mixture_ge (P Q : Law α) (t : ℝ) (h0 : 0 ≤ t) (h1 : t ≤ 1) :
    t*P.entropy+(1-t)*Q.entropy ≤ (mixture P Q t h0 h1).entropy
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [H_self] using H_mixture_ge P Q t h0 h1 (fun x => x)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.entropy_le_log_size
statement:
lemma entropy_le_log_size (P : Law α) (s : Finset α)
    (h : ∀ x, 0 < P x → x ∈ s) : P.entropy ≤ log (s.card : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let q (x : α) := if x ∈ s then (s.card:ℝ)⁻¹ else 0
  have hs : 0 < (s.card:ℝ) := by
    obtain ⟨x,hx⟩ := P.mem_nonempty
    exact_mod_cast (Finset.card_pos.mpr ⟨x,h x hx⟩)
  have H : P.entropy ≤ P.crossE q := by
    apply entropy_le_cross_aux
    · intro x; dsimp only [q]; split_ifs <;> positivity
    · rw [← Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ s) (by intros i _ hi; simp [q,hi])]
      rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun x (hx : x ∈ s) => ite_eq_left hx : ∀ x ∈ s, q x = (s.card:ℝ)⁻¹)]
      simp [ne_of_gt hs]
    · intro x hx
      dsimp only [q]; rw [ite_eq_left (h x hx)]; positivity
  refine H.trans (le_of_eq ?_)
  unfold crossE
  calc
    _ = P.Ex (fun _ => log (s.card:ℝ)) := P.Ex_congr_mem fun x hx => by
      simp only [q, ite_eq_left (h x hx), log_inv, neg_neg]
    _ = _ := P.Ex_const _

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.entropy_le_of_tv
statement:
theorem entropy_le_of_tv (P Q : Law α) (s : Finset α)
    (h : ∀ x, 0 < P x → x ∈ s) :
    P.entropy ≤ Q.entropy + (log 2 + P.tv Q * log (s.card:ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  let t := P.tv Q
  have h0 : 0 ≤ t := tv_nonneg _ _
  have h1 : t ≤ 1 := tv_le_one _ _
  let a (x : α) := min (P x) (Q x)
  have ht : ∑ x, a x = 1-t := P.tv_common Q
  have ha (x : α) : 0 ≤ a x := le_min (P.nonneg x) (Q.nonneg x)
  have hpl (x : α) : 0 ≤ P x - a x := sub_nonneg.mpr (min_le_left _ _)
  have hql (x : α) : 0 ≤ Q x - a x := sub_nonneg.mpr (min_le_right _ _)
  have hps : ∑ x, (P x - a x) = t := by rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, P.total, ht]; ring
  have hqs : ∑ x, (Q x - a x) = t := by rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Q.total, ht]; ring
  have hg : 0 ≤ log (2:ℝ) := log_nonneg (by norm_num)
  change _ ≤ _+(log 2+t*_)
  obtain ht0|ht0 := eq_or_lt_of_le h0
  · have H : P = Q := by
      apply Law.ext; intro x
      have h1 := Finset.single_le_sum (f:=fun x => P x-a x) (fun y _ => hpl y) (Finset.mem_univ x)
      have h2 := Finset.single_le_sum (f:=fun x => Q x-a x) (fun y _ => hql y) (Finset.mem_univ x)
      linarith [hpl x,hql x]
    rw [← ht0, H,zero_mul]; linarith
  obtain ht1|ht1 := eq_or_lt_of_le h1
  · rw [ht1, one_mul]; linarith [entropy_le_log_size P s h, Q.entropy_nonneg]
  have hb := proportional_apply a ha (ht.symm ▸ sub_pos.mpr ht1)
  let R := proportional a ha (by linarith)
  let U := proportional _ hpl (by linarith)
  let V := proportional _ hql (by linarith)
  have hP : P = mixture U R t h0 h1 := by
    apply Law.ext; intro x
    rw [mixture_apply]
    dsimp only [R,U]; rw [proportional_apply, proportional_apply, ht,hps]
    field_simp
    ring

  have hQ : Q = mixture V R t h0 h1 := by
    apply Law.ext; intro x
    rw [mixture_apply]
    dsimp only [R,V]; rw [proportional_apply, proportional_apply, ht,hqs]
    field_simp
    ring
  have hU : U.entropy ≤ log (s.card:ℝ) := entropy_le_log_size U s fun x hx => by
    apply h
    rw [hP,mixture_apply]
    exact add_pos_of_pos_of_nonneg (mul_pos ht0 hx)
      (mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr h1) (R.nonneg x))
  have Hu := entropy_mixture_le U R t h0 h1
  have Hv := entropy_mixture_ge V R t h0 h1
  rw [hP, hQ]
  nlinarith [V.entropy_nonneg]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.sq_Ex_le
statement:
lemma sq_Ex_le (P : Law α) (f g h : α → ℝ) (hg : ∀ x, 0 ≤ g x) (hh : ∀ x, 0 ≤ h x)
    (H : ∀ x, f x^2 ≤ g x*h x) : P.Ex f^2 ≤ P.Ex g * P.Ex h
proof:
:= by
  refine Finset.sum_sq_le_sum_mul_sum_of_sq_le_mul _
    (f:=fun x => P x * g x) (g:=fun x => P x * h x)
    (fun x _ => mul_nonneg (P.nonneg x) (hg x))
    (fun x _ => mul_nonneg (P.nonneg x) (hh x)) ?_
  intro x _
  have hi := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (H x) (sq_nonneg (P x))
  calc
    (P x * f x)^2 = P x^2 * f x^2 := mul_pow _ _ _
    _ ≤ _ := hi
    _ = P x * g x * (P x * h x) := by ring

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.sq_Ex_mul
statement:
lemma sq_Ex_mul (P : Law α) (f g : α → ℝ) :
    (P.Ex (fun x => f x * g x))^2 ≤ P.Ex (fun x => f x^2) * P.Ex (fun x => g x^2)
proof:
:=
  sq_Ex_le _ _ _ _ (fun _ => sq_nonneg _) (fun _ => sq_nonneg _) (fun _ => (mul_pow _ _ _).le)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.sq_Ex
statement:
lemma sq_Ex (P : Law α) (f : α → ℝ) :
    (P.Ex f)^2 ≤ P.Ex (fun x => f x^2)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [mul_one,one_pow,Ex_const] using sq_Ex_mul P f (fun _ => 1)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.quadratic_minkowski
statement:
lemma quadratic_minkowski (P : Law α) (f g : α → ℝ) :
    √(P.Ex fun x => (f x+g x)^2) ≤ √(P.Ex fun x => (f x)^2) + √(P.Ex fun x => (g x)^2)
proof:
:= by
  let A := P.Ex fun x => (f x)^2; let B := P.Ex fun x => (g x)^2
  let E := P.Ex fun x => (f x+g x)^2
  have hA := sq_sqrt (show 0 ≤ A from P.Ex_nonneg fun x => sq_nonneg _)
  have hB := sq_sqrt (show 0 ≤ B from P.Ex_nonneg fun x => sq_nonneg _)
  have hE := sq_sqrt (show 0 ≤ E from P.Ex_nonneg fun x => sq_nonneg _)
  let L := P.Ex fun x => f x * g x
  have hL : E = A+B+2*L := by
    unfold E A B L
    simp_rw [← Ex_lmul,← Ex_add]; congr 1; funext i; ring
  have hU : L^2 ≤ (√A*√B)^2 := by rw [mul_pow,hA,hB]; exact sq_Ex_mul _ _ _
  have hL' : L ≤ √A*√B := by nlinarith [show 0 ≤ √A*√B by positivity]
  change √E ≤ √A+√B
  nlinarith [sqrt_nonneg A,sqrt_nonneg B]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.sq_Cx_norm
statement:
lemma sq_Cx_norm (P : Law α) (f : α → ℂ) :
    ‖P.Cx f‖^2 ≤ P.Ex (fun x => ‖f x‖^2)
proof:
:=
  (pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) (P.Cx_norm _) _).trans (sq_Ex _ _)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.privateH_le
statement: lemma privateH_le (P : Law α) (k : α → Law β) : P.privateH k ≤ P.entropy
proof:
:= by
  have H := (P.withNext k).Hcond_le_H Prod.fst Prod.snd
  exact (show _ ≤ _ from H).trans (le_of_eq (by
    unfold Law.H; rw [send_fst_withNext]))

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.signal_cost
statement:
lemma signal_cost (P : Law α) (k : α → Law β) :
    (P.withNext k).Hcond Prod.snd Prod.fst = P.Ex fun x => (k x).entropy
proof:
:= by
  unfold Hcond; rw [H_pair_rev]; simp_rw [Prod.mk.eta,H_self,entropy_withNext,H,send_fst_withNext]; ring

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.privateH_const
statement:
lemma privateH_const (P : Law α) (Q : Law β) :
    P.privateH (fun _ => Q) = P.entropy
proof:
:= by
  unfold privateH Hcond
  simp only [Prod.mk.eta,H_self]
  rw [entropy_withNext,Ex_const]
  unfold H
  rw [show P.withNext (fun _ => Q) = P.tensorP Q from rfl,send_snd_tensorP]; ring

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.Hcond_compare
statement:
lemma Hcond_compare (P : Law α) (Y : α → β) (X : α → γ) (q : γ → Law β)
    (hq : ∀ i, 0 < P i → 0 < q (X i) (Y i)) :
    P.Hcond Y X ≤ P.Ex fun i => -log (q (X i) (Y i))
proof:
:= by
  rw [Hcond_after]
  rw [← after_Ex_sum P X (fun x i => -log (q x (Y i)))]
  refine Ex_mono_mem _ fun x hx => ?_
  rw [← Ex_send (P.after X x) Y (fun i => -log (q x i))]
  apply entropy_le_cross_aux _ (q x) (q x).nonneg (q x).total.le
  intro i hi
  obtain ⟨i,rfl,hii⟩ := (send_pos_iff _ _ _).mp hi
  obtain ⟨rfl,H⟩ := (after_mem hx).mp hii
  exact hq i H

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.Hcond_pair_comm
statement:
lemma Hcond_pair_comm (P : Law α) (X : α → β) (Y : α → γ) (Z : α → η) :
    P.Hcond (fun x => (X x,Y x)) Z = P.Hcond (fun x => (Y x,X x)) Z
proof:
:= by
  unfold Hcond; congr 1; apply P.H_partition; simp [and_comm]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.refine_signal
statement:
theorem refine_signal (P : Law α) (k : α → Law β) (v : α × β → Law γ)
    (q : β → Law γ) (hq : ∀ x i, 0 < q x i) :
    let R
proof:
:= triple P k v
    P.privateH k - R.Hcond (fun i => i.1.1) (fun i => (i.2,i.1.2)) ≤
      (P.withNext k).Ex (fun x => (v x).kl (q x.2)) := by
  intro R
  let X := fun i : (α × β) × γ => i.1.1
  let B := fun i : (α × β) × γ => i.1.2
  let C : (α × β) × γ → γ := Prod.snd
  have he : P.privateH k = R.Hcond X B := by
    have HH := R.Hcond_send Prod.fst Prod.fst Prod.snd
    rw [show R.send Prod.fst=P.withNext k from send_fst_withNext _ _] at HH
    exact HH
  have hi := Hcond_compare R C B q (fun x _ => hq _ _)
  have hx : (P.withNext k).Ex (fun x => (v x).crossE (q x.2)) = R.Ex (fun i => -log (q (B i) (C i))) := by
    unfold crossE R triple; rw [Ex_withNext _ v]
  have hv1 : R.Hcond C (fun x => (X x,B x)) = R.Hcond Prod.snd Prod.fst := by
    refine Hcond_right_partition _ _ ?_
    intro a b; unfold X B; simp
  have hv2 : R.Hcond C (fun x => (X x,B x)) = (P.withNext k).Ex fun x => (v x).entropy :=
    hv1.trans (signal_cost _ _)
  change P.privateH k - R.Hcond X (fun x => (C x,B x)) ≤ _
  simp_rw [he,kl,Ex_sub,hx,← hv2]
  have h1 := Hcond_chain R X C B
  have h2 := Hcond_chain R C X B
  rw [Hcond_pair_comm] at h2
  linarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.replace_signal
statement:
theorem replace_signal (P : Law α) (k : α → Law β) (v : α → Law γ)
    (q : β → Law γ) (hq : ∀ x i, 0 < q x i) :
    P.privateH k - P.privateH v ≤
      (P.withNext k).Ex (fun x => (v x.1).kl (q x.2))
proof:
:= by
  have H := refine_signal P k (fun x => v x.1) q hq
  let R := triple P k (fun x => v x.1)
  have hi : R.send (fun x => (x.1.1,x.2))=P.withNext v := by
    apply ext_of_Ex; intro f
    unfold R triple; rw [Ex_send]; simp only [Ex_withNext]; simp only [Ex_const]
  have HH : P.privateH v=R.Hcond (fun x => x.1.1) (fun x => x.2) := by
    unfold privateH
    rw [← hi,Hcond_send]
  have hu : R.Hcond (fun x => x.1.1) (fun x => (x.2,x.1.2)) ≤ P.privateH v := by
    rw [HH]
    apply Hcond_antitone
    intro a b h; exact (Prod.mk.inj h).1
  calc
    _ ≤ P.privateH k - R.Hcond (fun x => x.1.1) (fun x => (x.2,x.1.2)) :=
      sub_le_sub_left hu _
    _ ≤ _ := H

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.after_channel
statement:
lemma after_channel (P : Law α) (f : α → β) (k : α → Law γ)
    {b : β} (h : 0 < P.send f b) :
    (P.withNext k).after (fun x => f x.1) b = (P.after f b).withNext k
proof:
:= by
  have H : (P.withNext k).send (fun x => f x.1) = P.send f := by
    exact Eq.symm (by
      conv_lhs => rw [← send_fst_withNext P k]
      rw [send_send])
  apply Law.ext; rintro ⟨x,i⟩
  apply mul_left_cancel₀ h.ne'
  nth_rw 1 [← H]
  rw [send_mul_after,withNext_apply,withNext_apply,← mul_assoc,send_mul_after]
  simp only [ite_mul,zero_mul]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.det_channel
statement:
lemma det_channel (P : Law α) (f : α → β) (k : α → Law γ) :
    let R
proof:
:= P.withNext k
    let W : α × γ → β := fun i => f i.1
    (P.send f).Ex (fun i => (P.after f i).privateH k) + R.Hcond W Prod.snd =
      P.privateH k := by
  intro R W
  have HH : (P.withNext k).send (fun x => f x.1) = P.send f := by
    exact Eq.symm (by conv_lhs => rw [← send_fst_withNext P k,send_send])
  have he : (P.send f).Ex (fun i => (P.after f i).privateH k) =
      R.Hcond Prod.fst (fun i => (W i,i.2)) := by
    rw [Hcond_right_partition (Z:=fun i => (i.2,W i)) R Prod.fst (by simp [and_comm]),Hcond_after_cond]
    rw [show R.send W=_ from HH]
    apply Ex_congr_mem
    intro i hi
    change _ = ((P.withNext k).after _ _).Hcond _ _
    rw [after_channel P f k hi]
    rfl
  rw [he,← Hcond_chain]
  unfold privateH Hcond
  congr 1
  apply H_partition
  simp [W]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.prob_mono
statement: lemma prob_mono (P : Law α) (p q : α → Prop) (h : ∀ i, p i → q i) : P.prob p ≤ P.prob q
proof:
:= by
  unfold prob; apply Ex_mono; intro i
  split_ifs with H H' H'
  · norm_num
  · exact (H' (h _ H)).elim
  · norm_num
  · norm_num

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.prob_union
statement: lemma prob_union (P : Law α) (p q : α → Prop) : P.prob (fun i => p i ∨ q i) ≤ P.prob p + P.prob q
proof:
:= by
  unfold prob; rw [← Ex_add]; apply Ex_mono; intro i
  by_cases H : p i <;> by_cases H' : q i <;> norm_num [H,H']

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.prob_send
statement:
lemma prob_send (P : Law α) (f : α → β) (p : β → Prop) :
    (P.send f).prob p = P.prob fun x => p (f x)
proof:
:= by
  unfold prob; rw [Ex_send]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.upperTail
statement:
lemma upperTail (P : Law α) (p : α → Prop) (f : α → ℝ) (h : ∀ i, 0 ≤ f i)
    (r : ℝ) (he : ∀ i, p i → r ≤ f i) :
    r*P.prob p ≤ P.Ex f
proof:
:= by
  unfold prob; rw [← Ex_lmul]; apply Ex_mono; intro i
  split_ifs with H
  · rw [mul_one]; exact he i H
  · rw [mul_zero]; exact h i

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.independent
statement:
lemma independent (P : Law α) (p : α → Prop) (T : ℕ) :
    (pack (fun _ : Fin T => P)).prob (fun i => ∀ k, p (i k)) =
    (P.prob p)^T
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have H (i : Fin T → α) :
      (if ∀ k, p (i k) then 1 else (0:ℝ)) =
        ∏ k, (if p (i k) then (1:ℝ) else 0) := by
    split_ifs with H
    · simp [H]
    push Not at H
    obtain ⟨x,hx⟩ := H
    exact Eq.symm (Finset.prod_eq_zero (i:=x) (Finset.mem_univ x) (by simp [hx]))

  have he : (pack (fun _ : Fin T => P)).prob (fun i => ∀ k, p (i k)) =
      (pack (fun _ : Fin T => P)).Ex (fun i => ∏ k, (if p (i k) then (1:ℝ) else 0)) := by
    rw [prob_eq]; simp_rw [Ex, ← H]
    simp
  rw [he]; unfold prob
  rw [pack_Ex_prod (fun _ : Fin T => P) (fun _ i => if p i then 1 else 0)]
  simp

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.bernoulli_trial
statement:
lemma bernoulli_trial {x : ℝ} (h : 0 ≤ x) (hh : x ≤ 1) (m : ℕ) :
    ↑m * x^m * (1-x) ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  have H := geom_sum_mul_neg x m
  have H1 : m*x^m ≤ ∑ i∈Finset.range m, x^i := by
    calc
      _ = ∑ i∈Finset.range m, x^m := by simp
      _ ≤ _ := by
        exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun i hi => pow_le_pow_of_le_one h hh (Finset.mem_range.mp hi).le
  nlinarith [pow_nonneg h m, mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right H1 (sub_nonneg.mpr hh)]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Law.lowerTail
statement:
lemma lowerTail (P : Law α) (p : α → Prop) (h Hp : ℝ) (f : α → ℝ)
    (hh : ∀ i, p i → f i ≤ Hp+h) (hf : ∀ i, ¬p i → f i ≤ h) :
    P.Ex f ≤ Hp * P.prob p + h
proof:
:= by
  unfold prob
  refine le_trans (P.Ex_mono (g:=fun i => Hp*(if p i then 1 else 0)+h) (fun i => ?_)) ?_
  · split_ifs with H
    · rw [mul_one]; exact hh _ H
    rw [mul_zero,zero_add]; exact hf _ H
  rw [Ex_add,Ex_lmul,Ex_const]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Period.phase_add
statement:
lemma phase_add (u x y : ℝ) :
    phase u (x + y) = phase u x * phase u y
proof:
:= by
  unfold phase
  rw [← Complex.exp_add]
  congr 1
  push_cast
  ring

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Period.phase_freq_add
statement:
lemma phase_freq_add (u v x : ℝ) :
    phase (u+v) x = phase u x * phase v x
proof:
:= by
  unfold phase
  rw [← Complex.exp_add]
  congr 1
  push_cast
  ring

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Period.phase_mul_arg
statement: lemma phase_mul_arg (u x y : ℝ) : phase u (x*y) = phase (u*x) y
proof:
:= by
  unfold phase; ring_nf

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Period.norm_phase_sub
statement:
lemma norm_phase_sub (u x y : ℝ) :
    ‖phase u x - phase u y‖ ≤ |u| * (2*π* |x-y|)
proof:
:= by
  have heq : phase u x - phase u y = (phase u (x-y)-1) * phase u y := by
    rw [sub_mul, ← phase_add, sub_add_cancel, one_mul]
  rw [heq, norm_mul, phase_unimod, mul_one]
  unfold phase
  have HH : ‖Complex.exp (Complex.I * ↑(u * (2*π*(x-y)))) - 1‖ ≤ ‖u*(2*π*(x-y))‖ :=
    Real.norm_exp_I_mul_ofReal_sub_one_le
  refine HH.trans ?_
  simp [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg Real.pi_pos.le]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Period.norm_mod
statement:
lemma norm_mod {ρ : ℝ → ℝ} (h0 : ∀ x, 0 ≤ ρ x) (u x : ℝ) :
    ‖modρ ρ u x‖ = ρ x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [modρ, norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (h0 _),
    phase_unimod, mul_one]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Period.coeff_near
statement:
lemma coeff_near {ρ : ℝ → ℝ} (hρ : Measurable ρ) (h0 : ∀ x, 0 ≤ ρ x)
    (B : ℝ) (hb : ∀ x, ρ x ≤ B)
    {u v a r x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ box a r) (hu : |u-v| ≤ 1) :
    ‖coeffH (modρ ρ u) a r - phase (u-v) x * coeffH (modρ ρ v) a r‖ ≤
        density ρ a r * (2 * π * r)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := hx.1
  have h2 := hx.2
  have hr : 0 < r := by linarith
  let w (t : ℝ) := a+r*t
  have hw : Measurable w := measurable_const.add (measurable_const.mul measurable_id)
  let F (u t : ℝ) := haarH t • modρ ρ u (w t)
  have hF (s : ℝ) : Integrable (F s) μ₁ := by
    apply Integrable.of_bound (Measurable.aestronglyMeasurable
      (measurableH.smul ((measurable_mod hρ s).comp hw))) B
    refine ae_of_all _ fun z => ?_
    change ‖haarH z • modρ ρ s (w z)‖ ≤ _
    rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, norm_mod h0]
    exact (mul_le_of_le_one_left (h0 _) (H_bound z)).trans (hb _)
  let c := phase (u-v) x
  have ht (t) (ht : t ∈ unitInt) :
      ‖F u t - c * F v t‖ ≤ ρ (w t) * (2 * π * r) := by
    have heq : F u t = phase (u-v) (w t) * F v t := by
      dsimp only [F, modρ]
      nth_rw 1 [← sub_add_cancel u v]

      rw [phase_freq_add]
      simp only [Complex.real_smul]
      ring
    rw [heq, ← sub_mul, norm_mul]
    have hk : |w t - x| ≤ r := by
      rcases ht with ⟨t1,t2⟩
      dsimp [w]
      rw [abs_le]
      constructor <;> nlinarith
    calc
      ‖phase (u-v) (w t) - c‖ * ‖F v t‖ ≤ (2*π*r) * ρ (w t) :=
        mul_le_mul ((norm_phase_sub _ _ _).trans (by
          calc
            _ ≤ 1 * (2*π*r) := by gcongr
            _ = _ := one_mul _)) (by
              rw [show F v t = haarH t • modρ ρ v (w t) from rfl, norm_smul,
                Real.norm_eq_abs, norm_mod h0]
              exact mul_le_of_le_one_left (h0 _) (H_bound _))
          (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity)
      _ = _ := mul_comm _ _
  have hwi : Integrable (fun t => ρ (w t)) μ₁ :=
    Integrable.of_bound ((hρ.comp hw).aestronglyMeasurable) B
      (ae_of_all _ fun t => by
        change ‖ρ (w t)‖ ≤ B
        simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (h0 _)] using hb _)
  change ‖(∫ t, F u t ∂μ₁) - c*(∫ t, F v t ∂μ₁)‖ ≤ (∫ t, ρ (w t) ∂μ₁)*_
  have hhcv : Integrable (fun t => c * F v t) μ₁ := (hF v).const_mul _
  rw [← integral_const_mul, ← integral_mul_const, ← integral_sub (hF u) hhcv]
  exact (norm_integral_le_integral_norm _).trans
    (integral_mono_ae ((hF u).sub hhcv).norm (hwi.mul_const _)
      ((ae_restrict_mem measurable_unitInt).mono ht))

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Period.cell_unique
proof:
:= by
  have hr : 0 < s*side n := mul_pos hs (side_pos _)
  have key : ∀ k l : ℕ, k < l →
      lft a s n k + s*side n ≤ lft a s n l := by
    intro k l h
    have H : ((k:ℝ)+1) ≤ (l:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast h
    unfold lft
    exact le_trans (by rw [add_mul]; simp [add_assoc] :
      a + (k:ℝ)*(s*side n) + s * side n ≤ a + ((k:ℝ)+1) * (s*side n))
      (add_le_add_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right H hr.le) _)
  by_contra h
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne h with h|h
  · exact (not_lt_of_ge ((key k l h).trans hy.1)) hx.2
  · exact (not_lt_of_ge ((key l k h).trans hx.1)) hy.2

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Period.shift_near_unit
statement:
lemma shift_near_unit {ρ : ℝ → ℝ} (hρ : Measurable ρ) (h0 : ∀ x, 0 ≤ ρ x)
    (B : ℝ) (hb : ∀ x, ρ x ≤ B)
    {u v x D : ℝ} (J : ℕ) (hx : usable ρ 0 1 J D x) (hD : 0 ≤ D)
    (hu : |u-v| ≤ 1) :
    ‖shift (modρ ρ u) 0 1 J x‖ ≤ ‖shift (modρ ρ v) 0 1 J x‖ +
      D * (2 * π) * 2
proof:
:= by
  let c := phase (u-v) x
  have hl (n : ℕ) (hn : n < J) : ‖haarLayer (modρ ρ u) 0 1 n x -
      c * haarLayer (modρ ρ v) 0 1 n x‖ ≤ D * (2 * π) * side n := by
    unfold haarLayer
    rw [Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    let inP (k : ℕ) := x ∈ box (lft 0 1 n k) (1*side n)
    have hp : 0 < (1:ℝ)*side n := mul_pos zero_lt_one (side_pos n)
    by_cases h : ∃ k ∈ Finset.range (2^n), inP k
    · obtain ⟨k,hk,hxk⟩ := h
      rw [Finset.sum_eq_single k]
      · let a := lft 0 1 n k
        let r := 1 * side n
        change ‖haarG _ • coeffH _ a r - c * (haarG _ • coeffH _ a r)‖ ≤ _
        simp only [Complex.real_smul]
        rw [mul_left_comm c, ← mul_sub, norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs]
        refine (mul_le_of_le_one_left (norm_nonneg _) (G_bound _)).trans
          ((coeff_near hρ h0 B hb hxk hu).trans ?_)
        have Hk := hx n hn k (Finset.mem_range.mp hk) hxk
        refine (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right Hk (show 0 ≤ 2*π*(1*side n) by positivity)).trans ?_
        simp [mul_assoc]
      · intro l hl hlk
        have H : ¬ inP l := fun hh => hlk (cell_unique 0 1 zero_lt_one n hh hxk)
        rw [jump_outside hp H _, jump_outside hp H _]
        simp
      · intro h; exact (h hk).elim
    · rw [Finset.sum_eq_zero]
      · rw [norm_zero]; exact mul_nonneg (by positivity) (side_pos _).le
      · intro k hk
        have H : ¬ inP k := fun hh => h ⟨k,hk,hh⟩
        rw [jump_outside hp H _, jump_outside hp H _]
        simp
  have ht : ‖shift (modρ ρ u) 0 1 J x - c * shift (modρ ρ v) 0 1 J x‖ ≤ D*(2*π)*2 := by
    unfold shift
    rw [Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    refine (norm_sum_le _ _).trans ((Finset.sum_le_sum (fun n hn => hl n (Finset.mem_range.mp hn))).trans ?_)
    rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (sum_geometric_two_le _) (by positivity)
  have hh := norm_sub_norm_le (shift (modρ ρ u) 0 1 J x) (c * shift (modρ ρ v) 0 1 J x)
  rw [norm_mul, phase_unimod, one_mul] at hh
  linarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Period.shift_pull
statement:
lemma shift_pull (F : ℝ → ℂ) (a s : ℝ) (hs : 0 < s) (J : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    shift F a s J (a+s*x) = shift (fun y => F (a+s*y)) 0 1 J x
proof:
:= by
  unfold shift
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun n _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
  let l := lft 0 1 n k
  have h1 : lft a s n k = a+s*l := by unfold l lft; ring
  rw [h1]
  unfold jump coeffH
  congr 2
  · dsimp only [l]
    field_simp
    all_goals ring
  all_goals
    simp_rw [show ∀ v : ℝ, a+s*l+(s*side n)*v = a+s*(l+(1*side n)*v) by intro v; ring]
    rfl

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Period.shift_scale
statement:
lemma shift_scale (F : ℝ → ℂ) (c : ℂ) (a s : ℝ) (J : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    shift (fun y => c * F y) a s J x = c * shift F a s J x
proof:
:= by
  unfold shift haarLayer
  simp_rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun n _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
  dsimp only [jump, coeffH]
  simp only [Complex.real_smul]
  simp_rw [mul_left_comm (↑(haarH _)) c, integral_const_mul]
  ring

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Period.map_affine
statement:
lemma map_affine (a : ℝ) {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) :
    Measure.map (fun x : ℝ => a+s*x) volume = ENNReal.ofReal (s⁻¹) • volume
proof:
:= by
  rw [show (fun x : ℝ => a+s*x) = ((a+·) ∘ fun x : ℝ => s*x) from rfl]
  rw [← Measure.map_map (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop), Real.map_volume_mul_left hs.ne',
    Measure.map_smul]
  all_goals first
    | simp only [abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr hs), map_add_left_eq_self]
    | exact (measurable_const.add measurable_id).aemeasurable

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Period.restrict_affine
statement:
lemma restrict_affine (a : ℝ) {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) (G : Set ℝ) (hG : MeasurableSet G)
    (f : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞) (hf : Measurable f) :
    (∫⁻ x in G, f x) =
      ENNReal.ofReal s * ∫⁻ x in (fun y : ℝ => a+s*y) ⁻¹' G, f (a+s*x)
proof:
:= by
  let φ (x : ℝ) := a+s*x
  have hm : Measurable φ := by unfold φ; fun_prop
  have H : Measure.map φ (volume.restrict (φ ⁻¹' G)) =
      ENNReal.ofReal (s⁻¹) • volume.restrict G := by
    rw [← Measure.restrict_map hm hG, map_affine a hs, Measure.restrict_smul]
  change _ = ENNReal.ofReal s * ∫⁻ x in φ ⁻¹' G, f (φ x)
  rw [← lintegral_map hf hm, H, lintegral_smul_measure, smul_eq_mul, ← mul_assoc,
    ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul hs.le, mul_inv_cancel₀ hs.ne', ENNReal.ofReal_one, one_mul]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Period.cube_eventually
statement:
lemma cube_eventually :
    ∀ᶠ j : ℕ in atTop, ((j:ℝ)+1)^3 ≤ (8:ℝ) * 2^j
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [(tendsto_pow_const_div_const_pow_of_one_lt 3
    (show (1:ℝ)<2 by norm_num)).eventually (gt_mem_nhds (show (0:ℝ)<1 by norm_num)),
    eventually_ge_atTop 1] with j hj h
  change (j:ℝ)^3/(2:ℝ)^j < 1 at hj
  have hh := (div_lt_one (by positivity)).mp hj
  have H : (j:ℝ) + 1 ≤ 2 * (j:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast (show j+1 ≤ 2*j by omega)
  calc
    _ ≤ (2*(j:ℝ))^3 := by gcongr
    _ ≤ 8*2^j := by rw [mul_pow]; linarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Period.UnitTreeBound.affine
statement: theorem UnitTreeBound.affine (hunit : UnitTreeBound) : AffineTreeBound
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨C, hC, h⟩ := hunit
  refine ⟨C+8*(2*π)*2, by positivity, ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [h, cube_eventually] with j hj hcj
  intro ρ hρ hp h0 hm hB J G hG hGood a s hs hs'
  let φ (x : ℝ) := a+s*x
  let F (x : ℝ) := ρ (φ x)
  have hs0 : 0 < s := by linarith
  have hmφ : Measurable φ := by unfold φ; fun_prop
  have hF : Measurable F := hρ.comp hmφ
  let B := Real.exp ((2:ℝ)^j)
  let D := ((j:ℝ)+1)^3
  have hD : 0 ≤ D := by unfold D; positivity
  have hF0 (x) : 0 ≤ F x := h0 _
  have hFB (x) : F x ≤ B := hB _
  let Gt := G ∩ box a s
  have hbm : MeasurableSet (box a s) := measurableSet_Ico
  let H := φ ⁻¹' Gt
  have hH : MeasurableSet H := hmφ (hG.inter hbm)
  have hsub : H ⊆ unitInt := by
    intro x hx
    have ⟨h1,h2⟩ := (show φ x ∈ Gt from hx).2
    dsimp only [φ] at *
    constructor <;> nlinarith
  have hmF : (∫ x, F x ∂μ₁) ≤ 2 := by
    change (∫ x, ρ (a+s*x) ∂μ₁) ≤ 2
    rw [mean_translate_scale ρ a hs0, smul_eq_mul, ← div_eq_inv_mul]
    exact (div_le_iff₀ hs0).mpr ((density_short ρ hρ hp h0 B hB hm a s hs').trans (by linarith))
  have hu : ∀ x ∈ H, usable F 0 1 J D x := by
    intro x hx n _ k _ hk
    let l := lft 0 1 n k
    let r := (1:ℝ)*side n
    have hr : 0 < r := mul_pos zero_lt_one (side_pos _)
    have hrs := mul_pos hs0 hr
    change density F l r ≤ _
    have hgd := hGood _ ((show φ x ∈ Gt from hx).1) (φ l) (s*r) hrs
      (by simpa [r] using (show s * side n ≤ 1 from
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hs' (side_pos n).le).trans
          (by simpa using side_le n)))
      (show φ x ∈ box (φ l) (s*r) by
        change l ≤ x ∧ x < l+r at hk
        change a+s*l ≤ a+s*x ∧ a+s*x < a+s*l+s*r
        constructor <;> nlinarith [hk.1,hk.2])
    change D*(s*r) ≥ _ at hgd
    change (∫ y, ρ (φ (l+r*y)) ∂μ₁) ≤ _
    simp_rw [show ∀ y, φ (l+r*y) = φ l + (s*r)*y by intro y; unfold φ; ring,
      mean_translate_scale ρ (φ l) hrs]
    rw [smul_eq_mul, ← div_eq_inv_mul, div_le_iff₀ hrs]
    exact hgd
  have htrans (x : ℝ) (hx : x ∈ H) :
      maxShift ρ a s J (φ x) ≤ maxShift F 0 1 J x + ENNReal.ofReal (D*(2*π)*2) := by
    refine iSup_le fun n => ?_
    let u := (n:ℝ)*s
    let k := ⌊u⌋
    have heq (y : ℝ) : modρ ρ (n:ℝ) (a+s*y) = phase n a * modρ F u y := by
      unfold modρ
      rw [phase_add, phase_mul_arg]
      dsimp only [F,φ,u]
      ring
    change ENNReal.ofReal ‖shift _ _ _ _ (a+s*x)‖ ≤ _
    simp_rw [shift_pull _ a s hs0, heq, shift_scale, norm_mul, phase_unimod, one_mul]
    have hnear : |u-(k:ℝ)| ≤ 1 :=
      abs_le.mpr (by have := Int.floor_le u; have := Int.lt_floor_add_one u; dsimp only [k]; constructor <;> linarith)
    refine (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (shift_near_unit hF hF0 B hFB J (hu _ hx) hD hnear)).trans ?_
    rw [ENNReal.ofReal_add (by positivity) (by positivity)]
    exact add_le_add_left (le_iSup (fun n : ℤ =>
      ENNReal.ofReal ‖shift (modρ F n) 0 1 J x‖) k) _
  let Z := maxShift ρ a s J
  have hZ : Measurable Z :=
    measurable_maxShift_comp hρ measurable_const measurable_const measurable_id _
  have hz (x) (hx : x ∉ box a s) : Z x = 0 := by
    unfold Z maxShift; simp only [shift_outside hs0 hx, norm_zero, ENNReal.ofReal_zero, iSup_const]
  have hiG : (∫⁻ x in G, Z x) = ∫⁻ x in Gt, Z x := by
    rw [← lintegral_indicator hG, ← lintegral_indicator (hG.inter hbm)]
    exact lintegral_congr (fun x => by
      by_cases hx : x ∈ box a s <;> by_cases hy : x ∈ G <;> simp_all only [
        mem_inter_iff, not_false_eq_true, and_self, and_false, false_and,
        indicator_of_mem, indicator_of_notMem])
  change (∫⁻ x in G, Z x) ≤ _
  rw [hiG, restrict_affine a hs0 Gt (hG.inter hbm) Z hZ]
  change ENNReal.ofReal s * ∫⁻ x in H, Z (φ x) ≤ _
  have hmH := hj F hF hF0 hmF hFB J H hH hsub hu
  refine le_trans (b := ∫⁻ x in H, Z (φ x)) (mul_le_of_le_one_left zero_le
    (by simpa using ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal hs')) ?_
  refine (lintegral_mono_ae ((ae_restrict_mem hH).mono htrans)).trans ?_
  rw [lintegral_add_right _ measurable_const]
  have Hvol : volume H ≤ 1 := (measure_mono hsub).trans (by simp [unitInt])
  have Hbound : (∫⁻ _ : ℝ in H, ENNReal.ofReal (D*(2*π)*2)) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (D*(2*π)*2) := by
    simp only [setLIntegral_const]
    exact mul_le_of_le_one_right zero_le Hvol
  refine (add_le_add hmH Hbound).trans ?_
  rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_add (by positivity) (by positivity)]
  apply ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
  rw [add_mul]
  apply add_le_add_right
  calc
    _ ≤ ((8:ℝ)*2^j)*(2*π)*2 := by gcongr
    _ = _ := by ring

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Period.measurable_unitInt
statement: lemma measurable_unitInt : MeasurableSet unitInt
proof: := measurableSet_Ico

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Period.measurable_circle
statement: theorem measurable_circle : Measurable circle
proof:
:=
  AddCircle.measurable_mk'.comp (measurable_const.mul measurable_id)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Period.map_circle_volume
statement: lemma map_circle_volume : Measure.map circle μ₁ = circleMeasure
proof:
:= by
  let t : ℝ := 2*π
  have ht : 0 < t := Real.two_pi_pos
  let φ (x : ℝ) := t*x
  have h : Measurable φ := measurable_const.mul measurable_id
  change Measure.map (((↑) : ℝ → AddCircle t) ∘ φ) μ₁ = _
  rw [← Measure.map_map AddCircle.measurable_mk' h]
  have hf : φ ⁻¹' Ico 0 (0+t) = unitInt := by
    ext x
    simp only [unitInt, mem_Ico, mem_preimage, zero_add, φ]
    constructor
    · intro ⟨hx, hy⟩; constructor <;> nlinarith
    · intro ⟨hx, hy⟩; constructor <;> nlinarith
  rw [μ₁, ← hf, ← Measure.restrict_map h measurableSet_Ico,
    Real.map_volume_mul_left ht.ne', Measure.restrict_smul,
    Measure.restrict_congr_set Ico_ae_eq_Ioc, Measure.map_smul,
    (AddCircle.measurePreserving_mk t 0).map_eq, AddCircle.volume_eq_smul_haarAddCircle,
    smul_smul, abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr ht), ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (inv_pos.mpr ht).le,
    inv_mul_cancel₀ ht.ne', ENNReal.ofReal_one, one_smul]
  all_goals first
    | rfl
    | exact AddCircle.measurable_mk'.aemeasurable

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Period.periodic_circle
statement: lemma periodic_circle : Function.Periodic circle 1
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  simp only [circle, mul_add, mul_one, AddCircle.coe_add_period]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Period.measurable_coord
statement: theorem measurable_coord : Measurable coord
proof:
:=
  (measurable_subtype_coe.comp (AddCircle.measurableEquivIco (2*π) 0).measurable).div_const _

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Period.coord_circle_eq
statement: lemma coord_circle_eq {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ unitInt) : coord (circle x) = x
proof:
:= by
  let t := (2 * π)
  have ht : (0:ℝ) < t := Real.two_pi_pos
  change (((AddCircle.equivIco t 0 ((t*x:ℝ):AddCircle t)).val) / t) = x
  have h : t * x ∈ Ico 0 (0+t) := by
    rcases hx with ⟨h1,h2⟩
    simp only [mem_Ico]
    constructor <;> nlinarith
  rw [AddCircle.equivIco_coe_eq h]
  exact mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ ht.ne'

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Period.phase_cont
statement: lemma phase_cont (u) : Continuous (phase u)
proof: := by unfold phase; fun_prop

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Period.phase_unimod
statement: lemma phase_unimod (u x) : ‖phase u x‖ = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [phase, Complex.norm_exp]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Period.fourier_circle
statement: lemma fourier_circle (n : ℤ) (x : ℝ) : fourier n (circle x) = phase n x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [circle, fourier_of_real, phase, Complex.ofReal_mul, Complex.ofReal_intCast,
    mul_assoc]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Period.phase_periodic
statement: lemma phase_periodic (n : ℤ) : Function.Periodic (phase n) 1
proof:
:=
  fun x => by rw [← fourier_circle, ← fourier_circle, periodic_circle x]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Period.sum_eq
statement:
lemma sum_eq (f : Torus → ℂ) (hf : Measurable f) (N x) :
    symmetricPartialSum f N (circle x) = sumReal (f ∘ circle) N x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [symmetricPartialSum, sumReal, fourierCoeff_eq_integral, ← map_circle_volume]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl ?_
  intro n _
  rw [integral_map (f:=fun x => f x * fourier (-n) x) measurable_circle.aemeasurable
    ((hf.mul (fourier _).continuous.measurable).aestronglyMeasurable)]
  simp only [fourier_circle, Function.comp_def]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Period.cost_transfer
statement:
lemma cost_transfer (f : Torus → ℂ) (hf : Measurable f)
    (j : ℕ) (C : ℝ) (G : Set ℝ) (hG : MeasurableSet G)
    (hsize : μ₁ Gᶜ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (C / ((j:ℝ) + 1)^2))
    (hint : (∫⁻ x in G, maxReal (f ∘ circle) x ∂μ₁) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (C * (2:ℝ)^j)) :
    HasMaxCost f j C
proof:
:= by
  let S := coord ⁻¹' G
  have hS : MeasurableSet S := measurable_coord hG
  refine ⟨S, hS, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [← map_circle_volume, Measure.map_apply measurable_circle hS.compl]
    have heq : circle ⁻¹' Sᶜ =ᵐ[μ₁] Gᶜ := by
      filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem (μ:=volume) measurable_unitInt] with x hx
      change (coord (circle x) ∉ G) = (x ∉ G)
      rw [coord_circle_eq hx]
    rwa [measure_congr heq]
  · rw [← lintegral_indicator hS, ← map_circle_volume,
      lintegral_map ((measurable_symmetricMaximal _).indicator hS) measurable_circle]
    rw [← lintegral_indicator hG] at hint
    convert hint using 1
    apply lintegral_congr_ae
    filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem (μ:=volume) measurable_unitInt] with x hx
    have heq : symmetricMaximal f (circle x) = maxReal (f ∘ circle) x := by
      simp only [symmetricMaximal, maxReal, sum_eq f hf]
    by_cases h : x ∈ G <;> simp [S, coord_circle_eq hx, heq, h]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.HasMaxCost.add
statement:
lemma HasMaxCost.add {f g : Torus → ℂ} {C D : ℝ} {j : ℕ}
    (hF : HasMaxCost f j C) (hG : HasMaxCost g j D)
    (hf : Integrable f circleMeasure) (hg : Integrable g circleMeasure)
    (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hD : 0 ≤ D) : HasMaxCost (f+g) j (C+D)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨F, hFm, hFs, hFi⟩ := hF
  obtain ⟨G, hGm, hGs, hGi⟩ := hG
  refine ⟨F ∩ G, hFm.inter hGm, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [add_div, ENNReal.ofReal_add (by positivity) (by positivity), Set.compl_inter]
    exact (measure_union_le _ _).trans (add_le_add hFs hGs)
  · have h (x : Torus) :
        symmetricMaximal (f + g) x ≤ symmetricMaximal f x + symmetricMaximal g x := by
      unfold symmetricMaximal
      refine iSup_le fun n => ?_
      rw [symmetricPartialSum_add hf hg]
      refine (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
        (norm_add_le (symmetricPartialSum f n x) (symmetricPartialSum g n x))).trans ?_
      rw [ENNReal.ofReal_add (by positivity) (by positivity)]
      exact add_le_add (le_iSup (fun N => ENNReal.ofReal ‖symmetricPartialSum f N x‖) n)
        (le_iSup (fun N => ENNReal.ofReal ‖symmetricPartialSum g N x‖) n)
    refine (lintegral_mono h).trans ?_
    rw [lintegral_add_left (measurable_symmetricMaximal _), add_mul,
      ENNReal.ofReal_add (by positivity) (by positivity)]
    exact add_le_add ((lintegral_mono_set inter_subset_left).trans hFi)
      ((lintegral_mono_set inter_subset_right).trans hGi)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.HasMaxCost.rot
statement:
lemma HasMaxCost.rot {f j C} (h : HasMaxCost f j C)
    (c : ℂ) (hc : ‖c‖ = 1) : HasMaxCost (fun x => c * f x) j C
proof:
:= by
  simpa [HasMaxCost, symmetricMaximal_mul, hc] using h

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Period.RealGoodBound.goodBound
statement: theorem Period.RealGoodBound.goodBound (hb : Period.RealGoodBound) : GoodBound
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨C, hC, h⟩ := hb
  refine ⟨C+C+(C+C), by positivity, ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [h] with j hj
  intro f hf ha he
  let f₀ := hf.aestronglyMeasurable.mk f
  let g (x : Torus) := if ‖f₀ x‖ ≤ Real.exp ((2:ℝ)^j) then f₀ x else 0
  have hf₀ : Measurable f₀ := hf.aestronglyMeasurable.measurable_mk
  have hg : Measurable g :=
    Measurable.ite (measurableSet_le hf₀.norm measurable_const) hf₀ measurable_const
  have hfg : f =ᵐ[circleMeasure] g := by
    filter_upwards [hf.aestronglyMeasurable.ae_eq_mk, he] with x hx hx'
    change f x = f₀ x at hx
    simp only [g, ← hx, hx', ite_true]
  have hgb (x : Torus) : ‖g x‖ ≤ Real.exp ((2:ℝ)^j) := by
    dsimp only [g]
    split_ifs with HH
    · exact HH
    · rw [norm_zero]; positivity
  have hgi : Integrable g circleMeasure := hf.congr hfg
  have hgm : (∫ x, ‖g x‖ ∂circleMeasure) ≤ 1 :=
    (integral_congr_ae (hfg.symm.fun_comp (‖·‖))).le.trans ha
  have hpart (w : Torus → ℝ) (hw : Measurable w)
      (hw0 : ∀ x, 0 ≤ w x) (hwn : ∀ x, w x ≤ ‖g x‖) :
      HasMaxCost (fun x => (w x : ℂ)) j C ∧
        Integrable (fun x => (w x : ℂ)) circleMeasure := by
    have hc : Measurable (fun x => (w x : ℂ)) := Complex.continuous_ofReal.measurable.comp hw
    have hwi : Integrable w circleMeasure := Integrable.of_bound hw.aestronglyMeasurable _
      (ae_of_all _ (fun x => by
        simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (hw0 x)] using
          (hwn x).trans (hgb x)))
    have hwci : Integrable (fun x => (w x : ℂ)) circleMeasure :=
      Integrable.of_bound hc.aestronglyMeasurable _ (ae_of_all _ (fun x => by
        simpa only [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (hw0 x)] using
          (hwn x).trans (hgb x)))
    have hm : (∫ x, (w ∘ circle) x ∂μ₁) ≤ 1 := by
      simp only [Function.comp_apply, ← integral_map (f:=w)
        measurable_circle.aemeasurable hw.aestronglyMeasurable, map_circle_volume]
      exact (integral_mono hwi hgi.norm hwn).trans hgm
    obtain ⟨G,hG,hsize,hInt⟩ := hj (w ∘ circle) (hw.comp measurable_circle)
      (fun x => congrArg w (periodic_circle x))
      (fun x => hw0 _) hm (fun x => (hwn _).trans (hgb _))
    exact ⟨cost_transfer _ hc j C G hG hsize hInt, hwci⟩
  have hdiff (w : Torus → ℝ) (hw : Measurable w) (hwn : ∀ x, |w x| ≤ ‖g x‖) :
      HasMaxCost (fun x => (w x : ℂ)) j (C+C) ∧
        Integrable (fun x => (w x : ℂ)) circleMeasure := by
    obtain ⟨hp, hpi⟩ := hpart (fun x => max 0 (w x)) (measurable_const.max hw) (fun x => le_max_left _ _)
      (fun x => max_le (norm_nonneg _) ((abs_le.mp (hwn x)).2))
    obtain ⟨hn, hni⟩ := hpart (fun x => max 0 (-w x)) (measurable_const.max hw.neg)
      (fun x => le_max_left _ _) (fun x => max_le (norm_nonneg _) (by have := (abs_le.mp (hwn x)).1; linarith))
    rw [show (fun x => (w x : ℂ)) = (fun x => ((max 0 (w x) : ℝ) : ℂ))
          + (fun x => (-1:ℂ) * ((max 0 (-w x) : ℝ) : ℂ)) by
      ext1 x
      rcases le_total 0 (w x) with hwx| hwx
      · simp [hwx]
      · simp [hwx]]
    exact ⟨hp.add (hn.rot _ (by simp)) hpi (hni.const_mul _) hC hC, hpi.add (hni.const_mul _)⟩
  obtain ⟨hr, hri⟩ := hdiff (fun x => (g x).re)
    (Complex.continuous_re.measurable.comp hg) (fun x => Complex.abs_re_le_norm _)
  obtain ⟨hi, hii⟩ := hdiff (fun x => (g x).im)
    (Complex.continuous_im.measurable.comp hg) (fun x => Complex.abs_im_le_norm _)
  have H : HasMaxCost g j (C+C+(C+C)) := by
    have H := hr.add (hi.rot Complex.I (by simp)) hri (hii.const_mul Complex.I)
      (by linarith) (by linarith)
    convert H using 1
    ext1 x
    rw [Pi.add_apply, mul_comm, Complex.re_add_im]
  have eq : symmetricMaximal f = symmetricMaximal g := by
    ext1 x
    simp only [symmetricMaximal, symmetricPartialSum_congr_ae hfg]
  rw [eq]
  exact H

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Period.phase_trig
statement:
lemma phase_trig (u t : ℝ) :
    phase u t = ↑(Real.cos (ang u t)) + ↑(Real.sin (ang u t)) * Complex.I
proof:
:= by
  unfold phase ang
  rw [mul_comm Complex.I, Complex.exp_mul_I, Complex.ofReal_cos, Complex.ofReal_sin]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Period.phase_sub
statement:
lemma phase_sub (u x y : ℝ) :
    phase u (x-y) = phase u x * phase (-u) y
proof:
:= by
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg, phase_add]
  unfold phase
  simp

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Period.dirichlet_cont
statement: lemma dirichlet_cont (N : ℕ) : Continuous (dirichlet N)
proof:
:= by
  apply continuous_finsetSum
  exact fun _ _ => phase_cont _

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Period.dirichlet_bound
statement:
lemma dirichlet_bound (N : ℕ) (t : ℝ) :
    ‖dirichlet N t‖ ≤ 2*(N:ℝ)+1
proof:
:= by
  refine (norm_sum_le _ _).trans ?_
  simp only [phase_unimod, Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one, Int.card_Icc]
  exact_mod_cast (by omega : ((N:ℤ)+1-(-(N:ℤ))).toNat ≤ 2*N+1)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Period.dirichlet_succ
statement:
lemma dirichlet_succ (N : ℕ) (t : ℝ) :
    dirichlet (N+1) t = dirichlet N t + ↑(2 * Real.cos (ang (N+1:ℕ) t))
proof:
:= by
  unfold dirichlet
  let M : ℤ := N
  have heq : Finset.Icc (-((N+1:ℕ):ℤ)) ((N+1:ℕ):ℤ) =
      insert (M+1) (insert (-M-1) (Finset.Icc (-M) M)) := by
    ext i
    simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_Icc]
    dsimp [M]; omega
  have h1 : M+1 ∉ insert (-M-1) (Finset.Icc (-M) M) := by
    simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_Icc]
    dsimp [M]; omega
  have h2 : -M-1 ∉ Finset.Icc (-M) M := by
    simp only [Finset.mem_Icc]; omega
  rw [heq, Finset.sum_insert h1, Finset.sum_insert h2]
  have h3 : ang ((↑(-M-1) : ℝ)) t = -ang (N+1:ℕ) t := by unfold M ang; push_cast; ring
  have h4 : ((↑(M+1):ℝ)) = ((N+1:ℕ):ℝ) := by simp [M]
  rw [phase_trig, phase_trig, h3, h4, Real.sin_neg, Real.cos_neg, Complex.ofReal_neg,
    Complex.ofReal_mul, Complex.ofReal_ofNat]
  dsimp only [M]
  ring

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Period.dirichlet_sin
statement:
lemma dirichlet_sin (N : ℕ) (t : ℝ) :
    dirichlet N t * ↑(Real.sin (π*t)) = ↑(Real.sin (ang N t + π*t))
proof:
:= by
  induction N with
  | zero => simp [dirichlet, phase, ang]
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [dirichlet_succ, add_mul, ih, ← Complex.ofReal_mul, ← Complex.ofReal_add]
    congr 1
    have H : ang n t + π*t = ang (n+1:ℕ) t - π*t := by
      unfold ang; push_cast; ring
    rw [H, Real.sin_sub, Real.sin_add]
    ring

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Period.sin_posabs
statement:
lemma sin_posabs {q : ℝ} (hq : |q| ≤ π/2) :
    |q|/2 ≤ |Real.sin q|
proof:
:= by
  have H := Real.mul_abs_le_abs_sin hq
  apply le_trans _ H
  have hc : 1/2 ≤ 2 / (π:ℝ) := (le_div_iff₀ Real.pi_pos).mpr (by linarith [Real.pi_lt_four])
  nlinarith [abs_nonneg q]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Period.dirichlet_id
statement:
lemma dirichlet_id (N : ℕ) {t : ℝ} (ht : t ∈ centerWin) (hn : t ≠ 0) :
    dirichlet N t = ↑(Real.cos (ang N t) +
      Real.sin (ang N t) * (Real.cos (π*t) / Real.sin (π*t)))
proof:
:= by
  have hh : |π*t| ≤ π/2 := by
    rcases ht with ⟨h1,h2⟩
    rw [abs_le]; constructor <;> nlinarith [Real.pi_pos]
  have hsin : Real.sin (π*t) ≠ 0 := by
    have H1 := abs_pos.mpr (mul_ne_zero Real.pi_pos.ne' hn)
    have H2 := sin_posabs hh
    intro h
    rw [h,abs_zero] at H2
    linarith
  have H := dirichlet_sin N t
  apply mul_right_cancel₀ (by exact_mod_cast hsin : (↑(Real.sin (π*t)) : ℂ) ≠ 0)
  rw [H, ← Complex.ofReal_mul, Real.sin_add]; congr 1; field_simp; ring

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Period.cot_error
statement:
lemma cot_error {q : ℝ} (hq : |q| ≤ π/2) (hn : q ≠ 0) :
    |Real.cos q / Real.sin q - 1/q| ≤ 4
proof:
:= by
  have hk := sin_posabs hq
  have hp : 0 < |q| := abs_pos.mpr hn
  have hs' : 0 < |Real.sin q| := by linarith
  have hs : Real.sin q ≠ 0 := abs_pos.mp hs'
  have h2 : |q| ≤ 2 := by linarith [Real.pi_lt_four]
  have hcos : |Real.cos q - 1| ≤ |q|^2 / 2 := by
    rw [abs_le, sq_abs]
    constructor
    · linarith [@Real.one_sub_sq_div_two_le_cos q]
    · nlinarith [Real.cos_le_one q]
  have H : |q * Real.cos q - Real.sin q| ≤ |q|^3 := by
    rw [show q * Real.cos q - Real.sin q = q * (Real.cos q - 1) + (q-Real.sin q) by ring]
    apply (abs_add_le _ _).trans
    rw [abs_mul]
    calc
      _ ≤ |q| * (|q|^2/2) + |q|^3/6 := add_le_add
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hcos hp.le) (Real.abs_sub_sin_le q)
      _ ≤ _ := by nlinarith [pow_pos hp 3]
  rw [show Real.cos q / Real.sin q - 1/q = (q*Real.cos q - Real.sin q)/(q*Real.sin q) by field_simp,
    abs_div, abs_mul]
  apply (div_le_iff₀ (mul_pos hp hs')).mpr
  exact H.trans (by nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h2 (sq_nonneg |q|)])

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Period.κfactor_bound
statement: lemma κfactor_bound : |κfactor| ≤ 4
proof:
:= by
  unfold κfactor constK
  rw [abs_div, abs_mul, abs_of_pos Real.pi_pos]
  rw [div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)]
  norm_num
  linarith [Real.two_le_pi]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Period.diffK_major
statement:
theorem diffK_major {t δ : ℝ} (hd : 0 < δ) (hd' : δ ≤ 1)
    (ht : t ∈ window) (N : ℕ) :
    ‖diffK δ N t‖ ≤ if |t| < δ then 70 * ((N:ℝ) + 1) else 20
proof:
:= by
  have hs : |Real.sin (ang N t)| ≤ 1 := Real.abs_sin_le_one _
  have hcc := κfactor_bound
  have htw : |t| ≤ 1 := abs_le.mpr ⟨ht.1, ht.2.le⟩
  split_ifs with H
  · apply (norm_sub_le _ _).trans
    have h1 : ‖centerWin.indicator (dirichlet N) t‖ ≤ 2*(N:ℝ)+1 := by
      by_cases h : t ∈ centerWin
      · simpa [h] using dirichlet_bound N t
      · simp only [indicator_of_notMem h, norm_zero]; positivity
    rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_mul]
    have h2 : |Real.sin (ang N t)| ≤ (N:ℝ)*(8*δ) := by
      apply Real.abs_sin_le_abs.trans
      simp only [ang, abs_mul, abs_of_pos Real.pi_pos]
      norm_num
      gcongr
      linarith [Real.pi_lt_four]
    calc
      _ ≤ 2*(N:ℝ)+1+(4*(2/δ))*((N:ℝ)*(8*δ)) :=
        add_le_add h1 (mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul hcc (kernel_small hd hd' t)
          (abs_nonneg _) (by norm_num)) h2 (abs_nonneg _) (by positivity))
      _ ≤ _ := by field_simp; nlinarith
  · have htpos : δ ≤ |t| := le_of_not_gt H
    have hn : t ≠ 0 := abs_pos.mp (hd.trans_le htpos)
    have hk := kernel_middle hd htpos htw
    by_cases hc : t ∈ centerWin
    · have hθ : |π*t| ≤ π/2 := by
        rcases hc with ⟨h1,h2⟩
        rw [abs_le]; constructor <;> nlinarith [Real.pi_pos]
      have hA : |Real.cos (π*t) / Real.sin (π*t) - κfactor * kernel δ t| ≤ 4 + 4 * 2 := by
        rw [show Real.cos (π*t) / Real.sin (π*t) - κfactor * kernel δ t =
          (Real.cos (π*t)/Real.sin (π*t)-1/(π*t)) + (-κfactor)*(kernel δ t-constK/t) by
          unfold κfactor constK
          have := Real.pi_pos
          field_simp
          all_goals ring]
        apply (abs_add_le _ _).trans
        rw [abs_mul, abs_neg]
        exact add_le_add (cot_error hθ (mul_ne_zero Real.pi_pos.ne' hn))
          (mul_le_mul hcc hk (abs_nonneg _) (by norm_num))
      unfold diffK
      rw [indicator_of_mem hc, dirichlet_id _ hc hn, ← Complex.ofReal_sub, Complex.norm_real,
        Real.norm_eq_abs]
      rw [show Real.cos (ang N t) + Real.sin (ang N t) * (Real.cos (π*t) / Real.sin (π*t)) -
          κfactor*kernel δ t*Real.sin (ang N t) = Real.cos (ang N t) +
          Real.sin (ang N t)*(Real.cos (π*t)/Real.sin (π*t)-κfactor*kernel δ t) by ring]
      apply (abs_add_le _ _).trans
      rw [abs_mul]
      refine (add_le_add (Real.abs_cos_le_one _) (mul_le_mul hs hA (abs_nonneg _) zero_le_one)).trans ?_
      norm_num
    · have htl : 1/2 ≤ |t| := by unfold centerWin at hc; grind
      unfold diffK
      rw [indicator_of_notMem hc, zero_sub, norm_neg, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_mul]
      have he : |constK/t| ≤ 1 := by
        rw [abs_div, div_le_one (abs_pos.mpr hn)]
        unfold constK
        norm_num
        linarith
      have hQ : |kernel δ t| ≤ 3 := by rw [abs_le] at *; grind
      exact (mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul hcc hQ (abs_nonneg _) (by norm_num)) hs
        (abs_nonneg _) (by norm_num)).trans (by norm_num)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.measurable_symmetricMaximal
statement: theorem measurable_symmetricMaximal (f : Torus → ℂ) : Measurable (symmetricMaximal f)
proof:
:=
  Measurable.iSup (fun N => (measurable_symmetricPartialSum f N).norm.ennreal_ofReal)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.symmetricMaximal_mul
statement:
theorem symmetricMaximal_mul (f : Torus → ℂ) (c : ℂ) (x : Torus) :
    symmetricMaximal (fun y => c * f y) x = ENNReal.ofReal ‖c‖ * symmetricMaximal f x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [symmetricMaximal, symmetricPartialSum_const_mul, norm_mul,
    ENNReal.ofReal_mul (norm_nonneg c), ENNReal.mul_iSup]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.GoodBound.ae_tail_majorant
statement:
theorem GoodBound.ae_tail_majorant
    (hgb : GoodBound) (F : ℕ → Torus → ℂ) (w : ℕ → ℝ) (L : ℕ)
    (hF : ∀ j, Integrable (F j) circleMeasure)
    (hw : ∀ j, 0 < w j)
    (hsum : Summable (fun j => (2:ℝ)^j * w j))
    (hm : ∀ j, (∫ x, ‖F j x‖ ∂circleMeasure) ≤ w j)
    (hh : ∀ j, ∀ᵐ x ∂circleMeasure, ‖F j x‖ ≤ w j * Real.exp ((2:ℝ)^(j+L))) :
    ∀ᵐ x ∂circleMeasure, ∃ b : ℕ → ℝ, Summable b ∧ ∀ᶠ j : ℕ in atTop,
      ∀ N, ‖symmetricPartialSum (F j) N x‖ + ‖F j x‖ ≤ b j
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨C, hC, hG⟩ := hgb
  obtain ⟨j₀, hj₀⟩ := eventually_atTop.1 hG
  let D := L + j₀
  have hg (j : ℕ) : ∃ G : Set Torus, MeasurableSet G ∧
      circleMeasure Gᶜ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (C / ((j:ℝ) + 1)^2) ∧
      (∫⁻ x in G, symmetricMaximal (F j) x ∂circleMeasure)
        ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (w j * (C * (2:ℝ)^(j+D))) := by
