    let f (x : Torus) : ℂ := (((w j)⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) * F j x
    have winv : 0 < (w j)⁻¹ := inv_pos.mpr (hw j)
    have hf (x : Torus) : ‖f x‖ = (w j)⁻¹ * ‖F j x‖ := by
      simp only [f, norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos winv]
    have hnorm : (∫ x, ‖f x‖ ∂circleMeasure) ≤ 1 := by
      simp_rw [hf]
      rw [integral_const_mul]
      exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hm j) winv.le).trans (le_of_eq (inv_mul_cancel₀ (hw j).ne'))
    have hheight : ∀ᵐ x ∂circleMeasure, ‖f x‖ ≤ Real.exp ((2:ℝ)^(j+D)) := by
      filter_upwards [hh j] with x hx
      calc
        ‖f x‖ = (w j)⁻¹ * ‖F j x‖ := hf x
        _ ≤ (w j)⁻¹ * (w j * Real.exp ((2:ℝ)^(j+L))) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hx winv.le
        _ = Real.exp ((2:ℝ)^(j+L)) := by field_simp [(hw j).ne']
        _ ≤ Real.exp ((2:ℝ)^(j+D)) := Real.exp_monotone
          (pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num) (by dsimp [D]; omega))
    obtain ⟨G, hs, hsize, hi⟩ := hj₀ (j+D) (by dsimp [D]; omega) f ((hF j).const_mul _) hnorm
      hheight
    refine ⟨G, hs, hsize.trans (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal ?_), ?_⟩
    · apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hC (by positivity)
      gcongr
      simp
    have heq : F j = (fun x => ((w j : ℝ) : ℂ) * f x) := by
      ext1 x
      dsimp [f]
      rw [← mul_assoc, ← Complex.ofReal_mul, mul_inv_cancel₀ (hw j).ne',
        Complex.ofReal_one, one_mul]
    rw [heq]
    simp_rw [symmetricMaximal_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (hw j)]
    rw [lintegral_const_mul _ (measurable_symmetricMaximal f), ENNReal.ofReal_mul (hw j).le]
    exact mul_le_mul_right hi _
  choose G hGm hGsize hGi using hg
  have hCs : Summable (fun j : ℕ => C / ((j:ℝ)+1)^2) := by
    have hh : Summable (fun n : ℕ => 1 / ((n+1:ℕ):ℝ)^2) :=
      (summable_nat_add_iff 1).mpr (Real.summable_one_div_nat_pow.mpr (by norm_num))
    simpa [div_eq_mul_inv] using hh.mul_left C
  have hcompl : (∑' j, circleMeasure (G j)ᶜ) ≠ ∞ := by
    apply ne_of_lt
    refine (ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum hGsize).trans_lt ?_
    rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_tsum_of_nonneg _ hCs]
    · exact ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top
    · intro n; positivity
  let M (j : ℕ) (x : Torus) :=
    (G j).indicator (symmetricMaximal (F j)) x + ENNReal.ofReal ‖F j x‖
  have hM (j : ℕ) : AEMeasurable (M j) circleMeasure :=
    (((measurable_symmetricMaximal _).indicator (hGm _)).aemeasurable).add
      ((hF j).norm.aestronglyMeasurable.aemeasurable.ennreal_ofReal)
  have ht : ∫⁻ x, (∑' j, M j x) ∂circleMeasure ≠ ∞ := by
    have hhM (j : ℕ) : (∫⁻ x, M j x ∂circleMeasure)
          ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (w j * (C * (2:ℝ)^(j+D)) + w j) := by
      dsimp only [M]
      rw [lintegral_add_left ((measurable_symmetricMaximal _).indicator (hGm _)),
        lintegral_indicator (hGm j),
        ← ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal (hF j).norm
          (ae_of_all _ fun x => norm_nonneg _),
        ENNReal.ofReal_add (by have := hw j; positivity) (hw j).le]
      exact add_le_add (hGi j) (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (hm j))
    rw [lintegral_tsum hM]
    apply ne_of_lt
    refine (ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum hhM).trans_lt ?_
    have hwS : Summable w := hsum.of_nonneg_of_le (fun n => (hw n).le) (fun n =>
      le_mul_of_one_le_left (hw n).le (one_le_pow₀ (by norm_num : (1:ℝ) ≤ 2)))
    have hfull : Summable (fun j => w j * (C * (2:ℝ)^(j+D)) + w j) :=
      ((hsum.mul_left (C*(2:ℝ)^D)).add hwS).congr fun n => by
        simp only [pow_add]
        ring
    rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_tsum_of_nonneg _ hfull]
    · exact ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top
    · intro n; have := hw n; positivity
  filter_upwards [ae_eventually_notMem hcompl, ae_lt_top' (AEMeasurable.tsum hM) ht] with x hx hx'
  refine ⟨fun n => (M n x).toReal, ENNReal.summable_toReal hx'.ne, ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [hx] with j hj
  intro N
  have hmn := ENNReal.ne_top_of_tsum_ne_top hx'.ne j
  rw [← ENNReal.toReal_ofReal
    (add_nonneg (norm_nonneg (symmetricPartialSum _ _ _)) (norm_nonneg _))]
  apply ENNReal.toReal_mono hmn
  simp only [M, ENNReal.ofReal_add (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)]
  have : x ∈ G j := by simpa using hj
  rw [Set.indicator_of_mem this]
  exact add_le_add_left (le_iSup (fun N => ENNReal.ofReal ‖symmetricPartialSum (F j) N x‖) N) _

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.integrable_continuous
statement:
lemma integrable_continuous {f : Torus → ℂ} (hf : Continuous f) :
    Integrable f circleMeasure
proof:
:= by
  apply hf.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport
  exact IsClosed.isCompact (isClosed_tsupport f)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.eventually_partialSum_trigPoly
statement:
theorem eventually_partialSum_trigPoly {p : C(Torus, ℂ)} (h : p ∈ trigPolys) :
    ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in atTop, ∀ x, symmetricPartialSum p N x = p x
proof:
:= by
  induction h using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem p hp =>
    obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := hp
    filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop k.natAbs] with N hN
    intro x
    simp only [symmetricPartialSum, fourierCoeff_fourier]
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single k]
    · simp
    · intro b _ hb
      simp [hb]
    · intro hk
      exfalso
      apply hk
      simp only [Finset.mem_Icc]
      omega
  | zero => filter_upwards with N x using symmetricPartialSum_zero N x
  | add p q _ _ hp hq =>
    filter_upwards [hp, hq] with N hpN hqN
    intro x
    change symmetricPartialSum ((p : Torus → ℂ) + (q : Torus → ℂ)) N x = p x + q x
    rw [symmetricPartialSum_add (integrable_continuous p.continuous)
      (integrable_continuous q.continuous), hpN x, hqN x]
  | smul c p _ hp =>
    filter_upwards [hp] with N hpN
    intro x
    change symmetricPartialSum (fun y => c * p y) N x = c * p x
    rw [symmetricPartialSum_const_mul, hpN x]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.exists_bounded_trigPoly_approx
statement:
lemma exists_bounded_trigPoly_approx (f : Torus → ℂ)
    (hf : Integrable f circleMeasure)
    (B : ℝ) (hB : 0 < B) (hb : ∀ᵐ x ∂circleMeasure, ‖f x‖ ≤ B)
    (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ p : C(Torus, ℂ), p ∈ trigPolys ∧
      (∫ x, ‖f x - p x‖ ∂circleMeasure) ≤ ε ∧ ∀ x, ‖p x‖ ≤ B + 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g, hg, hgi⟩ :=
    hf.exists_boundedContinuous_integral_sub_le (show 0 < ε/4 by linarith)
  let k (x : Torus) : ℂ := (B / max B ‖g x‖) • g x
  have hk : Continuous k := by
    have h1 : Continuous fun x => max B ‖g x‖ := continuous_const.max g.continuous.norm
    exact (continuous_const.div h1 (fun x => ne_of_gt (lt_max_of_lt_left hB))).smul g.continuous
  let k' : C(Torus, ℂ) := ⟨k, hk⟩
  have hkB (x : Torus) : ‖k x‖ ≤ B := by
    have hm : 0 < max B ‖g x‖ := lt_max_of_lt_left hB
    simp only [k, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (div_pos hB hm)]
    exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_max_right B ‖g x‖) (div_pos hB hm).le).trans
      (div_mul_cancel₀ B hm.ne').le
  have hdk (x : Torus) (hx : ‖f x‖ ≤ B) : ‖f x - k x‖ ≤ 2 * ‖f x - g x‖ := by
    suffices H : ‖g x - k x‖ ≤ ‖f x - g x‖ by
      have hi := dist_triangle (f x) (g x) (k x)
      simp only [dist_eq_norm] at hi
      linarith
    rcases le_total ‖g x‖ B with hxg | hxg
    · simp [k, max_eq_left hxg, hB.ne']
    have hp : 0 < ‖g x‖ := hB.trans_le hxg
    have hxone : (0:ℝ) ≤ 1 - B/‖g x‖ := sub_nonneg.mpr ((div_le_one hp).mpr hxg)
    calc
      ‖g x - k x‖ = ‖((1:ℝ)-B/‖g x‖) • g x‖ := by
        rw [sub_smul, one_smul]; simp only [k, max_eq_right hxg]
      _ = ‖g x‖ - B := by
        rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hxone, sub_mul, one_mul,
          div_mul_cancel₀ B hp.ne']
      _ ≤ ‖g x‖ - ‖f x‖ := sub_le_sub_left hx _
      _ ≤ ‖f x - g x‖ := by rw [norm_sub_rev]; exact norm_sub_norm_le _ _
  have hkc : k' ∈ closure (trigPolys : Set _) := by
    change k' ∈ trigPolys.topologicalClosure
    rw [trigPolys, span_fourier_closure_eq_top]; trivial
  obtain ⟨p, hps, hp⟩ := Metric.mem_closure_iff.mp hkc (min 1 (ε / 2)) (by positivity)
  have hp' (x : Torus) : ‖k x - p x‖ < min 1 (ε / 2) := by
    change ‖k' x - p x‖ < _
    rw [← dist_eq_norm]
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt (ContinuousMap.dist_apply_le_dist _) hp
  refine ⟨p, hps, ?_, fun x => ?_⟩
  · calc
      _ ≤ ∫ x, (2 * ‖f x - g x‖ + (ε / 2)) ∂circleMeasure := by
        apply integral_mono_ae (hf.sub (integrable_continuous p.continuous)).norm
          (((hf.sub hgi).norm.const_mul _).add (integrable_const _))
        filter_upwards [hb] with x hx
        have h1 := dist_triangle (f x) (k x) (p x)
        simp only [dist_eq_norm] at h1
        exact h1.trans (add_le_add (hdk x hx)
          ((hp' x).le.trans (min_le_right _ _)))
      _ = 2 * (∫ x, ‖f x - g x‖ ∂circleMeasure) + (ε/2) := by
        rw [integral_add (show Integrable (fun x => 2 * ‖f x - g x‖) _ from ((hf.sub hgi).norm.const_mul _)) (integrable_const _),
          integral_const_mul]; simp
      _ ≤ ε := by linarith
  · have h1 := norm_sub_norm_le (p x) (k x)
    rw [norm_sub_rev] at h1
    have h2 := ((hp' x).le.trans (min_le_left _ _))
    linarith [hkB x]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.pad_pos
statement: private lemma pad_pos (j) : 0 < pad j
proof: := by unfold pad; positivity

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.summable_pad
statement: private lemma summable_pad : Summable (fun j => (2:ℝ)^j * pad j)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [pad, ← mul_pow]
  exact summable_geometric_of_norm_lt_one (by norm_num)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.pad_height
statement:
private lemma pad_height (j : ℕ) :
    Real.exp ((2:ℝ)^(j+2)) ≤ pad j * Real.exp ((2:ℝ)^(j+4))
proof:
:= by
  have hj : (j:ℝ) ≤ (2:ℝ)^j := by exact_mod_cast (Nat.lt_two_pow_self (n:=j)).le
  have hex : (4:ℝ)^j ≤ Real.exp ((3:ℝ) * j) := by
    have h3 := Real.add_one_le_exp 3
    rw [mul_comm 3, Real.exp_nat_mul]
    exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (by norm_num) (by norm_num at h3; linarith) _
  have Hmul : (4:ℝ)^j * Real.exp ((2:ℝ)^(j+2)) ≤ Real.exp ((2:ℝ)^(j+4)) := by
    refine (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hex (Real.exp_nonneg _)).trans ?_
    rw [← Real.exp_add]
    apply Real.exp_monotone
    simp only [pow_add]
    linarith
  simp only [pad, one_div, inv_pow, ← div_eq_inv_mul]
  apply (le_div_iff₀ (by positivity : (0:ℝ)<4^j)).mpr
  rw [mul_comm]
  exact Hmul

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.GoodBound.ae_convergence_bounded
statement:
theorem GoodBound.ae_convergence_bounded (hgb : GoodBound) (f : Torus → ℂ)
    (hf : Integrable f circleMeasure) (B : ℝ) (hB : 0 < B)
    (hb : ∀ᵐ x ∂circleMeasure, ‖f x‖ ≤ B) :
    ∀ᵐ x ∂circleMeasure, Tendsto (fun N : ℕ ↦ symmetricPartialSum f N x) atTop (𝓝 (f x))
proof:
:= by
  choose p hp hm hpB using
    (fun j => exists_bounded_trigPoly_approx f hf B hB hb (pad j) (pad_pos j))
  let F (j : ℕ) (x : Torus) : ℂ := f x - p j x
  have hFi (j) : Integrable (F j) circleMeasure :=
    hf.sub (integrable_continuous (p j).continuous)
  let w (j : ℕ) : ℝ := (2*B+1) * pad j
  have hw (j) : 0 < w j := mul_pos (by linarith) (pad_pos _)
  have hs : Summable fun j => (2:ℝ)^j * w j :=
    (summable_pad.mul_left (2*B+1)).congr fun j => by dsimp only [w]; ring
  have hmw (j) : (∫ x, ‖F j x‖ ∂circleMeasure) ≤ w j :=
    (hm j).trans (le_mul_of_one_le_left (pad_pos j).le (by linarith))
  have hheight (j) : ∀ᵐ x ∂circleMeasure, ‖F j x‖ ≤ w j * Real.exp ((2:ℝ)^(j+4)) := by
    filter_upwards [hb] with x hx
    calc
      ‖F j x‖ ≤ ‖f x‖ + ‖p j x‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
      _ ≤ (2*B+1)*Real.exp ((2:ℝ)^(j+2)) := by
        have := hpB j x
        have : 1 ≤ Real.exp ((2:ℝ)^(j+2)) := Real.one_le_exp (by positivity)
        nlinarith
      _ ≤ w j * Real.exp ((2:ℝ)^(j+4)) := by
        dsimp only [w]
        rw [mul_assoc]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (pad_height j) (by linarith)
  filter_upwards [hgb.ae_tail_majorant F w 4 hFi hw hs hmw hheight] with x hx
  obtain ⟨b, hsum, hmaj⟩ := hx
  apply Metric.tendsto_nhds.mpr
  intro ε hε
  obtain ⟨j, hj, hj'⟩ :=
    (hmaj.and (hsum.tendsto_atTop_zero.eventually (gt_mem_nhds hε))).exists
  filter_upwards [eventually_partialSum_trigPoly (hp j)] with N hN
  have hfdecomp : f = F j + (p j : Torus → ℂ) := by ext; simp [F]
  calc
    dist (symmetricPartialSum f N x) (f x)
        = ‖symmetricPartialSum (F j) N x - F j x‖ := by
          nth_rw 1 2 [hfdecomp]
          rw [symmetricPartialSum_add (hFi j) (integrable_continuous (p j).continuous),
            hN x, dist_eq_norm]
          simp only [Pi.add_apply, add_sub_add_right_eq_sub]
    _ ≤ ‖symmetricPartialSum (F j) N x‖ + ‖F j x‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
    _ ≤ b j := hj N
    _ < ε := hj'

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.GoodBound.main_bound_consequence
statement:
theorem GoodBound.main_bound_consequence (hgb : GoodBound)
    {f : Torus → ℂ} (hf : MemLLogL f) :
    ∃ E : Set Torus, MeasurableSet E ∧ circleMeasure E = 0 ∧ ∀ x ∉ E,
      Tendsto (fun N : ℕ ↦ symmetricPartialSum f N x) atTop (𝓝 (f x))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let w (j : ℕ) := heightLayerMass f j + pad j
  have hw (j : ℕ) : 0 < w j :=
    add_pos_of_nonneg_of_pos (heightLayerMass_nonneg f _) (pad_pos _)
  have hs : Summable (fun j => (2:ℝ)^j * w j) := by
    have hs' := hf.summable_weighted_heightLayerMass.mul_left ((1:ℝ)/2)
    refine (hs'.add summable_pad).congr ?_
    intro j
    dsimp only [w]
    rw [pow_succ]; ring
  have hm (j) : (∫ x, ‖heightLayer f j x‖ ∂circleMeasure) ≤ w j := by
    rw [← heightLayerMass_eq_integral_norm hf]
    apply le_add_of_nonneg_right
    exact (pad_pos j).le
  have hh (j) : ∀ᵐ x ∂circleMeasure,
      ‖heightLayer f j x‖ ≤ w j * Real.exp ((2:ℝ)^(j+4)) := by
    refine ae_of_all _ fun x => ((norm_heightLayer_le f j x).trans (pad_height j)).trans ?_
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
      (le_add_of_nonneg_left (heightLayerMass_nonneg _ _)) (Real.exp_nonneg _)
  have hbConv := hgb.ae_convergence_bounded _ hf.boundedPart_integrable _
    (Real.exp_pos _) (ae_of_all _ (norm_boundedPart_le f))
  have hConv (j) := hgb.ae_convergence_bounded _ (hf.heightLayer_integrable j) _
    (Real.exp_pos _) (ae_of_all _ (norm_heightLayer_le f j))
  apply exists_measurable_null_of_ae
  filter_upwards [hbConv, ae_all_iff.mpr hConv,
    hgb.ae_tail_majorant _ w 4 hf.heightLayer_integrable hw hs hm hh] with x hb hc hx
  obtain ⟨b, hsum, hmaj⟩ := hx
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := eventually_atTop.1 hmaj
  have hbd (j : ℕ) : BddAbove (Set.range
      (fun N : ℕ => ‖symmetricPartialSum (heightLayer f j) N x‖)) :=
    ((hc j).norm).bddAbove_range
  choose r hr using hbd
  let b' (j : ℕ) := if j < k then r j else b j
  have hs' : Summable b' := by
    apply (summable_nat_add_iff k).mp
    have hh := (summable_nat_add_iff k).mpr hsum
    simpa [b'] using hh
  have hmaj' (j N) : ‖symmetricPartialSum (heightLayer f j) N x‖ ≤ b' j := by
    dsimp [b']
    split_ifs with H
    · exact hr j (Set.mem_range_self N)
    · exact (le_add_of_nonneg_right (norm_nonneg _)).trans (hk j (by omega) N)
  have ht := tendsto_tsum_of_dominated_convergence hs' hc
    (Eventually.of_forall fun N j => hmaj' j N)
  have h := hb.add ht

  simpa only [hf.symmetricPartialSum_heightDecomposition, boundedPart_add_tsum_heightLayer] using h

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Period.center_sub
statement: private lemma center_sub : centerWin ⊆ window
proof:
:= by
  unfold centerWin window; grind

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Period.sumReal_integral
statement:
lemma sumReal_integral (ρ : ℝ → ℝ) (hρ : Measurable ρ) (h0 : ∀ x, 0 ≤ ρ x)
    (B : ℝ) (hb : ∀ x, ρ x ≤ B) (hp : Periodic ρ 1) (N : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    sumReal (fun y => (ρ y : ℂ)) N x =
      ∫ t in window, (ρ (x-t):ℂ) * centerWin.indicator (dirichlet N) t
proof:
:= by
  have hterm (n : ℤ) :
      (∫ y, (ρ y:ℂ) * phase (-n:ℤ) y ∂μ₁) * phase n x =
        ∫ t in centerWin, (ρ (x-t):ℂ) * phase n t := by
    let p (y : ℝ) := modρ ρ (-n:ℤ) y * phase n x
    have hpp : Periodic p 1 := by
      intro w
      simp only [p,modρ,hp w,phase_periodic (-n) w]
    have H (t : ℝ) : p (x-t) = (ρ (x-t) : ℂ) * phase n t := by
      dsimp only [p, modρ]; push_cast
      rw [mul_assoc, mul_comm (phase _ _), ← phase_sub,
        show x-(x-t)=t by ring]
    rw [← integral_mul_const]
    change (∫ y, p y ∂μ₁) = _
    simp_rw [← H]
    have HH := seg_translate_scale_rev p x (by norm_num : (-(1/2):ℝ)≤1/2)
      (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<1)
    simp only [one_mul, inv_one, one_smul] at HH
    rw [show x-(-(1/2):ℝ) = (x-1/2)+1 by ring, seg_period_unit p hpp] at HH
    simpa only [centerWin, neg_div] using HH.symm
  have hxρ : Measurable fun t => (ρ (x-t):ℂ) :=
    Complex.continuous_ofReal.measurable.comp (hρ.comp (by fun_prop))
  have heq (t : ℝ) : (ρ (x-t):ℂ)*centerWin.indicator (dirichlet N) t =
      centerWin.indicator (fun t => (ρ (x-t):ℂ)*dirichlet N t) t := by
    by_cases ht : t ∈ centerWin <;> simp [ht]
  unfold sumReal
  simp_rw [hterm,heq]
  rw [setIntegral_indicator (show MeasurableSet centerWin from measurableSet_Ico), inter_eq_right.mpr center_sub]
  unfold dirichlet
  simp_rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  rw [integral_finsetSum]
  intro n _
  refine seg_integrable _ (show Measurable (fun t => (ρ (x-t):ℂ)*phase n t)
    from hxρ.mul (phase_cont n).measurable) B _ _ fun t _ => ?_
  simp only [norm_mul, phase_unimod, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
    abs_of_nonneg (h0 _), mul_one]
  exact hb _

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Period.kernel_compare_result
statement:
lemma kernel_compare_result (ρ : ℝ → ℝ) (hρ : Measurable ρ) (h0 : ∀ x, 0 ≤ ρ x)
    (B : ℝ) (hb : ∀ x, ρ x ≤ B) (hp : Periodic ρ 1)
    (hm : (∫ x, ρ x ∂μ₁) ≤ 1) (N J : ℕ)
    (hJ : 140 * ((N:ℝ)+1) * B * side J ≤ 1) (x : ℝ) :
    ENNReal.ofReal ‖sumReal (fun y => (ρ y:ℂ)) N x‖ ≤ 41 + 4 * maxConvK ρ J x
proof:
:= by
  let d := side J
  have hd := side_pos J
  have hd' := side_le J
  have hB : 0 ≤ B := le_trans (h0 0) (hb 0)
  let u : ℝ := N
  let w (t : ℝ) := ρ (x-t)
  let V (t : ℝ) : ℂ := kernel d t • modρ ρ u (x-t)
  have hwm : Measurable w := hρ.comp (by fun_prop)
  have hw (t : ℝ) : 0 ≤ w t := h0 _
  have hwB (t : ℝ) : w t ≤ B := hb _
  have hwi (a b) : IntervalIntegrable w volume a b :=
    interval_integrable w hwm B (fun t => by
      simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (hw t)] using hwB t) a b
  have hw' : IntegrableOn w window :=
    Integrable.of_bound hwm.aestronglyMeasurable B (ae_of_all _ fun t => by
      simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (hw t)] using hwB t)
  have hmass : (∫ t in window, w t) ≤ 2 := by
    have H := seg_translate_scale_rev ρ x (by norm_num : (-1:ℝ) ≤ 1)
      (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<1)
    simp only [one_mul, inv_one, one_smul, sub_neg_eq_add] at H
    change (∫ t in Ico (-1:ℝ) 1, ρ (x-t)) ≤ 2
    have h := seg_period_int ρ hp (interval_integrable ρ hρ B (fun t => by
      simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (h0 t)] using hb t)) (x-1) 2
    rw [H, show x+1=x-1+(↑(2:ℕ) : ℝ) by norm_num; ring, h]
    simp; linarith
  have hVi : IntegrableOn V window := by
    have hVm : Measurable V := (kernel_measurable _).smul
      ((measurable_mod hρ u).comp (by fun_prop))
    apply Integrable.of_bound hVm.aestronglyMeasurable ((2/d)*B)
    apply ae_of_all
    intro t
    dsimp only [V]
    rw [norm_smul, norm_mod h0]
    exact mul_le_mul (kernel_small hd hd' _) (hb _) (h0 _) (div_nonneg (by norm_num) hd.le)
  let c := phase (-u) x
  let A : ℝ → ℂ := fun t => (w t:ℂ)* ↑(κfactor * kernel d t * Real.sin (ang u t))
  have hA (t) : A t = ↑((-κfactor)*(c * V t).im) := by
    have heq : c * V t = ↑(kernel d t)* (w t:ℂ) * phase u (-t) := by
      simp only [V,c,modρ,w,sub_eq_add_neg, phase_add, Complex.real_smul]
      have H : phase (-u) x * phase u x = 1 := by rw [← phase_freq_add]; simp [phase]
      linear_combination ↑(kernel d t) * (↑(ρ (x + -t)):ℂ) * phase u (-t) * H
    rw [heq, phase_trig]
    simp [A, ang, -Complex.ofReal_sin, -Complex.ofReal_cos]; ring
  have hiA : IntegrableOn A window := by

    have h : Integrable (fun t => c * V t) (volume.restrict window) := hVi.const_mul _
    rw [show A = _ from funext hA]
    exact Integrable.ofReal (h.im.const_mul _)
  have heA : (∫ t in window, A t) = ↑((-κfactor)*(c * convK (modρ ρ u) x J).im) := by
    simp_rw [hA]
    rw [integral_complex_ofReal, integral_const_mul]
    have h : Integrable (fun t => c * V t) (volume.restrict window) := hVi.const_mul _
    have hh := integral_im h
    change (∫ t in window, (c * V t).im) = (∫ t in window, c * V t).im at hh
    rw [hh, integral_const_mul]; rfl
  let T (t : ℝ) := (w t:ℂ) * centerWin.indicator (dirichlet N) t
  have hiT : IntegrableOn T window := by
    have h : Measurable T := (Complex.continuous_ofReal.measurable.comp hwm).mul
      ((dirichlet_cont _).measurable.indicator measurableSet_Ico)
    apply Integrable.of_bound h.aestronglyMeasurable (B*(2*N+1))
    apply ae_of_all
    intro t
    simp only [T, norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (hw t)]
    apply mul_le_mul (hwB _) ?_ (norm_nonneg _) hB
    by_cases ht : t ∈ centerWin
    · simpa [ht] using dirichlet_bound N t
    · simp only [indicator_of_notMem ht, norm_zero]; positivity
  let M := (70:ℝ) * ((N:ℝ)+1)
  let S : Set ℝ := Ico (-d) d
  have hSm : MeasurableSet S := measurableSet_Ico
  have hSw : S ⊆ window := Ico_subset_Ico (neg_le_neg hd') hd'
  let W (t : ℝ) := S.indicator (fun _ => M*B) t
  have hiW : IntegrableOn W window := (integrable_const _).indicator hSm
  have heW : (∫ t in window, W t) ≤ 1 := by
    dsimp only [W]
    rw [setIntegral_indicator hSm, inter_eq_right.mpr hSw, setIntegral_const,
      Real.volume_real_Ico_of_le (by dsimp only [d]; linarith), smul_eq_mul]
    dsimp only [M,d]
    linarith
  have hei :
      ‖(∫ t in window, T t) - ∫ t in window, A t‖ ≤ 41 := by
    rw [← integral_sub hiT hiA]
    apply (norm_integral_le_integral_norm _).trans
    calc
      _ ≤ ∫ t in window, (20*w t + W t) := by
        apply integral_mono_ae (hiT.sub hiA).norm ((hw'.const_mul (20:ℝ)).add hiW)
        filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem (show MeasurableSet window from measurableSet_Ico)]
          with t ht
        have hk : ‖T t - A t‖ = w t * ‖diffK d N t‖ := by
          dsimp only [T,A, diffK,u]
          rw [← mul_sub, norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (hw t)]
        change ‖T t - A t‖ ≤ 20*w t+W t
        have HH := diffK_major hd hd' ht N
        rw [hk]
        by_cases htd : |t| < d
        · rw [ite_eq_left (show |t| < side J from htd)] at HH
          have hs : t ∈ S := ⟨(abs_lt.mp htd).1.le,(abs_lt.mp htd).2⟩
          rw [show W t = M*B from indicator_of_mem hs _]
          change _ ≤ M at HH
          have : 0 ≤ M := by dsimp [M]; positivity
          have := mul_le_mul (hwB t) HH (norm_nonneg _) hB
          nlinarith [hw t]
        · rw [ite_eq_right (show ¬ |t| < side J from htd)] at HH
          have : 0 ≤ W t := by
            by_cases h : t ∈ S
            · rw [show W t = M*B from indicator_of_mem h _]
              dsimp [M]; positivity
            · rw [show W t = 0 from indicator_of_notMem h _]
          nlinarith [hw t]
      _ ≤ 41 := by rw [integral_add (hw'.const_mul (20:ℝ)) hiW, integral_const_mul]; linarith
  have hbound : ‖sumReal (fun y => (ρ y:ℂ)) N x‖ ≤ 41 + 4 * ‖convK (modρ ρ u) x J‖ := by
    rw [sumReal_integral ρ hρ h0 B hb hp]
    change ‖∫ t in window, T t‖ ≤ _
    have hh := le_trans (norm_sub_norm_le (∫ t in window, T t) (∫ t in window, A t)) hei
    rw [heA, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_neg] at hh
    have H1 := Complex.abs_im_le_norm (c * convK (modρ ρ u) x J)
    rw [norm_mul, show ‖c‖=1 from phase_unimod _ _, one_mul] at H1
    have := mul_le_mul κfactor_bound H1 (abs_nonneg _) (by norm_num)
    linarith
  apply (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal hbound).trans
  rw [ENNReal.ofReal_add (by norm_num) (by positivity), ENNReal.ofReal_mul (by norm_num)]
  have Hle := le_iSup (fun n : ℤ => ENNReal.ofReal ‖convK (modρ ρ n) x J‖) (N:ℤ)
  simp only [Int.cast_natCast] at Hle
  norm_num

  gcongr
  rw [← ofReal_norm]; exact Hle

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Period.AffineTreeBound.realGoodBound
statement: theorem AffineTreeBound.realGoodBound (h : AffineTreeBound) : RealGoodBound
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨C, hC, h⟩ := h
  let D := 100 + 64*C
  refine ⟨D, (show 0 ≤ 100+64*C by positivity), ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [h] with j hj
  intro ρ hρ hp h0 hm hb
  let B := Real.exp ((2:ℝ)^j)
  have hB : 0 < B := Real.exp_pos _
  obtain ⟨G,hG,hGs,hGc,hGd⟩ :=
    density_good_set ρ hρ hp h0 B hb hm (((j:ℝ)+1)^3) (by positivity)
  refine ⟨G,hG,hGc.trans (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal ?_),?_⟩
  · have hn : (1:ℝ) ≤ (j:ℝ)+1 := by simp
    apply div_le_div₀
    all_goals first
      | dsimp [D]; positivity
      | positivity
      | dsimp [D]; linarith
      | gcongr; norm_num
  rw [μ₁, Measure.restrict_restrict hG, inter_eq_left.mpr hGs]
  let Y (N : ℕ) (x : ℝ) := ENNReal.ofReal ‖sumReal (fun y => (ρ y:ℂ)) N x‖
  let Ym (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ) := ⨆ N : ℕ, ⨆ (_ : N ≤ n), Y N x
  have hYm (n : ℕ) : Measurable (Ym n) := by
    refine Measurable.iSup fun N => Measurable.iSup fun _ => ?_
    refine Measurable.ennreal_ofReal (Measurable.norm (Continuous.measurable ?_))
    apply continuous_finsetSum
    intro k _
    exact continuous_const.mul (phase_cont _)
  have hYm_m : Monotone Ym := fun n m h x => iSup_le fun k => iSup_le fun hk =>
    le_iSup₂ (f:=fun N (_h : N ≤ m) => Y N x) k (le_trans hk h)
  have hmax (x : ℝ) : maxReal (fun y => (ρ y:ℂ)) x ≤ ⨆ n, Ym n x := by
    refine iSup_le fun n =>
      (le_iSup₂ (f := fun N (_h : N ≤ n) => Y N x) n le_rfl).trans (le_iSup (fun n => Ym n x) n)
  refine (lintegral_mono hmax).trans ?_
  rw [lintegral_iSup hYm hYm_m]
  refine iSup_le fun n => ?_
  have Hs : Tendsto side atTop (𝓝 0) :=
    tendsto_pow_atTop_nhds_zero_of_lt_one (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
  obtain ⟨J,hJ⟩ := ((show Tendsto (fun j => 140*((n:ℝ)+1)*B*side j) atTop (𝓝 0) by
    simpa only [mul_zero] using Hs.const_mul (140*((n:ℝ)+1)*B)).eventually
      (gt_mem_nhds (show (0:ℝ)<1 by norm_num))).exists
  change 140*((n:ℝ)+1)*B*side J < 1 at hJ
  have HL : (∫⁻ x in G, maxConvK ρ J x) ≤ 16 * ENNReal.ofReal (C*(2:ℝ)^j) :=
    convolution_cost hρ h0 B hb G hG hGs _ J
      (fun s hs a _ => hj ρ hρ hp h0 hm hb J G hG hGd a s hs.1 hs.2.le)
  have HE (x : ℝ) : Ym n x ≤ 41 + 4 * maxConvK ρ J x := by
    refine iSup_le fun k => iSup_le fun hk =>
      kernel_compare_result ρ hρ h0 B hb hp hm k J (le_trans ?_ hJ.le) x
    have := side_pos J
    gcongr
  refine (lintegral_mono HE).trans ?_
  rw [lintegral_add_left measurable_const,
    lintegral_const_mul _ (show Measurable (maxConvK ρ J) from measurable_maxConvK hρ J),
    setLIntegral_const]
  have hv : volume G ≤ 1 := (measure_mono hGs).trans (by simp [unitInt])
  calc
    _ ≤ 41 + 4*(16*ENNReal.ofReal (C*(2:ℝ)^j)) :=
      add_le_add (mul_le_of_le_one_right zero_le hv) (mul_le_mul_right HL _)
    _ = ENNReal.ofReal (41 + 4*(16*(C*(2:ℝ)^j))) := by
      rw [ENNReal.ofReal_add (by positivity) (by positivity),
        ENNReal.ofReal_mul (show (0:ℝ)≤4 by norm_num),
        ENNReal.ofReal_mul (show (0:ℝ)≤16 by norm_num)]
      norm_num
    _ ≤ _ := ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (by
      dsimp [D]
      have H : (1:ℝ) ≤ 2^j := one_le_pow₀ (by norm_num)
      linarith)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Period.measurableH
statement: lemma measurableH : Measurable haarH
proof:
:=
  (measurable_const.indicator measurableSet_Ico).sub (measurable_const.indicator measurableSet_Ico)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Period.measurableG
statement: lemma measurableG : Measurable haarG
proof:
:=
  (measurableH.comp (measurable_const.mul measurable_id)).sub
    (measurableH.comp ((measurable_const.mul measurable_id).sub measurable_const))

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Period.H_of_left
statement: lemma H_of_left {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ Ico (0:ℝ) (1/2)) : haarH x = 1
proof:
:= by
  have : x ∉ Ico (1/2:ℝ) 1 := fun h => (not_lt_of_ge h.1) hx.2
  rw [haarH, Pi.sub_apply, indicator_of_mem hx, indicator_of_notMem this, sub_zero]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Period.H_of_right
statement: lemma H_of_right {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ Ico (1/2:ℝ) 1) : haarH x = -1
proof:
:= by
  have : x ∉ Ico (0:ℝ) (1/2) := fun h => (not_lt_of_ge hx.1) h.2
  rw [haarH, Pi.sub_apply, indicator_of_notMem this, indicator_of_mem hx, zero_sub]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Period.H_outside
statement: lemma H_outside {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∉ unitInt) : haarH x = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : x ∉ Ico (0:ℝ) (1/2) := fun h => hx ⟨h.1,h.2.trans (by norm_num)⟩
  have h2 : x ∉ Ico (1/2:ℝ) 1 := fun h => hx ⟨le_trans (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)≤1/2) h.1,h.2⟩
  rw [haarH, Pi.sub_apply, indicator_of_notMem h1, indicator_of_notMem h2, sub_zero]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Period.H_bound
statement: lemma H_bound (x : ℝ) : |haarH x| ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hx : x ∈ unitInt
  · rcases lt_or_ge x (1/2) with h|h
    · rw [H_of_left ⟨hx.1,h⟩]; simp
    · rw [H_of_right ⟨h,hx.2⟩]; simp
  · simp [H_outside hx]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Period.G_outside
statement: lemma G_outside {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∉ unitInt) : haarG x = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : 2*x ∉ unitInt := by
    rintro ⟨h1,h2⟩
    exact hx ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
  have h2 : 2*x - 1 ∉ unitInt := by
    rintro ⟨h1,h2⟩
    exact hx ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
  simp [haarG,H_outside h1,H_outside h2]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Period.G_bound
statement: lemma G_bound (x : ℝ) : |haarG x| ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hx : 2*x ∈ unitInt
  · have hx' : 2*x-1 ∉ unitInt := by
      intro h
      linarith [hx.2,h.1]
    simpa [haarG,H_outside hx'] using H_bound (2*x)
  · simpa [haarG,H_outside hx] using H_bound (2*x-1)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Period.side_pos
statement: lemma side_pos (n : ℕ) : 0 < side n
proof: := by unfold side; positivity

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Period.side_le
statement: lemma side_le (n : ℕ) : side n ≤ 1
proof: := by unfold side; exact pow_le_one₀ (by norm_num) (by norm_num)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Period.pow_mul_side
statement: lemma pow_mul_side (n : ℕ) : (2:ℝ)^n * side n = 1
proof: := by rw [side, ← mul_pow]; norm_num

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Period.side_succ
statement: lemma side_succ (n : ℕ) : side (n+1) = side n / 2
proof: := by simp [side, pow_succ, div_eq_mul_inv]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Period.cell_in_top
statement:
lemma cell_in_top (a : ℝ) {s : ℝ} {n k : ℕ} (hs : 0 < s) (hk : k < 2^n) :
    box (lft a s n k) (s * side n) ⊆ box a s
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  rcases hx with ⟨h1,h2⟩
  constructor
  · refine le_trans ?_ h1
    exact le_add_of_nonneg_right (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (mul_pos hs (side_pos _)).le)
  · refine lt_of_lt_of_le h2 ?_
    calc
      lft a s n k + s * side n = a + ((k+1:ℕ) : ℝ) * (s*side n) := by
        push_cast; unfold lft; ring
      _ ≤ a + ((2:ℝ)^n) * (s*side n) :=
        add_le_add_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
          (by exact_mod_cast (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hk)) (mul_pos hs (side_pos _)).le) _
      _ = a + s := by rw [mul_left_comm, pow_mul_side, mul_one]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Period.norm_mem_box
statement:
lemma norm_mem_box {a s x : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) :
    (x-a)/s ∈ unitInt ↔ x ∈ box a s
proof:
:= by
  unfold unitInt box
  simp only [mem_Ico, le_div_iff₀ hs, div_lt_iff₀ hs, one_mul, zero_mul]
  constructor
  · intro ⟨h1,h2⟩; constructor <;> linarith
  · intro ⟨h1,h2⟩; constructor <;> linarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Period.jump_outside
statement:
lemma jump_outside {a r x : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (hx : x ∉ box a r) (F) :
    jump F a r x = 0
proof: := by simp only [jump, G_outside (mt (norm_mem_box hr).mp hx), zero_smul]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Period.shift_outside
statement:
lemma shift_outside {a s x : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) (hx : x ∉ box a s) (F J) :
    shift F a s J x = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun n _ => Finset.sum_eq_zero fun k hk => ?_
  exact jump_outside (mul_pos hs (side_pos _)) (fun H => hx (cell_in_top a hs
    (Finset.mem_range.mp hk) H)) _

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Period.measurable_mod
statement: lemma measurable_mod {ρ : ℝ → ℝ} (hρ : Measurable ρ) (u : ℝ) : Measurable (modρ ρ u)
proof:
:=
  (Complex.continuous_ofReal.measurable.comp hρ).mul (phase_cont u).measurable

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Period.measurable_jump_comp
statement:
lemma measurable_jump_comp (hF : Measurable F) (ha : Measurable A) (hr : Measurable R)
    (ho : Measurable O) : Measurable fun x => jump F (A x) (R x) (O x)
proof:
:= by
  refine (measurableG.comp ((ho.sub ha).div hr)).smul ?_
  apply StronglyMeasurable.measurable
  unfold coeffH
  refine StronglyMeasurable.integral_prod_right (Measurable.stronglyMeasurable ?_)
  exact (measurableH.comp measurable_snd).smul (hF.comp
    ((ha.comp measurable_fst).add ((hr.comp measurable_fst).mul measurable_snd)))

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Period.measurable_shift_comp
statement:
lemma measurable_shift_comp (hF : Measurable F) (ha : Measurable A) (hr : Measurable R)
    (ho : Measurable O) (J : ℕ) : Measurable fun x => shift F (A x) (R x) J (O x)
proof:
:=
  Finset.measurable_sum _ (fun _ _ => Finset.measurable_sum _ (fun _ _ =>
    measurable_jump_comp hF (ha.add (measurable_const.mul (hr.mul measurable_const)))
      (hr.mul measurable_const) ho))

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Period.measurable_maxShift_comp
statement:
lemma measurable_maxShift_comp {ρ : ℝ → ℝ} (hρ : Measurable ρ) (ha : Measurable A) (hr : Measurable R)
    (ho : Measurable O) (J) : Measurable fun x => maxShift ρ (A x) (R x) J (O x)
proof:
:=
  Measurable.iSup (fun _ => (measurable_shift_comp (measurable_mod hρ _) ha hr ho J).norm.ennreal_ofReal)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Period.bounded_jump
statement:
lemma bounded_jump {F : ℝ → ℂ} (hf : Measurable F) (B : ℝ) (hb : ∀ x, ‖F x‖ ≤ B)
    (a r x : ℝ) : ‖jump F a r x‖ ≤ B
proof:
:= by
  have h (v : ℝ) : ‖haarH v • F (a+r*v)‖ ≤ B := by
    rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    exact (mul_le_of_le_one_left (norm_nonneg _) (H_bound _)).trans (hb _)
  have hm : Measurable (fun v => haarH v • F (a+r*v)) :=
    measurableH.smul (hf.comp (measurable_const.add (measurable_const.mul measurable_id)))
  rw [jump, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs]
  refine (mul_le_of_le_one_left (norm_nonneg _) (G_bound _)).trans
    ((norm_integral_le_integral_norm _).trans ?_)
  apply le_trans (b:= ∫ _, B ∂μ₁)
  · exact integral_mono (Integrable.of_bound hm.aestronglyMeasurable B (ae_of_all _ h)).norm
      (integrable_const _) h
  · simp

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Period.bounded_haarLayer
statement:
lemma bounded_haarLayer {F : ℝ → ℂ} (hf : Measurable F) (B : ℝ) (hb : ∀ x, ‖F x‖ ≤ B)
    (a s : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ) : ‖haarLayer F a s n x‖ ≤ (2:ℝ)^n * B
proof:
:= by
  apply (norm_sum_le _ _).trans
  apply le_trans (b := ∑ _ ∈ Finset.range ((2:ℕ)^n), B)
  · exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun k _ => bounded_jump hf B hb _ _ _
  simp

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Period.bounded_shift
statement:
lemma bounded_shift {F : ℝ → ℂ} (hf : Measurable F) (B : ℝ) (hb : ∀ x, ‖F x‖ ≤ B)
    (a s : ℝ) (J : ℕ) (x : ℝ) : ‖shift F a s J x‖ ≤ ∑ n ∈ Finset.range J, (2:ℝ)^n * B
proof:
:=
  (norm_sum_le _ _).trans (Finset.sum_le_sum fun _ _ => bounded_haarLayer hf B hb _ _ _ _)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Period.seg_eq_interval
statement:
lemma seg_eq_interval (f : ℝ → E) {a b : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b) :
    (∫ x in Ico a b, f x) = ∫ x in a..b, f x
proof:
:= by
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hab]
  apply setIntegral_congr_set
  exact Ico_ae_eq_Ioc

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Period.seg_translate_scale
statement:
lemma seg_translate_scale (f : ℝ → E) (d : ℝ) {a b c : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b) (hc : 0 < c) :
    (∫ x in Ico a b, f (d + c*x)) = c⁻¹ • ∫ x in Ico (d+c*a) (d+c*b), f x
proof:
:= by
  rw [seg_eq_interval _ hab, intervalIntegral.integral_comp_add_mul f hc.ne',
    seg_eq_interval _ (by gcongr)]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Period.seg_translate_scale_rev
statement:
lemma seg_translate_scale_rev (f : ℝ → E) (d : ℝ) {a b c : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b) (hc : 0 < c) :
    (∫ x in Ico a b, f (d - c*x)) = c⁻¹ • ∫ x in Ico (d-c*b) (d-c*a), f x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [sub_eq_add_neg, ← neg_mul]
  rw [seg_eq_interval _ hab, intervalIntegral.integral_comp_add_mul f (neg_ne_zero.mpr hc.ne'),
    seg_eq_interval _ (by nlinarith : d + (-c)*b ≤ d + (-c)*a),
    intervalIntegral.integral_symm, inv_neg]
  simp

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Period.mean_translate_scale
statement:
lemma mean_translate_scale (f : ℝ → E) (d : ℝ) {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) :
    (∫ x, f (d + c*x) ∂μ₁) = c⁻¹ • ∫ x in Ico d (d+c), f x
proof:
:= by
  simpa [μ₁, unitInt] using
    seg_translate_scale f d (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) ≤ 1) hc

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Period.seg_period_unit
statement:
lemma seg_period_unit (f : ℝ → E) (hf : Periodic f 1) (a : ℝ) :
    (∫ x in Ico a (a+1), f x) = ∫ x, f x ∂μ₁
proof:
:= by
  rw [seg_eq_interval _ (by linarith), hf.intervalIntegral_add_eq a 0,
    μ₁, unitInt, seg_eq_interval _ (by linarith)]
  simp

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Period.seg_period_int
statement:
lemma seg_period_int (f : ℝ → E) (hf : Periodic f 1)
    (hfi : ∀ a b, IntervalIntegrable f volume a b) (a : ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    (∫ x in Ico a (a+k), f x) = k • ∫ x, f x ∂μ₁
proof:
:= by
  rw [seg_eq_interval _ (by simp : a ≤ a+(k:ℝ)), ← seg_period_unit f hf a,
    seg_eq_interval _ (by linarith)]
  simpa using hf.intervalIntegral_add_zsmul_eq (k:ℤ) a hfi

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Period.seg_integrable
statement:
lemma seg_integrable (f : ℝ → E) (h : Measurable f) (B : ℝ) (a b : ℝ)
    (hB : ∀ x ∈ Ico a b, ‖f x‖ ≤ B) :
    IntegrableOn f (Ico a b)
proof:
:= by
  exact Integrable.of_bound h.aestronglyMeasurable B
    ((ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ico).mono hB)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Period.interval_integrable
statement:
lemma interval_integrable (f : ℝ → E) (h : Measurable f) (B : ℝ) (hB : ∀ x, ‖f x‖ ≤ B)
    (a b : ℝ) : IntervalIntegrable f volume a b
proof:
:=
  ⟨Integrable.of_bound h.aestronglyMeasurable B (ae_of_all _ hB),
    Integrable.of_bound h.aestronglyMeasurable B (ae_of_all _ hB)⟩

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Period.density_short
statement:
lemma density_short (ρ : ℝ → ℝ) (hρ : Measurable ρ) (hp : Periodic ρ 1)
    (h0 : ∀ x, 0 ≤ ρ x) (B : ℝ) (hb : ∀ x, ρ x ≤ B)
    (hm : (∫ x, ρ x ∂μ₁) ≤ 1) (a s : ℝ) (hs : s ≤ 1) :
    (∫ x in Ico a (a+s), ρ x) ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  have hsub : Ico a (a+s) ⊆ Ico a (a+1) := Ico_subset_Ico_right (by gcongr)
  apply le_trans (b := ∫ x in Ico a (a+1), ρ x)
  · exact setIntegral_mono_set
      (seg_integrable _ hρ B _ _ (fun x _ => by simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (h0 x)] using hb x))
      (ae_of_all _ h0) (ae_of_all _ (fun _ hx => hsub hx))
  · rwa [seg_period_unit _ hp]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Period.density_good_set
statement:
theorem density_good_set (ρ : ℝ → ℝ) (hρ : Measurable ρ) (hp : Periodic ρ 1)
    (h0 : ∀ x, 0 ≤ ρ x) (B : ℝ) (hb : ∀ x, ρ x ≤ B)
    (hm : (∫ x, ρ x ∂μ₁) ≤ 1) (D : ℝ) (hD : 0 < D) :
    ∃ G : Set ℝ, MeasurableSet G ∧ G ⊆ unitInt ∧
      μ₁ Gᶜ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (64 / D) ∧
      ∀ x ∈ G, ∀ (a s : ℝ), 0 < s → s ≤ 1 → x ∈ Ico a (a+s) →
        (∫ y in Ico a (a+s), ρ y) ≤ D*s
proof:
:= by
  let W (p : ℝ × ℝ) := Metric.ball p.1 p.2
  let T : Set (ℝ × ℝ) := {p | 0 < p.2 ∧ p.2 ≤ 1 ∧ W p ⊆ Ico (-4) 4 ∧
    D*p.2 < ∫ y in W p, ρ y}
  let A := ⋃ p ∈ T, W p
  have hWo (p) : IsOpen (W p) := Metric.isOpen_ball
  have hAo : IsOpen A := isOpen_iUnion fun p => isOpen_iUnion fun _ => hWo p
  obtain ⟨V,hVT,hdis,hV⟩ :=
    Vitali.exists_disjoint_subfamily_covering_enlargement_ball T Prod.fst Prod.snd
      1 (fun p h => h.2.1) 4 (by norm_num)
  have cnt : V.Countable := PairwiseDisjoint.countable_of_isOpen (s:=W) hdis
    (fun p _ => hWo p) fun p hp => ⟨p.1, Metric.mem_ball_self (hVT hp).1⟩
  have hv (p) : ‖ρ p‖ ≤ B := by simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (h0 p)] using hb p
  have hi : IntegrableOn ρ (Ico (-4:ℝ) 4) :=
    seg_integrable _ hρ B _ _ (fun p _ => hv p)
  have hneg : (∫ x in Ico (-4:ℝ) 4, ρ x) ≤ 8 := by
    have HH := seg_period_int ρ hp (interval_integrable ρ hρ B hv) (-4) 8
    norm_num at HH
    rw [HH]
    linarith
  let ρ' (y : ℝ) := ENNReal.ofReal (ρ y)
  have hi' : (∫⁻ x in Ico (-4:ℝ) 4, ρ' x) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal 8 := by
    dsimp only [ρ']
    rw [← ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal hi (ae_of_all _ h0)]
    exact ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal hneg
  have hcov : A ⊆ ⋃ p ∈ V, Metric.ball p.1 (4 * p.2) := by
    refine iUnion₂_subset fun p hp => ?_
    obtain ⟨q,hq,hpq⟩ := hV p hp
    exact fun x hx => mem_iUnion₂.mpr ⟨q,hq,hpq hx⟩
  have hsingle (p : ℝ × ℝ) (hp : p ∈ V) :
      volume (Metric.ball p.1 (4 * p.2)) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (8 / D) * ∫⁻ x in W p, ρ' x := by
    have hp' := hVT hp
    rw [Real.volume_ball, ← ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal (hi.mono_set hp'.2.2.1)
      (ae_of_all _ h0), ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (by positivity)]
    apply ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
    have hh := hp'.2.2.2
    calc
      _ = 8 / D * (D * p.2) := by field_simp; ring
      _ ≤ _ := by gcongr
  have : Countable V := cnt.to_subtype
  have htot : volume A ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (64 / D) := by
    refine ((measure_mono hcov).trans (measure_biUnion_le volume cnt _)).trans
      ((ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum (fun i : V => hsingle i.val i.property)).trans ?_)
    rw [ENNReal.tsum_mul_left]
    have hlim : (∑' p : V, ∫⁻ x in W p, ρ' x) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal 8 := by
      rw [← lintegral_iUnion]
      · refine le_trans (lintegral_mono_set (iUnion_subset (fun (p : V) => ?_))) hi'
        exact (hVT p.property).2.2.1
      · exact fun p => (hWo p).measurableSet
      · exact fun i j h => hdis i.property j.property (fun e => h (Subtype.ext e))
    refine (mul_le_mul_right hlim _).trans (le_of_eq ?_)
    rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (by positivity : 0 ≤ 8 / D)]
    ring_nf
  refine ⟨unitInt \ A, measurable_unitInt.diff hAo.measurableSet, sdiff_subset, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [μ₁, Measure.restrict_apply (measurable_unitInt.diff hAo.measurableSet).compl]
    exact (measure_mono (by grind : ((unitInt \ A)ᶜ ∩ unitInt) ⊆ A)).trans htot
  · intro x hx a s hs hs' hxs
    by_contra hn
    let p := (a+s/2,s)
    have hsub : Ico a (a+s) ⊆ W p := by
      intro y hy
      rcases hy with ⟨h1,h2⟩
      simp only [W, p, Real.ball_eq_Ioo, mem_Ioo]
      constructor <;> linarith
    have hsub' : W p ⊆ Ico (-4:ℝ) 4 := by
      intro y hy
      simp only [W,p,Real.ball_eq_Ioo, mem_Ioo] at hy
      rcases hx.1 with ⟨h1,h2⟩
      rcases hxs with ⟨h3,h4⟩
      constructor <;> linarith [hy.1, hy.2]
    have hp : p ∈ T := ⟨hs, hs', hsub', lt_of_lt_of_le (lt_of_not_ge hn)
      (setIntegral_mono_set (hi.mono_set hsub') (ae_of_all _ h0)
       (ae_of_all _ (fun _ h => hsub h)))⟩
    exact hx.2 (mem_iUnion₂.mpr ⟨p,hp,hsub hxs⟩)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Period.kappa_eq_mean
statement:
lemma kappa_eq_mean (t : ℝ) : kappa t =
    ∫ v, haarG v * haarH (v-t) ∂μ₁
proof:
:= by
  apply Eq.symm
  apply setIntegral_eq_integral_of_forall_compl_eq_zero
  intro v hv; rw [G_outside hv, zero_mul]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Period.step_split
statement:
private lemma step_split {a b c : ℝ} (h : a ≤ b) (h' : b ≤ c) (x) :
    Step a c x = Step a b x + Step b c x
proof:
:= by
  unfold Step
  simp only [indicator_apply, mem_Ico]
  split_ifs <;> grind

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Period.haarH_step
statement:
private lemma haarH_step (x) :
    haarH x = (P 0 x + P 1 x) - (P 2 x + P 3 x)
proof:
:= by
  change Step 0 (1/2) x - Step (1/2) 1 x = _
  rw [step_split (b:=1/4) (by norm_num) (by norm_num) x,
    step_split (c:=1) (b:=3/4) (by norm_num) (by norm_num) x]
  norm_num [P]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Period.step_twice
statement:
private lemma step_twice (a b c x : ℝ) :
    Step b c (2*x-a) = Step ((b+a)/2) ((c+a)/2) x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Step, indicator_apply, mem_Ico]
  split_ifs <;> grind

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Period.haarG_step
statement:
private lemma haarG_step (x) :
    haarG x = (P 0 x - P 1 x) - (P 2 x - P 3 x)
proof:
:= by
  change Step 0 (1/2) (2*x) - Step (1/2) 1 (2*x) -
    (Step 0 (1/2) (2*x-1) - Step (1/2) 1 (2*x-1)) = _
  nth_rw 1 2 [show 2*x = 2*x - 0 from (sub_zero _).symm]
  simp only [step_twice]
  norm_num [P]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Period.step_trans
statement: private lemma step_trans (a b t x : ℝ) : Step a b (x-t) = Step (a+t) (b+t) x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Step, indicator_apply, mem_Ico]
  split_ifs <;> grind

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Period.step_mul
statement:
private lemma step_mul (a b c d x : ℝ) :
    Step a b x * Step c d x = Step (max a c) (min b d) x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Step, indicator_apply, mem_Ico, max_le_iff, lt_min_iff]
  split_ifs <;> grind

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Period.integrable_step
statement: private lemma integrable_step (a b) : Integrable (Step a b)
proof:
:= by
  apply IntegrableOn.integrable_indicator _ measurableSet_Ico
  exact integrable_const _

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Period.integral_step
statement: private lemma integral_step (a b) : (∫ v, Step a b v) = max 0 (b-a)
proof:
:= by
  unfold Step
  rw [integral_indicator measurableSet_Ico, setIntegral_const, smul_eq_mul, mul_one,
    measureReal_def, Real.volume_Ico, ENNReal.toReal_ofReal']
  rw [max_comm]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Period.pair_id
statement:
private lemma pair_id (t x : ℝ) (n m) : P n x * P m (x-t) =
    Step (max ((n:ℝ)/4) ((m:ℝ)/4+t)) (min ((n:ℝ)/4+1/4) ((m:ℝ)/4+1/4+t)) x
proof:
:= by
  unfold P; rw [step_trans, step_mul]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Period.integrable_pair
statement: private lemma integrable_pair (t : ℝ) (n m) : Integrable (fun x => P n x * P m (x-t))
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [pair_id]
  exact integrable_step _ _

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Period.integral_pair
statement:
private lemma integral_pair (t : ℝ) (n m) : (∫ x, P n x * P m (x-t)) =
    hatK (t-(((n:ℝ)-m)/4))
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [pair_id]
  rw [integral_step, hatK]
  congr 1
  rw [abs_eq_max_neg]
  grind

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Period.kappa_eq
statement:
lemma kappa_eq (t : ℝ) :
    kappa t = hatK (t-3/4) - hatK (t+3/4) + 3*hatK (t+1/4) - 3*hatK (t-1/4)
proof:
:= by
  let F (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ) := P n x * haarH (x-t)
  let G (n : ℕ) :=
    (∫ x, P n x * P 0 (x-t)) + (∫ x, P n x * P 1 (x-t)) -
    ((∫ x, P n x * P 2 (x-t)) + (∫ x, P n x * P 3 (x-t)))
  have H (n : ℕ) : Integrable (F n) ∧ (∫ x, F n x) = G n := by
    let f (m : ℕ) (x : ℝ) := P n x * P m (x-t)
    have hm (m) : Integrable (f m) := integrable_pair t n m
    have he (x : ℝ) : F n x = (f 0 x + f 1 x)-(f 2 x + f 3 x) := by
      unfold F f; rw [haarH_step]; ring
    have hfunc : F n = fun x => (f 0 x + f 1 x)-(f 2 x + f 3 x) := funext he
    have h1 : Integrable fun x => f 0 x + f 1 x := (hm _).add (hm _)
    have h2 : Integrable fun x => f 2 x + f 3 x := (hm _).add (hm _)
    rw [hfunc, integral_sub h1 h2, integral_add (hm 0) (hm 1), integral_add (hm 2) (hm 3)]
    exact ⟨h1.sub h2, rfl⟩
  have he (x) : haarG x * haarH (x-t) = (F 0 x - F 1 x)-(F 2 x - F 3 x) := by
    rw [haarG_step]; unfold F; ring
  unfold kappa
  simp_rw [he]
  have h1 : Integrable (fun x => F 0 x - F 1 x) := (H _).1.sub (H _).1
  have h2 : Integrable (fun x => F 2 x - F 3 x) := (H _).1.sub (H _).1
  rw [integral_sub h1 h2, integral_sub (H 0).1 (H 1).1, integral_sub (H 2).1 (H 3).1]
  simp_rw [(H _).2]
  dsimp only [G]
  simp_rw [integral_pair]
  push_cast
  ring_nf

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Period.hatK_cont
statement: lemma hatK_cont : Continuous hatK
proof: := by unfold hatK; fun_prop

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Period.hatK_neg
statement: lemma hatK_neg (x) : hatK (-x) = hatK x
proof: := by simp [hatK]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Period.hatK_bound
statement: lemma hatK_bound (x) : |hatK x| ≤ 1/4
proof: := by unfold hatK; grind

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Period.hatK_zero
statement: lemma hatK_zero {x : ℝ} (hx : (1/4:ℝ) ≤ |x|) : hatK x = 0
proof: := max_eq_left (by linarith)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Period.kappa_cont
statement: lemma kappa_cont : Continuous kappa
proof:
:= by
  have heq := funext kappa_eq
  rw [heq]
  have hh := hatK_cont
  fun_prop

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Period.kappa_neg
statement: lemma kappa_neg (t) : kappa (-t) = - kappa t
proof:
:= by
  rw [kappa_eq, kappa_eq]
  simp only [show ∀ a : ℝ, -t+a = -(t-a) by intro a; ring,
    show ∀ a : ℝ, -t-a = -(t+a) by intro a; ring, hatK_neg]
  ring

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Period.kappa_outside
statement: lemma kappa_outside (t : ℝ) (ht : 1 ≤ |t|) : kappa t = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [kappa_eq]
  rw [hatK_zero (by grind), hatK_zero (by grind), hatK_zero (by grind), hatK_zero (by grind)]
  norm_num

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Period.kappa_bound
statement: lemma kappa_bound (t : ℝ) : |kappa t| ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [kappa_eq]
  have a := hatK_bound (t-3/4)
  have b := hatK_bound (t+3/4)
  have c := hatK_bound (t+1/4)
  have d := hatK_bound (t-1/4)
  grind

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Period.hatK_integral
statement: lemma hatK_integral (a : ℝ) : (∫ t in Ico (a-1/4) (a+1/4), hatK (t-a)) = 1/16
proof:
:= by
  have hc : Continuous fun t => hatK (t-a) := hatK_cont.comp (continuous_id.sub continuous_const)
  rw [seg_eq_interval _ (by linarith),
    ← intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals
      (hc.intervalIntegrable (a-1/4) a)
      (hc.intervalIntegrable a (a+1/4))]
  have hL : (∫ t in a-1/4..a, hatK (t-a)) = ∫ t in a-1/4..a, (t+(1/4-a)) := by
    refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr ?_
    intro t ht
    rw [uIcc_of_le (by linarith)] at ht
    unfold hatK
    grind
  have hR : (∫ t in a..a+1/4, hatK (t-a)) = ∫ t in a..a+1/4, ((1/4+a)-t) := by
    apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
    intro t ht
    rw [uIcc_of_le (by linarith)] at ht
    unfold hatK
    grind
  rw [hL,hR, intervalIntegral.integral_add, intervalIntegral.integral_sub (a:=a)]
  · norm_num
    ring
  all_goals apply Continuous.intervalIntegrable; fun_prop

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Period.hatK_inside
statement:
lemma hatK_inside {a : ℝ} (ha : 1/4 ≤ a) (ha' : a ≤ 3/4) :
    (∫ t in Ico (0:ℝ) 1, hatK (t-a)) = 1/16
proof:
:= by
  have hh (t) (ht : t ∉ Ico (a-1/4) (a+1/4)) : hatK (t-a) = 0 :=
    hatK_zero (by grind)
  rw [← hatK_integral a, setIntegral_eq_integral_of_forall_compl_eq_zero,
    setIntegral_eq_integral_of_forall_compl_eq_zero hh]
  intro t ht; apply hh; grind

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Period.hatK_outside
statement:
lemma hatK_outside {a : ℝ} (ha : 1/4 ≤ a) :
    (∫ t in Ico (0:ℝ) 1, hatK (t+a)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine setIntegral_eq_zero_of_forall_eq_zero ?_
  intro t ht
  exact hatK_zero (by grind)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Period.kappa_integral
statement: lemma kappa_integral : (∫ t in Ico (0:ℝ) 1, kappa t) = constK
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [kappa_eq]
  have hL (a : ℝ) : IntegrableOn (fun t => hatK (t-a)) (Ico (0:ℝ) 1) := by
    refine seg_integrable _ (hatK_cont.measurable.comp (by fun_prop)) (1/4) _ _ ?_
    intro t _; exact hatK_bound _
  have hR (a : ℝ) : IntegrableOn (fun t => hatK (t+a)) (Ico (0:ℝ) 1) := by
    simpa using hL (-a)
  rw [integral_sub, integral_add, integral_sub]
  · rw [integral_const_mul, integral_const_mul, hatK_inside (by norm_num) (by norm_num),
      hatK_inside (by norm_num) (by norm_num), hatK_outside (by norm_num),
      hatK_outside (by norm_num)]; norm_num [constK]
  all_goals first
    | exact hR _
    | exact hL _
    | exact (hL _).sub (hR _)
    | exact Integrable.const_mul (hR _) _
    | exact Integrable.const_mul (hL _) _
    | exact ((hL _).sub (hR _)).add (Integrable.const_mul (hR _) _)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Period.kernel_measurable
statement: lemma kernel_measurable (δ) : Measurable (kernel δ)
proof:
:= by
  refine StronglyMeasurable.measurable ?_
  unfold kernel
  refine StronglyMeasurable.integral_prod_right (Measurable.stronglyMeasurable ?_)
  exact (kappa_cont.measurable.comp
    (measurable_fst.div measurable_snd)).div (measurable_snd.pow_const 2)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Period.kernel_neg
statement: lemma kernel_neg (δ t : ℝ) : kernel δ (-t) = - kernel δ t
proof:
:= by
  unfold kernel
  simp_rw [neg_div, kappa_neg, neg_div, integral_neg]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Period.recip_deriv
statement:
private lemma recip_deriv (t x : ℝ) (hx : x ≠ 0) :
    HasDerivAt (fun r : ℝ => t/r) (-t/x^2) x
proof:
:= by
  have h := (hasDerivAt_const x t).div (hasDerivAt_id' x) hx
  simp only [zero_mul, mul_one, zero_sub] at h
  exact h

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Period.recip_cont
statement:
private lemma recip_cont {δ : ℝ} (hd : 0 < δ) (hb : δ ≤ 1) (t : ℝ) :
    ContinuousOn (fun r : ℝ => -t / r^2) (uIcc δ 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [uIcc_of_le hb]
  exact continuousOn_const.div (continuousOn_id.pow 2)
    (fun x hx => pow_ne_zero _ (hd.trans_le hx.1).ne')

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Period.kernel_small
statement:
lemma kernel_small {δ : ℝ} (hd : 0 < δ) (hb : δ ≤ 1) (t : ℝ) :
    |kernel δ t| ≤ 2 / δ
proof:
:= by
  have nn (x : ℝ) (hx : x ∈ uIcc δ 1) : x ≠ 0 :=
    (hd.trans_le ((show x ∈ Icc δ 1 by rwa [uIcc_of_le hb] at hx).1)).ne'
  have hc : ContinuousOn (fun r : ℝ => kappa (t/r) / r^2) (uIcc δ 1) :=
    (kappa_cont.comp_continuousOn (continuousOn_const.div continuousOn_id nn)).div
      (continuousOn_id.pow 2) (fun x hx => pow_ne_zero _ (nn x hx))
  have hI :
      ∀ c : ℝ, (∫ r in δ..1, -c / r^2) = c/1 - c/δ := fun c =>
    intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt (fun x hx => recip_deriv c x (nn x hx))
      (recip_cont hd hb c).intervalIntegrable
  unfold kernel
  rw [seg_eq_interval _ hb, abs_le]
  constructor
  · apply le_trans (b := ∫ r in δ..1, -(2:ℝ) / r^2) ?_
      (intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on hb (recip_cont hd hb _).intervalIntegrable
        hc.intervalIntegrable (fun x _ => div_le_div_of_nonneg_right
          (abs_le.mp (kappa_bound _)).1 (sq_nonneg x)))
    rw [hI]; linarith
  · have h := intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on (μ:=volume) hb hc.intervalIntegrable
      (recip_cont hd hb (-2)).intervalIntegrable (fun x _ => by
        exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (by linarith [(abs_le.mp (kappa_bound (t/x))).2]) (sq_nonneg x))
    refine h.trans ?_
    rw [hI]
    simp
    ring_nf
    norm_num

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Period.kernel_middle_id
statement:
lemma kernel_middle_id {t δ : ℝ} (hd : 0 < δ) (ht : δ ≤ t) (hb : t ≤ 1) :
    t * kernel δ t = constK - ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..t, kappa x
proof:
:= by
  have hb' := ht.trans hb
  have heq := intervalIntegral.integral_comp_mul_deriv (a:=δ) (b:=1) (fun x hx =>
    recip_deriv t x ((hd.trans_le
      ((show x ∈ Icc δ 1 by rwa [uIcc_of_le hb'] at hx).1)).ne'))
    (recip_cont hd hb' t) kappa_cont
  simp only [Function.comp_apply, div_one] at heq
  have H1 : (-t)* kernel δ t = ∫ x in t/δ..t, kappa x := by
    rw [← heq, kernel, seg_eq_interval _ hb', ← intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
    apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
    intro x _
    change -t * (_ / x^2) = _ * (-t / x^2)
    ring
  have hI : (∫ x in 1..t/δ, kappa x) = 0 := by
    have hg : (1:ℝ) ≤ t / δ := (le_div_iff₀ hd).mpr (by simpa)
    rw [← seg_eq_interval kappa hg]
    exact setIntegral_eq_zero_of_forall_eq_zero fun x hx =>
      kappa_outside x (hx.1.trans (le_abs_self _))
  have hK := kappa_integral
  rw [seg_eq_interval _ (by norm_num)] at hK
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_symm] at H1
  have h2 := intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals
    (kappa_cont.intervalIntegrable 0 t (μ:=volume)) (kappa_cont.intervalIntegrable t 1)
  have h3 := intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals
    (kappa_cont.intervalIntegrable t 1 (μ:=volume)) (kappa_cont.intervalIntegrable 1 (t/δ))
  linarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Period.kernel_middle_pos
statement:
lemma kernel_middle_pos {t δ : ℝ} (hd : 0 < δ) (ht : δ ≤ t) (hb : t ≤ 1) :
    |kernel δ t - constK / t| ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hp := hd.trans_le ht
  have hid := kernel_middle_id hd ht hb
  have hh := intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const
    (a:=0) (b:=t) (fun x _ => show ‖kappa x‖ ≤ 2 from kappa_bound x)
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, sub_zero, abs_of_pos hp, abs_le] at hh
  rw [abs_le]
  constructor
  · rw [le_sub_iff_add_le]
    field_simp
    nlinarith [hh.2]
  · rw [sub_le_iff_le_add]
    field_simp
    nlinarith [hh.1]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Period.kernel_middle
statement:
lemma kernel_middle {t δ : ℝ} (hd : 0 < δ) (ht : δ ≤ |t|) (hb : |t| ≤ 1) :
    |kernel δ t - constK / t| ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  rcases le_total 0 t with h|h
  · rw [abs_of_nonneg h] at ht hb; exact kernel_middle_pos hd ht hb
  · rw [abs_of_nonpos h] at ht hb
    have H := kernel_middle_pos hd ht hb
    rw [kernel_neg, div_neg, show -kernel δ t - -(constK / t) = -(kernel δ t - constK / t) by ring, abs_neg] at H
    exact H

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Period.seg_integral_slices
statement:
lemma seg_integral_slices (a b : ℝ) (h : ℝ → ℝ → ℂ) (A : Set ℝ)
    (hm : Measurable (uncurry h)) (B : ℝ)
    (hb : ∀ s ∈ Ico a b, ∀ y, ‖h s y‖ ≤ B) [IsFiniteMeasure (volume.restrict A)] :
    IntegrableOn (fun s => ∫ y in A, h s y) (Ico a b)
proof:
:= by
  refine seg_integrable _ hm.stronglyMeasurable.integral_prod_right.measurable
    (∫ _ in A, B) _ _ (fun s hs => ?_)
  apply (norm_integral_le_integral_norm _).trans
  have hm' : Measurable (h s) := hm.comp (measurable_const.prodMk measurable_id)
  exact integral_mono (Integrable.of_bound hm'.aestronglyMeasurable B
    (ae_of_all _ (hb _ hs))).norm (integrable_const _) (hb _ hs)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Period.measurable_layer
statement:
lemma measurable_layer {X : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X] {F : ℝ → ℂ} (hf : Measurable F)
    {A R O : X → ℝ} (hA : Measurable A) (hR : Measurable R) (hO : Measurable O) (n) :
    Measurable fun y => haarLayer F (A y) (R y) n (O y)
proof:
:=
  Finset.measurable_sum _ fun _ _ =>
    measurable_jump_comp hf (hA.add (measurable_const.mul (hR.mul measurable_const)))
      (hR.mul measurable_const) hO

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Period.inv_sq_bound
statement: private lemma inv_sq_bound {s : ℝ} (hs : s ∈ scales) : ‖(1/s^2:ℝ)‖ ≤ 4
proof:
:= by
  have hh := hs.1
  have h1 : 0 < s := by linarith
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
  rw [div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)]
  nlinarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Period.weight_bound
statement:
private lemma weight_bound {c : ℝ} {v : ℂ} (hc : c ∈ scales) {B : ℝ}
    (h : ‖v‖ ≤ B) : ‖(1/c^2) • v‖ ≤ 4 * B
proof:
:= by
  rw [norm_smul]
  apply mul_le_mul (inv_sq_bound hc) h (norm_nonneg _)
  norm_num

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Period.average_succ
statement:
private lemma average_succ (F : ℝ → ℂ) (hf : Measurable F) (B : ℝ) (hb : ∀ y, ‖F y‖ ≤ B)
    (x : ℝ) (J : ℕ) :
    averageH F x (J+1) = averageH F x J +
      ∫ s in scales, (1/s^2) • ∫ a in origins, haarLayer F a s J x
proof:
:= by
  let U (s a : ℝ) := shift F a s J x
  let V (s a : ℝ) := haarLayer F a s J x
  have hu : Measurable (uncurry U) :=
    measurable_shift_comp hf measurable_snd measurable_fst measurable_const J
  have hv : Measurable (uncurry V) :=
    measurable_layer hf measurable_snd measurable_fst measurable_const J
  have hUb (s a) := bounded_shift hf B hb a s J x
  let C := ∑ n ∈ Finset.range J, (2:ℝ)^n*B
  have HI (w : ℝ → ℝ → ℂ) (hw : Measurable (uncurry w)) (C : ℝ)
      (hW : ∀ s a, ‖w s a‖ ≤ C) :
      (∀ s, IntegrableOn (w s) origins) ∧
      IntegrableOn (fun s => (1/s^2) • ∫ a in origins, w s a) scales := by
    refine ⟨fun s => Integrable.of_bound (hw.of_uncurry_left.aestronglyMeasurable)
      C (ae_of_all _ (hW s)), ?_⟩
    simp_rw [← integral_smul]
    apply seg_integral_slices _ _ _ _ (_ : Measurable _) (4*C) (fun s hs a => weight_bound hs (hW s a))
    exact (measurable_const.div (measurable_fst.pow_const 2)).smul hw
  obtain ⟨hUI,hUI'⟩ := HI U hu C hUb
  obtain ⟨hVI,hVI'⟩ := HI V hv ((2:ℝ)^J * B) (fun s a => bounded_haarLayer hf B hb a s J x)
  have heq (s : ℝ) :
      (1/s^2) • (∫ a in origins, shift F a s (J+1) x) =
        ((1/s^2) • ∫ a in origins, U s a) + ((1/s^2) • ∫ a in origins, V s a) := by
    simp_rw [show ∀ a, shift F a s (J+1) x = U s a + V s a by
      intro a; exact Finset.sum_range_succ (fun n => haarLayer F a s n x) J]
    rw [integral_add (hUI s) (hVI s), smul_add]
  unfold averageH
  simp_rw [heq, integral_add hUI' hVI']
  rfl

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Period.scale_subst
proof:
:= by
  let f (r : ℝ) := kappa (t/r)/r^2
  have hp := side_pos n
  have hh := seg_translate_scale f 0 (by norm_num : (1/2:ℝ) ≤ 1) hp
  simp only [zero_add, mul_one] at hh
  have H (s : ℝ) : (1/s^2)*((2:ℝ)^n)*kappa (t/(s*side n)) =
      side n • f (side n * s) := by
    rw [show (2:ℝ)^n = (side n)⁻¹ by
      field_simp
      exact pow_mul_side _]
    unfold f
    rw [mul_comm (side n) s, smul_eq_mul, mul_pow]
    simp only [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_inv_rev]
    field_simp

  unfold scales portion
  simp_rw [H]
  rw [integral_smul, hh, smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ hp.ne', one_smul, side_succ]
  simp only [f, div_eq_mul_inv, one_mul]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Period.kernel_split
statement:
private lemma kernel_split (J : ℕ) (t : ℝ) :
    kernel (side (J+1)) t = kernel (side J) t + portion (side (J+1)) (side J) t
proof:
:= by
  let f (r : ℝ) := kappa (t/r)/r^2
  have hJ := side_pos J
  have hlt : side (J+1) ≤ side J := by rw [side_succ]; linarith
  have hi {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a ≤ b) : IntervalIntegrable f volume a b := by
    apply ContinuousOn.intervalIntegrable
    rw [uIcc_of_le hab]
    have H (x : ℝ) (hx : x ∈ Icc a b) : x ≠ 0 := (ha.trans_le hx.1).ne'
    exact (kappa_cont.comp_continuousOn (continuousOn_const.div continuousOn_id H)).div
      (continuousOn_id.pow 2) (fun x hx => pow_ne_zero _ (H x hx))
  rw [kernel, kernel, portion, seg_eq_interval f (side_le (J+1)), seg_eq_interval f (side_le J),
    seg_eq_interval f hlt, add_comm (a:=(∫ x in side J..1, f x)), intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals
      (hi (side_pos _) hlt) (hi (side_pos _) (side_le J))]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Period.convolution_average
statement:
lemma convolution_average (F : ℝ → ℂ) (hf : Measurable F) (B : ℝ) (hb : ∀ y, ‖F y‖ ≤ B)
    {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ unitInt) (J) :
    averageH F x J = convK F x J
proof:
:= by
  induction J with
  | zero =>
    simp [averageH, convK, shift, kernel, side]
  | succ n ih =>
    let q (t : ℝ) := F (x-t)
    have hq : Measurable q := hf.comp (by fun_prop)
    let r := side n
    let V (s t : ℝ) := (1/s^2*(2:ℝ)^n*kappa (t/(s*r))) • q t
    have heq : (∫ s in scales, (1/s^2) • ∫ a in origins, haarLayer F a s n x) =
        ∫ t in window, portion (side (n+1)) r t • q t := by
      have Hs (s : ℝ) (hs : s ∈ scales) :
          ((1/s^2) • ∫ a in origins, haarLayer F a s n x) = ∫ t in window, V s t := by
        have hs' : 0 < s := by linarith [hs.1]
        rw [haarLayer_average F hf B hb n hx hs' hs.2.le, smul_smul, ← integral_smul]
        unfold V q r
        simp_rw [smul_smul]
      have HVm : Measurable (uncurry V) :=
        (((measurable_const.div (measurable_fst.pow_const 2)).mul measurable_const).mul
          (kappa_cont.measurable.comp (measurable_snd.div (measurable_fst.mul measurable_const)))).smul
          (hq.comp measurable_snd)
      have Hi : Integrable (uncurry V) ((volume.restrict scales).prod (volume.restrict window)) := by
        apply Integrable.of_bound HVm.aestronglyMeasurable ((4*(2:ℝ)^n*2)*B)
        rw [Measure.prod_restrict]
        filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem (measurableSet_Ico.prod measurableSet_Ico)]
          with ⟨s,t⟩ ⟨hs,_⟩
        dsimp only [uncurry_apply_pair, V, q]
        rw [norm_smul, norm_mul, norm_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs (kappa _)]
        have h := inv_sq_bound hs
        gcongr
        all_goals first | simp | exact kappa_bound _ | exact hb _
      calc
        _ = ∫ s in scales, ∫ t in window, V s t := setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ico Hs
        _ = ∫ t in window, ∫ s in scales, V s t := integral_integral_swap Hi
        _ = _ := by
          dsimp only [V, r]
          simp_rw [integral_smul_const, scale_subst]
    have Hk (n : ℕ) : IntegrableOn (fun t => kernel (side n) t • F (x-t)) window := by
      apply seg_integrable _ ((kernel_measurable _).smul hq)
        ((2/(side n)) * B)
      intro t _
      change ‖kernel (side n) t • F (x-t)‖ ≤ _
      rw [norm_smul]
      exact mul_le_mul (kernel_small (side_pos _) (side_le _) t) (hb _) (norm_nonneg _)
        (div_nonneg (by norm_num) (side_pos _).le)
    let V' (t : ℝ) := portion (side (n+1)) r t • F (x-t)
    have H (t : ℝ) : kernel (side (n+1)) t • F (x-t) =
        kernel (side n) t • F (x-t) + V' t := by rw [kernel_split, add_smul]
    have Hi : IntegrableOn V' window := by
      rw [show V' = (fun t => kernel (side (n+1)) t • F (x-t)) -
        (fun t => kernel (side n) t • F (x-t)) by ext t; simp [H]]
      exact (Hk _).sub (Hk _)
    rw [average_succ F hf B hb, ih, heq, convK, convK]
    simp_rw [H, integral_add (Hk n) Hi]
    rfl

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Period.measurable_maxConvK
statement:
lemma measurable_maxConvK {ρ : ℝ → ℝ} (hρ : Measurable ρ) (J : ℕ) :
    Measurable (maxConvK ρ J)
proof:
:= by
  refine Measurable.iSup fun n => Measurable.ennreal_ofReal
    (Measurable.norm (show Measurable (fun x => convK (modρ ρ n) x J) from ?_))
  unfold convK
  apply StronglyMeasurable.measurable
  exact StronglyMeasurable.integral_prod_right (Measurable.stronglyMeasurable
    (((kernel_measurable _).comp measurable_snd).smul
      ((measurable_mod hρ _).comp (measurable_fst.sub measurable_snd))))

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Period.convolution_cost
statement:
lemma convolution_cost {ρ : ℝ → ℝ} (hρ : Measurable ρ) (h0 : ∀ x, 0 ≤ ρ x)
    (B : ℝ) (hb : ∀ y, ρ y ≤ B) (G : Set ℝ) (hG : MeasurableSet G)
    (hGu : G ⊆ unitInt) (Q : ℝ≥0∞) (J : ℕ)
    (H : ∀ s ∈ scales, ∀ a ∈ origins, (∫⁻ x in G, maxShift ρ a s J x) ≤ Q) :
    (∫⁻ x in G, maxConvK ρ J x) ≤ 16 * Q
proof:
:= by
  let Z (x s a : ℝ) := ENNReal.ofReal ‖(1/s^2:ℝ)‖ * maxShift ρ a s J x
  have Hi (x : ℝ) (hx : x ∈ G) :
      maxConvK ρ J x ≤ ∫⁻ s in scales, (∫⁻ a in origins, Z x s a) := by
    refine iSup_le fun n => ?_
    let f := modρ ρ (n:ℝ)
    have hm : Measurable f := measurable_mod hρ _
    have hb' (y : ℝ) : ‖f y‖ ≤ B := by rw [show f y = _ from rfl, norm_mod h0]; exact hb _
    rw [← convolution_average (modρ ρ n) hm B hb' (hGu hx) J]
    unfold averageH
    simp_rw [← integral_smul]
    rw [ofReal_norm]
    refine (enorm_integral_le_lintegral_enorm _).trans ?_
    refine lintegral_mono fun s => (enorm_integral_le_lintegral_enorm _).trans ?_
    refine lintegral_mono fun a => ?_
    unfold Z maxShift
    rw [← ofReal_norm, norm_smul, ENNReal.ofReal_mul (by positivity)]
    exact mul_le_mul_right (le_iSup (fun u : ℤ =>
      ENNReal.ofReal ‖shift (modρ ρ u) a s J x‖) n) _
  have Hm {X : Type} [MeasurableSpace X] (x s a : X → ℝ)
      (hx : Measurable x) (hs : Measurable s) (ha : Measurable a) :
      Measurable fun y => Z (x y) (s y) (a y) :=
    ((measurable_const.div (hs.pow_const 2)).norm.ennreal_ofReal).mul
      (measurable_maxShift_comp hρ ha hs hx _)
  have Hm' : Measurable fun w : ℝ × ℝ => ∫⁻ a in origins, Z w.1 w.2 a := by
    refine Measurable.lintegral_prod_right ?_
    exact Hm _ _ _ (measurable_fst.comp measurable_fst) (measurable_snd.comp measurable_fst)
      measurable_snd
  have HI (s : ℝ) (hs : s ∈ scales) :
      (∫⁻ x in G, (∫⁻ a in origins, Z x s a)) ≤ 16 * Q := by
    have hZ : Measurable (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => Z p.1 s p.2) :=
      Hm _ _ _ measurable_fst measurable_const measurable_snd
    rw [lintegral_lintegral_swap hZ.aemeasurable]
    have hA (a : ℝ) (ha : a ∈ origins) :
        (∫⁻ x in G, Z x s a) ≤ 4 * Q := by
      unfold Z
      rw [lintegral_const_mul _ (show Measurable (maxShift ρ a s J) from
        measurable_maxShift_comp hρ measurable_const measurable_const measurable_id J)]
      exact mul_le_mul' (by simpa using ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (inv_sq_bound hs)) (H s hs a ha)
    refine (lintegral_mono_ae ((ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ico).mono hA)).trans ?_
    have HV : volume origins = 4 := by norm_num [origins]
    simp only [setLIntegral_const]
    change 4*Q*volume origins ≤ _
    rw [HV]

    exact le_of_eq (by ring)
  refine (lintegral_mono_ae ((ae_restrict_mem hG).mono Hi)).trans ?_
  rw [lintegral_lintegral_swap Hm'.aemeasurable]
  refine (lintegral_mono_ae ((ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ico).mono HI)).trans ?_
  simp only [setLIntegral_const]
  exact mul_le_of_le_one_right zero_le (by norm_num [scales])

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Period.flip_dilate
statement:
private lemma flip_dilate (g : ℝ → ℂ) (d c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) :
    (∫ x : ℝ, g (d-c*x)) = c⁻¹ • ∫ x : ℝ, g x
proof:
:= by
  have h := Measure.integral_comp_mul_left (fun x => g (d+x)) (-c)
  simp_rw [neg_mul, ← sub_eq_add_neg] at h
  rw [integral_add_left_eq_self] at h
  simpa [abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr hc)] using h

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Period.jump_average_all
statement:
lemma jump_average_all (F : ℝ → ℂ) (hf : Measurable F) (B : ℝ) (hb : ∀ x, ‖F x‖ ≤ B)
    (x r b : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) (hr' : r ≤ 1) :
    (∫ a : ℝ, jump F (a+b) r x) =
      ∫ t in window, kappa (t/r) • F (x-t)
proof:
:= by
  let J (a : ℝ) := jump F (a+b) r x
  let f (v : ℝ) := haarG v • ∫ w, haarH w • F (x-r*(v-w)) ∂μ₁
  have heq (v : ℝ) : J (x-b-r*v) = f v := by
    have H : (x - (x-b-r*v+b))/r = v := by field_simp; ring
    unfold J f jump coeffH
    rw [H]
    simp_rw [show ∀ w, x-b-r*v+b+r*w = x-r*(v-w) by intro w; ring]
  have hA : (∫ a : ℝ, J a) = r • ∫ v, f v ∂μ₁ := by
    have HH := flip_dilate J (x-b) r hr
    simp_rw [heq] at HH
    have Hsupport : (∫ v, f v ∂μ₁) = ∫ v : ℝ, f v := by
      exact setIntegral_eq_integral_of_forall_compl_eq_zero
        (fun v hv => by unfold f; rw [G_outside hv, zero_smul])
    rw [Hsupport, HH, smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ hr.ne', one_smul]
  let W (v t : ℝ) := haarG v • (haarH (v-t) • F (x-r*t))
  have hw (v : ℝ) (hv : v ∈ unitInt) :
      f v = ∫ t in window, W v t := by
    have HH := flip_dilate (fun w => haarH w • F (x-r*(v-w))) v 1 (by norm_num)
    simp only [one_mul, sub_sub_cancel, inv_one, one_smul] at HH
    have Hs : (∫ w, haarH w • F (x-r*(v-w)) ∂μ₁) =
        ∫ w, haarH w • F (x-r*(v-w)) := by
      exact setIntegral_eq_integral_of_forall_compl_eq_zero
        (fun w hw => by rw [H_outside hw, zero_smul])
    have Hs' : (∫ t in window, haarH (v-t) • F (x-r*t)) =
        ∫ t, haarH (v-t) • F (x-r*t) := by
      apply setIntegral_eq_integral_of_forall_compl_eq_zero
      intro t ht
      rw [H_outside, zero_smul]
      rintro ⟨h1,h2⟩
      exact ht ⟨by linarith [hv.1], by linarith [hv.2]⟩
    change haarG v • _ = ∫ t in window, haarG v • (haarH (v-t) • F (x-r*t))
    rw [integral_smul, Hs, Hs', HH]
  have hWm : Measurable (uncurry W) :=
    (measurableG.comp measurable_fst).smul
      ((measurableH.comp (measurable_fst.sub measurable_snd)).smul
        (hf.comp (measurable_const.sub (measurable_const.mul measurable_snd))))
  have : IsFiniteMeasure (volume.restrict window) :=
    show IsFiniteMeasure (volume.restrict (Ico (-1:ℝ) 1)) from inferInstance
  have hWi : Integrable (uncurry W) (μ₁.prod (volume.restrict window)) := by
    apply Integrable.of_bound hWm.aestronglyMeasurable B
    refine ae_of_all _ fun ⟨v,t⟩ => ?_
    simp only [W, uncurry_apply_pair, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    refine (mul_le_of_le_one_left (mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _))
      (G_bound _)).trans ?_
    exact (mul_le_of_le_one_left (norm_nonneg _) (H_bound _)).trans (hb _)
  have hK (t : ℝ) : (∫ v, W v t ∂μ₁) = kappa t • F (x-r*t) := by
    dsimp only [W]; simp_rw [smul_smul]
    rw [integral_smul_const, kappa_eq_mean]
  have hB : (∫ v, f v ∂μ₁) = ∫ t in window, kappa t • F (x-r*t) := by
    rw [show (∫ v, f v ∂μ₁) = ∫ v, (∫ t in window, W v t) ∂μ₁ from
      setIntegral_congr_fun measurable_unitInt hw, integral_integral_swap hWi]
    simp_rw [hK]
  let q (t : ℝ) := kappa (t/r) • F (x-t)
  have Q : ∀ t, q (r*t) = kappa t • F (x-r*t) := fun t => by
    unfold q; rw [mul_div_cancel_left₀ t hr.ne']
  have hg : ∀ t ∉ window, 1 ≤ |t| := by
    unfold window; grind
  have hq : (∫ t in window, q t) = ∫ t, q t := by
    apply setIntegral_eq_integral_of_forall_compl_eq_zero
    intro t ht
    unfold q
    rw [kappa_outside, zero_smul]
    rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos hr]
    exact (le_div_iff₀ hr).mpr (by linarith [hg t ht])
  have hq' : (∫ t in window, q (r*t)) = ∫ t, q (r*t) := by
    exact setIntegral_eq_integral_of_forall_compl_eq_zero
      (fun t ht => by rw [Q, kappa_outside t (hg t ht), zero_smul])
  have htrans : (∫ t in window, kappa t • F (x-r*t)) = r⁻¹ • ∫ t in window, q t := by
    simp_rw [← Q]
    rw [hq, hq', Measure.integral_comp_mul_left, abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr hr)]
  change (∫ a : ℝ, J a) = ∫ t in window, q t
  rw [hA, hB, htrans, smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ hr.ne', one_smul]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Period.jump_average
statement:
lemma jump_average (F : ℝ → ℂ) (hf : Measurable F) (B : ℝ) (hb : ∀ x, ‖F x‖ ≤ B)
    {x s : ℝ} (n k : ℕ) (hk : k < 2^n) (hx : x ∈ unitInt) (hs : 0 < s) (hs' : s ≤ 1) :
    (∫ a in origins, jump F (lft a s n k) (s*side n) x) =
      ∫ t in window, kappa (t/(s*side n)) • F (x-t)
proof:
:= by
  have hr : 0 < s*side n := mul_pos hs (side_pos _)
  rw [setIntegral_eq_integral_of_forall_compl_eq_zero]
  · exact jump_average_all F hf B hb x _ _ hr
      ((mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hs' (side_pos n).le).trans
        (by simpa using side_le n))
  · intro a ha
    apply jump_outside hr
    intro ht
    obtain ⟨h1,h2⟩ := cell_in_top a hs hk ht
    exact ha ⟨by linarith [hx.1], by linarith [hx.2]⟩

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Period.haarLayer_average
statement:
lemma haarLayer_average (F : ℝ → ℂ) (hf : Measurable F) (B : ℝ) (hb : ∀ x, ‖F x‖ ≤ B)
    {x s : ℝ} (n : ℕ) (hx : x ∈ unitInt) (hs : 0 < s) (hs' : s ≤ 1) :
    (∫ a in origins, haarLayer F a s n x) =
      (2:ℝ)^n • ∫ t in window, kappa (t/(s*side n)) • F (x-t)
proof:
:= by
  unfold haarLayer
  rw [integral_finsetSum]
  · calc
      _ = ∑ _ ∈ Finset.range (2^n), ∫ t in window, kappa (t/(s*side n)) • F (x-t) :=
        Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k hk => jump_average F hf B hb n k (Finset.mem_range.mp hk) hx hs hs'
      _ = _ := by simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_range, ← Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul ℝ]
                  norm_cast
  · intro k hk
    refine seg_integrable _ (measurable_jump_comp hf ?_ measurable_const measurable_const) B _ _
      (fun a _ => bounded_jump hf B hb _ _ _)
    exact measurable_id.add_const _

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.main_of_grid
statement:
theorem main_of_grid (h : Dyadic.GridBound) {f : Torus → ℂ} (hf : MemLLogL f) :
    ∃ E : Set Torus, MeasurableSet E ∧ circleMeasure E = 0 ∧ ∀ x ∉ E,
      Tendsto (fun N : ℕ ↦ symmetricPartialSum f N x) atTop (𝓝 (f x))
proof:
:=
  h.unitTreeBound.affine.realGoodBound.goodBound.main_bound_consequence hf

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.almost_everywhere_fourier_convergence
statement:
theorem almost_everywhere_fourier_convergence (f : Torus → ℂ) (hf : MemLLogL f) :
    ∃ E : Set Torus, MeasurableSet E ∧ circleMeasure E = 0 ∧ ∀ x ∉ E,
      Tendsto (fun N : ℕ ↦ symmetricPartialSum f N x) atTop (𝓝 (f x))
proof:
:=
    main_of_grid Dyadic.gridProof hf

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.maximal_good_sets
statement: theorem maximal_good_sets : GoodBound
proof:
:=
    Dyadic.gridProof.unitTreeBound.affine.realGoodBound.goodBound

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.weak_L1_maximal_bound
statement:
theorem weak_L1_maximal_bound :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ (f : Torus → ℂ), MemLLogL f →
      ∀ w : ℝ, 0 < w →
        w*circleMeasure.real (cloudSet f w) ≤ C*luxNorm f
proof:

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.paperMain
statement:
theorem paperMain (f : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi) → ℂ)
    (hfm : AEStronglyMeasurable f AddCircle.haarAddCircle)
    (hfi : Integrable (fun x ↦ ‖f x‖ * Real.log (2 + ‖f x‖))
      AddCircle.haarAddCircle) :
    ∃ E : Set (AddCircle (2 * Real.pi)),
      MeasurableSet E ∧ AddCircle.haarAddCircle E = 0 ∧ ∀ x ∉ E,
        Tendsto
          (fun N : ℕ ↦
            ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc (-(N : ℤ)) (N : ℤ), fourierCoeff f k * fourier k x)
          atTop (𝓝 (f x))
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [circleMeasure, symmetricPartialSum] using
    (almost_everywhere_fourier_convergence f ⟨hfm, hfi⟩)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Beam.prism_limits
statement:
lemma prism_limits {s : Scene M} (h : Fit s) (u : Grid M) (W : Paths.Vector M)
    (a : ℝ) (z) :
    let m
proof:
:= matter s z; let r := prism s u W a z
    a*m ≤ r ∧ m* ‖meanV s u z‖ ≤ r := by
  intro m r
  have H := ray_bounds (W z) (letter s u z) (a*m)
  have he : letter s u z=(m:ℂ)* meanV s u z := (mean_hold s h _ _).1.symm
  constructor; exact le_trans (le_abs_self _) H.2.2.1
  rw [show m* ‖meanV s u z‖=‖letter s u z‖ by rw [he,norm_scaleC,abs_of_nonneg (matter_nonneg h z)]]
  exact H.2.1

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Beam.square_addthree
statement:
private lemma square_addthree (x y z : ℝ) :
    (x+y+z)^2 ≤ 3*(x^2+y^2+z^2)
proof:
:= by
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg (x-y),sq_nonneg (y-z),sq_nonneg (z-x)]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Beam.norm_addthree
statement:
lemma norm_addthree (x y z : ℂ) :
    ‖x+y+z‖^2 ≤ 3*(‖x‖^2+‖y‖^2+‖z‖^2)
proof:
:= by
  have H : ‖x+y+z‖ ≤ ‖x‖+‖y‖+‖z‖ := (norm_add_le _ z).trans
    (add_le_add_left (norm_add_le x y) _)
  exact le_trans (pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) H _) (square_addthree _ _ _)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Beam.factor_swap
statement:
lemma factor_swap {s q : Scene M} (hs : Fit s) (hq : Climb q)
    (u : Grid M) (z) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (he : a ≤ 1)
    (W : Paths.Vector M) (hh : matter q z ≤ 2*matter s z) :
    let g
proof:
:= dew u q z; let m := mist u s q z; let r := prism s u W a z; let j := pierce q z
    ‖factor q u z‖^2 ≤ r*(8*j+32*((g+m)/a)) ∧
    (a*shell q z)^2 ≤ r*(2*j) := by
  intro g m r j
  let v := meanV s u z; let w := meanV q u z
  let x := matter s z; let y := matter q z
  let t := shell q z; let b := nub q u z
  have hN : 0 ≤ x := matter_nonneg hs z
  have hM : 0 ≤ y := matter_nonneg hq.fit z
  change y ≤ 2*x at hh
  have ht : t^2=y*j := shell_sq hq z
  have hj : 0 ≤ j := pierce_nonneg hq.fit z
  have hb : ‖b‖^2 ≤ 4*y*g := nub_innovation q hq u z
  have hg : 0 ≤ g := dew_nonneg u hq z
  have hm : 0 ≤ m := mist_nonneg u s q hq.fit z
  have hv : ‖v‖ ≤ 1 := (mean_hold _ hs _ _).2
  have hd : a*x ≤ r ∧ x* ‖v‖ ≤ r := prism_limits hs u W a z
  have hr := le_trans (mul_nonneg ha.le hN) hd.1
  have hi : x ≤ r/a := (le_div_iff₀ ha).2 (by linarith [hd.1])
  have hQ : t^2 ≤ y^2 := by
    rw [← sq_abs]; exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg t) (shell_abs hq z) _
  constructor
  · have hx : ‖(t:ℂ)*v‖^2 ≤ 2*r*j := by
      rw [norm_scaleC,mul_pow,sq_abs,ht]
      have HE : y* ‖v‖^2 ≤ 2*r := by
        have H1 : ‖v‖^2 ≤ ‖v‖ := by nlinarith [norm_nonneg v]
        nlinarith [norm_nonneg v,hd.2]
      nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right HE hj]
    have hy : ‖(t:ℂ)*(w-v)‖^2 ≤ 2*(r/a)*m := by
      rw [norm_scaleC,mul_pow,sq_abs]
      have HE : m=y*‖w-v‖^2 := rfl
      apply le_trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hQ (sq_nonneg _))
      calc
        _= y*m := by rw [HE]; ring
        _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) hm
    have hz : ‖b‖^2 ≤ 8*(r/a)*g := hb.trans (by nlinarith)
    rw [show factor q u z=(↑t:ℂ)*v+t*(w-v)+b by unfold t b w nub; ring]
    apply (norm_addthree _ _ _).trans
    rw [add_div,mul_add]
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg hr hj,
      mul_nonneg (div_nonneg hr ha.le) hg,mul_nonneg (div_nonneg hr ha.le) hm,
      show r*(32*(g/a+m/a))=32*(r/a)*g+32*(r/a)*m by ring]
  change (a*t)^2 ≤ _
  rw [mul_pow,ht]
  have HE : a^2*y ≤ 2*r := by nlinarith [hd.1]
  nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right HE hj]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Beam.bridge_mist
statement:
lemma bridge_mist {s : Scene M} (h : Climb s) (u z : Grid M) (i : Bool)
    {q : Scene M} (hp : Ideal (s.smaller i) q) :
    mist u s q z ≤ 8*(dew u s z + (matter (s.smaller i) z-matter q z))
proof:
:= by
  let t := s.smaller i
  let v := meanV s u z; let w := meanV t u z; let l := meanV q u z
  let y := matter q z; let x := matter t z
  have H : y* ‖l-w‖^2 ≤ 4*(x-y) := (drain_changes hp u z).1
  have hH : x* ‖w-v‖^2 ≤ 2*dew u s z := mist_low u h i z
  have he : ‖l-v‖^2 ≤ 2*(‖l-w‖^2+‖w-v‖^2) := by
    have H := pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) (norm_add_le (l-w) (w-v)) 2
    rw [sub_add_sub_cancel] at H
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (‖l-w‖- ‖w-v‖)]
  have hy : 0 ≤ y := matter_nonneg hp.climb.fit z
  have hv : y ≤ x := by nlinarith
  change y* ‖l-v‖^2 ≤ 8*(_+(x-y))
  nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left he hy,dew_nonneg u h z,
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hv (sq_nonneg ‖w-v‖)]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Beam.extra_joints
statement:
lemma extra_joints {s : Scene M} (h : Climb s) (u z : Grid M) (i : Bool)
    {q : Scene M} (hp : Ideal (s.smaller i) q) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a)
    (he : a ≤ 1) (W : Paths.Vector M) :
    let t
proof:
:= s.smaller i
    let r := prism s u W a z; let k := matter t z-matter q z
    let j₀ := pierce s z; let j₁ := pierce q z
    let f₀ := dew u s z; let f₁ := dew u q z
    ‖factor s u z‖^2+‖factor q u z‖^2+ (a*shell s z)^2 + (a*shell q z)^2 +
      ‖letter t u z-letter q u z‖^2+(a*k)^2 ≤
         r*(20*(j₀+j₁)+400*((k+f₀+f₁)/a)) := by
  intro t r k j₀ j₁ f₀ f₁
  let x := matter s z
  have H : matter t z ≤ 2*x := matter_max h i z
  have He : ‖letter t u z-letter q u z‖ ≤ k := matter_drain hp u z
  have hk := (norm_nonneg _).trans He
  have hq : matter q z ≤ 2*x := by unfold k at hk; linarith
  have hr : 0 ≤ r := ray_pos _ _ _
  have hx : a*x ≤ r := (prism_limits h.fit u W a z).1
  have hi : k ≤ 2*(r/a) := by
