    have hh : x ≤ r/a := (le_div_iff₀ ha).2 (by linarith)
    have hQ := matter_nonneg hp.climb.fit z
    change k ≥ _ at hk
    unfold k; linarith
  have hd : (a*k)^2 ≤ k^2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (mul_nonneg ha.le hk) (by nlinarith) _
  have hh₁ := factor_swap h.fit h u z a ha he W (by linarith [matter_nonneg h.fit z])
  have HH₁ : ‖factor s u z‖^2 ≤ r*(8*j₀+32*(f₀/a)) := by
    have hH : mist u s s z=0 := by simp [mist]
    apply hh₁.1.trans
    change r*(8*j₀+32*((f₀+mist u s s z)/a)) ≤ _
    rw [hH,add_zero]
  have hh₂ := factor_swap h.fit hp.climb u z a ha he W hq
  have hh : ‖factor q u z‖^2 ≤ r*(8*j₁+32*((f₁+8*(f₀+k))/a)) := by
    have hv : mist u s q z ≤ 8*(f₀+k) := bridge_mist h u z i hp
    apply hh₂.1.trans; change r*(8*j₁+32*((f₁+mist u s q z)/a)) ≤ _
    gcongr
  have HX : (a*shell s z)^2 ≤ r*(2*j₀) := hh₁.2
  have HY : (a*shell q z)^2 ≤ r*(2*j₁) := hh₂.2
  have h₀ : 0 ≤ j₀ := pierce_nonneg h.fit z
  have h₁ : 0 ≤ j₁ := pierce_nonneg hp.climb.fit z
  have he₀ : 0 ≤ f₀ := dew_nonneg u h z
  have he₁ : 0 ≤ f₁ := dew_nonneg u hp.climb z
  have HZ := pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) He 2
  simp_rw [div_eq_mul_inv] at *
  have HH := inv_pos.2 ha
  nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hi hk,
    mul_nonneg hr he₀,mul_nonneg hr he₁,mul_nonneg hr hk]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Beam.contest
proof:
:= by
  linarith [square_addthree r t p,norm_addthree x y z]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Run.Streak.wave_combine
statement:
lemma wave_combine (e : Streak M) (t : Tide) (l r : Path M) :
    e.wave t (l++r)=e.wave (e.wave t l) r
proof:
:= by
  induction l generalizing t with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons b l ih => exact ih _

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Run.Streak.wave_bling
statement:
lemma wave_bling (e : Streak M) (t : Tide) (l r : Path M) :
    e.sumbling (e.wave t l) r ≤ e.sumbling t (l++r)
proof:
:= by
  induction l generalizing t with
  | nil => exact le_rfl
  | cons b l ih =>
    change _ ≤ sumbling e t (b::(l++r))
    rw [sumbling]
    apply le_trans (ih _)
    apply le_add_of_nonneg_left
    split; linarith [(bling_share e (b::(l++r))).1]
    exact le_rfl

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Run.Streak.holds_tail
statement:
lemma holds_tail (e : Streak M) (p r : Path M) (n : ℝ) (hp : e.wave none p=some n) :
    ∃ v w : Path M, p=v++w ∧ (∀ b∈w,e.outer b.post) ∧
      fullFax w=n ∧ e.bling (w++r) ≤ e.sumbling none (p++r)
proof:
:= by
  induction p using List.reverseRecOn generalizing n r with
  | nil => cases hp
  | append_singleton p b ih =>
    rw [wave_combine] at hp
    let t := e.wave none p; let k := e.rightNow b.post t
    let a := b.post
    change k.next=some n at hp
    have hx : e.sumbling t ([b]++r) ≤ e.sumbling none ((p++[b])++r) := by
      rw [List.append_assoc]
      exact wave_bling e none p _
    have HH (ha : k.alpha ∨ k.tick) (h : fax a=n) (hF : outer e a) :
        ∃ v w : Path M,p++[b]=v++w ∧ (∀ z∈w,e.outer z.post) ∧
          fullFax w=n ∧ e.bling (w++r) ≤ e.sumbling none ((p++[b])++r) := by
      refine ⟨p,[b],rfl,by simpa using hF,?_,?_⟩
      · change fax a+0=_; simpa only [add_zero] using h
      · apply le_trans _ hx; change bling _ _ ≤ sumbling e t (b::r); rw [sumbling,ite_eq_left ha]
        apply le_add_of_nonneg_right; linarith [sumbling_one e (rightNow e b.post t).next r]
    cases ht : t with
    | none =>
      by_cases hV : innerV e b.post
      · have hi : k=going true false (fax b.post) := by unfold k; rw [ht]; exact ite_eq_left hV
        rw [hi] at hp
        exact HH (by rw [hi]; exact Or.inl rfl) (Option.some.inj hp) (inner_outer e _ hV)
      · have hi : k=idle := by unfold k; rw [ht]; exact ite_eq_right hV
        rw [hi] at hp; cases hp
    | some x =>
      by_cases hV : outer e b.post
      · by_cases hz : 1 ≤ x
        · have hi : k=going false true (fax b.post) := by simp only [k,ht,rightNow,hV,hz, ↓reduceIte]
          rw [hi] at hp
          exact HH (by rw [hi]; exact Or.inr rfl) (Option.some.inj hp) hV
        have hi : k=going false false (x+fax b.post) := by simp only [k,ht,rightNow,hV,hz, ↓reduceIte]
        rw [hi] at hp
        obtain ⟨v,w,hw,h1,h2,h3⟩ := ih (b::r) x ht
        refine ⟨v,w++[b],by rw [hw,List.append_assoc],?_,?_,?_⟩
        · intro z hz; simp only [List.mem_append,List.mem_singleton] at hz
          exact hz.elim (fun hh => h1 z hh) (fun h => h ▸ hV)
        · unfold fullFax; rw [subtotal_app]
          change fullFax w+(fax b.post+0)=n
          rw [h2,add_zero]; exact Option.some.inj hp
        simp only [List.append_assoc, List.singleton_append]
        exact h3
      · have hi : k=idle := by unfold k; rw [ht]; exact ite_eq_right hV
        rw [hi] at hp; cases hp

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Run.Streak.holds_inner
statement:
lemma holds_inner (e : Streak M) (p l m : Path M) (h : ∀ b∈l,e.innerV b.post) (hh : l ≠ []) :
    ∃ v w : Path M, p=v++w ∧ (∀ b∈w++l,e.outer b.post) ∧ fullFax w ≤ 1 ∧
      e.bling (w++(l++m)) ≤ e.sumbling none (p++(l++m))
proof:
:= by
  cases l with
  | nil => exact (hh rfl).elim
  | cons b l =>
    let r := b::l; let t := e.wave none p; let k := e.rightNow b.post t
    have hv : ∀ b ∈ r,e.outer b.post := fun b hi => inner_outer e b.post (h b hi)
    have hh' : innerV e b.post := h b List.mem_cons_self
    have ho : outer e b.post := inner_outer e _ hh'
    by_cases ha : k.alpha=true ∨ k.tick=true
    · refine ⟨p,[],(by simp),hv,(by change (0:ℝ) ≤ 1; norm_num),?_⟩
      apply le_trans _ (wave_bling e none p (r++m))
      change bling e (b::(l++m)) ≤ sumbling e t (b::(l++m)); rw [sumbling,ite_eq_left ha]
      apply le_add_of_nonneg_right; linarith [sumbling_one e (rightNow e b.post t).next (l++m)]
    · cases hx : t with
      | none =>
        apply (ha ?_).elim
        apply Or.inl; unfold k; rw [hx]
        rw [rightNow,ite_eq_left hh']; rfl
      | some x =>
        have he : x < 1 := by
          by_contra! he
          apply ha; apply Or.inr; unfold k; rw [hx]
          simp [rightNow,ho,he,going]
        obtain ⟨v,w,hq,h₁,h₂,h₃⟩ := holds_tail e p (r++m) x hx
        refine ⟨v,w,hq,?_,(h₂.le.trans he.le),h₃⟩
        intro c hc; rw [List.mem_append] at hc
        exact hc.elim (h₁ c) (hv c)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Run.Streak.possible
statement:
lemma possible (e : Streak M) {x : Grid M} (p l m : Path M)
    (h : Trip x s (p++(l++m))) (hp : ∀ b∈l,e.innerV b.post)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : 2*log (sumbling e none (p++(l++m))) ≤ t) :

      let L
proof:
:= p++(l++m); yieldW (subtotal (duties x e.u) l) ≤
      10^15*(fullFax l+(1+fullKills L+e.flagged L)/e.thick+e.thick*t) := by
  intro L
  let a := e.thick; let F := duties x e.u
  have ha : 0 < a := e.thick_rate.1
  have hi : a ≤ 1 := e.thick_rate.2.1
  have hT : 0 ≤ t := le_trans (mul_nonneg (by norm_num)
    (log_nonneg (sumbling_one e none L))) ht
  have hL : 0 ≤ fullKills L := trip_K h; have hE : 0 ≤ flagged e L := flagged_pos e h
  by_cases H : l=[]
  · rw [H,subtotal_nil,yield_zero]
    change (0:ℝ) ≤ 10^15*(0+(1+fullKills L+flagged e L)/a+a*t)
    positivity
  obtain ⟨v,w,hv,hq,hf,hB⟩ := holds_inner e p l m hp H
  have HE : L=v++((w++l)++m) := by unfold L; simp [hv]
  have H0 : Trip x s (v++((w++l)++m)) := HE ▸ h
  obtain ⟨h₁,s',hh⟩ := trip_cut H0
  obtain ⟨h₂,q,h₄⟩ := trip_cut hh
  obtain ⟨h₃,r,h₅⟩ := trip_cut h₂
  have HX : 2*log (bling e (w++(l++m))) ≤ t :=
    le_trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (log_le_log
      (by linarith [(bling_share e (w++(l++m))).1]) hB) (by norm_num)) ht
  rw [show subtotal (duties x e.u) l=subtotal F (w++l)-subtotal F w by rw [subtotal_app]; unfold F; abel]
  apply (yield_sub _ _).trans
  apply le_trans (add_le_add
    (ribbon_bound e _ _ h₂ hq t (show 2*log (e.bling ((w++l)++m)) ≤ t from by rwa [List.append_assoc]))
    (ribbon_bound e _ _ h₃ (fun b hb => hq b (List.mem_append_left _ hb)) t HX))
  have hiP (g : Beat M → ℝ) :
      subtotal g L=subtotal g v+subtotal g (w++l)+subtotal g m := by
    rw [HE,subtotal_app,subtotal_app]; linarith
  have H₁ (p l : Path M) : fullKills (p++l)=fullKills p+fullKills l := subtotal_app _ _ _
  have H₂ (p l : Path M) : flagged e (p++l)=flagged e p+flagged e l := subtotal_app _ _ _
  have hk : fullKills w ≤ fullKills (w++l) ∧ fullKills (w++l) ≤ fullKills L := by
    have H : fullKills L=fullKills v+fullKills (w++l)+fullKills m := hiP killed
    constructor <;> linarith [trip_K h₁,trip_K h₄,trip_K h₅,H₁ w l]
  have he : flagged e w ≤ flagged e (w++l) ∧ flagged e (w++l) ≤ flagged e L := by
    have H : flagged e L=flagged e v+flagged e (w++l)+flagged e m := hiP _
    constructor <;> linarith [flagged_pos e h₁,flagged_pos e h₄,flagged_pos e h₅,H₂ w l]
  rw [show fullFax (w++l)=fullFax w+fullFax l from subtotal_app _ w l]
  have hY : 1 ≤ (e.thick)⁻¹ := (one_le_inv₀ ha).mpr hi
  unfold a at *
  simp_rw [div_eq_mul_inv]
  nlinarith [trip_fax h₅]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Run.Streak.sumbling_one
statement:
lemma sumbling_one (e : Streak M) (t : Tide) (l : Path M) :
    1 ≤ e.sumbling t l
proof:
:= by
  induction l generalizing t with
  | nil => exact le_rfl
  | cons b l ih =>
    rw [sumbling]; split
    · linarith [(bling_share e (b::l)).1,ih (rightNow e b.post t).next]
    rw [zero_add]; exact ih _

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Run.Streak.spark_mean
statement:
lemma spark_mean (e : Streak M) {s : Scene M} (v : Thread M s) (t : Tide)
    (h : Following j J f v) :
    stats v (e.sumbling t) ≤ 1+6*(stats v (e.events true t)+stats v (e.events false t))
proof:
:= by
  induction v generalizing t with
  | blank => rw [stats_nil,stats_nil,stats_nil]; change (1:ℝ) ≤ 1+6*(0+0); norm_num
  | ran s q k ih =>
    rw [stats_cons h,stats_cons h,stats_cons h]
    let m := rightNow e q t
    let U := uniform Bool
    let A := m.next
    have hh (b : Bool) :
        stats (k b) (e.sumbling A) ≤ 1+6*(stats (k b) (e.events true A) + stats (k b) (e.events false A)) :=
      ih b A (h.2.2.2.2.2 b)
    have H := U.Ex_mono hh
    rw [Ex_add (f:=fun _ => _),Ex_const, Ex_lmul, Ex_add] at H
    have HH := bling_mean e (ran s q k) h
    change stats (ran s q k) (bling e) ≤ _ at HH
    rw [stats_cons h] at HH
    simp_rw [sumbling,events]
    by_cases h1 : (rightNow e q t).alpha=true <;>
      by_cases h2 : (rightNow e q t).tick=true <;>
      simp only [h1,h2,or_true,true_or,Bool.false_eq_true,false_or,↓reduceIte] <;>
      (try simp_rw [stats_plus _ (f:=fun _ => _),Ex_add _ (f:=fun _ => _)])
    all_goals

      unfold A m U at H
      unfold stats at *
      try simp_rw [Ex_add _ (f:=fun _ => _)]
      simp_rw [Ex_const]
      linarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Run.Streak.checkpoints
proof:
:= by
  induction l generalizing s t with
  | nil => change 0 ≤ powerOf t+0; linarith
  | cons b l ih =>
    have HH := (fax_floor h.2.1.climb).1
    have H (t : Tide) (hh : 0 ≤ powerOf t) := ih t h.2.2 hh
    rw [events]
    change (if (rightNow e b.post t).tick then 1 else 0)+_
      ≤ powerOf t+(fax b.post+fullFax l)
    cases t with
    | none =>
      split_ifs with h₁
      all_goals by_cases hx : e.innerV b.post
      all_goals simp only [rightNow,hx,↓reduceIte,idle,going] at h₁ ⊢
      all_goals
        first | contradiction |
          (have hi := H (some (fax b.post)) HH
           simp only [powerOf,Option.getD] at *; linarith) |
          (have hi := H none (by change (0:ℝ) ≤ 0; norm_num)
           simp only [powerOf,Option.getD] at *; linarith)
    | some z =>
      change 0 ≤ z at ht
      by_cases h₁ : e.outer b.post
      · by_cases h₂ : 1 ≤ z
        · have hi := H (some (fax b.post)) HH
          simp only [rightNow,going,h₁,h₂,↓reduceIte,powerOf,Option.getD] at hi ⊢; linarith
        have hi := H (some (z+fax b.post)) (add_nonneg ht HH)
        simp only [rightNow,going,h₁,h₂,↓reduceIte,Bool.false_eq_true,powerOf,Option.getD] at *
        linarith
      · have hi := H none (by change (0:ℝ) ≤ 0; norm_num)
        simp only [powerOf,rightNow,idle,h₁,Bool.false_eq_true,↓reduceIte,Option.getD] at *; linarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Run.Streak.slack_nonneg
statement:
lemma slack_nonneg (e : Streak M) (s : Scene M) (h : Fit s) (t : Tide) :
    0 ≤ slackOf e s t
proof:
:= by
  unfold slackOf; split; exact (energy_small h e.u).1; positivity

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Run.Streak.fare_step
statement:
lemma fare_step (e : Streak M) (s q : Scene M) (h : Ideal s q) (t : Tide) :
    let T
proof:
:= rightNow e q t
    (uniform Bool).Ex (fun b => slackOf e (q.smaller b) T.next)
       + (if T.alpha then e.quota else 0) ≤ slackOf e s t + breakFare e ⟨s,q,false⟩ := by
  intro T
  let v := fun b => energy (q.smaller b) e.u
  let g := shower e.u q
  let K := killed (Thread.Beat.mk s q false)
  let Q := e.b^2
  have he : (v false+v true)/2=energy q e.u+g := wet_average q h.climb e.u
  have hH (b) : 0 ≤ v b ∧ v b ≤ 4 :=
    let H := energy_small (h.climb.child b) e.u
    ⟨H.1,H.2.trans (h.climb.child b).lift⟩
  have hq : 0 ≤ Q := sq_nonneg _
  have hz : 0 ≤ K := Ideal.kill_nonneg (B:=⟨s,q,false⟩) h
  have hG : 0 ≤ g := shower_nonneg h.climb
  have hf := flag_nonneg e q
  have HH : |energy s e.u-energy q e.u| ≤ 8*K := energy_drain (b:=⟨s,q,false⟩) h e.u
  let B := g+8*K+4*flag e q
  change _+(if T.alpha=true then 64*Q else 0) ≤ _+B
  cases t with
  | none =>
    by_cases hp : innerV e q
    · rw [show T=going true false (fax q) from ite_eq_left hp, fair_av]
      change _ + _ ≤ 128*Q+B
      simp only [slackOf,going,Option.isSome_some,↓reduceIte]
      change (v false+v true)/2+64*Q ≤ _
      rcases hp with h1|h1
      · unfold B
        rw [show flag e q=1 from ite_eq_left h1]; linarith [(hH false).2,(hH true).2]
      · have hx (b) : v b ≤ 64*Q := h1 b
        unfold B; linarith [hx false,hx true]
    · rw [show T=idle from ite_eq_right hp]
      rw [show (uniform Bool).Ex (fun b => slackOf e (q.smaller b) idle.next) =128*Q from Ex_const (uniform Bool) (128*Q)]
      simp only [idle,Bool.false_eq_true,↓reduceIte]
      change _ ≤ 128*Q+B; unfold B; linarith
  | some x =>
    by_cases hp : outer e q
    · have HE : T.next.isSome=true ∧ T.alpha=false := by
        simp only [T,rightNow,ite_eq_left hp]; split <;> simp [going]
      rw [fair_av]
      simp only [slackOf,HE.1,HE.2,Bool.false_eq_true,Option.isSome_some,↓reduceIte]
      change (v false+v true)/2+_ ≤ _+B; unfold B
      linarith [(abs_le.mp HH).1]
    · rw [show T=idle from ite_eq_right hp]
      rw [show (uniform Bool).Ex (fun b => slackOf e (q.smaller b) idle.next) =128*Q from Ex_const (uniform Bool) (128*Q)]
      simp only [idle,Bool.false_eq_true,↓reduceIte]
      have hi : ¬ ∀ b, v b ≤ 256*Q := fun HH => hp (Or.inr HH)
      push Not at hi
      obtain ⟨b,hb⟩ := hi
      change _ ≤ energy s e.u+B; unfold B
      cases b <;> linarith [(hH true).1,(hH false).1,(abs_le.mp HH).1]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Run.Streak.fare_total
statement:
lemma fare_total (e : Streak M) {s : Scene M} (v : Thread M s) (t : Tide)
    (h : Following j J f v) (hp : Fit s) :
    e.quota*stats v (e.events true t) ≤ slackOf e s t+stats v (subtotal (breakFare e))
proof:
:= by
  induction v generalizing t with
  | blank s =>
    rw [stats_nil,stats_nil]
    change _*0 ≤ _+0
    linarith [slack_nonneg e s hp t]
  | ran s q k ih =>
    have HH := jump_ideal h hp.lift
    rw [stats_cons h,stats_cons h]
    let T := rightNow e q t
    let A := if T.alpha=true then (1:ℝ) else 0
    let B := breakFare e (Thread.Beat.mk s q false)
    change e.quota*_ ≤ _+_
    have HF (b : Bool) : breakFare e ⟨s,q,b⟩=B := rfl
    simp_rw [events,subtotal_cons,HF]
    have HE (b : Bool) := ih b T.next (h.2.2.2.2.2 b) (HH.climb.child _)
    have HI := (uniform Bool).Ex_mono HE
    have HC := e.fare_step s q HH t
    have H0 : e.quota*A=if T.alpha=true then e.quota else 0 := by unfold A; split <;> ring
    unfold stats at *
    simp_rw [Ex_add _ (f:=fun _ => _),Ex_const]
    rw [Ex_add,Ex_lmul] at HI
    change _+(if T.alpha then _ else _) ≤ _+B at HC
    rw [← H0] at HC
    unfold A T at *
    simp only [↓reduceIte]
    linarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Run.Streak.expected_bling
statement:
lemma expected_bling :
    ∀ᶠ j : ℕ in atTop, ∀ M J : ℕ, ∀ s q : Scene M,
      ∀ f : Grid M → ℝ, ∀ k, Following j J f (ran s q k) → Fit s → q.live=true →
      (∀ x, f x ≤ exp (height j)) →
      ∀ e : Streak M, e.i ≤ mainIx j →
        stats (ran s q k) (e.sumbling none) ≤ 10^30*(height j)^3
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [sum_budget_run,hpoly 12800 32] with j hj hs M J s q f k h hh hq hF e he
  let v := ran s q k
  obtain ⟨h1,h2,h3,h4⟩ := hj M J f s q k h hh hq hF e
  let x := stats v (e.events true none); let y := stats v (e.events false none)
  let b := e.b^2; let d := height j
  have hi : 1 ≤ d := by nlinarith [H_ge j,show (1:ℝ) ≤ Thermal.H j^32 from one_le_pow₀ (H_ge j)]
  have HE : 1 ≤ d*b := by
    have hh1 := (main_bounds j (show e.i ≤ testIx j by unfold testIx; omega)).1
    have hE := Thermal.H_pos j
    rw [div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)] at hh1
    change 1/6400 ≤ b/100*Thermal.H j^32 at hh1
    have HB : 0 ≤ b := sq_nonneg _
    change _ ≤ d at hs
    nlinarith
  have hb : 0 < b := pow_pos e.rate.1 _; have hh' : b ≤ 1 := pow_le_one₀ e.rate.1.le e.rate.2
  have HR := spark_mean e v none h
  apply HR.trans
  change 1+6*(x+y) ≤ 10^30*d^3
  have HV : y ≤ stats v fullFax := by
    apply Ex_mono_mem
    intro i hi
    have hL : i∈s.here.block M := (dice_positive hh.ready.1).1 hi
    have HE := checkpoints e none (trip_stream v h hh hL)
      (by change (0:ℝ) ≤ 0; norm_num)
    rw [show powerOf none=0 from rfl, zero_add] at HE; exact HE
  let z := stats v e.flagged
  change stats v _ ≤ _ at h1 h2 h3
  change b*z ≤ 10^6*d at h4
  have hz : z ≤ 10^6*d^2 := by
    by_contra! HH
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left HE (show 0 ≤ 10^6*d by positivity)]
  have hh0 := fare_total e v none h hh
  have hx : stats v (subtotal (breakFare e)) =
      stats v (e.showers) + 8*stats v fullKills + 4*z := by
    have HI (l : Path M) : subtotal (breakFare e) l = e.showers l+8*fullKills l+4*e.flagged l := by
      induction l with
      | nil => change (0:ℝ)=0+_*0+_*0; ring
      | cons b l ih =>
        rw [subtotal_cons,ih]
        change shower e.u b.post+8*killed b+4*flag e b.post+_=
          shower e.u b.post+e.showers l+8*(killed b+fullKills l)+4*(flag e b.post+e.flagged l)
        ring
    unfold z stats
    simp_rw [HI,Ex_add,Ex_lmul]
  rw [hx] at hh0
  change 64*b*x ≤ 128*b+_ at hh0
  have HC : 64*b*x ≤ 10^7*d^2 := by nlinarith
  have HQ : x ≤ 10^7*d^3 := by
    by_contra! hx
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left HE (show 0 ≤ 10^7*d^2 by positivity)]
  change stats v fullFax ≤ 10^26*d at h3
  nlinarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Troupe.choice_bounds
statement:
lemma choice_bounds (g : Grade) (l : Path M) :
    let x
proof:
:= chooseCap g l
    x ≤ M+2 ∧ broadMass l g ≤ rangeIx x ∧ scaleC x ≤ 2*((broadMass l g:ℝ)+1) := by
  intro x
  let n := broadMass l g
  have hx : 2^x ≤ 2*(n+1) := (by
    change 2^(Nat.log 2 n+1) ≤ _
    have H := Nat.pow_log_le_add_one 2 n
    rw [pow_add]; omega)
  have H : n ≤ 2^M := by
    apply le_trans (Finset.card_le_univ _) (by rw [ZMod.card])
  refine ⟨?_,(Nat.lt_pow_succ_log_self (show 1 < 2 by norm_num) _).le,?_⟩
  · by_contra! hh
    have HI : 2^(M+2) < 2^x := Nat.pow_lt_pow_right (by omega) hh
    have HF : 0 < 2^M := by positivity
    rw [pow_add] at HI
    norm_num at HI; omega
  · unfold scaleC
    change (2:ℝ)^x ≤ 2*((n:ℝ)+1)
    exact_mod_cast hx

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Troupe.booking
statement:
lemma booking :
    ∀ᶠ j : ℕ in atTop,
      ∀ M J : ℕ, ∀ s : Scene M, ∀ f : Grid M → ℝ, ∀ t : Thread M s,
        t.Following j J f → Fit s → entry s →
        (∀ x,f x ≤ exp (height j)) →
        ∀ g : Grade, entitled g s j → ∀ m : ℕ,
          stats t (showScore (stage g m) (vacant M) j) ≤ heartP s g j* scaleC m^4
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [paint_birth,prelude] with j h₁ h₂ M J s f t h hh he hf g hg m
  apply (h₁ M J _ _ f (stage g m) h hh hg hf _).trans
  let x := scaleC g.i; let y := scaleC m; let L := amount s j; let z := exp (cutBook g s j)
  have hx : 1 ≤ x := scale_one _; have hy : 1 ≤ y := scale_one _
  have hL : 1 ≤ L := (amount_limits _ _).1
  have hz : 1 ≤ z := one_le_exp (cut_nonneg _ _ _)
  have HV := (h₂ M J s f t h hh he hf (stage g m)).1
  change stats t _ ≤ 10^50*x^14*L*y^4 at HV
  change 1+10^30*L^3*z*_ ≤ 10^82*x^14*L^4*z*y^4
  apply le_trans (add_le_add_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left HV (by positivity : 0 ≤ 10^30*L^3*z)) 1)
  let r : ℝ := x^14*L^4*z*y^4
  have hR : 1 ≤ r := by
    unfold r
    exact one_le_mul_of_one_le_of_one_le (one_le_mul_of_one_le_of_one_le (one_le_mul_of_one_le_of_one_le (one_le_pow₀ hx) (one_le_pow₀ hL)) hz) (one_le_pow₀ hy)
  nlinarith [show r=x^14*L^4*z*y^4 from rfl]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Troupe.hush_pos
statement:
lemma hush_pos (g : Grade) (j m : ℕ) (l : Path M) :
    0 < hush g j m l
proof:
:= div_pos (lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) < 1)
      (show_one _ _ _ _)) (pow_pos (scale_pos _) _)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Troupe.spill_share
statement:
lemma spill_share (g : Grade) (j : ℕ) (l : Path M) :
    let k
proof:
:= chooseCap g l
    let S := spillScore g j l
    1 ≤ S ∧ showScore (stage g k) (vacant M) j l ≤ S*scaleC k^5 := by
  intro k S
  have ha : ∀ m, 0 ≤ hush g j m l := fun _ => (hush_pos _ _ _ _).le
  constructor
  · exact le_add_of_nonneg_right (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun _ _ => ha _))
  · apply (div_le_iff₀ (pow_pos (scale_pos k) _)).mp
    change hush g j k l ≤ _
    unfold S spillScore
    have h := (choice_bounds g l).1
    have he : k∈Finset.range (M+3) := Finset.mem_range.mpr (by unfold k; omega)
    exact le_trans (Finset.single_le_sum (f:=fun i => hush g j i l) (fun _ _ => ha _) he) (le_add_of_nonneg_left (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) ≤ 1))

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Troupe.spill_bound
statement:
lemma spill_bound :
    ∀ᶠ j : ℕ in atTop,
      ∀ M J : ℕ, ∀ s : Scene M, ∀ f : Grid M → ℝ, ∀ t : Thread M s,
        t.Following j J f → Fit s → entry s →
        (∀ x,f x ≤ exp (height j)) →
        ∀ g : Grade, entitled g s j → stats t (spillScore g j) ≤ 4*heartP s g j
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [booking] with j hj M J s f t h hh he hf g hg
  let x := heartP s g j
  have HI : 1 ≤ x := by
    unfold x heartP
    exact one_le_mul_of_one_le_of_one_le (one_le_mul_of_one_le_of_one_le (one_le_mul_of_one_le_of_one_le (by norm_num) (one_le_pow₀ (scale_one _))) (one_le_pow₀ (amount_limits _ _).1)) (one_le_exp (cut_nonneg _ _ _))
  have HA (m) : stats t (hush g j m) ≤ x * side m := by
    let B := scaleC m
    have HE := hj M J s f t h hh he hf g hg m
    have hp : 0 < B := scale_pos _
    calc
      _ = stats t (showScore (stage g m) _ j) / B^5 := by
        unfold hush stats B; simp_rw [div_eq_mul_inv,Ex_mul]
      _ ≤ x * B^4 / B^5 := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right HE (pow_nonneg hp.le _)
      _ = x * side m := by rw [scale_side]; unfold B; have := scale_pos m; field_simp
  let R := Finset.range (M+3)
  have H (k : ℕ) : ∑ i∈Finset.range k, side i ≤ 2 := by
    have h₁ := geom_sum_mul_neg ((1:ℝ)/2) k
    unfold side; nlinarith [pow_nonneg (show (0:ℝ) ≤ 1/2 by norm_num) k]
  calc
    _ = 1+∑ i∈R,stats t (hush g j i) := by
      unfold stats spillScore; rw [Ex_add (f:=fun _ => 1),Ex_const,Ex_finset_sum]
    _ ≤ 1+∑ i∈R,x*side i := by apply add_le_add_right; exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => HA i
    _ ≤ _ := by rw [← Finset.mul_sum]; unfold R; change _ ≤ 4*x; nlinarith [H (M+3)]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Troupe.timex_scores
statement:
lemma timex_scores (g : Grade) (j : ℕ) (l : Path M) :
    0 ≤ timex g j l ∧
      2*log (showScore (stage g (chooseCap g l)) (vacant M) j l) ≤ timex g j l
proof:
:= by
  let v := scaleC (chooseCap g l)
  have hp : 1 ≤ v := scale_one _
  obtain ⟨h₁,h₂⟩ := spill_share g j l
  let a := spillScore g j l
  change 1 ≤ a at h₁
  let p := stage g (chooseCap g l)
  let s := showScore p (vacant M) j l
  change s ≤ a*v^5 at h₂
  have Hs : 0 < s := lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) (show_one _ _ _ _)
  have hi := log_le_log Hs h₂
  rw [log_mul (by positivity) (by positivity), log_pow] at hi; push_cast at hi
  change 0 ≤ 2*(log a+_) ∧ 2*log s ≤ 2*(log a+5*log v)
  constructor
  · apply mul_nonneg (by norm_num); exact add_nonneg (log_nonneg h₁) (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (log_nonneg hp))
  linarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Troupe.stat_jensen
statement:
lemma stat_jensen (t : Thread M s) (f : Path M→ℝ) (hp : ∀ l, 0 < f l)
    (x : ℝ) (hh : 0 < x) (h : stats t f ≤ x) :
    stats t (fun l => log (f l)) ≤ log x
proof:
:= by
  let P := s.here.dice M
  have HE (l) : log (f l) ≤ log x + (x⁻¹ * f l-1) := by
    have H := log_le_sub_one_of_pos (div_pos (hp l) hh)
    rw [log_div (hp l).ne' hh.ne',div_eq_inv_mul] at H; linarith
  have HC := P.Ex_mono (fun x => HE (t.stream x))
  rw [Ex_add _ (f:=fun _ => _),Ex_sub,Ex_const,Ex_lmul,Ex_const] at HC
  change _ ≤ log x +(x⁻¹*stats t f-1) at HC
  apply HC.trans; nlinarith [inv_pos.2 hh,inv_mul_cancel₀ hh.ne']

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Troupe.paid_levels
statement:
lemma paid_levels :
    ∀ᶠ j : ℕ in atTop,
      ∀ M J : ℕ, ∀ s : Scene M, ∀ f : Grid M → ℝ, ∀ t : Thread M s,
        t.Following j J f → Fit s → entry s →
        (∀ x,f x ≤ exp (height j)) →
        ∀ g : Grade, entitled g s j →
          stats t (timex g j) ≤ 10^7*(dBase g s j+cutBook g s j) ∧
          stats t (fun l => (chooseCap g l:ℝ)) ≤ 10^6*dBase g s j
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [spill_bound,prelude] with j h₁ h₂ M J s f t h hh he hf g hg
  let x := amount s j; let y := scaleC g.i; let z := cutBook g s j
  let B := spillScore (M:=M) g j; let Q (l : Path M) := scaleC (chooseCap g l)
  have hx : 1 ≤ x := (amount_limits _ _).1; have hy : 1 ≤ y := scale_one _
  have hz : 0 ≤ z := cut_nonneg _ _ _
  have hH := (h₂ M J s f t h hh he hf (stage g 0)).2
  change stats t (fun l => (broadMass l g:ℝ)) ≤ 10^31*y^6*x at hH
  have he₁ : stats t Q ≤ 10^33*y^6*x := by
    let C (l : Path M) := (broadMass l g:ℝ)
    calc
      _ ≤ stats t (fun l => 2*(C l+1)) := by
        apply Ex_mono; intro i; exact (choice_bounds g (t.stream i)).2.2
      _ = 2*(stats t C+1) := by unfold stats; rw [Ex_lmul,Ex_add,Ex_const]
      _ ≤ _ := by unfold C; nlinarith [one_le_pow₀ hy (n:=6)]
  let T := dBase g s j
  have hi : log y ≤ g.i := by
    unfold y scaleC; rw [log_pow]
    have Hx : log 2 ≤ 1 := by linarith [log_le_sub_one_of_pos (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<2)]
    exact mul_le_of_le_one_right (by positivity) Hx
  have HI : 1 ≤ T := by unfold T dBase; linarith [log_nonneg hx,Nat.cast_nonneg (α:=ℝ) g.i]
  have hQ : stats t (fun l => log (Q l)) ≤ 10000*T := by
    apply (stat_jensen t Q (fun _ => scale_pos _) _ (by positivity) he₁).trans
    rw [log_mul (by positivity) (by positivity), log_mul (by positivity) (by positivity),
      log_pow,log_pow]; push_cast
    change _ ≤ 10000*(1+log x+_)
    linarith [log_nonneg hx,Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<10),Nat.cast_nonneg (α:=ℝ) g.i]
  have HR : stats t (fun l => log (B l)) ≤ z+10000*T := by
    have hh' := h₁ M J s f t h hh he hf g hg
    change stats t B ≤ 4*(10^82*y^14*x^4*exp z) at hh'
    apply (stat_jensen t B (fun l => lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<1) (spill_share g j l).1)
      _ (by positivity) hh').trans
    rw [log_mul (by positivity) (by positivity),log_mul (by positivity) (by positivity),
      log_mul (by positivity) (by positivity),log_mul (by positivity) (by positivity),
      log_pow,log_pow,log_pow,log_exp]; push_cast
    change _ ≤ z+10000*(1+log x+_)
    linarith [log_nonneg hx,Nat.cast_nonneg (α:=ℝ) g.i, log_le_sub_one_of_pos (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<4),log_le_sub_one_of_pos (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<10)]
  constructor
  · change stats t (fun l => 2*(log (B l)+5*log (Q l))) ≤ 10^7*(T+z)
    unfold stats at *; rw [Ex_lmul,Ex_add,Ex_lmul]; linarith
  have HB (l : Path M) : (chooseCap g l:ℝ) ≤ 2*log (Q l) := by
    unfold Q scaleC; rw [log_pow]
    nlinarith [log_two_gt_d9,Nat.cast_nonneg (α:=ℝ) (chooseCap g l)]
  apply le_trans (b:=stats t (fun l => 2*log (Q l))) (Ex_mono _ (fun i => HB (t.stream i)))
  unfold stats at *; rw [Ex_lmul]; change _ ≤ 10^6*T; linarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.duet_zero
statement: lemma duet_zero (x : ℂ) : duet x 0=0
proof: := by simp [duet]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.duet_self
statement: lemma duet_self (x : ℂ) : duet x x=‖x‖^2
proof:
:= by
  rw [duet,mul_comm,Complex.mul_conj,Complex.sq_norm]; rfl

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.duet_add
statement: lemma duet_add (x y z : ℂ) : duet x (y+z)=duet x y+duet x z
proof: := by simp [duet,mul_add]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.duet_sub
statement: lemma duet_sub (x y z : ℂ) : duet x (y-z)=duet x y-duet x z
proof: := by simp [duet,mul_sub]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.duet_scale
statement: lemma duet_scale (x y : ℂ) (c : ℝ) : duet x ((c:ℂ)*y)=c* duet x y
proof:
:= by
  rw [duet,duet,mul_left_comm,Complex.re_ofReal_mul]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.duet_limit
statement: lemma duet_limit (x y : ℂ) : |duet x y| ≤ ‖x‖* ‖y‖
proof:
:= by
  apply (Complex.abs_re_le_norm _).trans
  rw [norm_mul,Complex.norm_conj]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.duet_inc
statement: lemma duet_inc (x y : ℂ) : ‖x+y‖^2=‖x‖^2+2*duet x y+‖y‖^2
proof:
:= by
  rw [Complex.sq_norm,Complex.sq_norm,Complex.sq_norm,duet]
  simp [Complex.normSq_apply]; ring

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.mean_hold
statement:
lemma mean_hold (s : Scene M) (h : Fit s) (u z : Grid M) :
    (matter s z:ℂ)*meanV s u z=letter s u z ∧ ‖meanV s u z‖ ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  have H := matter_norm h u z
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le (matter_nonneg h z) with ha|ha
  · have hi : letter s u z=0 := norm_le_zero_iff.mp (by linarith)
    simp [meanV,← ha,hi]
  unfold meanV; constructor
  · have hh : (matter s z:ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast ha.ne'
    field_simp
  rw [norm_div,Complex.norm_real,Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_nonneg ha.le]
  exact (div_le_one ha).mpr H

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.sun_rays
statement:
lemma sun_rays {s : Scene M} (h : Fit s) (u z) :
    0 ≤ sun s u z ∧ sun s u z ≤ matter s z
proof:
:=
  ⟨mul_nonneg (matter_nonneg h z) (sq_nonneg _),mul_le_of_le_one_right (matter_nonneg h _)
    (pow_le_one₀ (norm_nonneg _) (mean_hold _ h _ _).2)⟩

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.sun_energy
statement:
lemma sun_energy {s : Scene M} (h : Fit s) (u : Grid M) :
    energy s u=∑ z, sun s u z
proof:
:= by
  unfold energy energyZ; refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun z _ => ?_
  have he := mean_hold _ h u z
  change ‖letter s u z‖^2 / matter s z=_
  rw [← he.1,norm_mul,Complex.norm_real,Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_nonneg (matter_nonneg h z)]
  unfold sun; by_cases h : matter s z=0
  · rw [h]; ring_nf
  field_simp

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.energy_small
statement:
lemma energy_small {s : Scene M} (h : Fit s) (u) :
    0 ≤ energy s u ∧ energy s u ≤ share s
proof:
:= by
  rw [sun_energy h]
  constructor
  · exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => (sun_rays h _ _).1)
  rw [←matter_sum h]
  exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => (sun_rays h _ _).2

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.pierce_nonneg
statement: lemma pierce_nonneg {s : Scene M} (h : Fit s) (z) : 0 ≤ pierce s z
proof:
:=
    div_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (matter_nonneg h _)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.shell_sq
statement:
lemma shell_sq {s : Scene M} (h : Climb s) (z) :
    shell s z^2=matter s z*pierce s z
proof:
:= by
  by_cases he : matter s z=0
  · have hx := shell_abs h z; rw [he,abs_nonpos_iff] at hx
    rw [he,hx]; ring
  unfold pierce; field_simp

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.mist_nonneg
statement: lemma mist_nonneg (u : Grid M) (s t : Scene M) (h : Fit t) (z) : 0 ≤ mist u s t z
proof:
:=
    mul_nonneg (matter_nonneg h _) (sq_nonneg _)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.mist_low
statement:
lemma mist_low (u : Grid M) {s : Scene M} (h : Climb s) (b z) :
    mist u s (s.smaller b) z ≤ 2*dew u s z
proof:
:= by
  cases b <;> unfold dew <;> linarith [mist_nonneg u s _ (h.child false) z,mist_nonneg u s _ (h.child true) z]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.dew_nonneg
statement: lemma dew_nonneg (u : Grid M) {s : Scene M} (h : Climb s) (z) : 0 ≤ dew u s z
proof:
:=
    div_nonneg (add_nonneg (mist_nonneg _ _ _ (h.child false) _)
      (mist_nonneg _ _ _ (h.child true) _)) (by norm_num)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.shower_nonneg
statement: lemma shower_nonneg {u : Grid M} {s : Scene M} (h : Climb s) : 0 ≤ shower u s
proof:
:=
    Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ => dew_nonneg _ h _

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.mean_shift
statement:
lemma mean_shift {s : Scene M} (h : Climb s) (b) (u z) :
    (matter (s.smaller b) z:ℂ)*(meanV (s.smaller b) u z-meanV s u z) =
      (curl b:ℂ)*nub s u z
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_sub,(mean_hold _ (h.child b) _ _).1,matter_jump h b,
    letter_jump h,← (mean_hold _ h.fit _ _).1,nub]
  push_cast; ring

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.sun_shift
statement:
lemma sun_shift {s : Scene M} (h : Climb s) (u b z) :
    sun (s.smaller b) u z = sun s u z+curl b *
      (shell s z*‖meanV s u z‖^2 + 2*duet (meanV s u z) (nub s u z))+
        mist u s (s.smaller b) z
proof:
:= by
  let v := meanV s u z; let w := meanV (s.smaller b) u z-v
  let m := matter (s.smaller b) z
  have he : meanV (s.smaller b) u z=v+w := by unfold w; ring
  have HH : m*duet v w=curl b*duet v (nub s u z) := by rw [←duet_scale,
    show (m:ℂ)*w=_ from mean_shift h _ _ _,duet_scale]
  change m*‖meanV (s.smaller b) u z‖^2=matter s z* ‖v‖^2+curl b*(shell s z*‖v‖^2+_) +m*‖w‖^2
  rw [he,duet_inc]
  change m*_=matter s z*‖v‖^2+curl b* (shell s z*‖v‖^2+2*duet v (nub s u z))+_
  have he' : m=matter s z + curl b * shell s z := matter_jump h b z
  nlinarith [show m*‖v‖^2=(matter s z+curl b*shell s z)*‖v‖^2 by rw [he']]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.wet_average
statement:
lemma wet_average (s : Scene M) (h : Climb s) (u) :
    (energy (s.smaller false) u+energy (s.smaller true) u)/2 =
      energy s u+shower u s
proof:
:= by
  rw [sun_energy (h.child false),sun_energy (h.child true),sun_energy h.fit,
    ← Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_div,shower,← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro z _
  rw [sun_shift h,sun_shift h]
  unfold dew; simp [curl]
  ring

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.wet_walk
statement:
lemma wet_walk (s : Scene M) (h : Climb s) (u b) :
    energy (s.smaller b) u=energy s u+shower u s+curl b*gust s u
proof:
:= by
  rw [←wet_average s h u,gust]
  cases b <;> norm_num [curl] <;> ring

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.matter_max
statement:
lemma matter_max {s : Scene M} (h : Climb s) (b z) :
    matter (s.smaller b) z ≤ 2*matter s z
proof:
:= by
  have hi := matter_nonneg (h.child true) z
  have hj := matter_nonneg (h.child false) z
  cases b <;> linarith [matter_split h z]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.norm_scaleC
statement:
lemma norm_scaleC (x : ℝ) (v : ℂ) :
    ‖(x:ℂ)*v‖=|x| * ‖v‖
proof: := by rw [norm_mul,Complex.norm_real,Real.norm_eq_abs]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.nub_innovation
statement:
lemma nub_innovation (s : Scene M) (h : Climb s) (u z) :
    ‖nub s u z‖^2 ≤ 4*matter s z*dew u s z
proof:
:= by
  let q := s.smaller false
  let x := matter q z
  have hp : 0 ≤ x := matter_nonneg (h.child false) z
  have hi : ‖nub s u z‖^2=x*mist u s q z := by
    have HH := congrArg (fun x : ℂ => ‖x‖) (mean_shift h false u z)
    change ‖(x:ℂ)*(meanV q u z-meanV s u z)‖=‖(curl false:ℂ)*nub s u z‖ at HH
    rw [norm_scaleC,norm_scaleC,curl_unit,one_mul,abs_of_nonneg hp] at HH
    rw [← HH]; unfold mist x; ring
  rw [hi]
  have H : x ≤ 2*matter s z := matter_max h false _
  have he := mul_le_mul H (mist_low u h false z) (mist_nonneg u s _ (h.child false) z)
    (hp.trans H)
  change x*mist u s q z ≤ _ at he
  linarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.drain_changes
statement:
lemma drain_changes {s q : Scene M} (h : Ideal s q) (u z) :
    let k
proof:
:= matter s z-matter q z
    mist u s q z ≤ 4*k ∧ |sun s u z-sun q u z| ≤ 8*k := by
  let w := meanV s u z; let v := meanV q u z
  let r := matter s z; let t := matter q z
  intro k
  have hw := mean_hold s h.fit u z; have hv := mean_hold q h.climb.fit u z
  have H := matter_drain h u z
  rw [← hw.1,← hv.1] at H
  have hr : 0 ≤ r := matter_nonneg h.fit z
  have ht : 0 ≤ t := matter_nonneg h.climb.fit z
  change ‖(r:ℂ)*w-(t:ℂ)*v‖ ≤ k at H
  have hk := (norm_nonneg _).trans H
  have hh : k=r-t := rfl
  have H1 : t* ‖w-v‖ ≤ 2*k := by
    rw [show t* ‖w-v‖=‖(t:ℂ)*(w-v)‖ by rw [norm_scaleC,abs_of_nonneg ht]]
    rw [show (t:ℂ)*(w-v)=(r*w-t*v)-(k:ℂ)*w by rw [hh]; push_cast; ring]
    apply le_trans (norm_sub_le _ _)
    rw [norm_scaleC,abs_of_nonneg hk]
    have HH : ‖w‖ ≤ 1 := hw.2
    nlinarith
  have Hw : ‖w‖ ≤ 1 := hw.2
  have Hv : ‖v‖ ≤ 1 := hv.2
  have HE : ‖w-v‖ ≤ 2 := (norm_sub_le _ _).trans (by linarith)
  constructor
  · change t* ‖v-w‖^2 ≤ _
    rw [norm_sub_rev]
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left HE ht,norm_nonneg (w-v),
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left HE (mul_nonneg ht (norm_nonneg (w-v)))]
  · change |r* ‖w‖^2-t* ‖v‖^2| ≤ _
    rw [show r* ‖w‖^2-t* ‖v‖^2=k*‖w‖^2+t*(‖w‖-‖v‖)*(‖w‖+‖v‖) by rw [hh]; ring]
    apply le_trans (abs_add_le _ _)
    have ht' : |‖w‖-‖v‖| ≤ ‖w-v‖ := abs_norm_sub_norm_le w v
    rw [abs_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg hk (sq_nonneg _)), abs_mul,abs_mul,
      abs_of_nonneg ht,abs_of_nonneg (add_nonneg (norm_nonneg w) (norm_nonneg v))]
    have HE' : t*|‖w‖-‖v‖| ≤ 2*k := (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ht' ht).trans H1
    have hW' : k*‖w‖^2 ≤ k := mul_le_of_le_one_right hk
      (pow_le_one₀ (norm_nonneg _) Hw)
    nlinarith [norm_nonneg v,norm_nonneg w]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.energy_drain
statement:
lemma energy_drain {b : Beat M} (h : Ideal b.pre b.post) (u) :
    |energy b.pre u-energy b.post u| ≤ 8*killed b
proof:
:= by
  rw [sun_energy h.fit,sun_energy h.climb.fit,h.kill_eq,←matter_sum h.fit,←matter_sum h.climb.fit,
    ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib,← Finset.sum_sub_distrib,Finset.mul_sum]
  apply (Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _).trans
  exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => (drain_changes h u i).2

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Beam.Lamp.flash_cell
statement:
lemma flash_cell (e : Lamp M) (h : Climb e.site) (r t : Bool) (q : Scene M)
    (hq : Ideal (e.site.smaller r) q) (ha : 0 < e.width) (he : e.width ≤ 1)
    (z : Grid M) :
    let u
proof:
:= e.u
    let a := e.width
    let s := e.site
    let k := matter (s.smaller r) z-matter q z
    let C := 20*(pierce s z+pierce q z) + 400*((k+dew u s z+dew u q z)/a)
    prism (q.smaller t) u (e.carry r t) a z ≤
      prism s u e.W a z + curl r * e.first z + curl t * e.second r q z + 2*k+4*C := by
  intro u a s k C
  let w := s.smaller r; let y := q.smaller t
  let R := prism s u e.W a z
  let f (s) := letter s u z; let m (s) := matter s z
  let P (s) := factor s u z; let D (s : Scene M) := a*shell s z
  let X := curl r; let Y := curl t; let A := e.W z
  let F (x : Scene M) := a*m x
  let kill : ℂ := f q-f w; let lost : ℝ := F q-F w
  let g₀ := (↑X:ℂ)*P s; let g₁ := (↑Y:ℂ)*P q
  let gain := (↑Y:ℂ)*g₀; let plusf := g₀+kill+g₁
  let plusm := X*D s + lost + Y*D q
  have hk : ‖kill‖ ≤ k := by unfold kill; rw [norm_sub_rev]; exact matter_drain hq u z
  have hl : lost= -(a*k) := by unfold lost k F w m; ring
  have hp := (norm_nonneg kill).trans hk
  have hm : |lost|=a*k := by rw [hl,abs_neg,abs_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg ha.le hp)]
  have hs : |lost| ≤ k := by rw [hm]; nlinarith
  have hA : f y=f s+plusf := by
    have h1 : f w=f s+g₀ := letter_jump h r u z
    have h2 : f y=f q+g₁ := letter_jump hq.climb t u z
    rw [h2]; unfold plusf kill; rw [h1]; ring
  have hB : F y=F s+plusm := by
    have h1 : m w=m s+X*shell s z := matter_jump h r z
    have h2 : m y=m q+Y*shell q z := matter_jump hq.climb t z
    unfold F plusm lost D; unfold F; rw [h1,h2]; ring
  have h0 : 0 ≤ R := ray_pos _ _ _
  have hC : 0 ≤ C := by
    have h1 := pierce_nonneg h.fit z
    have h2 := pierce_nonneg hq.climb.fit z
    have h3 : 0 ≤ k+dew u s z+dew u q z := add_nonneg
      (add_nonneg hp (dew_nonneg u h z)) (dew_nonneg u hq.climb z)
    exact add_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (add_nonneg h1 h2))
      (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (div_nonneg h3 ha.le))
  have hx : |X|=1 := curl_unit _; have hy : |Y|=1 := curl_unit _
  have HG : content gain plusf plusm ≤ R*(4*C) := by
    have HH := contest g₀ kill g₁ (X*D s) lost (Y*D q)
    have Heq : ‖g₀‖=‖P s‖ := by unfold g₀; rw [norm_scaleC,hx,one_mul]
    have Hf : ‖gain‖=‖g₀‖ := by unfold gain; rw [norm_scaleC,hy,one_mul]
    have Hf' : ‖g₁‖=‖P q‖ := by unfold g₁; rw [norm_scaleC,hy,one_mul]
    have HV : ‖P s‖^2+‖P q‖^2+D s^2+D q^2+
        ‖kill‖^2+(a*k)^2 ≤ R*C := by
      have H := extra_joints h u z r hq a ha he e.W
      unfold kill; rw [norm_sub_rev]; exact H
    rw [show content gain plusf plusm=‖gain‖^2+(‖plusf‖^2+plusm^2) by unfold content; ring,Hf,Heq]
    change ‖plusf‖^2 + plusm^2 ≤ _ at HH
    rw [Heq,Hf',mul_pow X (D s),mul_pow Y (D q),show X^2=1 from curl_sq _,show Y^2=1 from curl_sq _,hl] at HH
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (D s),sq_nonneg (D q),sq_nonneg ‖P q‖,sq_nonneg ‖kill‖,sq_nonneg (a*k)]
  let glow' := glow A (f s) (F s)
  have HL : glow' gain plusf plusm =
      X*e.first z+glow' 0 kill lost+Y*e.second r q z := by
    unfold gain plusf plusm g₀ g₁ first second glint X Y glow'
    let F' := factor e.site e.u z
    let a' := curl r; let k' := curl t

    let L := e.glint z
    change L ((k':ℂ)*((a':ℂ)*F')) ((a':ℂ)*F'+kill+(k':ℂ)*P q)
      (a'*D s+lost+k'*D q)=a'*L 0 F' (D s)+L 0 kill lost+k'*L ((a':ℂ)*F') (P q) (D q)
    have h1 (v w p i : ℂ) (u y : ℝ) :
        L (v+p) (w+i) (u+y)=L v w u+L p i y := glow_add _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _
    have h2 (v : ℝ) (y : ℝ) (q w : ℂ) :
        L ((v:ℂ)*q) ((v:ℂ)*w) (v*y)=v*L q w y := glow_scale _ _ _ _ _ _ _
    rw [← h2,← h2,← h1,← h1]
    congr 1; ring
  have Hpill : glow' 0 kill lost ≤ 2*k := by
    apply le_trans (le_abs_self _); apply le_trans (glow_limit _ _ _ _ _ _)
    rw [norm_zero]; linarith
  change ray (A+gain) (f y) (F y) ≤ ray A (f s) (F s)+X*e.first z+Y*e.second r q z+2*k+4*C
  rw [hA,hB]
  apply (ray_shift A (f s) gain plusf (F s) plusm _ (by positivity) HG).trans
  change ray A _ _+glow' gain plusf plusm+_ ≤ _
  rw [HL]; linarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Beam.Lamp.flash
statement:
lemma flash (e : Lamp M) (h : Climb e.site) (r : Bool) (b : Beat M)
    (hb : b.pre=e.site.smaller r) (hq : Ideal b.pre b.post)
    (ha : 0 < e.width) (he : e.width ≤ 1) :
    let s
proof:
:= e.site
    let u := e.u
    let a := e.width
    let q := b.post
    let t := b.bit
    let k := killed b
    let C := 20*(fax s+fax q)+400*((k+shower u s+shower u q)/a)
    watt (winds b) u (carry e r t) a ≤ watt s u e.W a + curl r *start e +
      curl t *delayed e r q + 2*k + 4*C := by
  intro s u a q t k C
  let K z := matter (s.smaller r) z - matter q z
  have hK : k=∑ z,K z := by
    unfold K k; rw [hq.kill_eq]; rw [← matter_sum hq.fit, ← matter_sum hq.climb.fit,
      Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    rw [hb]
  let B z := 20*(pierce s z+pierce q z)+400*((K z+dew u s z+dew u q z)/a)
  have hC : C=∑ z,B z := by
    unfold C B fax shower
    rw [hK]
    rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib,←Finset.mul_sum,←Finset.mul_sum,← Finset.sum_div]; simp_rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    rfl
  rw [hK,hC,watt,watt,start,delayed, Finset.mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum,Finset.mul_sum,
    ← Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib,← Finset.sum_add_distrib,← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum; intro i _
  exact flash_cell e h r t q (hb ▸ hq) ha he i

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Beam.Lamp.start_cost
statement:
lemma start_cost (e : Lamp M) (h : Climb e.site) (ha : 0 ≤ e.width) :
    start e^2 ≤ 100*lit e e.site
proof:
:= by
  let a := e.width; let W := e.W; let s := e.site; let u := e.u
  let x := ∑ z,‖factor s u z‖; let y := ∑ z, |shell s z|
  have H : |start e| ≤ x + a*y := by
    apply le_trans (Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _)
    unfold x y; rw [Finset.mul_sum,← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum; intro i _
    apply (glow_limit _ _ _ _ _ _).trans
    rw [norm_zero,zero_add,abs_mul,abs_of_nonneg ha]
  have hX : x^2 ≤ _ := factor_bill _ h u
  have hY : y^2 ≤ _ := shell_bill _ h
  have hT : (start e)^2 ≤ (x+a*y)^2 := by
    rw [←sq_abs]; exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) H _
  have hV : (a*y)^2 ≤ a^2*(2*fax s) := by rw [mul_pow]; gcongr
  change _ ≤ 100*((energy s u+a^2)*fax s+shower u s)
  nlinarith [mul_nonneg (energy_small h.fit u).1 (fax_floor h).1,shower_nonneg (u:=u) h,sq_nonneg (x-a*y),
    mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg a) (fax_floor h).1]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Beam.Lamp.delayed_cost
statement:
lemma delayed_cost (e : Lamp M) (h : Climb e.site) {q : Scene M} (hq : Climb q)
    (ha : 0 ≤ e.width) (r : Bool) :
    delayed e r q^2 ≤ 100*(lit e e.site+lit e q)
proof:
:= by
  let a := e.width; let W := e.W; let s := e.site; let u := e.u
  let x (s : Scene M) := ∑ z,‖factor s u z‖
  let y := ∑ z, |shell q z|
  have H : |delayed e r q| ≤ x s+x q + a*y := by
    apply le_trans (Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _)
    unfold x y; rw [Finset.mul_sum,← Finset.sum_add_distrib,← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum; intro i _
    apply (glow_limit _ _ _ _ _ _).trans
    rw [norm_scaleC,curl_unit,one_mul,abs_mul,abs_of_nonneg ha]
  have hX₁ : x s^2 ≤ _ := factor_bill _ h u
  have hX₂ : x q^2 ≤ _ := factor_bill _ hq u
  have hY : y^2 ≤ _ := shell_bill _ hq
  have hT : delayed e r q^2 ≤ (x s+x q+a*y)^2 := by
    rw [←sq_abs]; exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) H _
  have hV : (a*y)^2 ≤ a^2*(2*fax q) := by rw [mul_pow]; gcongr
  let A (s : Scene M) := (energy s u+a^2)*fax s+shower u s
  have HI (w : Scene M) (hw : Climb w) : 0 ≤ energy w u*fax w ∧ 0 ≤ a^2*fax w :=
    ⟨mul_nonneg (energy_small hw.fit u).1 (fax_floor hw).1,mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg a) (fax_floor hw).1⟩
  have h1 := HI s h; have h2 := HI q hq
  change _ ≤ 100*((energy s u+a^2)*fax s+shower u s+((energy q u+a^2)*fax q+shower u q))
  nlinarith [shower_nonneg (u:=u) h, shower_nonneg (u:=u) hq,sq_nonneg (x s-x q),sq_nonneg (x q-a*y),sq_nonneg (x s-a*y)]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Lens.stipend
statement:
lemma stipend (g : Lens M) {b : Beat M} (h : Ideal b.pre b.post) (hp : 0 < g.rate) :
    let r
proof:
:= g.rate
    (g.coin b.post)^2/2 ≤
      g.hero (winds b)-g.hero b.pre+30*r*killed b+2000*r*((quest g).pay () b) := by
  intro r
  rw [winds,g.hero_walk]
  let x := g.swing b.post; let l := 2000*r
  have hi : 0 < r := hp
  have hh : 0 < l := by unfold l; positivity
  have hD := coin_flow g hp.le h.climb
  have hF := swing_flow g hp.le h.climb
  change x^2 ≤ 900*r*_ at hF
  have hx : l* (g.quest.pay () b) = -curl b.bit*x - x^2/(2*l) := by
    change l* (curl b.bit*(-x/l)-(-x/l)^2/2)=_
    field_simp
  have hE : x^2/(2*l) ≤ g.flow b.post/2 := by
    apply (div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)).mpr
    have HG : 0 ≤ g.flow b.post := le_trans (sq_nonneg _) hD.1
    unfold l
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg hi.le HG]
  have HW := (abs_le.mp (hero_drain g hi.le h)).2
  change _ ≤ _+curl b.bit*x - g.hero b.pre + 30*r*killed b + l*_
  rw [hx]; change _ ≤ 30*r *_ at HW
  linarith [hD.1]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Lens.dusk_tally
statement:
lemma dusk_tally (g : Lens M) {x : Grid M} {l : Path M} (h : Trip x s l) (hp : 0 < g.rate) :
    g.dusk l /2 ≤ 120*g.rate-g.hero s+30*g.rate*fullKills l + 2000*g.rate*(g.quest.tally () l)
proof:
:= by
  induction l generalizing s with
  | nil =>
    have H := (g.hero_limit hp.le (trip_head h).1).2
    change 0/2 ≤ _-hero g s+_*0+_*0; linarith
  | cons b l ih =>
    obtain ⟨rfl,ha,hb⟩ := h
    have hh := ih hb
    have hi := stipend g ha hp
    change _ ≤ _-g.hero b.pre+_+_ at hi
    change ((g.coin b.post)^2+g.dusk l)/2 ≤ _+ _*(killed b+fullKills l)+_*(g.quest.pay () b+g.quest.tally () l)
    linarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Lens.last_lag
statement:
lemma last_lag (g : Lens M) {x : Grid M} {l : Path M} (h : Trip x s l)
    (hp : 0 < g.rate) (c : ℝ) :
    let a
proof:
:= g.ease
    enters c l + part g.face (subtotal (frosty x g.focus g.rate) l) ≤
      a*(g.shifted.tally c l)+(g.dusk l+c^2)/(2*a)+10*g.rate := by
  intro a
  have he : 0 < a := Real.sqrt_pos.2 hp
  induction l generalizing s c with
  | nil =>
    change 0+part g.face 0 ≤ _*0 + (0+c^2)/(2*a)+10*g.rate
    rw [part_zero]; have hh : 0 ≤ (0+c^2)/(2*a) := by positivity
    linarith
  | cons b l ih =>
    let k := g.coin b.post; let t := curl b.bit*k
    have HE : a*g.shifted.pay c b = curl b.bit*c-c^2/(2*a) := by
      change a*((curl _)*(c/a)-(c/a)^2/2)=_
      field_simp
    rw [subtotal_cons,part_add]
    rw [frosty,part_mul]
    rw [Desk.tally,mul_add,HE]
    let A := frosty x g.focus g.rate
    change curl b.bit*c+(blow x b*k+part g.face (subtotal A l)) ≤
      curl b.bit*c-c^2/(2*a)+a*g.shifted.tally t l +(k^2+g.dusk l+c^2)/(2*a)+10*g.rate
    rw [add_div]
    cases l with
    | nil =>
      have hi : |blow x b*k| ≤ 10*g.rate := by
        rw [abs_mul,trip_final h,one_mul]; exact (part_bounded _ _).trans (prize_norm hp.le _ _)
      have hh : 0 ≤ (k^2+0)/(2*a) := by positivity
      rw [subtotal_nil,part_zero,tally]
      rw [show g.dusk []=0 from rfl]
      linarith [(abs_le.mp hi).2]
    | cons d l =>
      have hh := ih h.2.2 t
      have hH : enters t (d::l)=blow x b*k := by rw [trip_delay h]; unfold enters t; ring
      have hE : t^2=k^2 := by unfold t; rw [mul_pow,curl_sq,one_mul]
      rw [hH,hE,add_comm (g.dusk _)] at hh; change _+part g.face (subtotal A _) ≤ _ at hh
      linarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Lens.face_fire
statement:
lemma face_fire (g : Lens M) {x : Grid M} (l m : Path M) (h : Trip x s l)
    (hp : 0 < g.rate) (he : g.rate ≤ 1) (t : ℝ)
    (ht : 0 ≤ t)
    (h1 : 2*log (g.quest.heatW () (l++m)) ≤ t) (h2 : 2*log (g.shifted.heatW 0 (l++m)) ≤ t) :
    part g.face (subtotal (frosty x g.focus g.rate) l) ≤ 3000*g.ease*(1+fullKills l+t)
proof:
:= by
  let r := g.rate; let a := g.ease; let K := fullKills l
  let V := g.dusk l
  have HI := last_lag g h hp 0
  have h3 : 0 < a := Real.sqrt_pos.2 hp
  have h4 : a^2=r := Real.sq_sqrt hp.le
  change r ≤ _ at he
  change _ ≤ a*_+(V+0^2)/(2*a)+10*r at HI
  have hx := (g.quest.edge_score () l m).trans h1
  have hx' := (g.shifted.edge_score 0 l m).trans h2
  rw [show enters 0 l=0 by cases l <;> simp [enters]] at HI
  have HH := dusk_tally g h hp
  have hw := g.hero_limit hp.le (trip_head h).1
  have HS : V/(2*a) ≤ a*(120+30*K+2000*t) := by
    apply (div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)).mpr
    have HB : a*(120+30*K+2000*t)*(2*a) = 2*r*(120+30*K+2000*t) := by rw [← h4]; ring
    rw [HB]
    change V/2 ≤ 120*r-hero g s+30*r*K+2000*r*_ at HH
    change 0 < r at hp
    nlinarith [hw.1]
  have h6 : a ≤ 1 := by nlinarith
  have h8 : r ≤ a := by nlinarith
  have HQ : 0 ≤ K := trip_K h
  change _ ≤ 3000*a*(1+K+t)
  rw [show V+0^2=V by ring] at HI
  nlinarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.cold_share
statement:
private lemma cold_share (u : Grid M) (b : ℝ) (l : Path M) (d : Face) :
    let g
proof:
:= Lens.mk u b d; g.quest.heatW () l + g.shifted.heatW 0 l ≤ coldScore u b l := by
  intro g
  unfold coldScore
  rw [add_comm (1:ℝ)]
  apply le_trans _ (le_add_of_nonneg_right (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) ≤ 1))
  apply Finset.single_le_sum (f:=fun d : Face => (Lens.mk u b d).quest.heatW () l+
    (Lens.mk u b d).shifted.heatW 0 l) _ (Finset.mem_univ d)
  intro x hx; apply add_nonneg
  · linarith [(Lens.mk u b x).quest.heatW_one () l]
  · linarith [(Lens.mk u b x).shifted.heatW_one 0 l]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.cold_one
statement: lemma cold_one (u : Grid M) (b : ℝ) (l : Path M) : 1 ≤ coldScore u b l
proof:
:= by
  let g := Lens.mk u b (false,false)
  have H := cold_share u b l (false,false)
  change g.quest.heatW () l + g.shifted.heatW 0 l ≤ _ at H
  linarith [g.shifted.heatW_one 0 l,g.quest.heatW_one () l]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.cold_mean
statement:
lemma cold_mean (u : Grid M) (b : ℝ) (t : Thread M s) (h : t.Following j J f) :
    (s.here.dice M).Ex (fun x => coldScore u b (t.stream x)) ≤ 20
proof:
:= by
  unfold coldScore; rw [Ex_add _ (f:=fun _ => _),Ex_const,Ex_finset_sum]
  let U (d : Face) := Lens.mk u b d
  let P := s.here.dice M
  let F (d) := P.Ex fun x => (U d).quest.heatW () (t.stream x)+(U d).shifted.heatW 0 (t.stream x)
  change 1+∑ d,F d ≤ _
  have H (d) : F d ≤ 4 := by
    unfold F; rw [Ex_add]
    have HH : P.Ex (fun x => (U d).quest.heatW () (t.stream x)) ≤ 2 :=
      heat_bound _ t h _
    have HI : P.Ex (fun x => (U d).shifted.heatW 0 (t.stream x)) ≤ 2 :=
      heat_bound _ t h _
    linarith
  have HH : ∑ d,F d ≤ ∑ _d : Face,(4:ℝ) := Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => H i
  norm_num [Face] at HH
  linarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.fire_pref
proof:
:= by
  let v := subtotal (frosty x u b) l; let a := 3000*√b*(1+fullKills l+t)
  let score := coldScore u b (l++m)
  have H (d : Face) : part d v ≤ a := by
    let g := Lens.mk u b d
    have h1 : 1 ≤ g.shifted.heatW 0 (l++m) := heatW_one _ _ _
    have h2 : 1 ≤ g.quest.heatW () (l++m) := heatW_one _ _ _
    have h3 : g.quest.heatW () (l++m) + g.shifted.heatW 0 (l++m) ≤ score := cold_share _ _ _ d
    have H (x : ℝ) (h : 1 ≤ x) (hh : x ≤ score) : 2*log x ≤ t :=
      le_trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (log_le_log (by linarith) hh) (by norm_num)) ht
    apply g.face_fire l m h hb hi
    · exact le_trans (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (log_nonneg (cold_one _ _ _))) ht
    · exact H _ h2 (by linarith)
    · exact H _ h1 (by linarith)
  have h1 : |v.re| ≤ a := by
    rw [abs_le]
    have He := H (false,true); have Hf := H (false,false); simp only [part,curl,↓reduceIte,
      Bool.false_eq_true,neg_mul,one_mul] at He Hf
    constructor <;> linarith
  have h2 : |v.im| ≤ a := by
    rw [abs_le]
    have He := H (true,true); have Hf := H (true,false); simp only [part,curl,↓reduceIte,
      Bool.false_eq_true,neg_mul,one_mul] at He Hf
    constructor <;> linarith
  change ‖v‖ ≤ _
  unfold a at *; linarith [Complex.norm_le_abs_re_add_abs_im v]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.frosty_portion
statement:
lemma frosty_portion {x : Grid M} (u : Grid M) {b : ℝ} (hb : 0 < b) (hi : b ≤ 1)
    (l r m : Path M) (h : Trip x s (l++r++m)) (t : ℝ)
    (ht : 2*log (coldScore u b (l++r++m)) ≤ t) :
    ‖subtotal (frosty x u b) r‖ ≤ 12000*√b*(1+fullKills (l++r++m)+t)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ha,w,hc⟩ := trip_cut h
  obtain ⟨hd,v,he⟩ := trip_cut ha
  have H := fire_pref u hb hi _ _ ha t ht
  rw [List.append_assoc] at ht
  have HE := fire_pref u hb hi _ _ hd t ht
  let F := frosty x u b
  rw [show subtotal (frosty x u b) r=subtotal F (l++r)-subtotal F l by rw [subtotal_app]; abel]
  apply (norm_sub_le _ _).trans
  have HH : fullKills (l++r++m)=fullKills l+fullKills r+fullKills m := by simp [fullKills,subtotal_app,add_assoc]
  have HI : fullKills (l++r)=fullKills l+fullKills r := by simp [fullKills,subtotal_app]
  rw [HH]; rw [HI] at H; unfold F
  nlinarith [trip_K hc,trip_K he,sqrt_pos.2 hb]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.sky_variance
statement:
lemma sky_variance (s : Scene M) (h : Climb s) (u : Grid M) (L : ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ b, energy (s.smaller b) u ≤ L) :
    gust s u^2 ≤ 100*L*(fax s+shower u s)
proof:
:= by
  let v := meanV s u; let n := nub s u
  let m := matter s; let g := shell s
  let d := fun i z => mist u s (s.smaller i) z
  let G := energy s u; let J := fax s; let V := shower u s
  let A (z) := g z*‖v z‖^2; let B (z) := duet (v z) (n z)
  let D (i : Bool) := ∑ z, d i z
  have H (b : Bool) :
      energy (s.smaller b) u=G+curl b*((∑ z,A z)+2*∑ z,B z)+D b := by
    unfold D G
    rw [sun_energy (h.child b),sun_energy h.fit]
    simp_rw [sun_shift h,Finset.sum_add_distrib, mul_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib,Finset.mul_sum]
    exact le_antisymm le_rfl le_rfl
  have hm := matter_nonneg h.fit
  have hA : (∑ z,A z)^2 ≤ G*J := by
    unfold G J fax
    rw [sun_energy h.fit]
    refine Finset.sum_sq_le_sum_mul_sum_of_sq_le_mul Finset.univ
      (fun i _ => (sun_rays h.fit _ _).1)
      (fun i _ => pierce_nonneg h.fit i) (fun i _ => ?_)
    change (shell s i*‖v i‖^2)^2 ≤ (m i*‖v i‖^2)*pierce s i
    rw [mul_pow,shell_sq h i]
    have hN : ‖v i‖^2 ≤ 1 := pow_le_one₀ (norm_nonneg _) (mean_hold s h.fit _ _).2
    change (m i * _) * _ ≤ _
    rw [pow_two (‖v i‖^2)]
    have HE : 0 ≤ (m i*pierce s i)*‖v i‖^2 :=
      mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (hm _) (pierce_nonneg h.fit i)) (sq_nonneg _)
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hN HE]
  have hB : (∑ z,B z)^2 ≤ G*(4*V) := by
    unfold V shower G
    rw [sun_energy h.fit, Finset.mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_sq_le_sum_mul_sum_of_sq_le_mul Finset.univ
      (fun i _ => (sun_rays h.fit _ _).1)
      (fun i _ => mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (dew_nonneg _ h _)) (fun i _ => ?_)
    have Hq := nub_innovation s h u i
    have HE : (B i)^2 ≤ (‖v i‖ * ‖n i‖)^2 := by
      rw [←sq_abs]; exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) (duet_limit _ _) _
    rw [mul_pow] at HE
    change _ ≤ m i*‖v i‖^2 * _
    change ‖n i‖^2 ≤ 4*m i*_ at Hq
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left Hq (sq_nonneg ‖v i‖)]
  let R := (D false-D true)/2
  have hD : V=(D false+D true)/2 := by
    unfold V D shower dew; rw [← Finset.sum_div,Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  have hH : |R| ≤ V := by
    have HH (i) : 0 ≤ D i := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun _ _ => mist_nonneg u s _ (h.child i) _)
    rw [abs_le,hD]; unfold R; constructor <;> linarith [HH false,HH true]
  have hL₁ := (energy_small h.fit u).1
  have hL₂ : 0 ≤ V := shower_nonneg h
  have hF : 0 ≤ J := (fax_floor h).1
  have hQ : G+V ≤ L := by rw [show G+V=_ from (wet_average s h u).symm]; linarith [hp false,hp true]
  have hr : R^2 ≤ V*L := by
    change 0 ≤ G at hL₁
    have HH := abs_le.mp hH
    nlinarith
  rw [gust,H false,H true]
  simp only [curl,Bool.false_eq_true,↓reduceIte,neg_mul,one_mul]
  let a := ∑ z,A z; let b := ∑ z,B z
  change ((G+(a+2*b)+D false-(G+ -(a+2*b)+D true))/2)^2 ≤ 100*L*(J+V)
  rw [show (G+(a+2*b)+D false-(G+ -(a+2*b)+D true))/2=a+2*b+R by unfold R; ring]
  change a^2 ≤ _ at hA; change b^2 ≤ _ at hB
  have hG : 0 ≤ G := hL₁
  have hT : (a+2*b+R)^2 ≤ 3*(a^2+(2*b)^2+R^2) := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (a-2*b),sq_nonneg (2*b-R),sq_nonneg (a-R)]
  nlinarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.factor_bill
statement:
lemma factor_bill (s : Scene M) (h : Climb s) (u : Grid M) :
    (∑ z : Grid M, ‖factor s u z‖)^2 ≤
      16*(energy s u* fax s + shower u s)
proof:
:= by
  let n := nub s u; let v := meanV s u; let m := matter s; let g := shell s
  let G := energy s u; let J := fax s; let V := shower u s
  let f (z : Grid M) := |g z| * ‖v z‖; let k (z : Grid M) := ‖n z‖
  have hm := matter_nonneg h.fit
  have H (z : Grid M) : ‖factor s u z‖ ≤ f z+k z := by
    rw [show factor s u z=(↑(g z):ℂ)*v z+n z by unfold n v g nub; ring]
    apply (norm_add_le _ _).trans; rw [norm_scaleC]
  have hF : (∑ z,f z)^2 ≤ G*J := by
    unfold G J fax; rw [sun_energy h.fit]
    apply Finset.sum_sq_le_sum_mul_sum_of_sq_le_mul _
      (fun i _ => (sun_rays h.fit _ _).1) (fun i _ => pierce_nonneg h.fit _) (fun i _ => ?_)
    change (|shell s i| * ‖v i‖)^2 ≤ matter s i* ‖v i‖^2 * pierce s i
    rw [mul_pow,sq_abs,shell_sq h]
    exact le_of_eq (by ring)
  have hK : (∑ z,k z)^2 ≤ 2*(4*V) := by
    apply le_trans (b:=share s*(4*V))
    · rw [← matter_sum h.fit]
      unfold V shower; rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      apply Finset.sum_sq_le_sum_mul_sum_of_sq_le_mul _ (fun i _ => hm i)
        (fun i _ => mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (dew_nonneg _ h _)) (fun i _ => ?_)
      have Hh := nub_innovation _ h u i; change ‖nub s u i‖^2 ≤ _
      linarith
    · exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h.tight (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (shower_nonneg h))
  let a := ∑ z,f z; let b := ∑ z,k z; let c := ∑ z,‖factor s u z‖
  have he : c ≤ a+b := by unfold c a b; rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]; exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => H i
  have hc : 0 ≤ c := Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => norm_nonneg _
  change a^2 ≤ _ at hF; change b^2 ≤ _ at hK; change c^2 ≤ 16*(G*J+V)
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg (a-b)]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.shell_bill
statement:
lemma shell_bill (s : Scene M) (h : Climb s) :
    (∑ z,|shell s z|)^2 ≤ 2*fax s
proof:
:= by
  apply le_trans (b:=share s*fax s)
  · rw [←matter_sum h.fit]
    apply Finset.sum_sq_le_sum_mul_sum_of_sq_le_mul _ (fun i _ => matter_nonneg h.fit i)
      (fun i _ => pierce_nonneg h.fit i) (fun i _ => ?_)
    rw [sq_abs,shell_sq h]
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h.tight (fax_floor h).1

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Troupe.stream_cast
statement:
lemma stream_cast {s : Scene M} (v : Thread M s) (h : Following j J f v)
    (x : Grid M) : Cast j J f s (v.stream x)
proof:
:= by
  induction v with
  | blank => exact h
  | ran s q k ih =>
    let b := (step q).bit x
    exact ⟨rfl,⟨k,h⟩,ih b (h.2.2.2.2.2 b)⟩

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Troupe.quarrel_chart
statement:
lemma quarrel_chart (p : Plot) (c : Board M) (l : Path M) :
    (quarrel p c l).chart = goal p.ix p.main c.chart l
proof:
:= by
  induction l generalizing c with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons b l ih => exact ih _

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Troupe.quarrel_concat
statement:
lemma quarrel_concat (p : Plot) (c : Board M) (l r : Path M) :
    quarrel p c (l++r)=quarrel p (quarrel p c l) r
proof:
:= by
  induction l generalizing c with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons b l ih => exact ih _

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Troupe.oil_hero
statement:
lemma oil_hero (g : Grade) (l : Path M) :
    oiled (heroPlot g l) (vacant M) l
proof:
:= by
  unfold oiled cardStep; rw [quarrel_chart]; exact (choice_bounds g l).2.1

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Troupe.still_head
statement:
lemma still_head {s : Scene M} (l : Path M) (h : Cast j J f s l)
    (p : Plot) (c : Board M) (he : Comes c s j J f) :
    c.chart.items ⊆ (quarrel p c l).chart.items
proof:
:= by
  induction l generalizing s c with
  | nil => exact Finset.Subset.refl _
  | cons b l ih =>
    obtain ⟨rfl,⟨k,hk⟩,ht⟩ := h
    apply Finset.Subset.trans _ (ih ht (turn p c b.post) (comes_down p hk he b.bit))
    exact (zoom_spec _ he.valid p.ix p.main hk).extend

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Troupe.oily_cons
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨rfl,⟨k,hk⟩,he⟩ := h
  have hi := comes_down p hk ht b.bit
  exact ⟨le_trans (Finset.card_le_card (still_head l he p _ hi)) hv,hv,hi⟩

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Troupe.birth_just
statement:
lemma birth_just (p : Plot) (c : Board M) (s : Scene M) {b : Beat M} (l r : Path M)
    (h : Cast j J f s (l++b::r))
    (ht : Comes c s j J f) (hv : oiled p c (l++b::r)) :
    Comes (quarrel p c l) b.pre j J f ∧
      (∃ k, Following j J f (ran b.pre b.post k)) ∧ boom p (quarrel p c l) b.post
proof:
:= by
  induction l generalizing s c with
  | nil =>
    exact ⟨h.1.symm ▸ ht,h.2.1,(oily_cons p h ht hv).1⟩
  | cons a l ih =>
    have H := (oily_cons p h ht hv)
    exact ih (turn p c a.post) _ h.2.2 H.2.2 H.2.1

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Troupe.still_rec
statement:
lemma still_rec {s : Scene M} (p : Plot) {c : Board M} (b : Beat M)
    (l m : Path M) (h : Cast j J f s (l++b::m)) (he : Comes c s j J f)
    (hv : oiled p c (l++b::m)) (q : Scene M)
    (hh : (turn p (quarrel p c l) b.post).previous=some q)
    (x : Grid M) (hx : x∈net q j p.ix p.main) :
    c.previous=some q ∨ ∃ u w : Path M, l=u++w ∧
      recital (grade p) x (w++(b::m)) ≤ showScore p c j (l++b::m)
proof:
:= by


  induction l generalizing s c with
  | nil =>
    have H := oily_cons p h he hv
    change (turn p c b.post).previous=some q at hh
    rw [prior_step _ _ _ H.1] at hh
    by_cases hi : p.freshAt c b.post
    · rw [ite_eq_left hi] at hh
      cases Option.some.inj hh
      refine Or.inr ⟨[],[],rfl,?_⟩
      change recital _ _ (b::m) ≤ _
      simp only [List.nil_append,showScore,ite_eq_left H.1,ite_eq_left hi]
      apply le_trans (b:=burst p b.post j (b::m))
      · exact Finset.single_le_sum (f:=fun x => recital (grade p) x (b::m))
          (fun x _ => le_trans (by norm_num) (rec_one _ _ _)) hx
      linarith [show_one p (turn p c b.post) j m]
    · exact Or.inl ((ite_eq_right hi).symm.trans hh)
  | cons a l ih =>
    let d := turn p c a.post
    have H := oily_cons p h he hv
    have HE : Cast j J f (winds a) (l++b::m) := h.2.2
    rcases ih (c:=d) HE H.2.2 H.2.1 hh with hv|⟨u,w,hw,hv⟩
    · unfold d at hv; rw [prior_step p c a.post H.1] at hv
      by_cases hi : freshAt p c a.post
      · rw [ite_eq_left hi] at hv
        cases Option.some.inj hv
        refine Or.inr ⟨[],a::l,rfl,?_⟩
        let r := a::(l++b::m)
        change recital _ _ r ≤ showScore _ _ _ (a::(l++b::m))
        simp only [showScore,ite_eq_left H.1,ite_eq_left hi]
        apply le_trans (b:=burst p a.post j r)
        · exact Finset.single_le_sum (f:=fun x => recital (grade p) x r)
            (fun x _ => le_trans (by norm_num) (rec_one _ _ _)) hx
        linarith [show_one p (turn p c a.post) j (l++b::m)]
      · exact Or.inl ((ite_eq_right hi).symm.trans hv)
    · apply Or.inr; refine ⟨a::u,w,by rw [hw]; rfl,?_⟩
      change _ ≤ showScore p c j (a::(l++b::m))
      rw [showScore,ite_eq_left H.1]; apply hv.trans
      apply le_add_of_nonneg_left; split; apply burst_pos; norm_num

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Troupe.live_rec
statement:
lemma live_rec :
    ∀ᶠ j : ℕ in atTop, ∀ M J : ℕ, ∀ s : Scene M, ∀ f : Grid M → ℝ,
      ∀ (u : Grid M) (g : Grade) (l r : Path M) (b : Beat M),
        let L
proof:
:= l++b::r
        let p := heroPlot g L
        Cast j J f s L → entitled g s j → ringing u p j l b →
        ∃ x : Grid M, p.aligned b.post j u x ∧ ∃ a k : Path M, l=a++k ∧
          2*log (recital g x (k++b::r)) ≤ timex g j L := by
  filter_upwards [currently] with j h M J s f u g l r b L p hC hE hp
  let c := vacant M
  have HC := vacant_comes (j:=j) (J:=J) (f:=f) s
  have He := oil_hero g L
  obtain ⟨ha,⟨k,hk⟩,hK⟩ := birth_just p c s l r hC HC He
  obtain ⟨q,H,hQ,w,hw,hW⟩ := h p (fun hx => (hE hx).1) M J f b.pre b.post k hk _ ha hK u hp
  refine ⟨w,hW,?_⟩
  rcases still_rec p b l r hC HC He q H w hw with h1|⟨v,z,hz,ht⟩
  · cases h1
  refine ⟨v,z,hz,?_⟩
  apply le_trans _ (timex_scores g j L).2
  apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (by norm_num)
  exact log_le_log (lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) (rec_one g _ _)) ht

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.matter_nonneg
statement: lemma matter_nonneg {s : Scene M} (h : Fit s) (z) : 0 ≤ matter s z
proof:
:=
    nonnegative_hist s h.ready.2 h.pos.le _ _

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.matter_sum
statement: lemma matter_sum {s : Scene M} (h : Fit s) : ∑ z, matter s z=share s
proof:
:=
    total_hist _ h.ready.1 _

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.matter_norm
statement: lemma matter_norm {s : Scene M} (h : Fit s) (u z) : ‖letter s u z‖ ≤ matter s z
proof:
:=
    fz_norm _ h.ready.2 h.pos.le _ _ _

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.scalar_label
statement: lemma scalar_label (s : Scene M) (u : Grid M) : scalar s u=∑ z, letter s u z
proof:
:=
    scalar_series s _ u

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.scalar_norm
statement: lemma scalar_norm {s : Scene M} (h : Fit s) (u) : ‖scalar s u‖ ≤ share s
proof:
:= by
  rw [scalar_label, ← matter_sum h]
  exact (norm_sum_le _ _).trans (Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => matter_norm h u i)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.matter_split
statement:
lemma matter_split {s : Scene M} (h : Climb s) (z : Grid M) :
    matter (s.smaller false) z+matter (s.smaller true) z=2*matter s z
proof:
:=
    hist_split s h.fit.ready.1.1 h.deep _ _

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.letter_split
statement:
lemma letter_split {s : Scene M} (h : Climb s) (u z : Grid M) :
    letter (s.smaller false) u z+letter (s.smaller true) u z=2*letter s u z
proof:
:=
    fz_split s h.fit.ready.1.1 h.deep _ _ _

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.scalar_split'
statement:
lemma scalar_split' {s : Scene M} (h : Climb s) (u) :
    scalar (s.smaller false) u+scalar (s.smaller true) u=2*scalar s u
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [scalar_label,←Finset.sum_add_distrib,Finset.mul_sum,letter_split h]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.matter_jump
statement:
lemma matter_jump {s : Scene M} (h : Climb s) (b) (z) :
    matter (s.smaller b) z=matter s z+curl b* shell s z
proof:
:= by
  have hi := matter_split h z
  have H : shell s z=(matter (s.smaller false) z-matter (s.smaller true) z)/2 := rfl
  cases b <;> simp [H,curl] <;> linarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.symmetric_curl
proof:
:= by
  rw [show a=(f false+f true)/2 by rw [h]; ring]
  cases b <;> simp only [curl,Bool.false_eq_true,↓reduceIte]
  all_goals push_cast; ring

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.letter_jump
statement:
lemma letter_jump {s : Scene M} (h : Climb s) (b) (u z : Grid M) :
    letter (s.smaller b) u z=letter s u z+(curl b:ℂ)*factor s u z
proof:
:=
    symmetric_curl (fun b => letter (s.smaller b) u z) _ (letter_split h u z) _

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.scalar_jump
statement:
lemma scalar_jump {s : Scene M} (h : Climb s) (b u) :
    scalar (s.smaller b) u=scalar s u+(curl b:ℂ)*gain s u
proof:
:=
    symmetric_curl (fun b => scalar (s.smaller b) u) _ (scalar_split' h u) _

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.matter_drain
statement:
lemma matter_drain {s q : Scene M} (hh : Ideal s q) (u z : Grid M) :
    ‖letter s u z-letter q u z‖ ≤ matter s z-matter q z
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold matter hist letter fz
  unfold omegaObs dye wt
  rw [hh.lower.here,hh.lower.flat,hh.lower.fund,← Finset.sum_sub_distrib,← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  apply le_trans (norm_sum_le _ _)
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum; intro i _
  rw [← sub_mul,← Complex.ofReal_sub,norm_mul,Complex.norm_real,Real.norm_eq_abs,norm_chi,mul_one]
  refine le_of_eq (abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr ?_))
  apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ ((channel _ _).nonneg _)
  apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_right _ hh.fit.pos.le
  apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hh.lower.antitone hh.fit.ready.2 i) ((s.here.dice M).nonneg _)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.scalar_drain
statement:
lemma scalar_drain {b : Beat M} (h : Ideal b.pre b.post) (u) :
    ‖scalar b.pre u-scalar b.post u‖ ≤ killed b
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [scalar_label]
  rw [h.kill_eq,← matter_sum h.fit,← matter_sum h.climb.fit,← Finset.sum_sub_distrib,← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  exact (norm_sum_le _ _).trans (Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => matter_drain h u i)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.shell_abs
statement:
lemma shell_abs {s : Scene M} (h : Climb s) (z) :
    |shell s z| ≤ matter s z
proof:
:= by
  have H (b) := matter_nonneg (h.child b) z
  simp_rw [matter_jump h] at H
  rw [abs_le]
  constructor <;> linarith [show 0 ≤ matter s z+1*shell s z from H false,
    show 0 ≤ matter s z+-1*shell s z from H true]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.norm_halfcomplex
statement:
lemma norm_halfcomplex (x y : ℂ) :
    ‖(x-y)/2‖ ≤ (‖x‖+‖y‖)/2
proof:
:= by
  rw [norm_div]; norm_num; gcongr; exact norm_sub_le x y

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.factor_norm
statement:
lemma factor_norm {s : Scene M} (h : Climb s) (u z : Grid M) :
    ‖factor s u z‖ ≤ matter s z
proof:
:= by
  have H (b) := matter_norm (h.child b) u z
  apply (norm_halfcomplex _ _).trans
  linarith [matter_split h z,H true,H false]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.fax_floor
statement: lemma fax_floor {s : Scene M} (h : Climb s) : 0 ≤ fax s ∧ fax s ≤ 2

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.trip_fax
statement: lemma trip_fax {x : Grid M} {l : Path M} (h : Trip x s l) : 0 ≤ fullFax l
proof:
:=
    trip_nonneg h (fun _ hh => (fax_floor hh.climb).1)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.gain_series
statement: lemma gain_series (u : Grid M) (s : Scene M) : gain s u = ∑ z, factor s u z
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [gain,factor, ← Finset.sum_div, Finset.sum_sub_distrib,scalar_label]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.gain_norm
statement: lemma gain_norm {s : Scene M} (h : Climb s) (u : Grid M) : ‖gain s u‖ ≤ share s
proof:
:= by
  rw [gain_series,← matter_sum h.fit]
  exact (norm_sum_le _ _).trans (Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => factor_norm h u i)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Beam.content_pos
statement: lemma content_pos (v w : ℂ) (x : ℝ) : 0 ≤ content v w x
proof: := by unfold content; positivity

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Beam.ray_pos
statement: lemma ray_pos (v w : ℂ) (x : ℝ) : 0 ≤ ray v w x
proof: := sqrt_nonneg _

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Beam.ray_sq
statement: lemma ray_sq (v w : ℂ) (x : ℝ) : ray v w x^2=content v w x
proof:
:=
    Real.sq_sqrt (content_pos _ _ _)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Beam.ray_bounds
statement: lemma ray_bounds (v w : ℂ) (x : ℝ) : let r
proof:
:= ray v w x
    ‖v‖ ≤ r ∧ ‖w‖ ≤ r ∧ |x| ≤ r ∧ r ≤ ‖v‖+‖w‖+|x| := by
  intro r
  have hr : 0 ≤ r := ray_pos _ _ _
  have HH : r^2=‖v‖^2+‖w‖^2+x^2 := ray_sq _ _ _
  have hv := norm_nonneg v; have hw := norm_nonneg w; have hx := abs_nonneg x
  refine ⟨?_,?_,?_,?_⟩ <;> nlinarith [sq_abs x]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Beam.glow_add
statement:
lemma glow_add (v w : ℂ) (x : ℝ) (a b c d : ℂ) (h k : ℝ) :
    glow v w x (a+c) (b+d) (h+k)=glow v w x a b h+glow v w x c d k
proof:
:= by
  rw [glow,glow,glow,duet_add,duet_add]; ring

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Beam.glow_scale
statement:
lemma glow_scale (v w : ℂ) (x y h : ℝ) (a b : ℂ) :
    glow v w x ((y:ℂ)*a) ((y:ℂ)*b) (y*h)=y*glow v w x a b h
proof:
:= by
  rw [glow,glow,duet_scale,duet_scale]; ring

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Beam.glow_limit
statement:
lemma glow_limit (v w : ℂ) (x : ℝ) (a b : ℂ) (t : ℝ) :
    |glow v w x a b t| ≤ ‖a‖+‖b‖+|t|
proof:
:= by
  let r := ray v w x
  have H := ray_bounds v w x
  have hr : 0 ≤ r := ray_pos v w x
  unfold glow
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hr with h|h
  · change |_/r| ≤ _
    rw [←h,div_zero,abs_zero]; positivity
  change |_/r| ≤ _
  rw [abs_div,abs_of_nonneg hr]
  apply (div_le_iff₀ h).mpr
  have he := abs_add_le (duet v a+duet w b) (x*t)
  have hi := abs_add_le (duet v a) (duet w b)
  rw [abs_mul] at he
  change ‖v‖ ≤ r ∧ _ at H
  have h1 : ‖v‖ ≤ r := H.1
  have h2 : ‖w‖ ≤ r := H.2.1
  have h3 : |x| ≤ r := H.2.2.1
  nlinarith [norm_nonneg a,norm_nonneg b,abs_nonneg t,duet_limit v a,duet_limit w b]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Beam.ray_shift
statement:
lemma ray_shift (v w a b : ℂ) (x t : ℝ) (C : ℝ) (hc : 0 ≤ C)
    (h : content a b t ≤ ray v w x*C) :
    ray (v+a) (w+b) (x+t) ≤ ray v w x+glow v w x a b t+C
proof:
:= by
  let r := ray v w x; let d := glow v w x a b t
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le (show 0 ≤ r from ray_pos _ _ _) with he|he
  · have hh : content a b t ≤ 0 := by change _ ≤ r*C at h; rwa [←he,zero_mul] at h
    unfold content at hh
    have hA : a=0 := norm_le_zero_iff.mp (by nlinarith)
    have hB : b=0 := norm_le_zero_iff.mp (by nlinarith)
    have hT : t=0 := by nlinarith
    simp [hA,hB,hT,glow,duet_zero,hc]
  · let R := ray (v+a) (w+b) (x+t)
    have hH : R^2=r^2+2*r*d+content a b t := by
      have H : r*d=duet v a+duet w b+x*t := by
        unfold d glow; change r*(_/r)=_
        field_simp
      rw [show 2*r*d=2*(r*d) by ring,H]
      unfold R r
      rw [ray_sq,ray_sq,content,content,content,duet_inc,duet_inc]
      ring
    change R ≤ r+d+C
    change _ ≤ r*C at h
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (R-r)]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Beam.ray_slide
statement:
lemma ray_slide (v w : ℂ) (x : ℝ) (a : ℂ) (t : ℝ) :
    ray v (w+a) (x+t) ≤ ray v w x + ‖a‖ + |t|
proof:
:= by
  let r := ray v w x; let d := ray v (w+a) (x+t)
  have H := ray_bounds v w x
  have hR : r^2 = ‖v‖^2+‖w‖^2+x^2 := ray_sq _ _ _
  have hr : 0 ≤ r := ray_pos _ _ _
  have hd : d^2=‖v‖^2+‖w+a‖^2+(x+t)^2 := ray_sq _ _ _
  have hi : ‖w‖ ≤ r := H.2.1
  have Hq : |x| ≤ r := H.2.2.1
  change d ≤ _
  have HH : ‖w+a‖^2 ≤ (‖w‖+‖a‖)^2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) (norm_add_le w a) _
  have Ht : x*t ≤ r*|t| := (le_abs_self _).trans
    (by rw [abs_mul]; exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right Hq (abs_nonneg t))
  change d ≤ r+_
    + |t|
  nlinarith [sq_abs t,norm_nonneg a,abs_nonneg t]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Beam.yield_step
statement:
lemma yield_step (s : Scene M) (u : Grid M) (W : Paths.Vector M) (a : ℝ) :
    yieldW W ≤ watt s u W a
proof: := Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => (ray_bounds (W i) _ _).1

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Beam.watt_idle
statement:
lemma watt_idle {s : Scene M} (h : Fit s) (u : Grid M) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hx : a ≤ 1) :
    watt s u 0 a ≤ 8
proof:
:= by
  apply le_trans (b:=∑ i,2*matter s i)
  · apply Finset.sum_le_sum; intro i _
    change ray 0 _ _ ≤ _
    apply le_trans (ray_bounds _ _ _).2.2.2
    have HM := matter_norm h u i; have hM := matter_nonneg h i
    rw [abs_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg ha hM),norm_zero]
    nlinarith
  rw [←Finset.mul_sum,matter_sum h]
  linarith [h.lift]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Beam.watt_slide
statement:
lemma watt_slide {b : Beat M} (h : Ideal b.pre b.post) (u : Grid M) (W : Paths.Vector M) (a : ℝ)
    (ha : 0 ≤ a) (he : a ≤ 1) :
    watt b.post u W a ≤ watt b.pre u W a + 2*killed b
proof:
:= by
  let f := letter b.pre u; let g := letter b.post u
  let p := matter b.pre; let q := matter b.post
  rw [h.kill_eq,←matter_sum h.fit,←matter_sum h.climb.fit,← Finset.sum_sub_distrib,
    Finset.mul_sum,watt,watt,← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum; intro i _
  change ray (W i) (g i) (a*q i) ≤ ray (W i) (f i) (a*p i)+_
  conv_lhs =>
    rw [show g i=f i+(g i-f i) by ring,show a*q i=a*p i+a*(q i-p i) by ring]
  apply le_trans (ray_slide (W i) _ _ _ _)
  have H : ‖f i-g i‖ ≤ p i-q i := matter_drain h u i
  have HH := (norm_nonneg _).trans H
  rw [abs_mul,abs_of_nonneg ha,abs_sub_comm,abs_of_nonneg HH,norm_sub_rev]
  change _ ≤ _+2*(p i-q i)
  nlinarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Beam.yield_zero
statement: lemma yield_zero : yieldW (0:Paths.Vector M)=0
proof: := by simp [yieldW]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Beam.yield_pos
statement: lemma yield_pos (u : Paths.Vector M) : 0 ≤ yieldW u
proof: := Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ => norm_nonneg _

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Beam.yield_add
statement:
lemma yield_add (v w : Paths.Vector M) :
    yieldW (v+w) ≤ yieldW v + yieldW w
proof:
:= by
  unfold yieldW; rw [←Finset.sum_add_distrib]; exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => norm_add_le _ _

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Beam.yield_sub
statement:
lemma yield_sub (v w : Paths.Vector M) :
    yieldW (v-w) ≤ yieldW v + yieldW w
proof:
:= by
  unfold yieldW; rw [←Finset.sum_add_distrib]; exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => norm_sub_le _ _

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Beam.single_yield
statement:
lemma single_yield {x : Grid M} {s : Scene M} {b : Beat M} {l : Path M} (h : Trip x s (b::l)) (u) :
    yieldW (duties x u b) ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  have H := h.2.1.climb
  apply le_trans _ H.tight
  rw [← matter_sum H.fit]
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum; intro i _
  rw [duties,norm_scaleC,trip_final h,one_mul]; exact factor_norm H _ _

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Run.Streak.ribbon_eq
statement:
lemma ribbon_eq (x u : Grid M) (l : Path M) :
    weave x u l+hem x u l=subtotal (duties x u) l
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => change 0 + (0:Paths.Vector M)=0; rw [add_zero]
  | cons b l ih =>
    have hi : weave x u (b::l)= duties x u b+hem x u l := by
      cases l
      · simp [hem,weave]
      · rfl
    rw [hi,hem,subtotal_cons,← ih]; abel
