name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Run.Streak.count_both
proof:
:= by
  funext z
  change w z + (curl c.bit:ℂ)*((curl b.bit:ℂ)*factor b.post e.u z)=w z+ _
  rw [duties,trip_delay h]; push_cast; ring

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Run.Streak.write_down
statement:
lemma write_down (e : Streak M) {s : Scene M}
    {x : Grid M} (l : Path M) (h : Trip x s l) (hp : ∀ b∈l,e.outer b.post)
    (w : Paths.Vector M) :
    ∃ p q : Path M, l=p++q ∧
      yieldW (w+weave x e.u l) ≤
        watt s e.u w e.thick + 2 + e.thick * ((dealer e).tally (bare w) p) +
          subtotal (beamRent e) l
proof:
:= by
  match l with
  | [] =>
    refine ⟨[],[],rfl,?_⟩
    change yieldW (w+0) ≤ _+2+_*0+0
    rw [add_zero]
    linarith [yield_step s e.u w e.thick]
  | [b] =>
    refine ⟨[],[b],rfl,?_⟩
    change yieldW (w+duties x e.u b) ≤ watt s e.u _ _ + 2 + _*0+(beamRent e b+0)
    apply (yield_add _ _).trans
    linarith [single_yield h e.u,rent_nonneg e b h.2.1,yield_step s e.u w e.thick]
  | b::c::l =>
    let w' := carry (aimed e w b.post) b.bit c.bit
    have HE : w'=w+duties x e.u b := count_both e w h
    obtain ⟨rfl,h1,h2,h3,h4⟩ := h
    obtain ⟨p,q,H,HH⟩ := write_down e l h4 (fun z hz => hp z (by simp [hz])) w'
    have hD := light_bill e w b c h1 h3 h2 (hp b (by simp)) (hp c (by simp))
    let v := dealer e
    refine ⟨b::c::p,q,by simp [H],?_⟩
    rw [weave,← add_assoc,← HE,tally,tally,subtotal_cons,subtotal_cons]
    change _ ≤ watt b.pre _ _ _ + e.thick*(v.pay (bare w) b+v.pay (v.stepAt (bare w) b) c)+_+_ at hD
    change watt (winds c) e.u w' e.thick ≤ _ at hD
    change yieldW _ ≤ _ + _*(v.pay (bare w) b+(v.pay (v.stepAt (bare w) b) c+v.tally (bare w') p))+_
    change yieldW (w'+_) ≤ _+_ + _*(v.tally _ p)+_ at HH; linarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Run.Streak.ribbon_pref
statement:
lemma ribbon_pref (e : Streak M) {x : Grid M} (l m : Path M) (h : Trip x s l)
    (hp : ∀ b∈l,e.outer b.post) (t : ℝ) (he : 0 ≤ t)
    (h1 : 2*log ((dealer e).heatW (bare 0) (l++m)) ≤ t)
    (h2 : 2*log ((dealer e).heatW sleep (l++m)) ≤ t) :
    yieldW (subtotal (duties x e.u) l) ≤ 20+2*e.thick*t+2*subtotal (beamRent e) l
proof:
:= by
  let a := e.thick; let u := e.u; let r := e.beamRent
  have ha : 0 < a := e.thick_rate.1
  have hi : a ≤ 1 := e.thick_rate.2.1
  let d := dealer e
  rw [←ribbon_eq]
  apply (yield_add _ _).trans
  have HH₁ : yieldW (weave x u l) ≤ 10+a*t+subtotal r l := by
    obtain ⟨p,q,H,hh⟩ := write_down e l h hp 0
    have heq : l++m=p++(q++m) := by rw [H,List.append_assoc]
    have HV : d.tally (bare 0) p ≤ t := by
      apply ((dealer e).edge_score (bare 0) p (q++m)).trans
      rw [← heq]; exact h1
    rw [zero_add] at hh
    change yieldW (weave x u l) ≤ watt s _ 0 a+2+a*(d.tally _ _)+_ at hh
    apply hh.trans
    linarith [watt_idle (trip_head h).1 u a ha.le hi,mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left HV ha.le]
  change yieldW (weave x u l)+_ ≤ 20+2*a*t+_
  have HH₂ : yieldW (hem x u l) ≤ 10+a*t+subtotal r l := by
    match l with
    | [] =>
      rw [hem,yield_zero,subtotal_nil]
      nlinarith
    | b::l =>
      obtain ⟨H,hb,hk⟩ := h
      obtain ⟨p,q,H,hh⟩ := write_down e l hk (fun i hi => hp i (by simp [hi])) 0
      have heq : (b::l)++m=(b::p)++(q++m) := by simp [H,List.append_assoc]
      have HV : d.tally (bare 0) p ≤ t := by
        have HX : d.tally sleep (b::p) ≤ t := by
          apply ((dealer e).edge_score sleep (b::p) (q++m)).trans
          rw [← heq]; exact h2
        change single 0 b.bit+d.tally (bare 0) p ≤ t at HX
        simpa only [single,mul_zero,ne_eq,OfNat.ofNat_ne_zero,not_false_eq_true,zero_pow,zero_div,sub_zero,zero_add] using HX
      rw [zero_add] at hh
      rw [hem,subtotal_cons]
      change yieldW (weave x u l) ≤ watt (winds b) _ 0 a+2+a*(d.tally _ _)+_ at hh
      apply hh.trans
      have HH : 0 ≤ r b := rent_nonneg e b hb
      linarith [watt_idle (trip_head hk).1 u a ha.le hi,mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left HV ha.le]
  change yieldW _ + yieldW (hem x u l) ≤ 20+2*a*t+2*subtotal r l; linarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Run.Streak.bling_share
statement:
lemma bling_share (e : Streak M) (l : Path M) :
    let a
proof:
:= (rain e).heatW () l
    let b := (dealer e).heatW (bare 0) l
    let c := (dealer e).heatW sleep l
    let z := e.bling l
    1 ≤ z ∧ 1 ≤ a ∧ a ≤ z ∧ 1 ≤ b ∧ b ≤ z ∧ 1 ≤ c ∧ c ≤ z := by
  intro a b c z
  have H1 : 1 ≤ a := heatW_one _ _ _
  have H2 : 1 ≤ b := heatW_one _ _ _
  have H3 : 1 ≤ c := heatW_one _ _ _
  change 1 ≤ a+b+c ∧ 1 ≤ a ∧ a ≤ a+b+c ∧ 1 ≤ b ∧ b ≤ a+b+c ∧ 1 ≤ c ∧ c ≤ a+b+c
  exact ⟨by linarith,H1,by linarith,H2,by linarith,H3,by linarith⟩

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Run.Streak.bling_mean
statement:
lemma bling_mean (e : Streak M) (v : Thread M s) (h : v.Following j J f) :
    (s.here.dice M).Ex (fun x => bling e (v.stream x)) ≤ 6
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [bling,Ex_add]; let d := dealer e
  linarith [heat_bound d v h sleep,heat_bound d v h (bare 0),heat_bound (rain e) v h ()]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Run.Streak.ribbon_bound
statement:
lemma ribbon_bound (e : Streak M) {x : Grid M} (l m : Path M) (h : Trip x s l)
    (hp : ∀ b∈l,e.outer b.post)
    (t : ℝ) (he : 2*log (e.bling (l++m)) ≤ t) :
    yieldW (subtotal (duties x e.u) l) ≤
      10^14*(fullFax l+(1+fullKills l+flagged e l)/e.thick+e.thick*t)
proof:
:= by
  let a := e.thick; let u := e.u; let r := e.b
  have ha : 0 < a := e.thick_rate.1
  have hi : a ≤ 1 := e.thick_rate.2.1
  have hx := bling_share e (l++m)
  have hR (x : ℝ) (h : 1 ≤ x) (hf : x ≤ e.bling (l++m)) : 2* log x ≤ t :=
    le_trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (log_le_log (by linarith) hf) (by norm_num)) he
  obtain ⟨ha₀,ha₁,ha₂,ha₃,ha₄,ha₅,ha₆⟩ := hx
  have HH : 0 ≤ t := le_trans (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (log_nonneg ha₀)) he
  apply (ribbon_pref e l m h hp t HH (hR _ ha₃ ha₄) (hR _ ha₅ ha₆)).trans
  rw [rent_total]
  let V := showers e l; let K := fullKills l; let E := flagged e l; let J := fullFax l
  have hJ : 0 ≤ J := trip_fax h; have hK : 0 ≤ K := trip_K h; have hE : 0 ≤ E := flagged_pos e h
  have hM := e.cave_whole h hp
  have HE := ((rain e).edge_score () l m).trans (hR _ ha₁ ha₂)
  have hV : V ≤ 2*(4+8*K+4*E+r*J+10^5*r*t) := by
    have HR : 0 < r := e.rate.1
    change V/2 ≤ _-energy s u+8*K+4*E+r*J+10^5*r*_ at hM
    nlinarith [(energy_small (trip_head h).1 u).1]
  have heq : a^2=r := thick_rate e |>.2.2
  change 20+2*a*t+2*(10^6*(J+(K+E+V)/a)) ≤ 10^14*(J+(1+K+E)/a+a*t)
  apply le_of_mul_le_mul_left _ ha
  have HD (x y z : ℝ) : a*(x*(y+z/a))=x*(a*y+z) := by field_simp
  simp_rw [mul_add]
  have HG (x k : ℝ) : a*(x*(k/a))=x*k := by field_simp

  field_simp
  nlinarith [mul_nonneg ha.le HH,show a*a*J ≤ a*J from by exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by nlinarith) hJ,
    show a*(a*t)=r*t by rw [← heq]; ring]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Run.Streak.rate
statement: lemma rate (e : Streak M) : 0 < e.b ∧ e.b ≤ 1
proof: := ⟨side_pos _,side_le _⟩

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Run.Streak.thick_rate
statement: lemma thick_rate (e : Streak M) : 0 < e.thick ∧ e.thick ≤ 1 ∧ e.thick^2=e.b
proof:
:=
    ⟨sqrt_pos.2 e.rate.1,by unfold thick; simpa using Real.sqrt_le_sqrt e.rate.2,
      sq_sqrt e.rate.1.le⟩

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Run.Streak.flag_nonneg
statement: lemma flag_nonneg (e : Streak M) (s : Scene M) : 0 ≤ flag e s
proof: := by unfold flag; split <;> norm_num

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Run.Streak.flagged_pos
statement: lemma flagged_pos {l : Path M} {x : Grid M} (e : Streak M) (h : Trip x s l) : 0 ≤ flagged e l
proof:
:=
    trip_nonneg h (fun b _ => flag_nonneg e b.post)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Run.Streak.showers_pos
statement: lemma showers_pos {l : Path M} {x : Grid M} (e : Streak M) (h : Trip x s l) : 0 ≤ showers e l
proof:
:=
    trip_nonneg h (fun _ H => shower_nonneg H.climb)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Run.Streak.inner_outer
statement: lemma inner_outer (e : Streak M) (s : Scene M) (h : innerV e s) : outer e s
proof:
:=
    h.elim Or.inl fun H => Or.inr fun i => by nlinarith [H i]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Run.Streak.cave
statement:
lemma cave (e : Streak M) (b : Beat M) (hp : Ideal b.pre b.post) (hv : e.outer b.post) :
    let u
proof:
:= e.u
    shower u b.post/2 ≤ energy (winds b) u-energy b.pre u+8*killed b+4*flag e b.post+
      e.b*fax b.post+10^5*e.b*((rain e).pay () b) := by
  intro u
  rw [winds,wet_walk _ hp.climb]
  let s := b.post; let x := e.b; let y := gust s u
  let a : ℝ := 10^5*x
  have hx : 0 < x := e.rate.1; have he : x ≤ 1 := e.rate.2
  have hr : 0 < a := by unfold a; positivity
  have hT := (abs_le.mp (energy_drain hp u)).2
  have hJ : 0 ≤ fax s := (fax_floor hp.climb).1
  have hG : 0 ≤ shower u s := shower_nonneg hp.climb
  change shower u s /2 ≤ energy s u+shower u s+curl b.bit*y - energy b.pre u+
    8*killed b+4*flag e s+x*fax s+a*(rain e).pay () b
  by_cases h : e.rogue b.post
  · rw [show flag e s=1 from ite_eq_left h]
    have H : (rain e).pay () b=0 := by simp [rain,pay,h,single]
    have HV (i) : 0 ≤ energy (s.smaller i) u ∧ energy (s.smaller i) u ≤ 4 :=
      let H := energy_small (hp.climb.child i) u
      ⟨H.1,H.2.trans (hp.climb.child i).lift⟩
    have hY : |curl b.bit*y| ≤ 4 := by
      rw [abs_mul,curl_unit,one_mul,abs_le]; unfold y gust
      constructor <;> linarith [(HV false).1,(HV true).1,(HV true).2,(HV false).2]
    rw [H,mul_zero]; unfold s at *; nlinarith [(abs_le.mp hY).1]
  · rw [show flag e s=0 from ite_eq_right h]
    have H : a*(rain e).pay () b= -curl b.bit*y-y^2/(2*a) := by
      have HE : (rain e).stake () b.pre b.post = -y/a := by unfold rain; simp [h]; rfl
      rw [pay,HE,single]; field_simp
    have he₁ : y^2 ≤ 100*(256*x^2)*(fax s+shower u s) :=
      sky_variance s hp.climb u _ (hv.resolve_left h)
    have hx' : y^2/(2*a) ≤ x/2*(fax s+shower u s) := by
      apply (div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)).mpr
      unfold a; nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg x) (add_nonneg hJ hG)]
    rw [H]
    unfold s at *
    nlinarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Run.Streak.cave_whole
statement:
lemma cave_whole (e : Streak M) {l : Path M} {x : Grid M} (h : Trip x s l)
    (hh : ∀ b∈l,e.outer b.post) :
    let u
proof:
:= e.u
    showers e l/2 ≤ 4-energy s u + 8*fullKills l+4*flagged e l+e.b*fullFax l+
      10^5*e.b*((rain e).tally () l) := by
  intro u
  induction l generalizing s with
  | nil =>
    have H := trip_head h
    have HH := (energy_small H.1 u).2.trans H.1.lift
    change 0/2 ≤ 4-_+_*0+_*0+_*0+_*0
    linarith
  | cons b l ih =>
    obtain ⟨rfl,ha,hb⟩ := h
    have H := e.cave b ha (hh b (List.mem_cons_self))
    change shower u b.post /2 ≤ _ at H
    have hi := ih hb (fun b hi => hh b (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hi))
    change (shower u b.post+showers e l)/2 ≤ 4-energy b.pre u+
      8*(killed b+fullKills l)+4*(flag e b.post+flagged e l)+
      _*(fax b.post+fullFax l)+_*((rain e).pay () b+(rain e).tally () l)
    linarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Run.Streak.lit_upper
statement:
lemma lit_upper (e : Streak M) (W : Paths.Vector M) (t : Scene M) (h : Climb s) (hp : e.outer s) :
    let a
proof:
:= e.thick
    lit (e.aimed W t) s ≤ 300*(a*fax s+flag e s+shower e.u s) := by
  intro a
  let J := fax s; let q := shower e.u s; let g := energy s e.u; let r := e.b
  have hJ : 0 ≤ J ∧ J ≤ 2 := fax_floor h
  have hq : 0 ≤ q := shower_nonneg h
  have hα : 0 < a ∧ a ≤ 1 ∧ a^2=r := e.thick_rate
  have hr : 0 < r ∧ r ≤ 1 := e.rate
  change (g+a^2)*J+q ≤ 300*(a*J+flag e s+q)
  by_cases hh : rogue e s
  · have hg : g ≤ 4 := (energy_small h.fit e.u).2.trans h.fit.lift
    rw [flag,ite_eq_left hh]; nlinarith
  · have HE : g ≤ 256*r^2 := by
      have HV := hp.resolve_left hh
      have H : g+q=(energy (s.smaller false) e.u+energy (s.smaller true) e.u)/2 :=
        (wet_average s h e.u).symm
      unfold r; linarith [HV true,HV false]
    have hx : r^2 ≤ a := by nlinarith
    have Hx : g+a^2 ≤ 257*a := by nlinarith
    rw [flag,ite_eq_right hh]; nlinarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Run.Streak.rent_nonneg
statement:
lemma rent_nonneg (e : Streak M) (b : Beat M) (hp : Ideal b.pre b.post) :
    0 ≤ beamRent e b
proof:
:= mul_nonneg (by norm_num)
      (add_nonneg (fax_floor hp.climb).1 (div_nonneg
        (add_nonneg (add_nonneg hp.kill_nonneg (flag_nonneg e _)) (shower_nonneg hp.climb)) e.thick_rate.1.le))

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Run.Streak.rent_total
statement:
lemma rent_total (e : Streak M) (l : Path M) :
    subtotal (beamRent e) l=10^6*(fullFax l+(fullKills l+flagged e l+showers e l)/e.thick)
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => change (0:ℝ)=10^6*(0+(0+0+0)/_); ring
  | cons b l ih =>
    rw [subtotal_cons,ih]
    change 10^6*(fax b.post+(killed b+flag e b.post+shower e.u b.post)/e.thick)+
      10^6*(fullFax l+(fullKills l+flagged e l+showers e l)/e.thick)=
      10^6*((fax b.post+fullFax l)+(killed b+fullKills l+(flag e b.post+flagged e l)+
        (shower e.u b.post+showers e l))/e.thick)
    ring

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Run.Streak.light_bill
statement:
lemma light_bill (e : Streak M) (w : Paths.Vector M)
    (b c : Beat M) (hb : Ideal b.pre b.post) (hc : Ideal c.pre c.post)
    (hh : c.pre=winds b) (hp : e.outer b.post) (he : e.outer c.post) :
    let r
proof:
:= aimed e w b.post
    let v := dealer e
    let a := e.thick
    watt (winds c) e.u (carry r b.bit c.bit) a ≤ watt b.pre e.u w a +
      a*(v.pay (bare w) b+v.pay (v.stepAt (bare w) b) c)+beamRent e b+beamRent e c := by
  intro r v a
  let x := start r; let y := delayed r b.bit c.post
  have ha : 0 < a := e.thick_rate.1
  have hi : a ≤ 1 := e.thick_rate.2.1
  have HE : curl b.bit*x+curl c.bit*y=
      a*(v.pay (bare w) b+v.pay (v.stepAt (bare w) b) c)+(x^2+y^2)/(2*a) := by
    change curl _*_+curl _ *_ = a*(single (x/a) b.bit+single (y/a) c.bit)+_
    unfold single; field_simp; ring
  let J (b : Beat M) := fax b.post; let G (b : Beat M) := shower e.u b.post
  let Q (b : Beat M) := flag e b.post
  have H1 : x^2 ≤ 30000*(a*J b+Q b+G b) := by
    have H : x^2 ≤ 100*lit r b.post := start_cost r hb.climb ha.le
    have H' : lit r b.post ≤ 300*(a*J b+Q b+G b) := lit_upper e w b.post hb.climb hp
    linarith
  have H2 : y^2 ≤ 30000*((a*J b+Q b+G b)+(a*J c+Q c+G c)) := by
    have H : y^2 ≤ 100*(lit r b.post+lit r c.post) := delayed_cost r hb.climb hc.climb ha.le b.bit
    have Hx : lit r b.post ≤ 300*(a*J b+Q b+G b) := lit_upper e w b.post hb.climb hp
    have Hy : lit r c.post ≤ 300*(a*J c+Q c+G c) := lit_upper e w b.post hc.climb he
    linarith
  let K (b : Beat M) := killed b
  let A := J b+J c
  let B := Q b+Q c
  let C := G b+G c
  have HG (b : Beat M) (hb : Ideal b.pre b.post) :
      0 ≤ J b ∧ 0 ≤ Q b ∧ 0 ≤ G b ∧ 0 ≤ K b :=
        ⟨(fax_floor hb.climb).1,flag_nonneg _ _, shower_nonneg hb.climb,hb.kill_nonneg⟩
  obtain ⟨h1,h2,h3,h4⟩ := HG b hb
  obtain ⟨h5,h6,h7,h8⟩ := HG c hc
  have HX : (x^2+y^2)/(2*a) ≤ 10^5*(A+(B+C)/a) := by
    apply (div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)).mpr
    rw [show 10^5*(A+(B+C)/a)*(2*a)=200000*(a*A+B+C) by field_simp; ring]
    unfold A B C; nlinarith
  have hH := flash r hb.climb b.bit c hh hc ha hi
  change watt (winds c) e.u (carry r b.bit c.bit) a ≤ watt b.post e.u w a+
    curl b.bit*x+curl c.bit*y+ 2*K c+4*(20*A+400*((K c+G b+G c)/a)) at hH
  have HF : 2*K b+2*K c+4*(20*A+400*((K c+G b+G c)/a))+10^5*(A+(B+C)/a) ≤
      beamRent e b+beamRent e c := by
    change _ ≤ 10^6*(J b+(K b+Q b+G b)/a)+10^6*(J c+(K c+Q c+G c)/a)
    have hz : 1 ≤ a⁻¹ := (one_le_inv₀ ha).mpr hi
    unfold A B C
    simp_rw [div_eq_mul_inv]
    nlinarith
  linarith [watt_slide hb e.u w a ha.le hi]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Troupe.depth_next
statement: lemma depth_next (b : Beat M) : (winds b).here.lev=depthB b+1
proof:
:= by
  unfold winds depthB smaller
  cases b.bit <;> rfl

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Troupe.mute_cat
statement:
lemma mute_cat (u : Grid M) (p : Plot) (c : Board M) (j : ℕ) (l r : Path M) :
    muted u p c j (l++r) ↔ muted u p c j l ∧ muted u p (quarrel p c l) j r
proof:
:= by
  induction l generalizing c with
  | nil => simp [muted,quarrel]
  | cons b l ih =>
    change (_∧muted u p (p.turn c b.post) j (l++r)) ↔ (_∧_)∧_
    rw [ih]; simp only [and_assoc]; rfl

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Troupe.first_on
statement:
lemma first_on (u : Grid M) (p : Plot) (c : Board M) (j : ℕ) (l : Path M) :
    muted u p c j l ∨ ∃ a b r,l=a++b::r ∧ muted u p c j a ∧
      p.catches b.post (quarrel p c a) j u
proof:
:= by
  induction l generalizing c with
  | nil => exact Or.inl True.intro
  | cons b l ih =>
    by_cases h : p.catches b.post c j u
    · exact Or.inr ⟨[],b,l,rfl,True.intro,h⟩
    rcases ih (turn p c b.post) with H|⟨a,d,r,H,h1,h2⟩
    · exact Or.inl ⟨h,H⟩
    exact Or.inr ⟨b::a,d,r,by rw [H]; rfl,⟨h,h1⟩,h2⟩

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Troupe.close_persists
statement:
private lemma close_persists {A B : Finset (Grid M)} (h : A ⊆ B) (n : ℕ)
    {x : Grid M} (hv : enclosed A n x) : enclosed B n x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨f,hf,rfl⟩ := hv
  let k (x : Grid M) := if x∈A then f x else 0
  refine ⟨k,fun i hi => ?_,?_⟩
  · unfold k; split_ifs with hh; exact hf _ hh; simp
  · have H : ∑ i∈A,k i • i=∑ i∈B,k i • i := Finset.sum_subset h (fun i _ h => by simp [k,h])
    rw [← H]; exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun _ hx => by simp [k,hx]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Troupe.reach_persists
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i,hi,hE⟩ := hv
  exact ⟨i,close_persists h 1 hi,hE.trans hh⟩

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Troupe.mute_distance
statement:
lemma mute_distance (u : Grid M) (p : Plot)
    (c : Board M) (s : Scene M) (l r : Path M)
    (h : Cast j J f s (l++r)) (he : Comes c s j J f) (hh : muted u p c j l)
    (k : ℝ) (hp : atReach c.chart.items k u) :
    ∀ b∈l, snag (grade p) u b →
      s.here.lev ≤ depthB b ∧ ink b.post (grade p) j < k
proof:
:= by
  induction l generalizing s c with
  | nil => simp
  | cons b l ih =>
    intro z hz hx
    obtain ⟨rfl,⟨t,ht⟩,h₁⟩ := h
    have hC := zoom_spec _ he.valid p.ix p.main ht
    let d := turn p c b.post
    have HR : atReach d.chart.items k u := reach_persists hC.extend k k le_rfl hp
    have hi : b.post.here=b.pre.here := ht.2.1.1.here
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp hz with rfl|hz
    · refine ⟨le_of_eq (congrArg Node.lev hi.symm),lt_of_not_ge fun H => ?_⟩
      exact hh.1 ⟨hx.1,reach_persists hC.extend k _ H hp⟩
    obtain ⟨ha,hb⟩ := ih d (winds b) h₁ (comes_down p ht he b.bit) hh.2 HR z hz hx
    rw [depth_next] at ha; change b.pre.here.lev ≤ _
      ∧ _
    rw [← hi]; exact ⟨le_trans (Nat.le_add_right (depthB b) 1) ha,hb⟩

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Troupe.screen_time
statement:
lemma screen_time (u : Grid M) (p : Plot)
    (c : Board M) (s : Scene M) (L : Path M)
    (h : Cast j J f s L) (he : Comes c s j J f) (hp : volumeAt p s c)
    (hv : oiled p c L) :
    ∃ a : ℕ, ∀ l r : Path M, L=l++r → muted u p c j l →
      ∀ b∈l, snag (grade p) u b → betweenS a (latency p j) b
proof:
:= by
  induction L generalizing c s with
  | nil =>
    refine ⟨0,?_⟩; intro l r hh hp b hb; cases l
    · cases hb
    · cases hh
  | cons b L ih =>
    have hi := oily_cons p h he hv
    obtain ⟨rfl,⟨t,ht⟩,h₁⟩ := h
    have hC := zoom_spec _ he.valid p.ix p.main ht
    have hH := ht.2.1.1.here
    let d := turn p c b.post; let s := b.post
    have HC : localSize s.here p.ix d.chart := hC.expands (hH.symm ▸ hp)
    by_cases hx : snag (grade p) u b
    · let I := horizon s.here p.ix d.chart.size
      have heq : d.chart=(now p c b.post) := rfl
      have HB : atReach d.chart.items I u := by
        have HE := hC.awake hx.2 u hx.1
        change atReach d.chart.items (d.chart.wide+speed s.here p.ix d.chart.size) u at HE
        apply reach_persists (Finset.Subset.refl _) _ _ ?_ HE
        unfold localSize at HC
        unfold I horizon; nlinarith
      refine ⟨depthB b,?_⟩
      intro l r hL hh z hz hZ
      cases l with
      | nil => cases hz
      | cons w l =>
        change b::L=w::(l++r) at hL; cases hL
        rcases List.mem_cons.mp hz with rfl|hz
        · unfold betweenS latency; omega
        obtain ⟨ha,hb⟩ := mute_distance u p d (winds b) l r h₁ hi.2.2 hh.2 I HB z hz hZ
        refine ⟨?_, lt_of_not_ge (fun H => ?_)⟩
        · rw [depth_next] at ha; omega
        have Hx' := waiting p j s.here z.post.here H d.chart.size hi.1
        exact hb.not_ge Hx'
    · have HV : volumeAt p (winds b) d := by
        unfold volumeAt localSize; unfold localSize at HC
        apply HC.trans
        apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (by positivity)
        apply speed_le _ le_rfl
        rw [depth_next]; exact Nat.le_add_right _ _
      obtain ⟨a,ha⟩ := ih d _ h₁ hi.2.2 HV hi.2.1
      refine ⟨a,?_⟩
      intro l r hL hh z hz hZ
      cases l with
      | nil => cases hz
      | cons w l =>
        change b::L=w::(l++r) at hL
        have hw := List.cons.inj hL
        cases hw.1
        rcases List.mem_cons.mp hz with rfl|hz
        · exact (hx hZ).elim
        exact ha l r (List.cons.inj hL).2 hh.2 z hz hZ

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Troupe.bound_stage
statement:
lemma bound_stage {u : Grid M} {s : Scene M} (L : Path M)
    (h : Cast j J f s L) (g : Grade) :
    ∃ a : ℕ, ∀ l r : Path M, L=l++r → stall u g j L l →
      ∀ b∈l, snag g u b → betweenS a (billWait g j L) b
proof:
:=
  screen_time u (heroPlot g L) (vacant M) s L h (vacant_comes s)
    (by simp [volumeAt,vacant,classic,Chart.size,localSize]) (oil_hero g L)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Troupe.entry_share
statement: lemma entry_share {s : Scene M} (h : Fit s) (e : entry s) : share s=1
proof:
:= by
  unfold share entry at *; rw [←e,div_self h.pos.ne']

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Troupe.old_budget
statement:
lemma old_budget :
    ∀ᶠ j : ℕ in atTop,
      (minimumT j)⁻¹ ≤ height j ∧
      ∀ M J : ℕ, ∀ s : Scene M, ∀ f : Grid M → ℝ,
        s.Safe j J f → Fit s → entry s →
        (∀ x, f x ≤ exp (height j)) →
        ∀ b : Bool, deficit s (channel (optic s b))+(minimumT j)⁻¹ ≤ 10^24*amount s j
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [side_deficit,hpoly 12800 32] with j ht hh
  have H : (minimumT j)⁻¹ ≤ height j := by unfold minimumT; rw [one_div,inv_inv]; exact hh
  refine ⟨H,?_⟩
  intro M J s f h hp e hf b
  let x := height j; let y := amount s j
  have hm : 0 < s.mass := e ▸ hp.pos
  have hx := (amount_limits s j).2
  have hy : -log s.mass ≤ y := by
    unfold entry at e; rw [←e]; unfold y amount
    linarith [d_pos j,le_max_left (-log s.norm) 0]
  have hZ := ht M J s f h hf hm
  cases b
  · unfold optic; rw [ite_eq_right (by simp),funext no_label]
    have H₁ := local_deficit_dry s (uniform (Grid M)) hp.ready.1 hp.ready.2 hm x
      (fun i => (h.sub i).trans (hf i))
    unfold y x at *
    linarith [d_pos j]
  · simp only [optic,ite_true]
    unfold y at *; linarith [d_pos j]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Troupe.scale_one
statement: lemma scale_one (i : ℕ) : 1 ≤ scaleC i
proof: := one_le_pow₀ (by norm_num)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Troupe.scale_pos
statement: lemma scale_pos (i : ℕ) : 0 < scaleC i
proof: := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one (scale_one i)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Troupe.scale_side
statement: lemma scale_side (i : ℕ) : side i = (scaleC i)⁻¹
proof: := by unfold scaleC; rw [side_pow_two]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Troupe.prescale
statement: lemma prescale (p : Plot) : (precision p.ix p.cap:ℝ) ≤ 100*(scaleC p.ix* scaleC p.cap)
proof:
:= by
  have H (i : ℕ) : (i:ℝ) ≤ scaleC i := by
    unfold scaleC; exact_mod_cast Nat.lt_two_pow_self.le
  have hi := scale_one p.cap; have he := scale_one p.ix
  unfold precision
  push_cast; nlinarith [H p.cap,H p.ix]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Troupe.marker_one
statement: lemma marker_one (p : Plot) : p.marker ≤ 1 ∧ 1/p.marker ≤ 10^14 * (scaleC p.ix)^12
proof:
:= by
  let x := side p.ix; let v := scaleC p.ix
  have hx : 0 < x := side_pos _; have hv : 0 < v := scale_pos _
  have ht : x = v⁻¹ := scale_side _
  have he₁ : x^6 ≤ 1 := pow_le_one₀ hx.le (side_le _)
  unfold marker sharp; change (x^6/32768)^2/16 ≤ 1 ∧ _ ≤ _
  constructor
  · nlinarith [pow_pos hx 6]
  · change 1/((x^6/32768)^2/16) ≤ 10^14*v^12
    rw [ht]
    field_simp
    nlinarith [pow_pos hv 12]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Troupe.prelude
statement:
lemma prelude :
    ∀ᶠ j : ℕ in atTop,
      ∀ M J : ℕ, ∀ s : Scene M, ∀ f : Grid M → ℝ, ∀ t : Thread M s,
        t.Following j J f → Fit s → entry s →
        (∀ x, f x ≤ exp (height j)) →
        ∀ p : Plot,
          let x
proof:
:= amount s j
          let g := grade p
          let B := scaleC p.ix
          let D := scaleC p.cap
          stats t (minted p (vacant M)) ≤ 10^50*B^14*x*D^4 ∧
            stats t (fun l => (broadMass l g:ℝ)) ≤ 10^31*B^6*x := by
  filter_upwards [old_budget] with j hj M J s f t h hp hh hF p x g B D
  have he : 1 ≤ x := (amount_limits s j).1
  have HD : 1 ≤ D := scale_one p.cap; have HB : 1 ≤ B := scale_one p.ix
  let c := vacant M
  have hc : c.chart.Sound := classic_sound M
  have hS : share s=1 := entry_share hp hh
  have HT := mint_small p c s t h hc
    (show soundPrev c from fun s hs => by cases hs)
    (show p.cardStep c from by simp [cardStep,c,vacant,classic,Chart.size]) hp.pos
  have HP : deficit s (channel (optic s p.main))+(minimumT j)⁻¹ ≤ 10^24*x :=
    hj.2 M J s f (Thread.rooted _ h) hp hh hF _
  have hh : (p.creditsC c)=D := by simp [creditsC,c,vacant,classic,rangeIx,D,scaleC,Chart.size]
  constructor
  · have HH : p.debtC c s j ≤ 10^24*x+100*(B*D^3) := by
      have H₁ := (sight_budget s p.main c.chart.items (precision p.ix p.cap)).2
      change deficit s (p.kObs c s) ≤ _ at H₁
      rw [show c.chart.items.card=0 by simp [c,vacant,classic],Nat.cast_zero,zero_mul,add_zero] at H₁
      unfold debtC; rw [hh]
      have hF₁ : D*p.coinC ≤ 100*(B*D^3) := by
        have H := prescale p
        have hZ : p.coinC = D*(precision p.ix p.cap) := by simp [coinC,rangeIx,D,scaleC]
        rw [hZ]
        change _ ≤ 100*(B*D) at H
        have hv := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left H (sq_nonneg D); linarith
      linarith
    have hh₂ : p.slotC c ≤ D+1 := by
      unfold slotC; rw [hh,ite_eq_left (show c.previous=none from rfl)]
      exact mul_le_of_le_one_left (by positivity) (marker_one p).1
    have hh₃ : p.expenses c s j ≤ 10^26* (B*x*D^4) := by
      unfold expenses; rw [hS,show p.deltaC c s=0 from rfl]
      have HX : 0 ≤ B*D^3 := by positivity
      have HL : B*D^3 ≤ B*x*D^4 := by gcongr; all_goals nlinarith
      have HT : D ≤ B*D^3 := (by calc
        D ≤ D^3 := by simpa using pow_le_pow_right₀ HD (show 1 ≤ 3 by omega)
        _ ≤ _ := by nlinarith [pow_nonneg (le_trans (by norm_num) HD) 3])
      have HZ : x ≤ B*x*D^4 := by apply le_trans (b:=B*x) (by nlinarith); exact le_mul_of_one_le_right (by positivity) (one_le_pow₀ HD)
      nlinarith
    have HI : stats t (minted p c) ≤ (1/p.marker)*p.expenses c s j := by
      rw [one_div,← div_eq_inv_mul]
      apply (le_div_iff₀ (p.marker_pos)).mpr
      rw [mul_comm]; exact HT
    apply HI.trans
    have hz := (marker_one p).2
    calc
      _ ≤ (10^14*B^12)*(10^26*(B*x*D^4)) := by
        exact mul_le_mul hz hh₃ (expenses_nonneg p c _ j
          (show p.cardStep c from by simp [cardStep,c,vacant,classic,Chart.size]) hp.ready
          (show soundPrev c from fun s hs => by cases hs) hp.pos) (by positivity)
      _ ≤ _ := by
        have HV := pow_le_pow_right₀ HB (show 13≤14 by omega)
        nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right HV (show 0 ≤ x*D^4 by positivity),
          show 0 ≤ B^14*x*D^4 by positivity]
  · have H := buildup_total s t f h p.main p.ix c.chart hc hp.pos
    let r := amp p.ix p.main; let m := stats t (fun l => (broadMass l g:ℝ))
    have hr := amp_pos p.ix p.main; change 0 < r at hr
    have Heq (x' : Grid M) :
        buildup p.ix p.main c.chart (t.stream x')=(broadMass (t.stream x') g:ℝ) := by
      unfold buildup; rw [show c.chart.size=0 by simp [c,vacant,classic,Chart.size]]
      simp only [Nat.cast_zero,sub_zero]; rfl
    simp_rw [Heq] at H
    rw [show s.mass/s.norm=_ from hS,one_mul
      ] at H
    have hh : chartDebt s j c.chart p.main ≤ 10^24*x := by
      unfold chartDebt; apply le_trans _ HP
      change flex s p.main (fun _ _ => 1)+_ ≤ _; rw [flex_one]
    change (r/2*(r^2/2048))*m ≤ _ at H
    have hi : 1/B^2 ≤ r := by
      have HE := (strength_bounds p.main (side_pos p.ix) (side_le p.ix)).2.2
      rw [scale_side] at HE
      unfold r amp; rw [scale_side]; unfold B; simpa only [one_div,inv_pow] using HE
    change m ≤ _
    have hT : 4096 * 10^24*x / r^3 ≤ 4096*10^24*x*B^6 := by
      have hB : 0 < B := by positivity
      calc
        _ ≤ 4096*10^24*x/(1/B^2)^3 := by gcongr
        _ = _ := by field_simp
    apply le_trans (le_trans ?_ hT)
    · have H : 0 ≤ x*B^6 := by positivity
      linarith
    apply (le_div_iff₀ (pow_pos hr _)).mpr; nlinarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.part_bounded
statement: lemma part_bounded (d : Face) (x : ℂ) : |part d x| ≤ ‖x‖
proof:
:= by
  rw [part,abs_mul,curl_unit,one_mul]
  split; exact Complex.abs_im_le_norm _; exact Complex.abs_re_le_norm _

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.part_zero
statement: lemma part_zero (d : Face) : part d 0=0
proof: := by rcases d with ⟨b,c⟩; cases b <;> simp [part]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.part_add
statement: lemma part_add (d : Face) (x y : ℂ) : part d (x+y)=part d x+part d y
proof:
:= by
  rcases d with ⟨b,c⟩; cases b <;> simp [part,mul_add]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.part_diff
statement: lemma part_diff (d : Face) (x y : ℂ) : part d (x-y)=part d x-part d y
proof:
:= by
  rcases d with ⟨b,c⟩; cases b <;> simp [part,mul_sub]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.part_mul
statement: lemma part_mul (d : Face) (x : ℂ) (c : ℝ) : part d (c*x)=c*part d x
proof:
:= by
  rcases d with ⟨b,r⟩; cases b <;> simp [part,mul_left_comm]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.slide_range
statement: private lemma slide_range {w x : ℝ} (hw : 0 ≤ w) : |slide w x| ≤ w
proof:
:= by
  rw [abs_le]; unfold slide
  split_ifs <;> constructor <;> linarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.slide_inner
statement: private lemma slide_inner {w x : ℝ} (hx : |x| ≤ w) : slide w x=x
proof:
:= by
  rw [abs_le] at hx; unfold slide
  split_ifs <;> linarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.smooth_inner
statement: private lemma smooth_inner {w x : ℝ} (hx : |x| ≤ w) : smooth w x=x^2
proof:
:= by
  rw [smooth,slide_inner hx]; ring

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.slide_pay
statement:
private lemma slide_pay {w x y : ℝ} (_hw : 0 ≤ w) (hy : |y| ≤ w) :
    2*x*y-y^2 ≤ smooth w x
proof:
:= by
  rw [abs_le] at hy
  unfold smooth slide; split_ifs with h h'
  · nlinarith
  · nlinarith
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg (x-y)]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.smooth_mid
statement:
private lemma smooth_mid {w : ℝ} (x u : ℝ) (hw : 0 ≤ w) :
    smooth w x ≤ (smooth w (x+u)+smooth w (x-u))/2
proof:
:= by
  have H (t : ℝ) := slide_pay (x:=t) hw (slide_range (x:=x) hw)
  rw [smooth]
  nlinarith [H (x+u), H (x-u)]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.smooth_nonneg
statement: private lemma smooth_nonneg {w : ℝ} (x : ℝ) (hw : 0 ≤ w) : 0 ≤ smooth w x
proof:
:= by
  have H := slide_pay (x:=x) hw (by simpa using hw : |(0:ℝ)| ≤ w)
  simpa using H

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.smooth_lip
statement:
private lemma smooth_lip {w : ℝ} (x y : ℝ) (hw : 0 ≤ w) :
    |smooth w x-smooth w y| ≤ 2*w * |x-y|
proof:
:= by
  have H (x y : ℝ) : smooth w x-smooth w y ≤ 2*w*|x-y| := by
    have He := slide_range (x:=x) hw
    have hi := slide_pay (x:=y) hw He
    have hh : (x-y)*slide w x ≤ |x-y| *w := by
      apply le_trans (le_abs_self _)
      rw [abs_mul]; gcongr
    conv_lhs => lhs; rw [smooth]
    linarith
  rw [abs_le]
  have hx := H y x; rw [abs_sub_comm] at hx
  constructor <;> linarith [H x y]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.sq_lip
statement:
private lemma sq_lip (x y : ℝ) (hx : |x| ≤ 4) (hy : |y| ≤ 4) :
    |x^2-y^2| ≤ 8*|x-y|
proof:
:= by
  rw [show x^2-y^2=(x+y)*(x-y) by ring,abs_mul]
  apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ (abs_nonneg _)
  linarith [abs_add_le x y]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.tilt_lip
statement:
lemma tilt_lip (b : ℝ) (h : 0 ≤ b) (x y : ℝ) (hx : |x| ≤ 4) (hy : |y| ≤ 4) :
    |tilt b x-tilt b y| ≤ 30*b* |x-y|
proof:
:= by
  let w := 10*b
  have he := smooth_lip (w:=w) x y (by unfold w; positivity)
  rw [tilt,tilt,show smooth (10*b) x+b*x^2-(smooth (10*b) y+b*y^2)=smooth w x-smooth w y+b*(x^2-y^2) by unfold w; ring]
  apply le_trans (abs_add_le _ _)
  rw [abs_mul,abs_of_nonneg h]
  have H := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (sq_lip x y hx hy) h
  unfold w at *
  nlinarith [abs_nonneg (x-y),mul_nonneg h (abs_nonneg (x-y))]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.tilt_bounds
statement:
lemma tilt_bounds (b : ℝ) (h : 0 ≤ b) (x : ℝ) (hx : |x| ≤ 4) :
    0 ≤ tilt b x ∧ tilt b x ≤ 120*b
proof:
:= by
  have he : 0 ≤ 10*b := by positivity
  have hh : tilt b 0=0 := by rw [tilt,smooth_inner (by simpa using he)]; ring
  refine ⟨add_nonneg (smooth_nonneg x he) (by positivity),?_⟩
  have hi := tilt_lip b h x 0 hx (by norm_num); rw [hh,sub_zero,sub_zero] at hi
  exact ((le_abs_self _).trans hi).trans (by nlinarith)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.tilt_rise
statement:
lemma tilt_rise (b : ℝ) (h : 0 ≤ b) (x u : ℝ) :
    let D
proof:
:= (tilt b (x+u)+tilt b (x-u))/2-tilt b x
    b*u^2 ≤ D ∧ (|x+u| ≤ 10*b → |x-u| ≤ 10*b → u^2 ≤ D) := by
  let w := 10*b
  intro D
  have H1 : D=(smooth w (x+u)+smooth w (x-u))/2-smooth w x+b*u^2 := by
    unfold D w tilt; ring
  rw [H1]
  constructor
  · have HE := smooth_mid x u (by unfold w; positivity : 0 ≤ w); linarith
  intro hx hy
  change _ ≤ w at hx hy
  rw [smooth_inner hx,smooth_inner hy,smooth_inner (x:=x)]; nlinarith [mul_nonneg h (sq_nonneg u)]
  rw [abs_le] at hx hy ⊢; constructor <;> linarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.prize_norm
statement:
lemma prize_norm {b : ℝ} (hb : 0 ≤ b) (u : Grid M) (s : Scene M) :
    ‖prize u b s‖ ≤ 10*b
proof:
:= by
  unfold prize; split_ifs with H
  · apply (norm_halfcomplex _ _).trans; linarith [H false,H true]
  simp; linarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Lens.hero_walk
statement:
lemma hero_walk (g : Lens M) (s : Scene M) (b : Bool) :
    hero g (s.smaller b)=g.hero s+g.flow s+ curl b*g.swing s
proof:
:= by
  unfold flow swing
  cases b <;> norm_num [curl] <;> ring

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Lens.dot_walk
statement:
lemma dot_walk (g : Lens M) (s : Scene M) (hs : Climb s) (b) :
    g.dot (s.smaller b) = g.dot s+curl b*g.cash s
proof:
:= by
  rw [dot,scalar_jump hs b,part_add,part_mul]; rfl

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Lens.dot_limit
statement: lemma dot_limit (g : Lens M) (s : Scene M) (hp : Fit s) : |g.dot s| ≤ 4
proof:
:=
    (part_bounded g.face _).trans ((scalar_norm hp _).trans hp.lift)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Lens.hero_limit
statement:
lemma hero_limit (g : Lens M) (hr : 0 ≤ g.rate) (hp : Fit s) :
    0 ≤ g.hero s ∧ g.hero s ≤ 120*g.rate
proof:
:=
    tilt_bounds g.rate hr _ (dot_limit g s hp)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Lens.coin_flow
statement:
lemma coin_flow (g : Lens M) (hp : 0 ≤ g.rate) (hs : Climb s) :
    (g.coin s)^2 ≤ g.flow s ∧ g.rate*(g.cash s)^2 ≤ g.flow s
proof:
:= by
  have Hx := g.dot_walk s hs false
  have Hy := g.dot_walk s hs true
  simp only [curl,↓reduceIte,Bool.false_eq_true,one_mul,neg_mul,← sub_eq_add_neg] at Hx Hy
  have HE := tilt_rise _ hp (g.dot s) (g.cash s)
  unfold flow hero
  rw [Hx,Hy]
  refine ⟨?_,HE.1⟩
  unfold coin prize; split_ifs with H
  · have He (b : Bool) : |g.dot (s.smaller b)| ≤ 10*g.rate := (part_bounded _ _).trans (H _)
    apply HE.2 (Hx ▸ He false) (Hy ▸ He true)
  rw [part_zero]
  exact le_trans (by simpa only [ne_eq,OfNat.ofNat_ne_zero,not_false_eq_true,zero_pow] using
    (mul_nonneg hp (sq_nonneg (cash g s)))) HE.1

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Lens.swing_flow
statement:
lemma swing_flow (g : Lens M) (hp : 0 ≤ g.rate) (hs : Climb s) :
    (g.swing s)^2 ≤ 900*g.rate*(g.flow s)
proof:
:= by
  have Hx := g.dot_limit _ (hs.child false); have Hy := g.dot_limit _ (hs.child true)
  have H := tilt_lip _ hp _ _ Hx Hy
  have he : dot g (s.smaller false)-dot g (s.smaller true)=2*cash g s := by
    rw [dot_walk _ _ hs, dot_walk _ _ hs]; norm_num [curl]; ring
  rw [he,abs_mul,abs_of_nonneg (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)≤2)] at H
  change |hero g _-hero g _| ≤ _ at H
  have HH : |swing g s| ≤ 30*g.rate* |g.cash s| := by
    rw [swing,abs_div,abs_of_nonneg (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)≤2)]
    linarith
  have HV := pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) HH 2
  rw [sq_abs,mul_pow,sq_abs] at HV
  nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (coin_flow g hp hs).2 hp]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Lens.hero_drain
statement:
lemma hero_drain (g : Lens M) (hp : 0 ≤ g.rate) {b : Beat M} (hs : Ideal b.pre b.post) :
    |g.hero b.pre-g.hero b.post| ≤ 30*g.rate*killed b
proof:
:= by
  apply (tilt_lip _ hp _ _ (g.dot_limit _ hs.fit) (g.dot_limit _ hs.climb.fit)).trans
  apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (by positivity)
  unfold dot; rw [←part_diff]
  exact (part_bounded _ _).trans (scalar_drain hs _)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.curl_unit
statement: lemma curl_unit (b : Bool) : |curl b|=1
proof: := by cases b <;> norm_num [curl]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.curl_sq
statement: lemma curl_sq (b : Bool) : (curl b)^2=1
proof: := by cases b <;> norm_num [curl]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.fair_av
statement: lemma fair_av (f : Bool→ℝ) : (uniform Bool).Ex f = (f false+f true)/2
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Ex,Fintype.sum_bool,uniform_apply,Fintype.card_bool,Nat.cast_ofNat]
  ring

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.jump_ideal
statement:
lemma jump_ideal {k} (h : Following j J f (.ran s q k))
    (hq : share s ≤ 4) : Ideal s q
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ha,hb,hc,hd,he,hk⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨hz,hH⟩ := share_small hd
  refine ⟨⟨⟨ha.within,ha.positive⟩,hb.1.flat ▸ hz,hq⟩,?_,hb.1⟩
  exact ⟨⟨⟨hc.within,hc.positive⟩,hz,hH.trans (by norm_num)⟩,(rooted _ (hk false)).within.2,hH⟩

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Climb.child
statement: lemma Climb.child {q : Scene M} (h : Climb q) (b) : Fit (q.smaller b)
proof:
:=
  let hx := h.fit.ready
  ⟨⟨q.here.child_ok hx.1.1 h.deep b,hx.2⟩,h.fit.pos,
    share_child q hx.1.1 h.deep hx.2 h.fit.pos h.tight b⟩

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Ideal.kill_eq
statement:
lemma Ideal.kill_eq {B : Beat M} (h : Ideal B.pre B.post) :
    killed B = share B.pre-share B.post
proof:
:= by
  rw [killed,sub_div]; unfold share; rw [h.lower.flat]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Ideal.kill_nonneg
statement:
lemma Ideal.kill_nonneg {B : Beat M} (h : Ideal B.pre B.post) :
    0 ≤ killed B
proof:
:= div_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr
      (h.lower.mass_le h.fit.ready.2 h.fit.ready.1)) h.fit.pos.le

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.trip_head
statement:
lemma trip_head {x : Grid M} {l : Path M} (h : Trip x s l) :
    Fit s ∧ x∈s.here.block M
proof:
:= by
  induction l generalizing s with
  | nil => exact h
  | cons b l ih =>
    obtain ⟨rfl,ha,hb⟩ := h
    refine ⟨ha.fit,?_⟩
    have hi := (ih hb).2
    rw [← ha.lower.here]
    exact block_of_below (child_below _ _) _ hi

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.stream_child
statement:
lemma stream_child {s q : Scene M} {x : Grid M} (h : Less s q) (hx : x∈s.here.block M) :
    x ∈ (q.smaller ((step q).bit x)).here.block M
proof:
:= by
  change x ∈ (child q.here _).block M
  let b (x : Grid M) := decide (x∈q.here.R.block M)
  change x ∈ (child q.here (b x)).block M
  by_cases HH : x∈q.here.R.block M
  · rw [show b x=true from decide_eq_true HH]; exact HH
  · rw [show b x=false from decide_eq_false HH]
    rw [← h.here,block_union] at hx
    exact hx.resolve_right HH

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.trip_stream
statement:
lemma trip_stream {x : Grid M} (t : Thread M s) (h : t.Following j J f)
    (hf : Fit s) (hx : x∈s.here.block M) : Trip x s (stream t x)
proof:
:= by
  induction t with
  | blank => exact ⟨hf,hx⟩
  | ran s q k ih =>
    have H := jump_ideal h hf.lift
    let b := (step q).bit x
    exact ⟨rfl,H,ih b (h.2.2.2.2.2 b) (H.climb.child b) (stream_child H.lower hx)⟩

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.trip_cut
statement:
lemma trip_cut {x : Grid M} {l r : Path M} (h : Trip x s (l++r)) :
    Trip x s l ∧ ∃ s, Trip x s r
proof:
:= by
  induction l generalizing s with
  | nil => exact ⟨trip_head h,⟨_,h⟩⟩
  | cons b l ih =>
    obtain ⟨rfl,hh,hk⟩ := h
    obtain ⟨h₁,h₂⟩ := ih hk
    exact ⟨⟨rfl,hh,h₁⟩,h₂⟩

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.heav_bit
statement:
lemma heav_bit (p : Node) (b : Bool) (x : Grid M) (h : x∈(p.child b).block M) :
    p.Hi (pos x)=curl b
proof: := by cases b; exact p.Hi_L h; exact p.Hi_R h

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Gi_half
statement:
lemma Gi_half (p : Node) (b : Bool) (x : Grid M) (h : x∈(p.child b).block M) :
    p.Gi (pos x)=curl b * (p.child b).Hi (pos x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Gi_eq]
  have H := Set.disjoint_left.mp (p.block_separate M)
  cases b
  · rw [p.R.Hi_out (show x ∉ p.R.block M from H h)]
    change _=1*p.L.Hi (pos x); ring
  · rw [p.L.Hi_out (show x∉ p.L.block M from fun H' => H H' h)]
    change _= -1*p.R.Hi (pos x); ring

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.trip_delay
statement:
lemma trip_delay {x : Grid M} {c d : Beat M} {l : Path M}
    (h : Trip x s (c::d::l)) : blow x c=curl c.bit*curl d.bit
proof:
:= by
  have hx := (trip_head h.2.2).2
  obtain ⟨ha,hb,hH,hd,he⟩ := h
  have hE : (c.post.here.child c.bit)=d.post.here := by
    change (winds c).here=_
    rw [← hH,hd.lower.here]
  unfold blow; rw [Gi_half _ _ _ hx,hE]
  rw [heav_bit _ _ _ (trip_head he).2]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.trip_final
statement:
lemma trip_final {x : Grid M} {b : Beat M} {l : Path M}
    (h : Trip x s (b::l)) : |blow x b|=1
proof:
:= by
  have hx := (trip_head h.2.2).2
  unfold blow; rw [Gi_half _ _ _ hx,abs_mul,curl_unit,one_mul]
  let p := (winds b).here
  change x ∈ p.block M at hx
  change |p.Hi (pos x)|=1
  rw [block_union] at hx
  rcases hx with hx|hx
  · rw [p.Hi_L hx]; norm_num
  · rw [p.Hi_R hx]; norm_num

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.subtotal_nil
statement: lemma subtotal_nil {E : Type*} [AddMonoid E] (f : Beat M→E) : subtotal f [] = 0
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.subtotal_cons
statement:
lemma subtotal_cons {E : Type*} [AddMonoid E] (f : Beat M→E) (b : Beat M) (l : Path M) :
    subtotal f (b::l)=f b+subtotal f l
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.subtotal_app
statement:
lemma subtotal_app {E : Type*} [AddMonoid E] (f : Beat M→E) (l r : Path M) :
    subtotal f (l++r)=subtotal f l+subtotal f r
proof: := by simp only [subtotal, List.map_append,List.sum_append]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.trip_subtotal
proof:
:= by
  induction l generalizing s with
  | nil => simp only [subtotal_nil,le_refl]
  | cons b l ih => exact add_le_add (hp b h.2.1) (ih h.2.2)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.trip_nonneg
proof:
:= by
  induction l generalizing s with
  | nil => exact le_rfl
  | cons b l ih => exact add_nonneg (hp _ h.2.1) (ih h.2.2)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.trip_K
statement: lemma trip_K {x : Grid M} {l : Path M} (h : Trip x s l) : 0 ≤ fullKills l
proof:
:=
    trip_nonneg h (fun _ H => H.kill_nonneg)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Troupe.rec_one
statement: lemma rec_one (g : Grade) (u : Grid M) (l : Path M) : 1 ≤ recital g u l
proof:
:= by
  unfold recital; split; exact Run.Streak.sumbling_one _ _ _; exact cold_one _ _ _

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Troupe.amount_limits
statement: lemma amount_limits (s : Scene M) (j : ℕ) : 1 ≤ amount s j ∧ height j ≤ amount s j
proof:
:=
    let H := d_pos j
    have hh : 0 ≤ max (-log s.norm) 0 := le_max_right _ _
    by unfold amount; constructor <;> linarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Troupe.cut_nonneg
statement: lemma cut_nonneg (g : Grade) (s : Scene M) (j : ℕ) : 0 ≤ cutBook g s j
proof:
:= by
  unfold cutBook scLimit; split
  · exact (kappa_pos _ (by unfold codeWeight;
                           unfold capA reserve; norm_num) j _).le
  · have he := d_pos j
    have hh := le_max_right (-log s.norm) 0
    positivity

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Troupe.cover_limit
statement:
lemma cover_limit (s : Scene M) (g : Grade) (j J : ℕ) (hs : s.Safe j J f)
    (hp : Climb s) (h : s.settled j) (hg : entitled g s j)
    (hF : ∀ i,f i ≤ exp (height j)):
    ((net s j g.i g.main).card:ℝ) ≤ exp (cutBook g s j)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hx : g.main=true
  · rw [cutBook,ite_eq_left hx,hx]
    apply net_len_main _ _ _ _ h (hg hx).2
    have HH := (hg hx).1
    unfold testIx; omega
  unfold cutBook; rw [ite_eq_right hx]
  rw [show g.main=false from Bool.eq_false_iff.mpr hx]
  exact net_len_scalar _ _ hp.fit.ready hp.deep hp.fit.pos hp.tight (fun i => (hs.sub i).trans (hF i))

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Troupe.burst_pos
statement:
lemma burst_pos (p : Plot) (s : Scene M) (j : ℕ) (l : Path M) :
    0 ≤ burst p s j l
proof:
:=
  Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => le_trans (by norm_num) (rec_one (grade p) i l)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Troupe.show_one
statement:
lemma show_one (p : Plot) (c : Board M) (j : ℕ) (l : Path M) :
    1 ≤ showScore p c j l
proof:
:= by
  induction l generalizing c with
  | nil => exact le_rfl
  | cons b l ih =>
    rw [showScore]
    split; exact le_trans (ih _) (le_add_of_nonneg_left (by split; apply burst_pos; norm_num))
    exact le_rfl

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Troupe.paint_birth
statement:
lemma paint_birth :
    ∀ᶠ j : ℕ in atTop, ∀ (M J : ℕ) (s : Scene M)
      (t : Thread M s) (f : Grid M → ℝ) (p : Plot),
      Following j J f t → Fit s → entitled (grade p) s j →
      (∀ x, f x ≤ exp (height j)) → ∀ c : Board M,
        stats t (showScore p c j) ≤ 1+sticker s (grade p) j*stats t (minted p c)
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [Run.Streak.expected_bling] with j hB M J s t f p h hh hG hF c
  let g := grade p
  induction t generalizing c with
  | blank s =>
    rw [stats_nil,stats_nil]
    change (1:ℝ) ≤ 1+_*0; ring_nf; exact le_rfl
  | ran s q k ih =>
    let t := ran s q k
    let v := turn p c q
    let R := sticker s g j
    let h₀ := h
    have hK := jump_ideal h hh.lift
    have hC : cutBook g q j=cutBook g s j := by unfold cutBook scLimit; rw [hK.lower.flat]
    have HE : amount q j=amount s j := by unfold amount; rw [hK.lower.flat]
    have hR (b : Bool) : sticker (q.smaller b) g j=R := by change sticker q g j=R; unfold R sticker; rw [hC, HE]
    have hz : entitled g q j := fun hi => ⟨(hG hi).1,hK.lower.mode.trans (hG hi).2⟩
    obtain ⟨ha,hb,hc,hd,ht,hk⟩ := h
    let x := amount s j; let C (l : Path M) := burst p q j l
    have Hc : stats t C ≤ R := by
      let e := net q j p.ix p.main
      have HX : (e.card:ℝ) ≤ exp (cutBook g s j) := hC ▸ cover_limit q g j J hc hK.climb ht hz hF
      have Hi (u) : stats t (recital g u) ≤ 10^30*x^3 := by
        have h1 : 1 ≤ x ∧ height j ≤ x := amount_limits s j
        have h3 : 1 ≤ x^3 := one_le_pow₀ h1.1
        unfold recital
        by_cases H : g.main=true
        · simp_rw [ite_eq_left H]
          apply le_trans (hB M J s q f k h₀ hh (hz H).2 hF (rose g u) (hG H).1)
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (pow_le_pow_left₀ (d_pos j).le h1.2 _) (by norm_num)
        simp_rw [ite_eq_right H]
        exact le_trans (cold_mean _ _ t h₀) (by linarith)
      calc
        _ = ∑ y∈e, stats t (recital g y) := Ex_finset_sum _ _ _
        _ ≤ ∑ _y∈e, (10:ℝ)^30*x^3 := Finset.sum_le_sum fun y _ => Hi y
        _ ≤ _ := by
          simp only [Finset.sum_const,nsmul_eq_mul]
          unfold R sticker; change (e.card:ℝ)*_ ≤ 10^30*x^3*_
          rw [mul_comm (10^30*x^3)]
          apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right HX
          have h1 : 1 ≤ x := (amount_limits s j).1; positivity
    have HV := stats_cons h₀
    rw [stats_cons h₀,stats_cons h₀]
    have HI (b : Bool) : stats (k b) (showScore p v j) ≤ 1+R*stats (k b) (minted p v) :=
      let H := ih b (hk b) (hK.climb.child b) (show entitled g _ j from hz) v
      hR b ▸ H
    let U := uniform Bool
    have H := U.Ex_mono HI
    rw [Ex_add (f:=fun _ => _),Ex_const,Ex_lmul] at H
    change stats (ran s q k) C ≤ R at Hc
    rw [stats_cons h₀] at Hc
    by_cases HA : cardStep p (turn p c q) <;> by_cases HP : freshAt p c q
    all_goals
      simp_rw [showScore, boom, minted]
      simp only [HA,HP,birth,ite_false,ite_true]
      unfold t v R C U at *
      unfold stats at *
      try simp_rw [Ex_add]
      simp_rw [Ex_const]
      unfold g grade at *
      linarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.caveat_pos
statement: lemma caveat_pos (s : Scene M) (j : ℕ) (h : Fit s) : 0 ≤ caveat s j
proof:
:= by
  have he : 0 ≤ s.mass := avg_nonneg _ fun x _ => h.ready.2 _
  unfold caveat
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le he with he|he
  · unfold share; rw [← he,zero_div,zero_mul]
  exact mul_nonneg (div_nonneg he.le h.pos.le)
    (add_nonneg (deficit_nonneg s h.ready.1 h.ready.2 he _)
      (inv_nonneg.mpr (minimum_pos j).le))

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.caveat_step
statement:
lemma caveat_step {s q : Scene M} {l} (h : Following j J f (ran s q l)) (hh : Ideal s q) :
    (uniform Bool).Ex (fun b => caveat (q.smaller b) j) + (1/4:ℝ)*fax q ≤ caveat s j
proof:
:= by
  let U := (step q).probs; let v := (keep s q).snip; let Q := v.probs
  let Z := channel (dye q); let H (x) := deficit x Z; let a := (minimumT j)⁻¹
  have hm := pre_pos h
  have HE : Q.entropy ≤ a*Q false := debt_at h
  obtain ⟨hh1,hh2,h3⟩ := hh
  obtain ⟨ha,hb,hv,hp',ht,hs⟩ := h
  have hR : q.here.lev < M := (rooted _ (hs false)).within.2
  have hS : ReadyAt s := ⟨ha.within,ha.positive⟩; have hS' : ReadyAt q := ⟨hv.within,hv.positive⟩
  have hd := hh1.pos
  have hQ := hp'.1.2.2; have hZ := hh2.fit.pos
  have hM := keep_true hb.1 hS hS' hm
  have h₂ : Q true*(H q+a) ≤ H s+a := by
    have hi (b : Bool) : levels (v.dst b)=levels s := by
      unfold levels; rw [show (v.dst b).here=s.here from keep_here hb.1 _]
    have hz : Q.Ex (fun b => H (v.dst b)) ≤ H s+Q.entropy := by
      have hh := old_entropy_cost v Z
      have hh' := conditioned_balance Z v hM
      unfold H deficit; simp_rw [hi,Ex_sub (f:=fun _ => levels s),Ex_const]
      change v.probs.Ex _+ _ = s.actor.privateH Z at hh'
      unfold Q; linarith
    have hZ : 0 ≤ Q false * H (v.dst false) := by
      rcases eq_or_lt_of_le (Q.nonneg false) with h|h
      · rw [← h,zero_mul]
      have HH := other_ok hb.1 hS
      exact mul_nonneg h.le (deficit_nonneg (v.dst false) HH.1 HH.2 ((true_mass hM).mp h) Z)
    have ht₁ : Q true + Q false = 1 := by simpa only [Fintype.sum_bool] using Q.total
    rw [Ex,Fintype.sum_bool] at hz
    rw [show v.dst true=q from rfl] at hz
    nlinarith [show a*(Q true+Q false)=a by rw [ht₁]; ring]
  have ht₁ := space_deficit q Z hv.within.1 hR hv.positive hQ hZ
  let D (b : Bool) := H (q.smaller b)+a
  have h₁ :
      (uniform Bool).Ex (fun b => caveat (q.smaller b) j) =
        share q * U.Ex D := by
    have HI (b : Bool) : caveat (q.smaller b) j =
        (q.smaller b).mass * (q.norm⁻¹ * D b) := by unfold caveat D H; simp only [smaller]; unfold share Z dye a; dsimp; ring
    simp_rw [HI]
    rw [← output_split _ hv.within.1 hR hv.positive hQ (fun b => q.norm⁻¹*D b),
      Ex_lmul]
    unfold share U; ring
  have HZ : share q * ((1/4:ℝ)*(q.norm/q.mass)*fax q)=1/4*fax q := by
    unfold share; field_simp
  have hEq : share q = share s * Q true := by
    have H := kept_mass hb.1 hS hS' hm
    unfold share
    nth_rw 1 [H,hb.1.flat]
    unfold Q v; ring
  rw [h₁,← HZ,← mul_add]
  unfold D; rw [Ex_add (g:=fun b => a),Ex_const]
  have hDC : caveat s j=share s*(H s+a) := by unfold caveat H Z dye a; rw [hb.1.fund]
  have hsq : 0 ≤ share q := div_nonneg hQ.le hZ.le
  calc
    _ ≤ share q*(H q+a) := by
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ hsq
      change U.Ex (fun i => H (q.smaller i))+(1/4:ℝ)*(q.norm/q.mass)*fax q ≤ H q at ht₁
      linarith
    _ ≤ _ := by
      rw [hEq,mul_assoc,hDC]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h₂ (div_nonneg hm.le hd.le)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.stats_cons
statement:
lemma stats_cons {s q : Scene M} {k} (h : Following j J f (ran s q k)) (F : Path M → ℝ) :
    stats (ran s q k) F =
      (uniform Bool).Ex (fun b => stats (k b) (fun l => F (⟨s,q,b⟩::l)))
proof:
:=
  stream_branch k h (fun l _ => F l)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.stat_pay
statement:
lemma stat_pay (s : Scene M) (t : Thread M s) (g : Beat M → ℝ) :
    stats t (subtotal g)=Thread.fee t g
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.stats_nil
statement: lemma stats_nil (s : Scene M) (F : Path M → ℝ) : stats (blank s) F=F []
proof: := by simp [stats,stream,Ex_const]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.stats_plus
statement:
lemma stats_plus {s : Scene M} (t : Thread M s) (f g : Path M → ℝ) :
    stats t (fun l => f l+g l)=stats t f+stats t g
proof:
:=
    Ex_add _ (f:=fun _ => f _) (g:=fun _ => g _)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.stats_fix
statement: lemma stats_fix {s : Scene M} (t : Thread M s) (r : ℝ) : stats t (fun _ => r)=r
proof:
:=
    Ex_const _ _

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.caveat_total
statement:
lemma caveat_total {s : Scene M} (t : Thread M s) (h : Following j J f t) (hp : Fit s) :
    stats t fullFax ≤ 4*caveat s j
proof:
:= by
  change t.fee billFax ≤ _
  induction t with
  | blank s =>
    change stats (blank s) fullFax ≤ _
    rw [stats_nil, show fullFax (M:=M) [] = 0 from rfl]
    linarith [caveat_pos s j hp]
  | ran s q k ih =>
    have hx := jump_ideal h hp.lift
    have HH := caveat_step h hx
    rw [fee_ran _ h,Ex_add,show (uniform Bool).Ex (fun b : Bool => billFax ⟨s,q,b⟩) = fax q from by unfold billFax; exact Ex_const (uniform Bool) (fax q)]
    apply le_trans (b:=fax q+(uniform Bool).Ex fun b => 4*caveat (q.smaller b) j)
    · gcongr
      apply Ex_mono
      intro b
      exact ih b (h.2.2.2.2.2 b) (hx.climb.child b)
    rw [Ex_lmul]; linarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.showers_total
statement:
lemma showers_total (e : Streak M)
    {s : Scene M} (t : Thread M s) (h : Following j J f t) (hp : Fit s) :
    stats t e.showers ≤ 4-energy s e.u+8*stats t fullKills
proof:
:= by
  let g (b : Beat M) := shower e.u b.post
  change t.fee g ≤ 4-energy s e.u+8*t.fee killed
  induction t with
  | blank s =>
    have Hh := (energy_small hp e.u).2.trans hp.lift
    simp [Thread.fee,stream,Ex_const]; linarith
  | ran s q k ih =>
    let U := uniform Bool
    have H := jump_ideal h hp.lift
    have HE (b : Bool) := ih b (h.2.2.2.2.2 b) (H.climb.child _)
    rw [fee_ran _ h,fee_ran _ h]
    simp_rw [Ex_add]
    rw [Ex_const U (shower e.u q)]
    have HH : U.Ex (fun b => energy (q.smaller b) e.u) = energy q e.u+shower e.u q := by
      rw [show U=uniform Bool from rfl,fair_av]; exact wet_average q H.climb e.u
    have HF := (energy_drain (b:=⟨s,q,false⟩) H e.u)
    let K := killed (Thread.Beat.mk s q false)
    have HR : (uniform Bool).Ex (fun b => killed ⟨s,q,b⟩) = K := Ex_const U K
    have HT := U.Ex_mono HE
    rw [Ex_add,Ex_lmul,Ex_sub (f:=fun _=> 4),Ex_const,HH] at HT
    rw [HR]
    change |energy s _-energy q _| ≤ 8*K at HF
    change shower e.u q + U.Ex _ ≤ _ +8*(K+U.Ex _)
    linarith [(abs_le.mp HF).2]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.flag_point
statement:
lemma flag_point (s : Scene M) (e : Streak M) :
    e.b^2* e.flag s ≤ 128*surcharge s true (e.i-1)
proof:
:= by
  unfold Streak.flag
  split_ifs with h
  · rw [surcharge,ite_eq_left h.2]
    apply le_trans (b:=128*gateWidth true (e.i-1))
    · change side e.i^2*1 ≤ 128*(side (e.i-1)^2 / 128)
      have hh : side e.i ≤ side (e.i-1) :=
        pow_le_pow_of_le_one (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by omega)
      nlinarith [side_pos e.i]
    · exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h.2 (by norm_num)
  rw [mul_zero]
  exact mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (surcharge_nonneg s true _)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.flag_total
statement:
lemma flag_total (e : Streak M) {s : Scene M} (t : Thread M s) :
    e.b^2 * stats t e.flagged ≤
      128 * Thread.fee t (fun b => surcharge b.post true (e.i-1))
proof:
:= by
  change e.b^2 * t.fee _ ≤ _

  unfold Thread.fee
  rw [← Ex_lmul,← Ex_lmul]
  apply Ex_mono; intro x
  generalize t.stream x = l
  induction l with
  | nil => change _*0 ≤ _*0; exact le_of_eq (by ring)
  | cons b l ih =>
    rw [List.map_cons,List.sum_cons,List.map_cons,List.sum_cons]
    linarith [flag_point b.post e]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.sum_budget_run
statement:
lemma sum_budget_run :
    ∀ᶠ j : ℕ in atTop,
      ∀ M J : ℕ, ∀ f : Grid M → ℝ, ∀ s q : Scene M, ∀ k,
        Following j J f (.ran s q k) → Fit s → q.live=true →
        (∀ x, f x ≤ exp (height j)) →
        ∀ e : Streak M,
          let v
proof:
:= ran s q k
          stats v fullKills ≤ 4 ∧ stats v e.showers ≤ 36 ∧
            stats v fullFax ≤ 10^26*height j ∧ e.b^2 * stats v e.flagged ≤ 10^6*height j := by
  filter_upwards [segment_cost,side_deficit, hpoly 12800 32] with j h1 h2 ht
    M J f s q k h hh hx hF e v
  have hk := jump_ideal h hh.lift
  have hq := pre_pos h
  have hR : q.mass ≤ s.mass := hk.lower.mass_le hh.ready.2 hh.ready.1
  have hT := h.2.2.2.1.2.1
  let d := height j
  have hM : exp (-d) ≤ q.mass := le_of_not_gt (fun H => hT ⟨hx,Or.inr H⟩)
  have hE : -d ≤ log s.mass := by
    rw [←log_exp (-d)]
    exact log_le_log (exp_pos _) (hM.trans hR)
  have he : (minimumT j)⁻¹ ≤ height j := by unfold minimumT; rw [one_div,inv_inv]; exact ht
  have HP : stats v fullKills ≤ 4 :=
    le_trans (deaths v h hh.pos) hh.lift
  refine ⟨HP, le_trans (showers_total e v h hh)
    (by linarith [(energy_small hh e.u).1]),le_trans (caveat_total v h hh) ?_,
      le_trans (flag_total e v) ?_⟩
  · have HL := h2 M J s f (rooted _ h) hF hq
    have HJ : 0 ≤ share s ∧ share s ≤ 4 := ⟨share_pos' _ hh.ready hh.pos.le,hh.lift⟩
    have HY : 0 ≤ deficit s (channel (dye s)) := deficit_nonneg s hh.ready.1 hh.ready.2 hq _
    unfold caveat
    have h₃ : deficit s (channel (dye s)) + (minimumT j)⁻¹ ≤ 10^23*d+d+d := by
      change deficit s _ ≤ _ at HL; unfold dye d at *; linarith
    have h₄ : 0 ≤ d := (d_pos j).le
    change _ ≤ 10^26*d
    nlinarith
  · have H₁ := h1 M J s f v h hF hq hh.pos (fun _ => e.i-1) true
    have H₂ : 0 ≤ s.mass/s.norm := div_nonneg hq.le hh.pos.le
    have H₃ : s.mass/s.norm ≤ 4 := hh.lift
    have H₄ : 128*(2*height j-log s.mass) ≤ 384*d := by unfold d at *; linarith
    have h₄ : 0 ≤ d := (d_pos j).le
    nlinarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Desk.peak_base
statement:
lemma peak_base (A : Desk M E) (e : E) (a r : ℝ) (l : Path M) :
    r ≤ peak A e a r l
proof:
:= by
  induction l generalizing e a r with
  | nil => exact le_rfl
  | cons b l ih =>
    apply le_trans (le_max_left r (a+A.pay e b))
    apply ih

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Desk.peak_on
statement:
lemma peak_on (A : Desk M E) (e : E) (a r : ℝ) (h : a ≤ r) (l m : Path M) :
    a+tally A e l ≤ peak A e a r (l++m)
proof:
:= by
  induction l generalizing e a r with
  | nil => simpa only [List.nil_append,tally,add_zero] using h.trans (peak_base A e a r m)
  | cons b l ih =>
    rw [tally,← add_assoc]; exact ih _ _ _ (le_max_right r _)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Desk.heatW_one
statement: lemma heatW_one (A : Desk M E) (e : E) (l : Path M) : 1 ≤ heatW A e l
proof:
:=
    one_le_exp (by linarith [peak_base A e 0 0 l])

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Desk.edge_score
statement:
lemma edge_score (A : Desk M E) (e : E) (l m : Path M) :
    A.tally e l ≤ 2*log (heatW A e (l++m))
proof:
:= by
  rw [heatW,log_exp]; linarith [peak_on A e 0 0 (le_refl _) l m]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Desk.purses_high
statement: private lemma purses_high (a r : ℝ) : purses a (max r a) ≤ purses a r
proof:
:= by
  cases le_total a r with
  | inl h => rw [max_eq_left h]
  | inr h =>
    rw [max_eq_right h]; unfold purses
    let x := exp (r/4); let y := exp (a/2-r/4)
    have h1 : exp (r/2)=x^2 := by unfold x; rw [pow_two,← exp_add]; ring_nf
    have h2 : exp (a-r/2)=y^2 := by unfold y; rw [pow_two,← exp_add]; ring_nf
    have h3 : exp (a/2)=x*y := by unfold x y; rw [← exp_add]; ring_nf
    rw [show a-a/2=a/2 by ring,h1,h2,h3]; nlinarith [sq_nonneg (x-y)]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Desk.single_mean
statement:
private lemma single_mean (x : ℝ) :
    (uniform Bool).Ex (fun i => exp (single x i)) ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [fair_av]; unfold single
  change (exp (1*x-x^2/2)+exp (-1*x-x^2/2))/2 ≤ _
  rw [one_mul,neg_one_mul,exp_sub,exp_sub,← add_div,
    div_right_comm (_+_) (exp _),← cosh_eq]
  exact (div_le_one (exp_pos _)).mpr (cosh_le_exp_half_sq _)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Desk.peak_mean
statement:
lemma peak_mean (A : Desk M E) (t : Thread M s) (h : t.Following j J f) (e : E) (a r : ℝ) :
    (s.here.dice M).Ex (fun x => exp (peak A e a r (t.stream x)/2)) ≤
      exp (r/2)+exp (a-r/2)
proof:
:= by
  induction t generalizing e a r with
  | blank s =>
    change (s.here.dice M).Ex (fun _ => exp (r/2)) ≤ _
    rw [Ex_const]; exact le_add_of_nonneg_right (exp_pos _).le
  | ran s q k ih =>
    rw [stream_branch _ h (fun l _ => exp (peak A e a r l/2))]
    let p := A.stake e s q
    let w (b : Bool) := a+single p b
    let P := uniform Bool
    apply le_trans (b:=P.Ex fun i => purses (w i) r)
    · apply Ex_mono; intro b
      exact le_trans (ih b (h.2.2.2.2.2 b) _ _ _) (purses_high (w b) r)
    simp only [purses,w]
    have H (i : Bool) : exp (a+single p i-r/2)=exp (a-r/2)*exp (single p i) := by
      rw [← exp_add]; congr 1; ring
    simp_rw [H,Ex_add _ (f:=fun _ => _),Ex_const,Ex_lmul]
    apply add_le_add_right
    exact mul_le_of_le_one_right (exp_pos _).le (single_mean _)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Paths.Desk.heat_bound
statement:
lemma heat_bound (A : Desk M E) (t : Thread M s) (h : t.Following j J f) (e : E) :
    (s.here.dice M).Ex (fun x => A.heatW e (t.stream x)) ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  have H := A.peak_mean t h e 0 0
  change (s.here.dice M).Ex (fun x => A.heatW e (t.stream x)) ≤ _ at H
  norm_num at H; exact H

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.ante_nonneg
statement: lemma ante_nonneg (s : Scene M) (hs : 0 ≤ s.wage) (hp : 0 ≤ s.norm) (x : Grid M) : 0 ≤ ante s x
proof:
:=
    wt_nonneg _ hs hp _

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.ante_total
statement: lemma ante_total (s : Scene M) (hp : s.here.ok M) : ∑ x, ante s x = share s
proof: := wt_total _ hp _ _

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.ante_split
statement:
lemma ante_split (s : Scene M) (hp : s.here.valid) (hM : s.here.lev < M) (x : Grid M) :
    ante (s.smaller false) x + ante (s.smaller true) x=2*ante s x
proof:
:= by
  unfold ante
  simp only [smaller, wt_half hp hM]
  by_cases hh : x∈s.here.block M
  · have h₁ := Set.disjoint_left.mp (s.here.block_separate M)
    rw [block_union] at hh
    rcases hh with hh|hh
    · simp [child,hh,h₁ hh]
    · have h2 : x∉s.here.L.block M := fun he => h₁ he hh
      simp [child,hh,h2]
  · have h (b : Bool) : ¬ x∈(s.here.child b).block M := fun h => hh
      (block_of_below (child_below _ _) _ h)
    simp_rw [ite_eq_right (h _),wt,dice_apply ⟨hp,hM.le⟩,ite_eq_right hh,zero_mul,zero_div]
    ring

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.share_split
statement:
lemma share_split (s : Scene M) :
    share (s.smaller false)+share (s.smaller true)=2*share s
proof:
:= by
  unfold share mass; rw [show s.here.avg s.wage = _ from s.here.avg_split_real s.wage]
  dsimp only [smaller,child]; ring

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.nonnegative_hist
statement:
lemma nonnegative_hist (s : Scene M) (hs : 0 ≤ s.wage) (hp : 0 ≤ s.norm) (k : Grid M → Law α)
    (z : α) : 0 ≤ hist s k z
proof:
:=
  Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => mul_nonneg (ante_nonneg s hs hp _) ((k i).nonneg _)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.total_hist
statement:
lemma total_hist (s : Scene M) (hp : s.here.ok M) (k : Grid M → Law α) :
    ∑ z, hist s k z=share s
proof:
:= by
  unfold hist
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  simp_rw [← Finset.mul_sum, Law.total,mul_one]
  exact ante_total s hp

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.rung_mono
statement:
lemma rung_mono (s : Scene M) (hs : 0 ≤ s.wage) (hp : 0 ≤ s.norm) (k : Grid M → Law α)
    (f g : Grid M → α → ℝ) (h : ∀ i j, f i j ≤ g i j) :
    rung s k f ≤ rung s k g
proof:
:=
  Finset.sum_le_sum fun _ _ => Finset.sum_le_sum fun _ _ => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (h _ _)
    (mul_nonneg (ante_nonneg _ hs hp _) ((k _).nonneg _))

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.rung_const
statement:
lemma rung_const (s : Scene M) (hp : s.here.ok M) (k : Grid M → Law α) (c : ℝ) :
    rung s k (fun _ _ => c) = share s*c
proof:
:= by
  unfold rung; rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  simp_rw [← Finset.sum_mul]
  rw [← total_hist s hp k]
  rfl

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.rung_add
statement:
lemma rung_add (s : Scene M) (k : Grid M → Law α) (f g : Grid M → α → ℝ) :
    rung s k (fun i j => f i j + g i j)=rung s k f+rung s k g
proof:
:= by
  unfold rung; simp_rw [mul_add,Finset.sum_add_distrib]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.rung_lmul
statement:
lemma rung_lmul (s : Scene M) (k : Grid M → Law α) (f : Grid M → α → ℝ) (c : ℝ) :
    rung s k (fun i j => c*f i j)=c*rung s k f
proof:
:= by
  unfold rung
  simp_rw [Finset.mul_sum,mul_left_comm c]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.rung_error
statement:
lemma rung_error (s : Scene M) (hs : 0 ≤ s.wage) (hp : 0 ≤ s.norm) (hv : s.here.ok M)
    (k : Grid M → Law α) {f g : Grid M → α → ℝ} {r : ℝ}
    (hh : ∀ i j, |f i j-g i j| ≤ r) :
    |rung s k f-rung s k g| ≤ share s*r
proof:
:= by
  have he {f g : Grid M → α → ℝ} (h : ∀ i j, f i j ≤ r+g i j) :
      rung s k f ≤ share s*r+rung s k g := by
    apply le_trans (rung_mono s hs hp _ _ _ h)
    rw [rung_add (f:=fun _ _ => r),rung_const _ hv]
  have h1 := he (f:=f) (g:=g) fun i j => by linarith [(abs_le.mp (hh i j)).2]
  have h2 := he (f:=g) (g:=f) fun i j => by linarith [(abs_le.mp (hh i j)).1]
  rw [abs_le]; constructor <;> linarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.rung_hist
statement:
lemma rung_hist (s : Scene M) (k : Grid M → Law α) (f : α→ℝ) :
    ∑ i, hist s k i*f i = rung s k (fun _ i => f i)
proof:
:= by
  unfold rung; rw [Finset.sum_comm]; simp_rw [hist,Finset.sum_mul]
  rfl

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.rung_split
statement:
lemma rung_split (s : Scene M) (hp : s.here.valid) (hh : s.here.lev < M)
    (k : Grid M → Law α) (f : Grid M → α → ℝ) :
    rung (s.smaller false) k f+rung (s.smaller true) k f= 2*rung s k f
proof:
:= by
  unfold rung
  rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]; simp_rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib,Finset.mul_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_; refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
  rw [addMass,addMass,← add_mul,← add_mul,ante_split s hp hh]
  unfold addMass; ring

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.hist_split
statement:
lemma hist_split (s : Scene M) (hp : s.here.valid) (hh : s.here.lev < M)
    (k : Grid M → Law α) (z : α) :
    hist (s.smaller false) k z + hist (s.smaller true) k z = 2*hist s k z
proof:
:= by
  unfold hist; rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib,Finset.mul_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i hi => ?_
  have H := ante_split s hp hh i
  unfold ante at H
  rw [← add_mul,H,mul_assoc]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.hist_le
statement:
lemma hist_le {s q : Scene M} (h : Less s q) (hs : ReadyAt s) (hh : 0 ≤ s.norm)
    (k : Grid M → Law α) (z : α) :
    hist q k z ≤ hist s k z
proof:
:= by
  unfold hist wt; rw [h.here,h.flat]
  refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ?_ ((k _).nonneg _)
  exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (h.antitone hs.2 i)
    ((s.here.dice M).nonneg i)) hh

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.fisher_range
statement:
lemma fisher_range (s : Scene M) (hp : s.here.valid) (hh : s.here.lev < M)
    (hs : 0 ≤ s.wage) (he : 0 ≤ s.norm) (k : Grid M → Law α) : 0 ≤ fisher s k ∧ fisher s k ≤ share s
proof:
:= by
  have hM := nonnegative_hist s hs he k
  constructor
  exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => div_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (hM i)
  rw [← total_hist s ⟨hp,hh.le⟩ k]
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum; intro i _
  have h1 (b : Bool) := nonnegative_hist (s.smaller b) hs he k i
  have h2 := hist_split _ hp hh k i
  unfold diff
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le (hM i) with hm|hm
  · rw [← hm,div_zero]
  apply (div_le_iff₀ hm).mpr
  nlinarith [h1 true,h1 false,mul_nonneg (h1 true) (h1 false)]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.fz_split
statement:
lemma fz_split (s : Scene M) (hp : s.here.valid) (hh : s.here.lev < M)
    (A : Form M) (i z : Grid M) :
    fz s.here.L s.wage s.norm A i z + fz s.here.R s.wage s.norm A i z =
      2*fz s.here s.wage s.norm A i z
proof:
:= by
  unfold fz omegaObs
  rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib,Finset.mul_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun x hx => ?_
  have H := ante_split s hp hh x
  simp_rw [ante,smaller,child] at H
  rw [← add_mul,← Complex.ofReal_add,← add_mul,H]
  push_cast; ring

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Thread.debt_at
statement:
lemma debt_at {s q : Scene M} {l} (h : Following j J f (ran s q l)) :
    let P
proof:
:= (keep s q).snip.probs
    entropy P ≤ (minimumT j)⁻¹*P false := by
  let v := keep s q
  intro P
  have hm := pre_pos h
  obtain ⟨ha,hb,hc,hd,he,hk⟩ := h
  have hf := kept_mass hb.1 ⟨ha.within,ha.positive⟩ ⟨hc.within,hc.positive⟩ hm
  change q.mass = P true * s.mass at hf
  have Ht : P true+P false=1 := by simpa [Fintype.sum_bool] using P.total
  rcases hb.2 with hh | hh
  · have hi : P true=1 := by nlinarith
    have hj : P false=0 := by linarith
    unfold entropy Law.crossE Ex
    simp [hi,hj]
  have hi : minimumT j ≤ P false := by nlinarith
  have hj : 1 ≤ (minimumT j)⁻¹ * P false := by
    rw [← div_eq_inv_mul]; exact (one_le_div (minimum_pos _)).mpr hi
  have HH := entropy_le_log_card P
  simp only [Fintype.card_bool,Nat.cast_ofNat] at HH
  linarith [log_le_sub_one_of_pos (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<2)]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Thread.debt_total
statement:
lemma debt_total (t : Thread M s) (h : Following j J f t) :
    (unfoldW t).spotDebt ≤ (minimumT j)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  let a := (minimumT j)⁻¹
  have hp := (inv_pos.mpr (minimum_pos j)).le
  induction t with
  | blank => rw [unfoldW,extraDebt]; exact hp
  | ran s q l ih =>
    let v := (keep s q).snip
    have hx := h.2.2.2.2.2
    have h0 : ∀ b, (unfoldW (l b)).spotDebt ≤ a := fun b => ih b (hx b)
    let K := Wire.link q true fun b => unfoldW (l b)
    have HE : K.spotDebt ≤ a := (Ex_mono _ h0).trans (Ex_const _ _).le
    have HM := debt_at h
    rw [unfoldW,splice,spotDebt,Ex,Fintype.sum_bool]
    change v.probs.entropy+(v.probs true*K.spotDebt+v.probs false*spotDebt (extra (other s q) _)) ≤ a
    rw [extraDebt,mul_zero,add_zero]
    have hQ : v.probs true + v.probs false = 1 := by simpa [Fintype.sum_bool] using v.probs.total
    change v.probs.entropy ≤ a * v.probs false at HM
    nlinarith [v.probs.nonneg true]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Thread.segment_cost
statement:
lemma segment_cost :
    ∀ᶠ j : ℕ in atTop, ∀ M J : ℕ, ∀ s : Scene M, ∀ f : Grid M → ℝ,
      ∀ t : Thread M s, Following j J f t → (∀ x, f x ≤ exp (height j)) →
        0 < s.mass → 0 < s.norm →
        ∀ (p : Policy M) (b : Bool), t.fee (fun i => surcharge i.post b (p i.post)) ≤
          s.mass/s.norm * (128*(2*height j-log s.mass))
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [hpoly 12800 32] with j hg M J s f t h hf hm hn p b
  rw [surcharge_wire _ _ _ h hm hn]
  let T := unfoldW t
  have hu := rooted _ h
  have hk := splice_valid t h
  have H := edge_total p b T hk hm 0 (fun _ => Or.inl rfl)
  have HX := due_all T true hk hm
  have HD : T.spotDebt ≤ height j :=
    (debt_total t h).trans (by
      unfold minimumT; rw [one_div,inv_inv]; exact hg)
  have hi := local_deficit_dry s (uniform Unit) hu.within hu.positive hm (height j) (fun x => le_trans (hu.sub x) (hf x))
  rw [deficit,privateH_const] at hi
  refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ (by positivity)
  change T.expenditure _ ≤ _
  norm_num at *; linarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Thread.side_deficit
statement:
lemma side_deficit :
    ∀ᶠ j : ℕ in atTop, ∀ M J : ℕ, ∀ s : Scene M, ∀ f : Grid M → ℝ,
      s.Safe j J f → (∀ x, f x ≤ exp (height j)) → 0 < s.mass →
      deficit s (channel s.fund.mood) ≤
        10^23*height j-log s.mass
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [Fund.fund_est, Fund.envelope_scale, hpoly (3000*capA) 1] with j hH hv h
    M J s f hs hf hm
  let p := s.here
  let c := s.fund
  let A := c.mood; let k := channel A
  let P := s.actor; let d := height j
  let v := fun _ : Grid M => uniform Unit
  let Q := channel (place c.anchor M) (c.anchor.start M)
  have hp := hs.capital
  have h1 := replace_signal P v k (fun _ => Q) (fun i t => ch_pos _ _ _)
  have hE : (P.withNext v).Ex (fun x => (k x.1).kl Q) ≤ F A-log c.anchor.invlen+300 := by
    rw [Ex_withNext]; simp_rw [Ex_const]
    rw [← Ex_const P (F A-log c.anchor.invlen+300)]
    apply Ex_mono_mem _
    intro x hx
    have he : x ∈ c.anchor.block M :=
      block_of_below hp.domain M (piece_support hs.within (actor_def hs.within hs.positive hm) _ hx)
    exact (kl_ex _ _).le.trans (side_entropy hp.effects _ he)
  have ht := local_deficit_dry s (uniform Unit) hs.within hs.positive hm d
    (fun x => (hs.sub x).trans (hf x))
  have hi := hp.solvent
  have H := hp.relative
  have HE := ((hH M).2 s.fund s.here hp).1
  have hr : 1 ≤ d := hv.2.2.1
  change c.bank ≤ (1000+ reserve capA)*d at hi
  change F A ≤ _+3000*c.uses+400*c.spend at H
  change c.spend ≤ 2*(c.bank+1) at HE
  have hT : 3000*(c.uses:ℝ) ≤ d := by
    rw [pow_one] at h
    have hx := hp.under; unfold d c; linarith
  change (P.withNext v).Ex _ ≤ F A-log c.anchor.invlen+300 at hE
  change levels s - P.privateH v ≤ _ at ht
  change levels s - P.privateH k ≤ 10^23*d-log s.mass
  apply le_trans (b:=d-log s.mass+ (F A-log c.anchor.invlen+300))
  · linarith
  unfold reserve capA at *
  change F A ≤ log c.anchor.invlen + _ + _ at H; linarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Thread.deaths
statement:
lemma deaths (t : Thread M s) (h : Following j J f t) (hr : 0 < s.norm) :
    t.fee killed ≤ s.mass/s.norm
proof:
:= by
  induction t with
  | blank =>
    simp [fee,stream,Ex_const]; exact div_nonneg (Thread.rooted _ h).mass_lower hr.le
  | ran s q k ih =>
    rw [fee_ran _ h]
    obtain ⟨ha,hb,hc,hd,he,hk⟩ := h
    let P := uniform Bool
    let F := fun b : Bool => (q.smaller b).mass
    have hi (b : Bool) : (k b).fee killed ≤ F b/q.norm := by
      apply ih b (hk b)
      change 0 < q.norm; rw [hb.1.flat]; exact hr
    rw [Ex_add,show (fun b : Bool => killed ⟨s,q,b⟩) = (fun _ => (s.mass-q.mass)/s.norm) from rfl,Ex_const]
    have hh := P.Ex_mono hi
    rw [show P.Ex (fun b => F b / q.norm)=P.Ex F / q.norm by simp_rw [div_eq_mul_inv, Ex_mul]] at hh
    have HX : P.Ex F=q.mass := by
      unfold P F mass; rw [Ex,Fintype.sum_bool, uniform_apply,uniform_apply,Fintype.card_bool,Nat.cast_ofNat]
      simp only [smaller,child]
      rw [avg_split_real q.here]; ring
    rw [HX,hb.1.flat] at hh
    change _ + P.Ex _ ≤ _
    linarith [show (s.mass-q.mass)/s.norm=s.mass/s.norm-q.mass/s.norm by ring]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Thread.keep_here
statement: lemma keep_here (h : Less s q) (b) : ((keep s q).dst b).here=s.here
proof: := by cases b; rfl; exact h.here

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Thread.other_ok
statement: lemma other_ok (h : Less s q) (he : ReadyAt s) : ReadyAt (other s q)
proof:
:=
  ⟨he.1,sub_nonneg.mpr (h.antitone he.2)⟩

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Thread.keep_true
statement:
lemma keep_true (h : Less s q) (hs : ReadyAt s) (ht : ReadyAt q) (hm : 0 < s.mass) :
    (keep s q).snip.TrueLaw
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨weight_pos.mpr hm,?_⟩
  intro b x
  have HR := actor_weight (s:=s) hs.1 hs.2 x
  have HQ := actor_weight (s:=q) ht.1 ht.2 x
  have he := other_ok h hs
  have HE := actor_weight (s:=other s q) he.1 he.2 x
  rw [show (keep s q).snip.src=s from rfl,HR]
  cases b
  case true =>
    change q.weight* q.actor x = _
    rw [HQ]; unfold insideW; rw [h.here]
    by_cases HH : 0 < q.wage x
    · have hx := (h.coins x).resolve_right HH.ne'
      simp only [TossUp.snip,keep,decide_eq_true HH,ite_true]; rw [hx]
    have hx : q.wage x = 0 := by linarith [show 0 ≤ q.wage x from ht.2 x]
    simp only [TossUp.snip,keep,hx]; simp
  case false =>
    change (other s q).weight*(other s q).actor x = _
    rw [HE]; unfold insideW
    by_cases HH : 0 < q.wage x
    · have hx := (h.coins x).resolve_right HH.ne'
      simp only [TossUp.snip,keep,other,decide_eq_true HH,Pi.sub_apply]; rw [hx]; simp
    have hx : q.wage x=0 := by linarith [show 0 ≤ q.wage x from ht.2 x]
    simp only [TossUp.snip,keep,other,Pi.sub_apply,hx,sub_zero]; simp

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Thread.kept_mass
statement:
lemma kept_mass (h : Less s q) (hs : ReadyAt s) (ht : ReadyAt q) (hm : 0 < s.mass) :
    q.mass = (keep s q).snip.probs true*s.mass
proof:
:= by
  have H := balance (keep_true h hs ht hm) true
  apply mul_left_cancel₀ s.here.len_pos.ne'
  change q.here.len*q.mass=s.here.len*s.mass*_ at H
  rw [h.here] at H; rw [H]; ring

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Thread.pre_pos
statement:
lemma pre_pos {t : ∀ b, Thread M (q.smaller b)}
    (h : Following j J f (.ran s q t)) : 0 < s.mass
proof:
:=
  lt_of_lt_of_le h.2.2.2.1.1.2.2 (h.2.1.1.mass_le h.1.positive h.1.within)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Thread.splice_valid
statement: lemma splice_valid (t : Thread M s) (h : Following j J f t) : (unfoldW t).Valid true
proof:
:= by
  have H (s : Scene M) (h : Safe s j J f) : ReadyAt s := ⟨h.within,h.positive⟩
  induction t with
  | blank =>
    exact extra_ok _ _ true (H _ h) (Nat.add_sub_of_le (H _ h).1.2)
  | ran s q k ih =>
    obtain ⟨ha,hb,hc,hd,he,hk⟩ := h
    have hx : q.here.lev < M := (rooted _ (hk false)).within.2
    have hU := other_ok hb.1 (H _ ha)
    refine ⟨H _ ha,keep_here hb.1,keep_true hb.1 (H _ ha) (H _ hc),?_⟩
    intro b; cases b
    · exact extra_ok _ _ true hU (Nat.add_sub_of_le (H _ ha).1.2)
    exact ⟨H _ hc,hx,id,fun b => ih _ (hk b)⟩

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Thread.die_average
statement: private lemma die_average (Q : Law Bool) (f : Bool → ℝ) : Q.Ex f = Q true*f true + Q false*f false
proof:
:= by
  simp [Ex]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Thread.output_split
statement:
lemma output_split (q : Scene M) (hv : q.here.valid) (hh : q.here.lev < M)
    (hp : 0 ≤ q.wage) (hm : 0 < q.mass) (f : Bool → ℝ) :
    q.mass * (step q).probs.Ex f = (uniform Bool).Ex fun b => (q.smaller b).mass*f b
proof:
:= by
  have H := step_true hv hh hp hm
  rw [die_average,die_average]
  simp only [step_mass H,uniform_apply,Fintype.card_bool,Nat.cast_ofNat]
  ring

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Thread.output_rule
statement:
lemma output_rule (t : Thread M s) (g : Scene M → Scene M → ℝ) (h : Following j J f t) :
    s.mass * t.massLift g =
      t.fee fun b => b.post.mass*g b.pre b.post
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction t with
  | blank => simp [fee,Thread.massLift,stream,Ex_const]
  | ran s q k ih =>
    rw [fee_ran k h]
    obtain ⟨ha,hb,hc,hd,he,hk⟩ := h
    have hm' := hd.1.2.2
    have hM : 0 < s.mass := hm'.trans_le (hb.1.mass_le ha.positive ha.within)
    have hm := kept_mass hb.1 ⟨ha.within,ha.positive⟩ ⟨hc.within,hc.positive⟩ hM
