    have Hi : q.here.lev < M := (rooted _ (hk false)).within.2
    have H := output_split q hc.within.1 Hi hc.positive hm' fun b => (k b).massLift g
    rw [Thread.massLift,←mul_assoc,mul_comm s.mass,← hm,mul_add,H]
    have hh (b : Bool) := ih b (hk b)
    simp only [hh,Ex_add (uniform Bool) (f:=fun _ => q.mass*g s q),Ex_const]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Thread.spliced_cost
statement:
lemma spliced_cost (p : Policy M) (b : Bool) (t : Thread M s) (h : Following j J f t)
    (hm : 0 < s.mass) :
    (unfoldW t).expenditure (toll p b)=
      t.massLift fun _ q => q.norm/q.mass * surcharge q b (p q)
proof:
:= by
  induction t with
  | blank s =>
    exact extra_bill _ _ _ (fun i hi => by simp [toll,hi]) (Valid.atSrc (splice_valid _ h))
      hm (Nat.add_sub_of_le (Valid.atSrc (splice_valid _ h)).1.2)
  | ran s q k ih =>
    obtain ⟨ha,hb,hc,hd,he,hk⟩ := h
    let S := keep s q
    let P := S.snip.probs
    let l (b : Bool) := unfoldW (k b)
    have hs : ReadyAt s := ⟨ha.within,ha.positive⟩
    have ht := keep_true hb.1 hs (show ReadyAt q from ⟨hc.within,hc.positive⟩) hm
    let v := S.snip
    unfold unfoldW splice; rw [fee_spot (keep s q) _ _ ht]
    have hp : q.here.lev < M := (rooted _ (hk false)).within.2
    have hf := step_true hc.within.1 hp hc.positive hd.1.2.2
    let g := fun (s q : Scene M) => q.norm/q.mass * surcharge q b (p q)
    have H : expenditure (link q true l) (toll p b) =
        g s q+(step q).probs.Ex fun b => (k b).massLift g := by
      rw [fee_link _ _ _ hf,Ex_add]
      have hh := hd.2.2
      simp only [toll,true_and, ite_eq_left hh,Ex_const]
      congr 1
      apply Ex_congr_mem
      intro i hi
      exact ih i (hk _) ((true_mass hf).mp hi)
    rw [die_average]
    let L := expenditure (extra (other s q) (M-s.here.lev)) (toll p b)
    change P true * expenditure (link q true l) (toll p b) + P false*L = _
    rw [H]
    have HX : P false*L=0 := by
      rcases eq_or_lt_of_le (P.nonneg false) with hi|hi; rw [←hi,zero_mul]
      have He : L=0 := extra_bill _ _ _ (fun i hi => by simp [toll,hi]) (other_ok hb.1 hs)
        ((true_mass ht).mp hi) (Nat.add_sub_of_le ha.within.2)
      rw [He,mul_zero]
    rw [HX,add_zero]
    rfl

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Thread.surcharge_wire
statement:
lemma surcharge_wire (p : Policy M) (b : Bool) (t : Thread M s) (h : Following j J f t)
    (hm : 0 < s.mass) (hp : 0 < s.norm) :
    t.fee (fun i => surcharge i.post b (p i.post)) =
      s.mass / s.norm * (unfoldW t).expenditure (toll p b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [spliced_cost _ _ _ h hm]
  apply mul_left_cancel₀ hp.ne'
  let g (i : Beat M) := surcharge i.post b (p i.post)
  let F (x y : Scene M) := y.norm/y.mass * surcharge y b (p y)
  have H (s : Scene M) (t : Thread M s) (h : Following j J f t) :
      s.norm*t.fee g = t.fee fun i => i.post.mass*F i.pre i.post := by

    induction t with
    | blank => simp [fee,stream,Ex_const]
    | ran s q k ih =>
      rw [fee_ran k h,fee_ran k h,← Ex_lmul]
      obtain ⟨ha,hb,hc,hd,he,hk⟩ := h
      have Hq := hd.1.2.2
      congr 1; funext i; rw [mul_add]
      rw [← hb.1.flat]
      have HE := ih i (hk i)
      change q.norm*g _+ (q.smaller i).norm*_=_
      rw [HE]
      dsimp only [g,F]
      rw [show q.mass*(q.norm/q.mass* surcharge q b (p q))= q.norm * surcharge q b (p q) by field_simp]
  rw [H _ t h,← output_rule t _ h]
  change s.mass*t.massLift F = s.norm*(s.mass/s.norm*t.massLift F)
  generalize massLift t F = x
  field_simp

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.minimum_pos
statement: lemma minimum_pos (j) : 0 < minimumT j
proof: := by unfold minimumT; have := H_pos j; positivity

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.less_self
statement: lemma less_self (s : Scene M) : Less s s
proof:
:=
    ⟨rfl,rfl,rfl,rfl,fun _ => Or.inl rfl⟩

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Less.trans
statement: lemma Less.trans {s b c : Scene M} (h : Less s b) (h' : Less b c) : Less s c
proof:
:=
  ⟨h'.here.trans h.here,h'.fund.trans h.fund,h'.flat.trans h.flat,h'.mode.trans h.mode,
    fun x => (h'.coins x).elim (fun e => e.symm ▸ h.coins x) Or.inr⟩

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.less_lost
statement: lemma less_lost {s : Scene M} (u : Update j M s.here) : Less s (s.lose u)
proof:
:=
    ⟨rfl,rfl,rfl,rfl,fun x => by rw [lose_eq]; split_ifs <;> simp⟩

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Less.antitone
statement: lemma Less.antitone {s q : Scene M} (h : Less s q) (hp : 0 ≤ s.wage) : q.wage ≤ s.wage
proof:
:=
  fun x => (h.coins x).elim (fun e => le_of_eq e) (fun e => e ▸ hp x)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Less.mass_le
statement:
lemma Less.mass_le {s q : Scene M} (h : Less s q) (hp : 0 ≤ s.wage) (hv : s.here.ok M) :
    q.mass ≤ s.mass
proof:
:= by
  unfold mass; rw [h.here,avg_ex hv,avg_ex hv]
  exact Ex_mono _ (h.antitone hp)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Thread.rooted
statement: lemma rooted {s : Scene M} (t : Thread M s) (h : Following j J f t) : s.Safe j J f
proof:
:=
  match t with | .blank _ => h | .ran _ _ _ => h.1

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Thread.projected
statement: lemma projected (r : Play j M s) (h : r.Follows J f) : Following j J f (project r)
proof:
:= by
  induction r with
  | rest | ticket | freeze => exact h.1
  | jump s l r il ir =>
    obtain ⟨ha,hb,hc,hd,he⟩ := h
    refine ⟨ha,⟨less_self _,Or.inl rfl⟩,ha,hb,hc,?_⟩
    intro b; cases b; exact il hd; exact ir he
  | attempt s u l r il ir =>
    obtain ⟨ha,hb,hc,hu,hl,hr⟩ := h
    have ht := il hl
    have hp := ha.positive
    change Following j J f (reattach s _)
    cases H : project l with
    | blank => exact ha
    | ran t k =>
      rw [H] at ht
      obtain ⟨h₁,h₂,h₃,h₄,h₅,h₆⟩ := ht
      refine ⟨ha,⟨(less_lost u).trans h₂.1,?_⟩,h₃,h₄,h₅,h₆⟩
      have hv : (toss s u).TrueLaw :=
        toss_true _ ha.within ha.positive hb.1.2.2
      have he : (s.lose u).mass = (toss s u).probs false * s.mass := toss_mass hv false
      apply Or.inr
      apply le_trans (h₂.1.mass_le h₁.positive h₁.within)
      rw [he]
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ ha.mass_lower
      have Hx := ((main_bounds _ hu.ix_ok).1)
      have hF := hu.bias
      rw [← success_prob] at hF
      have HT : minimumT j ≤ beta u.ix/2 := by
        unfold minimumT
        apply le_trans (b:=((1/6400)/Thermal.H j^32)/2) ?_ (by linarith)
        exact le_of_eq (by ring)
      have HQ := (toss s u).probs.total; rw [Fintype.sum_bool] at HQ; linarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Thread.step_dice_child
statement:
lemma step_dice_child (p : Node) (hp : p.valid) (hh : p.lev < M) (b : Bool)
    {x : Grid M} (hx : 0 < (p.child b).dice M x) :
    (decide (x∈p.R.block M):Bool)=b
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := (dice_positive (child_ok p hp hh b)).mp hx
  cases b
  · exact decide_eq_false (fun H => Set.disjoint_left.mp (p.block_separate M) h1 H)
  exact decide_eq_true h1

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Thread.stream_branch
statement:
lemma stream_branch {s q : Scene M} (k : ∀ b, Thread M (q.smaller b))
    (h : Following j J f (.ran s q k)) (T : List (Beat M) → Grid M → ℝ) :
    (s.here.dice M).Ex (fun x => T (stream (.ran s q k) x) x) =
      (uniform Bool).Ex (fun b => ((q.smaller b).here.dice M).Ex fun x =>
        T (⟨s,q,b⟩::(k b).stream x) x)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ha,hb,hc,hd,he,hk⟩ := h
  let p := q.here
  have hh : p.lev < M := (rooted _ (hk false)).within.2
  rw [← hb.1.here,dice_child p hc.within.1 hh]
  let Q (b : Bool) := ((q.smaller b).here.dice M).Ex fun x => T (⟨s,q,b⟩::(k b).stream x) x
  have hi (b : Bool) :
      ((q.smaller b).here.dice M).Ex (fun x => T (stream (.ran s q k) x) x) = Q b := by
    refine Ex_congr_mem _ fun x hx => ?_
    let f (b) := T (⟨s,q,b⟩::(k b).stream x) x
    have h : (step q).bit x = b := step_dice_child p hc.within.1 hh b hx
    change f _=f b
    rw [h]
  change (((q.smaller false).here.dice M).Ex _ + ((q.smaller true).here.dice M).Ex _)/2 =
    (uniform Bool).Ex Q
  rw [hi false,hi true]
  rw [Ex,Fintype.sum_bool]; simp [uniform_apply]; ring

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Thread.fee_ran
statement:
lemma fee_ran {s q : Scene M} (k : ∀ b, Thread M (q.smaller b)) {g : Beat M → ℝ}
    (h : Following j J f (.ran s q k)) :
    fee (.ran s q k) g =
      (uniform Bool).Ex (fun b => g ⟨s,q,b⟩+(k b).fee g)
proof:
:= by
  unfold fee
  rw [stream_branch _ h (fun l _ => (l.map g).sum)]
  simp_rw [List.map_cons,List.sum_cons,Ex_add,Ex_const]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.weight_pos'
statement:
private lemma weight_pos' (p : Node) (A : Form M) (z v : Grid M) :
    0 < measureRate p A z v
proof:
:=
  mul_pos (side_pos _) (mul_pos (boltz_pos _ _) (boltz_pos _ _))

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.rate_sum_pos
statement:
private lemma rate_sum_pos (p : Node) (A : Form M) (z : Grid M) :
    0 < ∑ v, measureRate p A z v
proof:
:=
  Finset.sum_pos (fun _ _ => weight_pos' _ _ _ _) Finset.univ_nonempty

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.rate_sum_le
statement:
private lemma rate_sum_le (p : Node) (A : Form M) (hA : 0 ≤ A) (z : Grid M) :
    ∑ v, measureRate p A z v ≤ exp (-F (A+place p M))
proof:
:= by
  let s : Profile M := [(A,z), (place p M,start p M)]
  have ht : mixForm s=A+place p M := by simp [s,mixForm]
  have hV (x : Grid M) : measureRate p A z x = side M*tune s x := by
    unfold s measureRate; rw [tune_cons,tune_cons]
    simp [tune,sumE]
  have H := profile_envelope (s:=s) (by
    intro i hi
    simp only [s,List.mem_cons,List.not_mem_nil,or_false] at hi
    rcases hi with h|h <;> (subst i; first | exact hA | exact place_valid _ _)) 0
  simp_rw [hV,← Finset.mul_sum]
  unfold fc at H
  simp only [ht,neg_zero,chi_zero_left,mul_one,expU_real,Complex.norm_real,Real.norm_eq_abs] at H
  change expU (fun x => tune s x) ≤ _
  rw [F_origin]; exact (le_abs_self _).trans H

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.match_pos
statement:
private lemma match_pos (p : Node) (A : Form M) (z v : Grid M) :
    0 < matchLabel p A z v
proof:
:=
  div_pos (weight_pos' _ _ _ _) (rate_sum_pos _ _ _)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.KL_bound
proof:
:= matchLabel p A
    (channel B x).kl (q z) ≤ F B-F (A+place p M) +
      (channel B x).Ex (fun y => form A (z-y) + form (place p M) (start p M-y)) := by
  intro q
  have hB : 0 ≤ B := (add_nonneg hA (place_valid _ _)).trans h
  rw [kl_ex]
  conv_rhs => lhs; rw [← Ex_const (channel B x) (F B-F (A+place p M))]
  rw [← Ex_add]; apply Ex_mono; intro i
  let S := place p M; let t := start p M
  change log (channel B x i)-log (measureRate p A z i/∑ v, measureRate p A z v) ≤
    F B-F (A+S) + (form A (z-i)+form S (t-i))
  have H := log_le_log (rate_sum_pos p A z) (rate_sum_le p A hA z)
  rw [log_exp] at H
  rw [ch_K,K_eq,log_mul (side_pos _).ne' (exp_pos _).ne',log_exp,
    Real.log_div (weight_pos' _ _ _ _).ne' (rate_sum_pos _ _ _).ne',
    measureRate, log_mul (side_pos _).ne' (mul_pos (boltz_pos _ _) (boltz_pos _ _)).ne',
    log_mul (boltz_pos _ _).ne' (boltz_pos _ _).ne',boltz,boltz,log_exp,log_exp]
  change _ ≤ -F (A+S) at H
  unfold S t at *
  linarith [form_nonneg hB (i-x)]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.added_deficit
statement:
theorem added_deficit (s : Scene M) (p : Node) (A B : Form M)
    (hp : s.here.ok M) (he : s.here=p) (hh : 0 ≤ s.wage) (hm : 0 < s.mass)
    (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hB : A+place p M ≤ B) :
    deficit s (channel B) ≤ deficit s (channel A)+
      (F B-F (A+place p M)+4*(label A).Ex (form A)+264)
proof:
:= by
  subst p
  let q := s.here; let S := place q M
  let k := channel A; let v := channel B
  let T := matchLabel q A
  let P := s.actor; let H := P.withNext k
  let x := F B-F (A+S)
  let l := (label A).Ex (form A)
  let y := x+4*l+264
  have hi : H.Ex (fun z => (v z.1).kl (T z.2)) ≤ y := by
    unfold H; rw [Ex_withNext]
    have hhA : 0 ≤ S := place_valid q _
    have hx : S ≤ B := le_trans (le_add_of_nonneg_left hA) hB
    have hv : A ≤ B := le_trans (le_add_of_nonneg_right hhA) hB
    let m := q.start M
    have hm' (i) (hi : 0 < P i) :
        (k i).Ex (fun z => (v i).kl (T z)) ≤ y := by
      have he : i∈s.here.block M := piece_support hp (actor_def hp hh hm) _ hi
      have hE := place_internal (start_mem hp.1 hp.2) he
      have hh (z w : Grid M) : form A (z-w)+form S (m-w) ≤
          2*(form A (z-i)+form S (m-i))+ 2*(form A (i-w)+form S (i-w)) := by
        have h1 := form_triangle hA (z-i) (i-w)
        have h2 := form_triangle hhA (m-i) (i-w)
        rw [sub_add_sub_cancel] at h1 h2
        linarith
      have hG (v : Form M) (A : Form M) :
          (channel A i).Ex (fun y => form v (i-y)) = (label A).Ex (form v) := by
        have h1 (y : Grid M) : form v (i-y) = form v (y-i) := by
          rw [show i-y= -(y-i) by ring, form_even _ _]
        simp_rw [h1]; exact ch_noise _ _ _
      have Hta (z : Grid M) :
          (v i).kl (T z) ≤ x+2*(form A (z-i)+form S (m-i))+
            2*(l+100) := by
        have hi := KL_bound q A B hA hB i z
        apply hi.trans
        have he := (v i).Ex_mono (hh z)
        rw [Ex_add _ (f:=fun _ => 2*(form A (z-i)+form S (m-i))), Ex_const,Ex_lmul,Ex_add (f:=fun w => form A (i-w))] at he
        unfold v at he
        rw [hG,hG] at he
        have h1 := S_energy q.invlen q.invlen_ge (loc_scale hp.2) B hx
        have h2 := form_energy_mono hA hv hA
        unfold x l m S q place at *
        linarith
      apply le_trans ((k i).Ex_mono Hta); unfold k
      rw [Ex_add,Ex_add,Ex_lmul,Ex_add,Ex_const,Ex_const,Ex_const,ch_noise A (form A)]
      unfold y x S m l q at *; linarith
    exact (P.Ex_mono_mem hm').trans (P.Ex_const y).le
  have he := (replace_signal P k v T (match_pos q A)).trans hi
  unfold deficit; change levels s-P.privateH v ≤ levels s-P.privateH k+y
  linarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.priced_change
statement:
lemma priced_change :
    ∀ᶠ j : ℕ in atTop, ∀ M J : ℕ, ∀ s : Scene M, ∀ f : Grid M → ℝ,
    ∀ u : Update j M s.here, Safe s j J f → Safe (s.win u) j J f → 0 < (s.win u).mass →
      u.Good capA s.fund.mood s.actor →
      let A
proof:
:= s.fund.mood
      deficit (s.win u) (channel (u.next A)) ≤ deficit (s.win u) (channel A) + 500*u.credit := by
  filter_upwards [h_large 10,stiff_budget capA cap_ok] with j hp hx M J s f u hs hS hm hU
  intro A
  have H := added_deficit (win s u) s.here A (u.next A) hS.within rfl hS.positive hm
      hs.capital.effects.nonneg (le_add_of_nonneg_right hU.positive)
  have hh := hs.capital.effects.energy
  let a := Thermal.H j
  let d := height j
  have he : 1 ≤ a := H_ge _
  have ht : 0 ≤ plateErr j := by unfold plateErr; exact div_nonneg (d_pos _).le (pow_nonneg (H_pos _).le _)
  have hy := hU.reserves.1
  have hX := hs.capital.under
  apply H.trans
  have H : 4*(label A).Ex (form A)+264 ≤ 100*u.credit := by
    have hw :
        (label A).Ex (form A) ≤ 2*(capA*a*(plateErr j + 1000*a)) := by
      apply le_trans hh
      calc
        _ ≤ (capA*a)*(2*(plateErr j+1000*a)) := by gcongr <;> linarith
        _ = _ := by ring
    change capA*a*(plateErr j + 1000*a)+2000 ≤ d/a^4 at hx
    have hZ : d/a^4 ≤ u.credit := by
      apply le_trans _ hy; unfold d a
      gcongr <;> first | exact (d_pos j).le | exact H_ge j | omega
    have h0 : 0 ≤ capA*a*(plateErr j + 1000*a) :=
      mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (le_trans zero_le_one cap_ok) (by linarith)) (by linarith)
    linarith
  linarith [hU.cost]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.cap_ok
statement: lemma cap_ok : 1 ≤ capA
proof: := by norm_num [capA]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Fund.Ok.restrict
statement: lemma Ok.restrict {p q : Node} {c : Fund M} (h : c.Ok p j) (he : below q p) : c.Ok q j
proof:
:=
    { h with domain := below_trans he h.domain }

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Fund.track_add
statement:
lemma track_add (j n : ℕ) :
    track capA j (n+1)=track capA j n+ stepRad capA j
proof: := by simp only [track]; push_cast; ring

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Fund.envelope_scale
statement:
lemma envelope_scale :
    ∀ᶠ j : ℕ in atTop, sepRad j ≤ 1 ∧ fuel j > 0 ∧ 1 ≤ height j ∧ 1 ≤ height j/(H j)^2
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [spacing capA cap_ok,hpoly 1 2] with j hj hh
  have hx := H_pos j; have hd := d_pos j
  refine ⟨hj.2.2.2.2.1,mul_pos eps_pos (div_pos hd hx),one_le_pow₀ (by norm_num),?_⟩
  exact (le_div_iff₀ (by positivity)).mpr hh

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Fund.fund_est
statement:
lemma fund_est :
    ∀ᶠ j : ℕ in atTop, ∀ M : ℕ, (initial M).Ok root j ∧
      ∀ c : Fund M, ∀ p, Ok c p j →
        c.spend ≤ 2*(c.bank+1) ∧
        (¬ breached j c → p.ok M → Press capA j p c.mood ∧
           c.uses+1 ≤ capA*H j ∧
           ∀ (u : Update j M p) P, u.Good capA c.mood P →
             Ok (c.advance p u) p j)
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [envelope_scale,hpoly (3000*capA) 1,kappa_scales (codeWeight capA) (code_ge cap_ok)] with j hj h ht M
  have hr := hj.1
  have hp := H_ge j
  let a := H j; let d := height j
  have hD : 1 ≤ d := hj.2.2.1
  have ha : 1 ≤ a := hp; have ha' : 0 < a := H_pos _
  constructor
  · refine ⟨below_refl _,certified_start M,?_,by simp [initial],?_,?_,?_,?_⟩
    · simp only [initial,Nat.cast_zero]; linarith [show (1:ℝ) ≤ capA*H j from one_le_mul_of_one_le_of_one_le cap_ok hp]
    · change 0 ≤ _; have := reserve_ge cap_ok; have := d_pos j; positivity
    · simp [initial]
    · simp [initial, invlen_top,F_zero]
    have he := r_steps cap_ok j 0 (show ((0:ℕ):ℝ) ≤ _ by
      push_cast; have := one_le_mul_of_one_le_of_one_le cap_ok hp; linarith)
    dsimp [initial]
    rw [gap_zero he.1 (by have := he.2; linarith)]
    simp
  intro c p hh
  have hA := hh.effects.nonneg
  have HX := r_steps cap_ok _ _ hh.under
  have Hx := hh.verified
  have hy := gap_lower hA HX.1 (by linarith [HX.2])
  have hnp := hh.nonneg
  have hz : c.spend ≤ 2*(c.bank+1) := by linarith [hnp.1]
  refine ⟨hz,?_⟩
  intro hd he
  rw [breached] at hd
  have HH : c.spend ≤ 2002*d := by change ¬1000*d<_ at hd; linarith
  have ht' := hh.floor_ok
  have hI : c.uses+1 ≤ capA*H j := by
    have hk : (c.uses:ℝ) ≤ 20020000*a := by
      have HL := ht'.trans HH
      unfold fuel eps at HL; change (c.uses:ℝ)*(1/10000*(d/a)) ≤ _ at HL
      apply le_of_mul_le_mul_left _ (show 0 < d by linarith)
      field_simp at HL; nlinarith
    unfold capA; nlinarith [show H j=a from rfl]
  refine ⟨⟨he,c.uses,c.anchor,hh.domain,hh.effects,hh.under,?_⟩,hI,?_⟩
  · have ht : 3000*c.uses ≤ d := by
      have h1 := hh.under
      change _*H j^1 ≤ d at h; rw [pow_one] at h
      change 3000*(c.uses:ℝ) ≤ d
      linarith
    change _ ≤ _+capA*d
    have hL := hh.relative
    unfold capA; nlinarith
  intro u P hu
  let v := c.advance p u
  have hK := certified_add hh.effects hp he hu.positive hu.plate
  have hR : Ok v p j := by
    have hf : fuel j ≤ u.credit := by
      apply le_trans _ hu.duration
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ eps_pos.le
      apply le_trans _ (ht _ hu.ix_ok).2.2.1
      apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_right _ (H_pos _).le
      exact le_mul_of_one_le_left (d_pos j).le (code_ge cap_ok)
    have hc : 0 ≤ u.credit := hj.2.1.le.trans hf
    have hJ := hu.gap_est _ HX.1 HX.2
    refine ⟨below_refl _,hK,?_,?_,?_,?_,?_,?_⟩
    · unfold v advance; dsimp; push_cast; exact hI
    · dsimp only [v,advance]
      have he : 0 ≤ u.bill ∧ u.bill ≤ u.credit := by unfold Update.bill; split <;> simp [hc]
      constructor
      exact add_nonneg hnp.1 he.1
      exact add_le_add hnp.2 he.2
    · change c.bank+u.bill ≤ _
      unfold Update.bill; split
      · have hg := hu.reserves.2; linarith [hh.solvent]
      simp only [add_zero, hh.solvent]
    · change ((c.uses+1:ℕ):ℝ) * _ ≤ c.spend + u.credit
      push_cast; linarith
    · change F (u.next c.mood) ≤ _
      dsimp only [v,advance]
      push_cast
      have HZ := space_increment hh.effects hh.domain he
      linarith [hu.cost,hh.relative]
    · change gap (u.next c.mood) (track capA j (c.uses+1)) ≤ _
      rw [track_add]
      change gap _ _ ≤ 402*(c.bank+u.bill)-5000*((c.spend+u.credit)-(c.bank+u.bill))
      unfold Update.bill
      by_cases hh : u.regular = true
      · rw [ite_eq_left hh] at *
        linarith
      rw [ite_eq_right hh] at *
      have ht := hu.cheap (by simpa using hh)
      unfold eps at ht
      linarith
  exact hR

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Road.flat_finish
statement:
lemma flat_finish (s : Scene M) (b : Bool) (f : Event j M → ℝ) :
    flatFee (.finish s b) f = 0
proof: := by simp [flatFee,expHike,hike,fee,Ex_const]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Road.flat_push
statement:
lemma flat_push (v : Pace) (t : Road j M (s.pace v)) (f : Event j M → ℝ) :
    flatFee (.push s v t) f = f (Event.pace s v)+t.flatFee f
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [flatFee,Ex_hike_push,fee_pre,expHike,Ex_add (f:=fun _ => f (Event.pace s v)),Ex_const]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Road.flat_fork
statement:
lemma flat_fork (v : Turn j s) (t : ∀ b, Road j M (v.fork.dst b))
    (h : (.fork s v t : Road j M s).Trusted J f) (g : Event j M → ℝ) :
    flatFee (.fork s v t) g = v.fork.probs.Ex (fun b => g (.march s v b)+(t b).flatFee g)
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [flatFee,Ex_hike_fork h,fee_pre,expHike,Ex_add,Ex_const]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Road.total_step
statement:
lemma total_step (v : Turn j s) :
    v.fork.probs.Ex (fun b => exp (-likelihood (.march s v b))) ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  cases v with
  | ask u => simp [Event.likelihood, Ex_const]
  | move =>
    let Q := (step s).probs
    change Q.Ex (fun b => exp (-log (2*Q b))) ≤ 1
    have HH (b : Bool) : Q b * exp (-log (2*Q b)) ≤ 1/2 := by
      rcases eq_or_lt_of_le (Q.nonneg b) with H|H
      · rw [← H,zero_mul]; norm_num
      rw [Real.exp_neg,Real.exp_log (by positivity)]
      field_simp
      rfl
    unfold Ex; rw [Fintype.sum_bool]; linarith [HH true,HH false]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Road.headroom_nonneg
statement: private lemma headroom_nonneg (x : ℝ) : 0 ≤ headroom x
proof:
:= by
  unfold headroom; linarith [Real.add_one_le_exp (-x)]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Road.headroom_up
statement: private lemma headroom_up {x : ℝ} (hx : log 2 ≤ x) : 1/10 ≤ headroom x
proof:
:= by
  unfold headroom
  let t := log 2
  have h0 : 63/100 ≤ t := by unfold t; linarith [log_two_gt_d9]
  have h1 := Real.add_one_le_exp (t-x)
  have he : exp (-x) = exp (t-x)/2 := by
    rw [sub_eq_add_neg,exp_add]; unfold t; rw [exp_log (by norm_num)]; ring
  rw [he]
  change t ≤ x at hx; linarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Road.startup_ok
statement: private lemma startup_ok (s : Scene M) : 0 ≤ startup s ∧ startup s ≤ 2/10
proof:
:= by
  unfold startup
  split_ifs <;> norm_num

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Road.ticket_count
statement:
lemma ticket_count (t : Road j M s) (h : t.Trusted J f)
    (hm : 0 < s.mass) (x : ℝ) (hX : 0 < s.norm → log s.mass - log s.norm ≤ x) :
    t.flatFee beginFee /10 ≤ t.flatFee likelihood + t.flatFee count /10 + headroom x + startup s
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction t generalizing x with
  | finish s _ =>
    simp_rw [flat_finish]; linarith [headroom_nonneg x,(startup_ok s).1]
  | push s v t ih =>
    obtain ⟨ha,hb,hc,hd⟩ := h
    simp_rw [flat_push,Event.likelihood,Event.count,zero_add]
    have hM := pace_mass s v
    cases v with
    | cross =>
      have HH := ih hd (hM.symm ▸ hm) 0 (by simp [Scene.pace,out])
      have he : startup (s.pace .cross) ≤ startup s := by
        have Hs : s.live=true := hc.1
        simp [startup,Scene.pace,out,Hs]
        split_ifs <;> norm_num
      rw [headroom,neg_zero,exp_zero] at HH
      have := headroom_nonneg x
      change (0+_)/10 ≤ _
      linarith
    | renew =>
      have he : (s.pace .renew).norm=s.mass := rfl
      have HH := ih hd (hM.symm ▸ hm) 0 (by intro h; rw [he,hM,sub_self])
      rw [headroom,neg_zero,exp_zero] at HH
      change (1+_)/10 ≤ _
      by_cases H : s.norm=0
      · have Hs : startup s = startup (s.pace .renew)+1/10 := by
          unfold startup; rw [he,ite_eq_left H,ite_eq_right hm.ne']
          simp [Scene.pace, reset]
        linarith [headroom_nonneg x]
      have Hs : startup s = startup (s.pace .renew) := by
        unfold startup; rw [he,ite_eq_right H,ite_eq_right hm.ne']; rfl
      have hp := lt_of_le_of_ne ha.norm_ok (Ne.symm H)
      have HH' := log_le_log (show 0 < 2 *s.norm from by positivity) hc.2.le
      rw [log_mul (by norm_num) hp.ne'] at HH'
      have ht := headroom_up (x:=x) (by linarith [hX hp])
      linarith
  | fork s v t ih =>
    have ha := h.1
    have hρ := branchTrusted h
    have hc := h.2.1
    have hn : 0 < s.norm := by by_contra! he; apply hc.2.2; unfold enter; linarith
    let Q := v.fork.probs
    let L (b : Bool) := likelihood (.march s v b)
    have hx (b : Bool) (hb : 0 < Q b) :
        (t b).flatFee beginFee /10 ≤ (t b).flatFee likelihood + (t b).flatFee count /10 +
          headroom (x+L b) + startup (v.fork.dst b) := by
      have hp := (true_mass hρ).mp hb
      apply ih b (h.2.2.2 b) hp (x+L b)
      have HH := price_space v b hρ hm hb
      intro hy
      have he : (v.fork.dst b).norm=s.norm := by
        cases v with
        | move => rfl
        | ask u => cases b
                   · rfl
                   · exfalso; change (0:ℝ)<0 at hy; linarith
      rw [he]
      unfold L
      have ht := fee_bounds (.march s v b)
      unfold Event.memFee at HH
      linarith [ht.1,ht.2.1,hX hn]
    have hh : Q.Ex (fun b => headroom (x+L b)) ≤ Q.Ex L + headroom x := by
      have he (b : Bool) : headroom (x+L b) = (x+L b)+(exp (-x)*exp (-L b)-1) := by
        unfold headroom; rw [←exp_add]; ring_nf
      simp_rw [he,Ex_add,Ex_sub,Ex_lmul,Ex_const]
      have H : Q.Ex (fun b => exp (-L b)) ≤ 1 := total_step v
      unfold headroom; nlinarith [exp_pos (-x)]
    have HH : Q.Ex (fun b => startup (v.fork.dst b)) ≤ startup s + Q.Ex fun b =>
        count (.march s v b)/10 := by
      conv_rhs => lhs; rw [← Ex_const Q (startup s)]
      rw [← Ex_add]
      apply Ex_mono; intro b
      cases v with
      | move => simp [startup,Turn.fork,step,smaller,count]
      | ask u =>
        cases b <;> simp [startup,Turn.fork,toss,lose,win,hn.ne',count]
    simp_rw [flat_fork _ _ h]
    have ht := Q.Ex_mono_mem hx
    simp_rw [Ex_add] at *

    have hZ : v.fork.probs.Ex (fun b => beginFee (.march s v b)) = 0 := by
      simp only [beginFee,Ex_const]
    rw [hZ]
    simp_rw [div_eq_mul_inv,Ex_mul] at *
    unfold L Q at *
    norm_num at *
    linarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Road.final_coarse
statement:
lemma final_coarse :
    ∀ᶠ j : ℕ in atTop, ∀ M J : ℕ, ∀ s : Scene M, ∀ f : Grid M → ℝ,
      ∀ t : Road j M s, t.Trusted J f → 1/H j ≤ s.mass →
        t.flatFee likelihood ≤ 2*limitC * H j ∧
        t.flatFee count ≤ capA * H j ∧
        (s.norm=0 → t.flatFee beginFee ≤ 100*limitC*H j)
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [mem_budget,cutoff_log] with j hj h M J s f t hh hM
  have hp := H_pos j; have he := H_ge j
  have hm : 0 < s.mass := lt_of_lt_of_le (by positivity : 0 < 1/H j) hM
  have Hl := (hj M J s f t hh hm).2
  have hX : t.flatFee likelihood ≤ 2*limitC*H j := by
    have hQ (x : Grid M) (hx : 0 < s.actor x) : (t.hike x).fee likelihood ≤
        30000*H j+(t.hike x).membership := by
      let l := t.hike x
      obtain ⟨h1,h2,h3,h4,h5⟩ := final_sound hh hm hx
      have H₃ : log l.done.mass ≤ 20000*H j := (log_le_log h3 h1.budget).trans h
      have hz := log_le_log (by positivity : 0 < 1/H j) hM
      rw [one_div,Real.log_inv] at hz
      change l.like ≤ _ + l.membership
      change l.like = _ at h4
      linarith [log_le_sub_one_of_pos hp]
    unfold flatFee expHike
    apply (s.actor.Ex_mono_mem hQ).trans
    rw [Ex_add,Ex_const]; unfold expHike limitC at *; nlinarith
  have hY : t.flatFee count ≤ capA*H j := by
    have hQ (x : Grid M) (hx : 0 < s.actor x) : (t.hike x).fee count ≤ capA*H j := by
      obtain ⟨h1,h2,h3,h4,h5,_⟩ := final_sound hh hm hx
      linarith [h1.capital.under,Nat.cast_nonneg (α:=ℝ) s.fund.uses]
    unfold flatFee expHike; apply le_trans (s.actor.Ex_mono_mem hQ); rw [Ex_const]
  refine ⟨hX,hY, fun hn => ?_⟩
  have HZ := ticket_count t hh hm 0 (by simp [hn])
  rw [headroom,neg_zero,exp_zero] at HZ
  have hZ := (startup_ok s).2
  unfold limitC capA at *; linarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Road.attempt_count
statement:
lemma attempt_count :
    ∀ᶠ j : ℕ in atTop, ∀ M J : ℕ, ∀ s : Scene M, ∀ f : Grid M → ℝ,
      ∀ t : Road j M s, t.Trusted J f → 1/H j ≤ s.mass →
        t.flatFee tried ≤ 12800*capA*H j^33
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [final_coarse] with j hg M J s f t h hm
  let a := 12800*H j^32
  have H (s : Scene M) (t : Road j M s) (h : t.Trusted J f) :
      t.flatFee tried ≤ a*t.flatFee count := by
    induction t with
    | finish => simp [flat_finish]
    | push s v t ih =>
      simp only [flat_push,tried,count,zero_add]; exact ih h.2.2.2
    | fork s v t ih =>
      simp_rw [flat_fork v t h, Ex_add]
      rw [mul_add]
      apply add_le_add ?_
      · rw [← Ex_lmul]; exact Ex_mono _ (fun b => ih b (h.2.2.2 b))
      cases v with
      | move => simp [tried,count,Ex_const]
      | ask u =>
        have ht := h.2.2.1.2
        have HX : beta u.ix/2 ≤ (toss s u).probs true := by rw [success_prob]; exact ht.bias
        have hp := (main_bounds j ht.ix_ok).1
        simp [tried,count,Ex,Turn.fork]
        have hh : (toss s u).probs true + (toss s u).probs false = 1 := by simpa [Fintype.sum_bool] using (toss s u).probs.total
        rw [hh]
        calc
          1 ≤ a*(beta u.ix/2) := by have := H_pos j; unfold a; field_simp at *; nlinarith
          _ ≤ _ := by exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left HX (by unfold a; positivity)
  have hx := (hg M J s f t h hm).2.1
  apply (H s t h).trans
  calc
    _ ≤ a*(capA*Thermal.H j) := by exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hx (by unfold a; positivity)
    _ = _ := by unfold a; ring

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.cap_entropy
statement:
lemma cap_entropy (s : Scene M) (hp : s.here.ok M) (hh : 0 ≤ s.wage) (hm : 0 < s.mass) :
    s.actor.entropy ≤ levels s
proof:
:= by
  apply le_trans (entropy_le_log_size _ (s.here.group M) ?_)
  · rw [group_card hp.1 hp.2,wid]; push_cast; rw [log_pow]
    exact le_rfl
  intro i hi
  exact (mem_group _ _).mpr (piece_support hp (actor_def hp hh hm) i hi)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.deficit_nonneg
statement:
lemma deficit_nonneg (s : Scene M) (hp : s.here.ok M) (hh : 0 ≤ s.wage) (hm : 0 < s.mass)
    (k : Grid M → Law α) : 0 ≤ deficit s k
proof:
:=
  sub_nonneg.mpr ((privateH_le _ _).trans (cap_entropy _ hp hh hm))

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.levels_child
statement:
lemma levels_child (s : Scene M) (hb : s.here.lev < M) (b : Bool) :
    levels (s.smaller b) = levels s - log 2
proof:
:= by
  unfold levels
  have He : M - s.here.lev = M - (s.smaller b).here.lev +1 := by
    have H : (s.smaller b).here.lev = s.here.lev+1 := by cases b <;> rfl
    omega
  rw [He]; push_cast; ring

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.conditioned_balance
statement:
lemma conditioned_balance (k : Grid M → Law α) (v : Fork M) (h : v.TrueLaw) :
    v.probs.Ex (fun b => (v.dst b).actor.privateH k) + sideH v k =
      v.src.actor.privateH k
proof:
:= by
  have hi (b) (hi : 0 < v.probs b) :
      v.src.actor.after v.bit b=(v.dst b).actor := by
    apply Law.ext; intro x
    apply mul_left_cancel₀ hi.ne'
    rw [local_law h]
    exact send_mul_after _ _ _ _
  have He := det_channel v.src.actor v.bit k
  rw [← He]
  unfold sideH
  congr 1
  exact Ex_congr_mem _ (fun x hx => by rw [hi x hx])

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.old_entropy_cost
statement:
lemma old_entropy_cost (v : Fork M) (k : Grid M → Law α) :
    sideH v k ≤ v.probs.entropy
proof:
:= by
  let P := v.src.actor.withNext k; let B : Grid M × α → Bool := fun x => v.bit x.1
  have he : P.send B = v.probs := by
    have HH := send_send P Prod.fst v.bit
    rw [send_fst_withNext v.src.actor k] at HH
    exact HH.symm
  apply le_trans (Hcond_le_H P B Prod.snd); rw [Law.H,he]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.hist_special
statement:
lemma hist_special (s : Scene M) (i : Grid M) (A : Form M) :
    hist s (channel A) i = Mz s.here s.wage s.norm A i
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.hist_source
statement:
lemma hist_source (k : Grid M → Law α) (s : Scene M) (hp : s.here.ok M)
    (hh : 0 ≤ s.wage) (i : α) :
    hist s k i = (s.mass / s.norm) * s.actor.through k i
proof:
:= by
  rw [through_apply]
  unfold hist wt Ex; rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun x hx => by rw [← mass_actor hp hh]; ring

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.bit_cost
statement:
lemma bit_cost (Q : Law Bool) :
    (Q false-Q true)^2 ≤ 4*(log 2-Q.entropy)
proof:
:= by
  have H := tv_sq_le_kl (P:=Q) (Q:=uniform Bool)
    (fun i hi => by rw [uniform_apply]; positivity)
  have Ht : Q true + Q false = 1 := by simpa only [Fintype.sum_bool] using Q.total
  unfold tv kl crossE at H
  simp_rw [Fintype.sum_bool, uniform_apply,Fintype.card_bool, Nat.cast_ofNat, Ex_const,
    Real.log_inv] at H
  rw [show Q false-2⁻¹= -(Q true-2⁻¹) by linarith,abs_neg] at H
  rw [show Q false = 1-Q true by linarith]
  nlinarith [sq_abs (Q true-2⁻¹)]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.bit_def
statement:
lemma bit_def (s : Scene M) (k : Grid M → Law α) (hp : s.here.valid)
    (he : s.here.lev < M) (hh : 0 ≤ s.wage) (hm : 0 < s.mass) (hn : 0 < s.norm) :
    s.norm/s.mass * fisher s k ≤ 4*(log 2-sideH (step s) k)
proof:
:= by
  let v := step s
  have HV : v.TrueLaw := step_true hp he hh hm
  let R := s.actor.withNext k
  let P := R.send Prod.snd
  let z := fun x : Grid M × α => v.bit x.1
  let Q (i) := (R.after Prod.snd i).send z
  have H0 b i :
      v.probs b * ((s.smaller b).actor.through k) i = R.send (fun x => (z x,x.2)) (b,i) := by
    let C := fun x : Grid M × α => (z x,x.2)
    rw [through_apply, Ex,Finset.mul_sum]
    simp_rw [← mul_assoc]
    rw [send_apply,prob_eq,Fintype.sum_prod_type]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun x hx => ?_
    change (v.probs b*(v.dst b).actor x)*k x i = ∑ y, if C (x,y)=(b,i) then R (x,y) else 0
    rw [local_law HV]
    by_cases h : v.bit x=b
    · rw [ite_eq_left h]
      simp [C,z,h,R,withNext_apply]

      exact Or.inl rfl
    rw [ite_eq_right h]; simp [C,z,h]
  have HH (b i) : hist (s.smaller b) k i =
      (s.mass/s.norm)*(2*P i*Q i b) := by
    rw [hist_source k (s.smaller b) (child_ok _ hp he b) hh,step_mass HV]
    have HC := H0 b i
    rw [joint_after R z Prod.snd] at HC
    change _ = P i*Q i b at HC
    change 2*v.probs b*s.mass/s.norm*((s.smaller b).actor.through k i) = _
    rw [mul_assoc (a:=2) (b:=P i),← HC]; ring
  have hP (i) :
      hist s k i = s.mass/s.norm*P i := by rw [hist_source _ _ ⟨hp,he.le⟩ hh]; unfold P R; rw [send_snd_withNext]
  have ht i : s.norm/s.mass*((diff s k i)^2 / hist s k i) = P i*(Q i false-Q i true)^2 := by
    unfold diff; rw [HH,HH,hP]
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le (P.nonneg i) with He|He
    · simp [← He]
    field_simp
  let F (i : α) := log 2-(Q i).entropy
  calc
    _ = P.Ex fun i => (Q i false-Q i true)^2 := by rw [fisher,Finset.mul_sum]; simp_rw [ht]; rfl
    _ ≤ P.Ex fun i => 4*F i := Ex_mono _ (fun i => bit_cost _)
    _ = _ := by
      unfold F sideH; rw [Ex_lmul, Ex_sub (f:=fun i => log 2),Ex_const,Hcond_after]
      rfl

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.space_deficit
statement:
lemma space_deficit (s : Scene M) (k : Grid M → Law α) (hp : s.here.valid)
    (he : s.here.lev < M) (hh : 0 ≤ s.wage) (hm : 0 < s.mass) (hn : 0 < s.norm) :
    (step s).probs.Ex (fun b => deficit (s.smaller b) k) +
      (1/4:ℝ)*(s.norm/s.mass)*fisher s k ≤ deficit s k
proof:
:= by
  let v := step s
  have H := conditioned_balance k v (step_true hp he hh hm)
  have HH := bit_def s k hp he hh hm hn
  unfold deficit
  simp_rw [levels_child s he, Ex_sub (f:=fun _ => levels s - log 2),Ex_const]
  change (step s).probs.Ex (fun b => (s.smaller b).actor.privateH k)+sideH (step s) k=s.actor.privateH k at H
  dsimp only [step] at *
  rw [mul_assoc]
  linarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.member_deficit
statement:
lemma member_deficit (s : Scene M) (k : Grid M → Law α) (u : Update j M s.here)
    (H : (toss s u).TrueLaw) :
    let v
proof:
:= toss s u
    v.probs.Ex (fun b => deficit (v.dst b) k) ≤ deficit s k + v.probs.entropy := by
  intro v
  have he := conditioned_balance k v H
  have hV : ∀ b, levels (v.dst b)=levels s := by intro b; cases b <;> rfl
  unfold deficit
  simp_rw [hV,Ex_sub (f:=fun _ => levels s),Ex_const]
  change _+_ = s.actor.privateH k at he
  linarith [old_entropy_cost v k]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.local_deficit_dry
statement:
lemma local_deficit_dry (s : Scene M) {α : Type} [Fintype α] (P : Law α)
    (hp : s.here.ok M) (hh : 0 ≤ s.wage) (hm : 0 < s.mass)
    (d : ℝ) (h : ∀ x, s.wage x ≤ exp d) :
    deficit s (fun _ => P) ≤ d-log s.mass
proof:
:= by
  rw [deficit,privateH_const]
  let q := s.actor
  suffices H : levels s + q.Ex (fun x => log (q x)) ≤ d-log s.mass by
    change levels s - entropy q ≤ _
    unfold entropy crossE; rw [Ex_neg]; linarith
  rcases s with ⟨p,f,c,e,n⟩
  let s : Scene M := ⟨p,f,c,e,n⟩
  change levels s + _ ≤ _
  conv_lhs => lhs; rw [← Ex_const q (levels s)]
  rw [← Ex_add]
  refine le_trans (b:=q.Ex (fun _ => d-log s.mass)) (Ex_mono_mem _ fun x hx => ?_) (by rw [Ex_const])
  have hi := actor_def (s:=s) hp hh hm
  have ht : x ∈ p.block M := piece_support hp hi x hx
  have H (x' : Grid M) (hx' : x'∈p.block M) :
      log (p.dice M x') = -levels s := by
    have H1 : p.lev ≤ M := hp.2
    rw [dice_apply hp,ite_eq_left hx',
      log_mul (side_pos _).ne' (inv_pos.mpr p.len_pos).ne',levels,len]
    simp_rw [log_inv,side_pow_two, Real.log_inv,log_pow]
    dsimp [s]; rw [Nat.cast_sub H1]; ring
  have he : q x ≤ p.dice M x * exp d / s.mass := by
    rw [show q x = _ from hi x]
    unfold wt
    exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (h _) ((p.dice M).nonneg _)) hm.le
  have hi' : 0 < p.dice M x := (dice_positive hp).mpr ht
  have hc' := log_le_log hx he
  rw [log_div (mul_pos hi' (exp_pos _)).ne' hm.ne',log_mul hi'.ne' (exp_pos _).ne',
    log_exp,H _ ht] at hc'
  change levels s+log (q x) ≤ _
  linarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.no_label
statement: lemma no_label (x : Grid M) : channel (0:Form M) x = uniform _
proof:
:= by
  apply Law.ext; intro i
  rw [ch_K,K_eq,F_zero,form_zero,sub_zero,exp_zero,uniform_side,mul_one]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Road.one_split_price
statement:
lemma one_split_price :
    ∀ᶠ j : ℕ in atTop, ∀ M J : ℕ, ∀ s : Scene M, ∀ f : Grid M → ℝ, ∀ v : Turn j s,
      ∀ t : (b : Bool) → Road j M (v.fork.dst b), Trusted J f (.fork s v t) →

      v.fork.probs.Ex (fun b =>
        givenD (v.fork.dst b) - 500*(v.fork.dst b).fund.spend +
        infoFee (.march s v b) - memFee (.march s v b)) ≤
          givenD s - 500*s.fund.spend
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [priced_change] with j hj M J s f v t h
  have hb := branchTrusted h
  obtain ⟨ha,hh,he,h⟩ := h
  have hL := hh.1.2.2
  let k := channel s.fund.mood
  cases v with
  | move =>
    have hx : s.here.lev < M := (rootSafe (h false)).within.2
    have hZ := space_deficit s k ha.within.1 hx ha.positive hL (by
      by_contra! hv; exact hh.2.2 (show enter s from by unfold enter; linarith))
    change (step s).probs.Ex (fun b => deficit (s.smaller b) k -
      500*s.fund.spend + _ - (0+0)) ≤ _
    simp only [add_zero,sub_zero,infoFee]
    rw [Ex_add,Ex_sub,Ex_const,Ex_const]
    unfold massInfo givenD k at *; linarith
  | ask u =>
    let v := toss s u
    let d (b : Bool) := deficit (v.dst b) k
    have hX (b : Bool) (hv : 0 < v.probs b) :
      givenD (v.dst b) - 500*(v.dst b).fund.spend ≤ d b - 500*s.fund.spend := by
      cases b with
      | false => exact le_rfl
      | true =>
        have hh := hj M J s f u ha (rootSafe (h true)) ((true_mass hb).mp hv) he.2
        change deficit (s.win u) (channel (u.next s.fund.mood)) -500*(s.fund.spend+u.credit) ≤
          deficit (s.win u) (channel s.fund.mood) - 500*s.fund.spend
        linarith
    let Q := v.probs
    have ht : Q.Ex (fun b => memFee (.march s (.ask u) b)) = Q.entropy := by
      unfold entropy crossE; congr 1
      funext b; cases b <;> simp [memFee,failFee,winFee,surprise] <;> rfl
    have hv := member_deficit s k u hb
    change Q.Ex (fun b => givenD (v.dst b) - 500*(v.dst b).fund.spend + infoFee (.march s (.ask u) b) - memFee (.march s (.ask u) b)) ≤ _
    rw [Ex_sub,Ex_add,ht]
    simp only [infoFee,Ex_const,add_zero]
    have HE := Q.Ex_mono_mem hX
    rw [Ex_sub (g:=fun _ => _)] at HE
    unfold Q at *; change _ ≤ deficit s k - _
    change v.probs.Ex d ≤ _ at hv
    rw [Ex_const] at HE; change v.probs.Ex d ≤ deficit s k + v.probs.entropy at hv
    linarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Road.fisher_bound
statement:
lemma fisher_bound :
    ∀ᶠ j : ℕ in atTop, ∀ M J : ℕ, ∀ f : Grid M → ℝ,
      (∀ x, f x ≤ exp (height j)) →
      let s
proof:
:= beginPlay f true
      ∀ t : Road j M s, Trusted J f t → 1/Thermal.H j ≤ s.mass →
        t.flatFee infoFee ≤ limitC* height j := by
  filter_upwards [one_split_price,Fund.fund_est,mem_budget,hpoly limitC 1,Fund.envelope_scale]
    with j he hg hs hC ha M J f hF s t ht hm
  let a := Thermal.H j; let d := height j; let V := (10:ℝ)^19*d
  have HI (s : Scene M) (t : Road j M s) (h : t.Trusted J f) (hM : 0 < s.mass) :
      t.flatFee infoFee - t.flatFee memFee ≤ givenD s - 500*s.fund.spend + 500*V := by
    induction t with
    | finish s b =>
      have hh := h.1
      have hf := ((hg M).2 _ _ hh.capital).1
      simp_rw [flat_finish]
      have h1 : 0 ≤ givenD s := deficit_nonneg _ hh.within hh.positive hM _
      have h2 := hh.capital.solvent
      unfold reserve capA at h2
      unfold V d
      have he : 1 ≤ height j := ha.2.2.1
      linarith
    | push s v t ih =>
      have hi := ih h.2.2.2 (by rw [pace_mass]; exact hM)
      rw [flat_push,flat_push]
      simp only [infoFee,memFee, failFee,winFee,zero_add]
      cases v <;> exact hi
    | fork s v t ih =>
      let Q := v.fork.probs
      let F := fun b => givenD (v.fork.dst b)-500*(v.fork.dst b).fund.spend
      have hX (b : Bool) (hb : 0 < Q b) := ih b (h.2.2.2 b) ((true_mass (branchTrusted h)).mp hb)
      have hi := Q.Ex_mono_mem hX
      have hv := he M J s f v t h
      simp_rw [flat_fork _ _ h, Ex_add]
      change Q.Ex (fun b => F b + _ - _) ≤ _ at hv
      change Q.Ex _ ≤ Q.Ex (fun b => F b + _) at hi
      rw [Ex_sub _,Ex_add _ (g:=fun _ => _)] at hi
      rw [Ex_const] at hi
      rw [Ex_sub,Ex_add] at hv
      unfold Q at *; linarith
  have hp : 0 < a := H_pos _
  have hC' : limitC*a ≤ d := by simpa only [pow_one] using hC
  have hm' : 0 < s.mass := lt_of_lt_of_le (by positivity : 0<1/a) hm
  have hf := rootSafe ht
  have Ht : givenD s ≤ d+a := by
    change deficit s (channel 0) ≤ d+a
    rw [funext no_label]
    apply le_trans (local_deficit_dry s (uniform (Grid M)) hf.within hf.positive hm' d hF)
    have he := log_le_log (by positivity : 0<1/a) hm
    rw [one_div,log_inv] at he
    linarith [log_le_sub_one_of_pos hp]
  have HZ := HI _ _ ht hm'
  have hx := (hs M J s f t ht hm').2
  change t.flatFee memFee ≤ limitC*a at hx
  change _ ≤ _-500*0+_ at HZ
  change _ ≤ limitC*d
  unfold limitC V at *
  nlinarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Scene.mass_actor
statement:
lemma mass_actor {s : Scene M} (hp : s.here.ok M) (hh : 0 ≤ s.wage) (x : Grid M) :
    s.mass * s.actor x = s.here.dice M x * s.wage x
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le (avg_nonneg s.here (fun x _ => hh x)) with h|h
  · change 0=s.mass at h; rw [← h,zero_mul]
    unfold mass at h
    rw [avg_ex hp,Ex] at h
    have H (x) : 0 ≤ s.here.dice M x*s.wage x := mul_nonneg ((s.here.dice M).nonneg _) (hh _)
    exact (H x).antisymm (le_trans (Finset.single_le_sum (fun i _ => H i) (Finset.mem_univ _)) h.ge)
  · rw [actor_def hp hh h x,wt]; unfold mass; field_simp

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Scene.actor_weight
statement:
lemma actor_weight {s : Scene M} (hp : s.here.ok M) (hh : 0 ≤ s.wage) (x : Grid M) :
    s.weight * s.actor x = side M * s.insideW x
proof:
:= by
  rw [weight,mul_assoc,mass_actor hp hh,dice_apply hp,insideW]; split_ifs
  · field_simp [s.here.len_pos.ne']
  ring

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Scene.Ex_weight
statement:
lemma Ex_weight {s : Scene M} (hp : s.here.ok M) (hh : 0 ≤ s.wage) (g : Grid M → ℝ) :
    s.weight * s.actor.Ex g = s.weightE g
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [Ex,Finset.mul_sum,← mul_assoc,actor_weight hp hh,weightE,expU,smul_eq_mul,
    Finset.mul_sum,mul_assoc]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Scene.weight_pos
statement: lemma weight_pos {s : Scene M} : 0 < s.weight ↔ 0 < s.mass
proof:
:=
  mul_pos_iff_of_pos_left s.here.len_pos

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Scene.actor_reset
statement: lemma actor_reset (s : Scene M) : s.reset.actor = s.actor
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Scene.actor_out
statement: lemma actor_out (s : Scene M) : s.out.actor = s.actor
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Fork.step_true
statement:
lemma step_true {s : Scene M} (hp : s.here.valid) (he : s.here.lev < M) (hh : 0 ≤ s.wage)
    (hm : 0 < s.mass) : (step s).TrueLaw
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact weight_pos.mpr hm
  intro b x
  have h1 := child_ok s.here hp he b
  have h2 : s.here.ok M := ⟨hp,he.le⟩
  change (s.smaller b).weight * (s.smaller b).actor x =
    if decide (x ∈ s.here.R.block M)=b then _ else 0
  rw [actor_weight (s:=s.smaller b) h1 hh, show (step s).src=s from rfl, actor_weight h2 hh]
  unfold insideW
  change (side M * if x∈(s.here.child b).block M then s.wage x else 0) =
    if decide (x ∈ s.here.R.block M) = b then _ else _
  rw [block_union s.here]
  have heq : x∈s.here.L.block M → x∈s.here.R.block M → False := fun ha hb => Set.disjoint_left.mp (s.here.block_separate M) ha hb
  cases b <;> by_cases H : x∈s.here.L.block M <;> by_cases H' : x∈s.here.R.block M <;>
    simp_all [child]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Fork.toss_true
statement:
lemma toss_true {s : Scene M} (u : Update j M s.here)
    (hp : s.here.ok M) (hh : 0 ≤ s.wage) (hm : 0 < s.mass) :
    (toss s u).TrueLaw
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact weight_pos.mpr hm
  intro b x
  have hX := split_pos u hh
  have he :
      (s.win u).weight*(s.win u).actor x = side M*(s.win u).insideW x :=
    actor_weight (s:=s.win u) hp hX.2.1 x
  have he' : (s.lose u).weight*(s.lose u).actor x = side M*(s.lose u).insideW x :=
    actor_weight (s:=s.lose u) hp hX.1.1 x
  cases b <;>
    simp only [toss,Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte,he,he',actor_weight hp hh]
  all_goals
    by_cases H : u.take s.fund.mood x <;> by_cases H' : x∈s.here.block M <;>
      simp_all [insideW, win,lose]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Fork.balance
statement:
lemma balance (h : v.TrueLaw) (b : Bool) :
    (v.dst b).weight = v.src.weight * v.probs b
proof:
:= by
  rw [probs,send_apply,prob_eq,Finset.mul_sum]
  calc
    _ = ∑ x, (v.dst b).weight * (v.dst b).actor x := by
      rw [← Finset.mul_sum,(v.dst b).actor.total]; simp
    _ = _ := by simp only [h.law, mul_ite,mul_zero]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Fork.local_law
statement:
lemma local_law (h : v.TrueLaw) (b : Bool) (x : Grid M) :
    v.probs b * (v.dst b).actor x = if v.bit x=b then v.src.actor x else 0
proof:
:= by
  have H := h.law b x; rw [balance h b,mul_assoc] at H
  apply mul_left_cancel₀ h.vertex.ne'
  split_ifs at H ⊢ with hi <;> simpa [hi] using H

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Fork.expect_bit
statement:
lemma expect_bit (h : v.TrueLaw) (f : Bool → Grid M → ℝ) :
    v.probs.Ex (fun b => (v.dst b).actor.Ex (f b)) =
      v.src.actor.Ex fun x => f (v.bit x) x
proof:
:= by
  unfold Ex
  simp_rw [Finset.mul_sum,← mul_assoc,local_law h,ite_mul,zero_mul]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
  simp

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Fork.true_mass
statement:
lemma true_mass (h : v.TrueLaw) {b : Bool} :
    0 < v.probs b ↔ 0 < (v.dst b).mass
proof:
:= by
  rw [← weight_pos,balance h b,mul_pos_iff_of_pos_left h.vertex]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Fork.branch_pos
statement:
lemma branch_pos (h : v.TrueLaw) {x : Grid M} (hh : 0 < v.src.actor x) :
    0 < v.probs (v.bit x) ∧ 0 < (v.dst (v.bit x)).actor x
proof:
:= by
  have H := local_law h (v.bit x) x
  rw [ite_eq_left rfl] at H
  have He : 0 < v.probs (v.bit x) * (v.dst (v.bit x)).actor x := H.symm ▸ hh
  exact ⟨pos_of_mul_pos_left He ((v.dst _).actor.nonneg _),
    pos_of_mul_pos_right He (v.probs.nonneg _)⟩

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Fork.step_mass
statement:
lemma step_mass {s : Scene M} (h : (step s).TrueLaw) (b : Bool) :
    (s.smaller b).mass = 2*((step s).probs b)*s.mass
proof:
:= by
  have H := balance h b
  change (s.here.child b).len * (s.smaller b).mass = s.here.len*s.mass* _ at H
  rw [child_len] at H; nlinarith [s.here.len_pos]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Fork.toss_mass
statement:
lemma toss_mass {s : Scene M} {u : Update j M s.here} (h : (toss s u).TrueLaw) (b : Bool) :
    ((toss s u).dst b).mass = (toss s u).probs b*s.mass
proof:
:= by
  have H := balance h b
  have hh : ((toss s u).dst b).here=s.here := by cases b <;> rfl
  rw [weight,hh,weight] at H
  apply mul_left_cancel₀ s.here.len_pos.ne'
  rw [H]
  dsimp only [toss]
  ring

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Fork.success_prob
statement:
lemma success_prob {s : Scene M} (u : Update j M s.here) :
    (toss s u).probs true = u.chances s.actor s.fund.mood
proof:
:= by
  unfold probs; rw [send_apply]; simp [toss,Update.chances]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.cutoff_log
statement:
lemma cutoff_log :
    ∀ᶠ j : ℕ in atTop, log (2*cutoff j) ≤ 20000*H j
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [evt_slow, eventually_ge_atTop 1] with j hj hi
  have h1 := hj.2
  have hp : (1:ℝ) ≤ j := by exact_mod_cast hi
  unfold cutoff; rw [log_mul (by norm_num) (by positivity),log_pow]
  have hZ := log_le_sub_one_of_pos (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<2)
  have he : (j:ℝ)<2^(3000*slow j) := by exact_mod_cast h1
  have HH := log_le_log (by linarith : 0 < (j:ℝ)+1) (show (j:ℝ)+1≤ 2* (2:ℝ)^(3000*slow j) by linarith)
  rw [log_mul (by norm_num) (by positivity), log_pow] at HH
  have hg := H_ge j
  unfold Thermal.H at *; push_cast at *
  nlinarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Journal.fee_neg
statement:
lemma fee_neg (l : Journal j M) (f : Event j M → ℝ) :
    l.fee (fun x => - f x) = -l.fee f
proof:
:= by
  unfold fee
  suffices HH : ∀ l : List (Event j M), (l.map (fun x => -f x)).sum= -(l.map f).sum from HH _
  intro L; induction L with
  | nil => simp
  | cons i t ih => simp [ih,add_comm]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Journal.fee_div_sub
statement:
lemma fee_div_sub (l : Journal j M) (f g : Event j M → ℝ) (r : ℝ) :
    l.fee (fun x => f x/r-g x) = l.fee f/r-l.fee g
proof:
:= by
  unfold fee
  suffices H : ∀ l : List (Event j M), (l.map (fun x => f x/r-g x)).sum =
      (l.map f).sum/r - (l.map g).sum from H _
  intro a; induction a with
  | nil => simp
  | cons i t ih => simp only [List.map_cons,List.sum_cons,ih]; ring

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Road.minus_like_cap
statement:
lemma minus_like_cap (t : Road j M s) (h : t.Trusted J f) (hm : 0 < s.mass) :
    t.expHike (fun l _ => exp (-l.like)) ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  have hi := capital_bound (s:=s) (fun i => -i.likelihood)
    (by intro i v; simp [Event.likelihood]) (by
      intro s v; cases v with
      | ask u =>
        simp only [likelihood,neg_zero,exp_zero,Ex_const]; exact le_rfl
      | move =>
        let Q := (step s).probs
        change Q.Ex (fun b => exp (-log (2*Q b))) ≤ _
        have H (b : Bool) : Q b * exp (-log (2*Q b)) ≤ 1/2 := by
          rcases eq_or_lt_of_le (Q.nonneg b) with hx|hx
          · rw [← hx,zero_mul]; norm_num
          rw [exp_neg,exp_log (by positivity)]
          field_simp; rfl
        simp only [Ex,Fintype.sum_bool]; linarith [H true,H false]) t h hm
  simpa only [Journal.fee_neg,like] using hi

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Road.half_debit_cap
statement:
lemma half_debit_cap (t : Road j M s) (h : t.Trusted J f) (hm : 0 < s.mass) :
    t.expHike (fun l _ => exp (l.debit/2-l.fee count)) ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  have H' := capital_bound (s:=s) (fun i => i.failFee/2-i.count)
    (by intro x v; simp [failFee,count]) (by
      intro s v; cases v with
      | move =>
        simp [Ex_const,failFee,count]
      | ask u =>
        let Q := (toss s u).probs
        have Hq : Q true+Q false=1 := by simp only [← Q.total,Fintype.sum_bool]
        have he₁ : Q true*exp (-1) ≤ Q true/2 := by
          have HP : Q true ≤ 1 := Q.le_one _
          have hx := Q.nonneg true
          rw [exp_neg]
          have he : 2 ≤ exp 1 := Real.exp_one_gt_two.le
          field_simp; nlinarith
        have he₂ : Q false*exp ((-log (Q false))/2) ≤ 1-Q true/2 := by
          rcases eq_or_lt_of_le (Q.nonneg false) with Hx|Hx
          · rw [← Hx,zero_mul]
            linarith
          have Ht := Real.exp_pos ((-log (Q false))/2)
          let q := Q false
          have hs : exp ((-log q)/2)^2 = 1/q := by
            rw [pow_two,←exp_add, add_halves,exp_neg,exp_log Hx]; ring
          have HH : (q *exp ((-log q)/2))^2=q := by rw [mul_pow,hs]; field_simp
          change _ + q = 1 at Hq
          change _*exp ((-log q)/2) ≤ _
          change 0 < q at Hx
          change q*exp ((-log q)/2) ≤ _
          nlinarith [sq_nonneg (q-1)]
        unfold Ex
        rw [Fintype.sum_bool]
        simp only [failFee,count, surprise,Turn.fork,zero_div,zero_sub,sub_zero]
        unfold Q at *; linarith) t h hm
  simpa only [debit,fee_div_sub] using H'

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Road.negative_square
statement: private lemma negative_square (x : ℝ) : max (-x) 0 ^2 ≤ 4*exp (-x)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases H : 0 ≤ -x
  · rw [max_eq_left H]
    have hh := Real.add_one_le_exp ((-x)/2)
    rw [show exp (-x)=exp ((-x)/2)*exp ((-x)/2) from
      Eq.symm (by rw [← exp_add,add_halves])]
    nlinarith
  rw [max_eq_right (by linarith)]
  simp only [ne_eq, OfNat.ofNat_ne_zero, not_false_eq_true, zero_pow]
  positivity

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Road.neg_like_budget
statement:
lemma neg_like_budget (t : Road j M s) (h : t.Trusted J f) (hm : 0 < s.mass) :
    t.expHike (fun l _ => (max (-l.like) 0)^2) ≤ 4
proof:
:= by
  unfold expHike
  apply le_trans (Ex_mono _ fun x => negative_square ((t.hike x).like))
  rw [Ex_lmul]
  have hh := minus_like_cap t h hm; unfold expHike at hh
  linarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Road.spent_top
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [Fund.fund_est,Fund.envelope_scale] with j H hi M c p h
  have h0 := ((H M).2 c p h).1
  have h1 := h.solvent
  have h2 : 1 ≤ height j := hi.2.2.1
  unfold reserve capA at h1
  norm_num at *; linarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Road.mem_budget
statement:
lemma mem_budget :
    ∀ᶠ j : ℕ in atTop, ∀ M J : ℕ, ∀ s : Scene M, ∀ f : Grid M → ℝ,
      ∀ t : Road j M s, t.Trusted J f → 0 < s.mass →
        t.expHike (fun l _ => membership l ^2) ≤ (limitC*H j)^2 ∧
        t.expHike (fun l _ => membership l) ≤ limitC*H j
proof:
:= by
  classical
  filter_upwards [spent_top] with j hg M J s f t h hm
  let a := H j; let d := height j
  have ha : 1 ≤ a := H_ge _
  have hb : 0 ≤ a := le_trans zero_le_one ha
  have hd : 0 < d := d_pos _
  let F (x) := membership (t.hike x)
  let e (x) := debit (t.hike x)/2 - (t.hike x).fee count
  have hf : s.actor.Ex (fun x => F x ^2) ≤ (limitC*a)^2 := by
    have H (x : Grid M) (hx : 0 < s.actor x) :
        F x ^2 ≤ 10^58*a^2 + 128*exp (e x) := by
      obtain ⟨hs,hh,h1,h2,h3,h4⟩ := final_sound h hm hx
      let l := t.hike x
      have hi : l.fee count ≤ capA*a := by
        have ht := hs.capital.under
        change _ + l.fee count=_ at h3
        change ((l.done.fund.uses:ℕ):ℝ) ≤ capA*a at ht
        linarith [Nat.cast_nonneg (α:=ℝ) s.fund.uses]
      have hW : creditSum l ≤ 10^26*a := by
        have HP : l.done.fund.spend-s.fund.spend ≤ 10^19*d := by
          have hk := (rootSafe h).capital.nonneg
          exact le_trans (sub_le_self _ (hk.1.trans hk.2)) (hg M l.done.fund l.done.here hs.capital)
        apply h4.trans
        calc
          _ ≤ 2000000*a/d*(10^19*d) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left HP (by positivity : 0 ≤ 2000000*a/d)
          _ ≤ _ := by field_simp; nlinarith
      have hWW : F x ≤ (10^26+2*capA)*a+ 2*max (e x) 0 := by
        change membership l ≤ _
        rw [mem_parts]
        have hh := le_max_left (e x) 0
        change debit l/2-l.fee count ≤ _ at hh
        unfold capA at *; linarith
      have hr' := negative_square (-(e x))
      rw [neg_neg] at hr'
      have hr := le_max_right (e x) 0
      have hZ : 0 ≤ F x := l.positive_mem
      apply le_trans (pow_le_pow_left₀ hZ hWW 2)
      unfold capA; nlinarith [exp_nonneg (e x),
        sq_nonneg ((10^26+2*(10:ℝ)^16)*a-2*max (e x) 0)]
    apply le_trans (Ex_mono_mem _ H)
    rw [Ex_add,Ex_const,Ex_lmul]
    have Hh : s.actor.Ex (fun x => exp (e x)) ≤ 1 := half_debit_cap t h hm
    unfold limitC; norm_num at *; nlinarith
  change s.actor.Ex (fun x => F x^2) ≤ (limitC*a)^2 ∧ s.actor.Ex F ≤ limitC*a
  exact ⟨hf,by nlinarith [sq_Ex s.actor F,show 0 ≤ limitC*a by unfold limitC; positivity]⟩

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Road.log_mass_budget
statement:
lemma log_mass_budget :
    ∀ᶠ j : ℕ in atTop, ∀ M J : ℕ, ∀ s : Scene M, ∀ f : Grid M → ℝ,
      ∀ t : Road j M s, t.Trusted J f → 1/H j ≤ s.mass →
        t.expHike (fun l _ => (max (-log l.done.mass) 0)^2) ≤ (10*limitC*H j)^2
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [mem_budget] with j hj M J s f t h hm
  let a := H j
  have hp : 0 < a := H_pos j
  have he : 1 ≤ a := H_ge j
  have hs : 0 < s.mass := lt_of_lt_of_le (by positivity : 0 < 1/a) hm
  have Hl : -log s.mass ≤ a := by
    have HH := log_le_log (by positivity : 0 < 1/a) hm
    rw [one_div,Real.log_inv] at HH
    linarith [log_le_sub_one_of_pos hp]
  have Hx (x : Grid M) (hx : 0 < s.actor x) :
      let l := t.hike x
      (max (-log l.done.mass) 0)^2 ≤ 3*a^2 + 3*l.membership^2 + 3*max (-l.like) 0 ^2 := by
    intro l; obtain ⟨_,_,_,h1,_,_⟩ := final_sound h hs hx
    have hP := l.positive_mem
    have hi := le_max_right (-l.like) 0
    have h := le_max_left (-l.like) 0
    have heq : max (-log l.done.mass) 0 ≤ a + l.membership + max (-l.like) 0 := by
      apply max_le <;> first | (dsimp only [l] at *; linarith)
    nlinarith [show 0 ≤ max (-log l.done.mass) 0 from le_max_right _ _,
      sq_nonneg (a-l.membership),sq_nonneg (a-max (-l.like) 0),sq_nonneg (l.membership-max (-l.like) 0)]
  have HH := (hj M J s f t h hs).1
  have HE := neg_like_budget t h hs
  unfold expHike at *
  apply le_trans (Ex_mono_mem _ Hx)
  rw [Ex_add,Ex_add,Ex_lmul,Ex_const,Ex_lmul,Ex_lmul]
  unfold limitC at *; nlinarith [show H j=a from rfl]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Memory.stash_ready
statement:
lemma stash_ready (m : Memory M) {s : Scene M} (h : Ready m j s.fund)
    (u : Update j M s.here) (hD : 0 ≤ u.changeForm) (hA : 0 ≤ s.fund.mood) (w : Clutch j M) :
    Ready (m.stash s.fund.mood (u.next s.fund.mood) w) j (s.fund.advance s.here u)
proof:
:= by
  let B := u.next s.fund.mood
  have H : s.fund.mood ≤ B :=
    (le_add_of_nonneg_right (place_valid _ _)).trans (le_add_of_nonneg_right hD)
  constructor
  · intro t ht
    simp only [stash,piece,List.mem_append,List.mem_cons,List.mem_ofFn] at ht
    rcases ht with (he|he)|he
    · subst t; exact ⟨hA.trans H,le_rfl⟩
    · obtain ⟨i,rfl⟩ := he; exact ⟨hA,H⟩
    obtain ⟨hl,hr⟩ := h.ordered t he
    exact ⟨hl,hr.trans H⟩
  · simp [advance,stash,piece]
  · simp only [stash,List.length_append,piece,List.length_cons,List.length_ofFn,h.num,advance]
    ring

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Memory.stash_length_bound
statement:
lemma stash_length_bound (m : Memory M) {s : Scene M} (h : Ready m j s.fund)
    (hg : Safe s j J f) :
    ↑(m.profile.length) ≤ observationBudget capA j
proof:
:= by
  rw [h.num,observationBudget]
  push_cast; gcongr
  exact hg.capital.under

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Memory.sumE_piece
statement:
lemma sumE_piece (A B : Form M) (w : Clutch j M) (x : Grid M) :
    sumE (piece A B w) x = loadE A B w x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [sumE,piece,List.map_cons,List.map_ofFn,Function.comp_def,
    List.sum_cons,List.sum_ofFn,loadE]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Memory.sumE_stash
statement:
lemma sumE_stash (m : Memory M) (A B : Form M) (w : Clutch j M) (x : Grid M) :
    sumE (m.stash A B w).profile x = loadE A B w x + sumE m.profile x
proof:
:= by
  rw [←sumE_piece]
  simp only [stash,sumE,List.map_append,List.sum_append]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Memory.form_in_past
statement:
lemma form_in_past (m : Memory M) (p : Form M × Grid M)
    (h : ∀ i∈m.profile, 0 ≤ i.1) (hp : p ∈ m.profile) (x : Grid M) :
    form p.1 (p.2-x) ≤ sumE m.profile x
proof:
:= by
  suffices HH : ∀ l : Profile M, (∀ i∈l, 0 ≤ i.1) → p∈l →
      form p.1 (p.2-x) ≤ sumE l x from HH _ h hp
  intro l; induction l with
  | nil => simp
  | cons i l ih =>
    intro h h'
    have he : 0 ≤ i.1 := h i List.mem_cons_self
    have hh : ∀ i∈l, 0 ≤ i.1 := fun i hi => h i (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hi)
    simp only [sumE,List.map_cons,List.sum_cons]
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp h' with rfl|H
    · apply le_add_of_nonneg_right
      apply List.sum_nonneg
      intro i hi
      obtain ⟨x,hx,rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hi
      exact form_nonneg (hh _ hx) _
    exact (ih hh H).trans (le_add_of_nonneg_left (form_nonneg he _))

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Memory.multiply_stash
statement:
lemma multiply_stash (m : Memory M) (A B : Form M) (p : Node) (x : Grid M)
    (w : Clutch j M) :
    prefixE m.profile p x * fresh A B j x w =
      stashRate A B j * prefixE (m.stash A B w).profile p x
proof:
:= by
  have hi (A : Form M) (v) :
      channel A x v = (side M*exp (F A)) * exp (-form A (v-x)) := by
    rw [ch_K,K_eq,sub_eq_add_neg,exp_add,mul_assoc]
  have H (v : Fin (clones j) → Grid M) :
      ∏ i, channel A x (v i) = (side M*exp (F A))^(clones j) *
        exp (-(∑ i, form A (v i-x))) := by
    simp_rw [hi,Finset.prod_mul_distrib,← Real.exp_sum,Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
    simp [mul_pow,exp_nat_mul]
  unfold prefixE
  split_ifs with hh
  · obtain ⟨v,c⟩ := w
    rw [fresh,tensorP_apply,pack_apply,H,hi,stashRate]
    simp_rw [tune,sumE_stash,loadE,neg_add,Real.exp_add]
    ring
  · ring

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Memory.rate_positive
statement: lemma rate_positive (j : ℕ) (A B : Form M) : 0 ≤ stashRate A B j
proof:
:= by
  unfold stashRate; have := side_pos M; positivity

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Memory.batch_expected
statement:
lemma batch_expected (A B : Form M) (x : Grid M) (j : ℕ) :
    (fresh A B j x).Ex (fun w => loadE A B w x) =
      (label B).Ex (form B) + clones j * (label A).Ex (form A)
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [fresh,Ex_tensorP,loadE,Ex_add,Ex_const,Ex_finset_sum,
    Ex_pack_proj (fun _ => channel A x) _ (fun z => form A (z-x))]
  rw [ch_noise B (form B)]
  simp_rw [ch_noise A (form A)]
  simp

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Memory.batch_scale
statement:
lemma batch_scale :
    ∀ᶠ j : ℕ in atTop, ∀ M J : ℕ, ∀ s : Scene M, ∀ f : Grid M → ℝ, ∀ x : Grid M,
      ∀ u : Update j M s.here, s.Safe j J f → (s.win u).Safe j J f →
        let A
proof:
:= s.fund.mood
        let B := u.next A
        (fresh A B j x).prob (fun w => temp j < loadE A B w x) ≤ 1/4 := by
  filter_upwards [h_large (100000*capA^2),hpoly (100000*capA^2) 230] with j h1 h2 M J s f x u ha hb A B
  let T := fresh A B j x
  have hA : 0 ≤ A := ha.capital.effects.nonneg
  have hB : 0 ≤ B := hb.capital.effects.nonneg
  have hT (w : Clutch j M) : 0 ≤ loadE A B w x := add_nonneg (form_nonneg hB _)
      (Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => form_nonneg hA _)
  let p (w : Clutch j M) : Prop := temp j < loadE A B w x
  have he := upperTail T p (fun w => loadE A B w x) hT (temp j) fun _ hx => hx.le
  let h := H j
  have hh : 1 ≤ h := H_ge j
  have hc := cap_ok; have hp : 0 < h := H_pos j
  let d := height j; have hd : 0 < d := d_pos j
  have ht : 0 < temp j := by
    have he : 0 < capA := by linarith
    change 0 < d/h^100/(capA*h)
    positivity
  let L := 2*plateErr j +100
  have hL : 0 ≤ L := by
    change 0 ≤ 2*(d/h^400)+100; positivity
  have Hx (s : Scene M) (hS : s.Safe j J f) :
      (label s.fund.mood).Ex (form s.fund.mood) ≤ capA*h*L :=
    hS.capital.effects.energy.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hS.capital.under hL)
  have hw :
      temp j * T.prob p ≤ capA*h*L+h^120*(capA*h*L) := by
    apply he.trans
    unfold T; rw [batch_expected,clones_eq]
    exact add_le_add (Hx (s.win u) hb) (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Hx s ha) (by positivity))
  change _ ≤ (1/4:ℝ)
  refine le_of_mul_le_mul_left (hw.trans ?_) ht
  have hP : 1 ≤ h^120 := one_le_pow₀ hh
  have HC : 0 < capA := by linarith
  change capA*h*L+h^120*(capA*h*L) ≤ d/h^100/(capA*h)*(1/4)
  have h3 : 8*capA^2*h^222*L ≤ d := by
    unfold L
    change 8*capA^2*h^222*(2*(d/h^400)+100) ≤ d
    have Hz : 100000*capA^2 ≤ h^178 := by
      change 100000*capA^2 ≤ h at h1
      exact h1.trans (by simpa using pow_le_pow_right₀ hh (by omega : 1 ≤ 178))
    have Hi : 8*capA^2*h^222 * (2*(d/h^400)) ≤ d/2 := by
      rw [show h^400=h^222*h^178 by ring]
      field_simp
      nlinarith
    rw [mul_add]
    change 100000*capA^2*h^230 ≤ d at h2
    have Hx := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (pow_le_pow_right₀ hh (show 222 ≤ 230 by omega))
      (show 0 ≤ 100000*capA^2 by positivity)
    nlinarith
  calc
    _ ≤ 2*(h^120*(capA*h*L)) := by
      have h1 : 0 ≤ capA*h*L := by positivity
      nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hP h1]
    _ ≤ _ := by field_simp; nlinarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Scene.actor_def

lemma actor_def (hp : s.here.ok M) (hv : 0 ≤ s.wage) (he : 0 < s.mass) :

proof:

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Road.prior_tempered

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Road.prior_weight
statement: lemma prior_weight (x : Grid M) : prefixE (prior M).profile root x = 1
proof:
:= by
  have h : x ∈ root.block M := (mem_group _ _).mp (by rw [group_top]; exact Finset.mem_univ _)
  unfold prefixE; simp [h,tune,prior,sumE,form_zero]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Road.rating_bound
statement:
theorem rating_bound :
    ∀ᶠ j : ℕ in atTop, ∀ M J : ℕ, 1000*((2:ℝ)^J) ≤ 2^M →
      ∀ f : Grid M → ℝ, (∀ x, f x ≤ exp (height j)) →
      let s
proof:
:= beginPlay f true
      ∀ t : Road j M s, Trusted J f t → 1/H j ≤ s.mass →
      t.expHike (fun l _ => exp (rating s l)) ≤ H j * exp (height j) := by
  filter_upwards [stake_upper,stake_lower] with j hi h M J hJ f hF s t ht hm
  have hv := rootSafe ht
  have he := H_pos j
  have hx : 0 < s.mass := lt_of_lt_of_le (by positivity : 0<1/H j) hm
  let m := prior M
  have hu : expU (t.score m) ≤ 1 := by
    have H := hi M J hJ _ f t ht m (prior_ready j M)
    have HC : prefixE m.profile s.here = fun _ => 1 := funext prior_weight
    simp_rw [HC,one_mul,expU_ex,Ex_const] at H
    exact (expU_ex _).le.trans H
  let F := fun x => t.score m x
  have HX (x) : s.actor x ≤ (H j * exp (height j))* side M := by
    have H := mass_actor (s:=s) hv.within hv.positive x
    have HH : x∈s.here.block M := (mem_group _ _).mp (by
      change x∈root.group M; rw [group_top]; exact Finset.mem_univ _)
    rw [dice_apply hv.within,ite_eq_left HH,show s.here=root from rfl,len_top,inv_one,mul_one] at H
    apply le_of_mul_le_mul_left _ hx
    have h0 := side_pos M; have h1 := exp_pos (height j)
    calc
      _ ≤ side M*exp (height j) :=
        H.le.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hF _) h0.le)
      _ = (1/Thermal.H j)*(Thermal.H j*exp (height j)*side M) := by field_simp
      _ ≤ _ := by gcongr
  have HN : s.actor.Ex F ≤ H j* exp (height j) := calc
    _ ≤ ∑ i, Thermal.H j * exp (height j) * side M * F i :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (HX _) (score_nonneg _ _ _)
    _ = (H j * exp (height j)) * expU F := by
      simp [expU,smul_eq_mul,Finset.mul_sum,mul_assoc]
    _ ≤ _ := mul_le_of_le_one_right (by positivity) hu
  unfold expHike
  apply le_trans _ HN
  exact Ex_mono_mem _ fun x hh =>
    h M J s f t ht m (prior_ready _ _) hx x hh (prior_tempered _ _ _)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Road.rare
statement:
theorem rare :
    ∀ᶠ j : ℕ in atTop, ∀ M J : ℕ, 1000*((2:ℝ)^J) ≤ 2^M →
      ∀ f : Grid M → ℝ, (∀ x, f x ≤ exp (height j)) →
      let s
proof:
:= beginPlay f true
      ∀ t : Road j M s, Trusted J f t → 1/H j ≤ s.mass →
      s.actor.prob (fun x => (t.hike x).froze = true) ≤ 1/H j^10 := by
  classical
  let C := limitC
  have hC : 1 ≤ C := by unfold C limitC; norm_num
  filter_upwards [rating_bound,mem_budget,log_mass_budget,hpoly capA 1,hpoly (1000*C) 11]
    with j hi hh h ht h' M J hJ f hx s t hT hm
  let a := H j; let d := height j
  have he : 1 ≤ a := H_ge _
  have hp : 0 < a := H_pos _
  have hd : 0 < d := d_pos _
  let Q := s.actor
  have hM : 0 < s.mass := lt_of_lt_of_le (by positivity : 0<1/a) hm
  let V (x : Grid M) := (t.hike x).membership
  let W (x : Grid M) := max (-log (t.hike x).done.mass) 0
  let Y (x : Grid M) := rating s (t.hike x)
  have HE (x : Grid M) (hv : 0 < Q x) :
      (if (t.hike x).froze = true then (1:ℝ) else 0) ≤
        (V x^2+W x^2)*(d^2)⁻¹ + exp (-4*d)*exp (Y x) := by
    split_ifs with H
    · obtain ⟨h1,h2,h3,h4,h5,H6⟩ := final_sound hT hM hv
      rcases (h2 H).2 with Hh|Hh
      · by_cases HB : d ≤ V x
        · apply le_trans (b:=(V x^2+W x^2)*(d^2)⁻¹)
          · rw [← div_eq_mul_inv]
            apply (le_div_iff₀ (by positivity)).mpr; nlinarith [sq_nonneg (W x)]
          linarith [show 0 ≤ exp (-4*d)*exp (Y x) by positivity]
        apply le_trans (b:= exp (-4*d)*exp (Y x))
        · rw [←exp_add]
          apply one_le_exp
          unfold Y rating
          have hX := h1.capital.under
          rw [pow_one] at ht
          change capA*a ≤ d at ht
          change 1000*d < _ at Hh
          change -4*d+(((_-0)/8 - V x)-_) ≥ 0
          rw [show s.fund.uses=0 from rfl,Nat.cast_zero] at h5
          unfold a d at *; unfold V at *; linarith
        exact le_add_of_nonneg_left (by positivity)
      · apply le_trans (b:=(V x^2+W x^2)*(d^2)⁻¹)
        · unfold W
          let v := log (t.hike x).done.mass
          have he' : d ≤ max (-v) 0 := by
            apply le_trans _ (le_max_left _ _)
            have hh := log_lt_log h3 Hh
            rw [Real.log_exp] at hh
            unfold v d; linarith
          rw [← div_eq_mul_inv]
          apply (le_div_iff₀ (by positivity)).mpr
          change _ ≤ _+max (-v) 0 ^2
          nlinarith [sq_nonneg (V x)]
        linarith [show 0 ≤ exp (-4*d)*exp (Y x) by positivity]
    positivity
  have hV : Q.Ex (fun x => V x^2) ≤ (C*a)^2 := (hh M J s f t hT hM).1
  have hW : Q.Ex (fun x => W x^2) ≤ (10*C*a)^2 := h M J s f t hT hm
  have hY : Q.Ex (fun x => exp (Y x)) ≤ a * exp d := hi M J hJ f hx t hT hm
  have hZ := Q.Ex_mono_mem HE
  have HH :
      (Q.Ex (fun x => V x^2) + Q.Ex (fun x => W x^2))*(d^2)⁻¹ ≤ (1/2)/a^10 := by
    have Hp := add_le_add hV hW
    refine (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right Hp (by positivity)).trans ?_
    change 1000*C*a^11 ≤ d at h'
    have hv : 1000*C*a^6 ≤ d :=
      (calc
       _ ≤ 1000*C*a^11 := by gcongr; norm_num
       _ ≤ _ := h')
    rw [← div_eq_mul_inv]
    field_simp
    nlinarith [show 0 ≤ C*a^6 by positivity,
      pow_le_pow_left₀ (show 0 ≤ 1000*C*a^6 by positivity) hv 2]
  have HY : exp (-4*d)*Q.Ex (fun x => exp (Y x)) ≤ (1/2)/a^10 := by
    change 1000*C*a^11 ≤ d at h'
    calc
      _ ≤ exp (-4*d)*(a*exp d) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hY (exp_nonneg _)
      _ = a*(exp (3*d))⁻¹ := by
        rw [mul_left_comm,←exp_add,←Real.exp_neg]; congr 2; ring
      _ ≤ _ := by
        rw [← div_eq_mul_inv]
        apply (div_le_div_iff₀ (exp_pos _) (by positivity)).mpr
        have hz := add_one_le_exp (3*d)
        nlinarith [show 0 ≤ a^11 by positivity]
  unfold prob

  have HZ : Q.prob (fun x => (t.hike x).froze=true)=
      Q.Ex (fun x => if (t.hike x).froze=true then 1 else 0) := by rw [prob_eq]; simp [Ex]
  change Q.prob _ ≤ _
  rw [HZ]
  rw [Ex_add,Ex_mul,Ex_add,Ex_lmul] at hZ
  apply hZ.trans
  apply (add_le_add HH HY).trans
  exact le_of_eq (by unfold a; ring)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Road.temperature
statement:
lemma temperature (m : Memory M) {f : Grid M → ℝ} (s : Scene M)
    (h : s.Safe j J f) (x : Grid M) (hh : tempered m j s x) :
    sumE m.profile x ≤ cushion j
proof:
:= by
  have hi : 0 < capA*H j := mul_pos (by norm_num [capA]) (H_pos _)
  have hp : 0 ≤ cushion j := by unfold cushion; have := d_pos j; positivity
  calc
    _ ≤ s.fund.uses*temp j := hh
    _ ≤ (capA*H j)*temp j := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h.capital.under (div_nonneg hp hi.le)
    _ = cushion j := by unfold temp; rw [mul_comm,div_mul_cancel₀ _ hi.ne']

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Road.good_payment
statement:
private lemma good_payment :
    ∀ᶠ j : ℕ in atTop, ∀ M J : ℕ, ∀ s : Scene M, ∀ m : Memory M, ∀ x : Grid M,
      ∀ f : Grid M → ℝ, ∀ u : Update j M s.here, Safe s j J f → Safe (s.win u) j J f →
      u.Good capA s.fund.mood s.actor →
      Ready m j s.fund → x∈s.here.block M → u.take s.fund.mood x → tempered m j s x →
      1/2 ≤ (fresh s.fund.mood (u.next s.fund.mood) j x).prob (fun w => gate m s u w ∧
        tempered (stash m s.fund.mood (u.next s.fund.mood) w) j (s.win u) x)
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [Memory.batch_scale,Update.quiet_scale capA cap_ok,h_large 16]
    with j hj hl hp M J s m x f u hs hw hu hm hx he ht
  let A := s.fund.mood; let B := u.next A
  let Q := fresh A B j x
  let E (w : Clutch j M) := temp j < loadE A B w x
  let L (w : Clutch j M) := u.regular=true ∧ Update.quiet u w
  have hE : Q.prob E ≤ 1/4 := hj M J s f x u hs hw
  have hL : Q.prob L ≤ 1/4 := by
    by_cases h : u.regular=true
    · have H : L= u.quiet := by simp [L,h]
      rw [H]
      refine le_trans (hl _ _ _ _ u hu h _ he) ?_
      have hh : Thermal.H j ≤ Thermal.H j ^40 := by
        have ht := pow_le_pow_right₀ (H_ge j) (show 1 ≤ 40 by omega)
        simpa using ht
      field_simp; linarith
    unfold prob L; simp [h, Ex_const]
  let p (w : Clutch j M) := gate m s u w ∧ tempered (stash m A B w) j (s.win u) x
  have HA := hs.capital.effects.nonneg
  have hStash w : Ready (stash m A B w) j (s.win u).fund := stash_ready m hm u hu.positive HA _
  have hR : ∀ i∈m.profile, 0 ≤ i.1 := fun i hi => (hm.ordered i hi).1
  have hU (w) (hh : ¬ E w ∧ ¬ L w) : p w := by
    let m' := stash m A B w
    have he' : tempered m' j (s.win u) x := by
      unfold tempered at *
      have Hg : loadE A B w x ≤ temp j := not_lt.mp hh.1
      unfold m'; rw [sumE_stash]
      change _+_ ≤ ((s.fund.uses+1:ℕ):ℝ)*_
      push_cast; linarith
    refine ⟨?_,he'⟩
    unfold gate; split
    case isTrue h1 =>
      have HX := temperature m s hs x ht
      refine ⟨⟨x,hx,HX⟩,Update.consistent_triangle u HA (y:=x) ?_ ?_
        (fun H => hh.2 ⟨h1,H⟩)⟩
      · apply le_trans _ HX
        exact form_in_past m (A,m.current) hR hm.has x
      intro i
      apply le_trans _ (temperature m' (s.win u) hw x he')
      have hz := hStash w
      apply form_in_past m' (A,w.2 i) (fun i hi => (hz.ordered i hi).1) ?_ x
      simp only [m',stash,piece,List.mem_append,List.mem_cons,List.mem_ofFn]
      exact Or.inl (Or.inr ⟨i,rfl⟩)
    trivial
  change 1/2 ≤ Q.prob p
  have H : Q.prob (fun w => ¬ p w) ≤ 1/4+1/4 := by
    apply le_trans (b:=Q.prob (fun w => E w ∨ L w))
    · exact Q.prob_mono _ _ fun w hi => by by_contra! ht; exact hi (hU _ ht)
    apply le_trans (prob_union Q E L) (add_le_add hE hL)
  rw [prob_compl] at H; linarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Road.stake_lower
statement:
lemma stake_lower :
    ∀ᶠ j : ℕ in atTop, ∀ M J : ℕ, ∀ s : Scene M, ∀ f : Grid M → ℝ,
      ∀ t : Road j M s, Trusted J f t → ∀ (m : Memory M), Ready m j s.fund →
      0 < s.mass → ∀ x : Grid M, 0 < s.actor x → tempered m j s x →
        exp (rating s (t.hike x)) ≤ t.score m x
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [good_payment] with j hj M J s f t h m ht hm x hx he
  induction t generalizing m with
  | finish s b => simp [hike,rating,membership,fee,score]
  | push s v t ih =>
    obtain ⟨ha,hb,hc,hd⟩ := h
    have hS : (s.pace v).fund=s.fund := by cases v <;> rfl
    have Hi := ih hd m (by rw [hS]; exact ht) (by rw [pace_mass]; exact hm)
      (by rw [pace_actor]; exact hx) (by unfold tempered;rw [hS]; exact he)
    rw [show rating s ((push s v t).hike x) = rating (s.pace v) (t.hike x) by
      simp [rating,hike,prepend,membership,fee,count,hS,memFee,failFee,winFee]]
    exact Hi
  | fork s v t ih =>
    have hB := branchTrusted h
    obtain ⟨hx1,hx2⟩ := Fork.branch_pos hB (x:=x) (by rw [v.source]; exact hx)
    have hx3 := (true_mass hB).mp hx1
    obtain ⟨ha,hb,hc,hd⟩ := h
    cases v with
    | move =>
      let b := (step s).bit x
      have Hi := ih b (hd b) m ht hx3 hx2 he
      change exp (rating s (((t b).hike x).prepend (.march s .move b))) ≤ _
      apply le_trans _ Hi
      dsimp only [rating]
      simp [prepend,membership,fee, count, memFee,failFee,winFee,Turn.fork,step,smaller]
    | ask u =>
      let v : Turn j s := .ask u
      let T := toss s u
      let A := s.fund.mood
      let B := u.next A
      let P := T.probs
      let Z := fresh A B j x
      have Hx (b : Bool) (hv : v.fork.bit x=b) :
          exp (rating s ((fork s v t).hike x)) =
            P b * exp (rating (v.fork.dst b) ((t b).hike x) + (if b then u.bill/8-1 else 0)) := by
        change 0 < P (v.fork.bit x) at hx1
        rw [hv] at hx1
        let w := (t b).hike x
        have Hz (b : Bool) : memFee (.march s v b) = -log (P b) := by
          cases b <;> simp only [memFee,v,winFee,failFee,surprise,zero_add,add_zero] <;> rfl
        have Heq (q : Journal j M) (b) :
            rating s (q.prepend (.march s v b)) =
              log (P b)+ (rating (v.fork.dst b) q + if b then u.bill/8-1 else 0) := by
          unfold rating membership
          rw [fee_pre,fee_pre,Hz]
          cases b
          · change (q.done.fund.bank-s.fund.bank)/8 - (- log (P false) + _) - (0+q.fee _) =
              log (P false)+((q.done.fund.bank-s.fund.bank)/8-_-_+0)
            ring
          · change (q.done.fund.bank-s.fund.bank)/8 - (- log (P true) + _) - (1+q.fee _) =
              log (P true)+((q.done.fund.bank-(s.fund.bank+u.bill))/8-_-_+(u.bill/8-1))
            ring
        have H1 :
            (fork s v t).hike x = w.prepend (.march s v b) := by
          unfold w
          let F (b : Bool) := ((t b).hike x).prepend (.march s v b)
          change F (v.fork.bit x)=F b
          exact congrArg _ hv
        rw [H1,Heq,exp_add,exp_log hx1]
      by_cases H : u.take A x
      · have hb' : v.fork.bit x=true := decide_eq_true H
        have hu' : u.Good capA A s.actor := hc.2
        have HY : x∈s.here.block M :=
          piece_support ha.within (actor_def ha.within ha.positive hm) _ hx
        let Q (w : Clutch j M) := gate m s u w ∧ tempered (stash m A B w) j (s.win u) x
        have HHq : 1/2 ≤ Z.prob Q := hj M J s m x f u ha (rootSafe (hd true)) hu' ht HY H he
        let d := exp (rating (s.win u) ((t true).hike x))
        let W (w : Clutch j M) := stash m A B w
        have HN (w) (hw : Q w) : d ≤ score (t true) (W w) x := by
          change 0 < (v.fork.dst (v.fork.bit x)).mass at hx3
          change 0 < (v.fork.dst (v.fork.bit x)).actor x at hx2
          rw [hb'] at hx3 hx2
          exact ih _ (hd _) _ (stash_ready m ht u hu'.positive ha.capital.effects.nonneg w)
            hx3 hx2 hw.2
        let M' (w : Clutch j M) := if gate m s u w then score (t true) (W w) x else 0
        have HE' : d/2 ≤ Z.Ex M' := by
          have hpos (w) : 0 ≤ M' w := by unfold M'; split_ifs; exact score_nonneg _ _ _; norm_num
          have Ht := Z.upperTail Q M' hpos d (by intro i hi; unfold M'; rw [ite_eq_left hi.1]; exact HN i hi)
          have hh : 0 ≤ d := exp_nonneg _
          nlinarith
        have Heq : exp (-1) ≤ 1/2 := by rw [exp_neg,← one_div]; exact one_div_le_one_div_of_le (by norm_num) exp_one_gt_two.le
        rw [Hx _ hb']
        change P true * exp (rating (s.win u) ((t true).hike x) + (if _ then _ else _)) ≤
