          (if u.take A x then P true * (exp (u.bill/8)*Z.Ex M') else _)
        rw [ite_eq_left rfl,ite_eq_left H,exp_add,sub_eq_add_neg,exp_add]
        apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (P.nonneg _)
        change d * _ ≤ _
        rw [mul_left_comm]
        have hh : d * exp (-1) ≤ Z.Ex M' := by have hh : 0 ≤ d := exp_nonneg _; nlinarith
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hh (exp_nonneg _)
      have hb' : v.fork.bit x=false := decide_eq_false H
      change 0 < (v.fork.dst (v.fork.bit x)).mass at hx3
      change 0 < (v.fork.dst (v.fork.bit x)).actor x at hx2
      rw [hb'] at hx3 hx2
      have HX := ih false (hd false) m ht hx3 hx2 he
      rw [Hx _ hb']
      change P false * _ ≤ (if u.take A x then _ else P false * score (t false) m x)
      rw [ite_eq_right H,ite_eq_right (by decide),add_zero]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left HX (P.nonneg _)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.pace_mass
statement: lemma pace_mass (s : Scene M) (v : Pace) : (s.pace v).mass=s.mass
proof: := by cases v <;> rfl

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.pace_actor
statement: lemma pace_actor (s : Scene M) (v : Pace) : (s.pace v).actor=s.actor
proof: := by cases v <;> rfl

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Turn.source
statement: lemma Turn.source (v : Turn j s) : v.fork.src=s
proof: := by cases v <;> rfl

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Road.traced
statement:
lemma traced {s : Scene M} (t : Play j M s) (b : Bool) (h : t.Follows J f) :
    (trace b t).Trusted J f
proof:
:= by
  induction t with
  | rest s => exact ⟨h.1,h.2⟩
  | freeze s t ih =>
    obtain ⟨ha,hb,hc,hd⟩ := h
    cases b; exact ⟨ha,hb,hc⟩; exact ⟨ha,hb,hc,ih hd⟩
  | ticket s t ih =>
    obtain ⟨ha,hb,hc,hd,he⟩ := h
    exact ⟨ha,hb,⟨hc,hd⟩,ih he⟩
  | jump s l r il ir =>
    obtain ⟨ha,hb,hc,hd,he⟩ := h
    refine ⟨ha,hb,hc,?_⟩
    intro b; cases b; exact il hd; exact ir he
  | attempt s u l r il ir =>
    obtain ⟨ha,hb,hc,hd,he,hf⟩ := h
    refine ⟨ha,hb,⟨hc,hd⟩,?_⟩
    intro b; cases b; exact il he; exact ir hf

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Road.rootSafe
statement: lemma rootSafe {t : Road j M s} (h : t.Trusted J f) : Safe s j J f
proof:
:= by
  cases t <;> exact h.1

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Road.branchTrusted
statement:
lemma branchTrusted {v : Turn j s} {t : ∀ b, Road j M (v.fork.dst b)}
    (h : (Road.fork s v t).Trusted J f) : v.fork.TrueLaw
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ha,hb,hc,hd⟩ := h
  cases v with
  | ask u => exact toss_true _ ha.within ha.positive hb.1.2.2
  | move =>
    have Hh := (rootSafe (hd false)).within.2
    exact step_true ha.within.1 Hh ha.positive hb.1.2.2

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Journal.fee_pre
statement:
lemma fee_pre (e : Event j M) (z : Journal j M) (f : Event j M → ℝ) :
    (z.prepend e).fee f = f e + z.fee f
proof: := by simp [prepend,fee]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Road.travel
statement:
lemma travel {f : Grid M → ℝ} {good : Scene M → Journal j M → Prop}
    (he : ∀ s b, Safe s j J f → (if b then s.openHere j J f ∧ s.retire j else ¬ s.openHere j J f) →
       0 < s.mass → good s ⟨s,b,[]⟩)
    (h1 : ∀ (s : Scene M) (v : Pace), Safe s j J f → s.openHere j J f → pace_ok s v j →
      ∀ l : Journal j M, good (s.pace v) l → good s (l.prepend (Event.pace s v)))
    (h2 : ∀ (s : Scene M) (v : Turn j s), Safe s j J f → s.work j J f → turn_ok v →
      v.fork.TrueLaw →
      ∀ b : Bool, 0 < v.fork.probs b → ∀ l, good (v.fork.dst b) l → good s (l.prepend (.march s v b)))
    (t : Road j M s) (h : t.Trusted J f) (hm : 0 < s.mass) {x : Grid M} (hx : 0 < s.actor x) :
    good s (t.hike x)
proof:
:= by
  induction t with
  | finish s b => exact he _ _ h.1 h.2 hm
  | push s v t ih =>
    obtain ⟨ha,hb,hc,hd⟩ := h
    exact h1 s v ha hb hc _ (ih hd (by rw [pace_mass]; exact hm) (by rw [pace_actor]; exact hx))
  | fork s v t ih =>
    have hf := branchTrusted h
    obtain ⟨hx1,hx2⟩ := Fork.branch_pos hf (x:=x) (by rw [Turn.source]; exact hx)
    obtain ⟨ha,hb,hc,hd⟩ := h
    exact h2 s v ha hb hc hf _ hx1 _ (ih _ (hd _) ((true_mass hf).mp hx1) hx2)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Road.Ex_hike_fork
statement:
lemma Ex_hike_fork {f : Grid M → ℝ} {v : Turn j s} {t : ∀ b, Road j M (v.fork.dst b)}
    (h : (Road.fork s v t).Trusted J f) (F : Journal j M → Grid M → ℝ) :
    expHike (Road.fork s v t) F = v.fork.probs.Ex (fun b =>
      expHike (t b) (fun l x => F (l.prepend (.march s v b)) x))
proof:
:= by
  unfold expHike
  let g := fun (b : Bool) x => F ((hike (t b) x).prepend (.march s v b)) x
  have hi := expect_bit (branchTrusted h) g
  rw [Turn.source] at hi
  exact hi.symm

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Road.Ex_hike_push
statement:
lemma Ex_hike_push {v : Pace} {t : Road j M (s.pace v)} (F : Journal j M → Grid M → ℝ) :
    expHike (.push s v t) F = expHike t (fun l x => F (l.prepend (.pace s v)) x)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [expHike,pace_actor,hike]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Road.score_nonneg
statement:
lemma score_nonneg {s : Scene M} (t : Road j M s) (m : Memory M) (x : Grid M) :
    0 ≤ score t m x
proof:
:= by
  induction t generalizing m x with
  | finish => change (0:ℝ)≤1; norm_num
  | push s v t ih => exact ih m x
  | fork s v t ih =>
    cases v
    · unfold score turnScore; dsimp only
      split_ifs
      · apply mul_nonneg (Law.nonneg _ _)
        unfold sampleWinner; dsimp only
        apply mul_nonneg (exp_nonneg _)
        refine Ex_nonneg _ fun z => ?_; split_ifs
        · exact ih true _ _
        · norm_num
      exact mul_nonneg (Law.nonneg _ _) (ih false _ _)
    exact ih _ _ _

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Road.total_gate
statement:
private lemma total_gate {m : Memory M} (s : Scene M) (u : Update j M s.here) (f : Memory M → Grid M → ℝ)
    (hh : ∀ w : Clutch j M,
      let t := m.stash s.fund.mood (u.next s.fund.mood) w
      expU (fun x => prefixE t.profile s.here x * f t x) ≤ expU (prefixE t.profile s.here)) :
    let A
proof:
:= s.fund.mood; let B := u.next A
    let N := prefixE m.profile s.here
    expU (fun x => N x * sampleWinner s u m x f) ≤ exp (u.bill/8) *
      expU (fun x => N x*(fresh A B j x).prob (gate m s u)) := by
  intro A B N
  let c := exp (u.bill/8)
  let rate := stashRate A B j
  have he (x : Grid M) (w : Clutch j M) :
      N x * fresh A B j x w = rate * prefixE (stash m A B w).profile s.here x := multiply_stash _ _ _ _ _ _
  let U := uniform (Grid M)
  have step (w : Clutch j M) :
      U.Ex (fun x => N x*(fresh A B j x w * (if gate m s u w then f (stash m A B w) x else 0))) ≤
        U.Ex (fun x => N x * (fresh A B j x w * (if gate m s u w then 1 else 0))) := by
    by_cases H : gate m s u w
    · simp_rw [ite_eq_left H, ← mul_assoc,he,mul_assoc,mul_one,Ex_lmul]
      have Hh := hh w
      simp_rw [expU_ex] at Hh
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left Hh (rate_positive _ _ _)
    simp [H]
  have H0 (x : Grid M) :
      N x*sampleWinner s u m x f =
        c*∑ w, N x*(fresh A B j x w * if gate m s u w then f (stash m A B w) x else 0) := by
    unfold sampleWinner; dsimp only
    rw [← Finset.mul_sum]; unfold Ex
    dsimp only [B,A,c]; rw [mul_left_comm]
  have H1 (x : Grid M) :
      N x*(fresh A B j x).prob (gate m s u) =
        ∑ w, N x * (fresh A B j x w * if gate m s u w then 1 else 0) := by
    unfold prob Ex; rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  simp_rw [expU_ex,H0,H1,Ex_lmul,Ex_finset_sum]
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => step i) (exp_nonneg _)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Road.stake_upper
statement:
lemma stake_upper :
    ∀ᶠ j : ℕ in atTop, ∀ M J : ℕ, 1000*((2:ℝ)^J) ≤ 2^M →
      ∀ (s : Scene M) (f : Grid M → ℝ) (t : Road j M s),
        Trusted J f t → ∀ m : Memory M, m.Ready j s.fund →
          let g
proof:
:= prefixE m.profile s.here
          expU (fun x => g x*score t m x) ≤ expU g := by
  filter_upwards [conditional_bound capA cap_ok,Fund.fund_est] with j hu hf
  intro M J hJ s f t h m he
  induction t generalizing m with
  | finish s b =>
    intro g; simp [score]
  | push s v t ih =>
    obtain ⟨ha,hb,hc,hd⟩ := h
    have hF : (s.pace v).fund = s.fund := by cases v <;> rfl
    have hP : (s.pace v).here = s.here := by cases v <;> rfl
    have HH := ih hd m (hF.symm ▸ he)
    rw [hP] at HH
    exact HH
  | fork s v t ih =>
    obtain ⟨ha,hb,hc,hd⟩ := h
    intro g
    let V := uniform (Grid M)
    cases v with
    | move =>
      let Q (b : Bool) := prefixE m.profile (s.smaller b).here
      have h1 (b : Bool) :
          V.Ex (fun x => Q b x * score (t b) m x) ≤ V.Ex (Q b) := by
        have H := ih b (hd b) m (show Ready m _ _ from he)
        simp_rw [expU_ex] at H
        exact H
      have hi (x : Grid M) :
          g x*score (.fork s .move t) m x =
            Q false x*score (t false) m x + Q true x*score (t true) m x ∧
          g x = Q false x+Q true x := by
        have hh : x∈s.here.L.block M → x∈s.here.R.block M → False :=
          fun h h' => Set.disjoint_left.mp (s.here.block_separate M) h h'
        change (g x*score (t ((step s).bit x)) m x = _ ∧ _)
        unfold g Q
        unfold prefixE
        by_cases hl : x∈s.here.L.block M <;> by_cases hr : x∈s.here.R.block M
        all_goals
          first
            | exact (hh hl hr).elim
            | have hx : x∈s.here.block M ↔ _ := Set.ext_iff.mp (block_union _ _) x
              first
              | rw [show (step s).bit x = true from decide_eq_true hr]
                simp [smaller,child,hx, hl,hr]
              | rw [show (step s).bit x = false from decide_eq_false hr]
                simp [smaller,child,hx, hl,hr]
      rw [funext (fun x => (hi x).1),funext (fun x => (hi x).2)]
      simp_rw [expU_ex,Ex_add]
      unfold V at h1
      exact add_le_add (h1 false) (h1 true)
    | ask u =>
      let A := s.fund.mood
      let B := u.next A
      have hA : 0 ≤ A := ha.capital.effects.nonneg
      let T := toss s u
      let P := T.probs
      let F (b : Bool) := score (t b)
      have HI : V.Ex (fun x => g x*F false m x) ≤ V.Ex g := by
        have H := ih false (hd _) m (show Ready _ _ _ from he)
        simp_rw [expU_ex] at H; exact H
      have HH : V.Ex (fun x => g x* sampleWinner s u m x (F true)) ≤ V.Ex g := by
        unfold V; simp_rw [← expU_ex]
        have hG := total_gate s u (F true) (m:=m) (by
          intro w; exact ih true (hd true) _ (stash_ready m (s:=s) he u hc.2.positive hA w))
        apply hG.trans
        cases H : u.regular with
        | false =>
          change u.regular=false at H
          have Hp (x : Grid M) : (fresh A B j x).prob (gate m s u)=1 := by
            unfold prob; simp [gate,H,Ex_const]
          change exp (u.bill/8) * expU (fun x => g x * (fresh A B j x).prob _) ≤ _
          simp_rw [Hp,mul_one]
          simp [Update.bill,H]
        | true =>
          have Hh : u.bill=u.credit := by simp [Update.bill,H]
          change exp (u.bill/8) * expU (fun x => g x * (fresh A B j x).prob _) ≤ _
          rw [Hh]
          by_cases hN : admissible m.profile s.here (cushion j)
          · have HE : gate m s u = u.alarm A m.current := by
              funext w; simp [gate,H,hN]; rfl
            rw [HE]
            have HP := ((hf M).2 s.fund s.here ha.capital).2
              (fun h => hb.2.1 ⟨hc.1,Or.inl h⟩) ha.within |>.1
            have Ht := hu M s.here s.fund.mood HP (by
              apply le_trans _ hJ
              gcongr
              exact pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num) ha.depth_ok)
              s.actor u hc.2 H m.profile he.ordered (stash_length_bound m he ha) hN m.current
            apply le_trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left Ht (Real.exp_nonneg _))
            rw [← mul_assoc,← exp_add,add_neg_cancel,exp_zero,one_mul]
          · have Hp (x : Grid M) : (fresh A B j x).prob (gate m s u)=0 := by
              unfold gate prob
              simp [hN,H,Ex_const]
            simp_rw [Hp,mul_zero,expU_ex,Ex_const,mul_zero]
            exact Ex_nonneg _ fun i => prefixE_nonneg _ _ _
      rw [expU_ex,expU_ex]
      let R (x) := sampleWinner s u m x (F true)
      calc
        _ ≤ V.Ex fun x => P false * (g x * F false m x) + P true * (g x * R x) :=
          Ex_mono _ fun x => by
            change g x * (if u.take A x then P true*R x else P false*F false m x) ≤ _
            have h1 : 0 ≤ F false m x := score_nonneg _ _ _
            have h2 : 0 ≤ R x := by
              unfold R sampleWinner; dsimp only
              apply mul_nonneg (exp_nonneg _) (Ex_nonneg _ _)
              intro i
              split_ifs <;> first | exact score_nonneg _ _ _ | exact le_rfl
            have hG : 0 ≤ g x := prefixE_nonneg _ _ _
            split_ifs
            · rw [mul_left_comm]; exact le_add_of_nonneg_left (mul_nonneg (P.nonneg _) (mul_nonneg hG h1))
            · rw [mul_left_comm]; exact le_add_of_nonneg_right (mul_nonneg (P.nonneg _) (mul_nonneg hG h2))
        _ = P false*(V.Ex (fun x => g x*F false m x)) + P true*(V.Ex (fun x => g x*R x)) := by
          rw [Ex_add,Ex_lmul,Ex_lmul]
        _ ≤ P false*V.Ex g + P true*V.Ex g :=
          add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left HI (P.nonneg _)) (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left HH (P.nonneg _))
        _ = _ := by rw [← add_mul,show P false + P true = 1 by simpa only [Fintype.sum_bool,add_comm] using P.total,one_mul]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Event.surprise_nonneg
statement: lemma surprise_nonneg (v : Turn j s) (b : Bool) : 0 ≤ surprise v b
proof:
:=
    neg_nonneg.mpr (Real.log_nonpos (v.fork.probs.nonneg b) (v.fork.probs.le_one b))

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Event.fee_bounds
statement: lemma fee_bounds (q : Event j M) : 0 ≤ failFee q ∧ 0 ≤ winFee q ∧ 0 ≤ tried q
proof:
:= by
  cases q with
  | pace _ _ => exact ⟨le_rfl,le_rfl,le_rfl⟩
  | march s v b =>
    cases v with
    | move => exact ⟨le_rfl,le_rfl,le_rfl⟩
    | ask u => cases b
               · exact ⟨surprise_nonneg _ _,le_rfl, zero_le_one⟩
               · exact ⟨le_rfl,surprise_nonneg _ _,zero_le_one⟩

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Event.price_space
statement:
lemma price_space (v : Turn j s) (b : Bool) (h : v.fork.TrueLaw) (hm : 0 < s.mass)
    (hh : 0 < v.fork.probs b) :
    likelihood (.march s v b) =
      log (v.fork.dst b).mass - log s.mass + memFee (.march s v b)
proof:
:= by
  cases v with
  | move =>
    change log _ = log (s.smaller b).mass-log s.mass+(0+0)
    change 0 < (step s).probs b at hh
    rw [step_mass h b,log_mul (mul_pos (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<2) hh).ne' hm.ne']
    simp
  | ask u =>
    have he (b) :
        memFee (.march s (.ask u) b) = -log ((toss s u).probs b) := by
      cases b <;> simp [memFee,failFee,winFee,surprise,Turn.fork]
    rw [he]
    change 0 = log ((toss s u).dst b).mass - log s.mass + -log ((toss s u).probs b)
    change 0 < (toss s u).probs b at hh
    rw [toss_mass h b,Real.log_mul hh.ne' hm.ne']; ring

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Event.surprisal_cost
statement:
lemma surprisal_cost (s : Scene M) (u : Update j M s.here)
    (h : u.Good capA s.fund.mood s.actor) :
    surprise (.ask u) true ≤
      2000000*H j/height j * u.credit
proof:
:= by
  let c := surprise (.ask u) true
  let p := (toss s u).probs true
  let i := u.ix
  have hp : beta i /2 ≤ p := by unfold p; rw [success_prob]; exact h.bias
  have hc : c ≤ 200 * (1+i) := by
    have h1 := log_le_log (div_pos (beta_pos i) (by norm_num)) hp
    rw [log_div (beta_pos _).ne' (by norm_num)] at h1
    change -log p ≤ _
    linarith [log_le_sub_one_of_pos (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<2),beta_log i,
      Nat.cast_nonneg (α:=ℝ) i]
  have he := h.duration
  let d := height j
  let a := H j
  have hD : 0 < d := d_pos j
  have ha : 0 < a := H_pos j
  calc
    _ ≤ _ := hc
    _ ≤ (2000000*a/d) * (eps * u.encoded capA) := by
      change (200:ℝ)* (1+i) ≤ (2000000*a/d) * ((1/10000)*(codeWeight capA*d/a*(1+i)))
      have hW := code_ge cap_ok
      field_simp
      nlinarith [show 0 < (1:ℝ)+i by positivity]
    _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left he (by positivity : 0 ≤ 2000000*a/d)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Journal.mem_parts
statement: lemma mem_parts (l : Journal j M) : membership l = creditSum l+debit l
proof:
:= by
  unfold membership creditSum debit fee
  suffices HH : ∀ l : List (Event j M),
      (l.map memFee).sum=(l.map winFee).sum+(l.map failFee).sum from HH _
  intro l; induction l with
  | nil => simp
  | cons i t ih => simp only [List.map_cons,List.sum_cons,ih,memFee]; ring

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Journal.positive_fee
statement: lemma positive_fee (l : Journal j M) (f : Event j M → ℝ) (h : ∀ i, 0 ≤ f i) : 0 ≤ l.fee f
proof:
:= by
  unfold fee; apply List.sum_nonneg; simpa using fun i (_ : i∈l.events) => h i

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Journal.positive_mem
statement: lemma positive_mem (l : Journal j M) : 0 ≤ membership l
proof:
:=
  l.positive_fee memFee (fun i => add_nonneg (fee_bounds i).2.1 (fee_bounds i).1)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Road.final_sound
statement:
lemma final_sound {t : Road j M s} {f : Grid M → ℝ} (h : t.Trusted J f)
    (hm : 0 < s.mass) {x : Grid M} (hx : 0 < s.actor x) :
    let l
proof:
:= hike t x
    l.done.Safe j J f ∧ (l.froze=true → l.done.retire j) ∧ 0 < l.done.mass ∧
      l.like = log l.done.mass-log s.mass+l.membership ∧
      (s.fund.uses:ℝ)+l.fee count=l.done.fund.uses ∧
      l.creditSum ≤ 2000000*H j/height j * (l.done.fund.spend-s.fund.spend) := by
  classical
  let a := 2000000*H j/height j
  intro l
  let g := fun (s : Scene M) (l : Journal j M) => l.done.Safe j J f ∧
    (l.froze=true → l.done.retire j) ∧ 0 < l.done.mass ∧
      l.like = log l.done.mass-log s.mass+l.membership ∧
      (s.fund.uses:ℝ)+l.fee count=l.done.fund.uses ∧
      l.creditSum ≤ a*(l.done.fund.spend-s.fund.spend)
  change g s l
  refine travel (good:=g) ?_ ?_ ?_ t h hm hx
  · intro s b h hb hm
    refine ⟨h,fun hi => ?_,hm,?_⟩
    · change b=true at hi; rw [ite_eq_left hi] at hb; exact hb.2
    simp [creditSum,membership,like,fee]
  · intro s v h hb hv l H
    rcases H with ⟨H₁,H₂,H₃,H₄,H₅,H₆⟩
    refine ⟨H₁,H₂,H₃,?_⟩
    rw [pace_mass] at H₄
    have he : (s.pace v).fund=s.fund := by cases v <;> rfl
    rw [he] at H₅ H₆
    simp only [like,membership,creditSum] at *
    rw [fee_pre,fee_pre,fee_pre,fee_pre]
    dsimp only [likelihood,memFee,Event.count,winFee,failFee,prepend]
    simp only [zero_add,add_zero]
    exact ⟨H₄,H₅,H₆⟩

  · intro s v h he hl hv b hh l H
    obtain ⟨Hx,Hy,Hz,H₁,H₂,H₃⟩ := H
    refine ⟨Hx,Hy,Hz,?_,?_⟩
    · unfold like membership
      rw [fee_pre,fee_pre]
      have Hi := price_space v b hv he.1.2.2 hh
      unfold like membership at H₁
      dsimp only [prepend]
      linarith
    unfold creditSum; rw [fee_pre,fee_pre]; unfold creditSum at H₃
    dsimp only [prepend]
    cases v with
    | move =>
      change (s.fund.uses:ℝ)+(0+l.fee count)=_ ∧ 0 + _ ≤ _
      rw [zero_add,zero_add]
      exact ⟨H₂,H₃⟩
    | ask u =>
      have HH : surprise (Turn.ask (j:=j) u) true ≤ a*u.credit :=
        surprisal_cost s u hl.2
      cases b
      · change (s.fund.uses:ℝ)+(0+l.fee count)=_ ∧ 0+_ ≤ _
        rw [zero_add,zero_add]; exact ⟨H₂,H₃⟩
      · change ((s.fund.uses+1:ℕ):ℝ)+l.fee count= _ at H₂
        change l.fee winFee ≤ a * (_-(s.fund.spend+u.credit)) at H₃
        change _+(1+_)=_ ∧ surprise (.ask u) _+_ ≤ _
        push_cast at *
        constructor; linarith; linarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Road.capital_bound
statement:
lemma capital_bound {s : Scene M} (F : Event j M → ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ s : Scene M, ∀ v : Pace, F (Event.pace s v)=0)
    (hf : ∀ s : Scene M, ∀ v : Turn j s,
      v.fork.probs.Ex (fun b => exp (F (.march s v b))) ≤ 1)
    (t : Road j M s) {f : Grid M → ℝ} (h : t.Trusted J f) (hm : 0 < s.mass) :
    t.expHike (fun l _x => exp (l.fee F)) ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  induction t with
  | finish s b => simp [expHike,hike, fee,Ex_const]
  | push s v t ih =>
    rw [Ex_hike_push]
    simp_rw [fee_pre,hp,zero_add]
    exact ih h.2.2.2 (by rw [pace_mass]; exact hm)
  | fork s v t ih =>
    rw [Ex_hike_fork h]; simp_rw [fee_pre, exp_add,expHike,Ex_lmul]
    apply le_trans _ (hf s v)
    apply Ex_mono_mem; intro b hb
    have hi := ih b (h.2.2.2 b) ((true_mass (branchTrusted h)).mp hb)
    exact mul_le_of_le_one_right (exp_nonneg _) hi

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.top_avg
statement:
lemma top_avg {E : Type*} [AddCommMonoid E] [MulAction ℝ E] (f : Grid M → E) :
    root.avg f = expU f
proof:
:= by
  rw [avg_sum, group_top,len_top,inv_one,one_smul]
  rfl

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.lose_eq
statement:
lemma lose_eq (u : Update j M s.here) (x : Grid M) :
    (lose s u).wage x = if u.take s.fund.mood x then 0 else s.wage x
proof:
:= by
  by_cases H : u.take s.fund.mood x <;> simp [lose,Set.indicator,H]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.win_eq
statement:
lemma win_eq (u : Update j M s.here) (x : Grid M) :
    (win s u).wage x = if u.take s.fund.mood x then s.wage x else 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases H : u.take s.fund.mood x <;> simp [win,Set.indicator,H]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.split_pos
statement:
lemma split_pos (u : Update j M s.here) (h : 0 ≤ s.wage) :
    (0 ≤ (lose s u).wage ∧ (lose s u).wage ≤ s.wage) ∧
      (0 ≤ (win s u).wage ∧ (win s u).wage ≤ s.wage)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨⟨?_,?_⟩,?_,?_⟩
  all_goals
    intro i
    dsimp only [Pi.zero_apply]
    first | rw [lose_eq] | rw [win_eq]
    split_ifs <;> first | exact h i | exact le_rfl

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.begin_ok
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [Fund.fund_est] with j hj
  intro M J f b hp h
  refine ⟨root_ok _,Nat.zero_le _,(hj M).1,le_rfl,hp,le_rfl,?_⟩
  change root.avg f ≤ _
  rw [top_avg]
  unfold cutoff; have hi := Nat.cast_nonneg (α:=ℝ) j
  have h1 : 1 ≤ ((j:ℝ)+1)^3 := one_le_pow₀ (by linarith)
  linarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.plant
statement:
theorem plant :
    ∀ᶠ j : ℕ in atTop, ∀ M J : ℕ, J ≤ M → ∀ f : Grid M → ℝ,
    0 ≤ f → expU f ≤ 2 → (∀ x, f x ≤ exp (height j)) →
    ∀ b : Bool, ∃ t : Play j M (beginPlay f b), t.Follows J f
proof:
:= by
  classical
  filter_upwards [begin_ok, Fund.fund_est, make_update capA cap_ok] with j hb hK hM
  intro M J hJ f h0 ht he b
  let OK (s : Scene M) := ∃ t : Play j M s, t.Follows J f
  suffices HH : ∀ k : ℕ, ∀ s : Scene M, s.here.lev+k=J →
      s.Safe j J f → OK s by
    exact HH J _ (by simp [beginPlay,root]) (hb M J f b h0 ht)
  intro k; induction k using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | h k ih =>
  intro s hi hy
  suffices IH : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ s : Scene M, s.here.lev+k=J →
      s.Safe j J f → stage j s=n → OK s from IH _ s hi hy rfl
  intro n; induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | h n Now =>
  intro s hi hy hn
  subst n
  by_cases ho : openHere s j J f
  case neg => exact ⟨Play.rest s, hy, ho⟩
  have hh1 := hy.positive
  have hm : 0 < s.mass := ho.2.2
  have hL : s.here.lev < J := ho.1
  have hR : s.here.lev < M := hL.trans_le hJ
  have hp : s.here.valid := hy.within.1
  by_cases h : retire s j
  · have hq : s.out.Safe j J f := by
      obtain ⟨a,b,c,d,e,f,g⟩ := hy
      exact ⟨a,b,c,le_rfl,e,f,g⟩
    obtain ⟨t,h1⟩ := Now _ (show stage j s.out < _ by
      have heq : playing s.out = playing s := rfl
      have hmass : 0 < s.here.avg s.wage := hm
      have hbonusOut : bonus s.out = 1 := by simp [bonus,out,enter,mass,hmass]
      have hbonusS : 2 ≤ bonus s := by simp [bonus,h.1]
      have hfund : s.out.fund.uses = s.fund.uses := rfl
      rw [stage,stage,heq,hfund]
      rw [hbonusOut]
      omega)
      s.out hi hq rfl
    exact ⟨Play.freeze s t, hy,ho,h,h1⟩
  by_cases ha : enter s
  · have ha' : ¬ enter s.reset := by unfold enter reset; change ¬ 2*s.mass<s.mass; linarith
    have hq : s.reset.Safe j J f := by
      obtain ⟨a,b,c,d,e,f,g⟩ := hy
      exact ⟨a,b,c,hm.le,e,f,g⟩
    obtain ⟨t,h1⟩ := Now _ (show stage j s.reset < _ by
      have heq : playing s.reset = playing s := rfl
      have hbonus : bonus s.reset + 1 = bonus s := by
        unfold bonus
        rw [ite_eq_right ha', ite_eq_left ha]
        rfl
      have hfund : s.reset.fund.uses = s.fund.uses := rfl
      rw [stage,stage,heq,hfund]
      omega) s.reset hi hq rfl
    exact ⟨Play.ticket s t, hy,ho,h,ha,h1⟩
  by_cases HH : settled s j
  · have hE (b : Bool) : OK (s.smaller b) := by
      have H : (s.smaller b).here.lev = s.here.lev+1 := by cases b <;> rfl
      apply ih (k-1) (by omega)
      · omega
      refine ⟨s.here.child_ok hp hR b,by rw [H]; exact hL,
        hy.capital.restrict (s.here.child_below _), hy.norm_ok, hh1,hy.sub,?_⟩
      have H1 := avg_nonneg s.here.L (f:=f) fun x _ => h0 x
      have H2 := avg_nonneg s.here.R (f:=f) fun x _ => h0 x
      have H3 := ho.2.1
      rw [avg_split_real s.here] at H3
      cases b
      · change s.here.L.avg f ≤ _; linarith
      · change s.here.R.avg f ≤ _; linarith
    obtain ⟨l,hl⟩ := hE false
    obtain ⟨r,hr⟩ := hE true
    exact ⟨Play.jump s l r,hy,⟨ho,h,ha⟩,HH,hl,hr⟩
  unfold settled at HH; push Not at HH
  obtain ⟨hl,i,HH',HE⟩ := HH
  have hb : ¬ breached j s.fund := fun he => h ⟨hl,Or.inl he⟩
  have hx : exp (-height j) ≤ s.mass := by
    apply le_of_not_gt; exact fun hi => h ⟨hl,Or.inr hi⟩
  have hW := ((hK M).2 s.fund s.here hy.capital).2 hb hy.within
  have hV := actor_def hy.within hy.positive hm
  unfold enter at ha
  obtain ⟨u,rfl,hu⟩ := hM _ _ _ hR hW.1 s.wage hh1
    (fun x => le_trans (hy.sub x) (he x)) hx _ _ hV
    (by linarith) (le_of_not_gt ha) i HH' HE
  have h₁ := split_pos u hh1
  have h₂ : ∀ s : Scene M, bonus s ≤ 3 := fun s => by unfold bonus; split_ifs <;> omega
  have hY₁ : Safe (s.lose u) j J f :=
    ⟨hy.within,hy.depth_ok,hy.capital,hy.norm_ok,h₁.1.1,h₁.1.2.trans hy.sub,hy.cut⟩
  have hY₂ : Safe (s.win u) j J f :=
    ⟨hy.within,hy.depth_ok,hW.2.2 u _ hu,le_rfl,h₁.2.1,h₁.2.2.trans hy.sub,hy.cut⟩
  have hww : stage j (s.win u) < stage j s := by
      let N := totalUse j
      have h4 : s.fund.uses+1 ≤ N := by
        have HH := (Nat.le_ceil (capA*H j))
        have He : ((s.fund.uses+1:ℕ):ℝ) ≤ ↑N := by push_cast; exact hW.2.1.trans HH
        exact_mod_cast He
      have h3 := h₂ (s.win u)
      let L := Fintype.card (Grid M)+1
      have h5 : (s.win u).fund.uses = s.fund.uses+1 := rfl
      have h6 : (playing (s.win u)).card < L := Nat.lt_succ_of_le (Finset.card_le_univ _)
      unfold stage; rw [h5,show totalUse j - s.fund.uses= N-(s.fund.uses+1)+1 by omega]; simp only [add_mul, one_mul]
      dsimp only [N,L] at *; omega
  have hll : stage j (s.lose u) < stage j s := by
    have h4 : (playing (s.lose u)).card < (playing s).card := by
      apply Finset.card_lt_card
      refine Finset.ssubset_iff_of_subset (s₁:=playing (s.lose u)) ?_ |>.mpr ?_
      · intro x hx
        simp only [playing,Finset.mem_filter,Finset.mem_univ,true_and] at *
        exact lt_of_lt_of_le hx (h₁.1.2 _)
      have HE := lt_of_lt_of_le (show 0 < beta u.ix /2 from by have := beta_pos u.ix; positivity) hu.bias
      obtain ⟨x,hx,hx'⟩ := (prob_pos_iff _ _).mp HE
      have hf : 0 < s.wage x := by
        by_contra! H
        have hh := H.antisymm (hh1 x)
        rw [hV _,wt,hh,mul_zero,zero_div] at hx'
        exact lt_irrefl _ hx'
      refine ⟨x,?_,?_⟩ <;> simp [playing,hf,lose_eq, hx]
    unfold stage
    rw [show (s.lose u).fund=s.fund from rfl]
    have hh := h₂ (s.lose u); omega
  obtain ⟨l,hl'⟩ := Now _ hll (s.lose u) hi hY₁ rfl
  obtain ⟨r,hr'⟩ := Now _ hww (s.win u) hi hY₂ rfl
  exact ⟨Play.attempt s u l r, hy, ⟨ho,h,ha⟩,hl,hu,hl',hr'⟩

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Snapshot.Plot.vacant_comes
statement: lemma vacant_comes (s : Scene M) : Comes (vacant M) s j J f
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨classic_sound _,?_⟩
  simp [vacant]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Snapshot.Plot.comes_down
proof:
:= by
  have hZ := zoom_spec _ hp.valid p.ix p.main h
  obtain ⟨ha,hb,hc,hv,hE,hk⟩ := h
  refine ⟨hZ.sonic,?_⟩
  intro x hx
  simp only [turn] at hx
  split_ifs at hx with hX hY
  · obtain rfl := Option.some.inj hx
    exact ⟨hc,hv,hE,(rooted _ (hk false)).within.2,child_below _ _,rfl,rfl,rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨ha,hc,hE,h₁,h₂,h₃,h₄,h₅⟩ := hp.stored _ hx
  change _∧_∧_∧_∧below (q.here.child b) _ ∧ x.fund=q.fund ∧ x.live=q.live ∧ x.norm=q.norm
  rw [hb.1.fund,hb.1.flat,hb.1.mode,hb.1.here]
  exact ⟨ha,hc,hE,h₁,below_trans (child_below _ _) h₂,h₃,h₄,h₅⟩

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Snapshot.Plot.effort_bounds
statement:
lemma effort_bounds :
    ∀ᶠ j : ℕ in atTop, ∀ p : Plot, (p.main=true → p.ix ≤ mainIx j) →
      64*tolerance j p.ix p.main +20*sharp p.ix ≤ amp p.ix p.main / 2
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [h_large 100000] with j hg p hp
  let b := side p.ix
  have he := side_pos p.ix
  have h6 : b^6 ≤ b^2 := pow_le_pow_of_le_one he.le (side_le _) (by omega)
  have h4 : b^4 ≤ b := by simpa using pow_le_pow_of_le_one he.le (side_le _) (by omega : 1 ≤ 4)
  cases hm : p.main with
  | false =>
    have hb : b^2 ≤ b := by simpa using pow_le_pow_of_le_one he.le (side_le _) (by omega : 1 ≤ 2)
    change 64*(b^4/65536)+20*(b^6/32768) ≤ b/2
    nlinarith [show 0 < b from he]
  | true =>
    change 64*(1/Thermal.H j^40)+20*(b^6/32768) ≤ b^2/2
    have hx := (main_bounds j (show p.ix ≤ testIx j from Nat.le_trans (hp hm) (by unfold testIx; omega))).1
    change _ ≤ b^2/100 at hx
    let a := Thermal.H j
    have hh : a ≤ a^8 := by simpa using pow_le_pow_right₀ (H_ge j) (by omega : 1 ≤ 8)
    have ht : 64*(1/a^40) ≤ b^2/4 := by
      apply le_trans (b:=25*((1/6400)/a^32)) _ (by unfold a; linarith)
      have hp' : 0 < a := H_pos j
      field_simp
      change 100000 ≤ a at hg
      nlinarith
    unfold a at *
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg b]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Snapshot.Plot.currently
statement:
lemma currently :
    ∀ᶠ j : ℕ in atTop, ∀ (p : Plot), (p.main=true → p.ix ≤ mainIx j) →
    ∀ M J : ℕ, ∀ f : Grid M → ℝ, ∀ s q : Scene M, ∀ l,
      Following j J f (.ran s q l) → ∀ g : Board M, Comes g s j J f →
      cardStep p (turn p g q) → ∀ x, catches p q g j x →
        ∃ v : Scene M, (turn p g q).previous=some v ∧ below q.here v.here ∧
          ∃ y∈net v j p.ix p.main, aligned p q j x y
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [effort_bounds] with j h p hp M J f s q l hl c hc hC x hx
  classical
  obtain ⟨ha,hb,hh,hd,hQ,hk⟩ := hl
  obtain ⟨⟨b,hy⟩,v,hv,hD⟩ := hx
  let t := q.smaller b
  let B := p.main
  let r := spotLimit q j p.ix B
  have he₁ := share_small hd
  have hv' := (rooted _ (hk b))
  have hX : ReadyAt t := ⟨hv'.within,hv'.positive⟩
  have hqt : q.here.lev < M := (rooted _ (hk false)).within.2
  have hτ := h p hp
  let V := amp p.ix B
  let L := tolerance j p.ix p.main
  have hD' := share_child q hh.within.1 hqt hh.positive he₁.1 he₁.2 b
  have HX : V ≤ magnitude B t v+64*L := by
    apply le_trans hy
    have H := magnitude_near B t x v hX he₁.1.le 4 hD'
    have HE : 4*(16*t.here.len*rad (x-v)) ≤ 64*L := by
      rw [show t.here.len=q.here.len/2 from child_len _ _]
      have hp := q.here.len_pos; change rad _ ≤ L*q.here.invlen at hD
      calc
        _ ≤ 4*(16*(q.here.len/2)*(L*q.here.invlen)) := by gcongr
        _ = 32*L := by rw [rinv]; field_simp; ring
        _ ≤ 64*L := by linarith [show 0 < L from tolerance_pos _ _ _]
    linarith
  have he : strength B (side (p.ix+1)) ≤ V/2 := by
    unfold V amp; rw [side_succ]
    cases B with
    | false => exact le_rfl
    | true =>
      change (_/_)^2 ≤ _^2/2
      nlinarith [side_pos p.ix]
  have HW (s : Scene M) (hh : below q.here s.here) (hv : s.fund=q.fund)
      (H : intense p.main s (side (p.ix+1)) v) :
        ∃ y∈net s j p.ix p.main, aligned p q j x y := by
    obtain ⟨y,hy,hQ⟩ := (net_spec s j p.ix p.main).2.2 _ H
    have hR : spotLimit s j p.ix p.main ≤ spotLimit q j p.ix p.main :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (scale_below hh) (tolerance_pos _ _ _).le
    refine ⟨y,hy,?_⟩
    dsimp only [aligned]
    unfold adjacent at hQ
    by_cases Hz : p.main=true
    · rw [ite_eq_left Hz] at hQ ⊢
      obtain ⟨k,hk,hv'⟩ := hQ
      refine ⟨k,hv ▸ hk,?_⟩
      have HH := rad_add (x-v) (v-y-k)
      rw [show x-v+(v-y-k)=x-y-k by ring] at HH; linarith
    · rw [ite_eq_right Hz] at hQ ⊢
      have HH := rad_add (x-v) (v-y); rw [sub_add_sub_cancel] at HH; linarith
  rw [prior_step _ _ _ hC]
  change 64*L+20*sharp p.ix ≤ V/2 at hτ
  split_ifs with hF
  · refine ⟨q,rfl,below_refl _,HW q (below_refl _) rfl ⟨b,?_⟩⟩
    change strength B _ ≤ magnitude B t v
    linarith [sharp_pos p.ix]
  unfold freshAt at hF
  cases hA : c.previous with
  | none => simp [hA] at hF
  | some w =>
    obtain ⟨h1,h2,h3,h4,h5,h6,h7,h8⟩ := hc.stored w hA
    have he₀ : below q.here w.here := hb.1.here.symm ▸ h5
    have he' : w.fund=q.fund := h6.trans hb.1.fund.symm
    refine ⟨w,rfl,he₀,HW w he₀ he' ?_⟩
    rw [hA] at hF
    have hF' : (zoom q p.ix p.main c.chart).items=c.chart.items ∧ ∀ b,
        p.closer c (q.smaller b) w := by push Not at hF; exact hF
    have ht := share_small h2
    have H : magnitude B t v ≤ magnitude B w v +20*sharp p.ix := by
      have hZ : (turn p c q).chart.items=c.chart.items := hF'.1
      have hE : (now p c q).items=c.chart.items := hF'.1
      apply close_display t w B c.chart.items p.ix p.cap _ _ _ _ hX
        ⟨h1.within,h1.positive⟩ he₁.1.le ht.1.le hD' (ht.2.trans (by norm_num))
      · rw [← hZ]; exact hC
      · rwa [hE] at hv
      exact hF'.2 b
    obtain ⟨c,hq⟩ := sup_children B w h1.within.1 h4 h1.positive ht.1.le v
    exact ⟨c,by change strength B _ ≤ _; linarith⟩

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Snapshot.Plot.waiting
statement:
lemma waiting (p : Plot) (j : ℕ) (s t : Node)
    (h : s.lev+latency p j ≤ t.lev)
    (q : ℕ) (hh : q ≤ rangeIx p.cap) :
    horizon s p.ix q ≤ tolerance j p.ix p.main * t.invlen
proof:
:= by
  let c := p.cap; let i := p.ix
  let n := latency p j
  let k := 16+4*i+40*ell j
  unfold horizon speed band
  have h1 : 1+(q:ℝ) ≤ 2^(c+1) := by
    suffices HH : 1+q ≤ 2^(c+1) by exact_mod_cast HH
    have H : 0 < 2^c := by positivity
    change q ≤ 2^c at hh; rw [pow_succ]; omega
  have h2 : 2*((offset i q:ℝ)+10) ≤ 2^(i+c+10) := by
    suffices HH : 2*(offset i q+10) ≤ 2^(i+c+10) by exact_mod_cast HH
    unfold offset; change q ≤ 2^c at hh
    have H1 : i ≤ 2^(i+c) := Nat.le_trans Nat.lt_two_pow_self.le (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) (by omega))
    have H2 : q ≤ 2^(i+c) := Nat.le_trans hh (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) (by omega))
    rw [pow_add]; have H : 0 < 2^(i+c) := by positivity
    norm_num; omega
  have H : (1:ℝ)/2^k ≤ tolerance j i p.main := by
    unfold tolerance
    split
    · unfold sig slow
      push_cast; rw [← pow_mul]
      apply one_div_le_one_div_of_le (by positivity); unfold k; apply pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num) (by omega)
    rw [side_pow_two,inv_pow,← pow_mul]
    rw [one_div,div_eq_mul_inv,← mul_inv]
    unfold k; rw [inv_le_inv₀ (by positivity) (by positivity)]
    rw [show (65536:ℝ)=2^16 by norm_num,← pow_add]; apply pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num) (by omega)
  apply le_trans _ (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right H t.invlen_pos.le)
  unfold invlen
  apply le_trans (b:=2^(c+1) * ((2:ℝ)^(s.lev+reach i+10)*2^(i+c+10))) (by gcongr)
  rw [← pow_add,← pow_add,one_div,mul_comm _ ((2:ℝ)^t.lev),←div_eq_mul_inv]
  apply (le_div_iff₀ (by positivity : 0<(2:ℝ)^k)).mpr
  rw [← pow_add]
  apply pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num)
  unfold k i c latency reach at *
  omega

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Snapshot.grain_nonneg
statement: lemma grain_nonneg {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) : 0 ≤ grain a b
proof:
:=
    div_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (by linarith)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Snapshot.cloud_nonneg
statement:
lemma cloud_nonneg (a b : α → ℝ) (ha : ∀ i, 0 ≤ a i) (hb : ∀ i, 0 ≤ b i) :
    0 ≤ cloud a b
proof: := Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ => grain_nonneg (ha _) (hb _)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Snapshot.cloud_same
statement: lemma cloud_same (a : α → ℝ) : cloud a a=0
proof: := by simp [cloud,grain]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Snapshot.distance_cloud
statement:
lemma distance_cloud (a b : α → ℝ) (ha : ∀ i, 0 ≤ a i) (hb : ∀ i, 0 ≤ b i) :
    (distance a b)^2 ≤ ((∑ i,a i)+ ∑ i,b i)*cloud a b
proof:
:= by
  unfold distance cloud; rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  refine Finset.sum_sq_le_sum_mul_sum_of_sq_le_mul _
    (fun i _ => add_nonneg (ha _) (hb _)) (fun i _ => grain_nonneg (ha i) (hb i)) ?_
  intro i _
  rw [sq_abs,grain]
  rcases lt_or_eq_of_le (add_nonneg (ha i) (hb i)) with hi|hi
  · exact le_of_eq (by field_simp)
  · have hx := ha i; have hy := hb i
    rw [show a i = 0 by linarith,show b i = 0 by linarith]; simp

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Snapshot.shift_formula
statement:
private lemma shift_formula (a b : ℝ) (h : a+b ≠ 0) :
    grain a b=a-3*b+4*b^2/(a+b)
proof: := by unfold grain; field_simp; ring

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Snapshot.grain_shrinks
statement:
lemma grain_shrinks (a b t : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) (h : b ≤ a) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    grain b t ≤ grain a t + 4*(a-b)
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le ht with H|H
  · have HH (a : ℝ) : grain a 0=a := by
      unfold grain; by_cases h : a=0 <;> simp [h, pow_two]
    rw [← H,HH,HH]; linarith
  · rw [shift_formula _ _ (by linarith),shift_formula _ _ (by linarith)]
    apply le_of_sub_nonneg
    have hx : 0 < (a+t)*(b+t) := by positivity
    apply le_of_mul_le_mul_left ?_ hx
    rw [mul_zero]
    have HE : t^2 ≤ (a+t)*(b+t) := by nlinarith
    have HT := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right HE (show 0 ≤ a-b by linarith)
    have HZ :
        (a+t)*(b+t)*((a-3*t+4*t^2/(a+t)+4*(a-b)) - (b-3*t+4*t^2/(b+t))) =
          (a-b)*(5*((a+t)*(b+t))-4*t^2) := by field_simp; ring
    rw [HZ]; nlinarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Snapshot.grain_average
statement:
lemma grain_average (a b m t : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) (ht : 0 ≤ t)
    (h : a+b=2*m) :
    (grain a t+grain b t)/2 ≤ grain m t +4*((a-b)/2)^2/m
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le ht with H|H
  · have he (a : ℝ) : grain a 0=a := by
      unfold grain; by_cases h : a=0 <;> simp [h,pow_two]
    rw [← H,he,he,he]
    have HH : 0 ≤ 4*((a-b)/2)^2/m := div_nonneg (by positivity) (by linarith)
    linarith
  have hm : 0 ≤ m := by linarith
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hm with Hm|Hm
  · have he : a=m := by linarith
    have hh : b=m := by linarith
    rw [he,hh]; ring_nf; exact le_rfl
  rw [shift_formula _ _ (by linarith),shift_formula _ _ (by linarith),shift_formula _ _ (by linarith)]
  let d := (a-b)/2
  have he : t^2*m ≤ (a+t)*(b+t)*(m+t) := by
    have hH : t^2 ≤ (a+t)*(b+t) := by nlinarith
    exact mul_le_mul hH (by linarith) hm (by positivity)
  have hi :
      ((a-3*t+4*t^2/(a+t))+(b-3*t+4*t^2/(b+t)))/2 - (m-3*t+4*t^2/(m+t))
        = 4*t^2*d^2/((a+t)*(b+t)*(m+t)) := by
    unfold d
    field_simp
    rw [show m=(a+b)/2 by linarith]
    ring
  rw [add_comm (m-3*t+4*t^2/(m+t))]; apply sub_le_iff_le_add.mp

  rw [hi]
  change 4*t^2*d^2/((a+t)*(b+t)*(m+t)) ≤ 4*d^2/m
  apply (div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity) Hm).mpr
  nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left he (sq_nonneg d)]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Snapshot.cloud_kill
statement:
lemma cloud_kill {s q : Scene M} (h : Less s q) (hh : ReadyAt s) (hv : ReadyAt q)
    (hp : 0 ≤ s.norm) (k : Grid M → Law α) (a : α → ℝ) (ha : ∀ i, 0 ≤ a i) :
    cloud (hist q k) a ≤ cloud (hist s k) a+4*(share s-share q)
proof:
:= by
  have H : 0 ≤ q.norm := by rw [h.flat]; exact hp
  rw [← total_hist _ hh.1 k, ← total_hist _ hv.1 k]
  unfold cloud; rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib,Finset.mul_sum,←Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => grain_shrinks _ _ _
    (nonnegative_hist s hh.2 hp k i) (nonnegative_hist q hv.2 H k i) (hist_le h hh hp k i) (ha _)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Snapshot.cloud_drift
statement:
lemma cloud_drift (s : Scene M) (hp : s.here.valid) (hh : s.here.lev < M)
    (hs : 0 ≤ s.wage) (he : 0 ≤ s.norm) (k : Grid M → Law α)
    (t : α → ℝ) (ht : ∀ i, 0 ≤ t i) :
    (uniform Bool).Ex (fun b => cloud (hist (s.smaller b) k) t) ≤
      cloud (hist s k) t+4*fisher s k
proof:
:= by
  let p (i) := hist (s.smaller false) k i; let q (i) := hist (s.smaller true) k i
  let m (i) := hist s k i
  have hi i : (grain (p i) (t i)+grain (q i) (t i))/2 ≤
      grain (m i) (t i) +4*(Procedure.diff s k i)^2/m i := by
    apply grain_average
    · exact nonnegative_hist (s.smaller false) hs he k _
    · exact nonnegative_hist (s.smaller true) hs he k _
    · exact ht _
    · exact hist_split _ hp hh k _
  calc
    _ = ∑ i,(grain (p i) (t i)+grain (q i) (t i))/2 := by
      unfold cloud; rw [← Finset.sum_div,Finset.sum_add_distrib,Ex,Fintype.sum_bool]
      simp only [uniform_apply,Fintype.card_bool,Nat.cast_ofNat]
      unfold p q; ring
    _ ≤ _ := Finset.sum_le_sum (s:=Finset.univ) fun i _ => hi i
    _ = _ := by simp_rw [fisher,cloud,mul_div_assoc,Finset.mul_sum,Finset.sum_add_distrib]; rfl

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Snapshot.sharp_pos
statement: lemma sharp_pos (i : ℕ) : 0 < sharp i
proof: := div_pos (pow_pos (side_pos i) _) (by norm_num)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Snapshot.coordinate_le
statement:
lemma coordinate_le (i m : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (h : n ≤ rangeIx m) :
    (n:ℝ)*(8*side (precision i m)) ≤ sharp i
proof:
:= by
  apply le_trans (b:= (2:ℝ)^m*(8*side (precision i m))) (by
    apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by exact_mod_cast h)
      (by have := side_pos (precision i m); positivity))
  unfold precision sharp
  have heq : side (25+6*i+m) = side 25 * side i ^6 * side m := by
    simp [side,pow_add,pow_mul,mul_comm 6 i]
  rw [heq]
  rw [show (2:ℝ)^m * (8*(side 25 * side i^6 * side m))=
        (side m*(2:ℝ)^m) *(8*side 25)*side i^6 by ring,side_card]
  rw [one_mul, div_eq_inv_mul]
  gcongr; norm_num [side]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Snapshot.image_income
statement:
lemma image_income (s : Scene M) (d : Finset (Grid M)) (b : Bool)
    (i m : ℕ) (f : Dome (precision i m) d → ℝ) :
    ∑ x, portrait b s d i m x * f x =
      rung s (channel (optic s b)) (fun x y => f (y,tiles (precision i m) d x))
proof:
:= by
  unfold portrait; rw [rung_hist]
  unfold rung addMass
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
  simp_rw [mul_assoc,← Finset.mul_sum]
  congr 1
  exact Ex_send _ _ _

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Snapshot.portrait_compare
statement:
lemma portrait_compare (s : Scene M) (b : Bool) (d : Finset (Grid M))
    (i m : ℕ) (c : Grid M → ℂ) (p : Grid M)
    (F : TileN (precision i m) d → ℂ) (h : ∀ x, ‖chi p x-F (tiles (precision i m) d x)‖ ≤ sharp i)
    (hc : ∀ i, ‖c i‖ ≤ 1) (hp : s.here.ok M)
    (ha : 0 ≤ s.wage) (hv : 0 ≤ s.norm) (hs : share s ≤ 4) :
    |sales b s c p - ∑ x, portrait b s d i m x * utility b (c x.1) (F x.2)| ≤
      8*sharp i
proof:
:= by
  rw [image_income _ _ _ _ _ (fun x => utility b (c x.1) (F x.2))]
  unfold sales
  apply le_trans _ (show share s*(2*sharp i) ≤ 8*sharp i from by nlinarith [sharp_pos i])
  apply rung_error s ha hv hp
  intro j k
  exact (utility_diff _ _ _ _ (hc k)).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (h j) (by norm_num))

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Snapshot.close_display
statement:
lemma close_display (s t : Scene M) (b : Bool) (d : Finset (Grid M)) (i m : ℕ) (hd : d.card ≤ rangeIx m)
    (p : Grid M) (he : enclosed d 1 p) (hh : distance (portrait b s d i m) (portrait b t d i m) ≤ sharp i)
    (hs : ReadyAt s) (ht : ReadyAt t) (ha : 0 ≤ s.norm) (hb : 0 ≤ t.norm)
    (hc : share s ≤ 4) (hC : share t ≤ 4) :
    magnitude b s p ≤ magnitude b t p +20*sharp i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨f,hf,hF⟩ := painted _ _ he (precision i m)
  have hx (x) := (hF x).trans (coordinate_le _ _ hd)
  obtain ⟨g,hg,hG⟩ := (test_complete b _ hs.2 ha p).2
  let Q (x : Dome (precision i m) d) := utility b (g x.1) (f x.2)
  let P (s : Scene M) := portrait b s d i m
  let V (s : Scene M) := ∑ x, P s x*Q x
  have hV : V s ≤ V t +3*sharp i := by
    rw [add_comm]; apply sub_le_iff_le_add.mp
    unfold V; rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    calc
      _ ≤ ∑ x, 3* |P s x-P t x| := Finset.sum_le_sum fun x _ => by
        rw [← sub_mul]
        apply le_trans (le_abs_self _)
        rw [abs_mul,mul_comm]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (utility_bounds _ _ _ (hg _) (hf _)) (abs_nonneg _)
      _ ≤ _ := by rw [← Finset.mul_sum]; exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hh (by norm_num)
  have h1 : |sales b s g p - V s| ≤ 8*sharp i :=
    portrait_compare _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ hx hg hs.1 hs.2 ha hc
  have h2 : |sales b t g p - V t| ≤ 8*sharp i :=
    portrait_compare _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ hx hg ht.1 ht.2 hb hC
  have hi := (test_complete b t ht.2 hb p).1 _ hg
  rw [hG] at h1
  linarith [sharp_pos i,(abs_le.mp h1).2,(abs_le.mp h2).1]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Snapshot.shade_close
statement: lemma shade_close (e : ℕ) (x s : Grid M) : ‖chi s x-shine e M (shade e x s)‖ ≤ 8*side e
proof:
:= by
  let p := s*x
  let r := raise (min_le_right e M) (shade e x s)
  have HE : chi s x=chi 1 p := by unfold chi p; rw [one_mul]
  have hp : ‖chi 1 p-chi 1 r‖ = ‖1-chi 1 (p-r)‖ := by
    rw [show chi 1 p-chi 1 r = (chi 1 (p-r)-1)*chi 1 r by
      rw [sub_mul,← chi_add,sub_add_cancel,one_mul],norm_mul,norm_chi,mul_one,norm_sub_rev]
  have hi : Dyadic.diam (p-r) ≤ side e := by
    let b := min e M
    have hV : rad (p-r) ≤ 2^(M-b)-1 := snap_dist _ p
    rcases le_total e M with he|he
    · have hh : side M*(2:ℝ)^(M-e)=side e := (descale (p:=⟨e,0⟩) he).symm
      rw [show b=e from min_eq_left he] at hV
      unfold Dyadic.diam; rw [←hh]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by linarith) (side_pos _).le
    rw [show b=M from min_eq_right he] at hV
    rw [Nat.sub_self,pow_zero,sub_self] at hV
    unfold Dyadic.diam; have H := hV.antisymm (rad_nonneg _)
    rw [H,mul_zero]; exact (side_pos _).le
  rw [HE]; change ‖chi 1 p-chi 1 r‖ ≤ _
  rw [hp]
  have HH := norm_phase_sq (1:Grid M) (p-r)
  nlinarith [(cost_diam (p-r)).2,side_pos e,diam_nonneg (p-r)]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Snapshot.see_as_H
statement:
private lemma see_as_H (s : Scene M) (b : Bool) (d : Finset (Grid M)) (e : ℕ) :
    let P
proof:
:= tracker s b
    s.actor.privateH (sight s b d e) =
      P.Hcond Prod.fst (fun i => (i.2, tiles e d i.1)) := by
  intro P
  let g : Grid M × Grid M → Grid M × Dome e d :=
    fun i => (i.1,i.2,tiles e d i.1)
  have H : s.actor.withNext (sight s b d e) = P.send g := by
    apply ext_of_Ex; intro f
    simp_rw [P,tracker,Ex_send,Ex_withNext,sight,Ex_send]
    rfl
  rw [privateH,H,Hcond_send]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Snapshot.sight_budget
statement:
lemma sight_budget (s : Scene M) (b : Bool) (d : Finset (Grid M)) (e : ℕ) :
    let v
proof:
:= deficit s (channel (optic s b))
    v ≤ deficit s (sight s b d e) ∧ deficit s (sight s b d e) ≤ v+d.card*e := by
  unfold deficit; intro v
  let P := tracker s b
  let X : Grid M × Grid M → TileN e d := fun i => tiles e d i.1
  let g := fun i : Grid M × Grid M => (i.2,X i)
  change v ≤ levels s-_ ∧ _
  rw [see_as_H]
  have H1 : s.actor.privateH (channel (optic s b))=P.Hcond Prod.fst Prod.snd := rfl
  change levels s-_≤levels s-P.Hcond _ g ∧ levels s-P.Hcond _ g ≤ levels s-_+_
  rw [H1]
  have H := Hcond_antitone P Prod.fst (Y:=g) (Z:=Prod.snd) (fun i j hi => congrArg Prod.fst hi)
  refine ⟨by linarith [H],?_⟩
  have hX := P.H_card X
  have HX : P.H X ≤ (d.card:ℝ)*e := by
    apply hX.trans
    simp only [TileN,RingN,Grid,Fintype.card_fun,Fintype.card_coe,ZMod.card]
    push_cast; rw [Real.log_pow,Real.log_pow]
    gcongr
    have he : (min e M:ℕ) ≤ e := by omega
    have hi : ((min e M:ℕ):ℝ) ≤ e := by exact_mod_cast he
    nlinarith [log_le_sub_one_of_pos (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<2),
      Nat.cast_nonneg (α:=ℝ) (min e M)]
  have h₂ :
      P.Hcond Prod.fst Prod.snd = P.Hcond (fun i => (i.1,X i)) Prod.snd := by
    unfold Hcond; congr 1; apply H_partition; simp [X]
  rw [h₂, Hcond_chain]
  have H₃ : P.Hcond Prod.fst (fun i => (X i,i.2)) = P.Hcond Prod.fst g :=
      P.Hcond_right_partition _ (by simp [g,and_comm])
  rw [H₃]
  linarith [Hcond_le_H P X Prod.snd]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Snapshot.painted
statement:
theorem painted (u : Grid M) (d : Finset (Grid M)) (h : enclosed d 1 u) (e : ℕ) :
    ∃ f : TileN e d → ℂ, (∀ i, ‖f i‖=1) ∧
      ∀ x, ‖chi u x-f (tiles e d x)‖ ≤ d.card*(8*side e)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v,hv,rfl⟩ := h
  let F (i : TileN e d) := ∏ x : d, switch (v x) (shine e M (i x))
  have Hs (i : ℤ) (z : ℂ) (h : ‖z‖=1) : ‖switch i z‖=1 := by unfold switch; split_ifs <;> simp [h]
  refine ⟨F,?_,?_⟩
  · intro i; unfold F; rw [Complex.norm_prod]
    exact (Finset.prod_eq_one fun j _ => Hs _ _ (norm_chi _ _))
  intro x
  have h1 (i : d) :
      chi (v i • (i.val)) x = switch (v i.val) (chi (i.val) x) := by
    have hx := abs_le.mp (hv i.val i.property)
    have hh : v i.val = -1 ∨ v i.val=0 ∨ v i.val=1 := by omega
    rcases hh with H|H|H <;> simp [H,switch,chi_zero_left,chi_neg']
  have hx : chi (∑ i∈d,v i • i) x = ∏ i : d, switch (v i) (chi (i:Grid M) x) := by
    simp_rw [← h1]; rw [← Finset.sum_attach d,chi_comm,←phaseChar_apply]
    have H := Compress.char_sum (phaseChar x) (fun i : d => (v i.val) • i.val)
    change (phaseChar x) (∑ i : d, v i.val • i.val) = _
    rw [H]; exact Finset.prod_congr rfl fun i _ => chi_comm x _
  let p (i : d) := switch (v i) (chi (i:Grid M) x)
  let q (i : d) := switch (v i) (shine e M (tiles e d x i))
  have hp i : ‖p i‖=1 := Hs _ _ (norm_chi _ _)
  have hq i : ‖q i‖=1 := Hs _ _ (norm_chi _ _)
  have hh (S : Finset d) :
      ‖∏ i∈S,p i - ∏ i∈S,q i‖ ≤ S.card * (8*side e) := by
    induction S using Finset.induction_on with
    | empty => simp
    | @insert i t hi ih =>
      let a := ∏ y∈t,p y
      let b := ∏ y∈t,q y
      rw [Finset.prod_insert hi,Finset.prod_insert hi]
      change ‖p i*a-q i*b‖ ≤ _
      have he : ‖p i-q i‖ ≤ 8*side e := by
        unfold p q tiles switch
        split_ifs
        · simp; exact side_pos e |>.le
        · exact shade_close _ _ _
        · rw [← map_sub,Complex.norm_conj]
          exact shade_close _ _ _
      have hA : ‖a‖=1 := by unfold a; rw [Complex.norm_prod]; exact Finset.prod_eq_one (fun i _ => hp i)
      rw [show p i*a-q i*b=(p i-q i)*a+q i*(a-b) by ring]
      apply le_trans (norm_add_le _ _)
      rw [norm_mul,norm_mul,hA,hq,mul_one,one_mul,Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hi]; push_cast
      change ‖a-b‖ ≤ _ at ih
      nlinarith
  rw [hx]
  simpa only [Finset.card_univ,Fintype.card_coe] using hh Finset.univ

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Snapshot.net_len_scalar
statement:
lemma net_len_scalar {s : Scene M} (j i : ℕ) (h : ReadyAt s) (hm : s.here.lev<M)
    (hx : 0<s.norm) (hq : share s ≤ 2) (he : ∀ x, s.wage x ≤ exp (height j)) :
    ((net s j i false).card:ℝ) ≤ exp (scLimit s i j)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let t := net s j i false
  let b := side i
  let q := s.here
  let d := exp (height j)
  let p := s.norm
  let w := tolerance j i false
  have heq : w=b^4/65536 := rfl
  let u := w*q.invlen/4
  let U := arc M u
  have hb : 0 < b := side_pos i
  have hh : b ≤ 1 := side_le i
  have hq' : 0 < q.invlen := q.invlen_pos
  have hp : 0 < u := by unfold u; have hw := tolerance_pos j i false; positivity
  have hV : b^4 ≤ b := by simpa using pow_le_pow_of_le_one hb.le hh (show 1 ≤ 4 by omega)
  have hd : u ≤ (2:ℝ)^M := calc
    _ ≤ q.invlen := by unfold u; rw [heq]; nlinarith
    _ ≤ _ := loc_scale h.1.2
  have hD : u ≤ (U.card:ℝ) := arc_card_lo _ _ hp.le hd
  let V := t ×ˢ U
  let a (x : Grid M × Grid M) := x.1+x.2
  have HH := net_spec s j i false
  have hI : InjOn a V := by
    rintro ⟨x,k⟩ H ⟨y,l⟩ H' HE
    obtain ⟨H1,H2⟩ := Finset.mem_product.mp H
    obtain ⟨H3,H4⟩ := Finset.mem_product.mp H'
    change x+k=y+l at HE
    have hxy : x=y := by
      by_contra hxy
      apply HH.2.1 x H1 y H3 hxy
      have hx : rad (x-y) ≤ 2*u := by rw [show x-y=l-k by linear_combination HE]; exact rad_diff H4 H2
      change rad _ ≤ w*q.invlen
      unfold u at hx; linarith [rad_nonneg (x-y)]
    subst x; simp_all
  let X (z : Grid M) (i : Bool) := ‖scalar (s.smaller i) z‖
  let Y (z : Grid M) := X z false^2 + X z true^2
  have hk i : ReadyAt (s.smaller i) :=
      ⟨child_ok _ h.1.1 hm i,h.2⟩
  have hs i : share (s.smaller i)≤4 := share_child s h.1.1 hm h.2 hx hq i
  have Hnear (z : Grid M × Grid M) (hz : z∈V) : (b/4)^2 ≤ Y (a z) := by
    obtain ⟨x,k⟩ := z
    obtain ⟨h₁,h₂⟩ := Finset.mem_product.mp hz
    obtain ⟨i',hv⟩ := HH.1 x h₁
    have hi : 4*(8*(s.smaller i').here.len*rad ((x+k)-x)) ≤ b/4 := by
      have hg : rad k ≤ u := (mem_arc _ _).mp h₂
      rw [show x+k-x=k by ring, show (s.smaller i').here.len=q.len/2 from child_len _ _]
      have hi : q.len*u=w/4 := by unfold u; rw [rinv]; field_simp [q.len_pos.ne']
      have hp' : q.len*rad k ≤ w/4 := hi ▸ (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hg q.len_pos.le)
      nlinarith
    have hB := scalar_compare _ (x+k) x (hk _) hx.le _ (hs i')
    rw [side_succ] at hv
    change b/2 ≤ X x i' at hv
    change |X (x+k) i'- X x i'| ≤ _ at hB
    change (b/4)^2 ≤ Y (x+k)
    unfold Y; cases i' <;>
      nlinarith [(abs_le.mp hB).1,sq_nonneg (X (x+k) false),sq_nonneg (X (x+k) true)]
  have HL (i':Bool) : ∑ x : Grid M, X x i'^2 ≤ 8*q.invlen*d/p := by
    have H := scalar_power (s.smaller i') (hk _) hx d 4 he (hs _) (exp_nonneg _)
    have hV : (s.smaller i').here.invlen=2*q.invlen := by
      change (s.here.child _).invlen=_
      rw [invlen,child_depth,pow_succ]; unfold q invlen; ring
    rw [hV] at H
    exact H.trans (le_of_eq (by unfold p; simp only [smaller]; ring))
  have ht : t.card*u*(b/4)^2 ≤ 16*q.invlen*d/p := by
    calc
      _ ≤ t.card*(U.card:ℝ)*(b/4)^2 := by gcongr
      _ = ∑ _x∈V, (b/4)^2 := by simp [V]
      _ ≤ ∑ x∈V, Y (a x) := Finset.sum_le_sum Hnear
      _ = ∑ x∈V.image a, Y x := by rw [Finset.sum_image]; exact fun x hx y hy H => hI hx hy H
      _ ≤ ∑ x, Y x := Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (Finset.subset_univ _)
        (fun i _ _ => add_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (sq_nonneg _))
      _ ≤ 16*q.invlen*d/p := by
        unfold Y; rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
        rw [show 16*q.invlen*d/p=8*q.invlen*d/p+8*q.invlen*d/p by ring]
        exact add_le_add (HL false) (HL true)
  have hr : 0 < p := hx
  have hd : 0 < d := exp_pos _
  have h_u : (t.card:ℝ) ≤ ((2:ℝ)^26*d)/(p*b^6) := by
    unfold u at ht; rw [heq] at ht
    field_simp at ht ⊢
    nlinarith
  change (t.card:ℝ) ≤ _
  apply h_u.trans
  have h1 : log ((2^26*d)/(p*b^6)) ≤ scLimit s i j := by
    rw [Real.log_div (by positivity) (by positivity),Real.log_mul (by positivity) hd.ne',
      Real.log_mul hr.ne' (by positivity), log_pow, log_pow]
    unfold d b scLimit; rw [log_exp,side_pow_two,log_inv,log_pow]
    push_cast
    have Hp' : -log p ≤ max (-log s.norm) 0 := le_max_left _ _
    have Hi : 0 ≤ max (-log s.norm) 0 := le_max_right _ _
    nlinarith [log_le_sub_one_of_pos (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<2),d_pos j,Nat.cast_nonneg (α:=ℝ) i]
  exact le_trans (b:=exp (log _)) (le_of_eq (exp_log (by positivity)).symm) (exp_monotone h1)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Snapshot.magnitude_near
statement:
lemma magnitude_near (main : Bool) (s : Scene M) (i k : Grid M) (hp : ReadyAt s) (hh : 0 ≤ s.norm)
    (b : ℝ) (hb : share s ≤ b) :
    magnitude main s i ≤ magnitude main s k + b * (16*s.here.len*rad (i-k))
proof:
:= by
  let p := s.here
  obtain ⟨g,hg,hG⟩ := (test_complete main s hp.2 hh i).2
  let z := chi (i-k) (p.start M)
  have hZ : ‖z‖=1 := norm_chi _ _
  let f (x : Grid M) := g x*z
  have hf (x) : ‖f x‖≤1 := by unfold f; rw [norm_mul,hZ,mul_one]; exact hg _
  let T := 16*p.len*rad (i-k)
  have ht : 0 ≤ T := by have he := p.len_pos; have hv := rad_nonneg (i-k); unfold T; positivity
  have HI (x : Grid M) (hx : x∈p.block M) :
      ‖chi i x-z * chi k x‖ ≤ 8*p.len*rad (i-k) := by
    have HE := phase_distance (i-k) x (p.start M)
    rw [show chi i x-z*chi k x=(chi (i-k) x-z)*chi k x by rw [sub_mul,←chi_add',sub_add_cancel],norm_mul,norm_chi,mul_one]
    have hx' := diam_block hx (start_mem hp.1.1 hp.1.2)
    apply HE.trans; rw [mul_comm (rad _)]; gcongr; exact rad_nonneg _
  let P := channel (optic s main)
  let w (p : Grid M → ℂ) (i x y : Grid M) := utility main (p y) (chi i x)
  have hhU :
      sales main s g i ≤ sales main s f k + share s*T := by
    rw [show sales main s f k=rung s P (w f k) from rfl,← rung_const s hp.1 P T,←rung_add]
    refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun x _ => Finset.sum_le_sum fun y _ => ?_
    by_cases hx : x∈p.block M
    · have heq : w f k x y = utility main (g y) (z*chi k x) := by unfold w utility f; rw [mul_assoc,norm_mul,hZ,mul_one]
      have hl := utility_diff main (g y) (chi i x) (z*chi k x) (hg _)
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
      · change w g i x y ≤ _
        unfold w at heq ⊢; dsimp only; rw [heq]
        unfold T; linarith [(abs_le.mp hl).2,HI x hx]
      exact mul_nonneg (ante_nonneg _ hp.2 hh _) (P _ |>.nonneg _)
    · have H : ante s x=0 := by unfold ante wt; rw [dice_apply hp.1,ite_eq_right hx,zero_mul,zero_div]
      change addMass s P x y*_ ≤ addMass s P x y*_
      rw [addMass,H]; ring_nf; exact le_rfl
  have HH := (test_complete main s hp.2 hh k).1 f hf
  rw [← hG]; apply hhU.trans
  exact add_le_add HH (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hb ht)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Snapshot.Plot.turn_chart
statement:
lemma turn_chart (a : Plot) (g : Board M) (s : Scene M) :
    (a.turn g s).chart = a.now g s
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Snapshot.Plot.prior_step
statement:
lemma prior_step (a : Plot) (g : Board M) (s : Scene M) (h : a.cardStep (a.turn g s)) :
    (a.turn g s).previous= if a.freshAt g s then some s else g.previous
proof:
:= by
  unfold turn; dsimp only
  have hh : cardStep a ⟨a.now g s, none⟩ := h
  rw [ite_eq_left hh]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Snapshot.Plot.marker_pos
statement: lemma marker_pos (a : Plot) : 0 < a.marker
proof: := div_pos (pow_pos (sharp_pos _) _) (by norm_num)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Snapshot.Plot.deltaC_pos
statement:
lemma deltaC_pos (a : Plot) {g : Board M} (h : soundPrev g) (s : Scene M)
    (hp : ReadyAt s) (hv : 0 ≤ s.norm) : 0 ≤ a.deltaC g s
proof:
:= by
  unfold deltaC; cases H : g.previous with
  | none => simp only [le_refl]
  | some q =>
    obtain ⟨h1,h2,h3⟩ := h q H
    exact cloud_nonneg _ _ (nonnegative_hist s hp.2 hv _) (nonnegative_hist q h1.2 h2 _)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Snapshot.Plot.costC_pos
statement: lemma costC_pos (a : Plot) {g : Board M} (h : a.cardStep g) : 0 ≤ a.creditsC g
proof:
:= by
  unfold creditsC; exact sub_nonneg.mpr (by exact_mod_cast h)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Snapshot.Plot.slot_pos
statement: lemma slot_pos (a : Plot) {g : Board M} (h : a.cardStep g) : 0 ≤ a.slotC g
proof:
:=
    mul_nonneg a.marker_pos.le (by have h := a.costC_pos h; split_ifs <;> linarith)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Snapshot.Plot.turn_prev
statement:
lemma turn_prev (a : Plot) {g : Board M} (h : soundPrev g) (s : Scene M)
    (h₁ : ReadyAt s) (h₂ : 0 ≤ s.norm) (h₃ : share s ≤ 2) : soundPrev (a.turn g s)
proof:
:= by
  intro x H; simp only [turn] at H
  split_ifs at H with heq he
  · rw [Option.some.injEq] at H; subst x; exact ⟨h₁,h₂,h₃⟩
  · exact h x H

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Snapshot.Plot.changed_point
statement:
private lemma changed_point {p : Plot} {g : Board M} {s q : Scene M} {u}
    (h : Following j J f (.ran s q u)) (ht : soundPrev g) (hd : 0 < s.norm)
    (hg : g.chart.Sound) (hk : cardStep p (p.turn g q)) :
    let C
proof:
:= p.turn g q
    p.marker*p.birth g q+
      (uniform Bool).Ex (fun b => p.slotC C + p.deltaC C (q.smaller b))
      ≤ p.slotC g + p.deltaC g s +4*(share s-share q) +8*fisher q (p.kObs C q) := by
  classical
  intro C
  let Q := uniform Bool
  have HV : Widen q p.ix p.main g.chart C.chart := zoom_spec g.chart hg p.ix p.main h
  obtain ⟨ha,hb,hc,hx,hy,hu⟩ := h
  have hs : ReadyAt s := ⟨ha.within,ha.positive⟩
  have hq : ReadyAt q := ⟨hc.within,hc.positive⟩
  obtain ⟨h₁,h₂⟩ := share_small hx
  have hI : q.here.lev < M := (rooted _ (hu false)).within.2
  have ht' (b : Bool) : ReadyAt (q.smaller b) := ⟨child_ok q.here hc.within.1 hI b,hc.positive⟩
  have hY (b : Bool) : share (q.smaller b) ≤ 4 := share_child q hc.within.1 hI hc.positive h₁ h₂ b
  let V (i : Scene M) := portrait p.main i C.chart.items p.ix p.cap
  let k := p.kObs C q
  let F (j : Scene M) (s : Scene M) := cloud (V s) (V j)
  have Hx (t : Scene M) (ht : ReadyAt t) (hv : 0 ≤ t.norm) :
      Q.Ex (fun b => F t (q.smaller b)) ≤ F t q+4*fisher q k :=
    cloud_drift q hc.within.1 hI hc.positive h₁.le k (V t) (nonnegative_hist _ ht.2 hv _)
  have hp : p.creditsC C ≤ p.creditsC g := by
    have hZ : g.chart.size ≤ C.chart.size := Finset.card_le_card HV.extend
    exact sub_le_sub_left (by exact_mod_cast hZ) _
  have hi : 0 ≤ share s-share q := by
    unfold share; rw [hb.1.flat]
    exact sub_nonneg.mpr (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (hb.1.mass_le ha.positive ha.within) hd.le)
  have hF : 0 ≤ fisher q k := (fisher_range _ hc.within.1 hI hc.positive h₁.le _).1
  have hcN := p.deltaC_pos ht s hs hd.le

  have H {w : Scene M} (hw : g.previous=some w) (heq : C.chart.items=g.chart.items) :
      Q.Ex (fun b => F w (q.smaller b)) ≤ p.deltaC g s + 4*(share s-share q)+4*fisher q k := by
    have hT := ht _ hw
    apply le_trans (Hx _ hT.1 hT.2.1)
    apply add_le_add_left
    have H : p.deltaC g s = cloud (hist s k) (V w) := by
      unfold deltaC; rw [hw]
      unfold V k kObs; rw [heq]
      unfold portrait sight optic; rw [hb.1.fund]
    rw [H]
    exact cloud_kill hb.1 hs hq hd.le k _ (nonnegative_hist _ hT.1.2 hT.2.1 _)
  have hh : C.previous = if p.freshAt g q then some q else g.previous := p.prior_step _ _ hk
  rw [Ex_add (f:=fun _ => slotC p C),Ex_const]
  by_cases he : p.freshAt g q
  · rw [ite_eq_left he] at hh
    have Hs : Q.Ex (fun b => p.deltaC C (q.smaller b)) ≤ 4*fisher q k := by
      have hx := Hx _ hq h₁.le
      have ht (x : Scene M) : p.deltaC C x=F q x := by unfold deltaC; rw [hh]
      simp_rw [ht]
      have hc : F q q = 0 := cloud_same _
      rwa [hc,zero_add] at hx
    rw [birth,ite_eq_left he,mul_one]
    change _ + (_+Q.Ex _) ≤ _+8*fisher q k
    have hSlot : p.slotC C = p.marker*p.creditsC C := by unfold slotC; simp [hh]
    rw [hSlot]
    cases hv : g.previous with
    | none =>
      unfold slotC; rw [ite_eq_left hv,mul_add,mul_one]
      nlinarith [marker_pos p]
    | some w =>
      unfold slotC; rw [ite_eq_right (by rw [hv]; simp),add_zero]
      unfold freshAt at he; rw [hv] at he
      rcases he with he|he
      · have H : C.chart.items≠g.chart.items := he
        have HX : g.chart.items ⊂ C.chart.items := Finset.ssubset_iff_subset_ne.mpr ⟨HV.extend, Ne.symm H⟩
        have hz : p.creditsC C+1 ≤ p.creditsC g := by
          have hi : (g.chart.size:ℝ)+1 ≤ C.chart.size := by exact_mod_cast Finset.card_lt_card HX
          unfold creditsC; linarith
        nlinarith [marker_pos p]
      ·
        by_cases H0 : C.chart.items=g.chart.items
        case neg =>
          have HX : g.chart.items ⊂ C.chart.items := Finset.ssubset_iff_subset_ne.mpr ⟨HV.extend, Ne.symm H0⟩
          have hz : p.creditsC C+1 ≤ p.creditsC g := by
            have hi : (g.chart.size:ℝ)+1 ≤ C.chart.size := by exact_mod_cast Finset.card_lt_card HX
            unfold creditsC; linarith
          nlinarith [marker_pos p]
        obtain ⟨b,hG⟩ := he
        have HV := H hv H0
        have HH : p.marker ≤ Q.Ex (fun b => F w (q.smaller b)) := by
          let l := q.smaller b
          obtain ⟨hN1,hN2,hN3⟩ := ht _ hv
          have hZ (i) : 0 ≤ F w (q.smaller i) := cloud_nonneg _ _
            (nonnegative_hist _ (ht' i).2 h₁.le _) (nonnegative_hist _ hN1.2 hN2 _)
          have hY' : (sharp p.ix)^2 ≤ 6*F w l := by
            have Hv : sharp p.ix ≤ distance (V l) (V w) := by
              unfold V; rw [H0]; exact le_of_not_ge hG
            apply le_trans (pow_le_pow_left₀ (sharp_pos _).le Hv _)
            apply le_trans (distance_cloud _ _ (nonnegative_hist _ (ht' _).2 h₁.le _)
              (nonnegative_hist _ hN1.2 hN2 _))
            have ht : ∑ i,V w i = share w := total_hist w hN1.1 _
            have ht' : ∑ i,V l i = share l := total_hist l (ht' b).1 _
            change ((∑ i, V l i)+ ∑ i,V w i)*F w l ≤ _
            rw [ht,ht']
            apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith [show share l ≤ 4 from hY b]) (hZ b)
          unfold Q Ex
          rw [Fintype.sum_bool,uniform_apply,uniform_apply]
          unfold marker; unfold l at *
          cases b <;> simp only [Fintype.card_bool,Nat.cast_ofNat] <;> nlinarith [hZ true,hZ false]
        nlinarith [marker_pos p]

  rw [ite_eq_right he] at hh
  obtain ⟨w,hv⟩ : ∃ w, g.previous=some w := by
    cases hx : g.previous
    · simp [freshAt,hx] at he
    · exact ⟨_,rfl⟩
  have hs : p.birth g q=0 := ite_eq_right he
  have heq : C.chart.items=g.chart.items := by
    unfold freshAt at he; rw [hv] at he; exact Classical.byContradiction (fun H => he (Or.inl H))
  have hS' : p.slotC C=p.slotC g := by simp [slotC,creditsC,Chart.size, hh,heq]
  have hV' (x : Scene M) : p.deltaC C x=F w x := by unfold deltaC; rw [hh,hv]
  rw [hs,mul_zero,hS']; simp_rw [hV']
  have ht := H hv heq
  change _ ≤ _+8*fisher q k
  unfold Q at *; linarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Snapshot.Plot.debt_recur
statement:
private lemma debt_recur (p : Plot) (g : Board M) {s q : Scene M} {k}
    (h : Following j J f (.ran s q k)) (hd : 0 < s.norm) (hg : g.chart.Sound)
    (hk : cardStep p g) (hp : cardStep p (p.turn g q)) :
    let C
proof:
:= p.turn g q
    (uniform Bool).Ex (fun b => share (q.smaller b)*debtC p C (q.smaller b) j)
      + (1/4:ℝ)*fisher q (p.kObs C q)
      ≤ share s * debtC p g s j := by
  intro C
  have hm := pre_pos h
  have hC : Widen q p.ix p.main g.chart C.chart := zoom_spec _ hg _ _ h
  let v := (keep s q).snip
  let U := (step q).probs
  let Q := v.probs
  let Z (c : Board M) := p.kObs c q
  let F := Z g; let W := Z C
  let H (x) := deficit x F
  let E (i) := deficit (q.smaller i) W
  let V (c : Board M) := p.creditsC c*p.coinC+(minimumT j)⁻¹
  have HE : Q.entropy ≤ (minimumT j)⁻¹* Q false := debt_at h
  obtain ⟨ha,hb,hv,hp',ht,hs⟩ := h
  have hT (b : Bool) := hs b
  have hR : q.here.lev < M := (rooted _ (hs false)).within.2
  have hS : ReadyAt s := ⟨ha.within,ha.positive⟩
  have hS' : ReadyAt q := ⟨hv.within,hv.positive⟩
  have hQ := hp'.1.2.2
  have hZ : 0 < q.norm := hb.1.flat.symm ▸ hd
  have hM := keep_true hb.1 hS hS' hm
  have hi₁ : deficit q W+V C ≤ H q+V g := by
    by_cases hi : C.chart.items=g.chart.items
    · unfold W Z H F V kObs creditsC size; rw [hi]; exact le_rfl
    have hG : p.creditsC C+1 ≤ p.creditsC g := by
      have hh : g.chart.items ⊂ C.chart.items := Finset.ssubset_iff_subset_ne.mpr ⟨hC.extend, Ne.symm hi⟩
      have he : (g.chart.size:ℝ)+1 ≤ C.chart.size := by exact_mod_cast Finset.card_lt_card hh
      unfold creditsC; linarith
    have hh1 : 0 ≤ p.coinC := by unfold coinC; positivity
    have h₁ := (sight_budget q p.main g.chart.items (precision p.ix p.cap)).1
    have h₂ := (sight_budget q p.main C.chart.items (precision p.ix p.cap)).2
    change deficit q W ≤ _ at h₂
    change _ ≤ H q at h₁
    have h₃ : (C.chart.items.card :ℝ)* precision p.ix p.cap ≤ p.coinC := by
      unfold coinC
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by exact_mod_cast hp) (by positivity)
    unfold V
    nlinarith
  have hv₀ : (minimumT j)⁻¹ ≤ V g :=
    le_add_of_nonneg_left (mul_nonneg (costC_pos _ hk) (by unfold coinC; positivity))
  have h₂ : Q true*(H q+V g) ≤ H s+V g := by
    have hi (b : Bool) : levels (v.dst b)=levels s := by
      unfold levels; rw [show (v.dst b).here=s.here from keep_here hb.1 _]
    have hz : Q.Ex (fun b => H (v.dst b)) ≤ H s+Q.entropy := by
      have hh := old_entropy_cost v F
      have hh' := conditioned_balance F v hM
      unfold H deficit; simp_rw [hi,Ex_sub (f:=fun _ => levels s),Ex_const]
      change v.probs.Ex _+ _ = s.actor.privateH F at hh'
      unfold Q; linarith
    have hZ : 0 ≤ Q false * H (v.dst false) := by
      rcases eq_or_lt_of_le (Q.nonneg false) with h|h
      · rw [← h,zero_mul]
      have HH := other_ok hb.1 hS
      exact mul_nonneg h.le (deficit_nonneg (v.dst false) HH.1 HH.2 ((true_mass hM).mp h) F)
    have ht₁ : Q true + Q false = 1 := by simpa only [Fintype.sum_bool] using Q.total
    rw [Ex,Fintype.sum_bool] at hz
    rw [show v.dst true=q from rfl] at hz
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hv₀ (Q.nonneg false),show
      V g*(Q true+Q false)=V g by rw [ht₁]; ring]
  have ht₁ := space_deficit q W hv.within.1 hR hv.positive hQ hZ
  have hx b : debtC p C (q.smaller b) j=E b+V C := rfl
  let D (b : Bool) := E b+V C
  have h₁ :
      (uniform Bool).Ex (fun b => share (q.smaller b)*debtC p C (q.smaller b) j)=
        share q * U.Ex D := by
    have HI (b : Bool) : share (q.smaller b)*debtC p C (q.smaller b) j =
        (q.smaller b).mass * (q.norm⁻¹ * D b) := by rw [hx]; unfold share D; simp only [smaller]; ring
    simp_rw [HI]
    rw [← output_split _ hv.within.1 hR hv.positive hQ (fun b => q.norm⁻¹*D b),
      Ex_lmul]
    unfold share U; ring
  have HZ : share q * ((1/4:ℝ)*(q.norm/q.mass)*fisher q W)=1/4*fisher q W := by
    unfold share; field_simp
  have hEq : share q = share s * Q true := by
    have H := kept_mass hb.1 hS hS' hm
    unfold share
    nth_rw 1 [H,hb.1.flat]
    unfold Q v; ring
  rw [h₁,← HZ,← mul_add]
  unfold D; rw [Ex_add (g:=fun b => V C),Ex_const]
  have hDC : debtC p g s j=H s+V g := by
    unfold debtC H F V Z kObs sight optic
    rw [hb.1.fund]
  have hsq : 0 ≤ share q := div_nonneg hQ.le hZ.le
  calc
    _ ≤ share q * (deficit q W + V C) := by
      change U.Ex E + _ ≤ deficit q W at ht₁
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ hsq; linarith
    _ ≤ share q*(H q+V g) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hi₁ hsq
    _ ≤ _ := by
      rw [hEq,mul_assoc,hDC]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h₂ (div_nonneg hm.le hd.le)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Snapshot.Plot.expenses_nonneg
statement:
lemma expenses_nonneg (p : Plot) (g : Board M) (s : Scene M) (j : ℕ) (hg : p.cardStep g)
    (h : ReadyAt s) (hp : soundPrev g) (hv : 0 < s.norm) :
    0 ≤ p.expenses g s j
proof:
:= by
  have hm : 0 ≤ s.mass := avg_nonneg _ fun i _ => h.2 i
  have hsc := deltaC_pos p hp s h hv.le
  have Ht := slot_pos p hg
  unfold expenses; have hS : 0 ≤ share s := div_nonneg hm hv.le
  suffices HH : 0 ≤ share s*debtC p g s j by linarith
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hm with H|H
  · unfold share; rw [← H,zero_div,zero_mul]
  apply mul_nonneg hS
  unfold debtC
  have hC := p.costC_pos hg
  exact add_nonneg (deficit_nonneg _ h.1 h.2 H _) (add_nonneg
    (mul_nonneg hC (by unfold coinC; positivity)) (inv_nonneg.mpr (minimum_pos j).le))

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Snapshot.Plot.mint_small
statement:
lemma mint_small (p : Plot) (g : Board M) (s : Scene M) (t : Thread M s)
    (h : Following j J f t) (hp : g.chart.Sound) (hg : soundPrev g) (hv : p.cardStep g)
    (hs : 0 < s.norm) :
    p.marker*(s.here.dice M).Ex (fun x => minted p g (t.stream x)) ≤ expenses p g s j
proof:
:= by
  induction t generalizing g with
  | blank =>
    have h1 := rooted _ h
    simpa only [stream,minted,Ex_const,mul_zero] using
      expenses_nonneg p g _ j hv ⟨h1.within,h1.positive⟩ hg hs
  | ran s q k ih =>
    rw [stream_branch k h (fun l _ => minted p g l)]
    let C := p.turn g q
    by_cases hh : p.cardStep C
    case neg =>
      have h1 := rooted _ h
      dsimp only [C] at hh
      simpa only [minted, ite_eq_right hh, Ex_const,mul_zero] using
        expenses_nonneg p g s j hv ⟨h1.within,h1.positive⟩ hg hs
    have hD := changed_point h hg hs hp hh
    have hF := debt_recur p _ h hs hp hv hh
    have hZ := zoom_spec g.chart hp p.ix p.main h
    obtain ⟨ha,hb,hc,hx,hd,hk⟩ := h
    have hv := turn_prev p hg q ⟨hc.within,hc.positive⟩ (share_small hx).1.le (share_small hx).2
    have hq : (uniform Bool).Ex (fun b => share (q.smaller b))=share q := by
      simp only [Ex,uniform_apply,Fintype.sum_bool,Fintype.card_bool,Nat.cast_ofNat]
      have ht := share_split q; linarith
    let f (i : Bool) := ((q.smaller i).here.dice M).Ex fun x => minted p C ((k i).stream x)
    have HM :
        p.marker*((uniform Bool).Ex f) ≤ (uniform Bool).Ex fun i => expenses p C (q.smaller i) j := by
      rw [← Ex_lmul]; apply Ex_mono; intro i
      exact ih i C (hk i) hZ.sonic hv hh (share_small hx).1
    unfold expenses at *
    simp_rw [Ex_add] at *
    simp_rw [Ex_const,Ex_lmul] at HM hD
    rw [hq] at HM

    have HH : p.cardStep (p.turn g q) := hh
    simp only [minted, ite_eq_left HH]
    simp_rw [Ex_add,Ex_const]
    change p.marker*(p.birth g q+(uniform Bool).Ex f) ≤ _
    dsimp only [C] at *
    nlinarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Snapshot.tolerance_pos
statement: lemma tolerance_pos (j i : ℕ) (b : Bool) : 0 < tolerance j i b
proof:
:= by
  unfold tolerance sig; have H := slow_pos j; have HH := side_pos i; split <;> positivity

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Snapshot.spotLimit_pos
statement: lemma spotLimit_pos (s : Scene M) (j i : ℕ) (b : Bool) : 0 < spotLimit s j i b
proof:
:=
    mul_pos (tolerance_pos _ _ _) s.here.invlen_pos

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Snapshot.adjacent_zero
statement:
lemma adjacent_zero (s : Scene M) (j i : ℕ) (b : Bool) :
    adjacent s j i b 0
proof:
:= by
  have H := spotLimit_pos s j i b
  cases b
  · change rad _ ≤ _
    simpa [rad] using H.le
  · refine ⟨0,?_,?_⟩
    · rw [delta_zero]; unfold sepRad; positivity
    simp only [sub_self]
    simpa [rad] using H.le

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Snapshot.adjacent_neg
statement:
lemma adjacent_neg (s : Scene M) (j i : ℕ) (b : Bool) {x : Grid M} (hx : adjacent s j i b x) :
    adjacent s j i b (-x)
proof:
:= by
  cases b with
  | false =>
    change rad (-_) ≤ _
    rw [rad_even]; exact hx
  | true =>
    obtain ⟨v,hv,h⟩ := (show fnear _ _ _ x from hx)
    refine ⟨-v,?_,?_⟩
    · rw [delta_even _ v]; exact hv
    rw [show -x- -v= -(x-v) by ring,rad_even]; exact h

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Snapshot.exists_net
statement: lemma exists_net (s : Scene M) (j i : ℕ) (b : Bool) : ∃ d, net_ok s j i b d
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let L := intense b s (side (i+1)); let H := adjacent s j i b
  let P (d : Finset (Grid M)) := (∀ i∈d, L i) ∧ (∀ i∈d,∀ u∈d,i≠u → ¬ H (i-u))
  let F := Finset.univ.filter P
  have he : (∅:Finset (Grid M))∈F := by simp [F,P]
  obtain ⟨d,hd,hh⟩ := Finset.exists_max_image F Finset.card ⟨_,he⟩
  have hp := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hd).2
  refine ⟨d,hp.1,hp.2,?_⟩
  intro x hx
  by_contra! Hh
  have hn : x∉d := by intro he; apply Hh _ he; rw [sub_self]; exact adjacent_zero _ _ _ _
  have hh' : insert x d ∈ F := by
    apply Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _,?_⟩
    refine ⟨?_,?_⟩
    · intro w ht
      rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp ht with h|h; exact h ▸ hx; exact hp.1 _ h
    intro w hw q hq h'
    rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hw with rfl|hw
    · exact Hh q ((Finset.mem_insert.mp hq).resolve_left (Ne.symm h'))
    rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hq with he|he
    · subst q
      intro hc
      apply Hh w hw
      rw [show x-w= -(w-x) by ring]
      exact adjacent_neg _ _ _ _ hc
    exact hp.2 _ hw _ he h'
  have hi := hh _ hh'
  rw [Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hn] at hi; omega

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Snapshot.net_spec
statement:
lemma net_spec (s : Scene M) (j i : ℕ) (b : Bool) :
    net_ok s j i b (net s j i b)
proof: := Classical.choose_spec _

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Snapshot.net_len_main
statement:
lemma net_len_main (s : Scene M) (j i : ℕ) (h : i+1 ≤ testIx j) (hs : s.settled j)
    (he : s.live=true) : ((net s j i true).card:ℝ) ≤ exp (kappa j (codeWeight capA) (i+1))
proof:
:= by
  apply le_of_not_gt
  intro hh
  obtain ⟨H,H1,H2⟩ := net_spec s j i true
  exact hs he _ h ⟨_,hh.le,H,H1⟩

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Snapshot.share_pos'
statement: lemma share_pos' (s : Scene M) (hs : ReadyAt s) (hp : 0 ≤ s.norm) : 0 ≤ share s
proof:
:=
  div_nonneg (avg_nonneg _ (fun x _ => hs.2 x)) hp

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Snapshot.share_small
statement: lemma share_small {s : Scene M} (hb : work s j J f) : 0 < s.norm ∧ share s ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hi := hb.2.2
  have hx := hb.1.2.2
  unfold enter at hi
  refine ⟨by linarith,?_⟩
  exact (div_le_iff₀ (by linarith)).mpr (le_of_not_gt hi)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Snapshot.share_child
statement:
lemma share_child (s : Scene M) (hp : s.here.valid) (h : s.here.lev < M)
    (hs : 0 ≤ s.wage) (hh : 0 < s.norm) (hb : share s ≤ 2) (b) :
    share (s.smaller b) ≤ 4
proof:
:= by
  have H := share_split s
  have HF (i : Bool) : 0 ≤ share (s.smaller i) := share_pos' (s.smaller i)
    ⟨s.here.child_ok hp h i,hs⟩ hh.le
  cases b <;> linarith [HF false,HF true]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Snapshot.scalar_point
statement:
lemma scalar_point (s : Scene M) (i : Grid M) (hp : ReadyAt s) (hh : 0 ≤ s.norm)
    {p : Node} (ht : below s.here p) (x : Grid M) (he : x∈p.block M)
    (k : Grid M) :
    ‖scalar s i-chi (i-k) x*scalar s k‖ ≤ share s * (8 * p.len * rad (i-k))
proof:
:= by
  have HF y (hy : y∈s.here.block M) :
      ‖chi i y-chi (i-k) x*chi k y‖ ≤ 8*p.len * rad (i-k) := by
    rw [show chi i y-chi (i-k) x*chi k y=(chi (i-k) y-chi (i-k) x)*chi k y by
      rw [sub_mul,← chi_add',sub_add_cancel],norm_mul,norm_chi,mul_one]
    have h := phase_distance (i-k) y x
    apply h.trans
    rw [mul_comm (rad _)]
    have hi := diam_block (block_of_below ht _ hy) he
    gcongr
    exact rad_nonneg _
  unfold scalar; rw [Finset.mul_sum,←Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  apply le_trans (norm_sum_le _ _)
  rw [← ante_total s hp.1, Finset.sum_mul]
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum; intro y hy
  unfold ante; rw [mul_left_comm,← mul_sub,norm_mul, Complex.norm_real,Real.norm_eq_abs,
    abs_of_nonneg (wt_nonneg s.here hp.2 hh _)]
  by_cases H : y∈s.here.block M
  · exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (HF _ H) (wt_nonneg s.here hp.2 hh _)
  rw [wt,dice_apply hp.1,ite_eq_right H,zero_mul,zero_div]
  simp

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Snapshot.scalar_compare
statement:
lemma scalar_compare (s : Scene M) (i k : Grid M) (hp : ReadyAt s) (hh : 0 ≤ s.norm)
    (b : ℝ) (hb : share s ≤ b) :
    |‖scalar s i‖-‖scalar s k‖| ≤ b * (8*s.here.len*rad (i-k))
proof:
:= by
  have Hs := hp.1
  let x := s.here.start M
  have HH := abs_norm_sub_norm_le (scalar s i) (chi (i-k) x*scalar s k)
  rw [norm_mul,norm_chi,one_mul] at HH
  apply HH.trans ((scalar_point s i hp hh (below_refl _) x (start_mem Hs.1 Hs.2) k).trans ?_)
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hb (by have := s.here.len_pos; have := rad_nonneg (i-k); positivity)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Procedure.Snapshot.scalar_power
statement:
lemma scalar_power (s : Scene M) (hp : ReadyAt s) (hh : 0 < s.norm) (d b : ℝ)
    (h : ∀ x, s.wage x ≤ d) (he : share s ≤ b) (hd : 0 ≤ d) :
    ∑ i, ‖scalar s i‖^2 ≤ s.here.invlen * b * d / s.norm
proof:
:= by
  let p := s.here
  let P := ante s
  let f (i : Grid M) : ℂ := ((P i / side M:ℝ):ℂ)
  have hb := side_pos M
  have Hχ (i : Grid M) : scalar s i = fc f (-i) := by
    unfold scalar fc expU; rw [neg_neg, Complex.real_smul,Finset.mul_sum]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun _ _ => by unfold f P ante; push_cast; field_simp [(Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr hb.ne')]
  have HT (i : Grid M) :
      side M*‖f i‖^2 ≤ P i * (p.invlen * d / s.norm) := by
    have hi : P i ≤ side M*p.invlen * d / s.norm := by
      unfold P ante wt; rw [dice_apply hp.1]
      split_ifs with hx
      · rw [rinv p]
        apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_right _ hh.le
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (h i) (by have := s.here.len_pos; positivity)
      · simp only [zero_mul,zero_div]; have := p.invlen_pos; positivity
    unfold f
    have he : 0 ≤ P i := ante_nonneg s hp.2 hh.le _
    rw [Complex.norm_real,Real.norm_eq_abs,sq_abs]
    calc
      _ = P i * (P i / side M) := by field_simp
      _ ≤ _ := by
        apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ he
        apply (div_le_iff₀ hb).mpr
        apply hi.trans; exact le_of_eq (by ring)
  calc
    _ = ∑ i, ‖fc f i‖^2 := by simp_rw [Hχ]; exact Fintype.sum_equiv (Equiv.neg _) _ _ (fun _ => rfl)
    _ = _ := fc_parseval f
    _ ≤ ∑ i, P i * (p.invlen *d/s.norm) := by
      unfold expU; rw [smul_eq_mul,Finset.mul_sum]; exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => HT i
    _ ≤ _ := by
