      rw [← Finset.sum_mul,show ∑ i,P i = _ from ante_total s hp.1]
      apply (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right he (show 0 ≤ p.invlen*d/s.norm by
        have := p.invlen_pos; positivity)).trans
      exact le_of_eq (by unfold p; ring)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.Update.alarm_le
statement:
lemma alarm_le (u : Update j M p) (A : Form M) (z y : Grid M) :
    alarmQ u A z y ≤ clones j * singleQ u A z y
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let T := clones j
  let L := fresh A (u.next A) j y
  let F (i : Fin T) (w : Clutch j M) : ℝ := if u.single A z w.1 (w.2 i) then 1 else 0
  have hi (i : Fin T) : L.Ex (F i) = u.singleQ A z y := by
    unfold L fresh F singleQ prob; rw [Ex_tensorP]
    refine congrArg _ (funext fun v => ?_)
    let f (z' : Grid M) := if u.single A z v z' then (1:ℝ) else 0
    exact Ex_pack_proj (fun _ => channel A y) i f
  unfold alarmQ prob; apply le_trans (b:=L.Ex (fun w => ∑ i, F i w))
  · apply Ex_mono
    intro w
    split_ifs with H
    · obtain ⟨i,hi⟩ := H
      have HE := Finset.single_le_sum (f:=fun i => F i w) (fun i _ => by
        unfold F; split_ifs <;> norm_num) (Finset.mem_univ i)
      rwa [show F i w=1 from ite_eq_left hi] at HE
    exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => by unfold F; split_ifs <;> norm_num
  rw [Ex_finset_sum]
  simp_rw [hi, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin,nsmul_eq_mul]
  exact le_rfl

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.Update.shift_app
statement:
lemma shift_app (u : Update j M p) (x y z : Grid M) :
    u.app (x+y) z = ply (snap_le (M:=M) j p) u.V
      (fun i => u.v i z * chi (raise (snap_le (M:=M) j p) i) y) x
proof:
:= by
  unfold app ply
  refine congrArg _ ?_; funext i
  rw [chi_add]; ring

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.Update.one_moment
statement:
private lemma one_moment {A : Form M} {p : Node} (hp : p.ok M) (hA : 0 ≤ A)
    {P : Law (Grid M)} {C : ℝ} (u : Update j M p) (HG : u.Good C A P) (HR : u.regular)
    (s : Profile M) (hS : ∀ i∈s, 0 ≤ i.1)
    (HH : A+place p M + mixForm s ≤ tilde (H j) A p)
    (z' d : Grid M) :
    expU (fun y => prefixE s p y * boltz A (z'-y) * ‖u.app (y+d) z'‖^(2*sLen j)) ≤
      exp (32 -F (A+place p M)-u.credit/4)
proof:
:= by
  let t := p.start M
  let B := place p M; let U := A+B; let V := tilde (H j) A p
  let W : Profile M := (B,t)::(A,z')::s
  have he (y : Grid M) : prefixE s p y * boltz A (z'-y) ≤ exp 32 * tune W y := by
    unfold prefixE; split_ifs with hi
    · have H : form B (t-y) ≤ 32 := place_internal (start_mem hp.1 hp.2) hi
      have HH : 1 ≤ exp 32 * boltz B (t-y) := by unfold boltz; rw [← exp_add]; apply one_le_exp; linarith
      unfold W; rw [tune_cons,tune_cons]
      have hx : 0 ≤ tune s y * boltz A (z'-y) := mul_nonneg (tune_pos _ _).le (boltz_pos _ _).le
      apply le_trans (le_mul_of_one_le_left hx HH)
      exact le_of_eq (by ring)
    · rw [zero_mul]
      exact mul_nonneg (exp_nonneg _) (tune_pos _ _).le
  let f (i) := u.v i z' * chi (raise (snap_le (M:=M) j p) i) d
  have hf (i) : ‖f i‖ ≤ 1 := by
    unfold f; rw [norm_mul,norm_chi,mul_one]; exact HG.unit _ _
  have hi (i : Grid M) : ‖expU (fun y => (↑(tune W y):ℂ)*chi i y)‖ ≤ exp (-F U)*cred V i := by
    have HB := place_valid p M
    rw [expU_coeff (fun y => (↑(tune W y):ℂ))]
    apply le_trans (profile_envelope (s:=W) ?_ _)
    · rw [q_even _ _]
      have Heq : mixForm W = U+mixForm s := by unfold W U; rw [mix_cons,mix_cons]; abel
      rw [Heq]
      exact q_compare (add_nonneg hA HB) (le_add_of_nonneg_right (mix_nonneg hS)) HH _
    intro z hz
    simp only [W,List.mem_cons] at hz
    rcases hz with hh|hh|hh <;>
      first | exact hS z hh | (subst z; first | exact HB | exact hA)
  have hN := weighted_envelope (sLen j) (snap_le _ _) V u.V f hf (tune W) _ hi
  let T := sLen j
  calc
    _ ≤ exp 32 * expU (fun y => tune W y * ‖u.app (y+d) z'‖^(2*T)) := by
      rw [expU_ex,expU_ex,← Ex_lmul]; apply Ex_mono; intro x
      rw [← mul_assoc]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (he x) (by positivity)
    _ = exp 32 * expU (fun y => tune W y * ‖ply (snap_le _ _) u.V f y‖^(2*T)) := by
      simp only [shift_app]; rfl
    _ ≤ exp 32*(exp (-F U)*HeatM (snap_le _ _) V u.V T) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hN (exp_nonneg _)
    _ ≤ _ := by
      rw [← heat_exp,← exp_add,← exp_add]; apply exp_monotone
      have H : u.credit/4 ≤ levelCost (snap_le _ _) V u.V T := HG.evidence HR
      unfold U B; linarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.Update.consistent_length
statement:
private lemma consistent_length (u : Update j M p) (z : Grid M) (A : Form M) :
    (uniform (Grid M)).prob (u.consistent A z) ≤ exp (4*cushion j-F A)
proof:
:= by
  unfold consistent
  rw [prob_translate (fun w => form A w ≤ 4*cushion j)]
  unfold prob
  let f := 4*cushion j
  have hi : (uniform _).Ex (fun w => exp (-f)*(if form A w ≤ 4*cushion j then 1 else 0)) ≤
      q A 0 := by
    rw [q_origin,expU_ex]; refine Ex_mono _ fun i => ?_
    split_ifs with H
    · rw [mul_one]; exact exp_monotone (neg_le_neg H)
    rw [mul_zero]; exact (boltz_pos _ _).le
  rw [Ex_lmul,← F_origin] at hi

  refine le_of_mul_le_mul_left ?_ (exp_pos (-f))
  rw [← exp_add]
  rw [show -f+(4*cushion j-F A)=-F A by unfold f; ring]
  simpa only using hi

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.Update.one_clone_tail
statement:
theorem one_clone_tail {A : Form M} {p : Node} (hp : p.ok M) (hA : 0 ≤ A)
    {P : Law (Grid M)} {C : ℝ} (u : Update j M p) (HG : u.Good C A P) (HR : u.regular)
    (s : Profile M) (hS : ∀ i∈s, 0 ≤ i.1)
    (HH : A+place p M + mixForm s ≤ tilde (H j) A p) (z : Grid M) :
    (beta u.ix/4)^(2*sLen j) * expU (fun y => prefixE s p y * singleQ u A z y) ≤
      exp (32 - F (A+place p M)-u.credit/4+4*cushion j)
proof:
:= by
  let f := prefixE s p
  let L := label (u.next A)
  let V := uniform (Grid M)
  let b := beta u.ix/4
  let N := 2*sLen j
  let M0 := fun y d => u.single A z (y+d)
  let S := fun z' : Grid M => if u.consistent A z z' then (1:ℝ) else 0
  have he (y : Grid M) : b^N * (f y*singleQ u A z y) ≤ exp (F A) *
      L.Ex (fun d => V.Ex fun z' => S z' * (f y * boltz A (z'-y) * ‖u.app (y+d) z'‖^N)) := by
    unfold singleQ; rw [ch_ex]
    have hc (y z : Grid M) : channel A y z = exp (F A) * (V z * boltz A (z-y)) := by
      rw [ch_K,K_eq,boltz,show V z = side M from uniform_side z,
        sub_eq_add_neg,exp_add]
      ring
    rw [← mul_assoc]
    change (b^N*f y)*L.Ex _ ≤ _
    simp_rw [← Ex_lmul L]
    refine Ex_mono _ fun d => ?_
    unfold prob Ex
    rw [Finset.mul_sum,Finset.mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun z' _ => ?_
    have hp := prefixE_nonneg s p y
    change 0 ≤ f y at hp
    dsimp
    split_ifs with H
    · unfold S; obtain ⟨h1,h2⟩ := H
      simp only [ite_eq_left h1,mul_one,one_mul]
      have hf : b^N ≤ ‖u.app (y+d) z'‖^N :=
        pow_le_pow_left₀ (by have := beta_pos u.ix; positivity) h2 _
      convert mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hf
        (mul_nonneg hp ((channel A y).nonneg z')) using 1 <;>
        (simp only [hc]; ring)
    rw [mul_zero,mul_zero]
    unfold S
    split_ifs <;> (have := V.nonneg z'; have := boltz_pos A (z'-y); positivity)
  let E := 32-F (A+place p M)-u.credit/4
  have hm (d z' : Grid M) :
      V.Ex (fun y => f y * boltz A (z'-y) * ‖u.app (y+d) z'‖^N) ≤ exp E := by
    unfold V; rw [←expU_ex]
    exact one_moment hp hA u HG HR s hS HH z' d
  rw [expU_ex]; change b^N * V.Ex (fun y => f y * u.singleQ A z y) ≤ _
  rw [← Ex_lmul]
  apply le_trans (V.Ex_mono he)
  rw [Ex_lmul,Ex_swap V L]
  have hiD (d : Grid M) :
      V.Ex (fun y => V.Ex fun z' => S z' * (f y * boltz A (z'-y) * ‖u.app (y+d) z'‖^N))
        ≤ exp (4*cushion j-F A)*exp E := by
    rw [Ex_swap V V]; simp_rw [Ex_lmul]
    apply le_trans (b:=V.Ex fun z' => S z'*exp E)
    · exact V.Ex_mono fun z' => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hm d z') (by unfold S; split_ifs <;> norm_num)
    rw [Ex_mul]
    have hC : V.Ex S = V.prob _ := rfl
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hC.le.trans (consistent_length u z A)) (exp_nonneg E)
  calc
    _ ≤ exp (F A)*L.Ex (fun _ => exp (4*cushion j-F A)*exp E) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (L.Ex_mono hiD) (exp_nonneg _)
    _ = _ := by rw [Ex_const,←exp_add,←exp_add]; unfold E; congr 1; ring

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.mem_ball
statement: lemma mem_ball (A : Form M) (r : ℝ) (x : Grid M) : x ∈ ball A r ↔ delta A x ≤ r
proof: := by simp [ball]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.nearby_bias
proof:
:= P.Ex (fun x =>
      if x ∈ (child p B).block M then
          (channel A x).Ex (fun z => (v z * chi s x).re) else 0)
    ∃ w : Grid M → ℂ, (∀ z, ‖w z‖ ≤ 1) ∧ test u v -8*E ≤ test i w := by
  intro test
  let x' := p.start M
  let w (z : Grid M) := v z * chi (u-i) x'
  have hp0 : 0 ≤ E := nonneg_of_mul_nonneg_left ((rad_nonneg _).trans hE) p.invlen_pos
  have hn (z : Grid M) : ‖w z‖ ≤ 1 := by simp_rw [w,norm_mul,norm_chi,mul_one]; exact hv z
  have he (x : Grid M) (hx : 0 < P x) :
      (channel A x).Ex (fun z => (v z * chi u x).re) -8*E ≤
        (channel A x).Ex (fun z => (w z * chi i x).re) := by
    calc
      _ = (channel A x).Ex (fun z => (v z * chi u x).re-8*E) := by rw [Ex_sub,Ex_const]
      _ ≤ _ := Ex_mono _ fun z => by
        have hh := phase_distance (u-i) x x'
        have heq : ‖chi (u-i) x-chi (u-i) x'‖ ≤ 8*E := by
          apply le_trans hh
          calc
            _ ≤ E * p.invlen * (8 * p.len) := by
              have H := p.invlen_pos
              gcongr
              exact diam_block (piece_support hp hP _ hx) (start_mem hp.1 hp.2)
            _ = _ := by rw [rinv]; field_simp [p.len_pos.ne']
        have Hg : (v z*chi u x).re-(w z*chi i x).re ≤ 8*E :=
          calc
            _ = (v z*chi i x * (chi (u-i) x-chi (u-i) x')).re := by
              unfold w
              rw [show v z*chi i x * (chi (u-i) x-chi (u-i) x') =
                    v z*(chi (u-i) x * chi i x)-v z*chi (u-i) x'*chi i x by ring,
                ← chi_add',sub_add_cancel,Complex.sub_re]
            _ ≤ _ := by
              apply le_trans (le_abs_self _)
              apply le_trans (Complex.abs_re_le_norm _)
              rw [norm_mul,norm_mul,norm_chi,mul_one]
              exact (mul_le_of_le_one_left (by positivity) (hv z)).trans heq
        linarith
  refine ⟨w,hn,?_⟩
  unfold test
  rw [← Ex_const P (8*E),← Ex_sub]
  refine P.Ex_mono_mem fun x hx => ?_
  split_ifs
  · exact he x hx
  linarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.extract_spectrum
statement:
lemma extract_spectrum (j : ℕ) {A : Form M} {p : Node} {a : Grid M → ℝ} {α b k : ℝ}
    (hp : p.valid) (hv : p.lev < M)
    (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hα : 0 < α) {P : Law (Grid M)} (hP : PieceLaw p a P)
    (hm : 0 < p.avg a) (hm' : p.avg a ≤ 2*α)
    (he : 8*sig j ≤ b^2) (hr : request A j p a α b k) :
    let l
proof:
:= snapGrid j p M
    ∃ (s : Finset (Grid l)) (B : Bool) (v : Grid l → Grid M → ℂ),
      s.Nonempty ∧ k-log 2 ≤ log (s.card:ℝ) ∧
        separated (raise (snap_le _ _)) A (sepRad j) (sig j*p.invlen/2) s ∧
        biases P p A (snap_le _ _) s B v (b^2/100) := by
  classical
  intro l
  have hl := snap_le (M:=M) j p
  let g := down hl
  let d := raise hl
  let R := sig j*p.invlen
  let D := sepRad j
  obtain ⟨s,hs,hb,hr⟩ := hr

  let t := s.filter (fun x => b^2 ≤ energyZ p.L a α A x)
  have hh : ∃ B, ∃ t' ⊆ s, s.card ≤ 2*t'.card ∧
      ∀ x∈t', b^2 ≤ energyZ (p.child B) a α A x := by
    by_cases H : s.card ≤ 2*t.card
    · exact ⟨false,t,Finset.filter_subset _ _,H,fun i hi => (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).2⟩
    · refine ⟨true,s \ t, Finset.sdiff_subset, ?_,?_⟩
      · have hh : t ⊆ s := Finset.filter_subset _ _
        rw [Finset.card_sdiff_of_subset hh]
        have hi := Finset.card_le_card hh; omega
      intro x hx
      obtain ⟨hx,hx'⟩ := Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hx
      obtain ⟨B,hu⟩ := hb x hx
      cases B
      · exact (hx' (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hx,hu⟩)).elim
      · exact hu
  obtain ⟨B,t,ht,h1,h2⟩ := hh
  let U := t.image g
  have hp' : ok p M := ⟨hp,hv.le⟩
  have hX (x : Grid M) : rad (x-d (g x)) ≤ R/20 := (step_scale j hp'.2).2.2.2 x
  have hY (x) (hx : x∈s) (y) (hy : y∈s) (hne : x≠y) :
      ¬ fnear A D (R/2) (d (g x)-d (g y)) := by
    intro hn
    obtain ⟨i,hi,h⟩ := hn
    apply hr _ hx _ hy hne
    refine ⟨i,hi,?_⟩
    simp only [id_eq]
    rw [show x-y-i = (d (g x)-d (g y)-i)+(x-d (g x))+ -(y-d (g y)) by ring]
    apply le_trans (rad_add _ _)
    have hh := rad_add (d (g x)-d (g y)-i) (x-d (g x))
    rw [rad_even]
    linarith [hX x,hX y,rad_nonneg (x-d (g x))]
  have hi : Set.InjOn g s := by
    intro x hx y hy H
    by_contra he
    apply hY x hx y hy he
    refine ⟨0,?_,?_⟩
    · rw [delta_zero]; unfold D sepRad; positivity
    rw [H,sub_self,sub_self]
    have hh : 0 ≤ R := by have hhi := hX x; linarith [rad_nonneg (x-d (g x))]
    simpa [rad] using div_nonneg hh (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)≤2)
  have Hc : exp k ≤ 2*U.card := by
    rw [show U.card=t.card from Finset.card_image_of_injOn (hi.mono ht)]
    exact hs.trans (by exact_mod_cast h1)
  have Hc' : (0:ℝ) < U.card := by linarith [exp_pos k]
  have Hcp : 0 < U.card := by exact_mod_cast Hc'
  have hvv (i : Grid l) :
      ∃ v : Grid M → ℂ, (∀ z, ‖v z‖ ≤ 1) ∧ (i∈U →
        b^2/100 ≤ P.Ex fun x => if x∈(p.child B).block M then
          (channel A x).Ex fun z => (v z*chi (d i) x).re else 0) := by
    by_cases hh : i∈U
    · obtain ⟨x,hx,rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hh
      obtain ⟨v,hv1,hv2⟩ := piece_child_bias hp hv ha hα hP hm hm' A x B (h2 x hx)
      obtain ⟨w,hw1,hw2⟩ := nearby_bias hp' hP A x (d (g x)) B hv1 (sig j/20)
        ((hX x).trans (by unfold R; rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div]))
      refine ⟨w,hw1,fun _ => ?_⟩
      dsimp only at hw2
      nlinarith
    exact ⟨fun _ => 0,fun _ => by simp, fun h => (hh h).elim⟩
  choose v hv1 hv2 using hvv
  refine ⟨U,B,v,Finset.card_pos.mp Hcp,?_,?_,hv1,hv2⟩
  · have hh := log_le_log (exp_pos k) Hc
    rw [log_exp,Real.log_mul (by norm_num) Hc'.ne'] at hh
    linarith
  intro i hi j hj he
  obtain ⟨x,hx,rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hi
  obtain ⟨y,hy,rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hj
  exact hY x (ht hx) y (ht hy) (fun h => he (congrArg g h))

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.flat_selection
statement:
lemma flat_selection (D : ℝ) (hD : 1 ≤ D) :
    ∀ᶠ j : ℕ in atTop, ∀ (M : ℕ) (A B : Form M), 0 ≤ A → 0 ≤ B →
      ∀ t : ℝ, t ≤ D*height j →
        F (A+long j • B)-F A ≤ 400*t →
      ∃ c : ℝ, height j * H j^200 ≤ c ∧ H j^140*c ≤ long j ∧
        flat (H j) (plateErr j) A (c • B) ∧
        F (A+c • B)-F A ≤ 400*t ∧
        (label (A+c • B)).Ex (form B) ≤ 400*t/c
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [nat_pow_small_slow 402 10000,h_large (1000*D)] with j hj h M A B hA hB t ht hw
  let d := height j
  let a := H j
  have H1 : 1 ≤ a := H_ge j
  have hp : 0 < a := H_pos j
  have hd : 0 < d := d_pos j
  let m := slow j ^ 401
  let curve (i : ℕ) := d*a^200 * (2*a^140)^i
  have hm : 0 < m := pow_pos (slow_pos j) _
  have he : curve m ≤ long j := by
    have Hm : ell j *200 + (1+ell j *140)*m ≤ wide j := by
      apply le_trans _ hj
      have h1 := ell_le_h j
      have h2 : 1 ≤ slow j := slow_pos j
      have h3 : slow j ≤ slow j ^402 := le_self_pow h2 (by decide)
      have h4 : 1+ell j * 140 ≤ 141 * slow j := by omega
      calc
        _ ≤ ell j *200 + (141*slow j)*m := Nat.add_le_add_left (Nat.mul_le_mul_right m h4) _
        _ = ell j *200 + 141*slow j^402 := by unfold m; ring
        _ ≤ 10000*slow j^402 := by omega
    have HE : a = (2:ℝ)^(ell j) := by unfold a H slow; push_cast; rfl
    unfold curve long
    calc
      _ = d*(2:ℝ)^(ell j*200+(1+ell j*140)*m) := by
          rw [HE, pow_add, pow_mul,pow_mul,pow_add,pow_one,pow_mul]; ring
      _ ≤ _ := by
        change d*_ ≤ d*_
        gcongr; norm_num
  have h_step (i : ℕ) : a^140*curve i = 2⁻¹*curve (i+1) := by unfold curve; rw [pow_succ]; ring
  have hn (i) : d*a^200 ≤ curve i := by
    apply le_mul_of_one_le_right (by positivity)
    exact one_le_pow₀ (by have := one_le_pow₀ H1 (n:=140); linarith)
  have hu (i : ℕ) (hi : i < m) : a^140*curve i ≤ long j := by
    rw [h_step]
    refine le_trans ?_ he
    have HE : curve (i+1) ≤ curve m :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (pow_le_pow_right₀
        (by have := one_le_pow₀ H1 (n:=140); linarith) hi) (by positivity)
    have HP : 0 ≤ curve m := by unfold curve; positivity
    norm_num; linarith
  let E (i : ℕ) := F (A+(2⁻¹*curve i) • B)
  have Hlow (i : ℕ) : F A ≤ E i := by
    apply F_mono (le_add_of_nonneg_right _)
    intro x
    apply mul_nonneg _ (hB x)
    unfold curve; positivity
  have Hhi : E m ≤ F A + 400*t := by
    apply le_trans (b:=F (A+long j • B))
    · refine F_mono (add_le_add_right ?_ _)
      intro x
      have hhP : 0 ≤ curve m := by unfold curve; positivity
      have hh : 2⁻¹*curve m ≤ long j := by norm_num; linarith
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hh (hB x)
    linarith
  have hi' : ∃ i, i < m ∧ E (i+1)-E i ≤ plateErr j := by
    by_contra! Hh
    have hi : ∀ l : ℕ, l ≤ m → E 0+l*plateErr j ≤ E l := by
      intro l hll; induction l with
      | zero => simp
      | succ l ih =>
        have hh := ih (by omega)
        have hl := Hh l hll
        push_cast; linarith
    have HH := hi m le_rfl
    have HG : (m:ℝ)*plateErr j = a*d := by
      have He : (m:ℝ) = a^401 := by unfold m a H; push_cast; rfl
      rw [He]
      change a^401 * (d/a^400)=a*d
      rw [pow_succ]; field_simp
    have HL := Hlow 0
    rw [HG] at HH
    change _ ≤ a at h
    change _ ≤ D*d at ht
    nlinarith
  obtain ⟨i,hi,hF⟩ := hi'
  have hiP : 0 < curve i := by unfold curve; positivity
  have heq := hu _ hi
  have HH : F (A+curve i • B)-F A ≤ 400*t := by
    refine (sub_le_sub_right (F_mono (add_le_add_right ?_ A)) _).trans hw
    intro x
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ((le_mul_of_one_le_left hiP.le (one_le_pow₀ H1)).trans heq) (hB x)
  refine ⟨curve i, hn i,heq,?_,HH,?_⟩
  · unfold flat
    rw [smul_smul,smul_smul]
    exact (by rw [show H j ^140*curve i = _ from h_step i]; exact hF)
  apply (le_div_iff₀ hiP).mpr
  have H := mean_energy A (curve i • B)
  rw [funext (fun x => form_smul B (curve i) x), Ex_lmul] at H
  rw [mul_comm]
  exact H.trans HH

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.wave_even
statement: lemma wave_even (s : Grid M) : (wave s).Even
proof: := by intro x; simp [wave,chi_neg]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.wave_comm
statement: lemma wave_comm (s y : Grid M) : wave s y = wave y s
proof: := by unfold wave; rw [chi_comm]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.wave_abs
statement: lemma wave_abs (s y : Grid M) : |wave s y| ≤ 1
proof:
:=
  (Complex.abs_re_le_norm (chi s y)).trans (norm_chi _ _).le

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.cost_even
statement: lemma cost_even (s : Grid M) : (cost s).Even
proof: := by intro x; unfold cost; rw [wave_even _ x]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.cost_symm
statement: lemma cost_symm (s y : Grid M) : cost s y = cost y s
proof: := by unfold cost; rw [wave_comm]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.cost_bounds
statement: lemma cost_bounds (s y : Grid M) : 0 ≤ cost s y ∧ cost s y ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  unfold cost
  rcases abs_le.mp (wave_abs s y) with ⟨h1,h2⟩
  constructor <;> linarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.norm_phase_sq
statement: lemma norm_phase_sq (s x : Grid M) : ‖1-chi s x‖^2 = 2*cost s x
proof:
:= by
  unfold cost wave
  have H := Complex.sq_norm (chi s x)
  rw [norm_chi] at H
  rw [Complex.sq_norm]
  simp only [Complex.normSq_apply,Complex.sub_re,Complex.sub_im,Complex.one_re, Complex.one_im] at *
  nlinarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.norm_phase_add
statement:
lemma norm_phase_add (s x y : Grid M) :
    ‖1-chi s (x+y)‖ ≤ ‖1-chi s x‖+‖1-chi s y‖
proof:
:= by
  rw [chi_add,show 1-chi s x*chi s y = 1-chi s x + chi s x*(1-chi s y) by ring]
  refine (norm_add_le _ _).trans ?_
  rw [norm_mul,norm_chi,one_mul]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.cost_add
statement: lemma cost_add (s x y : Grid M) : cost s (x+y) ≤ 2*(cost s x+cost s y)
proof:
:= by
  have H1 := norm_phase_sq s x
  have H2 := norm_phase_sq s y
  have H3 := norm_phase_sq s (x+y)
  have H4 := norm_phase_add s x y
  nlinarith [norm_nonneg (1-chi s (x+y)),sq_nonneg (‖1-chi s x‖-‖1-chi s y‖)]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.form_zero
statement: lemma form_zero (x : Grid M) : form 0 x = 0
proof: := by simp [form]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.form_at_zero
statement: lemma form_at_zero (A : Form M) : form A 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [form, cost, wave, chi_zero_right]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.form_add
statement: lemma form_add (A D : Form M) (x : Grid M) : form (A+D) x = form A x + form D x
proof:
:= by
  simp [form, add_mul, Finset.sum_add_distrib]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.form_smul
statement: lemma form_smul (A : Form M) (t : ℝ) (x : Grid M) : form (t • A) x = t*form A x
proof:
:= by
  simp [form, mul_assoc, Finset.mul_sum]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.form_sum
statement:
lemma form_sum {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → Form M) (x : Grid M) :
    form (∑ i ∈ s, f i) x = ∑ i ∈ s, form (f i) x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp [form_zero]
  | @insert i s hi ih => rw [Finset.sum_insert hi,Finset.sum_insert hi,form_add,ih]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.form_even
statement: lemma form_even (A : Form M) : (form A).Even
proof: := by intro x; simp [form, cost_even _ x]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.form_mono
statement: lemma form_mono {A D : Form M} (h : A ≤ D) : form A ≤ form D
proof:
:= by
  intro y
  exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun s _ => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (h s) (cost_bounds _ _).1

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.form_nonneg
statement: lemma form_nonneg {A : Form M} (h : 0 ≤ A) (y : Grid M) : 0 ≤ form A y
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [form_zero] using form_mono h y

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.form_triangle
statement:
lemma form_triangle {A : Form M} (h : 0 ≤ A) (x y : Grid M) :
    form A (x+y) ≤ 2*(form A x+form A y)
proof:
:= by
  unfold form
  rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib,Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum; intro i hi
  apply le_trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (cost_add _ _ _) (h i))
  exact le_of_eq (by ring)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.boltz_even
statement: lemma boltz_even (A : Form M) : (boltz A).Even
proof: := by intro x; simp [boltz,form_even _ x]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.boltz_pos
statement: lemma boltz_pos (A : Form M) (y : Grid M) : 0 < boltz A y
proof: := exp_pos _

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.boltz_sum
statement:
lemma boltz_sum (A D : Form M) (y : Grid M) :
    boltz (A+D) y = boltz A y * boltz D y
proof:
:= by
  simp [boltz,form_add, exp_add,mul_comm]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.q_even
statement: lemma q_even (A : Form M) : (q A).Even
proof:
:= fun x => congrArg Complex.re <|
  fc_neg_even (fun y => (↑(boltz A y):ℂ)) (fun y => by simp [boltz_even _ y]) x

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.cq
statement:
lemma cq (A : Form M) (x : Grid M) :
    (↑(q A x):ℂ) = fc (fun y => (↑(boltz A y):ℂ)) x
proof: := real_fc_even _ (boltz_even _) _

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.q_origin
statement: lemma q_origin (A : Form M) : q A 0 = expU (boltz A)
proof:
:= by
  apply Complex.ofReal_inj.mp
  rw [cq, ← expU_real,fc]
  simp_rw [neg_zero,chi_zero_left,mul_one]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.q_origin_pos
statement: lemma q_origin_pos (A : Form M) : 0 < q A 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [q_origin]; unfold expU
  rw [smul_eq_mul]
  exact mul_pos (side_pos _) <| Finset.sum_pos (fun i _ => boltz_pos _ _) Finset.univ_nonempty

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.q_total
statement: lemma q_total (A : Form M) : ∑ x, q A x = 1
proof:
:= by
  have H := invert_fc (fun y => (↑(boltz A y):ℂ)) 0
  simp_rw [← cq,chi_zero_right,mul_one,← Complex.ofReal_sum] at H
  simpa only [boltz,form_at_zero,neg_zero,Real.exp_zero,Complex.ofReal_inj] using H

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.q_add
statement:
lemma q_add (A D : Form M) (u : Grid M) :
    q (A+D) u = ∑ v : Grid M, q A v * q D (u-v)
proof:
:= by
  apply Complex.ofReal_inj.mp
  rw [cq]; push_cast
  simp_rw [cq,boltz_sum,Complex.ofReal_mul]
  exact fc_prod _ _ _

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.boltz_series
statement:
lemma boltz_series (A : Form M) (u : Grid M) :
    ∑ v : Grid M, q A v * wave v u = boltz A u
proof:
:= by
  have H := congrArg Complex.re <| invert_fc (fun y => (↑(boltz A y):ℂ)) u
  simp only [← cq,Complex.re_sum, Complex.re_ofReal_mul,Complex.ofReal_re] at H
  exact H

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.F_origin
statement: lemma F_origin (A : Form M) : exp (-F A) = q A 0
proof: := by rw [F,neg_neg,exp_log (q_origin_pos A)]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.F_zero
statement: lemma F_zero : F (0:Form M) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [F,q_origin,expU_ex]; unfold boltz
  simp_rw [form_zero]
  simp only [neg_zero, exp_zero, Ex_const, log_one, neg_zero]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.F_mono
statement: lemma F_mono {A B : Form M} (h : A ≤ B) : F A ≤ F B
proof:
:= by
  unfold F
  apply neg_le_neg
  apply Real.log_le_log (q_origin_pos _)
  rw [q_origin,q_origin,expU_ex,expU_ex]
  exact Ex_mono _ fun x => exp_monotone (neg_le_neg (form_mono h x))

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.K_eq
statement: lemma K_eq (A : Form M) (x : Grid M) : K A x = exp (F A-form A x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [K,boltz,← F_origin]
  rw [← exp_sub]
  congr 1
  ring

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.K_even
statement: lemma K_even (A : Form M) : (K A).Even
proof: := fun y => by simp [K,boltz_even _ y]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.K_pos
statement: lemma K_pos (A : Form M) (x : Grid M) : 0 < K A x
proof: := div_pos (boltz_pos _ _) (q_origin_pos _)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.K_total
statement: lemma K_total (A : Form M) : expU (K A) = 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold K
  simp_rw [expU_ex,div_eq_mul_inv,Ex_mul,← expU_ex,← q_origin,mul_inv_cancel₀ (q_origin_pos _).ne']

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.label_apply
statement: lemma label_apply (A : Form M) (x : Grid M) : label A x = side M * K A x
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.label_pos
statement: lemma label_pos (A : Form M) (x : Grid M) : 0 < label A x
proof:
:=
  mul_pos (side_pos _) (K_pos _ _)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.label_ex
statement:
lemma label_ex (A : Form M) (f : Grid M → ℝ) :
    (label A).Ex f = expU fun x => K A x * f x
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [expU_ex,Ex,uniform_side,label_apply,mul_assoc]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.label_cx
statement:
lemma label_cx (A : Form M) (f : Grid M → ℂ) :
    (label A).Cx f = expU fun x => (K A x:ℂ) * f x
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [expU_cx,Cx,uniform_side,label_apply,Complex.ofReal_mul,mul_assoc]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.cred_eq
statement: lemma cred_eq (A : Form M) (u : Grid M) : (↑(cred A u):ℂ) = (label A).Cx (chi u)
proof:
:= by
  rw [label_cx]
  simp_rw [K,div_eq_inv_mul,Complex.ofReal_mul,mul_assoc]
  rw [expU_lmul,expU_coeff,cred,div_eq_inv_mul,Complex.ofReal_mul,← cq,q_even _ u]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.cred_ex
statement: lemma cred_ex (A : Form M) (u : Grid M) : cred A u = (label A).Ex (wave u)
proof:
:= by
  unfold wave
  simpa only [re_Cx,Complex.ofReal_re,wave] using congrArg Complex.re (cred_eq A u)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.cred_norm
statement: lemma cred_norm (A : Form M) (u : Grid M) : |cred A u| ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  have H := norm_Cx_unit (label A) (chi u) (fun x => (norm_chi _ _).le)
  rwa [← cred_eq,Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs] at H

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.chi_one_ne
statement: private lemma chi_one_ne {s : Grid M} (hs : s ≠ 0) : chi s 1 ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  intro H
  have hi (x : Grid M) : chi s x = 1 := by
    rw [chi_comm,← ZMod.natCast_zmod_val x,← nsmul_one,chi_nsmul,chi_comm 1 s,H,one_pow]
  have hh := expU_chi s
  rw [ite_eq_right hs,funext hi,← funext chi_zero_left,expU_chi,ite_eq_left rfl] at hh
  norm_num at hh

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.odd_phase
statement: private lemma odd_phase {s : Grid M} (hs : s ≠ 0) (h : s+s=0) : chi s 1 = -1
proof:
:= by
  have H1 : chi s 1 * chi s 1 = 1 := by rw [← chi_add', h,chi_zero_left]
  have H2 : (chi s 1 - 1)*(chi s 1+1)=0 := by rw [show
    (chi s 1 - 1)*(chi s 1+1)= chi s 1 * chi s 1-1 by ring,H1,sub_self]
  rcases eq_zero_or_eq_zero_of_mul_eq_zero H2 with h1|h1
  · exact (chi_one_ne hs (sub_eq_zero.mp h1)).elim
  · exact eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left h1

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.ch_parity
statement:
private lemma ch_parity (s : Grid M) :
    expU (fun i => chi s (i+i)) + expU (fun i => chi s (1+(i+i))) = 2 * expU (chi s)
proof:
:= by
  have hi (i : Grid M) : chi s (i+i) = chi (s+s) i := by rw [chi_add,chi_add']
  simp_rw [chi_add _ 1,hi]
  rw [expU_lmul,expU_chi,expU_chi]
  by_cases hs : s=0
  · subst s; simp [chi_zero_left]; ring
  rw [ite_eq_right hs]
  split_ifs with H
  · rw [odd_phase hs H]; ring
  ring

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.c_parity
statement:
private lemma c_parity (f : Grid M → ℂ) :
    expU (fun i => f (i+i)) + expU (fun i => f (1+(i+i))) = 2 * expU f
proof:
:= by
  let g (x : Grid M) := ∑ s, fc f s * chi s x
  suffices HH : expU (fun i => g (i+i)) + expU (fun i => g (1+(i+i))) = 2 * expU g by
    have hi : g=f := funext (invert_fc _)
    rwa [hi] at HH
  unfold g
  simp_rw [expU_sum,expU_lmul]
  rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib,Finset.mul_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
  rw [← mul_add,ch_parity]; ring

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.r_parity
statement:
private lemma r_parity (f : Grid M → ℝ) :
    expU (fun i => f (i+i)) + expU (fun i => f (1+(i+i))) = 2 * expU f
proof:
:= by
  have hi := c_parity (fun x => (↑(f x):ℂ))
  simp_rw [expU_real] at hi
  exact_mod_cast hi

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.dbl_ex
statement:
private lemma dbl_ex (f : Grid M → Grid M → ℝ) (P : Law (Grid M))
    (hP : P = uniform _) : dblmean f = P.Ex fun x => P.Ex (f x)
proof: := by simp_rw [hP,dblmean,expU_ex]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.branch_eq
statement:
private lemma branch_eq (f : Grid M → Grid M → ℝ) (c : Grid M) :
    branch f c = expU (fun u => expU fun i => f u (c+(i+i)-u))
proof:
:= by
  unfold branch dblmean
  rw [expU_prod (fun u i : Grid M => f u (c+(i+i)-u))]
  refine congrArg expU (funext fun i => ?_)
  dsimp
  rw [← expU_translate (fun u => f u (c+(i+i)-u)) (c+i)]
  refine congrArg expU (funext fun j => ?_)
  have H : c+(i+i)-(c+i+j)=i-j := by ring
  simp only [H]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.branch_sum
statement:
private lemma branch_sum (f : Grid M → Grid M → ℝ) :
    branch f 0 + branch f 1 = 2 * dblmean f
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [branch_eq,dblmean,zero_add, expU_ex]
  rw [← Ex_add, ← Ex_lmul]
  refine congrArg (uniform (Grid M)).Ex (funext fun u => ?_)
  simp_rw [← expU_ex]
  rw [r_parity (fun a => f u (a-u))]
  rw [show (fun a => f u (a-u)) = (fun a => f u (-u+a)) from funext fun a => by
    have H : a-u=-u+a := by ring
    rw [H]]
  rw [expU_translate]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.half_mul
statement: private lemma half_mul (s c : Grid M) : halfWave s c * halfWave s c = chi s c
proof:
:= by
  rw [halfWave,← phase_add, show pos c /2+pos c/2=pos c by ring]
  have H := chi_cast (s.val:ℤ) c
  simpa only [Int.cast_natCast,ZMod.natCast_zmod_val] using H.symm

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.branch_waves
statement:
private lemma branch_waves (s c i j : Grid M) :
    wave s (c+i+j) + wave s (i-j) =
        2*(unitWave s c i).re*(unitWave s c j).re ∧
    wave s (c+i+j) - wave s (i-j) =
        -(2*(unitWave s c i).im*(unitWave s c j).im)
proof:
:= by
  have Hn : halfWave s c * conj (halfWave s c) = 1 := by
    rw [Complex.mul_conj,←Complex.sq_norm,(show ‖halfWave s c‖=1 from phase_unimod _ _)]
    simp
  have He : chi s (c+i+j) = unitWave s c i * unitWave s c j := by
    unfold unitWave
    rw [chi_add,chi_add,← half_mul]
    ring
  have Hf : chi s (i-j) = unitWave s c i * conj (unitWave s c j) := by
    unfold unitWave
    rw [chi_sub,map_mul]
    rw [show halfWave s c * chi s i * (conj (halfWave s c) * conj (chi s j))
          = (chi s i * conj (chi s j)) * (halfWave s c * conj (halfWave s c)) by ring,Hn,mul_one]
  simp only [wave,He,Hf,Complex.mul_re, Complex.conj_re, Complex.conj_im]
  constructor <;> ring

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.bil_sum
statement:
private lemma bil_sum {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → Grid M → Grid M → ℝ) (h : Grid M → ℝ) :
    bil (fun i j => ∑ k ∈ s, f k i j) h = ∑ k ∈ s, bil (f k) h
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [bil,dblmean, Finset.mul_sum, expU_sum]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.dblmean_scale
statement:
private lemma dblmean_scale (c : ℝ) (f : Grid M → Grid M → ℝ) :
    dblmean (fun i j => c*f i j) = c * dblmean f
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [dbl_ex _ (uniform _) rfl,Ex_lmul]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.bil_scale
statement:
private lemma bil_scale (c : ℝ) (f : Grid M → Grid M → ℝ) (h : Grid M → ℝ) :
    bil (fun i j => c*f i j) h = c*bil f h
proof:
:= by
  unfold bil
  rw [← dblmean_scale]
  congr 1; funext i j; ring

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.pair_nonneg
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing h with
  | zero =>
    unfold bil dblmean
    simp_rw [pow_zero, mul_one, expU_ex, Ex_lmul,Ex_mul]
    exact mul_self_nonneg _
  | succ n ih =>
    let f := pairPot A R
    have heq :
        bil (fun i j => (f i j)^(n+1)) h =
          ∑ s : Grid M, A s * bil (fun i j => (f i j)^n) (fun i => h i * R s i) := by
      have He (i j : Grid M) : f i j ^(n+1) =
          ∑ s, A s*(R s i*R s j*(f i j)^n) := by
        rw [pow_succ]
        dsimp only [f,pairPot]; rw [Finset.mul_sum]
        exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun _ _ => by ring
      simp_rw [He,bil_sum,bil_scale]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun s _ => congrArg (A s*·) ?_
      unfold bil; refine congrArg dblmean ?_; funext i j; ring
    rw [heq]
    exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun s _ => mul_nonneg (hA s) (ih _)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.pair_exp_nonneg
statement:
private lemma pair_exp_nonneg {A : Form M} (hA : 0 ≤ A) (R : Grid M → Grid M → ℝ) (h : Grid M → ℝ) :
    0 ≤ bil (fun i j => exp (pairPot A R i j)) h
proof:
:= by
  let f := pairPot A R
  have hi : Tendsto (fun n => bil (fun i j => aprox n (f i j)) h)
      atTop (𝓝 (bil (fun i j => exp (f i j)) h)) := by
    simp only [bil,dblmean,expU,smul_eq_mul]
    refine Tendsto.const_mul _ <| tendsto_finsetSum _ fun i _ => ?_
    refine Tendsto.const_mul _ <| tendsto_finsetSum _ fun j _ => ?_
    exact Tendsto.const_mul _ (aprox_lim _)
  apply ge_of_tendsto hi (Eventually.of_forall fun n => ?_)
  simp_rw [aprox,bil_sum,bil_scale]
  exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun s _ => mul_nonneg (by positivity) (pair_nonneg hA _ _ s)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.branch_pos
statement:
private lemma branch_pos {A : Form M} (hA : 0 ≤ A) (s t c : Grid M) :
    0 ≤ branch (fun y z => K A y*K A z * ((wave s y-wave s z)*(wave t y-wave t z))) c
proof:
:= by
  let U := fun s i => unitWave s c i
  let R := fun s i => (U s i).re
  let h := fun i => (U s i).im*(U t i).im
  let D := (2:ℝ) • A
  let w := 2*(F A-∑ i, A i)
  have HK (i j : Grid M) :
      K A (c+i+j)* K A (i-j) = exp w * exp (pairPot D R i j) := by
    simp_rw [K_eq,← exp_add]
    have He : form A (c+i+j) + form A (i-j) =
        2*∑ i, A i - pairPot D R i j := by
      dsimp [form,pairPot,D]; rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib,Finset.mul_sum,← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => by
        dsimp only [cost,smul_eq_mul,R,U]
        have H := (branch_waves k c i j).1
        linear_combination -(A k) * H
    unfold w
    congr 1
    linarith
  unfold branch
  have Heq :
      (fun i j => K A (c+i+j) * K A (i-j) *
          ((wave s (c+i+j)-wave s (i-j)) * (wave t (c+i+j)-wave t (i-j)))) =
        (fun i j => 4*exp w * (h i * h j * exp (pairPot D R i j))) := by
    funext i j
    rw [HK,(branch_waves _ _ _ _).2,(branch_waves _ _ _ _).2]
    unfold h U; ring
  rw [Heq,dblmean_scale]
  exact mul_nonneg (by positivity) <| pair_exp_nonneg (by
    intro i
    change 0 ≤ 2*A i
    exact mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (hA i)) R h

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.ginibre
statement:
theorem ginibre {A : Form M} (hA : 0 ≤ A) (s t : Grid M) :
    cred A s * cred A t ≤ (label A).Ex (fun i => wave s i * wave t i)
proof:
:= by
  let P := label A
  let f : Grid M → Grid M → ℝ :=
    fun i j => (wave s i-wave s j) * (wave t i-wave t j)
  let g : Grid M → Grid M → ℝ :=
    fun i j => K A i*K A j*f i j
  have H := branch_sum g
  have H1 := branch_pos hA s t 0
  have H2 := branch_pos hA s t 1
  change 0 ≤ branch g _ at H1 H2
  have heq :
      dblmean g = P.Ex fun i => P.Ex (f i) := by
    unfold P; simp_rw [label_ex,dblmean,expU_ex,g,mul_assoc,Ex_lmul]
  have He (i j : Grid M) : f i j =
      ((wave s i * wave t i + wave s j * wave t j) - wave s j * wave t i) - wave s i*wave t j := by
    unfold f; ring
  rw [heq] at H
  have Heq (i : Grid M) : P.Ex (f i) =
      ((wave s i*wave t i + P.Ex (fun i => wave s i * wave t i))
        - P.Ex (wave s)*wave t i) - wave s i * P.Ex (wave t) := by
    rw [funext (He i)]; simp_rw [Ex_sub,Ex_add,Ex_lmul,Ex_mul,Ex_const]
  simp_rw [Heq,Ex_sub,Ex_add,Ex_lmul,Ex_mul,Ex_const] at H
  rw [cred_ex,cred_ex]
  change P.Ex _ * P.Ex _ ≤ P.Ex _
  nlinarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.expU_wave
statement: private lemma expU_wave (v : Grid M) : expU (wave v) = if v=0 then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  have hi := congrArg Complex.re (expU_chi v)
  rw [expU_cx,re_Cx] at hi
  rw [expU_ex]
  split_ifs with H <;> simp only [H,ite_eq_left,Complex.one_re] at hi
  · subst v; exact hi
  · exact hi

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.summesh_eq
statement:
lemma summesh_eq (h : l ≤ M) (A : Form M) :
    summesh h A = expU fun x => boltz A (raise (show M-l ≤ M by omega) x)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let k := M-l
  have hk : k ≤ M := by unfold k; omega
  have he (i : Grid k) : boltz A (raise hk i) =
      ∑ t, q A t * wave (cut hk t) i := by
    rw [← boltz_series]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun t _ => ?_
    rw [wave,chi_comm,cut_chi,chi_comm i _,wave]
  change summesh h A = expU fun x : Grid k => boltz A (raise hk x)
  simp_rw [he,expU_sum,expU_ex, Ex_lmul, ← expU_ex,expU_wave,mul_ite,mul_one,mul_zero]
  let s : Finset (Grid M) := Finset.univ.image (raise h)
  have H : Finset.univ.filter (fun i => cut hk i=0) = s := by
    ext x
    simp only [s,Finset.mem_image,Finset.mem_filter,Finset.mem_univ,true_and]
    exact annihilator h x
  rw [← Finset.sum_filter,H]
  unfold s summesh
  exact (Finset.sum_image (by intro i _ j _ he; exact raise_inj _ he)).symm

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.summesh_bounds
statement:
lemma summesh_bounds (h : l ≤ M) {A : Form M} {R : ℝ} (hi : 2^(M-l) ≤ R) (hA : S M R ≤ A) :
    side (M-l) ≤ summesh h A ∧ summesh h A ≤ 12*side (M-l)
proof:
:= by
  rw [summesh_eq]
  let r := M-l
  have hr : r ≤ M := Nat.sub_le _ _
  let f (x : Grid r) := boltz A (raise hr x)
  change side r ≤ expU f ∧ _
  constructor
  · have H := Finset.single_le_sum (s:=Finset.univ) (f:=f)
      (fun i _ => (boltz_pos _ _).le) (Finset.mem_univ (0 : Grid r))
    have Hz : f 0 = 1 := by simp [f,boltz,form_at_zero]
    unfold expU
    rw [smul_eq_mul]
    rw [Hz] at H
    have := side_pos r; nlinarith
  · let g : ℝ := 2^r
    have hg : 0 ≤ g := by unfold g; positivity
    have he (x : Grid r) :
        form (S M g) (raise hr x) = form (S r g) x := by
      simp_rw [form_S,cost,wave_at_one,raised_pos]
    apply le_trans (b:=q (S r g) 0)
    · rw [q_origin,expU_ex,expU_ex]
      exact Ex_mono _ fun i => exp_monotone <| neg_le_neg <| (he i).ge.trans <|
        form_mono ((S_mono hg hi).trans hA) _
    · have HH := q_S_upper' g (by unfold g; positivity) (M:=r) le_rfl
      rwa [side_pow_two,← div_eq_mul_inv]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.S_one_pos
statement: lemma S_one_pos {R : ℝ} (h : 1 ≤ R) : 0 < S M R 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [S]; nlinarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.fq_apply
statement:
lemma fq_apply (hh : l ≤ M) (A : Form M) (hA : 0 ≤ A) (i : Grid l) :
    fq hh A hA i = q A (raise hh i) / summesh hh A
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.raiseChar_eq
statement:
lemma raiseChar_eq (hh : l ≤ M) (t : Grid M) (i : Grid l) :
    raiseChar hh t i = chi (raise hh i) t
proof: := by rw [cut_chi,chi_comm]; rfl

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.fq_spec
statement:
lemma fq_spec (hh : l ≤ M) (A : Form M) (hA : 0 ≤ A)
    {R : ℝ} (hr : 2^(M-l) ≤ R) (h : S M R ≤ A) :
    let p
proof:
:= fq hh A hA
    let c := fq_cost hh A
    (∀ x, 0 < p x) ∧ (∀ x, 0 ≤ c x) ∧ c 0=0 ∧
      (∀ x, (↑(exp (-c x)):ℂ)=(label A).Cx (fun t => raiseChar hh t x)) ∧
      (∀ x, -log (p x) = -log (p 0) + c x) ∧
      -log (p 0) ≤ F A - log (2^(M-l):ℝ)+12 := by
  have hi := summesh_bounds hh hr h
  have hp : 0 < summesh hh A := lt_of_lt_of_le (side_pos _) hi.1
  have hz (x : Grid M) : 0 < q A x := q_pos_one hA
    (lt_of_lt_of_le (S_one_pos (le_trans (one_le_pow₀ (by norm_num : (1:ℝ)≤2)) hr)) (h _)) x
  have he (x : Grid M) : 0 < cred A x := div_pos (hz x) (hz 0)
  refine ⟨fun x => div_pos (hz _) hp,fun x => neg_nonneg.mpr ?_,?_,?_,?_,?_⟩
  · apply Real.log_nonpos (he _).le
    exact (le_abs_self _).trans (cred_norm _ _)
  · simp [fq_cost,cred,(hz _).ne']
  · intro x
    simp_rw [fq_cost,neg_neg,exp_log (he _),raiseChar_eq]
    exact cred_eq _ _
  · intro x
    simp_rw [fq_apply,Real.log_div (hz _).ne' hp.ne',fq_cost,map_zero,cred,
      Real.log_div (hz _).ne' (hz _).ne']
    ring
  · rw [fq_apply,map_zero,Real.log_div (hz _).ne' hp.ne']
    have HH := log_le_log hp hi.2
    rw [log_mul (by norm_num) (side_pos _).ne', side_pow_two, Real.log_inv] at HH
    unfold F
    linarith [Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<12)]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.snap_le
statement: lemma snap_le (j : ℕ) (p : Node) : snapGrid j p M ≤ M
proof: := Nat.sub_le _ _

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.step_scale
statement:
lemma step_scale (j : ℕ) {p : Node} (hp : p.lev ≤ M) :
    let l
proof:
:= snapGrid j p M
    M-l ≤ p.lev ∧ (2:ℝ)^(M-l) ≤ p.invlen ∧
      p.invlen ≤ 64*(slow j:ℝ)^40 * 2^(M-l) ∧
      ∀ u : Grid M, rad (u-raise (snap_le j p) (down (snap_le j p) u)) ≤ sig j*p.invlen/20 := by
  intro l
  let n := M-l
  have he : n = p.lev - (40*ell j+6) := by dsimp only [n,l,snapGrid,snapExp]; omega
  have hn : n ≤ p.lev := by omega
  have ht : (slow j:ℝ)^40*64 = (2:ℝ)^(40*ell j+6) := by
    simp only [slow,Nat.cast_pow,Nat.cast_ofNat]
    rw [← pow_mul,pow_add]; norm_num; rw [mul_comm (ell j)]
  refine ⟨hn,pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num) hn,?_,?_⟩
  · rw [mul_comm 64,ht,← pow_add]
    exact pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num) (by omega)
  intro u
  have HH := snap_dist (snap_le (M:=M) j p) u
  apply HH.trans
  have hc : 0 < (slow j:ℝ)^40 := pow_pos (by exact_mod_cast slow_pos j) _
  by_cases hd : n=0
  · change (2:ℝ)^n-1 ≤ _
    rw [hd,pow_zero,sub_self]
    have := p.invlen_pos; unfold sig; positivity
  have hv : p.invlen = (2:ℝ)^n * ((slow j:ℝ)^40*64) := by
    rw [ht,← pow_add]; unfold invlen
    congr 1; omega
  rw [hv,sig]
  change (2:ℝ)^n-1 ≤ _
  have hs : 0 < (slow j:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast slow_pos j
  field_simp
  have H : 0 < (2:ℝ)^n := by positivity
  nlinarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.place_valid
statement: lemma place_valid (p : Node) (M : ℕ) : 0 ≤ place p M
proof: := S_nonneg _ _

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.loc_scale
statement: lemma loc_scale {p : Node} (hp : p.lev ≤ M) : invlen p ≤ 2^M
proof: := pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num) hp

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.place_internal
statement:
lemma place_internal {p : Node} {x y : Grid M} (hx : x ∈ p.block M) (hy : y ∈ p.block M) :
    form (place p M) (x-y) ≤ 32
proof:
:= by
  have hi := diam_block hx hy
  have hh := (diam_le_diff _ _).trans hi
  unfold place; rw [form_S]
  calc
    _ ≤ p.invlen^2 * (32 * Dyadic.diam (x-y)^2) := by gcongr; exact (cost_diam _).2
    _ ≤ p.invlen^2 * (32 * p.len^2) := by gcongr; exact diam_nonneg _
    _ = 32 := by rw [rinv]; field_simp [p.len_pos.ne']

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.certified_start
statement: lemma certified_start (M : ℕ) : Certified h err 0 root (0:Form M)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨root_ok _,le_rfl,Or.inl ⟨rfl,rfl⟩,by simp,?_⟩
  rw [show form (0:Form M) = fun _ => 0 from funext form_zero,Ex_const]
  simp

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.certified_add
statement:
lemma certified_add {A D : Form M} {p q : Node} {n : ℕ} (H : Certified h err n p A)
    (hh : 1 ≤ h) (hq : q.ok M)
    (hd : 0 ≤ D) (hF : flat h err (A+place q M) D) :
    Certified h err (n+1) q ((A+place q M)+D)
proof:
:= by
  let B := place q M
  let U := A+B+D
  let w := h^130
  have hp : 0 < h := by linarith
  have hw : 1 ≤ w := one_le_pow₀ hh
  have hB : 0 ≤ B := place_valid _ _
  have hA := H.nonneg
  have hAB := add_nonneg hA hB
  have hAU : A ≤ U := by
    apply le_trans (le_add_of_nonneg_right hB) (le_add_of_nonneg_right hd)
  have hBU : B ≤ U := by
    apply le_trans (le_add_of_nonneg_left hA) (le_add_of_nonneg_right hd)
  refine ⟨hq, hA.trans hAU, Or.inr hBU, ?_, ?_⟩
  ·
    let D' := w • D-D
    have hw' {E : Form M} (h : 0 ≤ E) : E ≤ w • E := by
      intro x
      exact le_mul_of_one_le_left (h x) hw
    have hD' : 0 ≤ D' := sub_nonneg.mpr (hw' hd)
    let V := w • A + w • B + D
    have heq : w • U = V+D' := by unfold U V D'; rw [smul_add,smul_add]; abel
    have h1 : U ≤ V := add_le_add_left (add_le_add (hw' hA) (hw' hB)) _
    have h2 : F (V+D')-F V ≤ err := by
      apply le_trans (F_increment (hA.trans hAU) h1 hD')
      have hh1 : U+D' ≤ A+B+(h^140:ℝ) • D := by
        have hP : w ≤ h^140 := pow_le_pow_right₀ hh (by omega)
        unfold U D'
        rw [show A+B+D+(w • D-D) = A+B+w • D by abel]
        refine add_le_add_right ?_ _
        intro x; exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hP (hd x)
      have hh2 : A+B + (2⁻¹:ℝ) • D ≤ U := by
        refine add_le_add_right ?_ _
        intro x; change 2⁻¹*D x ≤ D x; have hx := hd x; change 0 ≤ D x at hx; norm_num; linarith
      exact le_trans (sub_le_sub (F_mono hh1) (F_mono hh2)) hF
    let W := w • A+B+D
    have h3 : F W-F U ≤ F (w • A)-F A := by
      have ht := F_increment hA hAU (sub_nonneg.mpr (hw' hA))
      rw [show A+(w • A - A) = w • A by abel, show U+(w • A-A)=W by unfold U W; abel] at ht
      exact ht
    have h4 : F V-F W ≤ F (w • B)- F B := by
      have hBW : B ≤ W := le_trans hBU (add_le_add_left (add_le_add_left (hw' hA) _) _)
      have ht := F_increment hB hBW (sub_nonneg.mpr (hw' hB))
      rw [show B+(w • B - B) = w • B by abel, show W+(w • B-B)=V by unfold V W; abel] at ht
      exact ht
    have h5 : F (w • B) - F B ≤ 1000*h := by
      have he : w • B = S M (h^65 * q.invlen) := by
        rw [show w = (h^65)^2 by unfold w; rw [← pow_mul]]; unfold B place; rw [scale_S]
      have hs := one_le_pow₀ hh (n:=65)
      have hc := q.invlen_ge
      have hp' := q.invlen_pos
      rw [he]
      have H1 := F_S_upper M _ (one_le_mul_of_one_le_of_one_le hs hc)
      have H2 := F_S_lower _ hp' (loc_scale hq.2)
      rw [log_mul (by positivity) hp'.ne',log_pow] at H1
      unfold B place; push_cast at *
      linarith [Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos hp]
    have H6 := H.tighten
    change F (w • U) - F U ≤ _
    change F (w • A)-F A ≤ _ at H6
    rw [heq]
    push_cast; linarith

  let L := (2⁻¹:ℝ) • D
  have heq : U = A+B+L+L := by
    unfold L U
    rw [add_assoc (A+B) _ _,← add_smul]
    norm_num
  have h1 : F U-F (A+B+L) ≤ err := by
    have he : D ≤ h^140 • D := fun x => le_mul_of_one_le_left (hd x) (one_le_pow₀ hh)
    exact (sub_le_sub_right (F_mono (add_le_add_right he (A+B))) _).trans hF
  have hG : (label U).Ex (form D) ≤ 2*err := by
    have hh1 := mean_energy (A+B+L) L
    rw [← heq] at hh1
    have h2 (x : Grid M) : form L x = 2⁻¹ * form D x := form_smul _ _ _
    rw [funext h2,Ex_lmul] at hh1
    norm_num at hh1; linarith
  have hG' : (label U).Ex (form B) ≤ 100 :=
    S_energy q.invlen q.invlen_ge (loc_scale hq.2) U hBU
  change (label U).Ex (form U) ≤ _
  have h3 (x : Grid M) : form U x = form A x+form B x+form D x := by
    unfold U; rw [form_add,form_add]
  rw [funext h3,Ex_add,Ex_add]
  have hh1 := form_energy_mono hA hAU hA
  have hh2 := H.energy
  push_cast; linarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.tilde_le
statement:
lemma tilde_le {h : ℝ} (hh : 1 ≤ h) {A : Form M} (hA : 0 ≤ A) (p : Node) :
    A+place p M ≤ tilde h A p
proof:
:= by
  apply add_le_add _ (S_mono p.invlen_pos.le (by linarith [p.invlen_pos]))
  intro i; exact le_mul_of_one_le_left (hA i) (one_le_pow₀ hh)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.tilde_tight
statement:
lemma tilde_tight {n : ℕ} {A : Form M} {p q : Node} (H : Certified h err n p A)
    (hh : 1 ≤ h) (hq : q.ok M) :
    F (tilde h A q)-F (A + place q M) ≤ n*(err+1000*h)+2000
proof:
:= by
  let B := place q M
  let A' := h^130 • A
  let B' := S M (1000*q.invlen)
  have hA := H.nonneg
  have hB : 0 ≤ B := place_valid _ _
  have hA' : A ≤ A' := fun i => le_mul_of_one_le_left (hA i) (one_le_pow₀ hh)
  have hB' : B ≤ B' := S_mono q.invlen_pos.le (by linarith [q.invlen_pos])
  have hX := F_increment hA hA' hB
  have hY := F_increment hB hB' (hA.trans hA')
  have hc := q.invlen_ge
  have hc' := q.invlen_pos
  have hZ : F B'-F B ≤ 2000 := by
    have h1 := F_S_upper M (1000*q.invlen) (by linarith)
    have h2 := F_S_lower _ hc' (loc_scale hq.2)
    rw [log_mul (by norm_num) hc'.ne'] at h1
    unfold B B' place
    linarith [Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<1000)]
  have HH := H.tighten
  rw [add_comm B _,add_comm B' _] at hY
  change F A'-_ ≤ _ at HH
  change F (A'+B')-F (A+B) ≤ _
  linarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.space_increment
statement:
lemma space_increment {n : ℕ} {A : Form M} {p q' : Node} (H : Certified h err n p A)
    (h : q'.below p) (hq : q'.ok M) :
    F (A+place q' M)-F A ≤ log q'.invlen - log p.invlen + 3000
proof:
:= by
  let B := place q' M
  have hh := scale_below h
  have hn := q'.invlen_ge
  have hp := q'.invlen_pos
  have hz := p.invlen_pos
  rcases H.prev with ⟨he,h'⟩|he
  · rw [h',he,F_zero,zero_add,invlen_top,log_one]
    unfold place
    linarith [F_S_upper M _ hn]
  let r := p.invlen/20
  let s := arc M r
  have hr : 0 < r := by unfold r; positivity
  have hs : r ≤ s.card := arc_card_lo _ _ hr.le (by
    unfold r; linarith [loc_scale H.fits.2])
  have hB := place_valid q' M
  let L := (1/120:ℝ)
  have hl : 0 < L := by unfold L; norm_num
  have hx1 (i : Grid M) (hi : i ∈ s) :
      q A 0 * (L/q'.invlen) ≤ q A i * q B (-i) := by
    have hx := (mem_arc _ _).mp hi
    have h1 := cred_short _ p.invlen_ge (loc_scale H.fits.2) _ he i hx
    have h2 := q_short _ hn (loc_scale hq.2) i (by unfold r at hx; linarith)
    calc
      _ = (exp (-F A)*(1/2))*((1/60)/q'.invlen) := by rw [F_origin]; unfold L; ring
      _ ≤ (exp (-F A)*cred A i)* q B i :=
        mul_le_mul (by gcongr) h2 (by positivity) (mul_nonneg
          (Real.exp_nonneg _) (cred_nonneg H.nonneg _))
      _ = _ := by rw [← q_express, q_even _ _]
  have HX :
      q A 0 * ((p.invlen / q'.invlen) / 2400) ≤ q (A+B) 0 := by
    have ha := q_origin_pos A
    rw [q_add]; simp_rw [zero_sub]
    calc
      _ = r * (q A 0 * (L/q'.invlen)) := by unfold r L; ring
      _ ≤ ↑s.card*(q A 0 * (L/q'.invlen)) := by gcongr
      _ = _ := (show ∑ _i ∈ s, (q A 0 * (L/q'.invlen)) = _ by simp).symm
      _ ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, q A i * q B (-i) := Finset.sum_le_sum hx1
      _ ≤ ∑ i, q A i * q B (-i) :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (Finset.subset_univ _)
          (fun i _ _ => mul_nonneg (q_nonneg H.nonneg _) (q_nonneg hB _))
  have hhA := q_origin_pos A
  have Hl := log_le_log (by positivity) HX
  rw [log_mul (by positivity) (by positivity),log_div (by positivity) (by norm_num),
    log_div (by positivity) (by positivity)] at Hl
  change F (A+B)-_ ≤ _
  unfold F
  linarith [Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<2400)]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.H_ge
statement: lemma H_ge (j : ℕ) : 1 ≤ H j
proof: := by unfold H; exact_mod_cast slow_pos j

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.H_pos
statement: lemma H_pos (j : ℕ) : 0 < H j
proof: := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one (H_ge j)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.d_pos
statement: lemma d_pos (j : ℕ) : 0 < height j
proof: := by unfold height; positivity

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.beta_pos
statement: lemma beta_pos (i : ℕ) : 0 < beta i
proof: := by unfold beta; have := side_pos i; positivity

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.beta_le
statement: lemma beta_le (i : ℕ) : beta i ≤ 1
proof: := by unfold beta; nlinarith [side_le i, side_pos i]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.eps_pos
statement: lemma eps_pos : 0 < eps
proof: := by norm_num [eps]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.kappa_pos
statement: lemma kappa_pos (A0 : ℝ) (hA : 0 < A0) (j i : ℕ) : 0 < kappa j A0 i
proof:
:= by
  unfold kappa; have := H_pos j; have := d_pos j; positivity

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.beta_log
statement: lemma beta_log (i : ℕ) : -log (beta i) ≤ 100 + 2*i
proof:
:= by
  rw [beta,Real.log_div (by have := side_pos i; positivity) (by norm_num),
      side_pow_two,Real.log_pow,Real.log_inv,Real.log_pow]
  push_cast
  nlinarith [Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<2),
    Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<100),Nat.cast_nonneg (α:=ℝ) i]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.h_large
statement: lemma h_large (A : ℝ) : ∀ᶠ j : ℕ in atTop, A ≤ H j
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n,hn⟩ := exists_nat_gt A
  filter_upwards [slow_tendsto.eventually (eventually_ge_atTop n)] with j hj
  exact hn.le.trans (show (n:ℝ)≤ slow j from Nat.cast_le.mpr hj)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.hpow_index
statement: lemma hpow_index (A : ℝ) (n : ℕ) : ∀ᶠ j : ℕ in atTop, A*H j^n ≤ (j:ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [wide_le_j,eventually_pow_small_slow n A] with j hj h
  exact h.trans (by exact_mod_cast hj)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.hpoly
statement:
lemma hpoly (A : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    ∀ᶠ j : ℕ in atTop, A*H j^n ≤ height j
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [hpow_index A n, eventually_pow_small 1 1] with j hh h
  exact hh.trans (by simp only [pow_one,one_mul] at h; exact h)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.hpoly_mix
statement:
lemma hpoly_mix (A : ℝ) (n m : ℕ) :
    ∀ᶠ j : ℕ in atTop, A*H j^n*(j:ℝ)^m ≤ height j
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [hpow_index A n,eventually_pow_small (m+1) 1] with j hh h
  refine (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hh (by positivity : 0 ≤ (j:ℝ)^m)).trans ?_
  rwa [pow_succ,one_mul,mul_comm] at h

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.bottom_level
statement: lemma bottom_level (j : ℕ) : side (mainIx j) = 1/H j^16
proof:
:= by
  simp only [side_pow_two,H,slow,mainIx,Nat.cast_pow,Nat.cast_ofNat,← pow_mul,one_div,mul_comm 16]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.main_bounds
statement:
lemma main_bounds (j : ℕ) {i : ℕ} (hi : i ≤ testIx j) :
    ((1/6400)/H j^32 ≤ beta i) ∧ (i:ℝ) ≤ 19*H j ∧
      -log (beta i) ≤ 200*H j
proof:
:= by
  have hX : i ≤ 19*slow j := by
    have hx := ell_le_h j; have h' := slow_pos j
    unfold testIx mainIx at hi; omega
  have hx : (i:ℝ) ≤ 19*H j := by unfold H; exact_mod_cast hX
  have hn := H_ge j
  have hi : side (testIx j) ≤ side i :=
    pow_le_pow_of_le_one (by norm_num) (by norm_num) hi
  have he : side (testIx j) = side (mainIx j)/8 := by simp [side,testIx,pow_add]; ring
  refine ⟨?_,hx,by linarith [beta_log i]⟩
  unfold beta
  calc
    _ = side (testIx j)^2/100 := by rw [he,bottom_level]; unfold H; ring
    _ ≤ _ := by have := side_pos (testIx j); gcongr

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.sigma_small
statement:
lemma sigma_small :
    ∀ᶠ j : ℕ in atTop, ∀ i, i ≤ testIx j → 8*sig j ≤ side i^2
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [h_large 1000] with j hj i hi
  have hn := (main_bounds j hi).1
  unfold beta at hn
  change 8*(1/H j^40) ≤ _
  have he : 8*(1/H j^40) ≤ 100*((1/6400)/H j^32) := by
    have hh : H j ≤ H j ^ 8 := by
      have := pow_le_pow_right₀ (by linarith : 1 ≤ H j) (show 1 ≤ 8 by omega)
      simpa using this
    have hc : 512 ≤ H j ^ 8 := by linarith
    have := H_pos j
    rw [show H j^40=H j^8 * H j^32 by ring]
    apply (mul_le_mul_iff_left₀ (show 0 < H j^32 by positivity)).mp
    field_simp
    nlinarith
  linarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.Tk_bounds
statement:
lemma Tk_bounds :
    ∀ᶠ j : ℕ in atTop,
      (sLen j:ℝ)* H j ^6 = height j ∧ 0 < sLen j
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [t_expr] with j hj
  constructor
  · unfold H height; exact_mod_cast hj.1
  · exact pow_pos_nat _

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.kappa_scales
statement:
lemma kappa_scales (A0 : ℝ) (hA : 1 ≤ A0) :
    ∀ᶠ j : ℕ in atTop, ∀ i, i ≤ testIx j →
      height j/H j^2 ≤ eps*kappa j A0 i ∧ kappa j A0 i ≤ height j ∧
      A0 * height j / H j ≤ kappa j A0 i ∧ 100 ≤ kappa j A0 i
proof:
:= by

  filter_upwards [ell_tendsto.eventually (eventually_pow_small 1 (20*A0)),
    ell_tendsto.eventually (eventually_ge_atTop 1),h_large 10000,hpoly 100 2]
    with j he he' hj hh i hi
  let x := H j; let d := height j
  have hx : 10000 ≤ x := hj
  have hx' : 0 < x := H_pos j
  have hd : 0 < d := d_pos j
  have hk3 : A0 * height j / H j ≤ kappa j A0 i := by
    unfold kappa; have hp : 0 < A0*d/x := div_pos (mul_pos (by linarith) hd) hx'
    exact le_mul_of_one_le_right hp.le (le_add_of_nonneg_right (by positivity))
  refine ⟨le_trans ?_ (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hk3 eps_pos.le),?_,hk3, le_trans ?_ hk3⟩
  · change d/x^2 ≤ 1/10000*(A0*d/x)
    apply (div_le_iff₀ (sq_pos_of_pos hx')).mpr
    rw [show 1/10000*(A0*d/x)*x^2 = (A0*x/10000)*d by field_simp]
    have hi : 10000 ≤ A0*x := by nlinarith
    nlinarith
  · have hI : i+1 ≤ 20*ell j := by unfold testIx mainIx at hi; omega
    have hX : A0*(1+(i:ℝ)) ≤ x := by
      have hE : 20*A0*(ell j) ≤ x := by
        unfold x H slow; push_cast; simpa using he
      have hx2 : (i:ℝ)+1 ≤ 20*ell j := by exact_mod_cast hI
      nlinarith
    unfold kappa
    change A0*d/x*(1+i) ≤ d
    rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div]
    apply (div_le_iff₀ hx').mpr
    exact le_trans (le_of_eq (by ring : A0*d*((1:ℝ)+i)=d*(A0*(1+i))))
      ((mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hX hd.le).trans (le_of_eq rfl))
  · change 100 ≤ A0*d/x; apply (le_div_iff₀ hx').mpr
    change _ ≤ d at hh
    change 100*x^2 ≤ d at hh
    nlinarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.stiff_budget
statement:
lemma stiff_budget (C : ℝ) (hC : 1 ≤ C) :
    ∀ᶠ j : ℕ in atTop, C*H j*(plateErr j + 1000*H j)+2000 ≤ height j/H j^4
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [h_large (2*C),hpoly (10000*C) 6] with j h h'
  let d := height j; let a := H j
  have ha : 2*C ≤ a := h
  have Ha : 1 ≤ a := H_ge _
  have ha' : 0 < a := H_pos _
  have hd : 0 < d := d_pos _
  change 10000*C*a^6 ≤ d at h'
  change C*a*(d/a^400+1000*a)+2000 ≤ d/a^4
  apply (le_div_iff₀ (pow_pos ha' _)).mpr
  have he : a^6 ≤ a^400 := pow_le_pow_right₀ Ha (by omega)
  have he1 : C*a*(d/a^400)*a^4 ≤ d/2 := by
    calc
      _ ≤ (a/2)*a*(d/a^6)*a^4 := by gcongr; linarith
      _ = _ := by field_simp
  have he2 : C*a*(1000*a)*a^4+2000*a^4 ≤ d/2 := by
    rw [show C*a*(1000*a)*a^4=1000*C*a^6 by ring]
    have hg : a^4 ≤ C*a^6 := le_trans (pow_le_pow_right₀ Ha (by omega))
      (le_mul_of_one_le_left (by positivity) hC)
    linarith
  rw [mul_add,add_mul, add_mul]; linarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.reserve_ge
statement: lemma reserve_ge {C : ℝ} (h : 1 ≤ C) : 1 ≤ reserve C
proof: := by unfold reserve; linarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.code_ge
statement: lemma code_ge {C : ℝ} (h : 1 ≤ C) : 1 ≤ codeWeight C
proof: := by unfold codeWeight reserve; linarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.log_mesh
statement:
lemma log_mesh (j : ℕ) {p : Node} (hp : p.lev ≤ M) :
    log p.invlen - log ((2:ℝ)^(M-snapGrid j p M)) ≤ 1000*H j
proof:
:= by
  let E : ℝ := 2^(M-snapGrid j p M)
  have hx : p.invlen ≤ 64*H j^40 * E := (step_scale j hp).2.2.1
  have hH := H_pos j
  have he : 0 < E := by unfold E; positivity
  have ht := log_le_log p.invlen_pos hx
  rw [log_mul (by positivity) (by positivity), log_mul (by norm_num) (by positivity),log_pow] at ht
  change log p.invlen-log E ≤ _
  push_cast at ht
  linarith [H_ge j,Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos hH,log_le_sub_one_of_pos (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<64)]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.levelcost_scale
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [Tk_bounds,hpoly 20000 1,h_large 2000] with j ⟨he,hT⟩ h0 h1 i hi
  let h := H j; let d := height j
  have hl : -log (beta i) ≤ 200*h := (main_bounds _ hi).2.2
  have hp : 1 ≤ h := H_ge _
  have hi : 402*h ≤ h^6/2 := by
    have ht : h^2 ≤ h^6 := pow_le_pow_right₀ hp (by omega)
    change 2000 ≤ h at h1
    nlinarith
  change _ ≤ d
  have ht : 0 ≤ (sLen j:ℝ) := by positivity
  change (sLen j:ℝ)*h^6=d at he
  change _*h^1 ≤ d at h0; rw [pow_one] at h0
  nlinarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.span_scale
statement:
private lemma span_scale (C : ℝ) (hC : 1 ≤ C) :
    ∀ᶠ j : ℕ in atTop, ∀ B : ℝ, 0 ≤ B → ∀ i, i ≤ testIx j →
      B*(beta i^2/8) ≤ reserve C * height j →
      ∀ n : ℕ, n ≤ 2^(2*j) →
        B*log (2*n+1:ℝ) ≤ height j * (j:ℝ)^2
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop 2, hpow_index (10000000000*reserve C) 64]
    with j hj hh B hBp i hi hB n hn
  let h := H j; let d := height j; let b := beta i
  have he : (1/6400)/h^32 ≤ b := (main_bounds _ hi).1
  have hp : 0 < h := H_pos _
  have hd : 0 ≤ d := (d_pos j).le
  have hY : B ≤ reserve C*d*(400000000*h^64) := by
    have hX : B * (((1/6400)/h^32)^2/8) ≤ reserve C*d :=
      le_trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by gcongr) hBp) hB
    field_simp at hX
    have hv : h^32^2 = h^((32:ℕ)^2) := rfl
    nlinarith [show 0 ≤ reserve C*d*h^64 from mul_nonneg
      (mul_nonneg (by linarith [reserve_ge hC]) hd) (by positivity),show (h^32)^2=h^64 by ring]
  have hI : log (2*n+1:ℝ) ≤ 4*(j:ℝ) := by
    have h₁ : (1:ℝ) ≤ 2^(2*j) := one_le_pow₀ (by norm_num)
    have h₂ : (n:ℝ) ≤ 2^(2*j) := by exact_mod_cast hn
    apply le_trans (log_le_log (by positivity) (by linarith : (2*n+1:ℝ) ≤ 3*2^(2*j)))
    rw [Real.log_mul (by norm_num) (by positivity),Real.log_pow]
    have ht : 2 ≤ (j:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hj
    push_cast
    nlinarith [log_le_sub_one_of_pos (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<2),log_le_sub_one_of_pos (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<3)]
  change _ ≤ d*(j:ℝ)^2
  calc
    _ ≤ B*(4*(j:ℝ)) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hI hBp
    _ ≤ reserve C*d*(400000000*h^64)*(4*(j:ℝ)) := by gcongr
    _ = d*(1600000000*reserve C*h^64)*(j:ℝ) := by ring
    _ ≤ d*j*(j:ℝ) := by
      have h1 := reserve_ge hC
      have h3 : 1600000000*reserve C*h^64 ≤ (j:ℝ) :=
        (by calc
          _ ≤ (10000000000*reserve C)*h^64 := by gcongr; norm_num
          _ ≤ _ := hh)
      gcongr
    _ = _ := by ring

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.charge_small
proof:
:= by
  let D := reserve C; let a := codeWeight C; let d := height j; let h := H j
  let k := kappa j a i
  have hD : 1 ≤ D := reserve_ge hC
  have ha : 0 < a := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one (code_ge hC)
  have hd : 0 < d := d_pos _; have hh : 0 < h := H_pos _
  have hk' : 0 < k := kappa_pos _ ha _ _
  have hkp : a*d/h ≤ k := le_mul_of_one_le_right (by positivity)
    (le_add_of_nonneg_right (by positivity))
  change 4*(300000*D^2*d^2/h^2)/(eps*k) ≤ k/10
  apply (div_le_iff₀ (mul_pos eps_pos hk')).mpr
  calc
    _ ≤ (a*d/h)/10*(eps*(a*d/h)) := by
      change 4*(300000*D^2*d^2/h^2) ≤
        (100000000*D*d/h)/10*(eps*(100000000*D*d/h))
      unfold eps
      field_simp
      nlinarith [show 0 ≤ D^2*d^2 by positivity]
    _ ≤ _ := by have he := eps_pos; gcongr

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.obtain_compressed
statement:
lemma obtain_compressed (C : ℝ) (hC : 1 ≤ C) :
    ∀ᶠ j : ℕ in atTop, ∀ (M : ℕ) (A : Form M) (p : Node), p.lev < M → Press C j p A →
      ∀ (a : Grid M → ℝ), 0 ≤ a → (∀ x, a x ≤ exp (height j)) → exp (-height j) ≤ p.avg a →
      ∀ (P : Law (Grid M)) (α : ℝ), PieceLaw p a P → 0 < α → p.avg a ≤ 2*α →
      ∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ testIx j →
        request A j p a α (side i) (kappa j (codeWeight C) i) →
        let l
proof:
:= snapGrid j p M
        let hl := snap_le (M:=M) j p
        let A' := tilde (H j) A p
        let k := kappa j (codeWeight C) i
        ∃ (w : Finset (Grid l)) (x : Grid l) (B : Bool)
          (v : Grid l → Grid M → ℂ) (V : Law (Grid l)) (t : ℝ),
          eps*k ≤ t ∧ t ≤ reserve C * height j ∧ w.Nonempty ∧ supported w V ∧
          separated (raise hl) A (sepRad j) (sig j*p.invlen/2) w ∧
          biases P p A hl w B v (beta i) ∧
          4*k/5 ≤ log (w.card:ℝ) ∧
          F (A' + long j • averageCost hl V x)- F A' ≤ 350*t ∧
          ((t=eps*k ∧ evenly w V) ∨ t/4 ≤ levelCost hl A' V (sLen j)) := by
  filter_upwards [sigma_small, span_scale C hC,stiff_budget C hC,hpoly 5000 1,levelcost_scale,
    kappa_scales (codeWeight C) (code_ge hC),spectral_compression (reserve C) (reserve_ge hC)]
    with j hs hsp hh hz hL hkl hcp
  intro M A p hp hP a ha hA hm P α hPA hα hm' i hi hreq l hl A' k
  let c := eps*k; let d := height j; let h := H j; let D := reserve C
  have hq := hP.fits
  obtain ⟨n,p',ht,HG,hN,hF⟩ := hP.cap
  obtain ⟨s,B,v,hs0,hs1,hs2,hB⟩ := extract_spectrum j hq.1 hp ha hα hPA
    (lt_of_lt_of_le (exp_pos _) hm) hm' (hs i hi) hreq
  have hM := step_scale j hq.2
  have hyp : A + place p M ≤ A' := tilde_le (H_ge j) HG.nonneg p
  have ht' : place p M ≤ A' := (le_add_of_nonneg_left HG.nonneg).trans hyp
  have hA' : 0 ≤ A' := (place_valid _ _).trans ht'
  have hD0 : 1 ≤ D := reserve_ge hC
  have hh' : 1 ≤ h := H_ge _
  have ha0 : 5000*h ≤ d := by simpa only [pow_one] using hz
  have hd : 0 < d := d_pos j
  have hu : F A - log p'.invlen ≤ C*d := by unfold d; linarith
  have hR := log_mesh j hq.2
  obtain ⟨hk0,hk1,hk2,hk3⟩ := hkl i hi
  have heps := eps_pos
  have hC' : 0 < c := by unfold c k; exact mul_pos eps_pos (kappa_pos _ (lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one (code_ge hC)) _ _)
  have hY :
      -log (fq hl A' hA' 0) ≤ D*d := by
    obtain ⟨_,_,_,_,_,HE⟩ := fq_spec hl A' hA' hM.2.1 ht'
    apply HE.trans
    have hbr : F A'-F (A+place p M) ≤ d := by
      apply le_trans (tilde_tight HG (H_ge j) hq)
      apply le_trans (b:=C*h*(plateErr j + 1000*h)+2000) _ (le_trans hh ?_)
      · have he : 0 ≤ plateErr j :=
          div_nonneg hd.le (pow_nonneg (by linarith : 0 ≤ h) _)
        change (n:ℝ) * (plateErr j+1000*h)+_ ≤ _
        have hx : 0 ≤ plateErr j+1000*h := by linarith
        gcongr
      · exact div_le_self hd.le (one_le_pow₀ hh')
    have Hx := space_increment HG ht hq
    change log p.invlen-log (2^(M-l):ℝ) ≤ 1000*h at hR
    change _ ≤ _+C*d at hF
    unfold D reserve; linarith
  have hList (u : Finset (Grid l)) (hU : u⊆s) (m : ℕ) (he : m ≤ 2^(2*j)) :
      Compress.lnS (Fin m) (fun x : u => (x:Grid l)) ≤ height j * (j:ℝ)^2 := by
    obtain ⟨t,h1,h2⟩ := cheap_span hq ht HG hPA hl hM.1 hA hm
      (beta_pos i).le (beta_le i) hB
    apply le_trans (sumset_est (s:=u) (t:=t) (fun x hx => h1 _ (hU hx)) _)
    refine hsp _ (by positivity) i hi ?_ m he
    apply h2.trans
    change log p.invlen-log (2^(M-l):ℝ) ≤ 1000*h at hR
    unfold d h at *; unfold reserve; linarith
  have hCost (V : Law (Grid l)) (hw : supported s V) :
      levelCost hl A' V (sLen j) ≤ D*d := by
    have Hx := uniform_level_cost hq ht HG hyp hPA hl hA hm (beta_pos i) (beta_le i)
      hB V hw (sLen j) (pow_pos_nat _)
    unfold D reserve; unfold d at *; linarith [hL i hi]
  have hmem :
      c ≤ D*d := by
    calc
      _ ≤ eps*d := by
          unfold c k
          gcongr
      _ ≤ _ := by gcongr; unfold eps; linarith
  have hZ : 0 ≤ shrinkScale D j := by unfold shrinkScale; positivity
  obtain ⟨x,w,V,t,h1,h2,h3,h4,h5,h6,h7,h8,h9⟩ :=
    choose_compression hC' hZ hmem
      (fun u hu hv t hx hy hQ => hcp M l hl A' p.invlen hA' hM.2.1 ht' hY u hv
        (hList u hu) t (hk0.trans hx) hy hQ) hs0 hCost
  refine ⟨w,x,B,v,V,t,h1,h2,h5,h6,?_,?_,?_,h8,h9⟩
  · intro x hx y hy; exact hs2 x (h4 hx) y (h4 hy)
  · exact ⟨hB.1, fun x hx => hB.2 x (h4 hx)⟩
  have ht := h7.trans (charge_small hC)
  change k-log 2 ≤ _ at hs1
  change _ ≤ k/10 at ht
  change 100 ≤ k at hk3
  linarith [log_le_sub_one_of_pos (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<2)]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.K_add
statement:
lemma K_add (A D : Form M) (u : Grid M) :
    K (A+D) u = exp (F (A+D)-F A) * (K A u * boltz D u)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [K_eq, boltz, form_add,← exp_add]
  congr 1; ring

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.ex_tilt
statement:
lemma ex_tilt (A D : Form M) (f : Grid M → ℝ) :
    (label (A+D)).Ex f =
      exp (F (A+D)-F A) * (label A).Ex (fun y => boltz D y * f y)
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [label_ex,K_add, expU_ex,mul_assoc,Ex_lmul]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.ex_untilt
statement:
lemma ex_untilt (A D : Form M) (f : Grid M → ℝ) :
    exp (F A-F (A+D)) * (label (A+D)).Ex f = (label A).Ex (fun y => boltz D y * f y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [ex_tilt,← mul_assoc,← exp_add,sub_add_sub_cancel,sub_self,exp_zero,one_mul]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.boltz_mean
statement:
lemma boltz_mean (A D : Form M) :
    (label A).Ex (boltz D) = exp (F A - F (A+D))
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [Ex_const,mul_one] using (ex_untilt A D fun _ => 1).symm

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.cred_add_mono
statement:
lemma cred_add_mono {A D : Form M} (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hD : 0 ≤ D) (s : Grid M) :
    cred A s ≤ cred (A+D) s
proof:
:= by
  apply le_of_mul_le_mul_left _ (exp_pos (F A-F (A+D)))
  rw [cred_ex (A+D) s,ex_untilt,← boltz_mean]
  have he (x : Grid M) : boltz D x = ∑ t, q D t * wave t x := (boltz_series _ _).symm
  have hf : boltz D = fun x => ∑ t, q D t * wave t x := funext he
  simp_rw [hf,Finset.sum_mul,mul_assoc, Ex_finset_sum,Ex_lmul]
  rw [Finset.sum_mul]
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum; intro x _
  rw [mul_assoc,← cred_ex A x]
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (ginibre hA _ _) (q_nonneg hD _)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.cred_mono
statement:
lemma cred_mono {A B : Form M} (hA : 0 ≤ A) (h : A ≤ B) (s : Grid M) :
    cred A s ≤ cred B s
proof:
:= by
  have he : B = A+(B-A) := by abel
  simpa only [← he] using cred_add_mono hA (sub_nonneg.mpr h) s

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.F_increment
statement:
lemma F_increment {A B D : Form M} (hA : 0 ≤ A) (h : A ≤ B) (hD : 0 ≤ D) :
    F (B+D)-F B ≤ F (A+D)-F A
proof:
:= by
  suffices HH : F A-F (A+D) ≤ F B-F (B+D) by linarith
  apply Real.exp_le_exp.mp
  rw [← boltz_mean,← boltz_mean]
  rw [show boltz D = fun x => ∑ t, q D t * wave t x from funext fun x => (boltz_series _ _).symm]
  simp_rw [Ex_finset_sum,Ex_lmul,← cred_ex]
  exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ =>
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (cred_mono hA h i) (q_nonneg hD _)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.mean_energy
statement:
lemma mean_energy (A D : Form M) :
    (label (A+D)).Ex (form D) ≤ F (A+D)-F A
proof:
:= by
  apply Real.exp_le_exp.mp
  apply le_trans ((label (A+D)).Ex_exp (form D))
  rw [ex_tilt]
  have H (x : Grid M) : boltz D x * exp (form D x) = 1 := by simp [boltz, ← exp_add]
  simp_rw [H,Ex_const,mul_one]; exact le_rfl

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.cred_cost
statement: lemma cred_cost (A : Form M) (s : Grid M) : (label A).Ex (cost s) = 1 - cred A s
proof:
:= by
  unfold cost
  simp_rw [Ex_sub,Ex_const,cred_ex]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.form_energy_mono
statement:
lemma form_energy_mono {A B D : Form M} (hA : 0 ≤ A) (h : A ≤ B) (hD : 0 ≤ D) :
    (label B).Ex (form D) ≤ (label A).Ex (form D)
proof:
:= by
  unfold form; simp_rw [Ex_finset_sum,Ex_lmul,cred_cost]
  refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ (hD i)
  rw [sub_le_sub_iff_left]
  exact cred_mono hA h i

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.q_express
statement: lemma q_express (A : Form M) (x : Grid M) : q A x = exp (-F A) * cred A x
proof:
:= by
  rw [cred,F_origin,mul_comm,div_mul_cancel₀]
  exact (q_origin_pos _).ne'

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.q_compare
statement:
lemma q_compare {A P B : Form M} (hA : 0 ≤ A) (h : A ≤ P) (hh : P ≤ B) (s : Grid M) :
    q P s ≤ exp (-F A) * cred B s
proof:
:= by
  rw [q_express]
  exact mul_le_mul (exp_monotone (neg_le_neg (F_mono h))) (cred_mono (hA.trans h) hh s)
    (cred_nonneg (hA.trans h) s) (exp_nonneg _)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.delta_sq
statement: lemma delta_sq (A : Form M) (s : Grid M) : delta A s ^ 2 = 2*(1-cred A s)
proof:
:= by
  unfold delta
  rw [sq_sqrt ((label A).Ex_nonneg (fun i => sq_nonneg _))]
  simp_rw [norm_phase_sq,Ex_lmul,cred_cost]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.delta_zero
statement: lemma delta_zero (A : Form M) : delta A 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [delta,chi_zero_left]
  simp [Ex_const]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.delta_even
statement: lemma delta_even (A : Form M) : (delta A).Even
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  have H := delta_sq A x
  have H' := delta_sq A (-x)
  simp_rw [cred,q_even _ _] at H H'
  exact pow_left_inj₀ (sqrt_nonneg _) (sqrt_nonneg _) (by norm_num : 2≠0) |>.mp (H'.trans H.symm)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.delta_mono
statement:
lemma delta_mono {A B : Form M} (hA : 0 ≤ A) (h : A ≤ B) (s : Grid M) :
    delta B s ≤ delta A s
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := delta_sq A s
  have h2 := delta_sq B s
  nlinarith [cred_mono hA h s,(show 0 ≤ delta A s from sqrt_nonneg _)]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.delta_triangle
statement:
lemma delta_triangle (A : Form M) (s t : Grid M) :
    delta A (s+t) ≤ delta A s + delta A t
proof:
:= by
  let f (s i : Grid M) : ℝ := ‖1-chi s i‖
  refine le_trans ?_ <| quadratic_minkowski (label A) (f s) (f t)
  apply Real.sqrt_le_sqrt ((label A).Ex_mono fun i => ?_)
  apply pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) _ 2
  dsimp only [f]; rw [chi_comm,chi_comm s _,chi_comm t _]
  exact norm_phase_add _ _ _

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.delta_nsmul
statement:
lemma delta_nsmul (A : Form M) (s : Grid M) (k : ℕ) :
    delta A (k•s) ≤ k * delta A s
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp [delta_zero]
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [add_smul,one_smul]
    exact le_trans (delta_triangle _ _ _) (by push_cast; linarith)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.delta_int
statement:
lemma delta_int (A : Form M) (k : ℤ) :
    delta A (k:Grid M) ≤ |(k:ℝ)| * delta A 1
proof:
:= by
  cases k with
  | ofNat k =>
    simpa [abs_of_nonneg] using delta_nsmul A 1 k
  | negSucc k =>
    have H := delta_even A ((k+1:ℕ):Grid M)
    rw [show ((Int.negSucc k:ℤ):Grid M) = -((k+1:ℕ):Grid M) by simp,H]
    convert delta_nsmul A 1 (k+1) using 1 <;> simp
    left; rw [abs_of_nonpos (by have H := Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) k; linarith)]; ring

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.ball_pos
statement: lemma ball_pos (A : Form M) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r) : (0:ℝ) < (ball A r).card
proof:
:= by
  exact_mod_cast Finset.card_pos.mpr ⟨0,(mem_ball A r 0).mpr (by rw [delta_zero]; exact hr)⟩

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.gap_zero
statement:
lemma gap_zero {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hr' : r ≤ 1) :
    gap (0:Form M) r = 0
proof:
:= by
  have H : ball (0:Form M) r = {0} := by
    ext x; simp only [mem_ball,Finset.mem_singleton]
    constructor
    · intro hx
      by_contra hh
      have HE := delta_sq (0:Form M) x
      have HQ : q (0:Form M) x = 0 := by
        unfold q fc
        simp_rw [boltz,form_zero,neg_zero,exp_zero,Complex.ofReal_one,one_mul,expU_chi]
        simp [hh]
      rw [cred,HQ,zero_div] at HE
      have h1 : 0 ≤ delta (0:Form M) x := sqrt_nonneg _
      nlinarith
    · rintro rfl; rw [delta_zero]; exact hr
  simp [gap,F_zero,H]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.half_q_ball
statement:
lemma half_q_ball (A : Form M) (x : Grid M) (h : delta A x ≤ 1) :
    q A 0 /2 ≤ q A x
proof:
:= by
  have hi : (1/2:ℝ) ≤ cred A x := by
    have hx : 0 ≤ delta A x := sqrt_nonneg _
    nlinarith [delta_sq A x]
  nth_rw 2 [q_express]
  rw [F_origin]
  nlinarith [q_origin_pos A]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.gap_lower
statement:
lemma gap_lower {A : Form M} (hA : 0 ≤ A) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hr' : r ≤ 1) :
    -2 ≤ gap A r
proof:
:= by
  let s := ball A r
  have hi : s.card * q A 0 /2 ≤ 1 := calc
    _ = ∑ _u∈s, q A 0 /2 := by simp; ring
    _ ≤ ∑ u∈s, q A u := Finset.sum_le_sum fun i hi => half_q_ball A i (((mem_ball _ _ _).mp hi).trans hr')
    _ ≤ ∑ u : Grid M, q A u := Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg
      (Finset.subset_univ _) (fun _ _ _ => q_nonneg hA _)
    _ = 1 := q_total _
  have hp : 0 < (s.card:ℝ) := ball_pos _ hr
  have hh := Real.log_le_log (mul_pos hp (q_origin_pos A)) (y:=2) (by linarith)
  rw [log_mul hp.ne' (q_origin_pos A).ne'] at hh
  change -2 ≤ -log (q A 0)-log (s.card:ℝ)
  linarith [log_le_sub_one_of_pos (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<2)]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.overlap_bound
statement:
private lemma overlap_bound (U D : Finset (Grid M)) :
    U.card*D.card ≤ (U+D).card*((U-U)∩(D-D)).card
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let V := U ×ˢ D
  let f : Grid M × Grid M → Grid M := fun v => v.1+v.2
  have hV : MapsTo f V (↑(U+D):Set (Grid M)) := fun i hi =>
    Finset.add_mem_add (Finset.mem_product.mp hi).1 (Finset.mem_product.mp hi).2
  let L := (U-U)∩(D-D)
  have hi (i : Grid M) (hh : i ∈ U+D) : (V.filter fun v => f v=i).card ≤ L.card := by
    obtain ⟨x,hx,y,hy,rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_add.mp hh
    let g : Grid M × Grid M → Grid M := fun i => i.1-x
    apply Finset.card_le_card_of_injOn g
    · rintro ⟨t,v⟩ ht
      obtain ⟨hh,h⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp ht
      obtain ⟨hh1,hh2⟩ := Finset.mem_product.mp hh
      change t+v=x+y at h
      have he : t-x=y-v := by linear_combination h
      exact Finset.mem_inter.mpr ⟨Finset.sub_mem_sub hh1 hx,by dsimp [g]; rw [he]; exact Finset.sub_mem_sub hy hh2⟩
    · rintro ⟨t,v⟩ ht ⟨b,c⟩ hs H
      have H1 := (Finset.mem_filter.mp ht).2
      have H2 := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hs).2
      change t-x=b-x at H
      dsimp only [f] at H1 H2
      have hh : t=b := sub_left_inj.mp H
      have he : v=c := add_left_cancel (hh ▸ H1.trans H2.symm)
      rw [hh,he]
  rw [← Finset.card_product]
  change V.card ≤ _
  calc
    _ = ∑ i ∈ U+D, (V.filter (fun v => f v=i)).card := Finset.card_eq_sum_card_fiberwise hV
    _ ≤ ∑ _i∈U+D, L.card := Finset.sum_le_sum hi
    _ = _ := by simp [L]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.delta_diff
statement:
lemma delta_diff {A : Form M} {r : ℝ} {x y : Grid M} (hx : x∈ball A r)
    (hy : y∈ball A r) : delta A (x-y) ≤ 2*r
proof:
:= by
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg]; apply le_trans (delta_triangle _ _ _)
  rw [delta_even _ y]
  linarith [(mem_ball _ _ _).mp hx,(mem_ball _ _ _).mp hy]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.rad_diff
statement:
lemma rad_diff {r : ℝ} {x y : Grid M} (hx : x∈arc M r) (hy : y∈arc M r) :
    rad (x-y) ≤ 2*r
proof:
:= by
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg]; apply le_trans (rad_add _ _)
  rw [rad_even]
  linarith [(mem_arc _ _).mp hx,(mem_arc _ _).mp hy]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.log_pair
proof:
:= ball A r
    let D := arc M (σ*p.invlen/10)
    F (A+place p M)-F A + log (U.card:ℝ) ≤ log ((U+D).card:ℝ) + 130 - log σ := by
  intro U D
  let R := p.invlen; let d := σ*R/10
  let B := place p M
  let L := (U-U)∩(D-D)
  have hR : 0 < R := p.invlen_pos
  have hd : 0 < d := by unfold d; positivity
  have hDD : d ≤ ↑D.card := by
    have HE := loc_scale hp.2
    change R ≤ _ at HE
    apply arc_card_lo M _ hd.le
    unfold d; nlinarith
  have h₁ : (0:ℝ)< U.card := ball_pos _ hr
  have h₂ : (0:ℝ)< D.card := hd.trans_le hDD
  have hU : 0∈U := (mem_ball _ _ _).mpr (by rw [delta_zero]; exact hr)
  have hD : 0∈D := by
    apply (mem_arc _ _).mpr
    simpa only [rad, ZMod.val_zero,neg_zero,min_self,Nat.cast_zero] using hd.le
  have hL : (0:Grid M)∈L :=
    Finset.mem_inter.mpr ⟨by simpa using Finset.sub_mem_sub hU hU,
      by simpa using Finset.sub_mem_sub hD hD⟩
  have h₃ : (0:ℝ) < L.card := by exact_mod_cast Finset.card_pos.mpr ⟨0,hL⟩
  have h₄ : (0:ℝ) < (U+D).card := by
    exact_mod_cast Finset.card_pos.mpr ⟨_,Finset.add_mem_add hU hD⟩
  have hi (x : Grid M) (hi : x∈L) :
      q A 0 * ((1/120)/R) ≤ q A x * q B (-x) := by
    obtain ⟨hx,hy⟩ := Finset.mem_inter.mp hi
    have h1 : delta A x ≤ 1 := by
      obtain ⟨u,hu,v,hv,rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_sub.mp hx
      exact (delta_diff hu hv).trans hr'
    have h2 : rad x ≤ R/20 := by
      obtain ⟨u,hu,v,hv,rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_sub.mp hy
      have hh : rad (u-v) ≤ 2*d := rad_diff hu hv
      unfold d at hh; nlinarith
    calc
      _ = q A 0 /2 * ((1/60:ℝ)/R) := by ring
      _ ≤ q A x * q B x := mul_le_mul (half_q_ball _ _ h1)
        (q_short R p.invlen_ge (loc_scale hp.2) x h2)
        (by positivity) (q_nonneg hA _)
