      _ = _ := by rw [q_even _ _]
  have H : L.card * (q A 0 * ((1/120:ℝ)/R)) ≤ q (A+B) 0 := calc
    _ = ∑ i∈L, q A 0*((1/120:ℝ)/R) := by simp
    _ ≤ ∑ i∈L, q A i*q B (-i) := Finset.sum_le_sum hi
    _ ≤ ∑ i, q A i*q B (-i) := Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg
        (Finset.subset_univ _) (fun _ _ _ => mul_nonneg (q_nonneg hA _) (q_nonneg (place_valid _ _) _))
    _ = _ := by simp_rw [q_add,zero_sub]
  have HH : (U.card:ℝ)*D.card ≤ (U+D).card*(L.card:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast overlap_bound U D
  have H₁ := log_le_log (mul_pos h₁ h₂) HH
  have H₂ := log_le_log (show 0 < (L.card:ℝ)*(q A 0*((1/120:ℝ)/R)) by
    have := q_origin_pos A; positivity) H
  have H₃ := log_le_log hd hDD
  rw [Real.log_mul h₁.ne' h₂.ne',Real.log_mul h₄.ne' h₃.ne'] at H₁
  rw [Real.log_mul h₃.ne' (by have := q_origin_pos A; positivity),
    Real.log_mul (q_origin_pos _).ne' (by positivity), Real.log_div (by norm_num) hR.ne',
    Real.log_div (by norm_num) (by norm_num), Real.log_one] at H₂
  unfold d at H₃
  rw [Real.log_div (by positivity) (by norm_num),Real.log_mul hs.ne' hR.ne'] at H₃
  unfold F; change -log (q (A+B) 0) - _ + _ ≤ _
  linarith [log_le_sub_one_of_pos (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<120),
    log_le_sub_one_of_pos (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<10)]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.gap_packing
statement:
lemma gap_packing {p : Node} (hp : p.ok M) {r σ η : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hr' : 2*r ≤ 1)
    (hs : 0 < σ) (hs' : σ ≤ 1/4) (he : 4*σ ≤ η) {A C : Form M} (hA : 0 ≤ A)
    (hC : A+place p M ≤ C) (f : Grid l → Grid M) (s : Finset (Grid l)) (hn : s.Nonempty)
    (h : separated f A (2*r) (σ*p.invlen/2) s)
    (hc : ∀ x∈s, delta C (f x) ≤ η/2) :
    gap C (r+η) - gap A r ≤ F C - F (A+place p M) + 130 - log σ - log (s.card:ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  let U := ball A r; let R := p.invlen; let d := σ*R/10; let D := arc M d
  have he' : 0 < η := by linarith
  let W := U+D
  have hR : 0 < R := p.invlen_pos
  have hD : 0 ∈ D := by
    apply (mem_arc _ _).mpr
    simp [rad]
    unfold d; positivity
  have hU : 0∈U := (mem_ball _ _ _).mpr (by rw [delta_zero]; exact hr)
  have hW : 0 ∈ W := by simpa using Finset.add_mem_add hU hD
  have hB := ball_pos C (show 0 ≤ r+η by linarith)
  have hsW : 0 < (W.card:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast Finset.card_pos.mpr ⟨_,hW⟩
  have hC1 : place p M ≤ C := (le_add_of_nonneg_left hA).trans hC
  have hC2 : A ≤ C := (le_add_of_nonneg_right (place_valid _ _)).trans hC
  let F' : Grid l × Grid M → Grid M := fun i => f i.1+i.2
  have ha : s.card*W.card ≤ (ball C (r+η)).card := by
    rw [← Finset.card_product]
    apply Finset.card_le_card_of_injOn F'
    · rintro ⟨i,j⟩ hi
      obtain ⟨hi,hj⟩ := Finset.mem_product.mp hi
      obtain ⟨u,hu,v,hv,rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_add.mp hj
      apply (mem_ball _ _ _).mpr
      have h1 := hc i hi
      have hV : delta C u ≤ r := (delta_mono hA hC2 _).trans ((mem_ball _ _ _).mp hu)
      have hV' : delta C v ≤ η/2 := by
        have ht := delta_S R p.invlen_ge (loc_scale hp.2) _ hC1 v
        have hQ := (mem_arc _ _).mp hv
        exact ht.trans (by
          calc
            _ ≤ d * (20/R) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hQ (by positivity)
            _ = 2*σ := by unfold d; field_simp; ring
            _ ≤ _ := by linarith)
      change delta C (f i + (u+v)) ≤ _
      linarith [delta_triangle C u v,delta_triangle C (f i) (u+v)]
    · rintro ⟨i,j⟩ hi ⟨x,y⟩ hj HH
      obtain ⟨hi,hv⟩ := Finset.mem_product.mp hi
      obtain ⟨hx,hy⟩ := Finset.mem_product.mp hj
      change f i + j=f x+y at HH
      have Hx : i=x := by
        by_contra hh
        apply h i hi x hx hh
        obtain ⟨u,hu,t,ht,rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_add.mp hv
        obtain ⟨v,hv,q,hq,rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_add.mp hy
        refine ⟨v-u,delta_diff hv hu,?_⟩
        rw [show f i-f x-(v-u)=q-t by linear_combination HH]
        change _ ≤ σ*R/2
        have hE : rad (q-t) ≤ 2*d := rad_diff hq ht
        unfold d at hE; nlinarith
      subst x; rw [add_right_inj] at HH
      simp [HH]
  have h1 : (s.card:ℝ)*W.card ≤ (ball C (r+η)).card := by exact_mod_cast ha
  have hV : (0:ℝ) < s.card := by exact_mod_cast Finset.card_pos.mpr hn
  have H := log_le_log (mul_pos hV hsW) h1
  rw [log_mul hV.ne' hsW.ne'] at H
  have H' := log_pair hp hr hr' hs hs' hA
  change _ + log (U.card:ℝ) ≤ log (W.card:ℝ)+130-_ at H'
  unfold gap; change F C-_-(F A-log (U.card:ℝ)) ≤ _
  linarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Node.child_ok
statement:
lemma child_ok (p : Node) (h : p.valid) (hv : p.lev < M) (b) :
    ok (p.child b) M
proof: := by cases b <;> exact ⟨by first | exact p.valid_L.mpr h | exact p.valid_R.mpr h,hv⟩

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Node.child_len
statement: lemma child_len (p : Node) (b : Bool) : (p.child b).len=p.len/2
proof:
:= by
  cases b; exact p.len_L; exact p.len_R

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Node.child_below
statement: lemma child_below (p : Node) (b : Bool) : (p.child b).below p
proof:
:= by
  cases b; exact p.below_left; exact p.below_right

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.channel_apply
statement:
lemma channel_apply (A : Form M) (x z : Grid M) :
    channel A x z = label A (z-x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [channel,send_apply,prob_eq]
  simp_rw [add_comm x, ← eq_sub_iff_add_eq]
  simp

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.ch_K
statement:
lemma ch_K (A : Form M) (x z : Grid M) :
    channel A x z = side M * K A (z-x)
proof: := by rw [channel_apply,label_apply]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.ch_pos
statement: lemma ch_pos (A : Form M) (x z : Grid M) : 0 < channel A x z
proof: := by rw [channel_apply]; exact label_pos _ _

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.ch_ex
statement:
lemma ch_ex (A : Form M) (f : Grid M → ℝ) (x : Grid M) :
    (channel A x).Ex f = (label A).Ex fun z => f (x+z)
proof: := Ex_send _ _ _

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.ch_noise
statement:
lemma ch_noise (A : Form M) (f : Grid M → ℝ) (x : Grid M) :
    (channel A x).Ex (fun z => f (z-x)) = (label A).Ex f
proof:
:= by
  rw [ch_ex]; simp

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.wt_nonneg
statement:
lemma wt_nonneg (p : Node) {a : Grid M → ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) {α : ℝ} (hα : 0 ≤ α) (y) :
    0 ≤ wt p a α y
proof: := div_nonneg (mul_nonneg ((p.dice M).nonneg y) (ha y)) hα

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.wt_total
statement:
lemma wt_total (p : Node) (hp : p.ok M) (a : Grid M → ℝ) (α : ℝ) :
    ∑ y, wt p a α y = p.avg a / α
proof: := by simp_rw [wt, ← Finset.sum_div, avg_ex hp,Ex]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.make_piece
statement:
lemma make_piece (p : Node) (hp : p.ok M) {a : Grid M → ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hm : 0 < p.avg a) :
    ∃ P : Law (Grid M), PieceLaw p a P
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨⟨wt p a (p.avg a),wt_nonneg p ha hm.le,by rw [wt_total _ hp,div_self hm.ne']⟩,fun i => rfl⟩

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.piece_support
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hh; rw [h,wt,dice_apply hp,ite_eq_right hh,zero_mul,zero_div] at hx
  exact lt_irrefl _ hx

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.piece_density
statement:
lemma piece_density {p : Node} {a : Grid M → ℝ} {P : Law (Grid M)}
    (h : PieceLaw p a P) {d : ℝ} (h1 : ∀ x, a x ≤ exp d)
    (hm : exp (-d) ≤ p.avg a) (x : Grid M) :
    P x ≤ exp (2*d)*p.dice M x
proof:
:= by
  rw [h,wt]
  apply (div_le_iff₀ (lt_of_lt_of_le (exp_pos _) hm)).mpr
  have HE : exp (2*d)*exp (-d) = exp d := by rw [← exp_add]; congr; ring
  calc
    _ ≤ p.dice M x * exp d := by
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (h1 _) ((p.dice M).nonneg _)
    _ = exp (2*d)*p.dice M x * exp (-d) := by rw [mul_comm _ (p.dice _ _),mul_assoc,HE]
    _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hm (mul_nonneg (exp_nonneg _) ((p.dice M).nonneg _))

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.wt_half
statement:
lemma wt_half {p : Node} (h : p.valid) (hp : p.lev < M) (a : Grid M → ℝ) (α : ℝ)
    (x : Grid M) (b : Bool) :
    wt (p.child b) a α x = if x ∈ (p.child b).block M then 2*wt p a α x else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [wt,dice_apply (child_ok p h hp b)]
  split_ifs with hh
  · rw [wt,dice_apply ⟨h,hp.le⟩,ite_eq_left (block_of_below (child_below _ _) _ hh),child_len]
    field_simp
  simp

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.density_nonneg
statement:
lemma density_nonneg (p : Node) {a : Grid M → ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) {α : ℝ} (hα : 0 ≤ α)
    (A : Form M) (y z : Grid M) : 0 ≤ omegaObs p a α A y z
proof:
:=
  mul_nonneg (wt_nonneg p ha hα _) ((channel A y).nonneg z)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.mass_nonneg
statement:
lemma mass_nonneg (p : Node) {a : Grid M → ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) {α : ℝ} (hα : 0 ≤ α)
    (A : Form M) (z : Grid M) : 0 ≤ Mz p a α A z
proof:
:=
  Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ => density_nonneg _ ha hα _ _ _

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.mass_total
statement:
lemma mass_total (p : Node) (hp : p.ok M) (a : Grid M → ℝ) (α : ℝ)
    (A : Form M) : ∑ z, Mz p a α A z = p.avg a / α
proof:
:= by
  unfold Mz; rw [Finset.sum_comm]; simp_rw [omegaObs,← Finset.mul_sum,Law.total,mul_one]
  rw [wt_total _ hp]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.fz_norm
statement:
lemma fz_norm (p : Node) {a : Grid M → ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) {α : ℝ} (hα : 0 ≤ α)
    (A : Form M) (u z : Grid M) : ‖fz p a α A u z‖ ≤ Mz p a α A z
proof:
:= by
  apply le_trans (norm_sum_le _ _)
  simp_rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_real,norm_chi,mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs,
    abs_of_nonneg (density_nonneg _ ha hα _ _ _)]
  exact le_rfl

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.energyZ_le
statement:
lemma energyZ_le (p : Node) {a : Grid M → ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) {α : ℝ} (hα : 0 ≤ α)
    (A : Form M) (u : Grid M) : energyZ p a α A u ≤ ∑ z, ‖fz p a α A u z‖
proof:
:= by
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum; intro z _
  have hi := fz_norm p ha hα A u z
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le (mass_nonneg _ ha hα _ z) with H | H
  · rw [← H,div_zero]; exact norm_nonneg _
  · refine (div_le_iff₀ H).mpr ?_
    nlinarith [norm_nonneg (fz p a α A u z)]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.polar_identity
statement: lemma polar_identity (z : ℂ) : (polar z * z).re = ‖z‖
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hz : z=0
  · subst z; simp
  · unfold polar
    rw [mul_assoc,mul_comm (conj z),Complex.mul_conj,← Complex.sq_norm,← Complex.ofReal_mul,
       Complex.ofReal_re]
    have hN : ‖z‖≠0 := norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr hz
    field_simp

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.polar_unit
statement: lemma polar_unit (z : ℂ) : ‖polar z‖ ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hz : z=0
  · subst z; simp [polar]
  rw [polar,norm_mul,Complex.norm_real,Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_nonneg (by positivity),
    Complex.norm_conj, inv_mul_cancel₀ (norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr hz)]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.piece_child_bias
statement:
lemma piece_child_bias {p : Node} (hp : p.valid) (hv : p.lev < M)
    {a : Grid M → ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) {α : ℝ} (hα : 0 < α)
    {P : Law (Grid M)} (hP : PieceLaw p a P) (hm : 0 < p.avg a) (hm' : p.avg a ≤ 2*α)
    (A : Form M) (u : Grid M) (B : Bool) {b : ℝ}
    (hb : b^2 ≤ energyZ (p.child B) a α A u) :
    ∃ v : Grid M → ℂ, (∀ z, ‖v z‖ ≤ 1) ∧
      b^2/4 ≤ P.Ex fun x => if x∈(p.child B).block M then
        (channel A x).Ex fun z => (v z*chi u x).re else 0
proof:
:= by
  let f := fz (p.child B) a α A u
  let v : Grid M → ℂ := fun z => polar (f z)
  let J := P.Ex fun x => if x∈(p.child B).block M then
        (channel A x).Ex fun z => (v z*chi u x).re else 0
  have he1 (y z : Grid M) :
      omegaObs (p.child B) a α A y z = if y∈(p.child B).block M
        then (2*p.avg a / α) * (P y*channel A y z) else 0 := by
    rw [omegaObs,wt_half hp hv,hP]
    split_ifs
    · rw [wt,wt]; field_simp
    exact zero_mul _
  have he2 (z : Grid M) :
      ‖f z‖ = ∑ y, omegaObs (p.child B) a α A y z * (v z*chi u y).re := by
    rw [← polar_identity]
    change (v z* (_)).re = _
    dsimp only [f,fz]
    rw [Finset.mul_sum,Complex.re_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
    rw [mul_left_comm,Complex.re_ofReal_mul]
  have he :
      ∑ z, ‖f z‖ = (2*p.avg a / α)*J := by
    simp_rw [he2,he1]
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    unfold J Ex
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i hi => ?_
    by_cases h : i ∈ (child p B).block M
    · simp_rw [ite_eq_left h,Finset.mul_sum,mul_assoc]
    simp [h]
  have h0 := hb.trans (energyZ_le _ ha hα.le _ _)
  change b^2 ≤ ∑ z, ‖f z‖ at h0; rw [he] at h0
  have hp1 : 0 < 2*p.avg a/α := by positivity
  have hi1 : 2*p.avg a/α ≤ 4 := by apply (div_le_iff₀ hα).mpr; linarith
  have hj : 0 ≤ J := nonneg_of_mul_nonneg_right ((sq_nonneg _).trans h0) hp1
  exact ⟨v,fun i => polar_unit _,by change b^2/4 ≤ J; nlinarith⟩

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.ac_mul
statement:
private lemma ac_mul (f g : Grid M → ℝ) (hf : f.Even) (hg : g.Even) (x : Grid M) :
    ac (fun y => f y*g y) x = ∑ u : Grid M, ac f u * ac g (x-u)
proof:
:= by
  unfold ac
  simp_rw [Complex.ofReal_mul]; rw [fc_prod,Complex.re_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro i _
  rw [← real_fc_even f hf i,← real_fc_even g hg (x-i)]
  simp

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.ac_scale
statement:
private lemma ac_scale (f : Grid M → ℝ) (a : ℝ) (x : Grid M) :
    ac (fun y => a*f y) x = a*ac f x
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [ac,Complex.ofReal_mul]
  rw [fc_lmul]; simp

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.ac_sum
statement:
private lemma ac_sum {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → Grid M → ℝ) (x : Grid M) :
    ac (fun y => ∑ i ∈ s, f i y) x = ∑ i ∈ s, ac (f i) x
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [ac,Complex.ofReal_sum]; rw [fc_sum,Complex.re_sum]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.ac_const
statement:
private lemma ac_const (x : Grid M) : ac (fun _ => 1) x =
    if x=0 then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold ac
  simp_rw [Complex.ofReal_one]
  rw [← funext chi_zero_left,fc_chi]
  split_ifs <;> simp_all

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.ac_wave
statement:
private lemma ac_wave (s x : Grid M) :
    ac (wave s) x = ((if s=x then 1 else 0)+(if -s=x then 1 else 0))/2
proof:
:= by
  have he (y : Grid M) : (↑(wave s y):ℂ) = 2⁻¹*(chi s y + chi (-s) y) := by
    rw [wave,chi_neg']
    rw [Complex.re_eq_add_conj]
    ring
  unfold ac; simp_rw [he]
  rw [fc_lmul,fc_add,fc_chi,fc_chi]
  split_ifs <;> norm_num

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.blend_even
statement: private lemma blend_even (A : Form M) : (blend A).Even
proof: := by intro i; simp [blend,wave_even _ i]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.blend_boltz
statement:
private lemma blend_boltz (A : Form M) (x : Grid M) :
    boltz A x = exp (-(∑ i, A i)) * exp (blend A x)
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [boltz,form,blend,cost,mul_sub,Finset.sum_sub_distrib,mul_one,← exp_add]
  congr 1; ring

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.blend_spec
statement:
private lemma blend_spec (A : Form M) (x : Grid M) :
    ac (blend A) x = ∑ i, A i * ac (wave i) x
proof:
:= by
  unfold blend
  simp_rw [ac_sum,ac_scale]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.blend_ac_nonneg
statement:
private lemma blend_ac_nonneg {A : Form M} (hA : 0 ≤ A) (x : Grid M) :
    0 ≤ ac (blend A) x
proof:
:= by
  rw [blend_spec]
  apply Finset.sum_nonneg; intro i _
  apply mul_nonneg (hA i)
  rw [ac_wave]; split_ifs <;> norm_num

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.blend_ac_pos
statement:
private lemma blend_ac_pos {A : Form M} (hA : 0 ≤ A) {x : Grid M}
    (hx : 0 < A x) : 0 < ac (blend A) x
proof:
:= by
  rw [blend_spec]
  apply lt_of_lt_of_le (b:=A x * ac (wave x) x)
  · apply mul_pos hx; rw [ac_wave,ite_eq_left rfl]; split_ifs <;> norm_num
  apply Finset.single_le_sum (f:=fun i => A i * ac (wave i) x) _ (Finset.mem_univ x)
  intro i _
  apply mul_nonneg (hA i); rw [ac_wave]; split_ifs <;> norm_num

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.blend_pow_even
statement: private lemma blend_pow_even (A : Form M) (n : ℕ) : (fun y => blend A y^n).Even
proof:
:=
  fun y => by dsimp; rw [blend_even _ y]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.blend_pow_ac_nonneg
statement:
private lemma blend_pow_ac_nonneg {A : Form M} (hA : 0 ≤ A) (n : ℕ) (x : Grid M) :
    0 ≤ ac (fun y => blend A y^n) x
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing x with
  | zero => simp_rw [pow_zero,ac_const]; split_ifs <;> norm_num
  | succ n ih =>
    simp_rw [pow_succ]; rw [ac_mul _ _ (blend_pow_even _ _) (blend_even _)]
    exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => mul_nonneg (ih i) (blend_ac_nonneg hA _)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.blend_pow_ac_pos
statement:
private lemma blend_pow_ac_pos {A : Form M} (hA : 0 ≤ A) (n : ℕ) {x : Grid M}
    (hx : 0 < A x) : 0 < ac (fun y => blend A y^n) (n • x)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [ac_const]
  | succ n ih =>
    simp_rw [pow_succ]; rw [ac_mul _ _ (blend_pow_even _ _) (blend_even _)]
    apply lt_of_lt_of_le (b:=ac (fun y => blend A y ^n) (n • x)*ac (blend A) ((n+1)•x-n•x))
    · rw [add_smul,one_smul,add_sub_cancel_left]
      exact mul_pos ih (blend_ac_pos hA hx)
    apply Finset.single_le_sum (f:=fun u => ac (fun y => blend A y ^n) u * ac (blend A) ((n+1)•x-u)) _ (Finset.mem_univ (n•x))
    intro i _
    exact mul_nonneg (blend_pow_ac_nonneg hA n _) (blend_ac_nonneg hA _)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.aprox_lim
statement: lemma aprox_lim (v : ℝ) : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => aprox n v) atTop (𝓝 (exp v))
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [aprox, Real.exp_eq_exp_ℝ,div_eq_inv_mul] using
    (NormedSpace.expSeries_div_hasSum_exp v).tendsto_sum_nat

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.ac_lim
proof:
:= by
  unfold ac fc expU
  apply Complex.continuous_re.continuousAt.tendsto.comp
  simp only [Complex.real_smul]
  refine Tendsto.const_mul _ <| tendsto_finsetSum _ ?_
  intro y _
  exact Tendsto.mul (Complex.continuous_ofReal.continuousAt.tendsto.comp (h y)) tendsto_const_nhds

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.blend_part_le_exp
proof:
:= by
  apply ge_of_tendsto (ac_lim (fun n y => aprox n (blend A y)) _ x
    (fun y => aprox_lim _))
  filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop (n+1)] with k hk
  simp_rw [aprox,ac_sum,ac_scale]
  apply Finset.single_le_sum _ (Finset.mem_range.mpr hk)
  intro i _
  exact mul_nonneg (by positivity) (blend_pow_ac_nonneg hA _ _)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.q_nonneg
statement: lemma q_nonneg {A : Form M} (hA : 0 ≤ A) (x : Grid M) : 0 ≤ q A x
proof:
:= by
  change 0 ≤ ac (boltz A) x
  rw [show boltz A = _ from funext (blend_boltz A),ac_scale]
  exact mul_nonneg (exp_nonneg _) (le_trans
    (mul_nonneg (by positivity) (blend_pow_ac_nonneg hA 0 _)) (blend_part_le_exp hA x 0))

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.q_pos_one
statement: lemma q_pos_one {A : Form M} (hA : 0 ≤ A) (h : 0 < A 1) (x : Grid M) : 0 < q A x
proof:
:= by
  change 0 < ac (boltz A) x
  rw [show boltz A = _ from funext (blend_boltz A),ac_scale]
  apply mul_pos (exp_pos _)
  apply lt_of_lt_of_le _ (blend_part_le_exp hA x x.val)
  have hi : 0 < ac (fun y => blend A y ^ x.val) (x.val • 1) := blend_pow_ac_pos hA _ h
  rw [nsmul_one, ZMod.natCast_zmod_val] at hi
  exact mul_pos (by positivity) hi

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.cred_nonneg
statement: lemma cred_nonneg {A : Form M} (hA : 0 ≤ A) (x : Grid M) : 0 ≤ cred A x
proof:
:=
  div_nonneg (q_nonneg hA x) (q_origin_pos A).le

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.norm_fc_translate_boltz
statement:
lemma norm_fc_translate_boltz {A : Form M} (hA : 0 ≤ A) (a u : Grid M) :
    ‖fc (fun y => (↑(boltz A (a-y)):ℂ)) u‖ = q A u
proof:
:= by
  have hi (y : Grid M) : boltz A (a-y) = boltz A (y-a) := by
    rw [show a-y = -(y-a) by ring,boltz_even _ _]
  simp_rw [hi]
  rw [fc_right_translate (fun y => (↑(boltz A y):ℂ)) a u,norm_mul,norm_chi,one_mul,← cq, Complex.norm_real,
     Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (q_nonneg hA _)]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.envelope
statement:
lemma envelope {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → Form M) (h : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ f i)
    (a : ι → Grid M) (u : Grid M) :
    ‖fc (fun y => ∏ i ∈ s, (↑(boltz (f i) (a i-y)):ℂ)) u‖ ≤ q (∑ i ∈ s, f i) u
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on generalizing u with
  | empty =>
    apply le_of_eq
    convert norm_fc_translate_boltz (M:=M) (le_refl (0:Form M)) 0 u using 1 <;>
      simp [boltz,form_zero]
  | @insert i s hi ih =>
    have H := h i (Finset.mem_insert_self _ _)
    have HH (j) (hj : j∈s) : 0 ≤ f j := h j (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hj)
    simp_rw [Finset.sum_insert hi, Finset.prod_insert hi]
    rw [q_add,fc_prod]
    apply (norm_sum_le _ _).trans
    refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ => ?_
    rw [norm_mul,norm_fc_translate_boltz H]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (ih HH _) (q_nonneg H j)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.tune_pos
statement: lemma tune_pos (s : Profile M) (x : Grid M) : 0 < tune s x
proof: := exp_pos _

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.prefixE_nonneg
statement: lemma prefixE_nonneg (s : Profile M) (p : Node) (x : Grid M) : 0 ≤ prefixE s p x
proof:
:= by
  unfold prefixE; split_ifs
  exact (tune_pos _ _).le
  exact le_rfl

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.tune_cons
statement:
lemma tune_cons (s : Profile M) (A : Form M) (x y : Grid M) :
    tune ((A,x)::s) y = boltz A (x-y)*tune s y
proof:
:= by
  simp only [tune,sumE,List.map_cons,List.sum_cons,boltz, ← exp_add]
  congr 1; ring

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.mix_cons
statement:
lemma mix_cons (s : Profile M) (A : Form M) (x : Grid M) :
    mixForm ((A,x)::s) = A+mixForm s
proof: := by simp [mixForm]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.mix_bound
statement:
lemma mix_bound {s : Profile M} {A : Form M} (h : ∀ i∈s, i.1 ≤ A) (x : Grid M) :
    mixForm s x ≤ s.length*A x
proof:
:= by
  induction s with
  | nil =>
    unfold mixForm
    simp
  | cons i s ih =>
    obtain ⟨a,y⟩ := i
    rw [mix_cons]
    have hx := ih (by intro i hi; exact h i (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hi))
    have hh := h (a,y) List.mem_cons_self x
    simp only [Pi.add_apply,List.length_cons]
    change a x ≤ _ at hh
    push_cast; linarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.mix_nonneg
statement:
lemma mix_nonneg {s : Profile M} (h : ∀ i∈s, 0 ≤ i.1) :
    0 ≤ mixForm s
proof:
:= by
  induction s with
  | nil => simp [mixForm]
  | cons i s ih =>
    obtain ⟨a,y⟩ := i; rw [mix_cons]
    exact add_nonneg (h (a,y) List.mem_cons_self) (ih fun i hi => h i (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hi))

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.sumE_compare
statement:
lemma sumE_compare {s : Profile M} (x y : Grid M) (h : ∀ i∈s, 0 ≤ i.1) :
    sumE s y ≤ 2*(sumE s x + form (mixForm s) (x-y))
proof:
:= by
  induction s with
  | nil => simp [mixForm,sumE,form_zero]
  | cons i s ih =>
    obtain ⟨a,z⟩ := i
    have hh := ih (fun i hi => h i (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hi))
    have hx : 0 ≤ a := h (a,z) List.mem_cons_self
    simp only [mix_cons, sumE, List.map_cons, List.sum_cons, form_add]
    unfold sumE at hh
    have H := form_triangle hx (z-x) (x-y)
    rw [sub_add_sub_cancel] at H
    linarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.profile_envelope
statement:
lemma profile_envelope {s : Profile M} (h : ∀ i∈s, 0 ≤ i.1) (x : Grid M) :
    ‖fc (fun y => (↑(tune s y):ℂ)) x‖ ≤ q (mixForm s) x
proof:
:= by
  induction s generalizing x with
  | nil =>
    rw [show mixForm ([]:Profile M)=0 from by simp [mixForm]]
    apply le_of_eq
    convert norm_fc_translate_boltz (M:=M) (le_refl (0:Form M)) 0 x using 1
    simp [boltz,tune,sumE,form_zero]
  | cons i s ih =>
    obtain ⟨a,y⟩ := i
    simp_rw [mix_cons,tune_cons,Complex.ofReal_mul,fc_prod,q_add]
    apply le_trans (norm_sum_le _ _)
    refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => ?_
    have hx : 0 ≤ a := h (a,y) List.mem_cons_self
    have hh := ih (fun i hi => h i (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hi)) (x-i)
    rw [norm_mul,norm_fc_translate_boltz hx]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hh (q_nonneg hx _)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.close_kept
proof:
:= by
  have he (v : Grid M) (hv : pos v < p.len/2) :
      x+v ∈ p.block M ∨ x-v ∈ p.block M := by
    have hh1 : p.idx M ≤ x.val ∧ x.val < p.idx M+p.wid M := by
      rw [mem_block_iff hp.2] at hx; unfold idx wid; rw [add_mul,one_mul] at hx; exact hx
    have hh2 : 2*v.val < p.wid M := by
      have H := side_pos M
      have he : p.len = (p.wid M : ℝ)*side M := by
        unfold wid; rw [descale hp.2]; push_cast; ring
      rw [he,pos] at hv
      have hi : 2*(v.val : ℝ)< p.wid M := by nlinarith
      exact_mod_cast hi
    have heq (x : Grid M) :
        x∈p.block M ↔ p.idx M ≤ x.val ∧ x.val < p.idx M+p.wid M := by
      unfold idx wid; rw [mem_block_iff hp.2,add_mul,one_mul]
    rw [heq,heq]
    by_cases H : x.val+v.val < p.idx M+p.wid M
    · left; rw [ZMod.val_add_of_lt (H.trans_le (p.fitting hp.1 hp.2))]
      omega
    right; rw [ZMod.val_sub (by omega : v.val ≤ x.val)]
    omega
  rw [diam_min,min_lt_iff] at h
  rcases h with h|h
  · exact he v h
  · simpa only [sub_neg_eq_add,← sub_eq_add_neg] using (he (-v) h).symm

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.even_prob
statement:
private lemma even_prob (A : Form M) (p : Grid M → Prop) :
    (label A).prob (fun x => p (-x)) = (label A).prob p
proof:
:= by
  rw [prob_eq,prob_eq]
  apply Fintype.sum_equiv (Equiv.neg (Grid M))
  intro i
  simp only [Equiv.neg_apply,label_apply,K_even _ _]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.label_node_inside
statement:
private lemma label_node_inside {p : Node} (hp : p.ok M) {A : Form M}
    (hA : S M (1000*p.invlen) ≤ A) (h : 1000*p.invlen ≤ 2^M)
    (x : Grid M) (hx : x∈p.block M) :
    1/4 ≤ (label A).prob (fun z => x+z ∈ p.block M)
proof:
:= by
  let R := p.invlen; let r := p.len/2; let P := label A
  let u (z : Grid M) : Prop := Dyadic.diam z < r
  let v (z : Grid M) : Prop := x+z ∈ p.block M
  have hR : 1 ≤ R := p.invlen_ge
  have hr : 0 < r := by unfold r; have := p.len_pos; positivity
  have he : P.prob (fun x => ¬ u x) ≤ 1/2 := by
    have he : (P.prob (fun x => ¬u x))*r^2 ≤ 100/(1000*R)^2 := by
      apply le_trans _ (S_variance _ (by linarith) h _ hA)
      unfold prob
      rw [← Ex_mul]
      refine Ex_mono _ fun i => ?_
      dsimp only; split_ifs with H
      · rw [zero_mul]; positivity
      · rw [one_mul]
        apply pow_le_pow_left₀ hr.le _
        exact not_lt.mp H
    have ht : 100/(1000*R)^2 ≤ (1/2)*r^2 := by
      unfold R r; rw [rinv]
      have h0 := p.len_pos
      field_simp; nlinarith
    exact le_of_mul_le_mul_right (he.trans ht) (by positivity)
  have hb : P.prob u ≤ P.prob v + (P.prob fun z => v (-z)) := by
    unfold prob; rw [← Ex_add]; refine Ex_mono _ fun i => ?_
    by_cases hi : u i
    · have HH : v i ∨ v (-i) := by
        simpa only [v,sub_eq_add_neg] using close_kept hp hx hi
      rcases HH with HH|HH <;> simp only [hi,HH,ite_true] <;>
        split_ifs <;> norm_num
    · simp only [hi,ite_false]; split_ifs <;> norm_num
  rw [prob_compl] at he
  rw [even_prob A v] at hb
  change _ ≤ P.prob v; linarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.posterior_denominator
statement:
lemma posterior_denominator {p : Node} (hp : p.ok M) {A : Form M}
    (hA : S M (1000*p.invlen) ≤ A) (h : 1000*p.invlen ≤ 2^M)
    (s : Profile M) {r : ℝ} (hr : admissible s p r)
    (hn : ∀ i∈s, 0 ≤ i.1) (hh : (2:ℝ) • mixForm s ≤ A) :
    exp (- (2*r)-F A)/4 ≤ expU (prefixE s p)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x,hx,h1⟩ := hr
  let Q := label A
  let c := exp (- (2*r)-F A)
  have hc : 0 < c := exp_pos _
  have HE (y : Grid M) : c*(K A y * (if x+y∈p.block M then 1 else 0)) ≤
      prefixE s p (x+y) := by
    unfold prefixE; split_ifs with hiv
    · rw [mul_one,K_eq,tune]
      unfold c; rw [← exp_add]; apply Real.exp_monotone
      have hi := sumE_compare x (x+y) hn
      have h2 := form_mono hh (x-(x+y))
      rw [form_smul, show x-(x+y)=-y by ring,form_even A y] at h2
      rw [show x-(x+y)=-y by ring] at hi
      linarith
    · simp
  have hh' := Ex_mono (uniform _) HE
  simp only [Ex_lmul,← expU_ex,expU_translate,← label_ex] at hh'
  apply le_trans _ hh'
  have hh2 := label_node_inside hp hA h x hx
  let f (y : Grid M) := if x+y∈p.block M then (1:ℝ) else 0
  have Heq : (label A).prob (fun z => x+z∈p.block M)=(label A).Ex f := by

    rw [prob_eq]; simp [f,Ex]
  rw [Heq] at hh2
  change c/4 ≤ c*(label A).Ex f
  nlinarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.ply_unit
statement:
lemma ply_unit (hl : l ≤ M) (p : Law (Grid l)) (f : Grid l → ℂ) (hf : ∀ x, ‖f x‖ ≤ 1) (y) :
    ‖ply hl p f y‖ ≤ 1
proof: := norm_Cx_unit _ _ fun x => by rw [norm_mul,norm_chi,mul_one]; exact hf _

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.ply_one_zero
statement: lemma ply_one_zero (hl : l ≤ M) (p : Law (Grid l)) : ply hl p 1 0 = 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold ply; simp_rw [chi_zero_right, mul_one,Pi.one_apply]
  rw [show (fun _ : Grid l => (1:ℂ)) = fun _ => (↑(1:ℝ):ℂ) by simp, Cx_ofReal,Ex_const]
  rfl

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.HeatM_bounds
statement:
lemma HeatM_bounds (hl : l ≤ M) (A : Form M) (p : Law (Grid l)) (T : ℕ) :
    0 < HeatM hl A p T ∧ HeatM hl A p T ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · unfold HeatM Ex
    apply lt_of_lt_of_le (b:=label A 0 * ‖ply hl p 1 0‖^(2*T))
    · rw [ply_one_zero,norm_one,one_pow,mul_one]; exact label_pos _ _
    refine Finset.single_le_sum (f:=fun y => label A y * ‖ply hl p 1 y‖^(2*T))
      (fun i _ => mul_nonneg (label_pos _ _).le (by positivity)) (Finset.mem_univ _)
  · unfold HeatM
    refine le_trans (b:=(label A).Ex fun _ => 1) (Ex_mono _ fun x => ?_) (by rw [Ex_const])
    exact pow_le_one₀ (norm_nonneg _) (ply_unit hl p 1 (fun _ => by simp) _)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.heat_exp
statement:
lemma heat_exp (hl : l ≤ M) (A : Form M) (p : Law (Grid l)) (T : ℕ) :
    exp (-levelCost hl A p T) = HeatM hl A p T
proof:
:= by
  rw [levelCost,neg_neg, exp_log (HeatM_bounds _ _ _ _).1]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.heat_nonneg
statement:
lemma heat_nonneg (hl : l ≤ M) (A : Form M) (p : Law (Grid l)) (T : ℕ) :
    0 ≤ levelCost hl A p T
proof:
:= neg_nonneg.mpr (log_nonpos
      (HeatM_bounds _ _ _ _).1.le (HeatM_bounds _ _ _ _).2)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.Cx_send
statement:
lemma Cx_send (P : Law Γ) (X : Γ → Grid l) (f : Grid l → ℂ) :
    (P.send X).Cx f = P.Cx fun i => f (X i)
proof:
:= by
  unfold Cx
  classical
  simp_rw [send_apply,prob_eq,Complex.ofReal_sum,Finset.sum_mul]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (X i),ite_eq_left rfl]
  · intro j _ hj
    rw [ite_eq_right hj.symm, Complex.ofReal_zero,zero_mul]
  simp

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.pack_ply_expand
proof:
:= pack fun _ => p
    let W (X : Fin T → Γ) := ∏ i, f (tag (X i))
    let t := Compress.tot tag (ι:=Fin T)
    ‖ply hl (p.send tag) f y‖^(2*T) = Q.Ex fun X => Q.Ex fun X' =>
        (W X * conj (W X') * chi (raise hl (t X-t X')) y).re := by
  classical
  intro Q W t
  let u := fun x : Grid l => chi (raise hl x) y
  let g := fun x : Γ => f (tag x)*u (tag x)
  have hu (X : Fin T → Γ) :
      ∏ i, g (X i) = W X * u (t X) := by
    unfold g W; rw [Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
    have H (x : Grid l) : u x = raiseChar hl y x := (raiseChar_eq hl _ _).symm
    simp_rw [H, t,Compress.tot,Compress.char_sum]
  have he : ply hl (p.send tag) f y ^ T = Q.Cx fun X => W X * u (t X) := by

    have HX : ply hl (p.send tag) f y = p.Cx g := Cx_send _ _ _
    simp only [HX]
    unfold Q
    simp_rw [← hu, Cx_prod (fun _ : Fin T => p) (fun _ => g)]
    simp
  have hn (X X' : Fin T → Γ) : W X* conj (W X')*chi (raise hl (t X-t X')) y =
      (W X * u (t X)) * conj (W X'*u (t X')) := by
    unfold u; simp_rw [map_sub,map_mul,sub_eq_add_neg,chi_add',chi_neg']
    ring
  rw [mul_comm 2 _,pow_mul,← norm_pow,he,sq_norm_Cx]; simp_rw [hn]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.selected_heat
statement:
lemma selected_heat (T : ℕ) (hl : l ≤ M) (A : Form M)
    (hA : ∀ i : Grid M, 0 < cred A i) (p : Law Γ) (tag : Γ → Grid l) :
    Compress.heatMoment (Fin T) p tag (fq_cost hl A) = HeatM hl A (p.send tag) T
proof:
:= by
  let Q : Law (Fin T → Γ) := pack fun _ => p
  let t (f : Fin T → Γ) := Compress.tot tag f
  change (Q.Ex fun X => Q.Ex fun X' => exp ( -fq_cost hl A (t X-t X'))) = _
  unfold HeatM
  have h (y : Grid M) : ‖ply hl (p.send tag) 1 y‖^(2*T) = Q.Ex (fun X => Q.Ex
    fun X' => wave (raise hl (t X-t X')) y) := by
    simp only [pack_ply_expand,Finset.prod_const_one,Pi.one_apply,map_one,one_mul]
    rfl
  simp_rw [h,Ex_swap (label A) Q,wave]
  have he (i : Grid l) : exp ( -fq_cost hl A i) = (label A).Ex fun y => (chi (raise hl i) y).re := by
    rw [fq_cost,neg_neg,exp_log (hA _),cred_ex]; rfl
  simp_rw [he]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.weighted_envelope
statement:
lemma weighted_envelope (T : ℕ) (hl : l ≤ M) (A : Form M) (p : Law (Grid l))
    (f : Grid l → ℂ) (hf : ∀ x, ‖f x‖ ≤ 1) (W : Grid M → ℝ) (c : ℝ)
    (H : ∀ i, ‖expU (fun y => (W y:ℂ)*chi i y)‖ ≤ c*cred A i) :
    expU (fun y => W y * ‖ply hl p f y‖^(2*T)) ≤ c * HeatM hl A p T
proof:
:= by
  let P := label A
  let Q := pack fun _ : Fin T => p
  let t (X : Fin T → Grid l) := ∑ i, X i
  let v (X X' : Fin T → Grid l) := raise hl (t X-t X')
  let V (X : Fin T → Grid l) := ∏ i, f (X i)
  have hp : p.send (fun x => x) = p := send_id _
  have he (y : Grid M) : ‖ply hl p f y‖^(2*T)= Q.Ex fun X => Q.Ex fun X' =>
      (V X * conj (V X') * chi (v X X') y).re := by
    have hi := pack_ply_expand T hl p (fun x => x) f y
    rw [hp] at hi
    exact hi
  have he' (y : Grid M) : ‖ply hl p 1 y‖^(2*T)= Q.Ex fun X => Q.Ex fun X' =>
      wave (v X X') y := by
    have hi := pack_ply_expand T hl p (fun x => x) 1 y
    simp only [hp, Pi.one_apply,Finset.prod_const_one,map_one,one_mul] at hi
    exact hi
  have hV (X : Fin T → Grid l) : ‖V X‖ ≤ 1 := by
    unfold V; rw [Complex.norm_prod]
    apply le_trans (b:=∏ _i : Fin T, (1:ℝ)) (Finset.prod_le_prod₀ (fun i _ => ?_) (fun i _ => ?_)) (by simp)
    · positivity
    · exact hf _
  let L := Law.uniform (Grid M)
  have hX (X X' : Fin T → Grid l) : L.Ex (fun y => W y * (V X*conj (V X')*chi (v X X') y).re) ≤
      c * P.Ex (wave (v X X')) := by
    let Z := V X * conj (V X')
    let s := v X X'
    change L.Ex (fun y => W y * (Z*chi s y).re) ≤ c*P.Ex (wave s)
    have he : L.Ex (fun y => W y * (Z*chi s y).re) = (Z * expU (fun y => (W y:ℂ)*chi s y)).re := by
      rw [expU_cx,← Cx_lmul,re_Cx]
      refine congrArg _ (funext fun y => ?_); rw [mul_left_comm,Complex.re_ofReal_mul]
    rw [he, show P.Ex (wave s)=cred A s from (cred_ex _ _).symm]
    apply le_trans (le_abs_self _)
    apply le_trans (Complex.abs_re_le_norm _)
    rw [norm_mul]
    have hZ : ‖Z‖ ≤ 1 := by
      unfold Z; rw [norm_mul,Complex.norm_conj]
      calc
        ‖V X‖ * ‖V X'‖ ≤ 1 * ‖V X'‖ :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hV X) (norm_nonneg _)
        _ ≤ 1 := by simpa using hV X'
    exact (mul_le_of_le_one_left (norm_nonneg _) hZ).trans (H s)
  unfold HeatM
  simp_rw [he,he',expU_ex]

  simp_rw [← Ex_lmul Q, Ex_swap (label A) Q,Ex_swap (uniform (Grid M)) Q]
  simp_rw [← Ex_lmul Q]
  exact Q.Ex_mono fun X => Q.Ex_mono fun X' => hX X X'

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.log_shift_bound
statement: lemma log_shift_bound (s : ℝ) (h : |s| ≤ 1/2) : s-2*s^2 ≤ log (1+s)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hx,hx'⟩ := abs_le.mp h
  have hh : 0 < 1+s := by linarith
  have H := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr hh)
  rw [Real.log_inv] at H
  apply le_trans (b:= -( (1+s)⁻¹-1))
  · apply le_of_mul_le_mul_right _ hh
    rw [neg_mul,sub_mul,sub_mul,inv_mul_cancel₀ hh.ne',one_mul]
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg (by linarith : 0 ≤ (2*s+1)) (sq_nonneg s)]
  linarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.test_abs
statement:
private lemma test_abs (v : ℂ) (i x : Grid l) (h : ‖v‖ ≤ 1) :
    |(v * chi i x).re| ≤ 1
proof:
:=
      (Complex.abs_re_le_norm _).trans (by rw [norm_mul,norm_chi,mul_one]; exact h)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.factor_bounds
statement:
private lemma factor_bounds (β : ℝ) (v : ℂ) (i x : Grid l) (hp : 0 ≤ β) (hh : β ≤ 1)
    (hv : ‖v‖ ≤ 1) :
    0 < factorQ (β/4) v i x ∧
      β/4 * (v*chi i x).re - β^2/8 ≤ log (factorQ (β/4) v i x)
proof:
:= by
  have he := test_abs v i x hv
  let t := β/4 * (v*chi i x).re
  have hi : |t| ≤ β/4 := by
    unfold t; rw [abs_mul,abs_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
    exact mul_le_of_le_one_right (by positivity) he
  have hX := abs_le.mp hi
  unfold factorQ
  change 0 < 1+t ∧ t-_ ≤ _
  have hl := log_shift_bound t (hi.trans (by linarith))
  constructor
  · linarith [hX.1]
  apply le_trans _ hl
  nlinarith [sq_abs t,abs_nonneg t]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.q_exp_constant
statement:
private lemma q_exp_constant {f : Grid l → ℝ} :
    (↑(expU f):ℂ) = fc (fun i => (↑(f i):ℂ)) 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [fc,← expU_real]; simp_rw [neg_zero,chi_zero_left,mul_one]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.q_step
proof:
:= by
  have HE (i : Grid l) :
      (↑(Qp (insert x s) c v i z):ℂ) =
        (↑(Qp s c v i z):ℂ) * (1+ (↑(((c:ℂ)*v x z*chi x i).re):ℂ)) := by
    unfold Qp
    rw [Finset.prod_insert (fun hh => hx (enclosed_mem s hh)),mul_comm]
    push_cast
    rw [mul_assoc,Complex.re_ofReal_mul,factorQ]; push_cast; rfl
  obtain ⟨ht,ht'⟩ := span_augment h ((c:ℂ)*v x z) x hx

  constructor
  · simp_rw [HE]; exact ht
  apply Complex.ofReal_inj.mp
  rw [q_exp_constant]
  simp_rw [HE]
  rw [ht',← q_exp_constant,h']

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.span_collection
statement:
private lemma span_collection (s : Finset (Grid l)) (c : ℝ) (v : Grid l → Grid M → ℂ) :
    ∃ t ⊆ s, (∀ x∈s, enclosed t 1 x) ∧ ∀ z, expU (fun i => Qp t c v i z)=1
proof:
:= by
  let R := fun t : Finset (Grid l) => ∀ z, spanned t (fun i => (↑(Qp t c v i z):ℂ)) ∧
    expU (fun i => Qp t c v i z)=1
  suffices HH : ∀ k : ℕ, ∀ t ⊆ s, s.card-t.card=k → R t →
      ∃ t ⊆ s, (∀ x∈s, enclosed t 1 x) ∧ ∀ z, expU (fun i => Qp t c v i z)=1 by
    refine HH _ ∅ (by simp) rfl fun z => ⟨?_,?_⟩
    · simp only [Qp,Finset.prod_empty, Complex.ofReal_one]; exact spanned_one _
    simp only [Qp,Finset.prod_empty,expU_ex,Ex_const]
  intro k; induction k using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | h k ih =>
    intro t ht hk hr
    by_cases H : ∀ x∈s, enclosed t 1 x
    · exact ⟨t,ht,H,fun z => (hr z).2⟩
    push Not at H
    obtain ⟨x,hx,H⟩ := H
    have hh : insert x t ⊆ s := Finset.insert_subset hx ht
    refine ih (s.card-(insert x t).card) ?_ _ hh rfl fun z => q_step H (hr z).1 (hr z).2
    have he := Finset.card_le_card hh
    rw [Finset.card_insert_of_notMem (fun hh => H (enclosed_mem t hh))] at *
    omega

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.conditional_if_ex
statement:
lemma conditional_if_ex {α β : Type} [Fintype α] [Fintype β]
    (P : Law α) (k : α → Law β) (Q : α → Prop) (f : α → β → ℝ) :
    (P.withNext k).Ex (fun i => if Q i.1 then f i.1 i.2 else 0) =
      P.Ex (fun a => if Q a then (k a).Ex (f a) else 0)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ex_withNext]; refine congrArg _ (funext fun a => ?_)
  by_cases h : Q a <;> simp only [h,ite_false,ite_true,Ex_const]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.append_cost
statement:
private lemma append_cost {p : Node} {P : Law (Grid M)} {B : Bool} {A : Form M}
    {hl : l ≤ M} {s : Finset (Grid l)} {v : Grid l → Grid M → ℂ} {β : ℝ} (h0 : 0 ≤ β) (hb : β ≤ 1)
    (H : biases P p A hl s B v β) (i : Grid l) (hi : i∈s) :
    let C (x : Grid M) : Prop
proof:
:= x∈(p.child B).block M
    β^2/8 ≤ (P.withNext (channel A)).Ex fun xz =>
      if C xz.1 then log (factorQ (β/4) (v i xz.2) i (cut hl xz.1)) else 0 := by
  intro C; let L := channel A; let T := P.withNext L
  let f (xz : Grid M × Grid M) := if C xz.1 then (v i xz.2 * chi i (cut hl xz.1)).re else 0
  have H' : β ≤ T.Ex f := by
    unfold T f; rw [conditional_if_ex P L C (fun y z => (v i z * chi i (cut hl y)).re)]; have he := H.2 i hi
    simp_rw [cut_chi] at he
    exact he
  calc
    _ ≤ (β/4)* T.Ex f - β^2/8 := by nlinarith
    _ = T.Ex (fun xz => β/4*f xz - β^2/8) := by
      rw [Ex_sub,Ex_const,Ex_lmul]
    _ ≤ _ := Ex_mono T fun x => by
      unfold f
      split_ifs
      · exact (factor_bounds β _ _ _ h0 hb (H.1 _ _)).2
      nlinarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.cheap_span
statement:
lemma cheap_span {p p' : Node} {a : Grid M → ℝ} (hp : p.ok M) (hv : p.below p')
    {n : ℕ} {h err : ℝ} {A : Form M} (H : Certified h err n p' A)
    {P : Law (Grid M)} (ht : PieceLaw p a P) (hl : l ≤ M) (hh : M-l ≤ p.lev)
    {d : ℝ} (h1 : ∀ x, a x ≤ exp d) (hm : exp (-d) ≤ p.avg a) {B : Bool}
    {s : Finset (Grid l)} {v : Grid l → Grid M → ℂ} {β : ℝ} (h0 : 0 ≤ β) (hb : β ≤ 1)
    (HG : biases P p A hl s B v β) :
    ∃ t : Finset (Grid l), (∀ x∈s, enclosed t 1 x) ∧
      t.card*(β^2/8) ≤ 2*d + log p.invlen - log ((2:ℝ)^(M-l)) + F A - log p'.invlen + 301
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t,htt,hE,hq⟩ := span_collection s (β/4) v
  let Q := Qp t (β/4) v
  let C (x : Grid M) : Prop := x∈(child p B).block M
  let U := P.withNext (channel A)
  have hQ (i z) : 0 < Q i z := Finset.prod_pos fun x _ => (factor_bounds _ _ _ _ h0 hb (HG.1 _ _)).1
  let f (i : Grid l) (x : Grid M × Grid M) := if C x.1 then
    log (factorQ (β/4) (v i x.2) i (cut hl x.1)) else 0
  refine ⟨t,hE,le_trans ?_ (product_entropy_bound hp hv H ht hl hh h1 hm B Q hQ fun z => (hq z).le)⟩
  change _ ≤ U.Ex (fun x => if C x.1 then _ else _)
  have HE (x : Grid M × Grid M) : (if C x.1 then log (Q (cut hl x.1) x.2) else 0) = ∑ i∈t, f i x := by
    unfold Q Qp f
    split_ifs with hh
    · rw [Real.log_prod]
      exact fun i _ => (factor_bounds _ _ _ _ h0 hb (HG.1 _ _)).1.ne'
    · simp
  simp_rw [HE,Ex_finset_sum]
  calc
    _ = ∑ _i∈t, β^2/8 := by simp
    _ ≤ _ := Finset.sum_le_sum fun i hi => append_cost h0 hb HG i (htt hi)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.sumset_est
statement:
lemma sumset_est {s t : Finset (Grid l)} (h : ∀ x∈s, enclosed t 1 x) (n : ℕ) :
    Compress.lnS (Fin n) (fun x : s => (x:Grid l)) ≤ t.card * log (2*(n:ℝ)+1)
proof:
:= by
  let S := Compress.sums (Fin n) (fun x : s => (x:Grid l))
  have Hi : S ⊆ palace t n := by
    intro i hi
    obtain ⟨f,_,rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hi
    apply Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _,?_⟩
    simpa [Compress.tot] using enclosed_sum t (fun i => (f i:Grid l)) (fun i => h _ (f i).property)
  have HE := (Finset.card_le_card Hi).trans (palace_size _ _)
  change log (S.card:ℝ) ≤ _
  by_cases H : S.card=0
  · simp only [H,Nat.cast_zero,log_zero]
    exact mul_nonneg (by positivity) (Real.log_nonneg (by have H := Nat.cast_nonneg (α:=ℝ) n; linarith))
  · have Hh : 0 < (S.card:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast Nat.pos_of_ne_zero H
    have HE' := log_le_log Hh (by exact_mod_cast HE : (S.card:ℝ) ≤ (2*(n:ℝ)+1)^t.card)
    rwa [log_pow] at HE'

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.clones_eq
statement: lemma clones_eq (j : ℕ) : (clones j:ℝ)= H j^120
proof:
:= by
  unfold clones H; push_cast; rfl

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.clones_pos
statement: lemma clones_pos (j : ℕ) : 0 < clones j
proof: := pow_pos (slow_pos _) _

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.obs_scale
statement:
lemma obs_scale (C : ℝ) (hC : 1 ≤ C) :
    ∀ᶠ j : ℕ in atTop, 2+2*observationBudget C j ≤ H j^130
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [h_large (10*C)] with j h
  let a := H j
  have hp := H_ge j
  have hm : (clones j:ℝ)=a^120 := clones_eq _
  unfold observationBudget; rw [hm]
  change 2+2*(1+C*a*(1+a^120)) ≤ a^130
  change 10*C ≤ a at h; change 1 ≤ a at hp
  have h1 : a^122 ≤ a^130 := pow_le_pow_right₀ hp (by omega)
  have h2 : 1 ≤ a^120 := one_le_pow₀ hp
  have h3 : 10*C*a*(a^120) ≤ a^122 :=
    calc
      _ ≤ a*a*a^120 := by gcongr
      _ = _ := by ring
  have hs : 1 ≤ C*a := one_le_mul_of_one_le_of_one_le hC hp
  have h4 : C*a ≤ C*a*a^120 := le_mul_of_one_le_right (by linarith) h2
  linarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.alarm_scale
statement:
private lemma alarm_scale :
    ∀ᶠ j : ℕ in atTop, ∀ i, i ≤ testIx j → ∀ c : ℝ,
      height j/H j^2 ≤ c →
        log (clones j)+log 4+32+6*cushion j+height j/H j^4 -
          (2*(sLen j):ℕ)*log (beta i/4) ≤ c/8
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [Tk_bounds,h_large 100000,hpoly 1000000 123] with j ⟨hx,hy⟩ hp1 hp2 i hi c hh
  let d := height j; let a := H j
  have h := H_ge j; have hp := H_pos j
  have he := (main_bounds j hi).2.2
  have hz := log_le_sub_one_of_pos (show 0 < (clones j:ℝ) by rw [clones_eq]; positivity)
  rw [clones_eq] at *
  have h4 := log_le_sub_one_of_pos (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<4)
  rw [Real.log_div (beta_pos i).ne' (by norm_num)]
  push_cast
  let t : ℝ := sLen j
  have ht : 0 ≤ t := by unfold t; positivity
  change 1 ≤ a at h; change 0 < a at hp; change 100000 ≤ a at hp1
  change t*a^6=d at hx
  change -log (beta i) ≤ 200*a at he
  change 1000000*a^123 ≤ d at hp2
  have h₁ : log (a^120)+log 4+32 ≤ d/(64*a^2) := by
    change log (a^120) ≤ _ at hz
    apply (le_div_iff₀ (by positivity : 0<64*a^2)).mpr
    have hr : a^122 ≤ a^123 := pow_le_pow_right₀ h (by omega)
    calc
      _ ≤ (100*a^120)*(64*a^2) := by gcongr; linarith [one_le_pow₀ h (n:=120)]
      _ ≤ _ := by nlinarith [one_le_pow₀ h (n:=122)]
  have h₂ : 6*d/a^100 + d/a^4 ≤ d/(64*a^2) := by
    have hd : 0 ≤ d := by unfold d; exact (d_pos _).le
    calc
      _ ≤ 6*d/a^4+d/a^4 := by gcongr; norm_num
      _ = 7/(a^4)*d := by ring
      _ ≤ _ := by
        rw [div_eq_mul_inv d,mul_comm d]
        have hi : 7/a^4 ≤ (64*a^2)⁻¹ := by field_simp; nlinarith
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hi hd
  have h₃ : -(2*t)*(log (beta i)-log 4) ≤ d/(64*a^2) := by
    calc
      _ ≤ 500*t*a := by nlinarith
      _ ≤ _ := by
        apply (le_div_iff₀ (by positivity : 0<64*a^2)).mpr
        rw [← hx]
        rw [show 500*t*a*(64*a^2)=t*(32000*a^3) by ring]
        gcongr
        calc
          _ ≤ a*a^3 := by gcongr; linarith
          _ = a^4 := by ring
          _ ≤ _ := pow_le_pow_right₀ h (by omega)
  change log (a^120)+_+32+6*(d/a^100)+d/a^4-2*t*(log _-_) ≤ _
  have ht : d/(64*a^2)*64 ≤ c := by apply le_trans _ hh; exact le_of_eq (by ring)
  rw [← mul_div_assoc]
  have : 0 ≤ d/(64*a^2) := by unfold d; have := d_pos j; positivity
  linarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.conditional_bound
statement:
theorem conditional_bound (C : ℝ) (hC : 1 ≤ C) :
    ∀ᶠ j : ℕ in atTop, ∀ M : ℕ, ∀ p : Node,
    ∀ A : Form M, Press C j p A → 1000*p.invlen ≤ 2^M →
    ∀ P : Law (Grid M), ∀ u : Update j M p, u.Good C A P →
      u.regular → ∀ s : Profile M,
      (∀ i∈s, 0 ≤ i.1 ∧ i.1 ≤ A) → s.length ≤ observationBudget C j →
      admissible s p (cushion j) → ∀ z : Grid M,
      expU (fun x => prefixE s p x * u.alarmQ A z x) ≤
        exp (-(u.credit/8)) * expU (prefixE s p)
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [obs_scale C hC,alarm_scale,paid_tighten C hC] with j h ht hC'
  intro M p A hP hq P u Hu Hr s hS hn hs z
  let a := H j
  let E := u.credit
  let Q := tilde a A p
  have hp := hP.fits
  have hh : 1 ≤ a := H_ge j
  have hA : 0 ≤ A := by obtain ⟨_,_,_,ha,_⟩ := hP.cap; exact ha.nonneg
  have hZ : 2+2*(s.length:ℝ) ≤ a^130 := by linarith [show _ ≤ a^130 from h]
  have hM (x : Grid M) : mixForm s x ≤ s.length*A x := mix_bound (fun i hi => (hS i hi).2) x
  have hR : 0 ≤ p.invlen := p.invlen_pos.le
  have hX : S M (1000*p.invlen) ≤ Q := by
    apply le_add_of_nonneg_left
    intro i; exact mul_nonneg (pow_nonneg (by linarith : 0 ≤ a) _) (hA i)
  have hS' (i) (hi:i∈s) : 0 ≤ i.1 := (hS i hi).1
  have hF₁ : (2:ℝ) • mixForm s ≤ Q := by
    intro i
    have hh := hM i
    have h2 := S_nonneg M (1000*p.invlen) i
    have h3 : 0 ≤ A i := hA i
    change 0 ≤ S M (1000*p.invlen) i at h2
    change 2*mixForm s i ≤ a^130*A i+_
    nlinarith
  have hF₂ : A+place p M+mixForm s ≤ Q := by
    intro i
    have hh := hM i
    have h₂ := S_mono (M:=M) (b:=1000*p.invlen) hR (by linarith) i
    have h3 : 0 ≤ A i := hA i
    change A i+S M _ i + _ ≤ a^130*A i+S M (1000*p.invlen) i
    have hi : 0 ≤ (s.length:ℝ) := by positivity
    nlinarith
  have hlo := posterior_denominator hp hX hq s hs hS' hF₁
  have hhi := u.one_clone_tail hp hA Hu Hr s hS' hF₂ z
  let D := cushion j
  let L := clones j
  let T := 2*sLen j
  let b := beta u.ix/4
  have hL : 0 < (L:ℝ) := by unfold L; exact_mod_cast clones_pos j
  have hb : 0 < b := div_pos (beta_pos _) (by norm_num)
  apply le_of_mul_le_mul_left _ (pow_pos hb T)
  have H₀ : expU (fun x => prefixE s p x * u.alarmQ A z x) ≤
      L * expU (fun x => prefixE s p x * u.singleQ A z x) := by
    rw [expU_ex,expU_ex,← Ex_lmul]; refine Ex_mono _ fun x => ?_
    exact le_trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (u.alarm_le _ _ _) (prefixE_nonneg _ _ _)) (le_of_eq (by ring))
  calc
    _ ≤ b^T*(L * expU (fun x => prefixE s p x * u.singleQ A z x)) := by gcongr
    _ ≤ ↑L * exp (32-F (A+place p M)-E/4+4*D) := by
      rw [mul_left_comm]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hhi hL.le
    _ ≤ b^T*(exp (- (E/8)) * (exp (- (2*D)-F Q)/4)) := by
      have hc := exp_pos
      apply le_of_not_gt
      intro he
      have hz₀ := log_lt_log (show 0 < b^T*(exp ( - (E/8))*(exp (- (2*D)-F Q)/4)) by positivity) he
      rw [log_mul,log_pow,log_mul,Real.log_div (x:=exp (-(2*D)-F Q)) (y:=4),log_mul] at hz₀
      · simp_rw [log_exp] at hz₀
        have hY : log (L:ℝ)+ log 4 +32+6*D+height j / a^4 - (T:ℝ)*log b ≤ E/8 :=
          ht u.ix Hu.ix_ok _ Hu.reserves.1
        have hh' : F Q - F (A+place p M) ≤ height j/a^4 := hC' M p A hP
        linarith
      all_goals positivity
    _ ≤ _ := by
      gcongr

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.exists_uniform_sub
statement:
lemma exists_uniform_sub {s : Finset (Grid l)} (hs : s.Nonempty) :
    ∃ p : Law (Grid l), supported s p ∧ evenly s p
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have : Nonempty (s:Type) := Finset.Nonempty.to_subtype hs
  let f : s → Grid l := fun x => x.val
  refine ⟨(uniform _).send f, ?_,?_⟩
  · intro i hi; obtain ⟨x,rfl,_⟩ := (send_pos_iff _ _ _).mp hi
    exact x.property
  intro i hi
  rw [send_apply,prob_eq]
  simp_rw [uniform_apply,Fintype.card_coe]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (⟨i,hi⟩:s),ite_eq_left rfl]
  · intro j _ hj
    exact ite_eq_right (fun h => hj (Subtype.ext h))
  simp

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.represent_law
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x,hx⟩ := mem_nonempty P
  have hx' := hp x hx
  let f (i : Grid l) : s := if hi : i∈s then ⟨i,hi⟩ else ⟨x,hx'⟩
  refine ⟨P.send f,?_⟩
  rw [send_send]
  rw [send_congr_mem P (Y:=fun x => x),send_id]
  intro y hy
  simp [f,hp y hy]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.averageCost_pos
statement:
lemma averageCost_pos (hl : l ≤ M) (p : Law (Grid l)) (x : Grid l) :
    0 ≤ averageCost hl p x
proof: := fun _ => prob_nonneg _ _

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.average_form
statement:
lemma average_form (hl : l ≤ M) (p : Law (Grid l)) (x : Grid l) (t : Grid M) :
    form (averageCost hl p x) t = p.Ex (fun y => cost (raise hl (y-x)) t)
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [form,averageCost,prob,← Ex_mul,← Ex_finset_sum]
  congr 1; funext i
  simp only [ite_mul, one_mul,zero_mul]
  simp

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.spectral_compression
statement:
lemma spectral_compression (D : ℝ) (hD : 1 ≤ D) :
    ∀ᶠ j : ℕ in atTop, ∀ (M l : ℕ) (hl : l ≤ M) (A : Form M)
      (R : ℝ) (hA : 0 ≤ A), 2^(M-l) ≤ R → S M R ≤ A →
      -log (fq hl A hA 0) ≤ D*height j →
      ∀ (s : Finset (Grid l)), s.Nonempty →
        (∀ n : ℕ, n ≤ 2^(2*j) → Compress.lnS (Fin n) (fun x : s => (x:Grid l)) ≤ height j * (j:ℝ)^2) →
        ∀ t : ℝ, height j/(slow j:ℝ)^2 ≤ t → t ≤ D*height j →
        (∀ P : Law (Grid l), supported s P → levelCost hl A P (sLen j) ≤ t) →
        ∃ (x : Grid l) (u : Finset (Grid l)), x∈s ∧ u⊆s ∧ u.Nonempty ∧
          log (s.card:ℝ)-log (u.card:ℝ) ≤ shrinkScale D j/t ∧
          ∀ P : Law (Grid l), supported u P →
            F (A + long j • averageCost hl P x) - F A ≤ 350*t
proof:
:= by
  classical
  filter_upwards [Compress.entropy_compression D hD] with j hj
  intro M l hl A R hA hR hH hp s hs hL t ht ht' hT
  have : Nonempty (s:Type) := Finset.Nonempty.to_subtype hs
  let f : s → Grid l := fun x => x
  obtain ⟨h0,h1,h2,h3,h4,_⟩ := fq_spec hl A hA hR hH
  obtain ⟨x,u,hu,hv,H⟩ := hj s (Grid l) (Grid M) _ _ _ inferInstance _ _ f Subtype.val_injective
    (fq hl A hA) h0 (fq_cost hl A) h1 h2 (label A) (raiseChar hl)
    (by intro t i; rw [raiseChar_eq,norm_chi]) h3 h4 hp hL t ht ht' (by
    intro p
    let P := p.send f
    have HH := (hT P fun i hi => by
      obtain ⟨x,rfl,_⟩ := (send_pos_iff _ _ _).mp hi
      exact x.property)
    have hn (i : Grid M) : 0 < cred A i := by
      unfold cred
      exact div_pos (q_pos_one hA (lt_of_lt_of_le (S_one_pos
        ((one_le_pow₀ (by norm_num : (1:ℝ)≤2)).trans hR)) (hH _)) _) (q_origin_pos _)
    rw [selected_heat _ hl A hn p f,← heat_exp]
    exact exp_monotone (neg_le_neg HH))
  let w := u.image f
  have hw : w⊆s := by
    intro a ha
    obtain ⟨x,hx,rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp ha
    exact x.property
  refine ⟨x,w,x.property,hw,hu.image f,?_,?_⟩
  · rw [Fintype.card_coe] at hv
    rw [show w.card=u.card from Finset.card_image_of_injective u Subtype.val_injective]
    apply hv.trans; unfold shrinkScale; exact le_of_eq (by ring)
  intro P hP
  obtain ⟨Q,hQ⟩ := represent_law (s:=s) (show supported s P from fun x hx => hw (hP x hx))
  have hU (y) (hy : 0 < Q y) : y∈u := by
    have he : 0 < P (f y) := hQ ▸ Q.send_pos f hy
    obtain ⟨x,hx,H⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp (hP _ he)
    rwa [Subtype.ext H] at hx
  have He := H Q hU
  let B := averageCost hl P x
  have hX (y : Grid M) :
      exp ((-long j)*Q.Ex (fun i => Compress.defect f (raiseChar hl) i x y)) =
        boltz (long j • B) y := by
    unfold B boltz; rw [form_smul,average_form,← hQ,Ex_send]
    refine congrArg exp ?_; rw [neg_mul]
    simp_rw [Compress.defect,raiseChar_eq,cost,wave]
    rfl
  simp_rw [hX,boltz_mean, Real.exp_le_exp] at He
  change F (A+long j • B)-F A ≤ _
  linarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.choose_compression
statement:
lemma choose_compression {hl : l ≤ M} {A : Form M} {T : ℕ} {s : Finset (Grid l)} {b c Z L : ℝ}
    (hc : 0 < c) (hZ : 0 ≤ Z) (hb : c ≤ b)
    (H : ∀ u : Finset (Grid l), u ⊆ s → u.Nonempty →
      ∀ t : ℝ, c ≤ t → t ≤ b →
      (∀ P : Law (Grid l), supported u P → levelCost hl A P T ≤ t) →
      ∃ (x : Grid l) (w : Finset (Grid l)), x∈u ∧ w⊆u ∧ w.Nonempty ∧
          log (u.card:ℝ)-log (w.card:ℝ) ≤ Z/t ∧
          ∀ P : Law (Grid l), supported w P →
            F (A + L • averageCost hl P x) - F A ≤ 350*t)
    (hs : s.Nonempty) (hM : ∀ P : Law (Grid l), supported s P → levelCost hl A P T ≤ b) :
    ∃ (x : Grid l) (w : Finset (Grid l)) (P : Law (Grid l)) (t : ℝ),
      c ≤ t ∧ t ≤ b ∧ x∈s ∧ w⊆s ∧ w.Nonempty ∧ supported w P ∧
      log (s.card:ℝ)-log (w.card:ℝ) ≤ 4*Z/c ∧
      F (A + L • averageCost hl P x) - F A ≤ 350*t ∧
      ((t = c ∧ evenly w P) ∨ t/4 ≤ levelCost hl A P T)
proof:
:= by
  let Good (w : Finset (Grid l)) (x : Grid l) (P : Law (Grid l)) (t : ℝ) : Prop :=
    F (A + L • averageCost hl P x) - F A ≤ 350*t ∧
        ((t=c ∧ evenly w P) ∨ t/4 ≤ levelCost hl A P T)
  have bottom (u : Finset (Grid l)) (hu : u⊆s) (hv : u.Nonempty)
      (ht : ∀ P : Law (Grid l), supported u P → levelCost hl A P T ≤ c) :
      ∃ (x : Grid l) (w : Finset (Grid l)) (P : Law (Grid l)),
        x∈s ∧ w⊆s ∧ w.Nonempty ∧ supported w P ∧
        log (u.card:ℝ)-log (w.card:ℝ) ≤ Z/c ∧ Good w x P c := by
    obtain ⟨x,w,hx,hw,hS,h1,h2⟩ := H u hu hv c le_rfl hb ht
    obtain ⟨P,h3,h4⟩ := exists_uniform_sub hS
    exact ⟨x,w,P,hu hx,Finset.Subset.trans hw hu,hS,h3,h1,h2 _ h3,Or.inl ⟨rfl,h4⟩⟩
  let K := fun (u : Finset (Grid l)) (f : ℝ) => ∃ (x : Grid l)
      (w : Finset (Grid l)) (P : Law (Grid l)) (t : ℝ),
      c ≤ t ∧ t ≤ b ∧ x∈s ∧ w⊆s ∧ w.Nonempty ∧ supported w P ∧
      log (u.card:ℝ)-log (w.card:ℝ) ≤ 4*Z/c-Z/f ∧ Good w x P t
  have HH (n : ℕ) (u : Finset (Grid l)) (hu : u⊆s) (h0 : u.Nonempty)
      (f : ℝ) (hf : c ≤ f) (hB : f ≤ b) (he : f ≤ n*c) (hi : ∀ P : Law (Grid l),
        supported u P → levelCost hl A P T ≤ f) : K u f := by
    induction n generalizing u f with
    | zero => norm_num at he; linarith
    | succ n ih =>
    have hp : 0 < f := lt_of_lt_of_le hc hf
    have h1 : Z/f ≤ Z/c := by gcongr
    have hN : 0 ≤ Z/c := div_nonneg hZ hc.le
    obtain ⟨x,w,hx,hw,hS,hG,hM⟩ := H _ hu h0 f hf hB hi
    by_cases h : ∃ P : Law (Grid l), supported w P ∧ f/4 ≤ levelCost hl A P T
    · rcases h with ⟨P,hP,hE⟩
      exact ⟨x,w,P,f,hf,hB,hu hx,Finset.Subset.trans hw hu,hS,hP,by rw [mul_div_assoc]; linarith,hM _ hP,Or.inr hE⟩
    have h2 (P : Law (Grid l)) (hP : supported w P) : levelCost hl A P T ≤ f/4 :=
      le_of_lt <| lt_of_not_ge fun hh => h ⟨P,hP,hh⟩
    rcases le_total (f/4) c with hy|hy
    · obtain ⟨x,V,P,h1',h2',h3,h4,h5,h6⟩ := bottom w (Finset.Subset.trans hw hu) hS
        (fun x hx => (h2 x hx).trans hy)
      exact ⟨x,V,P,c,le_rfl,hb,h1',h2',h3,h4,by rw [mul_div_assoc]; linarith,h6⟩
    obtain ⟨x,V,P,t,h1',h2',h3,h4,h5,h6,h7,h8⟩ := ih w (Finset.Subset.trans hw hu) hS
      (f/4) hy (by linarith) (by push_cast at he; nlinarith) h2
    rw [show Z/(f/4)=4*(Z/f) by ring] at h7
    exact ⟨x,V,P,t,h1',h2',h3,h4,h5,h6,by linarith [div_nonneg hZ hp.le],h8⟩
  obtain ⟨n,hn⟩ := exists_nat_gt (b/c)
  obtain ⟨x,w,P,t,h1,h2,h3,h4,h5,h6,h7,h8⟩ :=
    HH n s (Finset.Subset.refl _) hs b hb le_rfl ((div_lt_iff₀ hc).mp hn).le hM
  exact ⟨x,w,P,t,h1,h2,h3,h4,h5,h6,h7.trans (sub_le_self _ (div_nonneg hZ (hc.le.trans hb))),h8⟩

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.cert_S_energy
statement:
lemma cert_S_energy {n : ℕ} {p : Node} {h err : ℝ} {A : Form M} (H : Certified h err n p A) :
    (label A).Ex (form (place p M)) ≤ 100
proof:
:= by
  rcases H.prev with ⟨he,_⟩ | he
  · subst p
    refine le_trans (b:=(label A).Ex (fun _ => 2)) (Ex_mono _ fun x => ?_)
      (by rw [Ex_const]; norm_num)
    rw [place, invlen_top, form_S]; simp [(cost_bounds 1 x).2]
  exact S_energy _ p.invlen_ge (loc_scale H.fits.2) A he

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.local_channel_energy
proof:
:= by
  let P := label A
  let B := place p M
  let t := start p M
  rw [ch_ex]
  change P.Ex (fun z => form B (x+z-t)) ≤ _
  calc
    _ ≤ P.Ex (fun z => 2*(form B z+form B (x-t))) := Ex_mono _ fun z => by
      rw [show x+z-t=z+(x-t) by ring]
      exact form_triangle (place_valid _ _) _ _
    _ ≤ _ := by
      rw [Ex_lmul,Ex_add (g:=fun _ => form B (x-t)),Ex_const]
      have hh : P.Ex (form B) ≤ 100 := cert_S_energy H
      have he : form B (x-t) ≤ 32 := place_internal hx (start_mem H.fits.1 H.fits.2)
      linarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.side_entropy
statement:
lemma side_entropy {n : ℕ} {p : Node} {h err : ℝ} {A : Form M}
    (H : Certified h err n p A) (x : Grid M) (hx : x ∈ p.block M) :
    (channel A x).Ex (fun z => log (channel A x z) -
      log (channel (place p M) (p.start M) z)) ≤ F A-log p.invlen+300
proof:
:= by
  let B := place p M
  let t := start p M
  let P := channel A x
  refine le_trans (b:=P.Ex (fun z => F A-F B+form B (z-t))) (Ex_mono _ fun z => ?_) ?_
  · change log (channel A x z) - log (channel B t z) ≤ _
    rw [ch_K,ch_K, log_mul (side_pos _).ne' (K_pos _ _).ne',
      log_mul (side_pos _).ne' (K_pos _ _).ne', K_eq, K_eq,log_exp,log_exp]
    linarith [form_nonneg H.nonneg (z-x)]
  · rw [Ex_add,Ex_const]
    have he := local_channel_energy H x hx
    have hi : log p.invlen-12 ≤ F B :=
      F_S_lower _ p.invlen_pos (loc_scale H.fits.2)
    unfold P B t at *; linarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.log_input_bound
statement:
lemma log_input_bound {p : Node} (hp : p.ok M) {a : Grid M → ℝ}
    {P : Law (Grid M)} (h : PieceLaw p a P) {d : ℝ} (h1 : ∀ x, a x ≤ exp d)
    (hm : exp (-d) ≤ p.avg a) (x : Grid M) (hx : 0 < P x) :
    log (P x) ≤ 2*d+log (side M)+log p.invlen
proof:
:= by
  have Hi := piece_support hp h _ hx
  have H := log_le_log hx (piece_density h h1 hm x)
  rw [dice_apply hp,ite_eq_left Hi,← rinv] at H
  rw [log_mul (exp_pos _).ne' (by have := side_pos M; have := p.invlen_pos; positivity),
    log_mul (side_pos _).ne' p.invlen_pos.ne', log_exp] at H
  linarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.cut_sum_bound
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Finset.sum_image (s:=p.group M)]
  · exact Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (Finset.subset_univ _) (fun x _ _ => hf x)
  intro x hx y hy he
  exact cut_injOn hp hv.2 hh ((mem_group _ _).mp hx) ((mem_group _ _).mp hy) he

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.log_side_ratio
statement: lemma log_side_ratio (hl : l ≤ M) : log (side M)-log (side l) = -log ((2:ℝ)^(M-l))
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [side_pow_two, Real.log_inv]
  simp_rw [Real.log_pow]
  rw [Nat.cast_sub hl]
  ring

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.product_entropy_bound
statement:
lemma product_entropy_bound {p p' : Node} {a : Grid M → ℝ} (hp : p.ok M) (hv : p.below p')
    {n : ℕ} {h err : ℝ} {A : Form M} (H : Certified h err n p' A)
    {P : Law (Grid M)} (ht : PieceLaw p a P) (hl : l ≤ M) (hh : M-l ≤ p.lev)
    {d : ℝ} (h1 : ∀ x, a x ≤ exp d) (hm : exp (-d) ≤ p.avg a) (B : Bool)
    (Q : Grid l → Grid M → ℝ) (hQ : ∀ x z, 0 < Q x z)
    (hQ' : ∀ z, expU (fun x => Q x z) ≤ 1) :
    (P.withNext (channel A)).Ex (fun xz => if xz.1∈(p.child B).block M then
      log (Q (cut hl xz.1) xz.2) else 0) ≤
        2*d + log p.invlen - log ((2:ℝ)^(M-l)) + F A - log p'.invlen + 301
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let C (x : Grid M) : Prop := x ∈ (p.child B).block M
  let T (x z : Grid M) := if C x then Q (cut hl x) z else 1
  have hT (x z) : 0 < T x z := by unfold T; split_ifs; exact hQ _ _; norm_num
  let L := channel (place p' M) (p'.start M)
  let v (xz : Grid M × Grid M) := if xz.1∈p.block M then side l * (L xz.2 * T xz.1 xz.2)/2 else 0
  have hvL (z) : 0 < L z := ch_pos _ _ _
  have hvV (xz) : 0 ≤ v xz := by
    unfold v; split_ifs
    · have := side_pos l; have := hvL xz.2; have := hT xz.1 xz.2; positivity
    · exact le_rfl
  have hcV : ∑ xz, v xz ≤ 1 := by
    rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type,Finset.sum_comm,← L.total]
    refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun z _ => ?_
    have he : ∑ x ∈ p.group M, side l * T x z ≤ 2 :=
      calc
        _ ≤ ∑ x ∈ p.group M, side l * (1+Q (cut hl x) z) :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum fun x hx => by
            apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (side_pos _).le
            unfold T; split_ifs
            · linarith
            · linarith [hQ (cut hl x) z]
        _ ≤ ∑ x, side l * (1+Q x z) := cut_sum_bound hl hp hh (fun x => side l*(1+Q x z))
          (fun x => by have := side_pos l; have := hQ x z; positivity)
        _ ≤ _ := by
          rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
          change expU (fun x => 1+Q x z) ≤ _
          rw [expU_ex,Ex_add,Ex_const,← expU_ex]
          linarith [hQ' z]
    have hA : (p.group M)=Finset.univ.filter fun x => x∈p.block M := by ext x; simp [mem_group]
    calc
      _ = (L z / 2) * (∑ x ∈ p.group M, side l*T x z) := by
        unfold v; rw [Finset.mul_sum,hA,Finset.sum_filter]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun x _ => ?_
        split_ifs <;> ring
      _ ≤ _ := by nlinarith [hvL z]
  let U := P.withNext (channel A)
  have hUS (x z : Grid M) (hx : 0 < U (x,z)) : 0 < P x := by
    rw [show U (x,z) = P x * channel A x z from rfl] at hx
    exact pos_of_mul_pos_left hx (ch_pos _ _ _).le
  have hhV (xz : Grid M × Grid M) (hx : 0 < U xz) : 0 < v xz := by
    obtain ⟨x,z⟩ := xz
    change 0 < if x∈p.block M then _ else _
    rw [ite_eq_left (piece_support hp ht _ (hUS x z hx))]
    have := side_pos l; have := hvL z; have := hT x z; positivity
  have He := entropy_le_cross_aux U v hvV hcV hhV
  unfold entropy crossE at He
  simp_rw [Ex_neg] at He
  let f := fun xz : Grid M × Grid M => log (P xz.1)
  let g := fun xz : Grid M × Grid M => log (channel A xz.1 xz.2)-log (L xz.2)
  let W := fun xz : Grid M × Grid M => if xz.1∈(p.child B).block M then
    log (Q (cut hl xz.1) xz.2) else 0
  have hE : U.Ex W ≤ U.Ex f + U.Ex g + log 2-log (side l) := by
    have Hx (p0 : Grid M × Grid M) (hx : 0 < U p0) :
      W p0 = f p0+g p0+(log 2-log (side l)) + (log (v p0)-log (U p0)) := by
      obtain ⟨x,z⟩ := p0
      have hx' := hUS x z hx
      unfold W f g v; dsimp
      rw [ite_eq_left (piece_support hp ht _ hx')]
      change (if x∈_ then _ else _) = log (P x)+_+_+(log (side l*(L z*T x z)/2)-log (P x * channel A x z))
      rw [Real.log_div (by have := side_pos l; have := hvL z; have := hT x z; positivity) (by norm_num),
        log_mul (side_pos _).ne' (mul_pos (hvL _) (hT _ _)).ne',
        log_mul (hvL z).ne' (hT _ _).ne',
        log_mul hx'.ne' (ch_pos _ _ _).ne']
      unfold T C; split_ifs
      · ring
      rw [log_one]; ring
    rw [Ex_congr_mem _ Hx]
    simp_rw [Ex_add,Ex_sub,Ex_const]
    linarith
  have Hf : U.Ex f ≤ 2*d+log (side M)+log p.invlen := by
    unfold U f
    simp_rw [Ex_withNext,Ex_const]
    rw [← Ex_const P (2*d+log (side M)+log p.invlen)]
    exact Ex_mono_mem _ (log_input_bound hp ht h1 hm)
  have Hg : U.Ex g ≤ F A-log p'.invlen+300 := by
    unfold U g
    rw [Ex_withNext,← Ex_const P (F A-log p'.invlen+300)]
    exact Ex_mono_mem _ fun x hx => side_entropy H x (block_of_below hv M (piece_support hp ht _ hx))
  have Ht := log_side_ratio hl
  change U.Ex W ≤ _
  linarith [log_le_sub_one_of_pos (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<2)]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.wave_at_one
statement:
lemma wave_at_one (x : Grid M) :
    wave 1 x = cos (2*π * pos x)
proof:
:= by
  have H := chi_cast (1:ℤ) x
  unfold wave; norm_num [phase] at H
  rw [H,Complex.exp_re]
  simp

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.wave_at_diam
statement:
lemma wave_at_diam (x : Grid M) :
    wave 1 x = cos (2*π * Dyadic.diam x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [diam_min]
  rcases le_total (pos x) (pos (-x)) with h | h
  · rw [min_eq_left h,wave_at_one]
  rw [min_eq_right h,← wave_at_one,wave_even _ _]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.cost_diam
statement:
theorem cost_diam (x : Grid M) :
    8*(Dyadic.diam x)^2 ≤ cost 1 x ∧ cost 1 x ≤ 32*(Dyadic.diam x)^2
proof:
:= by
  let y := Dyadic.diam x
  have hy := diam_nonneg x
  have hY := diam_le_half x
  unfold cost
  rw [wave_at_diam]
  have hp : 0 ≤ 2*π*y := mul_nonneg (by positivity) hy
  have he : |2*π*y| ≤ π := by rw [abs_of_nonneg hp]; unfold y at *; nlinarith [pi_pos]
  have H := cos_le_one_sub_mul_cos_sq he
  have H' := @one_sub_sq_div_two_le_cos (2*π*y)
  have hh : 2/π^2 * (2*π*y)^2 = 8*y^2 := by field_simp [pi_pos.ne']; ring
  have hh' : (2*π*y)^2/2 ≤ 32*y^2 := by
    calc
      _ = (2*π^2)*y^2 := by ring
      _ ≤ _ := by gcongr; nlinarith [pi_le_four,pi_pos]
  rw [hh] at H
  change 8*y^2 ≤ _ ∧ _ ≤ 32*y^2
  dsimp only [y] at *
  constructor <;> linarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.S_nonneg
statement: lemma S_nonneg (M : ℕ) (R : ℝ) : 0 ≤ S M R
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  change 0 ≤ if i=1 then _ else _
  split_ifs <;> positivity

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.form_S
statement: lemma form_S (R : ℝ) (x : Grid M) : form (S M R) x = R^2*cost 1 x
proof: := by simp [form,S,ite_mul]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.scale_S
statement: lemma scale_S (M : ℕ) (t R : ℝ) : t^2 • S M R = S M (t*R)
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  change t^2*(if i=1 then _ else _) = if i=1 then _ else _
  split_ifs <;> ring

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.S_mono
statement: lemma S_mono {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (h : a ≤ b) : S M a ≤ S M b
proof:
:= by
  intro i; unfold S
  split_ifs <;> nlinarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.expU_ray
statement:
private lemma expU_ray (R : ℝ) (h : 0 < R) :
    expU (fun x : Grid M => exp (-R * pos x)) ≤ side M + 1/R
proof:
:= by
  let a := R*side M
  have ha : 0 < a := mul_pos h (side_pos M)
  let q := exp (-a)
  have hq : 0 ≤ q := exp_nonneg _
  let m := 2^M
  let b := ∑ i ∈ Finset.range m, q^i
  have heq : expU (fun x : Grid M => exp (-R*pos x)) = side M * b := by
    have he (x : Grid M) : exp (-R*pos x) = q^x.val := by
      unfold q pos a
      rw [← Real.exp_nat_mul]; congr 1; ring
    simp_rw [he,expU,smul_eq_mul]
    rw [sum_grid (M:=M) (fun i => q^i)]
  have h1 : b * (1-q) ≤ 1 := by
    rw [show b*(1-q) = _ from geom_sum_mul_neg q m]
    have hh : 0 ≤ q^m := pow_nonneg hq _
    linarith
  have h2 : 1-q ≥ a/(1+a) := by
    have H := Real.add_one_le_exp a
    have HH : q*exp a = 1 := by unfold q; rw [← exp_add]; simp
    apply (div_le_iff₀ (by linarith)).mpr; nlinarith
  have hb : 0 ≤ b := Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => pow_nonneg hq _
  have hu : b*a ≤ 1+a := by
    apply (div_le_one (by linarith)).mp
    rw [mul_div_assoc]
    exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2 hb).trans h1
  rw [heq,← mul_le_mul_iff_left₀ h]
  unfold a at hu
  field_simp
  nlinarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.q_S_upper
statement:
lemma q_S_upper (R : ℝ) (h : 0 < R) :
    q (S M R) 0 ≤ 6*(side M+1/R)
proof:
:= by
  let f (x : Grid M) := exp (-R*pos x)
  have H (x : Grid M) :
      boltz (S M R) x ≤ 3*(f x + f (-x)) := by
    let y := Dyadic.diam x
    have H := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (cost_diam x).1 (sq_nonneg R)
    calc
      _ ≤ exp (1 + -R*y) := by
          unfold boltz
          rw [form_S]
          apply Real.exp_monotone
          dsimp only [y]
          nlinarith [sq_nonneg (4*R*Dyadic.diam x-1/4)]
      _ = exp 1 * exp (-R*y) := exp_add _ _
      _ ≤ _ := by
        apply mul_le_mul Real.exp_one_lt_three.le _ (Real.exp_nonneg _) (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) ≤ 3)
        dsimp only [y]; rw [diam_min]
        rcases le_total (pos x) (pos (-x)) with hh|hh
        · rw [min_eq_left hh]; exact le_add_of_nonneg_right (exp_nonneg _)
        rw [min_eq_right hh]; exact le_add_of_nonneg_left (exp_nonneg _)
  rw [q_origin,expU_ex]
  apply le_trans (Ex_mono _ H)
  rw [Ex_lmul,Ex_add]
  simp_rw [← expU_ex,expU_reflect]
  have he : expU f ≤ side M+1/R := expU_ray R h
  simp only [div_eq_mul_inv] at *; linarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.q_S_lower
statement:
lemma q_S_lower (R : ℝ) (h : 1 ≤ R) :
    (1/30:ℝ)/R ≤ q (S M R) 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [q_origin]
  let m : ℝ := 2^M
  let r := (m/10)/R
  let s := arc M r
  have hR : 0 < R := by linarith
  have hm : 0 < m := by unfold m; positivity
  have hr : 0 ≤ r := by unfold r; positivity
  have hsr : side M * m = 1 := side_card _
  have hsr' : side M * r = (1/10)/R := by unfold r; rw [← hsr]; ring
  have h1 : r ≤ s.card := arc_card_lo _ _ hr (by
    unfold r; apply (div_le_iff₀ hR).mpr; change m/10 ≤ m*R; nlinarith)
  have h2 (i : Grid M) (hi : i∈s) : 1/3 ≤ boltz (S M R) i := by
    have hy : 0 ≤ Dyadic.diam i := diam_nonneg i
    have hh : Dyadic.diam i * R ≤ 1/10 := by
      apply (le_div_iff₀ hR).mp
      rw [← hsr']
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ((mem_arc _ _).mp hi) (side_pos _).le
    have hj : form (S M R) i ≤ 1 := by
      rw [form_S]
      apply le_trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (cost_diam i).2 (sq_nonneg _))
      have H : (Dyadic.diam i * R)^2 ≤ (1/10:ℝ)^2 :=
        pow_le_pow_left₀ (mul_nonneg hy hR.le) hh 2
      nlinarith
    apply le_trans (b:=exp (-1))
    · rw [exp_neg,one_div]; exact (inv_le_inv₀ (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) < 3) (exp_pos 1)).mpr Real.exp_one_lt_three.le
    exact Real.exp_monotone (by linarith)
  unfold expU; rw [smul_eq_mul]
  calc
    _ = side M * r * (1/3) := by rw [hsr']; ring
    _ ≤ side M * s.card * (1/3) := by have := side_pos M; gcongr
    _ = side M * (∑ _i ∈ s, (1/3:ℝ)) := by simp; ring
    _ ≤ side M * ∑ i ∈ s, boltz (S M R) i :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Finset.sum_le_sum h2) (side_pos M).le
    _ ≤ side M * ∑ i, boltz (S M R) i :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg
        (Finset.subset_univ _) (fun _ _ _ => (boltz_pos _ _).le)) (side_pos M).le

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.q_S_upper'
statement:
lemma q_S_upper' (R : ℝ) (h : 0 < R) (hR : R ≤ 2^M) :
    q (S M R) 0 ≤ 12/R
proof:
:= by
  apply le_trans (q_S_upper R h)
  have hh : side M ≤ 1/R := by rw [side_pow_two,one_div]; exact (inv_le_inv₀ (by positivity : (0:ℝ) < 2^M) h).mpr hR
  simp only [div_eq_mul_inv] at *; linarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.F_S_lower
statement:
lemma F_S_lower (R : ℝ) (h : 0 < R) (hR : R ≤ 2^M) :
    log R - 12 ≤ F (S M R)
proof:
:= by
  have H := log_le_log (q_origin_pos _) (q_S_upper' R h hR)
  rw [Real.log_div (by norm_num) h.ne'] at H
  unfold F
  linarith [Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (show (0:ℝ)<12 by norm_num)]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.F_S_upper
statement:
lemma F_S_upper (M : ℕ) (R : ℝ) (h : 1 ≤ R) :
    F (S M R) ≤ log R+30
proof:
:= by
  have hp : 0 < R := by linarith
  have H := log_le_log (by positivity) (q_S_lower (M:=M) R h)
  rw [Real.log_div (by norm_num) hp.ne',one_div,Real.log_inv] at H
  unfold F
  linarith [Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (show (0:ℝ)<30 by norm_num)]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.S_energy
statement:
lemma S_energy (R : ℝ) (h : 1 ≤ R) (hR : R ≤ 2^M) (A : Form M) (hA : S M R ≤ A) :
    (label A).Ex (form (S M R)) ≤ 100
proof:
:= by
  let B := S M R
  apply le_trans (form_energy_mono (S_nonneg _ _) hA (S_nonneg _ _))
  let C := S M (R/2)
  have He : C+(3/4:ℝ) • B = B := by
    have HH := scale_S M (1/2) R
    rw [show 1/2*R=R/2 by ring] at HH
    unfold B C
    rw [← HH,← add_smul,show (1/2:ℝ)^2+3/4=1 by norm_num,one_smul]
  have H := mean_energy C ((3/4:ℝ) • B)
  rw [He,show form ((3/4:ℝ) • B) = _ from funext (fun x => form_smul _ _ x),Ex_lmul] at H
  have hP : 0 < R := by linarith
  have h1 : F B ≤ log R + 30 := F_S_upper M R h
  have h2 : log (R/2)-12 ≤ F C := F_S_lower _ (by positivity) (by linarith)
  rw [log_div hP.ne' (by norm_num)] at h2
  change (label B).Ex (form B) ≤ 100
  linarith [Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (show (0:ℝ)<2 by norm_num)]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.S_cost
statement:
lemma S_cost (R : ℝ) (h : 1 ≤ R) (hR : R ≤ 2^M) (A : Form M) (hA : S M R ≤ A) :
    (label A).Ex (cost 1) ≤ 100/R^2
proof:
:= by
  have H := S_energy R h hR A hA
  rw [show form (S M R) = _ from funext (form_S R),Ex_lmul] at H
  exact (le_div_iff₀ (sq_pos_of_pos (by linarith : 0 < R))).mpr (by rwa [mul_comm])

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.S_variance
statement:
lemma S_variance (R : ℝ) (h : 1 ≤ R) (hR : R ≤ 2^M) (A : Form M) (hA : S M R ≤ A) :
    (label A).Ex (fun i => (Dyadic.diam i)^2) ≤ 100/R^2
proof:
:= by
  apply le_trans _ (S_cost _ h hR A hA)
  exact Ex_mono _ fun x => (le_mul_of_one_le_left (sq_nonneg _) (by norm_num : (1:ℝ)≤8)).trans (cost_diam x).1

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.delta_S
statement:
lemma delta_S (R : ℝ) (h : 1 ≤ R) (hR : R ≤ 2^M) (A : Form M) (hA : S M R ≤ A)
    (s : Grid M) : delta A s ≤ rad s * (20/R)
proof:
:= by
  have hp : 0 < R := by linarith
  have h1 := S_cost R h hR A hA
  rw [cred_cost] at h1
  have h2 := delta_sq A 1
  have h3 : delta A 1 ≤ 20/R := by
    have h4 : delta A 1^2 ≤ (20/R)^2 := by
      apply le_trans (b:=2*(100/R^2)); rw [h2]; linarith
      rw [div_pow,← mul_div_assoc]; apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_right _ (sq_nonneg _); norm_num
    nlinarith [show 0 < 20/R by positivity]
  calc
    _ ≤ rad s * delta A 1 := by simpa only [rad_abs,liftInt_cast] using delta_int A (liftInt s)
    _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h3 (rad_nonneg _)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.cred_short
statement:
lemma cred_short (R : ℝ) (h : 1 ≤ R) (hR : R ≤ 2^M) (A : Form M) (hA : S M R ≤ A)
    (s : Grid M) (hs : rad s ≤ R/20) :
    1/2 ≤ cred A s
proof:
:= by
  have hp : 0 < R := by linarith
  have hi : delta A s ≤ 1 := calc
    _ ≤ _ := delta_S _ h hR A hA s
    _ ≤ (R/20) * (20/R) := by gcongr
    _ = 1 := by field_simp
  nlinarith [delta_sq A s,(show 0 ≤ delta A s from sqrt_nonneg _)]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.q_short
statement:
lemma q_short (R : ℝ) (h : 1 ≤ R) (hR : R ≤ 2^M)
    (s : Grid M) (hs : rad s ≤ R/20) :
    (1/60:ℝ)/R ≤ q (S M R) s
proof:
:= by
  let B := S M R
  change _ ≤ q B s
  have hh := cred_short R h hR B le_rfl s hs
  rw [q_express,F_origin]
  calc
    (1/60:ℝ)/R = ((1/30)/R)*(1/2) := by ring
    _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul (q_S_lower R h) hh (by norm_num) (q_origin_pos _).le

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.most_delta
statement:
private lemma most_delta {s : Finset (Grid l)} (hh : s.Nonempty) (P : Law (Grid l))
    (he : evenly s P) (hl : l ≤ M) (A : Form M) (x : Grid l) (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r)
    (H : 4*(label A).Ex (form (averageCost hl P x)) ≤ r^2) :
    ∃ u : Finset (Grid l), u⊆s ∧ s.card ≤ 2*u.card ∧ ∀ y∈u, delta A (raise hl (y-x)) ≤ r
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let f := fun y : Grid l => delta A (raise hl (y-x))
  have hH : 2*P.Ex (fun i => f i^2) ≤ r^2 := by
    have he (i : Grid l) : f i^2 = (label A).Ex (fun y => 2*cost (raise hl (i-x)) y) := by
      rw [Ex_lmul,cred_cost]; exact delta_sq A _
    rw [funext (average_form hl P x)] at H
    rw [Ex_swap (label A) P] at H
    simp_rw [he,Ex_lmul]
    linarith
  let u := s.filter (fun i => f i ≤ r)
  refine ⟨u,Finset.filter_subset _ _,?_,fun y hy => (Finset.mem_filter.mp hy).2⟩
  have hs : (0:ℝ) < s.card := by exact_mod_cast Finset.card_pos.mpr hh
  have HE : ((s\u).card:ℝ)/s.card*r^2 ≤ P.Ex (fun i => f i^2) := calc
    _ = ∑ i∈(s\u), (s.card:ℝ)⁻¹*r^2 := by simp; ring
    _ ≤ ∑ i∈(s\u), P i*f i^2 := Finset.sum_le_sum fun i hi => by
      obtain ⟨h1,h2⟩ := Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hi
      rw [he i h1]
      have hi' : r < f i := lt_of_not_ge (fun hh => h2 (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨h1,hh⟩))
      gcongr
    _ ≤ _ := Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (Finset.subset_univ _)
      fun i _ _ => mul_nonneg (P.nonneg _) (sq_nonneg _)
  have hu : (2:ℝ)*(s\u).card ≤ s.card := by
    field_simp at HE
    by_contra! ht
    have hQ : 0 < r^2 := pow_pos hr _
    nlinarith
  have h1 : 2*(s\u).card ≤ s.card := by exact_mod_cast hu
  rw [Finset.card_sdiff_of_subset (Finset.filter_subset _ _)] at h1
  unfold u; omega

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.spacing
statement:
lemma spacing (C : ℝ) (hC : 1 ≤ C) :
    ∀ᶠ j : ℕ in atTop,
      let η
proof:
:= stepRad C j
      0 < sig j ∧ sig j ≤ 1/4 ∧ 4*sig j ≤ η ∧
        0 < sepRad j ∧ sepRad j ≤ 1 ∧
        4*(400*reserve C/H j^200) ≤ (η/2)^2 ∧
        200-log (sig j) ≤ height j/H j^2 := by
  filter_upwards [h_large (10^8*reserve C),hpoly 1000 3] with j h h'
  intro eta; let a := H j; let s := sig j; let r := sepRad j; let D := reserve C
  have hp : 0 < a := H_pos j; have hh : 1 ≤ a := H_ge j
  have hD : 1 ≤ D := reserve_ge hC
  change 10^8*D ≤ a at h
  have he : s=1/a^40 := rfl
  have hr : r=1/a^30 := rfl
  have hi : eta=1/(10*C*a^31) := by
    unfold eta stepRad; change (1/a^30)/(10*C*a) = _
    ring
  have hC' : 0 < C := by linarith
  have hl : C ≤ D := by unfold D reserve; linarith
  have hx : 100*C ≤ a := by nlinarith
  have h_a (n : ℕ) (ht : 1 ≤ n) : a ≤ a^n := by
    simpa using pow_le_pow_right₀ hh ht
  change 0 < s ∧ s ≤ 1/4 ∧ 4*s ≤ eta ∧
    0 < r ∧ r ≤ 1 ∧ 4*(400*D/a^200) ≤ (eta/2)^2 ∧ 200-log s ≤ _/a^2
  rw [he, hr,hi]
  refine ⟨by positivity, ?_, ?_,by positivity,div_le_self (by norm_num) (one_le_pow₀ hh), ?_, ?_⟩
  · apply one_div_le_one_div_of_le (by norm_num) _
    linarith [h_a 40 (by omega)]
  · have ht : 40*C ≤ a^9 := by linarith [h_a 9 (by omega)]
    rw [show a^40=a^9*a^31 by ring]
    rw [← mul_div_assoc,mul_one]
    apply (div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity) (by positivity)).mpr
    have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ht (by positivity : 0 ≤ a^31)
    nlinarith
  · have ht : 10000*D ≤ a := by linarith
    have hZ : 640000*C^2*D ≤ a^138 := by
      apply le_trans (b:=a^3) _ (pow_le_pow_right₀ hh (by omega))
      calc
        _ ≤ 640000*(a/100)^2*(a/10000) := by gcongr <;> linarith
        _ ≤ _ := by nlinarith [show 0 ≤ a^3 by positivity]
    rw [show a^200 = a^138*(a^31)^2 by ring]
    field_simp
    nlinarith
  rw [log_div (by norm_num) (by positivity),log_one,log_pow]
  apply (le_div_iff₀ (by positivity : 0 < a^2)).mpr
  have he := log_le_sub_one_of_pos hp
  change 1000*a^3 ≤ _ at h'
  push_cast
  nlinarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.r_steps
statement:
lemma r_steps {C : ℝ} (hC : 1 ≤ C) (j n : ℕ) (h : (n:ℝ) ≤ C*H j) :
    0 ≤ track C j n ∧ track C j n ≤ sepRad j / 2
proof:
:= by
  have hp : 0 < H j := H_pos j
  have he : 0 ≤ sepRad j := by change 0 ≤ 1/H j^30; positivity
  have hC' : 0 < C := by linarith
  unfold track stepRad
  refine ⟨by positivity,?_⟩
  calc
    _ ≤ sepRad j/4 + (C*H j)*(sepRad j/(10*C*H j)) := by gcongr
    _ = sepRad j/4 + sepRad j/10 := by field_simp
    _ ≤ _ := by linarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.step_gap
statement:
lemma step_gap (C : ℝ) (hC : 1 ≤ C) :
    ∀ᶠ j : ℕ in atTop, ∀ (M l : ℕ) (hl : l ≤ M) (p : Node), p.ok M →
      ∀ (A V : Form M), 0 ≤ A → A+place p M ≤ V →
      ∀ (x : Grid l) (P : Law (Grid l)) (mult t r : ℝ),
      height j/H j^2 ≤ t → t ≤ reserve C*height j →
      height j*H j^200 ≤ mult → (label V).Ex (form (averageCost hl P x)) ≤ 400*t/mult →
      F V-F (A+place p M) ≤ 400*t → 0 ≤ r → r ≤ sepRad j/2 →
      gap V (r+stepRad C j) - gap A r ≤ 402*t ∧
        (∀ (s : Finset (Grid l)) (k : ℝ),
          s.Nonempty → separated (raise hl) A (sepRad j) (sig j*p.invlen/2) s →
          evenly s P → 4*k/5 ≤ log (s.card:ℝ) → t = eps*k →
          gap V (r+stepRad C j) -gap A r ≤ -(k/2))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  filter_upwards [spacing C hC] with j h
