  intro M l hl p hp A V hA hV x P mult t r ht hD hF hG hE hr hr'
  obtain ⟨hs,hs',he,hh,hh',hq,hS⟩ := h
  have hR : 2*r ≤ 1 := by linarith
  have hη : 0 < stepRad C j := by linarith
  have hI := H_pos j; have hI' := d_pos j
  have hT : 0 < t := lt_of_lt_of_le (by positivity) ht
  constructor
  · let f := fun _ : Grid l => (0:Grid M)
    have hw := gap_packing hp hr hR hs hs' he hA hV f {x} ⟨_,Finset.mem_singleton_self x⟩
      (by intro i hi j hj hn; simp_all)
      (fun i hi => by unfold f; rw [delta_zero]; linarith)
    simp only [Finset.card_singleton,Nat.cast_one,log_one,sub_zero] at hw
    linarith
  intro s k h1 h2 h3 h4 h5
  obtain ⟨u,hu,hcard,hdelta⟩ :=
    most_delta h1 P h3 hl V x (stepRad C j/2) (by linarith) (by
      apply le_trans _ hq
      have hz : 0 < height j* H j^200 := by positivity
      have hY : 400*t/mult ≤ 400*reserve C/H j^200 := calc
        _ ≤ 400*(reserve C*height j)/(height j*H j^200) := by have H := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one (reserve_ge hC); gcongr
        _ = _ := by field_simp
      linarith)
  have hn : u.Nonempty := Finset.card_pos.mp (by have HH := Finset.card_pos.mpr h1; omega)
  let f := fun i : Grid l => raise hl (i-x)
  have hi : separated f A (2*r) (sig j*p.invlen/2) u := by
    intro i hi b hb H H'
    obtain ⟨v,hv,hR⟩ := H'
    apply h2 _ (hu hi) _ (hu hb) H
    use v
    refine ⟨by linarith,?_⟩
    unfold f at hR; simp only [map_sub, sub_sub_sub_cancel_right] at hR; exact hR
  have hw := gap_packing hp hr hR hs hs' he hA hV f u hn hi hdelta
  have hu0 : (0:ℝ)<u.card := by exact_mod_cast Finset.card_pos.mpr hn
  have hv0 : (0:ℝ)<s.card := by exact_mod_cast Finset.card_pos.mpr h1
  have ht' := log_le_log hv0 (show (s.card:ℝ) ≤ 2*u.card by exact_mod_cast hcard)
  rw [Real.log_mul (by norm_num) hu0.ne'] at ht'
  unfold eps at h5
  linarith [log_le_sub_one_of_pos (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<2)]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.prob_translate
statement:
lemma prob_translate (v : Grid M → Prop) (t : Grid M) :
    (uniform _).prob (fun z => v (z-t)) = (uniform _).prob v
proof:
:= by
  unfold prob
  simp_rw [← expU_ex, show ∀ z, z-t = -t+z from fun z => by ring]
  rw [expU_translate (fun z => if v z then (1:ℝ) else 0)]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.dome_prob
statement:
lemma dome_prob (p : Node) (hp : p.ok M) (s : ℝ) (hs : 1 ≤ s) :
    (uniform _).prob (dome p M s) ≤ 4*s/p.invlen
proof:
:= by
  have hr := p.invlen_pos
  have he : (uniform _).prob (dome p M s) ≤ 2*(s/p.invlen + side M) := by
    unfold dome
    rw [prob_translate (fun z => Dyadic.diam z ≤ s/p.invlen)]
    exact arc_length _ _ (by apply div_nonneg <;> linarith)
  have hi : side M ≤ 1/p.invlen := by
    rw [side_pow_two,one_div]
    exact (inv_le_inv₀ (by positivity) hr).mpr (loc_scale hp.2)
  apply le_trans he
  have hx := (le_div_iff₀ hr).mp hi
  field_simp; linarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.prob_as_ex
statement:
lemma prob_as_ex {α : Type} [Fintype α] (P : Law α) (p : α → Prop) [DecidablePred p] :
    P.prob p = P.Ex (fun x => if p x then 1 else 0)
proof:
:= by
  rw [prob_eq]; unfold Ex; simp

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.ch_dome_bound
proof:
:= by
  let C := channel A x


  have hi : C.Ex (fun z => (8*s^2)*(if ¬dome p' M s z then 1 else 0)) ≤ 264 :=
    le_trans (C.Ex_mono (g:=fun z => form (place p' M) (z-p'.start M)) fun z => by
      unfold dome; split_ifs with Hh
      · rw [mul_zero]
        exact form_nonneg (place_valid _ _) _
      · have hp := p'.invlen_pos
        rw [not_le] at Hh
        rw [mul_one,place,form_S]
        apply le_trans (b:=p'.invlen^2*(8*(Dyadic.diam (z-start p' M))^2))
        · rw [div_lt_iff₀ hp] at Hh
          have hh := pow_le_pow_left₀ hs.le Hh.le 2
          nlinarith
        · exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (cost_diam _).1 (sq_nonneg _)) (local_channel_energy H x (block_of_below hv _ hx))
  rw [Ex_lmul,mul_comm] at hi
  apply (le_div_iff₀ (by positivity : 0 < 8*s^2)).mpr
  have HH : C.prob (fun x => ¬ dome p' M s x) =
      C.Ex (fun z => if ¬dome p' M s z then 1 else 0) := by
    refine @prob_as_ex _ _ _ _ (fun z => instDecidableNot)
  rw [show (channel A x) = C from rfl,HH]; exact hi

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.two_envelope
proof:
:= by
  let f := fun b : Bool => if b then B else A
  let v := fun b : Bool => if b then j else i
  have H := envelope Finset.univ f (fun i _ => by cases i; exact hA; exact hB) v (-s)
  simp only [Fintype.prod_bool,Fintype.sum_bool,f,v,Bool.false_eq_true,↓reduceIte,q_even _ _] at H
  rw [add_comm] at H
  have HE := q_compare (add_nonneg hA hB) (le_refl (A+B)) hh s
  apply le_trans ?_ HE
  rw [expU_coeff (fun y => (↑(boltz A (i-y)*boltz B (j-y)):ℂ)) s]
  apply le_trans _ H
  push_cast; simp_rw [mul_comm ((boltz A _):ℂ)]
  exact le_rfl

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.moments_bias
statement:
lemma moments_bias {p : Node} {P : Law (Grid M)} (hl : l ≤ M)
    {B : Bool} {A : Form M} {s : Finset (Grid l)} {v : Grid l → Grid M → ℂ}
    {β : ℝ} (hG : biases P p A hl s B v β) (Q : Law (Grid l)) (hQ : ∀ x, 0 < Q x → x∈s) :
    let U
proof:
:= P.withNext (channel A)
    β ≤ U.Ex (fun xz => if xz.1∈(p.child B).block M then
        (ply hl Q (fun i => v i xz.2) xz.1).re else 0) := by
  intro U
  let D (i : Grid l) (x : Grid M × Grid M) :=
    if x.1∈(p.child B).block M then (v i x.2*chi (raise hl i) x.1).re else 0
  have H (i : Grid l) (hi : 0 < Q i) : β ≤ U.Ex (D i) := by
    unfold U D; rw [conditional_if_ex P (channel A) (fun x => x∈(p.child B).block M)
      (fun x z => (v i z*chi (raise hl i) x).re)]
    exact hG.2 _ (hQ _ hi)
  calc
    _ = Q.Ex (fun _ => β) := (Q.Ex_const _).symm
    _ ≤ Q.Ex (fun i => U.Ex (D i)) := Q.Ex_mono_mem H
    _ = _ := by
      rw [Ex_swap Q U]
      refine congrArg U.Ex (funext fun x => ?_)
      unfold D
      split_ifs with hh
      · rw [ply,re_Cx]
      rw [Ex_const]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.ex_pow_bound
statement:
private lemma ex_pow_bound {α : Type} [Fintype α]
    (P : Law α) (f : α → ℝ) (hf : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x) (T : ℕ) :
    P.Ex f ^ T ≤ P.Ex (fun i => f i ^ T)
proof:
:= by
  have H := (convexOn_pow (𝕜:=ℝ) T).map_sum_le (t:=Finset.univ)
    (p:=f) (w:=fun i => P i) (fun x _ => P.nonneg x) P.total (fun i _ => hf i)
  exact H

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.uniform_level_cost
statement:
lemma uniform_level_cost {p p' : Node} {a : Grid M → ℝ} (hp : p.ok M) (hv : p.below p')
    {n : ℕ} {h err : ℝ} {A A' : Form M} (H : Certified h err n p' A)
    (HH : A+place p M ≤ A')
    {P : Law (Grid M)} (ht : PieceLaw p a P) (hl : l ≤ M) {s : Finset (Grid l)}
    {d : ℝ} (h1 : ∀ x, a x ≤ exp d) (hm : exp (-d) ≤ p.avg a) {B : Bool}
    {v : Grid l → Grid M → ℂ} {β : ℝ} (h0 : 0 < β) (hb : β ≤ 1)
    (HG : biases P p A hl s B v β) (Q : Law (Grid l)) (hQ : ∀ x, 0 < Q x → x∈s) (T : ℕ)
    (hT : 0 < T) :
    levelCost hl A' Q T ≤ 2*d + F A - log p'.invlen + 5000 - log β +
        2*T*(1-log β)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let R := p.invlen
  let R' := p'.invlen
  let E := levelCost hl A' Q T
  let K := place p M
  let fp := F (A+K)
  have hpR : 0 < R := p.invlen_pos
  have hpR' : 0 < R' := p'.invlen_pos
  let L := channel A
  let U := P.withNext L
  let a0 := 1000/β
  have ha : 1 ≤ a0 := (le_div_iff₀ h0).mpr (by linarith)
  let D := dome p' M a0
  have hD : U.prob (fun xz => ¬ D xz.2) ≤ β/2 := by
    unfold prob; dsimp only [U]; rw [Ex_withNext]
    rw [← Ex_const P (β/2)]
    refine Ex_mono_mem _ fun x hx => ?_
    have hH := ch_dome_bound hv H x (piece_support hp ht x hx) a0 (by linarith)
    apply le_trans (show (L x).prob _ ≤ _ from hH)
    unfold a0; field_simp; nlinarith
  let W (x z : Grid M) := ply hl Q (fun i => v i z) x
  have HW (x z : Grid M) : ‖W x z‖≤1 := ply_unit _ _ _ (fun i => HG.1 i z) _
  let f (xz : Grid M × Grid M) := if D xz.2 then ‖W xz.1 xz.2‖ else 0
  have hf (xz) : 0 ≤ f xz := by unfold f; split_ifs <;> positivity
  have he : β/2 ≤ U.Ex f := by
    let V := fun xz : Grid M × Grid M => if ¬ D xz.2 then (1 : ℝ) else 0
    have hG' : β ≤ U.Ex fun xz => f xz+V xz := by
      apply le_trans (moments_bias hl HG Q hQ)
      refine Ex_mono _ fun xz => ?_
      unfold f V
      change (if _ then (W _ _).re else _) ≤ _
      have hh := HW xz.1 xz.2
      have hh' := Complex.abs_re_le_norm (W xz.1 xz.2)
      by_cases hh0 : D xz.2 <;> simp only [hh0,ite_true, ite_false,not_false_eq_true, not_true,add_zero,zero_add] <;>
        split_ifs <;> first | positivity | linarith [(abs_le.mp hh').2]
    have hD' : U.Ex V ≤ β/2 := by
      rw [@prob_as_ex _ _ _ _ (fun z => instDecidableNot)] at hD
      exact hD
    rw [Ex_add] at hG'; linarith
  let N := 2*T
  have he1 : (β/2)^N ≤ U.Ex (fun i => f i ^ N) :=
      (pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) he N).trans (ex_pow_bound _ _ hf _)
  let V (z y : Grid M) := boltz A (z-y)*boltz K (p.start M-y)
  have hV (z) : expU (fun y => V z y * ‖W y z‖^N) ≤ exp (-fp) * exp (-E) := by
    unfold E
    rw [heat_exp]
    exact weighted_envelope T hl A' Q _ (fun x => HG.1 x z) _ _
      (fun s => two_envelope H.nonneg (place_valid _ _) HH _ _ _)
  let c := R*exp (2*d+F A+32)
  have hc : 0 ≤ c := by unfold c; positivity
  let b := side M
  have hbb : 0 < b := side_pos _
  have hpoint (x z : Grid M) : U (x,z) ≤ b*c*b*V z x := by
    have Hx := piece_density ht h1 hm x
    rw [dice_apply hp] at Hx
    have h1 : 0 < V z x := mul_pos (boltz_pos _ _) (boltz_pos _ _)
    by_cases h : x∈p.block M
    · rw [ite_eq_left h,← rinv] at Hx
      have HE := place_internal (start_mem hp.1 hp.2) h
      have hi : 1 ≤ exp 32 * boltz K (p.start M-x) := by
        unfold boltz; rw [← exp_add]
        apply Real.one_le_exp _; unfold K; linarith
      calc
        _ = P x * (b*(exp (F A)*boltz A (z-x))) := by
          unfold U L b
          rw [withNext_apply,ch_K,K_eq,boltz,← exp_add]; congr 4
        _ ≤ (exp (2*d)*(b*R)) * (b*(exp (F A)*boltz A (z-x))) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right Hx (by have := boltz_pos A (z-x); positivity)
        _ ≤ (exp (2*d)*(b*R)) * (b*(exp (F A)*boltz A (z-x))) *
            (exp 32*boltz K (p.start M-x)) :=
          le_mul_of_one_le_right (by have := boltz_pos A (z-x); positivity) hi
        _ = _ := by unfold c V; rw [exp_add,exp_add]; ring
    · rw [ite_eq_right h,mul_zero] at Hx
      unfold U; rw [withNext_apply,Hx.antisymm (P.nonneg _),zero_mul]
      positivity
  have HUB (z : Grid M) : ∑ x : Grid M, U (x,z)*f (x,z)^N ≤
      (if D z then b else 0) * (c*(exp (-fp)*exp (-E))) := by
    split_ifs with HHz
    · calc
        _ ≤ ∑ x : Grid M, b*c*b*V z x*‖W x z‖^N := Finset.sum_le_sum fun x _ => by
          simp only [f,HHz,ite_true]
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hpoint x z) (by positivity)
        _ = b*c*expU (fun x => V z x*‖W x z‖^N) := by
          unfold b expU; simp only [smul_eq_mul,Finset.mul_sum,mul_assoc]
        _ ≤ _ := by
          rw [← mul_assoc b c]; exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hV z) (by positivity)
    · have HH : N ≠ 0 := by unfold N; omega
      simp [f,HHz,HH]
  have HM :
      (β/2)^N ≤ 4*a0/R' * (c*(exp (-fp)*exp (-E))) := calc
    _ ≤ U.Ex (fun i => f i ^ N) := he1
    _ = ∑ z, ∑ x : Grid M, U (x,z)*f (x,z)^N := by unfold Ex; rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type,Finset.sum_comm]
    _ ≤ ∑ z, (if D z then b else 0) * (c*(exp (-fp)*exp (-E))) := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun z _ => HUB z)
    _ = (uniform _).prob D * (c*(exp (-fp)*exp (-E))) := by
      rw [prob_eq]; simp_rw [uniform_side,← Finset.sum_mul]; rfl
    _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (dome_prob p' H.fits a0 ha) (by positivity)
  have hrel : log R - 12 ≤ fp := (F_S_lower _ p.invlen_pos (loc_scale hp.2)).trans
    (F_mono (le_add_of_nonneg_left H.nonneg))
  have hlog := log_le_log (by positivity) HM
  unfold a0 c N at hlog
  rw [show 4*(1000/β)=(4000:ℝ)/β by ring] at hlog
  have hc' : 0 < R * exp (2*d + F A + 32) := by positivity
  rw [log_pow,Real.log_div h0.ne' (by norm_num)] at hlog
  rw [Real.log_mul (by positivity) (by positivity),Real.log_div (by positivity) hpR'.ne',
    Real.log_div (by norm_num) h0.ne', Real.log_mul hc'.ne' (by positivity),
    Real.log_mul hpR.ne' (by positivity),Real.log_mul (by positivity) (by positivity)] at hlog
  push_cast at hlog
  simp_rw [log_exp] at hlog
  change E ≤ 2*d + F A - log R' + 5000-log β+_

  nlinarith [log_le_sub_one_of_pos (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<4000),log_le_sub_one_of_pos (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<2),
    Nat.cast_nonneg (α:=ℝ) T]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.Update.consistent_triangle
statement:
lemma consistent_triangle {A : Form M} (u : Update j M p) (hA : 0 ≤ A) {x : Clutch j M}
    {y z : Grid M} (h : form A (z-y) ≤ cushion j)
    (h' : ∀ i, form A (x.2 i-y) ≤ cushion j)
    (H : ¬ u.quiet x) : u.alarm A z x
proof:
:= by
  unfold quiet at H
  push Not at H
  obtain ⟨i,hi⟩ := H
  refine ⟨i,?_,hi⟩
  unfold consistent
  have he := form_triangle hA (x.2 i-y) (-(z-y))
  rw [form_even _ _,show x.2 i-y+ -(z-y)=x.2 i-z by ring] at he
  linarith [h' i]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.Update.diff_cost
statement:
private lemma diff_cost (u : Update j M p) (hv : ∀ i z, ‖u.v i z‖ ≤ 1) (x z d : Grid M) :
    (‖u.app x z‖- ‖u.app (x+d) z‖)^2 ≤ 2*form u.adjust d
proof:
:= by
  let P := u.V; let r := raise (snap_le (M:=M) j p); let f := fun i => u.v i z
  let c := chi (r u.x) d
  have hn (x : Grid M) : u.app x z = P.Cx (fun i => f i * chi (r i) x) := rfl
  have he (i : Grid (snapGrid j p M)) : c*chi (r (i-u.x)) d = chi (r i) d := by
    unfold c; rw [← chi_add',← map_add]
    congr 2; ring
  let F (i : Grid (snapGrid j p M)) := f i * chi (r i) x * c *
      (1-chi (r (i-u.x)) d)
  have HQ : c*u.app x z-u.app (x+d) z=P.Cx F := by
    simp_rw [hn,← Cx_lmul,Cx,← Finset.sum_sub_distrib,chi_add _ x]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => by
      rw [← he]; unfold F; ring
  have hi (i) : ‖F i‖ ≤ ‖1-chi (r (i-u.x)) d‖ := by
    unfold F c; simp_rw [norm_mul,norm_chi,mul_one]
    exact mul_le_of_le_one_left (by positivity) (hv _ z)
  have H := abs_norm_sub_norm_le (c*u.app x z) (u.app (x+d) z)
  rw [HQ,norm_mul,show ‖c‖=1 from norm_chi _ _,one_mul] at H
  calc
    _ ≤ ‖P.Cx F‖^2 := by
      rw [← sq_abs]
      exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) H _
    _ ≤ _ := sq_Cx_norm P F
    _ ≤ P.Ex fun i => ‖1-chi (r (i-u.x)) d‖^2 := Ex_mono P (fun i => by gcongr; exact hi i)
    _ = _ := by simp_rw [norm_phase_sq, Ex_lmul, adjust,average_form]; rfl

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.Update.quiet_scale
statement:
lemma quiet_scale (C : ℝ) (hC : 1 ≤ C) :
    ∀ᶠ j : ℕ in atTop, ∀ M : ℕ, ∀ p : Node, ∀ P : Law (Grid M),
      ∀ (A : Form M) (u : Update j M p), u.Good C A P → u.regular → ∀ x : Grid M,
        u.take A x → (fresh A (u.next A) j x).prob (quiet u) ≤ 2/H j^40
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [h_large (10^16*reserve C)] with j hh M p P A u hu hr x hx
  let b := beta u.ix; let a := H j; let d := height j; let D := reserve C
  let V := u.next A
  let L := clones j
  have hL : (L:ℝ) = a^120 := clones_eq j
  have hb : 0 < b := beta_pos _
  have hI : 1 ≤ a := H_ge _
  have ha : 0 < a := H_pos _
  have hD : 1 ≤ D := reserve_ge hC
  change 10^16*D ≤ a at hh
  have he : (1/6400)/a^32 ≤ b := (main_bounds _ hu.ix_ok).1
  let T := channel A x
  let G := channel V x

  let bad (i) : Prop := ‖u.app x i‖ < 3*b/8
  have hi : 1/a^33 ≤ 1-T.prob bad := by
    unfold take at hx
    rw [ite_eq_left hr] at hx
    have hu' := hx.trans (Cx_norm T _)
    have hE := lowerTail T (fun x => ¬ bad x) (3*b/8) 1 (fun i => ‖u.app x i‖)
      (fun i _ => by
        have HE : ‖u.app x i‖ ≤ 1 := ply_unit _ _ _ (fun j => hu.unit j _) _
        linarith)
      (fun i hi => (show ‖u.app x i‖ < 3*b/8 from Classical.byContradiction (p:=bad i) hi).le)
    rw [prob_compl] at hE
    apply le_trans (b:=b/8) _ (by change b/2 ≤ _ at hu'; linarith)
    apply le_trans (b:= ((1/6400)/a^32)/8) ?_ (by linarith)
    field_simp
    nlinarith
  have hf : (T.prob bad)^L ≤ 1/a^40 := by
    let t := T.prob bad
    have he' := bernoulli_trial (prob_nonneg T bad) (prob_le_one T bad) L
    rw [hL] at he'
    change a^120*t^L*(1-t) ≤ _ at he'
    have ht : 0 ≤ t^L := pow_nonneg (prob_nonneg _ _) _
    change t^L ≤ _
    have he : a^120*t^L * (1/a^33) ≤ 1 :=
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hi (mul_nonneg (pow_nonneg ha.le 120) ht)).trans he'
    have hZZ : a^40 ≤ a^87 := pow_le_pow_right₀ hI (by omega)
    rw [show a^120*t^L*(1/a^33)=a^87*t^L by
      rw [show a^120=a^87*a^33 by ring]; field_simp] at he
    apply (le_div_iff₀ (by positivity : 0 < a^40)).mpr
    nlinarith

  let other (z : Grid M) := (b/8)^2 ≤ 2*form u.adjust (z-x)
  have hM : G.prob other ≤ 1/a^40 := by
    have hp := upperTail G other (fun z => 2*form u.adjust (z-x)) (fun i =>
      mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (form_nonneg (averageCost_pos _ _ _) _)) ((b/8)^2) (fun i hi => hi)
    rw [Ex_lmul, show G.Ex (fun z => form u.adjust (z-x)) =
      (label V).Ex (form u.adjust) from ch_noise _ _ _] at hp
    have hc := hu.high
    have HE : (b/8)^2*G.prob other ≤ 800*D/a^200 := by
      apply hp.trans
      have HT : 0 < d*a^200 := mul_pos (d_pos j) (pow_pos ha 200)
      apply le_trans (b:=2*(400*u.credit/u.scale)) (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hu.energy (by norm_num))
      calc
        _ ≤ 2*(400*(D*d)/(d*a^200)) := by
          have H₁ : d*a^200 ≤ u.scale := hu.high
          have H₂ : u.credit ≤ D*d := hu.reserves.2
          have hx : 0 < d := d_pos _
          gcongr
        _ = _ := by have hx : 0 < d := d_pos _; field_simp; norm_num
    apply le_of_mul_le_mul_left _ (show 0 < (b/8)^2 by positivity)
    calc
      _ ≤ _ := HE
      _ ≤ (((1/6400)/a^32)/8)^2 * (1/a^40) := by
          have Ht : a ≤ a^96 := by
            have := pow_le_pow_right₀ hI (show 1 ≤ 96 by omega); simpa using this
          field_simp
          nlinarith
      _ ≤ _ := by gcongr
  let Q := fresh A V j x
  have heQ : Q.prob (quiet u) ≤ G.prob other + (T.prob bad)^L := by
    let S : Law (Fin L → Grid M) := pack fun _ => T
    have HH (y z : Grid M) (hy : ¬ other y) (hz : ¬ bad z) : b/4 ≤ ‖u.app y z‖ := by
      have HE := diff_cost u hu.unit x z (y-x)
      rw [show x+(y-x)=y by ring] at HE
      unfold other bad b at *; nlinarith
    calc
      Q.prob (quiet u) ≤ Q.prob (fun xz => other xz.1 ∨ ∀ i, bad (xz.2 i)) :=
        prob_mono Q _ _ fun x hx => by
          by_contra! H
          obtain ⟨i,hi⟩ := H.2
          exact (hx i).not_ge (HH _ _ H.1 hi)
      _ ≤ Q.prob (fun x => other x.1) + Q.prob (fun x => ∀ i, bad (x.2 i)) := Q.prob_union _ _
      _ = _ := by
        rw [← prob_send Q Prod.fst other, ← prob_send Q Prod.snd (fun x => ∀ i, bad (x i))]
        unfold Q fresh
        rw [send_fst_tensorP,send_snd_tensorP]; congr 1
        exact independent T bad L
  change Q.prob _ ≤ 2/a^40
  apply heQ.trans; rw [show 2/a^40=1/a^40+1/a^40 by ring]; linarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.Update.chance_bias
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let T := u.tiltMean A
  have ht (x) : ‖T x‖ ≤ 1 :=
    norm_Cx_unit _ _ (fun y => ply_unit _ _ _ (fun i => hB.1 i y) _)
  have he := moments_bias _ hB u.V hQ
  change beta u.ix ≤ (P.withNext (channel A)).Ex (fun i => if i.1 ∈ (p.child B).block M then (u.app i.1 i.2).re else 0) at he
  rw [conditional_if_ex P (channel A) (fun x => x∈(child p B).block M) (fun x z => (u.app x z).re)] at he
  let b := beta u.ix
  have hU : b ≤ P.Ex (fun x => ‖T x‖) := by
    apply he.trans
    refine Ex_mono _ fun x => ?_
    split_ifs
    · rw [← re_Cx (channel A x) (u.app x)]
      exact (le_abs_self _).trans (Complex.abs_re_le_norm _)
    · positivity
  unfold chances prob
  have hs := P.Ex_mono (f:=fun x => ‖T x‖)
    (g:=fun x => (if u.take A x then 1 else 0)+b/2) (fun x => by
      by_cases H : u.take A x
      · rw [ite_eq_left H]; have hi : 0 ≤ b := (beta_pos _).le
        linarith [ht x]
      · rw [ite_eq_right H,zero_add]
        by_contra! he
        apply H
        unfold take; split
        · exact he.le
        trivial)
  rw [Ex_add,Ex_const] at hs
  change b/2 ≤ _
  linarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.paid_tighten
statement:
lemma paid_tighten (C : ℝ) (hC : 1 ≤ C) :
    ∀ᶠ j : ℕ in atTop, ∀ M : ℕ, ∀ p : Node, ∀ A : Form M, Press C j p A →
        F (tilde (H j) A p)-F (A+place p M) ≤ height j/H j^4
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [stiff_budget C hC] with j hh M p A H1
  obtain ⟨hq,n,q,hp,hG,hN,hF⟩ := H1
  have hp' := H_ge j
  have hd := d_pos j
  have ht : 0 ≤ plateErr j := by unfold plateErr; apply div_nonneg hd.le; exact pow_nonneg (H_pos j).le _
  apply (tilde_tight hG hp' hq).trans
  apply le_trans _ hh; gcongr

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.make_update
statement:
lemma make_update (C : ℝ) (hC : 1 ≤ C) :
    ∀ᶠ j : ℕ in atTop, ∀ M : ℕ, ∀ A : Form M, ∀ p : Node,
      p.lev < M → Press C j p A →
      ∀ (a : Grid M → ℝ), 0 ≤ a → (∀ x, a x ≤ exp (height j)) → exp (-height j) ≤ p.avg a →
      ∀ (P : Law (Grid M)) (α : ℝ), PieceLaw p a P → 0 < α → p.avg a ≤ 2*α →
      ∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ testIx j →
        request A j p a α (side i) (kappa j (codeWeight C) i) →
        ∃ u : Update j M p, u.ix = i ∧ u.Good C A P
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [obtain_compressed C hC, flat_selection (reserve C) (reserve_ge hC),
    paid_tighten C hC,kappa_scales (codeWeight C) (code_ge hC),step_gap C hC]
    with j hC' hflat hT hL h
  intro M A p hp H' a ha he hm P α hP hα hm' i hi hI
  obtain ⟨w,x,B,v,V,t,h0,h1,h2,h3,h4,h5,h6,h7,h8⟩ :=
    hC' M A p hp H' a ha he hm P α hP hα hm' i hi hI
  let d := height j
  let L := long j
  let k := kappa j (codeWeight C) i
  let hZ := H j
  let E := averageCost (snap_le (M:=M) j p) V x
  let S := place p M
  let R := A+S
  let Q := tilde hZ A p
  have Hq : p.ok M := H'.fits
  have HH : 0 ≤ A := by obtain ⟨_,_,_,h,_⟩ := H'.cap; exact h.nonneg
  have HE : 0 ≤ E := averageCost_pos _ _ _
  have Hh : 1 ≤ hZ := H_ge _
  have Hp : 0 < hZ := H_pos _
  have HQ : R ≤ Q := tilde_le Hh HH p
  have hd : 0 < d := d_pos j
  have ht : d/hZ^2 ≤ t := (hL i hi).1.trans h0
  have htp : 0 < t := lt_of_lt_of_le (by positivity) ht
  have hi : F (R+L • E)- F R ≤ 400*t := by
    have hh := F_mono (add_le_add_left HQ (L • E))
    have hi : F Q-F R ≤ d/hZ^4 := hT _ p A H'
    change F (Q+L • E)-F Q ≤ 350*t at h7
    have hE : d/hZ^4 ≤ d/hZ^2 := by gcongr; norm_num
    linarith
  obtain ⟨c,hc,hc',hb,hb',hb''⟩ := hflat M R E
    (add_nonneg HH (place_valid _ _)) HE t h1 hi
  let D := c • E; let N := R+D
  have HC : 0 < c := lt_of_lt_of_le (mul_pos hd (by positivity)) hc
  have HD : 0 ≤ D := smul_nonneg HC.le HE
  have Hstep (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hr' : r ≤ sepRad j/2) :
      gap N (r+stepRad C j) - gap A r ≤ 402*t ∧
        (evenly w V → t=eps*k → gap N (r+stepRad C j)-gap A r ≤ -(k/2)) := by
    obtain ⟨H1,H2⟩ := h M _ (snap_le _ _) p Hq A N HH (le_add_of_nonneg_right HD)
        x V c t r ht h1 hc hb'' hb' hr hr'
    exact ⟨H1,fun hh ht => H2 w k h2 h4 hh h6 ht⟩
  rcases h8 with ⟨Hc,Hv⟩ | HR
  · let u : Update j M p := ⟨i,V,x,v,c,t,false⟩
    refine ⟨u,rfl,?_⟩
    refine ⟨?_,h0,⟨ht,h1⟩,hc,h5.1,HD,hb,hb',hb'',u.chance_bias h3 h5,fun _ => Hc,?_,?_⟩
    · change i ≤ _
      assumption
    · simp [u]
    intro r hr hr'
    exact (Hstep r hr hr').2 Hv Hc
  let u : Update j M p := ⟨i,V,x,v,c,t,true⟩
  refine ⟨u,rfl,?_⟩
  refine ⟨?_,h0,⟨ht,h1⟩,hc,h5.1,HD,hb,hb',hb'',u.chance_bias h3 h5,?_,fun _ => HR,?_⟩
  · change i ≤ _
    assumption
  · simp [u]
  intro r hr hr'; exact (Hstep r hr hr').1

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Weak.offsetMeas
statement:
lemma offsetMeas {S : Set Torus} (h : MeasurableSet S) (z : Torus) :
    MeasurableSet (offsetS S z)
proof: := (measurable_const.add measurable_id) h

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Weak.flow
statement:
lemma flow (z : Torus) :
    MeasurePreserving (fun x => z+x) law law
proof:
:= by
  unfold law circleMeasure
  exact measurePreserving_add_left _ _

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Weak.volume_offset
statement:
lemma volume_offset (S : Set Torus) (h : MeasurableSet S) (z : Torus) :
    law.real (offsetS S z)=law.real S
proof:
:= by
  unfold Measure.real offsetS
  rw [(flow z).measure_preimage h.nullMeasurableSet]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Weak.offset_witness
statement:
lemma offset_witness (S T : Set Torus) (hs : MeasurableSet S) (ht : MeasurableSet T) :
    ∃ z : Torus, law.real (S∩ offsetS T z) ≤ law.real S * law.real T
proof:
:= by
  let U : Set (Torus × Torus) := {p | p.2 ∈ S ∧ p.1+p.2∈T}
  have hU : MeasurableSet U := (measurable_snd hs).inter ((measurable_fst.add measurable_snd) ht)
  let f := U.indicator (fun _ => (1:ℝ))
  have hF : Integrable f (law.prod law) := (integrable_const _).indicator hU
  have H (z : Torus) :
      ∫ x : Torus, f (z,x) ∂law=law.real (S∩offsetS T z) := by
    rw [show (fun x : Torus => f (z,x))=(S∩offsetS T z).indicator (fun x => (1:ℝ)) from rfl,
      integral_indicator (hs.inter (offsetMeas ht z))]
    simp
  have he (x : Torus) :
      ∫ z : Torus, f (z,x) ∂law=S.indicator (fun x => law.real T) x := by
    by_cases hh : x∈S
    · rw [show (fun z : Torus => f (z,x)) = (offsetS T x).indicator (fun _ => (1:ℝ)) from by
        funext z; unfold offsetS f U; by_cases hi : z+x∈T <;> simp [hh,hi,add_comm x z],
        indicator_of_mem hh,integral_indicator (offsetMeas ht x)]
      simp [volume_offset T ht]
    rw [show (fun z : Torus => f (z,x))=(fun _ => 0) from by funext z; simp [f,U,hh],
      indicator_of_notMem hh]; simp
  have HV : ∫ z, (∫ x, f (z,x) ∂law) ∂law = law.real S*law.real T := by
    rw [integral_integral_swap (f:=fun i j => f (i,j)) hF, funext he, integral_indicator hs]
    simp
  obtain ⟨v,hv⟩ := exists_le_integral hF.integral_prod_left
  exact ⟨v,(H v) ▸ HV ▸ hv⟩

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Weak.spread_meas
statement:
lemma spread_meas (S : Set Torus) {n : ℕ} (f : Fin n → Torus) (hS : MeasurableSet S) :
    MeasurableSet (spread S f)
proof:
:= by
  have h : spread S f= ⋃ i : Fin n,offsetS S (f i) := by ext x; simp [spread]
  rw [h]; exact MeasurableSet.iUnion fun i => offsetMeas hS _

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Weak.multiply_cloud
statement:
lemma multiply_cloud (S : Set Torus) (h : MeasurableSet S) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ z : Fin n → Torus, law.real (spread S z)ᶜ ≤ (law.real Sᶜ)^n
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    refine ⟨fun i => i.elim0,?_⟩
    rw [pow_zero]; exact measureReal_le_one
  | succ n ih =>
    obtain ⟨z,hz⟩ := ih
    obtain ⟨q,hq⟩ := offset_witness _ _ (spread_meas S z h).compl h.compl
    refine ⟨Fin.cons q z,?_⟩
    have HH : (spread S (Fin.cons q z))ᶜ=(spread S z)ᶜ ∩ offsetS Sᶜ q := by
      ext x
      have HI : x ∈ spread S (Fin.cons q z) ↔ x∈offsetS S q ∨ x∈spread S z := by
        constructor
        · rintro ⟨i,hi⟩
          refine Fin.cases ?_ ?_ i hi
          · intro H; exact Or.inl (by simpa using H)
          intro j h; right; exact ⟨j,by simpa using h⟩
        rintro (hh|⟨i,hi⟩)
        · exact ⟨0,by simpa using hh⟩
        exact ⟨i.succ,by simpa using hi⟩
      change x∉spread S (Fin.cons q z) ↔ x∉spread S z ∧ x∉offsetS S q
      rw [HI]; tauto
    rw [HH]; apply hq.trans
    rw [pow_succ]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hz measureReal_nonneg

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Weak.clouds_fill
statement:
lemma clouds_fill (S : Set Torus) (h : MeasurableSet S) (hp : 0 < law.real S) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ), 0 < n ∧ ∃ f : Fin n → Torus, 1/2 ≤ law.real (spread S f) ∧
      (n:ℝ)*law.real S ≤ 4
proof:
:= by
  let δ := law.real S
  let n : ℕ := Nat.floor (1/δ)+1
  have he : δ ≤ 1 := measureReal_le_one
  have hq : law.real Sᶜ = 1-δ := by rw [measureReal_compl h,probReal_univ]
  obtain ⟨z,hz⟩ := multiply_cloud S h n
  have HA : 1 ≤ (n:ℝ)*δ := by
    have he' := Nat.lt_floor_add_one (1/δ)
    unfold n; push_cast
    exact ((div_lt_iff₀ hp).mp he').le
  refine ⟨n,by unfold n; omega,z,?_,?_⟩
  · have H (n : ℕ) : (1+(n:ℝ)*δ)*(1-δ)^n ≤ 1 := by
      have hl : 0 ≤ 1-δ := by linarith
      induction n with
      | zero => norm_num
      | succ n ih =>
        rw [pow_succ]; push_cast
        have HE : (1+((n:ℝ)+1)*δ)*(1-δ) ≤ (1+(n:ℝ)*δ) := by
          nlinarith [Nat.cast_nonneg (α:=ℝ) n,mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg (α:=ℝ) n) (sq_nonneg δ)]
        nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right HE (pow_nonneg hl n)]
    rw [measureReal_compl (spread_meas S z h),probReal_univ, hq] at hz
    nlinarith [H n, pow_nonneg (show 0 ≤ 1-δ by linarith) n]
  · have he' := Nat.floor_le (show 0 ≤ 1/δ by unfold δ; positivity)
    change (n:ℝ)*δ ≤ 4
    have hd : 0 < δ := hp
    unfold n; push_cast
    nlinarith [div_mul_cancel₀ 1 hd.ne',mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right he' hd.le]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Weak.young_renorm
statement:
lemma young_renorm (f : Torus → ℂ) (b : ℝ) (hh : 0 < b) :
    Young (renorm f b)=fun x => priceΦ (‖f x‖/b)
proof:
:= by
  funext x; unfold Young renorm
  rw [norm_mul,Complex.norm_real,Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_pos (inv_pos.2 hh),←div_eq_inv_mul]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Weak.bill_renorm
statement:
lemma bill_renorm (f : Torus → ℂ) (b : ℝ) (hh : 0 < b) :
    modBill (renorm f b) 1= modBill f b
proof:
:= by
  rw [mod_unit,show (fun x => Young (renorm f b) x)=_ from young_renorm _ _ hh]; rfl

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Weak.lux_exists
statement: lemma lux_exists {f : Torus → ℂ} (h : MemLLogL f) : (luxSet f).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  let T := modBill f 1; let b := max T 1
  have hb : 1 ≤ b := le_max_right _ _
  have hh : 0 < b := by linarith
  refine ⟨b, hh,?_⟩
  let g := renorm f b
  have HG : Integrable (Young g) law := (mem_dilate _ h).2
  rw [← bill_renorm f b hh,mod_unit]
  apply le_trans (b:=∫ x,b⁻¹*Young f x ∂law)
  · apply integral_mono HG ((show Integrable (Young f) law from h.2).const_mul _)
    rw [← show (fun x => Young (renorm f b) x)=Young g from rfl]
    intro x
    change Young (renorm f b) x ≤ _
    rw [young_renorm _ _ hh]
    let t := ‖f x‖
    have HT : 0 ≤ t := norm_nonneg _
    have hv : t/b ≤ t := div_le_self HT hb
    change (t/b)*log (2+t/b) ≤ b⁻¹*(t*log (2+t))
    rw [← mul_assoc,← div_eq_inv_mul]
    apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (by positivity)
    apply log_le_log (by positivity); linarith
  · rw [integral_const_mul]
    rw [show (∫ x, Young f x ∂law) = T from (mod_unit f).symm,←div_eq_inv_mul]
    exact (div_le_one hh).mpr (le_max_left _ _)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Weak.consequence_maximal
statement:
lemma consequence_maximal (h : GoodBound) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ (f : Torus → ℂ), MemLLogL f →
      ∀ w : ℝ, 0 < w →
        w*circleMeasure.real (cloudSet f w) ≤ C*luxNorm f
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨C,hc,hF⟩ := circle_bill h
  refine ⟨C,hc,?_⟩
  intro f hf w hw
  let m := law.real (cloudSet f w)
  have H (b : ℝ) (hb : b∈luxSet f) :
      w*m ≤ C*b := by
    obtain ⟨hh,ht⟩ := hb
    let g := renorm f b
    have HE : inside g := ⟨mem_dilate _ hf,(bill_renorm f b hh).le.trans ht⟩
    have HP : cloudSet g (w/b)=cloudSet f w := by
      ext x
      rw [cloudy _ (by positivity) x,cloudy _ hw.le x]
      have Hz (i : ℕ) : ‖symmetricPartialSum g i x‖=‖symmetricPartialSum f i x‖/b := by
        unfold g renorm
        rw [symmetricPartialSum_const_mul,norm_mul, Complex.norm_real,Real.norm_eq_abs,
          abs_of_pos (inv_pos.2 hh),← div_eq_inv_mul]
      simp_rw [Hz,div_lt_div_iff_of_pos_right hh]
    have HI := hF g HE (w/b) (div_pos hw hh)
    rw [HP,div_mul_eq_mul_div] at HI
    exact (div_le_iff₀ hh).1 HI
  have HV : w*m/C ≤ sInf (luxSet f) :=
    le_csInf (lux_exists hf) fun b hb => (div_le_iff₀ hc).mpr ((H b hb).trans (le_of_eq (mul_comm C b)))
  change w*m ≤ C*sInf (luxSet f)
  rw [mul_comm C]; exact (div_le_iff₀ hc).1 HV

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Weak.feeSummed
statement:
lemma feeSummed (h : inside f) :
    (∑' j : ℕ,(2:ℝ)^(j+1)*heightLayerMass f j) ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  let g := Young f
  let A := heightLayerSet f
  have hF : Integrable g circleMeasure := h.1.2
  have HD := hasSum_integral_iUnion_ae (heightLayerSet_nullMeasurable h.1)
      ((heightLayerSet_pairwise_disjoint f).mono (fun _ _ h ↦ h.aedisjoint))
      (show IntegrableOn g _ _ from hF.integrableOn)
  have hi (j : ℕ) : (2:ℝ)^(j+1)*heightLayerMass f j ≤ ∫ x in A j,g x ∂circleMeasure := by
    rw [heightLayerMass, ← integral_const_mul]
    apply integral_mono_ae (h.1.integrable.norm.integrableOn.const_mul _) hF.integrableOn
    filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem₀ (heightLayerSet_nullMeasurable h.1 j)] with x hx
    have hlog : (2:ℝ)^(j+1) ≤ Real.log (2+‖f x‖) := le_trans
      (Real.log_exp ((2:ℝ)^(j+1))).symm.le
      (Real.log_le_log (Real.exp_pos _) (hx.1.trans (by linarith)))
    unfold g Young priceΦ; nlinarith [norm_nonneg (f x)]
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑' j,∫ x in A j,g x ∂circleMeasure := h.1.summable_weighted_heightLayerMass.tsum_le_tsum hi HD.summable
    _ = ∫ x in ⋃ i, A i,g x ∂circleMeasure := HD.tsum_eq
    _ ≤ ∫ x,g x ∂circleMeasure := by
      conv_rhs => rw [← setIntegral_univ]
      apply setIntegral_mono_set hF.integrableOn (ae_of_all _ fun x => p_nonneg _ (norm_nonneg _))
        (subset_univ _).eventuallyLE
    _ ≤ 1 := mod_unit f ▸ h.2

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Weak.grit_pos
statement: lemma grit_pos (j : ℕ) : 0 < grit j
proof: := by unfold grit; positivity

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Weak.grits
statement: lemma grits : Summable (fun j => (2:ℝ)^(j+1) * grit j)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [grit,pow_succ]
  apply Summable.congr ( (summable_geometric_of_norm_lt_one (by norm_num : ‖(2:ℝ)*(1/4)‖ < 1)).mul_right 2)
  intro n; rw [mul_pow]; ring

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Weak.grit_height
statement:
private lemma grit_height (j : ℕ) :
    Real.exp ((2:ℝ)^(j+2)) ≤ grit j * Real.exp ((2:ℝ)^(j+4))
proof:
:= by
  have hj : (j:ℝ) ≤ (2:ℝ)^j := by exact_mod_cast (Nat.lt_two_pow_self (n:=j)).le
  have hex : (4:ℝ)^j ≤ Real.exp ((3:ℝ) * j) := by
    have h3 := Real.add_one_le_exp 3
    rw [mul_comm 3, Real.exp_nat_mul]
    exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (by norm_num) (by norm_num at h3; linarith) _
  have Hmul : (4:ℝ)^j * Real.exp ((2:ℝ)^(j+2)) ≤ Real.exp ((2:ℝ)^(j+4)) := by
    refine (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hex (Real.exp_nonneg _)).trans ?_
    rw [← Real.exp_add]
    apply Real.exp_monotone
    simp only [pow_add]
    linarith
  simp only [grit, one_div, inv_pow, ← div_eq_inv_mul]
  apply (le_div_iff₀ (by positivity : (0:ℝ)<4^j)).mpr
  rw [mul_comm]
  exact Hmul

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Weak.taxpayer
statement:
lemma taxpayer (h : inside f) (j : ℕ) :
    let w
proof:
:= allowance f j; let F := piece f j
    0<w ∧ Integrable F circleMeasure ∧ (∫ x,‖F x‖ ∂circleMeasure) ≤ w ∧
      ∀ x, ‖F x‖ ≤ w*exp ((2:ℝ)^(j+4)) := by
  intro w F
  cases j with
  | zero =>
    have hi := h.1.boundedPart_integrable
    refine ⟨exp_pos _,hi,?_,fun x => (norm_boundedPart_le _ _).trans ?_⟩
    · apply le_trans (integral_mono hi.norm (integrable_const (μ:=circleMeasure) w)
        (norm_boundedPart_le _)) (by simp)
    · exact le_mul_of_one_le_right (exp_pos 2).le (one_le_exp (by positivity))
  | succ j =>
    have Hi := heightLayerMass_nonneg f j
    have he : grit j ≤ w := le_add_of_nonneg_left Hi
    refine ⟨lt_of_lt_of_le (grit_pos j) he,h.1.heightLayer_integrable _,?_,?_⟩
    · rw [show F=heightLayer f j from rfl]
      rw [← heightLayerMass_eq_integral_norm h.1]
      exact le_add_of_nonneg_right (grit_pos j).le
    intro x
    apply le_trans (le_trans (norm_heightLayer_le f j x) (grit_height j))
    apply mul_le_mul he (exp_monotone ?_) (exp_pos _).le (le_trans (grit_pos j).le he)
    exact pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num) (by omega)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Weak.toll_bound
statement:
lemma toll_bound (h : inside f) :
    let a (j : ℕ)
proof:
:= (2:ℝ)^j*allowance f j
    Summable a ∧ ∑' j,a j ≤ tollMax := by
  intro a
  let F (j : ℕ) := (2:ℝ)^(j+1)*heightLayerMass f j; let w (j : ℕ) := (2:ℝ)^(j+1)*grit j
  have hF : Summable F := h.1.summable_weighted_heightLayerMass
  have HX : (fun j => a (j+1))=fun j => F j+w j := by funext j; unfold a w F; rw [allowance,mul_add]
  have HT : Summable a := (summable_nat_add_iff 1).mp (HX ▸ (hF.add grits))
  refine ⟨HT,?_⟩
  rw [← HT.sum_add_tsum_nat_add 1,HX]
  rw [hF.tsum_add grits]
  have HE : ∑' i,F i ≤ 1 := feeSummed h
  simp only [Finset.sum_range_one]
  have hi : a 0=exp 2 := by simp [a,allowance]
  rw [hi]
  unfold tollMax; linarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Weak.paid_transform
statement:
lemma paid_transform (h : inside f) (x : Torus) (n : ℕ) :
    ENNReal.ofReal ‖symmetricPartialSum f n x‖ ≤ ∑' i, symmetricMaximal (piece f i) x
proof:
:= by
  let F (i : ℕ) := symmetricPartialSum (piece f i) n x
  let t (i : ℕ) := ‖F i‖
  have HE (i) : t (i+1) ≤ (2*n+1:ℕ)*(∫ x, ‖heightLayer f i x‖ ∂circleMeasure) :=
    norm_symmetricPartialSum_le _ n x
  have Hs : Summable t := (summable_nat_add_iff 1).mp
    ((h.1.summable_heightLayer_norm.mul_left ((2*n+1:ℕ):ℝ)).of_nonneg_of_le
      (fun n => norm_nonneg _) HE)
  have HH := h.1.symmetricPartialSum_heightDecomposition n x
  have H : symmetricPartialSum f n x=∑' j,F j := by
    rw [← (Hs.of_norm).sum_add_tsum_nat_add 1,Finset.sum_range_one]; exact HH
  rw [H]
  calc
    _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (∑' i,t i) := ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (norm_tsum_le_tsum_norm Hs)
    _ = _ := ENNReal.ofReal_tsum_of_nonneg (fun i => norm_nonneg (F i)) Hs
    _ ≤ ∑' i,symmetricMaximal (piece f i) x :=
      ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum fun i => le_iSup (fun n=> ENNReal.ofReal ‖symmetricPartialSum (piece f i) n x‖) n

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Weak.p_nonneg
statement: lemma p_nonneg (x : ℝ) (hx : 0 ≤ x) : 0 ≤ priceΦ x
proof:
:=
    mul_nonneg hx (log_nonneg (by linarith))

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Weak.p_zero
statement: lemma p_zero : priceΦ 0=0
proof: := by simp [priceΦ]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Weak.p_mono
statement:
lemma p_mono {x y : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) (he : x ≤ y) :
    priceΦ x ≤ priceΦ y
proof:
:= mul_le_mul he (log_le_log (by linarith) (by linarith))
      (log_nonneg (by linarith)) (hx.trans he)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Weak.p_support
statement:
private lemma p_support (x y : ℝ) (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hy : 0 ≤ y) :
    priceΦ y+slopeΦ y*(x-y) ≤ priceΦ x
proof:
:= by
  let a := 2+x; let b := 2+y
  have ha : 0 < a := by unfold a; linarith
  have hb : 0 < b := by unfold b; linarith
  have H : (a-b)/a ≤ log a-log b := by
    have hi := log_le_sub_one_of_pos (div_pos hb ha)
    rw [log_div hb.ne' ha.ne'] at hi
    rw [sub_div,div_self ha.ne']; linarith
  have HH : y/b*(x-y) ≤ x*((a-b)/a) := by
    have HE : 0 ≤ 2*(x-y)^2/(a*b) := by positivity
    have HV : x*((a-b)/a)-y/b*(x-y)=2*(x-y)^2/(a*b) := by
      field_simp; unfold a b; ring
    linarith
  change y*log b + (log b + y/b)*(x-y) ≤ x*log a
  nlinarith

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Weak.price_convex
statement:
lemma price_convex {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι] (f : ι → ℂ) :
    let a : ℝ
proof:
:= Fintype.card ι
    priceΦ ‖(a⁻¹:ℝ) • (∑ i, f i)‖ ≤ a⁻¹ * ∑ i,priceΦ ‖f i‖ := by
  intro a
  have ha : 0 < a := by unfold a; positivity
  let k := (∑ i, ‖f i‖)/a
  have hk : 0 ≤ k := by unfold k; positivity
  apply le_trans (b:=priceΦ k) (p_mono (norm_nonneg _) ?_)
  · rw [←div_eq_inv_mul]
    apply (le_div_iff₀ ha).mpr
    have HH : ∑ i : ι,(priceΦ k+slopeΦ k*(‖f i‖-k)) ≤ _ :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum fun (i : ι) (_ : i∈Finset.univ) => p_support ‖f i‖ k (norm_nonneg _) hk
    rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib,← Finset.mul_sum,Finset.sum_sub_distrib] at HH
    simp only [Finset.sum_const,nsmul_eq_mul,Finset.card_univ] at HH
    have H : ∑ i : ι,‖f i‖ = a*k := by unfold k; field_simp
    change a*priceΦ k+_ * (_-a*k) ≤ _ at HH
    rw [H] at HH; linarith
  rw [norm_smul,Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr ha.le)]
  apply (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (norm_sum_le _ _) (inv_nonneg.mpr ha.le)).trans
  exact (div_eq_inv_mul _ _).ge

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Weak.scale_admit
statement:
lemma scale_admit (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) :
    ∃ c : ℝ, 0 ≤ c ∧ ∀ x, 0 ≤ x → priceΦ (a*x) ≤ c*priceΦ x
proof:
:= by
  rcases le_total a 1 with h|h
  · refine ⟨1,by norm_num,fun x hx => ?_⟩; rw [one_mul]
    apply p_mono (mul_nonneg ha hx); nlinarith
  · refine ⟨a*(1+2*log a),by have := log_nonneg h; positivity,fun x hx => ?_⟩
    have HH : log (2+a*x) ≤ log a+log (2+x) := by
      rw [← log_mul (by positivity) (by positivity)]
      apply log_le_log (by positivity); nlinarith
    have hi : 1/2 ≤ log (2+x) :=
      le_trans (by linarith [Real.log_two_gt_d9]) (log_le_log (by norm_num : 0 < (2:ℝ)) (by linarith))
    have HR : log a ≤ 2*log a * log (2+x) := by nlinarith [log_nonneg h]
    unfold priceΦ; nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_trans HH (add_le_add_left HR _))
      (mul_nonneg ha hx)]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Weak.young_meas
statement:
lemma young_meas {f : Torus → ℂ} (h : AEStronglyMeasurable f circleMeasure) :
    AEStronglyMeasurable (Young f) circleMeasure
proof:
:= by
  have hp := h.norm
  unfold Young priceΦ
  exact hp.mul ((aemeasurable_const.add hp.aemeasurable).log).aestronglyMeasurable

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Weak.mem_dilate
statement:
lemma mem_dilate (c : ℂ) {f : Torus → ℂ} (hp : MemLLogL f) :
    MemLLogL (fun x => c*f x)
proof:
:= by
  let g (x : Torus) := c*f x
  have hi : AEStronglyMeasurable g circleMeasure := hp.1.const_mul _
  obtain ⟨v,hv,ht⟩ := scale_admit ‖c‖ (norm_nonneg _)
  refine ⟨hi,?_⟩
  change Integrable (Young g) circleMeasure
  apply ((show Integrable (Young f) _ from hp.2).const_mul v).mono' (young_meas hi)
  apply ae_of_all
  intro x
  change ‖Young g x‖ ≤ _
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_nonneg (show 0 ≤ Young g x from p_nonneg _ (norm_nonneg _))]
  unfold Young g; rw [norm_mul]; apply ht; exact norm_nonneg _

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Weak.mod_unit
statement:
lemma mod_unit (f : Torus → ℂ) :
    modBill f 1 = ∫ x, Young f x ∂circleMeasure
proof: := by simp only [modBill,div_one]; rfl

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Weak.sum_inside
statement:
lemma sum_inside {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι]
    (f : ι → Torus → ℂ) (h : ∀ i, inside (f i)) :
    let a : ℝ
proof:
:= Fintype.card ι
    inside (fun x => a⁻¹ • ∑ i, f i x) := by
  intro a
  let g (x : Torus) : ℂ := a⁻¹ • ∑ i, f i x
  let F (x : Torus) := a⁻¹ * ∑ i, Young (f i) x
  have ha : 0 < a := by unfold a; positivity
  have he (i) : Integrable (Young (f i)) circleMeasure := (h i).1.2
  have HH : AEStronglyMeasurable g circleMeasure := by
    unfold g
    have HH := Finset.aestronglyMeasurable_fun_sum Finset.univ (fun (i:ι) _ => (h i).1.1)
    exact HH.const_smul (a⁻¹)
  have HI : Integrable F circleMeasure := (integrable_finsetSum _ fun i _ => he i).const_mul _
  have HX (x : Torus) : Young g x ≤ F x := price_convex fun i => f i x
  have HV : Integrable (Young g) circleMeasure :=
    HI.mono' (young_meas HH) (ae_of_all _ fun x => by
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_nonneg (show 0 ≤ Young g x from p_nonneg _ (norm_nonneg _))]
      exact HX x)
  refine ⟨⟨HH,HV⟩,?_⟩
  rw [mod_unit]
  apply (integral_mono HV HI HX).trans
  unfold F; rw [integral_const_mul,integral_finsetSum _ (fun i _ => he i)]
  rw [←div_eq_inv_mul]
  apply (div_le_one ha).mpr
  have Hz (i) : ∫ x,Young (f i) x ∂circleMeasure ≤ 1 := by rw [←mod_unit]; exact (h i).2
  exact le_trans (Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => Hz i)) (by simp [a])

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Weak.cloud_meas
statement: lemma cloud_meas (f : Torus → ℂ) (s : ℝ) : MeasurableSet (cloudSet f s)
proof:
:=
    measurableSet_lt measurable_const (measurable_symmetricMaximal f)

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Weak.cloudy
statement:
lemma cloudy (f : Torus → ℂ) {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 ≤ s) (x : Torus) :
    x ∈ cloudSet f s ↔ ∃ N, s < ‖symmetricPartialSum f N x‖
proof:
:= by
  change _ < ⨆ N, ENNReal.ofReal ‖symmetricPartialSum f N x‖ ↔ _
  rw [lt_iSup_iff]
  simp only [ENNReal.ofReal_lt_ofReal_iff_of_nonneg hs]

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Weak.good_law
statement:
private lemma good_law (h : GoodBound) :
    ∃ (d : ℝ), 0 ≤ d ∧ ∃ (L : ℕ), 4 ≤ L ∧
    (∑' (n : ℕ), ENNReal.ofReal (d/((n+L:ℕ)+1:ℝ)^2)) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (1/32:ℝ) ∧
    ∀ (f : Torus → ℂ), inside f → ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ G : Set Torus, MeasurableSet G ∧
      circleMeasure Gᶜ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (d / ((n+L:ℕ)+1:ℝ)^2) ∧
      (∫⁻ x in G, symmetricMaximal (piece f n) x ∂circleMeasure) ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal (allowance f n * (d * (2:ℝ)^(n+L)))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨d,hd,h⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨N,hN⟩ := eventually_atTop.1 h
  let p (i : ℕ) := d/ ((i+1:ℝ)^2)
  have he : Summable p := by
    have hh : Summable (fun i : ℕ => 1 / ((i+1:ℕ):ℝ)^2) :=
      (summable_nat_add_iff 1).mpr (Real.summable_one_div_nat_pow.mpr (by norm_num))
    simpa [p,div_eq_mul_inv] using hh.mul_left d
  let P i := ENNReal.ofReal (p i)
  have hP (i : ℕ) : 0 ≤ p i := by unfold p; positivity
  have hp : (∑' i,P i) ≠ ∞ := by unfold P; rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_tsum_of_nonneg hP he]; exact ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top
  have HR := (ENNReal.tendsto_sum_nat_add P hp).eventually
    (gt_mem_nhds (show (0:ℝ≥0∞) < ENNReal.ofReal (1/32:ℝ) by positivity))
  obtain ⟨L,hH,hL⟩ := (HR.and (eventually_ge_atTop (N+4))).exists
  refine ⟨d, hd,L,by omega,hH.le,?_⟩
  intro f hh n
  let a := allowance f n; let q := piece f n; let k := n+L
  obtain ⟨ha,hq,hc,hG⟩ := taxpayer hh n
  change 0<a at ha
  let g (x : Torus) := ((a⁻¹:ℝ):ℂ)*q x
  have hv (x : Torus) : ‖g x‖ = a⁻¹ * ‖q x‖ := by simp only [g,norm_mul,Complex.norm_real,Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_pos (inv_pos.2 ha)]
  have hs : ∫ x, ‖g x‖ ∂circleMeasure ≤ 1 := by
    simp_rw [hv]
    rw [integral_const_mul,← div_eq_inv_mul]; exact (div_le_one ha).mpr hc
  have ht : ∀ᵐ x ∂circleMeasure, ‖g x‖ ≤ exp ((2:ℝ)^k) := ae_of_all _ fun x => by
    rw [hv,←div_eq_inv_mul]
    apply (div_le_iff₀ ha).mpr
    rw [mul_comm]
    apply (hG x).trans; unfold k; apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ ha.le; apply exp_monotone; apply pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num); omega
  obtain ⟨G,hM,hz,hT⟩ := hN k (by unfold k; omega) g (hq.const_mul _) hs ht
  refine ⟨G,hM,hz,?_⟩
  have H : piece f n = (fun x => (a:ℂ)*g x) := by
    funext x; unfold g q; rw [←mul_assoc,←Complex.ofReal_mul,mul_inv_cancel₀ ha.ne',
      Complex.ofReal_one,one_mul]
  rw [H]
  simp_rw [symmetricMaximal_mul,Complex.norm_real,Real.norm_eq_abs]
  rw [abs_of_pos ha,lintegral_const_mul _ (measurable_symmetricMaximal g),
    ENNReal.ofReal_mul ha.le]
  exact mul_le_mul_right hT _

name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Weak.median_budget
statement:
lemma median_budget (hp : GoodBound) :
    ∃ L : ℝ, 0 < L ∧ ∀ (f : Torus → ℂ), inside f → circleMeasure.real (cloudSet f L) ≤ 1/16
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨d,hd,n,hn,hh,h⟩ := good_law hp
  let k := d*(2:ℝ)^n
  let T := k*tollMax
  have hK : 0 ≤ k := by unfold k; positivity
  have hT : 0 ≤ T := mul_nonneg hK (by
    unfold tollMax
    have H : (0:ℝ) ≤ ∑' i, (2:ℝ)^(i+1)*grit i :=
      tsum_nonneg fun _ => mul_nonneg (by positivity) (grit_pos _).le
    linarith [exp_pos 2])
  let L := 32*(T+1)
  have hL : 0 < L := by unfold L; linarith
  refine ⟨L,hL,?_⟩
  intro f hf
  choose G hG hx hM using h f hf
  let g (j : ℕ) := (G j).indicator (symmetricMaximal (piece f j))
  let E := ⋂ j, G j
